name: AHENK Piano
description:
AHENK is a sampled piano that stands on a stage. Choose the piano, put the microphones where they stood when it was recorded, pick the hall, and play: on the keys of the screen, from a MIDI keyboard, or inside your music app as an AUv3 instrument.

PIANOS FROM REAL RECORDINGS
- A 274 cm concert grand with its lid fully open
- A 200 cm studio grand
- A felt-damped upright
- A short baby grand
Every note is recorded at many strengths. The pianos come down inside the app the first time you want them, and are matched in loudness, so switching pianos does not jump in level.

MICROPHONES WHERE THEY STOOD
Nine microphone positions stand around the piano, from over the strings to a dummy head out in the hall. Tap one in the MIC RACK and it walks to its place. Each microphone has its own level, character, room and its own reverb, delay and echo sends.

HALLS
Play in the recorded room, a recital room, a theatre, a concert hall, a stone church or a live room. The picture and the sound change together, even while you play.

A SCORE PAGE
Open a MusicXML or MIDI file and the piano on stage plays it through your microphones and your hall. Loop a passage, slow it down, solo a hand, or write your own notes and save them as MusicXML or MIDI.

STAGE SETUPS
Factory setups put the piano, the microphones, the hall and the effects in place with one tap. Save your own.

FREE TO PLAY, ONE PURCHASE TO OPEN EVERYTHING
The upright with two microphones in the recorded room plays free, with no account and no time limit. One In-App Purchase opens every piano, microphone, hall, setup and the score page, on iPhone, on iPad and in the AUv3 instrument.
If you already own AHENK for Mac or Windows from subverselab.com, sign in with your SubverseLab account and it opens here too.

AHENK needs an internet connection to download its pianos (the upright and the stage pictures come down at the first start, about 250 MB; the other pianos from about 200 MB to 1.4 GB each). After that it plays offline.

name: Antenna Cutbook
description:
Keep the cut sheet with the measurements.
Prepare your wire, label each element,
and return to a clear record of the build.

Antenna Cutbook is an offline workbench
for half-wave dipoles and quarter-wave radiators.
Calculate starting dimensions, save physical cut plans,
and record measured-resonance adjustments.

Useful when preparing a wire build, comparing a new target,
or taking a printable plan to the workbench.
Keep radiating length, connection allowance
and measured element length clearly separate.

Key Features (Included)
• Half-wave dipole and quarter-wave radiator estimates
• Target frequency with metric or imperial dimensions
• Separate radiating length and connection allowance per element
• Physical cut lengths and total wire to prepare
• Saved builds with names, wire and site notes
• Search, edit and duplicate saved cut plans
• Measured resonance and actual element-length journal
• Proportional adjustment suggestions that preserve the cut plan
• Printable PDF cut sheets, individual labels and paginated journals
• Text summaries and validated JSON backup export and merge import

Purchase
• All included features are available with the paid app download.
• No subscription or additional in-app purchase.
• Check the local App Store price before purchase.

Privacy
• Calculations, builds and measurements stay on your device.
• No account, advertising, analytics or automatic uploads.
• Import and sharing use only the files and destinations you choose.
• Apple device backups may include local app data under your settings.

Device Support
• Designed for iPhone and iPad, with iOS 17 or iPadOS 17 or later.
• English interface.
• No automatic live sync. Use JSON backups to move your records.

[Get Started]

1. In Workbench, choose an antenna type and enter your frequency.
2. Set units and connection allowance, then save a named build.
3. Open it in Builds to log measurements or preview the PDF.
4. Use Help & backups to export or merge a JSON backup.

Notes
Dimensions are starting estimates, not analyzer measurements.
Conventional formulas use 468/f MHz feet for total dipole length
or 234/f feet for one quarter-wave radiator.
Material, geometry and surroundings affect real results.

Connection allowance is extra physical wire, not radiating length.
Adjustment suggestions do not overwrite your original cut plan.
The app does not measure or predict SWR, impedance, gain
or installation performance. Ground systems, matching
and radio licensing are outside these calculations.
Verify actual dimensions and measurements before cutting.

- Contact: help@paran.app
- Support: https://paran.app/antenna-cutbook/support/
- Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
- Privacy Policy: https://paran.app/antenna-cutbook/privacy/

name: Asystent Kuriera
description:
Asystent Kuriera liczy, czy zlecenie się opłaca - zanim je przyjmiesz.

Wystarczy zrzut ekranu oferty. Aplikacja odczytuje go na telefonie (Apple Vision), wysyła do analizy tylko rozpoznany tekst i pokazuje wynik: zł/km, zł/h, czas, dystans, a jeśli chcesz - także stawki po podatku. Obraz nigdy nie opuszcza telefonu.

Jeszcze szybciej: Skrót iOS. Jedno tapnięcie (Back Tap, przycisk Action, widżet na ekranie blokady) robi zrzut, analizuje go i pokazuje werdykt w powiadomieniu. Bez klucza API w skrócie - analiza idzie z Twojego konta, więc nic nie da się z niego wyciągnąć.

DZIENNIK ZAROBKÓW

- Dzień, tydzień, miesiąc i rok: brutto, netto po podatku, zł/km, zł/h.
- Napiwki rozdzielone na gotówkę (w całości) i napiwki z aplikacji (po prowizji platformy).
- Paliwo z dystansu (l/100 km i cena) albo z kwoty; auto elektryczne liczy prąd (kWh/100 km i zł/kWh).
- Kilometry bez zleceń: podaj łączny przebieg dnia, resztę policzy aplikacja.
- Dodatki za lokal: reguła „nazwa lokalu → kwota” dolicza się sama do każdego pasującego zlecenia.
- Cele dnia i podatek - zmiany zapisują się od razu i wracają na każdym telefonie.

ZMIANA I CZAS PRACY

- Start i koniec zmiany jednym przyciskiem, z licznikiem godzin i kilometrów.
- Czekanie przy lokalu: gdy podjedziesz w promieniu 100 m, aplikacja mierzy czas odbioru i dopisuje go do zlecenia, więc zł/h liczy też stanie w kolejce.
- Zmiana żyje na ekranie blokady i w Dynamic Island, więc zegar tyka także w kieszeni.

RANKING

Ranking kurierów pokazuje, ile brutto zarobili inni w danym dniu, tygodniu i miesiącu - bez adresów, bez nazw lokali, bez tras. Możesz się z niego wyłączyć jednym przełącznikiem w Ustawieniach.

TWOJE KONTO NA ASYSTENTKURIERA.PL

Zaloguj się, żeby dziennik i ustawienia były na koncie i synchronizowały się między telefonem a przeglądarką. Konto usuniesz sam w Ustawieniach albo na asystentkuriera.pl/delete-account.

PRYWATNOŚĆ

- Zrzut ekranu nie opuszcza telefonu - do serwera idzie wyłącznie rozpoznany tekst.
- Lokalizacja służy do trasy, kilometrów i czekania przy lokalu.
- Nic nie jest sprzedawane ani udostępniane reklamodawcom.
- Szczegóły: https://asystentkuriera.pl/privacy

WAŻNE

Aplikacja nie jest powiązana z Pyszne, Uber Eats, Bolt Food, Glovo, Wolt ani Stuart. To narzędzie kierowcy: pomaga policzyć, czy zlecenie się opłaca. Stawki i czasy z aplikacji kurierskich mogą różnić się od rzeczywistych - trasa liczona jest z Twojej aktualnej pozycji i ruchu.

name: AZET
description:
AZET is the phone remote for AZET on your computer. Start an agent task from anywhere, follow it live, and answer when it needs you.

- See every agent and terminal running on your computer
- Answer questions and approve steps: logins, payments and one-time codes arrive as clear cards
- Get a notification when a task finishes or is waiting for you
- Type or dictate instructions, and attach photos from your phone
- Works on the same Wi-Fi, or from anywhere through AZET's relay

Your code, files and service logins stay on your computer. Phone and computer talk end to end encrypted; the relay forwards traffic it cannot read. The app has no ads and no tracking.

To start, install AZET on your computer from azet.io/download, open Settings > Mobile, and scan the pairing code with this app.

name: Bebico: Baby Tracker
description:
Bebico is a simple tracker that keeps your baby's day and health calendar in one place. Log feedings, sleep and diapers in a few taps, and never miss a vaccine or check-up again.

DAILY LOG
• Feeding: nursing (side and duration), bottle (ml, breast milk or formula) and solids. The next side is suggested when you log a new nursing session.
• Sleep: start it when your baby falls asleep and tap "Woke up" when they wake. Night sleep is split across the right days.
• Diapers: wet, dirty or both.
• The "Today" screen shows the time since the last feeding and the day's totals at a glance; go back to earlier days with one tap.
• A history page for each type: a chart of the last 7 days, the daily average and entries day by day.

VACCINE SCHEDULE AND REMINDERS
• Türkiye's national childhood immunization schedule (Ministry of Health) is built in; dose dates are calculated from the date of birth. In other countries, turn the schedule off and add vaccines yourself with their next dose date.
• A notification the day before and on the day of every vaccine and check-up, at the time you pick.
• Mark a vaccine as done with one tap; vaccines given on the same day are logged together.
• Add vaccines outside the schedule (rotavirus, meningococcal, flu) with their next dose date.

GROWTH AND DOCTOR VISITS
• Weight, length and head circumference, each with a chart and the latest change.
• Doctor visits: reason, doctor or clinic, cost and check-up date.
• See your yearly health spending.

MORE THAN ONE BABY
• A separate profile for each baby; switch from the home screen with one tap.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
• No account needed; everything is stored only on your phone.
• Save a backup to iCloud Drive before switching phones and restore it on the new one.
• No ads, no tracking.

Light and dark themes, English and Turkish.

Note: The vaccine schedule follows Türkiye's national childhood immunization schedule as updated by the Ministry of Health on 1 September 2026 (asi.saglik.gov.tr) and is for information only. Follow your family doctor's and pediatrician's advice on vaccine timing. Bebico does not give medical advice and does not replace a medical examination.

name: Bhagavad Gita: English & Audio
description:
Read and listen to all 700 verses of the Bhagavad Gita in English and Hindi, with audio: each verse recited in Sanskrit, a clear meaning in both languages and a short explanation. Everything you read works offline. Every verse and every feature is free, with nothing locked. No account needed.

Read a chapter at your own pace, listen to it like an audiobook, begin with seven days of the best-known verses, or come back for a daily verse.

READ AND UNDERSTAND
• All 18 chapters and 700 verses, in Sanskrit: Devanagari, simple Roman spelling or IAST
• Modern English, Annie Besant's Classic English translation (1922), and Simple Hindi: show one, or two side by side
• A plain explanation of every verse in English and Hindi and, where they differ, how the classical teachers read it
• Word-by-word meanings of the Sanskrit, in English and Hindi
• An introduction to every chapter, and a glossary of key terms such as dharma, yoga, karma and the three gunas

LISTEN
• Hear every verse recited in Sanskrit, then its meaning in English or Hindi; or only the Sanskrit, or only the meaning
• One verse, or a whole chapter that runs on into the next
• Plays in the background, with Lock Screen controls, speed and a sleep timer
• Repeat each verse 3, 5, 11 or 21 times, or pause after each one to say it aloud
• The page follows the verse being recited
• The audio downloads once, in the background, then plays offline

EVERY DAY
• A verse of the day, with Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• An optional reminder at the time you choose
• First steps: seven days with the Gita's best-known verses
• A chapter a day: the whole Gita in 18 days
• Find guidance: verses for when you are anxious, grieving, angry or unsure what to do

LEARN, KEEP AND SHARE
• Learn any verse by heart: hide lines, use first-syllable cues, then recall it on your own
• Spaced review brings back the verses you are unsure of
• Bookmarks, highlights and notes, with notes export
• Share any verse as a clean image with its Sanskrit and translation
• Search by verse number ("2.47"), in Sanskrit, in Roman spelling ("karmanye vadhikaraste") or by any English or Hindi word

READ COMFORTABLY
• Type made for Devanagari, and text that grows to the largest accessibility sizes
• Light, Sepia and Night themes
• Designed for iPhone and iPad
• Your saved verses, notes and progress stay on your phone, with no account or sign-up

ABOUT THE BHAGAVAD GITA
The Bhagavad Gita (also written Bhagavat Gita, Bhagavath Gita, Bhagwat Geeta, Bhagwad Gita, Bhagawad Geeta or Shrimad Bhagavad Gita) is the dialogue between Krishna and the warrior Arjuna on the battlefield of Kurukshetra, told in the Mahabharata. In 700 shlokas across 18 chapters it teaches the paths of selfless action, knowledge and devotion. It is among the most widely read Hindu scriptures, and readers of every background turn to it for guidance in daily life.

SOURCES AND TRANSLATIONS
The Sanskrit text and Annie Besant's 1922 translation are in the public domain. The Modern English and Simple Hindi translations, the explanations and the word meanings were made for this app from the Sanskrit and the public-domain classical commentaries: prepared with AI language tools and checked verse by verse in a separate AI-assisted pass. Every source is listed in the app, and you can report a correction from any verse.

The Sanskrit is recited by Swami Brahmananda (Central Chinmaya Mission Trust), from IIT Kanpur's Gita Supersite, under CC BY-SA 4.0. The English and Hindi meanings are read by AI voices. The audio downloads once after you install the app (about 24 MB for the Sanskrit, about 15 MB for each language).

name: Booster Rider
description:
Booster Rider is the app for couriers who deliver Booster's one-hour orders from luxury stores in London.

GO ONLINE, GET NEARBY JOBS
Switch on when you're ready to ride. Booster offers each job to the nearest rider, with what you'll earn, the store to collect from and the time to deliver by. Take it within a minute or let it pass.

COLLECT WITH PROOF
Each order leaves the store in a sealed Booster bag with its own ticket. Scan the code on the ticket with the app's camera, or type it, and the job moves on only when it matches.

HAND OVER SAFELY
The customer's exact address appears once you've collected the bag. At the door, the customer gives you a handover code, so every parcel reaches the right person.

SEE WHAT YOU EARN
Every delivery and payout in one place, by day, week or month.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your location is shared only while you're online and the app is open, and only your latest position is kept. You can ask to close your account at any time from the app.

Booster Rider is for couriers who have signed up with Booster and ride a bicycle or an e-bike in London.

name: BroachTester
description:
BroachTester on avarruslaskuri, joka auttaa mitoittamaan vedon, hampaat ja ohjauksen. Syötä avarrustyökalun mitat ja työstettävä reikä, niin saat vetovoiman, tehon ja lastun arviot.

Kuusi työkalua:
• Veto: voima, nopeus, pituus ja teho
• Hammas: nosto, jako, selkä ja aine
• Ohjaus: halkaisija, pituus, heitto ja väli
• Esireikä: halkaisija, viiste, pituus ja toleranssi
• Lastu: leikkuunopeus, lastu, jäähdytys ja syöttö
• Tarkastus: profiili, mittapoikkeama ja pinnanlaatu

Viitetaulukot ja tekniset tiedot tukevat työkalun asetusta. Pro avaa kaikki työkalut ja tulosten viennin.

name: Burkimi
description:
Find the dogs hiding in colorful logic puzzles. Each row, column, and colored area holds exactly one dog, and dogs cannot touch, even at a corner. Mark safe squares with Xs, place the dogs, and use a hint when a board gets tricky.

Complete levels to earn Coins and Bones. Use Coins for puzzle help and Bones to expand Pip’s home, choose wallpaper, and fill rooms and yards with decorations. Feed Pip, give him water, play together, and let him rest between puzzles.

Explore 10,000 levels at your own pace. Your board, home, and progress are saved on this device. When you are signed in to Game Center and iCloud Drive is available, your save can also be backed up and restored after reinstalling.

Optional in-app purchases offer extra Coins and puzzle boosts. Optional reward ads can grant an extra attempt when an ad is available.

name: Cockroach City: Breed & Battle
description:
Build the most charming roach city in the sewer! Breed, hatch and evolve 43 pixel-art species and lead your team to the top of the city.

BREED AND HATCH
● 8 elements: Sewer, Trash, Fire, Ice, Electric, Chemical, Metal and Shadow.
● Breed two roaches at the Love Nest and hatch a mystery egg: Hybrids, Rares, Legendaries and the Immortal Roach.
● See the odds of every breeding. A bad-luck bonus grows with each failed try.

RUN YOUR CITY
● Isometric habitats with your roaches walking around, gold bubbles to collect and farms to grow food.
● Feed them and watch each roach grow: baby, teen and adult.

TURN-BASED BATTLES
● Teams of 3, elemental advantages and special moves (burn, freeze, poison, shield, life steal).
● An Arena with 11 rivals and bosses, a 30-floor Drain Tower and a special event every week.

PVP AND LEAGUES
● Fight other players' defense teams, even while they're offline.
● Climb from the Drain to Queen of the City in weekly seasons with rewards.

No sign-up needed. Create a username and password only if you want cloud saves.
Cockroach City is free to play with optional in-app purchases (gems). Rewarded videos only if you want them. We don't track you.

name: Coffee: Markdown Notes
seller_name: AMPLIFIED CREATIONS - INFORMÁTICA E GESTÃO, LDA
description:
Coffee keeps your notes as plain Markdown files in a folder you choose, such as one in iCloud Drive. They're the same files Coffee on your Mac opens, and they open in any other app too. Nothing to import, nothing to export.

WRITE
- Headings, bold, lists and quotes formatted as you type, with the Markdown marks kept quiet
- A bar above the keyboard for headings, tasks, lists, links, code, highlights and photos, right where the caret is
- Press Return at the end of a list and it continues; press it again and the list ends
- Tap a task's box to tick it

SUMS
- Write 18 * 12 and the answer sits beside the line
- Totals, percentages and currencies: $200 in EUR is answered with today's rate
- Tap an answer to copy it

LINKED NOTES
- Type [[ and pick a note to link to it
- Tap a link to open the note, made for you if it isn't there yet
- See which notes link back to the one you're reading
- Tag notes with #tags and browse them in the sidebar

DRAWN, NOT JUST WRITTEN
- Mermaid flowcharts, pie charts and sequence diagrams drawn under their code
- Maths in $$ blocks drawn as formulas
- Canvases: notes, text and links as cards with arrows, in the same .canvas files Coffee for Mac and Obsidian use

BRING THINGS IN
- Import Word (.docx and older .doc), OpenDocument (.odt) and rich text (.rtf) documents as notes
- Share a note as a PDF or a web page, charts and formulas included

ASK
- Ask a question about the note or all your notes, answered on the device by Apple Intelligence (on iPhones and iPads that support it)

ORGANISED
- Folders and tags in the sidebar, notes pinned to the top
- Pins and sort order are shared with Coffee on your Mac
- Search titles and what's inside, or a #tag
- Spotlight finds your notes, and Shortcuts can add to your Inbox, start a note or open today's note

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
- Themes from Coffee for Mac: Coffee, Espresso, Matcha, Midnight and Paper
- Inter, Geist, serif or mono, at the size you like
- Light and dark mode
- On iPad, your notes beside the note, and keyboard shortcuts

ONE COFFEE FOR ALL YOUR DEVICES
Try everything free for 14 days. After that your notes stay readable, and your Coffee account unlocks writing on your iPhone, iPad and Mac.

name: compareME
description:
compareME pomaga śledzić zmiany sylwetki bez zgadywania. Zamiast robić dziesiątki zdjęć, nagrywasz krótki film, a aplikacja pozwala wyciąć z niego dokładnie te klatki, których potrzebujesz.

WYCINANIE KLATEK Z NAGRANIA
• Odtwarzaj film, zwalniaj go i przewijaj klatka po klatce.
• Przybliżaj obraz, żeby sprawdzić szczegóły.
• Wyblakłe kolory z filmów HDR z iPhone'a poprawiają się same.

ETAPY I POMIARY
• Każdy etap to jeden dzień z twoimi zdjęciami, pomiarami i notatką.
• Waga i obwody: szyja, barki, klatka, pas, biodra, a także biceps, przedramię, udo i łydka, osobno dla lewej i prawej strony.
• W ustawieniach wybierasz, jakie pomiary chcesz wpisywać.

PORÓWNANIA
• Dwa zdjęcia obok siebie albo na suwaku.
• Gotowe porównanie zapiszesz w galerii albo wrzucisz na social media.

PRYWATNOŚĆ
• Bez konta i logowania.
• Zdjęcia i pomiary zostają na twoim telefonie.

name: CoproSécurit TLS
description:
CoproSécurit TLS est l’application professionnelle des opérateurs de télésurveillance CoproSécurit.

Elle permet de consulter les alertes des sites surveillés, d’examiner les informations utiles au traitement des incidents, de suivre les décisions en attente et de recevoir des notifications pour les événements urgents.

L’accès est réservé aux opérateurs disposant d’un compte TLS autorisé. Cette application n’est pas destinée au grand public.

name: Crowd Hunt - Doodle Duo
description:
A crowd of funny hand-drawn doodle people is walking by. Your job: find the people you are asked for and tap them before the timer runs out!

• 150+ hand-drawn characters in blue, red, green and black pen
• Chefs, pirates, astronauts, knights, ghosts, ballerinas and many more
• Every level gets faster and busier
• Watch out for look-alikes: from level 7 the pen color matters too
• Rush Hour and Speed levels keep you on your toes
• Combos for fast finds and bonus points for no mistakes
• Spot the golden king to win back a lost heart
• Stuck? Tap the light bulb for a hint
• Picture clues for every target, great for kids and players who can't read yet
• Plays offline, no ads, no account, no purchases

How far can you get?

name: CYLVERGE
description:
Build the Circuit. Control the Force.

CYLVERGE is an engineering puzzle game where hydraulic systems, mechanical components, and pressure control come together.

Design hydraulic circuits, connect pipes, operate valves, adjust pressure, and control powerful industrial mechanisms. Every challenge requires careful planning and an understanding of how different components work together.

MASTER HYDRAULIC SYSTEMS

Connect pipes and create functional hydraulic circuits.

Control valves and redirect fluid flow.

Adjust pressure regulators and manage system limits.

Operate hydraulic cylinders and synchronize pistons.

Configure multi-stage mechanical operations.

EXPLORE ENGINEERING CHALLENGES

Progress through six engineering environments, each introducing new components, machinery, and increasingly complex systems.

Raise platforms, move industrial cargo, operate hydraulic presses, and coordinate multiple mechanisms to complete each objective.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY

Engineering Campaign: Complete structured challenges and master new hydraulic mechanics.

Challenge Mode: Solve special tasks with additional restrictions.

Free Workshop: Build circuits, experiment with components, and test your own configurations.

BUILD YOUR ENGINEERING SKILLS

Earn stars, unlock achievements, collect engineering points, and track your progress. Improve your configurations and discover more efficient ways to operate each machine.

Every connection matters. Every valve changes the system. Every successful operation starts with the right circuit.

Enter the workshop and take control of the force.

name: Dalaman Cebimde
seller_name: Kalynda Teknoloji Havacilik ve Turizm Limited Sirketi
description:
Dalaman Cebimde is the city app for people who live in and visit Dalaman, Turkey.

EVERYDAY ESSENTIALS
• Duty pharmacy: tonight's pharmacy on duty with address, one-tap call and directions.
• Power and water outages: planned and fault outages announced for Dalaman, with affected neighbourhoods and times.
• Obituaries and municipal notices, always shown with their source.
• Weather: current conditions, sea temperature, hourly and 7-day forecast, storm and heavy-rain alerts.
• Key numbers: emergency, faults and call centres on one screen.

IN TOWN
• Local directory: trades, groceries, hairdressers, food and more; filter by open now, call or message on WhatsApp.
• Local deals from shops.
• Noticeboard: jobs, rentals, for sale, second-hand, lost & found and services. Post ads for free.
• Events: concerts, festivals, sport, school events and market days.
• Minibus timetables with the next departure.

FOR VISITORS
• Bays and beaches: Sarsala, Sarıgerme, Göcek and more, with distance, facilities and directions.
• Dalaman Airport: live arrivals and departures, plus airport transfers.

Notifications: choose the topics you want (obituaries, outages, municipal notices, events).

Dalaman Cebimde is an independent city app, not an official app of Dalaman Municipality or any other authority. Pharmacy, outage, obituary and municipal information comes from the public pages of the relevant bodies and is shown with its source.

Available in English, Turkish, Russian and German.

name: Dartcaster
description:
Darts without the math: one iPhone on a tripod films your board and scores every dart.
When the camera is unsure, it asks. The scoreboard goes live on your TV.
Scoring by hand is always free, with no ads.

CAMERA SCORING
- Put your iPhone on a tripod below or beside the board. The app finds the board by itself.
- The camera scores every dart, in every game. When it is not sure, it asks which segment it was. Any dart can be corrected: tap it and pick the right segment.
- If the tripod moves a little, the app corrects for it.
- Camera images are processed on your phone and never leave it.
- Camera scoring is new and keeps getting better with every update.

SCOREBOARD ON YOUR TV
- A live, broadcast-style scoreboard via Chromecast or a TV with Chromecast built-in.
- Names, scores left, legs and sets and checkout suggestions, big on screen.
- Phone and TV on the same Wi-Fi. Ads never appear on the TV.

GAMES
- X01: 501 or 301, with legs and sets and double out. Play with friends or against the bot, from beginner to pro.
- Cricket, Around the Clock, Killer and Bob's 27.
- Duos: 2 against 2, with the standings of the evening.
- Checkout suggestions and bust detection on every visit.

STATISTICS
- Averages, checkouts, highest finish and 180s for every player.
- Everything stays on your phone. No account, no sign-in.

FREE OR UNLOCKED
- Scoring by hand, all games and your statistics are free, with no ads.
- Camera scoring and the TV scoreboard: free for an evening, until 6 am, after about a minute of short videos that you start yourself.
- Or unlock camera and TV for good with a one-time purchase, with no videos. You can restore your purchase at any time.

WHAT YOU NEED
- An iPhone. For camera scoring, a tripod or holder as well.
- For the TV, a Chromecast or a TV with Chromecast built-in.
- Tip: even light, such as a ring light around the board, helps the camera most.

Questions or ideas? Email support@dartcaster.nl.
Privacy: https://dartcaster.nl/en/privacy/

Chromecast is a trademark of Google LLC.

name: Dhikr Buddy: Zikir & Dua
description:
Dhikr Buddy is a cute companion that grows as you stay consistent. Each day you make dhikr, your buddy (a tuxedo cat to start) grows from New Buddy to Loyal Buddy, Close Buddy and finally True Buddy.

SOURCED DHIKR & DUAS
• Morning and evening adhkar, after-prayer dhikr and your own Daily Practice
• 1000+ duas from the Quran and hadith books, each with its source and a link to read it yourself
• 17 collections for every need: repentance, needs, istikharah, provision, family, illness, knowledge, character and more
• Timely duas: tahajjud, duha, Friday afternoon, Arafah and Laylat al-Qadr
• Duas for a loved one: pray for someone, then share the words if you wish

THE 99 NAMES
Make dhikr with one of Allah's names or a combination, such as «يَا اللَّهُ يَا رَزَّاقُ».

TASBIH COUNTER
Beads or number mode, open count or your own target, with gentle haptics.

DHIKR GARDEN & HEART DIARY
Every dhikr plants a tree in your garden. Note how you feel each day and see your consistency calendar.

PRAYER TIMES & REMINDERS
Reminders that follow your prayer times, including JAKIM e-Solat in Malaysia.

FOR EVERYONE
• Malay, English and Arabic
• Clear Arabic text; transliteration can be switched on when you need it
• Light and dark mode, 8 theme colours

YOUR PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no trackers. Everything stays on your phone.

Dhikr Buddy is free. You can leave an optional tip to support its development.

name: Dialwright
description:
Dialwright is a sundial designer and solar-time workshop. Choose any place on Earth and it works out the hour lines, gnomon angle and corrections you need to build a sundial that tells the time, and explains why it reads the way it does.

DESIGN FIVE KINDS OF DIAL
Horizontal garden dials, vertical dials for a wall facing the equator, equatorial rings, polar dials and analemmatic dials, where a person standing on the date scale becomes the gnomon. Pick hourly, half-hour or quarter-hour marks, set the size, and switch on longitude correction or summer-time labels. The plate redraws instantly, a table lists every hour-line angle or offset, and you can copy the table as text.

SETTING-OUT NOTES
Every design shows the style angle, gnomon size and longitude offset, with plain instructions for aligning the dial. Drawings mirror automatically for the southern hemisphere.

SUN NOW
Live sundial time beside clock time, to the second, with the sun's altitude and bearing, declination, equation of time, sunrise, solar noon, sunset and day length.

THE EQUATION OF TIME
See how far the sun runs fast or slow on any day of the year, as a year-long curve or as the figure-eight analemma, along with this year's extremes and a short explanation of why it happens.

SHADOW CASTER
Enter an object's height and any date and time to get the shadow's length and bearing, drawn on a compass, plus noon shadow lengths at the equinoxes and solstices.

SUN PATH
Plot the sun's track across the sky for any day and compare it with both solstices. Sunrise and sunset bearings show whether a wall or garden spot gets sun when your dial needs it.

CORRECTION CARD
A year-round table of how many minutes to add to your sundial's reading to get clock time, allowing for longitude, the equation of time and summer time.

PLACES AND PRIMER
Choose from 45 cities or enter exact coordinates and a time zone. A short primer covers gnomons, finding true north, sundial time and clock time, dial types, the southern hemisphere and building tips.

ALSO INCLUDED
• Metric or imperial lengths; 12- or 24-hour times
• Dark Mode and Dynamic Type support
• Works offline, with no account, no location access and no data collection

Never look directly at the sun. Dialwright works entirely by shadows.

name: Doodlebound: Draw Puzzle
description:
Meet Nib, a little pencil line who came to life in the margin of a school notebook. The page is full of gaps, spikes and grumpy stationery, and the only way forward is the line you draw.

Doodlebound is a hand-crafted physics puzzle adventure. Tap to jump. Touch and hold to slow time, then draw a bridge, a ramp or a spring. Your lines have real weight: they bend, bounce and fall. Many pages have more than one answer, so the solution is truly yours.

How it plays
• Tap to jump, hold to draw. No buttons, no tool menus.
• Time slows while you draw, and your ink is limited, so plan every stroke.
• Pick the right pen: pencil lines can be erased, crayon bounces like a spring, marker is heavy and falls with gravity.
• Tear paper strips and scribble out obstacles.
• New paper tricks: vanishing ink that fades after it carries you, dotted guides to trace in fountain-pen ink, and folded pages where every line is mirrored.
• Short pages of about 20 to 45 seconds, made for quick breaks. Easy to start, hard to earn three stars.

A story written on paper
• Two notebooks and 50 hand-made pages: The First Notebook and School Days.
• Outsmart King Eraser, who rolls in to rub out your pencil lines.
• Pass the test pages of Ms. Red Pen, the strictest grader in class.
• Find the hidden sticker on every page and fill your sticker album.

Daily Page: a puzzle every day
• A new page every day, the same for every player.
• Solve it with as little ink as you can and keep your streak going.
• Each day brings a twist rule: one stroke only, tight ink, a mirrored page, no slow motion and more.
• Share a spoiler-free result card with friends.

Make Nib yours
• Draw a hat for Nib at the start. Nib wears it on the journey.
• Collect pens and inks: shiny gold ink, galaxy ink, rainbow, calligraphy brush, neon, blackboard chalk and more.
• Dress Nib up: astronaut, ink ninja, stargazer, blue áo dài, Tết outfit and more.
• Outfits and inks are cosmetic only. They never change difficulty.

Paper you can almost hear
• Layered paper-craft art, with ink that soaks into the page.
• Calm, ASMR-style sound: pencil scratches, paper tears and eraser rubs.

Play in English, Vietnamese, German, Spanish or Arabic.

Doodlebound is free to play and includes optional in-app purchases and ads.

Optional VIP subscription (weekly or monthly): no interstitial, banner or app-open ads, rewarded-ad rewards without watching in unranked modes, and 100 Ink Stars every day you open the game. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm. The subscription renews automatically at the same price unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings. The Ink Pass is a one-time 30-day purchase and does not renew.

Terms of Use: https://maivika.com/en/doodlebound/terms
Privacy Policy: https://maivika.com/en/doodlebound/privacy

If you enjoy drawing puzzles, brain teasers and physics games with a creative twist, open the notebook and draw your own way through.

name: Drag Bike 201M Sunmori
description:
Tarik gas, tahan setang, dan buktikan motor drag modifikasimu paling cepat di lintasan 201 meter.

Drag Bike 201M Sunmori adalah game balap motor drag bike yang terasa Indonesia dari detik pertama: trek resmi 201 meter dua jalur, drag 800 meter, sirkuit road race, sampai sunmori bebas di jalanan kota yang hidup dengan lalu lintas, pejalan kaki, dan pergantian siang ke malam.

EMPAT CARA BALAP
- DRAG 201 M — trek dua jalur, standing start, menang atau kalah ditentukan seperseribu detik
- DRAG 800 M — lintasan panjang, adu top speed sampai mesin mentok limiter
- ROAD RACE — sirkuit berbelok, adu ambil jalur dan titik pengereman
- OPEN WORLD — sunmori bebas tanpa aturan, siang berganti malam, jalanan penuh lalu lintas

DUEL JALANAN 400 METER
Tempel motor lain di jalan, tahan sebentar di sampingnya, dan tawaran duel muncul sendiri. Menang dapat koin penuh, kalah masih dapat separuh. Persis sunmori yang berubah jadi balap liar begitu dua motor berdampingan di jalan lurus.

MODIFIKASI SAMPAI TELANJANG
Lima motor drag bike, dan tiap motor bisa dibongkar sampai ke sasis:
- Velg dan knalpot bebas dicampur antar motor — pasang velg motor lain di motormu
- Body dilepas per lapis: full body, half fairing, sampai telanjang total dengan mesin dan sasis kelihatan
- Dua livery per motor, plus motif helm dan jaket untuk jokimu

Bongkar bodinya sampai tinggal sasis dan mesin, pasang velg jari-jari dari motor lain, tempel knalpot kolong — bangun motor drag versimu sendiri, bukan versi yang sudah disiapkan.

FISIKA YANG JUJUR
Roda depan terangkat kalau gas terlalu dalam dari garis start. Rem depan terlalu keras bikin motor jungkir ke depan. Salah ambil jalur di sirkuit, motor dan joki terguling — lengkap dengan ragdoll, asap ban yang membakar aspal, dan letupan api dari ujung knalpot.

JALANAN YANG HIDUP
Kota ini tidak kosong. Ada mobil dan motor lain yang benar-benar jalan di jalurnya, orang menyeberang di trotoar, lampu jalan menyala saat senja. Kamu bisa sunmori pelan menikmati kota, atau menyalip semuanya sampai ada yang terpancing menantangmu duel.

RINGAN DAN BISA OFFLINE
Tiga tingkat grafis (SD / HD / FHD) supaya lancar di HP kentang maupun HP flagship. Balapannya bisa dimainkan tanpa koneksi internet / offline, kapan pun dan di mana pun.

KUMPULKAN KOIN, BANGUN MOTOR
Tiap balapan yang kau selesaikan membayar koin — menang dapat penuh, finis tapi kalah tetap dapat separuh, jadi tak ada latihan yang terbuang. Kumpulkan koinnya, beli motor baru, dan bangun motor drag paling ganas di kota.

Cocok untuk kamu yang suka game balap motor, drag bike, drag race, motor bebek modifikasi, herex, dan sunmori bareng.

Sanggup tembus 201 meter tanpa jungkir? Gas terus, jangan kendor!

name: Duly Noted: Sheet Music Player
description:
Hear your sheet music. Perfect for practice.

Snap a photo of the page or open a PDF, and Duly Noted plays it back while you follow the highlighted bar. Pause, set a loop, slow it down without changing the pitch, separate melody, chords and bass – and more.

Everything a practice session needs
• Your tempo, your loop: slow it down without changing the pitch and loop the tricky bars. Count-in, metronome and transposing to your key.
• Separate the parts: melody, chords and bass are separate voices. Mute the melody and practice over the changes, or keep only the bass line as your rhythm section.
• Follows the road map: first and second endings, repeat signs, segno, coda, D.S. al Coda and D.C. al Fine are played the way the piece is meant to go.
• Fix what was misread: recognition is never perfect. Pick a bar and correct a chord, a repeat or a jump, and the playback updates on the spot.

Reads what you give it
• Scan the pages with the built-in document scanner, or choose a PDF, a photo or a MusicXML file. You can also open a file in Duly Noted from Files, Mail or another app.
• Lead sheets, piano scores and single-line parts, one page or many.
• Clean printed music reads best. Handwritten music is not read yet.

Your library, private
Sign in with your e-mail – no password. Your pieces are stored on our server in the EU and are visible to no one but you. The same library works on your iPhone, iPad and computer. Delete a piece, or your whole account, whenever you like.

Simple pricing, no subscription
Your first piece is free for 14 days: slow it down, loop it and mute voices. After that you buy a pack of 3 or 10 pieces once – they stay unlocked while you use your account – or a year pass that runs for 12 months and ends by itself. No ads.

Please use Duly Noted with sheet music you own or have the right to use.

EB & LIVE is het onafhankelijke platform voor de live entertainment business en de muziekindustrie in Nederland en België. We brengen de branche samen en leveren nieuws en diensten aan organisatoren, promotors, podia, labels en muziekuitgevers.

name: Halcyon:GTD
description:
I built Halcyon because I wanted a proper task manager that didn't lock my lists away in somebody else's database.

Every project is a plain Markdown file in your iCloud Drive. You can open them in Files, Obsidian or any text editor, change things there, and Halcyon picks it up. If you stop using the app one day, your lists are still there, readable, exactly as you left them.

Plain files also mean an AI assistant can do a lot of the work for you. The slow part of GTD has always been the organising: going through everything that's come in, working out the next action, putting it in the right project with the right context. An agent like Claude can do most of that in the background. Point it at your Halcyon folder and ask it to go through this week's email and meeting notes and turn them into tasks, empty your Inbox, or tell you which projects have stalled. There's an AGENTS.md file in the folder that tells it how your lists work, so it doesn't make a mess, and everything it writes is plain text, so you can see exactly what it changed.

It's built around Getting Things Done, but you don't need to know GTD to use it.

CAPTURE
- Add a task from the app, a widget, Control Center, the share sheet, Siri or the Action button.
- Type it the way you'd say it, like "call Bob about the van next Thursday afternoon @phone". On devices with Apple Intelligence, Halcyon works out the date, time and context on the phone itself. Nothing is saved until you accept it.
- Everything goes to the Inbox first, so you don't have to decide where it belongs while you're busy.

ORGANISE
- Folders, projects, sections, tasks and subtasks.
- Due dates, start dates, reminders, priorities and repeating tasks.
- Tags and @contexts on anything, inherited from the folder or project they sit in.
- Waiting For and Someday/Maybe are just tags. Promoting an idea means removing the tag.
- Mark a project as sequential and only its next step shows up as a next action.

GET ON WITH IT
- Today, Upcoming, and Next Actions grouped by context.
- A Weekly Review that takes you through each project in turn.
- Search with filters, e.g. "#work due:overdue" or "@home -#someday".
- Home Screen widgets for Today, Next Actions and Upcoming. You can tick things off right there.
- Reminders can be copied into Apple Reminders, so the alerts reach your Watch and Mac as well.
- Spotlight finds your tasks, and any task can be copied as a link.

THE FILES
- Fields are written as plain text, like [due:: 2026-11-15]. It reads Obsidian Tasks syntax too.
- Works offline, and syncs through your own iCloud Drive.
- No account and no subscription. I don't collect any data at all.

Works on iPhone, iPhone Duo and iPad, iPad mini included. On iPhone Duo it follows the fold: closed, you get the iPhone layout for a quick look at Today; open it out and you get the full iPad layout, with your lists in a sidebar next to the tasks.

It's a 1.0, so there will be rough edges. If something doesn't work the way you'd expect, I'd really like to hear about it. The support link is below.

name: Heddy for Safari
description:
Works with aitutors.me.

Most clippers stop at saving. Heddy keeps going.
Heddy for Safari sends what you find on the web and on YouTube straight into your Jotters on aitutors.me, where seven subject professors help you understand it: clip it, jot it, ask about it, practise it, and come back to it a few days later. On Mac, iPhone and iPad.

1 · CLIP: keep it, with where it came from
• Tap Heddy in Safari and its panel opens beside the page. Select words and each selection becomes a numbered card, or tap + Picture and draw a box round a chart or photo. Keep up to 10 snippets and four pictures from one page, in your own order.
• Save to my Jotters puts them in your Jotter in that order, with the page's address, and each snippet keeps the sentence it came from.
• Save this page keeps the whole article, with its headings and lists.
• Choose which Jotter a save goes to, search your Jotters, or keep saving into one Jotter for the day. Done, Open my Jotter, or Undo this save.
• On a Mac you can also right-click words or a picture to add them.

2 · JOT: Watch with Heddy, in English or Chinese
Tap Watch with Heddy on a YouTube video and the desk opens beside it.
• Switch the desk between EN | 中.
• Digest: the transcript in English, Bilingual or Chinese, following the video. Tap a time to play from there.
• Jot the line being spoken, or type your own note, and save the jots to the video's Jotter by their times.
• Full desk opens the video in the Classroom on aitutors.me with your jots.

3 · ASK: seven professors beside you
Mentor and seven subject professors sit beside the page. Whatever subject you are studying, its own professor helps you think it through.
• Explain: select a line or a picture and your professor explains it.
• Insights: a short note on each chapter of a video, as you reach it.
• Ask: talk to the professor about a line, a moment or a picture.
The professors ask, hint and show a worked example of a similar problem. Your own answer stays yours to find.

4 · PRACTISE: your Jotter asks the questions
• Get it: three questions made from your own jots. Get one wrong and Heddy points you back to the jot, never to the answer.
• Teach it back: explain a topic in your own words and see what the professor heard.
• Quiz: a short quiz on each video, with a hint on every question.
• Make a card: turn a key point or a missed question into a flashcard.

5 · REVISE: Watch-outs come back to you
• Watch-outs: a common mistake kept with the right idea, back after 1, 3 and 7 days.
• Storyboard: link your jots into a mind map of the topic.

YOU ARE IN CHARGE
• Heddy reads a page only when you ask.
• What you save is kept on aitutors.me, under your own account, and nowhere else. Heddy has no analytics and no error reporting.
• In Safari, Heddy sends its requests through an aitutors.me tab so they use your own sign-in. If none is open, it opens the aitutors.me welcome page in a background tab.
• Some features depend on the subjects on your aitutors.me plan.

TURN IT ON
iPhone and iPad: Settings › Apps › Safari › Extensions › Heddy, then allow it on aitutors.me and YouTube.
Mac: Safari › Settings › Extensions › Heddy.

You need an aitutors.me account, signed in as the child in Safari. Free.

name: Heroes Keep Out
description:
Heroes are raiding your dungeon. Draw monsters, line them up, and hold the dungeon for thirty minutes.

■ Every draw changes the run
Collect gold and draw a monster. There are seven grades, from Grunt to Calamity, and you only know what you get when you draw. Raise your odds for the higher grades, or draw one more right now: the call is yours.

■ Three races, twenty-one monsters
Squishy Slimes, Vampires of the night, fire-breathing Dragons. Each race fights in its own way, and the higher the grade, the farther it reaches and the grander its attack.

■ Thirty boss heroes
Every minute a hero of renown arrives. Fail to drive one out in time, or let too many heroes crowd the dungeon, and the dungeon falls. Drive out the thirtieth, the Last Hero, and the dungeon is yours.

■ Growth that stays after a run
Spend the souls you earn on stronger monsters and a sturdier dungeon. Complete daily goals, and raise your monsters in the codex.

■ Short or long
A run lasts thirty minutes at most. Speed it up, or leave in the middle and pick it up later.

Ads appear only when you choose to watch one for an extra reward. Buy Remove Ads once and get the rewards with no ads.
Available in 14 languages.

name: Hifzara: Quran Memorization
description:
Hifzara is for learning Quran and memorizing it, one ayah at a time. Learn to read, listen, understand and carry the Quran in your heart.

LEARN WITH A DAILY PLAN
• Tell Hifzara where you are and how many minutes you have. You get a daily plan with new ayahs, recent ones and older ones to revise.
• Start from the end (Juz 'Amma) or from Al-Fatiha.
• Learn your very first ayah during setup.

THE WHOLE QURAN, PAGE BY PAGE
• A clear Madani 15-line Mushaf with all 114 surahs.
• Touch any word to hear it, see its transliteration and its meaning.
• Listen to every ayah recited by Mishary Alafasy and repeat it as often as you like.
• Meanings in 12 languages, including English, Dutch, Turkish, Urdu, Indonesian and Arabic.

PRACTISE FROM MEMORY
• Hide the text, show first letters, or peek with your finger.
• Exercises: Fill the Gap, Next Ayah, Verse Order and a Daily Mix.
• AI recitation check: our AI listens while you recite and checks your pronunciation word by word. Words you nailed turn green, words to polish orange, missed words red.

STAY MOTIVATED
• Streaks and a progress dashboard.
• Weekly leagues from Bronze to Diamond in groups of up to 100. Others only see your first name and the first letter of your last name, or nothing at all in private mode. Brothers-only or sisters-only groups are available. Small groups are topped up with practice rivals, always marked as such.

PRIVACY
Your progress stays on your iPhone. If you join the weekly league, only your first name, the first letter of your last name, your country and your points are shared with the league; you can delete them in Profile at any time. The app has no ads and no tracking.

SUBSCRIPTION
Hifzara Premium unlocks the full app. Yearly: 7 days free, then billed yearly. Monthly: billed monthly. Payment is charged to your Apple account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://kbhservices.dev/hifzara-privacy.html

**Review notes:**
Hifzara uses a hard paywall with a 7-day free trial on the yearly plan. Use a sandbox account to start the trial. The weekly league is served by our API at kbhservices.dev; small groups are filled with practice rivals that are labelled "Practice" in the app. No login is needed: a league account is created anonymously and can be deleted in Profile > League & privacy > Delete my league data.

**Screenshots (6.9", 1320×2868):** uploaded via the ASC API (APP_IPHONE_67): AppStore/marketing/en-US/01–06. See ASO.md for the research.

name: HopTizelda
description:
Hello, bunny people!

HopTizelda is a pocket hutch for everything about your rabbit. Add your bunny's name and birthday, and the meadow greets them by name every time you open it. Give their nose a boop while you're there.

Three little rounds a day
Feed, Clean, Groom. Tap one when it's done and it goes straight into the Care Diary, with a note if you like ("extra parsley, brushed tail"). The meadow shows how many of today's three rounds are finished, and day streaks keep count of how long you've kept them going.

A nudge at the right time
Turn on daily nudges and pick a time for each: a breakfast bell, a tidy-up reminder, a brush-and-cuddle call. Gentle, once a day, and easy to mute.

Vet Notes, kept tidy
Plan a visit with the clinic name, the reason (a check-up, a nail trim) and the questions you want to remember to ask. Mark it done afterwards and it moves to your history. These are your own personal records, not advice. Always follow your vet's guidance.

Weigh-ins with a trend line
Pop your bunny on the kitchen scale and log the number in grams or ounces. After two weigh-ins, a soft little chart shows the trend over time.

Two games for a happy break
Lily Hop: tap to hop from pad to drifting lily pad. Ride one for a moment, then jump before it carries you away. Reed banks are safe checkpoints.
Carrot Tug: Gus the gopher wants the giant carrot. Hammer the TUG! button to pull it your way before time runs out. He gets stronger every round, so watch for his sudden heaves.

Fresh from the Clover Post
Every day brings a new bunny fact. Did you know a group of rabbits can be called a fluffle? Each week there's a new pond goal for Lily Hop too, a number of pads to reach. No connection? The last post stays in the hutch.

Snug and private
Your diary, visits and weigh-ins live only on this iPhone. Nothing about you or your bunny is ever uploaded. It all works offline. No account, no ads, no in-app purchases. Boing sounds and haptic taps can each be switched on or off, and every list can be cleared whenever you want.

Now go give someone a cuddle. Binky!

name: Hörspur: Podcast Tracker
description:
Hörspur is your personal podcast tracker. Whether you listen in Spotify, Apple Podcasts or any other app – with Hörspur you always know which episodes you’ve already heard and which one is up next.

HOW IT WORKS
• Search and subscribe to podcasts – almost every podcast is available
• Check off episodes you’ve heard with one tap
• Mark all older episodes as heard at once
• “Today” shows you the next episode of every show
• Watchlist for podcasts you want to try

CALENDAR & CATCH-UP PLANNER
• See when your shows are likely to release new episodes
• The catch-up planner calculates when you’ll be caught up at your pace

STATS
• Listening hours, episodes and day streak
• Your top shows and favourite genres
• When you listen most – by weekday and month
• Stats for every year

NOTES & RATINGS
• Rate episodes with up to five stars
• Timestamped notes: remember what mattered at minute 12:34

YOUR STYLE
• Five themes: System, Light, Dark, Pitch black and Sepia
• English and German

PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your data stays on your device.

Note: Hörspur doesn’t play podcasts itself. Keep listening in your favourite app and keep track here.

name: HostCrew
description:
HostCrew is the staff app for hospitality teams: restaurants, cafés, hotels and event venues.

Your employer invites you; you sign in with the account they create for you. There is no public sign-up.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• See your schedule for today and the weeks ahead, with start and end times and your team
• Pass on your availability before the deadline, or set a fixed week once
• Request leave and see what is approved
• Check your worked hours
• Pick up open shifts with one tap ("I'll take it")
• Swap a shift with a colleague
• Read team news and chat with your team
• Clock in and out at work (when your employer uses it)

FOR MANAGERS
• Build and publish the schedule, see labour cost as you plan
• Approve leave, swaps and hours
• Advice per day from HorecaGPT: forecast, reservations and staffing

HostCrew is made by HorecaGPT B.V. in Nijmegen, the Netherlands.
Privacy: https://horecagpt.com/privacy
Delete your account: in the app under More → Delete account, or via https://horecagpt.com/account-verwijderen

name: Humanity Lifeline NADMEX
description:
Humanity Lifeline NADMEX is the exhibition edition of Humanity Lifeline.

Choose a preset status message, select a location on the map, and submit your message over an internet connection.

Features:
• Sign in, create an account, or continue as a guest.
• Browse preset status messages.
• Choose a location manually or use your device location with permission.
• Explore the bundled sample map.
• Use the app in English or Turkish.
• Read privacy and consent documents within the app.

This exhibition edition uses test messages. It does not replace emergency services. LifeLink, LoRa transmission, and SMS delivery are not available in this version.

name: İğnem: GLP-1 Dose Diary
description:
İğnem is a simple logbook for people on weight loss shots, written from the ground up. Doses come preset for Mounjaro, Ozempic, Wegovy and Saxenda; if your medication isn't listed, you can add it yourself.

The home screen answers three questions:
• When was my last shot?
• When is the next one?
• How much weight have I lost in total?

FEATURES
• Shot log: date, time, dose and injection site. Log it in two taps.
• Site rotation: shows the site you used last and suggests a different one for the next shot.
• Reminders: a notification on shot day, and another a few hours later if you forget to log it.
• Weight chart: your dose changes are marked on the curve.
• Side effect diary: nausea, constipation, fatigue and more, with severity from 1 to 3.
• Stock and cost: box price in your currency, doses left in the box, total spending and cost per kg.
• Apple Health: automatically imports the weight from your scale.
• Widget: days until your next shot and the weight you've lost, on your home screen.
• iCloud: your entries are backed up to your own iCloud account.
• CSV export: open all your entries in Excel, or take them to your doctor.

NO SUBSCRIPTION
Try it free for 7 days, then unlock it permanently with a one-time payment if you like it. Family Sharing is supported. Even after the trial ends, your past entries stay visible and can be exported.

PRIVACY
No account, no sign-in. Your data stays only on your device and in your own iCloud account. There is no analytics or advertising.

IMPORTANT
İğnem is a logbook; it does not suggest doses or give treatment advice. This app does not give medical advice. Consult your doctor for decisions about your treatment.

Mounjaro, Ozempic, Wegovy and Saxenda are registered trademarks of their respective owners; İğnem is not affiliated with these companies.

name: Jalokivipolku
description:
Sortering, der ligner en arbejdsdag.

Har du stået med en tom juiceflaske, en fedtet karton eller en knapcelle og vidst, hvad der skal gøre med den? Denne app gør de valg konkrette, så det bliver en vane, du bruger, næste gang du skal finde den rigtige beholder.

Sådan fungerer det

Du er på vagt i et kvarter med bygninger, gårde og lejligheder. Hver bygning indeholder genstande, der skal sorteres: pappkasser, flasker, tøj og batterier. Tryk på en genstand, gennemfør forberedelsen, hvis den kræver det, og send den derefter videre til det rigtige genbrugsområde.

Forberedelsen er kernen i oplevelsen. En flaske skal tømmes og skylles, en karton skal åbnes og fladtrykkes, en yoghurtbælter skal skrabe og skylles. Glemmer du forberedelsen, låser spillet valget for dig, indtil opgaven er gjort færdig. Du lærer dermed ikke kun, hvor noget hører hjem, men også hvorfor.

Det, der gør oplevelsen anderledes

En lastbil har begrænset plads. Hvert skift har sin egen kapacitet, og nogle ruter gennem kvarteret rummer færre genstande end andre. Overskrider du kapaciteten, er der ikke plads til de næste stop, og du må køre tilbage og tømme. Rækkefølgen af besøgene tæller altså lige så meget som sorteringen selv. Nogle bygninger skal besøges i en bestemt rækkefølge, fordi den nærmeste skal tømmes først.

Hver gennemført bygning giver et tip i logbogen. Tipsene beskriver konkrete arbejdsgange, der følger med niveau for niveau, så erfaringen bliver konkret og kan bruges i virkeligheden. Din indsats følges desuden af en samlet statistik over korrekte sorteringer, bedste forberedelsesresultat og bedste ruteplan.

Fire måder at træne på

Forberedelsestræneren gennemgår typiske situationer med klare spørgsmål og forklaringer, så du kan øve den del af arbejdet, der kræver mest omhygge. Rutelaboratoriet lader dig planlægge en kørselsrute, vælge rækkefølge på bygninger og teste, om lasten holder sig inden for kapaciteten. Sorteringsatlaset gennemgår hver materialetype med forklaringer, praktiske eksempler og typiske fejl. Logbogen samler de tips, du har låst, og viser dine resultater samlet.

20 bygninger og flere niveauer

Oplevelsen indeholder 20 bygninger spredt over et kvarter, fra gårde og terrasser til blokke, porte og broer. Hvert niveau introducerer en ny vinkel: forberedelse, batterier, besøgsrækkefølge, stram kapacitet, blandede materialer, større last og rolige afslutninger. Niveauerne låses op i rækkefølge, og din statistik og dine låste tips gemmes, så du kan fortsætte, hvor du slap.

Alt foregår offline på din enhed. Der er ingen konto, intet abonnement og intet krav om en forbindelse, mens du arbejder. Du kan åbne appen i en pause, øve et par genstande og lukke den igen, når du er færdig.

En lille, rolig træning, der gør hverdagens sortering en smule lettere.

name: JetLag Nav: Flight & Cruise
description:
JetLag Navigator is a 100% offline-capable travel companion designed to help reduce jet lag and smoothly adapt your body clock during international flights and long-distance cruises.

Key Features

1. Fully Offline Global Database
- Built-in database of 8,955 global airports (including elevation data) and ~3,000 ports plus cruise private islands.
- Works without internet or account login—calculate time zone differences and Daylight Saving Time (DST) even in Airplane Mode or at sea.
- Automatic high-altitude hydration guidance for destination airports above 1,000m.

2. Two Visual Timelines for Every Phase
- Circadian Adjustment Timeline: A vertical schedule from pre-departure to post-arrival with a real-time NOW indicator showing what to do right now.
- Parallel Time Tracks: View Caffeine, Light Exposure/Avoidance, Sleep/Nap, and Travel/Meals across 4 parallel lanes, with one-tap switching between departure and destination time zones.

3. Tailored by Seat Class & Cruise Mode
- Calculates light exposure, light avoidance, meal timing, caffeine cutoff, and rest windows based on your usual wake-up time and eastbound/westbound direction.
- Practical in-flight guidance tailored to Economy, Premium Economy, and Business Class.
- Cruise mode provides gradual Ship Time Shift guidance across multi-day ocean crossings.

4. Multi-Transit, 7 Languages & Local Notifications
- Supports direct trips as well as multi-stop transits and ports of call.
- Available in 7 languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, German, French, and Thai.
- Optional local notification reminders so you never miss key adjustment windows.

Note: This app provides general informational guidance on circadian rhythms and is not intended for medical diagnosis or treatment.

name: JMMove: Deliveries in Ghana.
description:
JMMove gets your things where they need to go, across Ghana.

Book a delivery in minutes
• Choose pickup and drop-off by typing an address, using your location, or tapping the map
• Add up to three more drop-offs on the same trip, each with its own receiver
• Pick the right vehicle: motorbike, aboboyaa (tricycle), car, van or truck
• See the price before you book, or offer your own price and let drivers respond
• Book now, or schedule a pickup for later
• Book again from a past delivery in one tap

Track every step
• Follow your driver on the map from pickup to drop-off
• Message or call your driver from the app, free over data
• Handover codes make sure your items reach the right person
• The receiver gets a text with a tracking link, no app needed
• See photos of your items at pickup and delivery

Pay your way
• Mobile money or card, handled securely by Paystack
• Or pay the driver in cash
• Thank your driver with a tip; all of it goes to them

Safe and simple
• Every driver confirms who they are with a live selfie and is approved by JMMove
• Rate your driver after each delivery
• Save Home, Work and other places for faster booking
• Help from the JMMove team, right in the app

name: KouKou: Hourly Group Photos
description:
KouKou is a day with your crew: one photo an hour, and a movie at the end.

Create a day and invite your people with a code or a link. Every hour, the clock goes koukou: the whole crew gets the notification at the same time and everyone takes their photo of the hour, right in the app. No camera roll, no retouching: the moment is what counts.

At the end of the day, your phone puts together your movie: all your photos, hour by hour, set to music composed for the occasion. Save it or share it as a story.

ONCE, OR EVERY WEEK
• All day long (6 AM to 6 AM the next day) or just some hours, even after midnight
• A single day, or every week on the days you choose, with the same crew
• Up to 9 people per day

AT NIGHT, WE SLEEP
• From 11 PM to 8 AM, koukous arrive silently: nobody gets woken up
• No photo? Kou, the mascot, snoozes in your place in the movie

YOUR MOVIE, MADE ON YOUR PHONE
• Vertical video ready for stories, plus a photo carousel
• Music composed for your day
• The movie is made on your phone, not on our servers

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
• No email, no password: just a first name
• Your photos are only visible to your crew
• They're deleted 30 days after the day, so save your movie!

Available in English, French, Spanish, German, Italian and Portuguese.

name: LoveMekey
description:
Find the words for the moments you overthink.

LoveMekey helps you reply in dating chats, new connections and everyday conversations. Paste the message you want help with, choose your voice, and get up to three reply ideas to review and make your own.

REPLY RIGHT WHERE YOU CHAT
Add LoveMekey in iPhone Keyboard Settings and switch to it in compatible text fields. Copy the other person's message, tap Paste message, generate suggestions and tap one to insert it. You decide what to send.

MAKE IT SOUND LIKE YOU
Choose from voices such as Just me, Warm heart, Quick wit, A little spark and Keep it kind. Adjust the scene, relationship, personality traits, closeness and goal in the app. Your saved choices also guide the keyboard's AI replies.

A LITTLE CONTEXT, WHEN YOU CHOOSE
Create optional chat nicknames and select the right one before replying. Only messages paired with replies you explicitly confirm as sent enter that chat's history. Recent confirmed turns can help the next reply stay on topic. One-off mode includes no chat history.

MORE WAYS TO WRITE
Polish a draft, find an opener, translate text, create a summary or pull out key points. You can also select a screenshot in the app and review text recognized on your iPhone before submitting it to AI.

TYPE YOUR WAY
Use English typing with local word suggestions, or Chinese pinyin with full-keyboard and nine-key layouts. Basic typing works offline. Replies follow the language of the supplied message; translation has its own target-language choice. The app interface is in English.

FREE DAILY WORDS, WITH ROOM FOR MORE
Free includes 5 AI generations per day. LoveMekey Pro includes 100 per day through a monthly or yearly auto-renewable subscription. Up to three reply, polish or opener suggestions count as one generation; other tools return one result. Allowances reset at 00:00 UTC and unused generations do not roll over.

YOUR WORDS. YOUR CHOICE.
AI uses text and optional confirmed history you deliberately submit, through our service to DeepSeek. Processing may take place outside your country, including in China. Review the provider disclosure and allow AI processing in the app first. AI in the keyboard also needs internet and Allow Full Access. Some apps and protected fields restrict third-party keyboards.

AI suggestions can make mistakes or assume facts you have not provided. Review and edit them before sending. LoveMekey does not identify your chat recipient or send messages automatically.

Apple sign-in is optional for free use and is required to connect a Pro membership. Localized subscription prices, duration and renewal terms are shown before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled through your Apple Account settings. You can restore purchases in the app.

Privacy: https://accounts.minmonkey.cn/lovemekey/privacy/
Terms: https://accounts.minmonkey.cn/lovemekey/terms/
Apple Standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Lucky Dragon Vegas
description:
Play Supply Spin, Storm Spin or Rescue Spin directly from the three cards at the top of the harbor. Free Play awards gold, fuel or parts and leaves your active expedition intact. There is no spin limit in Free Play.

Command Thor’s Thunderwing through tropical archipelagos and storm-torn seas. Answer distress signals, gather supplies and bring stranded companions home

Supply reels award fuel, parts and gold. Hold one reel between spins and tap BRAKE near the center of the timing bar for an extra combo. Each station gives three free spins; you can continue after the first

 Choose a safer, longer route or a shorter dangerous passage. Storm reels determine lightning, currents and treasure. Drag your ship around reefs, collect crates, and use your shield and dash tactically.

 Rescue reels supply hammers, shields and ropes. Match the right tool to each island obstacle, then recruit a new ally. Assign companions to Navigation or Medical to improve your next expedition.

Upgrade your engine for speed, infirmary for hull strength and hold for larger salvage rewards. Rescues unlock more distant islands. Progress saves automatically on this device.

All gold and rewards are fictional game resources. No purchases, deposits, cash prizes or cash-out. Random spins are adventure mechanics; every expedition can be completed through play.

name: Lumvi
description:
Lumvi is marketing for trades and local services, done for you. The app shows you everything we are doing for your business, wherever you are.

LEADS
People in local Facebook groups asking for exactly what you do, found for you twice a day. Open the post and reply in seconds.

JOBS
The work you have won, what it was worth and where each job came from.

CONTENT
Posts written and designed for your business, with your logo on the pictures, ready to go out to Facebook and Instagram. Plan a whole month in one go, or turn a photo of your own work into a post.

CALENDAR
What is going out and when.

WEBSITE
Your website, built for you. Ask for a change in plain words and see it before it goes live.

SEO
Where you rank on Google Maps against the businesses around you, and what to do about it.

ASK LUMVI
Questions about your business and your marketing, answered.

NOTIFICATIONS
A notification the moment new leads are found - tap it and they are in front of you.

Lumvi is for businesses that work with us. Sign in with your account, or create one to get started.

name: Lune - Calendário Menstrual
description:
O Lune acompanha a sua menstruação de um jeito simples, bonito e privado. Você registra os dias e o app mostra onde você está no ciclo, quando a próxima menstruação deve chegar e qual é a sua janela fértil estimada.

SEM ASSINATURA, SEM ANÚNCIO
Nada de plano mensal. Todos os recursos estão liberados.

SEUS DADOS SÃO SÓ SEUS
O Lune não tem conta, cadastro nem servidor próprio. O que você registra fica no seu iPhone e, se quiser, no SEU iCloud, para passar sozinho para um iPhone novo ou para o iPad. Ninguém mais vê, nem o desenvolvedor. Dá para desligar a sincronização nos Ajustes.

O QUE O LUNE FAZ
• Hoje: o dia do ciclo num anel colorido, a fase atual, quantos dias faltam para a próxima menstruação e a ovulação prevista.
• Calendário: menstruação registrada, menstruação prevista, janela fértil e ovulação estimadas, num toque.
• Registro do dia: fluxo, 1º e último dia da menstruação, sintomas, humor, relação, corrimento, sono, libido, atividade física, água, peso, temperatura e anotações.
• Sua semana: sugestões de treino, alimentação, disposição e humor para a fase em que você está.
• Histórico: duração média dos ciclos, regularidade, gráfico dos últimos ciclos e os seus padrões de sintomas (por exemplo, "dor de cabeça aparece em 4 de 5 ciclos, em média 2 dias antes da menstruação").
• Atraso: quando a menstruação passa da data, o app explica o que costuma causar atraso e quando vale fazer teste ou procurar um médico.
• Relatório para o médico: um resumo dos últimos ciclos, pronto para compartilhar na consulta.
• Treino: uma ficha semanal montada pelo app (em casa ou na academia, com ajuste para joelho, lombar e ombro), com execução série a série e descanso cronometrado.
• Lembretes no iPhone: no dia previsto, dois dias depois e 30 dias após a última menstruação, com modo discreto.
• Cor do app fixa ou mudando com a fase do ciclo, e temas nas datas comemorativas.
• Exportar e importar seus dados quando quiser.

DE ONDE VÊM AS INFORMAÇÕES
As previsões e as dicas de saúde foram conferidas contra fontes públicas (FIGO, NHS, ACOG, OMS e estudos científicos), listadas dentro do app.

IMPORTANTE
O Lune faz estimativas a partir dos seus próprios registros. Não é método contraceptivo, não faz diagnóstico e não substitui orientação médica.

name: Maekgul: Nameless Ronin
description:
A nameless ronin with nothing but a wooden sword. One day he will be a legend of the martial world.

[He fights on his own]
Your ronin hunts monsters automatically. Gold, materials and gear keep dropping while you watch, and keep piling up even while the app is closed. Come back and collect up to 24 hours of rewards.

[Gear up and see it]
Equip blades, sabers, spears, daggers and gauntlets. His clothes change from rags to golden robes as your gear grows. Forge, temper and awaken your equipment.

[Train and break through]
Raise your stats, learn martial arts and sect techniques, and face the trials of awakening to climb the realms of mastery.

[Explore the martial world]
Conquer regions one by one, climb the endless cave of Maekgul, hunt spirit beasts, and recruit companions who fight at your side.

- No sign-up needed. Optional Google or Apple sign-in to back up your progress.

name: Mahjong Sukjai Royal
description:
The monsoon rain had just cleared over the gilded rooftops of old Bangkok when Mali found the brass token tucked inside her grandmother’s lacquer box. Stamped upon its warm gold surface was a single crown and three words whispered only among late-night wanderers: Mahjong Sukjai Royal.

Following the scent of jasmine and roasting chilies down a lantern-lit alley, she pushed open a pair of carved teak doors and stepped into a world suspended in amber light. In the Grand Pavilion, ivory and emerald tiles clicked together like distant wind chimes. At the Mahjong Gold table, every matching symbol sent ripples of golden light across the felt, unlocking hidden cascades as if the tiles themselves remembered an ancient rhythm.

"Every chamber holds a different chapter of fortune," murmured the club’s caretaker, tipping his silk hat toward the glowing archways ahead.

Mali wandered deeper into the sanctuary. Beneath a dome of painted constellations, silver spheres tumbled down the pegs of Pearl Drop, chiming softly as they settled into velvet pockets. Beside the courtyard fountain, antique trinkets fused into radiant heirlooms inside the Treasure Merge workshop. Outside on the neon boulevard, the hum of Tuk-Tuk Rush carried the heartbeat of the midnight streets, while golden sparks rose from the sizzling iron pans of Wok & Roll.

As the hour grew late, she followed the paper lanterns up to the rooftop terrace, where the quiet leaves of Garden Party swayed beneath the dazzling bursts of the Starlight Festival. Every step along the six-hundred-mile Journey left a new emblem in her Vault and another keepsake upon her Collection shelf.

No gates were locked, and no coin of the outside world was ever asked for at the door—only curiosity, a steady hand, and the joy of watching the next golden tile fall into place. The velvet seat at the royal table is still warm. Step inside, and let the night begin.

Build a consistent devotional habit with the SOAP method — Scripture, Observation, Application, Prayer. Journal your reflections each day and track your streak on a simple calendar.

Read Scripture in multiple translations, follow a guided Bible reading plan, and save personal notes on any verse.

Stay connected to your church community: share prayer requests, see who's praying right now, mark your own prayer time on a live map, and keep up with events happening at your church.

Share encouragement through the community feed, keep sermon notes organized for later, and find a church near you.

Features:

• Scripture reading in multiple translations, with font-size controls and personal verse notes

name: Mote: Dust to Cosmos
description:
You begin as a quantum spark, the smallest thing there is. Tap to pull in matter and grow into a quark, an atom, a grain of dust, a rock, a planet and finally a star.

When your star dies, its mass decides what it becomes, just like in real astrophysics:

• White dwarf: pile on hydrogen without setting off a nova, all the way to the 1.4-sun Chandrasekhar limit.
• Creation: gather planets, then galaxies, grow civilizations and tune dark energy until you hold a whole universe.
• Neutron star: tap on the pulsar's beat to spin it faster, then collide neutron stars and forge gold.
• Black hole: feed it until it shines as a quasar and outweighs TON 618, the heaviest black hole known.

A GAME THAT GROWS WHILE YOU'RE AWAY
Early phases take minutes and reward tapping. Later ones take hours and days, and your objects keep growing while Mote is closed. Send comets on voyages, pick mutations, buy upgrades, and watch it all on your Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets and in the Dynamic Island.

REAL SCIENCE, PAINTED
Every one of the 28 phases is a hand-painted body, from quarks to superclusters, with real masses and a fact for every milestone you outgrow: heavier than Everest, than the Moon, than the Sun.

PLAY WITH EVERYONE
• Weekly Universe: a fresh race from dust every Monday, with special rules and its own leaderboard.
• Leaderboards for the world, your continent and your country.
• Galaxy of Fame: finish a fate and place your star in a galaxy shared by every player.
• Friends: compare with friends using a friend code.

FAIR BY DESIGN
Origins, from spark to star, is free. One purchase opens all four fates, every ending, the Weekly Universe and the leaderboards. Optional looks, skies and app icons are purely cosmetic. No ads, no subscriptions, no loot boxes and no speed-ups for sale.

name: Neesh Moments
description:
Neesh Moments is a quiet home for the places that mattered.

KEEP YOUR MEMORIES TOGETHER

MADE FOR NEESH TILES
Neesh is a small Australian studio making 3D-printed sandstone-style destination tiles for your wall. Neesh Moments is their companion: each Moment matches a tile at home. You don't need a tile to use the app.

name: Nestpot: Receipts & Budget
description:
Snap the receipt, share the bill.

Nestpot reads your receipts and invoices with the camera and keeps your household's shared expenses in one place. Who paid, who owes whom, and where this month's budget stands: all clear at a glance.

SNAP IT, NESTPOT FILLS IT IN
• Point the camera at a receipt or invoice. The amount, date, store and category are read right on your phone.
• Check what was read and fix anything before saving.
• Receipt reading happens entirely on your device with Apple Vision. Your photos are never sent to us.
• In Türkiye, QR codes on e-Arşiv and e-Fatura invoices are read too.

SHARED EXPENSES, ZERO ARGUMENTS
• Start a group with your partner, roommates or family and invite them with an iCloud share link.
• For each expense, pick who paid and how to split it: equally, by shares or by exact amounts.
• See balances instantly. "Settle up" suggests the fewest transfers to clear everything.
• Track a group budget together.
• Add people without an iPhone as "named members." Someone in the group keeps their entries.
• Joining someone else's group is always free.
• Nestpot never moves money. It shows who should pay whom.

RENT, BILLS, SUBSCRIPTIONS: NEVER MISS ONE
• Add your recurring payments once: rent, building fees, utilities, internet, subscriptions.
• Get a reminder before each due date. Tap "Paid" and the expense is recorded and the next date moves forward.
• Nestpot spots monthly payments in your past expenses and suggests them.

PERSONAL, WORK, HOME
• Three separate spaces, so work expenses never mix with the grocery run.
• Set a monthly budget per category and get notified at 80% and 100%.
• Charts: category breakdown, monthly trend and your top stores.
• Clear, rule-based saving tips built from changes in your spending.

PRIVACY

• Your data lives in your own iCloud account. Group data is shared only with the people you invite.

• No ads, no analytics, no tracking.

FREE (FOR ONE PERSON)

NESTPOT PRO
• Unlimited scans and spaces

• Unlimited recurring payments and reminders
