name: Origami - 3D Folding Guide
description:
Ever looked at a diagram in an origami book and had no idea how to make the next fold?
Origami guides you through every fold with 3D animations, one step at a time.
Rotate the paper to see each fold from the side or from behind. No account, no ads, and no internet connection needed to follow along.

FEATURES
• 3D animations: see how the paper folds at every step
• Rotate and zoom: view each fold from the angle you need
• Go at your own pace: move on, go back or pause whenever you like
• Plenty of models: crane, samurai helmet, paper plane, box, frog and more
• Three levels: start with the easy models and work your way up
• Choose your paper color: fold in the color you like
• A shelf for finished models: your Collection grows as you fold
• No account, no ads, no data collected: works offline except when buying Premium

MADE FOR YOU IF
• Diagrams in origami books are hard to follow
• Videos go too fast, and pausing and rewinding is a chore
• You’d like to relearn how to fold a crane or a paper plane
• You want to enjoy origami together as a family
• You want an app with no ads

IN DETAIL

■ One step at a time, in 3D animation
Watch each fold in 3D. Tap Next to move on or Back to return to the previous step. Drag the slider to move forward or backward through a fold and stop at any point. Each fold replays automatically, so you can watch it as often as you need.

■ Rotate, zoom and check
Drag to rotate the paper and pinch to zoom in or out. View each fold from the side, from behind or from any other angle.

■ The models
Choose from easy, medium and hard models. Fold a crane, samurai helmet, pinwheel or boat, or try a dog, cat, penguin, whale, dragon or pteranodon. There are paper planes, too. The box, balloon and fortune teller form three-dimensional shapes. Some models require Premium.

■ After you’ve folded
Finished models appear on your Collection shelf. The app adds faces to animal models. Turn music and sound effects on or off whenever you like.

■ Easy-to-follow instructions
Each step has one short sentence in plain English, with no origami jargon.

■ Pricing
Most models and the standard paper colors are free. Premium is a one-time in-app purchase that unlocks the remaining models and special papers such as gold, silver, shiny colors and Japanese patterns. Premium also lets you switch the app icon to a golden crane. There is no subscription. Premium supports Family Sharing, so one purchase covers the whole family. You only need an internet connection to buy Premium.

■ Privacy
No account is needed. The app collects no data and shows no ads.

FAQ
Q. Can I use it if I’ve never tried origami before?
A. Yes. Start with one of the easy models. Move through each step at your own pace, go back whenever you need to and rotate the paper to check a fold.

Q. How is it different from a book or a video?
A. Each fold is animated in 3D. You control when to move on and can rotate the paper to see it from any angle.

Q. What can I use for free?
A. Most models and the standard paper colors are free. The remaining models and the special papers require Premium, a one-time in-app purchase with no subscription.

Q. Does it work without an internet connection?
A. Yes. You only need an internet connection to buy Premium.

Q. Can I use it on iPad?
A. Yes. It works on both iPhone and iPad.

Q. If I stop partway through, where do I start next time?
A. Each model opens at the first step. Tap Next to move quickly to the step you reached.

Grab a sheet of paper and follow along, one fold at a time.

description:
Pearl is one app for the people you talk to and the things you do every day: chats and calls, a calendar, books, maps, wellness and the businesses you buy from.

Chats
• Talk one to one or in groups. Send photos, videos, voice notes, files, polls and your location.
• Tap a message to read it in your language. Translation runs on your device. For a language your device can’t translate, you can have Pearl’s server translate it.

Calls

Moments

Apps inside Pearl

Businesses

• Run your own business page with your shop or menu.

Privacy

• You can delete your account in the app.

name: Pickle Caller: Score & Pairs
description:
Pickle Caller keeps score for doubles pickleball and tells you who serves next.

Doubles scores are called with three numbers, like "4-2-1". When you are new to the game, it is easy to lose track of the score, the server number, and which side to serve from. With Pickle Caller, just tap the team that won each rally. The app shows the next call and who serves to whom.

- TAP THE TEAM THAT WON THE RALLY
• Tap the big button of the team that won the rally
• The app handles points, server changes, and side outs
• Tapped the wrong team? Undo as many times as you need

- SEE AND HEAR THE CALL
• The call (e.g. 4-2-1) is shown in large type and read aloud in English, Japanese, Korean, or Chinese
• The meaning of each number is shown below the call
• Turn the voice off at any time

- WHO SERVES FROM WHERE
• A top-down court diagram highlights the server and draws an arrow to the receiver
• When players switch sides after a point, just stand as shown

- MATCH SETTINGS AND HISTORY
• Play to 11, 15, or 21 (win by 2)
• Shows when it’s game point
• Rename the teams
• Finished matches are saved automatically with the date and score

- PAIRINGS FOR YOUR GROUP
• Enter the number of players (4–16) and courts (1–4) to create doubles pairings and a game order
• Rests rotate fairly, and the schedule avoids repeating partners and opponents where possible
• Tap the winning pair to build a standings table
• Add rounds later. Names are optional

- MADE FOR THE COURT
• No ads on the scoring screen during a match
• The screen stays on during a match
• Works offline. No account needed
• History and pairings stay on your iPhone

Supports traditional side-out scoring for doubles.

description:

TETAP JALAN WALAU INTERNET MATI
Data tersimpan di HP Anda, jadi kasir tetap bisa dipakai saat sinyal hilang.

FITUR UTAMA
- Kasir cepat, struk bisa dibagikan lewat WhatsApp atau disimpan sebagai PDF
- Produk dan resep, lengkap dengan harga pokok per porsi
- Stok dan stok opname, termasuk bahan baku
- Pembelian ke pemasok dan catatan utang pemasok
- Data pelanggan, poin, dan catatan piutang
- Open bill per meja dan layar pesanan untuk dapur
- Penjualan lewat aplikasi pesan antar, lengkap dengan potongan komisinya
- Karyawan, absensi, dan slip gaji
- Pembukuan otomatis: jurnal, laba rugi, dan neraca

- Hak akses per karyawan dengan PIN masing-masing

name: Relay24
seller_name: CLIENT CARE SOLUTIONS FOR TOURISM MANAGEMENT AND MARKETING
description:
Relay24 is the mobile app for teams that use Relay, the shared inbox for customer conversations. It is made for travel agencies and service businesses that answer customers on WhatsApp and on their website chat.

Your whole team works from one inbox:
• See every customer conversation in one place: yours, your team's and all.
• Reply with text, photos, files and voice messages.
• Claim a conversation by replying, and transfer it to a colleague with a reason.
• Track customer requests with deadlines and reminders.
• Answer WhatsApp and website voice calls. Calls ring like a normal phone call, even when the app is closed or the phone is locked.
• Get notified about new conversations, mentions and deadlines, and choose which ones you want.
• Supervisors see the team live and step in when a customer waits too long.

Relay24 requires a Relay company account. Your company manager adds you and gives you your sign-in.

name: Retro Club Short Track
description:
Retro Club Short Track is a pixel-art short track speed skating game.
Pick one of 8 clubs, enter the Cup and fight through the heats and the semi-final to win the final.
Simple controls let you speed up and change lanes, lean into corners, ride the slipstream, shove rivals and brace against their shoves.
Don't know the rules of short track? No problem. Learn the rules and the controls in the tutorial.

■ Cup: win the heats, the semi-final and the 6-lap final against 16 skaters, and collect Bronze, Silver and Gold trophies
■ Quick race: choose a 3-lap Sprint or a 6-lap Long race and chase your personal best
■ No upgrades, no gacha - just your skill

Choose from three difficulty levels (Easy, Normal, Hard). A Cup in progress is saved, so you can pick up where you left off.
Move and resize the on-screen buttons as you like, or play with a gamepad.
Play offline, in 13 languages including English, Korean, Japanese and Chinese.

Developer: JJJI STUDIO
Contact: contact@jjjistudio.com

name: Reunio: Church Management
description:
Reunio brings everything a church needs day to day into one app, for the staff and for the members.

FOR CHURCH STAFF
• Members: complete records with contact details, family, baptism and church history. Quick search and new members in seconds.
• Events and calendar: services, retreats and regular activities, always up to date.
• Attendance and check-in: members show the code on their card and attendance is recorded.
• Rosters and voting: organise service teams and assemblies.
• Congregations: churches with several congregations, each with its own access.
• Treasury: accounts, income and expenses by category, receipts and reports.
• Announcements: publish news and members receive a notification.
• Security: administrator access with two-step verification.

FOR MEMBERS
• Digital member card with Smart ID and QR code, ready to add to Apple Wallet.
• Church calendar, announcements and sermons.
• Prayer requests.
• History of your own giving, when the church allows it.
• Simple sign-in: Smart ID and date of birth, no password.

EASY TO START
Register your church in the app for free and invite your team. The Pro and Premium plans add modules and are arranged directly by the church.

Available in English, Portuguese and Spanish, in light and dark mode.

name: Soul RIP
description:
Soulfie is a Catholic prayer app for adults who want to keep their intentions close and pray for others.

Keep personal prayer intentions in one place, share requests with the Soulfie community, and support others in prayer. When a request allows responses, signed-in members can mark “I prayed” or “Mass offered.”

With advance prayer requests, you can prepare a request for the future and choose trusted contacts to receive it. Select contact review or scheduled publication. Dates are anticipated; Soulfie does not independently verify a death.

In Community Prayers, you can report posts and block authors.

Soulfie is designed for adults 18 and older.

name: Sparxtune
description:
Most affirmation apps read you a list of lines in a generic voice. This one doesn't.

Every session in Sparxtune is spoken by one person, start to finish: one continuous piece, never a list of quotes. Underneath each one runs a frequency, and you can see it measured in the app instead of simply being told it's there. Every session shows its exact length, to the second.

WHAT'S INSIDE

- 180+ guided affirmation sessions, in the same real human voice
- Deep Sessions, the longest, for the slower work
- Pure tones from 174 Hz to 963 Hz, with a timer and a binaural mode
- Recorded music tuned to the frequencies
- 3 complete sessions free, 5 more with your email

FOR YOU, RIGHT NOW

Wound up, wide awake, small, squeezed, foggy: tell the app how you feel and it takes you straight to the right session.

MEASURED, NOT PROMISED

Every frequency track was analysed and shows its own measurement. Most apps announce their hertz. This one shows you.

NIGHT MODE

Loop a session, set a 20-minute timer, or let it play all night.

A DAILY REMINDER

Pick your time. It arrives whether the app is open or not.

NO ADS

Your streak, your favorites and your own lines stay on your device. No advertising, ever, and nothing sold to anyone.

SPARXTUNE PREMIUM

Unlock every session with a monthly or yearly subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://sparxtune.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://sparxtune.com/privacy

Sparxtune is for relaxation and personal development. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat or cure any condition.

name: Stadspas079
description:
Ontdek acties in Zoetermeer, bekijk je tegoed en gebruik je digitale pas bij alle deelnemende locaties.

Met de Stadspas079 app ontdek je wat er in Zoetermeer te doen is. Je ziet acties bij sport, cultuur, horeca en uitjes. Heb je tegoed op je pas? Dan zie je in de app eenvoudig hoeveel je hebt en waar je het kunt gebruiken.

In de app staat jouw digitale pas. Laat deze scannen bij deelnemende locaties om acties te gebruiken of tegoed te besteden. Je ziet ook wat je eerder hebt gedaan en welke plekken je hebt bezocht.

De app helpt je om jouw stad beter te leren kennen. Maak een wensenlijstje met activiteiten die je wilt proberen en ontdek nieuw aanbod in jouw stad. Het aanbod groeit het hele jaar door, met steeds nieuwe acties en partners.

Voor oude bekenden en nieuwe favorieten. Een app voor jou, je buurvrouw of je opa.

name: Stilo
description:
مرحباً بك في ستيلو للشوكولاتة الفاخرة.

اكتشف تشكيلة مميزة من الشوكولاتة الفاخرة المصممة لتناسب أجمل مناسباتك.

نقدم لك:
- أهرام الشوكولاتة بتصاميم راقية.
- تشكيلات الشوكولاتة للمناسبات.
- توزيعات ستيلو المميزة.
- علب الهدايا الفاخرة.
- باقات الشوكولاتة والورود.
- طلبات الشوكولاتة بالكيلو مع إمكانية اختيار النوع والكمية.

لماذا ستيلو؟
- تصاميم أنيقة ولمسات فاخرة.
- خيارات متنوعة تناسب مختلف المناسبات.
- سهولة تصفح المنتجات والأسعار.
- تجربة طلب سهلة ومريحة.

التوصيل والدفع:
نوفر خدمة التوصيل داخل الطائف، مع إمكانية تنسيق التوصيل للمدن الأخرى عبر التواصل معنا.

ستيلو، لأن لكل مناسبة مذاقاً من الفخامة.

حمّل التطبيق واستمتع بتجربة ستيلو.

name: Stundenschlag
description:
Jede volle Stunde läutet die Glocke. Auf der ganzen Welt. Gleichzeitig.

Stundenschlag ist ein Backyard Ultra zum Mitlaufen von überall: Zur vollen Stunde startest du an deiner Basis – Haustür, Parktor, Straßenecke – und läufst eine Runde von 6,706 Kilometern. Bist du vor der nächsten Glocke zurück, darfst du weiter. Zu spät? Raus. Es gibt kein Ziel: Wer am längsten durchhält, gewinnt. 24 Stunden ergeben 100 Meilen.

SO FUNKTIONIERT'S
• Basis festlegen: Die App misst deinen Startpunkt per GPS.
• Runde planen: Tippe Wendepunkte auf die Karte – die App verbindet sie über Fußwege zu genau einem Yard (6,706 km) und setzt alle 200 m eine Wegmarke.
• Probe-Yard: Lauf die Runde einmal. Die App prüft sie wie im Rennen und zertifiziert sie.
• Check-in: Am Renntag bestätigst du ab 30 Minuten vor der ersten Glocke, dass du an deiner Basis stehst.
• Glocke: Drei Minuten vorher pfeift es, dann läutet die Glocke – auch bei gesperrtem Handy.

GPS-SCHUTZ
GPS misst auf kurvigen Wegen oft ein paar Prozent zu kurz. Auf deiner zertifizierten Runde ist das egal: Passierst du die Wegmarken in der richtigen Reihenfolge, zählt der Yard voll – 6,706 km, wie bei jedem Backyard. Fahrzeuge und gefälschte Positionen erkennt die App automatisch. Keine Rennleitung, keine Einsprüche – gleiche Regeln für alle.

UNTERWEGS
• Restzeit, Kilometer, Pace und Puffer auf dem Sperrbildschirm und in der Dynamic Island
• Das Feld live: wer noch läuft, welches Land vorne liegt – und Anfeuern per Fingertipp
• Crew: Bis zu fünf Leute sehen, wo du bist, und bekommen deine Wünsche („Trockene Socken“, „Brühe“)
• Notruf-Knopf: Deine Crew sieht den Notruf mit deiner Position

KOSTENLOS. KEIN PREISGELD. NUR RUHM.
Wer gewinnt, kommt in die Hall of Fame. Für alle anderen gibt es Abzeichen: Erste Glocke, Halbmarathon, Ultra, 100 km, 100 Meilen.

Teilnahme ab 18 Jahren, auf eigene Gefahr. Die App ersetzt keinen Rettungsdienst – im Notfall 112.

name: TeleDeck: IPTV Playlist Player
description:
TeleDeck plays the IPTV playlists you already have. Add an M3U or M3U8 link, a playlist file, or your provider's login, and watch your channels with a clean, fast player and a full TV guide.

TeleDeck does not include any channels, streams or subscriptions. You need your own playlist from a provider you are entitled to use.

SET UP IN SECONDS
• Add a playlist link, a playlist file, or a server login (username and password)
• Wi-Fi setup: open a page on your computer and paste your link there – no typing long addresses on the phone
• Keep several playlists side by side

WATCH YOUR WAY
• Channels sorted by group, with search, favourites and recently watched
• Picture-in-picture and AirPlay
• Audio track and subtitle selection
• Audio-only mode for radio and music streams
• Sleep timer and quick channel switching
• Plays HLS, MP4, TS, MKV and more, with an automatic fallback engine

TV GUIDE
• XMLTV guide support (also compressed files)
• See what's on now and next for every channel
• Programme reminders: get a notification 5 minutes before a show starts

HEALTH CHECK
• Test every channel in a playlist and see which ones are offline
• Hide offline channels with one tap

FAMILY
• Lock channel groups with a parental PIN

TELEDECK PRO
• No ads
• Unlimited playlists and reminders
• Multi-view: watch two channels at once
Pro is available as a one-time lifetime purchase or a yearly subscription. The yearly plan renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage it in your App Store account settings.

Available in 13 languages.

Privacy policy: https://imrashid.net/page/teledeck-privacy-policy
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: ThrowTrack
description:
Know your throws. Build your disc bag.

ThrowTrack is a disc golf companion for iPhone. Mark where you throw, walk to your disc and save the GPS distance. Review your throw history and statistics, organise your discs and explore the included course catalogue.

MEASURE YOUR THROWS
Record start and finish positions and see the straight-line distance with an estimate of GPS uncertainty. GPS accuracy depends on the surroundings and satellite reception. Distances are estimates, not measurements of the disc’s flight path.

MANAGE YOUR DISC BAG
Add and edit your discs, choose models from the included catalogue or enter your own. Photograph a readable disc stamp to receive model suggestions from on-device text recognition. Check and confirm each suggestion before saving; the scanner does not identify an unmarked disc by its shape.

HISTORY AND COURSES
Review saved throws, filter by disc and follow your statistics. Browse the bundled course catalogue and view available course information and maps. Course information may be incomplete or outdated.

YOUR DATA, YOUR CONTROL
Your disc bag and throw history are stored on your phone. Export a backup file and import it later. No account, advertising, subscriptions or in-app purchases. Apple Maps uses Apple’s services when loading maps.

Includes language choices and light or dark appearance. Location access is used for throw measurements; camera access is used only when you choose to scan a disc.

name: Thunder Pigeon
description:
Thunder Pigeon turns revision into ten quick questions a day.

Each topic is a set of things to learn: facts, key words and how-tos. Every one can be asked several ways (flashcards, multiple choice, fill the gap, typed answers, put the steps in order). Anything you get wrong is asked again at the end of the ten. Things you find hard come back sooner, and things you know still turn up now and then so they stay known.

A topic goes in steps:
- Learn it: read through the topic one thing at a time, with memory hooks.
- Practise: quick studies of ten questions until you know it all.
- Boss round: exam questions you mark yourself.
- Keep it: it comes back every so often, so you don't lose it.

Got a test coming? Add it. For the two weeks before, your home screen says what to do each day, and there are flashcards and a quick-fire quiz for the last look.

Your companion is a pigeon. It reacts to every answer, brings something back from every quick study (a spoon, a bolt, an odd sock) and picks up abilities as you level up. When a test is coming it charges up. Streaks, combos and finds keep it moving, with no leaderboards and no adverts. Get six in ten right by the end of a quick study or a quick-fire quiz and there's a short game to play.

Parents add the topics (with help from Claude if they like), add tests too, and see which things each child has learned and which ones they're stuck on. A child's phone is linked with a six-digit code from their parent.

name: Tiger Shield: Scam & Malware
description:
TIGER SHIELD — your Royal Bengal guard against scams
Scam, phishing and fake-link protection for iPhone and iPad, by Fred Intelligence Limited, Bangladesh.

Scammers write in your language, use the names of banks and mobile-money services, and push you to hurry. Tiger Shield helps you stop and check — before you tap, pay or share a code.

CHECK BEFORE YOU TRUST
• Link, number and SMS check — paste anything suspicious and get a clear answer and what to do now.
• Explain with AI — not sure? Tap once and our AI explains in plain Bangla, Hindi or English why a message may be a scam. It runs on our own servers; the message is not stored and is never sent to any other AI company. AI can make mistakes, so the result is guidance, not a guarantee.
• Fake bank and mobile-money sites — warns when a link pretends to be a bank, a mobile-money service or a phone operator but is not their official website.
• Online scam database — when you are signed in, checks also use our threat database of known malware and phishing sites, scam numbers and fraud SMS patterns.
• QR code check — scan with the camera or pick a screenshot.
• Share to check — share a link, message or QR picture from any app.

PROTECTION ON YOUR IPHONE
• Scam SMS filter — moves high-risk messages from unknown senders to Junk. Checked on your phone only.
• Scam call blocking — numbers reported by several users are blocked by iOS; official helplines are labelled.
• Safari blocker — blocks known tracker and ad domains in Safari.
• Encrypted DNS — blocks known phishing, malware, tracker and ad domains in every app. Official bank and mobile-money sites are never blocked. The domains you visit are not stored.
• Scan now — one tap checks every protection and shows what still needs turning on.

PERSONAL VAULT
• Keep private photos and PDF documents locked with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode.
• Encrypted and kept only on your device — never sent to us.
• Optional backup file protected by a password you choose.

IF YOU WERE SCAMMED
• Step-by-step: what to do right now.
• One tap to call official helplines (in Bangladesh: bKash 16247, Nagad 16167, Rocket 16216, Upay 16268, emergency 999).
• Learn the most common scams and how to spot them.

SECURITY TOOLS
• Device safety checklist.
• Password leak check — your password never leaves your phone; only the first 5 characters of its hash are checked.
• Strong password generator.

WHAT IPHONE DOES NOT ALLOW
Apple does not let any app scan other apps, lock apps, read your notifications or scan your files on iPhone or iPad, so Tiger Shield does not claim to do those things.

Important: Tiger Shield is an independent app by Fred Intelligence Limited. It is not the official app of any bank, mobile-money service, phone operator or government body. No security app can catch every scam — never share your PIN, OTP or password with anyone.

বাংলায়: টাইগার শিল্ড — সন্দেহজনক লিংক, নম্বর ও SMS যাচাই, AI দিয়ে সহজ বাংলায় ব্যাখ্যা, স্ক্যাম SMS ও কল ব্লক, নকল ব্যাংক/MFS সাইট ধরা, Face ID দিয়ে তালাবদ্ধ পার্সোনাল ভল্ট। বাংলাদেশে তৈরি, Fred Intelligence Limited-এর। PIN বা OTP কাউকে দেবেন না।

Privacy policy: https://fredbd.com/privacy.html

name: Tiny Tank: Cozy Aquarium
description:
Tiny Tank is a cozy, living planted aquarium for your iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV. Every plant, stone and fish sits in real water: light ripples across the leaves, the far side of the tank fades into blue haze, and the room you chose glows softly through the glass.

A TANK THAT FEELS ALIVE
• 33 fish species, 5 kinds of shrimp and 5 kinds of snails, each with its own behaviour and real swimming speed. Neons and rummy-noses school tightly, corydoras root through the gravel and dash up for air, plecos cling to the glass and come out at night.
• Shrimp pick at stones and driftwood, snails glide over every surface and pull into their shells when you knock on the glass.
• Turn the tank light off and the fish slow down and rest.
• Little moments happen on their own: a courting guppy, a school circling, shrimp chasing each other.

CARE FOR IT LIKE A REAL TANK
• Fish get hungry in real time, even while the app is closed. Feed them flakes, sinking pellets or algae wafers.
• New fish arrive as fry and grow to full size in about two hours of good feeding.
• Waste builds up and the water clouds over. Siphon the gravel and change the water, or the fish turn listless and start to die.
• Well-kept fish may breed; a few species might jump out overnight.
• Come back to a short "while you were away" report and keep your daily care streak going. Room for more fish opens up each day you return, up to 100.

MAKE IT YOURS
• 30 aquascape layouts, from iwagumi stone gardens to Dutch planted tanks and Amazon biotopes.
• Arrange stones, driftwood and plants yourself; every layout remembers your changes.
• 4 light fixtures in 8 colours with a dimmer, 6 tank builds, 3 cabinet finishes.
• Real equipment: hang-on-back filter, canister filter with lily pipes, heater, chiller with a live temperature display, CO2 diffuser and an air stone, each with its own current and sound.
• 18 rooms (living room, Japanese room, café, greenhouse, AI lab and more), each at morning, noon, afternoon and night, or following your clock.

RELAX
• 11 calm soundtracks, including four for meditation and slow breathing.
• Hide the interface and let the tank run as a living picture.

ON EVERY SCREEN
• iPhone and iPad: tap a fish to learn about it, tap the glass to startle the school, drag decor around, pinch to resize. Take a photo of your tank and share it.
• iPad keyboard shortcuts for every action.
• Mac: the tank lives in a window or fills the screen. Move the pointer and the fish come to look, click to feed, scroll to resize decor, and find every action in the menu bar.
• Apple TV: the tank fills the screen. Swipe on the Siri Remote to guide the fish, click to feed or to place decor.

In English and Vietnamese. No ads. No account. Your tank is saved on your device.

name: Treadlock: Walk to Unlock Apps
description:
Treadlock puts one rule on the apps that eat your evenings: they open while you walk, and lock again when you stop.

You bought a walking pad or a treadmill to move more, and the evenings still go to the couch and the feed. Treadlock makes the walk the price of the scroll. Pick TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Netflix or any other app, group them into a lock, and Treadlock shields them with Screen Time. Step on, start walking, tap Open on the shield, and the app is yours.

NOTHING TO BANK
Other step apps turn the day's steps into minutes you spend later, so by evening the errands have already paid for the scrolling. Treadlock has no bank. Access depends on walking right now:
- No earned minutes, no points, no daily allowance
- No override button, no timer, no schedule to edit
- Stop walking, and the shield returns 30 seconds after your last step, at the next Screen Time check (usually within a minute and a half)

HOW IT WORKS
- Choose apps or whole categories in Apple's own Screen Time picker
- Walk with your iPhone in your hand or pocket: Treadlock reads its step counter
- Tap Open on the shield while you walk, and the app opens right there
- Turn on a warning that arrives 30 seconds before your apps lock, so you can keep walking

LOCKS AND WALKS
- Group apps into locks and turn each lock on or off separately
- See whether you are walking, your steps per minute and today's open minutes
- The Walks tab keeps every walk with its time, duration and steps

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no server. Screen Time gives Treadlock opaque tokens, never the names of your apps. Your locks and walks stay on your iPhone, and steps never leave it.

FREE AND PRO
Free: one lock with up to 3 apps or categories, and the last 7 days of walks. The rule itself is never limited.
Treadlock Pro (auto-renewing weekly, monthly or yearly subscription; the yearly plan starts with a 3-day free trial): unlimited locks, any number of apps in a lock, and your full walking history.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple ID account settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

Treadlock needs Screen Time and Motion & Fitness access to work.

Terms of use: https://ozapplab.com/treadlock/terms
Privacy policy: https://ozapplab.com/treadlock/privacy-policy

name: Unlimited Faxing
description:
Unlimited Faxing is free to download and use. It puts online fax on your iPhone.

• Send faxes: choose a PDF or TIFF from Files, enter the fax number, pick your caller ID, and send.
• Inbox and Sent: see received and sent faxes and open them in the built-in fax viewer. Share or save the file from there.
• Free tools: make a fax cover sheet, and edit a PDF on your phone.
• E-signature: open a PDF, then tap the page to place your signature, text, or notes. Reorder or delete pages, then save the file.
• Sign in with your Unlimited Faxing account. Create a free account from the app if you don't have one yet.

This listing does not describe paid plans or any purchase outside the App Store.

name: uSandFlipSync
description:
Kuvittele rivi tiimalaseja lämpimällä kivihyllyllä. Yksi on korkea ja lähes täynnä. Toinen on matala ja melkein tyhjä. Kolmas on jossain niiden välissä, ja sen lasissa on halkeama, josta hiekkaa valuu hiljalleen. Tehtävänäsi on saada kaikkien tiimalasien hiekka loppumaan täsmälleen samaan aikaan.

Se onnistuu kääntämällä tiimalaseja yksi napautus kerrallaan.

Kun käännät tiimalasin, sen hiekan määrä vaihtuu: jo valunut hiekka muuttuu jäljellä olevaksi hiekaksi. Siksi jokaisen käännön ajoituksella on merkitystä. Ruudun yläreunassa kulkee aurinkokellon kaltainen aikajana. Kultainen hiekanjyvä näyttää, milloin tiimalasi tyhjenee, jos annat sen olla rauhassa. Ontto rengas puolestaan näyttää, milloin se tyhjenisi, jos kääntäisit sen juuri nyt. Seuraa renkaiden liikettä, odota oikeaa hetkeä ja napauta. Kun kaikki kultaiset jyvät osuvat synkronointialueelle ja viimeiset hiekanjyvät putoavat yhtä aikaa, tehtävä on suoritettu.

Reitillä on 48 etappia, ja joka kahdeksannen etapin jälkeen odottaa keidas. Jokainen pulma on suunniteltu toimivan ratkaisun pohjalta, joten mikään niistä ei johda umpikujaan. Tähtiä ansaitset tarkalla ajoituksella ja mahdollisimman vähillä napautuksilla. Aavikko tuo matkan varrella mukaan uusia haasteita:

- Haljenneet tiimalasit menettävät hiekkaa hiljalleen.
- Toisiinsa köytetyt tiimalasit kääntyvät yhdessä.
- Joitakin tiimalaseja voi kääntää vain kaksi kertaa.

Päivittäinen karavaani tarjoaa joka päivä uuden etapin, joka on sama kaikille pelaajille. Sillä on oma tulostaulunsa kaikkien aikojen tulostaulun rinnalla. Saat automaattisesti luodun matkailijanimen, joten sinun ei tarvitse kirjoittaa mitään.

Hiekka koostuu tuhansista pienistä jyvistä, ja jokainen käännös pyöräyttää tiimalasin ympäri miellyttävän napakalla liikkeellä. Taustalla soivat oudin sävelet, darbukan rytmit ja hiljainen hiekan kahina. Haptinen palaute tuo hiekan virtauksen tuntuman sormenpäihisi.

Ei käyttäjätiliä, mainoksia tai sovelluksen sisäisiä ostoksia. Pelin edistyminen tallentuu automaattisesti. Rivi tiimalaseja, ripaus kärsivällisyyttä ja yksi täydellinen hetki.

name: Velvelt Herald
description:
Velvet Herald is your personal host for beautifully spent evenings. Turn your free time into a little story filled with cozy rituals, thoughtful conversations, and imaginative activities.

Spend an evening on your own, with someone special, or among friends. Choose your mood, set the time you have, and select the things available at home. Velvet Herald brings them together in a guided plan — from tea and reading to creative challenges and shared memories.

• An evening made for you. Find activities that fit your mood and available time. Replace individual steps and save your favorite plans.

• Treasures already at home. Put your tea, books, paper, music, and board games to thoughtful use.

• Personal invitations. Give each guest a special role and share their invitation. A keeper of melodies or a collector of stories — everyone brings something to the evening.

• Step-by-step guidance. Activity prompts and chapter timers help you enjoy your plan at your own pace.

• A chronicle of memories. Keep a record of completed evenings with photos and personal notes.

• Meaningful insights. Explore your evening count, the moods you have enjoyed, and the planned time dedicated to completed experiences.

• Your personal residence. Add a profile photo and unlock new titles as your chronicle grows.

Burgundy velvet, golden details, and fantasy-inspired illustrations set the scene on iPhone and iPad.

Make tonight a story worth keeping.

name: WattWise Pro
description: WattWise tracks home appliance power use and bill forecasts. Offline utility tool with no account.

name: Where Is My Money
description:
Where Is My Money ti dice dove vanno i tuoi soldi e quanto puoi ancora spendere, senza fogli di calcolo.

SEGNARE UNA SPESA È VELOCE
Tocca + e scrivi come parli: "pizza 18,50 ristorante". L'app riconosce importo, categoria e conto. Oppure scegli tutto a mano.

UN BUDGET CHE TI RISPONDE
Imposti quanto vuoi spendere per casa, spesa, uscite. L'app ti dice quanto ti resta, quanto al giorno fino a fine mese e se stai andando troppo in fretta.

QUANTO PUOI PERMETTERTI OGGI
Tiene conto di stipendio, affitto e abbonamenti in arrivo, e ti mostra giorno per giorno come andrà il conto fino a fine mese.

RISPARMI CON UN PIANO
Fondo emergenza, viaggio, investimenti: per ogni obiettivo vedi quanto mettere via al mese e se il piano regge con quello che ti avanza davvero.

PATRIMONIO E MOVIMENTI
Tutti i conti in un posto: corrente, contanti, deposito, carta di credito. Cerchi, filtri per categoria o conto, e vedi l'andamento mese per mese.

I TUOI DATI RESTANO SUL TUO IPHONE
Nessun account, nessun server, nessuna pubblicità. Niente esce dal telefono. Per non perdere nulla, esporti un backup in File o iCloud quando vuoi e lo ripristini su un altro iPhone.

name: WorkPocket
description:
Document jobs as you work. Organize tasks, capture before and after photos, and share a PDF report from your iPhone.

Keep visit details, notes, task status, and photo captions together. Take photos in the app or add them from your photo library. Preview your report before sharing it. Your workspace stays on your iPhone, and no WorkPocket account is required.

WorkPocket Pro is a one-time purchase that unlocks photo markup, custom business branding, more PDF export options, and a saved PDF history.

name: worldband
description:
Live radio on a real Earth.

worldband puts over 48,000 radio stations from more than 220 countries on a satellite globe, each one where it broadcasts. Spin the Earth, zoom into a city, and pick a light to hear it live.

EVERY LIGHT IS A STATION
Zoom into any city to find its stations, from KEXP in Seattle to FIP in Paris and NHK in Tokyo. Search by name, place, language or genre, or browse every country.

GENRES AND RANDOM
Browse by genre, or press Random. With the purchase, choose a genre, language, country or sound quality for Random to play from.

NEVER STUCK ON SILENCE
Stations go off air or change their streams. When one doesn't play, worldband switches back to the last one and tells you.

ON EVERY SCREEN
• iPhone and iPad: the map with a panel like Maps, and playback on the Lock Screen and in Control Center. The purchase adds Today's Earth, widgets and iCloud sync.
• Mac: the globe in a window, and the radio in the menu bar when you close it, with keyboard shortcuts for changing stations.
• Apple TV: the satellite map fills the screen and follows what's playing, with your stations down the side.

FREE TO TRY
A dozen famous stations are free, like BBC World Service, KEXP, FIP and triple j, along with the globe, search and favorites. One purchase of $9.99 unlocks every other station on iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV. No subscription, no account, no ads, no tracking.

Stations come from Radio Browser, a free public directory, and stream straight from each broadcaster. The list updates every week.

name: WTManager
Wynds: There's a Wyn for that
description:
There’s a Wyn for that.

Every café and restaurant on Wynds has its own Wyn: a friendly character that knows the place. Ask it anything and it answers from the place itself.

ASK
Busy right now? Anything vegan? Open late? Parking? Ask any place nearby and get a straight answer, not a list of reviews.

BOOK
Say how many and when. The Wyn checks with you, then holds your table.

ORDER FROM YOUR TABLE
Scan the code on the table, pick what you want, and it goes straight to the counter. Follow it on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island: sent, being made, ready. Pay at the counter when you’re done. No app needed: the code opens Wynds instantly.

FIND WHAT’S AROUND YOU
Coffee, desserts, quick bites, late-night food: see what’s open near you on the map, with the places’ own Wyns.

Wynds is starting in Madhapur, Hitech City and Gachibowli in Hyderabad, with more places joining every week.

Own a place? Bring it to Wynds at studio.wynds.app.

name: YKS Tarih Kartları
description:
YKS Tarih, TYT, AYT;  9, 10, 11 ve 12. sınıf tarih konularını ünite sırasıyla çalışman için hazırlandı.

Konu özetleri Üniteleri sayfa sayfa, defter gibi oku. Okuduğun sayfalar kaydedilir.

Hap notlar Kısa ve ayırt edici bilgiler. Okuduklarını işaretleyebilirsin.

Son tekrar Sınav öncesi maddeli hatırlatma.

Çalışma kartları Kartın önünde soru, arkasında cevap vardır. Bildiğini ve tekrar edeceğini ayırırsın. Günün kartları, kaydedilenler ve tekrar destesi ayrı durur.

Konu testleri Yalnızca çoktan seçmeli sorular. Konuyu ve soru sayısını seçersin. Cevabı o anda ya da test sonunda görebilirsin.

Deneme sınavları TYT, AYT Tarih-1 ve AYT Tarih-2 denemeleri. Süre tutar, sorular arasında gezebilir ve sonunda sonucunu görürsün.

İlerleme Ünite ilerlemen, çalışma serin ve çözüm istatistiklerin profilde durur.

name: Yuzu: Logic Games & Puzzles
description:
Twenty-nine logic games, and a plush Shiba to play them with.

Yuzu is a toy dog who comes alive when nobody is looking. He fell out of a backpack in the park, and the way home is a long blue thread. Play with him, win blue buttons, and walk him home through the playground, the market, the fountain, the toy shop and the gardens.

AGAINST YUZU: 15 GAMES
He thinks, barks his move, sulks when he loses and waves when he wins.
• Four in a Row, Five in a Row, Three in a Row
• Flip (the classic of turning stones) and Bowls (sow the kibble round the board)
• Last Biscuit and Last Bone: take in turn, the last one decides
• Yuzu's Secret: work out the row of toys he buried
• Pairs, Hide and Seek, Fences, Chomp, Blockade, Planks and Don't Make Three

WITH YUZU: 14 GAMES
He sits beside you and sniffs, cheers and sleeps.
• Bone Hunt: dig, and every number says how far the nearest bone is
• Bedtime: put out the lamps so he can sleep
• Toy Boxes, Paw Picture, Puddles: grids with one answer, reasoned out
• Yarn Sort, Slide, Bowl Stack, Jump, Leapfrog, Blue Thread
• Copy Yuzu, Double Up and Three Cups

THREE LEVELS IN EVERY GAME
Easy teaches: it shows his threats, rules out impossible squares and says whether a move is good. Hard does not forgive. On Hard in Four in a Row he looks up to nine moves ahead.

EVERY DAY
Today's garden and today's secret: one puzzle a day, the same for everyone.

MORE TO COME BACK FOR
• Seven painted places on the way home
• Twelve stickers to earn, and your score in every game
• Undo, hints and a how-to card in every game

FREE TO PLAY
Every game and every level is free. Ads appear only between games, never during one, and never in your first games. You can watch a short video for one more hint, or to double the blue buttons after a win.

YUZU PLUS
One purchase, not a subscription: no ads between games, hints that never run out, and double blue buttons with one tap.

No account. Your scores stay on your iPhone.

Privacy Policy: https://saith96.github.io/yuzu-site/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://saith96.github.io/yuzu-site/terms.html

name: Zulassung STD – Stade
description:
Ihre Kfz-Zulassung in Stade – bequem vom Handy aus.

Fotografieren Sie Fahrzeugschein, Fahrzeugbrief und Ausweis, senden Sie den Antrag ab und wir erledigen den Rest bei der Zulassungsstelle. Sie müssen nicht vorbeikommen und nicht warten.

• Anmelden, Ummelden / Halterwechsel, Abmelden
• Wunschkennzeichen
• Kennzeichen-Schilder
• Stand Ihres Auftrags in Prozent
• Mitteilung aufs Handy, sobald Ihr Auftrag fertig ist – mit dem Betrag, der bei Abholung zu zahlen ist
• WhatsApp und Anruf direkt aus der App

Abholung: Carl-Benz-Str. 6, Stade
Montag bis Freitag 8:30–16:30 Uhr

Zulassungsservice STD – Zulassungen und Schilderdruck aller Art.

name: מעקב עוסק פטור
description:
מעקב עוסק פטור הוא כלי פשוט לעצמאים בישראל לרישום הכנסות והוצאות ולמעקב אחר תקרת המחזור השנתית של עוסק פטור.

מה האפליקציה מאפשרת:
- רישום מהיר של הכנסה או הוצאה עם סכום, תיאור ותאריך.
- סיכום חודשי ושנתי של הכנסות, הוצאות ורווח.
- מעקב אחר ההתקדמות מול תקרת העוסק הפטור (ברירת מחדל לשנת 2026, ניתנת לעריכה בהגדרות).
- ייצוא כל הרשומות לקובץ CSV לשיתוף עם רואה החשבון.
- ממשק מלא בעברית, מימין לשמאל.

פרטיות מלאה: כל הנתונים נשמרים במכשיר שלכם בלבד. האפליקציה אינה דורשת חשבון, אינה מתחברת לשרת ואינה אוספת מידע כלשהו.

גילוי נאות: האפליקציה היא כלי מעקב אישי בלבד ואינה מהווה ייעוץ חשבונאי, ייעוץ מס או ייעוץ משפטי. מומלץ לוודא את התקרה העדכנית מול רשות המסים או רואה חשבון.

name: السيرة النبوية
description:
تطبيق "السيرة النبوية" يساعدك على تعلّم سيرة النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم ومراجعتها بطريقة ممتعة، من خلال اختبارات أسئلة متعددة الخيارات.

أقسام التطبيق:
• السيرة النبوية المختصرة
• السيرة النبوية المفصلة (قبل الهجرة)
• السيرة النبوية المفصلة (بعد الهجرة)
• الأخلاق والشمائل والمعجزات
• قسم خاص بالأطفال بأسئلة مصوّرة ومبسّطة

المزايا:
• اختبارات مقسّمة حسب الموضوعات
• تصحيح فوري للإجابة مع بيان الإجابة الصحيحة
• حفظ النتائج ومتابعة التقدّم
• يعمل دون اتصال بالإنترنت
• بدون إعلانات

مناسب للعائلة والمدارس وحلقات التعليم، ولكل من يحب أن يتعرّف على سيرة النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم.

name: القصر للتقسيط
description:
التطبيق الرسمي لموظفي ومدراء شركة القصر للتقسيط (Facilité El Qaser).

للموظفين:
• تسجيل الحضور والانصراف بلمسة واحدة من داخل المحل، بالتحقق من الموقع والجهاز المعتمد ووقت الخادم.
• سجل الحضور الشهري: أيام الحضور والتأخير والغياب ورصيد الإجازة.
• طلبات التحضير اليدوي والإجازة وإذن الخروج وتغيير الجهاز، تصل إلى المدير مباشرة.

لمدراء المحلات:
• حالة المحل اليوم: الحاضرون والمتأخرون والمبيعات والتحصيل.
• اعتماد طلبات البيع بالتقسيط وطلبات الموظفين والأجهزة الجديدة.

للمدير العام:
• نظرة عامة على الشركتين: المبيعات، نسبة التحصيل، المتأخرات حسب المدة، وأفضل المحلات.

الخصوصية: يُؤخذ الموقع لحظة الضغط على زر التسجيل فقط، ولا يتتبّع التطبيق موقعك في الخلفية.

ملاحظة: التطبيق مخصص لموظفي الشركة، والدخول بحساب تسلّمه الإدارة.

name: شاكر محظور دلوقتي
description: العب ثمانية تحديات قصيرة مع شاكر. ابنِ البرج، وتابع الكوب بعينيك، ووازن الصينية، واسحب لصدّ الكرة. وفي التحديات الأخرى اختبر رد فعلك وذاكرتك، واعثر على الطريق في المتاهة، وحرّك القطع لتركيب صورة شاكر. اختَر تحدّيك من الرئيسية وحاول تحطيم أفضل نتيجة لك. اللعبة بالعربية، وتُحفظ نتائجك على جهازك، ويمكنك بدء اللعب دون حساب.

name: كوزينة ماما - العمال
description:
تطبيق داخلي لعمال محلات كوزينة ماما. يدخل الموظف بحسابه الذي تنشئه الإدارة، ثم:
• يمسح باركود أي منتج فيرى سعر البيع بالدينار الجزائري والدينار التونسي واليورو، ومكانه في المخزن والمحل.
• يحضّر طلبيات النقل بين المخزن والمحل ويستلمها بالمسح.
• يقوم بالجرد، ويسجّل السلع التالفة والمصاريف بالصورة.
• يطبع ملصقات الأسعار على طابعة المحل.
• يجهّز بوناً للصندوق أو يحسب للزبون مبلغ مشترياته.
• يسجّل حضوره وخروجه داخل المحل ويطّلع على كشوف راتبه.
التطبيق خاص بموظفي كوزينة ماما ولا يعمل دون حساب.

name: 가치사다리
description:
가치사다리는 미국 기업의 분할매수 참고 가격대와 과거 통계를 제공하는 한국어 앱입니다.

• 홈에서 공개 대상과 선정 기준일을 확인하세요.
• 보상형 광고를 시청해 신규 또는 매수 구간 종목을 열 수 있습니다. 연 종목은 내 종목에 저장되어 다시 볼 수 있습니다.
• 통계에서 과거 백테스트와 집계된 종목 추적 성과를 확인할 수 있습니다.
• 광고 없이 가상 종목을 추가하고 분할매수 가격대를 확인한 뒤 체험 보관함에서 다시 열어 볼 수 있습니다.

가격과 통계는 투자 참고 자료입니다. 과거 성과가 미래 수익을 보장하지 않으며 원금 손실이 발생할 수 있습니다.

name: 월하
description: Wolha - Under the moon, write your day.

name: ジョッキー対戦 - 競馬ゲーム・騎手レース
description:
あなたは騎手。手綱をにぎって、ゴールまでの駆け引きに勝て。

最大8頭が走る本格3D競馬レース。勝負を決めるのは、馬の強さより「乗り方」です。

■ 3つの操作だけ
・左手の「手綱」で速さを決める（抑えるほどスタミナが残る）
・右手の「内・外」で進路を選ぶ
・「ムチ」で一気に加速（本数に限りあり）

■ 本物の競馬の駆け引き
・道中は脚をため、最後の直線で全力。レバー横の「目安」マークが配分の手がかり
・前の馬の真後ろは風よけ。2秒ためて外へ出すと「スリングショット」で伸びる
・序盤に追いすぎると馬が「かかる」。コーナーは速いと外へふくらむ
・すぐ後ろの馬の前へ寄ると「斜行」で審議→降着
・着差はハナ・アタマ・クビ・馬身で表示。ゴール前はスローモーション

■ 作戦と装備で差をつける
逃げ・先行・差し・追込の作戦、蹄鉄（標準・軽量・グリップ）、ムチの本数、馬具（ブリンカー・バンデージ）。
良・稍重・重の馬場や「内が荒れている」日もあり、毎レース考えどころが変わります。

■ 遊び方いろいろ
・オンライン対戦：全国の騎手と最大8人で。集まらない枠はCPUが走ります
・ルーム対戦：合言葉で友だちと
・CPU戦：やさしい／ふつう／つよい
・タイムアタック：自己ベストの走りが半透明の馬になって一緒に走ります。今日のランキングも

■ 集めて、育てる
架空の馬24頭と勝負服16着。レースのごほうびやログインボーナスのコインで引けます。
同じ馬が出たら強化に使えます。強い馬は有利ですが、乗り方しだいで逆転できるように調整しています。

■ 安心して遊べるように
・会員登録なし。名前は自分で決めるニックネームだけ
・不適切な名前は自動で使えず、他の人の名前は「通報」で非表示にできます
・お金を賭ける要素はありません。コインや馬を現金・景品に換えることはできません
・登場する馬・騎手・競馬場はすべて架空です

プライバシーポリシー：https://keiba-vs-api.bnyamayu.workers.dev/privacy
利用規約：https://keiba-vs-api.bnyamayu.workers.dev/terms

name: 俳句地鶏
description:
セルフィーを撮影すると、そこに写っているものをAIで解析し、季語と情景を選ぶと独自の俳句生成AIで俳句を作成するアプリです。
生成された俳句は写真と一緒に共有できます。

name: 天线工坊
description:
天线工坊是一款面向射频工程师、天线开发人员、硬件验证团队和电子工程学习者的 iPhone 离线工具箱。14 项工具覆盖天线匹配、馈线损耗、端口隔离和测量记录，帮助你在同一项目中追踪设计估算、调谐改动和复测结果。

- **计算反射、损耗与效率。** 在 VSWR、S11、反射系数和回波损耗之间换算，查看反射功率与失配损耗。按频率汇总同轴电缆和连接器的损耗，并分别查看辐射效率、失配效率和总效率。
- **在 Smith 圆图上试算匹配。** 手动录入复数 S11，或从文件导入扫频数据。设置参考阻抗，逐步添加串联或并联的电感、电容，查看每一步的匹配轨迹、元件值和归一化阻抗。
- **估算天线尺寸与测量距离。** 计算半波偶极子的起始长度和远场参考距离，记录 PCB 天线净空、巴伦变换、鞭状天线地网和 PCB 环形天线参数，并估算天线罩引起的频移。结果附有公式、单位和模型适用条件。
- **对比调谐与布局版本。** 保存 S11 最低点、S21／S12 端口隔离和各频段的调谐前后数据。按板卡或机壳版本查看结果，并保留校准参考面、仪器设置、馈线和夹具等测量条件。

name: 阿方吉智
description:
效果器板是一款离线吉他效果器管理工具。用来记录你拥有的单块、它们在效果板上的接线顺序，以及每首歌实际上该怎么开、旋钮该拧到哪里。

设备库  录入品牌、型号、类型、供电和接口。每台设备可以记下自己的旋钮参数，同一型号拥有多块也能分开管理。

效果器板  按真实接线组成一条信号链，从吉他到音箱，顺序一目了然。

音色方案  为每块效果板保存一套开关和旋钮快照。适合区分节奏、主音、清音等不同场景，并标记常用方案。

演出  把歌曲放进歌单，为每首歌指定默认音色。演出模式用大字显示歌名、调性、BPM 和当前要踩开的效果器，可只看开启的设备，也能记住上次唱到哪一首，方便中场继续。

name: Totally Tote
description:
Don’t just organize - know where it is.

Where did you put the Christmas lights? Which tote has the camping stove? Totally Tote remembers where you put things so you can go straight to the right shelf.
- Add a tote with a photo, name or number, and location.
- List what’s inside and find it by item, tote name, or location.
- Update a tote when you move it or change what’s in it.
- Save a backup with your tote details and photos, then restore it when you need it.
Your catalog lives on your device and works offline. No account or subscription.

name: Christmas Planner: Gift List
description:
Plan Christmas in one place: gifts and a budget per person, the cards list, the menu with shopping list, and the schedule for the days around 25 December.

What you get:
- Every gift and budget, person by person
- Budgets that always add up
- Cards sent and received, year on year
- Christmas menu becomes your shopping list
- A plan for the big day, minute by minute

Free to start. One in-app purchase adds the rest, with no subscription.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

name: Tempino: Tuner & Metronome
description:
One app for every practice session.

Tempino is a tuner, a metronome and a practice log for music students and their teachers. Open it when you pick up your instrument, tune, set the tempo, and your minutes are logged for you.

TUNER
- Shows the note and how many cents sharp or flat you are
- Adjustable A4 and note names to match your instrument

METRONOME
- Accents, meters and subdivisions
- Tap tempo and a clear beat light

PRACTICE LOG
- A timer that records your minutes
- Streaks and a bar for every day of the week
- Tempo steps that climb toward your target tempo, one clean run at a time

FOR TEACHERS AND STUDENTS
- A teacher sends a small sheet (pieces, target tempo, minutes per week) by Messages, Mail or AirDrop
- Open it in Tempino and the pieces appear in your practice list
- At the end of the week send the report back in one tap
- No account for either side

PRIVATE
- No account, no ads, no tracking
- Works offline
- Everything stays on your device

TEMPINO PRO (one-time purchase)
- Unlimited pieces of your own
- Tempo charts for every piece
- A PDF report with a spot for a parent's signature
- Studio for more than 3 students

Tuner, metronome, practice log, teacher sheets and the weekly report are free to use.

Privacy: https://tempino.sanghuynhxuan.com/privacy
Support: https://tempino.sanghuynhxuan.com/support

name: Ottolingo
description:
Learn Mandarin Chinese through short videos. Understand real speech, discover useful words, and turn what you watch into vocabulary you can review.

Ottolingo brings watching, understanding, and remembering together with interactive Chinese subtitles and your own vocabulary collection.

• Understand what you hear
Tap words and phrases in Chinese subtitles to see English meanings and tone-mark pinyin. Explore longer expressions to understand how words work together, and listen to pronunciation.

• Save words with their context
Collect useful vocabulary from the videos you watch. Keep the original sentence and revisit the video to remember how an expression was used.

• Practice with flashcards
Review the words and phrases you chose. Reveal pinyin and meanings, revisit the original context, and mark vocabulary as learning or known.

• Build your personal dictionary
Search in Chinese, pinyin, or English. Discover different meanings and readings, hear pronunciation, and add personal notes.

• Grow your daily routine
Choose a daily learning goal and optional reminders. Fit watching and vocabulary practice into the time you have.

Start with a video. Leave with words you want to remember.

name: Cadence by Fionetix
description:
Cadence by Fionetix brings your team's daily project work to iPhone and iPad.

FOCUS ON YOUR WORK
See tasks assigned to you, reported by you, or mentioning you. Filter by project, status, priority, and due date.

KEEP PROJECTS MOVING
Browse accessible projects, switch between lists and boards, and update task statuses, priorities, assignees, labels, and due dates.

COLLABORATE IN CONTEXT
Write formatted descriptions and comments, mention teammates, reply to conversations, and attach photos or files.

STAY INFORMED
Use your inbox and optional push notifications to follow assignments, comments, mentions, and project activity. Supported notification links open the relevant work.

WORK COMFORTABLY ON MOBILE
Choose dark, light, or system appearance. Read recently synchronized content offline and keep drafts when your connection drops. Saving changes requires an internet connection.

Cadence requires an authorized workspace account. Sign in with your company Google account or supplied email credentials. Workspace and project roles determine your available content and actions.

name: Word Clue: Guess the Story
description:
Every profile is a person. Every word is a clue. Can you crack the case?

Word Clue mixes guessing with word hunting. Read the clues about a character, work out each one-word answer, then swipe across the letters to find it. Solve all five clues to close the file.

HOW TO PLAY
• Read a clue and guess the word
• Swipe through touching letters, even diagonally, to spell it
• Right answers vanish, letters fall and fresh ones drop in
• Each profile gives you 3 Chances, so choose your swipes carefully
• Solve all five clues to complete the profile

FEATURES
• 50 character profiles, from easy warm-ups to tough cold cases
• Case Files: detective cases with witnesses and accusations to solve
• Riddles for a different kind of challenge
• A Daily Challenge, free every day
• Letter and Spotlight boosters when you are stuck
• No ads

FREE TO START
The first profiles, the first case and the first riddles are free. One optional, one-time purchase unlocks everything for good. No subscription.

Sharpen your vocabulary, trust your instincts and find the word hiding in the letters.

name: Peakfold
description: Peakfold treats one day as a ridge. Six bands sit at elevations from 1 to 5, and each piece of work is seated where it fits: deep work on the crest, lighter work in the trough. You open the day by naming a charge. The contour moves with that choice and with a planning preference — lark, even, or owl — so the tallest band is not tied to the clock. Hours stay a hint. The ridge is the plan. Name the work and say how much crest it needs. A sample day can place eight realistic workloads so the slope is not empty. Move a seat to another band, or park work off today and carry it onto a later ridge. Closing writes how charged the day felt and how well the seats matched. The log keeps morning charge, evening charge, and fit. You can share the day's contour as a snapshot. The field legend explains the six bands. Energy labels are planning heuristics, last reviewed 12 Aug 2026. They are not a medical measurement and do not diagnose fatigue, sleep, or mood. The ridge stays on this device.

name: Tidecraft Spin
description:
Three docks share one wheel. Can you find a route that keeps them all moving?

Tidecraft Spin is a turn-based strategy puzzle set in a glowing ocean harbor. Choose your rotation, power two docks, and deliver copper and pearls in the required order. Changing tides shift each move, while deliveries and blocked intakes build pressure. Plan cooling stops before the engine reaches its limit.

Think beyond the next landing. A finished dock can still cool the engine, a single-use tool can change a crucial turn, and a longer rotation may open a route at a higher pressure cost.

Explore 18 voyages across three chapters, with changing tides, moving berths, and delivery deadlines. Preview a move without spending a turn, study the tide schedule, and decide when to commit.

Unlock three tools through play: Tide Anchor, Pressure Bell, and Counterweight. Review each turn to understand deliveries, cooling, and blocked intakes, then revisit voyages to improve your personal records in the Captain’s Log.

An illustrated How to Play guide introduces the rules. Progress is saved locally, so you can pause and return to your voyage.

Play offline. No account, ads, or in-app purchases.

name: Radio Caffè Criminale
description:
Radio Caffè Criminale è una testata giornalistica di cronaca nera e giudiziaria, registrata presso il Tribunale di Lucca (n. 3/19 del Registro dei periodici). L'app raccoglie in un posto solo articoli, dossier, podcast e video della testata.

NOTIZIE E SEZIONI
Gli articoli di cronaca nera, giustizia, attualità e dal mondo, divisi per sezione, con la ricerca.

DOSSIER DEI CASI
Per i casi seguiti dalla testata, articoli e puntate in ordine. Un caso si può seguire: quando escono articoli nuovi, l'app lo segnala con un avviso.

PODCAST
Giallo Criminale, Art & Crimes e gli altri programmi, con il lettore dell'app: ascolto a schermo spento, comandi sulla schermata di blocco, ripresa dal punto lasciato. Le puntate si possono scaricare per l'ascolto senza rete.

VIDEO
Gli ultimi video del canale YouTube, dentro l'app.

SENZA RETE
Gli articoli già aperti e le puntate scaricate restano disponibili anche in modalità aereo.

PRIVACY
Nessun account, nessuna pubblicità, nessun tracciamento. L'app conta solo aperture e letture, in totali per giorno senza identificativi; il conteggio si spegne dalla pagina «La testata».

Radio Caffè Criminale nasce da Falco Investigazioni.

name: BuscaRutas+
description:
BuscaRutas+ te dice qué tiempo vas a encontrar en cada punto de tu ruta, a la hora en que pasarás por él, y la IA de Apple te resume los peligros y te da consejos.

MONTAÑA
• Senderos señalizados de todo el mundo cerca de cualquier lugar que busques
• Filtra por distancia, desnivel, duración o solo rutas circulares
• Perfil de altitud de cada ruta
• Aviso si te sales del track mientras caminas

COCHE
• Calcula tu ruta y mira el tiempo a lo largo de todo el recorrido
• Navegación paso a paso con voz y recálculo automático

EL TIEMPO EN TU RUTA
• Previsión hora a hora según tu ritmo: temperatura, lluvia, viento y rachas
• Avisos de tormenta, niebla, nieve, hielo, cota de nieve, calor, frío y llegada de la noche
• Resumen de peligros y consejos con Apple In propio iPhone

TUS RUTAS
• Crea rutas tocando el mapa
• Graba tus salidas con el GPS
• Importa y exporta archivos GPX de Wikiloc, s
• Añade nombre, descripción, nivel y foto a c

EN LA MUÑECA Y EN LA PANTALLA DE BLOQUEO
• Actividad en directo con la próxima maniobr
• Vibraciones de giro y alertas de tiempo en

PRIVADA DE VERDAD
Sin cuentas, sin anuncios y sin recoger datosu dispositivo.

Los avisos meteorológicos son orientativos: cs oficiales y decide con tu propio criterio.
Previsión: Open-Meteo. Senderos: Waymarked TrOpenStreetMap.

name: Appedx 23.5 For Teachers
description:
Appedx 23.5 Teacher is the school app made for teachers. Manage your whole school day from your phone: see today's classes, take attendance, enter marks and stay in touch with parents.

TODAY AT A GLANCE
• See your classes for the day, the class in progress and what comes next
• Get alerts for pending marks, exam duties and notifications

CLASSES AND STUDENTS
• View your classes and all your students
• Open a student's profile with guardian details
• Class teachers see class statistics and student performance

ATTENDANCE
• Mark attendance on a classroom view that shows benches and students
• Tap a student to mark present, absent, late or on leave
• Mark everyone present or absent in one tap, then submit

TIMETABLE
• View your weekly timetable, Monday to Friday
• See free periods and your live class

EXAMS AND MARKS
• Enter marks for exam papers, student by student
• View the exam timetable and your invigilation duties
• Create unit tests and manage their papers

LEAVE
• Check your leave balance
• Apply for leave and track approval

COMMUNICATION
• Class teachers send notices and quick polls to parents
• See how many parents have replied
• Read school circulars and meeting invitations

MORE TOOLS
• Request gate passes for students to leave early
• Write teaching notes and send them for approval
• Browse the academic calendar and your training record

SECURE ACCESS
Sign in with the login your school gives you. You only see your own classes and students. All data travels over a secure connection.

This app is for teachers of schools that use Appedx 23.5. If you cannot sign in, please contact your school office.

name: BoltzStat: Basketball Stats
description:
BoltzStat is live stats for team basketball, made for the sideline. Record every player's shots by court zone, along with rebounds, assists and minutes, as the game happens. When the final whistle blows, get a full box score and a game summary.

Built for coaches, parents and sideline scorers of amateur and youth teams.

RECORD THE GAME
- Tap a point on a full-court map to record a made shot. Hold to record a missed shot. The exact spot is saved.
- Free throws and seven other stat tiles, including rebounds and assists.
- Undo, and see what it will reverse before you tap.
- Optional minutes tracking, with a game clock, periods and substitutions.

SHOT CHARTS
- Shots are grouped by court zone: Simple (8 zones) or Detailed (14 zones).
- Pick a Chalkboard, Bubbles or Rings style.
- Shot colours show each zone's make percentage.
- Points in the paint are counted from where each shot was taken.

GAME SUMMARY
- Final score, win or loss, and team totals.
- A shot chart you can zoom into, plus a "Shots by zone" table.
- A box score for every player.
- Enter the opponent's final score when the game ends.

TEAMS AND PLAYERS
- Keep your teams and rosters, with points per game, field goal % and 3-point % for every player.
- Archive players instead of deleting them, so old games stay complete.

BEFORE THE GAME
- Set the opponent, date, venue and who is starting.
- Choose whether to track minutes for that game.
- Choose appearance: System, Light or Dark.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- All your data stays on your iPhone.
- No account, no login, no ads, no tracking.
- No internet connection needed.

FREE TO TRY, ONE-TIME UNLOCK
- Try BoltzStat free: one team and one game at no cost.
- To keep going, unlock the full app with a one-time purchase, BoltzStat Unlock. There is no subscription.
- Family Sharing is supported.

name: AI Hub - Multi-Model AI Chat
description:
AI Hub is a native multi-model AI assistant engineered specifically for iPhone and Apple Watch, combining fast everyday productivity with deep flagship reasoning.

KEY FEATURES
• Real-Time Multi-Model Streaming: Switch effortlessly between high-speed everyday models and deep-reasoning flagship models with native Markdown formatting, collapsible thinking traces, and syntax-highlighted code blocks.
• Multimodal Vision, PDF & Voice: Attach photos or PDF documents for instant summaries and visual insights, or dictate hands-free with natural text-to-speech playback.
• Native Apple Watch App & Complication: Ask questions directly from your wrist, hear concise spoken answers on your watch speaker, and sync your account and daily quota automatically with your iPhone.
• Custom Personas: Jump between General Assistant, Simultaneous Translator, Senior Architect, or Academic Editor—or craft your own custom system prompts.
• Privacy by Design: Explicit pre-chat AI data consent, zero third-party ad tracking (CCPA/CPRA & GDPR compliant), local on-device SwiftData chat history, one-tap AI response reporting, and instant in-app account deletion.

AI HUB PRO SUBSCRIPTION
• Free plan included with a daily fast-model message allowance.
• Upgrade to AI Hub Pro ($6.99/month or $49.99/year auto-renewable subscription) to unlock all flagship models, deep reasoning modes, and up to 300 daily messages shared across iPhone and Apple Watch.
• Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period in iOS Settings -> Apple Account -> Subscriptions.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://local-hk-mac-studio.tail1d9be5.ts.net/legal/terms?lang=en
Privacy Policy: https://local-hk-mac-studio.tail1d9be5.ts.net/legal/privacy?lang=en

name: 마일로 - 마일리지 항공권 검색기
description:
마일로는 대한항공 마일리지 보너스 좌석을 쉽게 찾게 도와주는 앱이에요.

■ 날짜만 고르면 갈 수 있는 곳이 한눈에
가는 날과 오는 날을 고르면 앞뒤 3일 안에서 마일리지 좌석이 열린 도시를 모아 보여 드려요. 일반석·프레스티지석·일등석, 왕복·편도 모두 찾을 수 있어요.

■ 자리가 열리면 바로 알림
원하는 노선과 기간을 등록해 두면 새 좌석이 열렸을 때 휴대폰 알림으로 알려 드려요. 로그인은 필요 없어요.

■ 마일리지로 사면 이득인지
같은 일정의 직항 현금 최저가와 비교해서 1마일이 몇 원의 가치인지 보여 드려요.

■ 연휴 좌석 오픈런
인기 연휴 좌석은 예약이 열리자마자 마감돼요. 예약이 열리는 날 오전 9시에 알려 드려요.

■ 달력으로 보는 열린 날
노선마다 마일리지 좌석이 열린 날과 필요한 마일을 달력으로 보여 드려요.

마일로는 대한항공 공식 서비스가 아니에요. 좌석은 노선을 돌아가며 갱신해서 실제 예매 화면과 다를 수 있고, 예매는 대한항공에서 해요.

name: Copy Pocket
description:
Keep frequently used text and links ready in the Copy Pocket keyboard.

Tap a saved item to insert it, or touch and hold to preview it. To save text or a URL from the clipboard, select History or Snippets and tap the save button.

The free plan keeps your latest 10 history items and up to 5 snippets. Pro is a one-time purchase that expands history to 500 items, removes the snippet limit, and adds categories and JSON import and export.

Saved items can be inserted with Full Access off. Saving and copying from the keyboard require Full Access. Saved content stays on your device.

name: i-Office
description:
i-Office is the internal back-office application of Senate Group restaurants. It is used by restaurant managers, back-office staff and owners. Access is restricted to company-issued accounts: there is no public registration and no in-app purchases.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Sales & revenue — live sales, revenue and closed-bill reports per venue, waiter and table.
• Inventory — current stock, purchase receipts, warehouse transfers with approval, inventory counts and movement reports.
• Menu — products, groups, prices and the kiosk / QR menu, synchronised to the POS.
• Reservations — reservation list, table assignment, guest cards and deposits.
• Staff & HR — staff list, positions, HR archive, certificates, salary tables and attendance (check-in / check-out).
• Kitchen — kitchen screen monitoring and kitchen reports.
• Devices & integrations — POS terminals, printers, fiscal devices, kiosk and messaging integrations.
• Notifications — operational alerts and announcements for staff.

HOW IT CONNECTS
The app talks to the restaurant's own POS server on the local network and to the Senate Group API. Some venues use plain HTTP inside their private network, which is why the app asks for local-network access on first use.

PERMISSIONS
• Photo library — only when you choose an image or video from your gallery (login background, staff photo, Excel / backup import).
• Notifications — operational alerts.
The camera and microphone are not used by the app; the system file picker may offer them.

ACCOUNTS
Accounts are created and removed by the company administrator. To delete an account or personal data, contact your administrator or Senate Group support (see the privacy policy).

name: Nûçe Muhabir
description:
Nûçe Muhabir is the internal newsroom app of Nûçe News Agency. It is for the agency's reporters, editors and subscribers; accounts are issued by the agency's administrators.

• File stories with text, photos, video and audio from the field — large uploads resume when the connection drops
• Editors review, approve or return stories and mark what has been used
• Browse the agency feed with filters by city, category, reporter and date
• End-to-end encrypted chat, voice messages and group conversations
• Voice and video calls between newsroom members
• Notifications for assignments, breaking news and messages
• Available in Kurdish (Kurmanji), Turkish and English

An account from Nûçe News Agency is required to sign in.

name: Aireio: Places to Work
description:
aireio finds you a good place to work, wherever you are.

Open the app and Near me shows the cafés, libraries, coworking spaces, study cafés and hostels around you in walking bands: within 5 minutes, 5 to 10, 10 to 20. The best places to work come first, each with a work score built from what people who worked there reported: Wi-Fi, outlets, noise, seating and laptop friendliness.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- See places near you on a map, with walking rings and work scores
- Filter by open now, Wi-Fi, outlets, type, price and work score
- Join a place's Wi-Fi in one tap, when someone has shared it
- Check in when you arrive: aireio confirms you are there, and a Live Activity keeps the Wi-Fi and a check-out button on your Lock Screen
- Add home-screen widgets for the best places nearby and what is open now
- Rate a place's Wi-Fi, outlets and noise, write a review and add photos; aireio reads menu prices and the Wi-Fi sign on your phone
- Save favorites, make lists and follow cities
- Add a missing place from the share sheet in Apple Maps, Google Maps or Safari
- Browse cities around the world before you travel

Sign in with Apple, Google or email. Everything people post can be reported, and you can block anyone.

aireio is free, with no ads.

name: GamePilot (Lite)
description:
GamePilot Lite turns your iPhone, iPad or Mac into a scoreboard for any game — and puts the board on the big screen.

KEEP SCORE FOR EVERY SPORT
• Basketball — game clock, shot clock (or none), team fouls, bonus and double bonus, timeouts, possession
• Football — downs, yards to go, ball on, possession, timeouts
• Soccer — running clock, added time, yellow and red cards
• Volleyball and pickleball — sets, serve, side outs, win by two
• Tennis — 15/30/40, deuce and advantage, tiebreaks
• Baseball and softball — balls, strikes, outs, runners, runs, hits and errors by inning

PUT IT ON THE BIG SCREEN
• AirPlay or plug into a TV or projector — the TV shows only the scoreboard, your buttons stay on your device
• Or use a second iPhone, iPad or Mac as the big screen: enter its 4-digit code and they stay in sync over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth
• Classic LED-style numbers that read from across the gym

BUILT FOR THE SCORER'S TABLE
• Every control for a sport fits on one screen
• Big buttons, undo, and a clock you can set to any time
• 30- and 60-second timeout countdowns shown on the board
• Fix a mistake anytime, even reopen a finished set
• Every game is saved — pick any older game back up where you left off
• Works offline. No account. No ads. Nothing collected.

name: 印记
description:
印记是一款完全离线的存证水印相机。

【为什么是「印记」】
工程监理交竣工资料、装修验收留档、租赁交房、保险查勘、物流签收、二手交易发货——这些场景的共同点是：你需要证明「某时、某地、某事」。印记把拍摄、归档、校验做成一条闭环，数据只在你手机上。

【双区水印，记录才可信】
· 系统区：拍摄时间（精确到秒）、GPS 坐标、海拔、设备信息、照片指纹——由设备自动写入，任何人都无法修改；
· 填写区：项目名、工单号、部位、责任人——由你补充。
两区在照片上以不同样式明确区分。正因为不能改，记录才有人信。

【一个工程一份档案】
按项目归集照片，自动编号、统计字节数；一键导出 PDF 证据包：封面、照片索引、逐页水印与指纹短码、根哈希校验说明，直接交付甲方。

【释放空间，不丢证据】
· 端侧识别重复 / 相似照片，逐组对比后再决定保留哪张，多余照片可单张删除（本机照片直接移除；已授权相册的原图经系统确认后从相册删除）；
· 归档式清理：照片先完整转入本地加密库，校验通过后才从相册移除，随时可还原；
· 所有数字均来自真实文件计量，不做任何系统级宣称。

【隐私即产品】
· 无账号、无服务器、无网络请求，不集成任何统计与广告 SDK；
· 照片 AES 加密存储于本机，卸载即全部删除；
· 分享副本可剥离 GPS 与设备信息。

【完全免费，无内购】
本版本全部功能免费开放：水印拍摄、项目管理、PDF 证据包、重复照片识别与归档式清理。应用不包含任何内购、订阅与付费墙；首次使用可按「设置 → 使用指南」的五步指引快速上手。

name: Skymphony Utopia
description:
Shape the weather. Restore the skies. Bring the world back to life.

Skymphony Utopia is a colorful puzzle adventure across a world of floating islands. The gardens have withered, the reservoirs have run dry and the ancient lanterns have gone dark. With four weather powers at your fingertips, you can bring every island back to life.

FOUR WEATHER POWERS
- Sunlight warms a cross of tiles, bringing sprouts into bloom, melting ice and lighting sundials.
- Rain falls from clouds to wake dry soil, revive withered trees and fill empty reservoirs.
- Wind sends clouds drifting until something stops them, spins windmills and sweeps away leaf piles.
- Lightning strikes from clouds to wake ancient pylons and shatter cracked boulders.

PUZZLES THAT GROW WITH YOU
Clouds block sunlight, rain needs a cloud above it and drifting clouds keep going until an obstacle such as a peak, a boulder or a tall blossom tree stops them. Water rushes through channels from full reservoirs, and energy flows through conduits to light the city's sky lanterns. Every island is a small, hand-tuned puzzle with a clear set of goals.

FIVE REGIONS TO RESTORE
Travel upward from Sunny Meadows through Rainfall Valley, Storm Peaks and Cloud Gardens to the Celestial City. Each region adds new mechanics and its own look. Watch islands regain their color, waterfalls and decorations as you complete them.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- 20 adventure levels and 5 region Trials
- A Daily Puzzle with a streak to keep
- 25 hidden sky crystals and 10 island decorations to unlock
- 14 achievements and a weather journal of your progress
- A Field Guide that fills in as you discover new sky features
- Three-star ratings based on par moves

PLAY YOUR WAY
- Unlimited undo and a hint button that suggests the next best move
- Optional highlighting of tiles where your chosen power will work
- Fully offline, with no account, ads or in-app purchases
- Sound, music, haptics and reduced motion settings
- VoiceOver labels for the board and controls
- One optional daily reminder for the Daily Puzzle

Control the weather. Restore the wonder.

name: Redrep
description:
Redrep is a free workout tracker for people who lift. Plan your week, follow it set by set with your last weights filled in, and let the progression rules tell you what to lift next time. No account, no sign-in, no ads and no tracking. Everything stays on your iPhone.

TRAIN SMARTER
• Readiness check: three taps before you train (sleep, soreness, energy). On a bad day, Go lighter takes a set off every exercise and keeps the day out of progression.
• Pain and injury map: tap a muscle on the body map and rate it from 1 to 5. Exercises that load it are flagged during your workout, with a swap one tap away.
• Max day: test your real one-rep max with a guided warm-up and up to three attempts. Programmes use the result for their percentages.
• Redline: a 0 to 100 score for every workout, so you see at a glance how hard you pushed.

PLAN AND LOG
• Weekly plans or a rotation, starter plans, supersets, warm-ups, drop sets, timed holds and plate math.
• Linear, double and triple progression, deloads and multi-week programmes.
• Over 5,600 exercises, each with its own animated figure and the worked muscles in red.
• A rest timer with a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• Estimated 1RM curves, records, streaks, a year-long activity map and muscle balance.
• Body weight, measurements and progress photos.
• Protein, water and supplements, with a daily supplement reminder.

MADE FOR IPHONE
• An Apple Watch app to log sets from your wrist, with your heart rate.
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets.
• Control Center, Lock Screen and Action button controls on iOS 18.
• Apple Health: save workouts and weigh-ins, and read back heart rate and weigh-ins.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
Redrep has no server and no account. Your plans, workouts and body data live on your phone, and Settings → Data & backup exports all of it as one file. Moving in? Import from Strong, Hevy and other apps.

Optional: an AI coach that works with an API key from a provider you choose.

Redrep is open source under the GNU AGPL v3.0. The readiness check and the pain map are training aids, not medical advice: see a professional about an injury.

name: Akor Yağmuru: Repertuar, Ritim
description:
Binlerce şarkının gitar, ukulele ve piyano akorlarına saniyeler içinde ulaşın! Akor Yağmuru; gitar, ukulele ve piyano öğrenenler tasarlanmış kapsamlı bir akor, ritim, akort ve repertuar uygulamasıdır.

ÖNE ÇIKAN ÖZELLİKLER
• Geniş Şarkı ve Akor Arşivi
Türkçe pop, rock, alternatif, özgün müzik ve sevilen binlerce şarkının en doğru akorlarına anında ulaşın. Şarkı veya sanatçı adına göre saniyeler içinde arama yapın.

• Sesinize Uygun Tona Tek Dokunuşla Geçin (Transpoze & Kapo)
Şarkının orijinal tonu sesinize uymuyor mu? Tek dokunuşla akorları istediğiniz tona transpoze edin, kapo (capo) perdesini ayarlayın ve kendi sesinize en uygun tonu kaydedin.

• Canlı Akor Takibi
Şarkıyı dinlerken akorların hangi saniyede değiştiğini canlı olarak takip edin. Senkronize akan akor kartları sayesinde ritmi ve geçişleri hiçbir zaman kaçırmayın.

• Gitar, Ukulele ve Piyano Akor Şemaları
Şarkıda geçen tüm akorların gitar, ukulele ve piyano üzerindeki basılış pozisyonlarını detaylı şemalarla inceleyin. Çaldığınız enstrümanı varsayılan olarak kaydedin.

• Sesli Ritim Rehberi ve Ritim Kalıpları
"Bu şarkı hangi ritimle çalınır?" derdine son! Şarkıya özel önerilen ritim kalıplarını görün, vuruş yönlerini takip edin ve sesli olarak dinleyerek kolayca öğrenin.

• Akort Aleti (Tuner)
Ekstra bir uygulamaya ihtiyaç duymadan gitarınızı ve enstrümanınızı saniyeler içinde akort edin. Otomatik tel algılama veya manuel tel seçimi modlarıyla her zaman doğru frekansta akordunuzu yapın.

• Kişisel Repertuar ve Şarkı Notları
Sevdiğiniz şarkılardan kendi repertuar listelerinizi oluşturun, sahne sıralamanızı düzenleyin, şarkılara özel kişisel notlar ekleyin veya repertuarınızdaki tüm şarkıları sıraladığınız şekilde tek sayfada görüntüleyip eşlik edin.

• Otomatik Kaydırma
Enstrüman çalarken ekrana dokunmanıza gerek kalmadan şarkı sözlerini ve akorları istediğiniz hızda otomatik kaydırın.

Akor Yağmuru'nu hemen indirin, enstrümanınızı alın ve müziğin ritmine katılın!

name: 2048 Bars: Beat Puzzle
description:
Every swipe writes a new bar.

2048 Bars is a merge puzzle where the tiles are rhythms. Two equal notes merge into a denser one: quarters become eighths, eighths become sixteenths, then chords, all the way up through twelve levels.

The board is a step sequencer. The four columns are the beats of a bar, the four rows are your instruments: piano, bass, hi-hat and kick. A playhead sweeps across the board and plays whatever you have built, so you hear the result of every move.

• Merge notes, fill the bar, climb the levels
• Swipe on the beat for a score multiplier
• Pick the sound for each row
• Undo, cut and swap boosters for tight spots
• Your game is saved after every move
• Follows the silent switch, so it never interrupts your music: turn silent mode off to hear the beat

Free to play with ads. An ad may appear the first time you reach a new level, and after a loss you can watch a video to play one more bar. The one-time purchase 2048 Bars Unlimited removes all ads and makes boosters unlimited. It is not a subscription.

Privacy policy: https://musepulse.app/apps/2048-bars/privacy
Support: https://musepulse.app/apps/2048-bars/support

name: 5Whys
description:
5Whys turns screen time into learning time. 5whys brings together short videos from selected educational creators so you can discover something new in a few minutes.
Choose five topics to shape your feed. Explore science, history, technology, and more at your own pace. Swipe to tell 5whys whether you learned something. Your reactions help shape what you see next.
Filter videos by language, platform, or format. Save videos to watch again and open the original source to discover more from the creator.
The app is available in English and French. You can start exploring without signing in.

name: À deux – Pregnancy Journal
description:
À deux helps you organize your pregnancy and keep your milestones and memories together on your iPhone.

INCLUDED FREE
• Estimated pregnancy calendar
• Dashboard with an estimated due date
• Appointment calendar
• Hospital-bag checklists

À DEUX + LIFETIME ACCESS
A one-time purchase, with no subscription, unlocks:
• Photo journal
• Manual contraction timer
• Advanced appointment reminders
• PDF journal export

YOUR PERSONAL SPACE
No account required. Your information and photos are stored locally in the app on your device. You choose whether to share an exported PDF.

Available in French and English. Internet access is required to purchase or restore À deux +.

Dates and milestones are informational estimates. Your care team’s dating and instructions take priority. The timer does not interpret contractions. À deux does not provide medical diagnosis or treatment and does not replace medical advice.

name: A Father's Journey
description:
A UFO took his baby bird son, and Dad is going to get him back!

A Father’s Journey is a heartfelt 3D platform adventure about a brave bird dad who will cross the whole world, and beyond, to rescue his son.

Run, jump and fight through 25 levels across amazing worlds:

Sunny forests full of traps
Hot deserts and midnight dunes
Stormy seas with lightning and ghost ships
Frozen lands of ice
Erupting volcanoes and rivers of lava
The big city, day and night
And finally... the Moon and outer space!

BECOME A HERO
