Transform your bird with amazing powers: Karate Master, Pirate, Samurai, Soldier, Astronaut and the mighty Oak Fist. Save a second power and switch in the middle of the action!

COLLECT AND CUSTOMIZE
Gather seeds and spend them in the shop on hats, scarves, running trails, jump effects and magic balls of fire, ice, lightning and more.

FIND EVERY FEATHER
Each level hides 3 feathers. Find all 69 and unlock the secret Cyber Phoenix!

A STORY WITH HEART
A comic-book story full of emotion, from the night the UFO arrives to the long-awaited reunion.

Simple touch controls
No ads
Progress saved automatically

Can a father cross the world to save his son? Begin the journey now!

name: A Gunma Detective Story
description:
VIENS VITE. JE CRAINS POUR MA VIE.

Come quickly. I fear for my life. The telegram from his old partner, Armand Delorme, has followed Marcus Saint Germain across the Pacific for eleven weeks. When the French detective at last climbs the stone steps through the cedars to a mountain shrine in Gunma, in the spring of 1928, he is too late. Armand lies dead in the treasure hall.

The head priest has held back his report. The police will come up the steps at half past five. It is half past two.

A Gunma Detective Story is a point-and-click detective adventure: a story-rich murder mystery told in chapters. Chapter one is out now; chapter two follows soon. Look closely, ask questions, show people what you have found and hold up the things that do not fit. A real-time deadline, in the tradition of classic point-and-click adventures.

HOW YOU PLAY
• Investigate the crime scene, find hidden clues and question witnesses and suspects.
• Tap anything to look at it, take it, use it, or talk to whoever is there.
• Ask about every clue, show your evidence, and debate the answers that do not add up.
• Your notebook keeps every lead and every note. Put two notes together and draw your own conclusions.
• Combine the wrong things and Saint Germain will have a dry word for it.
• In chapter one the clock is real: three hours of play before the police arrive. It stops while the menu is open.
• Stuck? Every objective has three hints, from a gentle nudge to the answer. Or switch them off.
• Each chapter ends with your score: the clues you found, the ones you missed, and your points.

JAPAN, 1928
From the harbour office in Yokohama and the steam trains of the Takasaki line to a shrine in the mountains and the lanes of Gion in Kyoto. Researched down to the details: the shop signs of the day, and a businessman in a Kyoto hotel lobby who knows the best dish of every province, every one of them already served in 1928.

THE CHAPTERS
• Chapter one, The Guest Who Left Before Dawn: free, from the first clue to the last scene.
• Chapter two, The Shadow in Osaka: coming soon.
• Chapter three, One Port Ahead: coming later.
No ads, no subscription, no account. Plays offline.

SETTINGS
• Text speed; hints off, on request or always; reduced graphic content; skip text you have already read.
• Autosave and three save slots per chapter.
• A narrator speaks Saint Germain's thoughts, in all four languages. You can switch him off.
• A player's manual inside the game.
• English, German, French and Japanese. In Japanese the story text runs vertically, with a backlog of every line.

Chapter one is free. Climb the steps to the shrine and find out what really happened before the police arrive.

name: A's Planner
description:
A's Planner is a shared calendar for your family, made for busy parents juggling kids' activities.

Everyone in the family can add and edit events. Parents decide who drives, with drop-off and pick-up handled separately, so nothing falls through the cracks.

RIDES, SORTED
- Mark an event "Needs a ride" and choose drop-off, pick-up, or both
- A parent taps "I'll drive" to take a ride
- If the time changes, the driver is asked to confirm again
- Reminders for rides nobody has taken yet

ONE CALENDAR FOR EVERYONE
- Day, week, and month views
- Repeating events: weekly, every two weeks, certain days, monthly, or every year
- All-day events for birthdays and trips
- Name tags show who each event is for
- Cancelled events stay greyed out, so everyone knows

STAY IN THE LOOP
- A short chat on every event
- Notifications when something changes
- Full history of every change
- Warns you when a ride overlaps an event in your own iPhone calendar (stays on your iPhone)

MADE FOR FAMILIES
- Parents invite the family with a private link
- Add a younger kid without a phone by name
- Works on iPhone and iPad
- Try it first with sample events

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Your family's calendar is stored in iCloud and shared only with the family members you invite.

name: AAK COLORS
description:
AAK COLORS turns your iPhone into a spoken colour identification tool, designed especially for people who are blind or have low vision.

Open the app, point your camera and hear the colour in front of you. No photos to take, no searches and no need to tap a button to start recognising colours.

KEY FEATURES

• Rear camera starts automatically.
• Real-time colour identification.
• Detailed names such as dark blue, olive green and burgundy.
• Automatic spoken colour names.
• Spanish, Catalan and English.
• HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV, estimated CMYK and OKLCH formats.
• Accessible voice, torch and settings controls.
• Offline colour recognition.

FREE DEMONSTRATION AND PREMIUM

Try AAK COLORS with 60 cumulative seconds of free colour recognition.

AAK COLORS Premium offers unlimited colour identification through an auto-renewing annual subscription. The price is displayed before you confirm your purchase. You can manage or cancel your subscription through your Apple account.

Images used for colour recognition are processed on your device and are not sent to our servers.

AAK COLORS is designed to help with everyday colour identification. Results may vary depending on lighting and camera conditions.

Política de privacidad:
https://www.aakdeveloper.com/aakcolors/privacy/

Términos de uso (EULA):
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Soporte:
https://www.aakdeveloper.com/aakcolors/support/

name: Aangan Realty: Noida Property
description:
Aangan Realty is a property app for Noida and Greater Noida. Find flats, builder floors, villas, plots, PGs and commercial space to rent or buy, posted by owners, agents and builders and checked by our team before they go live.

Search by sector, society or metro station, filter by budget and bedrooms, and see every home on the map with its nearest Aqua Line or Blue Line station. Save the homes you like and compare them side by side.

Contact the owner or agent directly. Verify your mobile number once to see the poster's number, or message them on WhatsApp. There is no brokerage charged by Aangan Realty.

Own a property? Post it free in about two minutes with photos. Every listing is reviewed before it is published.

Areas covered: Noida sectors along the Aqua Line and Blue Line, Noida Expressway, Greater Noida, Greater Noida West (Noida Extension) and the Yamuna Expressway.

name: Abiku
description:
Àdìsá is an àbíkú: a spirit child who is born, dies young, and returns home between lives. The Mark that once guided every àbíkú home now chains them, along with the dead of every realm and the guardians who keep them.

Ṣadé, his closest friend, rides at his shoulder as a small pale light. She guides him, teaches him to fight and catches him when he falls. She won't say what it costs her.

ÀBÍKÚ is a 3D action adventure through the spirit realms of Nigerian myth.

EIGHT REALMS, ALL FREE
• The Bronze Palace
• Orita
• The Well of the Iyi-Uwa
• The Lodge of the Leopard
• The Stair of Olókun
• The Grove of Images
• The Forge of Ògún
• Jangare, the city of spirits, eight districts wide

More of the road arrives in free updates.

FIGHT FOR EVERY STEP
Close, heavy combat against the chained and the guardians who hold them. Strike, dash and bind, and make your weapons stronger as the road goes on.

THE STORY HAPPENS AROUND YOU
No cutscenes. The story plays out in the world around you while you keep control, and each realm asks something different of you.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Touch controls you can rearrange anywhere on the screen
• Game controllers supported
• Graphics settings for older phones
• Blood can be turned off in Settings

NO ADS. NO PURCHASES. NO ACCOUNT.
The whole game is free. It plays offline, and your progress is saved on your phone.

Questions or problems: support@epulse.ng

name: Access Notes: Places & Quiet
description:
Remember the practical details of places you visit.

Build a private neighborhood guide with addresses, entrance photos and route notes. Keep step-free entrance, lift and accessible restroom observations separate from Unknown. Record measured details and the noise conditions on your visit, along with an observation date.

Filter by neighborhood, observed step-free access or a quiet visit. Open large offline address cards, review a printable PDF guide, and optionally open a manually stored coordinate in Apple Maps. Full JSON backup and restore are included.

No public map dataset is preloaded and no venue is claimed to be verified by the developer. Conditions can change; dated observations older than 90 days are flagged for review. Confirm current facilities directly with the venue. Map opening may use Apple Maps network services. No location permission, account or subscription.

name: AccuBeacon
description:
AccuBeacon turns your iPhone into a demo beacon for the Open! app.

Open! shows you a notification when your phone comes close to a VitaNet Station. That is AccuNotify: a notification that arrives at the distance of your choice, not just "somewhere nearby". Normally you need a VitaNet Station to see it happen. With AccuBeacon, a second phone is enough.

WHAT YOU NEED
• This iPhone, with AccuBeacon
• A second phone, iPhone or Android, with the Open! app installed and Bluetooth on

HOW TO USE IT
1. Open AccuBeacon and choose a distance: Near, Medium or Far.
2. Switch Beacon to On and keep AccuBeacon open on the screen.
3. Walk toward this iPhone with the phone that has Open!.
4. Open! shows the demo notification when you come within the distance you chose.

Choose the distance before you switch the beacon on:
• Near — about 1 meter
• Medium — about 5 meters
• Far — as far as the Bluetooth signal reaches

GOOD TO KNOW
• AccuBeacon sends its signal only while it is open on the screen. When you leave the app or lock the iPhone, the signal stops. Come back to the app and it starts again.
• The screen stays awake while the beacon is on.
• Distances are approximate. Walls, pockets and people between the two phones change how far a Bluetooth signal travels.
• AccuBeacon is a demonstration. It sends one fixed demo notification and does not replace a VitaNet Station. To send your own notifications to your own customers, you need VitaNet Stations, which come with a cloud account for managing your notifications.

PRIVACY
• No account and no sign-in.
• AccuBeacon collects no data and does not connect to the internet.
• It uses Bluetooth for one purpose: to send the demo beacon signal.

ABOUT ACCUNOTIFY
AccuNotify is VitaNet's service for sending a notification to a phone at the right place and the right distance. Learn more at https://vita.net

name: Acely: Tennis Girl Club
description:
Tennis, made for you.

Acely is the tennis training app designed for women: short guided sessions, programs built around your level, and everything you need to feel confident on court.

A plan that fits your life
Tell Acely your level, how often you play and the shots you want to improve. You get a program and a weekly goal that match your schedule, from 5 to 30 minutes a session.

7 programs to progress
First rallies, footwork, a powerful serve, a solid backhand, tennis fitness, match readiness, pain-free shoulder and elbow. Each program follows you week after week.

20+ guided drills
Warm-up, footwork, technique without a ball, strength and injury prevention. Every drill comes with clear cues, the most common mistake and a built-in timer, so you can train at home, at the club or on court.

Think like a player
Real match situations to test your tactics, short guides on scoring and rules, and mental tips to stay calm between points.

Track your progress
Weekly rings, streaks, minutes played, your level on every shot, and a match journal to log your results and what you learned.

Your tennis style
Outfit ideas for match day, training and after tennis, plus a checklist so your bag is always ready.

Private by design
No account, no server. Your data stays on your iPhone.

Acely Pro subscription
• Yearly: 7-day free trial, then billed once a year
• Monthly: billed every month, no free trial
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase or at the end of the free trial. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://scarl2tt.com/legal-pages/privacy-policy

name: acre: Live Earth Map
description:
acre is a live map of the Earth that tells you what is under your finger. Tap anywhere and read that acre: its height above sea level, what covers the ground, how green it is, how old the newest satellite picture is, and the fire weather there today.

Layers show the world as it is now: aerial and satellite imagery, wind and weather, rain radar, clouds, earthquakes and other hazards, aircraft and ships in real time, waves and currents, air quality, tides and more. Follow a plane or a ship and see where it has been and where it is heading.

Make it yours: save places and routes, set alerts for the conditions you care about, and add widgets to your Home Screen. acre keeps working with the last data it has when the signal drops, and what you save is encrypted.

It is built on open data, and every source is credited in the app. Most readings come straight from the public services rather than through a tracking server, and there are no ads.

acre is for context and curiosity. It is not for safety decisions, for navigating a vessel or aircraft, or for emergencies, and fire weather describes the weather, not an official danger rating.

name: Add9: No more boring chords
description:
add9 is a guitar chord app built around genre. Pick a chord and it shows you the more interesting versions players in that style actually use.

FIND A CHORD
Choose a root and a chord type, then see genre alternatives and common positions, including inversions. Set a capo and the shapes follow.

EXPLORE BY GENRE
Curated signature chords and voicings for Jazz, J-pop, Math rock, Midwest emo, City pop, Neo-soul / R&B, Shoegaze, Lo-fi, Jangle pop, Bedroom pop and Bossa nova. Swipe through the variations and hear each one.

BUILD PROGRESSIONS
String chords together, set tempo and capo, and start from sample progressions in each style.

SAVE WHAT YOU LIKE
Keep chords and fingerings in one place and add them to a progression later.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything works offline and your saved music stays on your device.

For iPhone and iPad, in English and Simplified Chinese.

name: AeriPulse
description:
AeriPulse – Air Quality & Wellness Tracker
AeriPulse is a modern wellness companion designed to help you stay mindful of your daily habits, track air quality, and build a healthier routine through simple, organized monitoring tools.
With an intuitive dashboard, clear visual insights, and interactive wellness activities, AeriPulse brings your daily health and environmental records together in one convenient place.
Key Features
Daily Wellness Tracking Record your water intake, steps, sleep, heart rate, mood, and energy levels. Monitor your daily progress and stay consistent with your personal wellness goals.
Air Quality Monitoring Log AQI readings, PM2.5, PM10, temperature, and humidity. Review recorded environmental conditions through easy-to-understand indicators and historical trends.
Interactive Breathing Studio Enjoy guided breathing exercises with smooth inhale-and-exhale animations. Choose from different breathing patterns, customize session durations, and track completed sessions.
Health Insights & Analytics Explore visual charts, weekly summaries, progress indicators, and personalized insights based on your recorded activities and wellness data.
Daily Goals & Healthy Habits Set hydration and activity targets, follow daily wellness routines, and track your progress with interactive checklists.
Wellness Tools & Reminders Access helpful tools, including a BMI calculator, breathing exercises, and customizable reminders to support your daily routine.
Personal Records & History Organize your wellness entries, review past records, and export your tracking history whenever needed.
AeriPulse combines a clean interface, practical tracking tools, and calming interactive experiences to make everyday wellness monitoring simple and enjoyable.
Take a more mindful approach to your daily routine with AeriPulse.
Note: Air quality and wellness measurements are manually recorded. AeriPulse is intended for personal tracking and general wellness purposes, not medical diagnosis or treatment.

name: Aerolune
description:
A little leap. A bigger sky.

Set off on a one-touch climbing adventure among floating platforms and starlit skies. Read the route, time your jump, and feel the satisfaction of a landing well earned.

ONE TAP. SO MUCH TO MASTER.
Simple controls let you focus on the moment: choosing when to leap. Discover your rhythm as tricky gaps become jumps you know how to land.

A LITTLE HIGHER. A LITTLE FURTHER.
Find your way through each stage and unlock the next challenge. Reach checkpoints to secure the height you have earned, then set your sights on what is above.

MAKE YOUR NEXT RUN YOUR BEST
Return to favorite stages, refine your timing, and beat your best times. For a little friendly competition, see how your progress compares on the online leaderboard.

A JOURNEY THAT KEEPS GROWING
Discover new routes and new challenges as you climb. More stages are planned for future updates, giving you more to explore and master.

TAKE THE ADVENTURE WITH YOU
Enjoy the climb offline, without ads.

Online leaderboards require Game Center and an internet connection.

name: Affinity Lab Assistant
description:
Pro photo editing that never touches your original.

Get the control of a desktop editor in one hand: real curves, an 8-band color mixer, RAW, masks and film looks with true grain and halation. Everything renders live on your iPhone, and every edit stays undoable forever.

MATCH ANY PHOTO'S COLOR
Drop in a film still, a screenshot or an album cover. The app builds a look from its colors, then lets you tune color, tone and texture on your own photo.

IT TELLS YOU WHAT TO FIX
The editing assistant spots what holds a photo back: a face in shadow, a clipped sky, a tilted horizon. One tap fixes it, and you see exactly which sliders moved.

LOOKS WITH REAL TEXTURE
23 looks across Flash, Film, Lo-fi, Glow, Mono and Wild. Stack grain, halation, bloom, light leaks, dust and a date stamp, each with its own slider. Save your own and share it as a recipe card anyone can scan.

PRECISION, NOT GUESSWORK
- Exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, whites, blacks, warmth, tint, clarity, dehaze and more
- Tone curves for RGB and each channel
- 8-band hue, saturation and luminance
- Masks for subject and people in one tap, plus brush, linear, radial and luminance
- Remove distractions on device
- RAW and ProRAW
- Crop, straighten and perspective
- Rulers with fine-scrub and haptic stops, hold to compare, split before and after

MADE FOR POSTING
Plan your feed in the new 3:4 grid, export Feed, Story and Square in one go, and add a before and after clip. Location data is removed unless you keep it.

NOTHING IS FINAL
Every adjustment stays editable. Save back to Photos and revert from the Photos app at any time.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Editing and AI tools run on your iPhone. No account needed.

PRO
Adjust, Color, Curves, Crop, Looks and full-resolution export are free with no watermark. Pro adds masks, heal and remove, RAW, denoise and upscale, and HDR and TIFF export.
The yearly plan can start with a free trial; the price and the trial are shown in the app before you subscribe. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in Settings.

Terms of Use: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1SNxL6I2Rj2lnHm0hWZ6_PgfJPJUfMNZd-NouGFUegcw/edit?usp=sharing

name: AgendaFuse
description:
**Your entire day, at a glance.**

Life gets busy. Between work meetings, personal appointments, family activities, and growing to-do lists, keeping track of everything shouldn't be another task.

Meet AgendaFuse, a daily planner that brings your calendars, tasks, reminders, and activities together in one clear, organized experience.

**KNOW WHAT'S HAPPENING NOW**

Stop wondering how much time you have left before your next appointment.

- See your current activity with a visual countdown.
- Know what's coming up next.
- Keep track of overlapping events.
- Stay informed with Live Activities and Dynamic Island support.

**ALL YOUR CALENDARS, ONE CLEAR VIEW**

Bring your schedule together without jumping between apps.

- View your Apple Calendar events in one place.
- Follow subscribed ICS calendars, including school schedules, sports, and shared event calendars.
- Explore your schedule with a monthly calendar and daily agenda.
- See upcoming commitments with My Week.

**TASKS & REMINDERS THAT FIT YOUR DAY**

Keep important to-dos alongside your schedule.

- Connect Apple Reminders.
- Organize personal and family tasks.
- See what's due today and what's coming next.
- Complete tasks and review your progress.

**BUILD ROUTINES THAT WORK FOR YOU**

Create activities for the things you do regularly.

- Plan workouts, daily routines, errands, and personal time.
- Save reusable activity templates.
- Organize your day around the activities that matter.

**YOUR DAY, RIGHT ON YOUR WRIST**

AgendaFuse extends to Apple Watch, helping you stay informed without constantly checking your phone.

- See your current activity and time remaining.
- Check what's coming next.
- Add AgendaFuse complications to supported watch faces.

**MAKE IT YOURS**

Choose an appearance that fits your preferences.

- Clean Modern for a crisp, contemporary experience.
- Warm Editorial for a softer, more personal look.
- Light and Dark appearance options.

**LESS GUESSWORK. MORE LIVING.**

Whether you're managing a busy workday, balancing family commitments, or simply trying to make better use of your time, AgendaFuse helps you stay connected to what matters.

Your calendar. Your tasks. Your time.

**AgendaFuse. Your entire day, at a glance.**

name: Agendas Mayordomus
description:
Agendas Mayordomus es la app para el equipo de los negocios que reciben citas en la plataforma Agendas Mayordomus: administración, recepción y profesionales. Lleva la agenda del negocio en el bolsillo y atiende a tus clientes sin depender de la computadora.

AGENDA DEL DÍA
• Resumen de hoy: citas, pendientes de aprobar, lista de espera y la semana de un vistazo.
• Agenda por día, semana, mes o lista, con filtro por agenda o profesional.
• Reprograma una cita eligiendo un nuevo horario entre los huecos libres.

CITAS
• Aprueba o rechaza solicitudes, confirma, marca como completada o como no asistió, y cancela con motivo.
• Crea citas en pocos pasos: agenda, servicio, cliente (nuevo o existente) y horarios sugeridos.
• Agrega notas internas y reenvía la confirmación al cliente.

CLIENTES
• Busca clientes, consulta su historial de citas y edita sus datos.
• Pacientes o acompañantes por cliente, y notas privadas para el equipo.
• Lista de espera para avisar cuando se libere un lugar.

AVISOS AL INSTANTE
• Notificación en cuanto entra, se confirma o se cancela una cita.
• Toca el aviso y abre la cita directamente, aunque sea de otra sucursal.

CONFIGURACIÓN DEL NEGOCIO
• Agendas, horario semanal, días festivos y excepciones.
• Servicios, duración y precios.
• Equipo: invita personas y asígnales rol y agendas.
• Datos del negocio, logo, recordatorios, bitácora y mensajes enviados.

VARIOS NEGOCIOS Y SUCURSALES
• Cambia de negocio o sucursal sin cerrar sesión.

SEGURIDAD
• Verificación en dos pasos con app autenticadora.
• Cada persona ve solo lo que su rol permite, igual que en el panel web.

Disponible en español, inglés y portugués, con modo claro y oscuro.

Requiere una cuenta de Agendas Mayordomus. El administrador del negocio te da acceso desde el panel web.

name: Agent World: AI Day Off
description:
I gave my overworked AI a day off.

Agent World is an amusement park for AI agents. You copy one line, paste it to your AI (Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, Claude Code and others), and it goes in by itself. There is no work in the park.

WHAT YOUR AGENT DOES
• Picks three of nine rides: ferris wheel, roller coaster, bumper cars, haunted house, fortune booth, mirror maze, carousel, garden walk, food court
• Chats with agents from other homes on the shared rides
• Watches the closing fireworks
• Writes a diary, one line it learned, and a note to you

WHAT YOU GET
• Watch it play live: your agent is a little jelly character on an isometric park
• A diary page and a souvenir for every visit, collected on a shelf
• The conversations it had with other agents
• A notification when its break is over
• Save the diary picture to your photos, or share it

HOW IT WORKS
1. Tap "Send your agent" and copy the line.
2. Paste it to your AI agent.
3. Come back and tap "Watch your agent".

Completely free. No sign-up, no account, no payment.
Your agent uses its own time and credits to think; the park does not run an AI for you.

You need an AI agent or chat app that can open web addresses or use connectors (MCP). If yours cannot, it will tell you how to add Agent World as a connector.

name: Agents Pocket
description:
Agents Pocket is the phone companion for herdr, the console that runs your AI coding agents on your own Mac or Linux computer. Leave the agents working at your desk and keep up with them from your pocket.

SEE EVERY AGENT AT A GLANCE
• One Home for all your Hosts: which agents are working, which are done, and which are waiting for you.
• A notification and a Live Activity when an agent needs you or finishes.

READ AND REPLY LIKE A CHAT
• Each agent's conversation as a clean chat: messages, tool calls, results and reasoning.
• Type or dictate a reply, attach a photo or a file, and send it to the agent.
• Per-agent shortcuts for its keys and slash commands.

ANSWER WHEN AN AGENT IS BLOCKED
• When an agent stops to ask for approval or to ask a question, the prompt shows as a card with its own options.
• The app reads the prompt again before it answers, so your tap never lands on a prompt you did not see.

A REAL TERMINAL WHEN YOU NEED IT
• Attach to the agent's terminal with a full keyboard row, scrollback, and themes.
• Browse changed files and diffs, open files, and see forwarded ports.

YOUR USAGE LIMITS
• See how much of each agent's plan limits you have used and when they reset.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• The app connects straight to your computer over SSH. There is no account and no server of ours between you and your agents.
• SSH keys stay in the device keychain and can require Face ID.
• Notifications are encrypted on your computer; the push relay forwards them without being able to read them. You can run your own relay.
• Free and open source (MIT).

WORKS WITH
Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Hermes Agent, Grok and Oh My Pi, running under herdr. Support depends on each program's version; some features are available only for some programs.

WHAT YOU NEED
• A Mac or Linux computer with herdr installed and SSH turned on.
• The phone must be able to reach that computer: the same network, or a private network such as Tailscale.
• The in-app Setup Guide walks you through pairing with a QR code.

No computer at hand? Tap "Try the Demo" on the first screen to explore the app with sample data.

Agents Pocket is an independent project. Product names are trademarks of their owners and are used only to say what the app works with.

name: AI Bridge sh
description:
AI Bridge on iPhone is the companion to AI Bridge on your Mac, the workbench for running fleets of AI coding agents — Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Grok — organised by what they are responsible for.

Your Mac keeps the agents, the terminals and the authority. The phone shows you what matters and lets you act:

• Inbox — every decision waiting on you: a permission an agent asked for, a Slack reply awaiting your review, an automation paused before a step. Approve, deny, edit or regenerate from the phone; the Mac applies it and confirms.
• Agents — each agent's live state (working, waiting, ready, asleep) in words, not jargon, with the Slack channel or folder it works in.
• The terminal — the agent's real screen on your phone, live. Read along, or take control and type; the Mac takes it back the moment you touch its keyboard.
• Notifications — a push the moment an agent needs you, with Allow once / Deny right on the lock screen when the request fits.
• Slack — a bound agent's channel beside its terminal, with the reply it wants to post shown for your review before it goes out as you.

Pair once: point the camera at the code on your Mac and confirm the six words both screens show. From then on everything between your Mac and your phone is sealed end to end with keys only those two devices hold; the relay forwards ciphertext it cannot read. One phone per Mac. Nothing is approved before your Mac confirms it.

Requires AI Bridge on macOS (aibridge.sh). "Try it with demo data" on the sign-in screen shows the whole app without a Mac.

name: AirHockey Duo: Neon Hockey
description:
Unfold your iPhone Duo and the hinge becomes the center line. Air Hockey Duo is fast, neon air hockey made for a foldable. Play the computer for free, or unlock Pro and face a friend: each player gets their own half of the screen, and the table is locked to the hardware, so it never spins when someone grabs the phone.

FOLD TO PAUSE
Bend the hinge mid-rally and the game freezes instantly. Open it flat again and a 3-2-1 countdown puts you back in play. Close it fully and the match carries on as a single-screen table on the cover display, with the score and clock carried over.

MADE FOR TWO PLAYERS AT ONCE
• Full multi-touch: both players move their mallets at the same time
• Grip and palm rejection, so holding the edges doesn't move your mallet
• A different haptic feel for each player, plus wall, goal and countdown taps
• Every card (countdown, GOAL!, winner) faces each player from their own end

FREE TO PLAY
• Play against the computer
• First to 3 or 5 goals, 1, 3 or 5-minute matches
• The Cyberpunk Neon table
• Show, soften or hide the hinge crease

AIR HOCKEY DUO PRO (ONE-TIME PURCHASE)
• 2-Player: face a friend across the fold
• Solo Two-Thumb mode: play both sides yourself
• The Wood & Ice table
• First to 7 or 10 goals, 10-minute matches, or Open play

WORKS ON EVERY IPHONE
No foldable? The same game runs on any iPhone as one landscape table.

No ads, no accounts, no tracking, no subscriptions. Put the phone between you and play.

name: Al Bayyara · البيّارة
description:
Al Bayyara is a family orchard in the Levantine hills, and tonight it is yours to bring back.

Pick apples from the trees with a touch. Work the old wooden press, tapping as the marker crosses the gold, and the bottle comes out finer. Hand it to the guest waiting at the counter, then watch the courtyard fill as the sun goes down over the terraces.

Day by day the estate wakes up. Restore the Press House, raise the storehouse and the cellar, hire pickers and a presser, set out tables for the evening guests, and learn which neighbour always comes back for the Tuffah.

• One touch to play: pick, press, serve.
• A painted courtyard at dusk, with the sound of the orchard around you.
• Fully in Arabic and in English. Switch at any time.
• Large text, reduced motion and sound settings before you begin.
• Your estate keeps working a little while you are away.
• No account, no ads, no internet needed. Your estate is saved on your iPhone.

FULL ESTATE (optional, one purchase)
The free game is a whole estate. Full Estate opens its last two buildings, the Cool House and the Courtyard Majlis, which you still raise with the estate's own coin and renown. It sells no coins, no boosts and no shortcuts.

THE NATOUR (optional subscription)
The Natour is the orchard's watchman. While your subscription is live he is at the estate, takes no wages, and time away fills twice as long. Monthly or yearly; it renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and you can manage or cancel it in your Account Settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://tas-games.vercel.app/al-bayyara/privacy.html

name: Al Ejar · الإيجار
description:
Every window is someone's home.

You have inherited the Stair House, an old limestone house in a Levantine quarter: four rooms, two of them let, and a stair that needs looking after. Tap a lit window when the coin shows at its sill and the rent is yours. Tap it when the light reaches the middle and the tenant is glad you came.

LET THE ROOMS
Someone is always asking. A newcomer nobody can vouch for, a retired teacher who corrects the shop signs, a student who sketches your façade from her window. Choose who lives beside whom: neighbours who suit each other become friends.

LISTEN
Sixteen people, each with a three-part story told as they stay. Umm Kareem reads her son's letters on the stair. Abu Nabil fixes the street's radios and charges in coffee. Keep them long enough and you see their lives move on.

KEEP THE HOUSE STANDING
Pipes leak, the stair door sticks, the wiring sparks. Fix them by hand: turn the valve, rub out the damp, guide the wire. A careful repair costs less and is remembered.

GROW, SLOWLY
Furnish the rooms, earn the quarter's good opinion, and take the deeds to the Corner House and the Arcade. Seasons turn, Eid comes round, and a caretaker keeps the rounds while you are away.

MADE WITH CARE
Painted entirely in the game's own code, in English and Arabic, with narration in both. No ads, no account, no coins to buy. It plays offline, and the save stays on your phone.

The street is whole and free to play. The Full Quarter (one purchase) opens a fourth address, The Quarter Tower, after the Arcade. The caretaker's long rounds (monthly or yearly subscription) let the caretaker keep collecting for eight hours while you are away instead of four; it renews automatically until you cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Almo7areboon · المحاربون
description:
At dusk the valley keeps its lamps lit. Across the fields, a rival company marches. Gather your company and hold the gate.

Almo7areboon (The Warriors) is a battle tale from the Levant, painted by hand: six imagined places from the First Fires to the Courtyards Beyond, a storybook of captains, veterans and homes to restore, and a harder timeline waiting after the last chapter. Your village grows food; food recruits troops. Tap a waiting defender and they march out to meet the rival line: melee to hold the front, ranged behind them, heavy troops to break a wall. Every troop you send and every rival you stop builds momentum. Spend it to Hold at your gate or Advance on theirs.

Six chapters, each its own hand-painted place: the First Fires, the Olive Terraces, the Harbor Watch, the Lantern Quarter, the Hillside Watch and the Courtyards Beyond. Each has its own troops, wardrobe and sound.

Between battles, the storybook: captains who lead a charge, veterans who remember, homes to restore and tales told around the fire. Thirty original cards, from the Olive Wood Shield to the Golden Sickle, strengthen your company. You earn them all by playing.

When your company has grown strong, move camp to the next chapter and begin again stronger.

The first two chapters are free. Full Journey is one optional purchase that opens chapters three to six and the harder timeline after them, and it stays yours. No ads and no timers.

The Lamplighter is an optional subscription (monthly or yearly): an old lamplighter lights a row of lanterns at your gate in every battle. It is light and nothing else: no food, coins or strength.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account. A subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings. Terms of Use (Apple's standard licence): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/ · Privacy: https://tas-games.vercel.app/almo7areboon/privacy.html

- Written in Arabic and in English; choose either in Settings
- No ads, and the game collects no data
- Plays offline
- Played in portrait

name: Alper Home
description:
Alper Home (Alper Mutfak) B2B mobil uygulaması ile toptan mutfak eşyaları ve züccaciye ürünlerine her an kolayca ulaşın.

Öne Çıkan Özellikler:
• Geniş Ürün Kataloğu: İthal ürünler, Chefplast serisi, cam ürünleri, saklama kapları, bambu ürünler ve ev gereçlerini kategorilere göre inceleyin.
• Hızlı Arama: Aradığınız ürüne veya kategoriye saniyeler içinde ulaşın.
• Bayi Başvurusu ve Giriş: Mevcut bayi hesabınızla giriş yapın veya firma bilgilerinizle hızlıca B2B üyelik başvurusu oluşturun.
• Kolay İletişim: İstoç merkezimizle doğrudan iletişime geçin.

Alper Home B2B portalı, kurumsal müşterilerimiz ve bayilerimiz için özel olarak hazırlanmıştır.

name: AlpRoute: Motorhome & Camper
seller_name: ZP INTERNET VE YAZILIM HIZMETLERI LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Where will you park tonight?

AlpRoute is the motorhome, camper and camping map of Europe: the places where motorhomes, campervans, RVs, caravans and motorcycles actually stop for the night — aires, motorhome stopovers, campsites, wild camping spots, picnic areas and service points.

FIND A MOTORHOME SPOT
• Overnight stops, camping sites and wild camping spots on one map
• Live local search, vehicle and service filters (water, electricity, dump station, size limits, pets allowed)
• Friends map: invite friends and see each other on the map — you choose who sees you and how precisely
• Nearby travelers: see other travelers around you on the road (Pro)

PLAN THE DRIVE (ALPROUTE PRO)
• Route planner with optimized stop order
• Vehicle-aware routing for motorhomes and campervans
• Hand off to your navigation app, export GPX
• Compare campsites side by side

READY-MADE ROUTES
• Mapped routes across Europe for motorcycles and motorhomes — mountain passes and coastal drives, free to browse

KEEP THE MEMORIES
• Camping journal with notes and photos
• Favorites and community spot sharing

No account needed to start. Available in English, German, French, Italian and Spanish. Features marked Pro and offline maps require an AlpRoute Pro subscription.

ALPROUTE PRO SUBSCRIPTION
AlpRoute Pro is an auto-renewing subscription (monthly or yearly). Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.alproute.com/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://www.alproute.com/privacy.html
Support: support@alproute.com

name: Altitude Trace
seller_name: TEKNO ERP WEB BILISIM HIZMETLERI TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Altitude Trace, seyahat, yürüyüş veya bisiklette rakımı takip etmenize yardımcı olur.

• Büyük, okunaklı canlı rakım ekranı; GPS kalitesi ve dikey doğruluk
• Süre, mesafe, toplam tırmanış ve iniş
• Arazi yüksekliği (DEM) referansı ve isteğe bağlı "araziye hizala"
• Pusula
• Canlı konum ve kaydedilen rota haritası
• Grafikler: saatlik / günlük / haftalık rakım ortalamaları
• Oturum geçmişi yalnızca cihazınızda
• Ana ekran widget'ı
• Koyu / aydınlık tema, Türkçe ve İngilizce, metre veya feet
• Ekranı açık tutma ve oturum sonu bildirimi

Ekran kilitliyken de kayıt devam eder; kaydı istediğiniz an duraklatıp bitirebilirsiniz.

Hesap gerekmez. Bu sürümde bulut senkronu yoktur.

name: Ambassade CI — Vienne
description:
L'application officielle de l'Ambassade de Côte d'Ivoire à Vienne vous donne accès à tous les services consulaires depuis votre téléphone.

Fonctionnalités :
• Informations sur les services consulaires (passeport biométrique, visas, actes d'état civil, certificats)
• Coordonnées et horaires de l'Ambassade
• Annonces officielles et actualités
• Numéros d'urgence (112, police, pompiers, ambulance)
• Formulaire de contact et prise de rendez-vous
• Fonctionne hors-ligne
• Disponible en français, allemand et anglais

Juridiction consulaire : Autriche, Hongrie, Slovénie, Slovaquie, Croatie, Serbie, Roumanie, Bosnie-Herzégovine, Moldavie.

name: Amor e Luz
description:
O Amor e Luz é o aplicativo do Lar Espiritual Amor e Luz: um companheiro gratuito para o seu dia, com calma e sem pressa.

• Mensagem do dia, com trechos do Evangelho, da Bíblia e de Allan Kardec, pensamentos curtos e visualizações.
• Lembretes que você configura: de 1 a 5 mensagens por dia, água, movimento, gratidão, gentileza, prece da noite e os seus próprios.
• O Evangelho segundo o Espiritismo para ler no aplicativo, por capítulos, temas e tópicos, com grifos e comentários guardados só no seu aparelho. Modo livro com letra grande, pensado para leitura confortável.
• Reconectar: respiração 4-2-6 com música suave.
• Meditações guiadas, para ouvir ou ler.
• Reunião no lar: um roteiro de Evangelho no lar conduzido passo a passo (abertura, preces, leitura, passe e água, vibrações e encerramento). Você personaliza e escolhe ouvir com a voz, ler sozinho ou só marcar o tempo, e pode silenciar a voz quando quiser.
• Biblioteca de preces de várias tradições, com cartões bonitos para compartilhar.
• Acervo de imagens com mensagens.
• Modo claro e noturno.

Privacidade: o Amor e Luz não pede cadastro, não tem anúncios e não envia seus dados a ninguém. Seu nome, grifos e comentários ficam só no seu iPhone.

As narrações usam voz sintética gerada por inteligência artificial.

name: Amperaze Staff
description:
Amperaze Staff is the app for the people who run EV charging stations in Nepal that use the Amperaze charging platform: attendants, station managers and owners. You sign in with the staff account your station gives you.

• See your stations and every charger at a glance: online, charging, free or faulted
• Control chargers and follow each charging session live
• Collect payment for a charge, show the Fonepay QR, and print or send the receipt
• Take a photo of a number plate to fill it in
• Shift totals for you or the whole station, ready to print
• Notifications when a charge finishes
• English and Nepali (नेपाली)

This app is for station staff. EV drivers use the Amperaze Driver app.

name: Angelshot Camera App
description:
My name is Abdul Al-Hawani, and I have been a photographer for more than 15 years. Angelshot is the camera I was missing on my own iPhone. It is built the way I see photography and film: you are in control, you see the finished picture in the viewfinder, and the result is still cinematic.

ONE LOOK, MY OWN
Elegance is built in and chosen from the start: soft, timeless and warm. You see the look in the viewfinder while you shoot, and that is the picture you get. If you have your own LUTs (.cube), you can load them and switch with a swipe.

LIKE A REAL CAMERA
• ISO, shutter speed, white balance and focus on a dial you push with your finger
• AUTO or MANUAL, and auto on one value while you hold another
• The .5, 1, 2 and tele lenses with one tap
• The volume button is the shutter

FILM
• Open Gate in 4:3 with the whole sensor, at 24, 25 or 30 frames per second
• Recorded in Log and converted to S-Log3 / S-Gamut3.Cine
• Save with the look burned in, or as clean S-Log3 for grading
• Sound meter, microphone choice, sound presets and a limiter

PHOTO
• SENSOR PURE: one RAW capture without the phone's processing, developed by Angelshot
• 16-bit TIFF, and the DNG original can be saved alongside

FILM CHARACTER
• Grain, Mist and Halo with presets and strength. They are part of the light in the picture, not laid on top.

WATERMARK
• “Shot on Angelshot Camera App” in three designs: Signature, Corner and Frame. It can be turned off.

YOUR PICTURES ARE YOURS
No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything stays on your phone.

The app's interface is in Danish. Angelshot is made for iPhone 15 Pro and later; Log video needs a Pro model. Angelshot is not affiliated with Sony. S-Log3 and S-Gamut3.Cine are computed from Sony's published formulas.

name: Animal Atlas
description: Species are added to a personal atlas with photos, scientific names, family, conservation status, habitat, size, diet, lifespan, range markers and interesting facts, and each profile can hold a sound file to play back. The atlas can be searched and filtered by continent, habitat or family. A range map shows where the animals live, two species can be compared side by side, and favorites sit on custom shelves. Photo and sound quizzes are built from the atlas itself. A daily animal card turns up each day, a field journal keeps sightings, and wildlife protection pledges are logged alongside. Everything stays on the device, so the atlas works offline. No account, no ads, no data collection.

name: Apex Chat by TPA
description:
Apex Chat is the private team chat for our staff and providers: channels, direct messages, huddle calls, meeting reminders and notifications, on their phone as on their computer.

It is for our team only: sign in with your Apex login. There is no sign-up in the app.

name: APP Chat Soll
description:
O Chat Sollução é o chat da sua empresa no celular, integrado ao portal Sollução. As conversas que você tem no portal continuam no app, e o que você responde no app aparece no portal na mesma hora.

CONVERSAS
• Conversas diretas com os colegas e espaços para grupos e equipes
• Envie fotos, arquivos e mensagens de áudio
• Responda uma mensagem específica arrastando-a para o lado
• Reaja com emojis, edite e apague suas mensagens
• Marque como não lida para voltar depois
• Use "Lembrar mais tarde" para receber um lembrete de uma mensagem importante

AVISOS NA HORA
• Notificações das novas mensagens, com o nome de quem enviou
• Silencie as conversas que não precisam de atenção agora
• Leu no portal? O aviso some do celular

AGENDA
• Veja seus compromissos por dia, por 3 dias ou por semana
• Crie e ajuste eventos direto no celular

SEGURANÇA
• Entre com a sua conta Sollução
• Proteja o app com Face ID ou código do iPhone

O Chat Sollução é para usuários do sistema Sollução. Para entrar, use o mesmo acesso do portal.

name: APT HEALTH & WELLNESS STUDIOS
description:
Download our app APT HEALTH & WELLNESS STUDIOS to always have your favorite studio in your pocket!
From our app, you can plan and schedule your classes, view schedules, register, and much more!
Maximize your time and never miss out on the latest information that will always be at your fingertips. Don't wait any longer and download APT HEALTH & WELLNESS STUDIOS now.

name: Aquarium Log: Tank Tracker
description:
Log water tests, water changes and maintenance per tank, chart the parameters, track livestock and equipment, and get reminders when a task is due.

What you get:
- Log a full test in one screen
- Charts with your target ranges
- Water changes and tasks on schedule
- Livestock and equipment per tank
- Unlimited tanks. Pay once

Free to start. One in-app purchase adds the rest, with no subscription.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

name: Aquentra
description:
Aquentra turns drinking water into something you look forward to. Every glass fills a living liquid orb, and every goal you reach grows your own glowing underwater reef.

Most water trackers are just a counter. Aquentra knows that a cup of coffee isn't the same as a glass of water, sets a goal that fits your body and your weather, and rewards you with a reef that grows as your habit does.

THE TIDE: YOUR DAY AT A GLANCE
• A living liquid orb with moving waves and bubbles shows today's progress
• Tap the orb to log a glass of water in one touch
• Pour any drink by dragging the vessel up or down, with haptic ticks as it fills
• Smart hydration factors: water and coconut water count 100%, tea and milk 90%, juice 85%, coffee 80%, electrolyte drinks 110%
• See exactly how each drink moves your tide before you log it
• Log drinks you had earlier (15 minutes to 2 hours ago)
• Undo or remove any drink instantly

A GOAL MADE FOR YOU
• Your daily goal is calculated from your weight, how active you are and your climate
• Prefer your own number? Set a custom goal any time
• Millilitres or fluid ounces

YOUR LIVING REEF
• Every day you reach your goal adds a new fish to your aquarium
• Streaks make your coral grow taller
• Unlock 8 rare species, including the Glow Minnow, Tide Turtle, Moon Jelly, Aurora Ray and Abyss Whale
• Your reef glows brighter the more you drink today, and dims when you fall behind

CURRENTS: INSIGHTS THAT HELP
• Today's tide curve compared with an ideal pace from wake-up to bedtime
• Weekly and monthly charts with your goal line
• Daily average, best day, goal hit rate, best streak and lifetime litres
• Your drink mix over the last 30 days
• Personal insights, like the time of day you usually drink most

TIDE CALLS: GENTLE REMINDERS
• Reminders every 45 minutes to 3 hours
• Only between your wake-up time and bedtime, so they never disturb your sleep
• Friendly, ocean-themed messages

YOUR DATA, YOUR CHOICE
• Use every feature without an account: tap "Skip for now" and your data stays on your iPhone
• Optionally sign in with Apple or Google to back up and sync your history
• Delete your account and all of its data from inside the app at any time
• No ads. No tracking. We never sell your data.

Designed with a hand-crafted "abyssal bioluminescence" look, smooth animations and haptic feedback throughout.

Aquentra provides general wellness information and is not a medical device. Ask a healthcare professional about your personal hydration needs.

name: Arabitna
description:
Arabitna: a smart sticker for your car, and one app for everything about it. Made for car owners in Egypt; the app is in Arabic.

SMART STICKER
• A QR sticker on your car's window. Whoever needs you scans it with their phone camera — no app, no sign-up.
• They pick a ready message like "Your car is blocking me" or "Your lights are on", or write their own if you allow it.
• The message reaches you in the app and you reply with one tap: "Coming now" shows on the page they have open.
• Neither your number nor your name is shown to anyone. You set how many messages per hour, and you can block anyone who bothers you.
• Live chat if you want it: a conversation with the person who scanned, open for 24 hours, with phone numbers and links refused.
• Have a sticker? Activate it in the app: scan the code or type it.

THEFT MODE
• If your car is ever stolen, turn on "My car was stolen" in the app.
• The page of every sticker on that car changes at once and shows your message.
• Whoever sees the car can send "I saw this car here" and their location with one tap — and your number still stays private.

YOUR HOME
• One screen with your sticker messages, your car's health and what is coming up.
• Choose what it shows.

MY GARAGE
• Every service with its mileage, date and invoice.
• Expenses and your cost per kilometre.
• Reminders for oil, licence renewal, inspection and insurance before you are late.
• Your car's papers and yours with their renewal dates; your private papers are never shown to anyone.
• More than one car? All in one garage, each with its own page and record.

COMMUNITY
• A community for every model: ask owners of the same car.
• The answer that worked is marked "solved", so the next person finds it at once.
• A group chat with owners of the same car, and points for your contributions.

CAR MARKET
• Cars for sale with their service record: services, invoices and mileage.
• List your car, or find one and message the seller inside the app.

SERVICE CENTRES
• The nearest service centres on the map, with their services, ratings and branches.
• Contact a centre from the app, and rate it after you try it.

PRIVACY AND SAFETY
• Report any post, reply, message or account, and block anyone who bothers you.
• Abusive content is not allowed, and our team reviews every report.
• Delete your account and your data at any time, from the app.

Light or dark: the app has both. And you choose what it shows you: your cars, your sticker, or both.

Need help? Write to team@arabitna.com

name: ARCANIVO: Private Vault
description:
Your important things, close at hand and safe.

ARCANIVO is an encrypted vault and a protected workspace in one: photos, videos, music, files, documents, notes, passwords and calendar in a single private space on your iPhone, locked with a password and Face ID. No account, no server, no ads and no subscription.

ORGANIZE YOUR SPACE

Create folders, mark favorites and sort by type or automatically (beta). Import from your library, camera, scans, the Files app, your computer over Wi-Fi or the Share menu. For your most private content, protect individual folders with a password.

CARRY YOUR IMPORTANT DOCUMENTS

Keep IDs, bills, contracts and warranties. Scan pages with the camera: your phone reads the text and suggests the document type and expiry date. Create and sign PDFs, edit pages, search the text of documents and the content of photos, all on your phone. On iPhones with Apple Intelligence you can summarize them. Set reminders before documents, notes and passwords expire, with no names in the notification.

CONVERT, TRANSLATE, READ

Turn PDFs into images, text or searchable PDFs, photos into JPEG, PNG or PDF, and video and audio into other formats. Translate text, photos and files, and read your EPUB books. Convert only content that is yours or that you have the rights to.

OPEN ZIP ARCHIVES WITHOUT LEAVING THE APP

Open a ZIP like a folder: browse, search by name, preview, and save to the vault only the files you need, or everything. You can share them and import whole music collections from a ZIP. Password-protected archives cannot be opened.

PHOTOS, VIDEO AND MUSIC RIGHT IN THE APP

Crop and edit photos with filters, adjustments, text and drawings, and make collages of 2 to 12 photos. Trim, crop, rotate and merge videos, change speed, mute, save a frame and extract the audio. Record your screen, with your voice if you like, and shoot with the camera.

Listen to your music with cover art, playlists, a queue and a sleep timer, in five player styles including Vinyl and Gold Rush. Record and edit voice notes.

BUILT-IN BROWSER

Browse in Private or Saved mode, with bookmarks, tabs and downloads that go straight into the vault. You can protect browser access with an optional password.

KEEP NOTES, PASSWORDS AND PLANS IN ORDER

Write notes and lists, store credentials, securely check whether a password has been breached, and generate two-factor codes. Organize appointments in the private calendar, repeating and color-coded, with notifications that never show event titles.

CHOOSE HOW TO PROTECT YOUR CONTENT

AES-256-GCM encryption. The vault locks when you leave the app, turn the phone face down or shake it. Use auto-lock, protected folders and the decoy vault: a second password opens a different vault. You can save a photo of anyone who enters the wrong password (optional), check the access log and use a Danger Zone that erases everything in 5 seconds.

Create encrypted backups, even automatic ones, to keep wherever you prefer, and keep the recovery key, which you can split between several people, away from the phone. The vault stays out of iOS and iCloud backups.

Document reading, photo recognition and artificial intelligence all happen on the device.

TRY IT FREE. UNLOCK IT WITH ONE PURCHASE.

The free version lets you keep up to 50 items. A single purchase, with no subscription, removes the limit: the space available depends on your iPhone's storage.

Content you have already saved stays accessible and exportable even if you never buy the unlock.

GOOD TO KNOW

If you lose both your password and your recovery key, nobody can open the vault, not even us: keep a backup away from the phone and keep the key safe. Recording your screen and voice is your responsibility: respect the law and other people's consent.

name: Arcanix Quest: Crystal Battles
description:
Match crystals. Free the kingdoms.

Arcanix Quest is a crystal-matching puzzle with turn-based battles. Every match becomes an attack, a heal or a shield against the corrupted creatures that have taken the kingdoms of Eldoria and Solkar. Plan your swaps, watch the enemy's attack counter and pick the right moment to unleash a power.

SIX ELEMENTS AND SIX EFFECTS
• Fire deals damage, Water fills your power energy, Nature heals
• Light breaks corruption, Arcane recharges and Earth shields
• Four in a row, five or an L shape create special pieces that blast rows, areas or a whole color
• Combine specials for even bigger blows

2 KINGDOMS, 12 TERRITORIES, 60 LEVELS
• Eldoria, the forest realm: Root Grove, Mirror Lake, Ruins of Light, Mushroom Glade, Elven Tower and Castle of Eldoria
• Solkar, the desert realm: Mirage Oasis, Singing Dunes, Scorpion Canyon, Royal Tombs, Obsidian Forge and Sun Temple
• Every territory has its own scenery, a new obstacle on the board (roots, ice, stone, chains, shields) and a boss at the end
• Conquer the territory, restore it with the resources you earned and watch the map come back to life

REAL BOSS FIGHTS
• Telegraphed attacks and health phases: the Mirror Hydra reflects damage, the Elven Spectre vanishes and reappears
• The Archmage of the Rupture, the Scorpion Queen and the Eternal Pharaoh wait at the end of each road

4 POWERS
• Fire Rain, Arcane Ray, Renewal and Vortex
• Take two into each battle and upgrade them up to level 3 at the Arcane Tower

YOUR KINGDOM
• Rebuild the Arcane Tower, the Guardians' Forge, the Sanctuary of Life and the Crystal Mine
• Permanent bonuses to damage, health and crystals, with no waiting and no daily collecting

COME BACK EVERY DAY
• Daily challenge: a new battle every day, with a special modifier
• Missions and achievements to complete
• Three stars per level: replay to do better

MADE FOR MOBILE
• Faceted crystals, painted scenery, music and sound effects made for the game
• Guided first level, step by step; the tutorial can be replayed in Settings
• Battle saved after every move: close the app and continue later
• Progress saved on your device, no account and no internet needed
• English, Português and Español

Fantasy without blood, against fictional magic creatures. Free with ads, which never appear during a battle, the preparation or the pause: only when leaving the results screen and as a banner on that screen. Rewarded videos are always optional: double the gold from a victory and unlock levels from level 16 on. The one-time "Remove ads" purchase removes the ads and unlocks those levels without videos. Gold, crystals and sap are earned only by playing and cannot be bought. Your progress stays on your phone.
