Privacy Policy: https://arcanixquest.filisoft.com.br/privacidade.php?lang=en

name: Arco de Campana
description:
Arco de Campana lleva la Semana Santa de Málaga en tu bolsillo.

• Hoy: la cuenta atrás para el Domingo de Ramos, lo último publicado, la efeméride del día y el evangelio.
• Noticias y reportajes con fotografía a pantalla completa.
• Agenda de cultos de las hermandades de Málaga y su provincia, por meses y con filtros.
• Itinerarios de Semana Santa: hora de salida, Tribuna, Torre Sur, Catedral y encierro de cada cofradía, día a día. Se guardan en el móvil para consultarlos sin cobertura en la calle.
• Templos y hermandades: mapa, ficha de cada templo, titulares, redes sociales y "Cómo llegar".
• Mi cofradía: sigue tus hermandades y recibe avisos de sus novedades, de sus cultos la tarde anterior y, en Semana Santa, cuando van a salir y a pasar por Tribuna, Torre Sur y Catedral. Si una cofradía se retrasa o suspende su salida, la app te avisa y ajusta los horarios.

Sin registro y sin publicidad. Tú eliges qué avisos recibes.

name: Arelplane
description:
Arelplane is the logbook that shows you where flying has taken you.

Every flight you log lands on one globe: the airports you have visited, the routes between them, and the states and countries you have reached. Pilots and passengers both belong here.

RECORD A FLIGHT
Tap Record before you taxi, on your iPhone or your Apple Watch, and put the phone away. Arelplane follows the flight with GPS, in the air and with the screen locked, and works without a signal. When you land it knows where you took off and landed, how long you flew, and draws the path you actually took.

YOUR MAP
• A globe with every route you have flown, as great-circle arcs
• Tap any airport or route to see the flights behind it
• Recorded flights show the real track

YOUR NUMBERS
• Hours, airports, countries and US states at a glance
• Dig into any number: which states, which airports in each, which flights
• Longest flight, farthest airport, highest field, longest streak and more

YOUR LOGBOOK
• Add flights by hand, or scan a boarding pass
• Bring in an existing logbook from a file or a photo of the page
• Send a track log or logbook export from ForeFlight and other apps straight to Arelplane
• Edit any flight; group flights into trips with photos and video
• Search your flights by airport, aircraft, date or person
• On iPad and iPhone Duo, the list stays on the left while the flight and its map open on the right

AIRPORTS, AIRCRAFT AND PILOTS
• Look up any airport or tail number and see your history with it
• Find other pilots and see their maps

Your account works on arelplane.com as well, with the same flights in both places.

name: ARO Eleven
description:
O ARO Eleven é o aplicativo corporativo exclusivo para clientes da agência ARO Eleven.

Com o app, gestores e contratantes têm controle total sobre as entregas contratadas:

- Dashboard Executivo: Indicadores de chamados abertos, entregas concluídas e taxa de eficiência de seus projetos.
- Central de Aprovação de Peças: Visualize imagens e documentos em alta definição, realize aprovações formais em um toque ou aponte os ajustes necessários para a equipe.
- Linha Direta por Chamado: Histórico organizado de comentários e respostas com os especialistas responsáveis pela sua conta.
- Notificações em Tempo Real: Fique informado instantaneamente sobre o avanço de cada entrega prioritária.
- Painel de Serviços Contratados: Consulta rápida ao escopo acordado e canais imediatos de suporte.

name: Aroma TV Player - Live & VOD
description:
Aroma TV Player is a media player for IPTV services that use the Xtream Codes API. It does not include any channels, movies or other content: you need a subscription from your own service provider, who gives you a provider code and a login.

- Enter your provider's code once; the app takes your provider's name, logo and colours.
- Live TV with a TV guide, channel groups, favourites and recently watched.
- Movies and series with posters, details, resume and "continue watching".
- Catch-up TV, where your provider offers it.
- Audio and subtitle selection, with almost every video format (MKV, AVI, TS, MP4, HLS...).
- A connection test that tells you whether a problem is your internet or the provider.
- A lock PIN to hide sections.
- A full interface in Arabic and English, with right-to-left support.

Aroma TV Player does not provide, sell or host any content. Use it only with content you have the right to watch.

name: Arraycraft
description: Arraycraft допомагає бригадам сонячних батарей планувати масиви дахів житлових будинків, не залишаючи будівельного майданчика. Відкрийте дошку проекту, щоб переглядати активні установки, фільтрувати роботи за фазами та переходити до кожного бунгало за допомогою азимутальних фішок та нотаток до фотографій даху. Натисніть на роботу, щоб створити ескіз модулів на живій сітці. Переглядайте умови нахилу, характеристики панелей та відступи під час розміщення кожної комірки. Карта струн (String Map) забарвлює траси MPPT у колір, позначає попередження про VOC та дозволяє оглянути трасу, перш ніж бригада почне підйом. Inverter Bay каталогізує обладнання за допомогою кіловатних фішок та детальної інформації про характеристики. Crew Guide зберігає статті з закладками про азимут, безпеку та найкращі практики. Режим огляду репетирує зразки дахів, коли вам потрібен швидкий ігровий майданчик. Все залишається на пристрої: роботи, ескізи, струнники та налаштування синхронізуються через локальне сховище, тому польові роботи продовжуються, коли сигнал падає. Створено для монтажників, які мислять кіловатами, струнками та чіткими макетами, а не електронними таблицями.

name: Arrow Block Quest
description:
A board of wooden blocks. An arrow you draw. Do you see the square tucked into the corner, or the L shape beside it? In Arrow Block Quest, both can be right. The interesting part is deciding which to collect first so there’s still room for the other.

Find the shapes hidden in the blocks
Start on a wooden tile and let your arrow turn through neighboring squares. Lift your finger and the blocks that form a target shape fly into your collection. The gap they leave can make a clue easier to see. A cluster that looked like nothing a moment ago might be just the shape you need. Try looking at it sideways. An L still counts when it’s lying down.

Pick a challenge that fits your mood
Ease into a Normal puzzle or give yourself a little more to untangle in Hard, Expert, or Master. Each mode has its own boards to unlock and progress to follow. Take your time with a tricky arrangement. The clock records your finish, and you can always revisit a favorite board to beat your personal best.

Two tools for those “what if” moments
●Hint lights up a group of blocks that can form a target. You get a fresh place to look, then draw the arrow yourself.
●Undo brings your most recently collected blocks back to the board and restores the target count. When a move leaves an awkward gap, put the pieces back and give your other idea a try.
●You start with a supply of both tools and can spend coins earned through play to get more.

Give your board a new grain
Earn coins by clearing levels, completing daily tasks, and unlocking achievements. Save them for a wooden tile skin you’ve had your eye on, or keep some handy for your next hint. A different color and grain can give even a familiar puzzle a fresh look.

Which shape catches your eye first, the square in the corner or the L on its side? Download Arrow Block Quest, trace the one you spot, and see what the remaining blocks reveal.

name: Arrow Rush Maze: Labyrinth
description:
Clear the board one arrow at a time.

Every arrow is a small logic puzzle. Tap it and it slides forward along its own bent body. If the way is clear, it leaves the maze and disappears. If another arrow or a block is in the way, it bounces back and you lose one of your three hearts. Read the board, choose the right order, and clear every arrow.

SIMPLE TO LEARN, SATISFYING TO MASTER
• Tap an arrow — no dragging, no timer, no rush.
• Watch it snake along its path with smooth, physics-driven motion.
• Plan the order: removing one arrow can open the way for the next.
• Unlimited free hints whenever you are stuck.

A LONG JOURNEY
The main campaign grows through Easy, Normal, Hard, Expert and Master, with more than 22,000 boards to clear. Stars reward clean runs: lose no hearts and use few hints to earn all three.

FUN BOARDS
Switch to Fun mode for 443 picture boards. Clear the arrows to reveal animals, objects and little scenes.

DAILY CHALLENGE
A new puzzle every day. Solve it to grow your streak, look back through the calendar, and earn a trophy for every month you complete.

RECORDS, AWARDS AND TROPHIES
Follow your best streak, stars and clears in Records; unlock Level Legend, Perfect Play and Unstoppable in Awards; fill the year with Challenge Trophies.

MADE FOR QUIET PLAY
• Fully offline — no wifi, no account, no sign-in.
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no subscription.
• Light and dark themes, optional vibration, five languages.
• Progress saves automatically on your device.

Take your time, find the order, and watch the board empty out.

name: ArrowRelic
description:
Turn the relic. Read the arrows. Find a way to the crystal.

Arrow Relic is a 3D mechanical puzzle game set among ancient ruins. Drag to inspect each structure from different angles, then tap an arrow block with a clear exit. Every direction matters: another block or the core itself can stand in your way.

A PUZZLE THAT CHANGES WITH EVERY MOVE
Gear arrows turn linked sections by 90 degrees, changing both their positions and directions. Keys open matching locks. Magnet-linked blocks move together when their paths are clear. Work out the right order, open the cage, and release the crystal core.

30 PUZZLES, THREE CHAPTERS
Follow the level map through sandstone ruins, icy chambers, and furnace-lit mechanisms. Earn stars as you progress and revisit completed puzzles to improve your results.

THINK BEFORE YOU TAP
Each attempt begins with three hearts. Blocked or invalid moves cost a heart, while looking around lets you plan your approach. Use Hint charges to find a next move, spend Undo charges to revisit a decision, or restart and try a new route.

MAKE THE RELIC YOUR OWN
Unlock six box styles as you advance, from Classic Gear and Frost Prism to Copper Vault and Star Compass. These collectible appearances change the look of your relic while keeping the puzzle rules the same.

Earn in-game coins through first clears, missions, daily gifts, and the Crystal Festival challenge. Spend them on Hint and Undo supplies.

PLAY OFFLINE
No account, advertisements, or in-app purchases. Progress and settings are stored on your device.

name: Artur Kałużny APP Panel
description:
Aplikacja dla uczestników programu mentoringowego Artura Kałużnego i Wyzwania Dodawanie – wyzwania regularnego publikowania rolek.

Wszystko, czego potrzebujesz do pracy nad swoim profilem, masz w jednym miejscu:

• Rolki – materiały, przykłady i Twoje kolejne wersje rolek do omówienia.
• Zadania – plan działań na każdy tydzień i śledzenie postępów.
• Sesje i spotkania – terminy spotkań 1:1 i ich historia.
• Zapytaj Artura – zadawaj pytania i otrzymuj odpowiedzi bezpośrednio w aplikacji.
• Powiadomienia – informacja o nowych rolkach, odpowiedziach i zbliżających się spotkaniach.
• Widżet – najważniejsze informacje i zadania na ekranie głównym.

Ważne: aplikacja jest przeznaczona wyłącznie dla klientów programu. Dane do logowania otrzymujesz po dołączeniu do mentoringu lub Wyzwania Dodawanie. Do działania wymagane jest połączenie z internetem.

name: Ashune
description:
• Save a screen with the opening, mesh allowance, spline join, waste, and roll size
• Mesh is the opening plus the allowance on each side
• Spline is the opening perimeter plus a short join
• Waste is added, then the length rounds up to a whole foot
• A roll is checked both ways, and the fit that yields more pieces is used
• A row multiplies one screen by a window count and compares it with the roll
• Erase the local file from the manual

name: AstroSight: Vedic Astrology
description:
Vedic astrology that shows its working.

AstroSight reads your Vedic (sidereal) birth chart by the Parashari rules of Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra (BPHS), the classical text of Indian astrology. Enter your date, time and place of birth to see your lagna, your Moon nakshatra and your Vimshottari dasha, and to check kundli matching for marriage. Vedic astrology uses the sidereal zodiac, so your signs may differ from your Western ones. Every reading has a "Why this?" button: it shows the placement in your chart behind it, the BPHS rule or verse it follows, and how much a small error in your birth time could change it.

Your kundli, precisely computed
- Janam kundli from your date, time and place of birth, in the sidereal zodiac with the Lahiri ayanamsa
- North Indian, South Indian (the square jathagam layout) or the Modern D1 wheel
- All 16 divisional charts, from D1 and D9 navamsa to D60
- Every planet's sign, house, degree and nakshatra

House Analysis for all 12 houses
- Bhava Phala for each house: its strength, its lord, the aspects on it and the BPHS reading

Know which dasha you are in
- Vimshottari mahadasha, antardasha and pratyantardasha, on one wheel
- A life-chapter timeline of your dashas
- Dates shown only as precisely as your birth time allows

Yogas and doshas, with the planets that form them
- Each yoga found in your chart, with the placements behind it and its own "Why this?"

Transits (gochar) through your own chart
- Jupiter, Saturn, Rahu and Ketu, read from your Moon
- Sade sati status for your Moon sign

Ashtakavarga
- Bindu totals for each planet and sign, from your chart

Kundli matching for marriage, koota by koota
- 36-point Ashtakoot guna milan (gun milan) for two saved charts
- Each of the eight kootas explained, with its own "Why this?"
- Mangal (manglik) balance checked for both charts and explained calmly

Your day, from your chart
- Daily panchang for your city: tithi, nakshatra and paksha
- Rahu Kaal and Abhijit muhurta times
- Today's reading for your own chart
- Pick a day: the next 30 days ranked for travel, an interview, a launch, a purchase, a big talk or study, from your own Moon

Honest by design
- Readings come from fixed classical rules, so the same chart always gets the same reading
- Rules from later tradition are labelled as traditional, not passed off as BPHS
- No consultations to book, no per-minute charges, and no remedies, gemstones or pujas to buy

Subscriptions and credits
New accounts start with free credits. Choose a monthly Star or Cosmos membership for recurring credits, or buy one-time credit packs. Prices are shown in your local currency by the App Store. Manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple Account settings. Purchases can be restored in the app.

AstroSight is for self-reflection and learning. It does not give medical, legal, financial or psychological advice and does not guarantee future outcomes.

Privacy: https://api.astrosight.solenyx.studio/privacy
Support: https://api.astrosight.solenyx.studio/support

name: Ate It: Local AI Food Journal
description:
You already photograph your food. Ate It turns that photo into a private journal entry, with approximate macros and a friendly AI thought, all done on your iPhone. A record to look back on, not a scoreboard, to help with your accountability.

• Snap a meal, pick a photo, or just type what you ate
• Approximate calories, protein, fat, carbs, sugar and fiber for every item, all editable
• A short, supportive AI thought that knows how your day is going
• Today's totals next to international reference values, for context
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Analyzed on your iPhone: no servers, no account, no ads
• Free, with no subscription

THE PHOTO IS THE RECORD
Ate It opens straight to the camera. Take a picture of your plate, pick one from your library, or tap the speech bubble and describe the meal instead. The photo, or your words, is the record. The numbers sit beside it as annotations.

OUR OWN ALGORITHM, APPLE'S ON-DEVICE AI
Ate It doesn't make one AI guess. Each photo goes through our own algorithm, built around Apple's on-device foundation model. It works out the foods, their macros, and how the meal fits into your day for your AI thought.

HONEST NUMBERS
Every item gets calories, protein, fat, carbs, sugar and fiber. No AI can weigh a plate from a photo, so every estimate is shown with a ~ and treated as a rough guide. You can rename items, change values, add something the model missed, or delete something it got wrong, right on the meal page.

FRIENDLY AI THOUGHTS
Each meal comes with a brief, supportive observation that takes into account what you've already eaten today and how the past week has gone. Sometimes it offers a small suggestion. There are no streaks, scores, badges or goals to hit.

YOUR DAY AT A GLANCE
The Today screen adds up the day's meals and sets them next to general international reference values (from the WHO and others, referenced in the app with sources). They're there for context, not as targets. The Journal tab keeps every past meal, photo first, and Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show today's journal without opening the app.

YOUR OWN WORDS
Every meal has a Journal note for whatever you want to write: how you felt, where you were, why you chose it. It's yours, kept apart from the AI algorithms.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Every meal is analyzed on your iPhone by Apple's on-device model. Ate It never sends your photos or descriptions anywhere: it has no accounts, no servers, no ads, no analytics and no tracking, and it makes no network requests. Your photos, descriptions and journal are kept on your device, and included in your iPhone backups like any app's data. Saving meal photos to your Photos library is optional and off by default.

REQUIRES APPLE INTELLIGENCE
Meal analysis uses Apple Intelligence and needs:
• an Apple Intelligence-capable iPhone (iPhone 15 Pro or later) running iOS 27
• Apple Intelligence turned on in Settings
• the on-device model downloaded (iOS does this in the background after you turn Apple Intelligence on)
Results can vary by iPhone: on iPhones with Apple's most capable chips, Ate It uses a more powerful on-device model (AFM 3 Core Advanced).

Without Apple Intelligence, the app opens but can't analyze meals. There is no cloud fallback, on purpose.

A NOTE ON ESTIMATES
Ate It is a journal, not a medical or diet tool. Entry details, macro estimates and AI thoughts are AI-generated and can be inaccurate, so double-check anything that matters. It doesn't give medical advice and isn't meant to diagnose, treat or manage any condition. For dietary needs, talk to a doctor or registered dietitian.

name: Atelier Journal: Client Notes
description:
Atelier Journal is a luxury, tablet-first digital notebook and client tracking workspace crafted specifically for psychologists, executive coaches, therapists, nutritionists, and independent consultants.

Designed to replace cold spreadsheets with the warmth and tactile elegance of a fine leather-bound journal, Atelier Journal pairs a zero-latency 120Hz stylus ink canvas with A–Z client indexing, interactive scheduling, and per-client payment tracking.

KEY FEATURES:

• 120Hz Stylus Ink & Bimanual Touch Canvas
Write naturally with Apple Pencil or active stylus while scrolling pages effortlessly with one finger and undoing strokes with a two-finger tap. Enrich session notes with styled typography boxes, 8 curated fonts, and Polaroid photo attachments.

• Tactile A–Z Client Directory & Multi-Page Dossiers
Jump to any client in seconds using right-edge A–Z tabs. Maintain dedicated, custom-named notebook pages for every client—from Intake & Assessment to Session Notes and Action Plans.

• 5 Authentic Paper Templates
Switch effortlessly between Dotted, Ruled, Graph, Cornell, and Ivory Blank paper textures.

• Interactive Monthly Calendar & Handwritten Daily Agenda
Select any date on the monthly calendar to combine structured appointment schedules with a dedicated handwritten daily briefing sheet.

• Client Billing & Accounting Ledger
Track collected revenue, pending balances, and complete per-client payment histories across bank transfer, card, and cash.

• Private Encrypted Cloud Sync & Offline Reliability
Take notes seamlessly offline with local caching and automatic real-time cloud synchronization protected by strict Row-Level Security isolation.
