name: ATS: Attendance Check-in/out
description:
ATS is the employee app for recording attendance and departure quickly and easily, on a single screen.

How it works
1. Your manager sends you an attendance code from the HR Sys app.
2. Copy the code and paste it into the app once.
3. Tap "Check in" when you arrive and "Check out" when you leave.

Features
• Just two buttons: check in and check out.
• Location check: your position is recorded with every entry, and check-in is allowed only inside the work area set by your manager.
• Works offline: entries are saved on your device and sent automatically, with the original time, once you are back online.
• Monthly attendance report: days worked and total hours, in A4 format ready to print or share as PDF.
• Local mode: record attendance on your device without any code.
• Your data is stored on your device and delivered to your manager through iCloud.
• Arabic-friendly interface.

Notes
• An iCloud account signed in on the device is required.
• To link with your employer, you need the employee code from your manager's HR Sys app.

name: Aubital
description:
Music Cylinder is a drawing instrument. You paint notes on a spinning cylinder; each turn becomes a loop you can layer, retune, and free-look around.

WHAT YOU DO
Open the app to a library of creations. Tap one to enter the editor, or start a new piece from home. In the editor, drag to draw notes around the cylinder — height is pitch, the spin sets the beat. Change instrument and rate from the bottom controls. Stack loops, undo, clear, or enter free look to orbit the sculpture and export a still. Creations stay on this device — there is no account and nothing is uploaded.

HOW IT WORKS
• Home / library — browse saved pieces; open one or create a new cylinder
• Draw — drag to place notes; lift to finish a stroke
• Instruments — piano, glass, flute, bell, cello, drums, and more; try sounds on the pad
• Rate & spin — set pulses per turn and how fast the cylinder turns
• Free look — orbit, pan, and export a still image

Privacy: Music Cylinder does not collect data. Everything you make stays on your iPhone or iPad unless you share an export yourself.

name: Audio Bible - Kadıköy Church
description:
Kadıköy Church is a free audio Bible and Bible reader in English and Turkish. Read the Bible offline, listen to it read aloud and follow a verse of the day and a reading plan, with no ads. It also brings together the churches of Kadıköy, Istanbul, with their service times and locations.

READ THE BIBLE
• The whole Bible in English (World English Bible), Old and New Testament.
• A Turkish Bible alongside it: the Kadıköy Kilise Translation (KK). Read the two translations side by side and compare a verse in both languages.
• Search the whole Bible for the verse you are looking for.

AUDIO BIBLE
• The entire Bible is narrated in English and in Turkish.
• As you listen, each word is highlighted in turn, so you never lose your place.
• Sleep timer, playback speed and 15-second skip back and forward.

OFFLINE BIBLE
• The text comes with the app, so there is nothing extra to download: read and search without an internet connection.
• Download the audio one book at a time or all at once and listen offline.

VERSE OF THE DAY AND READING PLANS
• Today: the Verse of the Day, today's reading, your reading plan and the Daily Flow.
• Reading plans such as Start with John, 30 Days in the Psalms and The Bible in a Year. Most plans add a short question to reflect on and a verse to memorize.
• Advent calendar: from 1 to 24 December a new door opens each day, a short reading at a time on the way to Christmas.
• A Verse of the Day notification and a reading plan reminder at the time you choose, never more than one a day.
• Reading streak, badges and your reading year.

MY NOTEBOOK
• Highlight verses in five colours, write notes and add bookmarks.
• Go over your memory verses until they stay with you.
• If you like, create a free account to sync your notes and progress across your devices. An account is optional.

CHURCHES IN KADIKÖY
• The churches of Kadıköy: a list by denomination, a weekly service schedule and a map.
• The map is built into the app and works offline; directions are one tap away.

The app follows your phone's language (English or Turkish), and you can change it any time in Settings.

No ads, no fees and no analytics tracking you. Kadıköy Church is the mobile companion to kadikoykilise.com.

name: Aura by Quadpoint
description:
Meet Aura by Quadpoint—your lightning-fast, private AI assistant designed specifically for your iPhone and iPad. 

Whether you're brainstorming, drafting, or looking for quick answers, Aura delivers intelligent assistance right on your device with complete privacy and zero cloud reliance.

KEY FEATURES:
• 100% Offline & Private: Runs entirely on your device. Your conversations and data never leave your hands or get uploaded to a cloud server.
• Lightning-Fast Intelligence: Built for speed so you get instant responses without waiting on slow network connections.
• Smart Web & Weather Lookups: Optional live data access when you need up-to-date web results or weather updates on the go.
• Zero Subscriptions: Say goodbye to endless monthly fees. Try it free for 3 days, then unlock full access with a simple, one-time purchase.

Experience the future of private, on-device artificial intelligence today. Download Aura by Quadpoint and keep your data where it belongs—with you.

name: Aussie IT Jobs
description:
Aussie IT Jobs is built for people working in technology in Australia.

FIND THE RIGHT ROLE
• Search IT and tech jobs across every state, from software and data to cloud, cyber security and support
• Filter by city, contract or full-time, and remote work
• Save jobs and apply with the resume on your profile

NEVER MISS A NEW JOB
• Turn any search into a job alert, instant, daily or weekly
• Get notified when employers update your application

TALK TO EMPLOYERS
• Message recruiters directly about your applications and interviews

JOIN THE COMMUNITY
• Tech communities for sharing advice, questions and news
• Discover tech events and meetups near you

YOUR DATA, YOUR CHOICE
• Control push notifications, sign out of all devices, or delete your account at any time from the app

Aussie IT Jobs is made in Australia by Data Intence.

name: Available Stays
description:
Find a place to stay and deal with the owner direct. No booking fees, no middleman, and the best price is usually the one you get from the owner.

HOLIDAY STAYS
Cottages, lodges and cabins, glamping, apartments, places with hot tubs, dog-friendly stays and homes by the sea, in the UK and abroad. Search by town, region or country, add your dates and guests, and see which places are free.

CAMPERVANS AND MOTORHOMES
Find a campervan or motorhome to hire near you, straight from the owner.

WORK AND CONTRACTOR STAYS
Houses, flats and rooms by the week for contractors and crews. Search near a town, postcode or site, and filter for bills included, van parking, separate beds and company invoices. See the hot areas and letting agents at a glance.

AVAILABLE NOW
Owners post dates they want to fill. Keep an eye on Available now for last-minute breaks.

SEARCH THE WAY YOU WANT
- Filter by dates, guests, price, pets, accessibility, amenities and more
- Flexible on dates? Just tell us how many nights
- Browse on the map and search any area
- Know the place already? Type its name or reference number to go straight to it

CONTACT THE OWNER DIRECTLY
Every listing shows the owner's own contact options: send a message, call, WhatsApp, email or visit their website. You arrange your stay and pay the owner directly.

SAVE AND SHARE
Save places you like and share them with friends and family.

No account needed. Just open the app and start looking.

name: Avia Logs: Flight Diary & Map
description:
Avia Logs is a flight diary for everyone who flies. Log every flight you take, watch your routes on a globe, and see how far you've really traveled.

ADD A FLIGHT IN SECONDS
• Snap your boarding pass or e-ticket, or pick a screenshot of a booking email. AI reads the airline, flight number, date, airports, times, seat and aircraft, and you check them before saving.
• A ticket with several legs? They're all found at once.
• Or add it by hand: pick two airports and the date, and add the rest if you like.
• Log upcoming trips too: your next flight waits at the top of the logbook.

EVERY ROUTE ON A GLOBE
• Your flights drawn as great-circle arcs on a globe you can spin.
• Switch between routes, airports and countries.

FLIGHT STATS
• Total distance, hours in the air and laps around the Earth.
• Airports, countries, airlines and aircraft types.
• Longest and shortest flight, top route and flights per month.

YOUR TRAVEL PASSPORT
• Collect every airport, country and aircraft type you fly.
• 24 badges to earn: 10 countries, long-haul, red-eye, crossing the equator and more.

SHARE YOUR YEAR
• A year-in-review card sized for stories.

PRIVATE AND FREE
• Free, with no ads and no account.
• Your flights are stored only on your iPhone. Export a CSV to keep a copy.
• Photos are read and not kept; names and booking codes are never saved.
• Works offline; only reading a photo needs a connection.
• Kilometers or miles and landing reminders.

Avia Logs is for passengers: it doesn't track planes live, it keeps the story of the flights you've taken.

name: Aviators: Sky Wars
description:
Start with a basic biplane and become a legend of the skies.

Aviators: Sky Wars is a vertical air-combat game where you fly alone against the AI: one joystick to fly, and your weapons fire on their own. It is free to play all the way: all content is earned by playing, and purchases only save time. It is an online game: it needs an internet connection.

AN OPEN MAP FOR EACH FRONT
Take off from your airfield and roam an open map full of “?” marks that show how far away they are. Behind them wait patrols, convoys, anti-aircraft batteries, command posts and a boss. Every enemy shows its level and a threat color: hunt the weak and run from the strong.

HOLD AND UNLOAD
What you earn is stored in your hold, which has limited capacity. Return to your base or to a depot and release the joystick to unload and get paid. If you are shot down you do not lose everything. Upgrade the hold to carry more on every sortie.

FORCE A SURRENDER
Break the armor of an enemy plane and it surrenders. Fly in formation beside it for a few seconds to keep its loot, with a chance of a weapon blueprint or an envelope of Funds.

HANGAR AND ARSENAL
Mount weapon cards in your plane's slots: nose guns, turrets, bombs and rockets, each with its own firing arc. There are six rarities: craft cards with blueprints and spare parts in the Arsenal, upgrade them and unlock the next ones. The rarest cards are never sold: they are only crafted with blueprints that drop while you play.

UPGRADE YOUR PLANE AND SEE IT
Every part you upgrade changes your plane's 3D model. Spend what you earn, level up the engine, fuselage and hold, and assemble bigger planes in the Assembly Shop.

ENVELOPES OF FUNDS
Funds come in envelopes: you earn them by playing, and you can also buy them to go faster.

A CAMPAIGN WITH FRONTS
Cross three fronts of a fictional war against the Pact and defeat the boss of each. When you are done, the Endless Air Siege never ends.

ALWAYS SOMETHING TO DO
• Daily and weekly missions
• 7-day and 28-day login calendars and a daily streak
• A Field Crate every few hours
• Events, weekly boss, tournaments and leagues
• Season pass
• Air Base with buildings and a Black market
• Game Center leaderboards
• Available in English, Spanish, German, French and Portuguese

NO WALLS, NO CHAT
There is no energy or lives to slow you down, and no chat or multiplayer: it is you against the AI. The violence is cartoon and fantasy between planes, with no blood; shot-down pilots bail out by parachute.

ADS AND PURCHASES, CLEARLY
The game is free and contains ads: an app-open ad on one opening in five and rewarded videos. Most are optional and give you a bonus (double loot, revive, speed-ups). If you have not bought anything, you also watch a video to collect the Field Crate, the daily reward, the Squadron Trunks and the free-track pass rewards. With any purchase, the first three are collected directly; the free-track pass rewards, only with the season pass. Without a video, the reward waits. There are no full-screen ads in the middle of a flight. Purchases (Funds, season pass and more) are optional: any purchase removes the app-open ad. No plane, part or weapon can only be obtained by paying (a few cosmetics are paid-only). You can delete your account from inside the game.

ACE CLUB (optional subscription)
Monthly auto-renewing subscription; the price and period are shown before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple account on confirmation and renews every month unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://cdpoma.github.io/aviators/privacy.html

name: Ayet Ayet — Meal ve Tefsir
description:
Ayet Ayet, Kur'an-ı Kerim'i her gün biraz okuyarak baştan sona meal ve tefsiriyle bitirmen için hazırlandı.

HER GÜN BİR OKUMA
Her gün sana ayrılan okumayı Arapça metni, Türkçe meali ve tefsiriyle birlikte okursun. Sırayla ilerlersin; bir okumayı bitirmeden sonrakine geçilmez, böylece hiçbir ayet atlanmaz.

OKUYANA KADAR HATIRLATIR
Seçtiğin saatte bildirim gelir. O günün okumasını tamamlamadıysan hatırlatma tekrarlanır.

AYET AKIŞI
Tefsirsiz, kısa günlük ayetler için ayrı bir akış ve ayrı bildirim. Gün içinde bir ayetle durup düşünmek için.

SERBEST OKUMA VE SURELER
Dilediğin sureyi açıp serbestçe okuyabilirsin. Sıralı okuman bundan etkilenmez.

ALTINI ÇİZ, KAYDET
Seni etkileyen ayetlerin altını çiz, Kayıtlar sekmesinde hepsine tek yerden dön.

İLERLEMENİ GÖR
Kur'an'ın ne kadarını okuduğunu, kalan süreyi ve okuma serini takip et.

NAMAZ VAKİTLERİ
Bulunduğun il ve ilçeye göre Diyanet namaz vakitleri. İstersen il/ilçeyi elle de seçebilirsin.

ÖZEL VE ÇEVRİMDIŞI
Hesap yok, reklam yok, veri toplama yok. Kur'an metni, meal ve tefsir uygulamanın içinde gelir; internet olmadan okuyabilirsin. İlerlemen yalnızca telefonunda saklanır.

Meal ve tefsir metinleri Diyanet İşleri Başkanlığı'nın izniyle kullanılmıştır.

name: AZT One
description:
AZT One brings employee self-service information and corporate communication together in one app.

For authorized workplace users:
• View your employee profile and organizational information.
• Check leave balances and absence history.
• Review daily and monthly attendance.
• View payslips with amounts hidden until you choose to reveal them.
• Access training and family records.
• Find colleagues in the corporate directory.
• Make and receive internal voice calls using an authorized corporate extension.
• Use call controls and view recent call history.
• View subordinate structures and leave summaries with manager access.

Real employee features require an existing corporate account, active employment, SMS verification and device registration. Subsequent access is protected by a four-digit PIN. Real corporate services are currently accessible from networks in Azerbaijan.

Calling availability depends on corporate permissions, network access and device settings. The app is not intended for emergency calls.

A clearly labelled demonstration account provides synthetic records and simulated calls. Demo calls do not connect to real telephone subscribers.

AZT One is a personal initiative developed by Kamal Kadirov and is not sponsored by Aztelekom.

Support: lamer224@gmail.com

name: Bakatako
description:
Bakatako is a daily doodle prompt and the community that draws it.

Every day there is one new prompt. Draw your take on it, post it, then scroll through how everyone else drew the same thing.

DRAW
- A full drawing editor on iPhone and iPad: layers, brushes like watercolor, chalk and ink, selection and transform tools, shapes, text, symmetry and filters.
- Your drawing saves as you go, so you can pick it back up later.
- Save your finished drawing to Photos.

SHARE
- Post to today's prompt, or just to your profile.
- Like and save doodles, and reply with a drawing of your own.
- Follow artists you like and see their new doodles in one feed.

LOOK BACK
- Every past prompt keeps its own page and its own color.
- Search for people and doodles.
- Earn medals as you draw.

Bakatako is free. You can browse without an account. Posting needs a free account (Apple, Discord or email). You can report doodles and block people from inside the app, and delete your account at any time.

For ages 13 and up.

name: Baker's Book: Sourdough Bread
description:
Store bread and cake recipes in baker's percentages, scale them to any pan or loaf count, and keep a sourdough starter on a feeding schedule.

What you get:
- Baker's percentages done right
- Change the tin, the recipe follows
- Never forget a feed
- Log every bake and crumb
- Mixed flours, true hydration

Free to start. One in-app purchase adds the rest, with no subscription.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

name: Ball: Bounce Puzzle
description:
Aim, launch and bounce Ball into the goal in as few launches as you can.

Ball is a one-tap physics puzzle. Drag back anywhere, let go, and watch Ball ricochet off walls, bounce on pads, zip through teleporters and press buttons in the right order. Every level can be solved, and none can be skipped with one straight shot.

999 LEVELS
• Earn up to 3 stars on every level, then keep going in endless mode.
• New pieces keep arriving: spikes, spinners, boosters, invisible walls, rhythm walls that switch on a beat, keys and cages, bombs, small rooms and more.
• Stuck? Assisted aiming and hints are there if you want them.

MORE WAYS TO PLAY
• Rush: race the clock and clear as many levels as you can. Grab clocks to slow time down.
• Mirror: one launch moves two balls at once, one of them flipped.

MAKE BALL YOURS
• 36 skins to unlock, from Cowboy to Sushi Roll, plus legendary skins with their own effects and sounds.
• 13 animated backdrops for your Home screen.
• Visit Ball's house in the Wardrobe.

COINS, PRIZES AND REWARDS
• Earn coins by clearing levels, and claim a free gift every day.
• Spend them on continues, skins, backdrops and the Prize Machine: steer the claw, grab a capsule and see what's inside. Drop rates are shown in the machine.
• Fill up the star track for coins, skins and backdrops.
• Coin packs are available as optional in-app purchases.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Plays offline. No account needed. No ads.
• Records and achievements, light and dark mode, vibrations, and 10 languages.

Questions or ideas? Send feedback from the game's Settings.

name: Ballot Atlas
description:
See the patterns behind the vote.

Ballot Atlas brings American election history into focus through interactive maps, clear charts, and guided stories. Start with your county, compare two elections, then step back to see how the country has changed.

EXPLORE THE MAP
Move between state and county views. Compare margins, shifts, and partisan lean. Turn geography into a cartogram sized by votes cast, reveal the difference between two elections with a swipe, or explore the map in three dimensions.

FIND YOUR PLACE
Search by county name or ZIP code, or choose an optional location lookup. Open a place to see its results and trajectory, then save counties you want to return to. Hear a chart as tones, scrub through its years, or share a place’s trajectory.

FOLLOW THE STORY
Explore all 60 presidential elections from 1789 through 2024, a popular-vote timeline back to 1824, and guided stories about the border, Atlanta's suburbs, pivot counties, and the difference between land and voters. Early maps distinguish electoral votes from popular votes and identify electors chosen by legislatures. Historical state and territory boundaries show how the map changed through 1912.

EXPLORE THE HOUSE
Trace party composition across 119 Congresses. Browse district returns from 1920 through 2024 and surviving early returns from 1788 through 1825. Missing or unconfirmed historical counts are left blank and explained. A dated 2026 House snapshot covers all 50 states and 435 districts, combining official state returns where collected with NPR's AP-tabulated results elsewhere. It is preliminary, not certified, and does not call winners.

EXPLORE THE SENATE
Browse historical Senate results and a dated preliminary 2026 snapshot of 35 races, including special elections. View candidates, published vote shares, source notes, and ranked-choice limitations.

LOOK BENEATH THE RESULTS
Explore realignment, polarization, demographic relationships, bellwether counties, and the movement of counties between political camps. Compare Senate and presidential results, or trace how a state's lean has changed.

BUILD A WHAT-IF
Assign states to build your own electoral map. In the 2028 Lab, explore 6,000 simulated maps. Adjust the national environment, national uncertainty, state-level volatility, trend continuation, and the weight of the preliminary 2026 House signal. These scenarios are illustrative models, not election forecasts. Assumptions and data limits appear alongside the results.

KEEP A COUNTY CLOSE
Add a county widget or an election-history widget, including Election of the Day on the Lock Screen. Find county results through Spotlight and use the app's county lookup with Siri and Shortcuts.

BUILT FOR EXPLORATION
Election data is bundled with the app, and calculations run on your device. No account is required. Optional location lookup finds your county on device without storing your coordinates or sending them to us.

A REFERENCE, WITH CONTEXT
County presidential maps cover 2000-2024. Sources include MIT Election Data + Science Lab, the Clerk of the U.S. House, the House Historian, the National Archives, Mapping Early American Elections, Newberry Library, historical reference tables, the U.S. Census Bureau, and USDA Economic Research Service. Source links, attribution, and coverage notes are included in the app. Alaska boroughs and Connecticut's 2024 county views use marked statewide stand-ins where comparable county results are unavailable.

Use the warm Paper appearance or the original Midnight palette. On larger displays, keep the map and place details together.

Ballot Atlas is an independent, nonpartisan reference app. It does not provide live election-night results, voting instructions, or official election services.

name: Ballrun-racing
description:
Ballrun is a 3D marble race decided by physics. Pick your ball, improve it and beat the computer balls down the tracks.

52 TRACKS IN SIX WORLDS
Roll through Cities, Sports, Amusement Park, Buildings, Grand Race and Classic. Ride the San Francisco cable car, the ski jump, the pinball hall, the haunted house and much more. Every track has its own shape, and the balls behave differently on each one.

SEVEN BALLS WITH THEIR OWN PERSONALITY
Steel, wood, rubber, porcelain and more. Some are fast on the flat, others grip the corners, and some bounce where you least expect. Earn credits by playing and upgrade your ball.

DESIGN YOUR OWN BALL
Choose colours, material and pattern, add numbers or initials, or use your own picture. The picture stays on your device.

AUTO OR MANUAL
Let physics do the work in Auto, or nudge the ball yourself with the on-screen buttons in Manual.

DAILY CHALLENGE AND LEADERBOARDS
The same track and the same opponents for everyone each day. Race for the best time and see your name on the leaderboard.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Create a room with a code, and up to eight players watch the same race on their own devices. You can also send a challenge, and your friend races against your ghost.

PLAY OFFLINE
Regular races work without a connection. Leaderboards and rooms need one.

CREDITS
Credits are an in-game currency earned only by playing. They cannot be bought, withdrawn or exchanged and have no monetary value.

FREE TO PLAY
You can choose to watch a video ad to get a free super race. Premium is a one-time purchase that gives super races without ads and removes the ad buttons. Credits cannot be bought.

name: Bapcat: Games for Cats
description:
Lay your iPhone or iPad on the floor and watch your cat hunt. Bapcat's toys move like real prey: they dart, freeze, hide and peek back out, and every swat gets a reaction.

24 TOYS THAT MOVE LIKE PREY
• Mouse, fish and laser dot to start with
• Ladybug, fly, beetle, butterfly, bird, feather, lizard, yarn string and spider
• Cricket, ant, crab, frog, tadpole, shrimp, dragonfly, bee, moth, firefly, hummingbird and a jingle ball
• 16 scenes with hiding spots, from a wooden floor and a rug to a pond, a beach and a night garden
• "Cat colours": blue and yellow prey on calm backgrounds, the colors cats see best
• Several toys at once with Mix, or let the Carousel switch toys on its own
• Play adapts to your cat: faster when it catches everything, slower when it struggles, and every hunt ends with an easy last catch

PREY CAM
Turn on Prey Cam and the front camera films your cat from the prey's side. When the hunt ends, Bapcat cuts the best catches into a short clip with slow motion and a catch counter. Clips stay on your device until you save or share them.

MADE FOR PAWS
• No buttons on the play screen for paws to press
• Hold the top-left corner for 2 seconds to end a hunt
• Step-by-step help to lock the screen with Guided Access

EVERY CAT GETS A PROFILE
• Catches, fastest reaction, favorite toy and hunt history
• Medals, a daily play goal and a streak
• A weekly Hunter card to share
• Record your own call: Bapcat plays it when a hunt starts and when your cat wanders off
• Play reminders, only if you want them

No ads. No account.

Stay with your cat while it plays, keep hunts short and finish with a real toy or a treat. A case or screen protector is a good idea.

FULL TOY BOX
Mouse, fish and laser dot are always included, and you can try each of the other toys once for 3 minutes. The Full Toy Box unlocks all 24 toys in every mode, Prey Cam clips in 1080p without the mark plus the side-by-side layout and music, any number of cats with full history and the weekly Hunter card, and your own call.

The Full Toy Box is offered as a weekly, monthly or yearly subscription, or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://bapcat-app.web.app/privacy

name: Bar - Pide Lo Nuestro
description:
Bar - Pide Lo Nuestro es la app para dueños y administradores de bares, discotecas y gastrobares que usan la plataforma Pide Lo Nuestro. Controla tu noche desde el celular, en tiempo real.

CON BAR - PIDE LO NUESTRO PUEDES:
• Ver la noche en vivo: ventas, cuentas abiertas, ventas por hora, bebidas más vendidas y ticket promedio.
• Seguir las comandas de la barra y la cocina al instante.
• Controlar la caja: aperturas, cierres, arqueos y movimientos.
• Llevar el licor y los insumos: botellas, stock, kardex y ajustes.
• Detectar fugas de la noche: cortesías, anulaciones y descuentos fuera de lo normal.
• Administrar meseros, personal y asistencia.
• Gestionar clientes, fiados y cuentas por cobrar.
• Ver reportes de ventas, equipo, operación e inventario en gráficas claras.

Multi-sede: maneja varios locales desde una sola cuenta.

IMPORTANTE: esta app es para negocios que ya tienen una cuenta en Pide Lo Nuestro. Debes iniciar sesión con las credenciales de tu bar.

name: Baraonda
description:
Your phone hosts the party.

Put an iPhone in the middle of the table. Inside is Fausto: a host convinced he is presenting the biggest show on world television. He is in a living room, in front of six people, but don't tell him.

Fausto talks, explains the games, keeps score, asks for applause and judges it. All you have to do is play.

FIRST, THE AUDITION
- Five secret questions each: two confessions, two nominations, one bet on who will lose.
- Taps only: nothing to type, twenty seconds a person.
- Your answers become the games of the evening.

THE GAMES
- The fuse: answer and pass the phone. It ticks in your hands, and it goes off on somebody.
- The big survey: "who in the group would you never trust with a plant?" Guess who got the most votes.
- The phone knows: answer in front of everyone what you confessed in secret. The others decide if you are lying.
- The impostor: everyone knows the word except one of you. Find them.

THE SHOW
- The applause meter: clap, the phone measures, and Fausto takes offence or glory.
- Losers don't get a forfeit: they get a condition. "Until the next round you talk like a sat nav."
- The twist: in the second-to-last round, whoever is last scores double.
- End-of-night awards, written about what actually happened.

THE NEWS OF THE EVENING
- At the end Fausto edits a thirty-second film: the faces, the headlines, the awards.
- A different genre every time: the news, the nature documentary, the match report, the trailer, the weather, the horoscope.
- Send it to the group with one tap.

MADE FOR THE TABLE
- 3 to 10 people, one phone.
- Two tones: family and friends. Ages thirteen and up.
- Works offline too.
- Evenings last twenty minutes, half an hour or an hour: you choose.

WITH RESPECT
- Videos, faces and the sound of the room stay on the phone.
- The microphone measures applause on the phone: nothing is recorded.
- If you want, Fausto writes rounds and the news about you with an AI service, which only receives names, audition answers and a list in words of what happened. He asks first, and everything works if you say no.
- No account, no ads.

Some sounds and Fausto's voice are generated with artificial intelligence.

Baraonda is an app by Cesarina, the home of Lorenzo Bazzani's apps. More apps at cesarina.app.

name: BarNone
description:
BarNone is a visual inventory for the things you own.

Photograph an object and its background disappears, leaving just the thing itself. Every item lives in one clean grid, so you can see what you have at a glance.

BUILD YOUR INVENTORY
• Take a photo or choose one. The background is removed automatically, on your device.
• BarNone suggests a name. Change it, add a weight, pick a category.
• Add up to ten photos at once, then name and weigh each one.
• Tidy any cut-out by hand: erase, restore, or tap a leftover patch to remove it.

MAKE LISTS THAT WORK
• Make a list for anything: a trip, a camping kit, a shoot, a move.
• Double-tap an item to mark it packed. Hold it to flag that it needs attention.
• Add written entries too, like "find keys" or "take bins out".
• See at a glance how many are packed, the percentage, the total pack weight and what is still outstanding.

FIND THINGS FAST
• Items are grouped by category: clothing, accessories, toiletries, electronics, gear and miscellaneous.
• Hold the title to search by name or narrow to one category.
• The things you use most come first.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account. No ads. No tracking.
• Your photos and lists stay on your device.

Light and dark appearance. Made for iPhone and Mac.

name: Barnrise
description:
Barnrise is an alarm clock that will not let you sleep in, because someone on the farm is waiting to be fed.

The alarm rings and you get a task. Solve it and you earn breakfast for a farm animal. Skip it and nobody eats.

EIGHT WAKE-UP TASKS
- Math problems
- Word scramble
- Word search
- Typing
- Shake your phone
- Photo proof: point your camera at something real, recognized on your device
- Push-ups, counted by your camera
- Go for a run: real steps, counted by your phone

Choose which tasks can wake you, set easy, medium or hard, and pick a new one every morning or the same one on the same weekday.

EIGHT ANIMALS, ONE FARM
You start with Hazel the chicken. Adopt Bess the horse, Scout the dog, Daisy the cow, Clover the sheep, Marmalade the cat, Biscuit the rabbit and Nibbles the goat with gold you earn by waking up, or unlock the whole farm with Barnrise Plus. Name every animal you adopt and keep a certificate of adoption.

Feed an animal three times and it loves you. Keep a streak going and every feeding is worth more gold: 20% more at three days, 50% more at a week, double at thirty.

NEVER TRAPPED
If a task is too hard this morning, you are never stuck. Switch to a different task after two minutes, or walk away after five. The alarm stops either way, you just do not earn breakfast. An alarm should be hard to ignore, not impossible to escape.

A SERIOUS ALARM CLOCK UNDERNEATH
- On iOS 26 and later, Barnrise rings through the system alarm feature, so it can sound on silent and in Focus
- On earlier versions of iOS, alarms use notifications, which silent mode and Focus can mute. Check your volume and Focus settings the night before
- Repeat days and a different time for each weekday
- Alarm tones named after your pets, climbing from quiet to the volume you chose
- A Bible verse waiting for you every morning, free
- No ads. No account or login required

WHAT IS FREE
The free version is a real alarm clock and a real farm: your wake-up time, repeat days, the math task, Hazel the chicken and a Bible verse every morning all work without paying.

BARNRISE PLUS
Plus unlocks every wake-up task, the whole barn of animals, all alarm tones, a different alarm time for each day of the week, and streak insurance, so one missed morning a month will not break your streak. Choose monthly, annual (with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers) or pay once for lifetime access.

PRIVACY
The camera is used only for the photo and push-up tasks. Pictures are checked on your phone and are never saved or uploaded. Physical activity data is used only to count steps for the running task. Each permission is requested the first time you use the feature that needs it.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple Account settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you subscribe.

Privacy Policy: https://barnrise.yellow8.app/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://barnrise.yellow8.app/terms/

Someone on the farm is counting on you. Get up. Stay up.

name: Barpoint
description:
Barpoint points a psalm or canticle for Anglican chant, then plays the four parts on this iPhone.

Pick a psalm, a canticle, or paste two halves with a colon. Barpoint places the bars from the speech rhythm and shows which half of a double chant to sing. Tap between syllables to move a bar. A word outside the built-in list is marked so you can check it.

Open Sing to hear soprano, alto, tenor, and bass. Solo one part, change the tempo, or shift the key. Share one page as a PDF.

Services stay on this phone. There is no account and no sign-in. The tunes are original desk chants written for Barpoint.

name: Barra Lista
description:
Barra Lista turns your home into a real bar.

Scan your bottles' barcodes and the app tracks how much is left in each one, in milliliters. Then it shows which drinks you can make right now, with exact measures for any number of guests.

• Barcode scanning; add any missing bottle once and it's saved.
• Stock in ml that goes down every time you make a drink.
• Easy-drinks filter, flavor profile and substitutions.
• Bartender mode: step by step, exact jigger guide, 3-2-1 shake timer and pro tips.
• Weekend reminder with a plan based on what's in your bar.
• Latin and classic cocktails: Pisco Sour, Chilcano, Margarita, Paloma, Mojito, Caipirinha and more.

BARRA LISTA PRO (OPTIONAL)
Removes ads and adds the party menu and reminders on several days. Monthly, or yearly with a 7-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account and renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, in Settings › your name › Subscriptions.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://tikabustudio.com/barralista/privacy/

For people of legal drinking age only. Drink responsibly.

name: Bartender Barry
description:
Bartender Barry is a bartending simulation. It puts you behind a neon-lit bar and asks you to run it, one night at a time.

POUR IT RIGHT
Take the right glass, hold the tap or the bottle, and let go at the line. Add ice, a lime wedge, mint or a cherry, then serve. Perfect pours build a combo, and a long enough combo opens Happy Hour: double cash for every drink.

RUN THE WHOLE BAR
Kegs run dry and bottles empty. Head to the back room, wash the dirty glasses, and let Barry carry a fresh keg to the bar while the customers keep waiting out front.

A NEW KIND OF TROUBLE EVERY NIGHT
• Tipsy customers who really should have water
• Regulars who need someone to listen
• A clogged toilet, bar fights, and guests who leave without paying
• Power cuts and the health inspector
• The Mob. Pay for protection, or fight. Win, and they come back with a bigger crew.

MAKE IT YOURS
Unlock 13 drinks as you level up and spend your earnings on more stools, a jukebox, a bouncer, better plumbing and a better arsenal. Three daily goals and a streak bonus give you a reason to open the bar tomorrow.

DRAWN AND PLAYED IN CODE
Every character and every bottle is drawn in code, and the music is generated live: lounge jazz while the bar is calm, something darker when the Mob walks in.

• Guided first night that teaches everything
• English and Turkish
• Free to play. No banner ads. Optional purchases remove the ads between nights or add bar cash.

Bartender Barry is a cartoon simulation game about running a bar. Please drink responsibly.

Questions? hello@krvlgames.com

name: Basal Mark
description:
Basal Mark is a thinning tool for foresters and woodland owners. Lay out fixed-area plots, put every tree on a stem map, and mark trees until the residual basal area reaches your target.

PLOTS AND STEM MAP
Pick a plot size (0.02, 0.04, 0.05 or 0.1 ha; 1/20, 1/10 or 1/5 ac; or your own radius). Tap the round plot map where a tree stands to add it by bearing and distance, and drag it to correct the position. Trees are drawn by diameter and species colour; crop trees are ringed and culls crossed.

DIAMETER AND HEIGHT
Slide the jaw of a drawn caliper to the stem, nudge it by half a centimetre, or type the diameter. Measure height with the phone's tilt: sight the top, sight the base, set the horizontal distance. Missing heights are estimated from measured trees of the same species.

STAND FIGURES
Basal area, trees, quadratic mean diameter and volume per hectare, with a confidence interval, the sampling error and how many more plots you need to reach your allowed error.

MARK TO TARGET
Switch the plot to Mark and tap trees. The stand board shows now and after marking against a target line you can drag. Auto marks the plot for you: thinning from below takes culls and the smallest stems first; crown thinning takes the competitors around your crop trees. Crop trees stay unmarked.

DIAMETER CLASSES AND MARKING SHEET
Stems or basal area by diameter class, before and after, and each species' share. The marking sheet lists every marked tree plot by plot with diameter, height and volume, and shares as CSV and text.

Species with code, colour and form factor. Metric or imperial units.

Everything stays on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Bastioneers
description:
The heart crystal is all that stands between the lands and the darkness. Place your heroes along the road, make them stronger and hold back every wave. Bastioneers is tower defense in lovingly crafted pixel art, with heroes instead of towers.

HEROES, NOT TOWERS
• Knights, archers, frost mages, bomb throwers and many more: every hero fights in their own way.
• Raise them through three levels, then choose their master class.
• Call new heroes with the hero call and awaken legends.

A LONG CAMPAIGN
• 75 levels in 15 chapters, from the Green Meadow to the lands beyond the sea.
• Every land with its own monsters, its own bosses and a lord at the end.
• Stars, chests, tasks and a camp that keeps working for you.

TACTICS IN EVERY WAVE
• Relics change your hero classes in the middle of battle.
• Meteor, Ice Age and War Horn: runes make your abilities more and more powerful.
• Turn your phone and the battlefield turns with it.

TOGETHER
• In co-op you defend one shared crystal: you on the left, your partner on the right.

WEEKLY ARENA
• Every week a new colosseum with a twist of its own.
• Fight with your own party in five ranks, from bronze to diamond.
• Climb the leaderboard and earn rewards for your place.

PLAYED FAIR
• Play without signing in. If you like, back up your progress with Sign in with Apple.
• Ads only when you choose them, for a second chance or bonus gems.
• Free with optional in-app purchases. No hero can be bought directly, and legends have to be earned.

name: Battle Baseball
description:
Battle Baseball runs youth baseball player showcases in Baton Rouge. Players sign up on their own, play with others at their skill level, and leave with real numbers.

At every showcase:
• Fastball velocity on radar, plus pop time and 40-yard dash
• Batting and pitching stats from the games
• Awards like MVP, Top Pitcher, and Top Hitter

In the app:
• A player card for each of your players, with their top fastball, awards, and a velocity chart across showcases
• Leaderboards by grad year for fastball, pop time, and 40 yard
• Showcase dates, age groups, and open spots, and reserving a spot
• Results posted after each showcase

Cards are private until a parent switches them public, and birth dates, schools, and contacts are never shown. Accounts are for parents and guardians 18 and over.

Every showcase raises money for local teams whose volunteers coach, keep score, and coordinate the day.

name: BaweanPintar
description:
BaweanPintar adalah aplikasi belajar untuk siswa SD/MI, SMP/MTs, dan SMA/MA/SMK. Berlatih soal, ikut try out, dan kenali minat kariermu — semuanya dari HP.

LATIHAN SOAL
• Bank soal per jenjang dan mata pelajaran untuk persiapan TKA dan UTBK.
• Setiap soal dilengkapi pembahasan yang muncul setelah kamu menjawab.
• Latihan per bab untuk memperkuat materi yang belum dikuasai.
• Termasuk contoh soal yang dirilis Pusmendik, ditampilkan lengkap dengan sumbernya.
• Gambar soal bisa diperbesar dengan sekali ketuk.

TRY OUT & SIMULASI
• Try out berwaktu seperti ujian sungguhan.
• Simulasi lengkap beberapa mata pelajaran sekaligus.
• Jawaban tetap tersimpan walau sinyal putus dan dikirim otomatis saat koneksi kembali.
• Nilai dan rekap hasil langsung terlihat setelah selesai.

TUGAS DARI GURU
• Kerjakan tugas latihan yang diberikan guru, lengkap dengan tenggat waktu.

TES DARI SEKOLAH
• Masukkan kode tes dari sekolahmu untuk mengerjakan tes minat karier (RIASEC) dan gaya kerja (DISC).
• Laporan hasil bisa dibuka langsung di aplikasi.

AKUN & PRIVASI
• Beranda bisa dilihat tanpa akun; akun hanya diperlukan untuk mulai berlatih.
• Kamu bisa menghapus akun beserta datanya kapan saja dari menu Akun.

BaweanPintar dibuat untuk siswa di Pulau Bawean dan daerah lain di Indonesia, dengan tampilan ringan yang nyaman dipakai di HP. Aplikasi ini adalah alat bantu belajar dan bimbingan karier, bukan layanan diagnosis.

name: BayPothSaraku
description:
A refrigerated shipment starts with a loading plan, not a live machine feed.
BayPothSaraku keeps trailer preparation and dock records together on your iPhone.

TRAILERS & CARGO IDENTITY
Register trailers and organize the pallets assigned to them.
Keep temperature classes visible in the loading plan.
Identify the staging readiness recorded for each load.
Review loading slots as planning details, not dock reservations.

WHAT WAS ACTUALLY LOADED
Record loading events as the work takes place.
Update the loading state using information entered by staff.
Document departure details and operational notes.
Keep each event distinct from the original plan.

TEMPERATURES WITH CLEAR ORIGINS
Enter temperature information as a manual observation.
Review values as recorded, without claiming sensor verification.
Use temperature classes to organize the cargo context.
No refrigeration equipment or calibrated sensor connection is required.

FOLLOW-UPS THAT STAY LOCAL
Set reminders for planned dock and loading tasks.
Choose whether to allow local notification alerts.
Return to saved records when a follow-up needs attention.
Operational information stays on the iPhone without sign-in or cloud sync.

BUILT FOR RECORDKEEPING
The app does not track trailers remotely or connect to dispatch systems.
It cannot reserve capacity, optimize routes or authorize departure.
It does not measure cargo condition or certify food safety.
BayPothSaraku makes manual cold-chain loading records easier to revisit.

name: BBPS Alumni
description:
BBPS Alumni is the digital home for the global alumni of Bal Bharati Public School. Bridging decades of excellence through meaningful connection, it brings former students together wherever life has taken them.

Reconnect, give back and grow with the BBPS community.

• Reconnect with batchmates
Find classmates by batch and branch, view alumni profiles and start a conversation with in-app chat.

• Alumni events
Discover reunions, meetups and school events, see the details and register in a few taps.

• Announcements
Get the latest news from the school and the Alumni Association, with notifications so you never miss an update.

• Mentorship
Connect with experienced alumni who can guide you through careers, higher studies and life after school, or volunteer as a mentor yourself.

• Careers and jobs
Browse opportunities shared by fellow alumni, apply directly, or post openings at your own organisation.

• Give back
Support school initiatives and fundraising campaigns, and help the next generation of Bal Bharatians.

• Gallery
Relive memories with photos from events, reunions and school life.

• Your profile
Show your class year, branch, profession and expertise, so the right people can find you.

• Help and support
Have a question? Contact the support team from inside the app.

Sign in with your phone number or email to get started. Your profile is verified by the Alumni Association, which keeps the community genuine and safe.

Once a Bal Bharatian, always a Bal Bharatian. Welcome home.

name: Beam: Screen Mirroring & Cast
description:
Big moments deserve more than a small screen. Beam brings your photos, videos, PDFs, compatible web videos and whiteboard ideas to a larger display. Cast one item when you want to keep it simple, or bring different content together in a Beam Session for a meeting, a story or a gathering.

CAST WHAT YOU CHOOSE
Share selected photos, play local videos, present PDF pages, or cast compatible web videos from Beam's built-in browser. You can also bring a whiteboard to the screen. When casting selected content, only the items you choose are shown on the display. Screen mirroring is available on supported devices.

MAKE IT A SESSION
With Beam Session, bring photos, videos, PDFs, web videos and whiteboards into one playback queue. Drag to change the order, choose how each item plays, and guide the experience from your phone. Move through meeting materials with purpose or let shared moments unfold in sequence.

DRAW LIVE OR PREPARE AHEAD
Use a live whiteboard to draw on your phone and show your strokes on the connected screen in real time when supported. Or prepare a whiteboard in advance and display it as a static page. Beam shows the available options for your connected device.

CREATE A MEMORY CLIP
Turn selected photos into a short clip with transitions, music and filters. Preview your creation before casting it.

KNOW BEFORE YOU START
Beam works with compatible AirPlay, Google Cast and DLNA devices. Before a Beam Session begins, Beam checks the selected connection and shows which items can play, which need a compatible presentation mode, and which are unavailable. Casting and mirroring capabilities vary by device and format.

Playback depends on your device, network, file format and content provider. Some protected streaming content may not support casting or mirroring. Beam does not download protected media or bypass DRM or third-party platform restrictions.




Privacy Policy:
https://aplsapp.com/privacy/privacy.html

Terms of Use:
https://aplsapp.com/terms/terms.html

name: Bear Bash
description:
Walk, stop, THROW! Lead a brave polar bear room by room through the snow and knock the warthogs out of the fight with snowballs.

Bear Bash is a room-by-room action game for all ages. Drag anywhere to walk, let go and your bear throws snowballs at the nearest hog all by itself. Clear the room, walk out the door, and grow stronger with every level-up.

STOP TO THROW
One easy rule, taught by a friendly coach in the very first room.

13 SKILLS TO MIX
Pick 1 of 3 at every level-up: toasty fire snowballs, icy Frost Balls, Bounce Balls, a Snow Buddy that circles you, Big Throws and more.

98 ROOMS IN 3 CHAPTERS
The Snowy Outpost, the 50-room Frozen Frontier and the twisting Glacier Gorge, with mini-bosses, thin ice, rolling snowballs, and Big Tusk, the boss hog.

YOUR RUN IS SAVED
At every door, with checkpoints along the way. Bedtime? Pick it up tomorrow.

UPGRADES THAT STAY
Spend the coins you earn on more HP, quicker paws and more. Each upgrade has a fixed coin cost.

A NEW GOAL EVERY DAY
A coin reward, and nothing lost if you skip a day.

HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
One free get-up every run, and if the hogs win a few times in a row, a Bear Hug gives you a stronger start. Earn up to 3 stars a room for dodging bumps.

HARD MODE
Clear a chapter to open it: tougher hogs, double coins and a new set of stars.

MADE FOR FAMILIES
- No ads.
- Nothing to buy: no loot boxes, no random rewards.
- Cartoon snowball fun only: hogs go "poof" and run off.
- No chat, no accounts, plays offline.
- Grown-up check before any outside link.
- Big buttons, big text and a reduce-motion setting.

Made by Seventh Anvil Games, the makers of Polar Bears vs. Warthogs.

name: Bears vs Hogs: Floe War
description:
Send your polar bears across the melting ice bridge and push the warthogs back to their camp!

Bears vs Hogs: Floe War is a bite-size strategy battle for the whole family. Energy fills up by itself: tap a unit card to send it onto the one ice bridge between the two camps. Reach their camp to win! Every splash melts the bridge in from both ends, so the camps creep closer. When do you push, and when do you hold?

10 UNITS, 5 A SIDE
- Bears: brawling Cubs, speedy Sledders, Snowball Bears, Lantern Bears and the mighty Digger.
- Hogs: Chargers, Mud Spitters, Shield Boars, Snow Piglets and Spark Hogs.
- Every unit hits harder on its own home ice.

PICK YOUR 3
Before each battle, see what the other side brings and choose the three units that beat it. Freeze, zap, fire and mud: hit the element yours beats for SUPER damage.

TWO CAMPAIGNS, 16 BATTLES
Play the bears' campaign or the hogs'. Earn up to 3 stars a battle and win new units along the way.

A DAILY BATTLE
A new twist every day, and a stamp for each day you win. Miss a day and nothing is lost.

2 PLAYERS, 1 DEVICE
Put the phone or tablet flat on the table, bears at one end, hogs at the other.

HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
A coach explains the first battle, a tip after every loss says what to try next, and if a battle beats you, the next try gets a little easier.

MADE FOR FAMILIES
- No ads.
- Nothing to buy: no loot boxes, no random rewards, no in-game currency for sale. Every unit is earned by playing.
- No chat, no accounts, plays offline.
- Grown-up check before any outside link.
- Big buttons, big text and element icons.

Made by Seventh Anvil Games, the makers of Polar Bears vs. Warthogs.

name: BeerLocator
description:
BeerLocator ti aiuta a scoprire in quali locali trovare le birre che cerchi, grazie alle segnalazioni di una community di appassionati.

• Cerca una birra e scopri in quali pub, birrerie e locali è stata vista, con la mappa e la distanza da te.
• Esplora i locali vicini e le birre che servono, alla spina o in bottiglia.
• Schede di birre e birrifici con stile, gradazione, colore e descrizione, e una wiki scritta dalla community.
• Spotta: segnala che una birra è disponibile in un locale, così gli altri sanno dove trovarla. Gli spot vengono confermati sul posto da altri utenti.
• Aggiungi birre, birrifici e locali che mancano e completa i dati del catalogo.
• Forum, amici e messaggi privati per parlare di birra, con le notifiche sul telefono.
• Mappa live facoltativa per vedere dove sono i tuoi amici, solo se la accendi.
• Punti, livelli e trofei premiano il contributo alla community (segnalazioni, conferme, dati aggiunti), mai la quantità di birra bevuta.

BeerLocator non vende alcolici e non incita al consumo: è riservato ai maggiorenni (18+). Bevi responsabilmente e, se bevi, non metterti alla guida.

Disponibile in italiano, inglese, tedesco, francese, spagnolo, olandese, polacco e ceco.

name: Belini Haul
description:
Veel kleine ondernemers en vastgoedmedewerkers hebben een bestelbus of klein bedrijfsvoertuig nodig, maar het zoeken kost vaak meer tijd dan nodig. Advertenties staan verspreid over allerlei websites, aantekeningen over welke wagen bevalt raken zoek, en een reserveringsaanvraag verdwijnt in een inbox zonder dat je weet hoe het ervoor staat. Belini Haul maakt een einde aan die versnippering. De app brengt het aanbod van minibusjes en lichte bedrijfsvoertuigen samen op één plek, zodat je rustig kunt vergelijken, bewaren en reserveren.

Alles begint op het startscherm. Daar blader je door het aanbod van minibusjes en bedrijfsvoertuigen. Elke vermelding toont de belangrijkste kenmerken, zodat je in één oogopslag ziet of een wagen bij je werk past. Spreekt een voertuig je aan? Open dan de detailpagina met de volledige beschrijving en alle gegevens die je nodig hebt om een goede keuze te maken.

Een voertuig bewaren doe je met één tik op de bewaarknop. Het verschijnt dan in je persoonlijke lijst met bewaarde voertuigen – handig zolang je nog twijfelt, vergelijkt of terugkomt op eerdere keuzes. Zo hoef je nooit opnieuw te zoeken naar een wagen die je al eerder zag. Bewaren staat los van reserveren, dus je zit nergens aan vast zolang je nog niet klaar bent.

Heb je de juiste wagen gevonden? Dan stuur je direct vanaf de detailpagina een reserveringsaanvraag, met de voertuiggegevens en de periode waarin je het voertuig wilt gebruiken. Na verzending verschijnt de aanvraag in je reserveringsoverzicht. Daar volg je elke aanvraag, van ingediend tot bevestigd. Zo zie je altijd welke reserveringen nog op bevestiging wachten en welke al rond zijn, zonder telefoontjes of e-mails na te hoeven lopen.

In het reserveringsoverzicht merk je het gemak van de opvolging het best. Elke aanvraag blijft zichtbaar tot de status verandert, en met één tik lees je de details van elke reservering terug. Geen ingewikkeld beheersysteem, maar een helder logboek dat laat zien waar je staat. Voor een ondernemer die tussen de klussen door plant, is die duidelijkheid vaak het verschil tussen rustig doorwerken en steeds moeten controleren of alles nog klopt.

Belini Haul is gemaakt voor kleine ondernemers die een bestelbus nodig hebben voor transport, bezorging of onderhoud, en voor vastgoedmedewerkers die voor een beheerorganisatie of verhuurder op pad gaan. Voor hen draait het zelden om een luxe auto. Het draait om een betrouwbaar voertuig dat beschikbaar is wanneer het nodig is, en om een proces dat geen extra werk oplevert. Precies daar richt Belini Haul zich op: overzicht, bewaren en aanvragen bijhouden, zonder overbodige functies.

De app is een rustige assistent, geen druk platform. Geen eindeloze meldingen die om aandacht vragen, geen ingewikkelde menu's om te leren. Elk onderdeel doet één ding goed: vinden, bewaren, aanvragen en opvolgen. Open de app en je ziet meteen wat er klaarstaat en wat je volgende stap is.

Kortom: met Belini Haul kom je sneller tot de juiste keuze en leg je die zonder gedoe vast. Blader door de beschikbare minibusjes en bedrijfsvoertuigen, bewaar wat je aanspreekt en stuur een reserveringsaanvraag die je kunt volgen tot de bevestiging binnen is. Een eenvoudige oplossing voor een praktisch probleem – en juist daardoor overzichtelijk voor iedereen die elke dag al genoeg te regelen heeft.

name: Bellpush
description:
Bellpush shows buses where they really are, live on a map, across England, with live train times across Great Britain.

Live buses
- Every bus that reports its position, on the map in its own colours, with where it is heading and how late it is.
- Departures from any stop, with live times where the bus is tracked, and how reliable each route usually is.
- Passengers can say what is happening with one tap: the bus did not come, it is full, it is running late.

Plan a journey
- From any address, postcode, stop, town or place, or from where you are, by bus, train or both.
- Choose fewer changes, less walking, a slower pace or step-free.
- A countdown on your Lock Screen tells you when to leave.

On the bus
- Bellpush counts down the stops on your Lock Screen and tells you when to press the bell.
- Share your trip with a link someone can follow until you get off.

Trains and the Underground
- Live departures for every National Rail station, with platforms, coaches and delays.
- Live London Underground arrivals, with the station's lines.

Routes and departure boards
- Every route in your county or city, grouped by operator, with a filter for disruption.
- Big, clear departure boards for any stop or station, for a screen, a shop or a phone on a stand. Five styles, from modern to a classic bus-stop sign.

Your Bellpush
- Save stops, routes, stations and journeys, with a Home Screen widget for the next buses.
- Alerts when a saved route is disrupted.
- Timetables for saved stops keep working with no signal.
- An optional account keeps everything on any phone. No marketing emails.
- Bus spotting: collect the buses you see and ride.

For everyone
- Audio mode reads departures and stops aloud, with a tap you can feel at each stop.
- A help card to show the driver, step-free options and read-out stops.

Bus data from the Department for Transport's Bus Open Data Service. Train times powered by National Rail Enquiries. Underground arrivals powered by TfL Open Data. Addresses and postcodes contain OS data, Crown copyright and database rights 2026. Bellpush is independent and not connected with any bus or train company.

name: Beltopolis
description:
Beltopolis is a relaxing factory builder where conveyor belts build themselves.

Tap a tree, rock or ore deposit to place a harvester, and a belt automatically runs back to your Main Hub. Tap open grass to add crafters: Workshops, Smelters, Assemblers and Quantum Labs pull ingredients from the Hub and send finished products back. When two belts cross, they hop over each other on a bridge.

UP TO 50 ERAS, ONE QUEST EACH
Every era gives you a fresh world and one goal. Start with The First Tree and work up through Planks, Stone, Bricks, Iron, Gears, Copper, Wire, Steel, Circuits, Silver, Gold, Jewelry, Glass, Microchips and Titanium to the Quantum Computer in era 21. Every Ascension after that adds a brand-new era and resource, growing the game all the way to 50 eras.

REBIRTH & PERKS
Finish an era's quest to Rebirth and earn a prestige point. Spend points in the Perk shop on permanent upgrades: faster harvesters, crafting and belts, cheaper buildings, a head start each era, double-output luck, longer offline time and more. Save up for Mega buildings, the Hub Extension, and Woodcutter's and Quarry Huts.

ASCEND
Finish the eras to Ascend. You go back to Era 1 with your perks, one more resource's harvesters turn GOLD (free, unlimited and faster), and a new era and resource unlock. Ascension worlds bring new looks, from Autumn Forest and Snowy Tundra to Desert Canyon and Tropical Jungle, and every third Ascension is an island chain where belts bridge the water.

UPGRADE ANY BUILDING
Tap a building to raise it through Tiers 1–5 or give it Double Output.

KEEPS RUNNING WHILE YOU'RE AWAY
Your factory keeps producing for up to 24 hours while you're gone, and longer with the Night Shift perk. A summary shows what you earned when you come back.

ALSO
• Player levels and XP, with bonus prestige points as you level up
• A free Daily Spin with prizes that grow as you progress
• Style Shop looks for belts, buildings and maps
• Achievements to chase
• 3 save slots
• Plays fully offline. No ads, no account, and no tracking.

Beltopolis is a Pocket Rivet game.

name: Bên Con: list đồ sơ sinh mẹ bé
description:
Bên Con là ứng dụng checklist đồ sơ sinh dành cho mẹ bầu và ba mẹ đang nuôi con năm đầu. Từ danh sách đồ sơ sinh cần mua, túi đi sinh cho mẹ và bé đến việc cần làm theo tháng, mẹ có một nơi để chuẩn bị, đánh dấu và theo dõi chi tiêu.

Mẹ đang băn khoăn mua đồ sơ sinh cần những gì, chuẩn bị đồ đi sinh ra sao hay nên dành bao nhiêu ngân sách? Bên Con giúp mẹ chia nhỏ việc chuẩn bị, rà soát đồ đã có và cân nhắc món cần mua tiếp theo.

Danh sách đồ sơ sinh, mua theo nhu cầu
• Checklist đồ sơ sinh cho bé, đồ cho mẹ và đồ dùng ăn dặm, chia thành từng nhóm dễ xem.
• Tham khảo số lượng gợi ý, thời điểm cần dùng và thông tin lựa chọn cho từng món.
• Đánh dấu đã mua, đã có sẵn hoặc không cần để hạn chế mua trùng.
• Thêm món riêng và điều chỉnh danh sách theo nhu cầu gia đình.
• Xem và đánh dấu checklist cả khi không có mạng.

Túi đi sinh cho mẹ và bé
• Chuẩn bị đồ đi sinh bằng một checklist riêng.
• Rà soát đồ cần mang theo, đánh dấu sau khi xếp vào túi.
• Cùng người nhà kiểm tra để dễ tìm đồ lúc cần.

Việc cần làm theo tháng thai kỳ và tháng tuổi của bé
• Xem checklist công việc theo từng tháng mang thai và từng tháng tuổi trong năm đầu của bé.
• Tập trung vào việc phù hợp với giai đoạn hiện tại.
• Đánh dấu hoàn thành, bỏ qua việc không phù hợp hoặc thêm việc riêng kèm ghi chú.
• Chuyển giai đoạn khi cần, tiến độ đã ghi nhận vẫn được giữ lại.

Ngân sách mua đồ sơ sinh và quản lý chi tiêu
• Đặt ngân sách riêng cho mỗi danh sách mua đồ.
• Ghi khoản chi thực tế, xem số tiền đã chi và còn lại.
• Theo dõi chi tiêu tới từng món để cân nhắc điều chỉnh.
• Tham khảo gói mua sắm gợi ý khi muốn bắt đầu nhanh.

Cùng gia đình chuẩn bị đón bé
• Mời chồng, ông bà hoặc người thân cùng xem và cập nhật checklist.
• Cùng rà soát đồ đã chuẩn bị để hạn chế mua trùng.
• Chia sẻ bằng liên kết hoặc mã mời, có thể thu hồi mã mời khi cần.

Khám phá bài viết cho mẹ và bé
• Đọc các bài viết do Bên Con biên soạn về chuẩn bị đồ dùng cho mẹ và bé.
• Tham khảo so sánh sản phẩm theo tiêu chí rõ ràng.
• Cân nhắc ưu điểm, hạn chế và nhu cầu phù hợp.
• Xem nguồn thông tin và cách đánh giá được trình bày trong bài.

Nhắc việc theo nhu cầu của mẹ
• Nhắc về mốc thai kỳ, tháng tuổi của bé và những việc còn đang chuẩn bị.
• Chủ động bật hoặc tắt từng nhóm nhắc việc trong cài đặt.

Mẹ có thể bắt đầu sử dụng mà không cần tạo tài khoản. Đăng nhập khi muốn đồng bộ sang thiết bị khác hoặc chia sẻ với người nhà. Các tính năng đồng bộ, chia sẻ và đọc nội dung mới cần kết nối mạng.

Mẹ có thể yêu cầu xoá tài khoản trong ứng dụng hoặc qua website nếu không còn cài app.

Một số bài viết có liên kết mua hàng tới các sàn thương mại điện tử tại Việt Nam. Bên Con có thể nhận hoa hồng từ các liên kết này để duy trì hoạt động. Giá mẹ trả không đổi và hoa hồng không quyết định thứ tự gợi ý. Phạm vi giao hàng phụ thuộc từng sàn và người bán.

Ứng dụng có hiển thị quảng cáo.

Cùng Bên Con, mẹ chuẩn bị từng chút, cả nhà cùng bên con.

Chính sách quyền riêng tư: https://benconvn.com/privacy.html
Hỗ trợ: https://benconvn.com/support.html
Yêu cầu xoá tài khoản: https://benconvn.com/xoa-tai-khoan.html

name: Bep Beep
description:
Bep Beep listens to Morse code from a radio and turns it into numbers. It is made for DayZ players on the Nasdara map, where the broadcast on frequency 80.0 gives away bunker locations and the codes to their doors.

HOW IT WORKS
• Tune to frequency 80.0 in the game and put your iPhone by the speaker or headphones.
• Tap Record. A long silence marks where a message starts and ends.
• Tap Stop. The app translates the message by itself: six digits of location and four digits of code.
• Show the bunker on a map with the game grid and place names.

WHAT IT DOES
• Picks out the beeps in noise and knows when a broadcast is really playing.
• Reads a message even if you start recording in the middle, and fills in the location from the known bunkers.
• Translates a finished recording from Files or Voice Memos too.
• Czech and English, following your phone's language.

MAPS
• Nasdara, Chernarus, Livonia and Sakhal, all working offline: terrain, main roads, towns and the game grid.
• Search for a town or village by name.
• Touch and hold anywhere to see the in-game coordinates.
• Bunkers and their door codes are shown on Nasdara, where the radio broadcast exists.

PRIVACY
Microphone audio is processed on your phone and is never stored or sent anywhere. The app has no accounts, no servers and no analytics, and it does not connect to the internet.

Unofficial fan-made tool. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Bohemia Interactive. DayZ is a trademark of Bohemia Interactive.

name: Berwanger Educacional
description: Idealizada por uma das maiores autoridades do país, Prof. Jane Berwanger, esta plataforma conta com comunidade ativa e cursos sempre atualizados.

name: Bible Analogy App
description:
Same truth, every generation.

Type what's going on — a worry, a conversation, a hard day with your child — and Bible Analogy App gives you a Bible analogy, a metaphor, a simile, and a verse to hold onto, each with the full King James wording. Then Relate rewords that same truth so every generation can hear it, from ages 3–5 up through 60+.

Church is one of the few rooms where a 6-year-old and an 80-year-old learn from the same message. This app helps you say it in each person's language.

WHAT YOU GET
• A simple home screen: one box for what's going on, who you're trying to reach, and a big Generate button.
• An analogy, a metaphor, a simile, and a verse, one at a time, with the exact King James text behind a tap, each labeled clearly.
• Relate: reword the same reading for ages 3–5, 6–9, 10–12, teens, 20s–30s, 40s–50s, and 60+. Young children get simple words; the exact KJV is always there when you want it.
• Picture to Scripture: photograph a saying, a quote, or an everyday scene — including a pet — and receive a biblical analogy. Quotes are traced to their origin and to Scripture; objects get a Bible analogy. The photo is read on this device and is not sent away.
• Discuss Scripture & the Word of God: put a verse into everyday words and talk it through, in language that fits who it's for.
• Daily Quiz Challenge: ten fresh questions a day, with a pass mark you can set to Beginner, Intermediate, or Expert, plus a Biblical Scholar track with deeper and written questions.
• Random analogy, when you just want a fresh reading.
• Share a picture you can text, email, save to Photos, or post. Choose a size for Messages and Mail, or for a social post or story. Your own words are never on the picture.

PRIVATE, ON PURPOSE
• Nothing you type is saved or sent.
• There is no account, no tracking, no analytics, and no ads.
• The only thing stored on your device is a list of already-shown item IDs, so you see fresh readings — IDs only, never your words. You can clear that list in Settings.
• Contribute / Suggest and Contact open your own mail app. A message leaves the device only if you send the email.

WORKS OFFLINE
• The readings come from a curated on-device bank of King James Scripture (public domain) and related notes. No internet is required to generate or Relate.

Dedicated to Steve and Dana Brandt, and in loving memory of Esther Scott (a.k.a. Grandma Scott), whose faith still guides us today.

Published by MJR Industries LLC.

Questions? sales@mjrillc.com

Developed by $traight ₵ache Homie™

name: Bible Detective Academy
description:
Learn to study the Bible for yourself, one case at a time.

Bible Detective Academy turns careful Bible study into detective work. Every case is a real passage of Scripture. Inspector Berea and the squad walk you through the same five phases every time: prepare your hunches, search the scene, test the theories, picture what happened, and file a finding you can live by.

LEARN THE SKILLS
Start in Training: one introduction and eight practice cases, each with a little less help, until you can work a case on your own. Along the way you collect the tools careful readers use: the six questions, key words, link words, the basic clues, pictures and parallels, and many more. Every tool has a card in your Notebook that explains it in full and shows the cases that use it.

99 CASES IN 8 DIVISIONS
Narrative, Gospels & Acts, Parables, Wisdom, Poetry, Letters, Law and Prophecy. Each division has five ranks, Rookie to Chief Inspector, and the cases get deeper as you climb. Optional side cases wait in envelopes along the way.

A REAL PASSAGE ON EVERY CASE
The passage sits on your desk as Exhibit A. Label phrases with coloured highlighters, tap a word for a short explanation, compare translations, and pin what you find to your case board.

PLAY LIKE A DETECTIVE
• Your own detective ID: choose a name and one of eight detectives
• Three offices to choose from: a lamp-lit office, a midnight case board, or a sunny daylight desk
• XP, detective levels, a daily streak (with a weekly rest day) and 28 badges, all earned by careful study, never by speed
• The CASE CLOSED stamp, a case report you can save as a PDF, and a certificate when you pass every rank

YOUR CASES FOLLOW YOU
Sign in with Apple, Google or email (the same free account as the Luminverse app) and your cases, notes and badges stay in step with the Academy website and your other devices. Training can be done without an account.

PRIVATE AND FREE
No ads and no purchases. Your notes are yours: only you can see them, and you can delete your account at any time from your Detective ID.

"Now these were more noble-minded than those in Thessalonica, for they received the word with great eagerness, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so." Acts 17:11 (NASB 1995)

name: Biblia Digital
description:
**Bíblia Digital App – Sua Palavra, todos os dias!**

Tenha a Bíblia sempre ao seu alcance e fortaleça sua caminhada com Deus através de uma experiência completa de leitura, aprendizado e reflexão bíblica.

O Bíblia Digital App foi desenvolvido para aproximar você da Palavra de Deus, oferecendo recursos que tornam seu momento de leitura ainda mais especial.

**RECURSOS DO APLICATIVO**

**Bíblia Digital**
Leia as Escrituras com a tradução JFA – Atualizada. Navegue facilmente entre os livros, capítulos e versículos.

**Planos de Leitura**
Organize sua jornada bíblica com planos de leitura de 6 meses e 1 ano. Acompanhe seu progresso e mantenha a constância na leitura.

**Versículo do Dia**
Receba diariamente uma mensagem da Palavra de Deus para inspirar sua fé e reflexão.

**Quiz Bíblico**
Teste seus conhecimentos sobre a Bíblia com desafios em diferentes níveis de dificuldade.

**SOS Bíblico**
Encontre palavras de conforto e orientação bíblica para diferentes momentos e sentimentos da vida.
**Versículo Aleatório**
Descubra novas passagens e receba uma palavra da Bíblia sempre que desejar.

**Personalização**
Personalize o visual dos versículos compartilhados, escolhendo cores, imagens de fundo e estilos decorativos.

**SUA JORNADA COM DEUS COMEÇA AQUI!**

Seja para sua leitura diária, estudo bíblico ou momento de reflexão, o Bíblia Digital App é um companheiro para manter a Palavra de Deus presente em sua vida.

Baixe e compartilhe a Palavra!

name: BibNara
description:
BibNara is a Bible game to learn while you play. Every answer comes with a short explanation and its Bible reference, so each question teaches you something new.

ADVENTURE
Journey through six chapters — Genesis, Exodus, Kings, Prophets, Gospels and Acts — with 36 levels of increasing difficulty. Earn up to three stars per level and unlock the next one as you go.

QUICK TRIVIA
Short 10-question rounds from a single chapter or a mix of all of them. Play relaxed or race the clock (15, 30 or 60 seconds) for speed bonuses and answer streaks. Beat your best score.

WEEKLY CHALLENGE
Every week, everyone answers the same 10 questions with one attempt that counts. Climb the world leaderboard and your country's, and collect weekly badges.

CHALLENGE A FRIEND
Create a challenge and share a code or link by WhatsApp or text message, or invite another player by nickname. You each play when you can, and the higher score wins.

LEARN WITH CONFIDENCE
• 1,000 original questions, each reviewed and checked against the Bible.
• Reference translations: World English Bible Updated (English) and Reina-Valera 1960 (Spanish).
• The game shows the reference for each passage so you can read it in your own Bible.
• Fully playable in English and Spanish.

FREE FOR EVERYONE
No ads, no subscriptions and nothing to buy to move forward. Adventure and Quick Trivia work offline and keep your progress on your phone. If you'd like, you can support the project with an optional tip; it doesn't unlock anything.

Competitive mode (weekly challenge and challenges) requires a free account and is for players 18 and older for now. We don't use ads, tracking or analytics.

BibNara is not affiliated with or endorsed by the publishers of the Bible translations mentioned.

name: BIMy Scan
description:
BIMy Scan turns an iPhone or iPad with LiDAR into a room scanner.

Walk through the space and point the phone at the walls. The app measures the room with the LiDAR sensor as you go and shows the points as they are captured. Send the scan, and BIMy builds a model from it: not a mesh, but a building — walls with their thickness, doorways, windows, furniture, the ceiling at its real height.

SCAN
• Live point cloud while you scan, with guidance when you move too fast
• Large flats in parts, room after room, in one session
• Voice notes pinned where you said them
• Everything stays on your device until you choose to send it

BUILD
• Walls measured from the scan; doors and windows placed on them
• Sloped attic ceilings read as roofs
• Furniture from Apple's RoomPlan, in the same scan
• A textured mesh of the room as it is
• Placed on the map and turned to north, if you allow location

SHARE
• Open the model inside the app
• A link anyone can open in a browser, no account needed
• Export the point cloud as PLY from the app

No account, no subscription, no ads, no tracking.

Requires a device with LiDAR: iPhone 12 Pro or later Pro models, or iPad Pro (2020 or later). A phone is not a survey instrument — the model is a draft to check against the building.

name: Bin Night: Bin Day Reminder

name: Bin2Trek Ride
description:
Bin2Trek Ride, şehirde her gün yola çıkanlar için tasarlanmış bir yolculuk uygulamasıdır.

Sabah işe yetişmeye çalışırken, akşam eve dönerken ya da hafta sonu şehrin öbür ucundaki bir işi halletmeye giderken hep aynı soruyu sorarsınız: Bu yolculuk nasıl geçecek? Bin2Trek Ride bu sorunun cevabını tek bir akışta toplar. Planlamadan takibe kadar her adım uygulamanın içinde ilerler; böylece aklınız yolda değil, işinizde kalır.

İlk adım, başlangıç noktanızı belirlemek. Bir apartman kapısı, bir durak ya da iş yerinizin girişi olabilir. Alış noktanızı netleştirin; çünkü iyi bir yolculuk, doğru bir başlangıçla başlar.

Ardından varış noktanızı ekleyin. Gideceğiniz adres, toplantı yapacağınız bina ya da akşam buluşacağınız mekân olabilir. Alış ve varış noktaları belli olduğunda planınızın temeli de hazırdır.

Sıra yolculuk sınıfınızı seçmekte. Mevcut seçeneklere göz atın ve o günkü ihtiyacınıza en uygun olanı belirleyin. Acelen varsa hızlı bir seçenek, bütçenizi korumak istiyorsanız daha dengeli bir tercih yapabilirsiniz.

Seçiminizi gözden geçirin ve rezervasyonunuzu onaylayın. İşte yolculuğunuzun resmen planlandığı an. Artık ne zaman yola çıkacağınızı ve nereye varacağınızı biliyorsunuz.

Rezervasyon oluşturulduğu anda takip de başlar. Bin2Trek Ride, yolculuğunuzun hangi aşamada olduğunu size gösterir. Yol boyunca neyin ne zaman gerçekleştiğini uygulamadan kolayca izlersiniz.

Varış noktanıza ulaştığınızda yolculuğunuz bırakılma anıyla tamamlanır. Bu, yolculuğun son perdesidir ve uygulama bu anı da sizinle birlikte takip eder.

Bin2Trek Ride, şehirde düzenli olarak yolculuk yapan herkes için tasarlandı: her gün aynı güzergâhı kullanan çalışanlar, derse yetişmeye çalışan öğrenciler ve birkaç durak arasında işlerini yetiştirmek zorunda olan herkes için.

Kullanımı olabildiğince sade tuttuk. Alış, varış, sınıf ve onay. Dört kısa adımın ardından yolculuğunuz başlar ve uygulama onu baştan sona takip eder. Bu sayede her yolculuk bir öncekine benzer; öngörülebilir ve sakin bir ritimde ilerler. Daha az belirsizlik, daha fazla zaman demektir.

Bin2Trek Ride'ı hemen indirin ve bir sonraki yolculuğunuzu başlangıç noktasından varışa kadar planlamaya bugün başlayın.

name: Binko - بينكو
description:
Binko بيجمعلك المحلات اللي بتعرفها بمكان واحد.

تصفّح ملابس، أحذية، شنط، إكسسوارات، إلكترونيات وتجميل من محلات حقيقية بمنطقتك، شوف الأسعار والعروض، واحفظ اللي بيعجبك.

description:
BIOneu es la herramienta interna de Biotramex y Neutratec para el personal de rutas de recolección.

Historial de tus servicios de los últimos 30 días.

name: Bird Hunter: Hunting Simulator
description:
Hunt birds on the wing with real shotguns, a hunting dog at your side and friends online. From a salt-marsh duck pond to the snowy woods of Alaska, every shot counts: lead the bird, choose your choke and load, and bring your bag home.

BIRD HUNTS
• Duck Pond: flights of ducks circle the marsh, land and flush
• Duck Boat: hunt the ducks from the water
• Chukar Hills: coveys run uphill, then burst out low and fast
• Olive Terraces: thrushes bound between the olive trees in autumn
• Quail Fields: walk them up in the long grass
• Bee-Eater Field, Pheasant Fields and Woodcock Woods at dusk
• Clay Range: 25 clays to sharpen your swing
Every hunt has missions, stars and coins.

BIG GAME IN ALASKA
Track deer, moose, wild boar, wolves and bears. Some of them fight back, and wolves hunt in packs. Bring buckshot, slugs or a scoped rifle.

FREE ROAM
Drive across five open maps: a mountain village, a wide valley, snowy north woods, a marsh with a duck blind, and the desert. Day turns to night, with rain, fog, storms and snow. Hunt wherever you like.

30+ GUNS
Pump-action, double-barrel and semi-automatic shotguns, hunting and sniper rifles, an air rifle and a crossbow. Swap chokes, pick birdshot, buckshot or slugs, and dress your guns in camo skins. Pellet spread, drop and lead are worked out for every shot.

HUNTING DOGS
Labrador, Golden Retriever, Border Collie, Husky, Dalmatian and more. Your dog flushes the birds and brings them back to you.

GEAR AND RIDES
