An electronic game caller and a duck call, binoculars, and a flashlight for night hunts. Drive pickup trucks, an off-roader, a quad bike or a motorcycle, or ride a horse.

HUNT WITH FRIENDS
Make a room and hunt online with friends, up to 4 players in a room. Share the room code, and talk with push-to-talk voice chat.

MADE FOR PHONES
Touch controls with a fixed stick and fire buttons on both sides, a left-handed mode, and aim help from Easy to Hard. Daily rewards, achievements and skills to level up. Plays in 16 languages.

Made in Lebanon: the first hunts are set in the hills of Kfar Hatta, among olive terraces, dry-stone walls and the village pond.

FREE TO PLAY, WITH ADS
Bird Hunter is free to download and play. It shows ads and offers optional in-app purchases: Gold, a Starter Pack, Remove Ads and other packs. Coins from hunting buy guns, dogs, cars and gear. Hunting boxes show their odds before you open them.

HUNTER CLUB (optional subscription): 30 Gold a day, no forced ads, 1.5x coins from hunts, a Gold box every week and a new camo every month. Monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://adev-tech.com/apps/bird-hunter/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://adev-tech.com/apps/bird-hunter/privacy/

name: BiteCurve: Fishing Forecast
description:
Plan your time on the water around the conditions at your own spots.
BiteCurve calculates a 0 to 100 bite index and daily peak window for the places you fish.
All spots and trip logs stay on your iPhone with no account, no ads, and no tracking.

Whether you fish warm or cold freshwater or US coastal saltwater, BiteCurve combines environmental data into a clear daily outlook. It is an estimate to help you plan when to be on the water, not a promise of a catch.

HOW THE BITE INDEX WORKS
For every spot you place on the map, BiteCurve evaluates:
• Light around sunrise and sunset
• Water temperature estimated from weather conditions
• Wind speed and direction
• Barometric pressure trend, plus optional live barometer readings from your iPhone during a trip
• Moon position
• Tide predictions from NOAA stations for saltwater spots along US coasts and territories

SPECIES AND WATER TYPES
Set the water type and target species for each spot to tailor the calculation:
• Largemouth bass
• Walleye
• Northern pike
• Rainbow trout
• Warm freshwater, cold freshwater, or saltwater

TRIP LOG AND OFFLINE ACCESS
• Log every outing, including trips with no catch, to build an honest record of your waters
• Keep saved forecasts on your device for about 10 days so you can check conditions offline at remote lakes or along the coast
• Private by design: your exact pin coordinates never leave your iPhone, and only a coarse 5 km map cell is sent to fetch Apple Weather data

INCLUDED WITHOUT A SUBSCRIPTION
• Up to 3 saved spots
• Today and tomorrow bite index and peak window
• Full trip log and live barometer trend during a trip

BITECURVE PRO
BiteCurve Pro is an optional auto-renewing subscription available on a yearly or monthly plan (the yearly plan includes a trial period). Payment is charged to your Apple Account, and you can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in your Apple Account settings. BiteCurve Pro unlocks:
• Unlimited saved spots
• 10-day outlook
• Hourly bite curve and tide curve
• Expected catch scaled to your personal trip log

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://apps.dautov.dev/bitecurve/privacy/

name: BLACKVAN Driver
description:
BLACKVAN Driver is the app for licensed VIP transfer drivers in Antalya.

Go online, and nearby ride requests reach you. Each request shows the pickup, the drop-off, the distance and the usual price on that route. You name your price. The guest sees the route and chooses the car.

While you are Online, the app shares your location so the guest can see the car approaching and you receive the closest jobs. Switch to Offline and location sharing stops.

The app is for drivers with a D2 licence and TÜRSAB documents. After you create an account, upload your documents. An admin checks them before you can take rides.

Guests book on blackvantransfer.com. Phone numbers stay hidden in the chat. You confirm boarding with a code.

Drivers start with a bonus and pay a 10% commission on completed rides. Balance top-ups are made by bank transfer and confirmed by the BLACKVAN dispatcher. The app does not sell digital goods.

name: BlastRiders: Island Artillery
description:
Aim. Calculate. Destroy.

BlastRiders is a turn-based artillery game between islands at sea, cartoony and packed with explosions. You drive a cannon car and face one opponent at a time, each on their own island. Set the angle and the power, read the wind and land the perfect shot on your rival's island before they hit you.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag on the arena to aim: the dots show the start of the trajectory
• The wind pushes your shot toward the arrow: adjust your aim
• Drive and jump across the terrain to find the best spot; your fuel lasts the whole match
• Knock down the wooden and stone blocks protecting your opponent and blast craters into the ground

8 WEAPONS
• Cannon, Double shot and Heavy grenade
• Piercing missile, which goes through wooden blocks
• Electric bomb, which leaves the opponent stunned
• Cluster shot, which scatters fragments over the area
• Gravity orb, which pulls in nearby shots
• Meteor: charge it by dealing damage and call a meteor from the sky
• Take up to four weapons into each battle

4 PILOTS, EACH WITH THEIR OWN VEHICLE
• Nova, the engineer: sees more of the shot trajectory
• Brakk, the demolisher: bigger explosions and a tougher tank
• Nyx, the arcanist: the wind affects her less
• Rex, the explorer: extra projectiles on the double shot and the cluster shot
• Beat the bosses to drive each of them

CAMPAIGN: 40 LEVELS IN 4 REGIONS
• Tropical Coast, Night Metropolis, Hanging Forest and Volcanic Forge
• 12 of Baron Kaldor's henchmen, each with their own weapons and play style
• 4 bosses: Brakk, Nyx, Rex and, at the end of the Volcanic Forge, Baron Kaldor himself
• Arenas with hills, ramps and destructible blocks
• Three stars per level: win, win with half your health and complete the level challenge

PLENTY TO DO
• Garage: upgrade armor, cannon and engine with the coins you earn in battle
• Arena vs. AI on four difficulty levels
• Daily Challenge: a new battle every day
• Aiming challenges, daily missions and achievements

MADE FOR MOBILE
• Cartoon art, explosions, pilots that react to every hit, music and sound effects made for the game
• Guided first match, step by step; the tutorial can be replayed in Settings
• Match saved every turn: close the app and continue later
• Progress saved on your device, no account and no internet needed
• English, Português and Español

Cartoon combat between vehicles, with no blood. Free with ads, which never appear during a match: only when leaving the results screen and as a banner on that screen. Rewarded videos are always optional, for extra coins. The one-time "Remove ads" purchase removes the ads. Coins are earned only by playing and cannot be bought. Your progress stays on your phone.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://blastriders.filisoft.com.br/privacidade.php?lang=en

name: Blockbuilt: Workout Builder
description:
Blockbuilt builds smart training blocks and tells you what to lift next.

BUILD A PROGRAM IN MINUTES
Tell Blockbuilt your goal, experience, days per week, session length, equipment, and any injuries or exercises to avoid. It writes a detailed, research-based prompt. Paste it into the AI chat you already use, paste the answer back, and Blockbuilt imports a complete 4-week program.

GOALS THAT FIT YOU
- Strength, muscle, power, conditioning and general fitness
- Sport and skill goals, like a higher vertical jump or more pull-ups
- Deadline goals, like a bigger bench by summer, with an honest check on whether the timeline is realistic

LOG FAST, PROGRESS AUTOMATICALLY
- Log weight and reps set by set, with a rest timer that keeps running when you leave the app
- Choose your progression rule, such as double progression, and Blockbuilt sets your next weight from what you actually lifted
- Heavier peak weeks and lighter deload weeks are adjusted for you
- A find-your-weights first workout, or enter maxes you already know

SUPERSETS, SUBSTITUTES AND VARIATIONS
- Supersets labeled and logged in order
- Every exercise comes with substitutes that respect your equipment and injuries, with matching sets and reps
- When a lift stalls, Blockbuilt suggests the next variation

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
- Charts of estimated max and top sets for every lift
- An optional body-weight log for bodyweight moves and jump goals

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No analytics. Your data stays on your iPhone, and you can export it as CSV or a full backup at any time.

Blockbuilt covers training only and gives no diet or nutrition advice. It is not medical advice and does not diagnose or treat injuries. Talk to a doctor or physical therapist before training if you have an injury or health condition.

name: Blotsy
description:
Blotsy is an imagination studio on your iPhone. Open a symmetrical inkblot, say what you see, and turn that glimpse into a short story and a picture.

This is a place for play and creativity. It is not a psychological test, and it does not analyse you.

DISCOVER
Swipe a full-screen gallery of one hundred and thirty inkblots: soft watercolour sheets on white, and neon-gloss sheets that glow on a dark ground. Every fifth page is a freshly folded blot. Shake the phone or tap Surprise me to jump to another. Filter by palette, share a sheet to Instagram Stories, or save a phone-sized copy to Photos so you can set it as your wallpaper.

FROM A PHOTO
Pick any picture on this iPhone and fold it into a symmetrical inkblot, in a watercolour or neon style. The fold happens on the device.

SEE
Name what you see in your own words. A moth. A mask. Two figures sharing a face. Those words become the seed of the story.

CREATE
In Ink Studio you draw on a mirrored canvas — what you paint on one side appears on the other. Choose a brush and a palette, then move on when the shape feels right.

TELL
The AI Storyteller writes a short tale in the genre you pick: Fantasy, Mystery, Adventure, or Children's. You can edit the title, the characters, and every line.

PICTURE
When this iPhone supports Image Playground, the Illustration Studio can paint a scene to go with the story.

LIBRARY
Save your pieces, come back to edit them, and share a sheet or a story. Your library lives on this iPhone.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Stories are written with Apple’s on-device Foundation Models. Illustrations use Apple Image Playground. Nothing is sent to a Blotsy server. There is no account, no analytics, and no cloud. Photos you pick or save stay on this iPhone unless you choose to share them.

Blotsy requires iOS 26. Story and illustration features need an Apple Intelligence–capable iPhone with Apple Intelligence turned on. You can still browse the library, fold photos into inkblots, draw, and save your work without those features.

name: Blue Hour HQ
description:
Blue Hour is the all-in-one app for real estate photography and media companies. Your whole team runs the business from one place: shoots, orders, client messages, business calls, team chat and delivery.

FOR PHOTOGRAPHERS
• See today's shoots with the address, entry notes and what to capture
• "Leave by" times with real drive time, and a lock screen countdown before each shoot
• Home Screen and lock screen widgets: next shoot, today's shoots, your week and pay so far
• Tap On my way and the client gets your arrival time
• Upload photos and video straight from the shoot
• Scan a floor plan with your iPhone Pro

FOR THE OFFICE
• Business calls ring on your phone like a normal call, even when it's locked
• Text and email clients from your business number and inbox
• Team chat with photos, voice memos and video calls
• Orders, schedules, revisions and deliveries in one list

BUILT FOR TEAMS
• Each person sees what their role needs
• Notifications you control, with quiet hours
• Your data stays yours. Delete your account any time from My Profile

Blue Hour is for companies that use Blue Hour. Your company owner adds you to the team, then you sign in with your email and password.

name: Blynn - View
description:
With Blynn, users can plan and organize stained glass, leaded panel, and small glass art projects from initial outline to finished assembly. The app provides a dedicated offline environment where creators can draw custom frames and piece boundaries, assign stable piece numbers, and track glass materials, textures, and dimensions. Creating and saving a new panel project requires 8 in-app coins.

Users can add material cards with custom codes, color names, transparency levels, and photo references to match with individual glass pieces. The app records cutting sessions, edge trimming notes, and dry-fit inspection states with static photos and markers. Projects are organized into stages including design, material selection, cutting, assembly, and final review, helping creators keep a complete visual and structural record of their handcrafted glass work.

name: BM Online
description:
BM Online es la app oficial del medio paraguayo BM Online: noticias de Paraguay y el mundo, la radio y la TV en vivo, entrevistas y podcasts, en un solo lugar.

NOTICIAS AL INSTANTE
• Portada con la nota destacada y lo último, actualizada todo el día.
• Secciones: Nacionales, Política, Economía, Internacionales, Deportes y más.
• Búsqueda de noticias y lectura cómoda, con la fuente de cada nota.
• Las notas que ya abriste quedan guardadas para leerlas sin conexión.

ÚLTIMO MOMENTO
• Avisos de las noticias urgentes con titular y foto. Los activás o desactivás cuando quieras desde Ajustes.

RADIO Y TV EN VIVO
• BM Radio en vivo, también con la pantalla bloqueada, desde el centro de control o por AirPlay.
• BM en vivo las 24 horas, con pantalla completa e imagen dentro de imagen.
• Aviso antes de usar datos móviles para cuidar tu plan.

VIDEOS Y PODCASTS
• Lo mejor de Bruno Masi, las últimas entrevistas y los capítulos de BM Podcast.

A TU MANERA
• Modo claro, oscuro o automático.
• Diseño nativo para iPhone, rápido y sin publicidad invasiva.

No hace falta crear una cuenta: abrís la app y ya estás informado.

name: BMM Ensayo
description:
BMM Ensayo es tu espacio personal para preparar las canciones del culto en iPhone y iPad.

Conecta el enlace de la carpeta de SharePoint que publica tu equipo desde BMM para Mac. Elige un culto, descarga sus canciones y ensaya a tu ritmo, incluso sin internet después de descargarlas.

• Encuentra cultos por nombre, fecha o canción.
• Escucha las pistas sincronizadas y ajusta el volumen de cada instrumento.
• Silencia pistas o utiliza Solo para concentrarte en una parte.
• Sigue las letras, los acordes y la próxima sección.
• Salta a una sección y repítela durante tu ensayo.
• En iPad, consulta letra y mezcla juntas. En iPhone, cambia entre ambas vistas.
• Conserva tu mezcla personal en el dispositivo.
• Borra descargas locales cuando necesites liberar espacio.
• Prueba el ejemplo incluido sin configurar una cuenta.

BMM Ensayo funciona en modo de solo lectura: tus ajustes no modifican las letras, los arreglos, las pistas ni el orden del culto de la aplicación principal.

Para utilizar tus propios cultos, tu equipo debe publicarlos desde BMM para Mac en una carpeta de SharePoint a la que tengas acceso. La conexión se hace por enlace y no requiere OneDrive en el teléfono. Una carpeta privada puede requerir iniciar sesión con Microsoft. Las canciones de tu equipo no están incluidas en la descarga de la app; se incluye un ejemplo de demostración.

name: Bodr
description:
Bodr turns your Apple Watch data into clear daily scores: how well you have recovered, how much sleep you need and how much strain to take on today.

Every morning Bodr compares your overnight heart rate, heart rate variability, breathing and sleep with your personal norm and shows recovery as a percentage. During the day it adds up strain from heart rate and workouts, and in the evening it tells you when to go to bed to sleep enough.

What Bodr has:
- Recovery from overnight readings against your norm.
- Sleep: how much you need, stages, schedule and bedtime.
- Daily strain on a scale up to 21, with a target for the day.
- Stress from heart rate through the day.
- Health monitor: heart rate variability, resting heart rate and breathing against your norm.
- Body age: an estimate from sleep, activity, VO2 max and resting heart rate.
- Trends over a week, a month and half a year, and a weekly summary.
- A habit journal and how habits affect recovery.
- A Lock Screen widget.

Bodr works with Apple Watch and the Health app and only reads data. It has no accounts, ads or servers: everything is worked out on your iPhone and stays there.

Bodr is not a medical device. Its scores are for wellbeing and training; they do not diagnose anything and do not replace a doctor.

name: BolivAI Home
description:
BolivAI Home puts your whole home in one calm screen.

One sentence tells you how the house is right now: which lights are on, which door is unlocked, how warm it is inside. Tap any room to see it and control it.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Lights: dim, brighten or switch off a room or the whole house
• Climate: set the temperature with a dial
• Security: arm, disarm and see every door and window
• Locks and garage: press and hold to open, so nothing opens by accident
• Cameras: see your cameras in one place
• Energy: what is using power right now and what it costs
• Automations: write it the way you say it ("turn off the lights at 11 pm") and BolivAI Home builds the rule
• Ask bar: tell BOLIV what to do and it does it
• Activity: everything that happened at home, in order
• Wall panel mode for a tablet on the wall

TRY IT FIRST
No devices yet? Open the demo home and try everything.

CONNECT YOUR HOME
BolivAI Home works with a BolivAI Home hub on your network, which talks to your lights, thermostats, locks, sensors and cameras.

MADE FOR EVERY SCREEN
iPhone, iPad, foldables and tablets, in light or dark, in 7 languages.

Free with ads. Remove ads anytime with a one-time purchase.

Made by BolivAI.

name: Bolt Book
description:
Bolt Book is a cloth stash and cutting notebook for people who sew at home. It keeps the width and the length still on each bolt, and it subtracts that length when you cut cloth for a project.

Record a bolt. Add the cloth on your shelf: a name, the fiber, where it sits, the width, the original length, and the length still on the roll. A bar shows the remaining length against the original length. Indigo, rust, cream, ink, olive, and blush are labels so the list is easy to scan.

Log a cut. A project is one piece you are making: planned, cutting, sewing, or finished. Each cut names a bolt, a length in centimeters, and a purpose, such as body panels or straps. Bolt Book will not save a cut that is longer than the cloth left on that bolt. Delete a cut, or delete the project, and that length goes back onto the bolt.

See what fits. On the Bench, enter the width and length a piece needs, or start from a tote, an apron, a cushion, or shorts. Those presets are estimates you can change. Bolt Book lists every bolt that is wide enough and still long enough, with the longest remaining piece first.

A short guide explains how the three lengths work, how a cut moves length on and off a bolt, and how the width check decides a match.

Your records stay on this iPhone, in one private file. The first launch includes sample bolts and a sample project, so you can try the flow right away. Deleting the app removes the file.

name: Bom Retiro do Sul
description:
O aplicativo oficial da Prefeitura de Bom Retiro do Sul coloca os serviços do município na palma da sua mão. Abra o app e veja tudo o que a prefeitura oferece: não é preciso criar conta para consultar os serviços.

REQUISIÇÕES DE SAÚDE
Peça transporte para consultas, exames e tratamentos fora do município. Envie o pedido pelo celular, acompanhe a análise da Secretaria de Saúde e receba a resposta sem precisar ir até o balcão.

REQUISIÇÕES DE OBRAS
Avise a prefeitura sobre problemas na cidade: buraco na via, iluminação pública apagada, calçada danificada, bueiro entupido, poda de árvore, entulho na rua, sinalização de trânsito, estrada do interior e mais. Tire a foto, marque o local no mapa e envie. Cada pedido recebe um número de protocolo.

MEUS PEDIDOS
Um só lugar para acompanhar tudo o que você pediu, de Saúde e de Obras, com a situação atual (aberto, em análise, em execução, concluído) e o histórico de cada etapa.

FALE CONOSCO
Telefones, endereço e site oficiais da prefeitura, sempre à mão.

ACESSIBILIDADE
Fonte de alta legibilidade, botão para aumentar o tamanho do texto e tema claro ou escuro.

Login apenas quando necessário: navegar pelos serviços é livre; só pedir e acompanhar requisições exige entrar na sua conta.

name: Bond Back: Rental Inspection
description:
A renter walks through a property room by room at move-in and move-out, takes timestamped photos with notes, and exports a dated PDF to use as evidence in a bond dispute.

What you get:
- Room by room, item by item
- Dated photos for every item
- A dated PDF with every photo
- Move-in vs move-out side by side
- Never miss the return deadline

Free to start. Optional in-app purchases add more.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

name: Boogli MouthSync
description:
Sing, and your monster sings with you!

Meet Sludge, a gooey tar monster with a big glowing mouth. Play a song, follow the karaoke lyrics, and watch Sludge sing every word with you: the mouth opens on the big notes, rounds out on "ooh", closes between words, and drips tar when things get loud.

SING ALONG
• Karaoke lyrics light up word by word, right on the beat.
• Sludge's mouth follows the words and your voice.
• Built-in Boogli songs work right away, no account needed.

YOUR MUSIC
• Sing songs from your Apple Music library.
• Popular sing-alongs: kid-friendly favorites, ready to play with an Apple Music subscription.
• Songs with sing-along lyrics are marked so you know which ones work best.

MORE WAYS TO PLAY
• Duet: two singers, one phone. Take turns line by line and score by singing your words as they light up.
• Free Sing: play music in any app, or just sing, and Sludge sings along.
• Chill mode: sit back and let Sludge perform.

MADE FOR FAMILIES
• No ads, no accounts, no tracking.
• Lyrics are never shown for songs marked explicit.
• Boogli listens on your phone and never records or uploads your voice.

More monsters are on the way!

Synced lyrics provided by Musixmatch. Apple Music songs require an Apple Music subscription.

name: Boostwn
description:
A six-sided steel plate of brass pegs lies on black leather. One gear on it always turns: the drive, clockwise. Burners stand on other pegs, each carrying an arrow that says which way it has to turn. Lay loose gears from the kit on the empty pegs until the whole train turns every burner the way its arrow says, and the flames light.

HOW IT WORKS
A gear meshes with every gear on a peg that touches its own and turns the other way. Copper turns clockwise, blued steel turns the other way, dull bronze stands still. Three gears that all touch - or any ring of an odd number of them - cannot turn at all: the train jams solid and every gear of it is ringed in red.

The short way is usually the wrong way. On almost every plate there are fewer gears than the kit holds that would join every burner to the drive - and then some burner turns backwards. The kit is exactly the fewest gears that can do the plate, and with them there is exactly one way to do it. Every plate was built and checked by exhaustive search before it shipped.

NINETY-SIX PLATES, EIGHT CHAPTERS
FIRST TURN opens with sixteen pegs and a single burner, and FULL STEAM closes with fifty-four pegs and four. In between the plates widen, pegs go missing, idle gears get in the way, and the one train you need has to branch. Each chapter has twelve plates and its own leather behind them.

THE GREAT TRAIN
Every plate you finish sets one more gear of a great train turning: ninety-six gears winding in three turns round a great burner, which lights when the last of them does. That is the only tally the game keeps.

NOTHING TO LOSE
Nothing is random and nothing is timed. Taps are not counted. UNDO takes back the last gear and has no limit, CLEAR lifts every loose gear, and any gear can be lifted again - so a plate cannot be spoiled. HINT rings the peg the next gear goes on, and a second press puts it there; a plate finished with no hint carries a second mark.

There is nothing to buy, no adverts, no energy, no lives, and nothing that expires overnight. The game works with no connection at all.

MADE TO BE READ
Nothing is told by colour alone: the drive and every burner carry an arrow, a jam carries a ring, and every refusal is said in words. Reduce motion stops the gears turning - their metals still say which way - and turns every animation into a short fade. Sound and haptics can each be switched off.

name: Bopi - Physics Experiments
description: Build your mechanics intuition in an offline workshop. Explore 30 experiments across motion, levers, friction, pulleys, collisions, stability and combined models. Adjust parameters, predict a direction, run or pause, and compare your prediction with the result. Keep saved runs with initial conditions, written explanations, annotated photos and voice notes. Export a PDF Lab Page and PNG snapshot; share audio separately. No account or in-app purchase. Simplified educational models only, not for engineering safety decisions.

name: Boramir Design
description:
Boramir Design is a workbench for jewellers, designers and small workshops that make pieces to order. Each order is one job record with client, deadline, budget, reference photos and a six-stage production tracker, so nothing has to live in a notebook on the side.

From that record you build the piece in 3D. The band, the centre stone, the accents and the engraving are parametric and measured in millimetres, so changing a width or a carat recalculates the rest instead of breaking it.

The arithmetic runs while you design. Volume becomes weight, weight becomes cost, and cost becomes the quote, with around twenty manufacturability checks flagging the failures that cost a casting. A client-facing Showroom mode turns the device around with one live piece, one price and no costings on screen.

What's inside?

• A 3D editor that speaks the trade: six band profiles, fourteen stone cuts across twenty species, prong, bezel and half-bezel settings, pavé, channel, three-stone and eternity arrangements.
• Engraving measured in real glyph size, exported as SVG ready for the machine.
• Live costing from metal volume to weight to cost to client price, with checks for casting, durability, sizing and setting failures.
• Showroom, a client view that hides your margins and leaves a single price.
• Shop figures: takings, bench hours, profit per bench hour, on-time record, and metal and stone consumption.

Finished work leaves the app as a PDF tech sheet and quote, STL and OBJ for the caster, SVG for engraving and a PNG render. Nothing goes to the cloud, so photos, designs and prices stay on the device, encrypted, behind the passcode and biometrics.

Drawn, priced and finished in one place!

name: Bosphorus Tour
description:
Take the helm of a tour boat and show your guests Istanbul from the water.

Bosphorus Tour is a calm, detailed boat game set on the real coastline of the Bosphorus. Cast off from Eminönü, Kabataş or Ortaköy, steer with the wheel and the engine telegraph, bring your guests close to each sight and let the guide tell its story. Handle the boat gently and arrive on time, and the tips will follow.

EIGHT TOURS, THE WHOLE STRAIT
• Old City Tour: Galata Tower, Topkapı Palace, the Maiden's Tower
• Palaces Tour: Dolmabahçe, Çırağan, Ortaköy, Beylerbeyi
• Fortresses, Sunset, Upper Bosphorus, Gate of the Black Sea and Moonlight tours
• The Grand Bosphorus Cruise, from Eminönü all the way to Anadolu Kavağı
• 25 sights in all, from the Golden Horn to the third bridge

A GUIDE ON BOARD
• A short, carefully checked story for every sight, read aloud in English or Turkish
• Guests ask questions on the way: answer well and they are delighted
• A logbook with a stamp for every sight you have shown

A BOAT THAT FEELS LIKE A BOAT
• A wheel and a five-step engine telegraph; the hull answers the way a real one does
• The strait's current, wind, rain and morning fog
• Ferries, pilot boats and big ships on passage: keep clear and sound the horn
• An autopilot for when you would rather watch, binoculars for a closer look
• Come alongside the landing with care: a bump costs you the guests' good mood

A LIVING STRAIT
• Morning, sunset and moonlight tours; the city lights up after dark
• Dolphins, cormorants, shearwaters and gulls, collected in a nature journal
• Guests who walk aboard and take photographs at every sight

MAKE THE BOAT YOUR OWN
• Six upgrades in the boat yard: engine, helm, comfort, seats, sound system, tea service
• New paints for the hull
• A Charter of the Day with a new route and a special wish every day, and private charters whenever you like
• 18 badges to earn, three tiers each

FAIR AND QUIET
• Free to download: the first two tours are free, as often as you like
• One single purchase, "Full Game", unlocks everything else, and it works with Family Sharing
• No ads, no subscription, no account, no data collected
• Plays without an internet connection
• English and Turkish
• For iPhone and iPad, with graphics levels to suit the device

Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database Licence (openstreetmap.org/copyright). The coastline data prepared for the game is published under the same licence:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Cg-Bl0N5xn7yadOhsfCodCajqJ2XImha

Bosphorus Tour is an independent game. It is not affiliated with any ferry or tour operator, museum or public body; the landmarks are the game's own models and the vessels are fictional.

name: Bosques de Pandora
description:
Bosques de Pandora es la app de consulta para los propietarios y responsables del negocio. Te muestra, en una sola pantalla y en lenguaje claro, cómo van las cuentas.

Qué puedes ver:
• Ingresos y gastos del día, del mes o de cualquier rango de fechas.
• A qué cuenta entró el dinero y cuánto de lo vendido corresponde a cada persona, con el cruce de cuentas entre socios.
• Ingresos por medio de pago y por área del negocio.
• Gastos por categoría, con el detalle de cada uno.
• Personas atendidas por día: visitantes y equipo, con los días de mayor y menor movimiento.
• Alojamientos: noches ocupadas, llegadas y personas recibidas por cada domo, con su foto.

Entrada segura: ingresas con tu correo y contraseña, y luego puedes activar la huella o Face ID para entrar más rápido. La biometría nunca sale de tu teléfono.

La app es solo de consulta: no modifica ni registra nada en el sistema.

Acceso exclusivo para cuentas autorizadas del negocio. Puedes explorar la app con datos de ejemplo desde la pantalla de inicio, sin necesidad de una cuenta.

name: BOV - Bandeja Or Vibora
description:
BOV - Bandeja Or Vibora is for a regular padel foursome that wants to know more than the score. After every match, one phone goes round the table and each player rates the other three on seven shots: serve, volley, bandeja, víbora, smash, lob and wall exits, from 1 to 10. Over the weeks, everyone builds a shot profile that shows which part of their game is getting better and which needs work.

A match night in three steps
Court Setup: tap a player, then a box on the court, to set Team A and Team B with drive and revés sides. Enter the set scores now or after rating, on big flip-style steppers that only accept real padel sets.
Pass & Rate: the screen says who gets the phone next, with their box lit on the court, and they hold a button to start, so a bump can't skip anyone. Each player rates the other three, shot by shot, with large 1–10 chips or "Didn't see it". No one sees the votes already given.
Match Reveal: when the fourth player is done, each player's per-shot averages flip onto a split-flap scoreboard. Stamps mark the best shot, the weakest shot and the biggest move since that player's last night. Tap a row to see the three votes behind it, anonymous and sorted. Save the night and you're back at the Clubhouse.

Your shot profile
Every player gets a radar of their seven shots, with their form before the last night drawn as an outline, a trend line for each shot across the nights, and an overall rating. "Work on this" picks the lowest shot that dropped since the night before and gives one plain tip for it.

The crew ranking
Standings list the crew by overall rating, with wins, sets won and each player's best shot. Head-to-head shows the record of each pair against the pairs it has played: wins, losses and draws.

History you can fix
Every night is kept as a score bug with teams and sets. Open one to see its boards again, correct the scores or the ratings, or delete it; every stat updates on its own.

Private and offline
Bandeja works with no account and no sign-in. Your crew, matches and ratings stay on the phone that runs the night, and players can be archived and restored without losing their history.

Bandeja Or Vibora is made for four players per match, a crew of any size, and one phone.

name: Box Labels: Moving QR Boxes
description:
Number every moving box, print a QR label for it, list what is inside, and scan the label at the new place to see contents and destination room.

What you get:
- Every box numbered and listed
- Print QR labels on A4, Letter or Avery
- Scan a box, see what's inside
- Colour-coded by destination room
- Find the kettle in seconds

Free to start. One in-app purchase adds the rest, with no subscription.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

name: BrainQuest: Little Brain Wins
description:
A little play. A lovely little win.

Meet BrainQuest: a colourful puzzle adventure with 1,000 challenges across 100 stages. Discover 25 ways to play, from Sudoku and word trails to crown logic, liquid colour sorting, memory, maths and culture quizzes.

YOUR ADVENTURE, TEN GAMES AT A TIME
Each stage brings ten challenges, starting gently and building towards trickier puzzles. Try every game, return to the ones you missed, and complete the stage to unlock the next. No countdown timers or energy bars.

FIND YOUR FAVOURITES
Explore Sudoku, Royal Logic, Colour Crowns, Sun & Moon, Word Wander, Letter Ladder, Liquid Colour Sort, sliding tiles, matching pairs, shape fitting, number patterns and more. Bigger grids and multi-round challenges appear as your journey grows.

MADE TO FEEL GOOD
Enjoy tactile native controls, soft animations, colourful stage artwork, optional sounds and haptics, and little celebrations. VoiceOver labels and Reduce Motion support help make the journey more comfortable.

A FRESH LOOK WHEN YOU NEED ONE
Rules are always available. After a missed attempt, unlock that game's hint for 3 gems and reopen it without paying again. Optional nudges cost 5 gems, new boards cost 10, and a full reference solution costs 50 gems or a completed rewarded video when eligible and available. Assisted completions count towards stage progress, but do not earn XP, win gems or independent-win trophies. You can also leave a game and come back later.

COLLECT LITTLE WINS
Earn XP and gems for independent first-time wins, build an activity streak and collect milestones. Connect to Apple Game Center for supported achievements and leaderboards.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Core puzzles work offline, with no separate BrainQuest account. Game Center, purchases and advertising videos need an internet connection. Progress and gem balances are stored on your device; they do not sync between devices. Gem purchases are optional consumable in-app purchases, not subscriptions. Advertising videos are optional, subject to availability, and limited to players who confirm they are 16 or older and enable videos. Privacy choices remain available in Settings.

BrainQuest is for recreational play and general knowledge, not an IQ test, medical service or promise of improved cognitive ability.

Ready for your next aha! moment?

name: Brava Piano: Learn Piano
description:
Learn piano one note at a time, on iPhone and iPad.

Brava Piano turns your screen into a beautiful stage. Golden notes fall onto the keys you need to play, and in Learn mode the music waits for you, so every piece is within reach, however slowly you need to go.

LEARN WITH NOTES THAT WAIT
• Falling notes with finger numbers on every note
• Practice the right hand, the left hand or both
• Loop any passage from A to B and slow it down
• Clear feedback on every note: Perfect, Good, Early or Late

REAL SHEET MUSIC
• Listen mode plays any piece on the concert grand while engraved notation scrolls along with every note
• Reading music finally starts to make sense

200 LESSONS AND 148 MASTERPIECES
• A complete course, from your first note to real repertoire
• Public-domain classics by Bach, Beethoven, Chopin, Mozart, Schubert, Debussy, Satie, Tchaikovsky, Joplin and more
• Four levels, from Beginner to Advanced

WATCH YOURSELF IMPROVE
• Stars, accuracy, your best streak and timing measured to the millisecond after every run

PLAY FREELY
• Free Play writes what you play as notation, live
• Record takes, layer them and save them to your library

YOUR OWN MUSIC
• Import any MIDI file
• Smart Clean finds wrong notes, duplicates and timing slips, and fixes the ones you choose
• Edit notes in the piano-roll editor
• Export any piece as an engraved PDF, ready to print

A REAL CONCERT GRAND
• Every key is a recording of a Yamaha C5 grand piano
• Choose the room: Salon, Concert Hall or Cathedral
• Shape the lid, touch and tone; metronome with count-in
• Play on screen or connect a USB or Bluetooth MIDI keyboard

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your progress stays on your device.

BRAVA PIANO PRO
After the free welcome, Brava Piano needs Pro. Choose Yearly with a 7-day free trial, Monthly, or Lifetime (a one-time purchase). Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, and can be managed in your Apple ID settings.

Terms of Use: https://itsacue.com/apps/bravapiano/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://itsacue.com/apps/bravapiano/privacy/

name: Bread of the Morrow
description:
Bread of the Morrow gives you one Bible verse and one reflection from the Church Fathers every day of the year. Bible in a Year takes you through the whole Bible of the Coptic Orthodox Church in 365 days.

Each day's verse comes from the American Standard Version, paired with a related teaching from saints and teachers of the Church: St. Cyril of Alexandria, St. Athanasius, St. John Chrysostom, St. Anthony the Great, and Coptic teachers including Pope Shenouda III, Archdeacon Habib Girgis, Bishop Moussa, and Fr. Tadros Yacoub Malaty. Every reflection is quoted from a named source.

Features:
- Daily Verse: the day's verse and reflection, ready the moment you open the app
- Reflections: browse all 365 days of the year
- Favorites: save the verses you want to return to
- Bible in a Year: read the whole Bible of the Coptic Orthodox canon in 365 days, including Tobit, Judith, Wisdom, Sirach, Baruch, the Maccabees, the Sequels of Esther and Daniel, and Psalm 151. Each day pairs the Old Testament with a Psalm, Wisdom reading, or New Testament chapter. Mark days as read, track your progress, start any day or follow the calendar year, and browse by day or by book
- Share: send a verse or the day's Bible references to family and friends
- Home Screen widget: see today's verse at a glance
- Light and dark mode, Dynamic Type, and VoiceOver support

Bread of the Morrow has no ads, no accounts, and no tracking. Everything is built into the app and works offline. Your reading progress stays on your iPhone.

Scripture quotations are from the American Standard Version (1901). In Bible in a Year, Tobit, Judith, the Sequel of Esther, Wisdom of Solomon, Sirach, Baruch, the Sequel of Daniel, 1–2 Maccabees and Psalm 151 are from Sir Lancelot C. L. Brenton's English translation of the Septuagint (1851). Both translations are in the public domain.
App icon cross artwork: "Coptic Cross monochrome" by David A se, Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0 (recolored).

name: Brew Journal: Coffee Timer
description:
Brew coffee or tea from a saved recipe with a guided pour timer, then log the beans and how the cup tasted so you can dial in the next one.

What you get:
- Every pour, timed and weighed
- Change the dose, the recipe scales
- Brew with the phone locked
- Log beans and roast dates
- Find your best cup again

Free to start. One in-app purchase adds the rest, with no subscription.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

name: Brick Take-Apart: 3D Puzzle
description:
Turn it. Pull it. Sort it.

Brick Take-Apart is a 3D puzzle about taking a finished brick model apart, one brick at a time. Spin the model with your finger, tap a brick whose way out is clear, and it flies into the color box that matches it.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag to turn the model, pinch to zoom, twist with two fingers.
• A brick slides out the way its studs face, but only when nothing stands in its way. Tap a blocked brick and the bricks in its way pulse.
• Pulled bricks go into an open box of the same color. No room? They wait in the holding slots.
• A full box makes way for the next one, and matching bricks hop over from the slots by themselves.
• Clear the model and the slots to win.

SLOTS FULL? DON'T PANIC
When every holding slot is taken you get a few seconds: quickly tap bricks the open boxes take. Each brick you box buys a little more time. Pull it off for a "Nice save!"

500+ PUZZLES, LEVELS WITHOUT END
• More than 500 puzzles: houses, vehicles, animals, food, castles and more, each with a name.
• After a short tutorial, Normal, Hard and Very hard maps come in a mixed order, and the level numbers never run out.
• Four boosters for tight spots: Hammer, Extra box, Clear slots and Extra slot.
• Daily check-in gifts with coins and boosters.

WORKSHOP: BUILD YOUR OWN MAPS
• Stack cubes on a grid up to 12×12×12, choosing from 37 colors (up to 8 per map), with undo, symmetry and a turning view.
• Pick a difficulty and the game turns your model into a puzzle. Clear it once yourself, then publish it.
• Play maps made by other players: sort by Popular, New, Top rated or Most played, and rate the ones you clear with stars.
• Share a map with its code.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
• Weekly and all-time rankings of levels cleared, plus a ranking for every level.
• Add friends with a friend code and compare your ranks.

GOOD TO KNOW
• No sign-up: you play right away. Link your Apple or Google account to take your progress to another device.
• The campaign works offline. Rankings, the Workshop, boosters and the shop need a connection.
• Color-blind symbols, reduced motion and graphics options in the game settings.
• Plays in 15 languages.
• Free to play, with ads between levels and optional rewarded videos. "Remove Ads + Unlimited Workshop" turns off the ads between levels and lifts the daily Workshop limit (without it you can start 5 maps by other players a day). Coins, booster packs and bundles are also sold in the game.

name: Brigada: escandallos y turnos
description:
Brigada es la app del cocinero que quiere su cocina bajo control: lo que cuesta cada plato, quién trabaja cada día, qué toca limpiar y a qué temperatura están las cámaras. Todo en el iPhone y listo para compartir en PDF.

ESCANDALLOS Y FICHA TÉCNICA
• Coste por ración, food cost, margen bruto y precio recomendado según tu objetivo.
• Platos y elaboraciones: una salsa o un fondo se usan dentro de otros platos con su coste por kilo.
• Peso neto y bruto con la merma de cada ingrediente, y qué parte del coste se lleva cada uno.
• Elaboración paso a paso, con tiempo, temperatura y foto de cada paso.
• Alérgenos calculados solos a partir de los ingredientes (los 14 obligatorios).
• Catálogo de 486 ingredientes: tú solo pones el precio al que compras.
• Al cambiar un precio ves al momento cómo queda cada plato.

CUADRANTE DE TURNOS
• Tu equipo, con su puesto y su color.
• Turnos de mañana, mediodía, tarde o noche, o a medida.
• Repite un turno en varios días y copia la semana anterior.
• Horas por persona cada semana.

LIMPIEZA POR ZONAS
• Cocina, cámaras, sala, barra, baños… con tareas diarias, semanales y mensuales.
• Calendario de la semana y progreso del día.
• Queda registrado quién lo hizo y a qué hora.

TEMPERATURAS
• Registro de cámaras, neveras y congeladores.
• Aviso si una lectura está fuera de rango.
• Informe mensual para tu autocontrol APPCC.

PDF CON ASPECTO PROFESIONAL
• Ficha de producción, escandallo con costes y exportación a Excel.
• Cuadrante de turnos para enviar al equipo.
• Calendario de limpieza para colgar.
• Informe de registros del mes.

TUS DATOS SON TUYOS
Sin cuentas ni servidores: todo se guarda en tu teléfono. Funciona sin conexión.

BRIGADA PRO
Brigada es gratis con hasta 5 platos y 4 personas en el equipo; limpieza, temperaturas y PDF son siempre libres. Brigada Pro quita esos límites con una suscripción mensual o anual que se renueva automáticamente. El pago se carga en tu cuenta de Apple al confirmar la compra y la suscripción se renueva salvo que la canceles al menos 24 horas antes de que termine el periodo. Puedes gestionarla y cancelarla en los ajustes de tu cuenta de Apple.

Condiciones de uso: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacidad: https://nicolasfgb.github.io/brigada-app/privacidad.html

En castellano, catalán e inglés.

name: BRIGO
description:
BRIGO is the companion app for the BRIGO CCS2 to GB/T charging adapter. The adapter lets a car with a GB/T DC socket charge at CCS2 fast chargers across Europe; the app connects to it over Bluetooth and shows you what is happening.

CHARGING
- Live state of the session: state of charge, power, voltage and current (actual and requested by the car), remaining time, and the maximum voltage and current of the car and the charger
- Stop charging from the app, or from the Live Activity on the lock screen
- Charge chart of the whole session

ADAPTER
- Charging mode, voltage matching, power limit and other adapter features
- Change the adapter PIN
- Firmware updates over Bluetooth

LOGS AND CHARGERS
- Download the adapter's log and browse every charging session it recorded
- Every charger you used, on a map, with the date, place and peak power of each visit
- Send a problem report with the session attached, so we can see what the charger and the car said to each other

AUTO CHARGE
- Start charging automatically through your own account at supported charging networks

CHARGE WITHOUT OPENING THE APP
- When you plug in, the phone connects to the adapter by itself and you answer from a notification or the lock screen

DIAGNOSTICS PROGRAM (OPTIONAL)
- Off unless you join; the app asks once and you can change it any time in Settings > Privacy
- While you are in it, the charging session logs from your adapter (charger identifiers, car VIN, charging values, time and place of charging, adapter serial number) are sent to the developer, only to monitor how adapters, chargers and cars work together, fix faults and improve the firmware and the app
- No ads, no tracking, no third-party analytics

No adapter yet? Tap "Try without an adapter" on the first screen to see a simulated charging session.

The app works only with authorized BRIGO adapters; it does not control other CCS2 to GB/T adapters. An account is needed only for cloud features such as linking an adapter, firmware updates and Auto Charge.

name: Bucha - Brew.Sip
description:
Bucha is a kombucha tasting journal for the flavors you have tried and the combinations you want to explore. Add a drink name and brand, choose a flavor, and keep a photo, star rating and tasting note together. Edit an entry when you have more to say, or delete it when you need to. Your calendar, monthly drink counts and most frequently recorded flavors give you a view of your own tasting history.

For a closer comparison, create a two-flavor trial. Note each combination and its ingredient amounts, score sweetness, tartness and bubbles, and write separate tasting notes before choosing your preference. Revisit a saved comparison or duplicate it for a fresh attempt.

There is room for visual inspiration, too. Browse a curated collection of kombucha drinks with tea bases, ingredients, flavor descriptions and serving suggestions. Explore the tea and ingredient atlas for fruit, herbs and spices, including their characteristics, preparation and storage. The discovery area offers flavor ideas and drink photographs when you feel like trying a different direction.

Create photo-and-text tasting moments, browse kombucha questions and answers, and write questions or answers of your own. Like or save moments to find them again from your profile. Hide content, report a problem or block an author to manage what appears in your view.

name: BUILD FROM THE BACK
description:
地方の小さなサッカークラブの監督に就任するところから物語は始まります。

「BUILD FROM THE BACK」は、弱小クラブを育てて全国の頂点を目指す、放置系サッカー監督シミュレーションです。

■ 眺める楽しさ、テキスト実況
試合は自動で進み、90分の試合がテキスト実況で流れます。無回転ミドルやバイシクルシュートといったスーパープレイの実況も。1秒＝1分のライブ感を、×2や「結果だけ」でも楽しめます。

■ クラブを育てる
練習場・ジム・売店・クラブハウスなどの施設を建てて、攻撃・守備・体力・連携の4つの数値を伸ばします。離れている間もクラブは育ちます（最大4時間）。

■ 監督の仕事
シーズンの成績でもらえる「監督評価」で、永続スキルの「監督の流儀」を身につけたり、評価ショップで地区の補強を買ったり。地区で優勝すると次の地区が開き、クラブを選び直して再挑戦します。

■ ゲームの特徴
・全5地区、50の架空クラブ（実在のクラブ・選手は登場しません）
・ゲームオーバーなし。自分のペースでゆっくり遊べます
・広告なし・アプリ内課金なし（買い切り）
・完全オフライン対応、ログイン不要
・日本語 / 英語対応

name: Builder Calc: Feet Inch Pro
description:
Builder Calc is the construction calculator for people who work in feet, inches and fractions all day: carpenters, framers, concrete and landscape crews, remodelers and serious DIYers.

FEET-INCH-FRACTION MATH
• Type 5 Feet 3 Inch 1/2 Inch and add, subtract, multiply, divide
• Feet × feet gives square feet, × inches gives cubic feet, Conv Yds gives yards
• Decimal feet, inches, yards, meters, centimeters, millimeters
• Fractions from 1/2 to 1/64, rounded the way a tape reads

RAFTERS AND ROOF
• Pitch, rise, run and diagonal: enter any two, get the rest
• Common rafter length, plumb and level cuts
• Regular hip and valley rafters with cheek cuts
• Jack rafters at 16, 19.2, 24 inch or any spacing

STAIRS
• Riser height and count from floor-to-floor rise
• Tread width and count, stairwell opening, stringer length, incline
• Riser-limited mode keeps every riser at or under your code maximum

CONCRETE AND MATERIALS
• Slabs, footings and columns in cubic yards, with bag counts
• Cost per unit, board feet (and per MBM), studs on center
• Sheets, blocks, roofing squares

CIRCLES AND ARCS
• Area and circumference, arc length from angle or chord and rise
• Segment and pie areas, arched windows and walls
• Columns and cones

BUILT FOR THE JOB SITE
• Keys grouped by colour, laid out like the handheld the trade has used for decades
• Paperless tape and four memories, copy any result
• Long-press any key for its help, no manual needed
• Works offline, nothing leaves your phone
• iPhone, iPad and Mac with one purchase

BUY ONCE
Dimensional math and conversions are free, forever. Builder Calc Pro unlocks unlimited project solutions with a single purchase. We will never add a subscription or ads.

ACCURACY YOU CAN CHECK
The engine reproduces the worked examples of the industry-standard handheld's user guide to the sixteenth of an inch, and each one is an automated test that runs before every release.

Builder Calc is an independent product and is not affiliated with Calculated Industries, Inc.

name: Buildher HQ
description:
BUILDher Portal brings your personalized fitness coaching into one simple place.
Built for women who want sustainable fat loss, strength, confidence, and a body they feel proud of, the Portal gives you the structure, accountability, and support to stay consistent - without guessing what to do next.
Inside the BUILDher Portal, you can:
•	Access LIVE coaching calls and connect with your coached in person
•	Stay connected with your coaches
•	Join a supportive community of women working toward stronger, healthier lives
•	Access coaching resources, education, and live-call information
•	Keep your plan, progress, and coaching support organized in one place
BUILDher is not about quick fixes or extreme plans. It is about building the habits, confidence, and strength that help you create results that last.

name: Burger Stack: Idle Tycoon
description:
Stack it right, serve it fast, and grow a tiny burger stall into a worldwide franchise!

Burger Stack is an idle tycoon game with a twist: every customer orders a real burger, and you build it layer by layer, from the bottom bun to the top. Get the order exactly right to grow your combo and multiply your earnings.

• BUILD EVERY ORDER
Bun, patty, cheese, lettuce, tomato, bacon and more. Tap the ingredients in the right order and watch the burger stack up on the counter. Perfect orders grow your combo, and one mistake resets it.

• FOOD CRITICS
Critics arrive with a timer. Serve their order in time for a big bonus.

• 8 KITCHEN STATIONS
Patty grill, fry station, drink bar, milkshake machine, chicken burger corner, dessert counter, drive-thru and food truck. Upgrade them, hit milestones and watch your income soar.

• HIRE YOUR CREW
Grill master, fry cook, bartender, pastry chef and more. Every crew member doubles the income of their station.

• OPEN FRANCHISES IN REAL CITIES
Pick cities on a real 3D globe: New York, London, Tokyo, Paris and more. Open a food stall, then a diner, then a flagship restaurant in each city. Every city adds a permanent income bonus and unlocks a signature recipe for your Recipe Book.

• SECRET SAUCE
Each franchise rewards Secret Sauce. Spend it on permanent upgrades that make every new shop stronger.

• MONTHLY FOOD FESTIVAL
A new themed festival every month with 20 reward tiers, plus daily quests and login streaks.

• PLAY YOUR WAY
Your shop keeps earning while you are away. No sign-in needed. Optional reward videos only, with no forced ads. Available in 10 languages.

Burger Club is an optional monthly subscription with extra income, faster offline earnings, daily gems and rewards without ads. It renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/ermis-burger/ana-sayfa

name: Burland Cat Club
description:
Burland Cat Club is the supporter app for Burland Cat Barn, a small, self-funded cat rescue in Hockley, Essex.

Meet the cats, follow your favourites and keep your Cat Club card on your phone.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Browse every cat currently at the barn, with their stories and who is looking for a home
• Tap the heart to follow your favourite cats
• See alerts in the app when a new cat arrives or one of your favourites changes status
• Keep your Cat Club card on your phone: the cat you support, your monthly amount and the latest news from your cat
• Cat profiles are saved on your phone, so they open even with no signal
• Share a cat with friends using your phone's share sheet
• Sign in with your Burland Cat Barn account: it is the same account you use on burlandcatbarn.co.uk, so your details are in one place
• Delete your account from inside the app at any time

Cat Club is real-world support for the cats' day-to-day care: food, litter and vet bills. It is not a digital subscription, and nothing in the app is unlocked by paying. Joining and changing your card happen securely on the Burland Cat Barn website, with card payments handled by SumUp. The app never stores card numbers.

Browsing the cats needs no account.

Burland Cat Barn is a self-funded rescue and is not a registered charity. Built for the cats by Serventi.

name: Büromanagement Prüfung
description:
Lerne für die Berufsschule und die Abschlussprüfung als Kaufmann oder Kauffrau für Büromanagement.

In der App sind 981 Übungsfragen: 721 zu den Lernfeldern 1 bis 13 des Rahmenlehrplans und 260 zur Wirtschafts- und Sozialkunde. Zu jeder Frage gibt es eine Erklärung und drei Tipps. Was du falsch hattest, kommt wieder, bis es sitzt.

So lernst du:
• Lernfeld für Lernfeld, passend zu dem, was in der Schule gerade dran ist
• WiSo Thema für Thema oder alles gemischt
• Prüfungsmodus für Teil 1 und Teil 2, je 30 Fragen, ohne Tipps
• Auf einen Blick sehen, was sitzt und was noch wackelt
• Hell oder dunkel, ganz ohne Konto

Gut zu wissen: Teil 1 der echten Prüfung ist ein schriftlicher Arbeitsauftrag mit Text- und Tabellenprogramm. Die App übt dafür den Stoff aus Lernfeld 1 bis 4, nicht die Programme selbst. Das Fachgespräch in Teil 2 übt die App nicht.

Zum Ausprobieren frei sind 61 Fragen: Lernfeld 1 und 10 Fragen aus der Wirtschafts- und Sozialkunde. Alles andere schaltest du mit einem Kauf frei, kein Abo.

Alle Fragen sind eigene Übungsfragen, keine Originalaufgaben der Kammern.

name: Burrow Hunters
description:
Which burrow mouth will the rats choose? Follow tracks above ground, then switch to the tunnel map and piece together their escape route. Plug side entrances, leave an open way out, and guard it with a cage or a soft net.

• Plan your patrol. Trace the tunnels you have surveyed and mark the exit you expect the colony to use. Factor in wind and weather, then try fictional wisps, baits, and scents. Change your plan as the colony learns to recognize familiar formulas.
• Time your catch. Hit the timing window, tap quickly, or slide the cage latch shut. Safely relocate the rats and let helpful wildlife pass.
• Review your results. Replay recent patrols to see where the rats actually emerged. Earn tactical ribbons and achievements, and unlock decorations for your camp.

Four ways to play
• Field Campaign. Take on 64 patrols across eight outdoor regions, including fields, orchards, and riverbanks. Learn new tools as you progress.
• Endless Night. Take on increasingly demanding waves, restock between rounds, and adjust to a colony that learns.
• Recipe Sandbox. Test formulas and routes with unlimited supplies, and record what you observe.
• Daily Patrol. Solve a new field puzzle each day and try to beat your personal best.

name: Burvia: Linocut Puzzle
description:
One linoleum block. One target print. And the question of what has to be carved away before each press.

Burvia is a reduction-linocut puzzle for phone and tablet. Each turn you carve cells out of the block, choose exactly one opaque riso ink (fluorescent pink, teal, yellow or federal blue) and press. Every cell still standing prints that ink over whatever was there. A carved cell never takes ink again.

Your goal: reproduce the target print with as few presses as possible.

Think backwards
Pressing at random leads to a dead end. The answer is built from the end: which colour sits on top last? What has to be gone before that press? Once the plan is in your head, every cut feels right.

Four carving tools
• U-gouge: carves a straight line from a cell to the edge of the block
• Block knife: takes out a 2x2 square
• V-gouge: carves an L-shaped corner
• Burin: removes a single cell, in limited stock

What is inside
• 80 hand-tuned prints in four workshops: the Stamp Workshop, the Poster Press, Botanical Prints and Seasonal Blocks
• Three short tutorial puzzles to learn carving and pressing
• Stars for presses against the par, the proven minimum
• A Daily Print, the same block for everyone, with a streak and a daily gift
• Endless mode with freshly generated prints
• A print room where every solved print hangs on the wall; three stars earn the frame

Calm, exact, fair
There is no game over, no timer and no move limit. Undo is unlimited. A hint shows the next sensible cut, and a proof previews a press without making it.

Made for every eye
In colour-blind mode each ink carries its own pattern and symbol.

A handmade riso and letterpress look, quiet sounds of the workshop, 20 languages, playable offline, no account needed.

Note: contains ads (banner, interstitial and optional rewarded videos); coin packs and Remove Ads are available as in-app purchases.

name: Cactio Support
description:
Cactio Support هو تطبيق مخصص لمساعدة الموظفين على إدارة طلبات الدعم التقني والعهد والصيانة ومتابعتها بسهولة من مكان واحد.

يوفر التطبيق تجربة منظمة للوصول إلى الخدمات التقنية ومتابعة الطلبات دون الحاجة إلى التنقل بين أنظمة متعددة.

أبرز المميزات:

- إنشاء تذاكر الدعم التقني ومتابعة حالاتها وتحديثاتها.
- استعراض العهد المسجلة للموظف وتفاصيلها.
- الاطلاع على العهد المشتركة المتاحة بحسب صلاحيات المستخدم.
- تقديم طلبات صيانة العهد ومتابعة تنفيذها.
- استقبال الإشعارات المتعلقة بالطلبات والتحديثات.
- تسجيل دخول آمن للموظفين باستخدام Google Workspace.

يساعد Cactio Support على تسهيل التواصل مع فريق الدعم التقني وتحسين متابعة العهد والخدمات الداخلية.

التطبيق مخصص للمستخدمين المصرح لهم داخل الجهات التي تستخدم نظام Cactio.

name: Caiyai
description:
Caiyai 是一款 AI 助手应用，帮助你通过对话整理信息、探索想法和处理日常任务。

• AI 对话：输入问题或想法，与所选 AI 模型交流，获取回答和建议。
• 图片与文件：在对话中选择图片或文件，为问题提供更多上下文。
• 会话记录：保存和查看历史对话，方便继续之前的讨论。
• 模型选择：根据需要配置和选择可用的模型服务。
• 语音输入：通过语音转文字输入内容。

模型服务的可用性、响应质量和费用取决于所选服务及账户配置。照片、麦克风等功能需要你在系统中授权。AI 生成内容可能存在错误，请核实重要信息。

name: Cake Chef: Bake & Decorate
description:
Open your own bakery! Put flour, sugar, eggs and butter in the bowl, mix, pour into the pan, bake in the oven and decorate the cake of your dreams.

THREE TREATS
• Layer cakes
• Bundt and loaf cakes
• Cut-out cookies

BAKE LIKE A REAL CHEF
• Follow the recipe – add the wrong thing (fish? onion?) and you'll taste it!
• Mix the batter just right and don't forget to grease the pan
• Take it out just in time – too early is raw, too late is burnt!

DECORATE ANY WAY YOU LIKE
• Spread frosting, pipe little pearls and write on your cake
• Fruit, sweets, flowers, candles, sprinkles and powdered sugar
• Porcelain, lace, wooden and glass plates plus cake stands
• Light the candles, tap to blow them out and make a wish!

ORDER MODE
• Customers ask for special cakes: "3 tiers, chocolate, heart-shaped, 5 candles!"
• Finish before the timer runs out, earn points and level up
• Grow from Baking Apprentice to Cake Queen

• Enter your chef name – customers will greet you by name
• Save a photo of your cake to show your family

The game is free and contains family-friendly ads. Ads can be removed forever with a one-time purchase (no subscription). Purchases are protected by a parental gate. No personal information is requested.

name: Calculadora 3D FACPP
description:
Quanto custa, de verdade, cada peça que você imprime? A Calculadora 3D FACPP soma todos os custos de uma impressão 3D (não só o material) e sugere um preço de venda que garante lucro.

Desenvolvido pela Faculdade Paulo Picanço (FACPP) para quem imprime em 3D: makers, laboratórios, estúdios e pequenos negócios.

FDM (FILAMENTO) E RESINA (LCD)
• Alterne entre impressão por filamento e por resina com um toque
• Na resina, inclua lavagem em álcool isopropílico, desgaste do FEP e descartáveis (luvas, filtros, papel)

TODOS OS CUSTOS NA CONTA
• Material: preço e peso do rolo ou volume do frasco, peso da peça e margem de desperdício
• Impressora: depreciação pelo preço e pela vida útil, além da taxa de manutenção
• Energia: potência da impressora, tarifa em R$/kWh e tempo de impressão
• Mão de obra: valor da hora, tempo de preparo e de pós-processamento
• Taxa de falhas e custos fixos mensais (overhead) rateados pelas horas trabalhadas

PREDEFINIÇÕES PRONTAS
• Materiais: PLA, PLA Silk, PETG, ABS/ASA, TPU e resinas Standard, lavável em água e ABS-Like
• Impressoras de filamento e de resina populares, com valores de referência que você pode ajustar

PRECIFICAÇÃO E RESULTADO
• Escolha entre markup sobre o custo ou margem sobre a venda
• Veja o custo real por unidade, o preço sugerido, o lucro líquido e os totais do lote
• Custo por hora e por grama/ml de material
• Gráfico mostrando quanto cada item pesa no custo
• Compartilhe o orçamento em texto com o nome do projeto e do cliente

PRIVACIDADE
Sem cadastro e sem login. Todos os cálculos são feitos no próprio aparelho; o app não coleta dados pessoais.

Tema claro e escuro.

Observação: os valores das predefinições são apenas referências. Confira os preços e tarifas da sua região antes de fechar um orçamento.

name: Calia - Ease
description:
Bring the colors together. Take a moment for yourself.
Calia is a relaxing water-sorting puzzle game. Tap a tube, pour matching colors together, and enjoy the quiet satisfaction of watching each tube fill and seal with a cork.
There’s no timer and no move limit that ends your game. Think through your next move, try a different approach, or restart any level for free. Play at your own pace.
150 PUZZLES TO EXPLORE
Begin with 100 classic levels, then discover 50 creative puzzles. Find keys to unlock tubes, melt layers of ice, reveal hidden colors, and explore paired color swaps and combined mechanics. Each variation gives you a new way to think about every pour.
FIVE THEMES TO DISCOVER
Explore garden greens, sunset shades, ocean colors, nighttime neon, and candy pastels. Unlock themes as you progress through the classic levels and choose the palette that suits your mood.
A LITTLE HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
Use a hint to find your next move, undo a pour to rethink your approach, or add an empty tube to make room. Exchange coins earned through play for helpful tools. Restarting a level is always free.
SMALL REWARDS ALONG THE WAY
Earn coins by completing puzzles, aim for three stars and Perfect results, collect daily rewards, and work toward treasure chests. Spend your earned coins on tools and themes.
PLAY YOUR WAY
Choose from 20 languages. Adjust sound, haptics, and motion effects, or turn on pattern-based color assistance to help distinguish the colors.
ENJOY OFFLINE PLAY
No account, no ads, and no in-app purchases. Your progress saves automatically on your current device, ready whenever you return.
Open Calia and start with a gentle pour.

name: Callfilt: Caller ID & Block
description:
Know who's calling, no contact needed.

Some numbers you want to recognise but never want in your contacts: your bank, a courier, the dentist, the building manager. Save them in Callfilt instead, and iOS shows their name on the incoming call screen. Numbers you never want to hear from, you block.

NAMED ON EVERY CALL
Give a number a name and that name appears on the call screen when it calls. Your contacts stay yours.

BLOCK UNWANTED CALLS
Turn on Block calls for a number, or swipe right on it, and its calls are rejected without ringing. The Blocked list shows every blocked number with the date you blocked it.

BLOCK A WHOLE RANGE
Call centres often call from many numbers that start the same way. Type the start, like 0850 222, choose how many last digits can be anything, and Callfilt blocks or names all of them: 10,000 numbers in one go. A number you saved on its own keeps its own name and setting.

COPIED A NUMBER? ADD IT IN ONE TAP
Copy a number from Recents and open Callfilt: a card offers to add it. Or skip opening the app: the Add copied number and Block copied number actions work in Shortcuts, with Siri, Back Tap or the Action button.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no sign-up, no servers. Your numbers stay on your iPhone, and Callfilt never sees your calls or your contacts.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Turn Callfilt on once in Settings › Apps › Phone › Call Blocking & Identification. Callfilt shows you the way.
• For numbers saved in your contacts, iOS shows the contact and ignores Callfilt's name and block. To block a contact, use Block This Caller in Contacts.
• iOS doesn't tell apps when a blocked number tries to call, so Callfilt can't show a call log.
• iPhone only.

In English and Turkish.

Privacy policy: https://cntech.io/privacy
Terms of use: https://cntech.io/terms

name: Calm Belt: New Island Life
description:
Du wachst am Strand einer kleinen, runden Insel auf. Seelicht ist so winzig, dass man ihre Krümmung sieht – wenn du läufst, dreht sich deine kleine Welt unter dir.

DEIN NEUES ZUHAUSE
Sammle Äste für ein erstes Zelt, zieh in ein Häuschen und bau es Stück für Stück aus. Über 380 Möbel, 200 Kleidungsstücke und Tapeten warten darauf, von dir zusammengestellt zu werden.

NACHBARN, DIE SICH AN DICH ERINNERN
40 Tier-Bewohner mit eigenen Eigenheiten, Geburtstagen und Geschichten. Wer oft vorbeischaut, wird Freund – und erlebt mit ihnen kleine Herzensgeschichten, Briefe und Abende am Feuerstein.

SAMMELN MIT SINN
Angle 40 Fischarten, fang 40 Insekten, grab 30 Fossilien aus und fülle das Fundhaus. Pflücke Früchte, kreuze Blumen, koche Gerichte und such jeden Morgen am Strand nach Treibgut.

DIE INSEL LEBT IN ECHTZEIT
Tag und Nacht, Wetter, Jahreszeiten und 13 Feste folgen deiner echten Uhr. Wenn du müde bist, schläfst du in deinem Bett bis zum nächsten Morgen.

SANFT STATT SCHULDIG
Kein Zeitdruck, keine Strafen fürs Wegbleiben. Komm wieder, wann du magst – die Insel freut sich.

FAIR
• Kostenlos spielbar; mit der Vollversion ohne Werbung. Keine Abos, keine kaufbaren Spielwährungen
• Kein Konto nötig
• Spielstand auf deinem Gerät und, wenn du möchtest, in deiner iCloud
• Mit einer Hand spielbar, im Hochformat

name: CAN Database Editor Mobile
description:
CAN Database Editor brings DBC and SYM database editing to your iPhone or iPad in a clear, information-rich workspace.

Explore messages and signals, edit their properties and understand how each signal fits into a CAN message—all without connecting CAN hardware.

EXPLORE YOUR DATABASE
Browse messages and signals in the database explorer. Search by name, signal or CAN ID, and inspect signal definitions in a detailed table.

EDIT WITH PRECISION
Create and edit messages and signals. Adjust signal names, start bits, bit lengths, byte order, signedness, scaling, limits and units using the Properties panel.

VISUALIZE SIGNAL LAYOUTS
See signal positions in a color-coded bit layout. Move signals with drag and drop and use validation feedback to identify layout conflicts.

WORK WITH DBC AND SYM
Open, inspect, edit and save both formats. Access the original database text through the built-in source editor.

CONVERT BETWEEN FORMATS
Export DBC databases as SYM and SYM databases as DBC. Review the conversion report before exporting to understand format-specific differences and metadata

name: Candle Tray
description:
Candle Tray keeps one incubation on this iPhone. Name the batch, set the species, and mark every egg as you candle it.

Clear eggs leave the count. Eggs you are not sure about stay in and sort to the front. After a round, the tray shows how many are out and the fertility of the ones you set.

Trace the air cell on a photo you keep on this phone. Hatch day records which eggs pipped and which hatched. The results page shows fertility and hatch of fertile. The records stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: CanvasEasy
description:
CanvasEasy turns door-to-door canvassing into a shared live map.

LOG EVERY DOOR
Drop a pin at each house and record what happened: talked, not home, left literature, refused, or vacant. When you talk with someone, note their name, contact info, where they stand, the issues they care about, and any follow-up.

PLAN YOUR NEXT HOUSE
The Visited map shows every door your team has knocked. The Try Again filter shows homes where nobody answered or someone asked for a call back.

SEE WHAT VOTERS CARE ABOUT
Stats show how many people answered, where they stand, and the issues they raise most, by day, by canvasser, or for the whole campaign. Export a spreadsheet or a PDF report anytime.

WORK AS A TEAM
Start a campaign and invite canvassers with a campaign code. Everyone shares one live map, so no one knocks the same door twice. Every plan includes unlimited canvassers.
PLANS
Free for your first 20 doors. Plans are priced by how many doors your campaign logs, with unlimited canvassers on every plan:
Starter: up to 1,000 doors
Campaign: up to 5,000 doors
Pro: up to 15,000 doors
Pay monthly, or pay yearly and get 2 months free.
Election Pass: up to 5,000 doors for 4 months with one payment. It does not renew.

Subscriptions are charged to your Apple ID and renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID subscription settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: (your privacy URL)

name: CarDash TV: Video, Maps, Trips
description:
Watch movies, live TV and videos on your car screen — and control everything from your iPhone.

CarDash TV casts video from your iPhone to your CarPlay display. Your phone becomes the remote: play, pause, skip, pick the quality, turn on subtitles and change the picture shape without touching the car screen.

YOUR CAR SCREEN, YOUR CINEMA
• Cast movies, shows and live TV to your car display
• Remote on your iPhone: quality, subtitles, picture size (Fit, Fill, Stretch, 16:9, 4:3, 21:9) and End
• Plays the next video by itself
• Watch only when parked, drive safely

ALL YOUR SOURCES IN ONE APP
• IPTV playlists (M3U links) and Xtream logins
• Plex, Jellyfin and Emby media servers
• Stremio add-ons
• Nextcloud and WebDAV folders
• Your own videos from Photos and Files

YOUTUBE AND THE WEB
• Browse YouTube and video sites on your iPhone
• Tap Send to Car to play it on the big screen

MIRROR YOUR IPHONE
• Show your iPhone screen on your car display

DRIVE SMARTER
• Trip planner with turn-by-turn directions on CarPlay
• Nearby fuel, parking, EV charging and food

FREE TO USE
• 60 minutes of car-screen video free to try
• Then watch a short ad for 30 more minutes, any time
• Trips and maps are always free

CARDASH TV PRO
• Unlimited car-screen video, no ads
• Yearly or Lifetime (one-time, Family Sharing)

Some apps protect their videos (Netflix, Prime Video and similar) and show a black screen when mirrored; their sound still plays.

Yearly renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in Settings → your name → Subscriptions.

CarDash TV doesn't provide any channels or content. Add only sources you have the right to watch.

Privacy: https://cardash-tv.web.app/privacy

name: Care Relay: Daily Handoff Log
description:
Keep the next caregiver informed with a local family handoff book.

Create a care profile with preferences, routines and an emergency contact. Assign daily care tasks, appointments, errands and check-ins. Record who completed each task and when. Add observations and pin important notes for the next shift.

Review a handoff PDF containing the profile, pending and completed tasks and observation history before you choose whom to share it with. Export or restore a full JSON backup. Optional local reminders keep upcoming tasks visible.

This is a personal record keeper. Sharing is manual; devices do not synchronize in real time. It does not diagnose, recommend treatment, calculate medication doses or dispatch emergency services. Follow the established care plan and qualified professionals for medical decisions. No developer account, tracking or subscription.

name: Carpathron PDF Editor
description:
Carpathron PDF Editor is a complete PDF reader and editor for iPhone and iPad. Reading is free for ever. Editing comes with Carpathron PDF Editor Pro, which you can try free for 3 days.

FREE - no time limit
• Open any PDF from the Files app: on the device, iCloud Drive, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive and other storage apps, or straight from your own WebDAV (Nextcloud and others) and S3 storage
• Open PDFs from other apps with "Open in" and share them back
• Continuous scroll, single and two pages, fit width or page, zoom, full screen and night mode
• Page thumbnails, bookmarks and attachments; search the whole document with a list of results
• Select and copy text; read the page aloud
• Print and share
• Fill in PDF forms and save them; export, import and reset form data
• Check digital signatures; see the document properties and its fonts

PRO - every editing tool
• Edit text where it is, in the document's own fonts; add text, change size, colour and alignment; find and replace
• Images: add, replace, move, resize, crop, rotate and extract
• OCR for scans and photos in English, Romanian, Italian, French, Spanish and German, done on the device: real, editable text at the original sizes, or a searchable layer
• Comments: highlight, underline, strike out, notes, text boxes, callouts, shapes, drawings, stamps and measurements, with replies
• Pages: merge PDFs and pictures, split, extract, insert, delete, reorder, rotate, crop and resize
• Page numbers, Bates numbers, headers and footers, watermarks, backgrounds, links and bookmarks
• Forms: create fields or find them automatically
• Signatures: hand-drawn, typed or from a picture; certificate (digital) signatures and your own digital ID
• Protect: passwords and permissions; true redaction, also by searching for e-mails, phone numbers and IBANs
• Privacy: find and remove earlier versions, metadata, editing history and hidden text
• Convert PDFs to Word, Excel, PowerPoint, HTML, RTF, text and images
• Compare two versions of a document
• AI assistant with your own key (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and others): summarise, explain, translate and rewrite

Your documents stay on your device: they go only where you save them, and to the AI provider you set up only when you ask the assistant.

SUBSCRIPTION
Carpathron PDF Editor Pro unlocks every editing tool on all your devices with the same Apple Account. Plans: 1 month, 3 months, 6 months or 1 year, each with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings. Any unused part of a free trial ends when you buy a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://qubitpage.com/software/privacy

name: Carroll Gardens Courier
description:
You are a delivery driver in Carroll Gardens, Brooklyn, and the clock is always running.

Pick up an order from a real corner deli, pizzeria or cafe, then get it to the door before the tip drains away. The streets are the neighbourhood's own: every block, one-way and address is built from real map data, with brownstones, street trees and street signs at the corners.

DELIVER
- Each order shows the pickup, the drop-off and what it is worth right now
- An arrow and a live route on the map point the way
