- Beat the par time for the full tip; dawdle and the fare shrinks

EARN AND UPGRADE
- Stop at Carroll Motors on Smith Street to spend what you have earned
- Sports car: much faster, with brakes to match
- Dump truck: slow, but it shoves parked cars down the street and hits twice as hard
- Motorcycle: quick and narrow enough for any gap, and gone in a single crash

CRASH
- Dent your car, lose a wheel, lose another, and finally go up in a fireball
- Knock over street signs, shake the leaves off trees or bring one down
- A fresh car arrives a few seconds later

PLAY TOGETHER
- Share a room name with friends and drive the same streets at the same time
- Compare earnings on the live leaderboard
- Ram each other if you must: the damage is real for everyone
- Or play offline, on your own

No ads, no accounts, no purchases.

Map data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors. Street photos (c) Mapillary contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0.

name: CarScreen: Car Widgets
description:
CarScreen puts the widgets you choose on your car's display and plays a sound of your choice whenever your iPhone connects to the car.

8 widgets for the car screen
• Digital Clock – The time, large and easy to read.
• Analog Clock – A classic clock face.
• Date – Today's date at a glance.
• World Clock – Your time and one more city.
• Photo – Your photos, rotating every few minutes.
• Countdown – Days until your next big day.
• Quote – A line of text you choose.
• Moon – Tonight's moon phase.

5 themes
Midnight, Neon, Paper, Retro LCD, Sunset. Pick one and every widget follows.

A sound when you connect
Pick one sound for when the car connects and another for when it disconnects. 8 are built in (Chime, Startup, Soft Bell, Boot, Arcade, Rev, Goodbye, Power Down), and with Pro you can import your own.

How to set it up
Show widgets on the car screen
1. Connect your iPhone to your car with CarPlay at least once.
2. On iPhone, open Settings → General → CarPlay and choose your car.
3. Tap Widgets and add the CarScreen widgets you want.
4. On the car screen, swipe to the widgets page next to the Dashboard.
CarPlay widgets need iOS 26 or later.

Play a sound when the car connects
1. Open the Shortcuts app and go to the Automation tab.
2. Create a new automation and choose CarPlay → Connects → Run Immediately.
3. Add the action “Play Connect Sound” from CarScreen.
4. Repeat with Disconnects and “Play Disconnect Sound”.

Free and Pro
Free: the Digital Clock, Date and Quote widgets, the Midnight theme, and the Chime and Goodbye sounds.
With CarScreen Pro you get:
• All 8 widgets
• All 5 themes
• All sounds, plus your own
• New widgets and themes as they arrive

CarScreen Pro is a yearly subscription with a one-week free trial, or a one-time lifetime purchase. You can manage or cancel the subscription in your Apple Account settings.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

CarPlay and iPhone are trademarks of Apple Inc.

name: CarScreen: Car Widgets & Video
description:
Put your photo, the time and a countdown on your car's dashboard screen, and play your own videos on the big screen while the car is parked, in compatible cars.

CHECK YOUR CAR FIRST, FOR FREE
Before you pay anything, the app plays a 5-second test clip and tells you clearly whether video works in your car. Video on the car screen only works when the car is parked and only in cars whose maker supports it.

VIDEO WHEN PARKED
• Your own videos from Photos and Files, sent to the car screen over AirPlay
• Your own M3U playlists: add the lists you already have. CarScreen does not include any channels or content
• A simple built-in browser to open the web pages you choose

DASHBOARD WIDGETS
• Photo: your own pictures
• Clock and date
• Countdown to a trip, a day off or any date
• Car name and license plate
• Parking place and time elapsed
• Your own quote or message
6 colour themes, and a parking timer that also runs as a Live Activity on your iPhone.

FREE FIRST, THEN PAY ONCE
Free: the car check, 2 widgets (Photo and Clock) and 1 theme. No account and no time limit.
One payment unlocks video, playlists, the browser, all 6 widgets, all themes and the parking timer. No subscription and no renewals. Restore it any time with the same Apple Account.

HOW TO ADD THE WIDGETS
On your iPhone: Settings > General > CarPlay > your car > Widgets.

SAFETY
Never watch video while driving. Video only plays on the car screen when the car is parked.

CarPlay and AirPlay are trademarks of Apple Inc. CarScreen is an independent app and is not affiliated with Apple.

name: CastJournal
description: CastJournal là ứng dụng nhật ký câu cá giúp bạn lưu giữ những chuyến đi và chiến lợi phẩm đáng nhớ. Ghi lại địa điểm, thời tiết, loài cá, trọng lượng, chiều dài, kỹ thuật câu và mồi đã sử dụng. Khám phá bộ sưu tập cá, theo dõi kỷ lục và thống kê hành trình câu cá của bạn. name: Celadon Seam
description:
In kintsugi a broken bowl isn't thrown away. Its cracks are filled with lacquer and gold until the break becomes the best part of it.

Each vessel comes to your tray with cracks branching across the celadon glaze. Touch a junction, draw the brush along a crack and gold follows your finger; lift, and that brushload is spent. A piece allows only a few small cups of lacquer, and no seam takes gold twice, so the puzzle is the route: where to begin and which crack to leave for last.

Mend with the fewest brushloads and no wipes and the seal reads Heirloom. The gold leaf it brings buys silver, bronze or rose-gold powder for your seams.

Higher in the Tansu Cabinet, deep cracks want two coats, glaze drips let gold run only downhill, and a chip stops the brush dead.

name: CG Carlyle
description:
Built around a few inputs — size, density, count — it turns them into the figures that matter: how much to prepare, how much to use, how much it weighs.

Numbers should hold together. Every figure stays tied to the others, so a change in size moves counts, length and mass at once, without a second pass.

Every finished run leaves a record behind: what was planned, what actually resulted, and where the two parted. Material is counted by weight and drawn down once, at the start.

With steady attention to precision and consistency, it offers a calmer and more dependable way to work with figures that have to add up.

name: CG Core
description:
Every screen is reduced to what the task needs: a few fields, one clear figure, and the next action within reach. Behind that surface the careful parts stay careful: records keep their history, totals hold their ground, and nothing you entered quietly changes on you.

Good tools should get out of the way. The best ones are barely noticed: you open it, put the work down, and close it again. That is the kind of use this is built for, short and predictable and free of ceremony.

Chait — рабочее место оператора: все чаты с клиентами в телефоне.

name: CHAM - Resist Cravings & Save
description:
A coffee here, a bag of chips there. When you're torn, open CHAM.

HOLD TO RESIST
Pick what you're craving and hold for one second. The money, calories and sugar you saved pour into your jar — coins and sugar cubes drop right in.

BE HONEST ON THE OFF DAYS
Gave in? Log it with "I gave in". It comes out of your jar, and you can see how often you resisted this week. No guilt, just a better next time.

SAVE UP FOR SOMETHING YOU WANT
Earbuds, a weekend trip, a film camera… Set a goal and every craving you resist brings you closer. Reached it? Tap "Bought it" to put it on your shelf and pick the next goal.

MONEY, CALORIES OR SUGAR
Switch what you count in one tap — and see how much body fat or how many sugar cubes you skipped.

MAKE IT YOURS
From an Americano to convenience-store gummies: add your own items with a photo, and hold and drag to reorder.

YOUR RECORDS STAY ON YOUR PHONE
No sign-up. Your records and photos are stored only on this device.

name: Charmius Vinery
description:
Discover wine, food pairings, and tasting experiences with a convenient companion for exploring wine collections, browsing menus, and planning memorable evenings. Browse wines and snacks, reserve a table, discover tasting events, and keep your selections organized in one place.

Explore 24 wines across four categories: Red, White, Rosé, and Sparkling. Browse images, names, characteristics, and prices, then discover each wine’s origin, grape variety, tasting notes, and serving recommendations. Choose between glass and bottle options, adjust quantities, and add your favorites to a shared cart. Use the pairing feature to discover snacks that complement your selection.

Browse 24 snacks across four categories: Meat, Cheese, Fruit, and Fish. Each item includes an image, ingredient description, portion size, and price. Select the number of portions and add your choice to the cart, or explore recommended wines that complement different flavors.

Reserve a table in one of three seating areas: the first floor, second floor, or open-air terrace. Choose your preferred date and time, then explore interactive seating plans with table capacities and availability. Select an available table, specify the number of guests, and enter your contact details to complete the reservation. Receive a confirmation with your selected date, time, seating area, table number, and guest count.

Discover eight wine experiences, including red, white, and sparkling wine tastings, blind tasting activities, sommelier evenings, wine cellar tours, wine and cheese experiences, and meetings with winemakers. View event descriptions, dates, times, locations, durations, and participation details. Check available places, select the number of guests, and confirm your booking directly in the app.

Explore food and wine combinations through two pairing sections: “Snack for Wine” and “Wine for Snack.” Select an item to discover recommended combinations with explanations of their flavor compatibility. Navigate directly from wine or snack details to matching recommendations and add selected items to your cart.

Use the built-in tip calculator to estimate additional costs based on a custom bill amount or your current cart total. Choose a suggested percentage or enter your own to view the calculated tip and overall total. Split the amount between multiple guests to see individual shares.

Keep your selections organized in a shared cart accessible throughout the app. Review items, adjust quantities, switch between glass and bottle options, remove selections, and see automatically updated totals.

name: Chat to PDF: Voice to Text
description:
Need a conversation on paper? Chat to PDF turns an exported chat into a tidy, page-numbered PDF you can read, print or send.

• Every message numbered, with date, time and sender
• Voice messages transcribed and placed in the conversation
• Day headers, participant list and message counts on the cover
• SHA-256 fingerprint of the original export on every page
• Over 50 transcription languages
• Opens straight from the share sheet of your messaging app

How it works
1. In your messaging app, open the chat and choose Export Chat, with media if you want voice messages.
2. Pick Chat to PDF in the share sheet.
3. Preview your PDF and share it wherever you like.

Chats can be imported, transcribed and previewed in the app. Sharing a PDF outside the app is unlocked with a one-time purchase: Single PDF unlocks one PDF, Lifetime unlocks every PDF.

Privacy Policy: https://chattopdf-app.vercel.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://chattopdf-app.vercel.app/terms

name: Checkmating
description:
Checkmating takes you from your very first move to master-level chess, in a living 3D world.

CLIMB FROM PAWN TO GRANDMASTER
Eleven ranks, from Pawn to Grandmaster, set close to real rating levels. Each rank has clear goals: lessons to finish, puzzles to reach, bots to beat. You always know what to do next.

AN ACADEMY THAT GROWS WITH YOU
Seven modules take you from the board and the rules to strategy and endgames. Walk the board "on the ground" as each piece, learn checkmate technique against Stockfish, train tactics and board vision, and get lessons built from the mistakes in your own games, so you never repeat them.

OVER 4 MILLION PUZZLES
Rated puzzles from 400 to 3000, weak-spot training, a daily puzzle and a master puzzle of the day, with a reminder on your phone if you like. Race the clock in Puzzle Rush: three minutes, or Survival with three lives.

PLAY BOTS WITH PERSONALITY
Fourteen opponents from first steps to grandmaster strength, each with its own style: the romantic gambiteer, the iron wall, the endgame machine, the magician. They talk back, too.

A GRANDMASTER COACH
Ask why a move works, what your opponent is planning, or how to beat the opening in front of you. The coach looks at your exact position and checks every idea with Stockfish.

PLAY PEOPLE ONLINE
Quick pairing in bullet, blitz, rapid, classical and daily, plus Chess960, Crazyhouse, Three-check and King of the Hill, each with its own rating. An alert tells you when it's your move.

ARENAS, FRIENDS AND MESSAGES
Join an arena tournament every hour, or create your own and invite friends. Add friends, message them and challenge them to a game.

MY GAMES
Every game you finish is kept with its opening, a Stockfish review and its PGN, plus your results, favourite openings and rating history.

TEAM CHESS
Build a team with friends. On your turn everyone suggests a move and explains why, and the captain plays the best idea. Explaining your thinking is one of the fastest ways to improve.

BADGES AND PROFILES
Earn 67 badges as you learn and win, share them, and show your country's flag on your profile.

CHECKMATING PRO
Everything above is free except the full Academy (Foundations and the Pawn chapter are free), Openings (the explorer, practice lines and your own repertoire) and chatting with the coach. Checkmating Pro is $4.99 per month, billed to your Apple ID. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel it in your Apple ID settings.

Terms of Use: https://checkmating.io/terms
Privacy Policy: https://checkmating.io/privacy

name: Chord Drill: Ear Training
description:
Ear training where you answer by playing or singing on your own instrument, and the phone listens to check you.

What you get:
- Hear it. Play it back.
- The app listens and checks every note
- Chords on guitar or piano
- See which intervals you miss
- Pay once. No ads.

Free to start. One in-app purchase adds the rest, with no subscription.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

name: Chordical - Synthesizer
description:
Chordical is a modular synthesizer and chord keyboard for iPhone and iPad. It runs the same sound engine and the same editor as the Chordical desktop plugin.

THE SYNTHESIZER
• Up to eight oscillators with sine, triangle, square, saw and noise shapes, unison and detune.
• Filters, envelopes and a chain of effects: reverb, delay, chorus, distortion, EQ, compressors and more.
• Every knob can be modulated. Drag a wire from a modulation node to any knob.
• The patch is a canvas of nodes. Pinch to zoom, drag to move, and hold a port to pick up a wire.

100 FACTORY PRESETS
• Ten banks of ten: Bass, Lead, Keys, Pad, Pluck, Brass, Poly, Wind, FX and Percussion.
• Save your own presets and banks, and share a preset file with the share sheet.

CHORDS AND PROGRESSIONS
• Pick a key and a scale and Chordical builds a chord progression for you.
• Play each chord with one finger on large chord buttons, or edit the chords one card at a time.
• Save progressions and come back to them later.

THE KEYBOARD
• A touch keyboard you can resize with its grip, and zoom to show more or fewer keys.
• Play with several fingers at once.
• Connect a MIDI keyboard over USB, a network MIDI session or Bluetooth LE, inside the app.

MADE FOR TOUCH
• On iPhone the patch fills the screen edge to edge, with a menu for presets, the keyboard, audio and MIDI.
• On iPad the patch, the oscilloscope and a docked keyboard share the screen.
• An output volume in Settings, and audio buffer sizes for low latency or long battery life.

No account is needed. Your presets and progressions stay on your device.

name: ChordLoop Practice Tools
description:
ChordLoop is a practice metronome that also remembers your setlists.

Set a tempo from 40 to 240 BPM, choose 4/4, 3/4 or 6/8, and accent the first beat of every bar. Tap tempo averages your taps when you want to match a recording quickly. The click is synthesised in real time, so there are no audio downloads and the app works entirely offline.

Build a setlist, give each piece its own tempo, time signature and bar count, then run the set. ChordLoop counts in, plays each piece in order, moves to the next piece when the bars are done, and pauses whenever you pause. Practice time is measured from a monotonic clock, so paused time is never counted.

When you finish, the session is saved on your device. History shows this week's total, a weekday overview and every session grouped by day, with per-piece details you can reopen at any time.

Highlights:
- Metronome from 40 to 240 BPM with accented downbeat
- 4/4, 3/4 and 6/8 time signatures with visual beat dots
- Tap tempo, adjustable click volume and 0–4 count-in bars
- Setlists with ordered pieces, drag reordering and estimated length
- Timed run with pause, next piece and finish controls
- Weekly and per-day practice history stored locally
- No account, no recording, no microphone access, no advertising

The app includes an online destination. On a cold start it reads one small configuration record from its configuration service and waits at most 2.5 seconds. If the destination is enabled and valid, the app opens it once after loading the local interface. Disabled, missing or failed configuration leaves every local feature available. Nothing is uploaded.

name: ChoreOFF Pro
description:
ChoreOFF Pro is the app for independent home service pros on ChoreOFF. Homeowners describe a job and pick the local pros they want to hear from. You see the request, send your price or pass, and run your ChoreOFF business from your phone.

Free to join, free to see requests and free to send quotes. You pay only when a homeowner picks your quote and you take the job: a 5% connection fee, $10 minimum. No contracts.

REQUESTS
Requests that fit your services and area show up in the app, the ones waiting on you first. Open one to see the job: the service, the town, the timing and the homeowner's description. Send a fixed price, an estimate, a price per hour or per visit, with up to 3 days you can come. Or pass. Quoting is free. When a homeowner picks you, you pay the connection fee and you both get each other's name, phone and email.

ALERTS ON THIS PHONE
Turn on alerts to hear the moment a new request comes in, when a homeowner picks your quote, and when a job you quoted closes. Turn each kind on or off. We still email you every request too.

YOUR HUB
Home shows one thing to do next: a short setup list, the requests that need you, one post a week ready to copy, a tip every Monday, and your accounts in one place.

FREE THIS WEEK
Have open time? Tap "I'm free this week" and you move up for nearby requests for 7 days, ahead of pros with the same rating.

YOUR PAGE, YOUR LINK AND QR CODE
Get one free page for your business: your work, your reviews, a Get a quote button that sends requests only to you, and a button for each of your accounts (Facebook, Google, Instagram, your website and more). Jobs from your own link have no connection fee. Share your short link (like choreoff.com/l/your-business) from your phone's share sheet. Print a QR code sign for your truck, signs and invoices. See how many taps and scans you got in the last 30 days.

GET FOUND EVERYWHERE
Step by step help for Google Business Profile, Facebook, Nextdoor, Craigslist and Instagram, with your details filled in and a first post ready to paste. Print your "Proud ChoreOFF Pro" sheet.

INVITE A PRO
Share your invite link with pros you trust. When a job is not a fit for you, you have someone to pass it to.

YOUR PROFILE
Add your about line, years in business, your prices, insurance, business registration and license details. Take photos of your logo and your work with your camera. We check every photo before homeowners see it.

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
Sign in with your email and a 6 digit code. No password. Lost your phone? Sign out everywhere from the app. You can delete your account in the app at any time.

ChoreOFF does not employ pros. You are an independent business: you set your prices and choose the jobs you want.

New to ChoreOFF? Join free at choreoff.com/pros.

name: ChowChak
description:
ChowChak is a comprehensive, modern Point of Sale (POS) and restaurant management system built specifically for fast-paced restaurants, cafes, cloud kitchens, and fine dining establishments.

Designed to eliminate order delays and improve table turnover, ChowChak brings front-of-house service and kitchen coordination together seamlessly.

KEY FEATURES:

• Interactive Floor & Table Management:
Visual floor layouts with live color-coded status for available, occupied, and reserved tables. Easily merge tables, split checks, and manage seating capacity.

• Instant KOT Generation & Kitchen Routing:
Generate Kitchen Order Tickets (KOT) in seconds and route them directly to the appropriate kitchen stations, reducing prep errors and customer wait times.

• Fast & Flexible Billing:
Process dine-in, takeaway, and delivery orders with ease. Support for multiple payment methods, split billing, custom discounts, and integrated taxes.

• Real-time Menu & Pricing Control:
Manage item variations, modifiers, custom notes, and dynamic availability directly from the floor.

• Printer & Receipt Integration:
Seamlessly connect with thermal receipt printers and kitchen display setups for instant order printing.

• Multi-user & Role Access:
Secure access for cashiers, captains, waitstaff, and branch managers with permission controls.

Note: ChowChak is an enterprise application for restaurant partners. Accounts are provisioned centrally by your restaurant administrator through the ChowChak Web Console.

name: ChowChak Rider
description:
ChowChak Rider is the dedicated delivery partner application connecting fleet riders with ChowChak restaurant partners for swift food delivery.

KEY FEATURES:
• Real-time delivery assignment alerts with pickup and customer drop-off details
• Integrated map routing and turn-by-turn navigation
• Single-tap delivery status updates (Arrived at Store, Picked Up, Delivered)
• Transparent delivery history and shift activity tracking
• Optimized for battery and data efficiency during active shifts

Note: ChowChak Rider is for registered delivery fleet partners. Rider accounts are onboarded and managed centrally by ChowChak dispatch administrators.

name: Chromiva
description:
Chromiva is a color studio for designers, developers, and anyone who wants to work with color more carefully on iPhone.

Build palettes in Palette Forge with a canvas of swatches, extract colors from a photo you pick in Image Extract, and shape gradients one stop at a time in Gradient Playground. Morph Engine blends two palettes with a single slider so you can preview transitions before you commit. Harmony Wheel suggests complementary, triadic, and analogous arrangements from any starting hue, and Theme Studio turns a palette into a full light and dark UI theme.

A built-in Contrast Coach checks every pair against WCAG ratios so your choices stay readable. Your Library keeps projects, collections, and favorites organised, with a timeline that tracks what you made and when. A daily challenge and curated starter palettes give you something fresh to try when you need a prompt.

Export to PNG, JPEG, CSS, Swift, JSON, or plain text and drop the result straight into your workflow through the share sheet or Files. Backups are readable JSON you own.

Chromiva was built with accessibility in mind — Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, and Reduce Motion are first-class, and there is no account to create before you start.

name: CineKomichi: Japan Locations
description:
Find the real places behind the stories you love.

CineKomichi is an independent, bilingual guide to 120 places in Japan connected with 80 films, TV dramas and anime works. Explore 43 places in Tokyo, 29 in Osaka, 34 in Kyoto and 14 elsewhere in Japan.

EXPLORE FOR FREE
• Browse all 120 places and their location photos.
• Filter by region and by international film and TV, Japanese film and TV, or anime.
• Search for a work or place and explore pins on an Apple Maps map.
• Read the connection to the work, linked sources, visiting tips and etiquette.
• See photo credits, licenses and the date photographed. Share a location photo with its license document.
• Switch between English and Japanese.
• Save up to 3 places in your trip, add your own notes and arrange their order.

MAKE ROOM FOR A LONGER TRIP
CineKomichi Pro is an optional one-time in-app purchase that removes the trip's 3-place saving limit. There is no subscription and no advertising in either version. All places, photos and maps remain free to explore. Restore your purchase using the Apple Account that purchased Pro.

PLAN WITH CARE
The guide, bundled location photos and saved trip can be read offline. Map tiles, directions and external links need an internet connection. Map pins show approximate places, not exact camera positions. This is a personal trip list, not an automatic itinerary or booking service.

Filming locations, story settings, identified models and reported inspirations are distinguished. Location photographs are not film frames and may show a different season or an earlier appearance. Check current opening hours, admission, transport and photography rules before visiting. A listing does not grant permission to enter private property.

CineKomichi is not affiliated with or endorsed by any film studio, broadcaster, publisher, creator or location operator. Work titles identify the connections being discussed. Location photographs are used under the licenses credited in the app; official film stills and character artwork are not included. Pro does not include admission, transport, offline map downloads or guaranteed future paid content.

For support, corrections or rights inquiries, use the support link or email support@ricewoodslab.com.

name: Cinema Browser

Cinema Browser is a full-screen browser for the video sites you watch. It stops the pop-ups, surprise tabs and fake buttons that sit on top of videos, so you press play and nothing else happens.

Add your sites and open them from big tiles or your Home Screen. Pop-up and new-tab blocking is built into the app, and ad lists update themselves.

Free covers two sites with full blocking. Pro adds unlimited sites, Home Screen widgets, Picture in Picture, stay-on-site mode and iCloud sync. Pro is a yearly subscription with a 7-day free trial.

No account. We don't see what you watch.

Subscription: payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage it in Settings.

Privacy: https://www.cinemabrowser.com/privacy
Terms: https://www.cinemabrowser.com/terms

name: cinema plod
description:
cinema plod это дневник фильмов и сериалов с личным прогнозом.

Ставишь оценки просмотренному, от 1 до 10. Из них складывается твой вкус, и у каждого фильма появляются два процента. Шанс, что понравится, и шанс, что станет шедевром. Прогноз учитывает рейтинг IMDb в твоей шкале, оценки людей с похожим вкусом и рецензии кинокритиков.

Что внутри
• Личные проценты у каждого фильма и сериала
• Подбор на вечер, три фильма под настроение с объяснением
• Подборки, топы и премьеры, отсортированные под тебя
• Новые серии того, что смотришь, и премьеры из «Буду смотреть» в уведомлениях
• Рецензии авторов телеграм-каналов о кино под фильмами
• Сравнение вкусов с друзьями и подбор фильма на двоих
• Обсуждения под каждой серией, спойлеры скрыты
• Поиск фильма по описанию сюжета
• Перенос оценок с Кинопоиска и Letterboxd

Без ленты, без рекламы, без бесконечной прокрутки. Главная это кнопки, а не витрина постеров.

name: Cinema Schema
description:
Cinema Schema is an offline workspace for production designers, look developers, and visual researchers who organize screen references.
Keep film, series, and short-drama titles in one place—with posters, tags, palette notes, lighting notes, and composition notes. Everything stays on your device. There is no account, no network feed, and no video playback.
VAULT
• Archive films, series, and short dramas with theatrical-style poster art
• Search, filter by medium, sort, and mark favorites
• Add your own titles and optional custom poster photos from your library
• Capture synopsis plus color, lighting, and framing notes for art direction
BOARDS
• Build collage moodboards from your vault posters
• Drag, rotate, and resize pins on a freeform canvas
• Export a board image to share or save locally
STUDIO
• Aspect Lab — preview common theatrical and vertical ratios on poster frames
• Grade Lab — compare teal-orange, bleach, noir, and warm-stock looks
• Shot Scale Guide — ECU to wide coverage against reference posters
• Lighting Deck — key, fill, rim, and practical-motivated reference cards
SETTINGS
• Dense grid preference and default sort
• Local storage overview
• Restore sample catalog or reset local data
• Clear privacy disclosure: offline reference only
Cinema Schema does not stream, download, host, or play movies, series, or short dramas. It is a personal visual-notes tool for planning looks and gathering picture references.

name: CineVue
description:
The library comes first. Choose a film, then write something that belongs to it.

CineVue is a writing desk for second creation. It does not play movies. You open a title, borrow its mood, and compose an original page in English. The film’s dialogue is not copied. Its plot is not retold.

Find a film in the library, or search for one. Films you have already opened stay on the shelf. One tap opens the desk. Film titles, posters, and details come from TMDB. This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

Write in the form the page needs:

Script — three short acts
Lines — two voices, close range
Scene — weather, gesture, speech
Ending — a different last light
Logline — the story in one breath
Monologue — one mind, a precise room
People — desire, habit, a line they keep
Beats — the spine, with no dialogue
Give the page a title and a first line. Pull a few words from the film, or add a name from the cast. Compose the page, then rewrite it: shorter, warmer, colder, continued, from another point of view, or as another take. Earlier cuts stay with the page.

Creations are kept under the film they came from. Search them, pin one, and return to it later. From the study, export the pages you choose — all of them, the pinned ones, or one film — as a text file you can share.

Pages stay on this iPhone. You can clear the study when you want them gone. Finding a film and composing a page need a network connection. A local reminder can tell you, the next morning, that a page is still open.

name: CircuitCheck
description: CircuitCheck logs electrical inspections and measurements. Offline business tool with no account.

name: Cities: Relax & Paint
description:
A little color can wake a whole city.

Explore cozy 3D miniatures inspired by places around the world. Drag a colorful piece from your tray, find its matching shape in the scene, and watch a quiet street come to life.

TAKE YOUR TIME
There is no timer to beat. Turn the scene, look closer, and find each piece at your own pace. Gentle hints help when you need a nudge.

20 PLACES TO DISCOVER
Visit Paris, London, New York, Rome, Tokyo, Sydney, Cairo, Agra, Beijing, Rio, Venice, Amsterdam, Athens, Istanbul, San Francisco, Santorini, Kyoto, Barcelona, Moscow, and Chichen Itza. Each scene is a playful miniature inspired by its landmark and local details.

SMALL DETAILS, LITTLE SURPRISES
Restore color to buildings, plants, people, and animals. Finish groups of pieces and see the miniature world begin to move.

PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
Your progress saves on your device. Return to a half-finished scene or replay a completed city. Music and sound can be switched off separately.

ONE SIMPLE UNLOCK
Paris is free to play. A single optional, non-consumable in-app purchase unlocks the other 19 cities. No ads and no subscription. Restore Purchases is available from the city menu and unlock screen. An internet connection is needed to buy or restore the unlock; included game content can be played offline.

name: ClariBuddy
description:
Build your clarinet practice routine with ClariBuddy.

Check your pitch using the microphone, practise with a metronome, follow guided lessons and track your progress. Import MusicXML and MIDI scores to practise your own music. Optionally send selected score photos or a PDF for external AI transcription after agreeing to each upload. Review the result and correct any mistakes. Use the finger-camera practice aid to explore fingerings. Pitch and camera estimates can be inaccurate and do not replace a teacher.

Start core practice without an account. If you choose, create an account with an ID and password to back up your progress. Save your recovery key separately. You can pause or delete your backup, export data and delete your account in the app.

Optionally join the practice room to see other participants' general practice activity. There is no free-text chat. Reporting and blocking are available.

Microphone sound and finger-camera video are analysed on your device. Accounts, backup and the practice room require an internet connection. This version has no ads, cash purchases or subscriptions.

Support: Help and support in the app, or rchoi2029@gmail.com
Privacy: https://13.54.221.243/privacy
Account and data deletion: https://13.54.221.243/delete-account

name: ClassicMountains
description:
山海经 —— 60 只神兽，逐卷注出处

山海经 · 神兽图，60 个条目，一个一个讲清楚。

【怎么玩】

• 关卡：点关卡地图上的节点进入，一关一道题，由难度决定题目数量
• 答对之后：条目的详情一次讲清，字段都标得出，来源也标得出
• 图鉴：全部条目与详情，已收录 / 收藏可筛选
• 我的：累计统计、我的收藏与我的记录

【里面有什么】

60 个条目，全部来自可溯源的公开资料，每条都注明出处。

【素材说明】

本 App 的插图与文字素材全部来自公有领域（公共版权）来源，或在 App 内自行绘制，
不打包任何受版权保护的第三方图像、字体、音频或视频素材。

【隐私】

不登录、没有账号、没有任何权限请求。你的关卡进度、收藏和记录只存在
你自己的手机里，卸载即彻底删除，我们看不到也拿不走。

联网只有一处：首启时向开发者自建服务器发一条安装来源统计（用来判断这次安装
是自然安装还是来自某个推广渠道；只含一个随机设备标识与设备参数，不含姓名、
邮箱、电话、位置、照片，也不含剪贴板内容）。除此之外全程离线。

【适合谁】

对山海经 · 神兽图感兴趣的人 —— 学生、老师、编辑，以及纯粹想把它看明白的人。

版本 1.0

name: Clic Padel Track
description:
Make padel coaching easier with a practical app designed to organize players, training sessions, match results, and performance statistics in one convenient place. Whether you coach individual athletes or manage regular group sessions, everything you need to plan activities and follow player development stays organized and accessible.

Keep track of padel matches with an easy-to-use score calculator. Enter player names, record points, games, and sets, and follow the score throughout each match. Save completed results to your sparring history, review previous performances, or share match summaries with others.

Create individual player profiles with skill levels, strengths, areas for improvement, and personal coaching notes. Update information as players develop and use their profiles to keep track of training priorities. Review sparring results and explore an automatically updated standings table featuring wins, losses, points, and score differences.

Organize your training schedule by selecting dates, times, courts, session durations, and participants. Plan individual or group activities, record attendance, and review previous sessions to understand training consistency and participation over time.

Explore a collection of practical padel tips and coaching materials. Save useful references, add your own training ideas, and keep important information available for future sessions.

Follow player development through detailed statistics and visual charts. Review training hours, session activity, attendance, match results, and performance trends to better understand progress and identify areas that need attention.

With a clear interface and convenient coaching tools, managing daily padel activities becomes simpler and more organized. Plan training sessions, manage players, record results, and follow their development in one place.

name: Clock Stopper: Tell Time
description:
Clock Stopper turns learning to tell time into a game. Tap New Time and the hands spin to a random time. Your child reads the clock, you mark it right or wrong, and the score keeps track.

I built Clock Stopper to teach my son to read an analog clock, with the clock up on our TV and the answer in my hand.

TWO WAYS TO PRACTICE
• Read It: The clock shows a time and your child says what it is. Mark it right or wrong, and the answer and spoken time pop up on the clock.
• Set It: The app shows a time and your child drags the hands to match, then taps Check.

MADE FOR THE BIG SCREEN
• Clock Only: Mirror your screen to a TV with AirPlay, then tap Clock Only to hide the controls so the TV shows just the clock. Swipe right for right and left for wrong.

GROWS WITH YOUR CHILD
• Five levels: hours, half hours, quarter hours, 5 minutes, and any minute
• Spoken-time hints like "quarter till five," with "till" or "to" to match how your family says it
• An hour pointer that stretches the hour hand to the edge, which you can hide as they improve
• 5-minute and 1-minute numbers around the edge that you can turn on or off

FUN TO KEEP GOING
• Streak stars that fill with each right answer, plus a high five, confetti, and fireworks for every 5 in a row
• Hands that spin to each new time
• Gentle sound effects that stay quiet in silent mode
• Four color themes (Classic, Ocean, Sunshine, and Forest), and the app icon changes to match

NO ADS. NO ACCOUNTS. NO TRACKING.
Clock Stopper doesn't collect any data, show ads, or sell anything inside the app. Pay once and it's yours.

name: Clockwork Calc: Hours & Mins
description:
Adding up hours shouldn't need a spreadsheet. Clockwork Calc is a calculator built for time. Type hours and minutes the way you'd type any number, and get answers you can use right away.

TYPE TIME THE FAST WAY
Every digit you type shifts the others left, like a cash register. Type 3 and you get 0:03. Then 0, and it's 0:30. Another 0, and it's 3:00. There's no colon to hunt for and no separate hours and minutes fields.

PREFER A COLON? IT'S THERE
Type 8 : 3 0 to get 8:30. Use whichever way feels natural.

CONVERT MINUTES AND SECONDS
Everything after the colon counts as minutes, however long: : 5 0 0 = gives 8:20. With SEC on, two colons mean seconds: : : 9 0 0 = gives 0:15:00.

DECIMAL HOURS IN ONE TAP
Timesheets and invoices want 7.75 hours, but you think in 7:45. Tap DEC and the whole calculation flips, your history included, between hours:minutes and decimal hours. Below every result you'll also see the same value in the other format.

PAST MIDNIGHT? COUNT THE DAYS
Tap DAYS and anything over 24 hours shows as days: 22:00 + 05:00 = 1d 03:00. Going back works too: 02:00 − 05:00 = −1d 21:00, which is 9 pm the day before. To type days directly, use the d key: 1 d 5 0 0 gives 1d 05:00. Handy for time zones, night shifts and long trips.

SECONDS WHEN YOU NEED THEM
Tap SEC for h:mm:ss: lap times, video edits, anything timed to the second. Typing works the same way, and it works with DAYS too: 1d 03:30:15.

ADD UP YOUR WHOLE WEEK
Every result stays in the history list above the display. Tap any past result to use it again in your next calculation.

COPY WITH A DOUBLE-TAP
Double-tap the result to copy it, ready to paste into a timesheet, invoice or message.

MULTIPLY AND DIVIDE TIME
2:30 × 3 = 7:30. 9:00 ÷ 4 = 2:15. Split a shift, work out time per task, or multiply a session by the number of days.

GREAT FOR
• Timesheets and payroll
• Freelancers and billable hours
• Shift work and overtime
• Studying, training and practice logs
• Video and audio lengths, lap and workout times
• Cooking and travel times, across time zones

A REGULAR CALCULATOR, TOO
Tap TIME to switch to an ordinary calculator, and the time on screen comes along as decimal hours: 38:30 becomes 38.5, ready for × 25 = 962.5. Each mode keeps its own calculation and history, so you can switch back and forth.

FREE, WITH NO ADS
• No ads, ever
• No account and no data collected
• Works fully offline, with no internet access needed

A clean, dark design with large keys, made to do one job well.

name: Close Circle: Birthdays
description:
Keep birthdays and anniversaries for the 10 to 50 people who matter, with gift ideas noted all year, a budget per occasion, and reminders early enough to act.

What you get:
- Every birthday, 21 days ahead
- Save gift ideas the moment you hear them
- Reminders early enough to post a gift
- Budget per occasion
- Next birthday on your home screen

Free to start. One in-app purchase adds the rest, with no subscription.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

name: ClubPaddy
description:
Clubpaddy is the members' app for racket clubs. Your club keeps its ladders, challenges, draws and chat in one place, and every member can see where they stand.

You join with an invitation from your club. A club officer approves you.

LADDERS AND CHALLENGES
- See your club's ladders and the order of play.
- Challenge a player above you, within the range your club allows.
- Agree a match time from the slots you both pick.
- Results move the ladder, and every result stays in the history.

COMPETITIONS
- Officers set up knockouts and group stages. You see your draw and your fixtures.
- You can join or decline a competition when you are asked.
- The draw is published as a fingerprint before it happens and the key is revealed afterwards, so anyone can check it was not re-rolled.

CLUB CHAT
- Message other adult members of your club, and join the conversations your officers set up.
- Send text, and photos from your library (up to four at a time). Mute a conversation, report a message or photo (including as illegal), or block a member whenever you need to. Officers review reports and can remove a photo.

CLUB LIFE
- Read announcements from your officers.
- Add a profile picture if you like. Officers can add the club's logo.
- Share your birthday (day and month only) if you want your club to wish you well. It stays private until you choose to share it.
- Ask your club to freeze your place while you are away.

YOUR DATA, YOUR CHOICE
- Export your data or delete your account from your profile. If something is still open, such as a match, the app tells you what to settle first. Your results stay in the club record as "Deleted member".
- Accounts are for people aged 18 and over, confirmed by the member when they sign up.
- No ads. No tracking.

Clubpaddy is free to download. You need an invitation from a club to join. Starting a club? Email support@clubpaddy.com.

name: clutter: raideteam
description:
clutter shows your photos and videos one at a time, so you can sort your library in small steps.

swipe right or tap keep to keep a photo. swipe left or tap delete to send it to the deletion inbox. tap an album to add the photo to it and move on. you can create a new album in place. tap undo to go back one step.

choose what to go through:
- all photos, oldest first
- random order
- one month at a time, with a count of what is left in each month

clutter remembers what you already reviewed, so you can stop and come back later. start over resets that. you can also skip photos that are already in an album.

nothing is deleted right away. photos you mark for deletion wait in the deletion inbox. look through them, keep any you want back, then delete the rest. iOS asks you to confirm and moves them to recently deleted, where they stay for 30 days.

videos and live photos play right on the card.

no ads, no purchases, no account, no tracking. clutter has no servers and collects no data. it needs full access to your photo library so it can show your photos and work with your albums.

for iPhone with iOS 26 or later.

name: Clyne - Calm & Wonder
description:
Clyne is a calm learning companion and personal aquarium journal for freshwater fish and shrimp keepers, bringing approachable care guides, useful learning collections and everyday tank records together in one place.

Highlights:
- Discover a more thoughtful approach to aquarium care. Explore guides on setting up a freshwater aquarium, cycling, filtration, feeding, acclimation, shrimp care, plants and water parameters. Search by keyword or browse topics and categories to find a useful starting point, then read practical explanations and key takeaways at your own pace.
- Make each little lesson part of your routine. Bookmark guides you want to revisit, keep them together in Saved, and follow your reading progress as you explore. Reading history helps you return to previous guides, while your learning checklist keeps the subjects you want to study close at hand. Choose interests such as fish, shrimp and aquascaping to make the experience your own.
- Stay connected to the small changes in your tank. Keep one main aquarium with its setup details, volume, inhabitants and equipment, then add dated water tests, water changes and observations. Record the measurements you have taken, including temperature, pH, ammonia, nitrite and nitrate, with optional GH, KH and TDS. Add notes for context, revisit your journal over time, and choose Metric or Imperial measurements for a familiar way to keep records.

name: Co'pilote
description:
Co'pilote, c'est votre chauffeur sur réservation en Île-de-France.

Réservez en trois gestes : départ, arrivée, date. Le prix s'affiche tout de suite.

Utilisez votre forfait et suivez le nombre de courses qui vous restent.

La veille, un rappel. Le jour J, vous voyez votre chauffeur arriver sur la carte dès qu'il part vous chercher, avec son heure d'arrivée.

Vos trajets réguliers se programment une seule fois. Vous pouvez aussi réserver pour un proche, et partager votre trajet par un lien.

Retrouvez vos courses et vos notes de course, et joignez Co'pilote par téléphone ou WhatsApp.

name: CoatLedger: Paint Estimates
description:
Plan a coating project from the measurements and product values you enter.

Record rectangular surfaces, group identical faces, and deduct doors or windows per face. CoatLedger shows how gross area and deductions produce your net surface area.

Create a material using coverage and pack volume from your own product label. Choose metric or US customary units, enter coats and extra allowance, and see theoretical volume, whole packs to purchase, and estimated leftover. Whole-pack calculations use a defined 12-decimal-place quotient rule.

Save an independent report with the measurements, material values, and calculation breakdown. Later edits to your project or material do not change that snapshot. Share a PDF or CSV, or reopen the report on your device.

Core estimates work without an account. Measurements are manual; the app does not detect positions or overlapping openings. Actual product instructions, surface conditions, and application can change real usage.

name: Colibri Edu
description:
O Colibri Edu reúne seus cursos, áudios, anotações e comunidade em um só lugar para você aprender no seu ritmo — no celular, no tablet e até sem internet.

PRINCIPAIS RECURSOS

• Cursos organizados por capítulos e aulas
Acompanhe seu progresso aula a aula, retome exatamente de onde parou e navegue com clareza entre módulos, textos principais e materiais complementares.

• Áudio e podcasts com múltiplas vozes
Ouça as aulas em formato de áudio ou podcast, escolha entre diferentes vozes/personas disponíveis no curso, controle a reprodução com o miniplayer contínuo e adicione episódios à sua playlist.

• Modo offline com fila de downloads
Baixe capítulos inteiros ou aulas específicas para ler e ouvir mesmo sem conexão. Acompanhe o progresso dos downloads diretamente no aplicativo.

• Desafios práticos
Coloque o conteúdo em prática com desafios vinculados às aulas, filtre por status (Pendentes, Respondidos e Avaliados) e acompanhe sua evolução ao longo dos cursos.

• Quadro de Notas
Registre anotações livres, dúvidas e aprendizados em cada aula e consulte tudo reunido no seu Quadro de Notas com busca por texto, aula ou curso.

• Comunidade integrada
Participe de espaços gerais e canais específicos de cada curso, acompanhe discussões por tópicos e threads em tempo real, reaja às mensagens e receba notificações de respostas.

• Experiência personalizada
Alterne entre tema Claro, Escuro ou Automático (sistema), escolha seu idioma (Português ou English), edite seu perfil e personalize seu avatar.

COMO ACESSAR
Use o mesmo e-mail da sua conta web para receber um código de acesso único (sem senha) e sincronizar seu progresso automaticamente.

name: Comb Census
description:
Comb Census turns a hive inspection into numbers. Lift each frame, paint what you see on both sides, and get an estimate of the whole colony, the way the Liebefeld method does it.

PAINT EACH FRAME
The screen is the frame: a wooden frame with 512 hexagon cells per side. Paint bees, open brood, capped brood, honey and pollen with your finger in three brush sizes, or step the coverage in eighths with + and −. Undo any stroke. Langstroth deep and medium, Dadant, British National, Zander, or your own frame size.

READ THE COLONY
Bees in the colony, open and capped brood cells, honey in kg and pollen area, from about 125 bees, 400 cells or 0.15 kg of honey per square decimetre. A cross-section of the box shows every frame as a bar; tap one to see both sides again. Capped brood tells you how many young bees emerge within 12 days.

WINTER STORES
Drag the winter goal along a 0–40 kg scale. The gap becomes sugar, water and 2:1 syrup to feed, with your own conversion rate.

THROUGH THE SEASON
Each hive keeps its inspections on a timeline with a season curve. Compare any two inspections side by side to see bees per day and whether the brood spread or shrank.

THE APIARY
Drag hives on a plan to where they stand. Overdue, weak and new hives are flagged, so you know which one to open next.

Vintage style: wooden frame bars, wax plates, honey and brood colours.

Everything stays on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Commit 100 - Habit Stickers
description:
Not three days. One hundred times.
Start freely, choose carefully, finish at your own pace.

Pick the one thing that matters most. On the days you do it, press and hold.
A gray, blank face turns into a green smile.
Make all 100 smile and you're done.

· One goal at a time
· Once a day
· Miss a day? No penalty. Just reach 100
· Keep a streak and the green grows deeper
· Optional daily reminder that stays quiet once you're done for the day
· Tap a filled face to see its date
· Share or save your record as an image anytime
· Finish 100 and save or share your certificate

No account. No ads. No settings to fiddle with.

name: Concrefer
description:
Concrefer turns your semester into a mission. Plan subjects, exams and assignments, focus in
immersive Pomodoro environments, sharpen your mind with daily brain games and watch your progress
climb, all inside one sleek, dark, futuristic study lab.
MISSION CONTROL DASHBOARD
– Animated rings track today's study time, finished tasks and focus rounds
– A weekly learning chart compares every day against your goal
– Subject cards show progress toward weekly targets at a glance
– Daily goals, upcoming deadlines and freshly unlocked badges in one place
SMART STUDY PLANNER
– Create subjects with custom icons, colours and weekly targets
– Add assignments, exams, projects and reading with due dates and effort estimates
– Interactive month calendar with colour-coded deadline dots
– Live countdowns to the second for every deadline and your next exam
– Organise by priority, due date or subject and filter pending or completed work
FOCUS ARENA
– Pomodoro timer with focus, short-break and long-break phases on an animated backdrop
– Six ambient environments: Rainy Library, Deep Space Lab, Forest Station, Ocean Deck, Ember Den
and Kharkiv Winter, or design your own
Concrefer · App Store marketing package · page 2 of 6
– Soundscapes generated live on your iPhone: soft rain, deep rumble, ocean swell or static hum
– Focus streaks, session statistics and a seven-day focus chart
– Optional alerts when a round ends, even when you leave the app
KNOWLEDGE MINI-GAMES
– Memory Match with study-themed cards
– 60-second Quick Math sprints in three difficulty levels
– Vocabulary Quiz with C1 academic words, including a Ukrainian-to-English mode
– Reaction Speed Test across five rounds
– Daily Brain Challenge: five fresh puzzles every day, the same for everyone
PROGRESS ANALYTICS
– Weekly and monthly performance graphs with tap-to-inspect days
– Study-time comparison by subject against the previous period
– Subject performance radar that blends time on target with task delivery
– A personal productivity score with a transparent breakdown
– Peak focus hours and highlights you can share
PROFILE & ACHIEVEMENTS
– Pilot profile with levels, ranks and XP
– 24 unlockable badges and learning milestones

name: Contrail Frugal Flight Tracker
description:
Contrail puts your trips on a split-flap departures board.

YOUR FLIGHTS, AT A GLANCE
• A departures board with your next flights, times, gates and remarks: ON TIME, DELAYED, BOARDING, IN FLIGHT, LANDED
• A boarding pass for every flight, with seat, gate, terminal and baggage belt
• Countdown, progress and live position while you're in the air
• Live Activities on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island

ADDS FLIGHTS FROM YOUR CALENDAR
• Finds flight numbers (SK 4121, WIF920), airport codes and routes like "Bodø – Tromsø" in your calendar events
• Knows hundreds of airlines, including regional carriers such as Widerøe, Loganair and Braathens
• Reading happens on your iPhone; nothing is uploaded

LOGBOOK
• Every flight you've taken: distance, hours in the air, routes map, top airports, airlines and routes, your longest leg

REAL FLIGHT DATA WITH YOUR OWN KEY
• Connect your own free FlightAware AeroAPI Personal key for real status, gates, delays, aircraft and live positions
• FlightAware's Personal plan includes up to $5 of free use each month — about 17 typical flights
• A built-in guide shows how to get a key, a cost meter shows your month's estimate, and "Stay within free credit" pauses live updates before you'd be charged
• No key? Try everything with a simulated sample flight

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking, no analytics
• Your flights and your key stay on your iPhone

Retro black-and-white or modern look, light and dark mode, adjustable Liquid Glass.

Flight data from FlightAware AeroAPI using your own account. Contrail is not affiliated with FlightAware.

name: Çöp Avcıları
description:
Karışık atıktan doğan Pasaklar Anadolu'yu sardı! Hüsnü Usta'nın köpürtücüsünü kap: Pasakları köpüğe hapset, topu tekmele ve doğru geri dönüşüm kutusuna yuvarla. Pasak varsa, biz varız.

NASIL OYNANIR
• Yürüme koluyla koş, ZIPLA ile bir üst kata çık, ATEŞ ile köpük at.
• Pasak birkaç köpükte topa dönüşür. Topun yanında ATEŞ'e basarsan tekmelersin; top duvarlardan seker, katlardan iner.
• Aynı anda yalnız bir kutu açık: hangisinin açık olacağına sen karar verirsin.
• Yanlış kutuya düşen Pasak sinirlenip geri fırlar. Aynı renkleri tek topla süpür, kombo yap!

6 BÖLGE, 60 BÖLÜM, 6 BOSS
Marmara kıyıları, Dalyan İztuzu, Akdeniz ormanları, Tuz Gölü, Van Gölü ve eski döküm sahası. Her bölgenin kendi zorluğu var: gece kumsalı, yangın, çöken platformlar, rüzgâr. Her bölgenin sonunda bir boss: Salya Pasak, Işık Pasak, Kıvılcım Pasak, Kuraklık Pasak, Ağ Pasak ve Büyük Yığın. Boss'u ancak saldığı Pasakları doğru kutuya ayırarak yenebilirsin.

HANGİ ATIK HANGİ KUTUYA?
Plastik, kâğıt, cam, metal, kompozit (süt kutusu), organik, atık pil ve elektronik atık: kutu renkleri Türkiye'deki sıfır atık renk skalasına göredir. Bölgelere girerken ve boss'ları yenince kaynaklı bilgi kartları açılır.

MADENLER VE ÖDÜLLER
• Gümüş ve altın kazan: elektronik atıktan altın çıkar!
• Derin'in Çantası: Hız Tabanı, Yoğun Köpük, Uzun Hortum, Dev Kabarcık ve İş Kaskı'nı bölümün istediğin anında kullan.
• Usta'nın Tezgâhı: her gün ücretsiz çevir.
• Yıldızları topla, A-Y-I-R harfleriyle can kazan.

HERKESE GÖRE
Kutu yardımını sen seç: Kapalı, İpucu ya da Otomatik. İlk 30 bölümde yenilsen de can gitmez.

Oyun ücretsizdir. İsteğe bağlı ödüllü reklamlar (dirilmek, can almak, çark çevirmek için) ve seyrek olarak bölüm sonlarında reklam içerir; ilk 10 bölümde bölüm sonu reklamı yoktur. İsteğe bağlı uygulama içi satın almalar vardır; kasaların içeriği sabittir ve önceden görünür. Bilgi kartları ve kutu yardımı satılmaz.

name: Copi - Car
description:
Copi is a personal notebook for comparing the cars you view and test drive. Keep vehicle details, observations, questions and your reasons for choosing together in one place.
Create separate comparisons for each shortlist. Start with everyday or family needs, or define your own priorities. Mark must-haves and add the conditions that matter to you, from driving position to luggage space.
Add each car's price, mileage, listing link and photos. Once parked, record observations in text or use optional English dictation, then review the wording before saving. Label personal experiences, seller claims and report information separately. Attach PDF or image references and link notes to a car, visit or need.
Compare cars side by side against your needs. Filter for differences or items needing attention, and record your own assessments. Track unanswered questions and enter replies yourself. The Next Steps view brings together open questions, unfinished visits and assessments marked for review.
Save your choice with the reasons, trade-offs and questions that remain. Revisit earlier decisions, archive completed comparisons and reopen them when needed.
Preview and export a full comparison or selected cars as PDF or plain text. Choose whether to include photos, links and vehicle details, then share through the iPhone's system share sheet.
Saved records are stored on your iPhone. Notes, comparisons and exports work offline, with no account required.

description:
CoproFirst est l'application de votre résidence. Elle se connecte au site de votre copropriété, installé par elle ou hébergé pour elle, et montre à chacun ce qui le concerne, et rien de plus.

name: Copy the Words: Photo to Text
seller_name: Shenzhen Taikoo You Technology Co., Ltd

Take a photo and copy the words you need. Copy the Words reads text from a photo on your iPhone so you can paste it into Notes, a message, or any app that accepts text.

• Tap Copy next to a paragraph to copy just that passage.

Use it for printed notes, signs, book passages, and labels. Text recognition runs on your iPhone, and there is no account to set up.

name: Cosmetics Tycoon: Brand Empire
seller_name: THE FINE GROUP IC VE DIS TICARET ANONIM SIRKETI
description:
Start with a kitchen counter and a little cash, build your own beauty brands, and end up running a holding.

In Cosmetics Tycoon you start a beauty brand and grow it. You choose what goes into the product, the bottle, the price and where it's sold. Sales come in, but the money doesn't hit your account right away; the supermarket pays you weeks later. That's what the game is really about: growing without running out of cash.

From kitchen to factory
You mix your first products in the kitchen. Then you have another factory make them for you, open a warehouse and build your own factory. You open stores and finally sell to the Gulf countries. Every step up costs money and takes time, and sales keep going while you move.

19 product groups
You start with skin and hair care. Each time you hand a brand over to your holding, new groups open: men's grooming, fragrance, organic products, baby care, makeup, salon products, pharmacy skincare, oral care, hotel products, sun care and more. After that come vitamins and supplements, and finally pet products. Each group has its own rules. Hair salons want training. Pharmacists won't stock you until they trust your product. Hotels buy by tender and fine you for short deliveries. Sunscreen has to pass its test.

Your choices have consequences
Every so often something happens and you have to choose. For example, holiday resorts ban two ingredients in your sunscreen: you can change the formula, pull out of those areas, or print "reef-friendly" on the pack and hope for the best. Some choices come back months later. Lab results arrive, a rival cuts prices, the supermarket wants a fee to put you on the shelf.

Watch your cash
On your first brand, marketplaces pay in 14 days and supermarkets in 15. On later brands it's usually 28 and 90 days. Meanwhile products expire and payday comes around. If you don't want to wait, you can get your money early for a fee. The game shows where your money is waiting, so you can see a cash squeeze coming.

Seasons
Valentine's Day, Eid al-Fitr, Mother's Day, Father's Day, summer, November sales and New Year. Deliveries slow down over Eid al-Adha. Get your stock ready in time, hit your season goal and win bronze, silver or gold.

Grow your holding
When a brand is big enough, you hand it over to your holding. It becomes a new floor in your tower and pays you a share of profit every day. Then you start a new brand with what you've learned. Climb from the Turkey league to Europe, and then the world.

What the game doesn't have
- No forced ads, no interstitials, no banners. Watch an ad only if you want the reward, up to a daily limit.
- Nothing you can buy gives you an edge.
- The game calendar keeps running while you're away; when you come back, a report shows what happened.
- Plays offline. English and Turkish.

Optional purchases
- Holding License (one-time): a brand museum with the packs and records of the brands you've handed over, detailed holding stats, and Glass Plaza and Night headquarters looks. You get ad rewards without watching ads; the daily limit stays the same.
- Luxury Packaging (one-time): three styles for your products, your store and your production line: Gold leaf, Midnight, and Pearl and rose gold.

name: Cotivox
description:
¿Terminaste un trabajo y te toca ponerte a redactar la cotización? Con Cotivox solo hablas.

HABLA, COTIZA Y COBRA

QUÉ PUEDES HACER

PARA QUIÉN ES
Técnicos, instaladores, electricistas, soldadores, plomeros, mecánicos, freelancers y pequeños negocios de servicios que quieren verse profesionales sin perder tiempo en papeleo.

name: Covo Close AI
description:
Covo Close AI listens to your in-home sales appointments and turns them into coaching you can actually use.

Start a recording, capture the customer's verbal consent, and talk to your customer like you always do. When you're done, Covo grades the appointment on the skills that close deals: rapport, needs assessment, inspection, presentation, pricing, objection handling and closing.

LIVE COACHING
While you're still at the kitchen table, Covo nudges you with the next question to ask and why it matters — so you can adjust in the moment, not next week.

THE FULL RECAP
Every appointment gets an overall score, category breakdowns, the exact quotes behind them, and specific phrasing to try next time. Share the recap as text.

SEARCHABLE TRANSCRIPT
Every word, tied to the audio. Tap any line to hear that moment again and find what was actually said about price, timing or the competition.

PRACTICE WITH COVO
Ask your coach why a deal stalled, then run a role-play replay of the same appointment and objections before the real follow-up.

FOR MANAGERS
See every rep's recordings, transcripts, scores and coaching from your own phone. Coach the whole team with the same standard, without riding along.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Customer consent is recorded and stored with every appointment. Recordings are visible only to you and your team's managers.

FOR COMPANIES
AI grading, live coaching and the Covo coach are included with your company's Covo plan, which your company administrator sets up with us. Recording, consent capture and your appointment library work for everyone.

Download Covo Close AI, record your next appointment, and see your first grade minutes later.

name: Crash Run: Traffic Smash
description:
Drive a jammed three-lane road and ram the car ahead. It flies off and wrecks another car, which flies into the next.

Every car reacts differently
• Bus: ploughs down its lane, clearing everything ahead
• Tanker: explodes and throws the cars around it
• Sports car: bounces between the guardrails across all three lanes
• Car carrier: its cars pop off one by one
• Cement mixer: the drum breaks loose and rolls two lanes wide
• Tow truck: spins round with the car it was towing, sweeping the next lanes
• Fuel trucks refill oil, ambulances repair, cash vans pay parts
• Trucks, police cars and roadwork barriers cost hull when you hit them

Oil keeps running down. Ram a fuel truck or clear a stage to refill. Wrecking cars fills the booster; while it runs, everything breaks. Pick an upgrade at every stage.

City, industrial zone, highway, roadworks, checkpoint: the road changes every stage, and each stretch has cars of its own.

Wrecked cars earn parts. Buy 12 cars in the garage and upgrade them. Each car plays differently: fast and fragile, heavy enough to push trucks, or able to fling police cars.

• Drag left or right anywhere on the screen, one hand
• No account, works offline
• Progress stays on your device
• In-game text is in Korean

name: CravePlan
description:
What's for dinner tonight? With CravePlan, the whole family knows.

CravePlan lays out the week's breakfasts, lunches, snacks and dinners, turns the planned dishes into a shopping list, and keeps everyone on the same plan through iCloud.

PLAN THE WEEK
• Every meal of every day at a glance, with a dot under each day: green when it's planned, red when a meal is still missing
• Several dishes per meal, tagged for adults, kids or anyone you add
• Your own meal sections and times, or extra sections for a single day
• Mark meals as eaten out (restaurant, takeout, at someone's place, school or work) or whole days as away

YOUR MEALS
• Every dish you plan is saved with its ingredients, ready for next time
• See when each meal was last made, so favorites don't come round too often
• Short on ideas? CravePlan suggests a dish you haven't had in a while

SHOPPING LIST
• All the ingredients for today, the week or the month, in one list
• Tick what you already have at home; the rest is what to buy
• Share the list as text, ready to import into Cart Hub

FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
• Share the plan through iCloud: everyone sees and edits the same plan, no accounts or sign-up
• Export today, the week or the month as a PDF table to print and pin on the fridge
• A weekly reminder if next week isn't planned or there's still shopping to do

APPLE WATCH
• Today's meals and the shopping list on your wrist
• Tick ingredients off in the store and add dishes by voice
• Next Meal and To Buy complications
• Works on its own through iCloud, even when your iPhone stays at home

IPAD AND MAC
• The whole week as a board on iPad, with the meals list and settings side by side
• Runs on Mac with Apple silicon

YOUR DATA
No account, no ads, no tracking, and no data collected. Your plan stays on your devices and in your own iCloud, shared only with the people you invite.

name: Cravion
description:
Every craving is just a wave. It rises, crests and breaks — usually within minutes. Cravion helps you stop fighting urges and start riding them out.

Whether it's the 3pm sugar pull, one more coffee, mindless doom-scrolling, an impulse buy or a cigarette, Cravion gives you a calm, playful way to catch the moment, wait it out and learn what sets you off.

CATCH IT IN SECONDS
Tap the URGE button the moment a craving hits. Pick what's pulling at you, set how big the wave is on a 1–10 scale, and choose what stirred it up — stress, boredom, tiredness, a social moment, habit, low mood, hunger or reward. Add a quick margin note if you like.

RIDE IT OUT WITH YOUR BREATH
Start a guided ride. A sun rises over the sea as you breathe in, hangs as you hold, and sets as you breathe out. Gentle haptics keep the rhythm, short grounding prompts keep your mind busy, and the waves visibly calm as the urge height falls. Ride for 1 to 15 minutes — your choice.

WATCH YOUR TIDE RISE
Every wave you ride raises your Willpower Tide, grows your streak and adds up the money and time you kept. Earn patches for milestones like your first ride, a 10-wave streak or 30 minutes of riding.

YOUR LOGBOOK
Every craving becomes an entry with its trigger, height, ride time and outcome. Filter by what you rode or wiped out on, by category, and update entries anytime.

SEE YOUR PATTERNS
Cravion turns your logbook into insight: your ride rate, best streak, daily waves for 7 or 14 days, a 24-hour craving clock that shows when urges hit, your top triggers and how you do against each craving. Plain-language notes point out what Cravion noticed — like when your urges peak.

KIND, NOT JUDGY
Gave in? It happens. Cravion notes the trigger and helps you paddle back out. Awareness is the skill.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Use every feature without an account — tap Skip and your logbook stays on your iPhone only.
• Optionally sign in with Apple or Google to back up and sync. Your guest history comes with you.
• No ads. No selling data. No tracking across apps.
• Delete your account and all cloud data anytime, right in the app.

FEATURES
• One-tap craving logging with a quick-log shelf for your usual suspects
• Guided "sun breathing" ride with haptics and grounding prompts
• Willpower Tide gauge, streaks, money and time kept
• Logbook with filters, notes and editing
• Patterns: daily chart, craving clock, triggers, per-craving ride rate
• Patches for milestones
• Sign in with Apple or Google, or no account at all

Cravion is a self-help and habit-awareness tool. It is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. If you are struggling with addiction or a health condition, please contact a qualified professional or a local support service.

Questions or ideas? https://cravion-surf-2611.web.app/support


WHAT'S NEW (version 1.0)
------------------------
Welcome to Cravion! Catch cravings, ride them out with sun breathing, and watch your willpower tide rise.

name: Crazy Rommé
description:
Rommé, wie du es vom Küchentisch kennst – und dann wird es verrückt.

Crazy Rommé ist das klassische Kartenspiel für dich allein gegen 1 bis 5 Computergegner. Sätze und Reihen auslegen, anlegen, Joker tauschen, Hand-Rommé: alles ist dabei. Und wer mag, schaltet den Verrückten Modus ein.

KLASSISCH SPIELEN
• 110 Karten mit 6 Jokern, 13 Handkarten, 30 Punkte zum ersten Auslegen
• Bis zu 5 Gegner, jeder mit eigener Stufe: Leicht, Mittel, Schwer, Extrem oder Cheater
• Die fairen Gegner sehen nur, was du auch siehst. Der Cheater kennt alle Karten – hält sich aber an die Regeln
• Fast jede Hausregel einstellbar: 30, 40 oder 50 Punkte, Ass rundherum (K-A-2), Joker mit fester Farbe, Klopfen, Ausgehen durch Auslegen, „Hand only“ und Umbauen wie beim Legespiel
• Zu jeder Regel gibt es eine kurze Erklärung direkt in der App
• Partie bis zu einer Strafpunkte-Grenze oder über eine feste Zahl von Runden, mit Punktetabelle und Finalrunde bei Gleichstand

DER VERRÜCKTE MODUS
• Zwölf Ereignisse, die keiner kommen sieht: Inflation, Steuerprüfung, Spiegeltag, Farbtausch, Stromausfall, Erdbeben, Kapitalismus, Kommunismus, Polizei, Schwerkraft und mehr
• Spezialkarten: Bombe, Heiße Kartoffel, Doppelagent, Klebekarte, Glaskarte und die Schrödinger-Karte
• Ein Beamter vom Kartenprüfungsamt spaziert über deine Hand – wisch ihn weg, er kommt beleidigt zurück
• Speed-Modus mit 4, 6 oder 8 Sekunden pro Zug
• „Alle gegen dich“: Die Computergegner spielen als Bande gegen dich
• Jedes Ereignis und jede Spezialkarte einzeln ein- und ausschaltbar. Die Gegner spielen nach denselben verrückten Regeln

ANGENEHM ZU SPIELEN
• Bedienung durch Antippen: Karte wählen, Ziel antippen – fertig
• Alles bis zum Abwerfen zurücknehmbar
• Karten fliegen über den Tisch, Sortieren nach Farbe oder Rang, Ziehen zum Umsortieren
• Quer- oder Hochformat, fünf Kartendesigns
• Automatisches Speichern – weiterspielen, wann du willst
• Statistik mit Verlauf deiner Strafpunkte und Siegquote je Gegnerstufe

FAIR UND RUHIG
• Keine Werbung, keine In-App-Käufe, kein Konto
• Funktioniert komplett offline
• Keine Datenerhebung, kein Tracking: Spielstand und Statistik bleiben auf deinem iPhone

name: Crista Urban Property Mgmt

The house app for the owners and cleaning team of Crista Urban Property Management, which runs short-term rental homes in Frisco and Plano, Texas.

For owners:
• See who is staying now and who arrives next, with dates, guests and booking details
• A calendar of every house, with each stay and nightly rate

• Alerts the moment a booking is made, changed or cancelled, and when a job is done

For the cleaning team:

name: Croakway
description:
Croakway is a fast, pick-up-and-play arcade game built for one thumb.

Hop your frog across seven lanes of traffic, then ride drifting logs and lily pads across the river to reach the five homes on the far bank. Fill all five to clear the level. Then do it again, faster.

SIMPLE CONTROLS
• Swipe to hop in any direction
• Tap to hop forward
• A long swipe hops twice

FOUR BOARDS
• Dusk River: logs, lily pads and rush-hour traffic
• Night Highway: headlights in the dark
• Frozen Crossing: ice floes on cold water
• Bayou: fog, pike and things in the reeds

WATCH OUT FOR
• Lily pads that sink under you
• Snakes on the median and the logs
• Pike with snapping jaws
• Crabs waiting in the homes
• The clock: 30 seconds per frog

SCORE BIG
• Catch the firefly in a home for a bonus
• Carry the pink buddy frog home for extra points
• Beat the clock for a time bonus
• Earn an extra life at 20,000 points

NO NONSENSE
• Free. No ads, no in-app purchases
• No account, no tracking, no data collected
• Plays offline
• Respects the silent switch and keeps your music playing

All pixel art and sound effects are original and generated in code.

name: Cross & Helm
description:
Cross & Helm makes handcrafted Christian pendants in Texas. This app brings the full collection and The Ordered Man 30-day challenge together in one place.

THE ORDERED MAN: A 30-DAY CHALLENGE
Christian first. Husband second. Father third.
One charge a day for 30 days, each built on Scripture and a clear action to take. Every day speaks to you as a Christian, a husband and a father. If you are not married or not a father yet, the challenge gives you a charge written for where you are.

Handcrafted in Texas.
Not an ornament. A declaration.

name: Crownvaulter
description:
The curtain rises on a tiny king with a very big leap.

Pull back, aim, and release to vault through a magical royal theater. Gather floating crowns, rebound from padded walls, ride moving cushions, and land on the royal finishing drum before time runs out.

Perform across 24 levels in three acts: Velvet Beginnings, Clockwork Acrobats, and Moonlit Encore. Begin with forgiving jumps, then master rhythmic moving stages and mischievous theatrical mallets. A dotted flight path helps you choose your angle and power.

Earn up to three stars per performance. Replay your favorite acts to improve your score, and explore your own score history and daily crown totals in the King's Performance notebook.

Features:
• 24 playable levels with deterministic physics and timing.
• Simple pull-and-release controls and visible trajectory previews.
• Illustrated velvet stages, crowned characters, and royal drums.
• Three hearts, safe checkpoints, and pause-anytime play.
• Real saved scores, stars, attempt history, and interactive charts.
• Sound, haptics, reduced effects, and aim sensitivity controls.
• Adaptive layouts for iPhone and iPad, including resizable windows.
• No login, ads, purchases, or backend.

name: CruxLog: Climbing Tracker
description:
Every send starts as a project. Log your climbs, count your attempts and watch your hardest grade go up over time. A personal progress diary for boulderers and gym climbers who want to remember every move.
Start with the gyms you climb at. Add each one with its name, city, address, type, notes and a cover photo, mark favorites and see every route logged there.
Each route gets its own record: gym, hold color, wall angle, style, grade, rating and notes. Search the log, filter by projects, sends or flashes, narrow it down by gym and sort it your way.
Grades work in both V and Font. The app converts one to the other, and you can switch scales anytime.
Attempts are tracked with a counter and a quick one-more-try button. Mark the send when it goes, then review the day-by-day history, which you can edit later.
Route Memory is where your beta lives. Photograph the wall or pick a shot from your gallery, tag the holds in order, draw arrows for each move and label individual steps. Before the next attempt, play the sequence back step by step and walk up to the wall with a plan.
Progress comes in clear numbers: total sends, flash rate, grade distribution, weekly activity, your streak of consecutive weeks and a breakdown by gym. Personal records track your hardest send and other milestones, and the app tells you when you set a new one.
The home screen shows your hardest send, this month’s numbers, current projects and recent activity, with one tap to add a route or a wall photo.
Everything stays on your device. No sign-up, and the diary works offline. Export your log as a spreadsheet, or share a route and its marked-up image. Works on iPhone and iPad in portrait and landscape.

name: Cruz VU - Audio Meter for iPad
description:
Cruz VU is a studio-grade meter for mix and master on iPad, built around the classic analog VU meter.

Cruz VU comes in four modes:
• VU: Analog ballistics true to the classic meter
• RMS: Two calibrations, RMS or AES17, for dynamic mixes
• LUFS: Momentary, Short-term, Integrated and LRA, to hit streaming targets
• Peak: Digital true peak on an analog needle, with PLR

Cruz VU includes an app and a plug-in.

The app meters the iPad’s microphone or a connected audio interface.
The Audio Unit plug-in, installed with the app, works in Logic Pro for iPad and other AUv3-compatible apps.

Compliant with studio and broadcast standards: IEC 60268-17, AES17, ITU-R BS.1770-5, EBU Tech 3341 and EBU Tech 3342.
Privacy built in. Audio is only measured and no data is collected. The app has no network access.
Built for minimal CPU use.

Feedback is welcome.

cryptachat is a private messenger built around end-to-end encryption. Your messages, voice notes, photos, videos, and calls are encrypted on your device and can only be read by the people you're talking to — not us, not the network.

EVERYDAY MESSAGING

name: CSCA Help: Exam Prep
description:

NOT AN OFFICIAL APP
CSCA Help is an independent study app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or run by the China Scholarship Council or the organisers of the CSCA, and its practice questions are its own, not official exam material.
