• Optional reminders: daily study, exam countdown, registration dates

ON YOUR HOME SCREEN

• A live timer on the Lock Screen while you sit a mock

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no sign-in. No ads. No tracking.
• Your progress is kept on your phone. A backup under a random code is optional.
• Works offline.

Questions or a mistake to report? contact@csca.help

name: CtrlKeyboard
description:
CtrlKeyboard is a keyboard for iPhone that formats your text in any app, and looks and feels like the system keyboard.

FORMAT IN ANY APP Select text and tap Bold, Italic, Underline or Strikethrough in the toolbar. CtrlKeyboard adds the Markdown marks (**bold**, *italic*, ~~strikethrough~~) that many messaging and note apps understand.

CHANGE CASE IN ONE TAP Turn the selection into UPPERCASE, Title Case or lowercase without retyping it.

SNIPPETS Save the text you type often, like an address or a sign-off, straight from the keyboard: select it and tap Save. Insert it in two taps, and manage your snippets in the app.

CLIPBOARD HISTORY Find what you copied earlier and paste it again. Pin what you use most.

ACCENTS AND LANGUAGES Type in English, French (AZERTY) and Spanish. Hold a letter and slide to its accent, as on the iPhone keyboard.

UNDO AND REDO Take back what you typed or deleted, a word at a time.

A NATIVE LOOK The same layout, key sizes and colors as the iPhone keyboard, in light and dark mode, with key previews and emoji.

FREE AND PRO Formatting, case changes, accents, emoji and three snippets are free. Undo and redo, clipboard history, unlimited snippets and the French and Spanish layouts come with a CtrlKeyboard Pro account.

PRIVACY CtrlKeyboard doesn't send what you type anywhere. Snippets and clipboard history stay on your iPhone. Full Access is only needed for copy and paste, snippets, clipboard history and your account.

To set it up: Settings > General > Keyboard > Keyboards > Add New Keyboard > CtrlKeyboard, then turn on Allow Full Access.

name: Cue Reader: Teleprompter
description:
A teleprompter for people recording themselves on a phone: the script scrolls as they speak, recognised on the device, and the video records in the same app.

What you get:
- The script moves when you speak
- Lines sit right under the camera
- Coughs and noise do not move it
- Rate takes and keep the best one
- Recognised on your phone, not online

Free to start. One in-app purchase adds the rest, with no subscription.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

name: CueSplice: Audio Clip Desk
description:
CueSplice turns selected audio into a practical library of marked moments and playable clips.

IMPORT YOUR AUDIO
Choose a readable M4A, MP3, WAV or AIFF file from Files. Play and seek in Audio Desk, then add named markers at precise time positions. An original sample is available when you choose Try sample audio.

MAKE A CLIP
Set Start and End in seconds or choose marker positions. Audition the selected range, save a named clip with notes, then export an actual M4A file. Open Exports to play the generated result and share it with the system share sheet.

KEEP THE WORK ORGANIZED
Search audio, clips and export history. Export records preserve the clip details used at the time. Manage local copies and remove them when you are finished.

Files must be readable, unprotected audio up to 100 MiB and 3 hours. Clips must be at least 0.100 seconds long. M4A export re-encodes audio and may align boundaries to codec frames. CueSplice does not record from the microphone. No app account is required.

name: CutNest Note
description: CutNest plans cuts for bars, pipes, and sheets and reduces waste. Offline productivity tool with no account.

name: Cuvée88 – Wine list & cellar
description:
Cuvée88 keeps your cellar, your stock and your wine list in one app. For restaurants and for collectors.

SPIN THROUGH YOUR CELLAR WITH ORBIT
Orbit lays out all your wines in rings around a single point. Tap a type, a colour or a region and the list next to it shows what fits, right away. Search and favourites are built in.

YOUR CELLAR, ALWAYS WITH YOU
• Wine, champagne, whisky, beer, coffee or tea: with vintage, region, grape and the spot where the bottle sits.
• Count bottles up or down with one tap, per location and per shelf.
• Set a minimum stock per drink. See what is running low and get an email when something runs low.
• Follow the market price of your wines and see what your cellar is worth.
• No signal in the cellar? Just keep going. Everything syncs once you are back online.

SCAN THE LABEL
Take a photo of the bottle and Cuvée88 reads the label. Then we search the web for the producer, region, grape and more. We only fill in what we find on a real page, with the link alongside. You choose what to apply.

YOUR WINE LIST FOR GUESTS
• Guests scan the QR code at the table and browse your list themselves, in English or Dutch.
• Two links: with prices for the table, without prices for your website.
• By the glass and by the bottle, with your own branding: colours, fonts and logo.
• Hide sold-out wines from guests with one switch.
• Make a PDF of your list in six layouts.
• See which wines your guests look at and save as favourites.

TOGETHER WITH YOUR TEAM
Invite your colleagues. Everyone works in the same cellar, each with their own role.

BRING WHAT YOU ALREADY HAVE
Move your existing list over with a CSV file. You can export at any time.

You need a Cuvée88 account. Your data is kept safe and is the same on all your devices. Some features, such as guest wine lists and the PDF wine list, depend on your plan.

Questions? Email us at hello@cuvee88.com.

name: CW Dojo: Learn Morse Code
description:
CW Dojo helps you learn Morse code for amateur radio CW.

COPY
- Koch method: start with 2 characters and add one each time you pass 90% accuracy
- Farnsworth spacing: keep characters fast and add space between them
- Type what you hear while it plays, then check your answers. Or just listen
- 1 to 100 characters per round. Practice only your weak characters or your own list
- Choose the order: Koch order (as on LCWO) or ABC

SEND
- Turn the screen into a straight key or a paddle
- The straight key adapts to your sending speed automatically

LISTEN (Plus)
- Decode Morse code around you with the microphone. Pitch and speed are detected automatically
- Use an external key or a radio to answer sending drills
- Sound stays on your iPhone. Nothing is recorded or sent

STATS (Plus)
- Weekly, monthly and yearly charts of practice time, accuracy, characters sent and characters learned
- Accuracy by character and your weak characters

PLUS (one-time purchase)
Unlocks Stats and Listen and removes ads. If you installed the app by December 13, 2026, everything is free for you without buying.

CODE SOURCES
International Morse follows ITU-R Recommendation M.1677-1 "International Morse code". Details are in Settings > Code sources.

PLEASE NOTE
Article 17 of the ITU Radio Regulations asks every country to protect the secrecy of radio communications. Most countries prohibit divulging or using the contents of radio messages that are not meant for you (for example, 47 U.S.C. § 605 in the United States, which does not apply to amateur radio transmissions). Please follow the law where you are.

name: CycleTime Note
seller_name: SAYANG ELY ELIKA BINTI ABD RAHIM
description: CycleTime measures task cycle times and production output. Offline productivity tool with no account.

name: Cyclo – Live Beats
description:
Type a line. Hear a loop.

Cyclo turns short lines of code into music. Write a pattern like s("bd*4, ~ sd") and it plays instantly as a loop you can tweak while it runs. No music theory needed.

WRITE BEATS WITH CODE
• A live code editor that highlights the sound playing right now
• A 16-step pattern view for every track, with mute keys
• BPM, swing and master knobs
• Starter templates to load and remix

LEARN AS YOU PLAY
• Short, hands-on lessons, most under 3 minutes
• From your first kick to layers, melodies and effects
• Every lesson plays as you type

A DRUM MACHINE IN YOUR POCKET
• Audition pads for kicks, snares, hats, claps, toms and more
• Decay, tune and crunch controls
• Sound kits from classic analog to tape and glitch

EXPORT AND SHARE
• Save your beats and play them anytime
• Export 4, 8 or 16 bars as WAV and share anywhere

CYCLO PRO
Free includes 3 beat slots, the Core 808 kit and the first lessons. Pro unlocks:
• Unlimited beat slots
• Every Pro sound kit
• Sync across your devices
• The full lesson curriculum

Subscriptions: Cyclo Pro Monthly ($4.99/month) and Cyclo Pro Yearly ($29.99/year). Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/cycloprivacy/ana-sayfa

name: DafScan: Private Scanner App
description:
DafScan turns paper into clean PDFs and keeps them on your iPhone. No ads, no account, no cloud.

Point the camera at a page and press the shutter. DafScan finds the page's edges, crops it and straightens it. Add more pages, pick a filter and share the PDF.

WHAT IT DOES
• Scans documents, receipts, letters, forms and notes
• Multi-page documents: add, rotate, reorder and delete pages
• Filters for clear text: Auto, Original, Gray, Black & White
• Change the crop or filter of a page after saving
• Turns photos you already took into a PDF
• Shares the PDF to Mail, Messages, Files or any other app

FIND AND COPY TEXT
• DafScan reads the text on every page, on your iPhone
• Search finds a scan by any word inside it
• Copy the text of a page
• PDFs are searchable, so you can find words in them anywhere
• Reads Hebrew, English and many other languages

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account. Open the app and scan.
• No ads, and free to use.
• No cloud. Scans are stored on your iPhone and nowhere else.
• Works offline. A scan leaves your phone only when you share it.

Deleting the app deletes your scans, so save the PDFs you want to keep to Files first.

name: Daily Bible Groups
description:
A quiet moment with the Bible, in game form.

Every day there's a new puzzle: 16 Bible words on a board, and 4 hidden groups of 4 waiting to be found. Tap four words you think belong together and submit. You have 4 mistakes — choose carefully.

If you enjoy a good grouping puzzle, you'll feel at home: every board hides four sets of four, and your job is to find the connection between the words, spot the link that ties each set together, and sort all sixteen words before your mistakes run out.

When you find a group, it turns into a verse card: the passage those words come from, from the Berean Standard Bible. Find all four groups and you reach the Reveal — name the day's passage from four choices, and unlock a short devotional thought to sit with.

Stuck? The first hint points you to the passage — "Look in Luke 17." Still stuck? The second hint shows you the first half of the verse itself, so you can match its words against the board. The Bible helps you solve it.

HOW IT PLAYS
• One new puzzle every day, the same for everyone
• 16 words, 4 hidden groups, 4 mistakes allowed
• Groups range from straightforward to deep — the last group is always the thinker
• Solved groups become verse cards you can read and keep
• Finish the board to unlock the Reveal and the day's devotional
• Relaxed mode in Settings: 6 mistakes, same puzzle, for a gentler game
• Holiday puzzle weeks through the year — Thanksgiving, Christmas, Holy Week and more
• Build a daily streak

FREE EVERY DAY
The daily puzzle is free, for everyone, forever. There are no ads in this app, no account to make, nothing to sign up for, and the app collects no data about you. It works fully offline.

LAUNCH OFFER — EVERYTHING OPEN
During our launch period, the full Archive of past puzzles, all three practice packs (Old Testament Stories, Life of Jesus, Early Church), and the Kids Pack are unlocked free inside the app. No purchase, no charge — just tap to unlock.

KIDS PACK
Easy puzzles written for ages 6–10 — Noah, Creation, David, Jonah — with short words, gentle assists (6 mistakes), and no timers or streak pressure.

Verse text is from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB), released to the public domain in 2023.

Questions or puzzle suggestions? Contact us at bibleappssupport@gmail.com — we read everything.

Play today's puzzle, find the groups, and spend a few minutes in the Word.

name: Daily Three: Gentle Puzzles
description:
Daily Three gives you three new puzzles every morning: one word puzzle, one number puzzle and one picture puzzle. Each takes a few minutes, and when you've finished all three you're done for the day.

Made to be easy on the eyes and kind to the player:
• Large, high-contrast text in a typeface designed for low vision, with three text sizes
• No timers and no scores to beat. A wrong answer just lets you try again
• Gentle hints whenever you want them: show a letter, or take away a wrong answer
• "Read it to me" reads each puzzle aloud
• A friendly morning reminder at the time you choose, or none at all
• See the days you've played this week and how many days in a row

The puzzles:
• Word: read the clue and tap the letters in order to spell the answer
• Number: everyday sums like making change, telling the time and simple number patterns
• Picture: four pictures, one that doesn't belong

Everyone gets the same three puzzles each day, so you can compare notes with family and friends. Want more? Play a practice round any time.

No account, no ads, no data collected. Everything stays on your device and works without an internet connection.

name: DailySlip
description:
DaySlip turns one sentence into today's cards.

Type a line, or hold the microphone and speak. Tap Parse for a draft, change anything you want, then tap Save. Nothing is stored until you save. You can also tap Add and write a card yourself, with or without a network.

Each card can have a time, a place, up to three steps, and a repeat: once, every day, weekdays, or one weekday. Check a card off and it stays on Today until the next day you open the app. It then moves to Finished and stays there until you clear it. Swipe a card to Today, Tomorrow, or Later.

Reminders are one local alert per card. There is no account, no iCloud sync, and no shared list.

Parse sends that one sentence to Google Gemini so it can suggest cards. Speech is transcribed on this iPhone and is not uploaded. Settings has a short privacy summary. The full policy is at the Privacy Policy URL.

name: Danzia.
description:
Practice a dance move, record yourself, and see how it compares with the reference. Danzia keeps both videos together so you can focus on the same step instead of switching back and forth and relying on memory.
Create a project for a routine, class combination, or section of choreography. Add a reference video from your library, then import or record your own practice. Play both videos side by side, adjust their starting points, and replay a short section until the movement is clear. Slow playback, mirror either video, swap sides, or view one video full screen when you need a closer look.
Save a Marker at a moment you want to remember. Create a Focus for a section that needs work, and write down what you want to change. When you practice again, add another recording to that Focus and compare an earlier take with a later one. Mark the Focus resolved when you feel ready to move on.
Danzia is made for the real work between lessons: repeating a phrase, checking timing, noticing a detail, and returning to it in your next session. Your projects and practice videos stay together .

name: DartArena
description:
DartArena je aplikace pro šipkové turnaje. Pořadatel v ní řídí celý turnaj z mobilu a hráči vidí, kdy a s kým hrají. Žádné papíry, žádné vyvolávání do mikrofonu.

PRO POŘADATELE
• Turnaj založíš za pár minut: AB pavouk, KO, skupiny s postupem
• Přihlášky přes odkaz nebo QR kód z letáku, kapacita a náhradníci
• Zápasy jdou na volné terče samy, nebo je posíláš ručně
• Nasazení, binga a zavření, zapisovač
• Leták s QR kódem na plakát i na sociální sítě
• Seriály s vlastním bodováním a týmové ligy

PRO HRÁČE
• Napíšeš své jméno a hned vidíš svůj zápas, soupeře a terč
• Mobil pípne, až tě pořadatel pošle na terč
• Pavouk a pořadí se plní samy, jak se dohrávají zápasy
• Hráčský profil se statistikami, medailemi a trofejemi
• Komunita šipkařů podle krajů, přátelé a týmy s vlastním chatem
• Kalendář turnajů podle krajů a na mapě

Soft i steel. Sledovat turnaj přes QR kód jde i bez účtu.
Turnaje se zakládají zdarma.

name: Data Timão
description:
O Data Timão reúne a história do Corinthians em dados: todos os jogos desde 1910, os ídolos, os títulos e as histórias que fizeram o clube do povo.

JOGO A JOGO
• Mais de 6.300 partidas, de 1910 até hoje
• Filtre por adversário, ano, competição, estádio e resultado
• Escalação, gols, técnico, árbitro e público de cada jogo
• Jogos novos entram no app automaticamente

ÍDOLOS E NÚMEROS
• Jogos, gols e a passagem de cada jogador pelo clube
• Artilheiros e recordes da história alvinegra

SALA DE TROFÉUS
• Todos os títulos do Timão, do Paulista ao Mundial

NOTÍCIAS E HISTÓRIAS
• Pré-jogo e pós-jogo com os números do confronto
• Datas marcantes e curiosidades do Almanaque

A FIEL REUNIDA
• Chat em tempo real e comentários em cada jogo
• Marque os jogos em que você esteve, salve favoritos e ganhe selos

O Data Timão é gratuito e feito por corinthianos. Se quiser ajudar a manter o projeto no ar, você pode fazer uma doação voluntária, que não libera nenhum recurso extra.

Dados do Almanaque do Timão, de Celso Dario Unzelte. Todos os direitos reservados para Bola Dentro Editora e Comunicação.

O Data Timão é um app independente, feito por torcedores, sem vínculo com o Sport Club Corinthians Paulista.

name: dataloggerx
description: DataloggerX is an industrial IoT companion app for AQUALOG dataloggers. It connects wirelessly via Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) to provide real-time pressure transducer monitoring, ambient environmental metrics, battery status gauges, zero-offset transducer calibration, and live serial console diagnostics.

name: DateSpan
description: Choose a start date, an interval in days and the number of dates. View the full sequence, then save, edit or search your plans. See dates from different plans together in chronological order. Schedules are kept on the device.

name: Dayglint: One Line a Day
description:
Dayglint is a journal that asks for one line a day.

Pick a mood, write a sentence, add a photo if there was one worth keeping. That's the whole entry. It takes under a minute, which is why it's easy to keep doing.

EVERY DAY
• One line, with a daily prompt when you don't know what to write
• Five moods, picked in one tap
• A photo from your camera or library, with an optional date stamp
• One reminder at the time you choose

LOOKING BACK
• A calendar tinted by mood
• On this day: what you wrote a month or a year ago
• Streaks, mood trends and a weekly recap you can share as an image

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account needed. Your entries and photos stay on your device. Sign in only if you want a backup you can restore on a new phone, and delete that account in the app at any time.

DAYGLINT PREMIUM
• Up to 4 photos per entry
• App lock with Face ID, Touch ID or fingerprint
• Search across every entry
• Export your journal as text
• More paper colors
• A full year of insights
• No ads

Premium is an optional auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your store account at confirmation. It renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your account settings.

Privacy: https://nathankim0.github.io/dayglint-site/privacy.html
Terms: https://nathankim0.github.io/dayglint-site/terms.html

name: Daystitch: 1 Second a Day
description:
Your day, in fifteen seconds.

Daystitch turns the small moments you'd never post into a reel people actually watch. Tap once to film one second. Do it fifteen times through the day — coffee, the walk, the view, the people — and Daystitch edits them into a 15-second reel with every cut on the beat.

ONE TAP, ONE SECOND
The camera records exactly one second, already framed for Reels and TikTok. It stays open, so you can shoot a few in a row. Or pick a moment from a longer video in Photos.

EDITED FOR YOU
Pick a template and Daystitch does the rest: it trims each second to the beat of the song, adds the hook at the start and a grid of your whole day at the end.
• Photo Dump — film-camera date stamp and flash cuts
• Day in My Life — story bar and timestamps
• Velocity — speed ramps, beat zooms and RGB shake
• VHS — tape grain, tracking glitches, ▶ PLAY
• Cinematic — film bars, slow motion, warm grade
• Polaroid — every second lands as an instant photo

DAY, WEEK OR MONTH
Make a reel of today, the last seven days or the whole month. Go back to any day, week or month you recorded.

MUSIC THAT FITS
Eight built-in tracks, free to post. Or bring your own song from Files — Daystitch finds its beat and cuts to it.

NEVER MISS A MOMENT
Choose an hourly nudge from 8 to 22 until your fifteen are in, or one reminder in the evening. A Lock Screen widget and a Control Center button open the camera in one tap. Your streak and "On this day" keep the habit going.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no upload, no ads. Your clips stay on your iPhone and in its iCloud backup until you share a reel yourself.

DAYSTITCH PRO
Free: unlimited recording, day, week and month reels, Photo Dump and Day in My Life templates, built-in music.
Pro unlocks Velocity, VHS, Cinematic and Polaroid, your own songs, and reels without the Daystitch watermark.

Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly. Both plans start with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase after the trial. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions. We remind you two days before a trial ends.

Privacy Policy: https://appkind.app/apps/daystitch/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://appkind.app/apps/daystitch/terms/
Apple Standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: dbit.one
description:
dbit.one — приложение для клиентов студии разработки dbit.one. В нём видно всё, что происходит с вашим проектом: сколько дней до сдачи, какой этап идёт, что уже принято по договору и что нужно оплатить.

СРОК И ШТРАФ
На первом экране — счётчик дней до сдачи. Срок записан в договоре, и за каждый день опоздания студия уменьшает ваш счёт на 2%, но не более чем на 10%. Если мы опаздываем, экран меняет цвет и показывает, на сколько уже уменьшена сумма. Пересчёт идёт автоматически каждый день.

ЭТАПЫ И ДЕМО
Работа сдаётся по этапам, каждый этап — работающая версия. Открываете сборку, проверяете и принимаете её или оставляете замечание. Замечание сразу уходит команде.

ДОГОВОР ПО ПУНКТАМ
Все пункты приложения к договору — списком: принято, в работе, ждёт вашего решения. К любому пункту можно написать замечание. Своему инженеру можно выдать ссылку на чтение, чтобы он сверил код с договором.

СЧЕТА И ДОКУМЕНТЫ
График оплат, оплаченные и выставленные счета, договор и акты — в одном месте.

СВЯЗЬ С КОМАНДОЙ
Чат с инженерами и менеджером проекта. Переписка остаётся при договоре.

ВИДЖЕТ, DYNAMIC ISLAND И УВЕДОМЛЕНИЯ
Срок сдачи — на домашнем экране и экране блокировки. Уведомления приходят, когда готово новое демо, выставлен счёт или команда ответила в чате.

ДЕМО-ПРОЕКТ БЕЗ РЕГИСТРАЦИИ
Если вы ещё не клиент, откройте демо-проект и посмотрите, как выглядит работа со студией изнутри.

Вход для клиентов — по номеру телефона из договора и одноразовому коду от менеджера.

name: Dead Giveaway: Party Game
description:
One of you is already a zombie. Nobody knows who.

Dead Giveaway is a zombie party game you play in person, on your own phones. To attack someone, a zombie has to get close. The phones measure the distance between you, so nobody reports their own tag and nobody argues about it afterward.

HOW A ROOM WORKS

1. Hold your phones together to join. There are no accounts and no room codes.
2. One unit is assigned patient zero. Everyone else is human, for now.
3. A zombie gets close to a human, holds the button and lets go.
4. Only that human gets a warning. Block in time and the zombie is stunned. Block late and it costs HP.
5. At 0 HP you are bitten. Welcome to the other team.

The last human left wins.

NOBODY SITS OUT

A caught human becomes a zombie, with a new job and a room full of former friends. The party keeps going until one human is left.

THE PHONES ARE THE REFEREE

There is no honor system. The phones measure the distance, with precision tracking when every phone in the room is an iPhone 11 or newer and with Bluetooth otherwise. If the phones cannot get a reading, the attack misses. A wall is a wall.

ONE ACCUSATION EACH

If you think you know who is not well, you get one binding accusation per room. Get it right and the zombie is exposed to everyone. Get it wrong and it costs you. Talking out loud is unlimited and not binding.

EVERY NIGHT ENDS WITH A RECEIPT

When the room closes, the unit prints an incident log: who patient zero was, who bit whom and when, and who blocked eleven times and then didn't. It is ready for the group chat.

BUILT FOR A FULL HOUSE

- iPhone and Android play in the same room.
- There is no player cap, so bring the whole party.
- It works for game nights, family gatherings, office parties and any event with a hallway.
- A phone in a pocket can still be bitten. Only an open app can block.
- The host sets the house rules: how hard a bite lands and how fast humans recover.

IS IT SCARY?

No. It is a zombie game run by a very calm public broadcast. Expect a lot of suspicion and no jump scares.

WHAT IT COLLECTS

There are no accounts and no ads, and the app does not collect location. A room keeps the names you picked and its log for up to 30 days, then deletes them.

name: Deadline Zero
description: Deadline Zero ranks finite deadlines by what happens after the date, not only by how soon they arrive. Add a title, a due date, a category, and a consequence. Categories cover trials, warranties, return windows, tickets, certificates, and contracts. Each consequence says what is at stake: a charge begins, coverage loses force, a return window closes, something must be renewed, or the stakes stay low. The board sorts items into Today, Week, Month, and Later. Inside each lane, a consequence score puts the heavier outcomes first. A charge that starts tomorrow outranks a low-stakes date that is closer on the calendar. When a date passes, record what actually happened: renewed, completed, returned, used, canceled, or irrelevant. Suggested outcomes follow the consequence you chose. Share text, a link, or a photo into Deadline Zero and it becomes a draft on the board. The Hot Cutoff widget shows the highest-consequence item, money at risk, and how many dates are overdue. Your deadlines stay on this iPhone and iPad. Open Hot for what to do first, Horizon for the weeks ahead, and Closed when you want the same title on a new date.

name: Deafeny
description:
Fall asleep to a podcast, a playlist or a live stream without it waking you up two hours later.

Deafeny lowers your volume gradually over the time you choose, then pauses whatever is playing and gets out of the way. No reaching for the pause button at 1 a.m.

A FLOATING TIMER
Start a fade in Deafeny and it opens the app you're listening to. Deafeny's countdown pops out into a small floating window on top, so you can see how long is left — and when the fade ends, Deafeny can pause even a full-screen video. The floating timer then closes, and your screen can turn off on its own.

ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN
The countdown is on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island too, with +15 min and Stop.

BUILT FOR BEDTIME
• Fade over 15, 30, 45, 60, 90 or 120 minutes, or anything from 1 minute to 8 hours
• Fade to silence, or to a quiet level you choose
• Pick the app you're listening to and Deafeny opens it for you; only apps you have installed are listed
• Turn the volume up mid-fade and Deafeny carries on from there across the time that's left
• Optional: put the volume back afterwards, so your device isn't silent in the morning — only once playback has actually stopped
• Copes with headphones or a Bluetooth speaker connecting or dropping mid-fade
• Works on iPhone and iPad, including resizable iPad windows

WHAT GETS PAUSED
• With your screen on: whatever is playing, video included, when you start the fade in Deafeny
• With your screen locked: podcasts, audiobooks and Apple Music pause; other apps finish at your chosen end volume

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Deafeny collects nothing, sends nothing, shows no ads and needs no account. Your settings stay on your device.

name: DeapSea: Dive Log & Freediving
description:
Your dive log, freediving coach and dive planner in one app: DeapSea fills in your logbook automatically from Apple Watch and helps you go deeper, longer and safer.

WHY DIVERS LOVE IT
• The essentials are free with no ads: logbook, dive map, automatic freediving on the watch, safety alerts and dive simulator
• Zero typing: dives and freediving sessions recorded by your watch show up on their own
• Scuba and freediving together, each with its own space
• An Apple Watch app built for freedivers
• Your data stays on your device: no account, no servers, no tracking

LEVEL UP YOUR FREEDIVING
• A multi-week program built around the level you're aiming for (federation-style levels)
• Static, dynamic no fins and dynamic with fins
• CO₂ and O₂ tables, technique and relaxation sessions calculated from your personal bests
• Track sessions and consistency, with reminders for training and club sessions
• Poolside coach: starts called out loud, countdown on your Lock Screen
• Dive reflex: see your heart rate drop on every breath hold
• Safety first: never alone, one up one down, plus a checklist before every session

FREEDIVING ON YOUR WRIST
• On Apple Watch Ultra, DeapSea can launch the moment you go under
• Every breath hold and every surfacing detected automatically
• Big surface timer and recommended recovery time
• Short buzz every 5 s, long buzz every 10 s
• Depth, fast-ascent and short-recovery alerts
• Guided program sessions with pool lengths counted for you

EVERY DIVE IN DETAIL
• Depth profile, ascent rate and safety stop
• Decompression calculated like a dive computer, including residual nitrogen from earlier dives
• Surface interval and an indicative no-fly time
• Full log entry: buddy, gear, gas, conditions, air consumption, marine life
• Your dive photos found automatically

YOUR DIVE MAP
• Entry point saved automatically (watch or iPhone GPS)
• Suggested site name you can edit, dives grouped by site
• Filters for scuba, freediving and pool

DIVE SIMULATOR
• No-decompression limits and stops by depth and bottom time
• Air vs. nitrox side by side
• Maximum operating depth and best mix
• Repetitive dives after a surface interval

YOUR DIVER LIFE
• Medical certificate and certification cards always with you, with expiry reminders
• Gear and service tracking
• Trips, species list, calendar and monthly recap
• UDDF, Subsurface and CSV import and export

SIMPLE AND ACCESSIBLE
• 12 languages, feet or meters, Dark Mode, VoiceOver, Siri

DEAPSEA PRO (OPTIONAL)
• Freediving training program, CO₂/O₂ tables and guided sessions on the watch
• Heart-rate analysis, records and trends, dive comparison
• PDF logbook, UDDF and Subsurface exports, custom alarms on the watch
• Monthly or yearly subscription with a 14-day free trial, or a one-time lifetime purchase

PRIVACY
With your permission, DeapSea reads depth, water temperature, heart rate and workouts from Health, and the watch app saves your freediving sessions there. Nothing is collected or shared.

Depth is recorded by compatible Apple Watch models (such as Apple Watch Ultra); the watch app requires watchOS 10 or later. No data yet? Explore the app with demo dives.

SAFETY
DeapSea is a logbook and training tool. It is not a dive computer and does not replace official dive tables, proper training or a buddy watching you. Never freedive alone. Decompression calculations and level benchmarks are indicative only. DeapSea is not affiliated with any training agency or federation.

Support: https://schmittutility.fr/assistance/

name: Dear Recruiter: Job Matches
description:
Dear Recruiter is a job search assistant that does the repetitive work of applying.

Upload the resume you already have. For every job, Dear Recruiter reads the posting, rewrites your resume to speak to what that employer asks for, and scores the match out of 100. An application is only prepared when the resume scores 70 or higher.

ONE SCREEN, ONE NEXT STEP
Your home screen tells you what to do next, and every card has one button: tailor this job, answer this question, send this application. No dashboards to learn.

HONEST BY DESIGN
Dear Recruiter never invents experience. When a job asks for something your resume does not show, it asks you a yes or no question. Say yes only to what is true, and it is written into the resume and remembered for next time.

JOBS THAT FIT, FOUND FOR YOU
Dear Recruiter checks employer career pages and job boards and shows the roles that fit your background, with a plain reason why.

APPLICATIONS PREPARED FOR YOU
Answer the questions every form asks once: work authorization, location, salary preference, start date. Your tailored resume and answers are then ready for each job, and you apply on the employer's site.

AUTOPILOT, WITH HONEST LIMITS
Turn on Autopilot and Dear Recruiter looks for new jobs, asks you yes or no questions, and tailors a resume for each one. If you connect your inbox with read-only access, it can also submit the application for you on some employer sites. Many sites ask for an "I'm not a robot" check or a question only you can answer, so most applications are sent by you, with everything prepared.

SHARE A JOB FROM SAFARI
Found a posting in your browser? Tap Share, choose Dear Recruiter, and the app opens ready to tailor your resume for it.

NOTIFICATIONS THAT RESPECT YOUR DAY
At most three a day (morning, 6pm and 9pm), and only when a question or a job is waiting for you.

YOU STAY IN CONTROL
Review every change before it goes out. Turn Autopilot on or off at any time. See every application and its status in one list.

YOUR DATA IS YOURS
No ads. Your information is never sold. Delete your account in the app at any time (More, then Delete account), or export everything first at dearrecruiter.app.

Dear Recruiter cannot guarantee interviews or offers. Match scores are an estimate of how well a resume covers a posting.

name: Death of the Fox Member Portal
description:
Download the Death of the Fox Brewing app for access to our memberships & special perks!

With the Death of the Fox Member Portal you will find

- Our Coffee and Beer Club
- Members Only Rewards
- Notifications

Stay connected to Death of the Fox Brewing! Join the Coffee and Beer Club and receive exclusive offers & special perks all in one place!

name: Decker’s LicenseQuest
description:
Spot a state or province. Add its region. Build your own road-trip collection with LicenseQuest.

Explore 96 illustrated jurisdictions with playful plate lettering. See which origins are common around your home base or trip starting point, earn points for unusual finds, and keep lifetime progress alongside individual trips.

• Collect regions with touch controls or optional push-to-talk.
• Browse an illustrated regional rarity map.
• Unlock plate achievements and roadside discoveries with irreverent crew commentary.
• Meet Decker, Weazl and Bubba as your score grows.
• Keep trip history and undo accidental finds.
• Optionally estimate mileage with GPS and view weather radar where coverage is available.
• Explore an optional BLE vehicle link for compatible adapters and vehicles; compatibility varies.

LicenseQuest records regions you identify, not registration numbers or vehicle owners. No account, ads or purchases. Collections live on your device; iPhone and iPad do not automatically sync.

Roadside commentary includes strong language and mature humor.

Use interactive features as a passenger or while safely parked. Weather is informational and may be delayed or unavailable. Vehicle hardware is optional for collecting; BLE telemetry requires a suitable adapter and supported vehicle.

name: Deepbound: Secrets Below
description:
Your grandfather left a mark on an antique compass. Now it has led you to
Wayfinder, a research boat with a capable companion, an opinionated drone,
and a mystery waiting beneath the surface.

Swim through a kelp forest. Survey the exterior of the stranded Atlas.
Observe a living reef. Then pilot your research ROV through a canyon and
mineral chimneys toward a forgotten archive.

UNDERSTAND THE WORLD BY USING IT
Move cargo and watch a recovery cradle respond. Trace light between mirrors.
Navigate by landmarks. Restore a station within its power budget. Interpret
sonar and preserve a discovery with the evidence that gives it meaning.

A COMPLETE VOYAGE
A story introduction, guided control practice, eight connected expeditions,
optional discoveries, a field journal,
equipment with a purpose, saved progress, replay and a homecoming ending.

EXPLORE AT YOUR OWN PACE
Directions to your next objective, an in-game Guide, untimed challenges,
helpful feedback and Mara's optional hints leave room
to experiment. Adjust look sensitivity, text size, world motion and audio.

KEEP WHAT YOU DISCOVER
Capture photographs of the game world in your private album. Choose
whether and where to share them through your device's own share controls.

Free, offline single-player adventure. No ads or in-app purchases.
No player account required.

Designed for curious explorers aged 12 and above. Deepbound is a fictional
adventure, not real diving instruction or certification.

name: Dendere Radio
description:
Dendere Radio è la radiosveglia che ti sveglia direttamente con la tua radio preferita, senza dover premere nessun tasto, proprio come una radiosveglia di una volta. E in più ti fa ascoltare migliaia di radio da tutto il mondo.

LA RADIOSVEGLIA CHE PARTE DA SOLA
• Scegli la radio, l'ora e i giorni: al mattino la radio comincia a suonare da sola
• Il volume sale piano piano, per un risveglio dolce
• Si prepara una volta sola, con una semplice automazione di Comandi Rapidi che l'app ti aiuta a creare e ti spiega passo passo
• Sveglia di riserva di iOS: se per qualsiasi motivo la radio non parte, suona comunque una sveglia con il tasto per ascoltare la radio

MIGLIAIA DI RADIO
• Le radio del tuo paese e di tutto il mondo, divise per genere
• Più ascoltate, Scopri e ricerca veloce per nome
• Preferiti e radio recenti sempre a portata di mano
• Loghi nitidi delle stazioni

PODCAST
• Sfoglia i podcast per categoria e ascolta le puntate

TUTTO QUELLO CHE SERVE
• Mini-player e lettore a schermo intero, con AirPlay
• Ascolto in sottofondo e comandi dalla schermata di blocco
• Modalità auto con tasti grandi
• Timer di spegnimento per addormentarti con la radio
• Tema chiaro o scuro, e a Natale icona con il cappellino e la neve

PRIVACY
Dendere Radio non raccoglie dati, non ha account e non ha pubblicità. Preferiti, sveglia e profilo restano sul tuo iPhone.

name: Derah KDS
description:
Derah KDS is the kitchen display for Derah POS. Put it on an iPad in your kitchen and every order your cashiers ring appears on it the moment it is sent — no paper, no shouting across the pass.

ORDERS AS THEY HAPPEN
• Tickets arrive oldest first, with the table or customer, order type, channel (Talabat, Keeta, website…) and a running timer.
• Add-ons in red, item notes and order notes (allergies) on the card.
• Edits after sending show on the line — New, 1 → 2, Voided — and a canceled order carries a banner, so nothing is made twice or for nobody.

DONE IN ONE TAP
• Tap an item to mark it done; the last one finishes the ticket.
• "All done" sends the order back to the till as Ready.
• Recall a finished ticket from the All Done tab.
• "On the fly" moves a rush order to the front.

SEE WHAT'S LATE
• Cards turn amber, then red, by each item's preparation time — or by your own thresholds.
• Scheduled orders wait in their own tab and come onto the line 20 minutes before they are due.
• All Day totals every item still to make.

BUILT FOR A KITCHEN
• Works on your shop's Wi-Fi: no internet needed during service.
• Survives a restart with every ticket in place.
• Stays awake, chimes on new orders, dark or light theme.
• Three text sizes, readable from across the line.
• English and Arabic.

Derah KDS works with Derah POS. Pair it in seconds: the screen shows its address and a 6-digit code; type them on the till.

name: Desk Stretch: Break Reminder
description:
Short guided stretch breaks between meetings, with reminders that skip times when your calendar shows you busy.

What you get:
- Reminders that wait for your meetings to end
- 2-minute guided stretches
- Pick the areas that feel tight
- See your break streak
- Your calendar never leaves your phone

Free to start. You can pay once or subscribe. Purchases are billed to your Apple account, and you can cancel a subscription any time in your store settings.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

Terms of use: https://michaeljohnpena.com/apps/deskstretch/terms/
Privacy policy: https://michaeljohnpena.com/apps/deskstretch/privacy/

name: Dickens Advent Calendar
description:
Read Charles Dickens's A Christmas Carol the way an advent calendar intends: one door, one short passage, one day at a time.
Starting December 1, a new door can be opened each day on a series of Victorian Christmas scenes. Tap it to read that day's passage, from Marley's ghost on Christmas Eve to Scrooge's change of heart. Door 25 brings Christmas morning, and a final door opens on December 26, the day after Christmas (to correspond to the final scene in the story).
- 26 short readings, each a few minutes long
- Passages taken from the text of the 1843 classic, in order, split into the five staves
- Illustrated scenes with a door hidden in each picture
- Doors unlock by date, and open doors stay open
- Easy to read: large type and a calm, warm look
- No account required, no ads, no purchases, no tracking. It works offline, no network connection required.

After the season, every door stays open, so you can read the story on any day of the year.

name: DigHere Goldfields
description:
Read the LiDAR. Find the gold.

Join Prospector Chip on the Australian goldfields. Gold isn't scattered at random here: it follows real fossicking geology. It sheds from quartz reefs, creeps downhill, travels down creeks that drain reef country and drops where the water slows.

• Survey bare-earth LiDAR terrain: old shafts, quartz reefs, creeks and buried deep leads
• Pan the gravel: shake it down, wash it away from you over the lip, flick out the stones
• Swing a detector: sweep low and slow, ground balance, and dig the right signal
• Camp by the river each night: clean your concentrates, and watch for Stinky Pete, Red Tape Rob the inspector and claim jumpers
• Prospect four regions: Central Victoria, New England NSW, the Palmer River and the WA Eastern Goldfields
• A new daily dig every day, on the same ground for everyone
• Earn badges, fill your treasure cabinet, and get on Stinky Pete's Honour Board

Play as much as you like without an account. Make a free DigHere account in the game to post your scores to the honour board.

A game for fun: in-game gold, gems and scores have no cash value.

From DigHere, Australia's fossicking map: dighere.com.au

name: DigiDevalaya Admin
description:
DigiDevalaya Admin is the mobile workspace for temple teams.
See the day’s work as soon as you sign in. The home screen shows today’s bookings and donations, then opens the tasks your role is allowed to use.
Bookings. View every booking and create a counter booking for a devotee at the temple.
Offerings. Follow today’s rituals and darshan, keep the offerings list, and check the panchang.
Donations. Record and review donations and receipts
Temple. Keep the main temple, shrines, halls, and counters in one place.
Sign in with the temple mobile number and MPIN. Each person only sees the modules assigned to their role.

name: Digital Camera Y2K · Flashpix
description:
Turn your phone into a digital camera from 2005. Flashpix is one pocket digicam, not a filter library: the screen is the back of the camera, the little LCD is your viewfinder, and every shot comes out with the same Y2K look — hard flash, deep CCD color and the orange date stamp in the corner.

ONE CAMERA. ONE LOOK.
• The direct-flash look: faces jump forward, the background falls into the dark, lights glow.
• CCD color: deep blues, punchy reds, a little grain in the shadows, a soft cheap lens.
• The orange date stamp, burned into the photo. Choose YY MM DD, DD MM YY or MM DD YY.
• Real flash on the back camera and a bright screen flash for selfies.
• White balance and My Colors like the old menus: tungsten blue, fluorescent pink, sepia, black and white.
• Self-timer, zoom, focus beep and the shutter sound.

A REAL CAMERA FEEL
• Review every shot on the little screen, flip through the 9-picture index, erase what you don't want.
• Your photos are saved to the camera roll automatically (you can turn this off).
• Share the photo, or an LCD snap: the picture on the camera's screen, ready for your photo dump.

DEVELOP YOUR OLD PHOTOS
Pick photos from your library and get them back as if they were shot on the DC-5, with the date they were really taken on the stamp.

FLASHPIX PRO
• Movie mode: 640×480 clips with the same look, sound and date.
• Any year on the date stamp, from '00 to '12.
• Unlimited develops from your library (the first 3 are included without Pro).
• Night scene, 5 MP pictures and 6 body colors.
Flashpix Pro is a weekly or yearly auto-renewing subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase; the weekly plan starts with a 3-day free trial and the yearly plan with a 1-week free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

No ads. No account. Your photos stay on your phone.

Terms of Use: https://flirta.app/terms-flirta
Privacy Policy: https://flirta.app/privacy-flirta

name: DigitLingo: Major System
description:
Remember numbers by turning them into words and memorable mental images.

DigitLingo helps you learn and practice the Major System, a mnemonic technique that transforms digits into consonant sounds. Combine these sounds to create words and associations that make numbers easier to remember.

Whether you're discovering memory techniques for the first time or already know the Major System, DigitLingo gives you a structured way to learn and practice.

**LEARN THE MAJOR SYSTEM**

Discover how digits correspond to consonant sounds and learn to build meaningful associations.

**TURN NUMBERS INTO WORDS**

Practice transforming numbers into words and mental images using the Major System.

**TRAIN YOUR MEMORY**

Strengthen your number memorization skills with exercises designed to help you practice associations and recall.

**MEMORIZE NUMBER SEQUENCES**

Practice remembering sequences of digits and test how accurately you can recall them.

**BUILD YOUR SKILLS THROUGH PRACTICE**

Start with the basics, reinforce what you've learned, and keep developing your number memory skills.

DigitLingo is designed for students, beginners, memory enthusiasts, and anyone interested in learning a practical number memorization technique.

Learn the language of numbers with DigitLingo.

name: DigSpain: record shops
description:
DigSpain is the guide to independent record shops in Spain, made by Vinilogy.

• 245 shops in 78 cities and islands, with search and "near me".
• Eight cities with a full guide: Barcelona, Madrid, Valencia, Granada, Vigo, Bilbao, Seville and Vitoria-Gasteiz, with a map, opening hours and what is open now.
• Build your plan: add the shops you want to visit and we order them as a walking route. When a leg is long, we suggest public transport. Reorder it however you like.
• Places for music lovers: venues, markets, music museums, hi-fi and instrument shops, to add to your route.
• With your Vinilogy account, each shop tells you how many records from your wishlist it has and at what price. Your wishlist is never public.
• Festivals and concerts: which records by the line-up artists are in the city's shops.
• Optional alerts: festival countdown and the agenda of the shops in your plan or favourites.
• In Spanish and English.

Hours and prices change: confirm with the shop before you go.

name: DimLagbe - Grocery Delivery
description:
DimLagbe brings the bazar to your door in Dhaka. Order fresh vegetables, fish, meat, eggs, dairy and trusted Bangladeshi brands — Teer, Rupchanda, Radhuni, Pran, Aarong, Kazi Farms, Ispahani and more — and pay cash on delivery.

• One-tap add to bag, checkout in under a minute — no sign-up needed
• Choose your delivery: within 3 hours, next day, or schedule a day and time
• Today's egg prices by hali, dozen or tray
• Free delivery on orders over ৳1,000
• Order again with one tap and track your order status
• Bangla and English
• Sign in with Apple, Google or email to save your address (optional)

Now delivering in Uttara, Nikunja, Khilkhet, Bashundhara R/A, Baridhara, Gulshan, Banani, Niketan, Mohakhali DOHS, Mirpur, Mirpur DOHS, Pallabi, Kafrul and Mohammadpur.

Need help? WhatsApp +8801335556688 or email support@dimlagbe.com.
DimLagbe is a service of Matrix Enterprise.

name: Dino Dig: Fossil Game
description:
Our park ranger needs a hand! Scoop the dirt away, brush off the dust, and chunky, friendly bones pop free and fly to your tray. Drag each bone onto the dinosaur outline. When the last one snaps in, the bones glow, the dinosaur yawns, wakes up and hops off to your dino park.

FREE TO TRY, ONE PURCHASE FOR THE REST
The first 4 dig sites and their parade are free to try. One purchase, the Full Unlock, adds 4 more dig sites, 4 more dinosaurs and the full parade.

HOW TO PLAY
- Tap with the Scoop to dig. Rub with the Brush to sweep.
- Grabbed the wrong tool? It mostly still works, just slower, and the right one hops to show you.
- Little treasures hide in the dirt too: leaves, an egg, a fossil shell, a ranger badge and a fossil sticker.
- Every site hides a keepsake for its dinosaur: a hat, a nest or a golden egg. Find it, and that dino wears it in the park.
- Bury a finished site to dig it again, with its bones in new spots.
- Visit the dino park and tap your dinosaurs. They hop, cheer and say hello.

EVERY DIG SITE IS DIFFERENT
Free to try: Daisy Pit, the Ranger Trail, Geyser Gulch and Waterfall Ledge. Finish these and your dinos throw a parade!
With the Full Unlock: Shell Cove, Big Stump, Warm Pool and Root Cave, then the full parade with all eight dinosaurs.

EASY FOR EVERYONE
- No reading needed. No way to fail. No clock.
- Big buttons and calm, original music.

FOR GROWN-UPS
- No ads.
- Nothing random for sale.
- Settings and purchases sit behind a grown-up check.
- No chat, no accounts. Progress saves on this device. Delete My Data is in Settings.

Made by Seventh Anvil Games, the makers of Polar Bears vs. Warthogs.

name: DinoLearn: Kids Learning Games
description:
An egg hatches… and a baby dinosaur becomes your child's learning buddy! DinoLearn offers short educational games for children aged 3 to 7 that adapt to their age and level.

LEARN THROUGH PLAY
• Maths: counting, comparing, adding, telling the time, money, sharing a cake (halves, thirds, quarters)
• Logic: odd one out, patterns, shapes and colours, memory, fruit sudoku, programming the dino with arrows
• Spanish: first words, numbers, memory in Spanish
• Discovering the world: animals, shadows, your country
• Writing: tracing shapes, letters and numbers with a finger
• Speaking games: the child answers out loud and the dino listens

A DINO TO RAISE
Every right answer earns fruit. Your child feeds the dino, watches it grow, and wins clothes and surprises to dress it up.

MADE FOR PARENTS
• Parents' area protected by a code
• Daily play time and bedtime
• Progress tracking, game selection, several children on one device

SAFE AND RESPECTFUL
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no account
• No data collected: everything stays on the device
• Speech recognition runs on the device: nothing is recorded or sent
• Works offline after the first download (dino voice and speech recognition, Wi-Fi recommended)

Available in 20 languages.

name: Disjoncto
description:
Disjoncto takes a residential electrical installation from the architect's plan to the Belgian RGIE/AREI file: position plan, single-line diagram, distribution board and lists, in one project.

ONE PROJECT, THREE VIEWS
The plan, the board and the single-line diagram are three views of the same project. Move a socket: the circuit, the cable, the board and the diagram follow.

THE PLAN
• Draw walls, rooms, doors and windows to scale, with a finger, Apple Pencil, mouse or trackpad.
• Import the architect's plan (PDF, image or DXF) and set the scale.
• On iPhone Pro and iPad Pro with LiDAR, scan a room with RoomPlan and get its walls, doors and windows.
• Place sockets, switches, light points and appliances with standard symbols.

CIRCUITS AND BOARD
• Each point joins a circuit, manually or automatically; the cable follows the walls.
• RCDs, breakers and outgoing lines are built from the project; the single-line diagram draws itself.

THE RGIE IN PLAIN WORDS
Every change re-runs the check against the RGIE rules (version 07): cross-sections, ratings, points per circuit, dedicated circuits, 300 mA and 30 mA RCDs, bathroom zones, voltage drop, phase balance. Each finding cites the article and suggests a fix you can undo.

THE FILE
Position plan, single-line diagram, lists and labels as A4 PDFs, ready for the approved inspection body.

ON SITE AND AT THE OFFICE
• Works offline; your projects stay on the device.
• iPad gestures: double-tap and long press on an item, context menu, Apple Pencil double-tap to switch tools.
• English, French, Dutch and seven other languages.

FREE, WITH PLANS
The app is free (1 project, watermarked documents). The site pass, the Pro and Team subscriptions and the lifetime licence remove the watermark and the limits; they are offered as in-app purchases. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, in your Apple account settings.

Disjoncto is a design aid: the official inspection of the installation is still carried out by an approved body.

Terms of use: https://disjoncto.com/en/terms-and-conditions/
Privacy: https://disjoncto.com/en/privacy/

name: DNZ Teknik SSH
