name: Dog Breed Identifier: BreedTag
description:
What breed is that dog? Snap a photo and find out in seconds.

Point your camera at any dog, at the park, on a walk or at the shelter, and get the breed, a match score and the likely mix. Then see what that breed needs: energy, grooming, training and care tips, all in one place.

SNAP ANY DOG
• Take a photo or pick one from your library
• See the closest breed with a match score
• Get a likely mix breakdown for mixed breeds and rescues
• Size and typical lifespan at a glance

GET TO KNOW THEM
• Energy, grooming, trainability and how they do with kids
• Temperament in a few words
• Practical care tips for exercise, coat and everyday care

ASK ANYTHING
On iPhones with Apple Intelligence, ask questions about your dog's breed and get friendly answers right on your device.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
Breed identification runs on your iPhone. Your photos are never uploaded, and it works without a connection.

EVERY PUP YOU MEET
Every scan is saved with its photo, so you can look back at the dogs you've met.

BREED ID PRO
Your first scan is free. Pro unlocks full profiles, mix breakdowns, all care tips, Ask and unlimited scans. Choose a weekly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple Account settings.

Results are estimates from a photo and are not a DNA test or veterinary advice.

Terms of Use: https://dogbreedidentifier.pages.dev/terms
Privacy Policy: https://dogbreedidentifier.pages.dev/privacy

name: Doma Radio
description:
Doma Radio brings the radio stations of home to your iPhone – from 187 countries around the world – from Switzerland to Brazil, from Canada to New Zealand. Whether you live there, have roots there or simply love the music: pick a station and start listening.

100% FREE, NO ADS
Doma Radio is free, shows no ads, needs no subscription and no account. If you enjoy it, you can leave an optional tip – every feature works without one.

OVER 6800 LIVE STATIONS, NEATLY SORTED
Choose one country or all of them at once and browse by style: popular, pop & hits, news & talk, regional, rock & alternative, dance & urban, oldies, folk & schlager, jazz & classical, chill & lounge, kids & comedy, faith and web radio.

WORLD MAP
Every station on one map: zoom from the globe down to your city and tap a station to listen. “Near me” shows the stations around you on request – your location never leaves your iPhone.

LIVE LISTENER COUNTS
For many stations you can see how many people are listening right now.

SEARCH ACROSS ALL COUNTRIES
Type a station name, a region such as "Luzern", "Bavaria" or "Split", or a music style – Doma Radio searches every country at once.

FAVORITES
Mark your favorite stations with a heart, arrange them as you like and keep them close at hand.

ALBUM ART AND LYRICS
When a station broadcasts the current song, Doma Radio shows the matching album cover and – where available – the lyrics.

MADE FOR EVERY DAY
• Home Screen widget
• Siri and Shortcuts
• Sleep timer
• AirPlay to speakers and TVs
• Controls on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Background playback
• Pause live radio and rewind up to 30 minutes
• Radio alarm: wake up to your favorite station
• Apple Watch app
• Control Center toggle
• Save songs and “Your Radio Year” with your listening stats
• Weather and local time where the station is

CLEAN AND BRIGHT
A calm, light design with bold, rounded type. The accent color follows the station you're listening to.

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
Doma Radio collects no personal data, has no analytics and no tracking. Favorites and settings stay on your device.

Note: stations are streamed live by the respective broadcasters. Availability, programming and song information are up to the stations. An internet connection is required; streaming over cellular uses data.

name: Dominion Connect
description:
Stay connected with your church through Dominion Connect.

Read church announcements, discover upcoming services and events, and join live video or audio gatherings. Access training courses and audio or video lessons made available to you by church staff.

Submit private prayer requests or share prayers with the church community. Request a one-on-one pastoral consultation and follow your appointment status. Manage your profile and keep up with church notifications.

An internet connection and a Dominion Connect account are required. Available content and features depend on your church role and access permissions. Camera and microphone access are requested when you choose to participate in a live meeting.

name: Dominó BR: Brazilian Dominoes
description:
Brazilian dominoes, the way it is played at the table.

Dominó BR is double-six dominoes with the most popular rules in Brazil: first to 100. Play one-on-one or in teams, train against 11 rivals with their own styles and compete in a whole championship, season after season. All with no internet and no sign-up.

BRAZILIAN RULES: FIRST TO 100
• 28 tiles, from 0-0 to 6-6
• Whoever goes out scores the sum of the tiles left in the opponents' hands
• Blocked game: the lowest sum wins (the team's, in team games)
• First to 100 points takes the match

QUICK MATCH
• One-on-one, with a boneyard to draw from
• In teams, you and your partner against another team, with all 28 tiles dealt
• Easy, Medium or Hard: play as many games as you like

TRAINING AGAINST 11 RIVALS
• Lia, Ana, Beto, Nara, Zeca, Maya, Raul, Nina, Davi, Clara and Carlos
• Each has a style: beginner, balanced, aggressive, observant, blocker, flexible, patient, calculating, strategist, closer and strategic
• Head-to-head record with each rival
• They are all fictional characters controlled by the computer — never real people

SEASONAL CHAMPIONSHIP
• 12 players: you and the 11 rivals
• 11 rounds, a standings table and a trophy for the champion
• Entry Division, 2nd Division, 3rd Division and Elite
• Games between the rivals are played on your device, with no fixed results

DAILY CHALLENGE
• One special game a day, with its own goal
• No penalty for the days you skip

LEARN AS YOU PLAY
• Your first game is guided step by step
• The Tutorial is always there to review the rules
• Playable tiles are highlighted

FAIR PLAY
• Tiles are shuffled at random
• The computer decides only from what is on the table: it never sees your hand

MADE FOR COMFORTABLE PLAY
• An elegant dark look with large ivory tiles that are easy to read
• Achievements and stats on your games
• Your game in progress saves itself: pick up where you left off
• Works offline, no account needed
• English, Português and Español

Free with ads, which never appear during a game. Banner on the menu and result screens. Rewarded videos are always optional: to get a move hint (up to 3 per game) or unlock rounds in the Championship's upper divisions. The one-time "Remove ads" purchase removes the ads between games and the banners and unlocks the upper divisions without videos. Your progress stays on your phone.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://dominobr.filisoft.com.br/privacidade.php?lang=en

name: DOODLE-Draw anything
description:
DOODLE is the doodle pad that answers for you.

You can use it to make a prediction about almost any object a spectator names.

THREE WAYS TO PERFORM

1. Phone only
Sketch a prediction on the canvas, ask a spectator to name any card, then press and hold the canvas and repeat the name. The card appears under your finger.

2. Phone + Bluetooth microphone
The phone can be in the spectator's hand from the start. Say the name of a card or an object into the microphone and the doodle appears on the phone.

3. Phone + microphone + e-paper pendant
The phone never appears. The doodle of the named card or object shows up on the e-paper pendant.

SYNC MODE
Hand the phone to a spectator and let them draw anything. You read the drawing privately on the pendant, then reveal it.

The Apple Watch can replace the microphone, the e-paper screen, or both.

FEATURES

• 52 playing cards, digits 0-9 that combine into 3- and 4-digit numbers, animals, and any doodle you draw yourself — each can be called by extra names (aliases)
• Up to 20 groups of doodles, up to 52 in each — the deck, digits and animals are already there
• Seven languages for the interface and for speech recognition
• Tap the canvas 5 times to open the backstage — the audience never sees the settings
• Sleep mask: 3 taps turn the screen black without leaving the app (switch it on in Settings)
• A status dot shows whether the microphone and the screen are really connected

WHAT YOU NEED
Nothing to start: the app works as a drawing pad on its own. The Bluetooth microphone and the e-paper pendant are optional, and so is the watch.

PRIVACY
Audio is recorded only while you hold the talk button or long-press the canvas. Chinese is transcribed by Apple's own speech recognition, every other language by Deepgram (USA); the clip is discarded afterwards and nothing is stored on a server. No accounts, no ads, no analytics, no tracking.
Full policy: https://doodle-magic-app.netlify.app/privacy

name: DoorHanger Admin
description:
DoorHanger Admin is for Admins of DoorHanger.

**Manage DoorHanger. Stay in control.**

DoorHanger Admin is the official administrative companion app for the DoorHanger platform. Designed exclusively for authorized DoorHanger administrators, it provides convenient access to the administrative dashboard directly from your iPhone.

Monitor platform activity, manage canvassing operations, oversee campaigns, review canvasser performance, and manage administrative tasks from one place.

### Key Features

- **Admin Dashboard:** Access your DoorHanger administration panel securely.
- **Campaign Management:** Monitor and manage active campaigns and campaign operations.
- **Canvasser Management:** Review canvasser activity, performance, and account information.
- **Activity Monitoring:** Access operational data and platform reports.
- **Image & Activity Review:** Review submitted canvassing images and related activity.

### Exclusively for Authorized Administrators

DoorHanger Admin is intended only for authorized DoorHanger administrators and team members. An administrator account is required to access the application. It is not intended for canvassers, customers, or general public use.

name: Dooringly
description:
Dooringly connects people who need to send parcels with travelers who can carry them.

SEND OR CARRY
Post a parcel request or offer space on your trip. Arrange domestic or international routes where available. Account registration is currently available for Australian residents; services and eligibility vary by country.

AGREE THE DETAILS
Discuss the route, dates, items and service terms in private messages. Review agreements and keep the agreed total price, parcel details, customs responsibility and supporting documents together.

RECORD EACH HANDOVER
Use the in-app QR scanner or handover PIN to record collection and delivery. Add photos and, when you choose, your current location as supporting evidence. Location sharing is optional; Dooringly does not continuously track you.

STAY INFORMED
Manage your listings and shipments, receive notifications and check shipment updates from one account. Receivers can review their incoming deliveries too.

Shopping assistance and identity verification are available only in markets where those services are enabled. Check availability in the app.

Dooringly is free to download. Member service fees, purchases, delivery and optional services are separate. Members provide carrying services and agree their terms; Dooringly helps them arrange and record those services.

For adults aged 18 and over. Camera, location and notification permissions are requested for the features that use them.

name: Dörtnala: Atlı Kaçış
description:
Dörtnala ücretsizdir. Reklam yok, uygulama içi satın alma yok, hesap açmak yok. İndir ve koş.

Ufukta yaratıklar belirdi. Kaçmak yok: atını onlara doğru sür, şerit değiştir, ateş et ve yolu aç.

NASIL OYNANIR
* Sağa sola kaydır: şerit değiştir.
* Ekrana dokun: ateş et.
* Ulti barını doldur, tek hamlede ekrandaki tüm yaratıkları sil.

YAŞAYAN BİR DÜNYA
Bozkırdan yağmura, kardan volkana, çölden ormana kadar her bölge yeni tehlikelerle gelir: lav çukurları, kum fırtınaları, deprem sarsıntıları.

ALTI DEV, HER BİRİ DAHA GÜÇLÜ
Yol uzadıkça devler sırayla karşına çıkar, her biri bir öncekinden güçlüdür ve başka türlü saldırır: ateş topu atan Boynuzlu Dev, sudan fırlayan Bataklık Yılanı, şeridi donduran Buz Devi, alev püskürten Lav Ejderi, kumun altından gelen Kum Solucanı ve kökleriyle yolu kesen Ağaç Cini.

YARATIK EVCİLLEŞTİR
Üzerinde halka olan nadir bir yaratık görürsen yanından geç ve onu evcilleştir. Birkaç saniyeliğine sırtına binip önündeki her şeyi ateşle tara.

TOPLA, GELİŞ, KUŞAN
* Altın topla, mağazadan yeni üniformalar, atlar, iz efektleri al. Pelerinli Akıncı'dan altın taçlı Güneş İmparatoru'na nadir, destansı ve efsane kıyafetlerin peşine düş.
* Tuttuğun takımın renklerinde bayrakla koş.
* Şarjör, eyer, mıknatıs, kalkan ve ultiyi geliştir.

HER GÜN BİR SEBEP
Günlük ödüller, görevler, 24 başarım ve madalyalar seni bekliyor. Rekorunu kırınca skor kartını paylaş, arkadaşlarına meydan oku.

Kısa oyunlar için ideal, internetsiz de oynanır. Dörtnala'yı ücretsiz indir, bakalım kaç metre gidebileceksin.

name: dosdeuno
description:
dosdeuno es el mercado de cartas coleccionables de Venezuela y Colombia: cartas de juegos (TCG) y cartas deportivas, de vendedores con tienda propia y reputación visible.

Compras con tu pago protegido
- Pagas en USDT y el dinero queda retenido en un escrow. El vendedor solo cobra cuando confirmas que llegó tu compra.
- Si el vendedor no despacha a tiempo, el 100% vuelve a ti de forma automática.
- Cada publicación trae las fotos reales de esa carta, su condición y el vendedor que la ofrece.
- Ofertas y contraofertas, favoritos, carrito con varios vendedores y envío por las empresas de aquí (Zoom, MRW y más) con cobro a destino.

Vendes en minutos
- Abre tu tienda, fotografía tus cartas con la cámara del teléfono y publícalas una a una, en lote o como deck.
- Busca tu carta en un catálogo de decenas de miles de cartas de Pokémon, One Piece, Dragon Ball, Magic, Yu-Gi-Oh!, Digimon, Lorcana, Riftbound y las ligas MLB, NBA, NFL, NHL, UFC, F1 y fútbol.
- Productos sellados, accesorios y breaks en directo.
- Cobras al confirmar el comprador, con 3,5% de comisión sobre la venta.

Avisos al teléfono: ventas, pagos, envíos, ofertas y mensajes de cada orden.

name: DossierCAN
description:
Independent app. Not affiliated with IRCC or the Government of Canada. Not immigration advice.

DossierCAN helps you understand and organize your Canadian permanent residence journey, step by step, so you don't miss a deadline.

YOUR PATH, CLEAR
• Québec path: Arrima → invitation → selection application → CSQ → permanent residence.
• Federal path: Express Entry (FSW, CEC, FST) or Provincial Nominee Programs (PNP).
• See your progress, your current stage and your next step. Mark stages as done and keep dates and notes.

DOCUMENTS AND EXPIRIES
• Document checklist based on your profile.
• Local reminders before your passport, work permit, language test, police certificate or medical exam expire.
• Countdowns for your deadlines (for example, 60 days after an invitation).

CALCULATORS (ESTIMATES)
• Approximate Express Entry CRS score.
• Simplified Québec grid estimator (PSTQ / Arrima).

REFERENCE
• Published fees, links to processing times, programs and a glossary (CSQ, ITA, AOR, COPR…).
• Every fact links to the public page where you can confirm it (canada.ca, quebec.ca) and shows the date it was checked.

LANGUAGES
Spanish, English and French. Arabic (right-to-left), Portuguese and Kabyle in beta.

PRIVACY
No accounts, no servers, no ads. Your data stays on your phone.

IMPORTANT
DossierCAN is an information and personal organization tool only. It does not submit applications for you, does not represent you before any government and does not give legal or immigration advice. Always confirm with the public sources or an authorized representative.

name: Doublecast Live
description:
Doublecast Live is the stage remote for Doublecast, the backing-track player and live video system for Mac.

PLAYBACK
Control the show running on Doublecast for Mac from your iPhone or iPad, on the same Wi-Fi.
• See the current song, time left, bar and beat, and every section at a glance.
• Play, stop, previous and next song, and jump to any section.
• Escape a looping section at the end of the current pass.
• Edit the setlist: add, reorder and remove songs, and switch setlists before the show.
• Mix the backing tracks: mute, solo and set the level of every track group.
• Lock the screen so a stray tap on stage can't stop the show.
• Optional: connect a Behringer X Air mixer on the same network.

CAMERA
Turn your iPhone into a live stage camera for Doublecast on your Mac.
• Full-screen pro viewfinder in portrait and landscape, with lens switching, exposure and focus lock.
• Tally shows when your camera is in preview or on air.
• Pair once by scanning the QR code your Mac shows.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. The app only talks to your own Mac on your local network, and pairing is encrypted.

TRY IT WITHOUT A MAC
Both modes have a built-in demo, so you can see how everything works before you set up your Mac.

Requires Doublecast for Mac. Learn more at doublecast.io.

name: Doughmath
description:
Doughmath is a bread baker's lab in your pocket. Write formulas in baker's percentages, scale any batch to exact grams, and bake on a timed schedule that tells you when to fold, shape and bake. Then score the crumb and keep notes, so every loaf teaches the next one.

FORMULAS IN BAKER'S PERCENTAGES
Flour is always 100%. Water, salt, starter or yeast and extras like oil, butter or malt are written as a share of it. Doughmath shows hydration, salt and total percentage as you type, draws every ingredient as a proofing jar, and gently warns you when the flours don't add up or the salt runs high.

SCALE TO GRAMS IN ONE TAP
Bake two loaves or twelve pizza balls. Scale by number of pieces and weight per piece, or by total dough weight, and every line of the formula is weighed out for you.

BAKE ON A SCHEDULE
Each formula carries its own plan: autolyse, mix, bulk ferment with stretch-and-fold reminders, shape, proof, bake and rest. Start a bake and a big countdown shows the current step, how long is left and when the next fold is due. Add five minutes when the dough needs it, or move on when it's ready. Turn on step and fold bells and Doughmath sends a local notification when it's time.

LOG EVERY BAKE
When the bread comes out, score the crumb from one to five loaves, record the room temperature in °C or °F and write crumb notes. Your history is grouped by month, with tallies for bakes this week, your average crumb score and average hydration.

QUICK MATHS ON THE BENCH
A true hydration check counts the flour and water hiding inside your 100% starter, and tells you how much salt 2% would be.

FIVE CLASSICS TO START FROM
Add a country loaf, Neapolitan pizza, rosemary focaccia, boiled bagels and a soft sandwich loaf to your shelf with one tap. Copy them, tweak them, or remove them whenever you like.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CHOICE
Sign in with Apple, Google or email, or tap "Bake as guest" and start right away. Guests can save their bakes to a full account later without losing anything. Your formulas and bakes sync securely and work offline.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads. No tracking. Your data is stored privately in Google Firebase and only you can read it. You can delete your account and every formula and bake from Pantry at any time.

name: Doura Roll Tracker
description:
A game of dice can be full of surprises. But after dozens or hundreds of rolls, are the results truly random? Duora helps you record every roll, manage your time, and turn the entire game into easy-to-understand statistics.

Tap on the total score after each roll, and the app will automatically record the result and pass the turn to the next player. You can input results from real dice, use a balanced deck of 36 combinations, or roll 3D dice directly on the screen.

With up to six players, Duora helps the group track each person's turn order and time. The timer can be set to one to three minutes, automatically stops when you leave the app, and allows you to pause at any time.

The interesting part lies in the statistics. The graph shows how many times each total score appears compared to expectations, who is having good luck, and which numbers haven't appeared in a long time. The app also tracks the number of double rolls, the time per roll, and uses the Chi-square test to assess the balance when sufficient data is available.

After each game, you can review the entire chart, share results with friends, and save your history for comparison across multiple games. Long-term accumulated data also helps you identify whether a set of dice is actually producing unusually skewed results.

name: DrawBook: Notes & Sketch
description:
DrawBook is a notebook for iPad. Write with Apple Pencil, sketch with the native brushes, and annotate PDFs, all without an account and without your notebooks ever leaving your device.

Writing and drawing
- Pens, pencils, markers and highlighters from PencilKit, with eraser, lasso and ruler
- Ruled, dotted, grid or blank paper
- Shapes you can move, resize, rotate and fill: rectangles, ellipses, triangles, lines and arrows
- A red laser pointer that fades after three seconds and is never saved

PDFs
- Import a PDF and write directly on its pages
- Export a page as PNG, the whole notebook as PDF, or an editable backup

Your notebooks, your device
DrawBook stores everything in the app's private storage on your iPad. There is no DrawBook server, no analytics, no ads and no tracking. You decide when to export or share a notebook.

Drawing AI (optional)
If you want, you can connect your own API key for OpenRouter, Ollama Cloud, Claude (Anthropic) or OpenAI. Then you can ask the AI to write, draw or change things on the current page, for example "Write 'Project plan' at the top" or "Draw an airplane in the top right". Before anything is sent, DrawBook shows what the provider receives and asks for your permission. You can withdraw it at any time in AI configuration. Your key stays in the iPad's keychain, and requests go directly from your iPad to the provider you chose.

DrawBook is free and open source under the MIT license.

name: Dreamer's Fishing Frenzy
description:
Fishing Frenzy helps kids and families catch more fish around San Angelo, Texas.

FIND THE BEST TIME TO FISH
• A fishing score for every hour of the day, built from the weather, wind, barometer, sun and moon
• Today's best window and the next good day, for the fish you want
• Alerts on your phone when your favorite fish should be biting

KNOW YOUR FISH
• Snap a photo and Fishing Frenzy guesses what you caught
• Guides to 30 Texas freshwater fish, with sizes, limits and how to catch them
• Fill your fish collection book, one kind at a time

12 SPOTS AROUND SAN ANGELO
Lake Nasworthy, Twin Buttes, O.C. Fisher, O.H. Ivie, E.V. Spence, the Concho River and more, with maps and tips.

FISH WITH FRIENDS
• Post your catches as real proof. Posts show the spot, never your exact location
• Add friends with a friend code and start catch-off challenges
• Earn badges and Fishing Points, dress up your fisher and decorate your fishing room
• Fun games for slow days

BUILT FOR KIDS
• No chat or direct messages
• Report or block anyone. A grown-up reviews every report
• Shop links sit behind a parent check
• No ads

Made in San Angelo, Texas.

name: Dreamland Scope
description:
Dreamland Control, Groom Lake sector. Your shift: an 80-mile scope, a fast sweep, and fourteen tracks that are not going to identify themselves.

Tap a blip. Work the sensors — height, radar cross-section, ESM emitter, IFF reply — then make the call: USAF, Allied visitor, Skunk Works, or Civil, and name the type from the recognition card dated 14 JUN 95. An SR-71 at FL800 doing Mach 3 is easy. A silent contact painting smaller than a bird is not. And if a track fits no line on the card… you know what to do.

Wrong group — or a track that slips off your scope untagged — is a strike. Four strikes and you are relieved of the console.

IDENTIFY
• 24 listed types: F-15C, F-16C, B-52H, B-1B, B-2A, KC-135R, E-3B, the Janet 737, A-10A, Tornado, Jaguar, CF-18, F-4F, F-111C, Mirage 2000, F-117A, U-2S, SR-71A, RQ-3A DarkStar — plus five civil randos who were not invited, and one contact that is not on the card
• Real identification work: speed, altitude, RCS, emitter and IFF profiles overlap on purpose — combine them
• Stealth is a budget, not a cloak: every sensor read and every intercept burns a low-observable's hide effort, until it paints like an airplane
• Low tracks drop into canyon terrain shadow and go dark

GET EYES ON IT
• Dispatch fighters, drones and satellites — the odds follow the physics (nothing with wings catches an SR-71)
• Satellite passes file imagery frames of what they find
• Thermal taskings plus a live satellite thermal feed hold a stealth track's heat: heat is not an ID, but it keeps the hunt alive

GET PROMOTED, GET TOYS
• Five career ranks, Trainee to Master Controller, unlocking amber and ice scopes, the 18-track Veteran Shift and the Skunk-heavy Black Shift
• Earn SUSTAINMENT and spend it with Chad at Meridian Dynamics: a five-rung radar ladder from the stock AN/FPS-20 to the GHOST EYE prototype array, plus processor, receiver and track-assist modules

THE CONSOLE
• A fully synthesized soundscape — room tone, sweep blips pitched by radar cross-section, radio squelch — generated live; there are no audio files
• Free. No account, no ads, no in-app purchases, no data collected. Plays completely offline

name: Drillmarine: Digging & Mining
description:
Pilot a drill submarine into the seabed. Dig tunnels, fill your hold with ore and gems, and get back to the dock before the air runs out.

Drillmarine is a digging and mining adventure under the sea. Every dive is a choice: one more vein of gold, or turn back while you still can? Sell what you bring home, upgrade your submarine, and go deeper than the crew before you ever did.

DIG, HAUL, RETURN
• Swipe to steer and dig in any direction: down, sideways, even back up.
• Watch three limits: oxygen, cargo space and hull.
• Run out of air and the rescue takes half your load. Make it home and everything is sold for you at the dock.
• The tunnels you dig stay open. Today's shaft is tomorrow's shortcut.

UPGRADE YOUR SUBMARINE
• Five upgrade lines: Oxygen, Motor, Cargo, Drill and Hull.
• Six modules, from Ore Sonar and Strong Lamp to Heat Shield and Collector.
• Harder rock needs a better drill, and your submarine changes its look as it grows.

FIVE ZONES, ONE LOST RESEARCH LINE
Travel from the Shallows through Broken Ridge, the Old Mine and the Black Vein down to the Deep Archive, 1,200 m below the surface. Open sealed bulkheads, reach five stations and start your next dives from them, and steer clear of thermal vents, corrosive water and electric arcs. Thirty missions and twelve recovered records tell what happened to the crew that built the line.

22 ORES AND GEMS
Copper, iron, silver and gold near the surface. Titanium, ruby, cobalt, iridium and diamond further down. The rarest stones wait below the story.

THE DEEP LINE HAS NO BOTTOM
When the story ends, the shaft keeps going. Every new band brings its own gem, tougher ground and a rule of its own: high pressure, currents, dark water, acid pockets, geodes and more. Earn deep gear such as the Echo Probe, the Bore, the Air Buoy and the Pulse Shield, and push your upgrades past tier V.

A REASON TO DIVE EVERY DAY
A daily reward, three daily contracts with a chest, captain levels, and ore that grows back in the zones you have reached.

FAIR BY DESIGN
• No ads.
• No energy bar and no wait timers. Dive as often as you like.
• No account. Plays offline, no Wi-Fi needed.
• iPhone and iPad. 9 languages.

Drillmarine is free to play and the whole story is free. Optional in-app purchases (pearls and a one-time starter pack) pay for dive supplies such as oxygen tanks and repair kits; pearls are also earned by playing. Prices are shown by the App Store before you buy, and you can turn off in-app purchases in Screen Time.

Questions or ideas? Write to bayrambas255@icloud.com
Privacy Policy: https://bayrambas255.github.io/drillmarine-support/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://bayrambas255.github.io/drillmarine-support/terms/

name: DrillSolver: Drilling Formulas
description:
Every drilling formula. Solve for anything.

Fill in what you know, leave one box blank, and DrillSolver works it out. Kill mud, MAASP, ECD, kick tolerance, cement tops, bit hydraulics, minimum curvature — 123 formulas, and every one runs in every direction. Know the kill weight and want the depth? Leave TVD blank. No rearranging on the back of a tally sheet.

Built by a wellsite supervisor who got tired of doing it on the phone's calculator.

SOLVE ANY WAY
• Any box can be the unknown, not just the answer
• Plain-English reasons when inputs can't be real — "the mud is already heavier than the shoe can hold" — instead of a junk number
• A heads-up when a number looks fat-fingered, like 12000 for 1200
• Notes on each formula's limits, like laminar-only or single-bubble methods

KILL SHEETS
• Wait & Weight, Driller's, Volumetric, Lubricate & Bleed and Bullheading
• Kill mud, ICP, FCP, strokes and time to bit and surface, MAASP before and after
• Step-down schedule and pressure chart, vertical or deviated (KOP and EOB)
• String and annulus sections, saved on the well
• Ballooning check: flowback or bleed-off readings tell you if it's tapering off or a kick
• LOT / FIT: test pressure for a FIT, leak-off EMW from a LOT, plotted with the bend picked for you
• Copy or share the whole sheet as text

A CALCULATOR WORTH KEEPING OPEN
• Big keys, basic or full scientific
• Your own amber constant keys: 0.00981, 0.0007854/1000, whatever you use
• Repeat equals: 2 + 2 = = = keeps adding 2
• Run any formula from the calculator and send the answer back
• Keyboard support on iPad and Mac

YOUR WELL, READY TO GO
• Pick the well you're on and every number you solve with is saved to it
• Shoe depth, TVD, mud weight and leak-off fill straight into the next formula
• Old numbers turn orange so you double-check them
• A history of every calc on every well

YOUR UNITS
• Canadian metric (kPa, kg/m³, m)
• Metric with bar and SG
• US oilfield (psi, ppg, ft)
• Change any single quantity, or switch units box by box
• Field constants from Canadian well control sheets, or exact ones

12 CATEGORIES
Well Control · Kill Sheet · Hydraulics · Bit Hydraulics · MPD · Mud · Cementing · Directional · Tripping · Volumes · Drill String · Drilling Performance

FREE AND PRO

name: Drybox: Filament Dryer
description:
Is your filament dry yet? Drybox answers that question.

Wet filament causes stringing, bubbles, weak layers and rough surfaces. A drybox helps, but a hygrometer reading on its own doesn't tell you much. Is 22% good? Is the box still drying, or has it gone as low as it can?

Drybox works it out for you. Log the box and room conditions from your hygrometer, and Drybox compares each reading with the lowest humidity your box can reach by heating the room air. The gap between the two is the moisture still coming out of your filament and desiccant. As it shrinks, you know the dry is almost done. If your room is too humid, Drybox can show you and you may decide to dry another day. 

KNOW WHERE YOUR DRY STANDS
Each reading gets a clear status:
• Humidity rising: something is adding moisture
• Still drying: the filament and desiccant are still releasing water
• Levelling off: progress is slowing
• Near minimum: about as dry as your box can get

SEE THE WHOLE DRY
An interactive chart shows every reading against the lowest humidity your box can reach. Touch and drag to inspect any point and watch the remaining moisture band narrow over time.

CHECK IT WITHOUT OPENING THE APP
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show current box humidity, the lowest possible and your status at a glance
• A Live Activity keeps your drying session on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island

NEVER FORGET A READING
Set a reminder and Drybox will notify you when it's time to log the next reading. Reminders repeat until you log again.

KEEP A HISTORY
Every session is saved, so you can look back at past drying runs and see how long each filament took.

Works with any drybox, filament dryer or sealed storage bin, and any hygrometer. Great for PLA, PETG, TPU, nylon, ABS, ASA and other filaments that absorb moisture.

name: Duo Buddy: Silly Screen Desk
description:
Duo Buddy turns the phone on your desk into a little friend with eyes. Put it down and Buddy wakes up, looks at you, keeps time, guards your focus and dozes off when you leave.

• Focus timer that pauses itself when you walk away and resumes when you sit back down

• Plug in the charger and it sighs with relief. At 100% it is happily full
• Squishy buttons, cute sounds and gentle haptics

MAKE IT YOURS
• 22 eye styles in six themes: cute, animals, fantasy, retro, sci-fi and minimal. From Kawaii and Puppy to Dragon, Galaxy and Neon
• Choose what shows on your desk: drag, reorder, add or remove widgets
• Give your buddy its own name

GREAT ON IPHONE DUO, IPHONE AND IPAD
Buddy fits the folded and the unfolded screen of iPhone Duo, and works great on any iPhone or iPad on a stand, in portrait or landscape.

name: Ebb: Read Along & Listen
description:
Ebb lines your audiobook up with the ebook, right on your iPhone, so you can read along word by word. Or listen in the car and keep reading from the sentence you heard last.

READ ALONG
The sentence being read glows softly and the spoken word follows the narrator, even at 1.5x speed. Set the highlight to bold or underline, or turn it off. Works with your own EPUB, MOBI, MP3 and M4B files.

PICK UP MID-SENTENCE

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Ebb listens to the narration on your device and matches it to the text. Your books never leave your phone. No account. No ads. No tracking.

A SERIOUS E-READER
Paper, Sepia and Night themes, your own fonts, margins and spacing. Atkinson Hyperlegible and OpenDyslexic built in, plus Focus mode. Pages or scroll. Highlights, notes and bookmarks. Search the whole book and define any word.

A SERIOUS AUDIOBOOK PLAYER

SPEED READ AND WATERFALL

MADE FOR FOLDABLES

FREE TO READ AND LISTEN

name: EcoBilling
Egg Bandit
description:

FREE TO TRY, ONE PURCHASE FOR THE REST
The first 10 heists, on Sunny Meadow and Red Barn Farm, are free to try. One purchase, the Full Unlock, opens Moonlight Farm, Haystack Hill and 10 more heists, for all 20.

HOW TO SNEAK
- Push into the fence to dig a tunnel under it.
- Grab eggs from the nests. Your sack holds three, and a full sack slows you down.
- Stay out of the hens' yellow sight cones. If a hen spots you, the rooster comes running!
- Caught? Bandit pops back to his den with the eggs he's already banked. Run out of tries and just try again. Nothing is lost.

CLEVER TRICKS
- Hide in tall corn and loose haystacks.
- Throw a pebble and the hens wander over to see what the noise was.
- Drop a smoke puff to slip away from the rooster.
- Put on a hen costume and walk right past them. Bawk?

FOUR FARMS, TWENTY HEISTS
Sunny Meadow teaches you one trick at a time. Red Barn Farm has marching hens and two henhouses. Moonlight Farm turns out the lights. Haystack Hill brings Biscuit the sleepy farm dog, a squeaky gate, muddy lanes and a big basket of eggs.

NO RUSH
No clocks. Take as long as you like. Earn stars by staying out of trouble: one for winning the heist, one for never getting caught, and one for keeping the rooster from ever chasing you.

MADE FOR FAMILIES
- No ads.
- Gentle, silly and never scary.
- Stuck? A hint on the pause card shows every hen's path.
- No chat, no accounts, plays offline. Nothing random for sale.
- A big floating joystick and big buttons. Volume, mute and reduce motion in Settings.
- The Full Unlock, Restore Purchases and outside links sit behind a grown-up check.

Made by Seventh Anvil Games, the makers of Polar Bears vs. Warthogs.

name: El Buen Fin Economía
seller_name: INFOTEC, Centro de Investigacion e Innovacion en Tecnologias de la Informacion y Comunicacion
description:
¡Aprovecha la fiesta comercial más grande de México con la aplicación oficial de El Buen Fin!

Diseñada para ayudarte a realizar compras inteligentes, seguras y al mejor precio, esta app te permite explorar miles de ofertas, promociones y descuentos exclusivos en comercios y establecimientos participantes de todo el país.

Características principales:

Buscador de promociones: Encuentra productos, servicios y marcas participantes cerca de ti o en línea.

Geolocalización y mapas: Ubica fácilmente las tiendas físicas inscritas a El Buen Fin en tu zona.

Comercio seguro: Consulta únicamente establecimientos formales registrados en el portal oficial.

Favoritos y comparador: Guarda tus ofertas preferidas y planifica tus compras con anticipación.

Información al consumidor: Accede a recomendaciones de PROFECO para compras seguras y consejos para evitar fraudes.

Descarga la app y no te pierdas ningún descuento en este Buen Fin.

name: Eldravin
description:
At a core box, the question is often whether two short pieces belong together. Eldravin keeps that decision beside the original measurements, so a reviewer can see why a qualifying length changed without confusing it with the amount of core recovered.

Create a borehole and a run, record the drilled interval, and declare the sound-core threshold and equality convention. Measure each original piece in box order, including short fragments. Keep the box, tray slot, direction, measurer and optional photograph with its record. Original entry units and precision are retained; changing display units does not create another observation.

Use the piece references to inspect a measurement or propose a review with its neighbour. A mechanical join needs matching ends, written evidence and a reviewer. A natural boundary stays separate. The ledger exposes qualifying length, recovered length and drilled advance individually. For several runs, proportions use summed lengths rather than an average that gives short and long runs equal weight.

The labelled teaching box gives you a checkable example: 1500 mm drilled, 1350 mm recovered and 900 mm initially qualifying. Accept the supported 70 + 60 mm mechanical join and RQD changes from 60% to 68.67%, while recovery stays at 1350 mm. An unfinished measurement is distinct from confirmed zero recovery. Unresolved boundaries prevent a signed handover.

Correct a measurement with a reason and inspect its earlier source version. Freeze a reviewed run to retain the hole, pieces, method and boundary evidence as they stood at handover. Later corrections do not rewrite that frozen record. Share a paginated PDF, preserve structured JSON, import an independent copy, or export the original pieces as CSV. Photographs remain local and are excluded from those handover files.

The field book works without an account. English and Chinese interfaces include separate teaching text. Feedback prepares a local file for the recipient you choose through system sharing; it is not sent automatically. Eldravin organises entered measurements under a declared method. It does not take instrument readings or certify ground conditions.

An unreadable working archive stays protected until an independent byte-for-byte copy is verified and you confirm starting a new book.

name: Elementory BioWave
description:
Elementory BioWave combines the interactive Elementory Periodic Table & Chemical Harmonic Synthesizer with a multimodal Bio-Acoustic and Vital Waveform Laboratory.

Key Features:
• Elementory Core: Transform any name or chemical formula (H2O, NaCl, CH4, etc.) into atomic numbers, orbital diagrams, bond characteristics, and harmonic musical notes.
• Wave Laboratory: Emit precision pure tones, linear/logarithmic acoustic chirps, and bio-ion chords while capturing real-time microphone return waveforms, spectral peaks, and echo time-of-flight.
• Experimental Optical & Acoustic Labs: Explore fingertip camera photoplethysmography (PPG) waveforms, acoustic respiration periodicity, coherent breathing guides, and volumetric body-geometry ranges with explicit reference comparators and signal-quality failure gates.
• Validated Health & Sensor Hub: Log and track blood pressure, oxygen saturation (SpO2), authorized glucose readings, and body mass with strict data provenance separation and persistent checksum verification.

Disclaimer: Elementory BioWave is designed for educational, experimental, and general wellness purposes only and is not a medical device.

name: Elite Force Lite
description:
Elite Force Lite es la versión gratuita de Elite Force, una herramienta para magos y mentalistas que actúan de cerca.

Efectos incluidos en la Lite:
• Una carta pensada que ya estaba escrita en tus notas.
• Una foto que aparece en tu galería con la fecha que dice el espectador.
• Una llamada en la que una voz nombra la carta elegida.

Cada efecto se prepara antes de la actuación, en privado. Durante el juego, el teléfono se comporta como cualquier otro.

Gratis y para siempre: no caduca, no tiene anuncios, funciona sin conexión a internet y no recopila ningún dato.

¿Quieres más? Elite Force, la versión completa, añade muchos más efectos: números, fechas y horas que alguien elige al azar y que tú habías predicho, listas en las que el espectador elige con total libertad (o eso cree él) y nuevas rutinas en cada actualización.

Incluye una guía que explica cada efecto paso a paso. Los métodos solo se cuentan dentro de la app, para proteger el secreto.

name: ELtender
description:
ELtender — помощник поставщика в государственных закупках Кыргызской Республики.

Все тендеры в одном месте
Приложение собирает объявления с трёх порталов госзакупок (zakupki.gov.kg, goszakupki.okmot.kg и Портал ЭГЗ) и показывает их в одной ленте. Поиск по номеру, названию, заказчику и товару, фильтры по региону, сумме и способу закупки.

ИИ отбирает подходящие тендеры
Опишите, чем занимается ваша компания, — ИИ оценит каждое новое объявление и покажет, почему тендер вам подходит. Подписки на ключевые слова и уведомления о новых закупках.

Цены и документы
• Заполнение цен по лотам с надбавками и подсказками из базы ваших товаров
• Выгрузка ценового предложения в Excel и PDF
• Подбор документов к требованиям заказчика: устав, свидетельство, баланс, договоры опыта
• Письма и формы с вашими реквизитами, печатью и подписью
• Техническая спецификация предлагаемого товара по ТЗ заказчика

Заявки под контролем
Доска заявок по этапам: найдено, подготовка, подано, итог, поставка, отчёты, оплата. Итоги тендеров подтягиваются с порталов автоматически.

Для компаний и агентств
Несколько компаний в одном аккаунте, сотрудники с ролями, запросы клиентам по ссылке.

ELtender — продукт ELBAGAR.

name: Emberhop Caverns
description:
# Enter the World of Emberhop Caverns!

Get ready for an exciting pixel-art platforming adventure in Emberhop Caverns, where dangerous caves, mysterious forests, and challenging enemies await!

Take control of a brave armored adventurer and explore beautifully crafted fantasy environments. Jump across platforms, avoid deadly traps, battle dangerous creatures, and collect valuable gems as you make your way through each level.

ADVENTURE AWAITS

Explore different levels filled with obstacles, enemies, hidden challenges, and exciting environments.

COLLECT PRECIOUS GEMS

Gather sparkling gems throughout your journey and discover the rewards waiting for you.

MAGICAL POWER-UPS

Discover useful potions and protective abilities to help you survive dangerous encounters.

FACE DANGEROUS ENEMIES

Watch out for goblins and other creatures standing between you and victory.

EXPLORE PIXEL-ART WORLDS

Experience colorful fantasy environments featuring underground caverns, mysterious forests, glowing crystals, and detailed pixel-art landscapes.

TEST YOUR SKILLS

Master your jumps, avoid spikes, overcome obstacles, and see how far your adventurer can go.

Your adventure starts now!

Enter Emberhop Caverns and prove yourself as a true cave explorer!

name: Empire TMS
description:
Empire TMS is the driver app for Empire Trucking Corp drivers and owner-operators.

Sign in with the cell number and PIN you set up, and dispatch links your login to your truck. From then on, every load dispatch gives you shows up on your phone.

FOR EACH LOAD YOU CAN
- See every pickup and delivery stop, in order, with addresses, dates and appointment times
- Get directions to the next stop in one tap
- Mark the load Picked up and Delivered, so dispatch knows right away
- Undo a status if you tapped it by mistake
- Take a photo of the signed BOL or POD, or pick one from your photos, and send it straight to dispatch

No more texting pictures of paperwork or calling in every update. Dispatch sees it the moment you send it, and you get paid faster.

This app is for drivers working with Empire Trucking Corp. You need a login linked by our dispatch team to see loads.

name: Entech SM
description:
Entech SM is the social media panel for newsrooms, news portals and businesses working with Entech.al.

Pick an article from your portal or share a video straight from your phone's gallery. Entech SM builds a 9:16 reel with your logo, colours, animated headline and music, and publishes it at once to Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, X, LinkedIn, Threads, Telegram, Pinterest and Bluesky.

• Photo Reels from your WordPress articles
• Video Reels: share a video from Photos to Entech SM and it opens ready in the panel
• Branded templates: font, colours, logo, frames
• One tap, ten networks: post now, schedule or save as draft
• Instagram Story and article link as first comment
• History and "Post route": see per network whether it went out, the link, and the reason if it failed, with a Retry button
• Built-in assistant and direct contact with Entech support
• Team roles: admin and agents

Accounts are created by Entech.al for each newsroom or business. Entech connects your social networks for you.

Support: +355 69 546 0000 · socialmedia.entech.al

name: Entre nous – Lettres d'amour
description:
Entre nous, c’est une correspondance secrète, rien que pour vous deux.

Écrivez-vous comme autrefois : de vraies lettres, sur papier vergé ou rose poudré, à la plume, à l’encre bleu nuit ou bordeaux, scellées d’un cachet de cire à vos initiales. Quand l’autre la reçoit, il ou elle brise le cachet, l’enveloppe s’ouvre, et l’encre apparaît mot après mot.

DES LETTRES, ET TOUT LE RESTE
• Mots doux, photos façon polaroïd, vidéos et messages vocaux
• Battements de cœur : un geste, et son iPhone bat au rythme du vôtre
• Un cœur sur un message d’un double-tap
• L’écritoire : 6 papiers, 6 encres, 6 plumes, des cachets et des fleurs séchées

DÉLIVRÉES AU BON MOMENT
• Tout de suite, ou à la date choisie : son anniversaire, votre premier rendez-vous…
• Capsule : l’enveloppe scellée attend, avec son compte à rebours
• Surprise : rien n’apparaît avant le jour J
• « Ouvre quand… » : quand tu n’arrives pas à dormir, quand je te manque, quand on s’est disputé·es
• Le contenu reste scellé sur le serveur jusqu’à l’heure dite : impossible de tricher

VOTRE HISTOIRE À DEUX
• Le compteur de vos jours ensemble
• Le compte à rebours de vos retrouvailles
• Vos dates importantes, rappelées chaque année
• Une boîte à souvenirs pour toutes vos photos

RIEN QUE VOUS DEUX
• Chiffrement de bout en bout : vos clés secrètes ne quittent jamais vos téléphones
• Un sceau secret de six symboles pour vérifier que personne ne s’est glissé entre vous
• Les enveloppes sont effacées du serveur dès qu’elles sont relevées
• Verrouillage par Face ID. Ni publicité, ni traceur.

Pour commencer : connectez-vous avec Apple, invitez votre amour avec un code, et écrivez-vous.
Envie de découvrir d’abord ? Essayez avec un·e partenaire imaginaire.

name: EP ToploPlan
description:
EP ToploPlan calculates the heat loss and the cooling load of a home – room by room – and shows the heating and cooling capacity you need in kW.

Answer a few simple questions about the property, the walls, windows, floor and roof, and the app does the engineering for you. It is made for homeowners, installers and HVAC engineers.

HEATING
• Heat loss of every room and of the whole building
• Transmission, ventilation and reheat losses
• Recommended heat pump or boiler size with margin
• Climate data for Bulgaria and many cities in Europe and worldwide

COOLING
• Cooling load room by room, hour by hour
• Sun through windows, shading, blinds, curtains and overhangs
• People, lighting and appliances
• Each room at its own peak hour; the building at the common peak

UNDERFLOOR HEATING
• Water temperature 35/30, 40/35 or 45/40 °C
• Pipe 16×2, 17×2 or 20×2 mm, screed, base board and insulation
• Pipe spacing, pipe length and number of loops for every room
• Floor surface temperature check

REPORT
• Detailed tables for the client and the engineer
• Save as PDF, print or share
• Projects stay on your device and work offline

LANGUAGES
Bulgarian, English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Russian, Turkish, Romanian, Greek and Chinese.

SUBSCRIPTION
Entering your project is free. To see the results and the PDF report you need an EP ToploPlan Pro subscription – monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://eppetkovi.com/toploplan/privacy

The results are for information purposes. Developed by EP Petkovi EOOD.

name: Epic Sudoku PvP - Battle
description:
Sudoku is better with friends. Create a game, share a 6-letter code, and play on the same board in real time — every move shows up instantly for everyone.

FOUR WAYS TO PLAY

Score together — one board, +1 for every correct digit, −1 for a mistake. Who tops the leaderboard?
Race — everyone gets the same puzzle on their own board. First to finish wins.
Just together — solve as a team with no score, hints included.
Solo — classic sudoku that works fully offline.

FOUR LEVELS Easy, Medium, Hard and Expert. Every puzzle has exactly one solution and is graded by the techniques it needs.

THREE LOOKS

Midnight — deep dark glass with glowing digits and fireworks.
Air — clean and bright with huge type.
Notebook — graph paper and handwritten digits.

MADE FOR PLAYING

Up to 8 players in one game
Pencil notes, hints and a smart number pad that shows what’s left
Wrong digits are rejected with a shake — no ruined boards
Rematch everyone in one tap
English, Russian and Uzbek

No accounts, no ads, no tracking.

name: EquationClash
description:
Build an equation from your cards, hide it, and make everyone guess wrong.

EquationClash is a strategy card game where math meets bluffing. Every number card counts, every operator changes the story, and the best equation is the one your opponents can't read.

QUICK CLASH
• Build a 2- or 3-number equation from your hand and play it face-down
• Everyone else calls it: Higher or Lower than the last result?
• A right call scores 10; fool them and you score 5 for each
• Tied at the end? Sudden death until one player is out

GRAND CLASH
• Get 1 hidden and 2 open number cards, then swap one for a fresh card or keep your hand
• A 4th card arrives: now build your equations
• Use all 4 numbers with your +, − and ÷ to aim at 20 (High) or 1 (Low)
• Bonus × and √ cards change everything
• Secretly declare High, Low or Swing, then reveal together
• Ties go to the best colour card: Gold, Silver, Bronze, Black
• Win a side for 10 points, sweep both with a Swing for 25
• Play first to 50 points, or for 5, 10 or 15 rounds

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Online: real-time matches with friends on their own phones (up to 4 players in Quick Clash, 6 in Grand Clash). Join with a room code or QR code, or use quick match
• Vs Computer: Easy, Medium or Hard opponents, fully offline
• Practice: a coach explains every move so you learn the strategy
• Assist: switch on odds, suggested moves and a best-equation hint whenever you want help

PROGRESS
• Earn XP, climb from Bronze to Master, and collect 20 badges

Free, with no ads, no purchases and no account needed.

Privacy policy: https://equationclash.mhfhijab.com/privacy.html

name: EquiCadence
description:
EquiCadence turns your iPhone into a gait analysis tool for horses. Film your horse from the side and see how it moves, with its skeleton drawn over the picture and the numbers beside it.

SEE THE MOVEMENT
• Use the live camera or any recorded video
• Walk, trot and canter recognised automatically
• Speed, stride length and stride rate
• Head and pelvis symmetry at trot, and which leg to look at
• Footfall timeline and time on the ground for each leg

FILM IT WELL
• Live tips while you film: move closer, hold steady, wait for side-on
• Practice mode: rehearse with a virtual horse before you go to the yard
• Works on the lunge as well as in a straight line
• A built-in guide explains every measurement and its usual range

TRACK EVERY HORSE
• A log for each horse, with charts over time
• Marks a measurement when it changes from that horse's usual
• Export one session or a whole history as an Excel spreadsheet

PRIVATE
Everything is analysed on your iPhone. No account, and your videos are never uploaded.

EquiCadence is a screening aid. It can point at a leg worth a closer look; it cannot diagnose an injury. If your horse looks or feels wrong, call your vet.

name: Érudit – Culture G
description:
Chaque jour a son histoire. Érudit te la raconte en une minute.
Tous les matins, découvre ce qui s'est passé à la même date au fil des siècles : une bataille qui a changé le monde, un chef-d'œuvre, la naissance d'une star ou une grande découverte.
4 MOMENTS PAR JOUR 
• Histoire, Art, Divertissement et Science 
• Plus de 1 400 moments, un pour chaque catégorie et chaque jour de l'année 
• Une fiche claire : l'essentiel en une phrase, le récit complet, puis Wikipédia pour aller plus loin

DES PORTRAITS QUI FONT UN CLIN D'ŒIL 
Les grands personnages du passé prennent vie : leur portrait d'époque te fait un clin d'œil.

DES WIDGETS POUR TON ÉCRAN D'ACCUEIL 
• L'événement du jour, en petit, moyen ou grand format 
• « Les 4 du jour » pour tout voir d'un coup 
• Un widget pour l'écran verrouillé

TES CENTRES D'INTÉRÊT 
Choisis tes catégories préférées : chaque jour, Érudit tire au sort le moment à la une parmi ta sélection.

DES QUIZ POUR RETENIR 
• Chaque dimanche, un quiz sur les fiches lues dans la
semaine 
• Un quiz en fin de mois et un grand quiz le 31 décembre

SUIS TES PROGRÈS 
• Ta série de jours d'affilée 
• Ta frise du temps, qui se remplit à
chaque fiche lue, de l'Antiquité à aujourd'hui 
• Tes favoris, un calendrier et la recherche dans toute l'année

Sans compte, sans publicité, et sans collecte de données.

name: Escrinio
description:
O Escrínio é um cofre só neste iPhone. Guarde fotos, vídeos originais (incluindo 4K HEVC e Dolby Vision), senhas, cartões, contatos, notas e sites.

Desbloqueie com PIN numérico, padrão ou Face ID opcional. Um segundo PIN abre um cofre vazio, se você quiser.

Os arquivos entram como estão, sem recomprimir. O player é interno. Exportar para o app Fotos só acontece quando você confirma.

Não há conta, nuvem nem análise. A chave fica no Keychain deste aparelho. Apagar o app apaga o cofre. Não há recuperação de PIN.

name: ESG QuickShop Monitor
description:
ESG QuickShop Monitor is the mobile companion of the QuickShop retail system. It gives shop owners and staff a quick view of the business, and tools for daily work on the shop floor.

IMPORTANT: The app works only with an account that your employer created in QuickShop. You cannot register in the app. If you do not have an account, ask the owner or manager of your shop.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

Monitor
- See sales and turnover for the shop, the market and the bar.
- Open invoices and see the details of each one.
- See fiscal invoices and deleted invoices.
- Read the shift closing report.

Work on the shop floor
- Scan a barcode to check the price and the stock of an article.
- Record goods that arrive from a supplier (purchase invoice).
- Count the shelf stock (inventory check).
- See the articles of a supplier.

Stay informed
- Get a notice when a new document arrives (when your shop enables it).
- See when a newer version of the app is available.

Print
- Print reports on your 80 mm, 58 mm or A4 printer, or share them as a PDF.

LANGUAGES
English, Albanian, Italian, Croatian, Greek, Macedonian and Serbian.

PRIVACY
Your employer is the controller of your shop data. The app sends crash reports and screen usage statistics to Google Firebase. These are linked to a random installation identifier, not to your name, your shop or your sales. Read the full policy at https://www.esg.al/privacy.html

SUPPORT
Questions or problems? Write to info@esg.al

name: Eshune
description: Eshune is an offline notebook for a rectangular cross-stitch grid. Divide the stitches by the fabric count and add a margin on each side. Multiply the stitches by the inches of floss you type, turn that into yards, and round the skein count up. A round hoop is sized from the cloth diagonal. A skein splits by the strands you put in the needle. Several colors can share the same skein count.

name: eSIM Travel – Mobile Data
description:
Get mobile data for your trip before you pack. With eSIM Travel, you can compare prepaid plans for more than 190 destinations, buy and install your eSIM on your iPhone, and see how much data you have left while you're away.

Find a plan that fits your itinerary
Spending a week in Japan or crossing borders in Europe? Search by country for a single stop, or open a regional plan to see which destinations it covers. Compare data, validity and price side by side. Where unlimited plans are available, check the daily high-speed allowance before you choose.

Buy and top up in the app
Pay at secure checkout with Apple Pay, PayPal or card, without leaving the app. Running low on data? Top up the eSIM you already have, right from the app.

Set up before departure
Open your purchased eSIM in the app and follow the installation steps over Wi-Fi. You can also install it by scanning the QR code in your delivery email. At your destination, select your travel eSIM for cellular data and keep your usual SIM in place.

Know what's left
Open Usage to check your remaining gigabytes, how much you've used and how many days are left on a fixed-data plan. If you have several eSIMs, select the one you want to check.

To use a travel eSIM, you'll need an eSIM-compatible, carrier-unlocked iPhone. Coverage and activation timing depend on the plan you choose.

name: Estrai! with Mago Benny Boy
description:
Make every draw a little magical!

Estrai! with Benny Boy the Magician is a fun random picker and team organizer for parties, classrooms, family games and Tombola nights.

DRAW NAMES
• Add names one by one or paste a list.
• Pick participants at random, with optional no-repeat draws.
• Enjoy a drumroll and a cheerful reveal sound.

CREATE TEAMS
• Split participants into balanced random teams.
• Rename teams to make every game your own.
• Add or remove points and view the live standings.

TOMBOLA & NUMBERS
• Use your personal interactive Tombola card for free.
• With PRO, draw numbers and follow the 1–90 board.
• Create, share and print Tombola cards and team sheets as PDFs.

FREE & PRO
The free edition supports up to 5 names and team participants plus a free personal Tombola card. Estrai! PRO permanently unlocks number draws, the Tombola board, unlimited names and team participants, and advanced PDF tools. Pay once, with no subscription.

Your lists and results are saved on your device. Estrai! works offline and requires no account.

Ready for the next magical draw?

name: Evimero
description:
**Welcome to Evimero Wellness Club!**

Discover a new approach to wellness, recovery, and performance with the Evimero app. Located in Tampa, Florida, Evimero Wellness Club is a private membership community dedicated to helping you feel better, move better, and live better.

name: Examen Civique Facile – Quiz
description:
Get ready for the French civics exam with clear explanations in your own language.

Examen Civique Facile helps you train for the French civics exam (examen civique), required since January 1, 2026 for the multi-year residence permit (CSP), the resident card (CR) and naturalization. Pick your path, enter your exam date, and study at your own pace, a few minutes a day.

WHY YOU CAN TRUST IT
• 646 questions, each with a simple explanation and its source.
• The 516 knowledge questions come from the official list published by the French Ministry of the Interior (Etalab 2.0 licence).
• The 130 situational questions are original practice exercises. They are labelled as unofficial in the app.
• The date of the last question-bank update is shown in the app.
• The real rules: 40 questions, 45 minutes, 32 correct answers to pass.

INDEPENDENT APP
Examen Civique Facile is not an official app. It is not affiliated with any government body, including the French Ministry of the Interior or any préfecture. Before paying for the exam or filing an application, always check the official pages.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
• Questions, answers and explanations translated into Arabic, English, Spanish, Portuguese and Turkish.
• Listen to each question in French and in your language (depending on the voices installed on your iPhone).
• Interface translated into these languages, with Arabic displayed right to left.
• The real exam is in French only: the translation is there to help you understand.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

description:
