• Light and dark themes, VoiceOver support.

Share any flower from your garden as a card and let your friends grow their own.

name: Fillr-die Einkaufslistenapp
description:
Fillr is your smart shopping list – simple, fast and clear.

LIST
• Add, check off and delete items quickly
• Remove completed items with one tap

PRICES
• Enter prices per store – e.g. Lidl, Aldi, Rewe, Edeka, Kaufland, Penny, Netto and dm
• Estimated prices from reference values and other Fillr users
• See your total at a glance
• Store comparison: where is your shopping cheapest?

SHOP TOGETHER
• Create a group and invite family, roommates or friends with a code
• Everyone sees the same list – live on all devices
• See who added each item

HANDY
• Open nearby stores and weekly deals with one tap
• Three themes: Light, Dark and Christmas
• German and English

No account needed – just open and start.

name: Film Dev Timer
description:
Film Dev Timer times every bath of a film development run and tells you exactly when to agitate.

LOAD A PROCESS
• CineStill Cs41 (C-41), Cs2 (ECN-2) and Df96 (B&W monobath), straight from CineStill's own charts, with push and pull.
• Published processes from Kodak, Ilford, Tetenal, Bellini, Arista, Rollei and Flic Film: C-41, E-6, ECN-2 and black & white.
• Your own presets: choose the chemistry, then every step, time, agitation and note. Start from scratch or from a copy of any preset.

SET THE TEMPERATURE, GET THE TIME
• The developer time follows the maker's time/temperature chart as you change the temperature.
• Go past the chart and the app follows its curve, marks the time as an estimate, and flags the temperature: red when too hot, blue when too cold.
• Reusable kits track every roll through the batch, lengthen the developer as the chemistry wears (CineStill's +2% or +4% per roll, Tetenal's and Bellini's stepped times), and warn when the chemicals are exhausted.

A TIMER YOU CAN USE WITH WET HANDS
• A big START/STOP button, and a clear cue for every second: POUR IN, LID ON, AGITATE with spinning arrows and a dot for each inversion, REST, DUMP & REFILL for washes, and DRAIN NOW in the last 10 seconds.
• Agitation timed to your method: hand-tank inversions (your count), lift rod, or a rotary processor.
• ±10 s, skip, back and restart, with confirmations so a stray tap can't throw away your developer time.
• An alarm repeats at the end of each step until you respond, and counts how long you're over.
• The screen stays on while the app is open. Lock the phone or switch apps and the step keeps counting down on the lock screen and in the Dynamic Island, with the START/STOP button right there and time-sensitive alerts for each agitation and the end of every step.

HISTORY
• Every run is kept: date and time, preset, temperature, rolls, and every step as it went, including skips and overtime.

No account, no ads, no tracking, and no internet access: everything stays on your iPhone.

name: Fioretto: Give-Up Challenges
description:
Fioretto helps you keep a promise you made to yourself: giving something up, one day at a time.

Write down anything you want to give up (sweets, coffee, alcohol, smoking, social media or anything else), pick how many days or leave the challenge open-ended, and watch your tree grow as the days go by. You can run several challenges side by side.

WHY FIORETTO
• Your own challenges: you choose what to give up, for as long as you like or with no end date
• Several challenges at once, each with its own live counter
• An illustrated tree that grows with you through 7 stages, in 21 styles, from Sakura Zen to Phoenix, from Bamboo to Galaxy
• Ranks and experience (XP): every day you keep it up levels you up
• Milestones and badges to collect
• SOS: guided breathing and your personal reasons for moments of temptation
• My reasons: remember why you started, with text and photos
• Stats: record, average, charts and challenge history
• Risk Map: find out which days and times of day are hardest for you
• Milestone notifications and reminders
• Widgets for the Home Screen and Lock Screen
• 40 light and dark themes and alternate app icons

PRIVACY FIRST
• No account to create
• Your data stays on your device and in your private iCloud
• Face ID lock

FREE, WITH FIORETTO PLUS
The app is free and shows a small non-personalized ad banner (Google AdMob). Fioretto Plus is a one-time purchase, not a subscription: it unlocks the premium themes and trees and removes the ads forever.

A GENTLE APPROACH
If you give in, there's no judgment: the days you made stay in your history and you can start again whenever you want.

name: FIRST RENT
description:
FIRST RENT, location de voitures à Longjumeau.

L'agence est au 13 rue de la Peupleraie, 91160 Longjumeau. Vous choisissez un véhicule et des dates, puis vous préparez le dossier dans l'application.

• Sept véhicules, avec le tarif à la journée
• Choix des dates de départ et de retour
• Formulaire, pièce d'identité, permis et photo de vérification
• Contrat à lire et à signer
• Appel de l'agence au 06 76 35 19 33

La remise se fait sur rendez-vous, à l'agence. Aucun montant n'est débité dans cette version.

name: First Times: Baby Memories
description:
Capture a child's milestones and small memories as they happen (photo, date, one line), then turn each year into a printable keepsake book PDF, without a subscription or a cloud account.

What you get:
- Capture a moment in 10 seconds
- Milestones with age stamped
- Every year becomes a book
- Print it anywhere
- Pay once. Never locked out.

Free to start. One in-app purchase adds the rest, with no subscription.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

name: Fish & Blast
description:
Fish & Blast is the relaxing, addictive block puzzle… with cute round fish!

Drag the pieces onto the 8 × 8 grid. Fill a row or a column and its fish are freed and jump out of the grid. Chain combos, go for a "Squeaky clean!" and beat your high score.

LOTS OF MODES
• Adventure: hundreds of levels with 1 to 3 stars, varied goals, Bosses and new surprises up to level 200 (bubbles, treasure chests, pufferfish, jellyfish, king crab…).
• Classic: the endless game, with a monthly leaderboard.
• Duel: face a player online, the first to free 100 fish wins.
• Survival: 5 seconds to place each piece!
• Daily Challenge: a new rule every day.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• Easy to learn, hard to put down.
• No timer (except in Survival): play at your own pace.
• Clever boosters: rotate, bomb, new pieces.
• Customize your fish, your grid and your reef in the shop.
• Play offline.
• Available in 11 languages.

Resume your game anytime, share your best wins and become the king of the reef!

Fish & Blast is free to play. It contains ads and optional in-app purchases.

name: FishNora: Fishing Forecast
description:
FishNora is a personal fishing assistant that tells you where, when and what to fish for today. Weather, light, tide and moon come together in one bobber: Poor, Fair, Good or Great. And you always see why.

TODAY
• Bobber level with the reasons behind it: wind, pressure trend, sunrise and sunset, tide, moon
• The best fishing windows of the day and a short, plain-language take on conditions
• Which species the conditions favor today
• Wind, pressure, wave height and sea temperature; estimated water temperature on lakes and rivers
• Sunrise, sunset, moon phase and solunar periods (shown as a traditional indicator)

FORECAST
• 7-day outlook with a bobber level and best time for each day
• Hourly detail for today and tomorrow

TIDES
• High and low tide times, tide phase and range wherever a station is nearby
• Calculated on your phone, so it works without a connection
• Pick a different station and add a time offset for your spot
• Shows how reliable the times are, based on distance to the station

SPOTS
• Save spots by long-pressing the map or searching for a place
• Each spot gets its own bobber, tides and 7-day forecast, salt or fresh water

CATCH LOG
• Photo, species, length, weight, count, bait or rig, and notes
• Bobber, water and air temperature, wind, pressure, tide and moon at that moment are added automatically
• My fish book: species you've caught, first catches and personal bests
• Export your log as a CSV file

50 SPECIES
Largemouth and smallmouth bass, walleye, channel catfish, bluegill, striped bass, redfish, speckled trout, snook, tarpon, sheepshead, pike, trout, salmon and more. Preferred conditions plus bait and tackle tips for each one.

ASSISTANT
Ask things like "What can I catch tomorrow morning?" or "Which bait should I try?" and get answers based on your spot's conditions.

WIDGET AND NOTIFICATIONS
• Home screen widget (small and medium): bobber, best window and the next 12 hours
• Morning briefing at 7:30 AM; storm and safety alerts for strong wind and high waves
• At most 2 notifications a day, quiet hours 10 PM to 7 AM

PRIVACY
No account, no ads. Your spots, catch log and photos stay on your phone. For weather data, your location is rounded to a grid of roughly 10 km (6 miles).

PREMIUM
• Hourly forecast for all 7 days
• Unlimited spots, each with its own "good conditions" alert
• Unlimited catch log with stats on the conditions you catch in
• Chat with the assistant (3 trial questions in the free version)
The yearly plan includes a 7-day free trial, and we remind you 1 day before it ends.

13 languages, imperial and metric units, light and dark theme.

The bobber shows how favorable conditions are; it is not a catch guarantee. Tide information is not for navigation. Your safety on the water is your responsibility.

SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION
FishNora Premium is offered as auto-renewing yearly and monthly subscriptions. The 7-day free trial applies to the yearly plan only. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://fishnora.someplus.work/terms
Privacy Policy: https://fishnora.someplus.work/privacy

name: FIT IN: Draw & Pass
description:
A wall is flying toward you. Draw the shape of its hole with one finger, close the line, and pass through before time runs out.

FIT IN is a fast, one-finger reflex game with a glowing neon style:
• Draw circles, squares, triangles, stars, hexagons and more
• Four sectors: Neon Grid, Circuit Board, Hive Net and Hyperspace
• Two-hole walls, double walls and boss finales
• Three modes: Relaxed, Normal and Master
• Freeze Time and Hint power-ups
• Stars, speed bonuses and perfect-fit combos
• 3 lives, and an optional ad to continue where you left off
• Game Center leaderboards
• English and Turkish

Easy to learn, hard to master. How far can you fit in?

name: Five Second Game
description:
There is no clock on screen. Tap START, count in your head, and tap STOP when you think the target time has passed. You're scored on how many milliseconds you miss by.

Every day brings one new target between 3 and 8 seconds. Everyone gets the same one, and you get one try. Stop within 10 milliseconds for a Perfect. Then share your result and see how your friends did on the same target.

Want to warm up first? Practice is always 5 seconds, and you can play it as often as you like.

- A new daily target at midnight Pacific
- Streaks and stats, kept on your phone
- An optional daily reminder that tells you the day's target
- Haptics that make every tap land
- No account, no sign-up

5 Second Game is part of Daily Toybox, a family of small daily games from Synergy. It's free, with an occasional ad between rounds and never while you play. Remove Ads is a single purchase.

Play on the web too, at 5secondgame.com.

name: Fix My Wi-Fi
description:
Fix My Wi-Fi tells you what is wrong with your Wi-Fi in plain words, and the one thing to try. Then it shows you whether the fix helped.

No jargon, no graphs to decode, no account. It measures on your device and nothing about your network is collected.

WHAT IT TELLS YOU
• One number and one sentence: a calm score out of 100, what is holding it back, and the one thing to try.
• Which device is to blame: open the app on two of your devices and Compare tells you whether the trouble is one of them or the router.
• Where your Wi-Fi reaches: pick a floor plan, go from room to room, and tap where you are. The signal is painted across your home.
• What your connection is good for: video calls, streaming and gaming, judged by how it behaves when it is busy, not just by a speed.

ON THE MAC
The Mac app sees the most, because macOS lets it:
• Signal, background noise, your channel and your neighbors' networks.
• Whether a clearly quieter channel exists, and which one. If there isn't one, it says so.
• Whether your Wi-Fi or your internet line is the limit, after a speed test.
• Drops: when your connection went away and came back, and for how long.
• A quiet score in the menu bar.

ON IPHONE AND IPAD
Everything is free. Apple does not let any app on iPhone or iPad see signal strength, channels or neighboring networks, so the app says so plainly and measures what it can: how steadily your router answers, your speed, and the path to your other devices.

WHAT IS FREE
• iPhone and iPad: everything.
• Mac: the score, what is wrong and the thing to try, channels, speed, today's timeline, and the room survey on standard floor plans.

THE MAC UNLOCK
One payment, no subscription. It adds each fix walked through step by step with a before-and-after check, Compare, quiet alerts, your full timeline, your own floor plan picture and as many measured spots as you like.

PRIVACY
There is no account, no analytics and no advertising. A speed test connects to a public speed server. Compare talks only to your own other device on your own network. The app asks for Location only because Apple treats a Wi-Fi network's name as location data; it never reads where you are.

If your router belongs to your internet provider or landlord, Copy report gives you a plain summary to send them.

name: Flare: See Who’s Free
description:
Flare is the fastest way to turn "we should hang out sometime" into "I'm free now, come through."

LIGHT A BEACON
Free for coffee for the next two hours? Tap "I'm free now" and your friends see it instantly: what you're up for, which neighborhood you're in, and when it ends. Planning something later? Light one for this evening.

SEE WHO'S AROUND
Your radar shows which friends are free right now, sorted by how close they are. Tap a beacon to say you're coming, chat with whoever's joining, and get directions to the spot.

GONE WHEN IT'S OVER
Beacons, chats and check-ins delete themselves when the beacon ends. No feed, no history, no pressure to post.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Friends only. Nobody you haven't added can see you.
• Friends see your neighborhood, never your exact spot, unless you tap "I'm here" inside a plan.
• Send a beacon to everyone, or just one circle: roommates, the running crew, work friends.
• Block and report anyone, anytime.

ADD FRIENDS IN ONE TAP
Share your invite link in a group chat, or let a friend scan your QR code. Anyone who opens it is your friend straight away.

MORE
• Notifications when a friend lights a beacon, joins yours, or messages you
• Calendar gaps: Flare can spot free time on your calendar (times only, on your iPhone)
• Ideas for what to do, made on your iPhone
• Save spots from Instagram, TikTok or Maps with the Share button
• Widgets, Live Activities and Siri: "I'm free in Flare"

FLARE+
Optional subscription for beacon themes and unlimited circles. Everything else is free.

Terms: https://shasta02.github.io/pulse-legal/terms
Privacy: https://shasta02.github.io/pulse-legal/privacy

name: Flash Order Store Manager
description:
A companion app for staff of restaurants and stores that use the Flash Order ordering platform, to manage store orders from a phone or tablet in the branch.

Orders
• Tabs for active, today, scheduled and all orders, with a branch filter
• Order details: items, modifiers, total, payment method and prep time
• Change the order status, assign a driver and view the order history
• Delivery address on the map, and contact the customer by phone or WhatsApp
• Print orders with AirPrint, or print new orders automatically

Kitchen board
• Orders waiting to be prepared, grouped by day, with a countdown for each order

Products and branches
• Mark a product as sold out in a branch and bring it back
• Set a branch to Busy to pause new orders

Alerts
• Real-time order updates, with a sound and notification for each new order

Staff sign in with the store ID, email and password created by the store owner in the Flash Order dashboard, and each employee only sees the screens their role allows. There is no sign-up in the app. The interface is in Arabic.

name: FlipcatDash
description:
Flip, dash and dodge with the cutest cats around!

Flipcat Dash is a one-tap runner. Tap to flip your cat between the floor and the ceiling, dodge spikes, bees and spiders, and see how far you can go. Easy to learn, hard to put down.

30 LEVELS, 30 CATS
Every level you clear unlocks a new cat: tabbies, tuxedos, calicos, a galaxy cat and more. Clear 10 levels to unlock Classic mode and chase your high score.

MEET THE REAL CATS
Six cats are based on my own real cats: Miso, Mocha, Bluey, Batman, Tigger and Bingo.

FOUR WAYS TO PLAY
• Tunnel – the original wall-to-wall flip run
• Rooftops – a moonlit run with moving wind gates
• Reactor – a three-lane dodge runner with laser gates
• Mouse Chase – stay ahead of a giant mouse that's swiping at you

BOSSES AND POWER-UPS
Face bosses like the Bee Queen and the Dog King, grab power-ups, chain clean dodges for combo multipliers, and use revives to keep a great run going.

COMPETE WITH FRIENDS
Daily and weekly Game Center leaderboards, plus trophies to earn.

DRESS UP YOUR CATS
Party hats, plus Halloween, Thanksgiving and Christmas outfits that any cat can wear.

Flipcat Dash is made by one person. If you enjoy it, an optional tip helps keep new levels, cats and outfits coming.

Flipcat Dash is free to play and offers optional in-app purchases.

name: FLIPNOTE DUO
description:
A beautiful home for the things you want to remember.

FLIPNOTE DUO brings the feel of a notebook to your iPhone and iPad. Choose a colorful cover, place it on a wooden shelf, and open a fresh page for your next thought.

MAKE IT YOUR OWN
Choose from 18 cover colors. Name your shelves and organize your notebooks with Move to shelf controls. Keep a journal, plan a weekend, collect reading notes, or start a sketchbook.

WRITE AND DRAW
Type on clean white pages or switch to PencilKit drawing tools. Choose a pen, marker, or eraser, explore 14 ink colors, and adjust your stroke width. Drawing supports touch and Apple Pencil on compatible hardware. Wide layouts show paired pages with a spiral down the middle; compact layouts keep each page easy to reach.

COLLECT YOUR IDEAS
Add editable Canvas cards, take a photo for a card, and paste photos or web links into notebook pages. Keep a thought beside the things that inspired it.

KEEP A COPY
Create PDFs to print, save to Files, or share using the system share sheet. Save an editable library backup, including shelves, and restore independent notebook copies. Recently deleted notebooks can be restored until you choose to empty Trash.

OPTIONAL PRIVATE ICLOUD SYNC
Enable iCloud sync to keep a small library across your iPhone and iPad using the same iCloud account. Local saving works offline. Sync checks while the app is active on the bookshelf; close an open notebook or choose Sync now to finish syncing. Concurrent notebook edits are preserved as recovery copies. The current limit is 40 MB per encoded library. Sync does not share notebooks with other people, and Undo/Redo history stays local to an editing session.

A FRESH PERSPECTIVE
On supported devices, AI Insights can summarize typed notes, pull out key points, and suggest ideas using Apple’s on-device model. Review each draft and choose whether to save it to Canvas. Requires iOS or iPadOS 26 or later, an eligible device, and available Apple Intelligence. Photos, drawings, and the contents of linked websites are not analyzed. Each request supports up to 6,000 characters of typed notes and idea cards.

YOURS TO WRITE
Core notebook features work on iPhone and iPad with iOS/iPadOS 17 or later. No separate FLIPNOTE DUO account is required. iCloud sync is optional and requires your iCloud account and available storage. Text, drawings, and attachments are separate page layers; Canvas uses cards rather than a freeform drawing surface.

name: Floor Pail
description:
Floor Pail is for the moment the old aquarium water is still in the pail on the floor. Before you pour it away, write the tank liters, the liters taken out, the liters poured back, the new water temperature, the tank water temperature, and the day.

This iPhone counts the percent of the tank taken out, whether you poured back more or fewer liters, the degree gap, and the days since the previous pail. This month it also counts the pails, the liters taken out, and the average percent. Earlier pails stay on this iPhone so you can read them later.

There is no account, network, sample pail, photo, reminder, water test, fish diagnosis, or chemical dose. The numbers are the arithmetic of what you type. The record stays on this iPhone and is removed when the app is deleted.

name: Flossva: Cross Stitch Tracker
description:
Flossva keeps your place in every pattern. Put your work down mid-row and pick it up days later exactly where you stopped.

CROSS-STITCH CHARTS YOU CAN TAP
Import the PDF chart you bought and Flossva rebuilds it as a grid of symbols. Tap a thread color in the legend and every stitch of that color still to do lights up. Tap each stitch as you sew it, or drag along a run. Progress and the stitches left for each color update as you go.
- Honest reading: when Flossva is unsure of a cell, it flags it for you to check. It never guesses.
- Scanned or paper chart? Scan it with the camera, line up the grid once, then mark it the same way.
- A marking lock for when the hoop brushes the screen, undo, a crosshair, row and column numbers pinned to the edges, find by symbol or code, and park a stitch to come back to.
- Smooth on charts of 50,000 stitches and more.

KNIT AND CROCHET PATTERNS
Open a written pattern PDF and keep a highlighter band on the row you are working. Move it with a tap or a drag; it stays exactly where you put it.
- Up to four counters for rows, repeats and increases or decreases
- Linked counters: when Row passes 8, Repeat goes up by one and Row starts again at 1
- Big mode: tap anywhere on the screen to count, without looking down
- Notes for each project

MADE FOR THE IPAD BY YOUR CHAIR
iPad first, with your iPhone as a companion for the same project. Split View, Stage Manager, Apple Pencil, a dark theme for evening stitching, VoiceOver and large text.

PRIVATE, NO ACCOUNT
- No account, no sign-up, no ads, no analytics
- Your patterns and progress stay on your devices and sync only through your own private iCloud, or stay on one device if you prefer
- Works offline
- Export a backup of any project at any time

TRY IT, THEN BUY IT ONCE
Every feature is free for 7 days. After that, one in-app purchase unlocks Flossva for good on all your devices. No subscription. Without it, your projects stay open to view and export: your work is never held hostage.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://flossva.com/privacy

name: Floundr: Fishing Maps & Spots
description:
Floundr is the fishing map built for South Florida, the Florida Keys and the Bahamas — made by anglers, for anglers and charter captains.

SEE THE BOTTOM
• NOAA nautical charts with adjustable opacity
• Seafloor relief shading and depth colors from NOAA's high-resolution survey models — reef edges, ledges, channels and holes stand out
• Depth contour lines and tap-anywhere depth readout
• Satellite imagery to spot reef patches, sand holes and grass flats in the shallows
• Mix layers: fade the chart over satellite or relief to see what's really down there

KNOW THE CONDITIONS
• Wind and gusts, waves and ocean currents with forecast timeline
• Tides and tidal currents from NOAA stations, with high and low times
• Sea surface temperature to find the edges

SAVE YOUR SPOTS
• Drop pins, name them, add notes and photos
• Exact coordinates in the format you use, ready to share or punch into your plotter
• Import and export GPX
• Spots sync privately across your devices with iCloud

GO OFFLINE
• Frame an area on the map and download it for use with no signal
• Downloads keep going in the background

RECORD YOUR TRIPS
• Track your run with distance, speed and time
• Keep trip logs: who was aboard, purpose, revenue and expenses, notes
• Export to CSV or PDF for your charter or business records

LOCAL DIRECTORY
• Find nearby bait & tackle, marine stores, parts dealers, mechanics, marinas and more — top-rated places near you
• Read and write Floundr reviews from fellow anglers

Floundr Pro: free for 3 months, then $3.99/month or $29.99/year. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase after the trial. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel any time in your App Store account settings. The directory, FAQ and contact features are free.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://floundr.app/privacy

Floundr is not for navigation. Always use official charts and your vessel's instruments. Depths are survey models, not soundings.

Data: NOAA Office of Coast Survey, NOAA NCEI, GEBCO, NOAA CO-OPS, NOAA NOMADS, NASA/JPL MUR SST, USGS.

name: Flowpin: BPMN Process Workshop
description:
Flowpin takes you through the whole workshop: take notes, draw the process, capture tasks and send the minutes at the end. Everything lives in one folder, everything stays on your device.

TAKE NOTES
• Note pages with handwriting (Apple Pencil) or typed text, both on the same page
• Convert handwriting to text, right on the device
• Photos of flipcharts and whiteboards, with a scanner that straightens the sheet
• Search across workshops, pages, typed text, handwriting and shape names

FROM WHAT WAS SAID TO A PROCESS
• "Model" turns your lines into a process: each line a step, "Purchasing: …" becomes a lane, a question becomes a decision
• Kept writing later? Flowpin adds the new lines to the existing process in the right place, if you want it to
• Use "@" to point to a shape: the line shows up at the step, a tap jumps to the diagram

DRAW PROCESSES
• Sketch with Apple Pencil: rectangle, circle and diamond become BPMN shapes
• Just as fast without a pencil: shapes from the palette, next step with a tap on the arrow
• Pools, lanes, gateways, events, message flows, data objects, text annotations
• Flow view: the same process as a numbered list of steps, linked live to the diagram
• Pin notes to shapes, annotate freely over the diagram (circle, underline, arrows)
• Hints for open ends and missing connections, can be turned off per file

AFTER THE WORKSHOP
• Tasks from notes and on shapes, collected per workshop and across all workshops
• Minutes as a PDF: details, participants, tasks, notes, photos and processes with their flow
• Export as BPMN 2.0, PDF, PNG, SVG or text

BPMN STAYS BPMN
• Every process is a valid BPMN 2.0 file
• Exports from Signavio, Camunda and ARIS open and save back without loss

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
• No account, no server, no analytics, no ads
• Saved on your device or in your iCloud Drive
• Works offline

name: Fluffel: Pixel Pet
description:
Every egg hatches into a surprise: your very own pixel pet with its own character. Feed it, bathe it, cuddle it – it keeps living in real time, even while the game is closed.

Furnish a whole house, harvest fruit and vegetables in the garden and cook with them in the kitchen. Hens, cows and pigs are waiting in the cellar.

Mini games, daily quests, clothes for every kind of weather and one day a sweetheart with an egg in the nest: there is always something to do.

Available in 83 languages.

• Every egg a surprise, an album to collect them all
• Boy or girl – and a sweetheart to match
• A whole house to furnish, with a barn in the cellar
• Fruit trees, berry bushes and vegetable beds
• Cook what you harvest; cooking and gardening with their own levels
• Daily quests with a golden chest as a reward
• Mini games for food, coins, furniture and clothes
• Clothes, hats and shoes that grow with your pet
• Hobbies for the big ones: bike, game console, painting, music
• Weather, day and night and the seasons, just like outside
• In 83 languages

name: FluxCrate
description: Enter a file size in MB, link speed in Mb/s and expected utilization. Compare an ideal transfer with an estimate that accounts for your chosen utilization. Save and search estimates, or sort them by duration. FluxCrate calculates locally from your inputs.

name: Flyfriend: Pen Pals
description:
Flyfriend brings pen pals back. Nothing here is instant: you write, you fold, your sheet becomes a paper plane and flies across the map to your friend's city. The postman drops it in their mailbox the next morning, in their time zone.

WRITE TO THE WIND
Don't know who to write to? Send your plane to "Someone new" and let the wind carry it. It lands in the garden of someone at least 50 km away who speaks your language. If they answer, you become pen pals; if not, they let it go and the wind takes it to another garden.

YOUR GARDEN
At the bottom of your screen is a photo-real garden with a tree, a fence and a mailbox. When a friend's letter arrives, the flag goes up. Stray planes from strangers get caught in the branches. The garden changes with the seasons, and the sky shows your city's real weather and time of day.

YOUR OWN HANDWRITING
Write your letters once and Flyfriend writes in your hand. A friend's letter opens in their handwriting, the pen moving across the paper. You can also dictate a letter.

A WOODEN CHEST
Keep the letters you love: each friend's are tied with a ribbon in your wooden chest. Burn the ones you'd rather not keep. Lock the chest with Face ID if you like.

YOUR PEN PALS
Share your pen pal code (FLY-XXXX-XXXX) or type a friend's code and they're added right away. The stamps on your profile are printed with real satellite images of the cities you write to.

SAFE AND CALM
Flyfriend is for adults (18+) only. Your location is used only at city level and shared rounded. Every letter can be reported and its writer blocked. No ads, no tracking.

FREE AND PRO
Free: 3 sheets a day, 2 pen pals and 1 plane to the wind a day. Flyfriend Pro: 5 sheets a day, as many pen pals as you like and 3 planes to the wind a day.

Flyfriend Pro is an auto-renewing monthly or yearly subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account when you confirm the purchase. It renews at the same price unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.

name: FM.Groove
description:
FM Groove is a pocket groovebox for iPhone and iPad. Tap out a beat on the pads, lay down a bassline, add an FM keys part and a chip melody, and let the sequencer loop it all, from one dark, hardware-style panel built for landscape.

Eight tracks, five sound engines, sixteen velocity pads and a 64-step sequencer on every track. No account, no ads and no internet needed.

FIVE SOUND ENGINES
• FM: a six-operator FM synthesizer with 32 algorithms, operator envelopes, feedback and a live algorithm diagram. Twelve factory voices, from electric piano and bells to brass, organ and bass.
• Acid: a monophonic bass synth with saw or square wave, resonant filter, envelope mod, accent and slide.
• Drums: a 16-pad synthesized kit with kicks, snare, clap, rim, hats, toms, cowbell, clave, crash, conga, shaker and zap. Tune, decay, tone and drive shape the whole kit.
• Chip: pulse, triangle and noise voices with crunchy low-bit character, plus a pitch sweep for lasers and hits.
• Pluck: a modelled string for guitars, harps and koto-style plucks, with damping, decay and pick tone.
• Give any track any engine, with factory presets and four macro knobs under your fingers.

PLAY THE PADS
• Sixteen multi-touch pads: finger-drum the kit, or play melodic tracks in key. Choose from nine scales (major, minor, dorian, mixolydian, pentatonic, blues and more), any root note and any octave.
• Pads respond to where you touch them, so you can play soft and loud.
• Hold pads with the arpeggiator: up, down, up-down or random, at 1/8, 1/16, triplet or 1/32 rates.
• Record live while the loop plays and your hits drop into the nearest step.

BUILD THE LOOP
• Eight tracks with up to 64 steps each, and a different loop length per track for polyrhythms. Tempo from 30 to 300 BPM, with tap tempo and swing.
• Per-step velocity, gate length, accent, probability and ratchets (one to four hits per step), plus slide on the acid bass.
• Drum tracks can place any number of pads on a single step.
• Randomize a track for instant ideas, or clear it and start again.
• Mute and solo any track, and set level and pan for each.

SHAPE THE SOUND
• An FM operator editor with level, ratio, fine and detune, and an envelope editor you can drag with your finger.
• On iPad, faders under the step keys control operator levels, feedback, level, pan, reverb and delay.
• LFO vibrato for the FM, acid and chip engines.
• A shared stereo reverb and a tempo-synced ping-pong delay, with a send on every track.
• Import 32-voice FM SysEx banks (.syx) from the Files app and load any voice into an FM track.

SAVE YOUR WORK
• Eight project slots, and your last session is saved automatically when you leave the app.
• The screen stays awake while the sequencer runs, and audio keeps playing if you switch apps.

NEW TO IT?
Tap HELP in the top bar for a built-in user manual that covers every control, page and function.

GOOD TO KNOW
• FM Groove is designed for landscape on iPhone and iPad.
• It works offline and collects no data.
• SysEx import reads standard six-operator FM voice data. Other formats are not supported.

name: FogBound: Last Lighthouse
description:
The fog is rising, and one lonely lighthouse is all that stands between the sea and the dark.

BUILD BY DAY
Every day you draw a hand of cards and grow your island tile by tile: meadows, forests and rocks, lumberjacks and quarries, houses, markets and glowing braziers. Plan your layout: towers next to each other grow stronger, lights reveal hidden creatures and every building has a job.

DEFEND BY NIGHT
When night falls, creatures crawl out of the mist. Drag the lighthouse beam across the water to burn them, let your watchtowers, cannons, frost spires and mage towers do the rest, and fire the Flash when they swarm. Every few nights something bigger rises from the deep: the Kraken, the Fog Maw and finally the Mist Leviathan.

A NEW RUN EVERY TIME
Survive ten nights to win. Each dawn you choose a blessing, so no two runs play the same. Upgrade and repair your buildings, move tiles around and find the combos that work for you.

KEEP PLAYING
• Unlock keepers with their own powers and collect lighthouses
• Climb ten fog levels, each a little harder
• Daily Challenge with a new twist every day
• Live events with exclusive rewards
• Endless mode: how many nights can you last?

Easy to pick up, made for short sessions and playable offline.

name: FoilGuard
description:
FoilGuard är ett verktyg för folieringsoperatörer och processansvariga. Appen kopplar formslag (cykler), temperatur, tryck och dwell-tid till risk för avflagning och klistring – så att du kan förlänga formlivet och hålla specialeaffekten stabil.
﻿
VEM APPEN ÄR FÖR
• Folieringsoperatörer / maskinskötare
• Process- och kvalitetsansvariga i tryckeri / förpackning
• Alla som loggar varmfoliering och vill förstå varför avflagning eller klistring uppstår
﻿
VAD DU KAN GÖRA
• Registrera formverktyg (mässing, koppar, magnesium, silikon) med nominell och använd livslängd
• Logga processparametrar: °C, bar (eller kg/cm²), dwell, hastighet, folietyp och substrat
• Få diagnos med riskpoäng för avflagning och klistring plus konkreta åtgärdsförslag
• Spara fungerande recept och återanvända dem i nya körningar
• Se flotthälsa, varningar när formen närmar sig livslängdsgräns och snabbstatistik
﻿
SÅ HÄR ANVÄNDER DU APPEN (STEG FÖR STEG)
﻿
1) Öppna FoilGuard
Appen startar direkt på Översikt. Du ser flotthälsa, varningar och genvägar. Exempeldata finns förhandsifylld så att du genast kan testa flödet.
﻿
2) Skapa eller kontrollera formverktyg
Gå till fliken Formverktyg → tryck +.
Fyll i formkod, namn, material, nominell livslängd och använda slag → Spara.
Öppna en form för att lägga till fler slag eller se kopplade loggar.
﻿
3) Logga en körning
Gå till fliken Process → tryck +.
Välj formverktyg, ange temperatur, tryck, dwell, hastighet och antal slag.
Välj folietyp, substrat och observerat resultat (OK / Avflagning / Klistring m.m.).
Tryck Spara & diagnostisera.
﻿
4) Läs diagnosen
Efter sparande öppnas Diagnosdetalj automatiskt.
Här ser du:
• Processpoäng
• Risk för avflagning och klistring
• Status för temp / tryck / dwell
• Åtgärdsförslag (höj/sänk temp eller tryck, justera dwell, rengör form, planera byte)
Du kan spara parametrarna som recept eller starta en ny logg med samma värden.
﻿
5) Använd receptbiblioteket
Gå till fliken Recept → skapa eller öppna ett recept.
Välj Använd i processlogg för att fylla i färdiga fönster.
Filtrera recept efter substrat vid behov.
﻿
6) Övervaka flotthälsa
På Översikt följer du varningar (t.ex. form nära livslängdsgräns) och statistik.
Justera enheter (bar / kg/cm²) under info-ikonen → Om FoilGuard.
﻿
VIKTIGT FÖR GRANSKNING / DEMO
• Ingen inloggning, inget konto, ingen nätverksfunktion krävs
• All data sparas lokalt på enheten
• Appen innehåller exempeldata så att hela flödet kan testas omedelbart:
Översikt → Formverktyg → Process (ny logg) → Diagnos → Recept
﻿
﻿
FoilGuard ersätter inte maskinmanualen, men ger ett tydligt processflöde för att dokumentera, diagnostisera och stabilisera folieringsjobb.

name: Fold and Crush
description:
The first game you play with the hinge.

Fold and Crush turns your iPhone Duo into the weapon. Don't tap, fold: snap the phone shut at just the right moment and squash whatever is caught between the screens.

• Roach Crush: Waves of cockroaches raid both screens. Tap to squash one, or fold your Duo shut and a black cotton slipper slaps down on the whole swarm.
• Mouse Trap: A giant trap sits right across the fold. Let the mouse creep in and start nibbling the cheese, then fold to spring the bar. Fold too slowly and it sees you coming.
• Book & Fly: The open book is your phone. Wait for the fly to land on a page, then close the cover on it. Hesitate and it's gone.

MADE FOR THE FOLD

• The trap's kill bar and the book's cover follow your hinge, degree for degree.
• Fold speed matters: a slow fold gives you away.
• Close the phone and the cover screen shows what just happened: a leather-bound book, the back of the trap, or the slipper that just landed.
• Every layout keeps the crease clear.

ALSO

• 3D spatial sound: hear the mouse scurry and the fly buzz around you.
• Glossy, bubbly Aero style.
• Best scores for each game.
• No ads. No in-app purchases.

Plays best on iPhone Duo. On other iPhones, an on-screen button stands in for the fold.

name: FOLD. – Fold Tracker
description:
How often do you actually open your iPhone Duo? FOLD. knows.

FOLD. counts every time your foldable iPhone opens and closes, and turns that data into something you'll enjoy looking at – precise, beautiful and completely private.

AUTOMATIC COUNTING
• Live: While FOLD. is open, it reads the hinge directly – including its angle.
• In the background: After a one-time setup in the Shortcuts app (about 1 minute, iOS 27.2 or later), FOLD. keeps counting even when the app is closed.
• Guided setup with a live test: FOLD. shows you whether background counting really works.

LIVE HINGE STUDIO
Your Duo as a model that folds along in real time – with an angle readout. Partially open, the view splits around the fold automatically.

FOLD DNA
A heatmap by weekday and hour reveals your personal patterns, plus insights such as your most active time, your busiest day, or whether you fold more at weekends.

FOLD REPLAY
Relive a day as an animated fold timeline.

STATISTICS
Day, week, month and year – with comparisons, records and averages.

MILESTONES & YEAR IN REVIEW
From 100 to 100,000 folds. Share your milestones and your year in review as a card.

WIDGETS
For your Home Screen and Lock Screen.

MADE FOR DUO
Unfolded, FOLD. shows your counter and insights side by side; folded, everything adapts to the outer display.

PRIVATE
No ads. No subscription. No account. All data stays on your device.

HONEST
FOLD. counts folds. It makes no claims about wear or the remaining lifespan of your hinge. Without the Shortcuts setup, folds made while the app is closed are not recorded.

Requires iPhone Duo. Background counting requires iOS 27.2 or later.

name: Foliara: Botanical Studio
description:
Foliara is an offline botanical design studio for creating original, editable plant specimens and botanical illustration plates.

Construct botanical forms from reusable vector components. Shape stems and branches, design leaf geometry, build layered flowers, apply deterministic morphology rules, and compose meaningful growth stages.

FEATURES

• Shape editable stems and connected branch structures
• Design reusable leaves with custom outlines and veins
• Construct flowers from editable petals and floral layers
• Generate controlled botanical distributions with morphology rules
• Compose growth stages and deterministic variations
• Create custom palettes, gradients, textures, and visual styles
• Arrange specimens into annotated botanical plates
• Organize projects in botanical collections
• Learn through practical guided workshops
• Start from eight original editable specimens
• Export artwork and portable project documents

Foliara is designed as a focused creative instrument rather than a plant identification service. Every specimen you create remains editable, allowing its structure, appearance, and presentation to evolve over time.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Projects and preferences stay on your device unless you choose to export or share them. Foliara requires no account, cloud service, analytics, or network connection.

name: Folio: Read Later on E-ink
description:
Folio turns everything you mean to read into a calm, typeset issue and delivers it to your Kindle or reMarkable. Save it on your phone, read it on paper-like e-ink. 
It's the best way to read articles and newsletters on your reMarkable tablet.

Articles you save, newsletters you forward and feeds you follow all land in one inbox. When you're ready, or on a schedule you set, Folio builds an issue with a cover, a table of contents and clean pages, then sends it to your devices.

SAVE ANYTHING
• Share a link from Safari, Reddit, X or any app with "Save to Folio"
• Forward newsletters to your own Folio address
• Upload PDFs, Word documents and text files
• Paste a link, and Folio pulls the article without the ads and clutter

FOLLOW WHAT YOU LOVE
• Follow RSS, Atom and JSON feeds from any blog or site
• Bring your feeds over from another reader with OPML import
• Organize sources into folders, mute the noisy ones

YOUR ISSUE, YOUR RHYTHM
• Pick the articles for the next issue, or let a schedule do it
• "Every Sunday at 8, up to an hour of reading" is one setting away
• Each issue gets its own cover, contents page and section dividers

DELIVERED TO YOUR E-READER
• Kindle: sent to your Kindle email automatically
• reMarkable: connected once, delivered every time
• Or read it right here, in a reader built for long reads

WORKS WITH YOUR AI ASSISTANT
Connect Folio to Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Grok and ask them to find articles, fill your inbox and send you an issue.

SUBSCRIPTION
Folio Basic is available as a monthly or annual auto-renewing subscription, with a free trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase after the trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it anytime in your App Store account settings.

name: FoMind - Forecast Training
description:
How good is your judgment, really? FoMind helps you turn gut feelings into reliable judgment.

• Make a prediction: ask a yes/no question, define how it will be resolved, write your reasoning, then commit to a probability from 1% to 99%.
• Check it when it's due: get a reminder on the resolve date, judge the outcome against your own criteria, and attach links or screenshots as evidence.
• Review and improve: separate luck from skill, note which reasons held up, and save the lessons you want to remember.
• See how accurate you are: Brier score, monthly trend and a calibration curve show whether you're overconfident or too cautious.
• 29 short lessons: conditional probability, Bayesian reasoning, base rates, causality, Fermi estimation and cognitive biases. Every lesson has a quiz, and 14 include interactive demos.
• Home Screen widget, due-date reminders, and export to JSON and CSV.

Your data stays on your device and in your own iCloud. No account, no ads, no data collection.

Available in English and Simplified Chinese.

name: Foodsta
description:
Discover great restaurants, explore exciting food offers, and find your next dining experience with Foodsta.
Foodsta makes restaurant discovery easy by connecting food lovers with restaurants, special offers, and local dining experiences.

name: Forever Armory
description:
Unofficial.
Forever Armory is a fan-made character viewer for World of Warcraft: Forever. It is not made, endorsed or supported by Blizzard Entertainment. Look up any Forever character on your iPhone. Type a first name and surname, pick US or EU, and see the character as the game shows it.

The character's portrait stands between two columns of equipment slots, with weapons below. Slot borders show each item's quality.
Tap any slot for the item's full tooltip: stats, enchants, durability, requirements, set pieces and bonuses, and sell price.

Character data, portraits and item icons come from Blizzard's World of Warcraft API and are © Blizzard Entertainment. World of Warcraft and Blizzard Entertainment are trademarks or registered trademarks of Blizzard Entertainment, Inc.

name: Forken
description:
Forken is a top-down woodland runner through four living seasons. Pick spring, summer, autumn, or winter, then keep moving: change lanes, jump, and roll as the trail runs ahead. When the path splits, read the weather, the challenge, and the supplies on each branch, and choose the road you want next.
Each season changes the run. In the rain garden, puddles slow your pace, and a shelter leaf can take one hit for you. In the sunstone canyon, shade and water keep the heat from breaking your gem chain. Amber woods push you forward on a tailwind, and Focus helps you hold the tighter turns. On the frost pass, snow gives you quick grip, ice asks for a longer turn, and every gem scores higher.
String gems together and the multiplier climbs to ×4. Call on Focus when a gap, a log, or a falling rock needs a cleaner read. Timber weaves, rockfalls, river bridges, and gem sprints arrive with signs that name what is coming. A rocket carries you over the hazards. A magnet pulls gems in from every lane. Cross all four seasons in one run, and the trail adds a bonus to your score.
Chase a higher personal best, set the music, woodland ambience, and haptics the way you like them, and head out again from another season.

name: FotoTurbo
description:
O FotoTurbo é o fluxo de entrega para fotógrafos de esporte e eventos: a foto sai da câmera, recebe a sua edição, passa por uma triagem automática e chega à plataforma de venda enquanto o evento ainda acontece.

RECEBA DIRETO DA CÂMERA
• No Mac: pelo cabo USB (Canon e Sony) ou pelo Wi-Fi da câmera, com servidor FTP embutido. Também importa de um cartão ou de qualquer pasta.
• No iPhone e no iPad: pelo cabo, com câmeras Canon.
• Cada foto entra na fila assim que você clica.

EDITE UMA VEZ, APLIQUE EM TODAS
• Ajustes no estilo do Lightroom: luz, cor, curva de tons, misturador de cores, preto e branco, nitidez e vinheta.
• Importe as suas predefinições do Lightroom (.xmp).
• Freio do lote: você aprova a primeira foto e as próximas saem sozinhas com o mesmo ajuste.
• Edições alternadas: até três edições diferentes, revezando foto a foto.

TRIAGEM AUTOMÁTICA
• Separa as fotos desfocadas antes da edição.
• Conta as pessoas e limita quantas fotos cada uma recebe.
• Blocklist: quem não quer ser fotografado nunca vai para a saída.
• Todo o reconhecimento acontece no seu aparelho, sem internet.

ENTREGA SEM ESPERA
• Exporta em JPG no tamanho e na qualidade que a plataforma pede.
• Envia direto para a sua conta na Fotto, na Banlek ou na Fotop.
• Vídeos (no Mac): cor, corte, câmera lenta, horizonte alinhado e estabilização, com envio junto das fotos.

ASSINATURA
O FotoTurbo é grátis para baixar. Para receber, editar e enviar fotos, assine o plano mensal, semestral ou anual, com 3 dias grátis para experimentar. A assinatura é da sua conta Apple e vale no Mac, no iPhone e no iPad com a mesma conta. Ela renova automaticamente pelo mesmo preço e período, a não ser que você cancele até 24 horas antes do fim do período, nos ajustes da sua conta Apple.

name: Fragdex: A Fragrance Shelf
description:
Every bottle you own, on one shelf. Fragdex helps you wear what you have, layer it in new ways, buy smarter, and see what your friends are spraying today.

YOUR SHELF
— Add a bottle in seconds: Fragdex fills in the notes, accords, seasons, longevity and projection for you
— Snap your own bottle photos, rate them, and track size, fill level and what you paid
— Pin your Top 5 and sort by rating, most worn, house or newest
— Browse by note to see everything you own with vanilla, oud, bergamot and more

TODAY
— Not sure what to wear? Pick the occasion and time of day, and Fragdex picks from your shelf for today's weather
— Log a wear with one tap; picks rotate so your forgotten favorites get some love

LAYER
— Get layering combos made from bottles you already own, with how to apply them and when they shine
— Check any two bottles together before you spray, and save the combos you love

NEXT BUY
— Keep a wishlist with your reason and target price
— See the gaps in your collection and what would fill them
— "Do I need this?" checks a fragrance you're eyeing against what you already own
— Find cheaper clones of the scents you love, with how close they really are
— See current retail prices and track what you've spent

STATS AND WRAPPED
— A calendar of every wear
— Your year in scent with Wrapped: most worn bottles, top notes and more

FRIENDS
— Add friends and follow along: who's wearing what today, what's new on their shelves this month
— Open a friend's shelf and add anything to your wishlist in one tap
— Get a heads-up when a friend has something from your wishlist, so you can smell it first
— Give friends private nicknames only you can see
— Share good-looking cards of your shelf, a bottle or your Wrapped, or send your collection link to anyone
— Optional alerts for friend requests and friends' new bottles

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Your shelf is for friends unless you choose otherwise, and you decide what shows on their feeds. No ads, no tracking, and your data is never sold. Block or report anyone from their page, and delete your account any time from Profile.

Fragdex is invite-only for now: ask a friend for an invite or request one in the app.

name: Frasiek Speed Reader
description:
Frasiek Speed Reader wyświetla tekst po jednym słowie, w stałym miejscu na środku ekranu. Oko nie musi przeskakiwać po linijkach, więc cała uwaga idzie w rozumienie, a czytanie jest szybsze.

Jedna litera każdego słowa jest czerwona i zawsze stoi dokładnie w osi ekranu — to punkt, na którym skupiasz wzrok.

FUNKCJE
• Wczytywanie plików PDF, TXT, DOCX (Word), RTF, EPUB i FB2
• Biblioteka książek z postępem czytania
• Zapamiętywanie miejsca, w którym skończyłeś
• Podgląd książki i wybór, od którego miejsca zacząć — pomiń ISBN, podziękowania czy spis treści
• Regulacja tempa od 100 do 1000 słów na minutę
• Ustawienie wielkości czcionki i pozycji czerwonej litery
• Czytanie w poziomie, w pionie lub automatycznie
• Czysty tekst: nawiasy, cudzysłowy i myślniki są pomijane, a kropki, przecinki, pytajniki i wykrzykniki zostają przy słowach
• Start i pauza jednym stuknięciem

PRYWATNOŚĆ
Aplikacja nie zbiera żadnych danych, nie wyświetla reklam i nie łączy się z internetem. Twoje pliki zostają na urządzeniu.

name: FreeMathSchool
description:
FMS is your all-in-one study app. Get help with homework, prepare for big tests, and stay in touch with the people from your school.

STUDY
• Ask FMS AI about any problem and get the answer worked out step by step.
• SAT and ACT prep with lessons, practice sets and full quizzes.
• Study sets and flashcards for any class, or make your own.
• Quiz results show what you got wrong and why.

YOUR SCHOOL
• Join your school's community to find classmates and school chats.
• Your school competes with others on a weekly board.

MESSAGES AND CALLS
• Chat one-on-one or in groups.
• Voice and video calls with friends.
• Block and report tools on every chat and profile.

REWARDS
• Earn coins and XP as you study and take part.
• Spend them on profile frames, backgrounds and more.

FMS PRO
Pro unlocks more FMS AI use and extra features. Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, billed monthly or yearly through your Apple ID. It renews unless you turn it off at least 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://freemathschool.org/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://freemathschool.org/privacy-policy/

name: Fresh Marks
description:
Fresh Marks is a notebook for a home freshwater aquarium. It stays on this phone. There is no account, no cloud copy.

Write down each tank: a name, the volume in liters, a short note, and the kind of water. The kind is Community, Shrimp, Planted, or Goldfish. Log a test with the date, temperature in Celsius, pH, ammonia, nitrite, and nitrate. On the tank page, the latest test is marked OK, Low, or High against a common hobby range for that kind of water. A high mark means the number sits outside the note, so you can plan a water change. It is not a medical result.

Life keeps two lists. Livestock is who lives in the tank, and how many. Care is work you already finished, such as a water change or a filter rinse. The app does not send reminders or order supplies.

Ranges explains the bands used for those marks. They are short hobby notes, not a prescription. Read your own test kit, and ask a qualified person if an animal looks unwell.

The first launch includes a sample planted tank so the marks are visible. You can restore that example later. Restoring replaces what you have typed.

name: FreshClock: Fridge & Pantry
description:
FreshClock shows what to eat before it spoils, and counts the money you save.

Add a grocery run in seconds: tap common foods, scan a barcode, or snap your receipt. FreshClock fills in typical expiry dates for the fridge, freezer and pantry, then sorts everything by what needs eating first.

• Green, yellow and red at a glance, soonest first
• Swipe right when you ate it, left when it's used up and goes on your grocery list
• One morning reminder, only on days something expires
• Use It Up: ideas and recipes for what needs eating first
• Your Month: what you saved, what you tossed, and tips to waste less
• Home Screen widget with the foods to use first
• No account, no ads, no tracking. Your pantry stays on your iPhone unless you share it with your household.

FreshClock Plus (optional subscription): read receipts and get recipe ideas every day, look back at every month, and share one pantry and grocery list with your household. $3.99 a month, or $34.99 a year with a 7-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple ID's subscriptions settings.

name: FRESHOUT Partner
description:
FRESHOUT Partner ir dienas rīks FRESHOUT Barbershop komandai.

Šeit ir pieraksti, kalendārs, komanda un salona katalogs. Atver lietotni ar kodu, ko iedod salons.

Ko vari darīt
• Skatīt pierakstus un dienas kalendāru
