• Sekot dienas ritmam salonā

Piekļuve ir ar kodu no salona.

name: Front Office: The Climb
description:
You're not the coach. You're the one who hires the coach.

Front Office: The Climb puts you in the athletic director's chair. Build your AD, land your first job and make the calls that decide whether a program rises or falls: budgets, facilities, hires, schedules, boosters and the people who depend on you.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• High School Athletics — about 100 real-classification schools in each of five states (North Carolina, Ohio, Georgia, Nevada and Florida). Run football, boys' and girls' basketball, baseball, track and field and band, then chase a state title.
• Division I College — run an FBS program with a team GPA, NIL revenue share and booster collective, live gate and concessions money, and facilities graded against your conference.
• International Soccer — take over a club in England or Spain, work the transfer window and free agents, and climb the divisions.

BUILD YOUR AD
Choose a background or create your own. Set your age, spend your points on leadership, finance, compliance and athlete care, and watch your grades grow. Hit a 70 rating and see what your AD would be worth at the other levels.

EVERY DECISION HAS A COST
• Negotiate your contract — take their offer, meet in the middle or push your own number.
• Renovate, upgrade or build new facilities, and hope they're ready for opening day.
• Balance equipment, training, travel and development against what's left in the fund.
• Read your month summary, then decide what to do next.

PLAY ANYWHERE
Sign in with the same account on the website, iPhone and iPad. Your careers follow you.

No ads. No tracking. No in-app purchases.

name: Frontier Lab: AI Tycoon
seller_name: TITAN INTERNATIONAL TRADING SERVICE COMPANY LIMITED
description:
It is 2017 and you have a garage, three friends and half a million dollars. Twenty years later someone will build AGI. Make it your lab.

Frontier Lab is a cozy pixel-art management sim about running an AI company from the first chatbot demo to the AGI race.

• Build a team worth fighting for: hire engineers, researchers and designers with their own traits, level them up and watch them work in your office. Rare talent comes with signature skills, and rival labs will try to poach your best people.
• Train your own models: rent or buy GPUs, pick what your model is good at, and reveal its benchmark scores against the frontier. Or build on a rival's API and pay them a cut.
• Ship products people use: pair 20 categories with 30 applications, discover the legendary combos, read the reviews, and keep live products healthy as the world's expectations rise.
• Live through the AI timeline: 54 milestones from 2017 to 2036 change what the market wants. Chatbots, code assistants, agents and robots each arrive in their own era.
• Grow from a garage to a campus: five headquarters, each bigger and busier, all hand-painted in pixel art.
• Raise money or stay independent: every funding round costs equity, and your final grade is the founder's stake.
• Take safety seriously, or don't: incidents, regulators and an AI treaty shape how much the public trusts you.
• Race to AGI: gather the best model, a mountain of compute and your strongest team for the final project. Win it first, lose it to a rival, or play it safe.

A full run takes about three hours and ends with a grade, a share card and Legacy perks for your next company.

Free to play, playable offline. Optional rewarded ads and in-app purchases: Gold Chips, packs and Headhunts for rare staff, with the odds shown before every pull.

name: Frostpeak: Piano & Songs
description:
Eight Frostpeak friends stand on a snowy stage, one for each key. Tap a key and its friend plays the note: Big Tusk has the low C, Pebble the G, and Zephyr the high C. Tap them all at once and the whole band plays. Nothing is ever wrong, so it always sounds good.

FREE TO TRY, ONE PURCHASE FOR THE REST
Piano and Bells, 15 songs, Record, and Band with one groove are free to try. One purchase, the Full Unlock, adds 12 more songs, the Xylophone and Choir voices and two more grooves.

FOLLOW THE LIGHTS
Pick a song card and the key that comes next glows. Tap it and the light moves on. The song waits for you, so there is no rush and no score. Finish a song and the cast takes a bow, the card gets a star, and the friends play the song back for you.

PLAY IT BY EAR
Once a song has its star, try Echo: the band plays a few notes, then you play them back. The light comes back to show the way. There is no way to lose.

27 SONGS
Twinkle Twinkle, Mary Had a Little Lamb, This Old Man and more classic nursery tunes, plus new songs written for Frostpeak, like Snowball Hop and Pebble's Lullaby. Every song uses only the eight keys on screen.

MAKE YOUR OWN MUSIC
- Record: tap the red dot, play up to 24 notes, and the friends play your tune back.
- Band: pick a drum and a gentle groove plays while you jam on top.
- Four voices: Piano, Bells, Xylophone and Choir.

FOR GROWN-UPS
- No ads.
- Bright, tall keys and no reading needed. Great for a big sibling to play with a little one.
- No chat, no accounts, plays offline.
- No clocks, nothing random for sale, nothing that nags to come back.
- Stars and recordings save on your device. A grown-up check guards Settings, the Full Unlock, Restore Purchases and Delete My Data.
- We made all the sounds ourselves.

Made by Seventh Anvil Games, the makers of Polar Bears vs. Warthogs.

name: Fruit Flick Reels
description:
Fruit Flick Reels is a juicy one-thumb arcade game about flicking a fruit coin into three spinning reels.

Aim, pull back and release. While you aim, the reels freeze — read the fruit, pick your moment and send the coin flying. Every hit locks the bottom fruit of a reel. Match three, build a pair or collect a full fruit salad when the spin ends.

MATCH, STACK, BURST
• 3 identical fruits — Juice Burst ×5 and a bonus coin
• 2 identical fruits — ×2 and a bonus coin
• 3 different fruits — Fruit Salad and +3 Juice charges

FILL THE JUICE METER
Six charges turn your next spin into a Golden Smoothie Spin: double score and one extra coin.

40 LEVELS ACROSS 5 CHAPTERS
Each chapter adds new targets and new traps. Watch out for wasps that steal coins, coconuts that bounce shots away, rotten fruit and sticky juice puddles that slow the coin down.

FRUIT RUSH
Unlocked after chapter two, this endless mode gives you three hearts. Every missed coin costs a heart. Chase your best score and climb the local leaderboard.

SIX COIN CHARACTERS
Earn coins in levels and Fruit Rush, then unlock cherry, watermelon, orange, pineapple, blueberry and lemon coin skins.

TWELVE ACHIEVEMENTS
Track your progress from the first flick to the Grand Champion.

BUILT FOR QUICK SESSIONS
No ads. No in-app purchases. No timers or energy. Play offline, anywhere.

Pull back, freeze the reels and find the perfect fruit.

name: Full Width Browsing for Safari
description:
Full Width Browsing for Safari is a Safari extension that helps you use more of your display when browsing websites on your folded iPhone Duo. Extend webpages into the space behind Safari's right-side controls for a wider, more immersive browsing experience.

Choose how websites fill your screen, expand backgrounds and images, or extend entire page layouts for more room to browse.

Features:

· Full Width Browsing: Expands the width of Safari websites to use the space behind the right-side control panel on iPhone Duo when folded.

· Edge-to-Edge Display: Extends webpages beneath Safari's side controls to make better use of the available screen space.

· Wide Backgrounds & Images: Expands website images and backgrounds while keeping text easy to read.

· Full Width Content: Extends text, images, and page layouts across the entire screen.

· More Screen Space: Makes better use of the iPhone Duo display when browsing websites in Safari.

· One-Tap Quick Switch: Turn wide browsing on or off instantly with a floating button.

· Per-Website Settings: Choose different browsing options for individual websites.

· Default Website Settings: Apply your preferred browsing layout to all websites.

· Blur Behind Controls: Adds a soft blur effect to webpage content behind Safari's side controls.

· Flexible Display Options: Choose between wider images and full-width content to match your browsing preferences.

· Designed for iPhone Duo: Built specifically for the folded iPhone Duo display, allowing websites to extend into the space behind Safari's right-side control panel.

· Privacy-first design: No data collection, tracking, or logging, your browsing stays completely private.

· Multilingual support: Use the extension in multiple languages for a globally friendly experience.

· Clean, user-friendly UI: Enjoy a streamlined design that integrates smoothly into your workflow.

name: Furry Star
description:
Furry Star is a gentle online garden for remembering the pets we have lost. There is nothing to fight and nothing to win. It is just a place to stay close to them.

Give your companion a headstone, shape a little spirit that keeps watch beside it, and decorate the place with flowers, lanterns and keepsakes. Walk through eight gardens that follow the real seasons and weather, from cherry blossoms to maple leaves to snow, and meet people from many countries who are remembering their own pets.

What you can do
- Create a memorial: name, photos, a short story and a letter, with the privacy setting you choose (public, friends only, or just you).
- Shape a spirit from twelve kinds of animals, with colors, patterns and accessories.
- Visit other memorials: leave a flower, light a candle that glows for 24 hours, or write a message.
- Release a sky lantern or a river lantern, once a day.
- Walk, sit on benches, chat, make friends and talk in private chat rooms.
- Quiet mode hides other players whenever you want to be alone.

Safe and calm
- Chat is filtered, and you can block or report anyone at any time.
- Your memorial is private by default and you decide who can see it.
- You can delete your account and everything in it whenever you like, from inside the game.
- No ads. No rankings. No pressure.

Available in 21 languages, including English, Japanese, Korean and Chinese.

name: Galevault
description:
Galevault is a storm-mountain villa mystery told through local dossiers. Page through case files with a side index, compare alibis and death reports, study evidence, walk the timeline, and pressure-test your theory with a consistency checker.

Each case opens into branching investigation paths with multiple endings stored on your device. No account. No connection required. Just cold paper, hard choices, and the gale outside the glass.

name: Galla Pager - Retro Beeper
description:
Messages that never stop. Read receipts that demand a reply.
Back then, a few digits were enough: 8282 hurry hurry, 486 I love you, 1004 angel.
Galla Pager brings back the pager — slow, simple and full of feeling.

■ Your own 012 number
Pick the 7 digits after 012 yourself or roll a random one. A birthday, an anniversary, a lucky number.

■ Say it in number codes
486, 8282, 1004… the classic code book is built in. Sometimes one short number says more than a long text.

■ Voicemail from a payphone
Voice pages open a payphone. Use the keypad like back then: 1 next · 2 repeat · 3 keep · 8 delete.

■ Your greeting, your voice
Record the first thing callers hear in your voicebox.

■ Phonebook · Random Page
Save the numbers that matter, or send a random page to someone new (you can turn this off in Settings).

■ Rings like a real pager
7 alert tones, vibrate, short beep or silent. 11 see-through body colors — your home screen icon changes too.

■ Stay safe
Long-press any page to report or block. Our team reviews every report.

No read receipts. No typing dots. No reply button.
Only you know if you listened.

name: Galleroo: Photo Cleaner
description:
Galleroo helps you clear out your camera roll without the chore.

Pick a month and swipe through it, one photo or video at a time. Right keeps it. Left drops it in Roo's pouch. Open the pouch to see everything you tossed and how much space it frees, then delete it all in one go.

Roo the kangaroo hops along the trail with you, cheers your combos and naps when you're done for the day.

What you get
- Swipe a month at a time, newest first, with a trail of the months still waiting
- Albums: clean one folder at a time
- On This Day: see what you shot on this date in past years
- Videos play right on the card, muted
- Undo the last swipe with a button or a shake
- Nothing is deleted until you empty the pouch

Your photos stay yours
- Photos never leave your iPhone. There is no account and no server.
- Deleted items go to Recently Deleted in Photos for 30 days, so you can still get them back.

Free and Pro
- 50 free swipes a day. Watch a short ad for 25 more.
- Galleroo Pro removes ads, gives you unlimited swipes and opens the smart tools: look-alike shots, blurry shots and big videos.
- Pro comes as a one-time Lifetime purchase or a Yearly subscription. The Yearly plan renews automatically each year unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the renewal date. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel it in Settings, your name, Subscriptions.

Privacy policy: https://axynto.com/galleroo/privacy
Terms of Use: https://axynto.com/galleroo/terms

name: Galune
description: Type the length of one row and the emitter spacing. The count includes both ends, and the last space stays equal to the spacing when the row divides evenly. Type a flow in gallons per hour and a runtime in minutes to see the gallons. Repeat that for several matching rows. Add a header and a waste percent to the tubing, then round up to the next whole foot. Multiply one day's gallons by a number of days you choose.

name: GamiTrack
description:
GamiTrack is the field app for sales and distribution companies in Nepal. Salespeople, delivery staff, dealers and office teams use one app, in Nepali or English.

FOR SALESPEOPLE
• Start your day and see today's route, shops and targets
• Check in at a shop, take a photo as proof and record what happened
• Take orders on the spot, with your company's prices and units
• Collect payments and plan collections for the week
• See your own scorecard and your beats on a map

FOR DELIVERY STAFF AND DEALERS
• See orders to deliver, and confirm delivery with a photo
• Dealers order from the company, send goods to shops and track their stock

FOR OWNERS AND MANAGERS
• Approve orders, returns and expenses from your phone
• Follow sales, stock, money owed and your team's day
• Manage shops, dealers, price lists and routes

BUILT FOR NEPAL
• Nepali and English, Bikram Sambat dates, NPR prices
• VAT invoices with the buyer's PAN
• Your company adds you; you sign in with your mobile number and an SMS code. Face ID or fingerprint unlock is optional.

LOCATION
For salespeople and delivery staff, the app records the route between Start day and End day so the company can see store visits and attendance, including while the app is in the background. The app asks for your consent before it starts, and tracking stops when you end your day.

GamiTrack needs an account created by your company. To see how it works, book a demo at gamitrack.com.

name: GammonClock: Backgammon Timer
description:
GammonClock is the backgammon clock the game has been missing. Lay your phone flat between you and your opponent: each half of the screen faces one player. When you've made your move, tap your side to start your opponent's clock.

BUILT FOR REAL MATCHES
- Tournament timing: 2 minutes per match point with a 12-second delay each move per the U.S. Backgammon Federation Tournament Rules, or set any time you like
- Delay first, then reserve: each move starts with free time, and your clock only runs once it's used up
- Reserve time carries over from game to game for the whole match, just like a tournament

KEEP SCORE ON THE CLOCK
- Record singles, gammons and backgammons with the cube value
- The Crawford game is marked automatically
- Fix a score mistake any time

MADE FOR THE BOARD
- Big, readable clocks, each facing its own player
- Undo an accidental tap
- A chime at 30 seconds, haptic ticks through the last 10 seconds, and an out-of-time alarm that plays even when your ringer is off
- The screen stays on for the whole match
- Works offline, with no account and no ads

Your privacy matters: GammonClock collects no data at all.

name: Garim: Redact ID & Photo Vault
description:
ID copies, bank statements, chat screenshots… run them through Garim before you hit send.
Garim finds ID numbers, phone numbers and account numbers automatically, blacks them out, and stamps a purpose watermark like "Rental application only".

■ Use it when
• A landlord or agent asks for a copy of your ID
• An employer asks for a bank account copy
• You send a screenshot to a marketplace buyer or customer support
• A hotel or rental asks for identity verification

■ Automatic redaction
Open a photo and Garim reads the text right on your phone and covers personal details:
• National ID numbers (keeps the birth date, hides the rest), SSN
• Driver's license, passport, card, account and phone numbers, email
• Addresses
• Works even when the ID is photographed sideways
Swipe to hide anything else, and pinch to zoom for precise edits.
Redactions are solid black boxes that can't be undone, unlike blur.

■ Purpose watermark
Pick "Identity verification only", "Rental application only" and more, or type your own.
The date and "Not valid for any other use" repeat diagonally across the whole image, so it can't be cropped out.

■ Photo Vault
• Keep important photos and videos behind a pattern lock
• Everything in the vault is encrypted with AES-256 and stays on this phone
• Garim asks whether to delete the originals from your library after moving them
• Redact a vault photo and share it without changing the original

■ Your photos stay on your phone
• No sign-up, no servers — nothing is uploaded
• Shared images carry no location or device information
• The vault is excluded from iCloud backup

■ Garim Pro (one-time purchase, yours forever)
Unlimited vault and no ads. The core features stay free for good.

Privacy policy: https://morup.kr/web/upload/morup/garim/privacy.html
Contact: dormall01@daum.net

name: GCC World
description: El Proyecto del Grupo Corazones Cruzados, es un "Proyecto de Desarrollo Humano" que aplica "Sistemas de Gobernanza Innovadores" con el fin de Reconocer y Aprovechar las "Condiciones" de los Sujetos, y generar "Soluciones" que se requieren implementar para confrontar o corregir Problemas Individuales y Problemáticas Sociales que hoy están causando nuestra degeneración como Sociedad, y nos alejan cada vez más de nuestro objetivo principal, el cual es "Cruzar al Mundo".

name: Gear Miles: Shoe & Bike Log
description:
Automatic mileage for running shoes and bike parts from Apple Health / Health Connect workouts, with replacement alerts.

What you get:
- Every run lands on the right shoe
- Chains, tyres and pads tracked too
- Rules: trail runs go to trail shoes
- Alerts before your shoes are done
- No Strava account needed

Free to start. One in-app purchase adds the rest, with no subscription.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

name: GEDA – Quản lý website
description:
GEDA giúp bạn chăm sóc website của cửa hàng, quán hay doanh nghiệp ngay trên điện thoại.

• Trợ lý AI: nhắn điều bạn muốn đổi, Trợ lý đề xuất nội dung và bạn duyệt trước khi áp dụng. Có thể gửi kèm ảnh.
• Sửa trang: chạm vào chữ hoặc ảnh trên trang để sửa, thêm hoặc sắp xếp các khối, rồi xuất bản khi đã sẵn sàng.
• Nội dung: đăng bài viết, cập nhật sản phẩm, thực đơn và danh mục; ảnh được tải lên ngay cả khi mạng chập chờn.
• Khách hàng: xem yêu cầu liên hệ và đơn hàng mới, gọi hoặc nhắn lại nhanh.
• Thông báo: biết ngay khi có đơn hàng hoặc liên hệ mới.
• An toàn: mở ứng dụng bằng Face ID hoặc vân tay, xác minh hai bước, xoá tài khoản ngay trong ứng dụng.

Cần có tài khoản GEDA. Bạn có thể tạo tài khoản ngay trong ứng dụng.

name: Gemini Race Day Crew
description: Race-day station tools for Gemini Timing crew and volunteers: check-in, chip check, results and roster lookup, awards, manual timing and venue load-out. Requires an event station PIN.

name: General Food Comedores
description:
General Food - Sistema Comedores es la aplicación diseñada para simplificar tu experiencia gastronómica diaria en el comedor de tu planta o empresa.

Con esta app podrás consultar la propuesta de menús, realizar tus elecciones de forma anticipada y retirar tu plato de manera rápida y sin complicaciones.

¿Qué puedes hacer desde la app?
- Consulta de Menús: Explora los platos disponibles para el día, la semana o el mes, revisa su información nutricional y conoce las opciones gastronómicas de tu comedor.
- Pedidos Previos: Selecciona tu menú de forma anticipada antes del horario de cierre establecido.
- Código QR Personal: Utiliza tu QR en las estaciones del comedor para una identificación rápida y ágil al momento de retirar tu servicio.
- Aviso de Novedades: Entérate de las últimas novedades, propuestas especiales y participa en encuestas institucionales.

Disfruta de una forma más ágil, moderna y organizada de gestionar tus almuerzos y desayunos diarios.

name: GeoWarn
description: Traffic changes? Set from and to — GeoWarn estimates your trip and when to wake up.

name: Gerador de Temas Odonto
description:
Precisa de um tema de aplicativo para um projeto de Odontologia? O Gerador de Temas Odonto ajuda estudantes, mestrandos e docentes a transformar uma ideia em uma proposta organizada de app educacional.

Desenvolvido pela Faculdade Paulo Picanço (FACPP) para apoiar a graduação, a extensão e o Mestrado Profissional.

GERADOR DE TEMAS
• Escolha o público (pacientes, acadêmicos, extensão, especialistas ou mestrado) e a especialidade
• Informe, se quiser, uma palavra-chave e o contexto do projeto
• Receba uma proposta com descrição, público-alvo, funcionalidades sugeridas, aviso ético, plano de validação e checklist para as lojas
• Copie o prompt pronto e abra o Google AI Studio para prototipar

CATÁLOGO DE TEMAS
• Temas de exemplo com análise completa
• Busca, filtros por público e favoritos
• Salve os temas que você gerou para consultar depois

DIRETRIZES
Consulta rápida a referências usadas em projetos acadêmicos: DCN de Odontologia, Código de Ética Odontológica (CFO), LGPD, ética em pesquisa (CEP/CONEP), Produtos Técnicos e Tecnológicos da CAPES e políticas das lojas para apps de saúde.

FLUXOS DE TRABALHO
Passos ilustrados do tema ao Produto Técnico e Tecnológico, da validação com a escala SUS, da publicação nas lojas e de projetos de extensão.

PRIVACIDADE
Sem cadastro e sem login. Tudo funciona no próprio aparelho: os temas, favoritos e votos ficam salvos só no seu celular, e o app não coleta dados pessoais.

AVISO
Conteúdo educacional. As propostas são montadas a partir de modelos e servem como ponto de partida para o planejamento acadêmico; não substituem a orientação docente nem o julgamento clínico.

name: Get Up: Mission Alarm Clock
description:
An alarm that keeps ringing until you complete a task: scan a barcode in another room, walk a number of steps, or solve maths.

What you get:
- The alarm you can't sleep through
- Scan the toothpaste to stop it
- Walk 50 steps, then you're up
- Rings even on silent (iOS 26)
- No ads. Ever.

Free to start. One in-app purchase adds the rest, with no subscription.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

Before you buy:
- Alarms that sound in silent mode need iOS 26 or later.

name: GHSG
description:
Built with a focus on innovation and intuitive design, GHSG brings capable bookkeeping within easy reach — pairing everything you need with a clean, uncluttered interface that makes daily recording feel effortless.

We believe great technology should make life easier. That's why GHSG is thoughtfully designed to help users stay organized, keep income and expenses in order, and manage their finances with greater confidence.

With a commitment to performance, reliability, and continuous improvement, GHSG delivers a smarter, more convenient, and more personalized way to stay on top of the books.

name: Gibbonade
description:
Five grips so far, the Durian's par is seven, and your gibbon hangs halfway up the trunk with the noon sun in its eyes.

Touch and hold, and it reaches for the nearest liana and swings. Lift your finger, and it flies on whatever the swing gave it. Every grab counts like a stroke in golf. Finish a tree one under par and a sunbird marks it; two under brings a hornbill.

Swaying lianas drift out of reach, deadwood snaps a second after you land, and rattan thorns or a wasp nest cost a grip. Figs picked on the way can be swapped with Pandan the binturong for new gibbons, and a friend can take the phone for a Troop Duel.

Near the top of the eighteen trees the canopy thins. Where sunlight breaks through, warm air rises and carries any gibbon that lets go at the right moment.

name: Gift Keeper: Gift Tracker
description:
What did I buy for them? And where did I put it?

Gift Keeper keeps every gift in one place: who it's for, what you bought, what you spent — and where you hid it, so Christmas morning never starts with a search party.

• Your people list: tap a name, see everything you bought for them
• The where-you-hid-it spot on every gift
• One gift for two people? Split it — Gift Keeper divides the price for you
• Snap a screenshot of an order and Gift Keeper reads it in
• A PIN lock, so nobody peeking at your phone sees their own gift

Built by a grandma who was tired of asking "which one is HIS?"

Gift Keeper is $15.99 a year. One subscription covers all your lists — Christmas, birthdays, and everything in between.

name: Gift Ledger
description:
Gift Ledger turns the busy work of giving into a calm, personal ritual. Keep a living list of the people you care about, remember the details they actually enjoy, and prepare for birthdays, anniversaries, holidays, and the everyday celebrations that are easy to miss. Each recipient has a thoughtful profile for favorite things, sizes, dislikes, and notes, so the next idea starts with context instead of guesswork. Create occasions with dates, reminders, and a comfortable target budget, then connect several gifts to the same moment and see the plan at a glance.

Capture gift ideas while you are browsing or listening. Sort them by person, category, estimated cost, and stage, then move a promising idea into a planned gift when it feels right. A gift keeps its own story: the recipient, occasion, store, status, planned cost, paid amount, purchase date, and a note for later. Record an expense after checkout, update a gift from planned to ordered, received, or given, and keep the purchase history useful long after the wrapping paper is gone.

The Overview brings the next few occasions and your year-to-date spending into one readable place. Quick actions help you add a person, occasion, or gift before the thought disappears. The Budget view gives you a clear annual limit, remaining room, and category pulse without making generosity feel like a score. The calendar helps you see the rhythm of the year, while the yearly report turns completed gifts into a gentle record of attention.

Gift Ledger is designed for real life: a few seconds in a shop, a quiet planning session at home, or a last-minute check before you visit someone. Search your circle, open a recipient to revisit preferences, and move naturally from an occasion to the gifts attached to it. Forms stay focused, costs are validated, and empty states always point to a useful next step. You can restore the example ledger to learn the flow, choose a light, dark, or system appearance, and control reminders from Settings.

Your ledger is shaped around your relationships and your own pace. Use it for a small circle or a full calendar of traditions, keep plans modest or ambitious, and let the app remember the meaningful details so you can spend more time choosing well and less time trying to remember what worked last year.

name: Gilos
description:
Gilos — доставка продуктов по Ташкенту. Свежие овощи, фрукты, молочное, мясо, хлеб и товары для дома — прямо к вашей двери.

ЧТО МОЖНО
• Быстрая доставка — заказ примерно за 30 минут или к удобному времени.
• Еженедельные корзины — подписка на готовую корзину для семьи. Выберите день и время, добавьте любые товары, ставьте на паузу или переносите доставку.
• Готовая еда и обеды в офис — блюда к нужной дате и времени или подписка на обеды по будням.
• Рецепты и подборки — пошаговые рецепты, все ингредиенты в корзину в одно касание.
• Скидки и промокоды — акции каждый день, сортировка по цене и скидке.
• Баллы — играйте в мини-игры, копите баллы и оплачивайте ими часть заказа.
• Чат поддержки — пишите нам текстом или с фото прямо в приложении.

ОПЛАТА
Курьеру наличными или картой при получении.

Вопросы? Пишите в приложении (Профиль → Поддержка) или звоните +998 20 029 98 98.

name: Girl Voice Changer: GirlMod AI
description:
Girl Voice Changer gives you a realistic girl's voice with AI that runs 100% on your iPhone. Not a chipmunk pitch effect. Use it live in your headphones. Your voice is never uploaded.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT
• 9 female voices: Sweet, Bright, Soft, Anime, College, Smoky, Warm, Mature, Granny
• Live mode: hear your girl voice as you talk
• Record once, hear yourself in every voice
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Works offline, even in airplane mode
• Share as a voice message or WAV file

Great for pranks, voice notes, videos, characters and roleplay.

Free to try. Unlimited removes every limit and records up to 2 minutes: weekly, or one Lifetime payment. No credits, no tokens.

Good to know: iOS doesn’t let any app change your voice during phone or FaceTime calls. Instead, record a clip and send it as a voice message, or use Live with headphones to hear your new voice as you talk.

name: Glancify - 看板与稍后读 · AI 助理
description:
Glancify，把你日常关注的各种信息（如待办、日程、金融行情、资讯、播客、视频、社交媒体等），收进一眼之间。
不被算法推荐牵着走，也不用在多App 之间来回切换看信息——你关注什么，就按自己需要搭一个信息流。

■ 你的看板，你说了算
· 待办、日程提示一屏呈现，还能把系统日历里的日程同步成倒计时
· 股票、基金、指数、汇率行情随时可看，红涨绿跌一目了然，点开可看分时与明细
· 各类数据显示条数、卡片高度都能调；重要的置顶，不重要的收起来
· 首页可设为看板或待阅，打开就是你想先看的那一屏

■ 收一个角落，让深度阅读发生
· 复制链接或从系统分享面板一键存入待阅，支持自添加 RSS 源与关键词监控
· 阅读模式一键去掉视觉噪音，字号、行距、字体、无图模式随你调
· 文章可离线缓存，飞机上、地铁里照样能读；可设置自动清理，避免无限囤积
· 一键摘录存笔记、收藏、笔记导出 CSV，同步 flomo，读过的内容留得下来也带得走

■ 同一份内容，多种方式消化
· 长文一键生成摘要卡：一句话概述 + 要点 + 洞察，像翻卡片一样左右滑
· 整篇翻译，语言不该是认知的边界
· 支持多种音色把文章读给你听，开车、做家务时也不落下
· 视频与播客链接可转成文字稿，语音识别在设备端完成，可听可读

■ 越用越懂你的 AI 小览
· 结合你的待办、行情与阅读记录，给出每日简报和推荐阅读
· 就某一篇文章展开讲讲、追问细节，或让它帮你记下一件事
· 长期记忆沉淀你的偏好，重要的一条不落，琐碎的不占地方，随时可查可删

■ 数据始终是你的
· 默认本地优先：看板、待阅、收藏、笔记与记忆都存在你自己的设备上
· 云同步、剪藏到 ima、收藏同步 Notion、笔记同步 flomo 按需启用
· 不接广告，不申请定位、通讯录、相机、麦克风等敏感权限

AI 摘要、翻译与 AI 小览为可选增强能力，可在设置中配置；不启用不影响看板、待阅、阅读、收藏与笔记等核心功能。
AI 生成内容可能不准确，仅供参考，不构成专业建议。

name: Glidra
description:
One tap. One chain. One exit.

Glidra turns a board of arrows into a single decision. Study the grid, choose your starting tile, and watch the chain unfold. Every tile must be cleared before you reach the exit.

LEARN THE PATTERN
Work through 64 Normal levels with room to practise each new mechanic. A wrong choice restarts the puzzle, so you can rethink your route and try again.

ENTER THE VAULT
Take on 12 additional puzzles with keys, locks, and turning tiles. The order matters as much as the direction.

SURVIVE THE GAUNTLET
Play generated puzzles in a run where one mistake sends you back to the beginning. New runs bring different boards.

FEEL THE CHAIN
Neon boards, animated tiles, rising musical feedback, and optional haptics make each successful route satisfying to watch. Sound, haptics, and reduced motion can be adjusted in Options.

PLAY IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Choose English, Turkish, Spanish, Portuguese, German or French in Options. Automatic follows your device language, with English as the fallback.

No player account is required. Progress is stored on your device. Occasional ads appear between completed Normal levels or before retries after failed attempts beyond the introductory levels. Gauntlet runs are ad-free. An optional one-time Remove Ads purchase disables interstitial ads; Restore Purchases is available in Options.

name: Glimmerpath
description:
Trace a paw-print path through the maze and walk Bo the polar cub home to the igloo, where Mama Bear is waiting with a hug.

START RIGHT AWAY
The first maze opens as soon as you start, with no menu and no sign-up. A little hand shows where to drag. Mistakes cost nothing: back up along the trail, tap undo, or start the maze again. Stuck? Tap the glowing paw and the next steps light up. No rush.

100 MAZES IN 5 WORLDS
The mazes start tiny and grow slowly, and each world adds one new idea:
- Snowy Meadow: learn the trail and catch the fish.
- Pine Woods: find the key that opens the gate.
- Ice Caves: slide along the ice.
- Berry Bridges: paths cross over and under.
- Aurora Night: light the lanterns in the dark.

FISH, STARS AND CRITTERS
Every maze has three stars: one for getting home, one for finding all the fish, and one for the hidden critter. Most critters hide down a dead end, so wrong turns can pay off. Each one goes in the sticker book, with 100 stickers to collect. At the end of each world, Bo comes home with a friend.

FOR GROWN-UPS
- No ads and nothing to buy.
- Play is all pictures, with no reading needed.
- No accounts and no chat. Progress saves on your device.
- A grown-up check guards Settings and Delete My Data.
- Left hand mode moves the buttons to suit either hand.
- We made the music and sounds ourselves.

Made by Seventh Anvil Games, the makers of Polar Bears vs. Warthogs.

name: Gloomspire: Tower Digger
description:
Dig down. Don't stop. Something is coming down the tower after you.

Gloomspire is a fast one-thumb arcade digger. Smash through the tower one brick at a time, grab the gems, and stay ahead of the Gloom. A run lasts exactly as long as you keep digging.

DIG
Bricks break in one hit. Stone takes two. Riveted iron never breaks, so you find a way round it, fast. Crates and powder kegs fall when nothing holds them up. Chests take time to open, and time is the one thing you do not have.

OUTRUN THE GLOOM
The Gloom gives you four seconds, then it comes. Keep moving and you leave it behind. Stand still and it finds you. Every floor it gets faster, and nothing saves you from it.

12 MONSTERS, 12 RULES
Everything down here has a rule. The shellback is armored on top, so strike it from the side. The thornling has spiked sides, so drop onto it. The mimic is a chest that bites. The wisp drifts through walls and cannot be hit at all. Learn the rule and it is a gem in your pocket. Forget it and the run is over.

12 FLOORS, 12 DANGERS
Each floor of the tower has its own look and its own trap: crumbling flagstones in the Keep, dart plates in the Treasury, falling boulders in the Mine, icicles in the frozen halls.

LIGHT UP THE DARK
The Lantern shoves the Gloom back and freezes it. The Drill breaks anything diggable in one hit. The Magnet pulls nearby gems to you and counts them double. Spend your gems on boosters before a run: a Comet start, an Aegis, a Second Wind.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Endless Tower: a fresh tower every run, and it never ends. One number matters: how deep you got.
• Daily Tower: one tower a day, the same for every player. Compare depths with your friends on equal terms.
• History: a hundred dungeons, cleared in order. Reach the exit for one star. Leave rich for three.

20 DIGGERS TO COLLECT
Knight, witch, ghost, astronaut, a cat that digs with its paws. Every character digs exactly the same, so the Daily Tower stays fair for everyone. Unlock them with the gems you find, or earn the rare ones by going deep.

MADE FOR YOUR PHONE
• One thumb, portrait, short runs. Restart in a second.
• Plays without an internet connection.
• Your progress is saved to iCloud and follows you to a new device.
• iPhone and iPad.

Gloomspire is free to play. It shows ads and offers optional in-app purchases; any purchase removes the banner and full-screen ads.

Privacy policy: https://gloomspire.app/privacy

name: Gloova
description:
Gloova est l'agenda en ligne pensé pour les professionnelles de la beauté : esthéticiennes, prothésistes ongulaires, coiffeuses, maquilleuses, instituts et indépendantes à domicile.

Vos clientes réservent elles-mêmes, 24h/24, depuis votre page de réservation. Vous gérez tout depuis votre iPhone ou votre iPad.

AGENDA
• Vue jour et semaine, rendez-vous créés en quelques secondes
• Créneaux, pauses et jours de fermeture
• Alertes avant chaque rendez-vous et widget sur l'écran d'accueil

RÉSERVATION EN LIGNE
• Votre page de réservation personnelle (gloova.fr/salon/votre-institut)
• Lien et QR code à partager sur Instagram, Facebook ou en institut
• Confirmations et rappels envoyés automatiquement par email

FICHES CLIENTES
• Historique des rendez-vous, notes, anniversaires
• Clientes à relancer et liste d'attente

PRESTATIONS ET FINANCES
• Catalogue de prestations avec durées et tarifs
• Chiffre d'affaires du jour, de la semaine et du mois

VITRINE
• Présentation de votre institut, galerie photos et avis clientes

FORMULES (abonnement mensuel, sans engagement)
• Gloova Pro – 9,99 €/mois : réservation, agenda, clientes, vitrine, avis, galerie, finances
• Gloova Pro+ – 13,99 €/mois : tout Pro, plus fidélité, cartes cadeaux, réductions, paiement en ligne, couleurs et polices
• Gloova Ultra – 15,99 €/mois : tout Pro+, plus équipe illimitée et agenda par employé

L'abonnement est prélevé sur votre compte Apple à la confirmation de l'achat. Il se renouvelle automatiquement chaque mois, sauf résiliation au moins 24 heures avant la fin de la période en cours. Vous pouvez gérer ou résilier votre abonnement dans les réglages de votre compte Apple.

Conditions d'utilisation : https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Confidentialité : https://gloova.fr/confidentialite

Une question ? contact@gloova.fr

name: Glorbi: Squishy Simulator
description:
Squeeze, stretch, relax.

Glorbi is a squishy toy that feels real. Every press, pinch and pull is simulated with real soft-body physics, so it dents under your thumb, bulges between your fingers and slowly springs back. Recorded squish sounds and gentle haptics follow every move.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Press, knead, pinch and stretch with one or two fingers
• Tap Squeeze to watch it get squished, then Reshape
• Tilt your phone and the highlights move with the light
• Five colors: Pistachio, Guava, Lavender, Honey and Glacier

FREE TO PLAY
The Pebble in every color is free, forever.

ONE UNLOCK FOR EVERYTHING
A single purchase opens the full library: every shape (Pebble, Pillow, Heart, Star and Gummy ring) and every filling (Gel, Memory foam, Coconut oil, Glitter gel, Foam and Mochi silicone), plus everything we add later.

LIMITED DROPS
Special squishies, like Pocket Nebula, are available for a limited time. Once you buy one, it's yours to keep.

NO ADS, NO ACCOUNTS
Nothing to sign up for. Turn sound or vibration off anytime.

Try it in your browser at glorbi.app.

name: Glowra: Weekend Picks
description:
Make a little room for a weekend adventure.

Glowra helps you choose where to go from 20 built-in destinations in Hangzhou, China. Set your preferences, pick a reveal style, and discover one place that fits your plans.

FIND YOUR NEXT OUTING
Filter places by visit duration, transport, estimated budget, group size, indoor or outdoor setting, and interests.

THREE WAYS TO REVEAL
Choose a card, capsule, or wheel animation to reveal a matching destination. All three styles are free and use the same selection process.

KEEP YOUR FAVORITES
Favorite places, save outing ideas as tickets, and revisit your recent draws. Use a previous ticket’s conditions to explore again.

TAKE THE NEXT STEP
View destination addresses and planning notes, share an idea as text, or open an address in an external map service.

SIMPLE AND LOCAL
No online account is required. Your profile and saved picks stay on your device, and destination selection works offline.

Glowra currently includes guides for Hangzhou only. Shanghai and Suzhou do not yet have built-in destinations.

Budgets are rough estimates in USD per person. Verify opening hours, actual prices, access, and booking requirements before travelling. Planned dates do not check venue availability. Saved tickets are planning records, not reservations or admission tickets, and the in-app illustration is decorative rather than navigation.

name: Gnosys
description:
Gnosys, c'est le clavier qui traduit pendant que tu écris.

Tu viens d'arriver au Québec? Écris dans ta langue, dans WhatsApp, Messenger ou n'importe quelle app : Gnosys envoie ton message en français du Québec, naturel et avec le « tu », ou en anglais du Canada.

CE QUE GNOSYS FAIT POUR TOI
• Clavier traducteur : tu écris dans ta langue, la traduction apparaît directement dans ton message.
• 14 langues : espagnol, français, anglais, portugais, arabe, chinois, ukrainien, russe, vietnamien, hindi, turc, italien, allemand et coréen.
• Mode conversation : face à face, chacun parle dans sa langue et Gnosys traduit à voix haute.
• Dictée : parle au lieu d'écrire, Gnosys traduit.
• Correction et ton amical grâce à l'intelligence assistée d'Apple (selon ton iPhone).

PRIVÉ PAR DÉFAUT
La traduction se fait sur ton iPhone. Gnosys n'envoie pas tes messages à un serveur et ne garde aucun historique. Après le premier téléchargement des langues, ça fonctionne sans Internet.

Fait à Sept-Îles, sur la Côte-Nord, pour que la langue ne nous sépare pas.

name: GO HAM!
description:
You stole the corn. The farmer is FURIOUS. RUN, PIGGY, RUN!

GO HAM! is a fast, funny endless runner starring one very hungry pig and one very angry farmer. Swipe to dodge, jump and roll your way down the road, grab every coin you can, and see how far you get before the farmer catches up.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Swipe left and right to switch lanes
• Swipe up to jump, and again in mid-air for a double jump
• Swipe down to roll under trouble
• Tap to fire corn at crows and hay bales

WHAT'S OUT THERE
• Hay bales, scarecrows, tractors and swooping crows
• Magnets that pull in every coin nearby
• Boost pads that send you surging forward
• Collect three hearts and... pigs really do fly
• A rainbow Super Star that makes you unstoppable

FOUR WORLDS TO UNLOCK
• FARM: where it all started
• CITY: traffic, dumpsters and rush hour
• NEON: a glowing neon skyline
• SPACE: aliens, UFOs and moon rocks

DRESS YOUR PIG
Spend the coins you collect in the STY-LE SHOP on new looks: Muddy, Golden Hog, Ninja Pig, Robo-Hog, Disco and more. There is a secret skin for anyone who can survive a full minute.

WORLDWIDE LEADERBOARD
Every world has its own top list. Add a first name and see where you rank against players everywhere, or skip it and just play.

NO ADS. NOTHING TO BUY.
The whole game is free. No ads, no in-app purchases, no account to create. It works offline too.

It only gets faster. Go ham or go home!

name: GoGoStatus
description:
Go Go Status helps you prepare clearer, share-ready photos and videos for WhatsApp Status. Choose media, create an optimized HD copy, save it on your iPhone, or send it to your linked WhatsApp account.

Go Go Status HD is an optional auto-renewing monthly subscription with a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple ID and renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple ID settings.

Terms of Use: https://gogo-web-production.up.railway.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://gogo-web-production.up.railway.app/privacy

Go Go Status is an independent app and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by WhatsApp or Meta.

name: Gold Rate: Gold Price Today
description:
Today's gold rate in Saudi Arabia, in riyals, for 24, 22, 21 and 18 carat: buying rate, selling rate and the change since yesterday's close, with the time of the last update in Riyadh time and the Hijri date (Umm al-Qura).

Where the rate comes from
Every figure is worked out from the world rate for a troy ounce of gold in US dollars, at 3.75 riyals to the dollar and 31.1035 grams to the ounce, updated every 5 minutes. The app says so plainly: the selling and old gold rates are estimates, not a shop's quote, and no rate includes making charges or VAT.

What is inside
• The gram rate of your carat in large type, and a table of all carats per gram, 10 g, ounce, kilo and tola.
• The world ounce rate in dollars and riyals, with today's low and high.
• Tola and pavan rates, and the Saudi rate converted to Indian and Pakistani rupees.
• Gold value calculator by weight and carat, with 15% VAT.
• Making charges calculator: build the bill, or work back from a shop's total to its charge per gram.
• Old gold calculator with stone weight taken off.
• How many grams an amount buys.
• Zakat on gold, with a nisab of 85 g (ZATCA guide) or 92 g (fatwas of Sheikh Ibn Baz).
• Gold bar values from 1 gram to 1 kilo, plus the Saudi guinea, British sovereign and Rashadi lira.
• Rate chart: today, then 1 to 20 years from monthly averages. The 7 and 30 day views appear once the daily history has filled up.
• Price alerts, such as "22K at or below 445".
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widget with your carat's rate and today's change.
• Works offline with the last saved rates and tells you when they are from.
• Share the rate as a message.
• Arabic and English, light and dark appearance, Dynamic Type.

No sign-up and no account. The app is free and shows ads.

The app does not buy or sell gold, does not advise buying or selling and makes no forecasts. Rates are a guide; the price in a shop differs by making charges and the seller's margin.

name: GoldenAce SunWin
description:
Golden Ace SunWin mang đến bốn trò chơi giải trí trong khung cảnh Noel với tuyết, ánh đèn và sắc đỏ vàng.

Tài Xỉu: lắc ba xúc xắc, xem tổng và phân loại kết quả. Bạn có thể chọn Tài hoặc Xỉu để đoán vui, hoặc lắc ngay mà không cần chọn. Các bộ ba được ghi riêng.

Bầu Cua Tôm Cá: khám phá bộ hình Noel gồm Cua đỏ, Tôm, Cá, Bầu, Gà và Cua xanh theo thiết kế của app. Đây là bộ hình riêng, không dùng Nai. Dự đoán một hình nếu muốn rồi xem kết quả của ba viên xúc xắc.

Tiến Lên Miền Nam: chơi với ba bot trên máy trong biến thể về nhất. Chọn bài, dùng Gợi ý, Đánh hoặc Bỏ lượt; người hết bài trước kết thúc ván. Luật bộ bài, chặt và tới trắng có trong Hướng dẫn.

Phỏm: luyện tập với ba bot theo biến thể bốn lượt đánh cố định, không né hạ. Ăn hoặc Bốc, Đánh, Hạ phỏm, Gửi và Ù theo từng giai đoạn. Điểm bài rác dùng để xếp hạng ván, không phải một loại tiền hoặc điểm có thể mua/đổi.

App không có đặt cược, xu ảo, ví, nạp/rút hay đổi thưởng. Không đăng nhập, không quảng cáo, không mua hàng trong app hoặc đăng ký trả phí. Các trò chơi, bot, hình ảnh và hướng dẫn hoạt động offline.

Ván đang chơi, cài đặt và 200 kết quả gần nhất được lưu trên thiết bị. Bạn có thể về Trang chủ rồi tiếp tục ván. Âm thanh và nhạc mặc định tắt; có thể bật lại cùng rung và hiệu ứng trong Cài đặt. Bản sao lưu của hệ điều hành phụ thuộc lựa chọn của người dùng.

Key Features

- Bốn trò chơi: Tài Xỉu, Bầu Cua bộ hình Noel, Tiến Lên Miền Nam và Phỏm.
- Ba bot cục bộ trong hai game bài, không cần tài khoản hoặc đối thủ online.
- Xúc xắc thật trong giao diện 3D; dự đoán vui hoàn toàn tùy chọn.
- Hướng dẫn rõ các biến thể, lịch sử local và tiếp tục ván trên máy.
- Màn chơi tràn màn hình iPhone và iPad; bài và xúc xắc thích ứng với cửa sổ, có bố cục ngang và dọc.

name: Gondola Trouble
description:
Welcome to the valley! The gondola station is packed, and a crowd of hikers is waiting to ride up the mountain.

Tap a gondola to send it out of the pile and into a free bay at the station. Hikers of the same colour walk round the loop and hop in, and a full gondola rides the cable up into the mountains. Plan your taps: there are only a few bays, and the wrong gondola at the wrong time blocks the whole station.

• Handmade peaks that get trickier step by step
• Every gondola points the way it can leave: free them in the right order
• Mystery gondolas show their colour only once they are free
• Rope Winch lifts a stuck gondola straight into a bay
• Fresh Coat repaints a gondola in the colour you need
• Summit Express: a special bay that leaves as soon as boarding stops
• Daily Rucksack with a free reward every day
• A cosy snowy look, squishy gondolas and happy hikers
• Plays offline, no account needed
• In 23 languages

Gondola Trouble is free to play. Optional in-app purchases are available for coins and boosters.

Privacy: https://gondolatrouble.amuradesign.ch/privacy/
Terms: https://gondolatrouble.amuradesign.ch/terms/
Support: https://gondolatrouble.amuradesign.ch/support/

name: GPS Map Camera - Gnananetra
description:
GPS Map Camera - Capture Photos with Location Details

Capture photos with GPS coordinates, address information, and location stamps using GPS Map Camera by Gnananetra.

Whether you're documenting work visits, recording locations, capturing travel memories, or organizing field activities, GPS Map Camera helps you keep useful location details alongside your photos.

KEY FEATURES

GPS LOCATION STAMPING
Add location details to captured photos, including GPS coordinates, latitude, longitude, and available address information.

ADDRESS INFORMATION
View location-based address details when available, including street and building information supported by your device's location services.

INSTANT PHOTO CAPTURE
Capture photos quickly with a simple, easy-to-use camera interface.

IN-APP PHOTO GALLERY
Keep captured photos organized in the application's gallery so you can access and view them whenever needed.

EASY PHOTO SHARING
Share captured photos with others directly from the application.

PHOTO AND LOCATION SHARING
Share a photo along with its location information, helping others understand where it was captured.

MAP LOCATION SHARING
Share your captured location using a map link and available address details.

CUSTOMIZABLE LOCATION STAMPS
Choose the location information you want to include in your captured photos.

IDEAL FOR

• Field visits and marketing activities
• Property and site inspections
• Travel and location documentation
• Business and work-related photography
• Construction and project site records
• Everyday photos with location details

ACCURATE LOCATION INFORMATION

Location details depend on your device's GPS signal, location permissions, and available mapping information. Exact addresses and building numbers may not be available at every location.

Developed by Gnananetra Consulting Services Private Limited.

Capture photos. Record locations. Share with confidence.

name: GR Mod - For Ricoh GR IV/III
description:
GR Mod makes a modified copy of Ricoh's official firmware for your GR camera, with the changes you choose, and installs it on the camera.

IMAGE CONTROL
• Import .xmp / .cube presets (sRGB / Rec.709) into the Cinema (Yellow) / Cinema (Green) slots, or into up to 20 added slots
• Rename looks, change their icons and the order of the menu

ASPECT RATIOS
Add your own, such as 65:24, 2.39:1 or 5:4, next to the camera's 3:2, 4:3, 16:9 and 1:1.

POWER-OFF IMAGE
Up to 8 pictures of your own for the camera's end screen.

ADDITIONS
Soft focus on the ADJ lever, date imprint, the GR IV Monochrome's B&W looks, Direct Flash, HDR gain map, exposure preview switch, more ADJ lever items and brighter automatic screen brightness.

SEND TO CAMERA
GR IV family: GR Mod connects to the camera over Bluetooth and its Wi-Fi and sends the firmware; the camera updates itself. No memory card needed.

SAVE TO DEVICE
Every supported model: save the firmware, copy it to a memory card and update from the camera.

SUPPORTED CAMERAS
GR IV, GR IV HDF (firmware 1.20 / 1.11), GR IV Monochrome (1.10), GR III, GR III HDF (2.20 / 2.10), GR IIIx, GR IIIx HDF (1.70 / 1.60). Sending over Wi-Fi works for the GR IV family, with firmware of the camera's own base version.

GR Mod starts from the official firmware, downloaded from Ricoh's website. The official firmware can be installed again at any time to go back. A camera that installs a newer firmware cannot go back to an older one.

GR Mod is an independent project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Ricoh Imaging.

name: GR Photo
description:
Get your photos off your GR without the wait, and see what an Image Control look will do before you take the shot.

GR Photo is a companion app for the Ricoh GR III, GR IIIx and GR IV.

YOUR PHOTOS, WITHOUT THE WAIT
Tap Library and GR Photo connects to the camera for you. Scroll through a full card without sitting through slow thumbnails, open any photo full screen, and save the ones you want as JPEG, RAW or both. Downloads carry on when you switch apps or lock your phone, so you can put it back in your pocket.

NO MORE GUESSING WITH IMAGE CONTROL
On the camera, building a look means changing a number, taking a test shot and trying again. In GR Photo you move a slider and see the change straight away on one of your own photos, side by side with the original. You can do it anywhere, with the camera still in your bag. The preview is a close approximation of what the camera produces.

ALL YOUR LOOKS, READY TO LOAD
The camera has three Custom slots. Your phone has room for every look you make. Keep them all in GR Photo and load whichever one suits the day into C1, C2 or C3 before you head out. Found an old photo with colours you love? Save the Image Control it was taken with and shoot with it again.

SHOOT FROM YOUR PHONE
See what the camera sees, tap to focus, and set aperture, shutter speed, ISO and exposure compensation from your phone. Or just use the big shutter button as a remote for tripod shots and group photos.

REMEMBER WHERE YOU TOOK IT
The GR has no GPS, but your phone does. Turn on geotagging and your photos come home with their location, ready to show on a map.

PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no analytics. GR Photo talks to your camera and, to draw the map of where a photo was taken, to OpenFreeMap. Nothing else.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Works with the GR III, GR IIIx and GR IV, including the HDF models and the GR IV Monochrome.
• Looks need a GR IV on firmware 1.04 or later, a GR IV HDF or a GR IV Monochrome. The GR III and GR IIIx can't exchange Image Control settings with a phone.
• So far GR Photo has been tested with a GR IV HDF. The GR III and GR IIIx have not been tried on a real camera yet.
• Available in 21 languages, with light and dark themes.

GR Photo is an independent project and is not affiliated with Ricoh.

name: GradeBuff
description:
GradeBuff turns studying into a game your family plays together.

Kids earn XP for real schoolwork: focus sprints, practice rounds, homework, reading and a weekly Boss Battle. XP only counts after a parent approves it, so the points always match the work.

FOR KIDS
- Focus sprint timer: 15, 25 or 45 minutes
- Practice rounds for their grade and classes, plus Speed run and Fix your misses
- A library of classic short stories, each with a quiz
- A battle pass with rewards a parent picks
- Build a city with the cash they earn
- Badges and day streaks

FOR PARENTS
- One approval queue for every child
- Choose the reward for each tier
- Add homework and due dates
- Chores that earn XP
- See everything your child does, and remove or delete accounts at any time

Made for families: no ads, no trackers and no chat. Children never need an email address. A parent creates every child's account.

For kindergarten through 12th grade.

name: Grandma's Tavern: Pinochle
description:
Grandma's Tavern is a two-player Pinochle card game with a fantasy roguelite twist. Bid, build meld, choose trump, and win tricks against the tavern's opponents. Learn the rules with Turnip or put your card skills to work in Story and Endless Night.

PLAY THE CARDS
Bid for the hand, choose trump, declare meld, and take tricks. Use the scoring reference to check combinations and points as you play.

BUILD YOUR RUN
In Story and Endless, card play affects Tolerance, Influence, and Resilience. Collect items that stay with you during your run and combine their effects as you face the next opponent.

MEET THE TAVERN
Choose your traveller and meet Hobb, Grum, Mordren, Vaelis, and Grandma through branching dialogue and fantasy stories inspired by tabletop adventures.

Story offers Easy, Normal, and Real Life card difficulty. Real Life uses an unbiased shuffle, like a real deck.

KEEP PLAYING IN ENDLESS NIGHT
Complete Story with the full-game unlock to access Endless Night. Opponents gain more health with each new night. Continue with your Story items, or start a fresh Endless run with a random permanent item and a starting stat-bonus choice. Endless uses Real Life card difficulty.

LEARN OR PLAY A FRIEND
Learn to Play with Turnip guides you through the game. Practise in Free Play Against Grandma, or challenge a friend online to two-player Pinochle.

EARN YOUR EXTRAS
Defeat opponents on Real Life difficulty to earn character-themed card faces, with two more designs available in Endless. Explore appearance options, achievements, unlocked cutscenes, and Lost and Found.

WHAT YOU CAN PLAY FREE
• Story through the encounter with Grum.
• Free Play Against Grandma.
• Play a Friend.
• Learn to Play.

Free Story progress is not saved when you exit.

ONE-TIME FULL-GAME UNLOCK
A single permanent in-app purchase unlocks:
• The complete Story and Story saving.
• Endless access after completing Story.
• Appearance customisation and earnable card-face designs.
• The cutscene gallery, Lost and Found, and achievements.
• Unlockable extras for Play a Friend.

Gameplay rewards must still be earned. No subscription is required.

ABOUT THE PROJECT
Grandma's Tavern is the first game project from Ice-Type Platypi Studios. The story, characters and rules were created by author Wayne T. Luttrull and the studio. The artwork is drawn in a coloured-pencil storybook style.

Pull up a chair. Grandma's waiting.

name: Gravel Mulch & Soil Calculator
description:
Gravel calculator, mulch calculator, soil calculator and cubic yard calculator in one free app. Measure your project, get the quantity in cubic yards and tons, then see the delivered price for your Florida ZIP code.

HOW MUCH GRAVEL, MULCH, SOIL OR SAND DO I NEED?
1. Pick a material: gravel, crushed stone, rock, pea gravel, limerock, topsoil, fill dirt, garden soil, sand or mulch.
2. Enter length and width. Pick a depth.
3. See how many cubic yards or tons you need.
4. Enter your ZIP code and see the price with delivery included.

GRAVEL CALCULATOR, STONE CALCULATOR, ROCK CALCULATOR
• Gravel calculator: cubic yards and tons of gravel for a driveway, a path or a drainage bed.
• Driveway gravel calculator: how many tons of gravel for a gravel driveway.
• Crushed stone calculator: #57 stone, #67 stone and #4 stone in tons.
• Pea gravel calculator: pea gravel in cubic yards and tons.
• Limerock calculator and road base calculator.
• Paver base calculator and paver patio calculator.
• French drain calculator: drain rock in cubic yards.
• Retaining wall backfill calculator.
• Recycled materials calculator: recycled asphalt millings in tons.

MULCH CALCULATOR
• Mulch calculator: cubic yards of mulch for garden beds and tree rings. Red mulch, brown mulch or black mulch.
• Playground mulch calculator.
• How many yards of mulch do I need? Enter the bed size and the depth. The mulch calculator gives the answer in cubic yards.

SOIL CALCULATOR, TOPSOIL CALCULATOR, DIRT CALCULATOR
• Topsoil calculator: cubic yards of topsoil for a lawn or for sod.
• Soil calculator and garden soil calculator.
• Raised garden bed soil calculator: soil for a raised bed.
• Fill dirt calculator: cubic yards of fill dirt for your yard.
• Fill sand calculator.

SAND CALCULATOR
• Sand calculator: concrete sand, mason sand, play sand and beach sand in cubic yards and tons.

CUBIC YARD CALCULATOR AND YARDAGE CALCULATOR
Use the cubic yard calculator for any landscape material. Enter the area and the depth, and the yardage calculator gives the cubic yards. Convert cubic yards to tons and tons to cubic yards. The converter uses the weight of each material, so a yard of mulch and a yard of stone give different answers.

LANDSCAPE MATERIAL ESTIMATOR
Plan a landscaping or construction project before you buy. The app is a gravel estimator, a mulch estimator, a topsoil estimator and an aggregate calculator. It gives the quantity in cubic yards and tons, and the cost of the material with delivery. Use it for a driveway, a patio, a walkway, a garden, a lawn, a playground, a French drain or a retaining wall.

DELIVERED PRICE BY ZIP CODE
Gravel delivery, mulch delivery, topsoil delivery, fill dirt delivery and sand delivery in Florida. The price you see is the price you pay. Delivery is included. Your price is held for 72 hours, so you can compare and decide. Order online and choose a weekday for your delivery. A dump truck brings the bulk material to your address.

FOR HOMEOWNERS, LANDSCAPERS AND CONTRACTORS
A landscaping calculator and a material calculator for a small garden bed or a full truck load of bulk landscape materials. Add many areas and the app adds them up. Email the quote to yourself or to your customer.

YOUR ORDERS
Sign in with your email to see your orders and your delivery details.

HELP FROM A PERSON
Call or text us from the app. A person replies Mon–Fri, 7 am–5 pm ET.

DELIVERY AREA
The gravel calculator, the mulch calculator, the soil calculator and the cubic yard converter work anywhere. Delivered prices and delivery are available in Florida only.

Free. No account needed to calculate or to see a price.

name: GraviSpin
description:
Drop. Spin. Capture. Let gravity change the game.

Play as the Sun against the Moon computer opponent on a 7×7 board. Each turn, drop a stone into a column or spend a spin to rotate the board 90° left or right. Every stone falls again, opening new possibilities with each shift of the board.

SURROUND STONES. START A CHAIN.
Stones of the same side form groups through horizontal and vertical connections. A group with no empty space directly above, below, left, or right is removed, giving the opposing side one point per stone. The remaining stones fall and may trigger further captures. Aim to capture six opposing stones in a match, with three spins available to each player. Plan your captures while keeping your own groups safe.

CHOOSE YOUR CHALLENGE
Face Easy, Normal, or Hard computer opponents. Learn how drops and rotations work together, then try a tougher rival. Built-in rules are ready whenever you need a refresher.

ONE DAILY PUZZLE. ONE MOVE.
Daily puzzles are generated offline using your device's local date. Study the starting board and choose one drop or one spin to reach the highest capture total available in a single move. Retry or replay the puzzle to explore your options.

EARN BADGES AND STONE SKINS
Unlock 10 achievement badges and track wins, total captures, your best chain, and solved puzzle days. Start with Sun & Moon stones, then earn the Bubblegum and Lava & Ice skins through achievements.

PLAY OFFLINE
Enjoy colorful space-themed artwork with animated drops, spins, and captures. No internet connection or account is required, and there are no ads. Statistics, badges, settings, and solved puzzle dates stay on your device. Adjust sound effects, vibration, and control hints to suit your preferences.

name: Gravity Rumble: Monster Trucks
description:
Monster truck racing where the planet decides how you drive.

Every world has its own real gravity, grip and air. On the Moon a small bump sends you sailing over craters. On Europa the ice slides away under your tyres. On Jupiter the truck weighs two and a half times what it does on Earth and every hill is a fight. Same truck, same controls, a completely different race.

SIX WORLDS
• Europa: slippery ice, no air, huge jumps
• Moon: craters and floaty landings
• Mars: red dunes and thin air
• Venus: thick air and lava fields
• Earth: grippy dirt and rolling hills
• Jupiter: crushing gravity

RACE YOUR WAY
• Three difficulty levels with longer, twistier tracks and tougher rivals
• Racing + weapons: machine gun, rockets, homing rockets and oil slicks slow your rivals down
• Pure racing: no weapons for anyone, driving only
• Nitro boost, and a ground slam to drop out of a long jump
• Two views in one game: 3D world or classic 2D side view

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
• Private online rooms for up to 4 players: share a 4-letter code and race
• Empty seats are filled with AI trucks
• Add friends with a friend code and invite them straight into your room
• Get a notification when a friend invites you

BUILD YOUR TRUCK
• Win coins in every race
• Upgrade engine, tyres, suspension, nitro and repair kit
• Unlock weapons and eight trucks: pickup, SUV, van, tractor, fire truck, police, race car and more
• Pick your paint

FAIR AND SIMPLE
• Free to play, no ads
• Everything can be earned by racing. Coin packs are optional.
• Play as a guest, or sign in to keep your progress on every device
• Touch controls made for phones, landscape

Start on Earth, then try the same jump on the Moon.

name: GridChat: Live Chat
description:
Every website visitor is a potential customer. GridChat puts your live chat inbox in your pocket, so you can answer questions, close sales and support customers the moment they reach out, even when you're away from your desk.

GridChat is the mobile companion to the GridChat live chat widget for your website. Sign in with your GridChat account and every conversation from your site arrives on your phone in real time.

NEVER MISS A MESSAGE
• Instant push notifications with sound when a visitor starts a chat or sends a message
• Optional alerts when a new visitor lands on your website
• Unread badges so you always know who is waiting for a reply

REPLY IN SECONDS
• Fast, familiar chat screen with typing indicators
• Send photos and files straight from your phone
• Filter your inbox by open, pending, closed, unread, offline and missed chats
• Search conversations by name, email, phone, page or message

SEE WHO'S ON YOUR SITE
• Live view of visitors browsing right now: location, current page and time on site
• Visitor details at a glance: name, email, phone, browser and previous chats
• Save visitors as contacts by adding their name, email and phone

WORK AS A TEAM
• Assign chats to teammates and see who is handling what
• Set your status to online, away, busy or offline
• Copy, share or email chat transcripts
• Ban abusive visitors in one tap

SECURE BY DESIGN
• Two-step verification support
• Your chats stay private to your workspace
• Delete your account and data any time from Settings → Security

Everything stays in sync with your GridChat web dashboard, where you can customise your widget, chatbot, AI assistant, team and billing.

Don't have an account yet? Create one at gridchat.cc, add the chat widget to your website in minutes, then sign in here.

Questions or feedback? Contact us at mail@gridchat.cc

name: Gridwell: Nonogram Puzzles
description:
Gridwell is a book of picture logic puzzles you can take anywhere. Each puzzle is a nonogram: the numbers beside every row and column tell you how many cells to fill, and in what runs. Fill the right ones and a small hand-drawn picture appears: a lighthouse, a fern, a snail, a teacup by lamplight.

If you know these puzzles as picross, griddlers, hanjie, paint by numbers or Japanese crosswords, you will feel at home. If they are new to you, the first plates teach the idea in a minute.

NO GUESSING, EVER
Every puzzle in Gridwell is checked before it ships. Each one has exactly one solution, and every cell can be worked out by pure logic from the clues. You never have to guess and hope. When you are stuck, there is always a next step to find.

PLAYS FULLY OFFLINE
No wifi? No problem. All 150 puzzles and the daily puzzle are inside the app, so Gridwell plays on a plane, on the subway, or anywhere without a signal. When you are online, your progress is backed up and the daily leaderboard updates.

150 HAND-DRAWN PUZZLES
Four collections, all open from the start:
• Coastline: harbor and shore
• Botanica: leaves, flowers and fruit
• Bestiary: creatures, from a snail to an elephant
• Small Hours: lamps, teacups and the moon

Puzzles range from quick 5x5 warmups to 20x20 plates you can settle into, and each collection climbs gently from easy to hard. Every picture you solve is kept in your Gallery, in color.

A DAILY PUZZLE
A new pixel art puzzle every day, the same one for everyone, with a daily leaderboard. You appear under a pen name we make up for you, and you can change it whenever you like. Missed a day? Catch up by watching a short video.

MADE TO BE CALM
• A bold, clean design in light and dark, with a high-contrast option
• Filled, crossed and empty cells differ by shape, not by color alone
• Calm, musical sound that plays alongside your own music and respects the silent switch, plus gentle haptics
• Drag to fill or cross a whole run in one stroke
• Unlimited undo, always free
• Optional mistake flagging that marks a cell only when its row or column proves it wrong
• Three free hints per puzzle, each showing the next logical step and explaining why
• A timer you can hide, with your best times kept
• Made for iPhone and iPad

NO SIGN-UP NEEDED
Open the app and start solving. If you want your progress on another device, you can sign in with Apple, Google or an email address, but you never have to.

FREE TO PLAY
Gridwell is free to play and supported by ads. There are no banner ads: you may see an ad between puzzles, and you can choose to watch a short video for an extra hint. Optional purchases:
• Remove Ads: a one-time purchase that turns off the ads between puzzles
• Gridwell Premium, monthly or yearly, each with a free trial: unlimited hints, no ads, missed dailies unlocked for free, and early access to new collections

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when a free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://legal.pranta.dev/privacy/html?projectName=gridwell
Terms of Use: https://legal.pranta.dev/terms/html?projectName=gridwell

Questions or ideas? Write to prantadutta1997@gmail.com.

name: Groundsman: Robot Yard Care
description:
Groundsman is the yard planner for Yarbo owners. Fix your robot's map, build plans, queue up the whole yard and keep up with maintenance, from your phone or your computer.

FIX YOUR MAP FROM YOUR PHONE
Drag an area's corners to where they really are, add or remove points, and carve out no-go zones around beds, ponds and play sets. Review every change before it's sent. Groundsman backs up your robot's map first, checks nothing changed on the robot since you started, and reads the map back afterwards to confirm it landed.

TELL IT WHERE THE LEAVES GO
Paint the stretch of border where the blower should send leaves, in as many stretches as you like. Set each area's blowing pattern, speed and spacing.

PLANS, BUILT AND STARTED HERE
Create, rename and delete plans on the robot. Pick the areas, save, and start with one tap. Every start checks the robot is docked, online and charged first.

QUEUE UP THE WHOLE YARD
Line up several plans and start them in order. The queue waits for charging and for your rules between plans. Pause, resume or stop the running plan any time, and see the path the robot drove on every past run.

WEATHER-SMART SCHEDULES
Schedules remind you when a run is due, and nothing starts without your tap. Rules skip a run for likely rain, thunderstorms, strong wind, frost, snow, quiet hours or a low battery.

NEVER MISS MAINTENANCE
Track blades, belts and checks for each attachment by the hours it actually worked, with a service history and a trip meter.

ALSO
• Areas page to manage every zone in one place
• Weather on the map: now, alerts and the next 48 hours
• Notifications for finished runs and real problems only
• Every robot in your home, shared with your household
• Download all your data any time; delete your account from Settings

SAFE BY DESIGN
Groundsman never drives your robot. Map changes are backed up first and checked after, deletes always ask, and the Yarbo app can stop the robot at any time.

Groundsman is an independent app made by Layer3D. It is not made, endorsed or supported by Yarbo. Yarbo is a trademark of its owner. You need a Yarbo robot and a Yarbo account to use Groundsman.

Terms: https://groundsman.io/terms
Privacy: https://groundsman.io/privacy

name: Growing Places
description:
A windowsill, a few cuttings, and a street full of people who need a plant. Let's see where it goes.

In Growing Places you run a little plant shop in pixels. Grow cuttings in your pots, sell them as they're ready, and match each customer with a plant that suits them: one wants something that's happy in a dim flat, another something safe around the cat. Get it right and they tip. Save up, and the windowsill becomes a market stall, then a corner shop, a greenhouse and, once you've found every plant in town, the Conservatory.

24 REAL HOUSEPLANTS
From a spider plant to a moth orchid, a bunny ear cactus to a maidenhair fern, every plant is drawn by hand in pixels, and every fact about them is real. Sal drops by with a quick question now and then, and the Field Guide keeps everything you learn, with where each fact comes from. It's handy for the plants on your own windowsill too: which like the bathroom, which forgive a missed watering, which are safe for pets.

A SHOP THAT TRAVELS
When the Conservatory opens, Uncle Marc packs the cart and the shop goes on the road. Five towns, from Little Dibbling to Coober Peaty, each with its own shelf of new plants, its own customers and what they like. Stop on the way to see the tinker, the lantern maker, the basket weaver and the signwriter. Turn the little globe to see where you've been, and go back any time: every town keeps its shop.

SAVE UP FOR SOMETHING
A show bench with places for your best plants, things for the shop, and gifts for each town that bring more people to its square. Uncle Marc's wallet keeps every till together, so there's always something to work towards, and nothing is ever lost.

COZY ALL THE WAY DOWN
Moss the shop cat. Bea, who'll mind the shop while you're away. Rain on the window, a lantern at night, and gentle music you can switch off. Bigger text and reduced motion when you want them.

TWO TOWNS FREE
Little Dibbling and Pottsworth are free, from the first cutting to Pottsworth's Conservatory. If you'd like to keep going over the bridge, the other three towns open with one purchase, paid once. No ads, no subscription, no account, no tracking. It plays without the internet, and your shop stays on your phone.

jackspr4t studios is a small studio in Melbourne, Australia, making gentle games. If Growing Places makes a quiet ten minutes a little nicer, it's done its job.

Mind the kilns in Pottsworth.

name: Guess My Doodle Duo
description:
One phone, two screens, one very loud guessing game. Open your iPhone Duo like a laptop: you draw on the inside while your friend watches every stroke appear live on the cover screen and shouts guesses before the clock runs out.

Guess My Doodle Duo turns the fold into a game board. The artist sees the secret word up top and sketches on the flat lower half. The guesser sits across the table, facing the outside screen, watching the doodle come together line by line with the score, a shrinking time bar and a hot streak banner. Say it out loud, the artist taps Got it, and the next word is already waiting.

HOW IT PLAYS
• The artist gets a secret word and starts drawing
• The guesser watches it unfold live on the cover screen
• Shout your answer. The artist taps Got it or Skip
• Quicker guesses earn more points, and a run of correct answers turns into a Hot streak worth extra

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
• Battle: two players trade seats over 2 or 4 rounds. Highest score takes it
• Party: pass the phone around the room and keep going as long as you like. The game remembers the best round and who drew it, and the cover screen shows the score to beat

MAKE IT YOUR GAME
• Rounds of 45 seconds, 1 minute, 1.5 minutes or 2 minutes
• Easy, mixed or hard words
• Skip a tough word or end a round early

LIVE REACTION REEL
The best part of a drawing game is the faces people make. With the camera on, the game quietly catches the laughs and groans as you play, then closes each round with a 3, 2, 1 reaction shot. Watch it all back as a stop motion reel, save it to Photos, or let it vanish for good. Nothing is kept unless you choose to save it.

WATCH IT DRAW AGAIN
Tap any finished doodle and watch it draw itself from the first line. Save the replay as a video or a picture and share the masterpiece, or the disaster.

NO DUO? STILL PLAYS
On any other iPhone, single phone mode shows the artist a word card first, then you draw while your partner watches from beside you.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No accounts, no ads, no tracking
• No internet connection needed
• Your pictures stay on your phone
• Prefer no camera? The game plays just as well with it off

Bright cream paper, bold outlines and snappy animations give every round a playful, polished feel. Grab a friend, open the fold and start drawing.

name: Gusvi: Food Label Scanner
description:
Shopping for a family where one child can't have peanuts, your partner is vegan and you are cutting sugar? Gusvi reads the label once and answers for each of them.

Point your camera at a packaged food's barcode. In a moment the verdict board opens with one row per person: Fits, Check, Avoid or Can't tell, always with the exact reason — "Contains milk", "May contain peanuts", "High in sugar · 56.3 g per 100 g".

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Scan a barcode, or type its digits when the camera can't read it.
• No barcode, or a product nobody has added yet? Photograph the ingredient list. The text is read on your phone, you can correct any word, and the same check runs on it.
• Keep a list for each person in Family: the 14 major allergens, "may contain" traces (checked or avoided), lactose, vegetarian or vegan, and what they keep an eye on — sugar, salt, saturated fat, ultra-processed food, palm oil.
• Choose who's eating before you scan: only those people get a row.
• Open any check again from History, grouped by day. It is rechecked with today's lists, so a new allergy shows up on old products too.
• Brazilian labels are read the way they are printed: "ALÉRGICOS: CONTÉM…", "PODE CONTER…", "CONTÉM GLÚTEN", "CONTÉM LACTOSE".
• English and Brazilian Portuguese, switchable in Settings.

HONEST BY DESIGN
Gusvi is a reading aid, not medical advice. It only compares the label data it has with the lists you chose; it gives no health score and never calls a food "safe". When the data is missing it says so and asks you to read the package — the package always wins. Product data comes from Open Food Facts, a free food database written by volunteers and shared under the Open Database License, so details can be incomplete or older than the box in your hand. Barcode lookups need an internet connection; photos are read on the device and are not uploaded. Your lists and History stay on your phone, with no account and no sign-in.

GUSVI PRO
