Free: unlimited barcode checks, one person, 3 photo reads a day, your 30 latest checks, with ads.
Gusvi Pro: up to 6 people checked together, unlimited photo reads, watch words (your own words flagged in any ingredient list, like aspartame or carmine), 2,000 checks in History with search, and no ads.

Gusvi Pro is an auto-renewing subscription. The periods and prices are shown before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings after purchase. Any unused part of a free trial, if offered, is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

Terms of Use (Apple standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Gusvi terms: https://gusvi.pages.dev/terms
Privacy policy: https://gusvi.pages.dev/privacy
Questions and ideas: support@gusvi.app

name: Gym Plates: Lift Rush
description:
You're a gym rat in a hurry to load your barbell. Weight plates are scattered all over the gym: stack them over your head and carry them to your bench before time runs out.

The more you carry, the slower you run, and a tall stack sways and threatens to topple. Treadmills drag you sideways, dumbbells roll across the floor, and the coach suddenly yells "SET!" and makes you squat. A rival hauls plates to his own bar and even takes them off yours, and gym-goers get angry when you grab their plate and chase you to take it back.

Hit the target? Lie down on the bench and press! Tap when the slider is in the green zone: the heavier the bar, the narrower the zone.

- 100 levels in 10 gyms: local gym, fitness club, beach, winter gym, Olympic arena, night club, jungle, desert, space station and the World Championship
- A plate stack that sways as you run
- A rival, gym-goers, a coach, treadmills and rolling dumbbells
- Protein makes the weight feel light, and a real pancake with sour cream adds time
- A bench press mini-game with three good reps and a close-up camera
- Up to three stars per level and personal records
- English and Russian
- Signing in is optional: guests keep their progress in the cloud too, and Apple or Google sign-in moves it to another phone
- Ads only when you choose (+30 seconds after time runs out) and now and then between levels; the "No Ads" purchase removes them between levels

name: GymGirl: Workouts for Women
description:
GymGirl: the workout planner for women, built to help you get stronger, tone your body and keep moving forward. Fuller glutes, weight loss, fitness at home or heavy gym lifts: GymGirl plans your week around your life, with structured strength training, cardio, adaptive plans and a built-in coach.

Progress that looks good on you.

No account, no ads. Your data stays on your phone.

WORKOUT PLANS FOR WOMEN, FOR EVERY GOAL & LEVEL
Choose from 16 (and growing) structured, multi-level workout plans that evolve with you. Finishing a level unlocks the next. Some examples:
• Power Glutes: 4 levels, from your first hip thrust to a five-day glute focus.
• Sculpt & Strong: for experienced lifters, switching between higher volume (Sculpt) and heavy compound lifts (Strong).
• Burn & Build: strength and cardio in one session.
• Get Fit & Home Cardio: dumbbells, bands or bodyweight. No gym needed.
• Strong for Life: joint-friendly strength, balance and power at any age.
• Gym Classics: Full Body, Upper / Lower, Push / Pull / Legs and more.
• Cardio: running from walk-and-jog to 5K and 10K, indoor cycling, home cardio up to HIIT, and gym cardio machines.

AUTOMATIC PROGRESSIVE OVERLOAD
Stop guessing how much to lift. The built-in coach looks at the sets you log and tells you when you're ready to go heavier, and by how much.
• Training blocks that build up step by step, with a planned lighter Deload Week.
• Adapts to your gear: change your equipment and your workouts switch to versions you can do.
• Busy day? Drag a workout to another day.
• Workout log: sets, reps and weights, rest timer, history, 400+ exercises, and GPS for outdoor runs and walks.
• Workout clock and rest timer on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, plus widgets.

WORKS WITH APPLE HEALTH
When you switch it on, GymGirl saves your workouts to Apple Health and reads heart rate, distance, steps, weight and height.

CYCLE INSIGHTS (PRO)
Log your period and GymGirl matches every workout to its cycle phase. Over time you see if, and how, your strength changes through your cycle, based on your own data. A training tool, not medical advice. Your cycle data stays on your phone.

HEART RATE GUIDED TRAINING (PRO)
Pair a Bluetooth heart rate strap:
• Rest between sets until your heart rate is back where you chose.
• Cardio in your target zone, with a beep when you drift out of it.

TRAIN FREE OR GO PRO
• FREE: gym logging, workout history, exercise library, progressive overload coach, 3 custom workouts and 5 custom exercises. The first 2 weeks of the Pro plan selected during first setup are open as well.
• PRO: the GymGirl Specials, full cardio plans, cycle insights, body measurements, heart rate training, and unlimited custom workouts and exercises. Finishing a level unlocks the next level of the plan

GymGirl Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly. The yearly plan starts with a 14-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation, or when the free trial ends. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://gymgirl.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://gymgirl.app/privacy

Currently available in 11 languages.

GymGirl is training guidance, not medical advice. Talk to your doctor before starting a new exercise program, especially during pregnancy or after an injury.

Questions? hello@gymgirl.app

name: Gyro Horizon – Inclinometer
description:
Gyro Horizon turns your iPhone or iPad in a car mount into an attitude instrument: an artificial horizon like in a cockpit, an inclinometer for off-road vehicles, or a large heading display – just swipe between them.

CALIBRATE IN THE MOUNT
• Park on level ground, put the iPhone in the mount, tap "Calibrate now" – done. However the iPhone is tilted, the display reads zero afterwards.
• Ground not level? Use two-step calibration: measure once, turn the vehicle around, measure again – the slope of the ground cancels out.
• Portrait and landscape, iPhone and iPad

ARTIFICIAL HORIZON
• Sky and ground with pitch ladder and bank scale
• Speed and altitude tapes, heading tape at the bottom
• Pitch and roll angles also shown as numbers

OFF-ROAD INCLINOMETER
• Roll (rear view) and pitch (side view)
• Green/yellow/red zones with adjustable limits
• Grade in percent
• Maximum values in each direction, reset at any time

HEADING
• Large compass rose with heading in degrees and compass point
• While driving, GPS track over ground, carried forward smoothly by the gyroscope between GPS fixes – even in tunnels

SETTINGS
• Units per display: km/h, mph or knots; metres or feet – the horizon starts with knots and feet
• Opens with the display you used last
• Damping for bumpy roads
• Keeps the screen on

PRIVACY
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Location and sensor data are only displayed, never stored

LANGUAGES
• English and German

NOTE
Only operate the app while stationary. The displays are for information only and replace neither your vehicle's instruments nor your own judgement off-road.

name: HABITserrano
description:
HABITserrano brings heat to your daily life. You decide what you want to make a habit, check it off with one tap and watch your heat level rise. Miss a day and it cools by just one step, never down to zero. Together we season to taste. Free, no ads, no trackers.

TODAY: YOUR PIE
Every habit is a slice of the big pie in its own colour. The more you do, the fuller it gets. Below it you see Heat, Open and Streak, the week bar and your habits as cards with an emoji you choose. Ring checkmarks for yes or no, counters for amounts like 8 glasses of water, timers for things like 20 minutes of exercise.

HEAT LEVEL INSTEAD OF A STREAK
The heat level runs from 0 to 5. It rises when you keep going and cools by only one step after a missed day. Your record stays as Best Streak. Once a week there is a mild day for illness, travel or rest: nothing cools. And with re-spicing you can log yesterday's habits until noon the next day.

ASK FIRST, THEN SUGGEST
On first launch the app asks what you want to tackle: eight goals such as movement, sleep, nutrition, learning or calm. Then you get matching suggestions to keep, change or leave out.

BREATHE: RELIEVE STRESS
A ball guides you through breathing exercises: Sigh, Calm, Box, Even and Sleep. "Stressed right now?" starts one with a single tap. On the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island the exercise keeps going as a Live Activity.

GLOW: YOUR INSIGHTS
Week, month or year, with a heatmap in chili colours, Best Streak and the rate for each habit. See at a glance where it burns and where a re-spice is worth it.

WIDGETS YOU CAN TAP
The widgets are interactive: check off right in the widget without opening the app. Small, medium, large and for the Lock Screen. Timers run as a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.

APPLE HEALTH
The app saves breathing exercises as Mindful Minutes and timers as workouts. Your health data stays on your device.

EVENING REMINDER
A friendly nudge at the time you choose, only when something is still open. Turn it on or off in Settings.

ON ALL YOUR DEVICES
With iCloud, iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo stay in sync. On iPhone Duo in laptop posture the pie sits on top and the list below, unfolded you get two columns, and the cover display gets a compact view. On iPad there is a large layout with a sidebar.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
No account needed. Sign in with Apple is optional; you can delete your account and data at any time under Settings > Account. No server of the provider, no analytics, no ads, no in-app purchase.

In Design 2.0 of the Chili app family: Liquid Glass, dark mode and three languages (German, English, Chinese), switchable in the app at any time.

name: Hala Mesengger
seller_name: MOHAMAD ILHAM HAIKAL BIN MOHD ISHAM
description:
Stay in touch with the people who matter on Hala Messenger. Start a private chat, bring everyone together in a group, or catch up over a voice or video call.
- Send messages, photos, videos, and voice notes.
- Share status updates and see who viewed them.
- Express yourself with stickers. Paste a copied GIF into a chat, preview it, and send it as an animated sticker.
- Pin important chats and archive conversations you want to come back to later.
- Switch between up to two Hala accounts on the same device.
Keywords

name: Half Stub
description:
A ticket, a reunion.
A show, a journey.
An exhibition, a moment to hold onto.

Ticket stubs fade and yellow with time, but the memories of every trip and meeting never do.
Half Stub turns your paper tickets into keepsake stubs, and brings together the photos, videos, and sounds from that very day.

**SCAN AND KEEP YOUR STUBS**
Photograph your paper tickets, auto-detect the edges, and save them as keepsake stickers. Train tickets, boarding passes, ferry tickets, concert tickets, exhibition tickets, and movie tickets — all have their place.

**BRING BACK THE DAY, AUTOMATICALLY**
Find matching photos and videos from your library by time and location, then attach them to your stub with one tap. Revisit photos, Live Photos, videos, and the audio you recorded that day.

**RECREATE A MISSING TICKET**
Recreate a stub from what you remember. Choose the ticket type, fill in the trip, date, or show details, and save your own personal keepsake.

**BUILD YOUR MEMORY COLLECTION**
Browse your timeline and ticket wall. Organize stubs into trips and collections. Create share cards, or share basic ticket details with a Half Stub share code.

**MAKE IT YOUR STYLE**
Choose from five visual themes — Journal, Night, Archive, Classic, and Departure — each with its own collection mood.

**YOUR PHOTOS STAY IN YOUR LIBRARY**
Photos and videos are referenced from your photo library, not duplicated into a separate Half Stub cloud library. Tickets, notes, and recordings sync via your iCloud account. Share codes never include your photos, videos, or audio recordings.

Download for free and keep up to 5 personal tickets. Explore scanning, recreation, timeline, and ticket wall features. Built-in sample stubs let you experience the full workflow without adding your own.

Half Stub offers monthly and annual auto-renewable subscriptions, plus a lifetime one-time purchase. Features and local pricing are shown in the app. Eligible new Annual Pass subscribers receive a 7-day free trial.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions auto-renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Account Settings. After the free trial, the selected subscription will renew at its regular price.

name: HALO for ISPs
description:
HALO is the field app for fiber internet sales teams.

Work your territory on a live map, log every door in one tap, keep re-visits on a list with reminders, sign up customers at the door with the plans for that address, set up autopay, and book the install before you leave.

Works with no signal: results and sales save on the phone and upload when you are back in coverage.

HALO is for sales teams whose company uses HALO. Sign in with the mobile number your company has on file.

name: Hameau
description:
Hameau réunit la vie de votre résidence dans une seule appli, simple, sans publicité et gratuite pour les habitants.

LES COMM' : LES INFOS DU BUREAU, AU BON MOMENT
Coupure d'eau, travaux, assemblée générale, nouvelles règles du local poubelles : le conseil syndical publie ses communications et vous recevez une notification. Les plus importantes restent épinglées en haut. Fini l'affiche du hall découverte le lendemain.

LES ANNONCES ENTRE VOISINS
Prêter une perceuse, vendre une poussette, louer une place de parking, proposer ou demander un coup de main : publiez une annonce en quelques secondes, avec photos, prix et durée. Chaque catégorie a sa couleur, on s'y retrouve d'un coup d'œil.

ON S'ARRANGE EN PRIVÉ
Une annonce vous intéresse ? Contactez son auteur en message privé, sans encombrer le fil de toute la résidence.

LES DOCUMENTS DE LA COPRO, TOUJOURS SOUS LA MAIN
Règlement, PV d'assemblée, contrats, convocations : les documents déposés par le bureau sont accessibles à tout moment, depuis votre téléphone.

UN ESPACE PRIVÉ, RÉSERVÉ À VOTRE RÉSIDENCE
- On rejoint sa résidence avec son code d'invitation ou en scannant le QR code affiché dans le hall ou à une AG.
- Le bureau valide chaque demande : seuls les habitants accèdent à l'espace.
- Votre numéro de logement n'est visible que par le bureau, jamais par les voisins.
- Signalement d'un contenu et blocage d'une personne en un geste.
- Connexion sans mot de passe, par un code reçu par e-mail.

VOUS CHOISISSEZ VOS ALERTES
Communications du bureau, nouvelles annonces, réponses, documents, messages : activez seulement les notifications qui vous intéressent.

GRATUIT POUR LES HABITANTS
Hameau est gratuit pour les habitants et ne contient aucune publicité. Les résidences jusqu'à 10 lots l'utilisent gratuitement ; au-delà, le conseil syndical souscrit un abonnement sur hameau.app.

Votre résidence n'est pas encore sur Hameau ? Parlez-en à votre conseil syndical : tout se met en place en quelques minutes sur hameau.app.

name: HandoChat
description:
HandoChat is private chat and calling for the people you actually know: friends, family and coworkers.

ZERO SPAM
Nobody can send you a single word until you've said yes. There's no public directory, no "people you may know" and no way to look you up, so strangers can't reach you. Block anyone without them being told.

VOICE CALLS, ENCRYPTED END TO END
Calls are encrypted with keys made on your two phones for that one call. A six-digit safety code lets you both check that nobody is listening in. Calls ring like a normal phone call, even with the app closed, and you can answer from the lock screen.

PASSWORDS THAT DISAPPEAR
Send a password or a code as a secret. It stays sealed until your friend opens it, and the moment they do, it's deleted from our server.

PHOTOS, FILES AND LINKS
Share pictures, documents and links in the same conversation. Notifications say who wrote and what kind of thing it was, never what it says, so your lock screen stays private.

FOR SMALL BUSINESSES
Turn on Open inbox and customers on HandoChat can message you right away. You also get a public link for your website or card.

NO PHONE NUMBER, NO ADS
Sign in with Google or Apple. There's no new password to make up and no phone number to hand over. No ads and no tracking.

HandoChat is invite-only: ask someone who already uses it to send you an invite link or a friend request. Messages are deleted automatically after 30 days.

HandoChat is made by ZilverNet.

name: Hangry Turtle: Fish Chase
description:
You are a baby turtle in a few inches of water. Dinner is swimming right there. It is small, it is quick, and it is always one millimeter out of reach.

Hangry Turtle is a little comedy about wanting something very badly and being built all wrong for getting it. Your turtle paddles one stroke at a time, waddles, skids past its target and bonks its head on the edge of the screen. It cranes its neck out after the fish, and the fish notices, darts away in a flash and turns back to wiggle at you. Stretch out even further, snap… and the game tells you exactly how close it was: "3 mm short!"

Miss too often and your turtle gets HANGRY: red in the face, steam from the nostrils, paddling like mad. Now it is the fish's turn to worry.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag the stick to paddle. Tap the big button to bite.
• Fresh, watchful fish dodge a bite they see coming. Wear them out, sneak up from behind, corner them, or lose your temper.
• Learn a trick: spit slime to slow a fish, belly-flop a shock wave that knocks out all around you, or net a whole school.
• One hand, upright or sideways, a level takes a minute.

WHAT IS IN THE BASIN
• 200 levels in twenty basins. Ten indoors: from a yellow basin, a red one, steel, a celadon bowl and an old clay jar to an enamel washbasin, a fish tank, a wooden tub, a lotus jar by night and the big tub. Ten out in the yard: a paddling pool, the garden sink, a rain barrel, a flowerpot saucer, a stone trough, a tin bucket, a tub of mud, a blue-and-white jar, a pond on a stormy night and, at last, the koi pond. The whole screen is water, and its edges are the only walls.
• There is always something new in the water: stones in the way; puffers that blow themselves up, a mouthful of spines until they run out of breath; rubber ducks and lily pads that fish hide under until you shove them aside; nights when only a flashlight shows what is around you; a sink with the plug pulled, where the water spins everything round; and thunderstorms, where every flash of lightning startles the fish stiff.
• Some levels load your turtle down: a stone on its back makes it slow to start, slow to turn and hard to stop, and a steelyard weight on a string has to be dragged along whenever it strays too far.
• Fifteen kinds of fish: sleepy minnows, tadpoles to gulp in combos, slippery loaches that take two bites, jumpers that leap away for good if you push them too far, ghost shrimp that flick away backwards, puffers, schools of neon tetras, the owner's goldfish (hands off!), and the kings: a loach, a puffer, a prawn, koi in three colors and, last of all, the Dragon King.
• Brother Bumble, the other turtle: sometimes he helps, sometimes he steals your fish, and he always gets in the way. Some days he ties on a black headband and plays ninja, and out in the yard he brings the ninja along.
• Three stars per level, each with its own little challenge. Lose twice in a row and the owner takes pity: a free chili for the next try.
• All You Can Eat, the endless mode: you start with 30 seconds, every fish buys a few more, and you eat until you drop. One high score.
• Fish flakes, a chili and a helpful poke from the owner's finger when a fish is too clever.
• Three tricks to learn (Slime Spit, Shock Wave, Net Toss); upgrades for flippers, neck and jaw; seven shells to wear, from watermelon and panda to solid gold, plus a ninja in a red headband; and five outfits, each with a use of its own: a bottle cap helmet, goggles, a leaf hat, a little crown, and a swordsman's straw hat and sword.

WHAT IS NOT IN THE BASIN
• No ads. No account. No data collected.
• Every level is free. The only purchase is an optional jar of dried shrimp, the turtle's favorite snack and the game's currency, which you also earn by playing.

Real water that ripples with every stroke, a turtle dressed in the photograph of a real hatchling, fish that look like fish, a neck that is never quite long enough, and a turtle that tries so hard. Good luck. You will need three millimeters more.

name: Hanri Light
description:
Make your lighting work for your day.

Hanri Light helps you set up and control compatible lights and gateways, organize your spaces, and create lighting routines from one app.

LIGHTING THAT FITS THE MOMENT
Turn supported lights on or off, adjust brightness, and choose color temperature or colors where available. Control one light or a group to set the mood for reading, relaxing, or an evening outdoors.

YOUR SPACES, ORGANIZED
Arrange compatible lights into groups and manage gateways by space. Use names and custom group images to keep your setup easy to recognize.

SCENES FOR EVERYDAY ROUTINES
Save lighting settings as scenes and bring them back when you need them. Create a reading scene, a quiet evening setting, or a brighter workspace using the controls available on your lights.

SCHEDULES THAT FOLLOW YOUR DAY
Set lighting schedules for selected times and repeat days. Schedule supported lights around sunrise and sunset using your location and the schedule's configured time zone.

GUIDED DEVICE SETUP
Follow the setup flow for compatible products, including supported Matter and Bluetooth Mesh devices. Scan a setup QR code or use the available pairing method for your device.

BEFORE YOU BEGIN
Compatible lighting hardware is required. Some devices also require a compatible gateway. Features vary by device, firmware, and connection type. An account is required to use the app. Device setup and cloud features require an internet connection.

Support: info@hanritech.com

name: Hanvijwell
description:
Hanvijwell is a complete rental-management app for shops that rent Hanfu, New Chinese-style (neo-traditional Chinese) apparel and vintage-style jewelry.

Keep every rental record in one beautiful place — from the moment a customer books a robe to the moment it comes home, is checked and the deposit is settled.

INVENTORY (WARDROBE)
• Hanfu, New Chinese-style apparel and Vintage Jewelry categories
• Photos, era/style (Han, Tang, Song, Ming, Qing, Republic, Modern), type, size and fabric colour
• Daily rate, deposit and purchase cost — see how much each piece has earned and when it has paid for itself
• Status at a glance: Ready, Out, Cleaning, Repair, Archived
• A 3-week availability strip for every piece

RENTALS
• Create a rental in four quick steps: customer → dates → items → confirm
• Items already booked for the chosen dates are automatically blocked — no double bookings
• Hand over, extend or reschedule (with clash checking) and cancel
• Return inspection: mark each item Perfect, Needs wash or Damaged; late and damage fees are taken from the deposit and the refund is calculated for you
• Payments, balance due and deposit tracking on every rental
• Share a clean receipt with your customer

CALENDAR & TODAY
• Month calendar of pickups and returns
• Today's pickups, items due back and overdue rentals on the home screen
• Care queue for items in cleaning or repair

CUSTOMERS
• Customer profiles with phone, social handle, measurements (height, bust, waist) and style preferences
• Rental history, total spent and member level
• Call, message or WhatsApp customers in one tap

REPORTS
• Monthly revenue, deposits held and money to collect
• Six-month revenue chart and your most-rented pieces
• See how much of each category is out right now

TEAMWORK
• The shop owner shares an invite code; staff join with their own account
• Everyone sees the same inventory, customers and rentals, synced in real time
• Works offline and syncs when you're back online
• Choose your currency (CNY, HKD, TWD, USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, SGD, MYR, INR, AUD, CAD)

DESIGNED FOR THE CRAFT
Ink-and-paper styling, cinnabar seal stamps, cloud and fret motifs and gentle animations make daily shop work a pleasure.

Free to use. No ads. No tracking. Delete your account at any time from Settings.

name: HardfiskCue
description:
HardfiskCue er din praktiske planlægningsapp til traditionel harðfiskur-produktion i nordiske kystområder.

Udendørs tørring afhænger af temperatur, vind, nedbør og fugt – og af hvor meget plads dit stativ har. HardfiskCue samler vejrvinde, kapacitet, tørretid, partier og udbytte ét sted, så du kan planlægge mere sikkert og undgå kaos, når vejret skifter.

FUNKTIONER
• Vejrvindue: vurder om dagen egner sig til udendørs tørring
• Kapacitet: beregn stænger, afstand og plads efter fiskens størrelse
• Tørretid: estimer cyklussen ud fra størrelse og vejrforhold
• Partier: følg hæng op, tjek, fryser og tag ned
• Udbytte: registrer råvægt, færdigvægt og forskelle mellem partier

HardfiskCue er lavet til producenter, der arbejder med klassisk kysttørring – fra september til maj og i skiftende nordisk vejr.

name: Harlequins Word
description:
A row of closed cases, one stone inside each, and a small troupe of players who each say one thing about them. Exactly one of them is lying.

Harlequin's Word is a deduction puzzle behind a velvet curtain. Tap a case to turn the stone inside it. When the row looks right, call it. If you are wrong, the stage tells you how many of the troupe your arrangement would make liars, and that number is your next clue rather than your punishment.

Nothing here is random and nothing is wagered. Every puzzle is searched through before it ever reaches you, so there is exactly one arrangement that makes exactly one claim false.

WHAT THE TROUPE SAYS:
Ten kinds of claim, mixed and stacked as the bill goes on.
• There is a ruby in case 3.
• There are exactly two sapphires.
• There is no emerald anywhere.
• There are more topazes than amethysts.
• Case 2 and case 5 hold the same stone.
• No two cases side by side hold the same stone.
• Every ruby lies to the left of every emerald.

FIVE ACTS, SIXTY CASES:
• First Bell, The Gallery, Masked Ball, Midnight Show and Last Curtain
• Three cases and three stones at the start, five of each by the last act
• Three voices on the bill at first and up to six later, and the weaver keeps adding lines until only one arrangement survives
• Call it right on the first try for three stars, within three tries for two
• Stars open the next act, so thinking before speaking is what moves you forward

MORE WAYS TO PLAY:
• A daily question, the same one for every player, with a streak that pays more each night you keep it
• Follow the Stone: a stone goes under one of three masks and the masks change places, faster each round. Attention, not logic. Three misses end the run.
• Records: five target scores set by the company, from Madame Rosa and the Ringmaster to the New Boy, waiting to be beaten

THE BOOTH:
• Six masks, from Harlequin and Pierrot to Midnight, and four sets of stones
• Paid for with tokens you earn by solving cleanly, never with money
• Every price is fixed and visible from the first day
• The mask you wear is the face that looks back at you from the verdict card

YOUR OWN FACE:
Under You, you can put a photograph of yourself behind the carnival mask and carry it through the show. The picture is shrunk, kept on your phone and sent nowhere, and one button removes it again. The game plays exactly the same if you never allow the camera.

name: HarpKeyMatch
description: HarpKeyMatch nimeää kymmenreikäisen huuliharpun kappaleen sävellajista ja otteesta. G-kappale ristiotteella pyytää C-harppua, ja toinen reikävedosta on perussävel. Jos soitin ei ole kotelossa tai ote ja asento riitelevät, tulos hylätään eikä askellinta siirretä. Illan lista säilyy puhelimessa.

name: HashHarbor: File Checks
description:
Know the bytes. Keep the check.

HashHarbor makes file checksum work clear and repeatable. Import local copies from Files, calculate SHA-256 or SHA-512, compare the full expected value, and preserve the result you actually checked.

IMPORT WITH BOUNDARIES
Select up to 20 ordinary files at once. Each file may be up to 100 MiB, with 250 MiB of retained copies and 100 active imported files. Actual copied bytes enforce the limit; source originals stay in Files. Empty files are supported.

CHECK THE COMPLETE VALUE
Streaming computation reads files in chunks and offers cancellation. Compare one imported copy with a strict 64-digit SHA-256 or 128-digit SHA-512 hexadecimal value. Inspect Match, Mismatch, failure and unfinished results separately. Copy a full checksum only when you choose to.

PRESERVE THE RESULT
Save up to 100 immutable snapshots. A saved record retains the checked name, byte count, algorithm and full checksum even after the imported copy is removed. Search your library and saved checks, reopen a record after relaunch, and share a CSV or JSON report through the native system sheet.

CLEAR DATA CONTROLS
File bytes and check records stay on your device. Local metadata recovery, temporary-copy cleanup and confirmed erase controls make storage boundaries visible. Metadata recovery does not recreate deleted file bytes. CSV uses an apostrophe prefix for formula-like fields; JSON preserves exact original names and values. Generated local reports remain until Erase local checks; copies shared elsewhere are separate.

A checksum match means equality with the value you supplied. It does not prove origin, authenticity, or malware safety. HashHarbor does not encrypt, crack, scan or download files. No login, subscription, advertising, analytics or user-data synchronization.

name: HB3-HB9 · Radioamateur
description:
Prépare l'examen de radioamateur suisse, HB3 (novice) ou HB9 (CEPT), avec l'app compagne du site hb3hb9.ch. Cours complets, questions corrigées et examens blancs chronométrés, tout dans ta poche, même hors ligne.

TROIS LANGUES
Toute l'app est en français, en allemand et en italien : cours, questions et interface. Tu changes de langue quand tu veux dans l'onglet Compte.

22 COURS
Tout le programme de l'examen, en 7 modules de réglementation et 15 modules de technique. Formules, schémas et exemples chiffrés, avec la durée de lecture et le nombre de questions de chaque module. Les parties qui ne concernent que le HB9 sont signalées, et tu peux les masquer si tu prépares le HB3.

1362 QUESTIONS CORRIGÉES
Les 605 questions officielles du catalogue d'examen, 605 versions reformulées pour vérifier que tu as compris et pas seulement retenu, et 152 questions nouvelles. Chaque réponse est corrigée et expliquée.

ENTRAÎNEMENT
Choisis un module, puis les questions à travailler : toutes, celles que tu n'as jamais vues ou celles que tu as ratées. La correction s'affiche tout de suite.

EXAMENS BLANCS
Dans les conditions du jour J : examen NOVICE (HB3) ou CEPT (HB9) en 95 minutes, ou examen complémentaire HB3 vers HB9 en 75 minutes. Les corrections n'apparaissent qu'à la fin, avec ton score par partie et le seuil de réussite de 70 %. Tu peux quitter et reprendre un examen en cours, puis revoir tes erreurs.

TA PROGRESSION
Questions réussies, modules travaillés, historique de tes examens. Avec ton compte hb3hb9.ch gratuit, ta progression te suit entre l'app, le site et tes autres appareils, et tu peux télécharger les PDF de révision.

EN COMPLÉMENT D'UN COURS
Rien ne vaut la formation d'un radio-club. Si tu en suis une, l'app t'aide à réviser et à t'entraîner entre les séances.

VIE PRIVÉE
Aucune publicité, aucun traçage. Le compte se crée en une minute et peut être supprimé depuis l'app.

hb3hb9 est une app indépendante. Elle n'est pas éditée par l'autorité qui fait passer l'examen.

73 et bonne chance pour ton examen !

name: Heads Down: Pomodoro Timer
description:
Heads Down is a plain pomodoro timer. It silences your iPhone while you work, logs every focus session against a task, and shares your hours as a CSV.

FOCUS TIMER
• Pick a task and tap Start focus. A 25 min focus starts, and a break follows by itself.
• Every 4th break is a long one. Change every length in Settings.
• The timer keeps correct time when your iPhone is locked or the app is closed.
• When time's up it rings like an alarm, even on silent or in Do Not Disturb.

DO NOT DISTURB WHILE YOU WORK
• Heads Down turns Do Not Disturb on when a focus starts and off when it ends.
• It uses two shortcuts you set up once in the Shortcuts app. The app walks you through it and tests them.

TIME TRACKING BY TASK
• Every focus session is logged against a task, so you can see where your hours went.
• History shows totals for today, this week, last week, this month, last month or all time.
• Change a session's task, rename or merge tasks, or delete a session.

SHARE YOUR HOURS
• Share any period as a CSV file with Mail, Messages or AirDrop, or save it to Files.
• One row per session, ready for Numbers, Excel or a timesheet.

WIDGETS AND LIVE ACTIVITY
• The countdown shows on the Lock Screen, in the Dynamic Island and in StandBy.
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show today's focus time or the running timer.

PRIVATE
• No account and no sign-up.
• Your tasks and sessions stay on your iPhone.

name: HearBuddy
description:
HearBuddy makes the voices around you louder and clearer in your headphones, and records them so you can listen again later. Made for busy restaurants, meetings, lectures and the doctor's.

HEAR BETTER
• Sound presets in plain words: Clear voices, Less noise, TV & far away and more
• Six easy sliders (Rumble, Words, Hiss) with help for each one
• Voice Focus, Low cut and Auto level against fans, hum and loud bangs
• Set each ear separately

RECORD AND FIND IT BACK
• Recording starts with Listen, and works without headphones too
• Pause any time and go on in the same recording
• Tap and hold the waveform to add a note at that moment
• Cut, keep or split long recordings
• Every recording keeps the sound you used, so you can use it again

APPLE WATCH
Record with the watch mic in one tap, also with the screen off. The recording goes to your iPhone by itself. Or start, pause and stop recording on your iPhone from your wrist.

PRIVATE AND SAFE
Everything stays on your devices: no account, no tracking. Volume starts low and a limiter keeps loud sounds from hurting.

HearBuddy is not a hearing aid or medical device. Ask people before you record them.

name: HeatSheet: RC Paddock
description: HeatSheet keeps your RC program in one paddock-sized workspace. Log each heat on a fast plus and minus timeline so you can see what changed between qualifiers and mains. Build setup sheets with the values that matter at the track: front toe, rear camber, shock oil, and more. The sheet wizard walks through seven gates so new cars do not start from a blank grid. Park chassis in the garage with notes and linked sheets, compare compounds on the rubber atlas for each surface, and open playbook tips when a handling symptom needs a clear next change. Everything stays on your device for practice nights, club races, and long travel weekends.

name: HedefUp
description:
Takıldığın soruda yanında bir öğretmen olsun. HedefUp, LGS, TYT, AYT ve KPSS'ye hazırlanan öğrenciler için yapay zekâ destekli bir soru çözüm ve tekrar uygulamasıdır.

Fotoğrafla soru defteri
Takıldığın soruyu çek. Ders ve konu otomatik belirlenir, soru defterine kaydedilir.

Adım adım çözüm
Çözüm ezberletmeden, her adımın nedeniyle anlatılır; sonunda cevap gösterilir.

Canlı çözüm tahtası
Standart pakette çözüm, tahtada adım adım yazılarak canlı gösterilir.

Sesli yapay zekâ öğretmen
Pro pakette öğretmeni tek dokunuşla ara: çözümü sesli anlatır, takıldığın yerde durur, sorularını cevaplar.

Testi kontrol et
Çözdüğün test sayfasının fotoğrafını çek; doğru, yanlış ve boş soruların işaretlensin, yanlışların deftere eklensin.

Deneme analizi ve akıllı tekrar
Deneme sonuçlarını gir; net ve tahmini puanını gör. Anlamadığın sorular doğru zamanda karşına çıkar.

Paketler
• Misafir: hesap açmadan hemen dene.
• Ücretsiz: Apple veya Google ile giriş yap, ilerlemeni sakla.
• Standart ve Pro (aylık abonelik): daha fazla soru, canlı çözüm tahtası, testi kontrol et, Pro'da sesli öğretmen; reklamsız.
• Ek paket ve sayfa paketi: tek seferlik ek haklar.

Abonelikler aylıktır ve dönem bitmeden en az 24 saat önce iptal edilmezse otomatik yenilenir. Ücret Apple hesabından alınır; aboneliği Ayarlar > Apple Hesabı > Abonelikler bölümünden yönetebilirsin.

Önemli: Yanıtlar yapay zekâ tarafından üretilir ve hatalı olabilir. Puan hesapları tahminidir.

Gizlilik: https://www.hedefup.com/gizlilik.html
Kullanım Koşulları (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Heirloom Ledger: Jewelry Log
description:
There's a ring in your family that everyone recognises and nobody can fully explain. Grandmother wore it, then it went to an aunt, and somewhere along the way the receipt, the year and the reason were lost.

Heirloom Ledger keeps all of it in one place: the piece, its papers, its story and the person it goes to next.

Start with a photo. Add what it's made of — metal, stones, hallmark, weight — and attach the papers that prove it: scan a certificate, photograph a receipt or bring in an appraisal you already have as a PDF. Hold and drag over any page to look closer through a jeweller's loupe.

Then write down how it travelled. Who gave it, in which year, on what occasion, in which town, and what was said that day. Over time these passages form a river of generations, where you can follow a single brooch from your great-grandparents to your children.

When you know who should have it next, name them and leave a few words for them. Then press and hold the wax seal until it sets. The bequest is now official, and one screen shows who receives what and which pieces are still waiting for someone.

For the insurer, there's the dossier. Flick the pieces you want covered into an envelope, and Heirloom Ledger lays out one tidy PDF: a cover with your policy details, a schedule of appraised values with a total, then a page for each piece with its photographs, provenance and copies of its papers. Send it in a moment or keep it for renewal day.

A small gem on every piece shows how ready it is: photographed, certified, backed by a receipt or a history, appraised recently. When an appraisal gets old or a piece still has no heir, it quietly appears under Needs attention, so nothing catches you off guard at the next renewal.

Made for the person in the family who keeps the box: those who inherited something precious, parents deciding what goes to each child, and anyone who has ever been asked by an insurer for "a list with photos".

Your family's story, kept as carefully as the jewellery itself.

name: HeritageCrafts
description:
非遗工序 —— 20 项非遗 · 约 120 道工序关卡

匠作 · 非遗工序谱，20 个条目，一个一个讲清楚。

【怎么玩】

• 关卡：点关卡地图上的节点进入，一关一道题，由难度决定题目数量
• 答对之后：条目的详情一次讲清，字段都标得出，来源也标得出
• 图鉴：全部条目与详情，已收录 / 收藏可筛选
• 我的：累计统计、我的收藏与我的记录

【里面有什么】

20 个条目，全部来自可溯源的公开资料，每条都注明出处。

【素材说明】

本 App 的插图与文字素材全部来自公有领域（公共版权）来源，或在 App 内自行绘制，
不打包任何受版权保护的第三方图像、字体、音频或视频素材。

【隐私】

不登录、没有账号、没有任何权限请求。你的关卡进度、收藏和记录只存在
你自己的手机里，卸载即彻底删除，我们看不到也拿不走。

联网只有一处：首启时向开发者自建服务器发一条安装来源统计（用来判断这次安装
是自然安装还是来自某个推广渠道；只含一个随机设备标识与设备参数，不含姓名、
邮箱、电话、位置、照片，也不含剪贴板内容）。除此之外全程离线。

【适合谁】

对匠作 · 非遗工序谱感兴趣的人 —— 学生、老师、编辑，以及纯粹想把它看明白的人。

版本 1.0

name: Hero Sling: Launch RPG
description:
■ Pull back, launch, and slash!
Pull the slingshot all the way and launch your mounted hero into the sky.
Slash monsters along the way, slam down for combos, and charge into giant bosses!
Every launch takes you farther and hits harder.

■ Slingshot Launch & Juicy Feel
• The harder you pull, the farther you fly
• Tap to jump, tap in the air to slam down
• Bounce off bushes and soar again
• Rumble as you pull the band, and a thump on release!

■ 6 Classes & Skills
• Warrior: dash and smash through monsters
• Archer: leap high and rain arrows
• Mage: blast the ground and spring forward with fire
• Rogue: blink forward 3 times, slashing everything in the way
• Berserker: spin with a whirlwind axe
• Lancer: soar up and slam down from the sky

■ 60 Mounts to Collect
• From seals to a golden dragon, in 6 grades from Common to Legendary
• Every mount has unique stats: launch power, slide, dash power
• Spectacular reveals for Unique and Legendary pulls
• A glowing trail when you fly really fast

■ 19 Worlds, 76 Monsters
• Green Meadow, Jungle, Snowfield, Lava Land, Crystal Palace and the Demon King's Land
• Different monsters and bosses in every world
• Defeat bosses to unlock their stories

■ Upgrades & Records
• Rubber Band, Hero's Sword, Armor, Sprint Boots, Momentum, Lucky Pouch
• Fanfare when you set a new record!
• Compete for distance on the ranking

Pull the slingshot and make your first launch now!

* This game offers in-app purchases such as rubies. Mount pull odds by grade are shown via the "Odds" button on the Mounts screen.

name: Heroguelike: Roguelike Tactics
description:
Lead a hero and an army across an endless world where sleeping machines lie among meadows and ruins

Each run begins with a hero, a starting army and supplies. Explore nearby lands, gather food, scrap, power cells and cores, and claim sites that support your journey

Choose a perk at each dawn. Recruit units, manage food and machine upkeep, and decide when to fight, salvage or move on. Your army battles while your hero leads the expedition

The world is generated on your device. Machines awaken as your actions raise a shared threat. Survive longer, strengthen your forces and decide what to do with the giants you find

Play fully offline. No account, ads, purchases or analytics. Saves stay on your device

Available in ten languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Hindi, Spanish, Arabic, French, Bengali, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and Indonesian

name: Hesperid Bough
description:
Something small and grinning is climbing Hera's tree. At the western edge of the world the Hesperides tend a sapling of golden apples, and every evening the thieves come: kobaloi trotting along the garden terraces, satyr kids leaping in arcs, files of ant-sized Myrmidons, harpies dropping out of the dusk.

Tap a thief and it scatters, leaving a bead of nectar that runs down to the roots. Tap one already making off with an apple and the apple goes back on its stalk. Whatever still hangs on the bough at sunset is yours, and golden apples laid on the shrine's altars win gifts from Hermes, Athena and Zeus.

Day after day the nectar soaks in and the sapling grows toward the sky, until the Hydra stirs in the spring at Lerna.

Only the nymph with the water jug should be left alone. She is watering the tree.

name: Hibira
description:
Hibira in your pocket. Check on your realtime apps, answer approval requests and keep an eye on your waiting rooms and live chat, all from one app.

• Overview: every app's connections, messages and usage against your plan.
• Debug console: watch your app's events as they happen.
• Approvals: approve or reject requests from your workflows and AI agents, add a comment, and see who decided what.
• Waiting rooms: see who is queued and let people in.
• Live Chat: open your team's inbox and reply to website visitors.
• Notifications: approval requests, usage alerts, service status, payment and webhook problems arrive as push notifications. Tap one to open the page it is about.
• Seven languages: English, Japanese, Korean, Thai, Vietnamese, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.

Hibira needs a Hibira account. Sign up free at hibira.io.

name: Hidwell: Bible Memory Verses
description:
Hide God's word in your heart, one verse at a time.

Hidwell helps you memorize Bible verses by typing only the first letter of each word. Each step hides more of the verse, until you can say it from memory. Pip the nutcracker reminds you when a verse is about to fade.

HOW IT WORKS
- Type the first letter of each word, with the words hidden more at every step
- Or choose the next word from four options, great for kids
- Listen to the verse read aloud, slowly or at normal speed
- Spaced review brings a verse back just before you would forget it
- See your memory of every verse as a percentage, and watch each one grow from a seed to a sapling to a tree

YOUR OWN VERSES
- Add any verse or passage by reference, like Philippians 4:6-7
- Paste a list from a church bulletin or group chat and Hidwell finds every reference
- Share a set of verses with your small group or family through a single link
- Use any translation you own: paste its text for your own verses and it stays on your devices

PUBLIC DOMAIN BIBLES, OFFLINE
- Nine translations included, such as BSB, WEB and KJV, plus several languages
- Works without a connection, no account, no ads
- Syncs through your own private iCloud, so your verses come with you to a new phone

FREE TO START
- Memorize up to 10 verses free, with passages up to 3 verses
- Hidwell Pro is a one-time purchase: unlimited verses and passages up to 12 verses. No subscription.

Hidwell does not include NIV, ESV or other copyrighted translations. NIV and ESV are trademarks of their owners and are not affiliated with Hidwell.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://hidwell.sanghuynhxuan.com/privacy

name: Hitokoe - One Call Protects
description:
Scam callers keep saying "don't hang up" and "don't tell anyone". A parent with the receiver at their ear cannot open an app and press a button.
Hitokoe asks nothing of your parent. What protects them is one call from you.

■ Get notified
When your parent's phone reports a long call with a number not in their contacts, you get a notification. Only "unknown number, N minutes" is sent. Never the number or the conversation. (See the in-app guide for what your parent's phone needs.)

■ Break in
Open the notification and the biggest button is "Call now". Your incoming call gives your parent a reason to hang up on the stranger.

■ One question after the call
After a long call, your parent's phone asks once: "Was that call okay?" Two big buttons. "Talk to family" calls you. Either answer reaches you.

■ iPhone and landline parents too
Step-by-step guides by phone type: Silence Unknown Callers, Live Voicemail, always-on answering machine, anti-fraud phones, international call opt-out, caller ID. Check off what is done and see progress on each parent's card. Generate the text for a wallpaper or a note by the phone: "Money talk? Call me first."

■ This week's scam pattern
One card a week based on public information from Japan's National Police Agency and the National Consumer Affairs Center: who they pretend to be, how it goes, what to tell your parent, and one question to ask on the phone.

■ Check-in log
Log each call to your parent. After a week of silence, the home screen gently reminds you.

■ Data promise
No account. The relay carries only "unknown number, N minutes", "call ended", and the two-button answer. No phone numbers of parents, no call content, no contacts. Records are deleted after 90 days.

■ Free, no ads, no purchases

Hitokoe does not detect or prevent fraud. It promises only to notify you and let you call. Content and guides are specific to Japan.

name: Holiplo Summits
description:
Work your way through the 100 mountains chosen by the Korea Forest Service.

Each mountain comes with its trails, how to reach the trailhead, summit weather, and where to eat and sleep afterwards. Stand on top, tap the button, get the stamp.

· All 100 mountains — Hallasan, Jirisan, Seoraksan, Bukhansan and more
· Trails with distance and map
· Summit weather
· Getting there, food and stays at the foot
· Summit stamps — tap near the top and it is marked "on-site"
· Upload a summit photo, share your record
· See every mountain you've climbed on one map
· Korean and English

Keeping a record needs a Kakao login. You can delete your account inside the app at any time; your record and photos go with it.

name: Home Inventory: Insurance List
description:
Photograph and list what you own, room by room, so you can prove value to an insurer after a loss.

What you get:
- Every room, every item, valued
- Snap a receipt, fields fill in
- Insurance claim PDF in two taps
- Warranty alerts before they lapse
- Your data stays on your phone

Free to start. One in-app purchase adds the rest, with no subscription.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

name: Homeschool Days: Portfolio Log
description:
Homeschool Days is the daily log and portfolio for homeschooling families. Write down what each child did today in under a minute, and at the end of the year hand your evaluator a clean portfolio PDF.

LOG THE DAY IN UNDER A MINUTE
• Tap Log today, pick a subject, then say or type what you did.
• Log for several children at once.
• Add minutes, book titles or photos of the work only when you want to.
• Count a school day with one tap when there is nothing more to add.
• Missed a few days? Fill them in from the calendar. Nothing is ever marked late.

A PORTFOLIO FOR YOUR EVALUATOR
• One PDF per child for each school year: a cover, a summary of days, hours and subjects, the log of educational activities, the reading list and samples of work.
• Photos of work sit under their subject in date order, so the start, middle and end of the year are easy to see.
• Share it by AirDrop, Mail or Files, or print it.
• Export the log as plain text at any time.

MADE FOR PENNSYLVANIA AND FLORIDA
• Pennsylvania: school days counted against 180, and every mandatory course for your child's level listed, so gaps show early.
• Florida: a dated log that names reading materials by title, with samples of work for the annual evaluation.
• Families in other states can use the general subject list.

Homeschool Days records and formats your log. It does not give legal advice; check your state's rules.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account and no sign-up.
• Your children's names, your log and your photos are stored only on your phone.
• No ads and no analytics.

SUBSCRIPTION
Try everything free for 7 days. After the trial, Homeschool Days is $49.99 a year in the US for the whole family, any number of children. The sample family, reading your own log and the plain-text export are always free.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at the end of the free trial. The subscription renews automatically each year unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the trial or the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Privacy policy: https://homeschooldays.pages.dev/privacy
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Hop & Post
description:
A message leaves with one ear up. Will it arrive with both ears raised? In Ear Hop Relay, every bunny passes along an ear pose with a twist, and the order of the team changes what reaches the finish.

Tap the lead bunny's unlocked ears to set the starting pose. Drag a bunny onto another, or tap two bunnies, to swap their places. One bunny swaps left and right, another flips an ear, and another copies one ear to the other. When your lineup is ready, tap Send the Relay and watch the pose travel from bunny to bunny.

Explore 24 stages across four meadow trails. Some deliveries need a specific pose midway through the route to earn a stamp. Later, the same lineup must deliver two letters, with the second letter visiting the bunnies in reverse order. Each letter has its own starting pose and finish goal.

Open the blue mailbox for a new Daily Relay. Use a hint when you get stuck, revisit cleared stages from the Trail Map, and aim for three stars by making a first-try delivery without hints. The Field Guide explains each bunny's trick. Progress is saved on your device, and the game is playable offline.

name: Hordeline
description:
Steer a growing squad down one lane and shoot your way through the oncoming horde.
Pick the gates that multiply your firepower, draft perks that fuse into new powers, and come back every day to push further.

Drag left or right with one thumb. Your squad fires on its own. Every gate, enemy, barrel and boss shows its number, so each choice is quick arithmetic: take the safe +3, or fight through the horde for the ×3 behind it. A run lasts a minute or two.

THE LANE
• Math gates (+, ×, −, ÷), shootable gates that climb as you hit them, weapon gates and locked gates behind a wall of enemies.
• Barrels that drop soldiers, coins and power-ups, and explosive barrels that clear a path.
• Six timed power-ups: Rapid Fire, Spread, Shield, Pierce, Freeze and Airstrike.

THE HORDE
• Seven enemy types: grunts, runners, brutes, shield troopers, splitters, bombers that set off chain explosions, and spitters that make you dodge.
• Three boss archetypes with telegraphed attacks, one on every fifth level.

PERK DRAFTS
• Three times a level, time slows and you pick one of three perks.
• 20 perks over three rarities, and 7 fusions: own the right pair and it becomes something new, like Wildfire, Lance Barrage or Phoenix.

40 LEVELS, 4 BIOMES
• Harbor Bridge, Dune Canyon, Frost Pass and Ember Forge, ten levels each, with a boss on every fifth.
• Earn 1 to 3 stars on each level.

GROW STRONGER
• Six permanent upgrade tracks: Damage, Fire Rate, Starting Squad, Coin Bonus, Crit Chance and Power-Up Duration.
• Four weapons to unlock and upgrade: Rifle, Scatter, Lance and Mortar.

EVERY DAY
• Daily Raid: a new raid every day with one or two twists, such as Double Horde, Glass Squad or Boss Rush, and its own leaderboard.
• A streak, with one free streak freeze each week.
• Three daily missions, plus a gem chest for finishing all three.
• A 7-day login calendar with a big gem reward on day 7.
• The Outpost earns coins while you are away, for up to 8 hours.

ENDLESS LADDER
• Unlocks after level 5. Escalating waves through all four biomes, a perk draft every 30 seconds, and a NEW BEST flash when you pass your record.
• One run for everyone each week, ranked on a global board that resets every Monday.

FAIR AND QUIET
• No ads. No purchases. No accounts.
• Playable offline. Only the leaderboards need a connection.
• All art and sound are made in the game's own code.
• Separate Music, Sound effects and Haptics switches, and a Reduce effects option that also follows the system's Reduce Motion.

name: Hot Goods: Pawn Shop Simulator
description:
Run the shadiest pawn shop in town. Everything that walks through your door is probably stolen. Haggle every deal, check serials against the police hot sheet, spot fake watches and sneakers under your loupe, and hide the hot stuff in the back room before the cops show up. Pay the rent, grow your shop and buy the building. No forced ads, ever.

HAGGLE LIKE A PRO
Every seller has a price they'll really take, and every buyer has a limit. Read their faces, watch their patience run out, counter, lowball, and close the deal with a handshake. Push too hard and they walk out the door.

REAL OR FAKE?
Watches, sneakers, designer bags, trading cards, paintings... Drag the jeweller's loupe over every item. A fake always has one detail that's off: a misspelled logo, crooked stitching, the wrong colour. Call it out and win the street's respect. Accuse an honest seller and you lose it.

IS IT HOT?
Every morning the police hand out a hot sheet of stolen serial numbers. Tap the item's serial plate and check it. Stolen goods are dirt cheap... but every one you touch raises the heat.

HIDE IT!
When the heat climbs, the cops come knocking. You get 10 seconds to drag the hot stuff into the back-room safe or the trash. Pay the fine, call a lawyer, or slip the detective a little something and hope it works.

GROW YOUR SHOP
Buy display cases, a neon sign, a bigger safe, a UV light, a scale and a serial scanner. Set your window sign each morning to bring in the buyers you want. Read the morning paper for hot tips: a sneaker drop, a gold rush, a police crackdown.

EVERY DAY A NEW STORY
40 kinds of items, a street full of characters, and five regulars with their own stories: Vinnie the supplier, Detective Rhodes, Maria the single mum, Mr Kessler the collector, and Sal, who'd hate for anything to happen to your nice shop. Your choices decide how your story ends.

PLAY OFFLINE, NO TIMERS
Play at your own pace, anywhere. No energy, no waiting, and no forced ads. Videos are always optional, and a one-time No Ads purchase skips them all.

Pay the rent every week, keep the loan shark happy, and buy the building. Will you be the honest dealer, the legend of the street, or the kingpin?

name: Hour Handoff
description:
Hour Handoff is a private board for the hours you work and the note you leave for the next person. Everything stays on this phone. There is no account

Week
See seven days at a glance. Tap a day to open the blocks that start that day. Each block has a start, an end, a break, a role, a place, an hourly rate, a status, and a short note. If the end is earlier than the start, the hours run past midnight and still belong to that block.

Pay
Paid hours are the span minus the break. The estimate multiplies those hours by the rate on the block. Completed blocks always count toward the month. Scheduled blocks count only when you include them. Called-off blocks stay on the week so you remember the change, and they stay out of the total. Set your own money symbol.

Notes
Write a handover with the situation, the tasks still open, and the watch-outs. Type a name or pick someone from your people list. People is a small directory for that picker. Phone numbers are text you can read; the app does not place a call.

Month
The same log, drawn as a grid. A dot means the day has at least one block. Tap the day to read the roles underneath.

Shiftnote is a personal tally you keep for yourself: a week strip, a handover, and an estimate of hours times rate. The first launch includes a short sample week so the strip is not empty. You can restore that example from More whenever you want it back. Restoring replaces what you have typed.

name: HourNests
description:
HourNests helps you find and book hourly hotel stays and private theatre sessions in Hyderabad.

FIND A STAY
Search by city, area or hotel. Choose your date, check-in time, stay duration, rooms and guests. Browse property photos and review booking details before confirming.

PLAN A PRIVATE THEATRE SESSION
Explore listed private theatres and available sessions for screenings, birthdays, anniversaries or time with friends. Check the venue details and guest capacity before booking.

MANAGE YOUR BOOKINGS
Verify your mobile number to view and manage your bookings. Keep your booking reference and contact HourNests support when you need help.

Use Nearby to find properties around your location, or search manually. Location and notification permissions are optional. Prices and availability depend on the property, selected date and duration. Property check-in and identification policies apply.

HourNests is operated by SP GROUP OF HOTELS. Support: support@hournests.com or +91 90638 31913.

name: House Jobs: Home Maintenance
description:
Remind you when each recurring home job is due (filters, gutters, smoke alarms, pool) and keep a dated history of when it was done.

What you get:
- Every home job, on its own schedule
- Swipe to mark done
- Reminders the day it's due
- History with dates, costs, photos
- Pay once, no subscription

Free to start. One in-app purchase adds the rest, with no subscription.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

name: How to Get Espers Premium
description:
'- Eyes that can see the fastest things in the world.
- And a body that's completely ordinary.

How to Get Espers is a superpower action visual novel about an esper with only half a superpower: one who can only watch. How Murphy's story ends is up to you.

[ STORY ]

Murphy can see any movement, no matter how fast, as if it were frozen in time. Flying fists, passing bullets, anything that happens in the blink of an eye: nothing escapes Murphy's eyes.

There's just one problem: Murphy's body can't keep up. Seeing everything, but unable to do a thing about it. Half a superpower, at best.

One ordinary day, Murphy gets caught up in an attempted kidnapping. From there come encounters with espers who are even stranger than Murphy…

A chase on a first meeting. A brawl in the middle of a date. A quiet life turns into superpowered chaos.

Between what can be seen and what can't. Between desire and limitation. What will Murphy learn, what bonds will form, and what growth lies ahead?

"So this is how you get an esper…?"

How do you get one?
And what will you actually end up with?

[ MEET MURPHY ]

- Power: Eyes like a high-speed camera
- Limit: An ordinary body. Only able to watch.
- Quirk: At critical moments time seems to stop, but Murphy is frozen too.

Your choices decide when Murphy's eyes turn a crisis into an opportunity.

[ MOMENTS WAITING FOR YOU ]

- A breathless chase before you even say hello
- A peaceful date turned into an esper free-for-all
- A kidnapping attempt that changes everything

[ FEATURES ]

- Action you can feel as you read
At critical moments, time seems to stop and Murphy sees every movement, while staying frozen too. Sometimes it's a frustrating crisis, sometimes the chance to turn the tables. Share Murphy's view in super slow motion. Dynamic, cinematic presentation delivers action rarely found in text-based story games.

- Graphic novel-style visual novel
Stylish illustrations meet visual novel storytelling. It reads as smoothly as a webtoon or web novel, so first-time players can jump right in.

- Chat-style UI, easy one-tap play
The story unfolds like a messenger chat. No complex controls. Just tap a choice, one-handed, on your commute or during a break.

- Choices that change fate: multiple endings
Every choice can change the fate of Murphy and the people in Murphy's life. Discover branching endings plus a unique ending for each character.

- Built for replays
Replay with different choices to uncover hidden routes and new endings, and collect gallery collectibles.

- Side stories
Unlock side stories after the ending to learn the secrets of the charming supporting cast.

[ AT A GLANCE ]

- Genre: Superpower action visual novel / story adventure
- Style: Graphic novel and webtoon-inspired anime art
- Play: Chat-style text game with choices
- Endings: Multiple endings + character endings
- Content: Side stories, gallery collectibles

[ PERFECT FOR FANS OF… ]

- Webtoons, web novels, manga and light novels
- Visual novels, text adventures and chat stories
- Superpowers, esper battles and hero stories
- Interactive stories with choices and multiple endings
- Mystery, action and twists
- Indie games with anime or comic-style art
- Witty banter between quirky characters
- Easy mobile games you can read a chapter at a time
- Story games that break the usual formula

A new superpower action visual novel from Buff Studio!
Start Murphy's story in How to Get Espers today.

Your reviews and ratings mean a lot to us. We'd love to hear what you think!

name: Hudhud: Salah Tracker
description:
Log your salah in one tap and keep your streak alight, day after day.

Hudhud is a personal journal for your five daily prayers, Witr, monthly charity and Ramadan habits. Open the app, mark what you prayed, and watch your streak flame grow. No account needed to start. No ads.

What's inside

• Today: your next prayer with a countdown, your progress out of five, and your streak flame.
• Streak flame: it lights when you complete all five prayers and stays lit while you keep going. Every 7 days in a row unlocks an achievement card.
• Share cards: a clean square image of your streak or badge, ready to share when you want.
• Five daily prayers: log each prayer once its time has started. Only today and yesterday can be edited, so your record stays honest.
• Witr: counted for its night even after midnight, with its own streak.
• Monthly charity: a reminder on the 26th of each month, logged once per month.
• Ramadan: optional habits you choose, following the Umm al-Qura calendar.
• Log: a monthly calendar with rings for complete and partial days.
• Stats: your progress over a week, month or year, with a breakdown per prayer.
• Twelve badges earned from your own record, repeatable every time you achieve them again.
• Local reminders you control: 5 to 30 minutes before a prayer, at its time, and a nudge to log it.
• Three Home Screen widgets and four Lock Screen widgets: next prayer, streak flame and today's prayers, with logging right from the widget.
• Apple Watch: the next prayer, your flame and today's prayers to log from your wrist, plus watch face complications.
• An app icon the app suggests as your streak grows, or pick one yourself.
• Prayer times for your city or your location, in 12 or 24 hour format.
• Arabic right-to-left interface with dark and light appearance, supporting larger text and reduced motion from your device settings.

Your privacy first

• No account needed to start, and no ads. Your record is kept on your device, with a backup copy so you can restore it on a new phone.
• Signing in with email is optional, to reach your record from any device.
• Prayer times are calculated on your device. Your city is saved with your settings; your precise location never leaves your device.
• Delete your account and everything in it at any time.

Please note

Hudhud is a personal journal for what you have prayed. It does not log worship automatically and is not a religious authority. The times shown are calculated and may differ slightly from your mosque, so follow your mosque when they differ.

Start today with a small, steady record, and let consistency do the rest.

name: Humora: Temperament Test
description:
Humora reads you through the oldest personality system there is: the four temperaments.

Rooted in the classical four-humor teaching of Erzurumlu İbrahim Hakkı's Marifetname (1757) and blended with your astrology birth chart, Humora shows who you are, how your inner balance shifts every day — and what brings you back to center.

DISCOVER YOUR TEMPERAMENT
• A 12-question temperament test (plus 4 deepening questions) about your body, rhythm and emotional style
• Your personal blend of the four temperaments — Safra (choleric), Dem (sanguine), Balgam (phlegmatic) and Sevda (melancholic) — on the humor wheel
• Your archetype, strengths, shadows and a guide for every season
• Your temperament is 70% your own answers and 30% the classical temperament of your natal chart

A DAILY READING THAT KNOWS YOU
• A personal headline built from today's real transits to your birth chart — with the hour the energy peaks
• Today's humor balance: which temperament runs high and how to bring it back
• Your best planetary hours, nourishment ideas, traditional body-care notes and a short balance ritual
• Moon phase, Moon sign, retrogrades and your daily horoscope for your Sun sign — all calculated for you, never copy-pasted

YOUR BIRTH CHART, IN DETAIL
• An accurate natal chart wheel with houses, Ascendant and Midheaven
• Every planet placement, aspect and dignity, with clear interpretations
• Your Big Three: Sun, Moon and Rising sign
• Element, modality and hemisphere balance — and the classical temperament of your chart

REPORTS THAT LEARN YOUR PATTERNS
• A 30-second evening check-in: mood, energy, sleep and how your body feels
• Weekly and monthly reports with a mood calendar and charts
• Personal insights such as "your mood is higher when the Moon is in water signs"

BOND: COMPATIBILITY & SYNASTRY
• Compare temperaments on the classical hot–cold and wet–dry axes
• What you give each other, where you rub — and a tip for both of you
• Chart-to-chart synastry for attraction, emotional bond, communication, stability and growth
• "Today between you": your daily relationship dynamic

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No AI chat. Every reading is calculated on your device from your answers, your birth data and planetary positions based on NASA JPL data.

AVAILABLE IN ENGLISH, TURKISH, SPANISH AND RUSSIAN
Light and dark themes included.

HUMORA PREMIUM
Unlock the full daily reading, the complete temperament guide, your detailed birth chart, weekly and monthly reports, and compatibility readings for up to 5 people.
Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Humora is for reflection and self-knowledge. It is not medical, psychological or financial advice.

Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/humoratemperament/ana-sayfa

name: Hundo: 100% Game Tracker
description:
Go for the hundo. Hundo is a completion tracker for open-world games: check off every region, side activity, story mission, collectible and car, and watch your percentage climb to 100%.

READY-MADE CHECKLIST FOR GTA VI
• Every region of the game's map that has been revealed, plus named spots around the main city
• Every confirmed side activity, from airboats and scuba diving to street races and mini golf
• Story missions, collectibles, vehicles and trophies are added as players discover them after launch
• Lists update automatically. No app update needed

MADE FOR COMPLETIONISTS
• Big progress ring and per-list progress bars
• Pin what you're doing next so it's always on top
• Add your own notes to any item: where you found it, what you still need
• Filter by To do or Done, and search everything
• Add your own items to any list

TRACK ANY GAME
• Start an empty tracker for any game and build your own checklists

HUNDO PRO (one-time purchase, no subscription)
• No ads
• Unlimited items and checklists of your own
• Track as many games as you want

No account needed. Your progress stays on your iPhone.

Hundo is an unofficial, fan-made app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Grand Theft Auto and GTA are trademarks of Take-Two Interactive. All other game names are trademarks of their respective owners.

name: HunterLog
description:
HunterLog is the digital hunting journal for hunters. Record your harvests in seconds, keep track of your territory and have your firearms, ammunition and documents with you at all times – clear, fast and without an account.

HARVESTS
• Harvests with species and class, weight, age, shot distance, firearm and ammunition
• Game tag, disposition, trichinella sample and game origin certificate, tracking and trophy
• Photos and location right when you record
• Closed-season warning when recording (German federal hunting seasons as a guide)
• Overview per hunting year (1 April to 31 March)

HUNTS AND SIGHTINGS
• Stand hunting, stalking, driven hunts, calling, den hunting and tracking with start and end
• Weather, wind, moon phase, sunrise and sunset
• Log sightings – including game you did not take

TERRITORY
• High seats, towers, ladders, drive-hunt stands, bait sites, salt licks, trail cameras and game plots on the map
• Location via GPS or by tapping on the map
• Favourable wind directions per stand
• Reminders for the regular safety inspection of high seats and towers

FIREARMS, AMMUNITION AND DOCUMENTS
• Firearms log with calibre, optics and shot counter
• Ammunition stock that updates automatically with every harvest
• Hunting licence, firearms licence, liability insurance, shooting certificate, hunting permit and lease with expiry reminders

STATISTICS AND EXPORT
• Statistics: harvests by species and month, success per stand, seen vs. taken, harvests by moon phase
• Bag list as PDF per hunting year, optionally with extra columns and a signature field

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
HunterLog needs no account and has no ads, no tracking and no cloud. All entries – including firearm and location data – are stored only on your device.

For iPhone and iPad, in English and German. Hunting seasons are based on German regulations.

TRIAL AND SUBSCRIPTION
For the first 7 days you can use HunterLog free of charge with all features. After that you can subscribe to the monthly subscription "HunterLog Pro". Without a subscription your data stays readable and can be exported as PDF; new entries, changes and statistics require the subscription.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically for one month unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Note: Hunting and closed seasons are a guide without guarantee. Always follow the regulations that apply where you hunt.

Privacy Policy: https://www.appetit-software.de/hunterlog/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.appetit-software.de/hunterlog/terms

name: Hushwolf: Werewolf Party Game
description:
The classic party game of werewolves and villagers, for 5 to 18 friends in one room. Hushwolf is the narrator, so nobody has to sit out as game master and everyone plays along.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
‚Ä¢ Everyone on their own phone: one person taps New game, the rest scan the QR code or type four letters. No account needed.
‚Ä¢ One phone for the group: the phone goes round for the roles and the vote. At night it lies in the middle, the narrator calls the roles one by one and whoever is called picks it up. Works without internet.
‚Ä¢ Play alone: against computer players who accuse, defend and bluff. Works without internet.

HOW A ROUND GOES
‚Ä¢ Hold your thumb on your card to see your secret role. Keep a straight face.
‚Ä¢ At night the wolves choose a victim together, the Seer looks into someone's soul, the Doctor protects someone.
‚Ä¢ In the morning the narrator tells who fell. Discuss at the table, then vote. The result comes all at once.
‚Ä¢ Play on until the wolves are gone, or until they outnumber the village.

MADE TO PLAY TOGETHER
‚Ä¢ A narrator with a real voice, with beautiful paintings for every part of the story (can be turned off)
‚Ä¢ TV screen: open Hushwolf on an iPad or a second iPhone next to the table and it shows the story, with painted film scenes of a village by the Dusk Wood
‚Ä¢ Five languages: English, Nederlands, Fran√ßais, Espa√±ol, Italiano
‚Ä¢ Rejoin after a locked screen or a lost connection
‚Ä¢ Beautifully painted role cards and twelve village characters
‚Ä¢ At the end: who was who, what happened each night, and awards like Best Liar
‚Ä¢ Another round with the same group in one tap

PLAYING ALONG IS FREE
Joining is always free and ad-free. As host you play with the classic roles (Werewolf, Villager, Seer, Doctor, Hunter, Mayor) and up to 10 players. Ads only appear on the host's phone, never during the night or the vote.

HOST PACK, PAY ONCE
8 extra roles (Witch, Cupid, Bodyguard, Alpha Wolf, Jester, Twin, Medium, Detective), your own mix of roles, up to 18 players and no ads. Only the host needs it: everyone at the table plays with all of it. No subscription.

Playing on everyone's own phone needs an internet connection. Ages 13 and up.

name: Hyper Surge
description:
Hyper Surge is a rhythm flight game where the music grows with you.

Your comet races through space, and every ring sits exactly on the beat of the soundtrack. Hit precisely and the flight gets faster while one music layer after another kicks in: first the pulse, then bass, drums, melody and finally the full climax. Make mistakes and you lose speed, combo and energy.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap: hit rings on the beat
• Hold: surf plasma rails and release at the exit
• Swipe: change lanes, jump over lasers, dive under arcs

FOUR WORLDS, FOUR UNIQUE IDEAS
• Nebula Odyssey – fog banks hide the track
• Solar Inferno – molten cores you hammer several times
• Crystal Cryosphere – frost mines you must not tap
• Chrono Singularity – time bubbles with slow motion and fast forward
Each world has its own soundtrack, generated live on your device.

ALWAYS SOMETHING NEW
Pendulum lasers, closed lanes, turbines, prisms, black holes, warp-ring slaloms and power-ups such as shield, beat magnet and double points. Every run is told in four acts and becomes more demanding step by step.

YOUR PACE
• Modes: 3 minutes, 5 minutes or endless
• Difficulty: Easy, Normal, Hard and Extreme
• Missions, upgrades and comet skins

BINAURAL 3D AUDIO
Sounds come from the direction of their lane and obstacles rush past you. Best with headphones.

FAIR AND AD-FREE
The app and the worlds Nebula Odyssey and Solar Inferno are free. Crystal Cryosphere and Chrono Singularity are one-time in-app purchases. No subscription, no ads, no account, no data collection – and fully playable offline. The in-game interface is mainly in German.

name: Hyva: Digital Business Card
description:
Hyva is the digital business card for people who meet customers in person. Hand them your card, keep the lead, and follow up before it goes cold.

SHARE YOUR CARD IN ONE TAP
• Show your QR code and they save you to their contacts in one tap, no app needed
• Add your card to Apple Wallet so it's always one tap away
• Write it to an NFC sticker for your counter, truck or booth
• Text it, email it or AirDrop it from the share sheet

BUILT FROM WHAT YOU ALREADY HAVE
• Paste your website and Hyva builds your card in about 30 seconds: logo, colors, phone, email and address
• Already have a printed card? Upload a photo or PDF. Hyva trims it, reads your details, pulls your logo, and makes the phone, email, website and address on it tappable

NEVER LOSE A LEAD
• Snap someone's paper business card and Hyva reads it into your leads
• Your Rolodex keeps the photo of every card you scan
• Tap a card to flip it to your notes, like "Met at the mixer, needs a quote in December"
• Get reminded to follow up so nobody slips through the cracks
• People who open your card can send you their info right from it

MORE WAYS TO GET CUSTOMERS
• A review link that asks happy customers for a Google review
• An email signature with your card in it
• Print-ready QR signs for your desk, car or booth
• See how many people opened your card and saved you

HYVA PRO
Free gives you your card, QR code, Save to Contacts and up to 10 leads. Pro adds unlimited leads, every card look, uploading your own card design, an automatic "great to meet you" email, your own web address, card stats and no Hyva branding. Pro is available monthly or yearly as an auto-renewing subscription through your Apple ID. Cancel anytime in your iPhone's Settings.

Privacy: https://gethyva.com/privacy

name: IanuaMatur
description: IanuaMatur helpt u uw pensioenvoorbereiding te ordenen: van persoonlijke gegevens en werkperiodes tot documenten en mijlpalen.
