name: IBIPMX
description: IBIPMX is a field notebook for measurements. Convert length, area and volume, estimate concrete, tile and paint, and keep each project's notes, equipment and calibration dates on your iPhone.

name: Ice Hockey Shifts
description:
Ice Hockey Shifts shows the games you record with the Ice Hockey Shifts app on your Garmin watch: every shift, how long you were on the ice, and how hard your heart worked on the ice compared with the bench.

• Shift timeline: every shift and bench stretch of the game, in order. Tap a shift for its length and heart rate.
• Ice time: total ice time, number of shifts, average and longest shift, and rest per minute of work, using the shift times your watch recorded.
• Ice vs bench heart-rate zones: the zone time Garmin Connect shows as one game total, split into time on the ice and time on the bench.
• Heart rate through the game, with your shifts shaded behind it.
• Fair share: say how many defence or forwards dressed and see your expected share of ice time next to your real one.
• Every shift in a table: start, length, bench time, average and max heart rate.

Getting a game in: export the activity's original file from Garmin Connect, save it to Files and tap Import. Activities recorded by other apps open with heart rate only.

Private: no account, no ads, no tracking. Your games stay on your phone and nothing is sent anywhere.

Shifts are recorded by the free Ice Hockey Shifts app for Garmin watches, from the Connect IQ Store. Works with Garmin. Heart-rate figures are for training interest only; this is not a medical device.

name: Icon Hoover
description:
Collect, organize and reuse your icons with Icon Hoover.

Scan folders you choose or a website and save a copy of each icon in your own library. Choose which SVG, ICO, ICNS and PNG formats to find, and follow links within the same website up to four levels deep.

Newly imported icons stay selected so you can add them to an existing group or create a new one. The URL filter lists only source websites.

• Organize icons into groups and subgroups, mark favorites and apply color labels.
• Search by name or URL and inspect the import date and original path or URL.
• Review variants with the same name and decide which ones to keep.
• Adjust the preview background and display tint. Edit supported SVG colors before copying or exporting a new copy.
• Copy and share icons; on Mac, drag them into other apps and access your library from the menu bar.
• Choose a local folder or an iCloud Drive folder to open the same library across your devices. Allow syncing to finish before working from another device.
• Catalan and English interface, with light and dark appearance.

Icon Hoover Normal is free for up to 500 unique icons. Plus removes this limit with a one-time purchase, without a subscription, for Mac, iPhone and iPad using the same Apple Account.

On iPhone and iPad, folder scans are limited to locations you select in Files. Web scans run while the app is open.

Icons and trademarks belong to their creators. Download and use only content you have permission to use, and respect licenses, terms of use and attribution requirements.

name: iCRM - CRM for Modern Business
description:
iCRM - Smart CRM for Modern Business

Manage Customers. Track Revenue. Stay Organized. Grow Smarter.

Running a business shouldn't be complicated. iCRM brings everything you need to manage your business into one beautifully designed, easy to use app.

iCRM – Smart CRM for Modern Business.

name: Igloo Defense
description:
The hogs are after the village snacks! Build igloo towers along the snowy trail and stop them before they get in.

Igloo Defense is a friendly tower-defense game starring the polar bears and the warthogs. Every hog wears a symbol, and the igloo with the same symbol beats it fast. Match the symbol, pick the right spot, upgrade at the right time, and the village stays safe.

30 LEVELS IN 3 WORLDS
Frosty Hollow, Glacier Gorge and Moonlit Pines, each ending in a boss: Big Tusk, Balloon Tusk or King Tusk.

4 IGLOO TOWERS
- Frost Igloo: slows hogs down.
- Zap Igloo: zaps one hog and jumps to the next.
- Cocoa Catapult: splashes a crowd.
- Mud Pit: slows them down on the trail.

4 KINDS OF HOGS
Fast Chargers, mud-spitting Spitters, tough Shield Boars and Hog Jets that fly over the mud.

NEW TWISTS
Two-gate maps where the hogs come from both sides, a long winding snake trail, and a boss who calls for help.

THE WORKSHOP
Spend the stars you win on stronger igloos and a richer village. Every upgrade is earned by playing.

A DAILY CHALLENGE
A level you know with a new twist every day, for a bonus star.

LEARN BY PLAYING
The first level shows you what to tap, step by step. Lost a level twice? A Helping Paw offers extra coins and lives. Earn 3 stars for keeping every snack safe, and use the 2x speed button when you like.

MADE FOR FAMILIES
- No ads.
- Nothing to buy: no loot boxes, no random rewards.
- No chat, no accounts, plays offline.
- Grown-up check before any outside link.
- Big buttons and big text.

Made by Seventh Anvil Games, the makers of Polar Bears vs. Warthogs.

name: Ilbon Mungbeopgyeol
description:
Ilbon Mungbeopgyeol is a Japanese conjugation and grammar-pattern study app for Korean speakers. Study the conjugations of 1,252 N5/N4 words and 144 grammar patterns, one screen at a time.

• Conjugation in one card: plain and polite forms, present and past, affirmative and negative, in a single table, with furigana over kanji.
• Find patterns by meaning: 15 meaning groups such as permission, obligation, conjecture and reason, or browse by connection form.
• Attach a pattern to any word and see the result.
• Numbers: rules and exceptions for reading times, minutes, dates, years, ages and counts, plus a converter that shows how any number is read.
• Word of the day and pattern of the day (Korea time).
• Browse in batches of five, mark known/unsure, bookmark and search. Kana charts one tap away.
• Works offline, no sign-up, dark theme.

Word readings and parts of speech are based on JMdict (EDRDG, CC BY-SA 4.0); JLPT level lists on Jonathan Waller (CC BY). This is an unofficial app, not affiliated with any JLPT organizer.

name: Improve My Serve: Tennis AI
description:
Improve My Serve is an AI tennis serve analyzer. Film one serve with your phone (side or behind view, up to 60 seconds, 60 fps recommended) and get a skeleton overlay of your motion, measured checkpoints and up to three prioritized fixes, each with a drill.

WHAT WE MEASURE ON YOUR SERVE
• Trophy position: knee bend and trunk lean
• A pause or hitch at the trophy position
• Racket drop (flagged as "possible" only, because the racket isn't tracked)
• Contact: contact height, elbow extension and how high your hitting arm is
• Rhythm and timing: toss-to-contact timing, kinetic-chain order and wrist speed

WHAT WE DON'T MEASURE
• Toss placement, pronation, grip and racket-face angle
• Serve speed, spin and where the ball lands
The app tracks your body, not the ball or the racket. When the footage isn't good enough, it says so instead of guessing.

Forehand, backhand and volley get a basic check.

FREE TO START
Sign in with Apple and your first analysis shows the whole report: every fix with its drill, key frames and the skeleton overlay video. A clip that can't be analyzed doesn't use it up.

IMPROVE MY SERVE PRO
• A 7-day practice plan for every report, built only from your fixes and drills
• Re-test on day 7 and see whether it worked
• Up to 10 analyses a day
Choose annual (with a 7-day free trial) or monthly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase or when the free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use: https://improvemyserve.com/terms · Privacy Policy: https://improvemyserve.com/privacy

Coaching guidance from a single phone camera — not medical advice.

name: IncenseTimer
description: IncenseTimer is a 1–60 minute timer with a virtual incense stick that slowly burns as time passes. Watch the glowing ember and rising smoke while you read, meditate, focus on work, or take a short break.

name: Index Note
description:
Your plans, diary, budget and notes in one book. Index Note is an iPhone and iPad diary you flip like a paper organizer, write in by hand and decorate with stickers.

■ Feels like a real diary

■ Diary

· Typed text and handwriting together on one page

■ iPad

· Turn on iCloud sync and your iPhone and iPad show the same diary
· Home Screen widgets

· Your entries stay on your device and in your own iCloud. Nothing is sent to us

· Every feature free for 30 days
· Then buy the lifetime pass once. No subscription
· One purchase works on iPhone and iPad with the same Apple Account
· Family Sharing: your family can use it without buying again
· After the trial, everything you wrote stays readable

English · 한국어 · 日本語 · 繁體中文

name: Infinitiv Pulse
description:
Infinitiv Pulse is the internal staff app for the Infinitiv.AI team. It brings attendance, leave, pay and company updates together in one simple app.
ATTENDANCE
- Check in and out with one tap at the office, or choose Remote when working from home
- Office check-in confirms you are at the office using your location
- Optional face check-in, with a blink-and-turn liveness check, so only you can check in as you
- Take and end breaks, and see your hours for the day and the month
- Ask for a time correction if you forgot to check in or out

DAY-END REPORT AND COMMUNITY
- Write a short report of your day when you check out
- See what the rest of the team worked on in the Community feed
- React and comment on each other's updates

LEAVE
- See your leave balances: annual, casual, sick and short leave
- Apply for leave in a few taps and follow its approval
- See the company holiday calendar and who is away

PAY AND DOCUMENTS
- View and download your monthly payslips
- Request salary certificates, experience letters and other letters
- Keep your documents and company ID card in your Wallet
- Submit expenses with a photo of the receipt

COMPANY
- Company news, announcements and policies
- Team directory and org chart
- Birthdays, work anniversaries and company celebrations

NOTIFICATIONS
- Get notified when your leave is approved, your payslip is ready, or someone comments on your update

Infinitiv Pulse is for Infinitiv.AI employees. You need an account created by your company's HR team to sign in.

name: inFitter - Outfit Organizer
description:
Your wardrobe, organised. An outfit ready every morning.

inFitter keeps all your clothes in one place, suggests outfits that suit the weather and helps you plan what to wear for the day, the week or your next trip. No account and no ads. Your wardrobe stays on your iPhone or iPad.

ADD YOUR CLOTHES IN SECONDS
• Take a photo, or pick several at once from your library
• Backgrounds are removed automatically (iOS 17 and later)
• The category, colours and a name are filled in from the photo
• Tag seasons, weather and fabrics

AN OUTFIT FOR EVERY DAY
• Today's outfit, matched to the weather and season
• Shuffle for a new suggestion, always a complete outfit
• Save favourite outfits and share them as a picture
• Mark clothes that need washing and they're left out of suggestions

PLAN AHEAD
• Plan outfits on the calendar and copy a day's plan to other days
• See what you wore, and when, in your outfit history
• A daily reminder to pick your outfit

INFITTER PREMIUM
• Unlimited wardrobe (the free version holds up to 50 pieces)
• Plan my week: outfits for the next 7 days in one go, using the forecast
• Trips & packing lists: outfits for each day of a trip, the destination's forecast and a ready-made packing list
• Detailed statistics: your most-worn pieces, colours and fabrics, and what you haven't worn lately
• Cost per wear: what each piece really costs every time you wear it
Monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and can be managed or cancelled in your App Store account settings.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads
• Your clothes and photos stay on your device
• Back up everything to one file and restore it on a new device

Made for iPhone and iPad, with light and dark themes. In English, Romanian, Spanish, German, French and Italian.

Weather data by MET Norway.

name: Ingredient Check: Allergy Scan
description:
Scan a barcode or photograph an ingredient label and see in two seconds whether it contains anything on your personal avoid list, including hidden names and "may contain" warnings.

What you get:
- Point at the label. See what matches.
- Catches whey, casein and ghee as milk
- Flags 'may contain' warnings
- Profiles for every family member
- Tells you when a recipe changes

Free to start. One in-app purchase adds the rest, with no subscription.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Looking things up sends data off your phone: the barcode or product code you scan so it can look up ingredients and nutrition goes to Open Food Facts. Nothing else you enter leaves your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

name: Ink Legion: Stickman Army
description:
Win a battle and its reward is yours that same second. No chests to open, no timers to wait out, no energy, no ads.

Chapter one is free to play. One payment unlocks the rest of the campaign for good, and Family Sharing covers your family. Nothing else is ever sold.

Ink Legion is a stickman army strategy game painted in black ink on paper, with a single red. You lead a small legion of stick figure soldiers across 24 battles in 4 chapters: meadows, long plains, narrow mountain passes and river fords.

COMMAND THE WHOLE ARMY
One tap orders every soldier. Attack sends them forward to engage. Hold stands where the line is when you give the order, with your bows behind it. Fall back pulls everyone home to the fort. Press and hold a unit card to order that unit alone: bows hold while swords charge. Each soldier changes what they do on the very next moment of the fight.

CHOOSE YOUR OPENING
Before a battle, pick how your legion starts: all swords, protected archers, or the balanced planned army. All cost the same, and recruits you have won join on top.

FOUR SOLDIERS, CLEAR COUNTERS
- Sword: fast and close. Cuts down bows.
- Bow: hits hard from range, weak up close.
- Spear: throws one javelin, then holds its reach and stops giants.
- Giant: slow and heavy. Crushes swords and shoves back everyone it hits.
Gold comes in during each battle. Spend it there on new troops and read the enemy's waves. Ground matters too: only a few soldiers a side can fight in a narrow pass, and bows on a plain stone fort wall shoot further.

REWARDS THAT ARE ALREADY YOURS
A win saves its reward to your iPhone before the Victory screen appears: a new soldier type, recruits who join every later battle, or extra starting gold. Every battle has three mastery seals: win it, win it losing few soldiers, and win it your own way. Each seal is stamped the moment you earn it.

AFTER THE CAMPAIGN
Win all 24 and the whole campaign opens again on Hard: bigger armies, a calm opening, and their own seals. Last Stand sends wave after wave until your line breaks, and your best wave is saved the moment you reach it.

SANDBOX
Pick both armies by type and count, up to 36 a side, then watch them fight. Same rules as the campaign.

ONE PAYMENT
Chapter one, its 6 battles, sword and bow, and the sandbox and Last Stand with the units you have won are free. One payment unlocks chapters 2 to 4, the spear and the giant, the full sandbox and Last Stand, and the Hard run. The price screen lists exactly what is free and what the unlock adds before you buy. A battle you have started always plays to the end. Family Sharing is on, so one purchase covers your family.

No account. No tracking. Plays offline. Your music keeps playing while you fight.

name: Inkling Writing App
description:
Every writing tool you love, finally in one place.

Inkling is a home for your stories: the chapters, the characters, the maps and the ideas you keep in five different apps. Open it on your phone, pick up where you left off, and keep going.

WRITE
- Chapters and drafts that save as you type and sync with your computer
- A daily journal with prompts, and dictation when you'd rather talk
- Word goals and gentle reminders that keep you coming back
- Keep writing in Google Docs if you like: Inkling works alongside them

PLAN
- Storyboard your plot with cards you can drag and link
- Build characters with looks, voices and backstories
- Outline with classic story structures

MAP
- Draw fantasy worlds and real cities in minutes
- Name your places, drop in castles and towns, and keep every map with its story

YOUR WORDS STAY YOURS
- Inkling never writes your story
- The optional generator (recaps of where you left off, dictation, finding your cast and places) is off until you turn it on
- Your writing is never sold and never used to train models

Free to start. Writers who want every tool can try everything free for a week.

Questions or ideas? hello@inkling.digital

name: Intent: Goal Timeline
description:
Intent puts your biggest goals on a timeline of your life, then turns them into three small steps you can take today.

It's easy to lose sight of long-term goals in a busy week, and to underestimate what a few years of steady work can do. Intent keeps the decade and today's work on the same screen.

SEE YOUR NEXT DECADE
Add a goal the way you'd say it, like "run a marathon by 30", and it lands on a line labelled by the age you'll be. Switch between this month, the next 12 months and the next ten years.

THREE STEPS TODAY
Each day, write the few things that move a goal forward. Every to-do shows the goal it serves, so small wins visibly add up.

A TIMELINE WIDGET
Put your decade on your Home Screen, see the days until your next goal, or keep it on your Lock Screen.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your goals and to-dos stay on your iPhone. No ads, no tracking. Sign in with Apple is used only to link your purchase so you can restore it.

ONE PRICE
Try the full onboarding free, then unlock Intent with a single $29 purchase. No subscription. Intent for Mac is included.

name: Interior Court
description:
Interior Court is a pixel-art tennis career game about the part of tennis nobody films: what happens in your head between points.

You start as a beginner on a club ladder. Plan your week, hire a coach, read up, rest, and play your match. Your strokes improve with practice, but matches are won by the decisions you make under pressure.

LOCK IN OR LET YOUR HABITS PLAY
Every point you choose: make the decisions yourself, or let your habits play it on autopilot. Locking in costs Focus, and Focus is hidden. You read it from your body, a shrinking decision clock, tunnel vision closing in, and the music. Knowing which points matter is the game.

A CHATTERBOX IN YOUR EAR
Your inner critic shouts during matches. Sometimes it is right. Usually it is not.

SCOUT, PLAN, ADAPT
Spot your opponent's tells, tag their playing type and their mental weak spot at the changeover, and switch to a game plan built for them. Beat a rival and they come back ready for it.

A COACH WHO GRADES DECISIONS, NOT RESULTS
After every match your coach debriefs you: the process goal you set, the big points you played on autopilot, and whether each choice was a good decision or a lucky one.

A WHOLE CAREER
- Five tiers: club ladder, City League, Sanctioned Tournaments, Opens, and the pro Futures tour
- 13 mental-game concepts to learn, from routines to reading your opponent
- Habits that grow from Learned to Owned the more you practise them
- A support crew: club pro, hitting partner, mental coach, fitness trainer
- Story arcs told by Anna, the club manager: an aching elbow, a job offer, a twelve-year-old with a temper
- Life gets in the way: deadlines, rain, snapped strings, a party the night before
- Finals, promotions and a cabinet that fills with trophies

FIRST SEASON FREE
Play the whole first season for free. Unlock the full game with a single purchase to keep your career going all the way to the pro tour. No ads, no subscriptions, no energy timers.

Plays offline. Saves on your device, with export and import to move a career between devices.

name: Interview Reps: Practice Aloud
description:
Practise interview answers out loud against your target job description and get private, on-device feedback on structure, length and filler words.

What you get:
- Paste the job ad. Get the questions.
- Answer out loud. See what you missed.
- STAR check on every answer
- Try again and compare
- Your answers never leave your phone

Free to try. Full use needs a subscription, billed to your Apple account. You can cancel any time in your store settings.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

Terms of use: https://michaeljohnpena.com/apps/interviewreps/terms/
Privacy policy: https://michaeljohnpena.com/apps/interviewreps/privacy/

name: Intranet Nova Mosilana
description:
Oficiální mobilní aplikace pro zaměstnance společnosti Nová Mosilana, a.s. zajišťující rychlý a zabezpečený přístup k firemnímu intranetu (intra.novamosilana.cz).

Hlavní funkce aplikace:
• Automatické přihlášení – bezpečné uložení přihlašovacích údajů v systémové klíčence iOS (Keychain) pro okamžitý přístup bez opakovaného zadávání hesla.
• Okamžitá push oznámení – upozornění na nové zprávy a aktuality na nástěnce intranetu i na osobní dokumenty vyžadující váš souhlas.
• Vestavěný prohlížeč PDF a příloh – otevírání interních směrnic, PDF dokumentů a příloh přímo uvnitř aplikace bez nutnosti přecházet do externího prohlížeče.
• Zabezpečená komunikace – veškerý přenos probíhá výhradně přes šifrované spojení HTTPS.

Poznámka: Aplikace je určena pro zaměstnance společnosti Nová Mosilana, a.s. a vyžaduje platné firemní přihlašovací údaje.

name: Io Parlo - Aprenda Italiano
description:
Chegou uma carta da Itália: a fazenda da tia Rosa agora é sua. Só tem um detalhe. Em Borgo Fiorito ninguém fala português.

Io Parlo é um jogo de fazenda aconchegante em que aprender italiano é o próprio jogo. Você não decora listas: você precisa da língua para comprar sementes, pedir um café, cozinhar com a Nonna e fazer amigos.

FALE DE VERDADE
• Converse com os moradores por voz ou por escrito.
• Eles respondem ao que você disse, corrigem com carinho e seguem a conversa.
• Cada morador tem a própria voz e o próprio jeito.

CADA PALAVRA É UMA SEMENTE
• Toque numa palavra nova para descobrir o que ela quer dizer.
• A palavra vira semente: plante, regue e colha para não esquecer.
• O que você mais esquece volta a aparecer nas conversas.

UMA VILA QUE LEMBRA DE VOCÊ
• Os moradores guardam o que você contou e trazem o assunto de volta.
• Recebem você com cartas, pedidos e convites, sempre no seu nível de italiano.
• Todo domingo sai a Gazzetta di Borgo Fiorito, com as notícias da sua semana.

UM ANO INTEIRO NA TOSCANA
• Quatro estações, festas na praça, feira às quartas e aos sábados.
• Cozinhe receitas com a Nonna Pina, pesque com o Beppe, cuide das galinhas.
• Conserte a lambreta da tia Rosa, descubra o segredo do vinhedo e, quem sabe, se apaixone.

ATÉ ONDE DÁ PARA CHEGAR
Ao fim do primeiro ano de jogo você terá visto cerca de 2.800 palavras e as estruturas do nível A2: apresentar-se, comprar, pedir, contar o que fez e combinar o que vai fazer.

O jogo precisa de internet. As conversas e as vozes dos moradores são geradas por inteligência artificial; por isso a sua fala e o que você escreve são enviados aos serviços que fazem a transcrição, a conversa e a voz.

Termos de Uso (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Isekai Defend: Pixel Roguelike
description:
Summoned to another world right after clocking out... and now Earth is under attack?

Isekai Defend is a side-view defense game. Pick one hero and hold back waves of monsters and bosses.

■ How it plays
- Pick a hero, then grow stronger every round with gear and cards from the shop
- Attack on the move, or stand still for a moment to hit even harder
- A warning appears before every boss, so you have time to prepare
- Choose Normal or Hard (Hard goes all the way to Round 99) · Hell is coming soon
- Collect heroes in the Codex, find party synergies and a hidden hero

■ Team up with AI
- Defend Earth with up to 3 AI teammates
- Compete in the Daily Challenge and on the Ranks (joining Ranks is optional, ages 14+)

■ Privacy
- Your progress is saved on your phone only
- Your nickname and round record are sent to our server only when you join the Ranks
- You can delete your record anytime in the app

Contact: jbdlabs.help@gmail.com

name: Istaqdim - استقدم

description:
استقدم يجمع مكاتب الاستقدام المرخّصة في الأردن في تطبيق واحد، لتجد العاملة المنزلية المناسبة لبيتك بسهولة.

• عروض وترتيبات سفر العاملات

name: Isvandora Outdoor
description:
Plan your next ice fishing trip in Sweden with Isvandora Outdoor. Explore eight Swedish lakes, compare equipment for winter fishing, and keep a personal catch log.

Find the right gear
Browse shelters, ice augers, rods, sonar, heaters and winter safety equipment. Compare specifications, explore gear bundles and save your favourites. Select rental dates to see an estimated cost breakdown.

Explore Swedish waters
Discover lake profiles from Åresjön in Jämtland to Hornavan in Swedish Lapland. Browse winter landscapes and see which fish species are listed for each lake.

Keep track of your catches
Record your catches in a personal log and look back on your days out on the ice.

name: IT Passport Exam in Chinese
description:
IT Passport Exam in Chinese is a study app for Chinese speakers preparing for Japan's IT Passport Examination (ITパスポート試験).

- Past questions published by IPA (fiscal years Reiwa 3 to Reiwa 8, 600 questions in total) in the original Japanese, each with its source citation
- A Simplified Chinese explanation for every answer option: why it is right, why it is wrong, and where the trap is
- Glossary: the katakana words and English abbreviations that appear in the questions, in Japanese, English and Chinese, searchable
- Practice by field, work through a year in its original order, and review the questions you got wrong
- Mock exam: 100 questions in 120 minutes like the real exam, with review, answer changes and flags
- Works fully offline and collects no personal data

Free: all 100 questions of the newest year (Reiwa 8), wrong-answer review, and one mock exam.
Full version: a one-time purchase (no subscription, no ads) unlocks all 600 questions of the six years and unlimited mock exams.

This app is independently made and is not affiliated with IPA (Information-technology Promotion Agency, Japan). The questions come from IPA's published past examinations; the Chinese translations and explanations were written by the developer. Passing the exam is not guaranteed.

name: Itec Go
description:
Using Itec Go:

- Your carrier must use Itec TMS
- Your carrier creates your account and assigns your work

With Itec Go you get:

- Your stops for the day, in order
- Directions and calls in one tap
- Complete a stop, or record why you couldn't
- Scan paperwork and take delivery, odometer and vehicle photos
- Notes for dispatch
- Notifications when your work changes

Location: while you have work assigned, the app collects your location, including in the background. It uses it to detect arrivals, departures and the start and end of your shift, and shares it with your carrier. Allowing location all the time is optional.

Is your carrier not on Itec TMS? Visit https://itecpos.com or email support@itecpos.com.

name: Jade: Pomodoro & Focus Timer
description:
Make room for focused work, one session at a time.

Jade is a calm Pomodoro timer for studying, working, reading and personal projects. Set a session, put on a soundscape and let a quiet scene keep you company while you focus. When you're done, see where your time went.

A timer that fits your routine
• Set focus and break lengths and the number of rounds
• Give each activity a label with its own timer and background
• Start in one tap from Home, or adjust the session before you begin
• Round and break alerts, plus a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, keep you on track when the app is closed
• Home Screen widgets show today's focus and start a session in one tap

Build your own soundscape
Mix soft piano, gentle rain, a distant storm, forest birds, a coffee shop, ocean waves, a forest stream, a fireplace and night crickets. Set each sound's volume until the mix feels right, or keep your session silent.

Clocks worth watching
Choose a clock style for each label. Spinner and Flip are free. Premium adds animated styles such as Liquid Flow, Big Bang, Stardust, Rebirth, Pivot and Thor, whose digits morph, burst and spin as the seconds pass. Preview any style on Home before you start.

Scenes that breathe
Pick from a library of calm photo backgrounds, or let Home and your labels rotate through a set you choose. Add Gentle Drift for free, or layer Premium atmosphere: sunbeams, fog, rain, snow, fireflies, film grain, and a golden hour that warms as your focus round ends. Try any effect on before you buy.

Focus together
The Globe shows people focusing around the world right now. Join with your approximate area, or stay anonymous at your country.

Your day at a glance
Home greets you with the part of the day and your week, plus a timeline of today: how much of the morning, afternoon or evening is left, and the sessions you've already finished.

See your progress
Look back by day, week, month or year: a timeline of each day, session history, streaks, a daily focus goal and statistics by label. Simple insights show when you tend to focus best.

Made for your screen
Light, dark, or an automatic theme that follows the time of day. Layouts for iPhone and iPad.

Premium, once
Unlock every Premium clock style and visual effect with a single purchase. No subscription, no account. You can also try a Premium style or effect for one session by watching a short video.

Find your rhythm with Jade.

name: Jamghat TV
description:
Jamghat TV turns any gathering into a game show. The TV is the stage, every phone is a buzzer, and the questions are about the people in the room, in Nepali, Hindi and English.

Hosting:

• New here? The app shows you how it works. Sign in with Apple and two shows are ready to run: Apna India Night and Hamro Nepal Night. Press Start a show and follow three steps: put it on the TV, bring everyone in, start.
• Put the show on your TV with Chromecast or Google TV, straight from the app. It stays on the TV when your phone locks. No Chromecast? Open jamghat.tv/tv in the TV's browser.
• One big button always says what happens next. Or let the show run itself and play along.
• Close the app or run out of battery: open it again and you are back in the same show.

Playing:

• Type the code on the TV and your name. No account, no sign-in.
• Answer with a tap, feel the result, cheer between questions.
• Your friends do not need the app: they open jamghat.tv on their phone and type the same code.

Shows about your own people (a wedding, a birthday, a family night) are made in Studio at jamghat.tv.

name: Jarcade
description:
Jarcade runs the J2ME (Java ME) games you already own on iPhone, iPad and Mac.

Jarcade does not include any games. Import your own .jar, .jad or .zip files from the Files app, the share sheet, or the Import folder, and they appear in your library with their original icons.

TWO CORES
• Core A covers MIDP 2.0 games, including 2D, 3D (M3G and Mascot Capsule), MIDI music, sound effects, and Forms and Lists.
• Core B covers WIPI and SKVM packages, plus simple MIDP games.
• Automatic mode picks the right core. You can change the core for any game.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Multi-touch keys with no press delay. Slide your finger from key to key.
• Four key skins: phone, handheld, classic and minimal.
• Move and resize every key in the layout editor, for all games or for one game, in portrait and landscape.
• Game controllers with remappable buttons, and hardware keyboards.
• Display modes: auto fit, fullscreen, pixel perfect and stretch, with a sharp or smooth filter.

PER-GAME SETTINGS
Screen resolution, FPS limit, 3D quality, sound, orientation and skin can all be set per game.

SAVE DATA
Browse each game's save files, export and import them as .zip, and keep named backup slots.

EXTRAS, ALL FREE
• iCloud Drive sync for your library and saves
• Game speed from 0.25× to 4×
• Turbo keys
• Save editor with hex view and value search

Available in English, Vietnamese and Simplified Chinese.

name: Jari View
description:
Take a closer look at your seat before booking a performance.

Explore eight venues and nine halls in Seoul and Gyeonggi through drawing-based 3D reconstructions. Choose registered seats and compare two views with matching eye-height and viewing settings.

Browse 186 official seat-view locations across Charlotte Theater, LG SIGNATURE Hall and the Seoul Arts Center Opera Theater. Find photo locations on maps and lists, then open photos from their original providers. Photos are not available for every seat.

Save 3D seats and photo-viewpoint seats on your device without an account. Revisit your choices and share supported photo-viewpoint addresses and original links. Photos and external pages require an internet connection.

3D views are reference reconstructions, not measured sightline guarantees. Stage layouts, orchestra pits, seats offered for sale and viewing conditions can vary by performance. Check the performance's official seating information before booking. JariView does not sell tickets.

name: Jazz Lab
description:
Jazz Lab is a lab for jazz and neo-soul guitar harmony and improvisation. Type a progression and see what to play over each chord, with the notes on the neck and voicings ready to use.

ANALYZE
Type chords the way you write them (Dm7 G7 Cmaj7, CΔ, A7/9, Cø). The app recognizes each chord's function in the progression and recommends scales, with guide tones, tensions and avoid notes.

HARMONY
Major, melodic minor and harmonic minor, in any key. On each degree: the chord, the mode, its shape on the neck, Drop 2, Drop 3 and shell voicings on every string set, and all 7 three-notes-per-string positions.

SCALES
Dominant diminished and whole tone, with shapes, upper structure triads and voicings. Plus all 26 scales in the app to study across the whole neck, in any key.

BARRY HARRIS
The major and minor 6th diminished scale, with the full ladder: each voice of the chord moves up to the next scale note, on every string set.

POCKET GUIDE
Straight-to-the-point theory, with diagrams, a chord-to-scale table and a 20-minute practice routine. Also as a PDF.

BUILT FOR PRACTICE
• Tap any note, chord or scale to hear it, played by a real guitar.
• Switch note names to intervals with one tap.
• Works offline.
• In English and Portuguese, light or dark.

FREE TO DOWNLOAD
Harmony (major) and Analyze are free, in every key. Everything else (melodic and harmonic minor, Scales, Barry Harris and the Guide) unlocks with a one-time payment, no subscription.

name: JD Basketball Scoreboard
description:
A real basketball scoreboard for your iPhone or iPad, from the makers of JD Hockey Scoreboard and JD Sports Scoreboard.

Big LED scores, a game clock, the period, and your team names. Prop it up at the scorer's table, hold it at the driveway game, or mirror it to a TV.

TAP THE SCORE
Tap a team's score and +1, +2 and +3 appear right under it. Pick one and the points go on. Swipe a score down to take a point off. Nothing else gets in the way of the board.

A CLOCK THAT WORKS LIKE THE REAL ONE
One big button starts and stops the clock. It shows tenths of a second in the last minute. At the horn the button moves you to the next period, offers overtime if the game is level, and a new game when it is over.

STARTS ON NBA RULES, SET UP YOUR WAY
Four 12-minute quarters out of the box. Change to halves and set any length in a few taps.

ADD WHAT YOUR GAME NEEDS
Each of these is a switch in Settings:
• Shot clock (24, 30 or 35 seconds). Tap to reset, hold for the short reset after a rebound.
• Team fouls, with a bonus light that comes on by itself at the limit.
• Timeouts left for each team.
• Possession arrow.
• Undo, to take back the last point, foul or timeout.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Team names, and a photo or logo for each team.
• Four digit styles and nine colour schemes, or pick your own colours.
• Five buzzers.

LEARN IT IN A MINUTE
Take a Tour shows every tap and swipe on a live board.

NO FULL-SCREEN ADS
One small banner keeps the app free. A single purchase removes it, forever. No subscription.

name: Jewelstoria
description:
Jewelstoria is a personal museum for your jewelry, watches and heirlooms. For each object it keeps what it is, whose hands it passed through and what happened to it along the way.

Ownership Journey
Record every keeper in order: Grandfather bought the watch in 1948, Dad had it from 1985, now it is with you. The app always knows who holds each piece today.

A timeline that builds itself
Add a restoration, a repair or a day it was worn. Ownership stages and events line up by date for each object and across your whole museum. A year or "circa" is enough when exact dates are lost.

Memories and documents
Keep notes, captioned photos and photographed receipts, certificates and letters with the object they belong to.

People
See everyone connected to your treasures and every object each person has held.

Legacy Package
When a piece moves to the next generation, create a PDF that reads like museum documentation: cover photo, facts, story, ownership chain, timeline and memories, with a dedication on the first page. Share it from your iPhone and record the transfer in the journey.

Collections and categories
Group objects your own way, such as Wedding or From Grandma's house, and search by name, story or person.

name: Jibungoto - Notes for Family
description:
When something happens to a parent, the family's first problem is simple: where is everything, and what did you want?
Jibungoto breaks that into 99 questions in 9 chapters and asks you three a day. What you answer becomes one book, a PDF, addressed to your family.

■ 99 questions, 9 chapters
About me / Family and important people / Where the money is / Insurance and pension / Phone and passwords / Health and treatment wishes / How to say goodbye / Notes on what I leave / Letters. Written in a forward-looking tone. You never write a PIN or password itself, only where you keep it.

■ Skipping is an answer
Mark any question "not answering" and it stays out of the book. Add your own questions. Reorder with a long press.

■ One PDF book
Cover (name, addressee, photo), table of contents, every chapter's questions and answers, tables, photos, letters, and a final page for the person who receives it. Unanswered questions become dotted lines to fill in by hand, so the book is complete at any stage. Print it, AirDrop it, save it. Past books are kept.

■ 4-digit passcode
The app opens with a 4-digit code. Face ID and fingerprints are deliberately not used, so a family member who knows the code can open the app and export the latest book even when you are not there. Print a "how to open" card for them (the code is never printed).

■ Everything stays on your phone
No server, no account. The only network access is when you open an official page. Export a zip for a new phone.

■ Free, no ads, no purchases

This app organizes information. It is not a legal will. Content and official links are specific to Japan.

name: Jigsaw Puzzle: 1v1 battle
description:
Unwind with beautiful jigsaw puzzles, made from your own photos or from our hand-crafted collection, and solve them alone or with friends.

PIECE BY PIECE, MORE HAPPINESS
Drag pieces from the tray and watch them snap into place. Join pieces into groups, zoom in for detail, and enjoy the satisfying click of every match. It's calm, simple and made for a few relaxing minutes or a long cozy evening.

TURN YOUR PHOTOS INTO PUZZLES
Pick any photo from your gallery or take a new one, and it becomes a jigsaw in seconds. Holidays, pets, family moments: relive your favourite memories piece by piece. Your photos stay on your phone unless you choose to play one online with friends.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS, LIVE
• Together: everyone works on the same board at the same time. See your friends' pieces move as they place them.
• Race: everyone gets the same puzzle. The fastest one wins.
Invite up to 3 friends with a simple 6-letter code. No account or sign-up needed.

A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY
Come back for the daily challenge, build your streak, and get a gentle reminder at the time you choose.

FROM 9 TO 200 PIECES
Pick your size, from a quick 9-piece break to a 200-piece expert challenge. Turn on rotation mode for an extra twist and earn bonus coins.

CHALLENGE A FRIEND
Solved one quickly? Send a friend code and see if they can beat your time.

MORE TO ENJOY
• Beautiful puzzles across Nature, Animals, Cities, Art, Food and Space
• Hints when you're stuck, plus a picture preview and an edge-pieces filter
• Coins, achievements, levels and stylish table themes
• Your progress saves after every move, so you can stop and resume any time
• Play offline: only playing with friends needs the internet
• Designed for phones and tablets

JIGSAW PREMIUM
Go Premium for no ads and exclusive collections, starting with Space. Or remove ads with a one-time purchase.

Premium is an auto-renewing monthly subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account or Google Play account, and the subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your account settings.

Privacy policy: https://jigsaw-516ea.web.app/privacy-policy.html
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: JMMove Driver
description:
Drive with JMMove and earn on your own schedule.

• Go online when you want to work; requests come from customers near you
• See the pickup, drop-off, distance, item details and price before you accept
• Accept the customer's price or offer your own
• Use your motorbike, aboboyaa, car, van or truck; bigger vehicles can also take smaller jobs
• Navigate to each stop, including trips with several drop-offs
• Message or call the customer for free in the app
• Take pickup and delivery photos as proof, and confirm each handover with the customer's code
• Low commission, so you keep more of every fare, and all of every tip
• Track your earnings and get paid to your mobile money wallet
• Keep your driver's licence and vehicle insurance up to date from your profile

To keep customers safe, every driver confirms their identity with a live selfie and
is approved by JMMove before receiving requests.

name: Journzy for novel writers
description:
You write. Your story remembers.

Journzy is your book in your pocket. Read your manuscript on the phone, check the story bible as of the page you are on, capture an idea before it goes, and decide on the notes Journzy has left for you. You write the book in Journzy on the web. The app never writes manuscript text, and the AI never writes your book. You write every word.

Journzy on the phone is the companion of the Journzy writing studio on the web, for novelists and other writers of fiction working on a novel. It keeps the characters, the places and the world of your novel close while you read, so the story keeps its continuity from chapter to chapter. For writers, that continuity is part of the craft of fiction, and this worldbuilding stays with the manuscript wherever you take it.

Read your book
• Your projects and books, with the place where you stopped.
• Download a book and read it with no connection.
• Pages or Scroll, Paper, Sepia or Night, and the text size you prefer.
• Contents, a jump to any chapter, and search within the book.
• The position code in the top bar shows the book, the chapter and the scene.

Comments and highlights
• Select a passage to comment on it or highlight it.
• The comments are the same as on the web: reply, resolve, reopen.
• What you write with no connection is sent once, when you are back online.

The story bible, as of your page
• Tap a name in the text to open its bible entry as it stands on that page. Facts from later chapters stay out of sight.
• Browse the characters, places, world entries and relationships in the story bible, with the worldbuilding behind them.
• The bible is also on the phone, so it works with no connection.

Capture
• Write a note, take a photo or record a voice note.
• A voice note is transcribed on your phone, and the recording never leaves your phone. Only the text of the note goes to Journzy.
• Share a link or a photo from another app into Journzy.
• New captures go to the inbox, and Journzy on the web shows them with your references.

Talk and Tavern
• Talk with a character or with the story, at a point in the book you choose.
• Tavern brings several characters into one conversation. Use "Who answers" to choose, or "Let them continue" to let them carry on.
• Choose "Pin as idea", "Save as note" or "Flag as spoiler" for a reply.
• Every reply is marked as an AI answer and has "Report this reply".
• Before the first AI request on a phone, a notice says where the text goes, and nothing is sent until you agree.

Notes
• The notes Journzy's checks have left on your book help guard continuity: contradictions with the story bible, and what needs a fix.
• Filter by Needs you, Must fix or Contradictions.
• Decide in the same words as on the web: Keep as written, Not a problem, Not now. You make each fix yourself, in the text, on the web.

Your account and your data
• The app is in English and Spanish.
• Delete your account in the app.
• Usage statistics and crash reports stay off until you switch them on.
• Talk and Tavern belong to the Author plan of a Journzy account.

Journzy is for novelists and writers of fiction who write every word themselves and want their novel to stay consistent, their characters true to the story bible and their worldbuilding without slips: eyes that change color, a house that gains a floor.

name: Juice Pals: Emoji Battery
description:
Give your battery some personality! Juice Pals turns your iPhone's battery into cute emoji, pals and themes that react to your charge.

BATTERY THEMES
• 20 themes around the battery icon: emoji, country flags, cat ears, crown, hearts, heroes, sport and more
• 12 animated emoji faces and 12 country flags
• Use your own photo: only the battery corner changes
• Apply in one tap with a Shortcuts action, or save the wallpaper to Photos
• Fine-tune the position for your iPhone model

PALS THAT FEEL YOUR BATTERY
• 32 original pals: cute mojis, sport stars and a Grown-ups collection (Need coffee, Monday mode, On 1%…)
• Their mood follows your battery: full of juice, doing fine, getting thirsty, need juice!

CHARGING ANIMATION
• A full-screen show every time you plug in, set up once with the Shortcuts app
• 8 styles: bubbles, hearts, neon, galaxy, rainbow, pixel rain, party and stadium
• Lock Screen look: big clock, date and battery percentage

DYNAMIC ISLAND & LOCK SCREEN
• Your pal and battery level in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen while charging

WIDGETS
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with your pal and battery level

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No ads, no account, no tracking. Everything stays on your iPhone.

Good to know: iOS doesn't let any app change the battery icon itself. Juice Pals adds the theme to your wallpaper, right around the icon. All pals and themes are original designs.

ONE PRICE, EVERYTHING INCLUDED
Pay once and every pal, theme, emoji, flag and charging animation is yours, including future updates. No subscription, no in-app purchases, no ads, no account.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://karnisalaheddine-hue.github.io/juicepals/privacy.html

name: JukeKeeper
description:
Got a jukebox, or a stack of 45s you're proud of? JukeKeeper puts your collection online, so everyone can see what's in it - and play it.

YOUR JUKEBOX, ONLINE
Every single and album gets its own page, with the cover, the label, the slot it's in and a video to play. Share your jukebox's own address and friends can browse it, pick their favourites and build a playlist.

ADDING RECORDS IS QUICK
- Point the camera at a barcode and it's found on Discogs.
- No barcode? Take a photo of the label and we'll read it for you.
- Spotted it on Discogs? Share the page to JukeKeeper and it's ready to save.
- Already on Discogs? Bring your whole collection over in one go.

VIDEOS FOR EVERY SONG
JukeKeeper picks up the videos Discogs lists for your records, and "Videos to do" walks you through the rest one song at a time. Keep watching in picture-in-picture while you do something else.

MADE FOR JUKEBOX OWNERS
- Title strips: print strips for your jukebox, sized to the real stock.
- In my jukebox: what's in which slot, at a glance.
- Fan favourites: see which songs your guests love.

Free to use. Sign in with Apple, Google or email.

name: JZ LAMP
description:
JZ LAMP connects your iPhone to compatible Bluetooth lights so you can adjust your lighting.

Features
• Scan for and connect compatible lights
• Adjust RGB color, brightness and effect speed
• Explore dynamic modes, save favorites and revisit recent modes
• Manage added lights and control multiple connected devices together
• Set the pixel count from 1 to 100 on compatible hardware
• View connection help and diagnostics
• Use the app in Simplified Chinese or English

Requires a light compatible with the JZ LAMP Bluetooth protocol. Power on your light, enable Bluetooth on your iPhone and allow Bluetooth access for the app before scanning. Available features depend on the light hardware and firmware.

name: Kadivar Basket
description:
Kadivar Basket is your Indian grocery store in the UK, on your phone. Lentils and dals, rice and atta, spices and masalas, namkeen, pickles and drinks, from the brands you already know: Mitram, Kadivar, Parle, Kashmira, Gits and more.

• Now delivering in Leicester, same day when you order before 12 noon
• Delivery across the UK is coming soon
• Pick the pack size you need, from 200 g to 20 kg, and buy by the case
• Weekly offers and combo packs
• Save favourites and reorder in seconds
• Pay securely through Shopify checkout, including Apple Pay
• Sign in with your kadivarbasket.co.uk account to see orders from the app and the website

Questions? Message us on WhatsApp from the Account tab.

name: Kado Learning
description:
Every student learns at their own pace and in their own way. Kado is the digital notebook that personalizes the learning experience, from elementary through high school.

Using an Apple Pencil or their finger, students complete exercises by hand, just as they would on paper. Kado recognizes their handwriting, analyzes their answers and identifies difficulties to provide guidance adapted to their individual needs. Rather than simply giving away the answers, Kado helps students build understanding and become more independent learners.

PERSONALIZED SUPPORT FOR EVERY STUDENT

• Complete exercises and write your work directly on a ruled digital page. • Get hints and questions tailored to your difficulties to help you move forward step by step. • Learn at your own pace with guidance that responds to your answers and mistakes. • Keep homework, revision exercises and tutoring sessions all in one place.

BETTER INSIGHT FOR PARENTS AND TEACHERS

• Follow completed assignments, mastered concepts and areas where students need support. • Teachers can create their own exercises, assign them to their classes and track each student’s progress. • Understand the likely causes of mistakes and explore suggested next steps to better support each student.

DESIGNED FOR FOCUSED LEARNING

• A clean, black-and-white interface with no ads or unnecessary distractions. • Keep working without an Internet connection. Your work automatically syncs when the connection is restored. • Find written and voice messages from teachers in “Mes devoirs” (My Homework).

GETTING STARTED

Kado requires an account created by a parent or school. Students access the app using their assigned student code.

Questions? Contact us at plateforme.novere@gmail.com.

name: Kalamaailma
description:
on tarkkaa ja rauhallista kalastusta. Peli ei ole pelkkaa napin painamista: jokainen heitto on valinta, jolla on seurauksia.

PELIN KULKU

Valitse heiton voima ja koukun syvyys, heitä siima ja jaa koukku vetoon. Kun kala tarttuu syöttiin, saat muutaman sekunnin nostaa koukun oikeaan hetkeen. Onnistuitko, alkaa kiskonta: vedä sormella oikealle, mutta pidä siiman jännitys kurissa. Kova vetäisy katkaisee siiman, laiskalla vedolla kala pääsee karkuun. Kun kala on voitettu, se nousee läpi koko vesikerroksen pintaan asti.

MITÄ PELI TEKEE ERI LAIISEKSI

Syvyys ja syötti ratkaisevat. Jokainen laji elää omalla syvyysalueellaan ja suosii tiettyä syöttiä. Oikealla syvyydellä ja lajin suosikkisyötillä tarttumiskerroin moninkertaistuu, väärillä valinnoilla se putoaa. Myös sää ja vuorokauden aika muuttavat tilannetta: aurinkoisella keliä kala on aktiivisempi, myrskyssä vastarinta on kovempi ja yöllä kala on valpas.

VARUSTEET JA TAIDOT

Kahdeksantoista varustetta jakaantuu keppeihin, siimoihin, koukkuihin, syötteihin ja uimureihin. Jokainen osa vaikuttaa omaan osa-alueeseensa: keppi ulottuu kauemmas ja kestää paremmin, siima katkeää harvemmin, syötti houkuttelee eri lajeja. Taitopuussa kolme haaraa, nappaus, kestävyys ja vauraus, jakautuvat viiteen tasoon kukin. Uusi taso antaa taitopisteen, jonka voi käyttää haluamansa mukaan.

EDISTYMINEN JA KOKOELMAT

Kalakirja täyttyy löytyvistä lajeista ja merkitsee kunkin painon ja pituuden. Päiväkirja pitää kirjaa kaikista saaliista paikkoineen ja päivineen. Yhdeksän kokoelmaa palkitsee pysyvällä etuisuudella, kun sen kalalajit on saatu. Kahdentykymmentäyksi saavutusta seuraa saaliiden määrä, löytytyjä lajeja, varustetta ja peräkkäisiä kalastuspäiviä.

VIISI KALASTUSPAIKKAA

Aurinkojärvi on avoinna heti, Trooppinen lahti tasolla viisi, Syvänmeren salaisuus tasolla 12, Jääkuningaskunta tasolla 22 ja Muinainen vesimaailma tasolla 35. Jokaisella paikalla on oma maisemansa, omat kalansa ja omat vaikeutensa. Kolmenkymmenen kalalajin joukossa on tavallisia järvikaloja, värikkäitä riisiakaloja, hehkuvia syvyysasukkaita ja kaloja, joiden paino mitataan kymmenissä kiloissa.

Päivittäiset ja viikottaiset tehtävät sekä päivän laji tarjoavat syyn palata kalastuksen ääreen. Kalakirja, päiväkirja ja edistyminen tallentuvat laitteelle ja kulkevat mukana vaihdon ja päivityksen yli.

Kalamaailma on peli siitä, mikä tunne on löytää juuri oikea syvyys juuri oikealla syötillä ja napata kala oikeasta hetkestä.

name: Karealbum
seller_name: ARTOLUME YAPAY ZEKA TEKNOLOJILERI ANONIM SIRKETI
description:
Karealbum, düğün, nişan, doğum günü, mezuniyet ve kurumsal etkinliklerde misafirlerin çektiği fotoğraf ve videoları tek bir QR kodla aynı albümde toplar.

• Etkinlikteki QR kodu okutun ya da size gönderilen bağlantıyı/kodu girin.

name: Karnet: Istanbul Travel Stamps
description:
Looking for things to do in Istanbul, Izmir or Ankara? Karnet is part travel guide, part city-explorer game you play on foot. Find places to visit on the map, walk there, snap a photo with the in-app camera and ink the place's stamp. Every travel stamp goes onto its district's page in your city passport.

2,000+ PLACES IN THREE CITIES
Historic sites, museums, viewpoints, food spots, art spaces, parks and hidden corners, district by district. See what's near you on the map, plan a city walk and find hidden gems away from the usual tourist trail.

SNAP IT, STAMP IT
A stamp can only be inked on the spot, with a photo taken in the app. Your photo turns into a postcard and the ink stamp lands on it. Every kind of place has its own stamp shape.

YOUR CITY PASSPORT
Every district is a page in your passport. Your passport stamps line up like postage stamps until the district's visa is complete. Earn badges, become a regular at the places you love and collect keepsakes from special moments.

WEEKLY QUESTS AND WALKING ROUTES
New quests every week: a Bosphorus view, a historic place, three places on the Asian side. Follow ready-made walking routes through the city's neighborhoods and earn bonus points when you finish one.

POSTCARDS FOR FRIENDS
Your stamps arrive in your friends' feed as postcards. Ask a friend for a joint stamp and see where you rank in your city and your district.

WIDGETS
Keep your latest stamp and your district visa on your home screen.

PRIVACY
Your exact location is never stored. Anything you share appears with a one-hour delay. Mark the area around your home or work as a private zone; stamps there stay with you.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Karnet is in English and Turkish.
• Place names and locations come from open data (OpenStreetMap, Wikidata, Overture Maps); sources are listed in the app and on our website.
• Questions or ideas: info@yelkovan.ai

name: KassaTap POS: Cash Register
description:
KassaTap turns your iPhone or iPad into a till for your café, restaurant, snack bar, bakery, grocery or shop. Sell in a few taps, print the receipt on a small thermal printer and see what you sold at the end of the day. It works offline, and the free version needs no account.

SELL IN A FEW TAPS
• Products in categories, with photos, options (size, extras) and favorites
• Quick search, discounts, tax included or added, any currency
• Cash with the change counted for you, card or mixed payments
• Sales history, reprints and refunds

PRINT ON A THERMAL PRINTER
• 58 mm and 80 mm ESC/POS receipt printers on your network (Wi-Fi or Ethernet)
• Your logo and every language print correctly, Arabic included, because receipts are printed as images
• Receipt templates to choose and adjust

FOR CAFÉS AND RESTAURANTS (Pro)
• Tables and open orders: move, join and split the bill
• Kitchen and bar tickets, each category to its own printer
• Waiters take orders from their own phone: they scan a QR code, nothing to install
• Takeaway and delivery

KNOW WHERE THE MONEY GOES (Pro)
• Staff with PIN codes and roles, and an activity log
• Cash closing with counted cash, cash in and cash out
• Sales reports by day, product, payment and staff: PDF, printed or Excel
• Stock with low-stock alerts

CUSTOMERS AND INVOICES
• Credit book: sell on a customer's account, record what they pay back, see who owes what (free)
• A4 invoices numbered per year (Pro)

FREE AND PRO
Free: selling, one printer, products, history, refunds, customers and credit, backups. No account, no time limit, no ads.
Pro: everything above, per store, on 2 devices. Create an account and get 14 days of Pro free. If Pro ends, you keep selling: the app goes back to Free and keeps your data.

ALSO
• Works without internet. Your data stays on your device, with an automatic daily backup and backup files you can keep anywhere
• English, French, Arabic, Spanish, Portuguese and Indonesian
• iPhone and iPad

KassaTap is a simple till and receipt app. It is not certified fiscal cash register software: if your country requires one, check its rules before using KassaTap for your official records.

SUBSCRIPTION
KassaTap Pro is an auto-renewable subscription, monthly or yearly, for one store. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for the renewal within 24 hours before that end. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Keel: Light Meter
description:
Keel is a light meter for film photographers. Frame your shot, tap Measure, and Keel gives you every aperture and shutter speed pair for the film in your camera.

MATCH WHAT YOUR CAMERA SEES
Pick the aspect ratio you're shooting, from 6×6 and 645 to 35mm, 4×5 and XPan, and Keel meters only what's inside the framelines. Choose a focal length and the viewfinder zooms to match what your lens sees.

FILM STOCKS
Choose from popular stocks like Kodak Portra, Ektar, Tri-X, Ilford HP5 and CineStill, or add your own. Star the films you shoot most to keep them at the top. Reciprocity, ISO, and latitude all come from your film selection.

READ THE WHOLE SCENE
A histogram shows the scene's brightness against your film's latitude, so you can see at a glance whether the shadows or highlights will hold. When a scene has more range than one reading can capture, Keel brackets automatically.

EXPOSURE COMPENSATION
Dial in up to ±3 stops for snow, backlight or a dark interior, and every reading adjusts with it.

LONG EXPOSURES, HANDLED
Keel corrects for reciprocity failure on long exposures. There's no need to switch to another app for timing, Keel has a built-in timer that automatically adjusts to the exposure time you've selected. With haptic feedback and sound, your phone can go back in your pocket during a long reading.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Nothing you point the camera at is saved or sent anywhere.

name: Keep Leap: Castle Gem Hop
description:
Keep Leap is a bright side-scrolling platformer set in two stone castle keeps. You guide Rolo, a round little green explorer, over gate roofs, crates and towers, scooping up gems on the way to the exit sign at the far end of each keep.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Hold the left and right arrows to roll, and tap the big green button to jump.
• Rolo can only push off castle ledges and crates. Plain walls give him nothing to jump from, so plan every leap.
• Gems are worth points: red 20, yellow 50, blue 100, orange 200, and the rare grey gem a whopping 500.
• Three lives per run. Fall into the moat and Rolo is back at the last checkpoint flag he reached.
• Your score and lives carry over from Keep 1 into Keep 2. Beat your highscore and it is saved on your device.

TWO HAND-BUILT KEEPS
Keep 1 has low gate roofs, a gem arch and a tall tower with blue gems on top. Keep 2 climbs higher, with crates to hop and a tricky detour to the rare grey gem. Every ledge is placed by hand, and each keep is one full run to the exit sign.

MEET THE CASTLE CREW
• Gilda the parrot, Royal Gem Appraiser: an AI helper that runs fully on your device. Ask her what gems are worth, how jumping works, where the rare grey gem hides or what happens when you fall. She also reads your own stats.
• The Gatehouse: chat with Captain Bram, Mason Bo the master builder and Scout Tansy the ledge mapper. Each of them has tips, secrets and stories about the keeps.
• Scout's Reel: a recorded run with chapters and captions that shows the moves in action.

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
The main menu is portrait. On iPhone you play in full-screen landscape; on iPad the whole game stays full-screen portrait and shows the full height of each keep. There is a pause button, cheerful castle music, and separate Music and Sound Effects switches. Tick "Delete score on exit" if you want a fresh start.

No accounts, no ads, no tracking, and it works offline.

name: Keepsake: Save Places & Links
description:
Share anything from any app, and Keepsake keeps it: links, places, photos and notes, sorted automatically into categories, never leaving your iPhone.

SAVE FROM ANY APP
Tap Share in Safari, Maps, Photos, Instagram or anywhere else and choose Keepsake. Save up to 10 photos at a time. Share the same link again and it's refreshed, not copied.

SORTS ITSELF
Each item goes into a category by its type, its words, its website and what’s in its photos. Add your own rules if you like, and anything you move by hand stays put.

ROUTES, AND THE ATHENS DAKTYLIOS
Plan the best route through up to 8 stops and start it in Apple Maps.
Driving into central Athens? Set your plate as odd or even, or as a car that may always enter (Euro 6, electric, hybrid or with a permit). On days your car may not enter, the route goes around the Daktylios, or parks just outside it and continues by metro, tram or on foot. Keepsake tells you when the restriction ends for the day, finds parking outside the zone, and follows your trip on the Lock Screen.

PLACES, GROUPED BY WHERE THEY ARE
Places shared from Google Maps and Apple Maps are grouped by country, region and city, with maps, neighborhoods, distances by car, on foot or by transit, and descriptions from Wikipedia. Save the places around you with Around Me, or drop a pin with Pin This Spot. Share a Google Maps list to see its places with the notes its author wrote, translated into your language on your iPhone. Choose which places to keep, and refresh the list later to add new ones.

PHOTOS THAT MAKE SENSE
Text in photos and screenshots is read on your iPhone, and the key lines are picked out for you. Keepsake tags each photo with what’s in it, like “beach” or “receipt”. If the photo has a location, you see where it was taken on a map, with the city and country.

FIND ANYTHING
Search titles, page text, labels and the words in your photos, with filters and favorites. The Saved Nearby widget shows the saved places closest to you.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no cloud, no tracking. Your items, photos and the text read from them stay on your iPhone. Only what's needed to look things up leaves it: the pages and Google Maps lists you share are opened to read them, locations go to Apple Maps, and place names go to Wikipedia, if you allow it.

KEEP IT SAFE
Password-protected backups that you keep wherever you like. Restore by replacing everything or adding to what's there.

In English and Greek.

name: Keepsake: Warranty & Care
description:
Give the things you own a little more care.

Keepsake keeps purchase details, warranty dates and care history together in a private, offline collection. From a coffee machine to a favorite lamp, keep useful records close at hand.

• Record names, categories, models, purchase dates, optional amounts and currencies, and notes.
• See upcoming care and warranty dates in your overview.
• Choose local reminders for care dates, warranty expiry and the week before expiry.
• Save a history of cleaning, repairs and routine care, then set the next care date. Correct or delete history entries without changing your current plan.
• Find belongings by name, model, category or notes. Filter by warranty status and sort by name or next care date.
• Export a JSON backup and restore new records without overwriting existing ones.
• Read the privacy policy and terms inside the app, even offline.

No account, advertising, tracking, subscriptions or in-app purchases. Your collection stays on your device unless you choose to export it. Optional reminders depend on iOS permissions and settings; up to 60 future alerts are scheduled at a time, so reopen the app periodically to refresh. Keep separate records for important warranty deadlines.

Purchase values are personal records; Keepsake does not convert currencies or verify warranty coverage.

name: Keevora
description:
Warranties, service dates, and item details are easy to lose across receipts, messages, and photos. When an appliance needs cleaning or a warranty is close to ending, that information is often not in one place.

Keevora is an offline app for personal belongings. You can save items you own, record warranty expiry dates, and keep maintenance schedules on this device. There is no account and no Keevora server.

How to use
Open Keevora and add a belonging. Choose a category such as electronics, home appliances, kitchen, furniture, personal accessories, tools, or other. You can add a name, brand, model, purchase date, price, warranty expiry, location, serial number, notes, and an optional photo from your photo library.

Add a maintenance schedule for cleaning, inspection, servicing, repair, replacement, or general care. Choose a date, an optional repeat interval, and whether a reminder should be attached to that schedule. When the work is done, mark it complete. Keevora saves a history record. If the schedule repeats, the next due date is calculated so a future task is not marked complete by mistake.

The Home screen shows the number of items, maintenance that is due, and warranties that are still active. These numbers come from items you saved. The Care tab groups overdue work, work due today, upcoming work, and completed history. Search finds belongings by name, brand, category, model, or location.

Reminders are optional. Keevora asks for notification permission only if you turn reminders on. Reminders are local notifications on this device. A reminder is scheduled for 9:00 AM on the due date. If that time has already passed, the next reminder is the following morning at 9:00 AM.

You can export your data as a JSON file through the system share sheet. You can also clear all app data after confirmation. Photos and records stay on the device unless you choose to export or delete them.

Who it is for
Keevora is for people who want a simple record of household and personal items, warranty dates, and maintenance, without creating an account.

name: Kelime Definesi
description:
Gelibolu'da eski bir sahafın kapısındasın. İçeride, yarım kalmış bir pusula defteri seni bekliyor. Defterin her sayfası, bir hükümdarın ya da efsanenin kayıp definesine giden bir harita. Haritaları açan şey kelimeler.

NASIL OYNANIR
• Anadolu Efsaneleri: karışık harflerden, ipucunun anlattığı kelimeyi bul.
• Dünya Defineleri: harf çemberinde parmağını harflerin üstünden geçir, kelimeleri çiz ve bulmacayı doldur.
• Her harita 25 duraktan oluşur. Durakları geçtikçe yol açılır, bölümlerin sonunda muhafız durakları ve define kapısı seni bekler.
• Süreye karşı oynarsın; takıldığında ipucu alabilir ya da fazla harfi atabilirsin. Acele etmek istemezsen Sahaf Modu'nda süresiz oyna.

NELER VAR
• 20 define haritası: Midas, Karun, İskender, Fatih, Kanuni, Tutankamon, Kleopatra, Napolyon, Cengiz Han, Piri Reis ve dahası.
• 500 durak; kolaydan zora yavaşça artan bir yol.
• Her haritada tarih ve efsane: "Biliyor muydun?" kartları kaynağıyla verilir, efsaneler "anlatılır" diye anlatılır.
• Özgün, elle çizilmiş görünümlü haritalar ve karakterler: kâşif sensin, sahaf Ahmet ya da Ayşe sana eşlik eder, martı Pusula ipuçlarını gagalar.
• Günün Bulmacası: herkes aynı gün aynı bulmacayı çözer; sonucunu cevabı vermeden paylaş, serini sürdür.
• Kâşifin Odası: bulduğun eserler vitrinde, hikâyeleriyle birlikte.
• Günlük giriş ödülü, hediye sandıkları, günlük hediye çarkı ve fenerler.
• İstersen günlük ödülün ve fenerlerin için hatırlatma (günde en fazla bir bildirim).
• İnternetsiz de oynanır; ilerlemen telefonunda saklanır. (Reklamlar ve satın almalar için internet gerekir.)
• Ekran okuyucu desteği: harfler ve düğmeler sesli okunur.

Oyun ücretsizdir. İsteğe bağlı ödüllü reklamlar ve duraklar arasında reklamlar içerir; altın, define sandıkları ve reklamsız oynama satın alınabilir. Sandıkların içeriği sabittir ve satın almadan önce yazar.

Kelime oyunlarını sevenler, tarihe ve efsanelere meraklı olanlar için hazırlandı. Kelimeleri bul, defteri tamamla, son defineye ulaş.

name: Kelvo: IPTV Player & M3U
description:
The news and the match. Two cartoons. A film and the channel you paused for it. Kelvo is built for the evening you spend hopping between a few favorites: one Recall key, like the "last" button on a TV remote, takes you straight back to what you were watching before.

RECALL, THE KEY THAT REMEMBERS
• Tap Recall in the player to jump back to the last channel, film or episode. Tap again to flip forward.
• Hold Recall to pin two things as a pair. The key then reads A ⇄ B and flips between just those two until you clear it.
• The Recall trail keeps the last 12 things you played in each playlist, newest first, with films and episodes at the exact spot you left them. Find it in the Back to row on Home, in All sections, or behind the Trail key in the player.
• A double tap on the far left edge of the video recalls too.

FIND YOUR WAY WITH THE DECK
• A low tray along the bottom of the screen names the section you're in. Swipe it sideways to move between Home, Live, Films, Series and Search, or pull it up for every section as a big tile, your Recall trail, Favorites and Settings.
• Under each section title, a row of round category keys. Tap one to switch, or open All categories to search, sort, see counts and pin the ones you use most.
• Live channels sit on remote-key rows with their logo, a heart and a badge when they're part of your pair or trail. On iPad they spread over two columns.
• Films and series show up as pinned polaroids with a coral bar for how much you've watched.

PICK UP WHERE YOU STOPPED
• Continue watching on Home holds every film and episode you started. Open one and choose Resume or Start over.
• Series pages list each season, and the episode you stopped in is marked.
• Favorites keep the channels, films and series you love one tap from Home.
• Search reads every channel, film and series in your playlist at once.

A CALM PLAYER
• Audio and subtitle tracks in one small sheet, only when the stream has them.
• Full screen with the Recall key still in reach, and a lineup list under the video in portrait.
• When a stream stalls, Kelvo tries its other format by itself and picks it back up.

YOUR PLAYLIST, NOT OURS
Kelvo is a player and nothing else. It includes no channels, films, series or playlists, and it isn't tied to any provider. To watch, add your own Xtream Codes login or M3U link or file from a provider you're allowed to use. Until then, the app shows an empty pinboard waiting for your playlist.

Kelvo is in English and follows your device's clock and text size, on iPhone and iPad.

KELVO MAX
The free plan plays one playlist and shows ads. Kelvo Max adds unlimited playlists and takes every ad away. Recall, favorites, Continue watching and the player work the same on both plans.

Kelvo Max is an auto-renewing subscription, offered by the week, the month or the year. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically for the same period and price unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for the renewal within the 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel it any time in your Apple Account settings after purchase. Any unused part of a free trial, if one is offered, is forfeited when you buy a subscription. Where a one-time Lifetime option is shown, it is paid once and never renews.

name: Kênh Truyện Ma: Nghe Truyện Ma
description:
Kênh Truyện Ma – ứng dụng nghe truyện ma audio miễn phí với kho hơn 17.000 truyện và 190.000 tập, thêm tập mới mỗi ngày. GIỌNG ĐỌC NỔI TIẾNG
• Nguyễn Ngọc Ngạn, Quàng A Tũn, Đình Soạn, Nguyễn Huy, Duy Thuận, MC Bông…

name: Kerf Calc: Feet Inch Fractions
description:
Kerf Calc is a feet-inch-fraction calculator built for the job site.

Type lengths the way you read them off the tape: 12 FEET 7 INCH 3/8. Add, subtract, multiply and divide them, and get the answer rounded to the nearest 1/16" (or 1/8", 1/32", 1/64" - your choice). Tap the format button to see the same answer in inches, decimal feet, meters or millimeters.

BUILT FOR THE JOB SITE
- Big keys you can hit with gloves on
- FEET, INCH and fraction keys right on the keypad
- Yards, meters, centimeters and millimeters mixed freely with feet and inches
- Every finished calculation saved on the tape - tap one to use it again
- Works fully offline. No account, no ads, no tracking

TOOLS
- Right triangle: rise, run, diagonal, pitch and angle - square a deck or a foundation
- Concrete: cubic yards for a slab, a 10% extra suggestion, and how many 80, 60 or 40 lb bags to buy
- Board feet: lumber volume for any count of boards
- Studs: how many studs a wall needs at 12", 16" or 24" on center

Kerf Calc is a calculation aid. Always confirm critical measurements and code requirements before cutting or building.

name: Keyback: Get Your Deposit Back
description:
Landlords keep billions in security deposits every year, and most of the time the tenant has no proof. Keyback gives you that proof in about ten minutes.

On move-in day, Keyback walks you through your rental one room and one item at a time. It tells you what to check and what to photograph. Rate each item, snap a photo or video of anything that isn't perfect, and move on. When you're done, sign and lock the record so it's date-stamped and can't be changed.

When you move out, you do the same walk. Your move-in photos and ratings show up next to every item, so you can match the angles and prove nothing changed. Keyback tracks your state's deposit deadline, and if your landlord stalls or charges you for damage that was already there, it writes the demand letter for you.

GUIDED WALKTHROUGH
• Room-by-room checklists for kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, garages, patios and more
• Tips for every item, like checking inside the oven and testing the smoke detector
• Big photo, video and import buttons, six condition ratings and quick notes
• Add your own rooms and items

PROOF THAT HOLDS UP
• Every photo and video is timestamped and fingerprinted (SHA-256)
• Optional GPS location shows photos were taken at the property
• Sign and finalize to lock the record, and have your landlord sign too if they're there
• Full video tours at move-in and move-out, compressed to stay sharp but small

EVERYTHING ABOUT YOUR RENTAL
• Upload your lease, addendums, receipts and notices
• Log damage, repairs and maintenance requests, including damage that was there before you
• Keep a timeline of every email, text and call with your landlord
• Meter readings and keys received and returned
• Reminders before your notice deadline, lease end, move-out and deposit deadline

GET YOUR MONEY BACK
• Deposit return deadlines for all 50 states and DC, with the statute and penalties
• Track deductions and mark the ones you dispute
• Move-in, move-out and side-by-side comparison PDF reports
• A deposit demand letter citing your state's law
• Email reports straight to your landlord
• Export an evidence package with every original file for small claims court

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your records stay on your iPhone. Turn on iCloud backup to keep a copy in your own iCloud Drive, and lock the app with Face ID.

PRICING
Keyback is free to use for one rental, including the full walkthrough, photos and videos. A one-time $4.99 unlock adds every report, the demand letter, the evidence package, iCloud backup and unlimited rentals. No subscription.

Keyback is a documentation tool, not a law firm, and does not give legal advice. Deposit rules are summaries of state law and can change.
