name: Keymcap
seller_name: A & D CREATIVE SOLUTIONS SDN. BHD.
description:
Welcome! We look forward to accompanying you on your journey—please feel free to share your valuable suggestions.

Keymcap turns the numbers on your utility meters into a clear picture of what you use and what it will cost. Log a reading from the electric board, water main, gas meter or solar export meter, and Keymcap works out your daily use, prices it with your own tariff and tells you what this billing cycle is heading for.

LOG A READING IN SECONDS
Tap the figure on a big meter-style keypad and watch it light up on a seven-segment display. Keymcap shows the usage since your last reading and the daily rate before you even save. Pick an earlier date if you forgot to log on the day, add a short note like "guests over", and fix or delete any reading later.

YOUR TARIFF, YOUR WAY
Copy the slabs from your bill: the price for each band of units plus the fixed charge. Keymcap prices every cycle slab by slab, just like your supplier, and the built-in bill check shows what any amount of units would cost. Solar export meters are counted as a credit.

KNOW THE BILL BEFORE IT LANDS
Set the day your billing cycle starts and Keymcap projects this cycle's units and estimated bill from your recent pace, with a day-by-day ruler showing how far through the cycle you are. The Panel adds every meter together into one estimate for the house.

COMPARE CYCLES
A ruled scale puts each cycle side by side with your average. See the change against last cycle, the daily average, and every stretch between readings inside a cycle.

CATCH THE SPIKE
When a stretch runs well above your usual daily use, the meter turns yellow and tells you by how much. Choose how sensitive the alert should be for each meter.

READING REMINDERS
Ask for a nudge every few days per meter. Reminders are local notifications created on your phone, and permission is only requested when you switch one on.

SIGN IN YOUR WAY
Sign in with Apple, Google or email, or tap "Read as guest" to start straight away. A guest can keep their panel later by attaching a sign-in, without losing any readings. Your data syncs across devices and keeps working offline.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no tracking, no analytics. Your meters, readings and tariffs are stored in your own account in Google Firebase, readable only by you. You can delete your account and every reading from inside the app at any time (Fuse box, Delete account).

Keymcap's figures are estimates based on the readings and tariff you enter; your supplier's bill is the official amount.

name: Kitchen Scaler: Recipe Math
description:
Cooking and baking should be enjoyable—not a frustrating math test with flour on your hands.

Kitchen Scaler is the ultimate hands-free culinary companion designed specifically for use on your kitchen counter. Whether you are halving a delicate pastry recipe, tripling a soup for dinner guests, converting grams to cups, or timing an oven bake, Kitchen Scaler puts high-contrast, zero-scroll culinary math right at your fingertips.

HANDS-OFF, ZERO-SCROLL COUNTERTOP DESIGN

• Giant, High-Contrast Readouts: Read scaled quantities effortlessly from 3 to 6 feet away while working at your cutting board or stove.
• Knuckle-Friendly Steppers: Adjust quantities with simple (-) and (+) touch targets—no virtual keyboard popping up over your recipe.
• Built-in Screen Keep-Awake: Never tap your screen with messy, buttery fingers just to keep your phone display awake.
• Zero-Scroll Core Workflow: Every primary tool and multiplier fits onto a single screen for quick, uninterrupted glances.

INSTANT FRACTION & SERVINGS SCALER
• Practical Culinary Fractions: Seamlessly scales ½, ⅓, ¼, ⅔, ¾, and ⅛ measurements with instant decimal-to-fraction reduction.
• 8 Quick Multipliers: One-tap scaling for ×0.33, ×0.5, ×0.67, ×1, ×1.5, ×2, ×3, and ×4.
• Recipe Servings Scaler: Scale by yield (e.g. Recipe makes 4, but you want 10) with automatic precision.
• Tap-to-Speak Readout: Tap any measurement card to have iOS read your scaled amount aloud hands-free.

MULTI-INGREDIENT RECIPE CHECKLIST
• Build your full ingredient list and scale the entire recipe simultaneously with a single tap.
• Large, tactile check-off boxes with strikethrough tracking so you never wonder if you already added the baking powder.
• Speak-All feature reads your entire recipe list step-by-step.
• One-tap export to your clipboard to send to shopping lists or notes.

BAKING & KITCHEN MEASUREMENT CONVERTER
• Smart Volume, Weight & Temp: Fluid ounces, cups, tablespoons, teaspoons, milliliters, liters, grams, ounces, pounds, °F and °C.
• Smart Spoon Breakdown: Automatically translates odd amounts into standard measuring spoons (e.g., 5 tsp = 1 tbsp + 2 tsp).
• Baking Pan Size Calculator: Instantly calculate the surface area scaling ratio when substituting pan sizes (e.g., 8-inch round to 9×13-inch baking dish).

EMERGENCY BAKING SUBSTITUTIONS & CHEATS
• Fast Emergency Subs Search: Missing buttermilk, cake flour, eggs, brown sugar, or active dry yeast? Find foolproof pantry swaps instantly.
• Quick Butter Stick Guide: Translate sticks, tablespoons, ounces, grams, and cups at a glance.
• 1-Cup Baking Weights: Standardized weights for flours, sugars, butter, and cocoa.
• Oven Temperature Quick Chart: Standard baking temps in Fahrenheit, Celsius, and culinary descriptions.

CUSTOM COOKING COUNTDOWN TIMER
• Large 80pt digital readout readable from across the room.
• Quick presets for common cooking tasks (1m, 3m, 5m, 10m, 15m, 20m, 30m, 45m).
• Enter any custom minutes and seconds with quick (+30s), (+1m), and (+5m) extensions while cooking.
• Multiple Kitchen Chimes: Choose between Kitchen Chime, Digital Beep, Oven Bell, or Urgent Pulse.
• Accidental Stop Protection: Confirmation dialog prevents accidental taps from resetting your active timer mid-bake.

100% PRIVATE & OFFLINE
• No account, sign-in, or internet connection required.
• Works completely offline in airplane mode or spotty kitchen Wi-Fi.
• Zero ads, zero tracking, and zero personal data collection.

Welcome to Kitchen Scaler!
• Hands-off, zero-scroll countertop interface with giant high-contrast typography.
• Fractional recipe scaling (halving, doubling, tripling, servings).
• Multi-ingredient recipe checklist with voice readouts.
• Volume, weight, temperature, and baking pan size converter.
• Emergency baking substitutions and reference cheat sheets.
• Cooking countdown timer with custom times, sound picker, and accidental stop protection.
• Keep-awake display toggle and native dark/light mode themes.

name: Kitty Kingpin: Idle Alley Cat
description:
Meet Kitty Kingpin, a tiny tuxedo cat from a Seoul back alley.
Take down neighborhood animals one by one and conquer all eight regions in this cute idle RPG.

■ Battles on its own
Your cat runs, scratches, and collects coins all by itself.
Tap for extra cat punches whenever you feel like jumping in.
Enemies arrive in packs, and one big move can send several flying.
Turn on Auto to use skills automatically, too.

■ Beat the boss, take the next block
Keep knocking enemies down and a boss shows up. Beat it within 30 seconds to open the next block.
the Fat Cat Boss, the Raccoon Dog Boss, the Bullfrog Chief, all the way to the black bear of Taebaek.
Lost? Grow a little more and try again. Your power score tells you when you're ready.

■ Seoul to Taebaek: 8 regions, 240 stages
Seoul, Gyeonggi, Chungcheong, Jeolla, Gyeongsang, Busan, Gangwon, Taebaek.
Every region has its own scenery, its own animals and its own bosses.

■ Charm humans, don't fight them
Sometimes a human walks by. You don't fight them—a little charm is all it takes.
An office worker on the way home gives you extra cash for treats, and a kind lady brings tuna cans.
A schoolkid cheers you on, while an older man gives you… plain rice.

■ Turf fees pile up while you're away
Every block you take over pays turf fees. They keep piling up for up to 8 hours even when the game is closed.
Come back and collect them all at once.

■ Five trusty crew members
Cheese, Chirpy, Acorn, Bean, and Calico. Not all of them are cats!
Bring up to three along to fight by your side.
Send resting crew on trips to blocks you've claimed. They'll bring back bundles of loot.
The farther they go and the longer they're away, the bigger the bundle.

■ The Crow Shop and the Crow's Bundle
The crow takes anything shiny. Raise your attack, health, and attack speed at the Crow Shop.
Open a Crow's Bundle for collars, cushions, and bells. Duplicates merge into stronger gear.
You can open free bundles every day, and drop rates are shown in the game.

■ Collect martial arts and train with a master
Draw Alley Scrolls to collect martial arts moves, buffs, and passive skills.
Equip four quick slots: three regular skills and one finisher.
Beat Taebaek's Asiatic black bear, and the Mountain Lord—a tiger from the mountains—will teach you the Whirlwind Kick.

■ Weekly raid and rankings
Hit the Giant Bull, a huge boss that never goes down, as hard as you can before time runs out.
Compete on damage dealt throughout the week and claim rewards every Monday.
There's also a stage leaderboard to see who's made it the farthest.

■ Daily and weekly missions
Tick off today's tasks one by one to open chests full of gems and tuna cans.
The mission line on the home screen always tells you what to do next.

■ Pick your favorite cat look
Choose from Tuxedo, Cheese, and Bombay skins to give your cat a new look.

■ Automatic iCloud saves
If iCloud is enabled for your Apple Account, your game progress is saved automatically.

■ Purchases and ads
You can buy gems and packs in the game, but you can play to the end without buying anything.
For items with random results, such as the Crow's Bundle and Alley Scrolls, the drop rates are shown in the game.
The only ads are rewarded ads that you choose to watch. The game goes on even if you never watch one.

This game contains randomized items (Crow's Bundle, Alley Scrolls).

name: KKdesk
seller_name: Zhengzhou Xixi Network Technology Co. Ltd.
description:
KKdesk is a simple, secure and fast cross-platform remote control app. Use your iPhone or iPad to access and control your Windows PC, Mac or Android device from anywhere.

CONTROL YOUR COMPUTER ANYWHERE
• Enter the device ID and connection password, and see the remote desktop in seconds
• Open documents, manage files and use any software on your computer, just as if you were sitting in front of it
• Sign in to your account to see all your devices at a glance and connect with one tap

INTUITIVE CONTROLS
• Trackpad mode: move the cursor with your finger, tap to click, scroll with two fingers, drag with precision
• Touch mode: tap directly where you want to act, simple and natural
• Shortcut key bar: Esc, Tab, Ctrl, Alt, Win, Shift and arrow keys always at hand, with support for key combinations
• Pinch to zoom in on details, so even a large desktop is easy to read on a small screen

SMOOTH AND SHARP
• Connects directly over your local network for lower latency
• Adjust image quality and frame rate to match your network; smoothness comes first on weak connections
• Live latency indicator shows your connection quality at a glance

SHARE YOUR IPHONE SCREEN
• Share your iPhone screen with a computer, great for remote demos or helping family members
• Screen sharing is view-only: the other side cannot control your phone
• You confirm every request before sharing starts; a clear indicator stays on while sharing, and you can stop with one tap at any time

SAFE AND SECURE
• Every connection requires a password; choose a temporary password or a fixed security password
• All connections are encrypted end to end in transit
• Built-in fraud warning: never share your screen with anyone claiming to be customer service, a bank or the police

GETTING STARTED
The computer you want to control needs KKdesk for desktop, available as a free download at kkdesk.com.

Note: The app interface is currently available in Simplified Chinese.

Questions or feedback? Reach us in the app under Me → Help & Feedback (我的 → 帮助与反馈).

name: KlickKiste
description:
With KlickKiste you build your very own video game – without a single line of code. Just tap a character, place it on the field and press the big green PLAY button. Your game is ready to play!

THREE KINDS OF GAMES
• Top-down: mazes, treasure hunts and monster chases
• Jump & run: build platforms, jump and collect coins
• 3D first-person: your field automatically turns into a 3D world you can walk through

SO EASY
• Huge buttons, almost no reading needed
• Paint walls with your finger
• Tap a character and pick with pictures what it does: stands still, walks back and forth, comes to you, shoots back, is your friend, explodes or can be collected
• Undo button for every mistake

A BIG TOY BOX
• Lots of characters: slime, ghost, dino, robot, dragon, unicorn, princess, knight, wizard and many more
• Coins, diamonds, hearts, super stars and crates
• Treasure chests: you decide what's inside – or let chance decide
• Five worlds: forest, castle, space, desert and candy land

DESIGN YOUR OWN WAVES
• Tap "Wave 2" and choose which monsters come in that round
• Pick the reward for every wave you clear
• Make monsters small, normal, strong or a boss – one by one or all at once
• Or switch on endless waves

YOUR GAME, YOUR RULES
• Choose your hero, your gear and how many lives you have
• Build your own pause menu with the settings you want: sensitivity, sound, aim help, speed or button size

GROWS WITH YOUR AGE
On first launch you pick your age. Little kids play with water pistols, bubbles and friendly characters. Older players unlock more gear step by step.

SAVE AND KEEP BUILDING
Give your game a name. The home screen shows all your games with a preview picture – ready to play or to keep building.

SAFE FOR KIDS
• No ads
• No in-app purchases
• No account, no internet needed
• No data is collected – everything stays on your device
• Links outside the app are protected by a parental gate

In English and German. For iPhone and iPad.

Have fun building!

name: Klyvanta
description:
APP NAME
Klyvanta

SUBTITLE (30 characters max)
Account Security Organizer

PROMOTIONAL TEXT (170 characters max)
Every online account you own, in one private orbit. See which accounts need 2FA or a fresh password, and never miss a subscription renewal. Works offline.

DESCRIPTION
Klyvanta is a beautiful, private organizer for every online account you own: email, banking, social, shopping, streaming, gaming, cloud and more.

Most of us have dozens of accounts and no idea which ones are protected. Klyvanta gives you a clear picture in seconds, and it never asks for or stores a single password.

YOUR ACCOUNTS, IN ORBIT
• See all your accounts circling a live security score on the Orbit home screen
• Organize them by category, colour, and pinned favourites
• Search, filter and sort by name, recent activity or risk

A SECURITY SCORE FOR EVERY ACCOUNT
• Tick off two-factor authentication, recovery email, recovery phone and unique password
• Klyvanta tracks how old each password is and suggests when to rotate it
• "Needs attention" highlights your weakest accounts and tells you exactly what to fix
• The password rotation queue puts the oldest passwords first. Change one, tap Done, and watch your score climb

NEVER MISS A RENEWAL
• Track subscription prices with monthly or yearly billing
• See your total monthly and yearly spend, broken down by category
• Get an on-device reminder 2 days before something renews

PULSE INSIGHTS
• Coverage dials for 2FA, recovery options, unique passwords and fresh passwords
• Spend breakdown by category
• A timeline of your recent changes

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Works completely offline. Your vault is stored only on your iPhone, with iOS file protection
• No passwords, no ads, no tracking, no analytics
• Optional Face ID / Touch ID app lock
• Export your data as JSON any time

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CHOICE
• Use every feature without an account: just tap "Skip for now"
• Or sign in with Apple or Google to personalize your profile
• Sign out or permanently delete your account in the app at any time, from the Me tab

Klyvanta does not connect to or change your accounts with other services. It is your personal map of them, so you always know where you stand.

Privacy Policy: https://klyvanta-95c5e.web.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://klyvanta-95c5e.web.app/terms

WHAT'S NEW (version 1.0)
Welcome to Klyvanta! Organize your online accounts, score their security, and track subscription renewals, all privately on your iPhone.

name: KnocKnock
description:
大廈的手機火警鐘。

大廈當值人員發出火警時，所有訂閱這座大廈的手機會即時響起火警鐘聲，畫面清楚顯示「本大廈火警」和大廈名稱。

• 不用登記：不問姓名、電話、單位或樓層
• 掃描大廈告示上的 QR 碼即可訂閱，亦可輸入大廈編號
• 鐘聲持續響起，直至你按「我已知曉」
• 按住「我已安全」，物業便知道又多一人報平安（只計人數，不知道是誰）
• 演習以藍色畫面顯示，並標明「演習」
• 警報結束時畫面轉為綠色
• 中文 / English

Knock Knock 需要大廈的物業公司已加入服務。Knock Knock 不能取代大廈的火警系統；如遇緊急情況，請致電緊急求助電話。

A fire alarm bell on your phone. Follow your building by scanning the QR code on its notice, with no sign-up. When the building's duty staff sound the alarm, your phone rings until you tap "Got it", and you can tell them you are safe with one hold.

name: KnocKnock Duty
description:
KK 當值是 Knock Knock 物業當值人員用的 App：在手機上向整座大廈的住戶發出火警或演習。

• 以物業公司開設的當值帳戶登入
• 「我的大廈」排在最前，一按即選
• 選「火警」或「演習」，按住按鈕 3 秒發出
• 發出後 5 秒內可撤回，期間不會有手機響起
• 即時顯示已送達、響鐘中、已知曉、已報平安的人數
• 按住 2 秒結束警報，住戶手機轉為綠色
• 中文 / English

帳戶由物業公司開設，不能在 App 內註冊。

For property duty staff using Knock Knock: sound a fire alarm or a drill on every subscribed phone in a building, withdraw it within 5 seconds, and follow delivery and safe counts live. Accounts are issued by the property company.

name: Komilfo Курьер
Kopfkiste
description:
Dein Kopf hat hundert offene Tabs? Kopfkiste hilft dir, alles rauszulassen und wieder klar zu sehen.

Erzähl deiner Kiste einfach, was dich gerade beschäftigt. Tippen oder sprechen, so durcheinander, wie es eben ist. Die Kiste sortiert für dich:
• Was heute dran ist, in kleinen, machbaren Schritten
• Was warten kann und sicher in der Kiste liegt
• Was du loslassen darfst

KLEINE SCHRITTE STATT RIESIGER LISTEN
Auf "Heute" liegen nur so viele Karten, wie heute wirklich gehen. Fühlt sich etwas zu groß an, macht die Kiste es kleiner. Alles andere wartet geduldig, bis du so weit bist.

GEWOHNHEITEN GANZ OHNE DRUCK
Wasser trinken, kurzes Workout, Medikamente, pünktlich ins Bett: Such dir kleine Gewohnheiten aus und hak sie mit einem Tippen ab. Statt einer Serie, die reißt, sammelst du Murmeln, die bleiben. Ein verpasster Tag ist kein Problem.

EINE KISTE, DIE SICH MITFREUT
Deine Kiste freut sich über jedes Erledigte, geht mit deiner Energie auf Abenteuer und bringt Fundstücke mit. Mit den Knöpfen, die du sammelst, richtest du euer Zimmer ein: Lampen, Pflanzen, Tapeten, Accessoires.

DURCHATMEN, WENN ES ZU VIEL WIRD
Kurze Übungen für zwischendurch: Atmen mit der Kiste, Gedanken Abstand geben, Gefühle benennen, einen netten Brief an dich selbst.

FÜR DICH GEMACHT
• Ruhiger Modus mit weniger Bewegung, wenn dir schnell alles zu viel wird
• Sanfte tägliche Erinnerung, wann du willst
• Deine Karten und Antworten bleiben auf deinem Handy

ABO
Kopfkiste kannst du 7 Tage kostenlos testen (Jahresabo). Danach gibt es ein Jahres- oder Monatsabo. Das Abo verlängert sich automatisch, wenn du es nicht mindestens 24 Stunden vor Ablauf in den Einstellungen deines Handys kündigst.

Nutzungsbedingungen: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Datenschutz: https://raoulsstamm-afk.github.io/kopfkiste-legal/datenschutz.html

Kopfkiste ist eine Alltags-App und ersetzt keine ärztliche oder psychotherapeutische Behandlung.

name: Kratzbaum-Krawall
description:
Bau den perfekten Kratzbaum – und dann lass die Katzen los! 

In Kratzbaum-Krawall baust du mit begrenzten Leckerli einen Kratzbaum aus Stämmen, Plattformen, Höhlen, Hängematten, Iglus, Tunneln und vielem mehr. Danach testen echte Katzen-Persönlichkeiten dein Bauwerk: Sie springen, kratzen, dösen, kuscheln – und machen alles kaputt, was nicht hält. Jeder gemütliche Moment bringt Katzenfreude .

BAUEN & TESTEN
• 30 Level mit immer neuen Herausforderungen: Gewitter, Glatteis, Saugroboter, Windböen und der riesige Nachbarskater Brutus
• Über 50 Bauteile – vom Sisalstamm bis zur Wandhöhle
• Jede Katze hat eigene Vorlieben, Wünsche und ein eigenes Gewicht

RETTUNGSMISSIONEN
• 19 Rettungen: Bau Wege, damit festsitzende Katzen sicher herunterkommen

VIELE SPIELMODI
• Duell für 2 Spieler an einem Handy
• Gegen den Bot in drei Schwierigkeiten
• Katzen-Olympiade mit Medaillen
• Zeitreise: Steinzeit, Ritterburg und Weltraum
• Katzen-Ansturm und Freies Bauen

DEIN KATZENHAUS
• Gerettete Katzen ziehen bei dir ein
• Füttern, spielen, bürsten, pflegen – und Freundschaften zwischen Katzen entstehen
• Richte das Haus ein, kaufe Möbel und erweitere die Räume
• Erstelle eigene Katzen, die als Baby starten und mit dir aufwachsen

AUSSERDEM
• Outfits und Accessoires für deine Katzen
• Erfolge, Fotoalbum, Tagesaufgaben und Katzen-Pass
• Komplett offline spielbar, keine Werbung, keine Datensammlung

name: Królestwo Atutu
description:
Swamp beasts, restless skeletons, and golden griffins clash across the table. Królestwo Atutu is a turn-based fantasy card game where a trump suit and the abilities of your monsters can turn the tide of battle.

The campaign stretches from the Wetlands to the Sunken Kingdom, the Sky Ruins, and beyond. Face the bosses along the way and give your deck new possibilities with collectible cards and upgrades.

name: KScanner: Document Scanner
description:
KScanner turns your phone into a compact document scanner. Photograph a page and the app finds the edges, straightens it and sharpens the text; save it as PDF, JPG, Word or Excel. Everything is processed on your phone: no account, no server, no ads.
The app is in English and Vietnamese: it follows your phone's language, and you can switch in Settings.

SCAN
• Scan many pages in a row; edges are found and pages straightened automatically, with manual cropping when needed
• Color, Black & white and Grayscale filters for a clean paper background and fewer hand shadows
• Blurry pages are flagged so you can retake them; rotate, reorder and delete pages
• Import photos already on your phone and crop them to the page
• Both sides of an ID card on one A4 page, printed at the card's real size
• Open PDFs and photos from other apps with Share → KScanner; they are kept in a “Sent from other apps” folder

READ VIETNAMESE TEXT ON YOUR PHONE
• After saving, the phone's built-in text recognition reads the page; images are never uploaded
• Copy the text; searchable, copyable PDFs
• Word export keeps the text and paragraphs, not the exact page layout
• Excel export splits rows and columns from tables on the page; treat it as a draft and check the figures
• Vietnamese accents are corrected only where the recognizer itself was unsure
• Find documents by name or by the text inside, with or without accents

FILL IN FORMS AND CHECK CONTRACTS
• Fill in a PDF: tap a blank to type, even on scanned paper forms
• Fill a form from a Vietnamese ID card, a passport or a VNeID screenshot: the app finds the blanks on the form, fills in name, date of birth, document number, address and more, and ticks the Male / Female box
• ID cards showing an address from before Vietnam's administrative reorganization: choose the address exactly as on the card or the new one
• Spell check for contracts: flags typos, likely accent mistakes, repeated words, and amounts whose figures and words disagree

18 PDF AND DOCUMENT TOOLS
Merge, split, reorder pages, rotate pages, add a password, remove a password, redact, watermark, images to PDF, PDF to images, compress, extract text, fill in a PDF, draw a signature, ID card on one page, page numbers, print, spell check.

SAVE AND SHARE
• Name documents and sort them into folders; add existing PDFs and photos to a folder
• Select documents right in the list to merge, split or rename them
• Share one or several documents at once, save to the Files app, print
• Password-protect PDFs right on your phone
• Back up all documents to a single file and restore it on a new phone
• Press and hold the app icon for quick actions: scan, import photos, scan an ID card, read text
• Record KScanner's screen with touch markers, handy for how-to clips

PRIVACY
• No sign-in, no ads, no tracking
• Images, documents and recognized text stay on your phone; files leave it only when you share, save or print them
• Optional app lock with its own 6-digit passcode, plus Face ID or Touch ID
• Deleting the app deletes all its data, so keep a copy of anything you need

PLEASE NOTE
Recognized text can contain errors, especially with blurry photos, small print, stamps and handwriting (not supported). Form filling and spell-check results also need a review. Check them before relying on them.

Published by Bao Loc Accounting Co., Ltd (Công ty TNHH Kế Toán Bảo Lộc) – ketoanbaoloc.com

name: Kuava Estate Access
description:
Kuava Estate Access is the gate and visitor system for residential estates. Residents invite visitors from their phone, security checks each pass at the gate, and the estate office has a clear record of every entry and exit.

FOR RESIDENTS
• Invite a visitor in seconds and share the pass on WhatsApp or by text
• Visitors need no app: they show a QR code, or give a 6-digit entry code if they have no smartphone
• Get an alert the moment your visitor arrives at the gate
• Give household members their own access
• Carry your own resident pass on your phone
• Report a problem to the estate office

FOR GATE SECURITY
• Scan a pass with the camera, or type the entry code
• See at once whether the pass is valid, already used, expired or cancelled
• Record walk-in visitors and call the resident for approval
• See who is still inside the estate
• Log incidents as they happen
• Keeps recording when the network drops, then uploads when it returns

FOR THE ESTATE
• Every entry and exit on a record nobody can edit
• New residents are approved by the estate office before they can invite anyone
• Each estate's data is kept separate and private

Kuava Estate Access is used by estates that have signed up with Kuava X. To use the app you register with your estate, and the estate office approves your account. If your estate is not using it yet, ask your estate management to visit www.kuava.app.

You can download a copy of your data or close your account at any time from "Your data and alerts" in the app.

name: Kurdi Fund
description:
A private app for the members of the Murad Al-Kurdi and Al-Kurd family, bringing the family tree, photo albums, occasions and the family fund together in one place.

• Family tree: browse the generations, find anyone, and see how any two people are related.
• Albums: family photos and documents for every member, and you can add your own from the camera or your gallery.
• Occasions: weddings, births and condolences as they happen.
• Family fund: your subscription status, your payments, and when and where the next meeting is.
• Notifications: a reminder on meeting day, a summary afterwards, and family occasions.

For family members only: sign up in the app with your national ID and mobile number, and the family administrators approve your account.

name: La Bom Box: Cajas y Repostería
description:
La Bom Box es la tienda de packaging y repostería para pastelerías, cafeterías, tiendas online y particulares. Somos fabricantes de cajas de cartón: más de 8.000 productos con precios de fábrica.

CAJAS CON TU LOGO
• Cajas para tartas, envíos postales y pizza personalizadas con tu marca
• Sube tu logo (PDF, PNG o JPG) directamente desde el móvil
• Negro o color al mismo precio, impresión hasta 15×15 cm

TODO PARA TU PASTELERÍA
• Cajas para tartas con ventana, cupcakes, bombones y brigadeiros
• Moldes, boquillas, decoración, bases y accesorios
• Precio por unidad y por pack siempre visible, IVA incluido

AHORRA COMPRANDO MÁS
• Descuento automático por volumen: 5 % desde 150 € y hasta 20 %
• Cuenta profesional para pastelerías y revendedores con precios especiales
• Repite tus pedidos en un toque

COMPRA FÁCIL Y SEGURA
• Tarjeta, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, MB WAY, Multibanco o transferencia
• NIF-IVA intracomunitario: compra sin IVA para empresas de la UE
• Envío con DPD y GLS a España, Portugal y toda Europa
• Seguimiento de tus pedidos y atención por WhatsApp

Disponible en español, português, English, français, italiano y Deutsch.

name: La Bonne Alerte
description:
La Bonne Alerte est le kiosque d'alertes gratuit, sans publicité et open source de labonnealerte.fr. Choisissez ce qui compte pour vous, et recevez une notification quand ça bouge. Que du signal.

PLUS DE 260 ALERTES, en France, en Belgique, au Québec et ailleurs :

• Vigilances météo, crues, qualité de l'air, pollens
• Coupures d'eau et d'électricité, pannes de services en ligne, transports
• Vie locale de votre commune
• Bons plans, jeux offerts, sorties
• Animaux perdus près de chez vous

SIMPLE ET RESPECTUEUSE

• Le kiosque se consulte sans compte
• Connexion par code reçu par e-mail, sans mot de passe
• Heures calmes : la nuit, les alertes sont mises de côté et vous sont envoyées groupées au réveil
• Choisissez de recevoir vos alertes par notification, par e-mail, ou les deux
• Suivez une alerte pour toute une zone ou pour votre commune
• Mode sombre, grandes polices
• Aucun traceur, aucune publicité

Application sous licence MIT. Code source du service : github.com/Epilouptique/labonnealerte

name: Landlapse: Satellite Land Map
description:
See how a piece of land has changed, even when you can't be there.

Landlapse turns free Sentinel-2 satellite imagery into a timelapse of any spot on Earth, from 2018 to this month, and tells you in plain words what changed: ground cleared, new buildings, field work, regrowth.

WHAT YOU GET
• A satellite timelapse of your land, built in about ten seconds
• A dated list of changes, each with before and after images and its size in acres and hectares
• An AI reading of each change, so you know if it is construction, clearing or just farming
• New satellite passes checked automatically every few days
• Works on iPhone and iPad

MADE FOR
• Owners of vacant, inherited or rural property
• Families with a parcel, farm or ranch in another state or country
• Anyone keeping an eye on a field, a woodlot or a building site

TRY IT FIRST
Open the built-in example, a site in Texas where open land became a factory, and explore the full timelapse and change list before you subscribe.

HONEST ABOUT THE LIMITS
Each pixel covers 10 metres. You will see clearings, roads, buildings, ponds and fields. You will not see cars, people or fences. Cloudy passes are left out.

PLANS
Plus: watch 5 places. Pro: watch 40 places. Monthly or yearly.
Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled. You can cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://landlapse.vercel.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://landlapse.vercel.app/privacy

No account, no email, no location access. Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data.

name: Larkfold
description:
Larkfold on pikseligrafiikalla toteutettu strategiapeli, jossa rakennat pienen rannikkoyhteisön vuoroveden ehdoilla. Aloita Ruovikkolahdelta, Tuulihiekalta tai Sumusaaristosta. Päätä, mihin sijoitat asumukset, vesisäiliöt ja kasvimaat, ja rakenna korotettuja laitureita, jotta tärkeät kulkureitit pysyvät auki myös nousuvedellä.

Jaa työt asukkaiden kesken. Kerää sadevettä, hoida kasvimaata ja ajoita kalastus laskuvedelle. Puhdista harmaavettä ruokosuodattimella ja palauta ravinteet maahan kompostoimalla biojäte. Kun saalis pienenee, anna kalakannalle aikaa elpyä ja suunnittele, mistä yhteisö saa sillä välin ruokansa.

Katso seuraavan päivän ennakosta, mitkä reitit voivat peittyä veden alle ja miten ruoka- ja vesivarastot muuttuvat. Kokeile, mitä tapahtuu, jos nostat veden noudon työlistan kärkeen. Kun myrsky lähestyy, päätä, mitkä rakennelmat kannattaa suojata ja mitkä siirtää ylemmäs.

Korjaa majakka, käy vaihtokauppaa ohikulkevien alusten kanssa ja seuraa, palaavatko linnut elpyvälle rannalle. Yhteisösi kasvaa päivä kerrallaan, kun sovitat sen tarpeet yhteen rannikon rytmin kanssa.

name: Lattice - Network
description:
Lattice is the interest-first campus network built exclusively for Brown University students. Network with classmates who share your passions, study the same subjects, and explore Providence together.

Whether you're looking for project collaborators, workout partners, club peers, or just someone who shares your niche hobbies, Lattice makes campus feel smaller and more connected.

KEY FEATURES:

• Interest-Driven Discover: Explore student profiles based on shared and similar personal and professional interests—from software engineering and venture capital to rock climbing, indie films, and photography.

• Campus Inquiries: Ask questions, find study groups, recruit club members, or coordinate campus activities. Target inquiries to specific student groups or reach the broader campus, and connect instantly in focused group chats.

• Smart Campus Search: Find classmates by courses, concentrations, campus clubs, dorms, and specific interests. Create group chats with peers in seconds.

• Verified Student Community: Sign up requires an active @brown.edu email address, ensuring a trusted, authentic community for Brown students.

• Privacy & Safety First: Comprehensive safety tools including user blocking, content reporting, customizable dorm search privacy, and granular profile visibility.

Find your community on campus. Welcome to Lattice.

name: LB Comanda
description:
O LBComanda é um aplicativo feito para simplificar o dia a dia do seu restaurante, bar ou lanchonete. Com ele, seus garçons e gerentes controlam o salão direto do celular, enviando os pedidos rapidamente para a cozinha e para o caixa sem complicação.
O que o aplicativo oferece:
Cardápio na mão: Encontre lanches, porções e bebidas rapidinho navegando pelas categorias ou usando a barra de busca.   
Pedidos fáceis: Adicione itens ao carrinho, altere a quantidade, digite observações para o preparo e envie o pedido para a cozinha com um clique.   
Mapa de Mesas: Veja na hora quais mesas estão livres e quais estão ocupadas (marcadas em vermelho) direto na tela.  
 Fechamento de Conta: Confira o extrato da mesa, aplique a taxa de serviço e feche a conta rapidamente usando as opções de Crédito, Débito ou PIX.  
 Entregas e Balcão: Organize as comandas de delivery e os pedidos para retirada no balcão de um jeito visual e fácil de controlar.   
Acesso Seguro: O login é feito apenas por funcionários cadastrados, exigindo o usuário, a senha e o CNPJ da empresa.   
Atenção:
Este aplicativo é de uso exclusivo para funcionários de empresas parceiras. Para conseguir entrar, o seu restaurante precisa ter uma conta ativa no sistema de gestão da LBComanda.

name: LeafSail: EPUB & TXT Reader
description:
LeafSail is a local TXT, EPUB and PDF reader. Bring your own books and read offline without an account.

• Import books from Files and resume your reading position.
• Save bookmarks and notes, return to the original passage, and share or export notes as text.
• Customize TXT and EPUB text size, spacing, themes, page turning and automatic reading. PDF retains its original layout with zoom and page bookmarks.
• Organize your library with search, sorting, reading-status filters, and card or list layouts.
• Follow the system language or choose English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, Italian, Spanish, French or Portuguese. Books are not automatically translated.

Optional Pro Lifetime is a one-time purchase for custom covers, fine automatic-reading controls and three presets, extra themes, and detailed local reading statistics. No subscription or automatic renewal. Basic reading remains free.

Supported files: TXT up to 32 MiB, DRM-free EPUB up to 100 MiB, and unencrypted PDF up to 100 MiB and 5,000 pages. PDF does not currently support OCR, text reflow or automatic reading. Themes do not recolor PDF document pages.

Books and reading data stay on your device. There is no developer-operated cloud sync. Keep original files and check device backups before deleting the app. A notes export is not a complete library backup.

Privacy policy: https://leafsail.typcb.cn/en/privacy/
Terms of use: https://leafsail.typcb.cn/en/terms/

name: Learn Russian By Stories
description:
Learn Russian the way you learned to read: one short story at a time.

Russian By Stories is a 90-day course built around short stories about everyday life in Moscow. Each day takes about 15 minutes – read a story, understand every word, practise, and move on.

READ

• Listen to the story read aloud

PRACTISE
• Quick exercises right after each story, on its words and grammar
• A grammar reference you can open any time

REMEMBER
• Every story's words join your review deck

90 DAYS, FOUR PHASES
Start with first words and finish with real conversations. Each phase builds on the last, one story a day.

MADE FOR FOCUS
• Works fully offline – no internet needed
• No account, no sign-up, no ads

Your progress stays on your phone. Start today with Story 1.

name: Lesson Schedule: School Day
description:
Lesson Schedule is a bright, simple school timetable made for pupils.

SEE YOUR DAY AND WEEK

KEEP UP WITH HOMEWORK

SET UP IN MINUTES

NEVER FORGET TOMORROW

name: Lets Raffle
description:
Lets Raffle makes it effortless to run a Secret Santa gift exchange. No cutting up paper, no names in a hat, no need to get everyone in the same room: create the draw, share the link, and let Santa do the rest.

TWO WAYS TO DRAW
• Invite link: Create the draw and share the link or QR code. Everyone enters their own details. The draw can run automatically on the date you choose, or you can start it yourself with one tap.
• I'll enter the names: Add the participants yourself and draw right away; each person gets their match by email.

EASY INVITES
• Share the invite link on WhatsApp, by email or as a story.
• A ready-made invitation image sized for stories.
• An A4 poster with a QR code for the office or school notice board.
• Guests join by typing the code or scanning the QR code.

THE SURPRISE STAYS A SURPRISE
• Everyone sees only the name they drew.
• The result is revealed step by step, like unwrapping a gift.
• If gifts will be sent, an address and phone number can be added optionally.

EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE
• The draws you organize and the ones you join are in the "My events" tab.
• If the draw has not happened yet, you wait with a countdown to New Year.
• Turkish and English.

Lets Raffle is also on the web: letsraffle.co

name: Letter Trail: ABC Tracing
description:
Trace a big snowy letter with your finger, and it turns into its picture. Trace B and it becomes Pebble the bear, waving hello. Trace A and an acorn rolls in.

FREE TO TRY, ONE PURCHASE FOR THE REST
A to F, a to f and 0 to 3 are free to try: 16 of the 62, with Letter Hunt and the sticker book. One purchase, the Full Unlock, opens the other 46.

HOOT SHOWS THE WAY
Hoot the snowy owl draws each stroke first with his feather. A green dot shows where to start and an arrow shows which way to go. As you trace, the footprints in the snow light up gold, one by one, with a soft crunch. Going the wrong way is never a fail: Hoot shows the way with a soft glow and an arrow.

THREE STEPS, AND A GAME WITHOUT TRACING
- When you're ready, the same letter fades: footprints, then faint dots, then just a start dot.
- Letter Hunt: Hoot says a letter and you tap it among big picture tiles. No wrong answers to count.

SCHOOL PRINT
- Ball-and-stick letters, the style taught in many US classrooms.
- Most letters start at the top; lines go top to bottom and left to right.
- a, d, g and q are "magic c" letters, in one stroke.

62 TO TRACE
- Capitals A to Z, lowercase a to z, and numbers 0 to 9.
- Numbers come with counting pictures: three fish for 3, two mittens for 2.
- Hoot says each letter's name and its picture word.
- Every finished letter goes in the sticker book. Trace it again for a sparkly gold frame.

FOR GROWN-UPS
- No ads.
- No reading needed to play. A harder mode starts letters on faint dots and gives Letter Hunt four choices.
- No clocks, nothing random, nothing that nags to come back.
- No accounts, no chat, plays offline; only buying or restoring needs a connection.
- A grown-up check guards Settings, the Full Unlock, Restore Purchases, outside links and Delete My Data.
- A For Grown-ups page explains the stroke order and shows which letters are done.
- Letter names and picture words only: no letter sounds or cursive yet.

Made by Seventh Anvil Games, the makers of Polar Bears vs. Warthogs.

name: Letters by Wings
description:
Some messages shouldn't arrive in a second.

Pigeon Messenger is slow messaging, the way letters used to travel — carried by your own pigeon. Write a letter, seal it with wax, and watch your pigeon carry it across a hand-drawn map of the world. There are no read receipts, no typing bubbles, no take-backs. Just the wait, and then: "A pigeon has arrived with a letter for you!"

HOW IT WORKS
• Every letter flies a real route. Your pigeon's flight time is based on the true distance between you and your friend — across town in under an hour, across the ocean in days. Pigeons rest at night, just like the real ones.
• Follow the journey live on a vintage illustrated map, with weather, rest stops, and the sound of wings.
• Schedule surprise letters — write today, and your pigeon will rest nearby and deliver on the morning of a birthday or anniversary.

YOUR FLOCK
• Everyone gets a Pigeon ID and a personal QR code. Add friends by ID, by scanning their code, or with an invite sent through iMessage.
• Friends only — no strangers, no spam. Block and report are built in.

LETTERS, KEPT
• Every letter you've sent or received lives in your pigeon house, sealed in wax until the moment it's opened.
• Share a song: YouTube links play right inside the letter.

Slow down. Write something worth waiting for.

name: Level Loop
description:
Level Loop is a level book for an automatic level and staff. Book each setup, close the loop on a benchmark, and turn the adjusted heights into a grade you can stake.

BOOK EACH SETUP
Backsight, intermediate sights with a chainage, and foresight, reduced by the height-of-instrument method as you go. Drag a drawn E-pattern staff (or a Philadelphia rod in feet) under a fixed cross-hair, step it by a millimetre, or type the reading. Read the upper and lower stadia hairs and the sight distance is worked out for you. The ΣBS − ΣFS check sits under the book.

CLOSE THE LOOP
Close on the start benchmark or on another one. The misclosure is set against an allowance of C × √K mm, with C = 4, 8, 12 or your own, and K from the sight distances or the route length. A dial shows how much of the allowance is used and bars show each setup's share. Setups with unbalanced sights are flagged.

ADJUST
Share the misclosure back by distance or by setups. Turn on the collimation correction from your last two-peg test and see the misclosure change.

TWO-PEG TEST
Four readings from midway and near peg A give the collimation error in mm per 30 m, with a drawing of both setups and an OK or ADJUST verdict.

GRADE AND STAKES
The booked ground becomes a profile. Drag the design line, long-press it to add a grade break, set a minimum fall and the width. Cut and fill bars and volumes follow the line, and the stake sheet lists the rod to read at every peg.

Benchmarks with descriptions, search and editing. Share the book with its closure, or the stake sheet, as CSV and text. Metres or feet.

Industrial style: ruled ledger pages, pressed plates, brass benchmark discs.

Everything stays on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Lexiquilt: Word Puzzle Game
description:
Place the pieces, weave the words.

Lexiquilt is a cozy, crossword-style word puzzle. Instead of typing answers, you drag colorful letter pieces onto the board and fit them together until every word clicks into place. Each piece carries a small symbol that matches its spot, so every puzzle is a satisfying mix of vocabulary and logic. And every puzzle has exactly one solution.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag a letter piece from the tray onto the board
• Tap a piece to rotate it; vertical words read top to bottom
• Match the symbols and fill every square
• Crossing words share a square, so one piece can complete two words

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• 60 handcrafted levels per language, from Starter to Expert
• A fresh daily puzzle every midnight: solve it each day to grow your streak
• Earn up to 3 stars per level and unlock 14 achievements
• Stuck? A hint places one piece for you, and Undo takes it back
• Play in English or Turkish, with interface and puzzle language set separately
• Plays offline, no account needed
• Light and dark themes, satisfying sounds and haptics, optional daily reminder

Short enough for a coffee break, clever enough to keep your mind busy. If you enjoy crosswords, word games, jigsaw puzzles or brain teasers, Lexiquilt is your new daily ritual.

FREE TO PLAY
Lexiquilt is free with ads. Every level includes one free hint; watch a short video for another, or buy "Remove ads" once to turn off ads for good and get unlimited hints.

Questions or ideas? We'd love to hear from you: lexiquiltapp@gmail.com

name: Lidseat
description:
Open the kiln and the jars are in one row, the lids in another. Codes on the bases, sizes in a notebook. A lid can enter a mouth and still be the wrong one. Give it away, and the jar that needed it more is left open.

LidFit Bench puts that job back on the workbench.

Write down each jar’s inner mouth and the outer diameter of the part of the lid that enters it. Set the gap you will accept, for example 0.2 to 0.8 mm. The diameter difference is mouth inner minus insert outer. The bench does not hand lids out first-come. It first gives a lid to as many jars as possible. When two plans pair the same number, it keeps the one closer to the middle of your gap.

On the bench, tap a body and a lid. The section lines up from the sizes you entered, with the difference and a depth check beside it. After you try the pair in your hands, mark it Fits, Sticks, or Wobbles. A fit can be locked, and those two pieces stay out of every other suggestion. Sticks and Wobbles set aside only that pair. Both pieces can still match with others.

Three more pages show the whole kiln.

Fit Map. Rows are bodies, columns are lids. Deeper color means a larger diameter difference. Tap a cell for both codes, the sizes, and the try-fit note.

Pairing Plan. Pick the jars up in code order. Each one has the lid suggested this time.

Size Shortages. Mouths with no usable lid, and mouths that had a candidate given elsewhere, are listed by size. Pieces you have not measured yet sit apart and are not counted as shortages.

Pieces live in batches. One kiln, one day, one glaze, kept separate. A key diameter can stay blank and is marked to measure. Feedback stays on this device and is not uploaded.

The first launch loads an editable sample, Kiln 14. Bodies A and B can both take lid X, but only A can take Y, so the largest one-to-one plan is A with Y and B with X. Change a number and the suggestion moves aside.

name: Lifelist
description:
Lifelist turns your "someday" list into a map you can actually climb.

Everyone has a list of things they'll do one day: see the northern lights, learn to bake bread, build a bookshelf, volunteer on Saturdays. Lifelist gives each of those a place on a hand-drawn topographic map, helps you plan the first steps, and keeps a record of every summit you reach.

YOUR SOMEDAY LIST, PROPERLY PLANNED
Write each experience down and sort it into Travel, Learn, Make, Taste, Adventure or Give back. Give it an effort level from 1 to 5, a cost estimate, the best season for it, a target year, and a few words on why it matters to you. Break big ones into plan steps and tick them off as you go.

PICK ONE FOR ME
Not sure what to do next? Set a budget, the energy you have and whether it should suit the current season, and Lifelist draws one open trail for you at random. Draw again until one calls to you.

PLANT YOUR FLAGS
When you do something on your list, mark it reached with the date, a rating and a memory note. Reached items become summit flags on your contour map, and Summits shows them as a timeline grouped by year, with your average rating and the kind of experience you reach most.

A MAP INSTEAD OF MENUS
Lifelist is one topographic sheet with four regions: Basecamp (your year at a glance and what's next), Trails (the full list, filtered and sorted), Summits (everything you've reached) and the Ranger Station (account and settings). Swipe across the map, or tap the small corner map to jump anywhere. Contour lines are drawn live and rise as your progress grows.

A YEARLY GOAL
Set how many summits you'd like to reach this year. Basecamp shows how many you've reached against that goal, what's planned for this year and which trails suit the season you're in.

SIGN IN YOUR WAY
Continue with Sign in with Apple, Google or email, or tap "Wander as guest" to start straight away. Guests can keep their list later by linking an account from the Ranger Station. Your list syncs across devices and stays usable offline.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads. No tracking. No analytics. Your list is stored in Google Firebase under your own account, readable only by you. You can delete your account and every trail, step and memory at any time from the Ranger Station.

Start with one line. Someday is a place you can get to.

COLORING BOOKS

FRAME-BY-FRAME CARTOONS

PLAYGROUND AND MINI GAMES
Star Jump, Tower Topple, Paper Race, Cloud Glide and Puppet Board. No losing, no timers.

LINO HELPS
Our guide Lino talks kids through every step. Little mode (4–6) works without reading, Big mode (7–9) opens more tools. Kids who want to can place the joint pins themselves.

FOR PARENTS
• No ads and no tracking: no analytics or social SDKs

LINOMI FAMILY

A Linomi Family subscription unlocks unlimited characters, every brush, every coloring book and every mini game, for the whole family. name: Lintel: Mahjong Solitaire
description:
Lintel is mahjong solitaire among arches, cloisters and spires. Take open tiles in matching pairs until the table is empty. Every deal is solvable, with Undo, Hint and Redeal a tap away for the moments you box yourself in.

Each deal is built backward from an empty table, one pair at a time, and replayed before you see it, so a way to clear it exists. Your own moves can still end in a dead end, and that is what Undo and Redeal are for.

Ground layer: how it plays
A tile is open when nothing lies on it and its left or right side is clear. Tap an open tile, then its match. Any flower matches any flower, and any season matches any season. The full set has 144 tiles in 42 different faces, drawn as vectors that stay sharp at any size, with a high-contrast option for stronger edges and shading. Every layout has a tall form and a wide form, picked to fit your screen when the table is dealt, so you can play upright or turned.

Second layer: a way back
Undo takes back as many moves as you like and does not touch your stars. Hint looks for a pair that keeps the table clearable; when it cannot tell, it shows any open pair. Redeal mixes the tiles that are left and rebuilds them so they can be cleared. In the rare position that cannot be rebuilt, the game says so and Undo is still there. When no pair is open, the table tells you and offers both ways out.

Third layer: the climb
Chapters run from the Arcade to the Spire: six chapters of ten levels, sixty in all, growing from 36 tiles to the full 144, with more layers and tighter patterns as you climb. A level is the same deal every time, so you can replay it for stars: one for clearing it, two without a redeal, three without a redeal or a hint. Time does not count toward stars, and a level opens when the one before it is cleared.
Layouts offers sixteen shapes from 36 to 144 tiles, each with its own silhouette and a new deal every time. Five are open from the start, the rest open as you climb the chapters, and each card keeps your fastest time and your wins.

Fourth layer: what you keep
Nine tables and five tile finishes open with stars, finished chapters and awards, and every locked one shows what opens it. Thirty-three awards come with their own drawn badges and progress bars. Statistics cover games, wins and win rate, fastest and average time, pairs removed, win streaks, stars by chapter, a fourteen-day chart and a record for every layout.

Top layer: the details
A short tutorial greets a new player: you take the pairs yourself, and you can skip it or replay it from Settings. How to play is an illustrated page. Sound effects and haptics can be switched off, the timer can be hidden, open tiles can be highlighted, and the theme follows the system or stays light or dark. WHO IT IS FOR

• Parents who want to learn together with their children.

name: Little Day Coach
description:
Little Day Coach helps families move through everyday routines with clear pictures, short spoken prompts, and one step at a time.

FOUR EVERYDAY ROUTINES
Good Morning: wake up, bathroom, brush teeth, get dressed, and breakfast.
Cozy Bedtime: pajamas, brush teeth, a story, lights low, and sleep.
Tidy Playroom: a simple sequence for putting toys and books away.
Screen Off Calm: put the screen down, move gently, and choose a quiet activity.

A QUIET MOMENT
Calm Corner offers a gentle breathing animation with short voice cues.

SMALL WINS
Mark each step done and collect stars. Today's steps reset each day while total stars stay saved on your device.

PARENT ZONE
A parent check protects progress controls, privacy information, and support links. A grown-up can reset a routine or delete all saved progress.

No account, ads, tracking, analytics, subscriptions, or in-app purchases. Routines, artwork, and synthetic narration are included for offline use. Progress stays on your device.

Designed for young children to use together with a parent or caregiver. Little Day Coach is a routine companion, not a medical or therapeutic service.

name: Little Dentist: Tooth Doctor
description:
The clinic is yours! In Little Dentist, patients come in one by one, tell you what hurts and take a seat. Say "Aaah!", zoom into the mouth, find the sore tooth and treat it like a real dentist.

10 DIFFERENT TREATMENTS
• Fillings: find the cavity, drill it clean, fill it, harden it with the blue light
• Root canal: take an X-ray, numb the gum, file and rinse the canals, fill them
• Extraction: pull the wobbly tooth with forceps, add gauze
• Crowns: put a porcelain or gold crown on a broken tooth
• Implants and brand-new teeth
• Braces, whitening, tartar cleaning, gum care and flossing

36 REAL DENTAL TOOLS
Mirror and probe, X-ray, numbing shot, drill, laser, suction, water spray, scaler, polisher, floss, filling, blue light, root canal file, forceps, implant screw, brackets and more. Every tool shows its name and what it does, so kids learn about healthy teeth while they play.

TAP, RUB, PULL
• Hold the drill, rub away tartar, pull the tooth up with the forceps
• Careful: if the drill touches a healthy tooth, the patient says "Ouch!" and you lose points!

EARN POINTS
• The right tool earns points, the wrong one costs points
• A flawless treatment earns 3 stars
• Unlock PRO tools like the laser, gold crown and pearl tooth as you score
• Weekly and all-time Game Center leaderboards

FOR KIDS AND GROWN-UPS
In easy mode the right tool glows and hints are shown. Expert Mode has no hints and gives more points.

The game is free and shows family-friendly ads between patients. They can be removed forever with a one-time "Remove Ads" purchase (no subscription). Purchases are protected by a parental gate, and every PRO tool can also be unlocked for free by playing. No personal data is requested.

name: Little Felt Flower
description:
Welcome to a sunny wool atelier where every flower starts as a loose ball of fibre.

Little Felt Flower is a calm, hands-on crafting game built on real material simulation. The wool you touch reacts the way wool does: it compacts under the needle, shrinks when it is wet and rubbed, and lines up when you comb it. No two flowers come out quite the same, because what you see is what your hands made.

THREE CRAFTS, THREE WAYS TO PLAY

Needle Felt Blossom
Press the felting needle into loose wool to firm it up, then tilt the needle to tuck stray fibres inside the petal outline. Choose shallow, medium or deep insertions, keep some areas soft and others firm, and watch out: overworked wool can tear.

Wool Shrink Bloom
Lay wet wool in the bowl and rub it into shape. Wool only shrinks in the direction you rub, and it never stretches back, so plan your strokes. Keep the moisture balanced, pour, blot and choose your pressure, and lift the piece out when it fits the pattern.

Fiber Blend Petal
Comb colourful fibres across the carding board. Long straight strokes line the fibres up, short back-and-forth scrubbing blends colours, and careful combing builds a strong sheet. Comb too much and the fibres start to snap.

FEATURES
• 100 handcrafted patterns: 40 needle felt, 30 wet felt and 30 fibre blend
• A different material simulation for each craft: wool density, a shrinking felt mesh and individual fibres
• Stars and craft quality based on shape, density, moisture, alignment and strength
• Felt Gallery: pin your favourite flowers and review how each one was made
• Short, interactive tutorials and a craft manual
• Gentle sound design and Core Haptics feedback you can feel as the wool pushes back
• Reduced Motion, adjustable touch sensitivity and three levels of gameplay assistance

OPTIONAL CRAFT THREADS
Finishing patterns earns Craft Threads. You can exchange them for single-use crafting aids such as the Density Lens, Soft Wool Repair, Shrinkage Preview, Moisture Balance, Fiber Strength Scan or an Extra Fiber Bundle. Thread packs and the Mending Tin are optional consumable purchases. They are used up when spent and cannot be restored. 

Pick up the needle and make your first little felt flower.

name: Little Haven
description:
Resgate animais, cuide do seu abrigo e ajude cada cão e gato a encontrar um novo lar.

Em Little Haven, você administra um abrigo de animais. Organize resgates, receba novos moradores temporários e acompanhe a saúde, a confiança e a preparação de cada animal para a adoção.

Construa canis, gatis e espaços de cuidado, contrate uma equipe e expanda o terreno conforme o abrigo cresce. Decore os ambientes e encontre famílias compatíveis com os animais que você acolheu.

Jogue no seu ritmo, com pausa e controle de velocidade. Você pode manter seu abrigo no dispositivo e jogar offline. Uma conta opcional permite guardar uma cópia na nuvem e participar dos recursos da comunidade.

Resgate, cuidado e adoção fazem parte da experiência gratuita. A loja oferece extras permanentes opcionais, como moradores, coleções de decoração e expansão do terreno.

name: LiveRox
description:
LiveRox lets you have friendly one-to-one video calls and chat with Roxy.

• Pick a topic: Friendly chat, Funny chat, Night chat or Your choice
• The first 30 seconds of every call are free, then 1.2 credits per minute
• Chat with Roxy: 2 free messages a day, and messages are always free during a call
• Send Roxy a virtual gift to say thanks: a rose, coffee, flowers and more

• Calls are private: screenshots and recordings are not allowed

LiveRox is for adults aged 18 and over. Conversations are friendly only; sexual content is not allowed. You can report or end any call at any time.

name: llumu. - منصة المؤثرين
description:
llumu. هي منصة المؤثرين في الشرق الأوسط وشمال أفريقيا — تجمع صنّاع المحتوى والعلامات التجارية في مكان واحد.

llumu.com

name: Loafen
description: Stop rebuilding a good loaf from memory. Loafen keeps each bake with the formula that made it, so the next dough starts from a result you can still judge, not from a guess at the counter. Scores for crumb, crust, smell, handling, and whether you would bake it again show which loaf is worth repeating. A photo, a voice note, and a timer on each step keep the look, the remark you made with messy hands, and the timing that actually produced it. Two bakes side by side show what you changed and whether the loaf got better. Change one thing next time, such as the water, the time, or the oven heat, and that version stays beside the earlier one, so the improvement has a cause. Pantry prices and the weight after baking turn the same ingredient list into what that batch cost, before you commit the flour.

name: Loafmark
description:
Loafmark is a baker's percentage bench for people who weigh dough.

Write a formula the way a bakery does: flour is always 100%, and water, salt, yeast, and one optional extra are percents of that flour. Scale it to a finished dough weight or to a flour weight, and Loafmark turns the percents into grams. A separate water line does only hydration: water grams = flour × hydration ÷ 100.

Keep a private log of what you actually mixed. A bake stores the grams you weighed, the bulk time, and the room temperature you type. A starter feed stores starter, flour, and water, then shows the ratio and the hydration of the new flour and water.

Short notes explain how baker's percent, salt, yeast, and a feed are counted. They are bakery habits, not nutrition advice. Loafmark does not run a timer, score a crumb, or tell you a loaf is finished.

Everything stays on this phone. There is no account and no sync. The first launch includes a weekday loaf, soft rolls, two bakes, and two feeds, so you can try the math before you type your own.

name: LOBEWISE
description:
A jelly-green earbud, a lacquered samurai, and a tiny galaxy sit in a row. Five seconds later, they're gone. Which one was just to the left of the galaxy?

LOBEWISE is a fast visual memory game set in a retro listening room. Memorize three to five designer earbuds in order. Once they disappear, a reference earbud returns with a FORWARD or BACKWARD sign. Pick the earbud that sat immediately beside it in that direction, then press FINAL.

Every correct answer deals a fresh lineup. One wrong answer ends your run. The challenge grows from six answer choices to ten across 15 levels. Clear Level 15 and you'll return to Level 1 with your score intact and a new lineup to learn.

• Ten distinctive earbud designs, from jelly glow and samurai lacquer to galaxy rings
• Five-second memory rounds and randomized lineups
• An endless Multiple-level loop with a personal best saved on your device
• Offline play with no account required

How long can you keep the lineup straight?

name: LockDot: Lock Screen To-Do
description:
See what matters every time you pick up your phone.

LockDot puts your list, your most important note and your “Did I…?” checks on the Lock Screen, so you never have to open an app to remember.

LIST ON THE LOCK SCREEN
• Add up to three lines to the Lock Screen widget.
• Tap a line on the widget to cross it out. No unlocking, no opening the app.

A NOTE IN THE DYNAMIC ISLAND
• Pin one note as a Live Activity: a gate code, a parking spot, “Get milk on the way home”.
• It stays in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen while you use other apps.

DID I…? YES / NO
• “Did I lock the door?” “Did I take my pill?” “Did I turn off the iron?”
• One tap on the widget answers it, with the time you did it.
• Answers reset at midnight, after a few hours, or only when you reset them.
• Made for anyone who double-checks, including people with ADHD or OCD.

WALLPAPER WITH YOUR LIST
• Draw your list right onto a wallpaper: black, graphite, paper, ember or your own photo.
• Fits up to 8 lines and works on any iPhone, no widget space needed.
• Shortcuts action “Make Lock Screen Wallpaper”: pair it with “Set Wallpaper” and your Lock Screen updates itself every morning.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up, no ads.
• Everything stays on your iPhone. Nothing is sent to a server.

FREE AND PRO
LockDot is free with 3 lines, 2 questions, the Dynamic Island note and wallpapers with a small LOCKDOT mark.
LockDot Pro unlocks unlimited lines and questions, photo wallpapers without the mark and the history of your answers. Pro comes as a monthly or yearly subscription with a 7-day free trial.

Every conversation about your project sits in one place, next to the things that are waiting on you: questions to answer, designs and social posts to approve, and new releases to check before they go live.

- For you: one list of everything waiting on your answer or approval
- Approve work or send it back without leaving the app
- Notifications when there is a new message or something needs you
- Search every chat you are in

LogicLeap Chat is for LogicLeap clients. You need an invitation from LogicLeap to sign in.

name: London Tube AI: Map & Routes
description:
London Tube AI is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to Transport for London or National Rail. Powered by TfL Open Data.

Know when your train comes, whether your line is running and when to get off. Every time on screen says whether it is live, timetabled or estimated, so you know what you can rely on.

LINE STATUS
- Live status for every Tube line, the DLR, the Elizabeth line and London Overground
- Planned closures for this weekend and the next seven days
- TfL's notices set out clearly: what is affected, where, and until when

LIVE ARRIVALS
- Live departures for all 338 Tube, DLR and Elizabeth line stations, by line and platform
- Nearby stations and bus stops, with walking distance and live times
- Lift outages and step-free information from TfL

JOURNEY PLANNING
- Door-to-door journeys from TfL's Journey Planner, with the walk between platforms included
- Leave now, depart at or arrive by, and step-free routes
- The fare for your journey, first and last trains, and the next train you can still catch
- A trip with several stops, in the order that suits you

NATIONAL RAIL
- Live departures at stations with mainline trains
- Live times for the train legs of your journey, including delays

ON THE TRAIN
- Follow your journey stop by stop, with an alert one stop before yours
- Journey progress on your Lock Screen with Live Activities
- Underground, where GPS cannot reach, the app says when its position is an estimate

THE MAP
- Every station, with trains placed from TfL arrival predictions (estimated, not GPS)
- Tap a station for live arrivals, facilities and step-free access

ALSO
- Home Screen widgets for line status, your commute and a favourite bus stop
- Disruption alerts at most twice a day, morning and afternoon, and only when something is wrong
- Santander Cycles docks, river bus sailings and the cable car
- How busy a station is now compared with usual, from TfL data
- London weather from MET Norway

YOUR DATA
No account needed, and your saved places stay on your device. If the app helps you, you can leave an optional tip.

For time-critical journeys, always check TfL's own information and station notices.

Powered by TfL Open Data. Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database rights 2016. Geomni UK Map data © and database rights 2019. Powered by the Transport for London Journey Planner API. Powered by National Rail Enquiries. Weather data from MET Norway (CC BY 4.0).

name: Longevity Hero

Longevity Hero is a workout log where your progress shows up on your own hero.

Log your sets and watch your hero grow. Every muscle group you train lights up on an anatomical character, and levels and XP show you are moving forward — not just showing up.

LOG & TIMER
• Log a workout in a minute: 70+ exercises, weight, reps, time, cardio
• Rest timer with a notification — even on the lock screen
• Personal records and a training calendar
• Morning check-in: sleep, energy, stress, pain — and advice on how to train today

YOUR HERO
• 11 muscle groups, front and back, each with its own level
• Levels, ranks and a daily streak
• Choose your hero's look

FRIENDS LEAGUE
• Weekly ranking with friends via an invite link
• See your friends' heroes and who trained this week

ANALYTICS & REPORT
• Strength charts, longevity index, pain and sleep trends
• Monthly report — a card ready for stories

PRIVACY
Your workouts stay on your phone. No ads, no tracking. Export your data any time.

6 languages: English, Українська, Deutsch, Español, Français, Polski.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID on confirmation. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple ID settings.

name: Longvexa
description:
Longvexa turns the everyday habits linked to a long, healthy life into one simple flower that blooms as you go.

Every day you have six pillars to fill: Sleep, Move, Hydrate, Mind, Sunlight and Connect. Tap a petal to log it and watch your Vital Bloom grow. Complete a pillar and you bank "vital minutes", a playful score that shows your good days adding up.

THE VITAL BLOOM
• Six colourful petals, one for each pillar, that grow as you log
• A daily Bloom score from 0 to 100
• Streaks and a Life Bank of every vital minute you've earned
• A daily note that points you to your weakest pillar, with a simple tip

LOG IN SECONDS
• Tap a petal, tap a pillar tile, or open the log sheet from the big + button
• Fix up any of the last 7 days
• Choose up to three focus pillars and Longvexa puts them first
• Set your own daily goals for every pillar

PULSE: FASTING AND BREATHING
• A fasting window timer with 13, 16, 18 and 20 hour presets
• A clear stage timeline (Digest, Settle, Burn, Deep) with your goal marked
• A breath coach with Box (4-4-4-4), Calm (4-7-8) and Even (5-5) patterns
• Breathing sessions count toward your Mind pillar automatically

TIME CAPSULE
• Write a letter to your future self
• Seal it for a month, six months, a year, five years or any date you pick
• It stays locked until then, and you get a notification the moment it opens

YOUR DATA, YOUR WAY
• Use every feature without an account. Guest data stays on your iPhone
• Sign in with Apple or Google to back up and sync. Your guest progress comes with you
• Works offline. Changes sync when you're back online
• Delete your account and all of its data from inside the app at any time
• No ads, and no tracking across other apps

A DESIGN THAT FEELS DIFFERENT
Bold colour blocks, ink outlines, satisfying presses and playful animations make checking in something you'll look forward to.

Longvexa is a wellness and habit app. It is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice. Vital minutes are a motivational score, not a medical estimate. Talk to your doctor before fasting or making major changes to your health routine.

name: LOOPI — Short Videos & AI
description:
LOOPI is the short-video platform built around creating, not just scrolling. Every video is 20 seconds or less — quick to watch, quick to make.

WATCH
• A feed of short videos shaped by what you like
• An explore grid of creators you don't follow yet — tap any square and keep swiping up through new people
• Full search: videos, people, chat rooms and hashtags

CREATE — UPLOAD FIRST
• Upload your own clips, up to 20 seconds each
• Caption them, tag them, and share them straight into chats

CREATE WITH AI
• Type a prompt and LOOPI generates a video for you
• AI generations use credits — LOOPI's in-app currency for creating. One credit makes a standard 10-second video; two make a 20-second one

CHAT, BUILT INTO THE FEED
• Direct messages, group chats and open rooms
• Private rooms protected by a password, for your friends
• Message bubbles float over the video you're watching — reply without ever leaving the feed

PLAY TOGETHER
• Penalty Kicks (swipe to shoot, swipe to save), Pong Clash with power-ups, and FoodNinja — playable against the computer or live against a friend
• Start a game session inside a group chat and fight for the standings board your whole group can see
• Every game runs on free game coins: earned by playing, never bought, never cashed out. Fun only — never real money

CREATOR LEVELS
• Earn XP every time you upload or generate
• Climb 5 levels, from Starter to Star Creator, and earn badges and streak bonuses
• A higher level means more starting reach for your videos — and the exact rules are published openly inside the app

WEEKLY COMPETITIONS — OPENING SOON
• A weekly best-video contest on a set prompt opens once the LOOPI community reaches 500 creators
• The competition card in the app shows the live creator count, so everyone can watch it unlock

LOOPI is for adults aged 18 and over. Every video and profile can be reported, every user can be blocked, accounts can be private or public, and you can delete your account at any time in Settings.

Watch it. Make it. Loop it.

name: Loopthrum
description:
Eight cells in a loop, four calculations and nine possible digits: fill the loop so that every calculation works. Use each digit from 1 to 9 at most once. One digit is left over.

In the daily puzzle, the four results make up the date. A new puzzle arrives each day. Free play has three levels: easy gives you two digits, medium uses addition, subtraction and multiplication, and hard adds division.

Rotate the board to read each calculation comfortably from left to right. Keep candidate digits as notes, check your entries or use up to three hints. When you solve the puzzle, Ella celebrates with a trophy. The Chihuahua changes her outfit with the seasons.

Share your result as an image or create a two-page A4 PDF with the puzzle and its solution. The app supports English and German, iPhone and iPad, and light and dark appearance.

All puzzles and images are included and work offline. No account is needed. There are no ads, in-app purchases or tracking. Your progress and settings stay on your device.

name: Loopway Wayfellow
description:
Loopway Wayfellow turns mental maths into a one-line path puzzle. Every circle on the grid shows a sum. Work out the answers in your head, then draw a single line through the circles from the smallest answer to the largest, covering every square on the way.

FOUR LEVELS, SET TO THE SINGAPORE SYLLABUS
- P3: add and subtract
- P5: times and divide
- P6: mixed operations and squares
- Sec 1: negative numbers

THREE CHAPTERS OF RULES
- Trails: end your line on the largest answer
- Loops: finish next to where you started, closing the loop
- Wrap-around: the dashed edges connect. Leave one side of the grid and come back on the other

FOUR WAYS TO PLAY
- Trail School: no timer and no hearts. Tap Hint to light up the next circle, and see the worked answers in order after every trail. Progress is saved for each level
- Blitz Rush: mental maths against the clock. Every solve adds seconds
- Shadow Chase: a shadow follows your line from the start, so calculate fast
- Blackout Memory: glance at the sums, then they hide. Trace the answers from memory

MADE BY A TEACHER
Designed by a former Singapore secondary-school teacher so that every move is a small maths decision: which answer comes next? A short tour explains the rules on first launch, and "How to play" brings it back any time.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no sign-in, no ads, no in-app purchases and no tracking. Your level, progress and best scores stay on your device.

Questions or ideas? Use the Support link on this page.

name: Loot Lurker: PC Game Deals
description:
Loot Lurker finds the best price for PC games across dozens of stores, and tells you whether it's really a good deal. It's powered by IsThereAnyDeal, which has tracked game prices across stores for years.

SEE TODAY'S DEALS
• A top pick, new all-time lows and deals ending soon, right on Home
• Browse every deal, sorted by trending, biggest cut, lowest price or ending soon
• Filter by store, price, discount, DRM and platform
• Search any game, on sale or not

KNOW IF IT'S A GOOD PRICE
• Every deal shows today's price next to the game's all-time low
• Two years of price history for each game, as a chart
• Every store's price for a game, with vouchers and their codes
• All-time, 12-month and 3-month lows at a glance
• Bundles and subscriptions that include the game

YOUR WAITLIST, IN YOUR POCKET
• Sign in with your IsThereAnyDeal account to see your waitlist with today's prices
• Find what's near its all-time low, or in a bundle right now
• Add and remove games from any game's page

MADE FOR YOU, NOT FOR ADS

name: Loupe: Coin Collection Tracker
description:
Loupe is an honest coin collection tracker that keeps your own photos, fills your date-and-mint sets and tells you when a coin deserves a closer look. No AI guessing, no price ranges, no weekly plans.

KEEP YOUR REAL COINS
• Guided capture for obverse, reverse and edge, cropped to the coin
• An on-device light, glare and focus check after every shot
• A tidy collection of your actual photos, never stock images

IS IT SPECIAL?
• Silver, steel and odd-metal years checked from the type and year alone: 90% silver quarters, 1943 steel cents, the 1982 copper and zinc split, wartime nickels
• Known key dates, die varieties and errors flagged with what to look for
• Optional weight and diameter confirm the metal against official specifications

FILL YOUR SETS
• Albums for Lincoln cents, Jefferson nickels, Roosevelt dimes, Washington and state quarters and Kennedy halves
• Every empty slot is your want list: tap it to add that exact coin

GET A SECOND OPINION
• One tap saves ready-to-post photos and text for popular coin forums
• Log what real collectors say, set a verdict and track grading submissions with real grade labels
• A timeline for every coin: collected, asked, grading, settled

FAST ENTRY
• Last-used year and mint, a decade wheel and Save & add next keep sorting a jar quick

HONEST BY DESIGN
• Free forever for your first 25 coins and one album, with every feature
• Export your collection as a spreadsheet with photos, free
• Pro adds unlimited coins and every album: monthly, yearly or a one-time lifetime price
• No account, no ads. Your coins stay on your iPhone.

Loupe does not value coins. Not affiliated with any forum or grading service.

LOUPE PRO
Loupe Pro adds unlimited coins and every album.
