name: Lovitude: Couple Gratitude
description:
Lovitude is a small daily ritual for couples: every day, each of you writes the other a thank-you. Something specific they did, said or simply were that day. At 8 pm the messages are revealed, and theirs opens as soon as you've written yours.

Nobody reads a word early, so you can write calmly, whenever it comes to you, without racing to be first.

HOW IT WORKS

• A question of the day, the same for both of you, in case you don't know where to start.
• One message per person per day, up to 500 characters, with an emoji if you like.
• At reveal time (8 pm, or whenever you choose) both messages are revealed. Theirs opens once you've written yours, or at midnight if you haven't written by then.
• React to their thank-you with an emoji, so they know it landed.
• Nudges: one tap on Today sends your partner a "thinking of you" buzz, like the old MSN ones, with its own sound.
• Your streak: the days in a row you both wrote, your best streak and every thank-you you've shared.
• A history of all your messages, day by day.
• Shared tasks: one list for the two of you, with due dates, repeats and comments, and who did what.

GETTING STARTED IS EASY

Sign in with Apple or Google and invite your partner with a code, a QR or a link. As soon as they join, you're in. Your partner can be on iPhone or Android.

MADE FOR EVERY DAY

• Works offline: write on the train and it sends when you're back online.
• Gentle reminders if you forget: half an hour before the reveal if you haven't written yet, another in the evening, and a heads-up when your streak is at risk. Every one of them can be turned off.
• Widgets for the Home Screen and the Lock Screen: your streak and today's message at a glance.
• Change the reveal time or the time zone whenever you like.
• In English and Spanish.

PRIVACY

Lovitude has no ads and doesn't sell your data. Notifications never show what a message says. Messages are stored encrypted, you can export them whenever you like, and you can delete your account from Settings at any time.

Free, with no ads and no in-app purchases.

name: Loyality - Digital Stamp Cards
description:
Loyality turns your paper punch card into a digital stamp card your customers keep in Apple Wallet. No app for them to download, no cards to print, no stamps to fake.

This app is for business owners and their staff. Customers simply scan the QR poster at your counter and add your card to their wallet.

HOW IT WORKS
• Set your reward, like "10 coffees, 1 free", and your card's colors and logo.
• Print your QR poster and put it by the till. Customers scan it and add your card in seconds.
• When they pay, tap Scan customer and scan the card on their phone. The stamp appears on their card right away.
• When the card is full, they get their reward. Scan again to redeem it.

STAMP WITH CONFIDENCE
• One scan per visit. A retried or double tap is only counted once.
• Optional time between stamps for the same customer, to stop misuse.
• No camera handy? Type the card number instead.
• Every stamp and reward records who gave it and when. Mistakes can be undone with a reason, and the history keeps both.

SEE WHAT'S WORKING
• Active members, repeat-visit rate, stamps given and rewards redeemed, for the last 7, 30 or 90 days.
• Daily visits and a new-member journey: joined, first visit, came back, earned, redeemed.
• Member groups: new, active, returning, dormant and reward ready.
• Honest numbers only. Rates appear once there is enough data, and we never guess at your revenue.

BRING CUSTOMERS BACK
• Send offers, greetings and reminders that appear on your customers' wallet card.
• Choose who gets it: everyone, customers close to a reward, rewards waiting, new members, or people you haven't seen lately.
• Schedule messages and set up holiday greetings ahead of time.

RUN IT WITH YOUR TEAM
• Invite staff by email. Staff can scan and redeem; only owners change rewards, see reports and manage the plan.
• Manage several shops from one account.

GETTING STARTED
Loyality is free to download. Sign in with your email, create your shop and print your poster in a few minutes.

Questions? support@getloyality.com

name: LSATForge
description:
LSAT Forge is an interactive LSAT study and preparation app designed to help you develop stronger reasoning skills, identify weaknesses, and track your progress toward law school.

Whether you're beginning your LSAT preparation or refining your skills before exam day, LSAT Forge combines structured lessons, independent practice, diagnostic quizzes, and game-inspired challenges to make studying more engaging.

INTERACTIVE LESSONS AND REWARDS

Make studying more enjoyable with a lesson-based learning experience.

• Complete guided lessons covering essential LSAT concepts
• Earn experience points (XP) and increase your level
• Complete daily challenges and earn achievements
• Unlock additional lessons and challenges
• Track your learning progress over time

TARGETED LSAT PRACTICE

Practice the skills that matter most on the LSAT.

• Logical Reasoning questions organized by question type
• Reading Comprehension passages and questions
• Select specific skills and difficulty levels
• Practice with or without time limits
• Review detailed answer explanations
• Focus on previously unseen questions

LSAT SCORE ESTIMATOR

Evaluate your progress using dedicated diagnostic quizzes.

• Choose from 15, 30, or 45-question assessments
• Receive an estimated LSAT score on the 120–180 scale
• View a projected score range
• Identify strengths and areas requiring improvement
• Track performance across practice sessions

Score estimates are approximate and are not official LSAT scores or validated predictions of examination performance.

CUSTOMIZABLE QUESTION LIBRARY

Build and manage your own LSAT practice collection.

• Import additional questions using compatible JSON files
• Export your entire question library or selected questions
• Track previously seen and unseen questions
• View question history, accuracy, and dates added
• Filter questions by category, difficulty, and source
• Remove unwanted questions from your collection
• Use a question-generation guide to create compatible practice packs with external tools

REVIEW AND IMPROVE

Build better study habits through focused review.

• Revisit incorrectly answered questions
• Track accuracy across different reasoning skills
• Identify recurring mistakes
• Reinforce concepts through spaced repetition
• Monitor long-term study progress

LSAT REGISTRATION RESOURCES

Access official LSAT registration resources and stay organized while preparing for your examination.

STUDY YOUR WAY

Use LSAT Forge for structured, game-inspired learning or traditional independent practice. Lessons and rewards are optional, giving you control over how you prepare.

LSAT Forge is an independent educational application and is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the Law School Admission Council (LSAC). Practice questions are independently developed and are not official LSAT examination questions.

name: Luck Tax
description:
Got lucky? That’ll be one phone call you’ve been avoiding.

Luck Tax keeps a dry little ledger between you and the universe. Something good happens: you owe it a small task that’s hard but good for you. Something bad happens: the universe owes you a treat. Simple bookkeeping. A small ritual for everyday tasks.

Your lucky breaks finally get the things you keep putting off done.

HOW IT WORKS
• Log it in seconds. “Won concert tickets.” “Missed the bus.” Write one line, tap the area of life, how it happened and how big it was.
• Get your invoice. Three ways to pay, matched to what happened: a 30-minute walk, the email you’ve ignored the longest, the drawer of doom. Pure luck is paid in effort. Gifts are paid forward. Things you earned get a quick look back.
• Pay with your put-offs first. Keep a list of what you’re avoiding, and your next lucky break pays for it. Overdue Apple Reminders count too, and tick themselves off when you pay.
• Bad day? Collect. The universe owes you: a real nap, a long hot shower, a slow walk with nowhere to be. No guilt. It’s on the books.
• Adjust the pace. Pay your dues and the tasks grow with you. Drop a few and it eases off. Short on energy? Owe it for now, or pay in installments.

LOOK BACK AT YOUR ENTRIES
Patterns summarizes the areas and categories you selected in your entries. It does not determine why events happened. Optional suggestions can help you choose something to try next.

WATCH THE SCALES
Your balance with the universe sits on a set of scales on the home screen. Owe too much and it tips. Pay up and you hear the coins drop.

YOURS, AND ONLY YOURS
• No account, no ads, no tracking. Your ledger stays in the app; optional Apple Reminders may sync through your configured accounts.
• Tell it what to skip: sweets, caffeine, hard workouts, spending money or work tasks. The built-in library excludes alcohol, pork and gambling. Choose tasks that suit your circumstances.
• Share your statement of account as a card.
• Dark mode. English, Deutsch, Français, Español and Nederlands.

Luck Tax is a light-hearted way to build good habits, not a substitute for professional help. If you’re having a hard time, it can show you a local support line.

Got lucky lately? You know what that means.

name: Lucky Casino Chance Anatomy
description:
What if luck could be explored through mathematics rather than intuition? Behind every unexpected result lies a world of probabilities, statistical patterns, and numerical relationships. Discover how chance shapes random experiments, why certain outcomes appear more frequently than others, and how mathematical principles explain events that may initially seem unpredictable.

Turn curiosity into experimentation with interactive randomness simulators. Explore spinning wheels, dice, coin tosses, card draws, random numbers, and probability-based selections. Adjust parameters, run thousands of trials, and examine how observed results compare with theoretical expectations. Take your investigations further with Monte Carlo experiments, detailed statistical summaries, and visual charts that reveal the fascinating behavior of random processes.

There is much more to chance than numbers alone. Explore scientific discoveries, remarkable historical facts, and the mathematical ideas that shaped our understanding of probability. Read educational materials, examine formulas and algorithms, and build your knowledge through a practical reference collection. Each topic offers a different perspective on the relationship between randomness, probability, and human perception.

Put your analytical thinking to the test with interactive matching challenges that combine knowledge and speed. Connect concepts with their definitions, complete timed tasks, and compare your current performance with your personal best. From curious observations to complex statistical models, every exploration brings a new opportunity to understand the science of chance.

name: Lucky Ducky Digits
description:
Lucky Ducky Digits picks your lottery numbers with a real spinning ball drum. Watch the balls tumble and drop one at a time, just like a live drawing.

Play Pick 3 free in every state. One $4.99 unlock opens every other game: Powerball, Mega Millions, Millionaire for Life, Cash 5, Take 5, Lotto, Pick 4, Keno and more from every state.

• REAL DRUM: every ball drops out of the drum on its own, plus a HOT line of the numbers that dropped most
• ULTRA, WHEEL and SPREAD for many lines at once
• Count filter: see which numbers came out most at each point in a 21-draw count, and mark your BUY counts
• My Tickets: lock your lines and they're checked after every draw
• Win alerts on your phone
• Scan a paper ticket to see if it won
• Keno countdown to the next game, right on time

Lucky Ducky Digits doesn't sell tickets or take bets. It picks numbers and checks your tickets for fun. Play responsibly; you must be of legal age to play the lottery in your state.

description:
Bedien je elektrische camperluifel en de luifelverlichting gewoon met je iPhone.

Luifel vervangt de afstandsbediening door één overzichtelijk scherm:

name: Lumimi - Beikost & Rezepte
description:
Lumimi helps you plan your baby’s first foods with a daily meal idea, recipes, a food diary, a weekly meal plan, and a shopping list. Everything stays on your device — no account, no ads, and no tracking.

DAILY MEAL IDEA

A suitable suggestion every day, tailored to your baby’s age, stage of starting solids, and food texture (purées, soft lumps, or finger foods)

Known allergies and excluded ingredients are always taken into account

View an alternative if the suggestion isn’t right for you

RECIPES FOR BABIES

33 recipes: vegetable, potato and meat purées; milk and cereal porridges; fruit and cereal purées; vegetarian purées; and finger foods

See each recipe’s allergens at a glance

Search and save your favorites

Ingredient quantities and step-by-step preparation instructions, including safety guidance

FOOD DIARY

Record what you offered and how your baby reacted

Keep track of new ingredients without assessing food tolerance

WEEKLY MEAL PLAN AND SHOPPING LIST

Plan recipes for the week

The shopping list (Pro) automatically combines ingredients

Take ingredients you already have into account when planning

PRIVACY FIRST

No registration, no ads, and no analytics or tracking services

All data stays locally on your device

Export and import your data as a file, and delete all your data at any time

LUMIMI PRO (OPTIONAL)
Lumimi Pro gives you additional features: more daily alternatives, one-tap 7-day meal planning, a shopping list, scaled ingredient quantities, multiple profiles, and unlimited favorites. Pro is available as a monthly or annual subscription through the App Store. Payment will be charged to your Apple Account upon confirmation of purchase. Your subscription renews automatically unless canceled in your account settings at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. The price is shown in the App Store before you purchase. If Pro expires, your data will remain saved.

IMPORTANT
Lumimi is a general planning tool and does not replace medical or professional nutritional advice. The recipes are suggestions and have not been reviewed by doctors or qualified nutrition professionals. Discuss when and how to introduce solid foods with your pediatrician. Allergy settings act as filters and do not replace checking the ingredients yourself.

LANGUAGES
The app interface is available in 14 languages. Recipe texts are currently available in German and English.

name: Lumiq: Light Puzzle
description:
One beam, one mirror, one crystal – that is how it begins. Lumiq is a puzzle game that starts calm and gets truly tricky, set in six atmospheric halls, from a storm-lashed lighthouse to an observatory above the clouds.

Tap to turn mirrors. Swipe to slide them. Prisms split white light into red, green and blue, filters let a single color pass, portals carry beams across the room, and switch crystals open gates. When every crystal is lit at once, light floods the whole hall.

• 300 levels in six worlds, each with its own mood and new elements
• An especially hard daily puzzle every day, no internet required
• Stars for short solutions, but no timer and no penalties
• Undo for every move; in easy mode, tips when you are stuck
• Sounds that turn your crystals into a chord, and delicate haptics
• Rotate the room and pinch to zoom, color-blind mode with symbols and patterns
• English and German

Fair and simple: the first two worlds with 100 levels are free. The four further worlds with 50 levels each are available separately as one-time purchases. No subscription, no ads, no account, no tracking. All progress stays on your device.

name: LunaPic: Photo Effects Studio
description:
Photo Studio is an independent creative workspace for iPhone and iPad. Import a photo from Photos or Files, combine reversible edits, then render a file on your device.

• Crop, straighten, rotate, flip, resize, and adjust your photo.
• Stack six free effects or explore all 16 in the Pro sample.
• Tap a color to cut it out, add text or an overlay, and undo changes step by step.

name: Lusoria
description:
Classic games. No ads. No Wi-Fi needed.

Lusoria is a small collection of games for iPhone that work anywhere: on a plane, on the Tube, or with the phone in flight mode.

There are no ads, no accounts and nothing to buy. Your scores and settings stay on your phone.

SNAKE
Four ways to play. Classic has the look of an old handheld. Modern adds power-ups. Ultra is in 3D, with a wormhole dive into a tunnel bonus stage. Today's board is the same board for everyone, every day.

MERGE
Slide the tiles and join matching numbers.

MINES
Clear the field without hitting a mine.

BRICKS
Bounce the ball and break the wall.

DROP
Drop numbered pieces and combine three or more of the same.

Found a bug or have an idea? Email chris@lumara.digital.

name: Magpie Jar
description:
Magpies collect shiny things. Magpie Jar does the same for culture: the film you'll still think about next year, the record you'll put on repeat, the book you'll press into a friend's hands.

TODAY
A short list, new every day. A film in cinemas, a record out this week, one thing from the archive, and a kind thing or two to do away from the screen. Tick them off, or swipe left for not today.

DISCOVER
Films and series on the streaming services you pay for, in your country. Narrow it down by place, period, genre or maker, or describe what you're in the mood for in your own words. Every card shows where it streams. You can discover records, books and art too.

EXPLORE
Spin the globe and slide through history. See the films, books, records and paintings that came from a place and a time, drawn on the borders of the day.

PICKS
Stamp each card: loved, nope, skip or later. Every marking informs the recommendations tailored to your taste and builds your future lists.

SAVED
Your library and your lists in one place. Mark something once and it follows you between the app and magpiejar.com.

Magpie Jar is about building a world canon. It is carefully curated. It is not a search engine and doesn't aim to be one.

Look around without an account. Sign in with Google or Apple to keep your marks, lists and Today ticks on every device.

No tracking, and your data is never sold. Delete your account at any time in the app or at magpiejar.com/delete-account.

name: MahjFresh: Daily Mahjong
description:
MahjFresh is American-style mahjong in a few minutes a day.

Every day, everyone gets the same fresh hand. Pass tiles in the Charleston, pick a hand from the card, call the discards you need, and try to make mahjong before the three computer players do. Then come back tomorrow for a new one.

ONE HAND A DAY
• The same deal for every player, so your score means something.
• A hand takes a few minutes. No timers, no rush.
• Lost today's hand? Replay it for practice as often as you like. Only your first try counts.

A CARD OF ITS OWN
• The Mahj Fresh Card: 56 hands in 9 sections, made for this game.
• Browse the whole card any time, and pin the hands you're chasing so they stay in view while you play.
• Jokers, flowers, blanks, pungs, kongs and quints, played the way you know them.

CHARMS AND RECORDS
• Win a hand and take home a charm. There are 100 to collect, with new ones for each season.
• Track your streak, win rate, best score and every hand you've played.
• Share your result with one tap. No spoilers for anyone still playing.

LEAGUES WITH FRIENDS
• Start a private league and invite your mahjong group with a link.
• Standings rank everyone by wins, score and streak.
• Up to 50 players per league. Invite only.

NEW TO THE GAME?
• Try a practice hand before you sign up. No account needed.
• A short guide walks through the card, the Charleston, calling and jokers, with tiles you can tap.
• Computer players keep a friendly pace while you learn.

NO NONSENSE
• Free to play. No ads, no purchases, no tracking.
• Sign up with just an email and a password.
• Delete your account whenever you like, right in Settings.

Mahjong for sunny days and good times. Pull up a chair.

name: Mahjong Passport
description:
Relax with mahjong solitaire in Mahjong Passport.
Match pairs of tiles across 29 cities with no timer.
Complete each city to add a stamp to your passport.

How to play
Mahjong Passport is a relaxing mahjong solitaire game. Tap two identical free tiles to match them. A tile is free when nothing sits on top of it and its left or right side is open. Clear the board, then move on to the next stop. There is no timer, and every board can be solved.

Every city has its own tiles
The number tiles are classic mahjong. The rest of the set is the city itself: its landmarks, its food and its souvenirs. In New York you match yellow taxis, hot dogs, pretzels and the Big Apple, along with the Statue of Liberty, the Empire State Building and the Brooklyn Bridge. London brings double-decker buses and fish and chips, Vancouver has orcas and seaplanes, and Honolulu has ukuleles and shave ice.

Star tiles and the souvenir album
Souvenir and landmark tiles carry a gold star. Any two from the same group make a pair, like the flower and season tiles in traditional mahjong. Each one you match goes into your souvenir album with a short note about the real thing, from a slice of New York cheesecake to a Kyoto tea bowl.

Stamps, gold pages and postcards
Finish a city and its stamp goes into your passport. Earn more stars and the stamp turns silver, then gold. Finish every city in a leg of the trip to get a gold passport page and a postcard for that leg. Each city sends a postcard of its own, too.

A daily puzzle
There is a new board every day. Clear every daily puzzle in a month to earn that month's postcard.

World Tour: a new route every week
Once you have five stamps, the World Tour opens. Each week brings a new themed route, such as Mediterranean Week or Silk Road Week. Pack your hints, shuffles and undos, pick one of two roads at every fork, and collect Travel Kit items that help you along the way. Finish the route to earn that week's World Tour certificate.

29 cities, 1,300 stages
Some cities are relaxed, some are a real challenge. The difficulty rises slowly as you travel, and new tiles join the trip. Ice tiles thaw as you make matches, fog tiles show their picture once they are free, and stone tiles crack and break as you match the tiles beside them. The newest cities are Vienna, Beijing, Barcelona, Taipei, Vancouver and Berlin.

Play at your own pace
• No timer
• Hint, shuffle and undo
• When there are no matches left, undo your last move or take a look at the board
• Large Tiles mode for bigger tiles and text
• Vibration can be turned off
• Available in 9 languages

Your passport is ready. Where will you go first?

name: MAISON CORE
description:
Welkom bij MAISON CORE – een boutique Reformer Pilates studio in Amsterdam waar kracht, houding en controle centraal staan. Ontdek Core Total, een full-body Reformer workout waarin gecontroleerde beweging, precisie en focus samenkomen. Geschikt voor zowel beginners als ervaren sporters.

name: Maison: Clock & Photo Widgets
description:
Make your iPhone look tailored. Maison gives you elegant widgets, wallpapers and Control Center buttons in one place, designed to sit together on one calm, beautiful Home Screen.

• No ads, ever. Core widgets never get locked.
• Edit right on a Home Screen preview, at the real iOS size.
• Pick a finished set, or match every widget to your own photo.
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets.

WIDGETS
• Clock & Date: dials, numerals and dates. Lock Screen versions included.
• Photo: one photo or a rotating album, in a heart, arch, circle, star or rounded frame.
• Countdown: the days until a trip, a birthday or an anniversary, with a progress line.
• Music: Card, Vinyl and Cassette styles for Apple Music, with play and skip buttons.
• Weather: current conditions and the hours ahead.
• Day Board: today's events, battery and storage in one glance.
• Greetings: a hello that changes with the time of day.
• Text and Text Launcher: your own words, or a clean list of the apps you choose, opened by link or shortcut.

FINISHES
Every widget comes in Frosted, Onyx, Ivory, Champagne or Clear. Clear blends a widget into your wallpaper: take two screenshots, one of the page where the widget shows a test pattern and one of an empty page with the same wallpaper, and Maison lines the widget up with the picture behind it. Clear works with the Default and Dark Home Screen styles. iOS still draws a fine glass edge around every widget.

SETS & THEME MATCH
Start from a set: a wallpaper and widgets already matched. Or pick any wallpaper or photo, and Maison pulls three colors from it and applies them to the widgets you choose.

WALLPAPERS
A curated library of wallpapers, plus Glass, Halftone, ASCII and Water effects for your own photos. Turn a wallpaper into a Live Photo with gentle motion. Save to Photos, then follow the short guide to set it. iOS does not let apps change your wallpaper for you.

CONTROL CENTER (iOS 18 and later)
Add buttons that copy a piece of text, open a link, show a quote or send your daily greeting.

MAISON PRO
Core widgets stay yours, with no ads. Maison Pro unlocks every style, font, wallpaper and set, unlimited saved designs, and Live Photo export. Choose a monthly plan, a yearly plan with a trial period, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Prices are shown in the app before you buy.

GERÇEK HATLAR, GERÇEK İSTASYONLAR
• İzmir Banliyösü'nün kuzey ve güney kolları, Büyük ve Küçük Menderes, Tire, Söke, Gediz, Bakırçay, Göller, Kütahya ve Frig hatları: toplam 11 hat
• Gerçek harita, arazi yüksekliği ve uydu görüntüsüyle oluşturulmuş güzergâhlar
• Tüneller, köprüler, hemzemin geçitler ve aydınlık yer altı istasyonları
• Peronda bekleyen, kapılar açılınca inip binen yolcular

GERÇEKÇİ SÜRÜŞ
• Çekiş ve fren kolu, hız göstergesi, fren silindiri, sinyaller ve hız sınırları
• Elektrikli banliyö dizileri, bölgesel dizel diziler, dizel ve elektrikli lokomotifler
• Makaslar, totman, imdat freni, kum, farlar ve silecekler
• Hareket memurları telsiz mesajlarında sana adınla seslenir
• Kabin, dış ve kuşbakışı kameralar: parmağınla çevir, iki parmakla yakınlaştır

HER SEFER FARKLI
• Sabah, gündüz, akşam ve gece seferleri
• Açık, bulutlu, sisli ve yağmurlu hava
• Dakiklik, hız disiplini, kusursuz duruş ve yolcu konforu puanlanır

İyi yolculuklar, makinist!

name: Mallowcrate
description:
Mallowcrate är en mysig pussel där du skjuter honungskartonger upp på daisier.

Mallow är en rund marshmallow-kurier med en skott på huvudet. Ängeln är full av grova kartonger, och varje daisy-pålägg väntar på en. Du går ett bricka i taget. Gå in i en kartong så skjuter den framåt. Du kan inte dra en kartong, och du kan inte skjuta två samtidigt. Nivån är klar när alla daisier är täckta.

Trettiosex handgjorda nivåer är uppdelade i sex ängar: Ängel, Trädgård, Klöver, Honung, Ljuslyktor och Stjärnljus. Det första skjutet är ett enda steg. Senare hyllor kräver att du går långt runt, parkerar en kartong och följer ordningen. Varje nivå har en par, det minsta antalet steg som krävs. Slutför inom två steg av par för tre stjärnor. En bredare bånd ger två. Ett klart resultat ger en. Din bästa rörelsepoäng spelas in på denna enhet.

Spela med en smid, skärmen eller pilarna på tangentbordet. Håll en riktning för att fortsätta gå. Återställ stegen tillbaka. Starta om placerar kartongerna där de började. En kartong som landar på en daisy studsar och glittrar, och en klar nivå får en liten firande.

Vad du kommer att hitta:

- Klassiska regler för ettstegs-skjutning
- Smidkontroller och en grov riktningspålägg
- Tastaturpilar, plus U för att ångra och R för att starta om  
- Ångra, starta om och en levande rörelse-tellare  
- Nivåval med lås, stjärnor och bästa poäng  
- Sex världar och trettiosex originalnivåer  
- Ljud och haptik som du kan stänga av  
- En guide för hur man spelar och en om-vägssida  
- Integritetspolicy och villkor, läsbara i appen  

Mallowcrate är offline. Den har inget konto, inga annonser, ingen spårning och inga köp. Framsteg, stjärnor samt ljud- och haptikinställningar behålls i lokal lagring på din iPhone eller iPad. Ta bort appen eller tryck på Återställ framsteg – den lokala sparandet försvinner.

Skapat för en tyst minut och en något svårare minut därefter.

name: Manciple: Household Steward
description:
Manciple is your household steward. In old grand houses the manciple kept track of every provision — what was in store, what was running low, what to buy next. Now it lives in your phone.

Scan what you buy, and Manciple keeps track of everything at home — the fridge, the freezer, the bathroom cabinet, the garage — tells you what to use first, and builds your shopping list for you.

KNOW WHAT'S AT HOME
• Scan a barcode: name, brand, pack size and a real product photo are filled in.
• Already have it? Manciple tells you right in the aisle — "You already have 4 bottles at home".
• Rooms: Kitchen, Bathroom, Office, Garage… or your own. Food and non-food alike.
• Fridge, Freezer and Pantry spots, with Fresh / Expiring / Expired / Low filters and an expiry calendar.

ADD A WHOLE SHOP AT ONCE
• One photo of your haul, a receipt (prices included), a camera sweep, or just type a list.
• No barcode? Show the item — Apple Intelligence works out what it is and how many.
• Snap a handwritten list or a chat screenshot to fill your shopping bag.

NEVER MISS AN EXPIRY
• Reminders before each item expires, a daily digest, and a reminders inbox.
• "Use first" on the home screen, oldest batch first.
• Is it still good? Snap fruit, veg or meat and get a freshness check.

COOK FROM WHAT YOU HAVE
• Meal ideas that use up what's expiring.
• Name a dish and the number of people — get the proper recipe, tick what you'll use from home, swap missing things for what you have, and send the rest to your bag.
• Food inspiration from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and more.

A SHOPPING BAG THAT FILLS ITSELF
• Running low? It's added automatically.
• Tick items as you shop and stock them back in one tap. Buy online links for your favourite shops.

ORGANIZE YOUR STORAGE
• Add your fridge, cabinets and racks with their size — or measure them with the camera (LiDAR on Pro iPhones).
• Manciple works out what goes on which shelf: food safety, weight, how often you use it, what fits.

JUST SAY IT
• "I bought 3 carrots, they go in the fridge." "We finished the milk." The assistant does it for you.
• Siri & Shortcuts: "Add to my Manciple bag", "What's expiring in Manciple?"

SHARE WITH FAMILY — PHONE TO PHONE
• Sync a home with family nearby over Wi-Fi/Bluetooth. Encrypted, no account, no server.
• Keep separate homes — your place, your parents' place, the office.

FOR SHOPS AND KITCHENS
• Business mode adds SKUs, suppliers, reorder levels, stock value and supplier orders.

INSIGHTS
• Freshness score, stock value, money wasted, used vs. wasted by week.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account. No ads. No tracking. Your data stays on your phone.
• Apple Intelligence runs on-device. Backup to a file whenever you like.

A guided tour shows you around on first launch. Apple Intelligence features need a compatible iPhone with Apple Intelligence turned on; everything else works on any iPhone with iOS 26 or later.

name: Mandragora
description:
Mandragora est l'outil des équipes animalières des parcs zoologiques partenaires de Mandragora.

Inventoriez les plantes présentes dans chaque enclos en les photographiant ou en les recherchant dans la taxonomie, et consultez ce que la base Mandragora documente sur leurs effets, partie par partie, pour les animaux présents. Enregistrez ce que vous distribuez (branchages, feuillages, fruits) et la consommation observée, et signalez un incident en quelques gestes, même sans réseau.

Les informations affichées décrivent des observations documentées et sourcées. Elles ne constituent ni une recommandation, ni une autorisation d'exposition. L'application est réservée aux membres des établissements inscrits sur Mandragora.

name: Mane Crew
description:
Mane Crew keeps your salon team on the same page — one private app for the schedule, shift changes, attendance, performance and team chat.

FOR THE TEAM
• See the weekly schedule and your next shift at a glance
• Clock in and out from your phone
• Ask for a cover or trade a shift — coworkers can offer to help
• Request time off and see when it's approved
• Chat with the whole team or message a coworker or your manager privately
• Post on the team board and reply to posts
• See your own attendance and performance scorecard, with weekly and monthly trends
• Celebrate birthdays and the Stylist of the Week

FOR THE MANAGER
• Build the schedule as a draft, then publish the week with one tap
• Approve or decline shift exchanges and time-off requests — the schedule updates itself
• Track attendance and punctuality automatically from the time clock
• Enter weekly guest-service, quality, retail and extra-service results
• Scorecards for every stylist, with weekly and monthly trends
• Post official announcements
• A private leadership chat with assistant managers
• Every change is recorded in an activity log, and stylists can request corrections

PRIVATE BY DESIGN Only people the manager adds to the roster can join. Attendance and performance are visible only to each stylist and the manager, and private messages only to the people in them.

Notifications let everyone know when the schedule is posted, a shift needs covering, a request is answered, or a new message arrives — and can be turned off any time.

Not on a team yet? Tap "Explore with sample data" on the sign-in screen to try every feature with made-up people.

name: Mapcade
description:
Mapcade is a collection of short daily geography games. Every game has a new daily set of 5 rounds, the same for every player, so you can compare your score with friends and with everyone who played today.

DRAW AND MEASURE
• Fix the Border: two neighbours lost their shared border. Draw the line back in.
• Half and Half: one straight line that splits a country's people into two equal halves.
• Size It Up: resize a country until it matches its true size next to another one.
• Draw the Border: a country is blurred off the map. Trace its outline from memory.
• Finish the Coast: a stretch of coastline is missing. Draw it back.

KNOW YOUR WORLD
• Name the Shape, Find the Capital, Whose Flag?, Neighbours
• Chain, Who Has More?, How Far?, Compass
• Atlas of the Day: five rounds from five different games

JUST FOR FUN
Emoji Riddle, Star Origins, Whose Dish?, Odd Places, Two Truths and a Lie, Whose Money?, Where Is Colder?, In Their Words, Dig Through, Named After.

EVERY DAY
• New daily sets at midnight, 100 points a round
• See how your score compares with all players
• Daily streak with snowflakes that save a missed day, XP and levels
• Endless play whenever you want more
• Play with friends: the same 5 rounds, live, by link
• Share your result as a picture
• No account, no ads
• 10 languages: English, French, Spanish, German, Portuguese, Italian, Polish, Czech, Turkish and Russian

Maps: Natural Earth (public domain). Data sources and credits: https://mapcade.app/credits.html

name: Maps4me Waypoints
description:
Plan drone mapping flights on your iPhone and send the mission straight to DJI Fly, ready to fly.

Maps4me Waypoints is the companion app of the Maps4me Connect platform for drone mapping professionals. Sign in with your Maps4me Connect account to carry every flight plan you created on the web — and create new ones in the field in a few taps.

COMPATIBLE DRONES
• DJI Mini 4 Pro
• DJI Mini 5 Pro
• DJI Air 3
• DJI Air 3S
• DJI Mavic 3
• DJI Mavic 3 Classic
• DJI Mavic 3 Pro
• DJI Mavic 4 Pro
• DJI Lito X1
Using DJI Fly on iPhone (RC-N1, RC-N2 and RC-N3 controllers).

AREA MAPPING
• Grid, double grid and 3D oblique (nadir + 45° passes)
• Altitude, front and side overlap, line direction, start point and gimbal
• Recommended speed calculated from the drone's camera to keep the overlap
• Area, GSD, distance, flight time, batteries and photo count in real time

CORRIDOR AND FREE WAYPOINTS
• Corridor for roads, power lines and pipelines, split into segments automatically
• Free waypoints with actions (photo, video, hover)
• Orbit, helix and spiral around a point of interest, with the camera always on target

TERRAIN
• Terrain follow with SRTM elevation, keeping a constant height above ground
• Download terrain data to fly with no signal

STRAIGHT TO DJI FLY
• Connect the DJI Fly folder once: the mission appears in DJI Fly with the plan's name, ready to fly
• Large missions are split automatically at the 189-waypoint limit, without cutting flight lines
• Also exports the KMZ file and a Google Earth preview

SYNCED WITH THE WEB
• Plans saved on the iPhone show up on Maps4me Connect and vice versa
• Works in the field without internet

Requires a Maps4me Connect account with access to the Flight Plan Generator.

Fly responsibly: the pilot is responsible for the flight. Check the route and obstacles and follow your country's aviation rules and authorities before take-off. DJI and DJI Fly are trademarks of SZ DJI Technology Co., Ltd.; this app is not affiliated with DJI.

name: Marine Calc
description:
Marine Calc is a focused offline utility for marine engineering calculations.

- Calculate propeller margin and design-power RPM from shop-test and sea-trial data.
- Convert MCR engine load (%) to RPM, RPM to load (%), and power (kW) to RPM.
- Start with 15% load or use quick presets for 25%, 50%, 75% and 100%.
- See results as you type, with units and input validation.
- Retain your last inputs and settings, copy a contextual result, and review formulas and assumptions.
- Use Korean or English and light or dark appearance.

No account, ads or purchases. Calculations and help work without an internet connection.

Results follow the theoretical cubic propeller curve. Actual operation depends on draft, hull condition, weather and other factors. This utility is not applicable to constant-speed generators and does not determine operating limits or acceptance criteria.

name: Markdown Viewer for Safari
description:
Markdown Viewer turns raw Markdown files in Safari into clean, readable pages. Open a README, changelog, or any .md link and you get formatted headings, tables, and highlighted code instead of a wall of plain text.

It works on its own. Once the extension is on, there's nothing to tap: Markdown pages render as they load, and every other site is left alone.

WHAT YOU GET

• GitHub Flavored Markdown support: tables, task lists, strikethrough, and autolinks
• Syntax highlighting for code blocks in common programming languages
• Light and dark mode that follow your system setting
• A Raw/Rendered button to switch between the formatted page and the original source
• Heading anchors, so a link to a section (like #install) jumps to the right place
• YAML front matter tucked into a collapsible block instead of cluttering the top of the page

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Everything runs on your device. Markdown Viewer doesn't collect data, doesn't track you, and doesn't download anything; its libraries are built into the app. Scripts hidden in a Markdown file are removed before the page is shown, so a file can't run code in your browser.

It only touches pages that are actually Markdown. The renderer loads into a tab only when Safari is showing a Markdown file, so the rest of your browsing isn't slowed down.

IPHONE, IPAD, AND MAC

On iPhone and iPad, turn it on in Settings > Apps > Safari > Extensions. On Mac, turn it on in Safari > Settings > Extensions. Allow it on all websites so it can recognize Markdown files wherever you find them.

GOOD TO KNOW

Markdown Viewer works with files loaded from the web, such as raw files from code hosting sites, documentation servers, and project websites. Safari doesn't run extensions on files opened from your device, so local files aren't supported. A few sites block embedded images with strict security settings; text, formatting, and code highlighting still work there.

Recognizes .md, .markdown, .mdown, .mkd, .mkdn, .mdwn, .mdtxt, .mdtext, and .rmd files, plus pages served as text/markdown.

EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Mass Reaction: Balance Puzzle
description:
Deep in a forgotten laboratory, the scales are still moving.

Drop numbered balls into eight columns that stand on four scales. Every ball has a mass: the heavier side sinks, the lighter one rises, and a sudden tilt can throw a ball across the board. Line up three of a colour in a row to dissolve them, stack five in a column to fuse one heavy ball — and keep every stack below the carriage line.

EASY TO START, HARD TO BALANCE
Tap a column, swipe down, watch the weight shift. The rules fit in a sentence; mastering the balance takes much longer.

TWENTY SPECIAL BALLS
From level 3, a new special ball opens every level, all twenty by level 18. Bombs and cutters clear space, jokers fit any colour, zaps wipe out colours, rows and diagonals, tints and flashes repaint the board. Three silver stars clear the whole field; gold stars score it.

ONE ENDLESS RUN
No move timer and no stages to replay. One run that grows harder level by level, and one Game Center leaderboard for everyone.

QUIET BY DESIGN
No ads. No sign-up. The game plays offline. Optional packs of special balls are the only purchases, and your stash follows you through iCloud.

name: Master Barber: Shave & Trim
description:
Pick up the clippers and become the best barber in town!

Master Barber is a relaxing yet challenging shaving game where every single hair reacts to your touch. Read each customer's request, choose the right tool and deliver the perfect cut.

REAL BARBER TOOLS
• Scissors with adjustable length (2–30 cm)
• Hair clipper with mm settings
• Beard trimmer for crisp lines
• Electric foil shaver
• Classic straight razor – apply foam first or you'll nick the customer!
• Lemon cologne for the finishing touch (and a tip)
• NEW: Fade clipper for an instant gradient on the sides and nape
• NEW: Beard clipper that trims the beard without touching the hair
• Real sounds for every tool – and customers who say "ouch!"

SHAVE FROM EVERY ANGLE
Rotate around the customer – front, left, right and back. Clean the nape, fade the sides and check your work in full 3D. Pinch to zoom for precision work on mustaches and sideburns.

HUNDREDS OF CUSTOMERS
Young and old, long hair, curls, receding hairlines, stubble and giant beards. Every customer is different and every request is a new challenge: clean shave, goatee, buzz cut, short sides, hipster, full zero and more.

PRO TOOLS
Earn points to unlock professional tools like the Titan Pro Clipper and the Golden Razor – or unlock them instantly in the Pro Tool Kit.

COMPETE WORLDWIDE
Sign in with Game Center and climb the weekly and all-time leaderboards.

No account needed. Remove ads anytime with a one-time purchase that also unlocks every pro tool. Just you, your tools and a line of customers waiting for a fresh look.

name: Mater Viæ
description:
Mater Viæ é um companheiro de estudo bíblico católico, inspirado no Tratado da Verdadeira Devoção à Santíssima Virgem, de São Luís Maria de Montfort.

• Hoje: a frase do dia (uma para cada dia do ano), os mistérios do terço de hoje e uma regra de vida simples para ir marcando.
• Frase do dia no horário que você escolher, com histórico e favoritas, e lembretes opcionais (Angelus, terço e outros), agendados no próprio aparelho.
• Caminhada: pergunte por palavra, tema, personagem ou passagem e veja as fontes na Bíblia, no Catecismo, nos documentos da Igreja e em Montfort.
• Jornada da Consagração Total: 33 dias de preparação e a consagração no dia 34, com as orações e leituras que o Tratado indica para cada fase.
• Mapas de época: cada lugar bíblico no mapa do seu tempo, com povos, reinos e caminhos.
• Busca, trilhas temáticas, referências cruzadas e linha do tempo da história da salvação.
• Apple Watch: a frase do dia, os mistérios de hoje, o dia da jornada e as orações da fase no pulso.
• Em português, inglês e espanhol, com modo claro e escuro. Funciona sem internet, sem cadastro e sem anúncios. Seus dados ficam só no seu aparelho.

Crédito: pomba do ícone baseada no Twemoji © Twitter, Inc. e colaboradores, licença CC BY 4.0.

name: Matrix Classroom
description:
Matrix Classroom brings classwork and PDF marking together on iPad. Teachers can post announcements, organise notes and videos, set assignments and return marked work. Students can see what is due, hand in their work privately and download returned PDFs.

Mark with Apple Pencil. Work through one question across the class or mark a whole script. Keep the marking scheme beside the script, reuse comments, and tag common mistakes. Review the question summary, then return each student’s PDF with per-question marks and a total.

Students can join a class with a class code, follow the class stream, open lesson resources and check their feedback. Teachers connect their own Google Drive for class files. A teacher invitation is required to create classes.

name: Matrix Staff
description:
Matrix Staff нь Matrix салоны ажилтанд зориулсан апп.

• Ирц — салбар дээр ирсэн, явсан цагаа нэг товчоор бүртгэнэ
• Өнөөдөр — өдрийн үйлчлүүлэгчид, ирэх цагууд, төлөв

name: Mawashi Farm Management System
description:
Mawashi Farm Management is the working app for Mawashi's veterinary field teams and for the farm owners they look after in the United Arab Emirates. Accounts are issued by Mawashi — there is no public sign-up.

FOR FIELD TEAMS
• Open a visit at the farm gate and record the work as you do it: vaccinations, treatments, parasite control, lab samples, weighing, hoof trimming and shearing.
• Scan or type an ear tag or RFID chip and that animal's history is in front of you.
• Reproduction is covered too — pregnancy checks, breeding and deliveries.
• See each farm's herd at a glance — mothers, sires and young animals by age, pen and breed — and share a herd report as a PDF.
• Clock in when your shift starts and out when it ends. Location is recorded only in between, never before or after.
• Photographs, short videos and voice notes attach to the record they belong to.

IT WORKS WITHOUT A SIGNAL
Download the day's farms, animals and reference data before you leave. Anything you record while offline waits in a sync outbox and is sent the moment you are back in coverage. Nothing is lost, and nothing has to be typed twice.

FOR FARM OWNERS
• Your herd, animal by animal, with the treatments and health history of each one.
• Follow a visit as it happens, and read the vet's report afterwards.
• Ask for an emergency visit when an animal needs one.
• Invoices, payments and statements of account.
• Raise a concern and follow what is done about it.

FOR FARM WORKERS
Reporting is done by tapping a picture rather than typing: a sick animal, a birth, a death, an empty water trough and more. Add photographs, a short video or a spoken note. It is built so that a worker who cannot read or write can still report what is happening, and the vet picks it up on the next visit.

MEDICINE SAFETY
Withdrawal periods are enforced by the system. An animal still inside the withdrawal window of a medicine cannot be released for slaughter, and any override is recorded with the reason and the person who gave it.

ENGLISH AND ARABIC
Every screen works in both languages, right-to-left included, and you can switch at any time.

Mawashi Farm Management is provided to Mawashi's contracted customers and staff. To arrange access, please contact Mawashi.

name: MBSI Staff
description:
MBSI Staff is the official app for MBSI school employees.

  • Attendance – check in and out at work with location confirmation
  • Salary – see your monthly pay, bonuses and deductions with a day-by-day breakdown
  • Tasks – receive assignments, track deadlines and report progress
  • Notifications – get instant alerts about new tasks and important updates
  • Schedule – view lessons and daily timetables
  • Management tools – administrators can manage staff, classes, finances and reports

  Accounts are issued by the school administration. The app is for MBSI employees only.

name: MEA-AI
description:
MIA is your AI business assistant from Mulltiply — an exclusive app for store admins who want answers about their business without digging through reports. Ask a question in plain English or Hinglish and MIA answers from your own live store data: sales, orders, payments, stock, customers and items. No dashboards to learn, no filters to set. Just ask.
Key Features:
Conversational Business Answers: Ask about sales, orders, payments, stock, customers or items in everyday language. MIA reads your store’s live data and answers in seconds.
English & Hinglish: Ask however you speak. “Is mahine ki sales kitni hai?” works exactly as well as “What are this month’s sales?” MIA replies in the language you asked in.
Answers as They Are Written: Replies appear as MIA composes them, so you start reading immediately instead of watching a spinner.
Reports & Downloadable Files: Ask for a report and get a formatted summary on screen — or an Excel file you can download, save and share, with the row count up front.
Follow-Up Suggestions: Every answer comes with related questions you can tap to go deeper, so one question naturally leads to the next.
Chat History That Follows You: Conversations are saved to your Mulltiply account, not to your phone. Reinstall the app or switch devices and your chats are still there. Search them, reopen any one, or start fresh whenever you like.
Notifications: MIA tells you when something in your business needs your attention, so you know before you have to ask.
Flag an Answer, Get a Reply: If an answer looks wrong, report it in one tap. The Mulltiply team reviews it and replies inside the app, and you can follow whether it is being looked at, planned or fixed.
Admin-Only Access: MIA opens only for Mulltiply accounts with admin access, so your business data stays with the people who should see it.
Made Yours: Choose Light, Dark, or follow your device. Switch the app’s language between English and Hindi — MIA still answers in whichever language you ask in.
Why Choose MIA?
Answers, Not Dashboards:
Skip the reports, filters and exports. Ask the question you actually have and get the number you actually need.
Built on Your Real Data:
MIA reads your live Mulltiply store — the same orders, payments and stock your team works with every day. Nothing is estimated and nothing is stale.
Speaks How You Speak:
English, Hinglish, or a mix of both. Your assistant adapts to you rather than the other way around.
Your Work, Everywhere:
Chats live with your account, so the answer you found this morning is still there tonight, on any device you sign in from.
Getting Started:
Sign In With Your Mulltiply Account:
Enter your mobile number and the verification code we send you. You will need an existing Mulltiply account with admin access.
Ask Your First Question:
Try “Aaj ki sales kitni hui?” or “Which items are running low?” and see what comes back.
Make It Part of Your Day:
Check in each morning, download the reports you need, and let MIA do the digging.
Our Mission
Mulltiply builds tools that let local businesses run on real information rather than guesswork. MIA takes the data already sitting in your store and makes it something you can simply ask about — putting the kind of instant business intelligence large retailers take for granted into the hands of every seller.
Need Help?
For any queries or issues, contact us at admin@mulltiply.org. We’re here to assist you!
Download Now!
Stop hunting through reports. Ask MIA, and get on with your day.

name: Meadow Loop
description:
Welcome to Meadow Loop, your peaceful digital getaway!

Guide a cute, fluffy creature through beautifully painted meadows. Gather glowing flowers and solve gentle, rhythm-based puzzles to clear your path. There are no timers and no stress—just soothing music, pastel colors, and a charming world to explore. Perfect for a quick break or a meditative session. Download now and find your rhythm!

name: Mecaneo
description:
Mecaneo es un curso completo de mecanografía para aprender a escribir con los diez dedos sin mirar el teclado. Está pensado para que lo pueda seguir cualquiera, vea o no la pantalla.

El curso tiene nueve bloques y cuarenta y nueve lecciones que se abren en orden: la fila central, la superior y la inferior, las tres filas juntas, los acentos y las mayúsculas, los números, los signos y, al final, textos y dictados. Cada lección te explica con frases sencillas dónde poner los dedos y con qué dedo va cada tecla. Lo que falles se repite, y cada lección se puntúa con hasta tres estrellas.

Dos estilos en la misma app:
• Infantil: con Teclo, un personaje con voz propia, mucho sonido y celebraciones.
• Adulto: más sobrio, con colores y sonidos cuidados.

Y para ponerte a prueba, la Escalada: cinco tipos de prueba centrados en el ritmo (contrarreloj, memoria, racha, al compás y relámpago).

Con «Tu progreso» ves tu velocidad, tu precisión, las teclas que debes vigilar y tu constancia.

Accesible desde el principio:
• Se juega igual viendo la pantalla que con lector de pantalla.
• Las consignas se dicen con pausas, letra a letra cuando hace falta, y con una palabra de referencia para cada letra que puedes quitar.
• Letras grandes, estructura sencilla y sonidos para cada acierto y cada fallo.
• El dictado final tiene voz propia.

Cuenta de Ferna Juegos opcional para guardar tu progreso y recuperarlo en cualquier dispositivo, también en la web. Puedes entrar con un código por correo o con Face ID.

Mecaneo enseña mecanografía con teclado español. Puedes probarlo con el teclado en pantalla, pero para aprender de verdad a escribir con los diez dedos lo mejor es un teclado físico, por ejemplo uno Bluetooth. Es gratis y no tiene anuncios.

name: Mehndi Design: Bridal & Arabic
description:
Looking for easy, new and trending mehndi designs for your wedding, Eid or any function? Mehndi Design: Bridal & Arabic is a
henna design app that lets you preview a design on your hand, trace it on paper and save your favourites.
 KEY FEATURES
 Virtual Hand Try-On: place a transparent mehndi stencil on your live hand with the camera, adjust size, opacity and position with
pinch and drag, then take a photo before applying real henna.
Paper Trace Mode: turn any design into a sharp black-and-white stencil, place paper on your screen (brightness goes to
maximum automatically) and trace.
 Screen Touch Lock: lock the screen so your touches do not zoom or move the design while you trace.
1-Tap Mirror: flip any design from the right hand to the left hand instantly.
HD Zoom: zoom in on every dot, flower, peacock and mandala line in clear detail.
 Favourites, Download & Share: save your favourites, download designs to your gallery and share them with friends or your
mehndi artist on WhatsApp, Instagram and more.
DESIGN CATEGORIES
• Bridal Mehndi Design
• Arabic Mehndi Design
• Front Hand Mehndi
• Back Hand Mehndi
• Finger & Minimal Mehndi
• Feet & Ankle (Payal) Mehndi
• Indo-Arabic & Gol Tikki
• Festival Specials: Eid, Karwa Chauth, Diwali, Teej
Download Mehndi Design: Bridal & Arabic and find your next henna design today.

name: Memo Mender: Join Voice Memos
description:
Join your voice memos into one clean file — no clicks, no gaps, no dead air where the recordings meet.

Recorded a lecture in parts, practised a speech in takes, or hummed an idea six times? Add the recordings, put them in order, and Memo Mender joins them into a single file you can send, upload or keep.

SMOOTH JOINS
Every join gets a short crossfade, so there's no click or jump where one recording ends and the next begins. Tap any join to hear it, lengthen or shorten the fade, or nudge where it falls.

NO DEAD AIR
Long silences between recordings are shortened to a natural pause. Nothing inside a recording is touched — only the joins change.

CHAPTERS
M4A exports carry a chapter for each recording, named after it, so you can skip straight to part 3.

ON YOUR PHONE
Memo Mender never uploads anything. No account, no analytics, no microphone access, no subscription. Paid once.

What it isn't: it doesn't record, remove noise, or edit inside a recording.

Add recordings from Files, or share them to Memo Mender from another app's share sheet.

Support: https://resonantlab.ai/apps/memomender · Privacy: https://resonantlab.ai/apps/memomender/privacy

name: MENACPA - منصة المحاسبين
description:
MENACPA هي المنصة العربية للمحاسبين والمراجعين والمختصين في المالية والزكاة والضرائب في الشرق الأوسط وشمال أفريقيا.

اسأل واحصل على إجابة
• اطرح سؤالك المحاسبي أو الضريبي واحصل على أول إجابة فورية بالذكاء الاصطناعي، ثم إجابات من محاسبين وخبراء معتمدين.
• صوّت لأفضل إجابة واحفظ الأسئلة المهمة.

مساحات النقاش

• شارك قيود اليومية وصور الفواتير واستطلاعات الرأي مع زملائك.

أدوات للمحاسب
• حاسبات وأدوات عملية، تقويم المواعيد النظامية، وميزان المراجعة.
• مكتبة محاسبية وأكاديمية للتعلم المستمر.

وظائف وأخبار

name: Menubeam: TV Menu Board
description:
Menubeam turns a TV in your store into a digital menu board. Change menus, prices, sold-out status, and notices on your iPhone, and the TV updates right away.

Features
- Manage categories and menu items with photos
- Mark items as sold out with one tap
- Scroll notices at the bottom of the TV
- Preview your board on your phone
- Pair a TV with a QR code or 6-digit number
- Keeps showing the last menu during an internet outage

How it works
1. Create categories and add menu items in this app.
2. Install the free Menubeam TV app on a Google TV or Android TV device.
3. Scan the QR code shown on the TV to connect it.

The TV display needs the Menubeam TV app on a Google TV or Android TV device (a Google TV streaming stick works with any TV). Samsung Tizen and LG webOS TVs are not supported.

name: Meokgil: Ink Path Puzzle
description:
Paint your way to the pavilion.

A scholar walks among rocks floating in the mountain mist. Where the path breaks, a single drop of ink becomes a stepping stone — but ink is always scarce. Where you place it, and in what order you walk, is the puzzle.

• Turn the view and the bridges on the discs turn with it. Rotating the camera is part of the puzzle.
• Step on an inkstone to grind one more drop.
• Gather every lantern to light the pavilion.
• Three seals in every chapter: clear it, clear it without hints, clear it within the step limit.
• Finish all ten chapters to open the Endless Path, which grows wider with every stage.

Stuck? A hint shows only your next move. Gayageum and daegeum music, gentle haptics, and ink bleeding into hanji paper.
No ads, no accounts, works offline.

name: MeshLive: Live Video & Calls
description:
MeshLive lets you call people near you, and watch live video from nearby phones, directly over Bluetooth. There is no internet, SIM card or account to set up.

CALL PEOPLE NEARBY
- Voice and video calls between phones that are close to each other, end-to-end encrypted.
- Hold to talk when you only want your microphone on for a moment.
- Add people you trust by scanning each other's code. Nothing goes through a server.

WATCH AND LISTEN
- Watch livestreams from nearby phones.
- Listen to audio-only livestreams, like a local radio, with the screen off.

YOU DECIDE WHAT PEOPLE SEE
- Nearby phones normally see a generated name and a temporary ID that changes every 15 minutes.
- Your real name goes only to the people you allow.
- Block or report anyone from a call, a livestream or the list of people nearby.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account, no ads, no tracking, no analytics. MeshLive collects no data.
- Calls and streams are encrypted. A nearby Bluetooth scanner can still tell that a MeshLive device is there, and MeshLive does not make you anonymous.
- Delete everything erases your keys, contacts and settings from the phone.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Both people need MeshLive and must be within about 20 metres of each other.
- iOS lets MeshLive be found only while the app is open. Keep it open to receive calls: a closed app cannot ring.
- Works with MeshLive on other iPhones and on Android phones.
- You must be 18 or older. MeshLive does not replace calling emergency services.
- Free and open source, under the GNU General Public License version 3 or later.

Terms of use: https://meshlive.github.io/terms/
Privacy policy: https://meshlive.github.io/privacy/

name: Metro Tales
description:
oard the last train and see where the story takes you.

In Metro Tales, a chapter is a station and a choice is a route. Ride through a firefly garden, carry a letter to a cloud, help a whale settle down, or find shelter for a fox in the snow. Each included story has two endings. Your journey map shows the stops you've visited, so you can return to a junction and see what happens down the other track.

Have a story of your own? Write a chapter, add a choice, and link it to the next station. Watch the routes take shape on a subway map as you write. You can illustrate chapters with photos you select from your device.

Continue at your last station when you come back, make the text larger, or turn on bedtime mode for a warmer reading screen. Metro Tales works offline, and your stories and reading progress stay on your device.

name: Meu Lanchinho
seller_name: F. FIGUEIREDO DE MENEZES DESENVOLVIMENTO DE SOFTWARE LTDA
description:
Em um toque, o Meu Lanchinho monta o cardápio da lancheira da semana inteira:
cinco dias, sem repetir, equilibrado e dentro do que a sua criança pode comer.

a compra.

UMA TAREFA SÓ, BEM-FEITA

O app não tenta organizar a sua vida inteira. Ele resolve a lancheira escolar,
que é uma decisão repetida toda semana e cansa.

RESPEITA AS RESTRIÇÕES

Marque alergia, intolerância ou escolha da família: amendoim, castanhas,
gergelim, leite, ovo, glúten, soja. Nada com essas marcas entra no cardápio.
Cada filho tem as próprias restrições e as regras da escola dele, porque
irmãos podem estudar em escolas diferentes.

SEM REPETIR, SEMANA APÓS SEMANA

O cardápio considera as semanas anteriores para dar rodízio. Não gostou de um
item? Toque para trocar. Gostou? Segure para travar, e ele fica no lugar
quando você gerar a semana de novo.

A LISTA DE COMPRAS PRONTA

Agrupada por categoria, com as quantidades somadas quando há mais de um filho.
Marque o que já está na sacola e compartilhe em texto com quem vai ao mercado.

O LANCHE DE AMANHÃ NA TELA DE INÍCIO

Um widget mostra o lanche de hoje pela manhã e o de amanhã à tarde. E um
lembrete avisa na véspera, no horário que você escolher, só em dias letivos.

CRIADO POR PEDIATRA

O catálogo de alimentos e as regras de composição do lanche foram definidos e
revisados por pediatra. Sem ultraprocessados.

FUNCIONA SEM INTERNET

Nada sai do seu iPhone. Sem conta, sem login, sem cadastro, sem anúncios e sem
rastreamento. O app não coleta dado nenhum.

GRÁTIS E DESBLOQUEIO

Grátis: uma criança, a semana atual e o catálogo completo.

Desbloqueio vitalício, compra única e sem assinatura: vários filhos, semanas
ilimitadas com histórico e rodízio, regras da escola, cadastro dos alimentos
da sua casa, lembrete e widget.

As sugestões são de caráter geral e não substituem a orientação do pediatra
que acompanha a sua criança.

name: Mi Lista de Regalos
description:
Arma la lista de regalos de tu celebración y compártela con tu familia y amigos en un solo enlace.

Sirve para bodas, baby showers, cumpleaños, quince años, té de cocina, graduaciones, bautizos, casa nueva, Navidad y cualquier otra celebración.

CÓMO FUNCIONA
• Creas tu lista y le agregas los regalos que te gustaría recibir, con foto, descripción, cantidad y dónde comprarlos.
• La compartes por WhatsApp con un enlace.
• Tus invitados abren el enlace, escogen qué regalar y lo reservan con su nombre. No necesitan instalar nada ni crear cuenta.
• Los regalos reservados desaparecen de la lista, así nadie repite.
• Tú ves en todo momento quién regala qué.

UNA LISTA CON TU ESTILO
• Temas para cada tipo de celebración: marfil y dorado para bodas, celeste para baby showers, fiesta para cumpleaños y más.
• Sube una foto de portada y la lista toma sus colores.
• Fecha y hora del evento, con botón para agregarlo al calendario.
• Tiendas sugeridas para cada regalo, con enlace y ubicación.

GRATIS
Crea una lista con hasta 12 regalos sin pagar nada.

Tu información es tuya: puedes borrar tu cuenta y todos tus datos desde la app cuando quieras.

name: Mi Shas: Talmud Bavli
description:
Mi Shas te ayuda a llevar la cuenta de tu estudio del Talmud Bavli, daf por daf.

Marca lo que estudias en segundos y ve siempre cuánto llevas, cuánto te falta y cuándo terminas el Shas a tu ritmo real.

LO QUE PUEDES HACER
• Marcar uno o varios dapim a la vez, con su fecha, eligiendo amud א o ב.
• Ver tu avance total y por masejet, con las 37 masejtot del Bavli.
• Ponerte una meta: unos dapim al día o terminar en una fecha. La app te dice cuántos dapim necesitas o cuándo terminas.
• Elegir tus días de estudio (cada quien los suyos, viernes y sábado incluidos).
• Ver tu ritmo real de hoy, esta semana, los últimos 7 o 30 días, o desde la fecha que quieras.
• Historial por día, deshacer y rehacer cualquier cambio, y mover lo de un día a otra fecha.
• Recordatorios y felicitaciones para no perder la racha. Nunca en Shabat ni en tus horas de dormir.
• Modo oscuro y entrada con Face ID.

EMPIEZA EN 1 MINUTO
Crea tu cuenta con tu correo, elige tus días de estudio, marca las masejtot que ya terminaste y dónde vas, y pon tu meta. Tu información queda guardada en tu cuenta y la ves igual en el celular o en la web.

Sin anuncios. Tus datos son tuyos: puedes borrar tu cuenta cuando quieras desde la app.

name: Mica: Pure RAW & Film Camera
description:
Give Light Back to Optics.

Somewhere along the way, phone cameras stopped trusting light. Multi-frame HDR began lifting every shadow into flat, weightless gray. Synthetic sharpening started carving brittle white halos around faces and rooflines. Photographs became cleaner on a spec sheet - and lifeless to the human eye.

Mica is built on a different premise: light does not need to be invented when it is captured cleanly at the source.

Instead of feeding processed frames through synthetic tone-mapping, Mica reads unprocessed 14-bit linear Bayer RAW photon data directly off the sensor. It normalizes every sensor into linear CIE XYZ color space, applies physical highlight diffusion optics, and develops your frame through six master film and thick-dye CCD emulsions - entirely on your device, in real time.

UNPROCESSED 14-BIT BAYER RAW
- Captures pure linear sensor photon data with deep, dimensional blacks and organic highlight roll-off.
- Zero synthetic depth-cutout blur. Zero interpolated digital pinch-zoom upscaling.
- Pixel-to-pixel prime brightline framing across 13mm, 28mm, 35mm, 40mm, and 50mm (plus native 77mm optical telephoto on supported Pro hardware), keeping surrounding street context visible outside the frame line so you can anticipate the decisive moment.

SIX MASTER FILM & CCD EMULSIONS
Every emulsion in Mica 1.0 is unlocked out of the box - no subscriptions, no locked rolls:
- Posi Chrome: High street micro-contrast, disciplined shadow density, and rich primary separation.
- Nega Soft: Airy highlight shoulder and gentle warmth built for golden hour and daily reportage.
- Mono Hi: High-contrast silver monochrome with red-orange luminance weight and crisp metallic grain.
- K-18 Full CCD: Dense, oil-rich color separation inspired by classic full-frame thick-filter CCD backs.
- SR Portrait CCD: Wide highlight latitude and translucent rosy-ivory skin gradations.
- Compact '05 CCD: Punchy global S-curve contrast paired with early-2000s direct-flash porcelain tones.

PHYSICAL HIGHLIGHT DIFFUSION & NATURAL SKIN
- Highlight Diffusion Filter (HDF): Stepped (Off, I, II, III) and stepless Mie-scattering glow that blooms high-energy specular catchlights and backlit hair while keeping 90% of structural ray detail tack-sharp.
- Translucent Portrait Skin: Frequency-separated midtone refinement that calms harsh digital sensor grit on skin while preserving eyelashes, pupils, eyebrows, lips, and hair strands at 100% native RAW acuity.
- Context-Aware Illumination: Hardware rear direct flash sync (Off, Auto Night, Forced Fill), switching automatically on the front camera to a customizable Screen-Edge Softlight Halo (6200K Cool Porcelain, 5200K Daylight, 3800K Warm Peach).

BUILT FOR EVERY POSTURE - INCLUDING IPHONE DUO
- Instant toggle between continuous Eye-AF tracking and zero-lag hyperfocal Snap Focus (1.0m, 1.5m, 2.5m, 5.0m, Infinity), plus custom U1 / U2 / U3 optical recipe slots.
- Purpose-built across iPhone Pro, iPad, and foldable iPhone Duo: shoot one-handed on the closed outer deck, unfold into a two-column medium-format optical studio with live luminance/RGB waveform scopes, or half-fold at 90 degrees into a ground-glass Waist-Level Finder with a 2.5x critical magnifier and spirit level.

120HZ NON-DESTRUCTIVE .DNG DARKROOM
- Every shutter press saves a 10-bit Display P3 HEIF or maximum-quality P3 JPEG to Photos while archiving a rolling 50-shot Film Box of untouched .DNG negatives (star favorites to keep forever, or import external lossless .DNG files).
- Re-develop any negative at 120Hz: swap emulsions, trim exposure, HDF bloom, and silver grain, inspect with a split-wipe curtain and 2x optical pixel loupe, and finish with Museum White or Obsidian Black archival mats and retro quartz date stamps.

PRIVATE BY ARCHITECTURE
No accounts. No cloud uploads. No analytics or tracking. Every RAW negative and developed frame stays strictly on your device.

name: Michele Personal
description:
The app for clients of Michele Gomes, a personal trainer in Cape Cod, Massachusetts. Access is by invitation: Michele sends you a link, you confirm your date of birth and create your password.

Today's workout
Open the app and see the workout suggested for today, your next session with Michele and how many days you trained this month.

Guided workouts, set by set
Every exercise shows photos of the movement, sets, reps, load and Michele's notes. Mark a set as done and the rest timer starts on its own; your iPhone buzzes when it's time to go again. The screen stays on while you train.

Works offline
Weak signal at the gym is not a problem: the finished workout is kept on your iPhone and reaches Michele as soon as you are back online.

Step by step for every exercise
Instructions in English or Portuguese and, when available, a video of the exercise.

Points, challenges and milestones
Every training day is worth 10 points. Michele sets challenges for you, like 12 workouts by the end of the month, and you follow your progress. Milestones count workouts and weeks in a row, never weight or comparisons with anyone else.

Messages with Michele
Ask a question, let her know about a change of plans or tell her how the workout went. Michele also shares food and habit guidance you agreed on together.

Notices at the right time
Get a notice when Michele sends a message or a new workout, and 2 hours before your session.

Your data
Your information lives on Michele's private server, with an encrypted backup. You can request account deletion in the app, under My account.

name: Midge: Bug Reports
description:
Midge turns a bug on your iPhone or iPad into a report your team can act on: a screen recording or a marked-up screenshot, with the logs that explain it, in your Midge workspace, and a link that's copied the moment you tap Send.

RECORD THE SCREEN
• Record any app, not just Midge, with your voice if you like. Or use the camera for a bug on another screen.
• Start it from the app, Control Center, the Action Button or Siri ("Record a bug with Midge").
• When you stop, a notification brings you back with the video ready: trim it, cut parts out, send.
• Show your taps in the video: Midge sets up AssistiveTouch with you, in a few steps.

THE LOGS COME WITH IT
• Turn on Midge in Safari, and a web page you record comes with its console errors, network requests and clicks.
• Passwords, tokens, cookies and card numbers are removed on your iPhone, before anything is sent.
• Your device, iOS version and screen size are attached, so whoever opens it knows where it happened.

WATCH AND FIX
• Open any report in the app: the video, an AI summary with steps to reproduce and the likely cause, and the logs.
• Tap a log line and the video jumps there. Filter to the errors and failed requests.
• Search everything your workspace has sent.

SCREENSHOTS
• Share a screenshot to Midge straight from the screenshot editor, Photos or Files.
• Mark it up: arrows, boxes, a pen, text, and blur for anything that shouldn't be seen. Blur is burned into the image.
• Hide private info in one tap: Midge finds emails, card numbers, phone numbers and keys, on your phone, and blurs them.

A LINK IN SECONDS
• The link is copied as soon as you tap Send, while the upload finishes.
• Nothing gets stuck: an interrupted upload resumes where it stopped, and anything not sent yet waits on your phone.
• Leave the title empty and Midge names it from what's in the recording.

THE SAME MIDGE AS EVERYWHERE
• The same account, workspaces and links as Midge's Chrome extension, Mac app and website.
• Send to Slack, Jira, Linear or GitHub from midge.dev.
• Someone sent you a recording link? Open it in Midge and record your screen for them, with no account.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• Nothing leaves your phone until you tap Send.
• Choose who can open each report: anyone with the link, your workspace, or only you.

Midge is free: unlimited recordings, videos up to 15 minutes, no watermark.
