name: Milky Frog Merge Evolve
description:
Guide a creamy-yellow tadpole into the pond to find its own kind, dodge danger, and compete with a rival for opportunities to grow. Grow hind legs, develop all four limbs, and lose your tail, then evolve from an adult Milky Frog into increasingly quirky fantasy forms. Enjoy the journey from a tiny creature to a big Milky Frog.

Find Your Kind and Merge Three to Grow 
Find two companions at your level to automatically merge into the next form. Simply drag to steer as you swim and search, looking forward to the excitement of your next merge.

Eat Smaller Creatures, Dodge Bigger Ones, and Return Stronger
Eat lower-level creatures to build up growth, and steer clear of higher-level threats. Being swallowed sets you back a stage, while the lowest stage offers a chance to respawn. Find more companions, keep growing, and work your way back into the race.

From Pond to Shore, Growth Changes Where You Can Go
Search for companions in the water during the early stages. As an adult Milky Frog, you can move between water and land, while later forms roam the grass. Explore different areas as your character grows and discover new opportunities to merge.

Race Your Rival for the Same Companions
A rival controlled by your device is also searching for companions and evolving. Choose your direction, reach matching companions first, and enjoy casual competition as you race toward the final Divine Frog form.

Quirkier with Every Evolution, More to Discover with Every Merge
Chubby Frog, Mighty Frog, Arms-Crossed Frog, Angel Frog, Laughing Frog… Creamy-yellow characters with distinctive poses give you something new to look forward to with every evolution.

name: MingTag
description:
MingTag turns the café you are sitting in into a place to meet people.

Scan the QR sticker on your table and you are in. You can see who else is in the café right now, look at their profile, and send a connection request. If they accept, you can chat — text, photos, voice notes, and your location if you choose to share it.

• Scan your table, and you are visible only to people in the same café
• See the live floor: which tables are taken and who is at them
• Send a connection request, and chat only after they accept
• Share photos, voice notes and stickers in chat
• Share your location with a connection when you want to, and stop any time
• Block or report anybody, and delete your account from inside the app

Nobody can message you until you accept their request, and you stop being visible the moment you leave the table.

name: Minik Bostan
description:
A little soil. A little peace.

Give your farm a name and start with a handful of seeds. Prepare the soil, choose the in-game nutrient recipe, plant, water and watch your crops grow. No races or expiring orders: just a small farming break at your own pace.

FROM SOIL TO SALE
Grow 12 crops, from carrots and wheat to strawberries, oranges, lemons and mandarins. Harvest into your depot, pack two matching products into a crate, then sell it for game coins to buy seeds and new land.

FOUR REGIONS, 36 PLOTS
Explore the Vegetable Patch, Orchard, Open Fields and Valley. Unlock plots in order while crops in your other regions keep growing. Apple and citrus trees stay after harvest and bear fruit again.

WEATHER AND LITTLE UPGRADES
Sun, rain, frost, snow and storms shape your farm’s weather cycle. Give stressed plants a fictional recovery treatment in mild weather. After your first two harvests, install permanent drip irrigation on individual plots. A frost fan can help citrus in calm inversion frost; it is not protection against every type of cold.

A FRIENDLY VILLAGE
Fill neighbor orders without deadlines, deliver crates and earn small gifts. Decorate your fence, path and depot. Little visitors and lucky harvests bring your farm to life.

YOUR OFFLINE BREAK
Play in English or Turkish. The game is bundled inside the app and works offline from its first launch. No account, ads, subscription or in-app purchases. Progress saves automatically on your device and is not sent to the developer's server. Uninstalling the app or resetting its data may erase progress. There is no in-game account sync between devices.

Plants never disappear. When you return, the game calculates up to the last six hours of weather and care. Coins are a game resource only and cannot be exchanged for real money.

Farming, fertilizer, micronutrients, recovery and weather effects use simplified game rules. They are not real-world deficiency diagnoses, fertilizer doses or frost-control instructions.

name: MiniVids: Meme Video Effects
description:
Turn any clip into a moment people replay. Tap a person, pet or object in your video and MiniVids adds a real animated effect that locks onto it and follows it through the shot.

FREE FOR 7 DAYS, THEN PAY ONCE
Try every effect free for 7 days. After that, one small payment unlocks MiniVids forever. No monthly subscription and no weekly fees like most effect apps. Pay once and keep it, with future updates included.

THE LASER SCAN
A glowing laser sweeps across the frame, outlines your subject and locks on with a target readout. Pick green, red, blue, cyan, purple, amber, pink or white and choose the scan direction.

12 EFFECTS PEOPLE ACTUALLY WANT
• Laser Scan: sweep, outline and lock on
• Laser Eyes: glowing beams on every face
• Dramatic Zoom: punch in with a boom
• Spotlight: dim the world, light up the star
• Color Pop: your subject in color, the rest in black and white
• Red Circle: circle it and point at it, thumbnail style
• That's Me: freeze frame, record scratch and caption
• Impact Frame: anime speed lines and a shockwave
• Glitch: VHS or digital meltdown
• Deal With It: pixel shades drop onto every face
• Slow Mo Replay: instant replay in slow motion
• To Be Continued: freeze, sepia tone and the famous arrow

SMART AND EFFORTLESS
• Tap to choose any subject. It is outlined and tracked automatically as it moves
• Faces are found for you for Laser Eyes and Deal With It
• Every effect has its own sound effect
• Adjust color, length, strength and captions
• Works with videos and photos, or record a new clip

SAVE AND SHARE IN SECONDS
• Export in 720p, 1080p or full resolution up to 4K
• Save to Photos or share straight to your favorite social media apps
• No watermark on your videos

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything is rendered on your device. No account, no uploads, no tracking.

MADE FOR SOCIAL MEDIA
Perfect for memes, reactions, stories, sports highlights, pet videos, gaming clips and short videos that need that extra punch to go viral.

name: MiroVIP: Football Analysis
description:
MiroVIP brings MiroTiper's football content together in one app: AI match analysis from MiroBot, daily picks from Miro, live match data in MiroLive, and articles and audio in MiroFM.

MiroVIP is an information and analysis service. It is not a bookmaker: it does not accept or place bets and never handles stakes. Picks, probabilities and signals are estimates based on available data, not a guarantee of any result or winnings. For users aged 18 and over.

MiroBot – AI match analysis
• Daily AI predictions for football matches, filtered by league, confidence level and bet type
• Every prediction shows the market, the odds and a confidence level, with a short match commentary
• Match center with overview, team comparison and lineups
• Top picks grouped by historical quality tier, with an explanation of why each pick was selected
• Daily Slip: choose the pick pool, bet types, odds range and number of picks, and MiroBot assembles a daily combination to your rules
• Combination generator, a betslip preview and saved tickets for your own pick combinations
• Statistics of settled predictions by confidence level, bet type, league and period, so you can see where the model has been more and less accurate

MiroTiper – Miro's picks
• Picks shared by Miro, organized by day
• Miro's written briefings and audio commentary, with translated audio when available
• The original message is always available exactly as it was sent
• Settled results for each day's picks
• Share a pick with friends

MiroLive – live match data
• Live and upcoming matches with results, a match center, live updates, statistics and lineups
• Live signals for goal activity, attacking pressure, corners, cards and more, showing the minute each signal appeared. Signals are probability-based information, not a guaranteed result
• Follow the matches, teams and leagues you care about

MiroFM – football stories
• Football analysis, original articles and team performance context
• Audio versions for listening on the go, with background playback
• Searchable archive

Account and security
• Sign in with Apple or with a MiroVIP email account (separate from your MiroTiper website account)
• Optional unlock with Face ID or Touch ID
• See and sign out of your signed-in devices
• Delete your account in the app at any time
• Available in English, Slovak and Polish

Passes
Content in MiroVIP requires an account and an active pass. Passes are one-time in-app purchases for MiroBot, MiroTiper or both combined, for 1 to 6 months. MiroLive and MiroFM are included with every pass. Passes never renew automatically: you pay only for the period you choose, and the price is shown before you buy.

Play responsibly
MiroVIP is for adults only. Tips are information, not a guarantee of winnings. If gambling stops being fun, take a break and seek help, for example at gamblingtherapy.org.

name: Mirror Gate: Puzzle
description:
Mirror Gate is a physics puzzle game. Your hero walks on its own — you just place purple and green mirrors on the walls. Step into purple, come out of green, keeping all your speed! Fall from high, launch across the room, grab the key and unlock the doors.

100 levels, every one verified solvable. The last ones have only one solution among hundreds of possibilities.

• One-handed, portrait play
• 100 levels with a 3-star system
• Locked doors, keys, spikes and momentum puzzles
• Works offline, no ads

name: Misate
description: Misate is a quiet puzzle space for thoughtful grid navigation. Swipe in four directions to slide all colored blocks simultaneously toward matching targets across handcrafted boards. Completely free with no ads or subscriptions, it features one hundred hand-verified levels, unlimited undo, and a daily challenge streak. Enjoy a calm, pressure-free mental workout anytime.

name: MisNotas en Clase
description:
MisNotas conecta a tu familia con el colegio. Mira las notas, las tareas y la asistencia de tus hijos en el momento en que pasan, sin esperar a la reunión de padres.

IMPORTANTE: MisNotas funciona con la cuenta que te da tu institución educativa. Si tu colegio todavía no usa MisNotas, no podrás iniciar sesión.

PARA PADRES Y ENCARGADOS
• Notas por materia y por periodo, y la boleta de calificaciones.
• Tareas pendientes, entregadas y calificadas de cada hijo.
• Aviso cuando tu hijo entra al colegio, llega tarde o falta a una clase.
• Código QR familiar para marcar la entrada de tus hijos en la portería.
• Anuncios, eventos del calendario y mensajes directos con maestros y la dirección.
• Estado de cuenta: cargos, pagos y envío de comprobantes.
• Reportes de conducta y avisos de ausencia.
• Aviso cuando tu hijo sube y baja del bus escolar.

PARA ALUMNOS
• Tus tareas con fecha de entrega, y entrega de archivos y fotos desde el teléfono.
• Tus notas, tu horario de clases y tu asistencia.
• Tu código QR para marcar la entrada.

PARA MAESTROS
• Crea, publica y califica tareas desde el teléfono.
• Pasa lista en clase, con código QR o a mano.
• Envía anuncios y eventos a tus grupos y responde consultas.

Tus datos están protegidos: cada persona ve solo lo que le corresponde, y puedes desbloquear la app con Face ID.

Política de privacidad: https://misnotasenclase.com/privacidad

name: Miss North Florida
description:
The official app for delegates, families and staff of the Miss North Florida Scholarship Pageant.

- Schedule: every check-in, rehearsal, interview and pageant, with reminders before each event
- Handbook: the full delegate handbook, always in your pocket
- Updates: announcements from the pageant team
- Check-In: your personal QR code for fast check-in, even when signal is low
- Live Stream: watch the pageant live, right in the app
- Meet the Team: get to know the people behind the pageant
- Need Help?: message the pageant staff directly

Powered by Pageant Concepts AV.

name: MixDecant
description: Enter a drink’s concentrate and water parts and the volume you want to make. See the amount to pour for each ingredient and a visual ratio scale. Save and search recipes and review their combined ingredient quantities. Calculations run on the device.

name: MixteGO - Tiendas y Viajes
description:
MixteGO es la super-app creada en la Mixteca y para nuestra gente. Conectamos a clientes, comercios locales y conductores verificados en Heroica Ciudad de Huajuapan de León, Santiago Ayuquililla, Santiago Juxtlahuaca y más en una sola plataforma rápida, segura y fácil de usar.

¿QUÉ PUEDES HACER EN MIXTEGO?

• TIENDAS Y COMIDA A DOMICILIO:
Explora los mejores restaurantes, taquerías, cafeterías, farmacias, abarrotes y comercios locales de tu ciudad. Arma tu carrito, personaliza tu pedido y recíbelo caliente hasta la puerta de tu casa.

• TU NEGOCIO EN LINEA
Registra tu negocio y empieza a vender tus productos a todos en la ciudad y aumenta tus ventas y ganancias.

• VIAJES VIP (TRANSPORTE LOCAL SEGURO):
Solicita transporte rápido desde tu ubicación exacta con tarifas claras antes de viajar. Elige la modalidad que mejor se adapte a ti:
- Taxi Sedán: Comodidad y espacio para ti y tu familia.
- Mototaxi: Ideal para traslados ágiles dentro de tu comunidad.
- Moto Rider: Llega más rápido a tu destino evitando el tráfico.

• MANDADITOS EXPRESS:
¿Se te olvidaron las llaves, necesitas comprar algo en el mercado, pagar un servicio o enviar un paquete urgente dentro de la ciudad? Nuestros repartidores hacen el mandadito por ti.

SEGURIDAD Y TECNOLOGÍA EN TIEMPO REAL:
• Mapa interactivo y seguimiento en vivo del estatus de tu pedido o viaje.
• Código PIN de seguridad y alertas automáticas de proximidad cuando tu repartidor o conductor está a punto de llegar.
• Chat directo con fotos integrado con tu tienda y tu repartidor.
• Soporte local directo y atención personalizada en la región Mixteca.

Descarga MixteGO hoy mismo, elige tu municipio y apoya al comercio local con la mejor tecnología.

name: mkan
description:
mkan — see what's happening around you.

mkan brings together the places you love and the people you know. Check in at real cafés, restaurants, malls and parks, share what you're up to, and see what your friends and your city are talking about.

CHECK IN AT REAL PLACES
• See the places around you, nearest first, with an icon for every kind of place
• Search any place by name
• Check in with a line or a photo, for your friends or for everyone
• Every check-in builds your own record of the places you've been

POSTS FROM YOUR COUNTRY
• A feed of what people around you are sharing
• Like, comment and join the conversation
• Switch to Friends to see only the people you know

SHORT VIDEOS
• Full-screen videos up to 30 seconds
• "For you" learns what you enjoy, "Nearby" shows what's around you
• Upload straight from your photos

FRIENDS AND MESSAGES
• Add friends and follow where they've been on your timeline
• Private messages between friends

YOU'RE IN CONTROL
• Choose who sees each post and who sees your record
• Your exact location is never shown to anyone
• Block and report anyone, anytime
• Delete your account from the app whenever you want

mkan works in Arabic and English, in Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain and the UAE.

name: Mncfut
seller_name: ERTEMUR ZIRAAT SANAYI VE TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Thank you for choosing our app; every piece of feedback helps guide our ongoing improvements.

Mncfut is a calm keep-in-touch planner for the friends and family you never want to drift away from.

Everyone you add becomes a small dot orbiting you on a night-sky map. The longer it has been since you last reached out, the further their dot drifts. Log a call, a text, a visit or a letter, and watch them snap right back into your inner ring.

YOUR ORBIT, AT A GLANCE
- A live orbit map: teal dots are in touch, tangerine dots are drifting
- A dashed "due" ring shows exactly when someone needs a hello
- Who is drifting, sorted by how long it has been
- Upcoming birthdays for the next 14, 30 or 60 days
- "Reach out to 3": three gentle suggestions every week, picked from the people who have drifted furthest

A RHYTHM FOR EVERY PERSON
- Weekly, fortnightly, monthly, quarterly or yearly
- Relation, birthday and private notes (kids' names, the best time to call, the dog's name)
- A mini-orbit on every person's page with days since your last touch

LOG A TOUCH IN SECONDS
- Call, text, meet or letter, today or any day back
- A short note about what you talked about
- "Ask next time" items: jot down what to ask about, then tick them off when you do
- Edit or delete any touch later

A TIMELINE WORTH KEEPING
- Every touch grouped by day, filterable by kind
- Touches this week, in the last 30 days, and your weekly streak
- A personal timeline for each person, plus how often you really reach them

SIGN IN YOUR WAY
- Sign in with Apple, Google or email
- Or explore as a guest and save your circle to an account later, without losing anything
- Works offline and syncs when you are back online

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No ads, no tracking, no analytics
- Mncfut never reads your contacts, messages or call history. It only knows what you type
- Your data is stored securely in Google Firebase and only your account can read it
- Delete your account and every person, touch and note from inside the app, any time

Mncfut will not message anyone for you. It simply shows you who has drifted, so the next "how are you?" comes from you.

name: Mo bhaile
description:
Mo bhaile keeps a complete record of your home: what you own, where it is, what it cost, the paperwork that goes with it, and the work that keeps it running. "Mo bhaile" is Irish for "my home".

PHOTOGRAPH IT, CONFIRM IT
Take a photo of an appliance, its label or its receipt, and Mo bhaile drafts the record: name, brand, model, serial number, purchase date and price. You check the draft and save it; nothing is saved until you do. Live Scan picks out several things in one go.

EVERYTHING IN ITS PLACE
• Belongings room by room, with photos, values and a running total
• Receipts, warranties and manuals, with a reminder before a warranty ends
• Look up a model's manual online, and attach the PDF to keep it
• Paints and finishes for each room and, from a room's scan, how much paint its walls need
• Tradespeople, with what they look after, the work they did and what you paid
• Places within each room, from the hall cupboard to the top drawer, so you know where things are kept

PLAN THE UPKEEP
• Maintenance tasks that repeat on your schedule, with reminders
• Checklists for the jobs you do again and again
• A timeline of repairs, improvements and incidents
• Tasks added to your calendar when you want them there

ASK YOUR HOME
The Co-pilot answers from your own records and the text of your manuals and receipts: "When does the dishwasher's warranty end?" or "How do I descale the kettle?" It runs on your device with Apple Intelligence, and it can draft a task or an item for you to check and save.

FLOOR PLANS
Scan a room, or a whole floor room by room, for a measured plan and a 3D view. Pin your things to the plan, and get a route round the house to collect them.

READY FOR A CLAIM
Insurance Readiness shows what's missing: photos, receipts, values. Keep your policy's details, see what it covers, and turn an incident into a claim, with a PDF and a spreadsheet of what was lost.

SHARE WITH YOUR HOUSEHOLD
Share a home through iCloud with the people you live with. Choose who can make changes and who can only look, and see who added each record.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your records stay on your devices and in your own iCloud. There are no accounts, no servers of ours, no ads and no tracking.
• The AI runs on your device. Nothing is sent to an AI service.
• Everything works without the AI too: you can always add things yourself.
• Lock the app with Face ID, and export everything, or a Home Binder PDF, whenever you like.

ALSO
• Siri and Shortcuts: add an item, check a warranty, log maintenance done, open an item
• Your items in Spotlight search
• A widget with the tasks due and the warranties ending
• More than one home, such as a holiday home
• iPhone and iPad

The AI features need Apple Intelligence on a device that supports it. Floor plans need a device with a LiDAR Scanner.

name: MoaDuo
description:
MoaDuo is a Safari extension for the iPhone Duo outer display.

When the iPhone Duo is folded, Safari keeps a column of buttons on the right side of the outer display, and web pages stop short of it. MoaDuo stretches phone-width pages under that column so they use the whole screen.

WIDE VIEW
• Pages fill the full width of the outer display, under Safari's side buttons.
• Links and buttons that end up under the column still respond to taps.
• Bars stuck to the top or bottom of a page keep their buttons within reach.
• Stays wide on sites that redraw themselves, such as React and Next.js web apps.
• Desktop-width pages and screens without side buttons are left as Safari shows them.

ADJUST
• Blur or shade the page behind Safari's side buttons so the buttons stand out.
• Turn Wide View off for any site, or everywhere, from the MoaDuo menu in Safari.

PRIVACY
• MoaDuo changes the page layout on your device only. It collects no data and sends nothing over the network.

FREE TRIAL AND PURCHASE
• MoaDuo is free to download. Try Wide View free for 7 days, then buy it once to keep it. There is no subscription, and you are never charged automatically. When the trial ends without a purchase, Wide View stops.

MoaDuo works on the iPhone Duo outer display. Turn it on in Settings > Apps > Safari > Extensions > MoaDuo, and allow it on all websites.

name: Moi Président !
description:
Moi Président ! vous fait vivre la présidentielle 2027 de l'intérieur, semaine après semaine, à partir du 3 août 2026.

CHOISISSEZ VOTRE CANDIDAT, OU CRÉEZ LE VÔTRE
Jouez l'une des grandes figures de la politique française, ou créez votre propre candidat : prénom, nom, âge, famille politique (de l'extrême gauche à l'extrême droite), parti jeune ou établi, nom et couleur de votre logo.

UNE CAMPAGNE RÉALISTE
500 parrainages d'élus venant d'au moins 30 départements, plafonds de dépenses et remboursement de l'État, dons limités, emprunt auprès des banques. Rien n'est acquis : l'argent, les signatures et les soutiens se gagnent.

TROIS ACTIONS PAR SEMAINE
Meetings, médias, porte-à-porte, tournée des maires, livre, grand meeting dans de vraies salles. Votre équipe, votre programme chiffré et vos adhérents comptent.

DES DÉBATS EN DUEL
Cinq manches, une question, une attaque, des répliques : les effets ne se découvrent qu'après votre choix.

LA SOIRÉE ÉLECTORALE
Les résultats arrivent à 20 h et bougent jusqu'au bout de la nuit. Partagez votre résultat en image.

PUIS LA SUITE, SANS FIN
Législatives sur 577 circonscriptions (investitures, alliances, budget), puis gouverner : lois, 49.3, référendum, dissolution, ministres, motions de censure. Votre parti vit sur cinq ans, puis une nouvelle présidentielle commence. Le jeu se mémorise : vos scores, votre argent, vos adhérents.

Jeu gratuit, sans compte, qui fonctionne hors ligne. Une publicité au lancement d'une partie et toutes les 15 minutes de jeu ; un achat unique « Retirer la pub » la supprime.

Simulation fictive : les personnalités réelles ne sont pas associées au jeu. Les sondages sont publiés par des instituts imaginaires. Aucun parti, candidat ni média n'est affilié à cette application.

name: MOMIC: AI English Speaking
description:
MOMIC drops you into a 3D town where you talk your way through real situations: airport check-in, ordering at a café, a job interview, a team meeting, an IELTS mock test.

AN AI TUTOR BY YOUR SIDE
• Your AI tutor walks with you and replies instantly when you speak.
• After every turn, your sentence is corrected with a short explanation in your own language.
• Good sentences go into your notebook and come back for review after 1, 3, 7, 14 and 30 days.
• "Slower, easier" and "Ask in my language" are always one tap away.

25 REAL-LIFE SITUATIONS
Café, restaurant, hotel, bank, taxi and directions, airport, immigration, first day at work, team meetings, business calls, presentations, client meetings, price negotiation, complaints, trade fairs, factory, warehouse, construction site and more.

EXAM PRACTICE AND WORKING ABROAD
• A full IELTS Speaking mock test with cue cards and a 1-minute preparation timer.
• Programs for working abroad, EPS-TOPIK, Japanese and German.
• Mock test scores are practice estimates, not official results.

MORE THAN ENGLISH
Practise speaking English, Chinese, Korean, Japanese and German. The interface is available in 12 languages.

REAL PEOPLE WHEN YOU'RE READY
When you feel confident, join group rooms and talk with other learners. Strangers can only hear you when you agree.

PRIVACY
MOMIC does not store recordings of your voice. You can delete your account and all your data inside the app.

Free to start.

name: Montreal Casino Squash Club
description:
Montreal Casino Squash Club brings squash learning materials, practice tools and personal match records together in one app.
 Whether you are learning the basics or organising your regular practice, explore the available exercises, keep track of points and review your recorded results.
 Read articles about squash rules, serving, shot selection, court movement and rally planning. Check your understanding with short questions accompanying the learning materials.
 Explore exercises covering footwork, ball control, shot placement and other squash skills. Each exercise includes instructions to help you structure your practice.
 Use the exercise timer to follow the recommended practice duration. Pause, resume or reset the timer as needed.
 Track points for two players with the built-in score counter. Enter player names, add points, undo the last point or reset the score for a new game.
 Record opponents, dates and game scores. Review saved matches, edit entries and remove records you no longer need.
 See totals calculated from your saved matches, including matches played, wins, losses and games won or lost.
 Select your playing level, experience and preferred style to receive a suggested racket profile focused on control, power or balance.
 Explore the included court descriptions and competition information. Save court session plans and event registration details as personal records on your device. 
 Enable local notifications to receive a reminder before a saved court session.
 Match results, preferences, session plans and event records are saved on your device. Court and competition entries do not create a real venue reservation or submit a registration to an event organiser. Arrange actual bookings and participation directly with the venue or organiser.
 No account or sign-in is required.

name: Mood Dot: Year in Pixels
description:
Log your mood in one tap from a home-screen widget, add tags, and see a year-in-pixels grid and which tags go with your better days.

What you get:
- Log your mood from the home screen
- Your year, one dot a day
- See which days lift you
- Tags for sleep, people and plans
- No account. Locked with Face ID.

Free to start. One in-app purchase adds the rest, with no subscription.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

name: Moon Camera - Waist Level
description:
Waist-level photography. Twelve moments on a roll.

Compose through a 6 × 6 square viewfinder, select a film-inspired look and adjust its intensity. Shoot and view immediately in normal mode, or slow down with a twelve-exposure roll. Load, shoot, wind, seal and develop. Originals stay in the app. Store sealed rolls and develop them later to see their photos.

Exposure, film and intensity controls are directly available on the main screen. Portrait places the controls above the viewfinder; landscape displays the controls beside the camera. Hover layouts follow the physical screen division reported by iOS. You can also choose a standard, top/bottom or left/right layout manually.

Add reference lines or use the waist-level mirror. Focal-length presets and continuous zoom follow the available camera capabilities. Adjust ISO and shutter speed within the supported manual exposure range.

Use the dedicated language control to follow the system or choose English or Simplified Chinese independently.

Try all features free for 3 days, then unlock forever
Claim a 72-hour trial using the system iCloud account. iCloud keeps trial dates consistent across devices. The trial never charges automatically. After it ends, unlock all camera features with a one-time purchase: US$0.99 in the United States or CNY 6 in mainland China. Other storefronts show their local App Store price. Existing photos and rolls remain available to view and develop. Payment and restoration use your App Store account; the permanent unlock works without iCloud.

Photos are processed on your device. No ads or cross-app tracking. Save developed photos to Photos before uninstalling: iCloud trial synchronization does not back up your rolls.

Moon Camera is an independent photographic simulation and is not affiliated with any camera or film brand referenced in its interface.

Privacy policy: https://moon-camera-william-support.b3144161.chatgpt.site/ios/privacy/
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Moon Cube
description:
Moon Cube is a 3D cube puzzle you turn with your fingers — 2×2, 3×3, 4×4 and 5×5 — with a story to play, a solver for the cube on your desk, and a course that teaches the algorithms.

CUBE LAND
The cubes of an amusement park were scrambled and every ride stopped. Solve them to bring the park back, one ride at a time.
• 14 stages across the gate, the main island and Puzzle Isle
• Each ride plays differently: a few moves to undo, several cubes in a row, a time limit, a move limit, a full scramble
• Up to three stars per stage: clear it, clear it without hints, clear it within the target
• A 3D island you can look around; rides regain their color and start moving as you restore them

MY CUBE
Stuck on a real cube? Show it to the app.
• Scan a 2×2 or 3×3 with the camera — two photos from opposite corners, or one face at a time — or paint the stickers by hand
• Get a short solution (about 20 moves for a 3×3, 11 or fewer for a 2×2) and follow it one move at a time on a 3D cube
• If the colors cannot be right, the app tells you what is wrong: a miscounted color, a twisted corner, a flipped edge
• Camera images are used on the device only and are never saved or sent

TRAIN
• 34 algorithms in five courses: basic triggers, the beginner method, orienting the last layer (OLL), permuting it (PLL), and patterns
• Each drill starts from the case the algorithm solves; turn the on-screen cube yourself
• Follow along, do it from memory against the clock, or watch a demo
• Wrong turns are pointed out and undone for you

PRACTICE
• Scramble, solve, and keep your times — the timer starts on your first move
• Best and recent records per size, move counter, undo
• Hints that follow the way people solve (2×2 and 3×3), and auto-solve at ×0.5 to ×16 speed
• Pick up where you left off, separately for each size

Drag a sticker and the layer follows your finger, then snaps to the nearest quarter turn. Drag outside the cube, or use two fingers, to look around it.

No account, no ads, no in-app purchases. Works offline. iPhone and iPad, in English and Korean.

name: Mosoecs
seller_name: ERTEMUR ZIRAAT SANAYI VE TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Welcome! We’ve poured our hearts into refining this product and look forward to hearing your thoughts and ideas.


Mosoecs is a mailbox for letters to a later you. Write today, choose the day it may be opened, and seal it with wax. Until that day the letter stays closed: no peeking, only a countdown. When it arrives, you crack the seal, read what past-you had to say, and write back.

WRITE TO A LATER YOU
Write a letter to yourself in one month, six months, a year, on your next birthday, or on any day you pick. Or write one to read together with someone: a partner, a friend, a child. Put a short line on the envelope so you know roughly what is waiting, but not what it says.

SEALED MEANS SEALED
Each letter folds into an envelope and a wax seal stamps down with a postmark of the day. After that you can't read or edit it. Your mailbox shows the next letter to unlock with a live days, hours and minutes countdown, plus a timeline of every upcoming unlock. You can only push an unlock day later, never earlier.

THE OPENING CEREMONY
When a letter's day comes, it moves to the top of your mailbox. Press and hold the seal until it cracks, watch the flap lift, and the letter rises out. Then reply to your past self: your answer is sealed for the future too, and the two letters stay linked.

WRITING PROMPTS
Not sure what to say? Shuffle through gentle prompts ("What are you worried about that you hope later-you has forgotten?") and drop one into your letter with a tap. Drafts are kept while you write.

YOUR ARCHIVE
Every opened letter lives in the archive with the day it was written, the day it was opened and how long it waited. Filter by letters to yourself, shared letters or replies, and see a few quiet tallies such as your longest wait.

UNLOCK BELL
Switch on the unlock bell and your phone will let you know on the morning a letter can be opened. Notifications are only requested when you turn it on.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CHOICE
Sign in with Apple, Google or email, or just tap "Write as guest" and start. Guests can keep their letters later by attaching a sign-in, without losing anything. Letters sync through your private account and work offline too.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads. No tracking. No analytics. Your letters are stored in your own private space in Google Firebase that only your account can read. You can delete your account and every letter at any time from the Post office with "Close my mailbox".

Write something today. Let it drift. Open it when you've become a slightly different person.

name: MoveMark
description: MoveMark organizes moving tasks, boxes, and inventory. Offline productivity tool with no account.

name: MoyMenu Team
description:
MoyMenu Team is the staff app for restaurants and cafés that use MoyMenu (moymenu.com). Waiters, kitchen staff, cashiers, hosts and managers use the same app; each person sees the areas their role gives them.

To start, you need a set-up code from your manager, who makes it in the MoyMenu Business app. Scan it (or type it), choose a password and a PIN, and the phone is ready. After that you open the app with your PIN at the start of each shift. There is no sign-up in the app.

FLOOR
• Every table with its state, guests and total, hall by hall
• Tables that need you come to the top: a guest calling, a bill asked for, a new order from a guest's phone, food ready to serve
• An alert with sound and vibration when something new needs you, also while the app is in the background
• Show All tables, Mine, or only the ones that need you

TAKING AN ORDER
• The menu with photos, your frequent dishes first, and search
• Options and extras, a note on each dish, courses and "hold for later"
• Send to kitchen and see when the kitchen has it. On a bad connection the order waits on the phone and is sent again by itself.

TABLE AND BILL
• Every order at the table with its status: sent, cooking, ready, served
• Mark food served, send a held course, move or merge tables
• The bill. Cashiers and managers record the payment: cash, or a card run on the restaurant's own terminal, split between guests when needed
• Stamp cards: after payment, show the guest a QR code to collect stamps in the MoyMenu app, or scan their card code

KITCHEN
• Tickets by station, oldest first: tap Start, then Ready
• New, cooking and late tickets at a glance, and a Ready list
• On a tablet the board spreads over several columns

DOOR (for events the restaurant sells tickets for with MoyMenu)
• The live count: guests in and guests expected
• Scan the QR code on a guest's ticket, or find them by name or ticket code
• A clear answer: valid ticket, already in, cancelled, or a ticket for another night
• Let the guest in; if money is due, the screen shows how much to collect at the door
• Sell a ticket at the door to a guest without a booking
• Undo a let-in made by mistake
The app does not take card payments for tickets: it checks tickets and shows what to collect.

ALSO
• Azerbaijani, Russian and English; light and dark appearance
• Android phones and tablets, iPhone and iPad

Some parts (table ordering, the kitchen and tickets) depend on the restaurant's MoyMenu plan and on your role.

name: Mud Spa Tycoon
description:
A little mud, a few bubbles, and a line of happy pigs!

Run a cozy mud spa on a sunny farm in Mud Spa Tycoon. Spin for ingredients, complete each guest's bath recipe, earn in-game coin tips, and upgrade your service one visit at a time.

SPIN, STOP, AND MIX
Tap SPIN to get the ingredient wheel moving, then tap STOP to slow it down. The wheel slides before it settles, so timing matters. Match cocoa mud, mint clay, berry foam, honey, cucumber slices, and rose petals before your guest runs out of spins.

BUBBLES AND SPLASHES
A Golden Bubble fills any empty recipe slot. A Splash removes the rightmost filled ingredient. Finish recipes with spins to spare and build a streak of perfect baths to earn extra tips.

MEET SIX PIG GUESTS
Start with Rosie and Bluebell, then unlock Big Bacon, Minty, Lilac, and Goldie as your total guests served grows. Browse the Guest Book for their personalities, recipe sizes, and tip multipliers.

CHOOSE YOUR UPGRADES
Spend your earned coins on four upgrades: give each guest more spins, boost tips, lower the wheel's top speed, or add more Golden Bubble sectors. Pick the upgrades that suit your play style.

FIVE GUESTS, ONE SPA DAY
Serve five guests each in-game day, review your tips, and try to beat your best day's earnings. Visit the daily bonus wheel for extra in-game coins, with a new claim available at 00:00 UTC each day.

PLAY OFFLINE
Enjoy every feature without an internet connection. No account, ads, or in-app purchases. Coins, settled guest statistics, and upgrades are saved on your device. Sound effects and vibration have separate controls.

The game interface is currently in English. Coins are used only for in-game upgrades and cannot be redeemed for cash or physical items. Leaving a shift or restarting the app begins a new spa day; settled coins and long-term progress are kept.

Your next guest is ready for a soak!

name: Mung: Calm Ambient Scenes
description:
Stand your iPad or iPhone up, landscape or portrait, and let a gently moving scene fill the screen.

16 scenes to zone out to
• Cool: Waves, Flow, Aurora, Star Trails, Ripples, Fireflies, Lava Lamp, Sunset Sea
• Cute: Jellyfish, Moonlit Night, Snowy Village, Rainy Window, Tiny Planets, Hot Air Balloons, Campfire, Little Fish

Every scene is drawn live in code, not played from a video, so no two moments are ever the same.

A desk clock, your way
• Float a clock over any scene. Choose its position, size, font, 24-hour time, seconds, date, and opacity.
• The clock drifts very slowly to protect your screen from burn-in.

Made to leave running
• The screen stays on while the app is open.
• Switch scenes automatically every 1, 5, 15, or 30 minutes with a soft crossfade.
• Screen lock keeps little hands and stray taps from changing the scene. Press and hold to unlock.
• Power saving mode reduces battery use and heat.

No ads, no sign-up, no data collected.

name: Museum Puzzle 3D
description:
Restore museum treasures in a relaxing, stress-free atmosphere. More than 130 puzzles to discover: sculptures, paintings... iconic works from around the world to reassemble step by step, in true high-quality 3D.

Find where each fragment belongs, and enjoy that unique feeling as you place the very last piece. Take your time to admire each discovery once the puzzle is complete.

REAL WORKS OF ART
Made from real 3D scans or finely modelled, these detailed sculptures and paintings come mostly from famous museums such as The Metropolitan Museum of Art, the Minneapolis Institute of Art, the Cleveland Museum of Art and the British Museum. A Roman emperor, Hindu gods, Chinese bronzes, African masks, Egyptian treasures and great paintings.

EASY TO PICK UP
• Drag each piece from the strip to its place on the model
• Turn and zoom with your fingertips to explore freely in 3D
• A shadow of the model guides you; choose a detailed guide, or none at all
• Stuck? Ask for a hint
• A true 3D puzzle, with original controls that make assembling smooth and pleasant

A MUSEUM OF MANY MOODS
• Start by finding out who caused all the damage at the museum, in a fun animation
• Then step into the permanent collection: 36 free sculptures, room after room (portraits, gods of Asia, bestiary, vessels, masks of Africa)
• A free mystery gallery, to discover by completing puzzles in Master mode
More than 130 works in all, half of them free.

EXTEND YOUR VISIT
Two temporary exhibitions add more than 65 puzzles (in-app purchases):
• Ancient Egypt: 30 treasures, from Nefertiti to the Gayer-Anderson Cat
• Dinosaurs & Fossils: 36 skulls, skeletons and fossils, from the trilobite to Tyrannosaurus rex

REPLAY EVERY WORK
• Discover: about 8 pieces, for a relaxed first encounter
• Master: up to 20 pieces, unlocked after Discover, for a real challenge
Each sculpture first appears under a veil, introduced by a riddle.

A CALM, RELAXING EXPERIENCE
No countdown, no lives, no energy to wait for. Soft light, gentle animations, soothing music, at your own pace.

Free with ads: a short ad may appear once a puzzle is complete. Ads are spaced out and always announced, never a surprise. A one-time purchase removes them. Hints come with an optional short video. In-app purchases are optional and a way to thank the creator.

Available in English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese and Japanese.

Museum Puzzle 3D is an independent game. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the museums whose open-access collections it uses. Every work is credited in the game.

name: Mushroom Tempo
description:
Step into a glowing, magical forest with Mushroom Tempo, a relaxing yet addictive timing and rhythm game!

The rules are simple, but mastering them takes skill! Watch the glowing liquid drops fall. Your goal is to tap the screen exactly when the drop aligns with the target mark inside the mushroom jar. Perfect timing keeps your combo going, while missing it costs you lives.

name: MuStreamer
description:
MuStreamer è il riproduttore musicale audiophile progettato per chi pretende il 100% di fedeltà sonora dal proprio impianto Hi-Fi e dagli streamer di rete UPnP/DLNA (come Naim Mu-so e lettori compatibili).

PURA QUALITÀ BIT-PERFECT FINO A 24-BIT / 192 KHZ
• Streaming lossless FLAC / WAV senza ricampionamenti software né compressione dinamica.
• Integrazione nativa con Qobuz e TIDAL per sfogliare novità, album Studio Master, playlist e brani preferiti direttamente in app.
• Catalogo Hi-Res integrato pronto all'uso per testare subito il tuo impianto.

DECODIFICA LOCALE INTELLIGENTE (OFFLOAD WAV)
Possiedi uno streamer o un diffusore All-in-One con processore meno recente che fatica sui file FLAC 24/192 più pesanti? MuStreamer decodifica il flusso su iPhone/iPad/Mac e invia al tuo impianto un flusso WAV lineare Bit-Perfect leggero e ultra-stabile, eliminando scatti e interruzioni anche su Wi-Fi trafficati.

SUITE DI STRUMENTI HI-FI INTEGRATA
• VU Meter Analogico Stereo: risposta calibrata per monitorare in tempo reale livelli RMS e picchi di ciascun canale.
• Analizzatore di Spettro (RTA): visualizza l'energia acustica da 20 Hz a oltre 20.000 Hz per individuare risonanze della stanza.
• Fonometro SPL: misura la pressione sonora in dB(A) e dB(C) nel punto d'ascolto tramite il microfono del dispositivo.
• Generatore di Segnali & Toni: rumore rosa, rumore bianco e toni sinusoidali continui (20 Hz – 20 kHz) per tarare diffusori e subwoofer.
• Equalizzatore parametrico a 10 bande personalizzabile.

PRIVACY AL 100%
Nessun tracciamento pubblicitario, nessuna profilazione e nessun dato personale raccolto. I token restano protetti nel Portachiavi Apple locale.

name: MVP Phone
description:
MVP Phone is the company phone app for the staff of MVP Cabinets & Closets in Abilene, Texas. It is internal business software: you need an MVP Cabinets staff account to sign in.

With MVP Phone, staff can:
- Call customers from a company line, and answer incoming calls to that line, with the standard iPhone call screen.
- Text customers from the company line, including photos.
- See the shared call and text history for the company lines.
- Look up customers in the shared company contact list.
- Pick which company line this iPhone uses.

Sign-in uses your staff email and password. Your administrator decides which company lines your account can use.

MVP Phone does not show ads and does not track you.

name: Mwinda : la Bible à scroller
description:
Tu scrolles des heures sans t'en rendre compte ? Avec Mwinda, ce réflexe devient un moment avec Dieu. La Bible défile comme ton fil préféré : plein écran, un verset à la fois, en français.

Mwinda veut dire « lumière » en lingala. Une lumière pour ta journée, quelques minutes à la fois.

LIS LA BIBLE AUTREMENT
• Fil « Lecture » : toute la Bible verset par verset, du livre et du chapitre de ton choix. Tu reprends exactement là où tu t'es arrêté·e.
• Fil « Pour toi » : des versets choisis selon ce que tu vis (paix, force, confiance, joie, sagesse).
• Deux traductions : Louis Segond 1910 et Crampon 1923.
• Lecture hors ligne, sans compte à créer.

UN RENDEZ-VOUS CHAQUE JOUR
• Verset du jour.
• Rappel quotidien à l'heure que tu choisis.
• Série de jours pour garder le rythme, sans culpabilité.

GARDE ET PARTAGE
• Double tap pour ajouter un verset à tes favoris.
• Partage un verset en image, au format story.

COMPRENDS CE QUE TU LIS (PREMIUM)
• « Explique-moi simplement » : le sens d'un verset en quelques lignes claires.
• « Contexte » : qui parle, à qui, et à quel moment de l'histoire.
Ces explications sont générées par une intelligence artificielle. Elles t'aident à comprendre, sans remplacer ta lecture ni l'enseignement de ton Église.

20 PLANS DE LECTURE
• Pour commencer : Premiers pas avec Jésus, l'Évangile de Jean en 21 jours, l'Évangile de Marc en 16 jours.
• Pour ce que tu vis : trouver la paix, moins d'inquiétude, tenir bon dans l'épreuve, pardonner, choisir la gratitude.
• Pour grandir : le Sermon sur la montagne, les paraboles, les fruits de l'Esprit, les Psaumes en 30 jours, les Proverbes en 31 jours.
• Temps forts : le Calendrier de l'Avent et la Semaine sainte.
« Premiers pas avec Jésus » et le « Calendrier de l'Avent » sont gratuits. Les autres plans font partie de Mwinda Premium.

MWINDA PREMIUM
Le scroll, les deux traductions, le verset du jour, les favoris et le partage sont gratuits. Mwinda Premium ajoute les explications, tous les plans de lecture et les thèmes de lecture.
• Annuel : 34,99 € par an, après 7 jours d'essai gratuit.
• Mensuel : 5,99 € par mois.
Le paiement est débité sur ton compte Apple. L'abonnement se renouvelle automatiquement, sauf annulation au moins 24 heures avant la fin de la période en cours. Tu le gères et l'annules dans les réglages de ton compte App Store.

Textes bibliques : Louis Segond 1910 et Crampon 1923, domaine public.

Conditions d'utilisation : https://mwinda-legal.vercel.app/cgu
Politique de confidentialité : https://mwinda-legal.vercel.app/confidentialite

name: My Best Shot: Photo Organizer
description:
Put your best shot forward.

That squad selfie took ten tries. That perfect brunch got twelve. Someone blinked, the latte art went blurry, the light was off. Now all of them live in your iCloud forever, because going through them one by one is a chore.

My Best Shot does the sorting for you, in seconds.

FINDS YOUR RETAKES
• Gathers every pile of near-identical shots of the same moment: selfies, friends, food, pets, sunsets
• Works even when the framing moved a little between shots
• Same spot, different people? They stay in separate piles
• Pick the dates: today, this week, last month, year to date, all time or a custom range

PICKS THE WINNER
• Flags blinks, blur, looking away, dark shots and glare
• Crowns the best shot so you can decide in a blink
• Choose what matters to you: sharp, well lit, no glare, eyes open, eye contact

COMPARE LIKE A PRO
• Hold a face and every shot zooms to it, side by side
• Draw around anything, the latte art, the dessert, a smile, and every photo zooms there together
• Pinch to zoom in or out on all of them at once

CLEAR THE REST IN ONE TAP
• Everything starts as Keep. Flip the extras to Delete, then tap Proceed
• One confirmation for the whole pile. Deleted photos wait in Recently Deleted for 30 days
• Merge piles or split one in two whenever you like
• Watch the storage you've freed add up

FREE TO TRY, NO SUBSCRIPTION
Finding, comparing and picking are always free, and you can clear up to 50 photos a day. My Best Shot Pro removes the daily limit with a single one-time purchase. New here? Get Pro at a welcome price during your first week.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything happens on your iPhone or iPad. No accounts, no uploads, no ads, no tracking.

name: My Bookmarks by SC360
description:
My Bookmarks is a simple, private home for every link you want to keep.

Save from anywhere
Tap Share in Safari, Chrome or any app and choose My Bookmarks. The title and icon fill in for you. Pick where it goes, add tags or a note, and you're back where you were.

Organize your way
• Groups and categories, like Personal › Finance or Leisure › Travel
• Tags for quick filtering
• Favorites for the links you use every day
• A Recent list, with sorting by date, title or website

Find anything in seconds
Search titles, links, notes and tags at once, then narrow the results with Group, Category and Tag filters that work together.

Keep private links private
The Vault hides sensitive bookmarks behind a PIN and Face ID. It locks itself when you leave the app, and Vault links open inside the app so they stay out of your browser history.

Bring your bookmarks with you
Import years of bookmarks from Safari, Chrome, Firefox or Edge on your computer.

Back up and restore
Save a backup to iCloud Drive or Files whenever you like, with or without your Vault. Restoring only adds what's missing and never changes or deletes anything on your iPhone. Moving to a new iPhone takes a minute.

Your data stays yours
• No account, no sign-in
• No ads, no tracking, no analytics
• Everything is stored on your iPhone

One price, no subscription
Pay once. No ads, no trials, no subscriptions.

Questions or ideas? Use Report a Bug or Suggest a Feature in Settings.
Learn more at apps.sc360.net/mybookmarks

name: My Daily Okay
description:
A little check-in. A little peace of mind.

My Daily Okay makes a simple daily routine easier: choose your check-in times, tap the large I’m okay button, and keep people you trust close by. It is designed for older adults and anyone who appreciates clear words and simple controls.

YOUR DAILY ROUTINE
• Choose up to three check-in times and selected weekdays.
• Add a grace period that suits you.
• Receive reminders on your iPhone.
• Pause for a vacation and resume automatically.
• Review your recent check-ins.

YOUR PEOPLE
Choose up to eight contacts. When you connect email alerts, each contact receives an invitation and must agree before receiving missed-check-in emails. Contacts do not need the app or an account. If a scheduled check-in and its grace period are missed, an independent service attempts to email your agreed contacts, even if your phone is off.

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
No account or password to remember. No subscription, advertising or location tracking. Names and optional phone numbers stay on your device. Connecting email alerts shares the schedule, contact email addresses and check-in status needed to provide the service. You can turn off alerts and delete service data while online.

PLEASE UNDERSTAND THE LIMITS
This is a voluntary check-in tool, not an emergency response service. It does not detect falls, assess health or call emergency services. Server checks run every 30 minutes, so an alert may start up to about 30 minutes after the grace period, with additional delivery delays possible. Email may be blocked, delayed or missed. Agree a follow-up plan with your contacts.

Check in while online so the service can confirm receipt. An offline check-in is saved on your phone, but the service may still alert contacts. Simply uninstalling the app does not stop an active server schedule; turn alerts off first while online.

Email alerts only. No SMS service is offered.

name: My Own Worst Enemy
description:
Every time you rewind, a ghost repeats your last attempt. Leave a past self on a pressure plate, then use the gate it opens to make your next move.

Explore 100 puzzle-platforming levels across ten chapters, from the first switch to rooms that need four ghosts working together. Time jumps past moving hazards, push crates into place, and use short bursts of time to finish each room.

Unlock Blitz for shorter attempts and Echo Cap to limit the number of ghosts. Watch your replays, refine your routes, and play the campaign offline with portrait touch controls.

Online rankings are optional. Choose a public nickname to post verified best runs. Rankings compare fewer ghosts first, then total active time.

name: My Women Team
description:
Crée ton équipe de rêve et fais briller le foot féminin.

My Women Team, c'est le fantasy football 100 % féminin : compose ton équipe avec les joueuses de l'Arkema Première Ligue, marque des points à chaque journée et grimpe au classement. Suis aussi la WSL, la Liga F et la Ligue des championnes : stats, calendriers et vidéos.

COMMENT ÇA MARCHE
- Tu choisis tes joueuses (gardienne, défenseures, milieux, attaquantes) et ta capitaine.
- À chaque journée, leurs vraies performances te rapportent des points : buts, passes décisives, blanchissages, cartons…
- Tu valides ta compo avant la fermeture de la journée, tu joues ton pronostic et tu suis le classement.

TROIS FAÇONS DE JOUER
- Les pools ouverts : un par compétition, inscription libre, chaque joueuse disponible pour tout le monde.
- Le pool entre amis et les pools fermés : un repêchage où chaque joueuse n'appartient qu'à une seule équipe, puis des transferts, une coupe et un journal pour se chambrer.
- Le tableau de bord : défis de la semaine, duels, badges et niveaux à débloquer.

ET AUSSI
- Les stats des joueuses, le calendrier et les résumés vidéo des quatre compétitions.
- Des rappels sur ton téléphone avant chaque journée, pour ne jamais oublier ta compo.
- Un seul compte pour l'appli et le site www.my-women-team.com : ton équipe, tes pools et tes défis te suivent.

La formule Légende est offerte à toute personne inscrite avant le 10 janvier 2027, jusqu'à la fin de la saison 2026-2027.

My Women Team n'est ni affiliée ni approuvée par l'UEFA, les ligues, les fédérations, les clubs ou les joueuses.

name: MyAirco: MHI AC Wi-Fi Control
description:
Control your Mitsubishi Heavy Industries air conditioner from your iPhone or iPad. Set the temperature, switch between cooling and heating, and bring back your favorite settings with a tap.

MyAirco connects directly to compatible Mitsubishi Heavy Industries (MHI) air conditioners over your home Wi-Fi. Keep your rooms comfortable with clear controls, saved favorites and no account to create.

IS YOUR MITSUBISHI AC COMPATIBLE?
MyAirco requires a Mitsubishi Heavy Industries air conditioner with a compatible WF-RAC or WF-RAC-HTTPS Wi-Fi module. Check your unit's Wi-Fi interface before purchasing. A Mitsubishi brand name alone does not confirm compatibility: Mitsubishi Electric air conditioners are not supported.

Your iPhone or iPad and your air conditioner must be on the same local network. MyAirco is not a universal infrared remote and does not offer control from outside your home network.

YOUR COMFORT, YOUR SETTINGS
• Turn each air conditioner on or off and set the target temperature.
• Choose cooling, heating, dry, auto or fan mode.
• Adjust fan speed and vertical or horizontal airflow.
• Enable 3D Auto airflow on supported units.
• See indoor and outdoor temperatures when your unit provides them.

FAVORITES FOR EVERY DAY
Save settings for a quiet evening, a cool bedroom or a warm living room. Give each favorite a name and apply it with one tap. Matching mode icons and colors help you recognize cooling, heating and other saved modes at a glance. Favorites are saved separately for each air conditioner on your device.

ALL YOUR ROOMS IN ONE PLACE
View your air conditioners together, check their status and give them recognizable room names. Drag to arrange your rooms in the order that suits you.

GUIDED WI-FI SETUP
Find compatible air conditioners already on your network or follow the guide to connect a new module to your 2.4 GHz home Wi-Fi. On iPhone and iPad, enter the Wi-Fi name and password manually. Manual IP entry is also available if network discovery is blocked.

LOCAL CONTROL, NO CLOUD ACCOUNT
After setup, everyday control works over your local network, even without internet access. MyAirco sends commands directly to your air conditioner. No ads, analytics or tracking. Your settings and favorites are stored on your device.

Choose Celsius or Fahrenheit and use MyAirco in English, Dutch, German, French or Spanish. Available controls and temperature readings depend on your air conditioner and Wi-Fi module. Allow Local Network access so MyAirco can find and control your units.

EXAMPLES OF COMPATIBLE -WF AND -W MODELS
These models require a compatible WF-RAC or WF-RAC-HTTPS interface. For -W models without built-in Wi-Fi, a separate WF-RAC module is required.
• SRK15ZS-WF, SRK20ZS-WF, SRK25ZS-WF, SRK35ZS-WF, SRK50ZS-WF, SRK20ZSX-WF, SRK25ZSX-WF, SRK35ZSX-WF, SRK50ZSX-WF, SRK60ZSX-WF, SRK63ZR-WF, SRK71ZR-WF, SRK80ZR-WF, SRK100ZR-WF.
• SRK15ZS-W, SRK20ZS-W, SRK25ZS-W, SRK35ZS-W, SRK50ZS-W, SRK20ZSX-W, SRK25ZSX-W, SRK35ZSX-W, SRK50ZSX-W, SRK60ZSX-W, SRK63ZR-W, SRK71ZR-W, SRK80ZR-W, SRK100ZR-W.
• SRK15ZTL-W, SRK20ZTL-W, SRK25ZTL-W, SRK35ZTL-W, SRK50ZTL-W, SRK63ZTL-W, SRK71ZTL-W.
The same module requirement applies to -WFB/-WFT and -WB/-WT color variants. Model availability varies by country; check the Wi-Fi interface before buying.

MyAirco is an independent app by Yellowox. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or an official product of Mitsubishi Heavy Industries. Brand and product names are used only to describe compatibility.

name: MyGI Report
description:
MyGI Report helps you track symptoms, meals, supplements, and how you're
feeling day to day so you can spot patterns and walk into your next
doctor's appointment with real data instead of a fuzzy memory.

DAILY CHECK-INS
A short daily form for stress, hydration, sleep hours, and sleep quality
builds a fuller picture over time, alongside your symptom log.

SEE THE PATTERNS
The Report tab turns your log into a stool-type chart, bowel movement
volume and frequency stats, and at-a-glance cards for your most logged
symptoms, the food tags most associated with symptom days, and your
medicines and supplements over the last 7 days, 30 days, or all time.

BRING IT TO YOUR DOCTOR
Export a clean PDF report for any date range, or a CSV for a spreadsheet.
Reports are generated right on your device and shared through Apple's
standard share sheet.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
Everything is stored locally. There's no account, no tracking, no analytics,
no ads, and no server MyGI Report talks to. Back up or restore all of your
data at any time from Preferences. The backup covers everything, not just
your event log.

MyGI Report is a tracking and reporting tool. It is not a diagnostic tool and
does not provide medical advice. Always talk to a doctor or other qualified
health provider about your symptoms.

name: Nagless Learn
description:
Nagless Learn ends the evening homework argument. Your child agrees a homework time once, taps Done when it's finished (with a photo on Premium), and you find out in the afternoon, not at 10 pm.

HOW IT WORKS
• Snap the homework page. Your child photographs the notebook or workbook; the app reads the homework and the due date. Your child just confirms. That's Premium; on Free, homework is typed in one line.
• Agree on a time, once. The app looks at school and clubs and proposes a homework window. Your child accepts it or moves it once. That's the deal for the day.
• A photo when it's done. Straight from the camera, never from the gallery. With Premium, an AI check says whether the work looks done, not done or unclear, and why. It never grades and never gives answers. On Free, your child taps Done and you check.
• Both parents know in time. An alert only if the window slips, one tap to approve, and a short summary in the evening.

FOR AGES 8 TO 15
Junior mode (8–11) is guided: homework your child adds waits for you. Teen mode (12–15) lets your child plan alone, and you only hear about it when something slips.

TWO PARENTS, ONE PAGE
Two parents, or two homes: both see the same homework, the same photos and the same approvals.

YOUR CHILD'S DATA
• Homework photos are deleted after 30 days, never used to train AI.
• Your child has no email and no account: you pair their phone with a code.
• No ads. Nothing sold. All data is stored in the EU, on a server in Germany.
• Not tied to the school: Nagless Learn is only between you and your child.

FREE AND PREMIUM
Free: 1 child, 1 parent, homework typed by hand and ticked off with Done, the daily summary, the homework window and late alerts. No photos and no AI.
Premium: up to 6 children, a second parent, homework and timetables from a photo, an AI check of the finished page, auto-approval, a filter that covers inappropriate photos, full history. Premium is an auto-renewing subscription with a 14-day free trial, paid through your App Store or Google Play account. Cancel any time in your account settings.

Terms: https://naglesslearn.com/en/terms
Privacy: https://naglesslearn.com/en/privacy

name: Name: CPA AUD Blitz: Exam Prep
description:
Bite-size quizzes made for standing in the checkout line, waiting for food, riding transit — whatever, wherever.

Curated questions from a real test taker. Every question here was written and vetted by someone who has actually sat the CPA AUD exam — anything ambiguous, outdated, or that gave away its own answer got rewritten or cut. Current through the 2025 quality management standards. Open it, answer five questions, get on with your day.

Study whenever it fits your life — during breaks, in line, or on the couch. Everything works offline, so your progress never waits for a signal.

____________________________________

Study modes:

• Quick Blitz — a random question generator mixing all 16 AUD areas
• Daily Blitz Challenge — a daily 5-question streak keeper, same set for everyone

name: NASTV - NAS の動画をテレビで
description:
家のネットワークにある NAS（ファイルサーバー）の動画と写真を、Apple TV・iPhone・iPad で見るアプリです。

■ NAS を自動で探す
同じネットワークの NAS を探して一覧にします。見つからないときは IP アドレスを入れて追加できます。ゲストでも、ユーザー名とパスワードでもつなげます（SMB2・SMB3 に対応）。

■ 動画と写真を大画面で
フォルダを開き、「すべて／動画／画像」で絞り込み、「名前順／新しい順」で並べ替えて選ぶだけ。mp4・mov・m4v はそのまま再生、写真は全画面表示とスライドショー。

■ 次の動画を自動で再生
動画が終わると、ファイルの日時がいちばん近い次の動画を「あと10秒」で続けて再生します。撮った順に、ホームビデオを流しっぱなしにできます。

■ iPhone と Apple TV をつなぐ
Apple TV に出した QR を iPhone で読むだけ。iPhone から NAS の登録を Apple TV に送ったり、iPhone で選んだ動画を Apple TV で再生・一時停止したりできます。やりとりは家のネットワークの中だけで、暗号化しています。

■ 閲覧者モード（子どもや家族に）
管理者が選んだ動画だけを並べるモード。ほかのフォルダや設定は出ません。戻るには4桁の暗証番号が必要です。

■ NASTV Pro（買い切り）
・NAS を何台でも登録
・mkv・avi・wmv など、いろいろな形式の動画を再生
・閲覧者モード
1 回のお支払いで、Apple TV・iPhone・iPad のどれでもずっと使えます。無料のままでも、NAS 1 台の mp4・mov・m4v の動画と写真を見られます。

■ プライバシー
NAS の中身やパスワードを当社に送りません。広告も、利用状況の収集もありません。パスワードは端末のキーチェーンにだけ保存します。

※ NAS の設定で SMB2 以上を有効にしてください（SMB1 だけの古い NAS にはつながりません）。
※ NAS と Apple TV・iPhone・iPad は同じネットワークにつないでください。

name: Navegantes
description:
Navegantes es el control remoto de Navegantes Media Pro, el programa de presentación para iglesias en Mac.

Con el iPhone o el iPad en la mano puedes:
• Pasar las diapositivas de la letra, la presentación o los versículos.
• Elegir en qué pantalla sale cada cosa: Auditorio, Live, Stage, Lobby o Apple TV.
• Cambiar cómo sale la letra: pantalla completa, recuadro o abajo sin fondo.
• Poner videos, la señal en vivo y los lower thirds.
• Buscar una cita bíblica y proyectarla.
• Agrandar la presentación para leer la diapositiva actual y la que sigue mientras enseñas.
• Proyectar la pantalla de tu iPhone o iPad en las pantallas de la iglesia, sin cables.

Funciona por tu red Wi-Fi: el dispositivo y la Mac deben estar en la misma red. Necesita Navegantes Media Pro instalado en una Mac (navegantesmediapro.com).

name: Nealey Shop Copilot Staff
description:
Nealey Shop Copilot is the in-house app for the service advisors and technicians at Nealey Tire & Auto. It needs a Nealey Tire & Auto Google Workspace account to sign in.

CHECK-IN
Walk the car with the camera. The app recognizes each required check-in shot (exterior, wheels, windshield, interior, dash, VIN plate, tire placard, oil change sticker) and checks it off. It reads the license plate and VIN to find the repair order, notes pre-existing damage and warning lights, reads the odometer and tire pressures, and sends the photos and notes to the shop's inspection.

INSPECTION VIDEO
Record a finding, add captions and a matching repair animation, and send it to the repair order's inspection.

Demo mode shows every feature with sample data and no account.

name: Nearby: Places to Try
description:
Nearby is a map of the places you want to try or see.

Someone mentions a restaurant or a friend sends you a post. You read about a bar, a bookshop, a view worth the climb. Save it in a few seconds, and it is waiting on your map the next time you are close by.

SAVE A PLACE IN SECONDS
Search by name, type an address, or drop a pin. Give it a category, an icon and a colour, and any tags you like.

SEE WHAT IS AROUND YOU
Your places, nearest first, with the distance and the walk in minutes. Open one to see which way to face, get walking directions in Apple Maps, or find its booking page.

KEEP TRACK OF WHERE YOU HAVE BEEN
Mark a place as visited, and filter the map down to the kind of place you are in the mood for.

SEND A PLACE TO A FRIEND
Find friends by their handle and send them a place with a note. What friends send you waits until you add it to your own map, or say no thanks.

YOURS, ON EVERY PHONE
Sign in with Apple, Google or email, and your list is the same wherever you sign in. It keeps working with no signal, and catches up when you are back online.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no tracking, no analytics. Your places are yours; only the friends you choose see what you send them. Your location is used on your phone to show where you are and how far each place is. You can report or block anyone, and delete your account in the app at any time.

name: Nebula Claim: Space Arcade
seller_name: TUTKU YAZILIM BILGISAYAR HIZMETLERI SANAYI VE TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Draw lines, claim space and reclaim the galaxy!

An alien cloud has swallowed the stars. Fly your scout ship along the glowing border, dive into the darkness and draw a line back to safety. The side without the guardian is yours, and a hidden galaxy appears beneath it.

• SIMPLE TO PLAY, HARD TO MASTER
Swipe to steer. Leave the border to draw a line, return to the border to claim the area. Reach the target percent to clear the level.

• 30 UNIQUE GUARDIANS
Every level has its own giant guardian machine: spinning rings, firing cannons, rotating crystals and pulsing cores. They grow and shrink as they move, so watch your timing!

• DANGER EVERYWHERE
Hunters chase your line, border patrols guard the edges, and if you stop while drawing, the fuse starts burning.

• POWER-UPS
Enclose shields, freeze bolts and extra lives to collect them.

• 6 SECTORS, 30 LEVELS
Orion Arm, Emerald Nebula, Red Giant, Ice Rings, Event Horizon and the Galactic Core. Earn up to 3 stars on every level.

• PLAY ANYWHERE
Works offline. Short levels, perfect for a quick break.

Can you reclaim the whole galaxy?

name: NecroCrafter: Undead Roguelike
description:
The dead do not rest. You will not let them.

You are a fragile necromancer with a ritual dagger and a hunger for corpses. You do not out-fight the horde. You harvest it. Every creature that falls leaves a body behind, and every body is bone, blood and flesh waiting to be stitched back into service.

Stab. Harvest. Raise. Descend.

THE DEAD ARE YOUR WEAPON
• Cut down the first foes yourself, then walk over their corpses to strip them for parts.
• Spend bone, blood and flesh to raise skeletons, bone wolves, flesh golems and blood wretches.
• Your army tanks and kills. You stay weak on purpose, darting in with the blade to finish the dying and feed the next ritual.
• Minions fall and rot. The harvest never stops.

CLAIM A SOUL, SHAPE THE HORDE
• Harvested souls fill your meter. Every level offers a choice: reinforce a minion, sharpen the dagger, or bend your whole army to a new doctrine.
• Specialise each line of the dead: phalanxes that shrug off blows, skeleton mages hurling grave fire, bursting ossuary swarms, howling wolf packs, plague-ridden golems.
• Rings, amulets and trophies drop from the slain. Trophies orbit at your side and fight with you.

DESCEND INTO NESTED WORLDS
• An endless graveyard overworld, cursed marshes, frozen voids and ruined shrines, streamed around you as you walk.
• Portals lead into realms of pestilence, famine, carrion, war and cinder, each with its own beasts and its own law.
• Every realm hides more portals. There is no bottom, only deeper dark and richer harvests.
• The Tormentor follows you down. It remembers. It takes new shapes the deeper you go.

CATACLYSMS
• Sometimes the land itself ends. The sky reddens, the ground quakes, meteors fall and the earth tears open into a rift that throws you several depths down at once.

THE CRYPT WARDROBE
• Earn vestments, robe dyes, soul fire, blade colours, auras and trails by surviving deeper and longer.
• Dress your necromancer as a grave robber, a plague doctor, a bone lich or a crowned wraith king.

BUILT FOR YOUR PHONE
• One-thumb touch controls, portrait or landscape.
• Short runs that fit a bus ride, deep runs for a long night.
• Plays fully offline. No account, no sign-in.
• Gore intensity can be turned down or off in Options.

Raise. Harvest. Descend.

name: Needlefall - Vinyl Widget
description:
Needlefall turns the music you play into a spinning vinyl record.

Play a song in Apple Music and it lands on the turntable: the cover becomes the record label, the tonearm drops and the record starts to spin. Change the song and the record changes with it, in the app and on your Home Screen.

A TURNTABLE THAT FEELS REAL
Drag the tonearm onto the record to play, lift it to pause. Swipe the record up or down to change songs, double-tap it to favourite one. It spins up and coasts to a stop like a real deck, with a needle-drop sound and haptics.

VINYL WIDGETS FOR YOUR HOME SCREEN
Small, medium and large widgets that spin while your music plays, with play, pause and skip. Pick the background: the album's colours, its blurred cover, dark, light or fully clear over your wallpaper.

YOUR RECORD SHELF
Every album you really listen to lands in a 3D record crate that tilts as you move your phone. Open one to see its tracks and play any of them. Your Apple Music playlists are there too.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Pressings: black, amber, ruby, cobalt, jade, clear, marble, splatter and more, or the album's own colour
• Tables: felt, walnut, slate, navy, oxblood
• Four tonearms: classic, S-arm, straight and unipivot
• A stylus light under the headshell, in five colours

SHARE IT AS A RECORD
Turn any album into a share card: the sleeve with the record sliding out, ready for Stories, posts or chats.

MADE FOR EVERY SCREEN
iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo. Half-fold the Duo and the shelf sits above the turntable.

TRY IT FREE, BUY IT ONCE
Everything is free for 7 days. After that the turntable keeps playing; a single one-time purchase keeps your style and widget options for good. No subscription, no ads.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics. Your listening history stays on your device.

name: Neko Belt: Sushi Sort
description:
Welcome to Neko Belt, the coziest sushi bar in Japan, where every customer is a cat!

Tap a stack to send its top plate onto the conveyor belt. Each cat wants three plates of the same sushi. Serve them before the belt fills up and the kitchen jams.

It's easy to start and deeply satisfying to master:

• RELAXING PUZZLES: No timers. Take a breath, plan ahead and watch the plates glide to happy cats.
• A REAL CHALLENGE WHEN YOU WANT ONE: Hard and Super Hard levels test your planning. Watch out for covered plates, locked stacks and VIP cats with big appetites.
• 30 CATS, 30 STORIES: Every cat has a favorite sushi and a story of its own. Serve it to earn hearts and bonus coins.
• WELCOME DISHES: New cats wait at the door in the rain. Merge rice into their favorite bento to bring them inside.
• A JOURNEY ACROSS JAPAN: Earn stars, buy lanterns, wall art and golden rails, and travel through 12 cities, from Tokyo and Kyoto to Nagasaki's lantern festival and Fukuoka's summer nights.
• MAKE IT YOUR CAFÉ: Choose your host cat, discover friendship stories, collect accessories and pick a café palette. Your visit stamps never reset when you take a break.
• DAILY BENTO: A new generated puzzle every day, with a gentler introduction for new chefs.
• WEEKLY LEAGUE: Win levels to climb from Bronze to Diamond against real players in groups of 30. Top chefs earn bonus coins every week. Internet connection required.
• PLAY AT YOUR PACE: Normal puzzles work offline. Optional rewarded videos and purchases are available; no forced interstitial ads.
• SEASON PASS: Every month brings 30 tiers of rewards, with an optional Gold track.

Available in English, Türkçe, Deutsch, Français, Español, Italiano, Português, Nederlands and Polski.

Grab your apron, the cats are waiting!

name: Neon Hotline: Top Down Action
description:
Your pager goes off at midnight. An address and one line: "Package is inside. Leave no one."

NEON HOTLINE is a fast, brutal top-down action game. You die in one hit. So do they. No health bar, no second chance. The moment you die you are back at the start of the floor, with no waiting.

EVERY ROOM IS A PUZZLE
Who is behind that door? Can the gunman see you through the glass? Who comes running when a shot goes off? Think before you breach. Do not stop once you have.

USE WHATEVER YOU FIND
Knock them down with your fists, then finish them. Bat, knife, crowbar, pistol, shotgun, SMG: grab it, use it, throw it when it is empty. Slam a door in someone's face. Throw a knife across the room.

COMBOS AND GRADES
Clear a floor fast and your combo grows. Every chapter ends with a grade from D to A+. Good grades unlock new charms.

8 CHARMS, 8 WAYS TO PLAY
Pick a charm before each chapter: run faster, kill with your fists, fire quietly, make doors lethal, survive one hit, and more.

FEATURES
• Top-down shooter and brawler with one-hit kills, instant restarts and a retro 80s synthwave mood
• 10 chapters with dozens of floors and a steadily rising challenge
• Boss fights, and after chapter 10 an endless run of ever-harder chapters
• Four enemy types: brawlers, gunmen, dogs and heavies that only bullets can stop
• Neon lights, real-time shadows, synth soundtrack
• Controls built for phones: left thumb moves, right thumb strikes
• 14 languages
• No ads, no account, no internet needed

The first three chapters are free. One purchase unlocks every remaining chapter.

name: Nest-it: Create Games with AI
description:
Nest-it is a social platform where you turn ideas into playable mini games and apps with AI. Describe what you want in a single sentence and Nest-it generates something you can play right away. Then share it, scroll through what others have built, and play everything without leaving the app.

Create with AI
• Type one sentence describing the game or app you want and get a playable result in seconds.
• Add images or record a voice prompt to give the AI more to work with.
• Open the workflow canvas when you want advanced control over how your project is built.

Play in your feed
• Home is a full-screen vertical feed: swipe to move from one playable creation to the next.
• Games and apps run directly inside Nest-it, so there is nothing extra to install.
• Discover shows popular, newest and most liked creations, and search helps you find a specific one.

Remix
• Creators can turn on "Allow remix" so others can build on their project.
• Remix is off by default, so you decide whether your work is open to remixing.

Social
• Follow creators, like and comment on their games and apps.
• Keep your account private if you prefer, and use report and block tools whenever you need them.

Stories and messages
• Post stories that stay visible for 24 hours.
• Send direct messages with text, photos, voice messages and location sharing.

Credits and Nestit Premium
• AI generations use credits; credit packs are available as in-app purchases.
• Nestit Premium is an optional monthly auto-renewable subscription that lets you publish live multiplayer games. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase; the subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and you can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Good to know
• Nest-it is intended for users aged 13 and older.
• Sign in with your email address and password.
• There are no ads and no third-party analytics in the app.

Terms of Use: https://nestit.159.195.199.246.sslip.io/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://nestit.159.195.199.246.sslip.io/privacy.html

Have an idea for a game? Describe it, play it, and share it with Nest-it.

name: NetGraph: YKS Net Takibi
description:
NetGraph, YKS'ye hazırlanan öğrenciler için deneme neti takip uygulaması.

DENEMELERİNİ KAYDET
• TYT, AYT ve YDT denemelerini ders ders doğru / yanlış olarak gir
• Sosyal ve fen bilimlerini ders ders gir (Tarih, Coğrafya, Fizik, Kimya…)
• Net anında hesaplanır: Doğru − Yanlış ÷ 4
• AYT'de tüm alanları girebilirsin; hesaplamalarda kendi alanın (SAY, EA, SÖZ, DİL) esas alınır

GELİŞİMİNİ GÖR
• Toplam ve ders bazlı net grafikleri
• Ortalama, en iyi ve son net
• Her denemenin ayrıntısı: ders ders doğru, yanlış, boş ve net

HEDEF KOY
• TYT ve AYT için net hedefi belirle
• Hedefine ulaştığında bildirim gelir, bir üst hedefi seçersin

YKS SAYACI VE WIDGET'LAR
• YKS'ye kalan gün, saat ve dakika; tarih kendiliğinden ayarlanır
• Ana ekran ve kilit ekranı widget'ları

PUANINI VE SIRALAMANI GÖR
• Seçtiğin TYT ve AYT denemesi tek dokunuşla TercihLab'da hazır açılır, netlerini yeniden girmezsin

HESAP İSTEĞE BAĞLI
