• Hesap açmadan kullanabilirsin; verilerin cihazında kalır
• Apple, Google ya da e-postayla hesap açarsan denemelerin yedeklenir ve başka cihazda geri gelir
• Reklam yok, izleme yok

name: Next Thing: Kids Routines
description:
Parents build picture-step routines (morning, bedtime, getting out the door), and the child sees one step at a time on the phone or iPad with a visual timer and a reward at the end.

What you get:
- One step at a time
- A timer kids can see
- Follow along from the lock screen
- Your own photos as steps
- Stars and rewards at the finish

Free to start. One in-app purchase adds the rest, with no subscription.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

name: Nextep
description:
Nextep is a hand-kept episode tracker for the shows you actually watch. No online database to search, no spoilers, no noise: you add each show yourself with its seasons, episode counts, platform and average episode length, and Nextep keeps your place.

UP NEXT, EVERY EVENING
Open the app and the next unwatched episode of every show you're watching is waiting on its own little screen. Tap "Watched" and a burst of TV static confirms it. The card moves on to the following episode, and an Undo strip is there if your thumb slipped.

MARK EPISODES OR WHOLE SEASONS
Each show page lays out every season as a grid of episode tiles. Tap a tile to mark it watched, or mark an entire season in one go. Rate each season out of five, and set the show's status: watching, paused, finished or dropped. Finish the last episode and the show moves to finished on its own.

ADD SHOWS YOUR WAY
Type a title, pick or name the platform you watch on, set the episode runtime and add as many seasons as you need. Already halfway through? Tell Nextep how many episodes you've seen and Up next starts in the right place.

YOUR HOURS, IN LIGHTS
Stats adds up total hours watched, episodes this month compared with last month, an eight-week chart, your longest run of evenings in a row, where your hours went by platform, and your best-rated seasons. A dated history keeps every episode you've marked.

A FILM STRIP TO GET AROUND
Drag the film strip at the bottom and snap a frame into the gate: Up next, Shows, Stats or the Projection Booth.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CHOICE
Sign in with Apple, Google or email, or tap "Watch as guest" and start straight away. Guests can link a sign-in later from the Booth and keep everything. Your shows sync across your iPhones and still work offline.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads and no tracking. Your data is stored in Google Firebase and only you can read it. Delete your account and every show, rating and log from the Booth at any time.

name: Nexus Semijoias
description:
Nexus Semijoias helps authorized businesses and jewelry resellers organize products, display cases, stock and sales information.

Sign in with an existing Nexus account to open the areas available to your business. Account permissions and company isolation are checked by the Nexus server.

Use the native offline stocktake tool on iPhone or iPad to scan product barcodes or enter SKU codes, record quantities and prepare a CSV export for review. Offline stocktakes do not change server inventory, create sales or charge customers automatically.

Device unlocking can optionally protect access with Face ID or the device passcode. Camera scanning requires permission.

name: Nghe Mãi
description:
Nghe Mãi là kho nhạc độc bản do chính Nghe Mãi làm ra: hơn 2.400 bài, đủ thể loại từ acoustic, ballad, lofi tới nhạc US-UK, và mỗi tuần lại có thêm bài mới.

NHẤN MỘT LẦN, NHẠC CHẠY SUỐT BUỔI
• Bấm "Mở nhạc cả ngày", nhạc tự nối bài, không phải chọn từng bài.
• Tắt màn hình hay khoá máy, nhạc vẫn phát.
• Bài đã nghe được lưu lại: mạng chập chờn nhạc vẫn chạy.

KHÔNG QUẢNG CÁO
Không chèn quảng cáo giữa bài, không giọng đọc rao hàng chen ngang.

CHẾ ĐỘ QUÁN
Dành cho quán cà phê, nhà hàng, tiệm tóc, spa, cửa hàng: chọn không gian, nhạc tự chọn bản hợp không khí và chạy suốt giờ mở cửa. Toàn bộ bài hát thuộc sở hữu của Nghe Mãi, có giấy xác nhận nguồn gốc nhạc khi cần.

NGHE THEO TÂM TRẠNG
Cà phê sáng, tập trung làm việc, chill buổi tối, tình ca… Có bảng xếp hạng, album, podcast, và lời bài hát với những bài có lời.

Đăng ký miễn phí để nghe không giới hạn, lưu bài yêu thích và mở nhạc cả ngày.

name: Nia Cooking Games
description:
Roll up your sleeves: in Nia, you make every dish yourself, one real kitchen move at a time.

Swipe the knife and the tomato falls into slices. Peel, grate and pour. Stir the soup, knead the pizza dough, flip pancakes, fry up a batch of fries, press out cookies with a cutter and slide the tray into the oven. When it's ready, plate it up, add the toppings and watch a hungry customer take the first bite.

COOK WITH YOUR FINGERTIPS
• Every step is a hands-on move: chop, peel, grate, pour, stir, knead, fry, flip, bake, plate and decorate
• Picture prompts show what comes next, so there's nothing to read
• Stuck? A pink hand and arrow show exactly what to tap
• There's no timer and no penalty. A wrong move never ruins the dish, and every recipe gets finished

A MENU FULL OF FAVORITES
• Breakfast: pancakes, French toast, omelets, grilled cheese and menemen (Turkish-style eggs with tomatoes and peppers)
• Soups: vegetable, lentil, tomato, chicken noodle and alphabet soup
• Salads: tuna salad, potato salad, a crunchy tomato-cucumber-onion salad and a fruit platter
• Snacks: fries, tacos, quesadillas, hot dogs and yogurt topped with fruit
• Main dishes: pizza, burgers, sushi rolls, dumplings, spaghetti and meatballs, pasta, rice pilaf, köfte (Turkish meatballs) and baked chicken
• Desserts: cookies, brownies and donuts

A RECIPE BOOK THAT KEEPS GROWING
Every dish you finish becomes a page in your recipe book. Flip back anytime and cook it again. New recipes open every morning, so there's always something fresh on the menu. Can't wait until tomorrow? Unlock the next recipe with a short ad, or open them all at once with a one-time purchase.

A COZY CAFE TO COME BACK TO
Nia opens in a small, cozy cafe. A cheerful chef walks you through each recipe, a customer tastes what you made and shares a comment, and the chef beams with pride. Every recipe ends with a happy "Afiyet olsun!", Turkish for "enjoy your meal."

GOOD TO KNOW
• Recipes you've unlocked and your recipe book play offline. New daily recipes and ad unlocks need an internet connection.
• No account and no sign-up.
• Sound effects and music each have their own switch in Settings.
• Plays on iPhone and iPad, in landscape.
• Nia shows ads. A one-time purchase unlocks every recipe right away, but ads will still appear.
• Already bought it? It comes back automatically with the same Apple Account, even after reinstalling or on a new device.

Grab an apron: the whole family can take a turn at the stove. Let's get cooking!

name: Nibrule
description:
Nibrule designs calligraphy guide sheets to true scale on your iPhone, ready to print or share as a PDF. Set up the ruling for the pen in your hand and slip the printed page under your layout paper.

THREE KINDS OF PEN
Broad-edge sheets measure letter heights in nib widths, just as the exemplars teach. Enter your nib width and Nibrule works out every line. Pointed-pen sheets use an ascender : body : descender ratio, such as 3:2:3, with steep slant lines. Monoline sheets give pencils, fineliners and brush pens a fixed x-height.

THE NIB LADDER
Broad-edge sheets can print a ladder of nib-width squares beside every row. Measure one square with a ruler to confirm that your printer kept the sheet at true size.

THE NIB DRAWER
Pick your pen instead of typing a width: Pilot Parallel, Brause Bandzug and Sakura Pigma Calligrapher sizes are built in. Measured a nib of your own? Name it and save it to your drawer to use again. The nib's name prints in the sheet caption.

PEN-ANGLE MARKS
A small nib-edge stroke at the start of every broad-edge row shows the angle to hold your pen, from flat to 60°. Each script in the atlas starts at its usual angle: about 30° for Foundational, 40° for Italic and 20° for Uncial.

SLANT YOU CAN SEE
Choose any writing angle from 45° to upright with the slider or one-tap presets, and watch the angle gauge and the page update together. Set the spacing of the slant lines, or turn them off.

WARM-UP DRILLS
Add faint ovals, slant strokes or waves inside the x-height to trace before you write. Put them on the first row, every other row or every row.

A SCRIPT ATLAS
Twelve hands, from Foundational, Italic, Uncial and Textura to Copperplate, Spencerian and brush lettering. Each one has a short history, its usual proportions, pen angle, practice notes, a sample ruling and a chart of letter heights. Start a sheet from any of them in one tap, then adjust it. The home shelf shows them in a row; See all opens the complete list.

PAGE AND LINES
A4, A5, US Letter or US Legal, portrait or landscape, or a custom size for envelopes, cards and journals. Adjust the margins and row gap, add an optional caption that records your settings, choose from five line colours and set the line weight, or shade the x-height band.

PRACTICE LOG
After a session, save a dated note: the nib you used, the paper, what you practised and any extra notes. Pull the list to reload it from this device. Sessions never leave the phone unless you choose to share something else.

PRINT AND SHARE
Export a vector PDF with up to 20 identical pages, or a 300 dpi PNG. Print with AirPrint or save to Files. Exports are free and carry no watermark.

ALSO INCLUDED
• Charts of ascender, x-height and descender on each sheet, plus atlas x-heights and a mix of your saved sheets by pen
• Zoomable full-page proof for checking fine lines
• Millimetres or inches
• Dark Mode and Dynamic Type support
• Works offline, with no account and no data collection

name: Night Hunter Game
description:
Night Hunter is a 3D predator hunting game set after dark on the sheep farms of South Africa and the ranches of the United States. Call in jackals, coyotes and wolves, sweep the dark with your hunting light for the shine of their eyes, and make one careful shot before the animal works out what you are.

The sheep farmers of the Karoo are losing lambs, and the nights are long. Take your place on the stand, start the caller and hunt the predators that come in.

PREDATOR CALLING AS IT IS REALLY DONE
Choose from sixteen hand and electronic calls, from a rabbit in distress to a lone jackal and a whole pack answering. Every animal hears them differently: some come straight in, some circle round to get your wind, some hang up out of range and some leave. An electronic caller carries further than a hand call.

SPOTLIGHT HUNTING AT NIGHT
Scan the darkness with your hunting light and look for eyeshine. Red and green filters, stronger lights and better scopes decide how far you can see and how much the animals notice you.

LONG-RANGE SHOOTING
Your rounds drop with distance and your aim tires as the night goes on. Judge the range, hold steady and squeeze. A headshot at 200 m earns its own achievement. A sheep shot by mistake costs you.

HUNT JACKALS, COYOTES, WOLVES AND WILD BOAR
Work through six South African farms, each with its own nights and its own farmer to satisfy. Then travel to the United States for varmint hunting on five ranches, with coyotes, wolves and wild boar.

RIFLES, SCOPES AND GEAR
Three guns, plus lights, filters, silencers and callers, all paid for with what the nights earn. Upgrade your optics from the starter scope to the NH Jackal Sight (14×). Every round is bought, so make them count.

FEATURES
- Night hunting simulator on phone and tablet
- Jackal hunting, coyote hunting, wolves and wild boar
- 16 predator calls
- 11 farms and ranches across two countries
- Bolt-action rifle, shotgun and combat rifle
- 23 achievements and 4 leaderboards (Game Center)
- Plays offline
- English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Polish, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese

Free to play, with optional in-app purchases and adverts. Choose from hunting gear, skins and Bounty Dollars. Selected bundles and the larger Bounty Dollar packs remove banner ads and ads between nights. Rewarded videos stay optional.

name: NileFold
description:
Unfold a new path through an Egyptian-inspired world. In Nile Fold, you fold the edges of a papyrus map to connect a route from Start to Goal, then run a trial to see where the path leads.

Explore 65 handcrafted levels that gradually introduce overlapping layers, hidden windows, narrow and wide folds, two-color routes, crossing bridges, alternate solutions, and gold seals. Action guides point to the next control when a new mechanic appears, while 19 Skill School lessons let you practice at your own pace.

Solve each puzzle with careful observation, compare failed routes, and discover how every fold changes the map. Your progress is saved on your device.

name: Nimvelle
description:
Nimvelle je rutina, ktorú už máš, zapísaná.

Pridaj kroky, ktoré používaš ráno, a tie, ktoré používaš večer. Čistiaci prostriedok, tonikum, sérum, hydratačný krém, opaľovací krém, maska, exfoliant alebo čokoľvek iné, čo si ponecháte. Odkazujte krok na produkt na vašej poličke. Každý deň si odškrtni, čo si urobil. Deň je kompletný, keď sa kontroluje každý aktívny krok. Mesiac ukazuje kompletné dni a čiastočné dni a séria počíta beh, na ktorom ste. Dnes môže zostať voľný: ak ste ešte neskončili, včerajšia séria stále platí.

Na poličke je vytlačený deň, kedy ste pohár otvorili, a na balení je vytlačená bodka po otvorení. Nimvelle počíta dopredu od toho dňa a hovorí vám, kedy je okno otvoreného pohára zatvorené alebo kedy prešlo. Môžete si tiež všimnúť, aký plný sa pohár cíti, od plného až po prázdny. Tento dátum je návod na skladovanie pre výrobcu. Nie je to lekársky dátum a nie je to rada ohľadom vašej pokožky.

Denník je k dispozícii, ak ho chceš. Napíšte si osobnú poznámku o suchosti, škvrnách, nálade a spánku. Dvojtýždňový graf ukazuje, čo ste napísali. Nimvelle nerobí pokožku a nehovorí vám, čo máte zmeniť. Voliteľné fotografie pokroku sú vedľa seba, približne týždeň po sebe. Zostávajú v aplikácii, pokiaľ si nevyberiete uloženie kópie do Photos.

Pripomienky sú vypnuté, kým ich nezapnete. Ranný aj večerný čas môžu požiadať iOS o jemnú lokálnu poznámku. Ak je táto časť rutiny už hotová, Nimvelle vás už v ten istý deň nenabáda. Neexistuje žiadny účet ani push server.

Na prvé uvedenie je zabalená vzorková polica s rutinou, niekoľkými produktmi, niekoľkými skontrolovanými dňami a niekoľkými poznámkami, takže kalendár nie je prázdny. Odstráňte ho približne vtedy, keď sú vaše produkty dostatočné. Všetko, čo si pridal sám, zostáva.

Čo nájdete:

- Ranné a večerné kroky, ktoré môžete upravovať, pozastavovať alebo mazať
- Každý krok prepojený s produktom alebo ponechaný neprepojený
- Denné odškrtávanie, vrátane predchádzajúcich dní
- Mesačný kalendár s úplnými a čiastočnými dňami
- Prúdová séria a najdlhšia séria
- Polička s dátumom otvorenia, obdobím po otvorení a tým, koľko zostane
- Tiché varovanie pred zatvorením okna s otvorenou nádobou
- Voliteľné poznámky pre suchosť, škvrny, náladu a spánok
- Jednoduchý trend za posledné dva týždne
- Voliteľné fotografie pokroku, porovnané vedľa seba, uložené v zariadení
- Voliteľné lokálne pripomienky, ktoré môžete vypnúť
- Vzorkovú policu, ktorú môžete vybrať
- Haptiku môžeš vypnúť
- Zásady ochrany osobných údajov a podmienky, ktoré sú čitateľné v aplikácii

Nimvelle nemá žiadny účet, žiadne reklamy, žiadne sledovanie a žiadne nákupy. Ak fotoaparát odmietnete, stále si môžete vybrať fotografiu alebo ju preskočiť. Ak Fotky zamietnete, fotoaparát môžete stále používať. Ak odmietnete oznámenia, check-in stále funguje. Nič, čo zaznamenáte, sa nenahráva.

Nimvelle nie je lekárske zariadenie. Nediagnostikuje, nelieči ani nemonitoruje ochorenie. Séria je počet krokov, ktoré ste spomenuli. Poznámka je spomienka. Rozhodnutia o vašej pokožke patria vám.

name: Nino Rush
description:
Nino est un petit panda roux qui a une drôle de façon de voyager : il se met en boule et il fonce. Aide-le à retrouver son terrier à travers des mondes pleins de lumière.

ROULE, SAUTE, REBONDIS
Reste appuyé d'un côté de l'écran pour rouler, glisse le doigt vers le haut pour sauter. C'est tout. Le reste, c'est de l'élan : prends de la vitesse dans les descentes, franchis les trous, saute de paroi en paroi.

UN MONDE, UNE LUMIÈRE
Chaque monde a sa lumière, ses décors et sa nouveauté. Quelques-uns de ceux qui t'attendent :
• La Prairie du matin : rouler et sauter
• La Forêt aux champignons : les champignons qui rebondissent
• Les Cimes gelées : la glace qui glisse
• Les Grottes de cristal : les tourbillons qui t'attirent
• Les Ruines fleuries : les clés et les portails
• Le Volcan : la lave
• Les Îles du ciel : la gravité inversée

DES MONTAGNES EN LACETS
Grimpe en lacets dans les tunnels qui serpentent au cœur des montagnes, et prends la route qui passe derrière la piste : un champignon t'y envoie.

TROIS ÉTOILES PAR NIVEAU
Certaines sont sur ta route, d'autres bien cachées. Rejoue pour toutes les trouver et bats ton record de temps. Bats le chrono d'un niveau pour gagner sa couronne, et fais la course contre le fantôme de ton meilleur temps. Au fil des étoiles, des bébés pandas roux rejoignent Nino et roulent derrière lui.

LE ROCHER ARRIVE !
Dans chaque monde, une course-poursuite t'attend : sème le gros rocher grincheux avant qu'il ne te rattrape. Et au chamboule-tout, prends de l'élan et fonce dans les caisses.

LE DRESSING DE NINO
Avec les pièces que tu ramasses, offre à Nino des chapeaux, des couleurs et des traînées ; quelques-uns se gagnent plutôt avec tes couronnes ou tes autocollants. Remplis aussi son album de 24 autocollants, dont certains bien farfelus.

L'ATELIER DE NINO
Dessine tes propres niveaux au doigt : sculpte le sol, creuse des grottes, pose champignons, flèches, ronces et pièces, cache tes étoiles, puis teste ton niveau aussitôt. Envoie-le à un ami avec un simple code, et voyez qui fait le meilleur temps. Des casse-têtes t'attendent aussi : creuse le bon chemin avec ta pelle pour ouvrir la route du terrier.

JAMAIS COINCÉ
Tu tournes en rond ? Lumi la luciole connaît le chemin et vole devant toi. Et chaque jour, une petite balade te propose de revisiter un niveau.

LA DÉMO, PUIS L'AVENTURE COMPLÈTE
La démo gratuite comprend les premiers mondes avec leurs courses-poursuites et leurs chamboule-tout, tout l'atelier et les premiers casse-têtes. Un achat unique, « L'aventure complète », ouvre tous les autres mondes et tous les casse-têtes. Un autre achat, facultatif, « Le grand dressing », ouvre d'un coup tous les looks qui s'achètent avec des pièces ; sans lui, ils se gagnent tous en jouant.

JOUE COMME TU VEUX
À la fin d'un niveau, si tu veux, une courte vidéo d'un de nos autres jeux ou applis double les pièces de ce niveau. Le jeu marche hors ligne. Ta progression reste sur ton téléphone ; un compte facultatif en garde une copie, pour la retrouver sur un autre téléphone.

name: Nonopost: Nonogram Letters
description:
Nonopost turns your pixel drawings into picture letters. Draw a small picture, add a short message and send it to a friend as a link. Your friend sees only number clues. The picture and your message appear when they solve the nonogram.

[How to play]
• The numbers beside each row and above each column tell you the runs of filled cells in that line
• Tap to fill a cell, switch to X to mark empty cells, and drag to fill a whole line at once
• Every puzzle has one solution and can be solved by logic alone, without guessing
• A puzzle takes about 3 to 10 minutes

[Today's Puzzle]
• A new 15×15 puzzle every day at 00:00 UTC, the same for every player in the world
• Solve it to reveal the picture. Your time and daily streak are saved
• Share your result as an emoji grid that does not give the picture away
• 120 practice pictures in 10×10 and 15×15 are free

[Picture letters]
• Draw on a 10×10 or 15×15 grid (20×20 with Premium), write a message of up to 40 characters and choose your stationery
• The app checks that your drawing can be solved. If needed, it opens a few starting cells for your friend
• Send the link with any messaging app. No account and no sign-up
• Your friend solves it in the app, or in a web browser without installing anything
• The picture and message travel inside the link itself. They are not uploaded to or stored on our servers
• Reply with a picture of your own

[Inbox and safety]
• Letters you receive wait in your inbox. The latest 50 are kept on your device
• Hide any letter, or block a sender on your device so their letters no longer appear
• Report a letter: your email app opens with the letter, addressed to our support team
• Messages are checked against a list of offensive words before they are sent

[Ink]
• Earn ink by solving puzzles and letters, or by watching an optional video
• Spend it on hints (reveal a cell, check a line), extra undo, picture themes and stationery
• Some hints and undo are free every day and in every puzzle
• No random rewards. Everything is shown before you choose it

[Premium and other purchases]
• Monthly and yearly plans: no ads, past daily puzzles, unlimited hints and undo, all stationery, 20×20 drawing, plus 30 ink every day. Both start with a 7-day free trial
• Remove Ads: a one-time purchase that removes banner and full-screen ads. Optional rewarded videos stay available
• Picture Pack (40 practice pictures in 4 themes) and Stationery Pack (8 designs): one-time purchases
• Ink packs of several sizes, and a one-time starter pack

The app is available in 39 languages. Your records and letters stay on your device.

[About subscriptions]
• Monthly and yearly plans renew automatically. At the end of the free trial or of each period, the price of the chosen plan is charged to your Apple ID
• A subscription renews at the same price unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• You can cancel in Subscriptions in your App Store account settings
• One-time purchases do not renew

Terms of Use: https://crelve-nono-post.web.app/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://crelve-nono-post.web.app/privacy.html

name: Noow App
description:
Se voir, là, sans rien planifier. Noow aide tes amis et toi à trouver une idée de sortie, sans organiser de longues discussions.

Choisis un moment — ce soir, demain ou cet après-midi — et une envie : restaurants, cinéma, jeux, balades, concerts ou cafés.

Une idée s’affiche. Envoie-la en un tap, puis retrouve seulement les amis partants.

Crée ton compte, ajoute tes amis et garde vos prochaines sorties à portée de main.

name: Noriu Dainuoti
description:
NoriuDainuoti – dainavimo studijos Kaune programėlė mokiniams ir jų šeimoms.

Žinutės su mokytoju, savaitės tvarkaraštis ir mėnesio mokėjimai – vienoje vietoje.

ŽINUTĖS SU MOKYTOJU IR STUDIJA
• Rašykite savo mokytojui ar studijai tiesiai programėlėje.
• Siųskite nuotraukas, PDF dokumentus ir balso įrašus – pavyzdžiui, namų užduotį ar repeticijos įrašą.
• Gaukite pranešimą telefone, kai atsako mokytojas.
• Ansamblių nariai bendrauja grupės pokalbyje.

TVARKARAŠTIS
• Visų šeimos vaikų pamokos savaitės vaizde: laikas, trukmė ir mokytojas.
• Negalite ateiti? Praneškite vienu paspaudimu – mokytojas sužinos iš karto.
• Pradžios ekrane visada matysite artimiausią pamoką.

MOKĖJIMAI
• Mėnesio įmokos pagal pasirašytą sutartį ir jų terminai.
• Apmokėkite saugiai per Montonio – banko pavedimu arba kortele.
• Visada matysite, kas jau apmokėta.

VISA ŠEIMA – VIENOJE PASKYROJE
• Keli vaikai – viena paskyra.
• Prisijunkite su Google, Apple arba vienkartiniu kodu el. paštu – jokių slaptažodžių.
• Patys pasirinkite, kokius pranešimus gauti telefone ir el. paštu.

MOKYTOJAMS
Studijos mokytojai programėlėje mato savo pamokų tvarkaraštį ir mokinius, rašo pastabas po pamokų ir atsako į šeimų žinutes.

APIE STUDIJĄ
NoriuDainuoti – dainavimo studija Kaune, Vilijampolėje. Individualios ir grupinės vokalo pamokos vaikams, paaugliams ir suaugusiesiems: nuo pirmos natos iki scenos, tavo tempu.

Programėlė skirta studijos mokiniams ir jų šeimoms. Dar nesate mūsų mokinys? Užsiregistruokite į pirmąją pamoką svetainėje noriudainuoti.lt.

name: Norpack
description:
Norpack is the app of norpack.pt, the Portuguese online shop for packaging for your business.

• Cake and pastry boxes, pizza boxes, take-away packaging, shipping boxes, bags, ribbons, labels and catering disposables
• Personalized boxes: upload your logo from Photos or Files and we print it
• Clear prices with VAT, sizes and minimum quantities
• Shipping calculated in the cart, free over €150 in mainland Portugal
• Pay with MB WAY, Multibanco, card or Klarna in the secure norpack.pt checkout
• Follow your orders and get a notification when the status changes

The app is in Portuguese. Questions? Write to norpack.pt@gmail.com.

name: Note Taker: Offline Transcribe
description:
Record a lecture or meeting, transcribe it on the phone with no upload, then find any moment by chapter or search.

What you get:
- Your lecture, transcribed on your phone
- Live text while you record
- Jump to any chapter
- Search every word you have recorded
- Nothing uploaded. Ever.

Free to start. One in-app purchase adds the rest, with no subscription.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

name: Nounly
description:
Nounly makes English grammar stick, one quick card at a time.

Swipe through bite-sized grammar challenges: tenses, articles, prepositions, verbs and more. Nounly learns what you find hard and brings it back until you get it right, so every minute goes where you need it most.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• A feed of short grammar questions that adapts to you
• Clear explanations after every answer
• A new word puzzle every day, with hints when you're stuck
• Mistakes review: practise exactly the questions you got wrong
• Listen: hear words and sentences read aloud
• Save cards to come back to later
• Streaks, XP, levels and badges to keep you going
• Gentle daily reminders, at the time you choose

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Use Nounly fully without an account. Your progress stays on your phone. If you like, sign in with Apple or Google to keep your progress safe and carry on from another phone. No ads, no tracking.

Great for learners of English, students preparing for exams, and anyone who wants to write and speak with more confidence.

name: NOVA FALCON
description:
The galactic frontier is under siege. Pilot the VX-series fighter "Falcon" and break through the enemy fleet.

- One-finger drag to move, automatic fire
- 30 chapters of 10 stages, each with its own giant boss and bullet patterns
- Three distinct fighters: balanced Falcon, swift Rain and heavy-hitting Hammer
- Collect power-ups, clear bullets with bombs and unleash your special attack
- Upgrade your fighters with coins and chase high scores
- Crisp pixel art and satisfying explosions

No sign-in required and fully playable offline. Optional Sign in with Apple lets you back up and restore progress via the cloud. No ads, no tracking. Optional in-app purchases (coin packs, shard packs, ship bundles); everything can also be earned by playing.

name: Nova House: Space Shooter
description:
Nova House is an arcade space shooter that moves to the beat of house music.

You start with a small ship and a single shot. Every kill brings you closer to new weapons, up to 10 shots at once. Your ship changes shape and grows stronger every level, from "Spark" all the way to "Omega".

• 100 levels across two galaxies, with different goals: kill targets, survival, score runs, Storm waves, rescue missions and Barrier stands
• Blast: charge the button with your kills and tap it at the right moment to wipe out nearby bullets
• The second galaxy, the Cosmic Ocean, has its own backgrounds, music and ships
• 20 enemy types, from zombies, aliens and cyber skulls to jellyfish, manta rays, anglerfish and sea serpents
• 10 bosses with phases and bullet patterns
• Nova ∞: endless waves, unlocked when you clear the first galaxy
• Daily challenge: a new level every day with a special rule, and more stardust the longer your streak
• 3 new missions every day
• Stars on every level: replay any level you like to collect them all
• A chest after every boss, plus rare cards that change how you play
• 18 medals that pay out stardust
• Loot dropped by monsters: lasers, missiles, shields, nova blasts and more
• DROP mode: chain your kills, fill the beat meter and score triple points
• Power-up cards between levels, permanent upgrades in the Hangar, plus paint jobs and designs for your ship
• House music and backgrounds that never stop changing
• Game Center leaderboard
• In English and Greek
• Plays offline, with no ads and no in-app purchases

Drag your finger to move. Firing is automatic.

name: NOVA PLAYER
description:
NOVA PLAYER est un lecteur multimédia autonome conçu pour lire vos propres playlists M3U / M3U+, guides de programmes XMLTV et accès API Xtream personnels sur iPhone et iPad.

Points forts :
• Mini-lecteur Direct intégré : parcourez vos catégories et chaînes tout en continuant la lecture vidéo, avec bascule instantanée en plein écran.
• Organisation complète : onglets Direct, Films, Séries et Favoris avec recherche instantanée et tri rapide.
• Guide TV (EPG) : affichage du programme en cours et à suivre directement sous le lecteur.
• Moteur matériel performant : prise en charge large des flux HLS, TS, MP4 et MKV avec sélection des pistes audio, sous-titres, Picture-in-Picture et AirPlay.
• Gestion multi-profils simplifiée : ajout local ou synchronisation distante via QR Code et code d'appareil sur https://mynovaplayer.com.

Mention légale importante :
NOVA PLAYER est un logiciel lecteur multimédia vide. L'application ne contient, n'héberge, ne fournit et ne vend aucune chaîne de télévision, aucun film, aucune série ni aucun flux ou abonnement vidéo. L'utilisateur doit fournir ses propres contenus légaux.

name: Novera POS
description:
Novera POS is a point-of-sale system for shops and retail outlets: grocery markets, supermarkets, building materials and décor stores.

The app is designed for employees of businesses connected to Novera. Your account and PIN code are issued by your company administrator.

CHECKOUT
• Fast PIN sign-in
• Open and close shifts, track cash in the register
• Scan barcodes and QR codes with your iPhone or iPad camera
• Cart, discounts and multiple payment methods
• Digital and printed receipts with a QR code
• Receipt history with day filters

INVENTORY
• Goods receipt, stock levels and stock value
• Product cards with photos
• Print price tags and barcode labels

CUSTOMERS & DEBTS
• Customer database
• Sales on credit and repayments
• Debt book per branch

FOR MANAGERS
• Sales and revenue overview by branch
• Expenses and stock reports
• Per-employee access permissions

WORKS OFFLINE
If the connection drops, sales are stored on the device and sent to the server automatically once you are back online.

The app interface is in Uzbek.

name: NSC
description:
L’app des clients de Nuisibles sous Contrôle (NSC), société belge de lutte contre les nuisibles.

Elle ouvre votre espace client, celui que vous connaissez sur notre site, avec votre adresse e-mail et votre mot de passe. Il faut déjà être client de NSC : l’accès se reçoit par une invitation de NSC.

Vos lieux
• Chaque maison, magasin ou bâtiment suivi par NSC, avec son adresse, ses passages faits et à venir, et ses documents.

Vos passages et rendez-vous
• Le prochain passage du technicien, la date et l’heure.
• L’historique des passages, avec ce qui a été fait.

Vos documents
• Rapports d’intervention, plans de lutte, attestations, contrat signé et annexes.
• Factures, avec ce qui reste à payer et l’échéance.
• Chaque document s’ouvre dans l’app ; le bouton Partager d’iOS l’enregistre dans Fichiers, l’imprime ou l’envoie à votre comptable.

Identifier un nuisible
• Répondez à quelques questions et photographiez ce que vous voyez (crottes, nid, insecte, dégâts) avec l’appareil photo de l’iPhone.
• L’assistant de NSC vous dit de quoi il s’agit probablement et quoi faire en attendant ; vous pouvez demander une intervention en un geste.

Raccourcis
• Appui long sur l’icône : « Identifier un nuisible », « Mes rendez-vous », « Mes documents ».

Votre compte
• Vos coordonnées chez NSC, le téléphone et l’e-mail de NSC en un geste.
• Vous pouvez supprimer vous-même votre accès et votre compte de connexion, dans « Mon compte ».

Aucune publicité, aucun suivi publicitaire dans l’app.

name: Nullwave
description:
Nullwave is a midnight radio mystery you play on device. Sweep a large circular frequency dial, lock onto hidden carriers, and step into branching audio-puzzle scripts told through text and choices.

Explore multiple night episodes, each with forking paths and several endings. Your progress and unlocked endings stay in a local archive. Visit the Night Desk for privacy details, a replayable guide, and a full reset.

No account. No ads network. No connection required. Just the booth, the dial, and whatever answers between stations.

name: Number Quest: Maths for Kids
description:
Number Quest is a calm, playful maths adventure for learners aged 5 to 16 and beyond. Pick a trail that fits the age, play a quick round, collect stars and build a streak. There are no ads, no loot boxes and no countdown to guilt.

CHOOSE A TRAIL
Five trails grow with the player:
• Sprouts (ages 5–6): counting, shapes, patterns and first sums
• Trail (ages 7–9): addition, subtraction, times tables 2 to 12, reading the clock, time and money
• Climbers (ages 10–12): fractions, decimals, percent, area and word problems
• Scholars (ages 13–15): integers, algebra, ratios, exponents and angles
• Masters (16+): linear equations, quadratics, slope, trig basics, stats and functions

SEVEN WAYS TO PLAY
• Quest: ten questions and three lives. Finish the trail to earn stars.
• Sprint: sixty seconds, as many right answers as you can.
• Daily: eight new questions every day, the same for every player on a trail.
• Daily puzzle: find the hidden sum in six tries, like a word puzzle with numbers. A new one every day on each trail.
• Number Pop: tap the rising bubble with the right answer before it floats away.
• Stack: right answers clear the coloured rows; wrong or slow ones push a new row in. Two minutes a round.
• Practice: no timer. Pick a topic, use hints and read a written explanation after each question.

LEARN FROM MISTAKES
Every question comes with a clear explanation. In Practice, a wrong answer shows how it works, and an optional tutor can explain the step you missed in a different way.

A LITTLE EVERY DAY
Pick a daily goal of 5, 10 or 15 minutes. A live timer counts the time spent answering questions. Every day you reach the goal earns shells and grows your streak. You can turn on one gentle reminder a day, at a time you choose, only on days the goal isn't reached yet. It's set on the phone itself, so no account is needed.

SHELLS, PETS AND YOUR OWN BUDDY
Make a buddy with faces, hair, colours and more. Shells buy hats, backgrounds and one of 45 pets, from a goldfish to a dragon, shown right beside your buddy. Give your pet a name. Spend now or save up for something bigger. Missing a day never takes anything away: shells and prizes are kept, and more days of play unlock special prizes like a narwhal and a phoenix.

BUILT TO BE CALM
Questions are generated on the device, so there is always something new to try. Stars, streaks and experience points reward steady practice, not speed alone. Each trail has its own colours, from bright and bubbly for the youngest to calm and clean for older players, in light and dark themes.

IN SEVEN LANGUAGES
English, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese, Indonesian and Hindi. The game opens in your phone's language, and you can switch any time with the globe button.

PLAY AS A GUEST OR SIGN IN
You can start playing straight away without an account. Accounts are for ages 13 and over: sign in with Apple or email if you want your stars and streaks to follow you across devices. Younger players keep their progress on the device.

NO INTERNET?
The app still gives you a ten-question round on your trail, and goes back to the full game when you're online again.

FOR PARENTS AND TEACHERS
A page for grown-ups shows minutes played, how each topic is going and what to practise next. It can be printed, or sent by email every Sunday evening. Free printable worksheets with answer keys are at numberquest.me/worksheets.

GOOD FOR
• Parents who want short, friendly practice sessions
• Teachers and homeschoolers looking for a free classroom warm-up
• Teens and adults brushing up on algebra, ratios and trig
• Anyone who would rather play than drill worksheets, and still do the maths

Number Quest is free to play, with no ads and nothing to buy. Shells are earned by playing and can never be bought.

Questions or feedback? hello@corbi.au

name: Numboxed
description:
Numboxed is a storage inventory system that works without a printer, labels or scanning. Write a number on each box with a marker, then keep the list of what's inside on your phone. Numboxed gives you the next free number, tracks every item, and shows you exactly where things are, from the place to the zone to the box. Type a box number on the big keypad to open it instantly, or search for any item and get the full path to it. 

Map out your garage, attic, balcony, storage unit or country house with a simple grid layout, and see which boxes sit in which zone. Take items out, lend them to friends with a return date, and return them to their original box. Overdue loans are highlighted, so nothing goes missing. Snap photos of boxes, contents and places to recognize them at a glance. 

Plan seasonal swaps, trips to the country house and moves with checklists of boxes to bring out or put away. Numboxed reminds you about returns, upcoming plans, storage rent and boxes you haven't opened in a year, and its Insights show duplicates, empty boxes and expiring items.

name: NumLuck
description:
Explore traditional number meanings with NumLuck.

• Type or paste digits, or read numbers from photos and the camera.
• Compare scores and digit-pair meanings in one searchable list.
• Choose six scoring focuses from the home screen: Balanced, Finance, Career, Romance, Social, Ease. Set your language and luck colors.
• Sort by recent, number or score. Save history locally and delete entries anytime.

Letters and symbols are removed while digits and leading zeros are retained. At least two digits are needed for a score. Split very large inputs into batches.

Recognition and ratings run on your device. No account, ads or analytics. The app does not upload or retain photos. iCloud-only originals may require a system download.

iPhone and iPad · iOS 17 or later.

name: Nuur: Quran & Prayer Times
description:
Nuur brings together the Quran, prayer times with the adhan, the Qibla, supplications and hadith. The app works in French, Wolof, English and Arabic. It needs no account, shows no ads and does not track you.

The Quran
The Uthmani text from Tanzil is shown verse by verse, or as continuous text page by page like a printed mushaf. Three translations are included: Saheeh International in English, Rachid Maach and Muhammad Hamidullah in French, with the notes of Saheeh International and Rachid Maach. Transliteration and two Arabic tafsirs, Al-Muyassar and Al-Jalalayn, are also available. Browse by surah, juz, hizb or page, add bookmarks and notes, and follow a plan to complete the Quran.

Recitation
Nineteen reciters, including Mishary Alafasy, Abdul Basit, Al-Husary, Al-Minshawi and Maher Al-Muaiqly. To memorize, Nuur repeats each verse and then the whole passage as many times as you choose. A downloaded surah plays offline.

Prayer times and adhan
Times are calculated on your phone, from your location or one of 34,000 cities. Fourteen calculation methods are available, with a choice of school for Asr and minute-by-minute adjustments to match your mosque. Pick the adhan for each prayer among five voices, and add a reminder before prayer time. The monthly timetable shows imsak and iftar during Ramadan.

Qibla and mosques
The compass shows the direction of the Kaaba and how far it is. The map lists nearby mosques from OpenStreetMap, with directions.

Supplications
The complete Fortress of the Muslim: 132 chapters, from waking up to travelling, in Arabic, transliteration and translation, with audio and a repetition counter. The tasbih offers eight phrases of dhikr with a goal and a vibration at each round. The 99 Names of Allah come with their meanings.

Hadith
Sahih al-Bukhari, Sahih Muslim, An-Nawawi's 40 Hadith and 40 Hadith Qudsi, in Arabic and English, with word search.

Calendar and zakat
The Hijri calendar shows Islamic feasts and recommended fasting days. The calculator gives zakat on wealth and zakat al-fitr.

Assistant
Ask about belief, prayer or fasting. The assistant first searches the Quran and hadith in the app, cites its sources as links and presents the views of the schools of law. Its answers are generated by artificial intelligence: for a personal ruling, ask an imam or a scholar.

Your bookmarks, notes and settings stay on your phone. Privacy policy: https://nuur.softengaidagro-sn.com/confidentialite

name: Nvcio
seller_name: UCEL AKSESUAR MOBILYA MALZEMELERI ITHALAT IHRACAT SANAYI VE TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Thanks for downloading and trying out our app—we truly value your support and feedback.

Nvcio keeps chores fair in a shared home. Add the people you live with, write down the jobs that keep the place running, and Nvcio hands each one to the next person in line, every day, week or month. Tap Done and the chore's effort points drop into that person's glass jar, so everyone can see who has been pulling their weight.

TAKE TURNS WITHOUT ARGUING
Each chore has its own rotation. Pick who takes part and in what order, choose daily, weekly or monthly, and Nvcio works out whose turn it is right now and who is up next. No more "I did it last time".

POINTS FOR EFFORT
Not all chores are equal. Give every chore 1 to 5 effort points: watering the plants is a 1, cleaning the bathroom might be a 4. When a chore is marked done, its points drop into the jar of whoever actually did it, even if they were covering for someone.

A FAIRNESS BALANCE AT A GLANCE
The Jars screen lines up everyone's jar and shows a simple balance: who is ahead of an even share and who could take the next big job. Count points for this week, this month or all time.

SWAP WHEN LIFE HAPPENS
Away for the weekend? Hand your turn to a housemate with one tap, and optionally take one of their chores in return. The swap only affects this period; the usual rotation carries on afterwards.

THIS WEEK ON ONE BOARD
The home board shows today's, this week's and this month's chores with whose turn it is, how much time is left and what's already done. Filter by person to see just your own list. Undo a tick if it was tapped by mistake.

HISTORY YOU CAN TRUST
Every Done is kept with its date, time and points. Browse it by day or by person, and take points back out if something was logged wrongly.

MADE FOR HOUSEMATES, FAMILIES AND COUPLES
Housemates are just names with a colour-coded chip, managed from one phone. Nobody else needs to install anything or make an account.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CHOICE
Sign in with Apple, Google or email, or tap "Try it first" to start as a guest. Guests can save their household to a real account later without losing anything. Your data syncs through Google Firebase, works offline, and you can delete your account and everything in it from House rules at any time.

NO ADS, NO TRACKING
Nvcio has no ads, no analytics and no tracking. It only stores what you add: housemates' names, chores, and the done history.

name: Oak Label
description:
Oak Label lets you design and print labels on a Bluetooth thermal label maker from your iPhone or iPad. There's no account and no subscription, and printing is always free.

FREE
• Print over Bluetooth to supported pocket thermal printers, such as the Phomemo D30, with no print limits
• Text labels with auto-fit, alignment and fonts
• Date and use-by labels: {date} and {date+7} fill in automatically when you print
• QR codes for links and plain text
• Starter templates: pantry, freezer, price tag, address, file folder, cable, shelf/bin and name tag
• A library of saved labels, plus copies and quick reprint

OAK LABEL PRO: $9.99 ONE TIME
• Wi-Fi QR codes, so guests scan a label to join your network
• Business templates: Made by and Guest Wi-Fi
• Save your own templates
• Batch print from spreadsheets: paste rows or import a CSV, and get one label per row. Try it free 3 times.

Pro is a single purchase, not a subscription. Restore Purchases brings it back on a new device.

Connect to your printer from inside Oak Label. You don't need to pair it in iOS Settings. Oak Label remembers your printer and reconnects automatically. Match the label size in the app to the roll in your printer.

Your labels stay on your device. Oak Label has no ads, no analytics and no tracking.

Phomemo is a trademark of its respective owner. Oak Label is not affiliated with or endorsed by printer manufacturers. Oakline Media is a trade name of JF Companies Inc.

name: Oathrank: Workout Streak
description:
Your discipline deserves a rank.

Oathrank turns your training consistency into a ranking. One box for every day you train. Every complete week moves you up. Miss one day too many, and you start over.

HOW IT WORKS
• Tick the box when your session is done: gym, running, cycling, swimming, anything.
• Choose your rest days, 0 to 4 a week: they don’t break your streak.
• One joker a month covers the unexpected.
• Every complete week in a row moves you up one division.
• An evening reminder if you forgot to tick: just one, and only if you want it.

19 RANKS TO THE TOP
Recruit, Bronze, Gold, Diamond, Master, Legend… all the way to Immortal, after 52 weeks in a row. Every rank has its own animated character, emblem and backdrop. Whether you train 3 or 6 times a week, reaching the top takes the same time: only your consistency counts.

CHALLENGE YOUR FRIENDS
Add friends with a code and compare your ranks and streaks on a leaderboard. Nobody else sees your profile.

CHOOSE YOUR WORLD
Greek mythology is free: Zeus, Poseidon, Athena, Heracles… Unlock other worlds, each with its 19 characters, animated backdrops and avatars:
• Vikings: Thor, Odin, the Valkyries
• Pirates: Blackbeard, Davy Jones, the Kraken
• Egypt: Anubis, Horus, Ra
And plenty more to discover. Each theme is a one-time purchase, no subscription. It changes the look, never your rank: the top can’t be bought.

YOUR RANK CARD
Your name, your avatar, your best streak. A new avatar unlocks every time you reach a rank for the first time.

NO ADS, NO TRACKING
No ads, no tracking. Your streak is saved to your account: you’ll find it on all your devices.

The app is available in English and French.

One box a day. How long will you last?

name: Objection! - Trial Trainer
description:
Objection! turns courtroom objections into a fast, dramatic reflex game. Watch real-feeling trial scripts unfold — witness testimony, cross-examination, even opening statements and closing arguments — and call out the objection before the clock runs out.

Every trial is built around real Federal Rules of Evidence and general mock trial practice: hearsay exceptions, foundation requirements, character evidence, expert testimony limits, improper argument tactics, and more. Get it right and the judge sustains your objection — on the spot, with a plain-English explanation of exactly why. Get it wrong, and you'll see exactly what you missed.

24 trials across criminal and civil tracks, from foundational basics to deep dives into a single evidentiary doctrine with more to come. Compete against your own best score on every trial, choose your difficulty, and pick Federal Rules or general Mock Trial conventions.

Built for law students, mock trial competitors, and anyone who's ever wanted to yell "Objection!" and actually know why.

name: OceanBow
description: Choose an ocean friend, start the beat and turn back to your instrument. Practice open strings, bowing and short pieces at your own tempo. Choose a bow length, listen for the optional accent or count the beats yourself. After practice, open the on-device calendar to see which friends swam with you.

name: Oddpair Bond
description:
Oddpair Bond to narzędzie składające się z dwóch urządzeń, stworzone z myślą o występach typu iluzja sceniczna i mentalizm. Umożliwia ono wykonawcy dyskretne otrzymywanie informacji o wyborach dokonanych przez widza na drugim urządzeniu mobilnym. System nie wymaga zakładania kont ani korzystania z zewnętrznych serwerów; oba telefony iPhone synchronizują się za pośrednictwem lokalnej, szyfrowanej sesji (z wykorzystaniem sieci Wi-Fi, Bluetooth i/lub lokalnej sieci komputerowej).

Skonfiguruj swoje rekwizyty w aplikacji – mogą to być kolory, zakresy liczbowe lub listy przedmiotów osobistych.
Wyznacz jedno urządzenie jako „urządzenie wykonawcy”, a drugie jako „urządzenie uczestnika”.
Sparuj urządzenia za pomocą 6-cyfrowego kodu lub poprzez zeskanowanie kodu QR (kody parowania są ważne przez około 60 sekund).
Gdy wykonawca rozpocznie sesję, widz dokonuje wyboru i potwierdza go na ekranie swojego urządzenia.
Wykonawca może ustawić opóźnienie ujawnienia wyniku, ręcznie sterować jego widocznością lub całkowicie go ukryć; wynik jest również automatycznie maskowany, jeśli aplikacja zostanie przeniesiona do tła.
Tryb „próby” pozwala przećwiczyć cały numer na jednym urządzeniu, włącznie z symulacją zerwania połączenia.

Lokalna łączność między urządzeniami: Wykorzystuje szyfrowaną sesję typu „Multipeer”; dane przesyłane są wyłącznie pomiędzy dwoma urządzeniami.
Trzy kategorie rekwizytów: Kolory, liczby oraz przedmioty – wszystkie w pełni konfigurowalne, z opcją zapisywania w ulubionych lub powielania.
Funkcje dla profesjonalistów: Możliwość opóźnionego ujawnienia wyniku, ręczne sterowanie jego prezentacją oraz prywatne notatki dla wykonawcy (niewidoczne dla widza).
Samodzielne próby: Ćwicz cały występ bez potrzeby używania drugiego urządzenia; sesje próbne są odpowiednio oznaczone.
Dane przechowywane lokalnie: Aplikacja oferuje wyszukiwanie i filtrowanie historii, eksport oraz przywracanie kopii zapasowych, a także narzędzia do odzyskiwania danych – wszystko to bez konieczności posiadania konta czy korzystania z chmury.

name: OddRep: Wrist Motion Tracker
description:
Your practice deserves a record—even when it is not a conventional workout.

OddRep uses Apple Watch to log wrist-based activities such as kendama, diabolo and hula hoop. Start a session to track duration, estimated reps and available heart rate, then review your records on iPhone. An Apple Watch is required for real motion recording; iPhone alone does not capture wrist motion.

MAKE THE RECORD FIT YOUR PRACTICE
Choose a built-in activity or create your own. Use rep-counting mode for rhythmic movements, or timed mode when duration is what matters. Adjust the detection axis, sensitivity and minimum rep interval to suit your motion. Estimated reps are not a count of successful tricks or a measure of form.

RECORD ON WATCH. REVIEW ON IPHONE.
Start, pause, resume and finish on your wrist. When both devices are connected and reachable, you can also control the session from iPhone. Transfer saved records to your phone, filter by activity or date, and explore duration, reps, available heart rate and session charts for heart rate, cadence and motion intensity.

SEE YOUR PRACTICE ADD UP
Review daily duration and rep trends in Overview, or compare sessions for the same activity in Insights. No leaderboard. No form score. Just a clearer picture of the time and rhythm you put in.

OPTIONAL APPLE HEALTH SYNC
With the required permission, records transferred to iPhone can be saved as workouts in Apple Health. Automatic sync is on by default and can be switched off in Overview. You can also sync an individual real session manually. Completion depends on connectivity, app state and authorization.

TAKE YOUR RECORDS WITH YOU
Export real session summaries and chart data as CSV. When a raw motion file is available, you can export that too. Keep your own archive or analyze it your way. Exported files may contain motion and heart-rate information, so check before sharing.

ONE PURCHASE. NO SUBSCRIPTION.
A paid download with no in-app purchases, subscriptions or ads. No sign-up and no analytics tracking SDK. OddRep keeps records on your devices and does not upload your motion or health data to the developer. You choose whether to save workouts to Apple Health or share an export. Sample and demo sessions are excluded from Health sync and CSV export.

BEFORE YOU START
• Real motion recording requires a compatible Apple Watch. Without one, you can explore sample records on iPhone.
• Reps are estimated from wrist acceleration peaks. Strap fit, movement and detection settings affect the result. Check against a known count before relying on a setup.
• Heart rate depends on Watch measurements and permission, and may not be available for every session.
• OddRep does not recognize activities, grade form, estimate calories or provide medical advice. It is not intended for diagnosis or treatment.

name: oeYYeo: Lantern Rush
description:
At 7:40 PM the Midline goes dark.

The rain comes up the gorge, the lamps of Esker gutter out block by block, and the static walks in from the dark. Five heroes stand at the end of one lane with their backs to the city. You are what keeps them standing.

HOLD THE LANE
The static comes in waves: quick wisps, steady crawlers, and brutes that hit twice as hard. Your five throw sparks at everything that reaches them, and every spark lands for exactly the damage it says. When a hero's card reads READY, tap it:

Ingeborg holds Lantern Road at the Edge. Her Lantern Road slows the whole static to a crawl.
Anselm cuts apart dead mirrors in the Yard. His Dead Mirror doubles every shot for a few seconds.
Mireya keeps the Awning open on the Midline. Her Warm Cup relights the lamps the static put out.
Odalys works the night shift in the Undertrack. Her Last Train runs through every foe in the lane.
Tobiah is undefeated in the Skyring. His Skyring Strike lands one great blow on the biggest thing out there.

The fifth wave of every week brings the Blackout, a walking dark with a lantern caught in its chest. Hold it off and the week is yours.

POUR THE SPARKS
Between waves, the sparks you won pour from a brass lantern down a board of pegs, rails and gates. Drag to aim. Thread the x2 and x3 gates and your sparks multiply; drift wide and they spill down the drains. It is a few seconds of pure nerve, and a sharp aim takes nearly twice the sparks of a careless one into the next fight.

SPEND THEM WELL
Spend your sparks on upgrade cards, each showing its exact number now and after: Sharper Sparks, Faster Hands, Spare Lamps, Richer Static, or one hero's ability a level up. Your first card each week is free. No lucky draws, no hidden rolls: the cards are always your weakest upgrades, so every choice is a real one.

NINE WEEKS IN ESKER
Each week is a chapter of the city's season: the auditor's blank notices, a whole block gone dark, the Skyring semifinal under the lights, letters that come back on the last train perfectly dry, and a vote on one substation key. Clear a week and its lamp lights on the season map, with up to three stars for how many of the city's lamps you kept burning.

THE WORKSHOP
Stars buy permanent head starts in the Workshop: Sharper Sparks, Faster Hands, Deep Lamps and the Seasoned Five. Lost a wave? You get one retry a week. Want the third star? Come back stronger and take the week again.

Climb the Game Center leaderboard and earn achievements as you light the season.

Your progress follows you between your iPhone and iPad through iCloud, and the whole game plays offline.

Free to play. No ads. Nothing to buy. Just Esker, the rain, and one lamp that will not go out.

name: oksi
description: Manage lessons, homework and messages with oksi. Teachers can organize their schedule and students, track lesson packages, assign homework and vocabulary, and teach with chat, video calls and a shared whiteboard. Students access their lessons through a private link from their teacher. Teacher accounts are created by an administrator. oksi records lesson payments but does not process payments.

name: Oldtimer Garage
description:
Oldtimer Garage ist die digitale Fahrzeugakte für Oldtimer- und Youngtimer-Besitzer.

ALLES ZU DEINEM KLASSIKER AN EINEM ORT
Rechnungen, Gutachten, Restaurierungsfotos und Notizen – sauber sortiert nach Fahrzeug und Datum. Belege scannst du einfach mit der Kamera.

ZUSTANDS-CHECK
Bewerte Karosserie, Lack, Chrom, Innenraum, Motor, Fahrwerk, Elektrik und Originalität mit Noten von 1 bis 5. Sechs feste Foto-Ansichten dokumentieren dein Fahrzeug. Die App ermittelt die Gesamtnote.

TERMINE IM GRIFF
TÜV und H-Gutachten, Ölwechsel, Saisonkennzeichen, Versicherung und Batterie im Winterlager – mit Erinnerung rechtzeitig vorher.

FAHRTEN UND KILOMETER-LIMIT
Zeichne Ausfahrten auf oder trag sie von Hand ein. Die App zeigt, wie viele Kilometer dir bis zum Limit deiner Oldtimer-Versicherung bleiben.

WERT IM BLICK
Trag Werte aus Gutachten ein und verfolge die Entwicklung als Kurve. Die App zeigt, wie sich der Wert im Verhältnis zu Kaufpreis und Investitionen entwickelt hat.

FAHRZEUGHISTORIE ALS PDF (PRO)
Beim Verkauf zählt jede belegte Arbeit. Erstelle auf Knopfdruck eine Fahrzeughistorie mit Eckdaten, Chronik, Belegen und Fotos – auf Wunsch ohne Beträge.

PRO
Kostenlos für ein Fahrzeug. Pro schaltet unbegrenzt viele Fahrzeuge und die Fahrzeughistorie als PDF frei – als Jahresabo mit einer Woche gratis oder einmalig für immer. Das Abo verlängert sich automatisch, wenn es nicht mindestens 24 Stunden vor Ablauf in den Einstellungen deines Apple-Accounts gekündigt wird.
Nutzungsbedingungen: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Keine Werbung. Kein Tracking. Kein Konto. Deine Daten bleiben auf deinem iPhone.

name: OMG: One More Gem
description:
How deep would you go for one more gem? They told you the diamonds came from deep beneath the surface. They never told you what put them there. At first, it was just a glimmer in the dark. Then another. Each discovery brought you closer to a fortune - and closer to something no one had ever reached before. So you built a rover. Packed your supplies. And started digging. The deeper you went, the stranger the world became. The rocks grew harder. The heat intensified. The light from the surface disappeared. And sometimes, when the drill fell silent, you thought you heard something move. Why do the crystals glow brighter the deeper you go? Who left those marks in the stone? And why does it feel like something down there knows you’re coming? There’s only one way to find out.

DIG DEEPER
Pilot your mining rover through layers of rock and uncover a mysterious underground world filled with gems, diamonds and secrets.

BUILD A STRONGER ROVER
Upgrade your drill and equipment to reach deeper places, break through tougher terrain and survive the rising heat.

KNOW WHEN TO TURN BACK
Watch your fuel, temperature and rover condition. Bring your treasures to the surface, prepare for the next expedition and decide how much you’re willing to risk.

DISCOVER WHAT LIES BELOW
Not everything buried underground is waiting to be found. Some secrets are best left in the dark.

But what if the next diamond is just a little deeper? Some things are better left undiscovered. Diamonds aren’t one of them.

name: Onawo
description:
Onawo is the social app built for Zimbabwe.

Ask Zimbabwe. Answer Zimbabwe. Onawo brings the conversations that matter to Zimbabwean communities into one place - a place to ask real questions, share practical knowledge, keep up with local news, and stay in touch privately.

DISCOVER AND ANSWERS
- Ask questions and get answers from people who know Zimbabwe best
- Follow topics, search what has already been answered, and build on the community's knowledge
- Discover people, profiles and conversations in your community

PRIVATE, ENCRYPTED CHAT
- One-to-one messaging with end-to-end encryption
- Send text and photos, share your location, and see delivery and read receipts
- Voice and video calls, status updates, and group chats
- Privacy controls: mute, block, star messages, set chat themes, and manage linked devices
- Back up and restore your chats with a passphrase you control

NEWS AND LOCAL KNOWLEDGE
- A feed of top stories from Zimbabwe and beyond
- Read articles in a clean reader and follow the topics you care about
- Browse trusted Zimbabwean legal websites and public-interest resources

TOOLS FOR EVERYDAY LIFE
- Scan QR codes and documents
- Extract text from images with on-device text recognition
- Work with PDFs and trim videos before sharing
- Track customers, invoices, expenses and business records with simple billing tools

BUILT FOR ZIMBABWE
Onawo is a local-first product from Gokamu Digital (Private) Limited. Registration is currently limited to Zimbabwean mobile numbers.

Your conversations stay yours: chat messages are encrypted on your device, and your encryption keys are stored locally.

name: OnCallAlert
description:
OnCallAlert is the companion app for your self-hosted OnCallAlert server. It puts your on-call alerts on your phone so you can see them and act on them quickly.

What you can do
• Get push notifications when an alert is sent to you
• See open alerts and their details
• Acknowledge an alert
• Resolve an alert
• Pair your phone with your own server in a minute

How it works
OnCallAlert is not a hosted service. You run the OnCallAlert server yourself, then pair this app to it:
1. Sign in to your server's web interface.
2. Open your profile and choose "Connect Mobile App".
3. In the app, scan the QR code, or enter your server URL and the pairing token.

Your alerts stay on your server. The app is a mirror of your server's alerts, plus acknowledge and resolve.

Please note
• You need an OnCallAlert server to use this app.
• Push notification delivery depends on your phone, your network and the push service.

Learn more at https://oncallalert.dev

name: One Heart Bible
description:
One Heart is a Bible reader for couples, families and small groups who read Scripture aloud together on one phone or iPad.

TAKE TURNS
• Set up two or more readers, each with a name and a color.
• Choose 3, 6 or 9 verses per turn. The text shows whose turn it is.
• A discussion symbol marks a good place to stop and talk together.

GROUPS THAT KEEP THEIR PLACE
• Make a group for your marriage, your family or your Bible study.
• Each group keeps its own readers, place, notes and highlights.

STUDY TOGETHER
• Highlights, bookmarks, notes and memory verses.
• Search the Bible and jump to any book, chapter and verse.

FIVE BIBLE EDITIONS
King James Version, World English Bible, Berean Standard Bible, American Standard Version (1901) and Russian Synodal (Синодальный перевод).

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking.
• Your reading stays on your device. Back up a group to a file whenever you like.

name: One Less Thing: Shared Lists
description:
Keep the little things you do together in one place. Make a group for your household, family, or friends and invite them with a code or QR invite.

• Share to-do lists and see who’s taking care of each task.
• Sort groceries by aisle and adjust quantities as you shop.
• Schedule tasks and events, then see your day on an hourly timeline.
• Add places to errands and find pending stops on a map.
• Pin a shared list to your Home Screen with the One Less Thing widget.
• Make changes offline and sync them when you reconnect.

Give your lists your own look with Pastel, Retro Future, Vibrant, or Paper Studio. Light and dark appearances are available in Settings.

name: One Line: Five Year Journal
description:
Answer one question a day in one sentence, and see how you answered the same question on this date in past years.

What you get:
- One question a day
- See what you said last year
- Under a minute, every evening
- Today's question on your home screen
- Private. On your phone. No account.

Free to start. One in-app purchase adds the rest, with no subscription.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

name: One to One: Verified Dating
description:
One to One is an invitation-only dating app for adults, kept balanced one to one: one woman for every man, county by county.

How joining works
You apply in a few quiet questions: your first name, your date of birth, your city and state, whether you are a woman or a man, who you hope to meet, and what you are looking for. A person reads every application, for completeness and intent, not appearance. Members are admitted in pairs, as your county's balance allows. If there is no place for you yet, we tell you where you stand. Before anyone can see you, you verify with a government ID and a live selfie, checked by Stripe. We keep the result, never the documents.

Your profile
Up to nine photos, a short bio, your interests, and prompts you answer on camera or in writing, so people hear how you talk. A person on our team reviews every photo and clip before other members see it.

Discover
Discover introduces people one at a time, with their photos, clips and prompts. Interest is not a like, and it is not rationed. Nobody hears about an Interest that is not mutual.

Aligned
When the interest is mutual, a conversation opens, and either of you can speak first. Write, send a voice message, or send a photo of your own. Nothing expires.

Safety
Report and Block sit on every profile and in every conversation, and you can end an alignment at any time. Every report is read by a person. One to One is for adults, 18 and over: the ID check confirms it before anyone is approved. You can pause introductions whenever you like, and you can delete your account inside the app.

What we don't do
No ads. We don't sell your personal information. We never read your phone's location: members see your city and state, nothing more precise. No swiping, no counters, no streaks.

Price
Everyone joins free. One to One may add a paid membership later. It will be optional, and verification, Interest, chat, block, report, ending an alignment and your preferences stay free.

One to One is available in the United States. Questions: hello@onetooneapp.com

name: OneMove Resonance & Balance
description:
Two spectral tools for vocals and mixes, as AUv3 plug-ins for iPad and iPhone.

RESONANCE: CALM THE RINGING, KEEP THE LIFE
Resonance finds the frequencies that ring, and cuts only those, only while they ring. Harshness, mud and sibilance calm down without dulling the rest of the sound.
• One Depth control does the job. Detail, Attack, Release, Max Cut, Mix and Output refine it.
• Soft or Hard character, and Delta to hear only what is being removed.
• Shape where it works: draw a band or a tilt on the live spectrum.
• Seven factory presets.

BALANCE: TAME WHAT DOMINATES, LIFT WHAT HIDES
Balance is an equalizer that rebalances the spectrum as the music moves. Tame turns down what dominates and masks the rest; Recover lifts what is hidden. Bias, Brighten and Boost set the character.
• Keyed by a voice, Balance clears space in the music only where the voice needs it (Voice Duck).
• A live EQ display shows every band as it moves.
• Five factory presets.

ZERO LATENCY
Both plug-ins report zero latency, so they are safe to sing and play through live.

KEY LINK: NO ROUTING NEEDED
Put one plug-in on the vocal and set it to Send Key. Put another on the music, set it to Process and choose the same letter. The music then makes room for the voice. It works in any host, with no side-chain routing, and also with OneMove Vocal Console and OneMove Air ("Send vocal key"). Hosts with side-chain routing can feed the plug-ins' side-chain input directly.

TRY IT IN THE APP
The app has its own player: a vocal over music, with A/B bypass. Hear either plug-in on the whole mix, or on the music keyed by the vocal. No host needed.

FREE TO TRY, THEN UNLOCK ONCE
Every feature works in any host. Each time a plug-in loads, it processes for 5 minutes, then passes your audio through untouched until you reload it. Bounces and exports pass through unprocessed until you unlock. Unlock Resonance, Balance or both, once. No subscription. Family Sharing supported. Your settings carry over.

WORKS WITH
AUv3 hosts on iPad and iPhone. Mono and stereo. Every control is a host parameter for automation. Black or cream panel.

HELP
The app and the plug-in settings have a Help & feedback section: the manual, and a form to report a bug, suggest an idea or ask a question.

PRIVACY
Everything runs on your device. No account, no tracking, no data collected. Help links open onemove.audio in Safari; the form sends nothing unless you press Send.

Demo vocals: "Lost_Pella" by queeniemusic (CC BY 3.0) and "More Than 2 Sides (accapella)" by Colin Mutchler (CC BY 2.5), via ccMixter; short excerpts. Demo music by OneMove Audio.

name: OnePage: AI Reflection
description:
A clearer mind, one page at a time.

POWERED BY APPLE INTELLIGENCE

One Page is a private reflection journal powered by Apple Intelligence and inspired by Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT).

Explore your thoughts, understand your emotions, and discover new perspectives through personalized questions generated directly on your iPhone.

Unlike traditional journaling apps, One Page uses Apple's on-device intelligence to guide your reflections while keeping your personal writing private.

PERSONALIZED AI REFLECTION

Every thought is different. Your questions should be too.

Apple Intelligence generates thoughtful, personalized questions based on what you write, helping you explore situations from different perspectives.

PRIVACY BY DESIGN

Your thoughts belong to you.

AI-assisted reflections are processed on your device using Apple's Foundation Models framework. Your journal entries are stored locally on your iPhone, without being sent to developer-operated AI servers.

INSPIRED BY CBT

One Page incorporates reflection exercises inspired by Cognitive Behavioral Therapy to help you:

• Explore connections between thoughts and emotions
• Recognize patterns in your thinking
• Consider alternative perspectives
• Develop greater self-awareness

CONTINUE WITH FOLLOW-UP

Reflection doesn't have to end after one session.

Revisit saved entries and continue exploring your thoughts through Follow-up questions.

WRITE WITHOUT AI

Prefer to write freely?

One Page also supports manual journaling, allowing you to record and revisit your thoughts without using Apple Intelligence.

BUILT FOR APPLE INTELLIGENCE

AI-assisted features require an Apple Intelligence-compatible iPhone running iOS 26 or later, with Apple Intelligence enabled and the necessary on-device models available.

Compatible iPhones include iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 15 Pro Max, iPhone 16 models, and newer Apple Intelligence-compatible models.

Apple Intelligence availability may vary depending on language, region, and device settings.

On unsupported devices, AI-assisted reflection is unavailable. Manual journaling remains accessible.

ONE PAGE. YOUR SPACE.

No pressure. No perfect answers.

Just a quiet place to reflect, one page at a time.

IMPORTANT

One Page is intended for personal reflection and general wellness. It does not provide medical diagnoses, psychotherapy, or professional mental health treatment.

name: Open Decks
description:
Let everyone at the party pick the music.
Open Decks is a party jukebox built on Apple Music. The host's iPhone becomes the decks, and guests request songs from their own phones.

■ Jump in with a QR code
Guests don't need the app. On the same Wi-Fi, they scan the QR code on the host screen and request songs in their browser.

■ Everyone's songs, in turn
Requests line up in a queue and play one after another. Each guest gets a color, so you can see whose song is up.

■ Pick from the host's list
Guests choose from a playlist the host picks, or search all of Apple Music. The host can turn search off to keep to the playlist.

■ The host stays in control
Play, pause, skip, reorder and remove from the host screen. When nobody requests anything, the playlist keeps playing.

■ 6 languages
Japanese, English, German, Spanish, French and Korean. Guests choose their own language.

■ Free plan and Open Decks Unlimited
The free plan allows 3 guests per party. Open Decks Unlimited (monthly, with a 1-week free trial) removes the limit. Apple Music playback itself is never limited on either plan.

* The host needs an Apple Music subscription.
* Guests must be on the same Wi-Fi as the host.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://gist.github.com/motokiogata/c8363ef945006800c1e225278c5ad86d

name: Open Universe
description:
Open Universe is the free app of Open Universe, Inc., a Miami nonprofit that champions contemporary art by artists with disabilities working in supportive studios.

One app for all of our programs:
• Open Invitational, our art fair (Miami, during Art Week) and Open Invitational Gallery
• Open Museum, a permanent museum in development in Miami
• The Living Collection, art placements for homes, businesses and public spaces

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Get alerts the moment new artwork arrives, and choose which programs you hear from in the in-app Alerts settings: New artwork, Open Invitational, Open Invitational Gallery and Open Museum.
• Browse artworks and exhibitions, and tap an alert to go straight to the work or show it is about.
• Save the works you love with the heart button. Your Saved list lives on your device.
• Share any artwork, exhibition or story with the native share sheet.
• Pull down to refresh, and keep a friendly offline screen when you lose connection.
• Plan your visit to the fair and gallery, and support artists by shopping or donating.

We present every artist not as a symbol of disability, but as a maker. Every sale and exhibition builds a documented record of the artist's value over time.

No account needed. No ads. No tracking. We use your device's notification token only to send the alerts you choose.

name: Openings Coach: Chess Drills
description:
Build your chess opening repertoire from PGN or by playing moves, then drill it with spaced repetition, offline and without an account.

What you get:
- Your openings, drilled until they stick
- Import any PGN with variations
- Only review what's due
- See where your games left book
- No account. Works offline.

Free to start. You can pay once or subscribe. Purchases are billed to your Apple account, and you can cancel a subscription any time in your store settings.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Looking things up sends data off your phone: the chess study, opening, or game data you ask for and the app name with its support page in the request headers goes to Lichess. Nothing else you enter leaves your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

Terms of use: https://michaeljohnpena.com/apps/openingscoach/terms/
Privacy policy: https://michaeljohnpena.com/apps/openingscoach/privacy/

name: OperaScan: Lyric Diction & IPA
description:
Photograph a page of your score or libretto and sing the words with confidence: lyrics, IPA and translation, line by line.

OperaScan reads the lyrics printed under the staves or set as verse, joins the syllables, drops the dynamics and stage directions, and tells Italian, German, Latin and English lines apart. Then every line shows:

• IPA for Italian, German and Latin, with the stressed syllable marked
• Singer's notes word by word: double consonants, open and closed vowels, ich-Laut and ach-Laut, final devoicing, Latin "gn", "sc", "ti" and more
• The meaning: German and Italian lines translated by Apple on your device, and common sung Latin texts (Mass, Requiem, Ave Maria, Stabat Mater and more) with our own English translations

Words the rules cannot decide are marked to check, never guessed.

Built for the practice room:
• Scan with the camera, choose photos, or import a PDF
• Correct any line; the IPA and translation follow
• Hide the English underlay of a bilingual edition, or show it
• Keep your pieces with their page photos for rehearsal

3 page scans are free with every feature. OperaScan Pro gives unlimited scans: yearly with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers, or weekly. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in your Apple Account settings at least 24 hours before the end of the period.

Terms of Use: https://bonega.ai/operascan/terms
Privacy Policy: https://bonega.ai/operascan/privacy

name: Orbelyn Trails
description:
Orbelyn Trails packs two different arcade games into one playful app built around Orby the robot. Jump into Orby Kart GP for a five-lap 3D kart race against three robot rivals: steer with the thumb buttons, grab boost pads, duck past cones, and dodge bombs that can fling you back a lap. Switch to Orby Maze for level-based grid puzzles where you sweep up every piece of cheese, open a glowing portal, and slip past zap-traps and a patrol drone that hunts you one step at a time.

Every run feeds the Trail, a path of twenty reward orbs that pay out bonus cheese, exclusive kart paints, and unlockable titles. Daily Quests refresh three new challenges each day for extra XP, and the Garage lets you spend cheese on ten kart finishes with a live 3D preview before you drive.

The Dashboard tracks your level, play streak, today's quests, and a weekly activity chart. A searchable History saves every race and maze run with star ratings, personal bests, filters, and full score details, so you can chase sharper times and higher completion stars. Haptic feedback punctuates boosts, hits, cheese pickups, and portal exits for a tactile feel on every attempt.

name: Orcela: PDF Estimate Maker
description:
Orcela is an estimate and quote maker for self-employed pros and small service businesses. Build a professional PDF estimate with your logo and brand color, and send it to your client in minutes.

WHO IT'S FOR
Electricians, painters, handymen, plumbers, HVAC technicians, cleaners, carpenters, contractors and any service provider who needs to send clear, good-looking estimates fast.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Clients: save client details and reuse them in new estimates.
• Products & services catalog: add your items once and drop them into any estimate.
• Line items: quantity, unit price, subtotal, discount and total calculated automatically.
• Expiration date, payment method, terms and notes.
• Professional PDF with your logo and brand color.
• Send via WhatsApp, email or any sharing app.
• Track every estimate: draft, sent, approved, in progress, completed and paid.
• Summary: what's open, what you collected and your approval rate.
• Works offline: create and edit without internet; your data syncs when you're back online.
• Estimates in English, Spanish or Portuguese, in US dollars, Canadian dollars, pounds, euros and more.
• Dark mode.

PLANS
• Free: up to 5 new estimates per month.
