• Orcela Pro: monthly or yearly subscription through the App Store, with unlimited estimates, PDFs without the "Made with Orcela" line and a 12-month summary. The price is shown in the app before you buy.

ORCELA PRO SUBSCRIPTION
Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase (or at the end of the 7-day free trial, if you're eligible). The subscription renews automatically unless it's canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and the renewal is charged within the 24 hours before it ends. Manage or cancel it in Settings › your name › Subscriptions.
Terms of Use: https://orcapro-api-production.up.railway.app/termos?lang=en
Privacy Policy: https://orcapro-api-production.up.railway.app/privacidade?lang=en

PLEASE NOTE
Orcela creates estimates and quotes. It does not create tax invoices, calculate sales tax, or process online payments.

Download Orcela and send your next estimate like a pro.

name: OrchardCue
description:
OrchardCue is an offline organizer for household device profiles. Browse a brand index, save protocol IDs, plan Cinema and Sleep scenes, and practice keypad layouts — all without an account.

Privacy Policy: https://qsrncnc.github.io/orchardcue-privacy/

IMPORTANT HARDWARE NOTE
Consumer iPhones do not emit infrared light. OrchardCue does not send signals to TVs or air conditioners. It stores device profiles, protocol IDs, scene plans, and practice-pad logs on your iPhone.

WHY ORCHARDCUE
- Offline brand / protocol index for many device families
- Guided match wizard that saves a protocol ID to a device profile
- Scene plans for Cinema, Sleep, Focus, and Away
- Practice pad with clear local feedback
- Private by design — everything stays on device

KEY FEATURES
- Brand aisle + searchable library (TV, AC, set-top, soundbar, projector, fan categories)
- Smart Match: choose kind, pick brand, review candidate protocol IDs, confirm, save
- Active practice pad for layout rehearsal with local haptic feedback
- One-tap Cinema and Sleep scene plans
- Home timeline of recent pad and scene activity
- On-device reference pack status

Perfect for keeping mixed-era living-room protocol notes organized on your iPhone.

name: Ordnance: Military Systems
description:
Ordnance is a reference catalogue of military systems of the world: more than ten thousand ships, aircraft, land systems, missiles and satellites from 126 countries, in service from 1914 to today. It fits in your pocket and works entirely offline.

DRAWN TO ONE COMMON SCALE
Put an aircraft carrier beside a destroyer, or a Spitfire beside a B-52, and every outline is drawn to the same scale, with a football field, a city bus or a person for reference. Compare up to six systems at once, from every domain.

EVERY ENTRY, PHOTOGRAPHED AND SPECIFIED
Three hundred American systems are written up in depth, from the M1 Garand to the B-21 Raider, each with photographs and a note on why it matters. The rest of the world comes from Wikidata and Wikipedia: summaries, photographs and a uniform specification table for every entry, so a Soviet tank and a British destroyer can be read the same way.

SEARCH THE WORLD
Search by designation, name, nickname or country. Punctuation is optional, so "fa18" finds the F/A-18E, and nicknames work too: Warthog, Buff, Spooky, AWACS. Filter by type, country, era and status.

SEE WHO OUTLIVED WHOM
The service life timeline lays out seventy years of aircraft, ships and missiles on one axis. The B-52 entered service in 1955 and is still flying; it outlived the aircraft that were meant to replace it.

HONEST ABOUT WHAT IT KNOWS
A figure that is not published is shown as "Not recorded", never guessed. Classified systems say so. Every Wikipedia text and photograph is credited, with its licence, on the page that uses it.

MADE FOR READING
Nine themes, from Gun Metal to Blueprint and Paper. Feet or metres. Full Dynamic Type support, VoiceOver labels, and a layout for iPad.

Free, with optional tips that unlock nothing. No account, no advertising, no tracking, and nothing about you leaves your device.

Ordnance is an independent reference work. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the US Department of Defense or any government.

name: Osmo Cargo
description: Заказывайте товары из Китая в Туркменистан напрямую без переплат! Удобный каталог, поиск товаров по фото, прозрачные цены и отслеживание доставки в реальном времени.

name: OuiParty: Party Games
description:
Your phone is the controller. Your friends are the show.

OuiParty is a party game for 2 to 8 players in the same room. One phone creates the party, everyone joins with a code or a QR code, and the fun starts in seconds. No cards, no board, no rules to read: every game explains itself in a few seconds.

38 MINI-GAMES THAT MAKE YOU MOVE
• Bomb Toss: shake your phone to pass the bomb before it blows.
• Tilt Race: tilt to roll your marble into the hole first.
• Shout & Buzz: shout “OUI!” louder than the others to win the right to answer.
• Quiz Studio: write your own quiz and see who answers fastest.
• Candle Puff: blow on your phone to put out exactly the right number of candles.
• Top Clash: spin your phone like a spinning top, last one standing wins.
• Rocket Traitor, Wolf Night, Ghost Manor: team up… but someone is lying.
• And Bulle Bowling, Soda Pop, Ice Block, Reel Rush, Statue Rush, Kraken and many more.

MADE FOR EVERYONE
• Family evenings, friends’ nights, birthdays, team building, holidays.
• Training mode: practise any game alone against 3 bots, at 3 levels.
• Rounds of 1 to 2 minutes: easy to start, hard to stop.
• Points add up over the evening, and the last player picks the next game.
• Optional big screen: put a tablet or a device on the TV and everyone watches the action.

FAIR AND SIMPLE
• Free, no account, no sign-up.
• No ads and no in-app purchases in this version.
• Microphone and camera are only used during the games that need them, on your phone: nothing is recorded.

Every player needs the app and an internet connection. Play in a clear space and hold your phone firmly!

Support: games.ouix.fr/ouiparty/support

name: Outage Power: Solar Calculator
description:
When the power goes out you want to know whether the fridge, the CPAP and the Wi-Fi will keep running, and what it takes to keep them going. Outage Power works that out from your own list of devices. Then it tells you how many solar panels would refill the battery where you live.

OUTAGE PLAN
Pick your devices from a list of more than 50 common appliances, or add your own with the watts from its label. Set how many hours a day each one runs and how many days the outage may last. You get the energy you need per day, the battery or power station size, the inverter watts, the running and starting watts a generator needs for the same list, and how long the station takes to recharge from a wall outlet.

RUNTIME
Already own a power station or a battery? Type its capacity and inverter rating. Outage Power shows how long it runs your list and whether the inverter can start a fridge or a pump.

SOLAR
Choose your US state or European country. Sun hours come from PVGIS, the solar database of the EU Joint Research Centre, with NREL data for the United States. You see the panel watts for an average day and for the darkest month, and how many sunny hours refill your station.

WARNINGS THAT MATTER
Each result comes with the checks people tend to miss: a space heater that empties a battery in an hour, a fridge that needs three times its running watts to start, wall charging limited by one outlet, LiFePO4 that will not charge below freezing, and medical devices that need a word with your provider. Under every result, How this is calculated lists each assumption and where it comes from.

SAVE AND SHARE
Save a plan for the house, the cabin or the RV, and share it as text with family or an electrician.

IT STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
There is no account to make and there are no ads. Outage Power does not track you or send anything you add anywhere, and it works offline, which matters when the grid is down. Your iCloud Backup includes it like any other app data. Delete all of it in Settings whenever you like.

Outage Power is free, with no in-app purchases. Results are estimates; check the nameplate of each device and the specs of your equipment.

name: Ovenpers
description:
Ovenpers helpt je ovensstempels te lezen die in de natte scherf zijn gedrukt. Ovennummer, privéstempel, keurmerk, ovengod, afkeur en sortering blijven apart. Eerst noteer je wat de stempel op de scherf deed. De gelukslezing uit de verzamelaarshandel staat daarnaast, op een eigen regel.

Je zoekt op ovenlijn, tijd en gebruik. Bij elk stuk horen laag, dezelfde kuil, veldnotitie, literatuur, een valse stempel en de mislezing. Een ovenverhaal hangt aan die stempel: mondelinge overlevering, ploeg, plek en wat rechtgezet moet worden.

Een eigen wrijfsel kun je fotograferen en bewaren, met een notitie ernaast. Twee stempels leg je open om te zien waar de zin uiteenloopt, of je oefent met een korte toets. Vastgezette stukken, eigen wrijfsels en notities blijven in het archief en kun je als geheel delen.

name: OverlayLive
description:
OverlayLive is the companion app for streamers who use OverlayLive overlays on their LIVE.

From your phone you can:
- See your LIVE status and stats as they happen
- Connect or stop your session
- Switch the overlays on your stream on and off
- Edit alerts, goals, widgets and games, with the same options as the web dashboard
- Set up the Chat Bot and the text-to-speech voice, and let your phone read comments aloud
- Follow your rewards and share your invite link
- Get notifications, in seven languages

An OverlayLive account is required.

OverlayLive is an independent tool and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by TikTok.

name: Oxford Info
description:
Oxford Info is your friendly pocket guide to Oxford. Find great food, free things to do, tonight's events and the city's most famous sights, all on a beautiful hand-drawn map.

EXPLORE A HAND-DRAWN MAP
• Real Oxford streets and buildings, drawn in a charming storybook style
• Famous landmarks illustrated by hand, from the Radcliffe Camera to Tom Tower
• Switch to 3D to see the city rise around you
• Filter by Food, Events, Free, Sights and Hidden gems
• Tap any place for photos, details, fun facts and walking directions

EAT, DRINK AND DISCOVER
• Hundreds of restaurants, cafés and pubs
• Filter by cuisine: burgers, pizza, Indian, Thai, vegan, brunch, desserts and more
• Free museums, parks and hidden corners most visitors walk straight past

WHAT'S ON IN OXFORD
• Concerts, comedy, theatre and choral evensong
• Updated every day, so you always see what's coming up

SELF-GUIDED WALKING TOURS
• 12 tours, including Dreaming Spires, Alice's Oxford, Tolkien & Lewis, Inspector Morse, Historic Pubs and Secret Oxford
• Step-by-step directions to each stop, with the route drawn on the map
• Stories and fun facts at every stop
• Tour at your own pace, and pick up where you left off

PLAY YOUR WAY AROUND OXFORD
• Riddle Hunt: solve clues to famous places across six levels
• Pin It: drop a pin where you think a landmark is. How close can you get?
• Oxford Quiz: test your knowledge against the clock
• Earn XP, level up and unlock free days of Oxford Pro

OXFORD IN THE PAST
• Take a photo of a famous building and discover its story
• Dates, architects, styles and a timeline through the centuries

SPEAKS YOUR LANGUAGE
English, Spanish, Russian, Chinese, French, German, Italian, Japanese and Arabic.

OXFORD PRO
Unlock everything Oxford has to offer:
• Every walking tour
• Audio narration on tours
• The Hidden gems map layer
• Every level of every game
• Oxford in the Past

Choose a 1-day, 7-day or 30-day pass (these do not renew), or a monthly subscription.

The monthly subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.

name: Oyagoto - Parent Care Line
description:
When a parent falls ill, nobody tells you where to start.
Oyagoto puts everything you will need to do for an aging parent in Japan on one line, in order: preparing while they are well, long-term care certification, care at home, moving to a facility, end of life, the days right after death, municipal and pension paperwork, inheritance, and life afterwards.

■ 79 tasks in 9 phases
Each task explains why it matters, what to do, where to go, what it costs, and links to the official page (Ministry of Health, National Tax Agency, Japan Pension Service, Ministry of Justice, municipalities). Every link was checked before release. The text is written in plain Japanese.

■ Deadlines become real dates
Enter one date, such as the day your parent passed away or the day you applied for certification, and every "within 7 days" or "within 10 months" task turns into an actual date, with reminders 7 days before, the day before, and on the day.

■ Small joys between the tasks
A little bean named Edamame suggests small things that fit the season and the phase: record three minutes of your parent talking about childhood games, press a red leaf, take one photo together. 108 in all. When you do one, add a note, a photo, or a voice clip, and it goes into the Memory Book.
Joy cards sit at the top of the home screen and change every time you open the app; swipe through them and tap one when you feel like it. Tasks run down the line below.

■ Your own tasks, your own order
Add tasks to the line, mark items "later" or "not applicable", and reorder them.

■ Everything stays on your phone
No server, no account. Notes, photos, voice clips, and dates are stored only on this device. The only network access is when you open an official page in the browser.
From Settings, export everything as one zip (tasks, joys, notes, photos, voice, and a PDF memory book) and choose where to save it. Import it on a new phone to restore everything.

■ Free, no ads, no purchases

This app is a guide to procedures in Japan, not legal, tax, or medical advice. Rules change; always confirm with the linked official page and the relevant office.

name: P-Toolkit
description:
P-Toolkit adds over 60 actions to the Shortcuts app. Build your shortcut as usual and let P-Toolkit handle the screens and processing Shortcuts doesn't have built in.

Every action runs on your device. No account, no data collection.

IMAGE EDITING & PICKING
• Full-screen image editor: crop, rotate, flip, adjust colour, draw, blur/pixelate, insert images and text. Turn each tool on or off per shortcut.
• Before/after comparison with a slider.
• Tap to pick points or boxes on an image and get their coordinates.
• Paint an area to get a mask or a cut-out.
• Swipe through images card-style to keep or reject them, then pass them on.
• Swipe-clean your photo library; photos are deleted only after you confirm.

AUDIO & VIDEO
• Media trimmer with a zoomed trim strip and instant preview.
• Compress video, convert formats, add music to video, read media info.
• Create Live Photos from video and pick the cover frame.

SHOW RESULTS
• Dashboards with stat cards, charts, tables, Week/Month/Year tabs and PNG/PDF export.
• Full-screen overlay for big messages.
• Menus with images and symbols.
• View files, photos, videos, PDF and HTML right in the app.

LIVE ACTIVITIES
• Pin a checklist, timer, progress bar, counter or note to the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island, updated from your shortcuts.

DATA & FILES
• Data store: values, lists and counters shared between shortcuts.
• File store: save and get files, visible in the Files app.

NOTIFICATIONS
• Send notifications with buttons, images, schedules and priority levels.

ON-DEVICE AI
• Run your own Core ML models on images or text, with a progress screen for long-running models.

DEVICE
• Device details: chip, RAM, storage, iOS version, thermal state, display.
• Hardware check: touch screen, dead pixels, speakers, microphones, vibration, sensors, cameras, flash, volume buttons and Face ID.

Every action comes with a how-to and sample data inside the app, so you can try it before adding it to a shortcut.

Available on iPhone, iPad and Mac. In English and Vietnamese.

name: PA Setup
description:
Beacons finden. Standorte zuordnen. Personal Alarm vorbereiten.

PA Setup unterstützt Installations- und Serviceteams bei der Einrichtung von Indoor-Standorten für Personal Alarm von rising systems. Erfassen Sie unterstützte Bluetooth-Beacons vor Ort, ordnen Sie jedem Gerät ein Gebäude und einen Raum zu und übertragen Sie ausgewählte Standorte an Ihre Personal-Alarm-Umgebung.

GERÄTE GEZIELT FINDEN
Die Geräteliste ist nach Signalstärke sortiert. Filter für Teltonika, Minew und Notfallknöpfe helfen Ihnen, die Auswahl einzugrenzen. Verfügbare Gerätekennungen erleichtern den Abgleich mit der Hardware vor Ihnen. Die Signalstärke dient zur Orientierung und ist keine genaue Entfernungsmessung.

JEDEN STANDORT EINZELN ERFASSEN
Hinterlegen Sie für jeden Beacon ein Gebäude oder einen Bereich und den genauen Standort. Die Angaben werden dem jeweiligen Gerät zugeordnet und während der Eingabe lokal gespeichert.

VOR ORT ERFASSEN, SPÄTER ÜBERTRAGEN
Für die Gerätesuche und lokale Standortentwürfe ist keine Anmeldung erforderlich. Ihre Entwürfe bleiben beim Neustart der App, beim Abmelden und beim Wechsel der Firma erhalten. Bereits erfasste Standorte können Sie später übertragen, auch wenn die Beacons nicht mehr in Funkreichweite sind.

DIE RICHTIGE FIRMA AUSWÄHLEN
Melden Sie sich mit Ihrem bestehenden Personal-Alarm-Benutzerkonto an. Wählen Sie eine für Sie freigegebene Firma und prüfen Sie die Standorte vor der Übertragung. Vorhandene Einträge mit derselben Beacon-Kennung werden innerhalb der gewählten Firma aktualisiert. Die Übertragung erfolgt verschlüsselt über HTTPS.

UNTERSTÜTZTE NOTFALLKNÖPFE PRÜFEN
Bei erkannten Minew-MWB02-Notfallknöpfen zeigt PA Setup den empfangenen aktiven oder inaktiven Alarmstatus. Weitere Geräteinformationen sind abhängig vom Modell und den gesendeten Daten. Der angezeigte Funkstatus bestätigt keine Alarmübertragung an eine Leitstelle.

HINWEISE ZUR IPHONE-NUTZUNG
Die Erkennung hängt vom Gerät und dessen Bluetooth-Sendeformat ab. Unterstützt werden Eddystone und ausgewählte Herstellerformate. Reine iBeacon-Signale werden in dieser Version nicht erfasst. Hardware-MAC-Adressen können nur bei unterstützten Geräten ausgelesen werden und sind nicht für jedes Bluetooth-Gerät verfügbar.

VORAUSSETZUNGEN
Für die Gerätesuche benötigen Sie kompatible Bluetooth-LE-Hardware und die Bluetooth-Freigabe. Zum Übertragen benötigen Sie eine Internetverbindung, eine für PA Setup freigeschaltete Personal-Alarm-Umgebung und ein bestehendes Benutzerkonto mit entsprechender Berechtigung. Serveradresse, Datenbankname und Zugang erhalten Sie von Ihrer Administration.

Die App dient der Einrichtung und Geräteprüfung. Die eigentliche Alarmierung und Personenüberwachung übernimmt das dafür eingerichtete Personal-Alarm-System.

name: Packlets – Push Notifications
description:
Your server is down. A customer just ordered. Your AI agent needs your OK. Packlets puts it on your iPhone instantly as a push notification.

No more emails, bots and chat groups where everything gets lost. Developers, shop owners and smart home fans collect everything their own tools have to say in Packlets. Clear, fast and beautiful.

UP AND RUNNING IN FIVE MINUTES
Create a channel, add one line of code, done. Whether your script runs on your laptop, a server or a Raspberry Pi.

ONE TAP IS ENOUGH
Approve, restart, mark as done: act right from the message, without opening your laptop. Your tool gets to work instantly.

MESSAGES THAT DO MORE
Charts, tables and toggles turn any notification into a tiny dashboard. Today's sales at a glance, the lights off with a tap.

YOUR AI AGENT, ALWAYS WITH YOU
Chat with your own agent like you would with a colleague. It researches, sorts and gets things done, and checks with you before anything important.

APPS MADE JUST FOR YOU
Approve invoices, keep an eye on your shop, control your smart home: build exactly the apps you're missing, or let your AI build them for you. In Packlets they're all right at hand, side by side.

NO CODE? NO PROBLEM.
Your tool can post to Slack, Discord or ntfy? Then it works with Packlets too. Paste the address, done.

YOU DECIDE WHEN IT RINGS
Set push, sound and quiet hours for each channel. What matters gets through, everything else waits quietly.

HOW PEOPLE USE PACKLETS
• Developers: servers, backups and deploys at a glance
• Shop owners: every order and the daily sales as a push
• Smart home fans: lights and heating right from the message
• AI tinkerers: their own agents that check in before important steps

Packlets is free. Download it now and get your first message on your iPhone in five minutes.

name: Pactiva: Workout With Friends
description:
Pactiva turns “we should work out more” into a promise you keep together.

Make a weekly pact with a friend, your partner or a small group of up to six. Everyone sets their own goal for the week, like three days. Log each workout, add a photo if you like, and see everyone’s progress in one place. On Sunday night the week closes: whoever misses their goal owes the stake you agreed on, like dinner, coffee or a week of dishes.

HOW IT WORKS
• Start a pact and invite your people with a link or a 6-character code
• Pick your weekly goal, from 1 to 7 days a week
• Choose the stake, or write your own
• Log a workout in seconds: activity, optional photo and a short note
• React to each other’s workouts and nudge anyone who’s falling behind
• See the result when the week closes and keep your streak going

MADE FOR REAL ACCOUNTABILITY
• Your goal, your partner’s goal, one shared week
• Personal streaks, plus a pact streak for every week you all hit your goals
• Reminders on the days and at the time you choose; they skip days you’ve already trained and go quiet once you hit your goal
• An evening heads-up when every remaining day counts

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Pacts are invite-only. No public profiles, followers or strangers
• No email or phone number needed, just a name
• No ads, no tracking
• Report a post or block someone at any time

Works with any kind of training: gym, running, walking, cycling, swimming, yoga, home workouts, sports or anything else.

Pactiva is free. Set your goal, make the pact and show up for each other.

name: Pada - Dhammapada Reading Plan
description:
Read the whole Dhammapada, the Buddha's best-loved collection of verses, at your own pace.

Open the app and continue right where you left off. A few verses a day, a few minutes a day, until you have read all 423 verses.

ONLY THE BUDDHA'S OWN WORDS
No made-up quotes. Every verse comes from the Pali Canon and shows its source, from Dhammapada 1 to 423.

PALI AND MODERN TRANSLATIONS
• The Pali original, close to the words the Buddha spoke
• A clear modern English translation by Bhikkhu Sujato
• Also in Vietnamese (Thích Minh Châu) and German (Sabbamitta)
• Show the translation only, the Pali with the translation, or the Pali large

A PACE YOU CAN KEEP
• 3 months (the length of the Rains Retreat), 6 months, 1 year, or by Vesak
• Missed a day? Your place is kept, and the rest is spread over the days left
• See your progress as 26 chapters filling up

GENTLE REMINDERS
• A daily reminder at the time you choose, with today's verses and how long they take
• Remind again in the evening only if you haven't read yet
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, including a Verse of the Day

FREE FOR EVERYONE
"The gift of the teaching surmounts all other gifts." (Dhammapada 354)
Every feature is free, with no ads and no subscription. If you like, you can support the developer with a small offering. It unlocks nothing.

PRIVATE
No account. Your reading records stay on your device.

Sources: Pali text from the Mahāsaṅgīti Tipiṭaka and translations via SuttaCentral, dedicated to the public domain (CC0).

name: Padel Mania
description:
Padel Mania runs your social padel session from your phone: a fair draw every round, live scores from every court, and one table everyone can follow.

PICK A FORMAT
Americano gives everyone a new partner each round. Mexicano pairs players with similar scores. King of the Court moves winners up a court and losers down. Run sessions for up to 24 players on up to 6 courts.

FAIR ROTATION YOU CAN SEE
The draw spreads partners and sit-outs as evenly as it can. The fairness meter shows how many partner pairings have happened, the most times two people have played together, and sit-outs for each player. Tap "Who partnered whom" to check every pairing.

CHANGE THINGS MID-SESSION
Someone arrives late? Add them. Someone leaves early? Remove them and they keep their points. Lost a court, or gained one? Change it between rounds and the draw re-plans.

SCORE BY TAP OR VOICE
Players score their own court from their own phone. Tap the point buttons, or turn on the mic and say "point us" or "point them", and the phone reads the score back. "What can I say?" lists every command. Prefer to play to the clock? Timed rounds show the same countdown on every phone.

A LIVE TABLE FOR EVERYONE
Share one invite link. Players follow the table in their browser, with no account and no download. It moves as scores come in, and catches up after a lost signal.

FILM YOUR MATCHES (IPHONE)
Stand your iPhone beside the court and record a match once everyone on court has said yes. Say "clip that" to keep the last 30 seconds in My clips. Turn on Arm up to score, then hold one arm up for a second to win the point for your side. Videos are saved on your iPhone (and in your own iCloud backup, if you use one). Padel Mania never uploads them.

LEADERBOARDS
The Leaderboard tab shows this session's table, and Everyone: a public board for your club, town, country or the world, this month or all time. Being on it is your choice: sign in with Apple, then switch it on in You. A match counts once someone from each pair confirms it, and you can report or block any entry. Share a table as a picture, with no surnames.

GROUPS AND LEAGUES
Play with the same crew? Make a private group, start a session for everyone with one tap, and watch a league table build across every session. No chat and nothing public.

FILL THE COURT
Post a game and players tap "I'm in". Book the court when all four are in. Reserves queue up and are offered the spot if someone drops out, and a confirm-by time shows everyone when to decide, so there's time to cancel the court.

FIND PLAYERS AND COURTS
Find open games and padel venues near you by town, postcode or your rough location. Choose from about 8,800 venues and court sites worldwide, from OpenStreetMap. Book a court opens the venue's own booking page, or directions if it has none. Booking and payment happen with the venue.
Venue data © OpenStreetMap contributors, under the Open Database Licence.

YOUR LEVEL
Your level, from 1.0 to 7.0, comes from your match results. Beating a stronger pair counts for more, and your level stays provisional until 5 matches. Your progress shows points won, win rate and partners over 30 days or the season.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
English, Español, Português, Italiano, Français, Svenska, Nederlands, Deutsch and العربية.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account needed. No adverts, no tracking, no analytics. Sessions need no surnames and are deleted from our server 30 days after they were last used. Download or delete your data in the You tab at any time.

Questions or ideas? support@supportlabs.co.uk

Terms of use: https://www.supportlabs.co.uk/padel-mania/terms/

name: PageFlow Reader
description:
The authentic feel of a printed book, reimagined for foldable screens.

PageFlow Reader takes full advantage of dual-screen and foldable devices. Unfold your phone to instantly view facing pages side-by-side, complete with realistic curl animations and tactile paper tones.

KEY FEATURES:
• Dual-Page Spread: Engineered for foldable screens and landscape reading with zero visual clutter.
• Universal Format Support: Read EPUB, PDF, TXT, RTF, HTML, FB2, DOCX, ODT, Markdown, and CBZ comic archives.
• Ambient Themes: Paper, Sepia, Sage, Rose, and OLED True Black tailored for day or night sessions.
• Audiobooks & Text-to-Speech: Listen to MP3, M4B, AAC, FLAC audiobooks or read aloud any book with on-device voices.
• Academic Workspace: In-text citations, bibliography generator (APA, MLA, Chicago), and dedicated research notes.
• Pure Reading, Zero Distraction: No ads, no tracking. Fast, private iCloud sync across all your Apple devices.

name: PageGlyph
description:
Turn document pages into text you can review, correct and keep.

PageGlyph recognizes text from PNG, JPEG, HEIC images and unencrypted PDF files selected in Files. Review the original page beside its recognized words, make corrections and find the current text across your documents.

A practical proofreading workflow:
• Review page previews, reorder pages or leave out pages before importing.
• Recognize English with Accurate or Fast processing, or use Accurate for Chinese + English when supported by the device.
• Compare original recognition boxes, raw text and your corrected text. Manual edits preserve the original OCR result.
• Search current page text and open the matching page.
• Create real UTF-8 TXT or structured JSON files as fixed snapshots. Reopen and share those actual files from Exports.
• Rename or delete documents. Independent exports remain available after their source document is deleted.

Every selected PDF page is rendered and recognized, including mixed text and scanned pages. Recognition runs on the device. One recognition task runs at a time; cancellation preserves completed pages. Entering the background stops unfinished work so you can retry incomplete pages later.

Limits: one source up to 100 MiB and 20 pages; up to 40 documents and 500 MiB of source copies; up to 100 exports. Images may be up to 12,000 pixels per side and 40 megapixels. Each page supports up to 100,000 text characters. Each export and the library metadata are limited to 32 MiB.

OCR can make mistakes. Review important text against the original. Small print, handwriting, columns, tables and formulas may be misread or appear out of order. Page formatting is not reconstructed. TXT and JSON are text-based exports; this version does not create searchable PDFs.

The local library keeps source copies, recognized text and corrections. System sharing, file providers and system backups follow the destinations and settings you choose. Clear all removes managed library records, source copies and generated exports; external originals, user-placed Files inputs and copies shared elsewhere remain separate.

name: Paginette: Classics Read Aloud
description:
Fall for a book one passage at a time.

Paginette is a feed made of books. Swipe through short passages from public-domain classics — as text, or read aloud by LibriVox volunteers with every word highlighted as it is spoken. When one stays with you, open the book right where it began.

THE FEED
• Every card is a verbatim passage from the original text, never rewritten.
• Swipe for the next one, tap play to hear it read, like it, save it or add the book to your shelf.
• Pick the languages, subjects and moods you like, or just start: the For you feed learns from what you finish, replay or skip. You can adjust or reset your interests at any time.

READ AND LISTEN TO THE WHOLE BOOK
• Read every chapter, with adjustable text size, themes, a table of contents and bookmarks.
• Listen to the full LibriVox recording with read-along: the word being spoken lights up, and where the timing is not reliable the app highlights the sentence, or nothing, rather than guess.
• Playback speed, sleep timer, background listening, and controls on the Lock Screen and in Control Center.
• Download books to read and listen offline.
• Works on iPhone and iPad, in portrait or landscape on iPad.

YOUR SHELF
• Keep books on a visual shelf: want to read, reading and finished.
• Make your shelf public or keep it private, and share a link.
• Follow other readers, share passages, and comment.

AI READING AIDS
Ask for a translation, some context or vocabulary help for a passage. These answers are written by AI, are always labelled "AI-generated · not from the original book", and can be wrong. The passages themselves are always the original text.

FREE, WITH PAGINETTE PLUS
Browsing the feed, reading, read-along, your shelf and the social features are free. Without Plus, full-book listening and AI reading aids have a daily limit, and you can keep one downloaded book at a time. Paginette Plus removes those limits: full-book listening and AI reading aids with no daily limit, and as many downloaded books as you like. You can browse without an account.

Plus is available as a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription, or as a one-time Lifetime purchase; prices are shown in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews automatically for the same period and price unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; the renewal is charged within the 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Account Settings on the App Store at any time after purchase. Lifetime is a single payment with no renewals.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://paginette.com/privacy

SOURCES
Recordings are by LibriVox volunteers and are in the public domain; audio streams from the Internet Archive. Book texts come from Project Gutenberg eBooks; each book page names its source. Public-domain status differs by country, so the app only shows works available where you are.

Paginette is an independent project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by LibriVox, Project Gutenberg or the Internet Archive.

name: Painted Diary: Color Journal
description:
Paint how today felt.

Painted Diary is a calm daily coloring ritual. Each day, it opens one section of an intricate drawing. Choose the color that matches your day, paint it with your finger, and add a few words if you like. Then the section is sealed under masking tape, and you won't see it again until the end.

Two weeks later, the tape peels away: fourteen days, in one painting you could never have planned. Tap any section to see its date and your note.

WHY IT FEELS DIFFERENT
• You never see earlier days, so every color is honest
• A surprise reveal at the end of every drawing
• No streaks and no guilt. Missed a day? The canvas simply waits
• One gentle reminder, at the time you choose

MADE FOR SLOW EVENINGS
• Detailed drawings for adults: botanical studies, tiles and ornament, rooftops, courtyards, meadows and night creatures
• Paint with your finger, with undo and clear until you're done
• A short note for each day
• Evening mode, which turns the app dark after sunset
• A gallery that keeps every finished painting with its days and notes
• Share your finished painting as an image
• Works with VoiceOver, larger text and Reduce Motion

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no sign-in. Your paintings and notes stay on your iPhone. We don't collect any data.

FREE TO START
Start with three drawings, free. Unlock the Starter Pack once for three more drawings, up to three canvases at a time, the reveal video and shares without a watermark. Add drawing packs one by one, two drawings each. And some days have two feelings: extra brushes let you paint one more section that day.

No ads. No subscription.

name: Paircade
description:
Your classic games. A little friendly competition.

Paircade brings Game Boy Advance play to iPhone and iPad, with a clean game library, comfortable touch controls and private rooms on a server you choose.

PICK UP AND PLAY
Import your own uncompressed .gba files from Files. Play in portrait or landscape with the original game proportions and crisp pixels. An original Link Lab demo is included so you can try the controls straight away.

KEEP YOUR ADVENTURE
Save normally in-game, create save states with dated thumbnails, and return to a saved moment.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Use 2x or 4x fast forward, button haptics and compatible Bluetooth or wired controllers. Customize controller buttons and landscape touch opacity. Choose crisp or smooth video, adjust game volume, and control Silent Mode and audio mixing. Touch controls hide when a controller connects; tap the display to open the quick menu.

BRING A FRIEND
Private room invitations include the server address and room code. Compatible Wireless Adapter games can connect through a self-hosted Paircade relay. Each player keeps their own game and save; story adventures remain separate. Both players need compatible games in the same language and a matching app/core version.

YOUR SERVER, YOUR CHOICE
No public multiplayer server is built into Paircade. One person hosts the supplied server package and invites friends. The app includes a self-hosting guide and server export. Offline play needs no server.

Games are not included. Paircade does not provide a game-download service. Save-state and speed changes are unavailable during multiplayer rooms.

Paircade is an independent emulator, not affiliated with Nintendo, Pokemon, Delta or RetroArch. Built with gpSP in interpreter mode; open-source notices and corresponding source are available in Settings.

name: Pandy Tickets - Escáner
description:
Pandy Escáner es la app de la puerta para los eventos que se venden en Pandy Tickets. Quien está en la entrada inicia sesión con su correo, elige el evento y apunta la cámara al código QR de cada entrada.

Cada lectura da una sola respuesta en pantalla completa, con su propio color, forma, sonido y vibración:
• Puede pasar: círculo verde.
• Ya entró: cuadro ámbar con la hora en que entró.
• No puede pasar: octágono rojo con el motivo.

Funciona sin internet. La app descarga la lista de invitados firmada antes de abrir la cámara, la verifica y sigue admitiendo personas si se cae la señal. Las entradas registradas sin conexión se sincronizan solas cuando vuelve la red, y si otro teléfono ya había registrado esa entrada, la app lo avisa.

También puedes:
• Buscar asistentes por nombre, sin internet y sin importar las tildes.
• Ver cuántas personas ya entraron ("128 de 913 adentro").
• Escanear en estaciones (barra, merch) y entregar lo que cada entrada tiene pendiente.

Necesitas una cuenta de Pandy Tickets con acceso al evento. Los organizadores crean sus eventos y agregan a su equipo de puerta en tickets.pandy.cloud.

name: Paperdune
description:
Give your screen some depth.

Paperdune composes cut-paper wallpapers: layers of color that ripple, with a soft shadow, a light edge and a fine grain. Every wallpaper is made right here, on your device, and looks like no other.

Layer by layer
Pick a shape, a palette and a relief. Tap the dice for a new idea, then adjust the angle, the waves or the shadow until the wallpaper is yours.

Sized for your screen
Every wallpaper saves sharp, at the exact resolution of your iPhone, iPad or Mac. On iPhone and iPad, see it under the clock before you save it, as on the Lock Screen. On Mac, set it on all your displays in one click.

My wallpapers
Keep the ones you love and find them later, redrawn at the format of your choice.

Nothing leaves your device
No account, no ads, no data collected.

Paperdune Pro
One purchase for iPhone, iPad and Mac, no subscription: all 17 palettes and colors of your own, every fine adjustment, every format up to 8K, and as many kept wallpapers as you like.

name: Paperlight: Screenshot Strip
description:
Paperlight turns the screenshots piling up in Photos into a calm strip of lanterns. New screenshots light up, older ones slowly dim, and the ones you no longer need drift into the basket, so your photo library stays clean.

HANG EVERY SCREENSHOT
• Your latest screenshots hang on a glowing strip, newest first.
• Pin the ones you want to keep; the rest fade with age.
• Turned one off by mistake? Undo, or take it back from the basket.

KEEP PHOTOS CLEAN
• Clear screenshots out of Photos in one step. iOS always asks first, and they stay 30 days in Recently Deleted.
• Paperlight keeps its own copy, so your strip stays complete.

FIND ANYTHING
• Search by the words inside your images, recognized on your device. Accents are optional.
• Automatic tags and smart titles for chats, receipts, code, maps and more.
• Smart actions: copy a one-time code or an account number, add a date to Calendar, open an address, link or phone number.

EDIT AND SHARE SAFELY
• Crop and draw, with Apple Pencil on iPad.
• Join several screenshots into one long image; overlapping parts are removed.
• Safe Share covers email addresses, card numbers, phone numbers, tokens and faces with solid blocks, and strips location data before you send.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything runs on your device. No account, no tracking, no ads.
• Lock the app with Face ID. Private screenshots stay sealed and never appear in widgets, Spotlight or iCloud.
• Your strip blurs while the screen is recorded, mirrored or shared.

MADE FOR iPHONE AND iPAD
• Share Extension, Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, Control Center controls and the Action button.
• Siri, Shortcuts and Spotlight search by text in your screenshots.
• Light Again Later: snooze a screenshot until you need it. One-time codes turn themselves off.
• iPad sidebar, multiple windows, drag and drop.

WORKS WITH PAPERLIGHT FOR MAC
Pin a screenshot on your Mac and it shows up on your iPhone; send an image from your iPhone to your Mac's strip. Sync is optional, uses your own iCloud, and needs Paperlight for Mac (sold separately at getpaperlight.com).

Paperlight for iPhone and iPad is free, with no in-app purchases.

name: Para Schedule
description:
Para Schedule keeps a paraprofessional's school day in one clear schedule: where to be, what to do, who hands off to whom, and what is different today.

TODAY FIRST
The app opens to Today: what you are doing now, what comes next, and the rest of the day, with the copy it comes from and when it was last refreshed.

BUILD YOUR ROUTINE ONCE
Add your duties with exact times, places, groups and roles. Start from a starter schedule or one of your own templates, or begin blank. Use it on your own; no coworkers, school account or student names are needed.

CHANGE ONE DATE
Assembly, a sub, an early release? Record the change for that date only. Your regular week stays as it was, and the next matching day is unchanged.

TEAM SCHEDULES (OPTIONAL)
Keep several adults' responsibilities in one schedule and see each person's own day. Share a read-only view with a named person for the adults, dates and details you choose.

PAPER WHEN YOU NEED IT
Make the same printouts as the website, including pocket schedules, as a PDF on your phone. Share it, save a copy, or print it. Each printout shows its date and version.

ONE ACCOUNT, EVERYWHERE
The app uses the same account as paraschedule.com. Your schedules, changes and sharing are the same ones you see on the website, and features follow your account's existing access.

GOOD TO KNOW
- An account and an internet connection are needed to open and save schedules. If the connection drops, the app keeps showing what it last loaded and says it may be out of date.
- The app contains no purchases. Plus is bought and managed on the website, which the app links to.
- Para Schedule organizes schedules; it does not assign staff, send alerts, or replace your school's own procedures.
- Please check with your school before entering anything that identifies a student. Para Schedule works without student names.

Delete your account any time from Settings > Account & data. Privacy: paraschedule.com/privacy

name: Parent Care Log
description:
Keep one organised record of caring for an ageing parent (visits, tasks, appointments, medicines, contacts, notes) and hand it over as a PDF.

What you get:
- Everything about Mum's care in one place
- Hand over to a sibling with one PDF
- Medicines with a full change history
- Every doctor and provider, one tap to call
- No account. Records stay on your phone

Free to start. One in-app purchase adds the rest, with no subscription.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

name: Paroles et Chants
description:
Toutes les paroles pour chanter ensemble, même sans réseau.

Dans un groupe, tout le monde connaît le refrain ; les couplets, beaucoup moins. Paroles et Chants réunit plus de 4 000 chants qu'on reprend à plusieurs : chansons à boire, chants de marins, chants de rugby et de supporters, répertoires occitan, basque, catalan, chants paillards…

• Hors ligne : le catalogue est sur votre téléphone, au fond d'une cave ou dans les tribunes.
• Recherche instantanée par titre ou par paroles.
• Des carnets prêts à chanter, par thème.
• Paroles en plein écran, taille de texte réglable, thème clair ou sombre.
• Favoris pour retrouver vos chants en un geste.
• Vidéos et liens d'écoute pour apprendre l'air.
• Partage d'un chant en un lien ou un QR code.

Sans compte, sans publicité, sans pistage.

Né à Toulouse, dans un jeune groupe de chant. Un chant manque ? Proposez-le sur parolesetchants.fr.

name: Parquote
description:
Parquote turns road-safety theory into an interactive academy. Learn the signs, read the road and train
your perception in safe, futuristic simulations, then watch your knowledge score climb.
DRIVER DASHBOARD
• Three fresh daily challenges with XP rewards
• A Driving Knowledge Score from 0 to 1000 across six skill areas
• A learning path of ten bite-size theory lessons
• Achievements, streaks and level progression
TRAFFIC SIGN ACADEMY
• An illustrated collection of 51 European-style road signs grouped by category
• Sign Scanner: recognise each sign as it comes into focus
• Random quizzes that mix "what does it mean" with "which sign is it"
• A clear meaning and what to do for every sign
HAZARD PERCEPTION LAB
• Eight animated street scenes set in Kharkiv: school runs, buses pulling out, opening doors, e-scooters,
rain and night driving
• Tap developing hazards early, because your score depends on reaction time
• Six timed junction decisions: priority to the right, priority roads, roundabouts, trams and pedestrians
• Replays highlight every hazard with a short lesson
DRIVING KNOWLEDGE QUIZ
• 52 questions on traffic rules, road markings, parking and safety
• Beginner, Intermediate and Expert levels, with timers on the harder two
RoadSense · App Store marketing package · page 2
• Illustrated road-marking exercises
• A detailed explanation after every answer
PARKING MASTER
• Top-down car physics with a steering wheel, gear selector and creep pedal
• Parallel parking, reverse bay, bay alignment and a cone slalom
• Guide lines, parking sensors and accuracy scoring
REACTION TRAINER
• Reaction pulse, traffic-light starts with red-and-amber traps, and brake response
• Stopping-distance maths for 50 and 90 km/h
• Trend charts, consistency stats and personal bests
LEARNING ANALYTICS AND PROFILE
• Weekly charts, quiz accuracy trends and a knowledge breakdown
• A progress radar comparing this week with last week
• Custom learning goals with deadlines and an optional budget in UAH
PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything runs and stays on your device.
IMPORTANT
Parquote is an educational simulator. It does not replace lessons with a licensed instructor or your country's
official traffic rules, and it must never be used while driving. Rule summaries reflect common Ukrainian and
European practice; always confirm details with official sources

name: Party Royale: Card Party
description:
Pull up a gold armchair. The party's at your table.

Party Royale is a fast, glamorous card party game. Match the top card by its family or its number, play action cards to flip the spotlight, and be the first to empty your hand. But every guest at the table has a secret weapon...

EVERY GUEST HAS A STAR POWER
Choose your star and play as them at every table. Each character has a once-per-match Star Power: Riya's Encore Dance plays two cards at once, Zara's Spotlight Steal swaps a card with the leader, Alex's Calculated rearranges the top of the deck, Arjun's Plus One makes the next player draw and miss a turn. Play cards of your signature family to charge it, then unleash it at the perfect moment.

THE FINAL SPOTLIGHT
When a player drops to one card, the room turns on them. Spend a charge to heckle them and make them draw, but a heckled player earns Encore Immunity until their next turn.

FOUR PARTY VENUES
Vegas After Dark, Bollywood Boulevard, Hollywood Spotlight and Campus Carnival each have their own look, music and a live party event that shakes up the rules: Jackpot Rush, Dance-Off, Paparazzi Flash and Pop Quiz.

AN ORIGINAL DECK
114 cards in four families, each with its own shape as well as its colour (Electric Violet star, Sunset Coral sun, Emerald Pulse diamond, Ocean Cyan wave). Action cards include Skip Beat, Reverse Spotlight, Double Draw, Encore, Wild Remix, Spotlight Blast and Crowd Switch, which passes every hand around the table.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Quick Party: 2 to 6 players against party guests, three difficulty levels
• Friends Night: pass and play with 2 to 4 friends on one iPhone or iPad, with party guests filling up to 6 seats
• House rules: stack draw cards, or remove Encore and Crowd Switch
• A guided first match teaches everything in a minute
• Level up, earn coins, collect the free Daily Spin and unlock new venues as you win

No ads. No in-app purchases. No account. Plays fully offline.

All characters are fictional adults created for this game.

name: Party-Bingo
description:
The same things happen at every party. Someone tells the story everyone already knows. Somebody is first on the dance floor. Someone asks when the food is ready. Party-Bingo turns all of it into a game.

HOW IT WORKS
• One person starts a round, everyone else joins via QR code or round code – no account, just a nickname.
• Everyone types situations that might happen tonight. Out of ideas? Grab ready-made suggestions for parties, birthdays, weddings, festivals, Christmas and more with one tap – harmless for family and office, cheeky for the house party.
• Something on your card happens? Snap a selfie with it – or have a witness confirm: “I saw it!”
• Full row? BINGO!

KEEPING IT EXCITING
• Pot or own card: everyone throws situations into one pot and gets a shuffled card – or everyone plays their own.
• Dare! Now and then a dare pops up for everyone. First to go for it and get a round of applause scores 2 points and a joker.
• Hot time: every now and then, for 10 minutes, your next confirmed mark counts triple.
• Swap joker: a square definitely won't happen anymore? Play a joker and rewrite it. You start with one – win more with Dare!
• Plan the party: set up a round up to 5 days ahead, fill your cards early and get a reminder the day before.
• Award ceremony with titles – like “Notary” for the busiest witness. Share the result image right away.

FAIR AND RELAXED
• No account, no email, no ads, no tracking.
• Rounds, texts and photos are deleted automatically after 7 days. Only your group sees the photos.
• Report, block and a word filter keep things friendly.
• Not a drinking game – suitable for ages 13+. The dares are harmless, and if you'd rather not, just sit it out.
• In English and German.

Party-Bingo works best with 3 to 30 people in the same room. Phones out, eyes open, cross it off!

Terms of Use: https://facenheel.github.io/partybingo/terms.html
Privacy: https://facenheel.github.io/partybingo/privacy.html

name: PartyGames - игры для друзей
description:
Party Games — сборник из 7 игр для вечеринки, дружеской встречи, дня рождения, корпоратива и Нового года. Все игры идут на одном телефоне: передавайте его по кругу и играйте. Без интернета, без регистрации и без рекламы. Идеально, когда нужно быстро занять компанию дома, на даче, в кафе, в поездке или в походе.

ВО ЧТО МОЖНО ПОИГРАТЬ

• МАФИЯ. Приложение становится ведущим: раздаёт роли, подсказывает ночные действия мафии, комиссара и доктора, озвучивает ход игры голосом и сразу определяет победителя. Ведущего выбирать не нужно, играть могут от 5 до 15 человек.

• ШПИОН. Все знают место, кроме шпиона. Задавайте вопросы, ищите чужого и старайтесь не выдать локацию. Можно играть с одним или двумя шпионами. Список мест заранее не показывается, поэтому интрига сохраняется до конца.

• КРОКОДИЛ. Показывайте слова жестами и мимикой, а команда угадывает. Три уровня сложности, выбор времени раунда, необязательный штраф за пропуск и очки для победы, которые вы задаёте сами.

• ПРАВДА ИЛИ ДЕЙСТВИЕ. Крутите рулетку и получайте вопрос или задание: от весёлых для друзей до посмелее. Можно заменить задание, если оно не подходит.

• УГАДАЙ КТО Я. Приложите телефон ко лбу, чтобы все видели вашего персонажа, а вы нет. Угадывайте, кто вы, по подсказкам друзей. Угадали, и игра продолжается, пока не определятся все места.

• ЭЛИС. Командная игра на объяснение слов. Объясняйте слова партнёрам, пока идёт таймер, и набирайте очки. Три уровня сложности: от простых слов до настоящих головоломок.

• ЗАДАНИЯ. Весёлые испытания для компании: кто выполнил первым, тот получает балл. Побеждает первый, кто набрал нужное число очков.

ПОЧЕМУ PARTY GAMES

• Один телефон на всю компанию. Не нужно, чтобы каждый скачивал приложение.
• Работает без интернета. Играйте где угодно.
• Понятные правила прямо в приложении, новичок разберётся за минуту.
• Яркий современный дизайн, светлая и тёмная темы.
• Игра сохраняется: свернули приложение или заблокировали экран, и партия ждёт на паузе. Можно продолжить с того же места.
• Настройки под вашу компанию: количество игроков, время раунда, уровень сложности, цель по очкам.
• Озвучка ведущего в Мафии включается и выключается в настройках.
• 14 языков интерфейса, в том числе русский, английский, испанский, немецкий, французский и другие.
• Без регистрации, без рекламных баннеров, без лишних разрешений.

КАК НАЧАТЬ

1. Выберите игру в списке.
2. Прочитайте короткие правила и добавьте игроков.
3. Нажмите «Начать» и передавайте телефон по кругу.

ДЛЯ КОГО

Для друзей и пар, студентов и коллег, семей с подростками, гостей на дне рождения и участников корпоративных вечеринок. Играть могут от 3 до 15 человек в зависимости от игры.

Скачайте Party Games и превратите любой вечер в весёлую игру!

Вопросы, идеи и пожелания: dkiosdevfb@gmail.com. Мы читаем каждое письмо и регулярно добавляем новые слова, задания и улучшения.

name: PatchAtlas: Port & Cable Map
description:
PatchAtlas keeps your device inventory and wiring notes in local workspaces.

Add devices, locations and notes, then record each port and connector family. Connect two compatible free ports on different devices in the same workspace. Add cable labels, lengths and notes; search connections and inspect both endpoints.

Capture an immutable wiring snapshot. Later edits leave the captured devices, ports and cables intact. Generate actual paginated PDF or text documents, preview them and share through the system sheet.

Export a whole-library JSON backup and restore a valid selected backup after confirmation. Manage your records and clear app-managed data from About.

Connector matching compares the physical family you choose. PatchAtlas does not detect equipment or verify electrical, power, signal, protocol or safety compatibility. Represent adapters as separate devices and connections. No app account is required.

name: Path of Arrow:Maze Puzzle
description:
Path of Arrows is a calm but cunning logic puzzle.

Read the board, trace a route, and send each arrow gliding out of the maze. Every arrow moves along its own path at its own pace — one wrong turn and it stops dead. Clear the whole board without running out of hearts.

• 22,000+ levels across five difficulty tiers, from gentle warm-ups to Master
• Daily Challenge with a streak to keep alive
• Achievements, stars and level scores
• Dark mode and five languages (English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어)
• Fully offline: no ads, no account, no internet required

Easy to learn. Hard to put down. Find your path.

name: Pats Baseball Club
description:
The official app of Pats Baseball Club in Pasadena, CA, for registered players, families and coaches.

• Schedule: every practice, game and tournament, with directions and alerts when anything changes.
• Team chat: parents chat, players chat (13+), and private messages with coaches. Any coach-player message always includes that player's parents.
• News: coach announcements and RSVPs.
• My Player: Pats Player Card testing results and progress.
• Payments: set up season dues by bank account or card.

Accounts are for families on a Pats roster. Sign in with the email the club has on file.

name: PawPal: Pet Care  Health
description:
PawPal is a simple pet care app that keeps daily care, vaccine schedules and health records for your dog, cat and other pets in one place. Start right away, no account needed.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Emergency QR ID card: Create a card with allergies, microchip and contact details. It works offline and can be shared as an image.
• Daily care tracking: Check off feeding, walks, play, grooming and medication. Build a healthy habit with your care streak.
• Smart reminders: Get notifications for vaccines, medication and vet appointments so you never miss a date.
• PDF health record: Turn vaccines, medication, weight and appointments into a PDF in one tap and share it with your vet.
• Multiple pets: Create separate profiles for dogs, cats, birds, rabbits and fish.
• Vets and pet shops nearby: Find vet clinics, pet shops and on-duty clinics near your location and get directions.
• Lost pet and adoption listings: Browse or post lost pet, adoption and mating listings. Optionally get alerts when a pet goes missing near you.
• Family sharing: Share care tasks with family members using a family code.
• PawPal AI assistant: Ask questions about pet care. The assistant only helps with pet topics and does not give veterinary diagnoses.

COMMUNITY SAFETY
Report inappropriate listings and block users you do not want to see. Reports are reviewed within 24 hours.

EARN PRO DAYS
Invite a friend: when they join with your code, you both get 7 days of Pro. You can also watch a short ad to earn a Pro day. Pro gives an ad-free experience and more AI chat.

PRIVACY AND PERMISSIONS
Permissions are optional: notifications are used for reminders, location for nearby vets, and the camera for taking photos. Picking photos from your gallery needs no permission. You can delete your account and data from within the app. The app contains ads. Four languages are supported: Türkçe, English, Русский, Українська.

LINKS
Privacy Policy: https://pawpal1.web.app/en/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://pawpal1.web.app/en/terms/
Support: https://pawpal1.web.app/en/support/
Account and data deletion: https://pawpal1.web.app/en/delete-account/
Contact: pawpalpati@gmail.com

PawPal is not a substitute for a veterinarian. In an emergency, see a vet immediately.

name: PDFagic - PDF Scanner & Editor
description:
Meet PDFagic, your all-in-one document scanner and PDF toolkit.

PDFagic makes it easy to scan, create, edit, organize and manage documents directly from your iPhone. Whether you are handling business paperwork, student notes, receipts, invoices, contracts or personal documents, PDFagic brings essential PDF tools together in one simple experience.

SMART DOCUMENT SCANNER

- Scan documents using your camera.
- Automatically detect document edges.
- Crop and adjust scanned pages.
- Enhance document clarity.
- Create multi-page PDF documents.
- Save and organize scanned documents.

POWERFUL PDF TOOLS

- Merge multiple PDF files into one.
- Split PDFs into separate documents.
- Compress PDFs to reduce file size.
- Reorder and organize PDF pages.
- Create PDFs from images.
- Convert supported files into PDF.

PDF EDITING AND SIGNATURES

- Add annotations and highlights.
- Draw and mark up documents.
- Add signatures to documents.
- Insert text and notes.
- Add watermarks to PDFs.

DOCUMENT SECURITY

- Protect PDFs with passwords.
- Unlock supported password-protected PDFs.
- Redact sensitive information.
- Keep important documents organized.

DOCUMENT MANAGEMENT

- Organize documents into folders.
- Search for saved documents.
- Access recent documents quickly.
- Manage and share PDF files.
- Export and print documents.

DESIGNED FOR EVERYDAY PRODUCTIVITY

From scanning an ID card to preparing a business contract, PDFagic helps simplify your document workflow.

Perfect for students, teachers, business professionals, freelancers, entrepreneurs and everyday document management.

PDFagic - Scan. Edit. Convert. Sign. Secure.

Your documents, made simple.

name: Peg: Instrument Tuner
description:
Tune a guitar, bass, ukulele, violin, viola, cello, mandolin or banjo with the phone's microphone, and keep a log of each instrument's strings.

What you get:
- Tune any of 11 instruments
- Locked string, no octave jumps
- Strobe view for fine tuning
- Log string changes and drift
- No ads, no subscription

Free to start. One in-app purchase adds the rest, with no subscription.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

name: PEG: Project Execution Graph
description:
PEG is Project Execution Graph: a field workspace that connects equipment, schedules, and work information for invited project teams.

SEE THE PLAN
Browse scheduled equipment and its planned stages. Search the inventory and filter by data hall, lineup, division, or assigned person.

OPEN THE EQUIPMENT RECORD
Review an item's status, planned dates, work instructions, and recorded physical connections. Navigate between related equipment without losing the context of the work.

PREPARE FOR THE FIELD
Download equipment and open the work you need before going offline. Save field updates locally, then submit them when connected. Pending and accepted updates remain distinct.

KEEP THE TEAM INFORMED
Authorized planned stage-date changes and accepted field updates use the shared project service. Advanced CPM scenarios, connection editing, and administration remain in the web workspace.

PEG requires an enabled project account and PEG access provided by your project administrator. Available information and actions depend on your permissions. Documents and media are not included in offline downloads in this version.

name: Pegspan
description:
A box of plastic beams, a row of pink pegs and a toy car that really wants to reach the other bank. Pegspan turns bridge engineering into a playroom: drag a beam from a peg or a bolt to a white dot, press GO and watch your structure take the weight.

HOW A BRIDGE COMES TOGETHER
• Three beam types. ROAD beams form the deck the vehicle drives on, WOOD is light and cheap, STEEL is heavy-duty and costs the most.
• Every stop gives you a budget in beam points. Spend under 80 % of it for three stars, under 92 % for two.
• Each beam can be up to 2.25 m long, so tall spans need clever triangles rather than one long plank.
• When the test runs, every beam glows mint while relaxed, lemon under strain and pink just before it snaps. Overload one and it pops, and the car drops into the water.
• Tweak, undo, erase and test again as often as you like.

THE TOY-TOWN MAP
24 stops along a winding path: Puddle Hop, Sandbox Gap, Duck Pond, Lolly Creek, Kite Hill, Marble Run, Teddy Ford, Jelly Canal, Block Tower, Crayon River, Yo-yo Falls, Train Set, Bubble Bay, Tin Soldier Pass, Paper Boat Port, Rocking Gorge, Puzzle Plains, Spinning Top, Cuckoo Cliffs, Rubber Duck Delta, Rainbow Rapids, Toy Box Canyon, Pinwheel Point and, finally, the Grand Playroom. Gaps widen, banks change height, support piers appear, and the traffic grows from a scooter to a car, a van and a truck. Each stop opens once the previous one holds.

RUSH HOUR
A fresh, generated building site every round and 75 seconds on the build clock. When the clock reaches zero, the test starts on its own, ready or not. Clear site after site until the first collapse ends the run, then try to clear more sites next time.

THE WORKSHOP
Every bridge that holds earns bolts, the in-game points: 5 per crossing plus 10 for each new star, and 8 for every Rush Hour site. Spend them on three upgrades, three levels each:
• Super Glue Joints: beams hold 12 % more load per level.
• Grippy Tyres: vehicles climb and pull 10 % harder per level.
• Bigger Toolbox: 5 % more beam points at every stop per level.

THE GARAGE
Six paint jobs for your test vehicle: Bubblegum, Mint Chip, Lemon Drop, Grape Soda, Tangerine and Midnight Toy. The colour you pick is the one that drives across your bridges.

THE STICKER BOOK
A page of stickers that keeps count of your stars, stops opened, bridges tested, crossings that held, splashes, beams placed, your Rush Hour record, bolts collected and workshop levels.

ALSO
• Plays in portrait and landscape, on phone or tablet.
• Haptics and the drifting balloons in the background can each be switched off.
• Works offline, with no account and no adverts. Progress stays on your device.

Grab a beam and get that car across.

name: Peke agentes
description:
Peke para agentes es la app del equipo de atención de los negocios que usan Peke. Lleva tu bandeja de chats al celular para que respondas a tus clientes estés donde estés.

Con la app podés:
• Ver los chats que tenés asignados, los de tu equipo y los que esperan respuesta.
• Contestar con texto, fotos, documentos, notas de voz, plantillas y links de pago.
• Responder desde la notificación, citar mensajes y reaccionar.
• Recibir un aviso cuando un cliente te escribe o te asignan un chat, aunque tengas la app cerrada.
• Asignar, liberar, posponer y cerrar conversaciones.
• Ver los datos del cliente y su historial antes de responder.
• Ponerte como "Ausente" para dejar de recibir chats nuevos.
• Proteger la app con Face ID o Touch ID.
• Usarla en modo claro u oscuro.

Funciona con los chats de WhatsApp e Instagram que tu negocio tiene conectados a Peke.

Necesitás una cuenta de Peke: te la crea el administrador de tu negocio desde peke.la. Entrás con tu email.

name: PenaltyBox: Team Fine Box
description:
Mistakes cost. Luckily, they fund the party.

PenaltyBox is the fine box for your football team, old boys, handball, padel, the office and your mates. Ditch the spreadsheet and the note in the dressing room – everyone can see who owes what, and who's washing the kit.

HAND OUT A FINE IN TWO SECONDS
Tap a teammate, pick the fine, done. Money fines or tasks like washing shirts or bringing cake.

PAY IN ONE TAP
Add your MobilePay Box, Vipps or phone number and "Pay" opens the payment app with the amount ready. PenaltyBox never touches the money.

FAIR FOR EVERYONE
• Finemaster, treasurer and members, each with their own rights
• Members suggest fines – the finemaster approves
• Disagree? Appeal the fine and the team votes

FUN TO FOLLOW
• Hall of shame: who tops the list?
• Seasons, badges and stats
• Savings goals for the Christmas party or the team trip
• Coins dropping into the box

MANY BOXES, ONE YOU
Be in the football team, the office and your friends' box at once. Swipe between boxes, see your own account across all of them and get notified when a fine lands.

UP AND RUNNING IN A MINUTE
Pick a template, give the box a name and a colour, and share the QR code with the team. No account needed – but with one (Apple, Google or e-mail) you're you on every device.

No ads. No tracking. Just fines.

name: Penapi
description: Discover food and drink ideas, enjoy simple local choice activities, revisit your history and keep favorites on your shelf. Personalize your pass with a nickname and profile photo. Records are stored locally. Choice activities involve no real money, betting or prizes.

name: Perchi-
description:
A little care. A closer bond.
A quieter morning, a new food, a first step onto your hand. Life with a cockatiel is full of small moments that are easy to forget. Perchi helps you keep those moments together, so everyday care and patient training have a clearer story.
Made for cockatiel caregivers welcoming a new companion or deepening an established bond, Perchi connects what you notice today with what you want to understand over time.
NOTICE THE DETAILS THAT MATTER
Keep weight, appetite, activity, droppings and breathing observations together. Add a note, photo or sound clip when it helps explain the moment. Look back through your timeline and weight history with the context that memory alone can miss.
BUILD TRUST, ONE SMALL STEP AT A TIME
Explore gentle stages for stepping up, returning to the cage, target practice and feeling comfortable with a travel carrier. Record short practices, rewards and body language. A thoughtful pause matters too: save a practice even when there were no successes, and move forward when you decide your bird is ready.
GIVE EVERYDAY CARE A CLEAR RHYTHM
Keep water, food, cleaning and interaction tasks in view. Set the days and planning times that suit your routine, mark tasks complete, and return to recent observations and practices from Today.
KEEP EACH BIRD’S STORY TOGETHER

BRING BETTER CONTEXT TO A VET VISIT

name: PetNote: Pet Care & Vet Log
description:
PetNote is a quiet, paper-inspired notebook for keeping daily cat and dog care records alongside veterinary documents. Designed with warm paper tones and clear hand-drawn tabs, it helps households keep practical health history organized without clutter or noise.

Core Features

1. Separate Stool and Urine Logs
Record bowel movements and urination independently, with clear status shading for formed, soft, or watery stool as well as urinary changes. Reviewing past days before a vet checkup stays straightforward and readable.

2. Meals, Medications, and Weight
Set up gram presets for dry food, wet food, or home-prepared recipes, along with flat medication cabinet presets. Log daily feedings, doses, body weight, and care notes in a few taps without retyping routine details.

3. Vet Visits and On-Device Lab Sheet Archive
Attach photos and PDF documents from clinic visits, including bloodwork panels, urinalysis reports, and prescriptions. Text and indicator extraction runs 100% on-device using Apple Vision OCR, so medical files stay searchable on your phone without being uploaded to external servers.

4. Import Existing Spreadsheets and Documents
Bring over past care logs directly on your device from Excel (.xlsx), Numbers, CSV, PDF files, or screenshots.

5. Family Sharing via Apple iCloud (Owner & Helper Roles)
Coordinate care across household members through Apple CloudKit (CKShare):
- Owner: Manages pet profiles, food portion recipes, and medication cabinet presets.
- Family Helper: Joins at no cost via invitation link to add and maintain daily excretion, meal, medication, and care entries, without risking accidental edits to established food or medication presets.

Privacy & Storage
- No ads, no third-party analytics or tracking SDKs, and no developer backend servers.
- All records and attachments live locally in SQLite on your device and in your private Apple iCloud account.

Pricing
- Free to download. All daily logging, unlimited vet and lab sheet archiving, spreadsheet import, and all 3 paper color themes for 1 pet are completely free.
- A one-time lifetime purchase (no subscriptions, no auto-renewal) is only needed to add 2 or more pet profiles or to initiate iCloud family sharing as an Owner. Invited family helpers join at no additional charge.

O Petzara é a agenda e a gestão do seu pet shop, banho e tosa ou clínica veterinária, no iPhone. Chega de caderno, planilha e horário marcado duas vezes.

TUTORES E PETS

name: Pgenim
seller_name: UCEL AKSESUAR MOBILYA MALZEMELERI ITHALAT IHRACAT SANAYI VE TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Welcome! We hope this app helps you work more efficiently, and we look forward to your suggestions.

Pgenim keeps your whole job hunt on one line. Every application moves left to right — Wishlist, Applied, Interviewing, Offer, Closed — so you always know what's waiting on you and what's waiting on them.

THE BOARD
Each application is a chevron card in its stage column: company, role, location or remote, salary range and how long it has sat there. Tap the arrow tip and the card slides into the next stage, or drag it onto any column. Closing an application asks how it ended — accepted, declined, rejected, withdrew or no reply — so your history stays honest.

FOLLOW-UPS THAT DON'T SLIP
Give any application a follow-up date. When it's due, the card turns amber and a banner on the board lists who to nudge. Switch on follow-up nudges in HQ for a 9:00 notification on the day. Mark it done with one tap.

INTERVIEW ROUNDS
Log every round with its type (phone screen, technical, take-home, panel, final and more), date and time, and your prep notes. The Rounds screen lists what's coming up by day, and ticking a round off moves it into your history. Logging the first round moves the application to Interviewing for you.

CONTACTS PER COMPANY
Keep recruiters, referrers and hiring managers with their title, email, phone, notes and when you last spoke. They're grouped by company, searchable, and appear on every matching application. Email or call straight from the card.

WEEKLY GOAL AND STATS
Set how many applications you want to send each week and watch the goal track fill on the board. Stats show your response rate, offer rate, a stage-by-stage funnel built from chevrons, eight weeks of output against your goal, which sources actually get replies, and how closed applications ended.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CHOICE
Sign in with Apple, Google or email — or tap "Browse first" to try everything as a guest. Guests can save their data to a real login later without losing a card. Your pipeline syncs through Google Firebase and keeps working offline.

PRIVACY
No ads. No tracking. No analytics SDKs. Your data is readable only by your own account. Delete your account and every application, round and contact from HQ at any time.

Pgenim — one line from wishlist to offer.

name: Photo Cleaner: Libera Espacio
description:
Libera espacio eligiendo tú qué fotos y videos conservar.

Photo Cleaner te ayuda a encontrar los archivos más grandes de tu iPhone, revisarlos y eliminar únicamente los que selecciones. Sin anuncios, suscripciones ni compras dentro de la app.

ENCUENTRA LO QUE MÁS PESA
• Ordena tus fotos y videos de mayor a menor tamaño.
• Filtra por tipo: fotos, videos, Live Photos y capturas.
• Revisa rangos de tamaño y los elementos que todavía no se pudieron medir.
• Cambia entre cuadrícula y lista.

REVISA CON CALMA
• Abre una vista previa antes de seleccionar.
• Consulta el tamaño, la fecha, la resolución y la duración de los videos.
• La selección se conserva al cambiar de filtro.
• Los cambios de Fotos no inician otro análisis mientras revisas: actualiza la biblioteca cuando tú quieras.
• Comprueba tu selección antes de confirmar el borrado.

PROCESAMIENTO EN TU IPHONE
No necesitas crear una cuenta. Photo Cleaner no envía tu biblioteca a servidores propios y no incorpora herramientas de seguimiento. El análisis se puede pausar y reanudar manualmente; una caché local evita repetir las mediciones de archivos sin cambios.

TEN EN CUENTA
Los tamaños corresponden a los recursos originales; las Live Photos incluyen su componente de video. La cifra puede diferir del espacio local que recuperarás.

El análisis no descarga originales de iCloud. Algunos archivos pueden quedar sin medir si no están disponibles localmente y el sistema no informa su tamaño. En versiones anteriores de iOS, la medición inicial puede tardar porque requiere leer los archivos locales.

Eliminar con Photo Cleaner equivale a eliminar en Fotos de Apple. Si utilizas Fotos en iCloud, el borrado se sincroniza con iCloud y tus otros dispositivos. La app no comprueba las copias de Google Fotos: verifica tu respaldo antes de borrar si quieres conservar una copia. Los archivos pasan a Eliminado recientemente en Fotos de Apple.

name: Photo Puzzle: Play Together
description:
Jigsaw puzzles are better together.

• Play together, far apart: create a room, send the link, and your friends join without an account. Everyone moves pieces at the same time.
• A real jigsaw feel: interlocking pieces, snapping groups and satisfying sounds. From 100 to 2000 pieces.
• Ready-made collections: nature, animals, birds, landscapes, cities, flowers, art and food. A new Daily Puzzle every day.
• Your own photo: turn a holiday, a pet or a family picture into a puzzle. Only the people in your room can see it.
• Surprise puzzle: hide the picture and let someone reveal it piece by piece, then show your message when it is finished.
• Three difficulty levels: Easy, Normal and Hard (pieces arrive rotated).
• Badges, points, weekly quests, a leaderboard and friends. Finished puzzles go into your sticker album.
• Share: a "we did it together" card, a time-lapse video and a puzzle sticker when you finish.

An account is optional; with one, your history and badges follow you across devices. Your photos are never used for advertising and are deleted with the room. The app is for users aged 13 and over; users under 18 need a parent's permission.

name: PhotoPurge: Remove Photo Data
description:
PhotoPurge shows the hidden details inside your photos and removes them before you share.

Every photo you take can carry the exact place it was taken, the phone that took it, the date and time, and the camera settings. Post it online and anyone can read that information. PhotoPurge lets you check it and clean it in seconds.

SEE WHAT YOUR PHOTO REVEALS
• Location shown on a map, with exact coordinates
• Device make and model, lens and software
• Date and time the photo was taken and edited
• Camera settings: aperture, shutter speed, ISO, focal length

REMOVE IT IN ONE TAP
• Creates a clean copy without location, device, date and camera data
• Keeps the photo's orientation, so nothing is rotated
• JPEG photos are copied without re-compressing
• Your original photo is never changed

SHARE OR SAVE SAFELY

Free, with no ads and no in-app purchases.
