name: PhotoRelay: Camera Transfer
description:
PhotoRelay connects your camera, photo editor and newsroom on iPhone and iPad.

Receive original files through the built-in FTP receiver. Preview your photos and export selected originals to your editing app. Share edited files back to PhotoRelay, then send them to your FTP or implicit-FTPS destination. Original file contents and embedded IPTC metadata are preserved by PhotoRelay.

Features:
• FTP camera receiving on your local network
• Photo previews and batch selection/export
• FTP and implicit-FTPS sending with progress and automatic retries
• Favorite destination, auto-send and three assignable share shortcuts
• Optional automatic saving to a named Apple Photos album or a chosen folder
• Transfer history and a local activity log
• Password storage in the system Keychain

Keep PhotoRelay open while receiving or sending. Receiving uses unencrypted FTP; use a trusted network. Outgoing FTPS uses implicit TLS, usually on port 990, with system-trusted certificates. Explicit FTPS (AUTH TLS) is not supported. Photos and folder auto-save create extra copies; check those copies before deleting originals. Your editor and server determine their own format support and behavior.

name: PhotoTrashIT: Photo Cleaner
description:
Keep the memories. Let the clutter go.

A camera roll full of almost-the-same moments can make sorting feel like a chore. PhotoTrashIT gives you one photo and one decision at a time—with a chance to check before anything is deleted.

CHOOSE WITH A SWIPE
Swipe right to keep a photo or left to add it to the deletion queue. Changed your mind? Undo your last swipe before confirming deletion.

LOOK CLOSER, DECIDE BETTER
Pinch or double-tap to zoom right inside the photo card. Check the details without leaving your place.

YOU HAVE THE FINAL SAY
Review the queue, remove anything you want to keep, then confirm in the iOS prompt. A swipe alone never deletes a photo.

START WHERE YOU WANT
Work through an album, shuffle your photos or review the newest first. Points, levels and daily stats make your progress visible. After a confirmed deletion, see your session result with estimated time saved and estimated photo size—not a stopwatch or a promise of freed storage.

One-time purchase. No ads, subscriptions or account required.

Confirmed deletions move to Recently Deleted in Photos, where they can normally be recovered for 30 days. Storage is not freed immediately; it is freed only after photos are permanently removed from Recently Deleted. With iCloud Photos enabled, deletions also apply to other devices using the same library.

name: Pick Me: Finger Picker
description:
Who pays? Who goes first? Who does the dishes? Put your fingers on the screen and let Pick Me decide.

Everyone places one finger on the screen. After a short countdown, one finger gets picked. No arguing, no rock-paper-scissors.

SEVEN WAYS TO DECIDE
• Classic – fingers down, one gets picked
• Spin the bottle – spin it, or flick it with your finger
• Dice – up to eight players, highest roll wins
• Teams – split the group into 2, 3 or 4 teams (Pro)
• Elimination – one finger drops out each round until one is left (Pro)
• Roulette – a light hops from finger to finger and stops on one (Pro)
• Wheel – your own names or options on a wheel (Pro)

MAGIC MODE (PRO)
Want to be sure you win, or sure you don't? Switch on Magic Mode and secretly decide the outcome with a hidden gesture. Nobody at the table will notice. Meant for a laugh among friends.

MADE FOR THE TABLE
• Sound and vibration, both optional
• Countdown of 1, 2, 3 or 5 seconds
• Works without an internet connection
• No ads, no account, no data collected

PICK ME PRO
Classic, Spin the bottle and Dice are free. A one-time purchase unlocks Teams, Elimination, Roulette, Wheel and Magic Mode. No subscription.

Good to know: an iPhone recognises up to five fingers at once.

name: Pickle Roll Call
description:
Play more pickleball. Skip the messy part.

Pickle Roll Call is the easier way to set up games and run them at the court. No more wondering who sits out next, who should partner up, or what to do when seven people show up for one court. The app sorts it out, fairly, on everyone's phone.

Post a game in about a minute: the day, the time and the court. Drop the link or the 4-digit game code into your group text or GroupMe, or read it out at the court. Players tap I'm in. When the game is full, the next person goes on the waitlist, and if someone drops out, the first person waiting gets the spot and a buzz on their phone.

Want to boost the fun on the court? Select one of these five bonus game formats to play, all free, so every week feels fresh:

- Round robin: a new partner every game, and nobody sits out twice before everyone has.
- King of the Court: winners stay on, and players waiting rotate in. Perfect when the numbers are odd.
- Up and Down the River: every court plays at once. Win and move up, lose and move down.
- Set partners: keep the same partner all session. Great for partner practice and tournament prep.
- Teams: split into two teams, mix partners within your team, and see which team wins the day.

Pick a format when you post, or decide at the court once you know who showed up. Too many players? The app suggests a format so everyone plays. Every player sees their court, partner and who's up next on their own phone, with a timer that runs on everyone's screen. Keep score if you like. Scores stay with that day's games, never on anyone's profile.

Even games, without the awkward conversation. The app uses the free Level Check to keep courts and teams even, and levels never show on the court screen.

After the game, give a Paddle Tap to the people who made it fun. Everyone you play with lands in your Pickle Pals, so you can message them and set up the next one.

- Reminders before every game, and one tap adds it to your calendar.
- CrewSync finds the time when most of your regular group is free.
- Find drop-in open play at clubs near you.
- Big text and big buttons, made for players of every age.

Your phone number and email are never shown to other players. Other players see your first name, last initial, level and home courts, and you can block anyone. Free, with no ads and no subscription.

name: Pidgo
description:
Your caption says “Comment GUIDE and I’ll send you my plan”. Pidgo’s AI reads it, finds the word and what you promise, and writes the whole automation. You add the link. A second later every comment gets a DM, even at 3 a.m.

YOUR CAPTION IS THE AUTOMATION
• Tap a post: the AI finds the word to comment and what you promise

• The only thing you add is the link

LIVE AS SOON AS YOUR REEL IS

Free during the beta, with every feature included. You need an Instagram creator or business account. No Facebook Page required.

name: Pillumi
description:
Mit Pillumi hast du deinen Medikamentenplan im Blick. Sieh, welche Einnahme als Nächstes ansteht, und dokumentiere sie auf dem iPhone oder der Apple Watch. Im Verlauf kannst du nachsehen, was du bereits erfasst hast, und versehentliche Einträge korrigieren.

DEIN PLAN FÜR HEUTE
Übertrage die Zeiten und Mengen aus deinem bestehenden Medikamentenplan. Lege tägliche Einnahmen, bestimmte Wochentage oder monatliche Termine fest. In der Tagesübersicht stehen offene Einnahmen oben. Dokumentierte Einträge findest du in einem eigenen Bereich.

ERINNERUNGEN UND KALENDER
Lass dich an geplante Einnahmen erinnern. Auf Wunsch steht der Medikamentenname direkt in der Mitteilung. Einzelne Termine und Terminserien kannst du auch in deinen Kalender eintragen.

MEDIKAMENTE SCHNELLER ERFASSEN
Scanne den Barcode oder den Text auf der Verpackung mit der Kamera. Pillumi sammelt den erkannten Text im Live-Scan. Auf unterstützten Geräten kann Apple Intelligence daraus Vorschläge für Name, Wirkstoff, Stärke und Darreichungsform machen. Du prüfst die Angaben und entscheidest, was du übernimmst. Ein Packungsfoto hilft dir, den Eintrag wiederzuerkennen.

AUF DER APPLE WATCH DOKUMENTIEREN
Sieh deinen Tagesplan am Handgelenk. Markiere eine Einnahme als eingenommen oder ausgelassen oder verschiebe sie um zehn Minuten. Mit aktiviertem iCloud-Abgleich kannst du einen bereits geladenen Plan auch ohne erreichbares iPhone nutzen. Die Watch speichert deine Einträge lokal und gleicht sie über iCloud ab, sobald eine Verbindung verfügbar ist.

VERLAUF UND PDF-BERICHT
Sieh in der Wochenübersicht, welche Einnahmen fällig waren und welche du als eingenommen dokumentiert hast. Exportiere deinen Medikamentenplan und das Einnahmetagebuch zusammen als PDF, auf Wunsch mit Deckblatt.

ICLOUD, FREIGABEN UND SIRI
Der optionale iCloud-Abgleich hält deinen Plan und Verlauf auf deinen Geräten verfügbar. Angehörigen kannst du eine Kopie ausgewählter Medikamentenpläne zum Lesen freigeben. Mit Siri-Kurzbefehlen kannst du nach der nächsten Einnahme fragen oder einen eindeutigen Termin nach Bestätigung dokumentieren.

Pillumi unterstützt dich bei der Organisation und Dokumentation deines bestehenden Medikamentenplans. Für medizinische Entscheidungen und Änderungen deines Plans wende dich an deine Arztpraxis oder Apotheke.

name: Pinball Parade
description:
Pinball Parade is three seaside pin tables in the 1950s manner, made in Redcar: wood rails, brass pins, bells and score 
reels, with the whole table on your screen.

Pull the plunger and the ball runs up the lane and round the arch. Touch the left half of the screen for the left flippers
and the right half for the right. The top half of every table is the wall, with its own smaller pair of flippers: get the

THE REDCAR BEACON
Climb the Beacon. Light the Parade. Roll the B-E-A-C-O-N lanes under the arch to open the Beacon's door, and lock two 
balls for multiball. Every roll down a promenade rail lights the next letter of L-E-M-O-N-T-O-P. Knock the Rock Shop's 
captive ball hard enough to ring its bell, and knock down RED and CAR to step up the bonus. Finish all six of the table's 
features to spell P-A-R-A-D-E and start THE PARADE.

THE WIND FARM
Catch the wind off Redcar sands. Five turbines turn out at sea: strike a blade hard and its rotor spins. Roll the four 
kite lanes and the kite carries the ball up and across the wall. A sand yacht sails across the sands, and beach flags fly 
either side of the tide line. Fill the five wind lamps for a GALE, then light the windows R-E-D-C-A-R for LIGHTS ON, and 
light the town.

ZETLAND RESCUE
Launch the lifeboat. Bring them home. A storm off the South Gare: the light at the top of the wall holds the ball while 
its brass hand swings, and fires it where the hand points. Shoot up the slipway and the Zetland, the 1802 lifeboat, 
carries the ball out to sea. Press as her bow points at the flashing survivor, then bring the ball home for A RESCUE. Ring
the wreck's bell for ALL HANDS, and ten rescues light THE GREAT STORM.

THE NEXT TABLE WHEELS IN
Start on the Beacon. Score 100,000 in one game there and The Wind Farm opens; score 500,000 on The Wind Farm and Zetland 
Rescue opens. Or get there over many games: every game adds to a running total. And there's a fourth table, hidden until 
you earn it.

TICKETS FOR THE PRIZE STALL
Every 2,000 points is a ticket. Save them up for a collection of Redcar prizes, from a toy windmill and a stick of Redcar 
rock to a model of the Beacon and the Zetland herself.

MADE FOR YOUR SCREEN
The table is built to the shape of your screen, top to bottom and edge to edge, on every iPhone and iPad with iOS 26 or 
later. Played upright, either way up. Plays with a keyboard too.

AND
Real pin-table sounds: bells, chimes and the knocker. Every feature of every table explained in the game, with a numbered 
picture. A Small Hands setting for little ones, whose games still count towards opening the next table.

It's all for fun. Tickets are won by playing and can't be bought, and there's no real money in the machine anywhere. No 
ads. No in-app purchases. No data collected: your scores, tickets and prizes stay on your iPhone or iPad.

Made by Redcar Rocks, in Redcar. From the makers of Tuppenny Tumble and Donkey Derby.

name: Pip's Big Solitaire Collection
description:
Relax with the solitaires you love and discover many more. In Pip's Big Solitaire Collection every deal can be won, so no game is ever wasted.

Pip, the friendly Joker, teaches you each game step by step, shows you a good move whenever you're stuck and cheers every win.

• MORE THAN 40 SOLITAIRES
Klondike (draw one or three), Spider (one, two or four suits), FreeCell, TriPeaks, Pyramid, Golf, Yukon, Scorpion, Canfield, Forty Thieves, La Belle Lucie, Clock and many more.

• EVERY DEAL CAN BE WON
Every game starts from a winnable deal. If a move would lose the game, Pip warns you, and he can take you back to the last point where it could still be won.

• EASY ON THE EYES
Big letters that follow your text size, large buttons, a large-print deck and a four-colour deck.

• LEARN WITH PIP
A short lesson for every game, the rules at a tap and a little history of each solitaire.

• A REASON TO COME BACK
A game of the day, three daily missions, a streak, levels, medals and achievements. Win new decks and card backs just by playing.

• PLAY YOUR WAY
Tap or drag, undo, automatic moves to the foundations, and game numbers to replay a deal or play the same one as a friend. Works offline.

• IPHONE, IPAD AND MAC
Your progress travels with you through iCloud.

No ads. No sign-up. Just you, the cards and Pip.

name: Pipnine
description:
Pipnine is a puzzle about small tiles and one big goal.

Drag a piece onto the board. When three matching tiles touch, they merge into one tile with one more pip. Fill a row or a column and it clears. Keep merging and you climb from one pip all the way to nine. Make a nine and it pops, taking its neighbours with it.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Three pieces at a time. Place them anywhere they fit.
• Three of a kind merge and free up space.
• Full rows and columns clear.
• A nine clears everything around it.
• The game ends when no piece fits.

WHAT IS INSIDE
• Endless mode with a chain of goals to chase.
• A daily puzzle: the same starting hand for everyone, one try per day, and a streak to keep.
• Tile themes to unlock as you play.
• Three helpers when the board gets tight: undo, swap and hammer.
• Sound and vibration you can switch off.
• Your game is saved when you leave and waits for you.

Pipnine is free to play and needs no account. A short ad may appear between games, and you can choose to watch one for an extra helper or a second chance. A one-time purchase removes the ads between games.

name: Pippin Barrow
description:
A lemon rolls if you let it. A melon stays where it lands and leans on everything beneath it. On a sloped barrow at the edge of a cobbled square, you drop fruit from the morning crate one at a time and let the heap find its shape.

Then the walkers come. A cook wants a pear, and it sits under half the heap. Tap it and it goes; whatever rested on it shifts, and anything that slips over the lip lands on the cobbles bruised. Serve walker after walker cleanly and your Coster's Cry climbs to three times the pips, which the Cartwright turns into straw bedding or an oak lip rail.

From Monday to Saturday the Warden chalks a mark you must reach to keep your pitch. Wind tugs at the awning, rain slicks the boards, and the pigeon that lands on your top apple never buys anything.

name: Pit Pals: Tiny Tuning
description:
Small cars. Clever builds.

Welcome to Pit Pals, a colorful toy garage where every track is a new tuning puzzle. Choose your parts, send your animal driver out for an automatic test, and discover what makes your build work.

BUILD YOUR RACER
Fit tires, gearing and suspension, with three choices in each category. Trade dry-road speed for wet-weather grip, choose stronger uphill pull, or protect the body over rough ground. Tap a part to fit it, or drag it into its matching slot.

READ THE ROAD
Explore 100 track challenges across five regions. Ten route types evolve through different lengths, corners, budgets and targets. Tarmac, gravel, water, bumps and climbs give you different reasons to rethink your setup.

WATCH YOUR IDEAS MOVE
Your driver handles the steering and braking. Watch the car travel along the course while speed, grip and body condition reveal how your choices behave. Pause when you need a moment, or use 2× playback to watch the test sooner.

LEARN, THEN TUNE AGAIN
Finish for one star, meet the time target for another, and keep enough body condition for the third. Read the result diagnosis, return to your saved build and try another combination. A missed target is a useful clue for your next idea.

A GARAGE THAT IS YOURS
• 27 tire, gearing and suspension combinations
• All parts available from the start
• Build budgets that are limits, not money to buy or spend
• Four animal drivers with the same physics: Rabbit, Fox, Panda and Turtle
• Saved builds, local best times and stars
• Optional sound effects and supported-device haptics
• Offline single-player gameplay, with no custom account, ads or in-app purchases

Little builds. Big discoveries.

Privacy Policy: https://pitpals-legal.pages.dev/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://pitpals-legal.pages.dev/terms/
Support: https://pitpals-legal.pages.dev/

name: Pitch: Guitar Tuner & Chords
description:
FREE: Standard tuning with automatic/manual string selection and reference tones, all 120 chords with all three positions, chord search, favorites, left-handed diagrams, chord sounds, and the metronome.

OPTIONAL PITCH FULL: A one-time In-App Purchase unlocks alternate and custom tunings, Chromatic tuning, A4 calibration, and precision mode. No subscription. Your local App Store price is shown before purchase. Restore purchases using the same Apple Account.

Start each session in tune, with chords and rhythm close at hand.

Pitch brings a guitar tuner, chord library, and metronome together in a native app for iPhone and iPad. Clear guidance helps you get started, while flexible tuning controls give experienced players room to explore.

FIND YOUR TUNING
• Choose from 12 presets, including Standard, Drop D, DADGAD, Open G, Open D, and Drop C.
• Save one custom six-string tuning.
• Use automatic string detection, select a string manually, or explore Chromatic mode.
• See the note, octave, frequency in Hz, and pitch difference in cents.
• Adjust the A4 reference from 430 to 450 Hz and choose a normal or precision in-tune display threshold.
• Listen to reference tones and feel optional haptic feedback when a string settles in tune.

DISCOVER YOUR NEXT CHORD
• Browse 120 chords across 12 roots and 10 chord types.
• Explore three positions for each chord: 360 voicings in total.
• Read clear fretboard diagrams with open strings, muted strings, and root notes.
• Follow string-by-string instructions and hear each voicing.
• Search symbols such as Am, F#m7, and Bbmaj7, and save your favorites.
• Switch to left-handed diagrams.

KEEP YOUR RHYTHM
• Practice from 30 to 240 BPM.
• Choose 2/4, 3/4, 4/4, or 6/4, with a distinct first beat.
• Tap along to find your tempo.

MAKE IT YOUR STUDIO
Works offline, without an account. Choose light or dark mode, follow your iPhone’s language, or select English, Thai, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, French, or German. A beginner’s guide is included.

Microphone audio is processed on your device and is never recorded or uploaded by Pitch. Chord diagrams use Standard tuning; the tuner supports the alternate presets listed above. The three chord positions are different voicings, not necessarily separated by a full octave.

name: Pixalia
description:
Pixalia turns your product into short video ads starring hyper-real AI creators. No shoot, no actors, no editing.

Design a creator once, pick their look and style, add a photo of your product, and Pixalia writes and generates a vertical video ad ready for TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Design your own AI creators and reuse them across campaigns
- Add your product from your camera or photo library
- Generate UGC-style video ads with an AI director that writes the scene for you
- Keep every creator and video in one library, then save or share

CREDITS
Image credits create creators. Video credits create videos. Buy a Credit Pack or a Studio Pack in the app. Credits are a one-time purchase, with no subscription.

Pixalia is for adults 18 and older and for businesses promoting products they have the right to sell.

Terms: https://pixalia.io/terms
Privacy: https://pixalia.io/privacy

name: PlantPace: Plant Care
description:
PlantPace is a calm notebook for your plants. It tells you when to water, feed, repot or rotate, and why, based on your pot, your window, the season and the weather where you live. No account, no ads.

CARE THAT FITS YOUR HOME
• Watering intervals adapt to pot size and material, light, room and season.
• Every task shows its reasons, so you learn as you go.
• Tell it "the soil was still wet" or "it was bone dry" and the schedule learns from you.
• Reminders for watering, feeding, repotting and turning towards the light.

114 PLANTS, CHECKED AGAINST SOURCES
• Houseplants, succulents, cacti, herbs, vegetables and fruit for pots.
• Light, water and toxicity values cross-checked with at least two independent sources such as university extension services and the RHS.
• Clear toxicity ratings for cats and dogs, with a "safe for my pets" filter.

FOR BALCONIES AND GARDENS
• "Sow this month": what you can sow or plant now in your climate, from tomatoes to garlic.
• Frost, heat, storm and heavy rain warnings for your outdoor plants.
• Outdoor watering follows the local forecast and rain.

DISCOVER
• Find plants that suit the light in a room.
• Hide plants that are toxic to the pets you live with.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your plants, photos and history stay on your phone.
• No account, no ads, no tracking, no analytics.
• Back up everything to one file you keep.

VACATION MODE AND WIDGET (PREMIUM)
• Before a trip, see which plants to water and which need someone; daily reminders pause while you're away.
• A home screen widget shows today's plants at a glance.

FREE AND PREMIUM
PlantPace is free for up to 15 plants, with all the care features. Premium removes the limit and adds vacation mode and a home screen widget: monthly, or yearly with a 7-day free trial. Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in your App Store or Google Play account settings.

Weather data: MET Norway (CC BY 4.0).

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://plantpace.someplus.work/privacy

name: Play Pulse: Sales & Reviews
description:
Play Pulse shows your Google Play business the moment it happens. Sales and refunds arrive live, along with every new review, release and crash.

WHAT IT SHOWS
• Live sales and refunds through your own Pub/Sub topic, with the country and the price.
• Money after tax and Google's fee, or before them, in the currency you pick, converted with the ECB daily rates.
• New reviews with their stars and text.
• Releases on every track, and how long Play Console took to review each one. With the optional Play Console sign in you get Google's own sent, approved and published times.
• Crash and ANR clusters and Android vitals, with a clear warning when an app goes past Google's bad behavior line.
• Optional notes to Slack and Discord.

On the Mac it lives in the menu bar, with today's earnings as its title. On iPhone and iPad it shows a banner for each sale, refund, review, release and crash.

WHAT YOU NEED
Play Pulse reads Google Play with your own Google Cloud service account key. The setup walks you through each step: a Cloud project, three APIs, a service account, its key and an invitation in Play Console. It ticks each step as it checks it.

Everything runs on your device with your own key. Nothing goes through a server of ours. The one exception is the wake up for instant banners on iPhone, which carries no content.

Not ready to set it up? Tap Explore with sample data on the first screen and look around with made up apps.

PRICE
Start with the free 14-day Trial, a free purchase that unlocks every feature for 14 days. Then buy Play Pulse Pro once to keep everything. One purchase covers iPhone, iPad and Mac with the same Apple Account. Nothing renews.

Play Pulse is not made by Google. Google Play is a trademark of Google LLC.

name: Play What You Want
description:
Play What You Want is a feed of quick, bright mini games. Swipe up for the next one, tap to play, and keep going.

PLAY
• Almost 30 hand-made games: sorting, puzzles, tycoons, arcade and more
• Every game has levels that get harder as you go
• Each one takes seconds to learn, no tutorials to sit through

MAKE YOUR OWN
• Type any game idea, like "a cat cafe where you serve lattes to cats"
• About a minute later it's ready to play
• Don't like something? Ask for a change: slower, easier, more levels
• Your games show up for everyone to play, and you can delete them any time

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
• Add friends with a link or find them in Search
• Send games to each other with a message
• Like the games you love and find more in Search

Your feed learns what you like the more you play. No ads.

You can play without an account. Make a free account (just a username and password, no email) to make games, add friends and keep your progress on any phone.

You need to be 13 or older to make an account. Be kind: you can report or block anyone, and we remove anything that breaks the rules.

name: PlayBot - AI Agents
description:
Your AI team, in your pocket.

PlayBot brings your AI agents to your iPhone. Give each agent a name, a role and a folder to work in, then follow every conversation, approve what matters and keep work moving from wherever you are.

Made for small businesses and for the people who build them: newsletters and social posts, customer emails, monthly reports, website changes and deploys, side by side in one place.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Chat with your agents and watch each step as they work
• Approve, always allow or deny an action before it happens
• Organize agents in folders and see at a glance who is working, ready or waiting for you
• Send files, photos and voice messages, and hear replies read aloud
• Keep track of tokens, estimated costs and plan limits

YOUR DATA, UNDER YOUR CONTROL
Your agents run on your own computers, with your own accounts at the AI providers. Conversations and files stay in your private PlayBot Hosted workspace. The app sends no usage analytics.

GETTING STARTED
Sign in to your PlayBot Hosted workspace: on your computer, open Settings → Mobile Connect and scan the code with the app.

Works with agents from Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, Gemini CLI and Antigravity running on your computers.

name: Pleniofy
description:
Pleniofy ist die all-in-one Lösung für Workforce Management. Verwalten Sie Ihre Mitarbeiter, erfassen Sie Arbeitszeiten und generieren Sie aussagekräftige Berichte – alles in einer benutzerfreundlichen App.

FUNKTIONEN:
• Zeiterfassung und Stundenzettel
• Mitarbeiterverwaltung
• Kundenmanagement
• Lieferantenverwaltung
• Kontaktverwaltung
• Aufgabenverwaltung
• Detaillierte Berichte und Analysen
• Mobiler Zugriff jederzeit und überall

Ideal für kleine und mittlere Unternehmen, die ihre Prozesse digitalisieren möchten.

Hinweis: Für die Nutzung der App ist ein Pleniofy-Firmenkonto erforderlich. Ihre Zugangsdaten erhalten Sie von Ihrem Arbeitgeber.

Weitere Informationen finden Sie auf www.pleniofy.com

name: Plenty.
description:
Plenty is a private dining journal for families who eat out together, especially the person who usually picks the restaurant or orders for the table. Keep the details that make a good meal worth repeating and put them to work the next time you go out.
Remember the dish, and who loved it
Save a restaurant visit with a photo, a note, or a quick voice memo. Give each diner their own reaction to a dish and mark what they’d order again. Next time you’re back, look up the dishes your family wants to repeat and see what each person thought.
Find a good combination for this table
Start with saved dishes, add a dish by hand, or scan a menu photo and confirm the dish names. Choose who’s eating and see suggestions based on their tastes and past meals, with reasons you can check. Keep the dishes you’re excited about, swap others, and save a plan for the next visit. Confirm ingredients and dietary needs with the restaurant before ordering.
Give everyone a say in where to eat
Shortlist a few restaurants, then spin the wheel, pass the phone for a private vote, or compare places head to head. Turn the winner into a new dining memory once you’re at the table.
From a quick weeknight bite to a favorite weekend spot, Plenty helps you remember the meals your family talks about and plan the ones you’ll want to have again.

name: Plotday: To-Dos, Right on Time
description:
Do to-dos just right, on time.

Plotday puts your to-do list and your calendar on one timeline. A task isn't really planned until it has a time, so Plotday helps you give every task one.

■ Write it down, Plotday finds the time
Type a task the way you'd say it — "Dinner with Sam at 7 #personal" — and the date, time and project are set for you. Tasks without a time are suggested into the free gaps of your day.

■ Today and what's next, on one screen
Timed tasks sit on your schedule; untimed ones appear as soft suggestions in open slots. In the scheduler, long-press and drag a block to move it to the exact time you want.

■ Works around your meetings
See your Google Calendar and iPhone Calendar events alongside your tasks, and automatic planning steers clear of them.

■ Works offline
Check and edit your list on a plane; it syncs when you're back online. Reminders ring at the time you set, even when the app is closed.

■ Home screen widget
See today's tasks and check them off without opening the app.

■ For developers
Link GitHub issues and pull requests — the checkbox fills itself when they merge. AI assistants can read and add tasks through MCP.

■ Together
Share projects with an invite link, assign tasks, and edit together in real time.

name: Plotter: Murder Sudoku
description:
One person in every row. One in every column. One killer, alone with the body.

Plotter is a murder mystery you solve like a sudoku. Each puzzle is the floor plan of a flat, seen in 3D. Read the clues, place every suspect and the victim on the grid, and the killer gives themselves away: they're the only other person in the victim's room.

HOW IT WORKS
• One per row, one per column: everybody in the flat, the victim included, stands on their own row and their own column.
• Mind the furniture: nobody stands on a table, a shelf or a plant. Chairs, sofas, beds, rugs and baths are fine.
• Clues never lie: "Alma was sitting on the sofa." "Nobody was in the study." "Dante was right next to the fridge."
• Alone with the body: once everyone is placed, accuse the one person who shared the victim's room.

120 PUZZLES, EACH WITH EXACTLY ONE ANSWER
From easy 4 × 4 flats to fiendish 7 × 7 ones with up to six suspects. Every puzzle is checked by a solver: one answer, worked out from the clues alone, no guessing.

MADE FOR PEN-AND-PAPER LOGIC FANS
Tick off the clues you've used, see at a glance which rows and columns are taken, and take your time: there's no timer.

FROM THE MAKERS OF MURDER FLAT
The same cosy little flats, the same suspects, a new kind of puzzle.

FREE TO START
Puzzles 1 to 10 are free. All 120 puzzles are a weekly subscription that you can cancel at any time. No ads, no account, works offline.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://murder-flat.web.app/sudoku-privacy

name: PLUVA Remote
description:
PLUVA Remote connects your phone to a compatible Bluetooth-enabled PLUVA JT-HTP001 heating pad. The physical heating pad is required for device controls.

YOUR PAD, WITHIN REACH
Connect over Bluetooth to turn heating on or off, choose from six heat levels, set a supported timer, and adjust the pad's button lights while heating is on. The app shows the status reported by your connected pad.

CONTROL WITHOUT AN ACCOUNT
You do not need an app account or product registration to use the controls. Bluetooth control works locally while your phone and pad are within range; it does not require an internet connection. The app is not an internet remote control.

HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
Read the built-in guides offline, including pairing, timer operation, button lights, product care, and privacy. You can choose to open an email draft to contact PLUVA or visit the product-registration website in your browser. Sending a message or submitting a registration is optional.

GETTING STARTED
Power the pad according to its instruction manual, enable Bluetooth on your phone, and tap Pair Device in the app. Allow Bluetooth access when prompted and select JT-HTP001.

Connecting does not automatically start heating. Follow the heating pad's instruction manual and safety guidance whenever using the product.

Compatibility: a supported Bluetooth-enabled PLUVA JT-HTP001 heating pad. Other products are not currently supported.
Support: support@whatispluva.online
Privacy: https://www.whatispluva.com/pages/pluva-app-privacy-policy

name: PMR Access: accessible places
description:
Don't let an obstacle ruin your journey again.

PMR Access is the free, collaborative app for accessible travel. For wheelchair users, people with reduced mobility or visual impairment, older adults, parents with a stroller, and the caregivers who go with them.

ADAPTED ROUTES AND VOICE GUIDANCE
A route calculated for your profile (manual or power wheelchair, cane, stroller, visually impaired) that avoids reported obstacles. Turn-by-turn voice guidance with vibrations.

REPORT OBSTACLES IN ONE TAP
Broken sidewalk, construction, no curb cut? Report it on the map: the community is warned and your city can fix it.

ACCESSIBLE PARKING
Accessible parking spaces around you, and whether other users found them free or taken.

ACCESSIBLE PUBLIC TRANSPORT
Accessible stops and lines from more than 300 networks, broken station lifts and live network alerts.

ACCESSIBLE PLACES
Shops, restaurants, accessible restrooms, beaches: the accessibility of each place, from OpenStreetMap and Acceslibre, the French government database.

NATURAL-LANGUAGE SEARCH
"A step-free restaurant open now": type or say what you are looking for.

YOUR RIGHTS AND LOCAL ORGANIZATIONS
Mobility inclusion card, disability benefits, MDPH: the rights related to getting around, with official links. Plus disability organizations in your area.

GROUP OUTINGS
Suggest or join outings to accessible places.

OUR COMMITMENTS
Free. No ads. No account required. Your mobility profile stays on your phone. What you check on site can improve OpenStreetMap, the free map.

FOR CITIES
Reports feed a free dashboard for technical services: from report to completed works.

Join the community and let's build a city that is accessible to all.

A question or an idea? Write to us: pmraccessfr@gmail.com

name: Pocket Loops
description:
Tap a path to turn it. Join every piece into one unbroken loop. Watch your garden grow.

Pocket Loops is a calm, satisfying puzzle you can play in a minute or lose yourself in for an hour. Every solved loop adds growth to your miniature garden, and every five growth brings a new plant into bloom.

WHY YOU'LL KEEP COMING BACK
• Earn up to three stars on every loop: solve it without hints, within par, for a perfect score
• Build a streak: solve loops in a row for bonus suns
• Open a daily gift that grows for seven days in a row
• Play the shared daily loop and keep your daily streak alive, with streak freezes for busy days
• Unlock 12 hand-drawn plants and earn Rooted, Flourishing and Mastered badges for each
• Harvest the suns your garden grows while you are away
• Test yourself on timed Hard and Super Hard milestone loops for bigger rewards

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Puzzles adapt to how you play
• Undo is always free and your first hint on every loop is on us
• Spend suns on extra hints, extra moves, streak freezes and garden growth
• Works offline; progress is saved on your device
• Haptics, high-contrast paths, Dynamic Type and Reduce Motion support

Pocket Loops is free to play with ads. Optional rewarded videos can give you extra hints, extra moves, doubled harvests and gifts, and completion bonuses. Sun packs are available as optional in-app purchases.

GARDEN CLUB
An optional monthly or yearly subscription that removes all ads, gives unlimited hints, doubles your daily gift, adds a completion bonus without watching a video and unlocks the Moonlight garden.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

name: Pocket Trips MY
description:
Every ticket, hotel and place in one pocket.

Pocket Trips keeps your whole trip in one calm, simple place: flights, hotels, trains, car hire, places to see and what you spend. No more digging through emails and screenshots at the airport.

ADD BOOKINGS IN SECONDS
Take a screenshot of a booking or open the PDF e-ticket, tap Share, choose Pocket Trips. Flight numbers, times, hotel dates and booking references are read and filled in for you.

YOUR TRIP, DAY BY DAY
See each day of the trip in order, with check-in times, terminals and confirmation codes ready when you need them.

PLAN IT TOGETHER
Invite family and friends to a trip. Everyone sees the same plan, and on Pro they can add and edit with you.

TRACK WHAT YOU SPEND
Log expenses in any currency and see the total in ringgit, by category and by day.

KEEP THE MEMORIES
Add photos to each trip so the plan becomes the story.

POCKET TRIPS PRO
Free lets you plan one trip at a time with 3 smart uploads. Pro unlocks:
- Unlimited trips
- Unlimited smart uploads of bookings and receipts
- Friends and family can edit with you
- Expenses and budget tracking
- Trip photos
- Flight and check-out reminders
- Business Class themes

Pro yearly comes with a 7-day free trial. Or buy a Trip Pass to unlock Pro for one trip, for everyone on it.

name: Pocket VCR: Retro Video Player
description:
Your own videos become videotapes.

Pocket VCR lines up the videos on your iPhone as tapes on a shelf, and plays them on a TV with a built-in tape deck. Pick a tape, slide it into the deck, and the reels start turning as the picture comes up on the CRT.

■ Fold it: TV on top, deck below
Fold a foldable iPhone and set it on a desk. The top half becomes a CRT television and the bottom half becomes the deck. Open it flat for the tape shelf. Close it for a small TV in your hand. Playback keeps going when you change the shape.
It works as the same machine on a regular iPhone or iPad.

■ Load a tape, rewind it
• Tapes slide into a windowed cassette bay, where you can see the reels turn
• Play, Stop, Pause, Fast Forward, Rewind and Eject keys
• Hold the picture on screen while you search forward or back. Press the same key again to go faster
• Each tape remembers where you stopped and picks up from there

■ "Then" and "Now" picture
• Then: the look of videotape, with soft colors, scan lines, and the date and time at the bottom
• Now: your video as it was shot
• Turn the tracking knob to settle the picture
• Tap the TV screen to enlarge the picture

■ Albums and months on the shelf
Your Photos albums, and the months you shot in, show up as tapes. The spine shows the name; the face shows how many videos and how long. Three sample tapes are included.
Open a tape to see every clip in it at a glance, and start playing from any clip.

■ What the one-time purchase adds (In-App Purchase)
• Make your own tapes: choose videos, name the tape, put it on the shelf
• Dubbing: save up to 60 seconds from where you are, with the "Then" look and the date
• Change label colors
Watching the sample tapes and your album and month tapes is all available without a purchase.

■ Also
• No account needed. Videos play on your device and are never sent anywhere
• No ads

name: Podbook – Books & Audio
description:
Podbook is first and foremost an e-book reading client for your Calibre library, on iPhone and iPad. Browse the books on your server, download them or have them converted, and pick up where you left off. An EPUB or PDF imported from your device works too, with no server.

Translate on the fly to read more easily: show the translation beside the original text, in the language of your choice. Yours for a foreign book, or another one to practice. The pane follows you as you turn the page.

Switch to audio in the book's language or in your translation language, in the car too. Choose a voice for each language, adjust the speed and see which sentence is being spoken.

Highlight passages, add notes and bookmarks, and find your annotations again. Show or hide them, with confirmation before deletion.

With a language model configured, create summaries to revisit the main ideas of your reading.

Some translation features require downloaded models or a compatible service. Creating summaries requires a configured language model. You do not need a Podbook account to import a file.

Podbook is open source under the MIT license: its code is published at git.cythin.eu/Kourser/podbook.

The interface is available in 24 languages. The translation language and the summary language can be chosen freely among these 24, whatever the book's language.

name: PointCraft Tennis
description:
Every point starts with a decision. Read your opponent’s position, choose power and spin, and draw your shot on the court. Change direction or depth to create space, then pick your moment to attack.

Work through 100 Tennis Career challenges, play a Quick Match, or enter an eight-player singles tournament. Practice serving and returning in sets with first and second serves, deuce, and tie-breaks.

Replay rallies shot by shot and practice from the moment you want to change. Alternative controls let you aim and set power without drawing.

Play offline in English or Spanish.

name: PokéTracker: TCG Collection
description:
PokéTracker is an app to track your Pokémon Trading Card Game collection, free to download, with an optional subscription, PokéTracker Plus. Log every card you own, in every version, follow your progress set by set and know what your collection is worth.

YOUR COLLECTION SAFE IN ICLOUD
• Synced automatically to your iCloud, no account to create
• It comes back on its own after a reinstall or on a new iPhone
• Free, for everyone

EVERY SET, EVERY VERSION
• More than 20,000 cards, from the Base Set to the latest expansion, in English and French
• Normal, reverse holo, holo and special versions tracked separately
• Promos, trainer kits and other extras in their own tab
• Optional master set mode

YOUR PROGRESS
• Completion of each set, in the language you collect
• Missing cards at a glance, and what it would cost to finish the set
• Binder view, 3 × 3 like a real binder

PRICES AND VALUE
• Cardmarket and TCGplayer market prices for each version
• Total value of your collection and its day-by-day curve
• Your most valuable cards and the week's biggest price changes

ADD CARDS IN SECONDS
• Search by name or number (“25/165”, “SVI 025”)
• On-device scanner: point the camera at a card to find it from its number and name; batch mode for a whole stack (5 recognized cards free every 24 hours, unlimited with PokéTracker Plus)
• Choose condition, language, version and quantity

ALSO
• Wishlist, in the exact version you want, with its own search
• Every card by an illustrator, from any card's page
• Share a picture of a set's progress or the list of cards you still need
• JSON and CSV backups
• Works offline after the first download
• No account, no ads, no tracking: your collection stays on your iPhone and in your iCloud

POKÉTRACKER PLUS (OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION)
• Unlimited scanner
• Graded cards: company, grade, certificate and slab photo
• Goals: every card of a Pokémon or of a set
• Virtual binders (3 × 3, 3 × 4 or 4 × 4 pages), a showcase to share and widgets
• Price history of a card, purchase price, cards left out of your progress
The rest of the app is free: collection, sets, prices, value, stats, wishlist and backups. If your subscription ends, nothing you created is deleted.

Monthly or yearly auto-renewable subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; you can manage and cancel it in your App Store account settings.

name: Polar Bears vs. Warthogs
description:
The Arctic strikes back!

Captain Arctus and the Polar Bear Air Force are taking the skies back from the Warthog army in a fast, colorful arcade shooter, then going FULL KAIJU to smash the Warthog base.

BEAR SMASH
Climb the towers, punch out the windows, swat planes out of the sky and bring the whole Warthog base down.

SMASH TRAIL
120 more Warthog bases from the Ice Shelf to the Deep Jungle, each with its own machines and hazards. Your gear powers the smash: armor adds hearts, boots add speed, jetpacks JET SLAM.

HOG WILD
Switch sides and fly the Warthog ace against squadrons of diving polar bears.

500 LEVELS ACROSS 10 WILD WORLDS
Arctic Base, Glacial Fjords, Frozen Harbor, Badlands, Tiki Islands, Volcano Isles, Enchanted Forest, Sky Kingdoms, Hog City and Moon Base, each with its own Warthog army and a signature boss machine with an elemental weakness.

ELEMENTAL WEAPONS
Frost bows that freeze, blasters that burn, storm zappers that chain lightning, honey cannons that gum hogs up. Mix elements for SHATTER, CARAMELIZE and SUPERCONDUCT combos.

A NEW BUILD EVERY RUN
Pick upgrades, unlock world-only cards and synergies, and unleash each world's Zone Power. Recruit up to 5 bears for your flight squad, each with their own passive.

MORE TO PLAY
- Daily Bear Smash, Daily Challenge and Endless Survival.
- Achievements and leaderboards with Game Center.
- Story, Easy, Medium, Hard and Legendary difficulty.
- English, Spanish, French, German and Portuguese.

FAIR PLAY
- No loot boxes, no gacha. Gear, talents and fur skins are earned in play.
- Videos are optional: watch one for a bonus, or skip it. They never play unless you tap for one.
- Remove Ads, bought once, turns the videos off and gives the bonus without one.
- Optional one-time packs add heroes and looks, not power: two hero packs (heroes you can also earn by playing), two fur-skin sets, and a Complete Edition with all of them plus Remove Ads.
- Every purchase sits behind a grown-up check. No chat, no accounts, plays offline.

Made by Seventh Anvil Games.

name: PolarCam
description:
PolarCam turns your iPhone into a polarization camera.

Place a linear polarizer in front of the camera, take four photos with it turned to 0°, 45°, 90° and 135°, and PolarCam calculates the linear Stokes parameters for every pixel. It then shows you how light in the scene is polarized: reflections, glare, stress in transparent materials, and more.

WHAT YOU SEE
• AoLP+DoLP: the angle of polarization shown as colour, and the degree of polarization shown as brightness
• DoLP: the degree of linear polarization
• AoLP: the angle of linear polarization, shown faithfully
• Results for the combined RGB image or for the red, green and blue channels separately
• Tap any point to read its values; pinch to zoom in to the pixel level
• A colour scale is always shown beside the image

MADE FOR MEASUREMENT
• Captures in RAW (DNG) so the calculation uses the sensor's linear data
• Optional automatic alignment corrects small hand movement between the four photos
• When a scene can't be aligned as a whole, PolarCam can use only the areas that line up, and marks the rest
• Adjustable exposure and sampling scale

KEEP AND EXPORT YOUR DATA
• Every measurement is saved on your iPhone and can be reopened exactly as it was calculated
• Export images as PNG, and S0, S1, S2, DoLP and AoLP as 32-bit float TIFF files for analysis in other software
• Optionally keep the original DNG photos
• Select and delete measurements to manage storage

REQUIREMENTS
PolarCam needs a linear polarizing filter placed in front of the iPhone camera and turned by hand between photos. Hold the iPhone steady, or use a tripod, for the best results.

PolarCam was developed at the Department of Optics and Photonics, National Central University, Taiwan.

name: Polquette
description:
Polquette är en salong du kan hålla.

En illustrerad hand väntar på skärmen. Välj en nagelform: mandel, kvadrat, kista, oval, stiletto eller rund. Välj en färg från en lång palett. Välj ett finish: glans, matt, crem, krom, glit eller glitter. Lägg till en fransk spets, en gradient eller en liten dekoration: ett klistermärke, en blomma, en ädelsten, ett stycke folie, en pärla eller en tunn linje.

Tryck på en nagel för att måla endast den fingern, eller måla alla fem samtidigt. Återställ och återupptaga finns i studion. Åtta utvalda lookar ger hela handen i ett tryck: Blush Pearl, Burgundy Foil, Colorful Bloom, Nude Gold Line, Midnight Chrome, Sage Cream, Coral Glitter och Ivory French. Spara en manikyr i din bok. Den stannar kvar på denna iPhone eller iPad.

Det finns ett litet spel bredvid studion. Dagens stol efterfrågar en specifik manikyr. Boken med stolar är en kort karriär med tolv tidpunkter. Skicka in den hand du målat. Poängen går upp till tre stjärnor: tre när alla önskemål uppfylls, två när bara ett missas, en när något matchar och inga när ingenting gör det. En stjärna öppnar nästa stol. Din bästa poäng behålls.

Vad du kommer att hitta:

- Sex nagelformer och en rik färgpalett
- Glans, matt, crem, krom, glit och glitter  
- Franska tips, gradienter och dekorationer  
- Mål en nagel eller alla fem  
- Återställ och återupptag  
- Åtta ettklicks look, inklusive Blush Pearl, Burgundy Foil, Colorful Bloom och Nude Gold Line  
- En bok med sparade look på enheten  
- En daglig designstol och en salongkarriär med tolv stolar och stjärnprestationer  
- Haptik som du kan stänga av  
- Integritetspolicy och villkor, läsbara i appen  

Polquette har inget konto, inga annonser, ingen spårning och inga köp. Den ber inte om foton, plats eller kontakter. Catch a color använder kameran för att matcha en lack. Call a polish använder mikrofonen för en kort ljudsignal. Varken bilden eller ljudet sparas eller laddas upp.

Färg på skärmen är en bild av lack, inte lack själv. Polquette är ett spel, inte ett kosmetiskt produktservice och inte en salon tjänst.

name: Poof: Photo Cleaner
description:
Poof helps you clear out your photo library, one quick decision at a time.

FIND THE CLUTTER
Poof scans your library on your iPhone and groups what is usually safe to remove: exact duplicates, similar shots, bursts, blurry, dark and blank photos, screenshots, screen recordings, large videos and receipts. The home screen shows about how much space you could free and how many items are waiting for you.

SWIPE TO DECIDE
Review one card at a time. Swipe left to delete, right to keep, up to skip, with undo. Each card says why it was suggested.

COMPARE LOOKALIKES
Open a group of duplicates or similar shots, compare them full screen, and keep the best one. Videos play right in the app.

SORT YOUR LIBRARY
Photos are sorted into categories such as nature, food, places and documents, and also by year. You can save the categories as albums in Photos. Your photos are not moved or changed.

YOUR RULES
Set rules for what Poof should suggest, put them in order, pause them or add your own. Poof also learns from the choices you make.

SAFE BY DESIGN
- Nothing is deleted silently. Items go to a batch that you review first, and iOS asks for your confirmation before anything is deleted.
- Deleted items stay in Recently Deleted in Photos for 30 days.
- Favorites and edited photos are protected and never suggested for deletion.

PRIVATE
All analysis happens on your iPhone. Poof has no account, no servers, no ads and no analytics. Your photos are never uploaded.

A small celebration, with an optional sound, marks every cleanup, along with milestones for what you have freed.

Space estimates are approximate. Available in English and Hebrew.

name: Pootpad
description:
Pootpad is the app for dog walking services and their clients. Enter your walking service's 6-digit code, or find a walking service near you in the app, and from then on you can see exactly how your dog is doing.

FOR DOG OWNERS (ALWAYS FREE)
• Live status: picked up, out walking and back home, with a notification at every step
• A report after every walk: photos, the route on the map, how long and how far, pee and poo
• Two-week schedule: request fixed days, cancel a day or ask for an extra one
• Pass on your holidays in a few taps
• Chat with your walking service
• Strip cards and invoices in one place, pay by Tikkie or cash
• Find a walking service nearby and send a request
• Up to 3 dogs, with more than one walking service

FOR WALKING SERVICES
• Groups per day with a fixed pick-up order and walking area
• Start the round and keep owners updated automatically
• One report with photos for the whole group at once
• Requests, new dogs and introductions in one place
• A public profile, so owners nearby can find you
• Key overview: the label only shows a number, never an address
• Local news about leash rules and off-leash areas, to forward to your owners
• Dogs that should not walk together are flagged

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Pootpad works in Dutch, English and Turkish and follows your phone's language.

PRIVACY FIRST
Owners only see their own dog and walks, never the names or addresses of other clients. The route is only recorded during a walk, never at someone's home. No ads.

Made for walking services in the Netherlands, in Ede on the Veluwe, by Driezie Studio.

name: Portal Edu

name: Positional Chess
description:
Finding a move is the beginning. Understanding the plan changes the way you see the board.

Positional Chess, by Ajedrez de Silicio, combines practice and theory to train your chess judgment. It is designed for intermediate and advanced players, using a FIDE or online rating of 1500 or higher as a guide. One level, with 1,666 study decisions organized into 53 themes.

THINK, DECIDE AND UNDERSTAND
Study the position and play your move on the board. Then answer a specific question about your idea, read the explanation and follow the continuations move by move. The guided sequence takes you through the example and the indicated comparisons.

CONNECT THE IDEAS
Initiative, maneuvering, pawn breaks, prophylaxis, pawn structures, types of center and many other concepts. Learn to recognize what the position calls for, how to coordinate your pieces and when to convert an advantage.

LEARN FROM YOUR MISTAKES
Return to unfinished decisions from the theme index and review your mistakes. Check your training rating and keep your progress. This is an internal app rating, with no official equivalence to FIDE or online ratings; it does not promise a specific gain in playing strength. Repeating a position does not rate it again.

KEEP THE BOARD IN VIEW
Move pieces by dragging them or tapping the starting and destination squares. Follow variations with piece symbols and coordinates, flip the board and read explanations alongside the position. Designed for iPhone and iPad.

STUDY AT YOUR OWN PACE
• The entire catalogue works offline after installation.
• Spanish and English follow your device language.
• Up to five local profiles with independent progress.
• Back up your progress and restore it through Files. You can transfer it between iOS and Android; there is no automatic synchronization.
• No ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases.

Your purchase includes the training material in this version. It does not include academy membership or full class videos. Continuations run to the end of each verified example, which may be before the end of the game.

Support: gpacheco@ajedrezdesilicio.com

name: Postalita
description:
Postalita is a diary that looks like a stamp album.

Each day you write a little about it and pick a photo. Postalita turns it into a hand-drawn crayon stamp, and over time your year fills with tiny illustrated memories.

name: Potion Lab: Liquid Sort Puzzle
description:
Become an alchemist and sort colorful potions!
A brain-training puzzle where you arrange mixed liquids into tubes by color.
Simple rules, endless challenge. The perfect way to relax your mind!

Features

• 1,000 Levels — 5 difficulty tiers from Beginner to Grand Master
• Daily Challenge — New puzzle every day + streak tracking
• Season Events — Limited Spring/Summer/Winter challenges (5 levels each)
• 4 Seasonal Themes — Auto/Spring/Summer/Autumn/Winter
• 55 Achievements — Progress, Stars, Speed, Mastery and more
• Global / Friends / Weekly Leaderboards
• Level Editor — Create your own puzzles
• Colorblind Mode — Accessible to everyone

How to Play

1. Tap a tube to select it
2. Tap another tube to pour the same color
3. Clear when all tubes are filled with a single color!

Consecutive same-color blocks move together. Empty tubes accept any color.
Stuck? The hint system suggests the next move.

Highlights

• 5 languages: Korean, English, Japanese, Spanish, Traditional Chinese
• Offline play (only leaderboards need internet)
• Free to play

Game Modes

• Normal: 1,000 levels with progressive difficulty
• Daily Challenge: Same puzzle for all players + leaderboard

Relax and train your brain at the same time. Experience the magic of colors in Potion Lab!

name: Pour Bench
description:
Pour Bench is a notebook and calculator for candle makers who pour wax into round vessels. It turns a jar’s fill height and a wax density into grams, then keeps that pour on this iPhone.

Measure a round vessel and enter the inside diameter, the full height, and the fill height in centimeters. Fill volume is a cylinder: π × radius × radius × fill height. A square or oval tin uses a different shape, so those measurements will not match the glass.

Enter the wax density in grams per milliliter from the bag. Wax grams equal fill milliliters × density × the number of vessels. Fragrance grams equal wax grams × the percent you type ÷ 100. The percent is your choice. If the wax maker prints a maximum, that printed number is the one to follow.

A saved pour keeps the grams from the moment you save it. Later edits to a vessel or a density leave old pours unchanged. A wick note stores a name and the diameter you paired it with. It is a record of a previous pour, not a chart that chooses a wick.

Waxes, vessels, pours, and wick notes stay on this iPhone. There is no account and no sync. The first launch includes a tumbler, a votive, two waxes, one pour, and two wick notes, so the arithmetic is visible immediately.

name: Power Clash Arena
description:
POWER CLASH ARENA — Fast, explosive 1v1 superpower duels.

Choose your hero. Master your powers. Outplay computer-controlled rivals in intense best-of-3 battles. Dodge, guard, chain elemental attacks, and unleash your ultimate to turn the fight around.

THE SIGNATURE POWER CLASH

SIX HEROES, DISTINCT POWERS

• Vex — Psionic Controller

FAST COMBAT, REAL TIMING

• Use destructible cover and interactive arena hazards
• Tap to auto-aim or drag to aim manually with touch-friendly controls

FIVE DISTINCT ARENAS

Fight across Sky City, Energy Lab, Neon Harbor, Volcano Core, and Frozen Base.

WAYS TO PLAY

• Ranked Duels — climb from Bronze to Legend
• The Gauntlet — survive a 10-floor run
• Hyper Speed — weekly event
• Daily Challenge — take on fresh objectives

GROW STRONGER. MAKE IT YOURS.

Level up heroes, upgrade powers, and collect gear. Unlock skins, finishes, auras, and stances. Complete daily missions, pursue career goals, and progress through the Season Pass.

PLAY YOUR WAY

• Single-player — all opponents are computer-controlled

• No ads
• Optional in-app purchases

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Practice Rewind
description:
See and hear what you just practiced, without losing your flow.

Record a passage, then listen back on a loop. Practice Rewind suggests a start and end, lets you scrub or adjust the selection, and gets you back to recording quickly.

• Record with the front or rear camera and pinch to zoom.
• Replay at your own pace, with adjustable speed and optional pitch correction.
• Zoom and pan the replay video to inspect details.
• Bookmark useful takes, add optional labels, and save named, dated compilations for later.
• Play through a compilation automatically, with navigation and scrubbing always available.
• Choose smaller video files while keeping the audio capture setup unchanged.
• Use optional on-device English voice commands or compatible AirPods controls, or use the buttons.

Free, with no ads and no account required. Recordings and analysis stay on your device; saved recordings may be included in backups managed by iOS.

Keep Practice Rewind open while recording and listening. AirPods controls depend on compatible hardware and iOS settings. Suggested passage boundaries can be adjusted manually.

name: Praha jede!
description:
Other apps find you a connection. Praha jede! gets you there.
It's transit navigation for Prague: it finds your route using live delays, then rides with you. See live where you are and how far is left. The app watches your transfer and your stop, tells you which car to board and alerts you in time.

Free. No account, no ads, no tracking. In 8 languages: Čeština, English, Deutsch, Polski, Українська, Español, Italiano, Français.

NAVIGATION FROM DEPARTURE TO ARRIVAL
• Enter a destination and the app finds a door-to-door route with transfers, walking and live delays.
• Live trip progress: where you are, how many stops are left and where you change. On the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island too.
• It watches your transfer and your stop and alerts you, even with the screen locked. Your phone can stay in your pocket.

name: Prayer Time: Saudi Arabia
description:
Prayer times for cities across Saudi Arabia, calculated on your phone with the Umm al-Qura method used in the Kingdom.

Pick your city from the list or let the app choose the nearest one to you. You get today's six times — Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib and Isha — and the next prayer with a countdown.

What's inside:
• A reminder when each prayer time begins; turn it off for any prayer.
• A reminder five minutes before iqamah, using the intervals set by the Ministry of Islamic Affairs: Fajr 25 minutes, Dhuhr, Asr and Isha 20, Maghrib 10.
• The whole month in one table, with the Hijri date for every day.
• Qibla direction by compass and the distance to the Kaaba.
• Hanafi Asr as an extra line if you follow it.
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets: the next prayer and today's times.
• Dark mode, large text, Arabic and English.

Method: Fajr at 18.5° below the horizon, Asr when a shadow equals its object, Maghrib at sunset, Isha 90 minutes after Maghrib (120 in Ramadan). We checked the times against the official Umm al-Qura table: they differ by no more than a minute.

Times are calculated on your phone, so the app works offline. Your location stays on your device and is never sent anywhere.

This is not an official app. If a time here differs from your mosque's adhan, follow the mosque.

name: Prefixus: Russian Prefixes
description:
Created by Viktoria Belova, a teacher of Russian as a foreign language, Prefixus helps A2 learners understand how prefixes change the meaning of Russian verbs and practise using them in context.

Explore 21 prefixes with animated diagrams, Russian examples and English translations. See how prefixes describe entering, leaving, arriving, approaching and more.

Practise with 168 questions across 21 dedicated sets. Read an explanation after each answer, compare similar prefixes, try mixed quizzes and review your mistakes. Bookmark useful cards and track your progress on your device.

For English-speaking learners who can already read Cyrillic. Lessons and exercises work offline. Free to use with no account, subscriptions or in-app purchases.

name: Prismatch – Light & Color
description:
Match every fixture. In console values. Prismatch compares fixtures, lamps and LED walls with a reference lamp using the iPhone camera and shows what to adjust on your lighting desk.

All values are guide values: they show direction and order of magnitude, and you nudge live until it turns green. Prismatch is not a measuring instrument and does not replace a calibrated colorimeter or your eye on site.

DESK MATCHING
• Measure a reference lamp, then measure more lamps
• Correction per lamp in console values: HSB/HSI ("Hue +4°, Sat −6 %"), CIE xy, and for white light kelvin and tint
• Values to suit common lighting desks
• Live mode: the needle moves toward 0, and "Match" tells you the lamp is close enough
• PDF report for handover and documentation

LED WALL CHECK
Point the camera at the wall: Prismatch compares areas and shows where color or white is off.
Correction assistant – white point correction in the LED processor's own unit (kelvin or x/y) with RGB gain, correction per cabinet, live mode, PDF report. Approximate values, no calibration.

LEE AND ROSCO FILTERS
The nearest filters from the makers' published tables, with number, name and distance Δu′v′. If no filter is close, it says so.

LIGHT VALUES
Live reading with kelvin and Duv (green/magenta), CIE xy, XYZ and u′v′, an RGBW starting value for LED fixtures, RAW capture and averaging over several frames.

ALSO FOR PAINTERS, CAR PAINT AND DESIGN
• "Surface" mode for walls, paint, fabric and print, optionally with a white reference
• Color name, HEX, RGB, HSB, HSL, CMYK, Lab, LCh, OKLCH, Display P3
• Type in values and convert them, pick a color from a logo or photo
• A/B matching with ΔE2000 and a traffic light by tolerance
• File readings by project, share as PDF or CSV

FREE AND PRO
Free: live measuring with color name; show and enter HEX, RGB, HSB, HSL and kelvin; color from an image or logo; up to 10 saved colors.
Pro (one-time in-app purchase CHF 9.90, no subscription): desk matching, LED wall check, LEE and Rosco filters, RAW capture, all other scales, A/B matching, white reference, unlimited saving, projects, PDF and CSV export.

ABOUT ACCURACY – PLEASE READ
Prismatch works with the iPhone camera. All values are approximate guide values, not a substitute for a calibrated measuring instrument. Results depend on light, surface, distance, camera and device and can differ noticeably from the true color. Always check a real physical sample before painting, ordering or printing.

PRIVACY
Prismatch collects no data. The camera image is analyzed on the device only; nothing is uploaded. No account, no ads, no tracking.

Filter names and numbers are the property of their respective makers. Prismatch is not affiliated with them.

Designed and developed in Switzerland.

name: Prison Places
description:
How full are the prisons in England and Wales? Prison Places shows you, using the official figures the Ministry of Justice publishes every week.

FREE PLACES FOR MEN
See how many prison places are free for adult men right now, how that changed since last week and since a year ago, and what share of usable places is already full.

TRENDS
Week-by-week charts since January 2025: free places, men in prison against usable places, how full men's prisons are, places for women and young offenders, and the number of people released early on home detention curfew. Drag across any chart to read each week.

FORECASTS
Compare the Ministry of Justice prison population projections (low, central and high) with today's capacity, see whether the prison population is tracking above or below the official projection, and see when prisons would be full if the recent trend carries on.

RECALLS AND REMAND
How many men are recalled to prison from licence each quarter, how many recalled men are in prison now, and what share of prisoners are recalled or on remand.

EVERY PRISON
Every prison in England and Wales from the monthly bulletin, sorted by how full it is, with its operational capacity, free places and crowding. Search by name and switch between men's, women's and young offender establishments.

UP TO DATE AND PRIVATE
Figures are downloaded straight from GOV.UK when you open the app, and kept on your iPhone so you can look at them offline. No account, no tracking, no ads.

Prison Places is an independent app by GC Development. It is not made by or affiliated with the Ministry of Justice or HM Prison and Probation Service. Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

description:
愛犬と一緒に入れるカフェを、地図でさっと探せるアプリです。

行ってみたら犬は入れなかった、という残念な思いをしないために。Puppy With Cafe は、犬の同伴可否を「出典」と「確認日」つきで掲載し、確認できていないことは推測せずに「未確認」と表示します。

【できること】
・地図の上の検索バーで、店名・駅名・エリアから探す（現在地の周りも選べます）
・「いつ行く？」で日時（今日から1週間以内）を選ぶと、その時間に開いているお店だけを表示
・「うちの子」の大きさ（小型・中型・大型）と店内での過ごし方を設定すると、入れると明記されたお店に「うちの子OK」を表示（設定は端末内のみ）
・お店の詳細では「店内で一緒に過ごせます」「テラス席で一緒に過ごせます」などの答えを最初に表示し、その根拠（出典の種類と確認月）も一目で分かります
・「店内OK」「テラス」「大型犬OK」「犬メニュー」でも絞り込み
・気になるお店は「行きたい」、行ったお店は「行った」に保存（端末内のみ）
・電話、公式サイト、Instagram、食べログへのリンク。Apple マップ／Google マップへの経路案内、共有

【情報の考え方】
・犬の同伴可否は、公式サイト・公式SNS・食べログ・犬連れ向けの紹介記事などの出典を運営が確認し、確認日と一緒に表示します（出典の種類は店ごとに異なります）。
・確認できない項目は「未確認」「情報なし」とし、推測で「OK」にはしません。うちの子が入れるかも、お店の情報に明記があるときだけ「OK」と表示します。
・掲載情報は目安です。同伴条件や営業時間は変わることがあるため、来店前に店舗へご確認ください。

【プライバシー】
・ログイン・アカウント登録は不要。広告・解析・トラッキングはありません。
・現在地は「使用中のみ」の許可で、周辺のお店と距離の表示にだけ使い、端末内で処理します。送信も保存もしません。許可しなくても、駅名やエリアを指定して使えます。

【対象エリア】
現在は東京都内のカフェを掲載しています。順次広げていきます。

【ご注意】
地図上の座標の一部は、デジタル庁「アドレス・ベース・レジストリ」を運営が加工して作成しています。

name: PushPlay Launcher
description:
PushPlay is a free home for games people made. Browse Discover for new games from independent makers, install the ones you like, and play them right on your phone or tablet.

• Discover: a reviewed list of games, with Featured picks to start with.
• Library: everything you've installed, ready to play, with updates arriving on their own.
• Join a party: when a party game is running on a TV, scan its code or type the four-letter room code and your phone becomes the controller.
• Controller support: pair a Bluetooth controller and play with buttons, not just touch.
• Online play: some games let you play with others online.

No account needed to play. Sign in with just your email if you want to rate games or get a maker's betas. You can report any game, or hide a publisher you don't want to see.

Making games? Push your code to GitHub and PushPlay builds and publishes it for you. Learn more at pushplay.gg.

name: Q Business Center
description:
Q Business Center is the app for the people who work at Q Business Center in Sin El Fil, Beirut: the companies in its offices and their teams.

With the app you can:
- Report a problem in your office or in the building and follow it until it is fixed.
- Announce a visitor before they arrive, so reception and security expect them.
- Read notices from the management and see what is planned in the building.
- See the building at a glance: what is on each floor, the lifts, visitor parking and valet, and who to call.
- Find your documents in one place.

You need an account created by Q Business Center's management to sign in. Your information stays inside Q Business Center: the app shows only this building.

name: QISY
description:
QISY är QI Construction AB:s (QICON) arbetsverktyg för byggprojekt. Appen är till för företagets medarbetare, underentreprenörer och kunder. Du behöver ett konto från QI Construction AB för att logga in. Det går inte att skapa ett konto i appen.

FÖR DIG SOM ARBETAR I PROJEKTEN
• Checka in och ut på projektet. Appen kontrollerar att du är på arbetsplatsen.
• Ta rast och fortsätt arbetet med ett tryck.
• Se dagens uppgifter, ditt schema och din historik.
• Öppna projektets ritningar, dokument och instruktioner.
• Ta foton av arbetet med kameran och lägg dem på projektet.
• Läs streckkoder när du hämtar verktyg och material.
• Anmäl frånvaro och se dina frånvarorapporter.
• Följ Mina uppgifter och få notiser om nya uppgifter och ändringar.
• Läs och signera avtal direkt i telefonen.
• Läs företagets nyheter, guider och dokument.

FÖR DIG SOM ÄR KUND
• Följ dina projekt.
• Se dina offerter och begär en ny.

PLATS
Appen använder telefonens plats när du checkar in och ut, och under arbetspasset medan du är incheckad, även när appen ligger i bakgrunden. Platsen används för tidrapporteringen: den visar om du är på arbetsplatsen, på resa mellan projekt eller hämtar material. När du har checkat ut eller har rast läser appen inte din plats.

Appen är gratis och innehåller ingen reklam och inga köp.

Har du frågor om ditt konto? Kontakta QI Construction AB.

name: QR Pronto
description:
QR Pronto brings a scanner, a generator and a QR code library together in one app. The essentials run on your device, with no account required and no ads.

SCAN SAFELY
• Camera or photo library, QR codes and barcodes
• See the content before any action, with alerts for suspicious links
• Multi-scan without duplicates and CSV export

CREATE THE RIGHT CODE
• Link, Wi-Fi, contact, WhatsApp, Pix, email, SMS, event, location, social networks and more
• Templates, colors, logo, frame and a readability check
• PNG up to 4096 px, SVG and A4 PDF; batch generation of up to 500 codes

EVERYTHING ORGANIZED
• Library with search, folders, tags, favorites and private items
• History of scanned and created codes
• Face ID or PIN lock and password-protected backups

DYNAMIC QR CODES (OPTIONAL)
With a QR Pronto account, create QR codes whose destination can be changed after printing and track scans. The same account works on qrpronto.com.

Subscriptions: Starter, Pro and Unlimited, monthly or yearly, auto-renewing through the App Store. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase and renews at the same price unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in Settings › your name › Subscriptions.

Terms of use: https://qrpronto.com/termos-app.html
Privacy: https://qrpronto.com/privacidade-app.html

name: QRDrop Offline
description:
QRDrop Offline lets you transfer files by displaying and scanning a sequence of QR codes. Once the sender is open, the transfer itself needs no Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, or mobile data.

On the sending device, choose a file in QRDrop to turn it into QR codes. You can also open qrdrop.dev on a computer and use the web sender. On your iPhone or iPad, open Receive and scan the first code, then scan the remaining codes in any order. Save the reconstructed file to a location you choose.

• Send files up to 16 MiB.
• Scan QR codes live or from a video you select or record.
• Adjust playback speed or step through each code manually.
• Try a transfer with the built-in sample file.

File contents are processed on your devices. Transfers require no QRDrop account or cloud upload.

name: Quarter: Block Puzzle Loops
description:
Quarter is a calm, clever puzzle about connecting paths. Drag curved corners, straights, crossings and linked pieces onto a 5×5 board. When the ends meet in a closed loop, it pops.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Connect the ends. Any colors can join, and linked pieces land together.
• Close any loop. Circles, squares and long winding shapes all count.
• Two loops in one drop score double, and big loops earn a size bonus.
• A dead-end piece breaks its corner off the board. Close loops to fill COMEBACK, the side bar. A full bar brings the whole board back and rolls it into a new finish. Each fill needs more points.
• The run ends when nothing in the tray fits. If a Rotate, Bomb or Re-deal you've earned would save it, the game tells you.

SIXTEEN FINISHES
The board changes its whole look as you play: Screenprint, Plush fur that sways when you move your phone, Chrome that reflects, '90s Print, Pipeworks, Sea Glass, Safari, Neon, Bubbles, Blueprint, Gummy, Lava, Quilt, Holo, Arcade and Patina. Every finish is drawn live, and its clear animation is its own.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Classic runs that ease you in while you learn.
• A Daily puzzle that's the same for everyone.
• Optional goals for big loops, double loops and combos.
• Works offline. No account, no timers, no energy.

Made by Haplo, a tiny indie studio.

name: QueueSim Games
description:
QueueSim Games is a free set of queueing games, built on the QueueSim discrete event simulation engine. The first game is Staff the Day.

Staff the Day
A coffee shop is open 6am to 6pm, busiest in the morning: 70 customers an hour at opening, 100 an hour from 8 to noon, 50 an hour after noon. Each order takes 3 minutes on average, some quicker, some longer. When customers come in faster than the baristas can make drinks, a line builds and everyone in it waits.

You have 8 shifts. Each shift is 6 hours and starts on the hour, from 6am to noon, so it ends by closing. That's 48 staff-hours. Place them so customers wait less. Lowest average wait wins.

Four shifts 6am-12pm and four 12pm-6pm puts 4 on every hour. The QueueSim engine ran 30 days of it: customers waited 20.98 minutes on average, and 46.1% were served within 10 minutes. QueueSim's best schedule gets the average wait down to 3.86 minutes. QueueSim shows its best score, never its schedule. Can you get close?

How you play
Drag a shift from the tray onto the day, or tap a shift, then an hour, to start it there. The day shows customers an hour and how many staff are on each hour as you go. If an open hour has nobody on, the game shows it in red; you can still run it and see what it does to the line.

Then run the day. There are 3,003 ways to place the 8 shifts, and the QueueSim engine ran every one for 30 days ahead of time, so your score comes back at once. The result shows your average wait next to 4 on all day and QueueSim's best, the share served within 10 minutes, the best and worst day, and your day hour by hour: the average wait, how long the line was and who was on.

How it works
Five short screens walk through the coffee shop's day, why every order takes time, the shifts you have, and what 4 on all day does to the wait, before you play.

The board
Sign in with Apple to put your name on the board. The board is all time: one row per player, their best play. It shows your first name, last initial and company. Playing needs no account. You can delete your account from Account at any time.

More games coming
One Line or Four, The Cliff and Hold or Hang Up are on the way and show as Coming in the app.

Build this for your operation
The same game can be built on your own day: your customers by hour, your service times, your shift lengths and rules. QueueSim runs every schedule you could place, and your team plays your day. Tap "Build this for my operation" to ask the QueueSim team.

QueueSim Games is free, with no ads and no in-app purchases. It needs an internet connection: every score comes from the QueueSim server. The web version is at queuesim.com/staff-the-day.

name: Quiet Diary: Voice Journal
seller_name: Shenzhen Zhilianchuang Network Technology Co., Ltd.
description:
A voice journal and private diary with lock. Just talk, and your diary keeps it for you. No typing, no ads, no account.

Quiet Diary is a calm place for your days: a few words, a photo, a voice note, how you felt. Everything stays on your iPhone, behind your own passcode and Face ID.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Talk instead of typing: hold the button, speak, let go. Your voice is saved encrypted on this iPhone.
