• Turn a recording into text when you want to. It keeps your own words and never writes for you.
• Lock it: 4-digit passcode or pattern, with Face ID or Touch ID. Nothing shows in the app switcher.
• Widgets: start a voice note from your Home Screen, Lock Screen or Control Center, and see "On this day" at a glance.
• Handwriting fonts and paper: lined, grid or dotted, so every page feels like yours.
• Cute mood stickers: 12 moods, and a calendar that shows how your whole month felt.
• A little season on every page: the 72 micro-seasons or a daily line, with seasonal watercolors.
• Make it yours: three themes, home styles, fonts and cute sticker sets, all with a live preview of your home screen.
• On this day: see what you wrote one, two, ten years ago, like a 10-year diary.
• Photos, tags and search: up to 9 photos per entry, a photo wall, and tags to find anything fast.
• Recently deleted: entries stay for 30 days before they are gone.
• Back up to your own iCloud Drive, or export everything as a ZIP. Coming from Android? Import your Quiet Diary export.

OUR PROMISE
• No ads. Ever.
• No sign-up needed.
• Your old entries are never locked behind a paywall.
• Pro is a one-time purchase. No subscription.

PRIVACY
• Your diary lives on your iPhone. Photos and recordings are encrypted.
• iCloud backup is off until you turn it on, and it goes to your own iCloud Drive, not to us.
• Nothing is uploaded unless you tap "Transcribe" or "Tidy". Only that one recording or text is sent; our server does not keep it, and it is never used for training.
• No tracking. No ad or third-party analytics SDKs.

FREE AND PRO
• Free: writing, photos, lock, widgets, tags, search, mood calendar, backup and the emoji moods. Talk 3 times a day (up to 1 minute each).
• Pro (one-time purchase): unlimited voice notes up to 5 minutes each, 60 minutes of transcription and 100 tidy-ups a month, all sticker sets, cute handwriting fonts and home styles.

FAQ
• Can someone hear my recordings? No. They are encrypted on your iPhone, and only you can open the app.
• Will it change what I said? No. "Transcribe" keeps your words. "Tidy" only removes fillers and fixes punctuation, and you can always switch back to the original.

Quiet Diary, a quiet place for your days.

Privacy Policy: https://quietdiary.app/privacy

name: Quillcall
description:
Quillcall is the audio call app for people who teach, tutor or coach by the hour or by the minute.

Start a call in one tap and share a link or a 6-digit code. Your student joins from the Quillcall app or any web browser, no install and no account needed. Type notes on the same screen during the call, no switching apps. When it ends, Quillcall knows exactly how long the session was.

BUILT FOR SESSIONS
• One tap to start. Students join with a link or a code, as a guest if they like.
• Exact call time: you both see the same start, end and total, so there is nothing to argue about.
• Notes on the same screen as the call (with Notion connected).
• Works with Bluetooth headsets, car kits and speakers, and keeps going with the screen off or while you use another app.
• Mute, audio route and call time controls in the call.

NOTION SESSION LOG (OPTIONAL)
• Connect your own Notion and each finished call is added as a row: date, start, end and total time.
• Calls on the same day are merged into one row, and your notes are saved in that row.
• Use your own database or let Quillcall create one. Disconnect any time.

SAFE FOR YOU AND YOUR STUDENTS
• Report or block anyone on a call; blocked people can never join your calls.
• Audio goes directly between the phones whenever possible (otherwise through an encrypted relay) and is never recorded.
• No ads, no tracking, no analytics.
• Sign in once with Google or Apple. Delete your account and your server data at any time, right in the app.

Starting a call requires a Google or Apple account; joining as a guest does not. A microphone is required. Notion is a trademark of Notion Labs, Inc. Google is a trademark of Google LLC. Quillcall is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Notion or Google.

name: Quizkrutt
description:
Gi hjernen din litt konfetti!

Quizkrutt er en norsk quizapp for små pauser og store aha-opplevelser. Velg et tema, prøv tre nivåer og les korte forklaringer etter hvert svar. Ingen klokke jager deg.

• 540 spørsmål i grunnspillet, fordelt på seks kategorier.
• Tre nivåer: sju riktige av ti åpner neste nivå i samme kategori.
• Quizbibliotek med åtte pakker og 140 ekstra spørsmål, blant annet Historie og Mat og drikke.
• Last ned nye pakker uten konto, og spill dem senere uten nett.
• Sofaduell: to spillere bytter på samme iPhone eller iPad.
• Nettduell: spill fem felles spørsmål på hver deres enhet med kallenavn og romkode. Fasit vises når begge har svart.
• Pause og fortsett senere. Fremdriften lagres på enheten.
• Nullstill solo- eller pakkefremdrift, og behold nedlastede pakker og innstillinger.

Solo, lagrede quizpakker og sofaduell fungerer uten nett. Nettduell og nye nedlastinger krever internett. Ingen ChatGPT-konto eller passord kreves. Ingen annonser, abonnement eller kjøp i appen.

Grunnspillet har temaene Litt av alt, Verden rundt, Dyr og natur, Film og musikk, Sport og spill samt Vitenskap og teknologi. Fremdrift lagres separat på hver enhet og synkroniseres ikke.

Spørsmålene er egenformulert med KI-støtte og redaksjonell gjennomgang. Oppdager du en feil, kan du melde fra via supportsiden.

name: R&P Wave
description:
R&P Wave is an internal app of R&P Electronics for staff authorised by the company.

There is no public sign-up; sign in with a company-issued account.

Contact: admin@rpc.vn

name: Raceflow Mech
description:
Raceflow Mech — приложение для персонала картодромов, которые работают на Raceflow. Механик ведёт парк картов по штрихкоду, хронометрист управляет заездом у трассы, маршал следит за ним с телефона.

Для входа нужен аккаунт сотрудника — его выдаёт картодром. Регистрации в приложении нет.

БОКС
• Наведите камеру на штрихкод на раме — откроется карточка карта. Наклейка не читается — код можно набрать вручную, в темноте поможет фонарик.
• Весь парк на одном экране: у каких картов вышел срок расходников, где есть замечания, какие стоят в ремонте.
• Карточка карта: схема с деталями, расходники и их ресурс, лучший и средний круг, замечания.
• Замену отмечают нажатием на деталь на схеме — сразу несколько расходников, с моточасами и заметкой. Запчасти можно тут же списать со склада.
• Замечание оставляют обычным или сразу снимают карт с линии — он уходит в ремонт.

ЗАЕЗД
• Идущий заезд в реальном времени: обратный отсчёт, места, круги и отставание от лидера.
• Старт и финиш с телефона.
• Штрафы и компенсации: причина из списка или своя, нужный круг; выписанное можно снять.
• Замена карта на ходу: отсканируйте новый карт — круги продолжат идти пилоту, а сломанный уйдёт механику в ремонт.
• Командные гонки: пит-стоп со сменой пилота и карта по скану наклеек.
• Менеджер может добавить заезду время, если гонку останавливали.

Что доступно сотруднику, решает картодром: механик работает в боксе, хронометрист ведёт заезд, маршал его смотрит. Бокс доступен, если у картодрома подключён модуль «Бокс: механик».

При первом запуске укажите адрес станции картодрома — его подскажет администратор. Телефон работает через Wi-Fi площадки, а если у картодрома включён удалённый доступ — из любой сети.

name: Radio Companion
description:
Your radio stays exactly as it is. Every session gets better.

Radio Companion sits beside your shortwave radio while you listen. It's made for portables and vintage sets with no cable or Bluetooth. You tune by hand, as always, and the phone shows you what's out there, helps you log what you hear and keeps it for you.

WHAT'S ON NOW, FROM WHERE YOU ARE
See the stations on the air right now, grouped by band with the most open band first, and how well each should reach you. A status card shows the sky where you are, each band's chances this hour and what's starting soon. The broadcast schedules are inside the app, so it works with no connection.

TUNE BY HAND
Type the frequency your radio is on and see who's likely there: the station on the air with its reception estimate, others on the same frequency, what's nearby and what comes on later today. Use the arrows to step through the scheduled frequencies.

CATCH WITH ONE TAP
Heard something? Catch saves the moment, the frequency and who was scheduled there. If you want, it also records a short clip through the phone's microphone. Not sure who it was? Leave it to identify later, or search the whole schedule around that time and frequency.

CONDITIONS YOU CAN READ
See each band's chances hour by hour, estimated for your location and refined with live space-weather data from NOAA: the ionosphere, solar flares and the aurora. When something is happening on the Sun, the app tells you in plain words what it means for listening. A map shows where a band's signals come from, and the path a station's signal takes to reach you, hop by hop.

A LOG THAT'S YOURS
Give each catch a SIO signal report, your receiver and antenna, and a note. Send stations reception reports with your clip, and keep track of the QSL cards that come back. Get a recap of each session, see your firsts, and fill a passport with the countries you've heard. Search and filter the log, correct a catch or add one by hand, and export it as CSV or ADIF.

CALM AND ACCESSIBLE
Designed dark first for a dim room, with a light theme and high contrast. Large text follows your phone's text size, touch targets are big, VoiceOver works throughout and the app is easy to use with one hand. No sounds: a gentle haptic only confirms a catch.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
No account, no ads, no tracking. The app collects nothing about you. It never connects to your radio and never transmits: it only receives. Its only network requests fetch NOAA's space-weather data, which you can turn off in Settings, and the app works fully without it.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
English, Spanish and Portuguese. A short guided tour shows you around the first time you open it.

App updates bring new schedules at each season change, in late March and late October.

Station schedules: EiBi and the Aoki list (NDXC). Space weather: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center. Radio Companion is not affiliated with them.

name: RadiographicWeld
description:
An RT inspection story begins with a planned job and ends with a documented observation.
RadiographicWeld keeps industrial radiography records organized without interpreting images.
PLANNED JOB CONTEXT
Create an RT Job to identify work planned for inspection.
Keep the planned context connected to the records that follow.
Distinguish the job definition from exposure details captured afterward.
EXPOSURE & IMAGE REFERENCES
Add an RT Record when an exposure has been documented.
Connect the exposure entry to its originating job.
Keep image identifiers with the record for later reference.
Document indications as observations supplied by the user.
REVIEW WITHOUT AUTOMATED JUDGMENT
Enter the inspection result manually.
Read the result alongside its exposure and indication references.
Keep recorded evidence distinct from formal acceptance.
ON-DEVICE ORGANIZATION
Keep inspection records in a local Core Data database.
Maintain app preferences on the device.
Set optional reminders for follow-up inspection tasks.
Reminder alerts use Apple’s local notification service.
Share information only when you initiate the action.
SAFETY HAS A SEPARATE AUTHORITY
No dose, source-strength or shielding calculations are provided.
No exposure-distance or exclusion-zone calculations are included.
The app does not determine compliance or accept radiographs automatically.
Follow licensed procedures and qualified interpretation requirements.
RadiographicWeld supports inspection documentation, not radiation planning.

name: RaiseSteady Sound Box
description:
Sound Box is a calm music, beat, loop, and groove studio, from first taps to full grooves. It is built for families at home by RaiseSteady Games from raisesteady.com by Nexodyne Limited. Touch a pad or tap a beat and every note harmonizes cleanly: no menus to read, no ads, and nothing to buy.

WHAT IS INSIDE
• Eight color-coded multi-touch musician pads (cat, frog, bear, bird, star, whale, fox, and owl) that play notes and toggle bouncing loops
• Five melodic instruments: acoustic marimba, celesta music box, warm electric piano, plucked harp, and studio bass
• Eight-piece drum and percussion kit: soft kick, snare, woodblock rim, closed hat, open hat, shaker, handclap, and chime
• Five musical scales (C major pentatonic, D dorian, A minor pentatonic, F lydian, and G mixolydian) so notes and chords harmonize warmly
• Four studio views, open in every age band: Band Pads, an eight-step Loop Grid, a sixteen-step Beat and Chord Studio, and the Groove Workstation
• Four-section pattern chains and a live filter and echo pad in the Groove Workstation
• Eight starter groove presets, from Sunny Walk and Starlight Lullaby to Cozy Campfire and Ocean Waves
• Thirty-step undo and a song shelf that keeps up to 100 songs organized on the device
• Gentle background grooves and studio sounds, each with its own switch

MADE FOR GROWING MUSICIANS
Big icon buttons and clear visual cues on the studio screen. A single tap on the new-song button does nothing. Hold it for 1.5 seconds: the active song goes to the shelf first, then a fresh sheet opens, so a favorite beat is never lost by accident. The active song is still there when the app opens again.

FOR GROWN-UPS AND FAMILIES
On first launch, a grown-up picks one of four age bands (2–4, 4–7, 8–11, 12–15). Each band sets the welcoming studio view, tempo, harmonic scale, and starter groove while every instrument and groove tool is open from the start. The Grown-ups area opens after a three-second hold and a short word sum. Behind the gate you can switch age bands, turn sounds and background grooves on or off, and manage the song shelf. You can also save or share a song as stereo .wav audio or a visual .png song card. Credits, licenses, and "More from RaiseSteady" links to raisesteady.com in Safari sit inside the same gate.

NOTHING LEAVES THIS DEVICE
No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts, no cookies, no analytics, and no tracking. Links to raisesteady.com sit only inside the Grown-ups area behind the parental gate and open in your browser without sending app data. Every sound, instrument, font, and saved song stays on your device and works offline in airplane mode.

Every instrument and groove tool is included for free from the start.

Sound Box is made by RaiseSteady Games from raisesteady.com by Nexodyne Limited.

name: Rando Piano
description:
Rando Piano is a toy piano that writes loops for you.

ROLL
• Roll the dice for a two-bar arpeggiated loop in any of 12 keys and 7 scales
• Four chord blocks: tap one for another chord, long-press to pin it
• White pegs in the blocks show every note; blocks split to show bar 2's own chords

SHAPE
• Nine pattern buttons: up, down, up-down, skip, gallop, hop, scale up, scale down, chord
• Four faders: bar 2's own chords, chord colour from triads to jazz, tempo and space
• Every move changes the loop while it plays, pinned chords stay put: mix chords and arpeggios
• Pop or lofi chord progressions, 11 sounds from grand piano to chip

SHARE
• Export the loop as a seamless 32-bit WAV, ready for your DAW or sampler

No account, no ads, no tracking.

Piano samples: FluidR3_GM via gleitz/midi-js-soundfonts, CC-BY 3.0.

name: Random Myth Idle
description:
An egg cracks and one hero is yours: Zeus, Thor, Athena or Hades. You do not get to choose.
Your hero cannot be swapped. Raise that one hero all the way.

[The more it grows, the more it changes]
- 11 forms per hero. Over five stages the body grows and the whole look changes
- From Stage 3 there are three branches (Order, Might, Chaos). The gear you equip decides the branch, and changing gear changes it back
- Branches are never sold. Every form is unlocked by playing

[A run]
- Monsters close in from every side on a round arena. 30 waves, a boss every 10
- Your hero fights on its own. Spend run gold on one of three upgrades and press the Divine Move when it is charged

[Between runs]
- Spend faith on attack, health and gold income
- Four gear slots. Merge three of a kind to raise the grade
- Faith keeps gathering while the app is closed (up to 8 hours)
- Shadow Tower, 100 floors: automatic duels against shadows of other gods

[Hero slots]
- When any hero reaches Stage 4, a second hero slot opens so you can raise another hero separately

[Ads and purchases]
- Ads are rewarded ads shown only when you press a button (idle faith x2, one revive per run, run faith x2, one free gear chest a day). No banners, no interstitials
- Contains in-app purchases: rewards without ads (VIP), hero slots, a starter pack and faith
- The odds of the daily free gear chest are shown in the shop (grade 2 60%, grade 3 33%, grade 4 7%)

[Good to know]
- No account, no login. Progress is stored on this device only. Deleting the app or changing devices loses your progress
- One-time purchases (VIP, hero slots, starter pack ownership) can be recovered with Restore purchases in the shop. Purchased faith is not restored
- Korean, English and Japanese

name: RASH Tronics Remote
description:
RASH Tronics Remote turns your iPhone into a second remote for a R.A.S.H Tronics wheelchair ramp or lift. It talks to the ramp's Controller over Bluetooth Low Energy.

HOW IT WORKS
• Press and hold a key on the screen to move the lift; let go to stop.
• The keys work only while the app is open on the screen. Leaving the app, opening Control Center or the app switcher, or locking the iPhone stops them. The screen stays on while the remote is open.
• Your installer pairs the iPhone with your ramp's Controller once. If the pairing is ever lost, ask your installer or contact support.

WHAT YOU NEED
• An iPhone with iOS 17 or newer.
• A R.A.S.H Tronics Controller with firmware 3.2.0 or newer, paired with this iPhone by your installer.

USE WITH CARE
• The app does not replace the physical remote that came with the ramp. Keep the physical remote in the vehicle.
• Make sure the ramp area is clear of people and objects before you move the lift.
• Never operate the ramp while the vehicle is moving.
• If the ramp doesn't respond as expected, stop, use the physical remote, and contact support.

FIRMWARE UPDATES
Controller firmware updates are for authorized installers. The app takes firmware only from a signed release list on our server, and the Controller checks each file's signature before it installs it.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking. The pairing is kept in the iOS Keychain and your settings stay on your iPhone. The internet is used only to check for Controller firmware.

Support: https://www.rashtronics.com/apps/support

name: RasterDock: Image Batches
description:
Turn a set of pictures into useful delivery files. RasterDock helps you resize images together, save your usual output settings and create a PDF contact sheet for review.

IMPORT A WORKING SET
Create a named batch and choose your own static JPEG, PNG or HEIC images with the system photo or file picker. Check the actual dimensions, file size and display orientation. Select images and change their order before processing. Original photos and source files stay unchanged.

EXPORT CONSISTENT IMAGES
Keep original dimensions, fit inside a box, or choose an exact width or height while preserving proportions. Prevent enlargement when you need it. Generate JPEG files with a chosen quality and white or black transparency background, or PNG files that preserve transparency. Check each generated file and its actual output dimensions.

MAKE A CONTACT SHEET
Arrange selected images in two, three or four columns on A4 or Letter pages. Choose page orientation, a title and optional filenames. Preview the real multipage PDF before sharing.

REUSE AND REOPEN
Save named presets for repeated work. Generated files are saved in an independent export history, so you can reopen them even after removing a source batch. Share selected output files with the system share sheet.

RasterDock stores its working library on your device. Imported copies and generated files can be removed individually or erased together in About. A batch holds up to 25 images; each imported image can be up to 25 MiB and 40 megapixels. New output omits source metadata, but visible image content may still contain private information.

name: Ratify USA Constitution Test
description:
A Constitution test is coming, and reading the textbook again isn't working.
This turns the whole unit into a game: every question on the 8th grade
Constitution test, played as a battle across the 13 original states.

THE MAP

The states sit on a winding map in the order they really ratified. Delaware is
first, and it covers what came before the Constitution. Pennsylvania is the
Convention. Rhode Island, which skipped the Convention and ratified last, is
the final boss, with questions from every chapter. Sign a state by battling
through its questions. Nine signed and the Constitution is ratified, the same as
in 1788.

NO STARTING OVER

A missed question comes back at the end of the round for another try, so a
state is never lost and nothing has to be replayed from the beginning. Right
the first time scores more. Answer streaks multiply the points, and each state
earns up to 3 stars.

FLASHCARDS, AS LOOT CHESTS

Every question is a chest with the question on the front. Think of the answer,
tap the chest, and the answer pops out. Claim the ones you know, send the rest
back, and claim them all.

PRACTICE TEST AND READINESS

A 50-question practice test like the real one, scored at the end with a list of
what to fix. A readiness score from 0 to 100 shows whether you'd pass today.

REVIEW AND SPEED ROUND

The review list collects every missed question, worst first, and a question
leaves it after two right in a row. The speed round is 60 seconds to answer as
many as you can.

176 QUESTIONS

Covering the Declaration and the Articles of Confederation, the Convention, the
Preamble, the big ideas, all three branches, Articles IV to VII, the Bill of
Rights and the later amendments. Each answer comes with a short trick for
remembering it.

FREE TO START

The first 3 states, flashcards and quiz are free. One purchase of $1.99 unlocks
all 13 states, the practice test, readiness, review and the speed round. No
subscription, no ads.

PRIVATE

No accounts, no ads, no analytics, nothing collected. Progress stays on the
phone.

Made for a middle school student with a test date.

name: RatioRig: Gear & Belt Ratios
description:
RatioRig helps you plan ideal multi-stage gear and belt drives. Enter the input speed and rotation, then follow the speed and direction of every driven shaft.

Build ordered rigs using external gear pairs, open belts and crossed belts. Enter whole tooth counts or effective pulley diameters in millimetres or inches. Original input values and units stay with the rig.

Inspect total reduction, speed factor, output rpm and the stage-by-stage trace. Compare two saved rigs using one common input speed and direction, without changing either rig.

Save a fixed calculation report before trying an alternative. Reports retain their inputs and results even when live rigs change. Preview paginated PDF or share PDF and CSV reports.

Save a local JSON backup in Files, share a whole-library backup, or restore a validated selected backup after confirmation. Clear all removes the managed library, recovery copy and temporary exports. Backups saved in Files remain user managed.

Calculations use ideal no-slip kinematics and parallel shafts viewed from the same side. Pulley values are effective diameters. RatioRig does not calculate torque, load, efficiency, strength, slip, belt fit or belt length. Numerical display precision is not a physical accuracy guarantee. No app login is required.

name: RaveIQ
description:
RaveIQ is one button to non-stop energy. Tap Start the energy and the music does not stop: live electronic dance radio from around the world, sorted by intensity so you stay in the high-energy lane you picked.

ENERGY LANES
Mainstage, House and dance, Trance, Techno, Psytrance, Hardstyle, Drum and bass, Hardcore and Eurodance. Each lane shows its tempo and how many stations are live right now.

AROUND THE WORLD
More than 450 live stations from 54 countries. Filter by continent or country, or turn on World Tour and RaveIQ hops to a station in another country on a timer. The music keeps going while it changes.

NEVER SILENT
If a station drops, RaveIQ skips to the next one in your lane by itself. No dead air, no tapping around.

TELL THE DJ
Type what you want, such as "fast drum and bass from the UK" or "uplifting trance for a long drive". The built-in DJ picks the lane, the countries and the stations and starts playing. It runs on your device.

LIGHT SHOW
Open the stage for a full-screen light show with the station, the lane and the tempo. Swipe sideways to change station, up or down to change lane.

APPLE WATCH APP
RaveIQ comes with its own Apple Watch app. Use the watch as a remote for the iPhone: change lane, skip, pause and turn the Digital Crown for volume. Or set Sound to Watch and stream straight from the watch to your headphones, with World Tour and favorites, and leave the phone behind.

MADE FOR THE BACKGROUND
Plays with the screen locked and while you use other apps. Play, pause and skip from the lock screen, Control Center and your headphones.

YOURS
Save favorites, block stations you never want to hear, search the worldwide directory to add more, and set a sleep timer.

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
No account, no sign-up, no tracking. RaveIQ adds no ads of its own. Favorites stay on your device.

Stations come from the community directory radio-browser.info. Each stream belongs to its broadcaster and plays directly from the broadcaster's own public stream, including whatever the broadcaster airs. Station availability changes over time. Streaming uses data, so Wi-Fi is a good idea for long sessions.

name: RealMinutes
description:
Why does getting ready take longer than expected? Why does a quick shopping trip use up more of your day than you planned?
RealMinutes helps you understand how long everyday activities really take, so you can stop guessing and make plans that fit real life.
MEASURE YOUR REAL TIME Start a timer for activities like cooking, cleaning, studying, shopping, or getting ready. Pause and resume when needed, or add a past duration manually. Save notes and conditions to remember what made a session different.
LEARN WHAT'S TYPICAL As you save recordings, RealMinutes calculates your usual duration for each activity. Compare your guesses with actual time and discover which tasks you tend to underestimate. A safer planning estimate gives you extra room when you need it.
PLAN BACKWARD OR FORWARD Need to be ready by 8:00 AM? Choose your activities and finish time to see when you should start. Or set a starting time to estimate when you'll finish. Reorder steps and add a buffer for unexpected delays.
REUSE DAILY ROUTINES Build routines for mornings, school preparation, cooking, housework, or anything you repeat. Save the activity order, then run each step with a timer instead of planning from scratch every day.
MAKE FREE MINUTES COUNT Have 20 minutes available? Quick Time Fit suggests saved activities that fit within that time, using your personal duration estimates.
SPOT USEFUL PATTERNS Explore simple charts, total time, recent activity trends, and comparisons between estimated and actual durations. Review your history, correct entries, and see how your timing changes.
MADE FOR EVERYDAY LIFE Create custom activities, choose icons and categories, save favorites, and use ready-made activity suggestions. Personalize the appearance, time format, and planning buffer. Explore sample data or export and import a local backup.
RealMinutes works offline without an account. Your activities, routines, notes, and recordings are stored on your device. No ads, subscriptions, or in-app purchases.
RealMinutes — Know how long life actually takes.

name: Recall Whistle: Dog Training
description:
A dog whistle that sounds the moment you tap it, with no ads and no fake "silent" claims. Recall Whistle plays loud, audible gundog-style cues and teaches your dog to come back with a 14-day recall program in 5-minute sessions.

WHISTLE AND CLICKER, FREE AND AD-FREE
• Recall: pip-pip-pip. Stop/Sit: one long blast. Turn: two pips.
• Big pads you can hit without looking, with a haptic on every tap.
• Plays with the silent switch on. Warns you if sound is going to AirPods or headphones instead of the speaker.
• A crisp clicker with a click + treat counter.
• Keeps the screen on while the whistle is open.

HONEST SOUND
Phone speakers can't play ultrasonic "silent" whistles, so we don't pretend. Every cue is an audible tone in the range iPhone speakers play loudest and dogs hear easily outdoors. At long range, use your own whistle with the same pattern and log the call in the app.

A 14-DAY RECALL PROGRAM
• Charge the whistle: pair the sound with treats (days 1–3, free).
• Distance: 3 m to 30 m+, on a long line, then off lead in a safe place.
• Distractions: toys, people, other dogs at a distance, new places.
Step-by-step sessions with reps, target distance, a timer and coaching from Pip the pointer. Safety guidance on every off-lead day. Written from published trainer guidance.

KNOW HOW RELIABLE YOUR RECALL IS
After each call, tap how they did: came, slow or ignored. Recall and stop scores appear only once you have logged enough calls, and the top bands need calls at real distance. No made-up numbers.

PRO
• All 14 program days
• Reliability by distance, context, a 14-day trend and per-day results
• Unlimited dogs, each with its own whistle and progress
Pro Monthly, Pro Yearly or a one-time Lifetime purchase. No free trial that converts behind your back.

No account, no server: everything stays on your phone. Export your data any time.

SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
Recall Whistle Pro is available as auto-renewing subscriptions, Pro Monthly ($1.99 / month) or Pro Yearly ($9.99 / year), or as Pro Lifetime ($14.99, one-time purchase). Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple ID settings (Settings › Apple ID › Subscriptions).
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://kiwilab.app/privacy

name: Recivvy
description:
Recivvy splits a receipt the fair way: everyone pays for what they actually had.

SCAN OR TYPE
Scan a receipt with the camera, upload a photo or PDF, or type an amount. Recivvy reads the items on your phone and fills in the invoice for you to check.

SPLIT YOUR WAY
• Split everything equally in one tap
• Or go item by item and tap who shared it
• Use any ratio, like 2:1
• Split "3 x beer" by units: two for Sam, one for Alex
• Equal, shares, exact amounts or percentages for simple bills

TAX AND TIP DONE RIGHT
Mark which items are taxable and enter the tax amount or the rate. Add a tip with one tap. Recivvy warns you if the numbers do not add up to the receipt total.

GROUPS AND INDIVIDUALS
Keep a running balance for each group, and a separate one for each person. See who owes whom and record paybacks when someone settles up.

SHARE THE SPLIT
Send any expense as a PDF showing each person's share, the items, and the original receipt.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No sign-up. Everything stays on your phone, and receipts are read on the device.

Built for receipts in the United States and Canada.

name: RecMyCall: Call Recorder
description:
RecMyCall records your phone calls, incoming and outgoing, without changing the way you call.

How it works
1. Start or answer a call as usual.
2. Open RecMyCall and tap REC.
3. Merge the calls. From that moment your call is recorded.
Hang up and the recording is waiting in the app.

What you get
• Every call recorded and safely stored
• Play back any moment
• Read your call as text, in the language that was spoken
• Share the audio or the text with one tap
• A live timer on your lock screen and in the Dynamic Island while you record
• In English, Dutch, German, Spanish, French and Arabic

Your privacy
Your recordings are stored in the EU and linked only to your account. Transcription also happens in the EU. Delete a recording or your whole account whenever you want.

Recording and the law
The rules for recording calls differ per country. In Germany, France and the United States the other person hears an announcement before the recording starts. Always make sure you are allowed to record a call.

Subscription
Try RecMyCall free for 3 days, then continue with a weekly or yearly plan. Each plan includes 60 recording minutes per week (15 minutes during the free trial). Need more? Buy extra minutes in the app. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase and the trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms: https://recmycall.com/terms.html
Privacy policy: https://recmycall.com/privacy.html

name: recova Logistik
description:
recova Logistik ist die App für Fahrerinnen, Fahrer und die Disposition der recova GmbH. Mit ihr werden Abholungen und Lieferungen von Elektroaltgeräten und Wertstoffen geplant, gefahren und dokumentiert.

Die App ist für Mitarbeitende von recova gedacht. Die Anmeldung erfolgt mit einem Zugang, den recova vergibt. Eine eigene Registrierung gibt es nicht.

FÜR FAHRER
• Die Tour des Tages mit allen Stopps, Zeitfenstern, Ansprechpartnern und Hinweisen zur Zufahrt
• Navigation zum nächsten Stopp mit einem Fingertipp
• Behälter tauschen, abholen oder zustellen, Codes mit der Kamera scannen
• Unterschrift von Kunde und Fahrer direkt auf dem Display, Übernahmeschein als PDF per E-Mail
• „Stopp nicht möglich“ mit Grund, Foto und Hinweis, damit die Disposition sofort reagieren kann
• Restmengen als Folgeauftrag erfassen, wenn das Fahrzeug voll ist
• Abfahrtskontrolle mit Kilometerstand und Fotos von Mängeln
• Tankbelege fotografieren und erfassen
• Funktioniert auch bei schlechtem Netz: Eingaben werden nachgereicht
• Oberfläche auf Deutsch, Englisch und Ukrainisch

FÜR DIE DISPOSITION
• Tagesplanung, Touren und offene Anfragen
• Live-Übersicht: Wo sind die Fahrzeuge, wann kommen sie beim Kunden an
• Push-Nachrichten bei neuen Anfragen, erfolglosen Anfahrten, Mängeln am Fahrzeug oder fehlendem Standort

STANDORT NUR WÄHREND DER TOUR
Die App bittet ausdrücklich um die Freigabe des Standorts und erklärt vorher, wofür er gebraucht wird. Übertragen wird nur von Tourbeginn bis zum letzten Stopp, auch wenn die App im Hintergrund ist. Solange die Ortung läuft, zeigt das Gerät das an. Danach endet sie automatisch. Die Ortung lässt sich jederzeit in den Einstellungen abschalten. Der Verlauf wird nach 7 Tagen gelöscht.

Keine Werbung, kein Tracking zu Werbezwecken, keine Analyse-Werkzeuge.

name: RectangleMirror Remote
description:
RectangleMirror Remote turns your iPad into a live view of what RectangleMirror on your Mac is sharing in a video call, with Apple Pencil on top.

SEE WHAT YOU SHARE
The mirrored region, or the window you are presenting, streams to the iPad over your local network. Pinch to zoom, pan with two fingers.

DRAW ON IT
Pen, highlighter, text boxes, colours and sizes. Every stroke appears in the shared window on the Mac as you draw it. Undo and Wipe are one tap away.

WHITEBOARD
Switch to a blank whiteboard and back in one tap. The whiteboard keeps its content; region annotations clear when you finish.

DRIVE THE MAC
Start or stop mirroring and pick regions from the iPad.

PAIRING
Choose your Mac in the app, accept the request on the Mac, and enter the one-time code it shows. The code works only for that iPad. The iPad remembers every Mac it paired with.

REQUIRES
RectangleMirror for Mac (macOS 14 or later) with the Pro subscription or its free 14-day trial, on the same Wi-Fi network. This app is free.

PRIVACY
Nothing is collected or uploaded. The app talks only to your Mac on the local network.

name: Red Sidewalks
description:
Red Sidewalks is the hyperlocal news app for Miami Beach and its barrier-island neighbors: South Beach, Mid-Beach and North Beach, Surfside, Bal Harbour, Bay Harbor Islands, North Bay Village and Sunny Isles Beach.

We cover the big local stories and the small, specific things nobody else tells you about: what's on the commission agenda, the permit filed down the block, the lane closure on your way to work, the king tide coming Thursday, the restaurant opening on the corner.

EVERY STORY SHOWS ITS SOURCES
Each story lists the agendas, records, official posts and reports it's built on, so you can read them yourself.

BUILT FOR READING
• Today: the top story, the latest headlines and what's coming up
• A clean, fast reader with photos, captions and credits
• Browse by neighborhood or by section: City Hall, Safety, Development, Beach & Environment, Getting Around, Food & Drink, Events, Business, Schools and History
• Search every recent story instantly, even offline
• Save stories to read later, with their photos, with no connection
• Adjustable text size, Dynamic Type, VoiceOver and dark mode

ON THE BEACH TODAY
Weather, wind and water, rip current risk, tides and sargassum, from the National Weather Service and NOAA.

FOR RESIDENTS
• The events calendar for all seven towns
• Public meetings and how officials voted
• Elections and the resident guide: who to call, parking, trash, flooding and hurricane prep
• Coming to the block: new permits and building filings on a map
• The Scanner: police, fire-rescue and road incidents
• Property sales and live beach cams
• Send a tip, or ask the Red Tape Desk to find something out

NO TRACKING
No ads, no account and no tracking. The app doesn't collect personal data. Saved stories stay on your iPhone.

name: Refrigerant Drill: 608 Study
description:
Practice questions for the Core and Type I sections of the EPA Section 608 technician test, written from the public regulation. Every answer shows the rule paragraph it comes from. Study aid: not an official EPA product and not affiliated with or endorsed by the EPA.

WHAT IT COVERS
149 original questions, 94 Core and 55 Type I, on the topics the regulation itself settles: the venting prohibition, the sales restriction, technician certification, evacuation requirements, recovery equipment, safe disposal, reclamation, leak repair basics, recordkeeping, small-appliance recovery, refrigerant types and ozone, and the definitions in the rule. It does not cover the topics on EPA's test-topic list that the regulation does not state, such as the refrigeration cycle, gauges, safety practice and shipping. Type II and Type III are not included.

EVERY ANSWER SOURCED
Each question was written from 40 CFR Part 82 Subpart F or EPA's Section 608 pages, and the answer shows its citation with the date that text was checked. Each answer key was checked twice against the rule text, independently of the author. That is not a review by an HVAC instructor.

PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
Progress is saved after every answer. Close the app in the middle of a practice exam and it reopens on the next unanswered question with the same time left.

WEAK SPOTS
The questions you have missed, grouped by topic, so you can re-drill only what you got wrong. A topic leaves the list once you answer it correctly twice in a row.

PRACTICE EXAMS
25 questions per section, the number each section of the certification test has, with the 70 percent pass mark (84 percent for a mail-in Type I test) from Appendix D to Subpart F. The 30-minute timer is this app's own practice timer; certifying organizations set their own time limits. A practice score does not predict your result.

ON YOUR PHONE
No account, no analytics, no network use. Paid once.

What it isn't: it does not certify you (the certification test is given only by EPA-approved certifying organizations), none of its questions is taken from that test, and it is not a course or a textbook.

Support: https://resonantlab.ai/apps/refrigerantdrill · Privacy: https://resonantlab.ai/apps/refrigerantdrill/privacy

name: Rehome Home Dashboard
description:
Give your iPad a place in your home.

Rehome brings home controls, clocks, weather and everyday tools together in a display you can leave open on a desk, shelf or counter.

• Connect your existing Apple Home, or use your own Home Assistant server.
• Control supported lights, scenes, climate devices and more.
• Choose and customize dashboard and clock faces.
• Keep timers, reminders, calendars and weather close at hand.
• Try a sample home before connecting your own devices.

Requires iPadOS 26 or later. Smart-home features require compatible accessories already configured in Apple Home or Home Assistant. Capabilities depend on your accessories and network.

Optional music features may require separate subscriptions, Home Assistant or Music Assistant. Claude and ChatGPT are optional, require your own API key and sharing permission, and may have separate API costs.

Your private house-map files are not included in other customers’ downloads. See our privacy policy for local storage and optional connected-service details.

Rehome is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Apple.

name: Relatività animata
description:
Scopri la teoria della relatività di Einstein con animazioni interattive, in un percorso di sette tappe pensato per ragazzi delle scuole medie e superiori e per tutti i curiosi.

COSA TROVI
• L'universo: una barra del tempo dal Big Bang a oggi, con le prime stelle e galassie.
• La Terra: dalla nube di polvere al pianeta di oggi, con l'orologio di 24 ore della sua storia.
• Spazio-tempo: vedi come una massa incurva lo spazio e la luce ne segue la forma.
• Velocità e tempo: un orologio a luce mostra perché a bordo di un'astronave il tempo rallenta.
• Gravità e tempo: confronta il tempo vicino a Terra, Sole, nana bianca, stella di neutroni e buco nero.
• I gemelli: il famoso paradosso, con i numeri alla mano.
• Il GPS: perché i satelliti hanno bisogno della relatività per restare precisi.
• Per studiare: due livelli di spiegazione (Base e Avanzato), quiz di tre domande per tappa, glossario, voce narrante, tema chiaro o scuro e testo ingrandibile.

COME FUNZIONA
Ogni tappa ha un'animazione che controlli con cursori e pulsanti, una guida «Prova tu», l'idea chiave spiegata in modo semplice e un approfondimento più dettagliato.

• 6 lingue: italiano, inglese, francese, tedesco, spagnolo, portoghese
• Funziona senza connessione
• Nessuna pubblicità, nessun account, nessun dato raccolto

name: Relay — все чаты в одном
Relay SSH
description:
Relay SSH puts every shell you run one tap away. Connect to any SSH server, whether Linux, macOS, BSD or a Raspberry Pi, and work comfortably from your iPhone or iPad.

A KEYBOARD MADE FOR SHELLS
• A full on-screen keyboard built for the terminal: Esc, Tab, Ctrl, Alt, arrows, Home, End, PgUp, PgDn and F1–F12
• Sticky Ctrl and Alt, so key combinations take one finger
• Hold a key for its symbol, and keys repeat when held
• One-tap snippets for the commands you run every day
• Run a command on connect, such as tmux attach
• Full support for hardware keyboards
• Adjustable font size in JetBrains Mono, and a larger cursor if you prefer

MANY HOSTS, MANY SESSIONS
• Save every server with its own icon, tint, group and tags, and mark favorites
• Keep several shells live at once and switch between them instantly
• Live status shows which hosts are online before you connect
• Search and filter by group, tag or favorite
• Find SSH servers on your network automatically
• Wake sleeping machines with Wake-on-LAN, then connect
• Reach private machines through a jump host

KEYS THAT NEVER LEAVE YOUR IPHONE
• Generate Ed25519, ECDSA or RSA 4096 keys on the device
• Private keys and passwords are stored in the Keychain on this device only
• Share a public key in one tap to add it to authorized_keys
• Import existing OpenSSH or PEM keys from Files
• Host keys are checked on every connection: you compare the fingerprint the first time, and Relay SSH warns you if it ever changes

SECURE BY DEFAULT
• Require Face ID to connect to a host, or to open the app
• With app lock on, your terminals are hidden in the app switcher
• Optionally clear the clipboard when a session ends

PORT FORWARDING AND FILES
• Local, remote and dynamic (SOCKS) port forwarding
• Tunnels restart on their own after a reconnect
• Browse files over SFTP, download to Files, and upload from Files

BUILT FOR EVERY SCREEN
• iPhone: a full-screen terminal with the keyboard right where your thumbs are
• iPad: a sidebar for your hosts, tabs for every open session, and two shells side by side
• iPhone Duo: unfold to see your hosts on one half and a live shell on the other, or fold it like a laptop for the terminal on top and the keyboard below
• Landscape gives the terminal more room

STAYS CONNECTED
• Reconnects automatically after Wi-Fi to cellular switches and network drops, keeping your scrollback
• Keep-alive packets stop idle connections from timing out
• Sessions pick up again when you come back to the app
• Copy the last command's output or share a session transcript

HANDY EXTRAS
• A haptic tap when a program rings the bell
• Keep the screen awake while a terminal is showing
• Pick an accent color to suit you

Relay SSH has no ads and no account to create. Your hosts, keys and passwords stay on your device. Crash reports and anonymous usage data help fix problems, never include what you type or what your servers send, and can be turned off in Settings.

name: Relova: Moving Home
description:
Moving home in Australia is a long list of small jobs, a few big deadlines and one bond you want back. Relova keeps all of it in one calm place on your iPhone.

A PLAN BUILT FOR YOUR MOVE
Tell Relova where you're moving from and to, and when. It builds a dated plan for your move: notice to give, removalists to book, power and internet to arrange, and the rules for your state, including licence and rego changes when you move interstate.

KEEP YOUR BOND
Record the old home room by room with dated photos, so you have evidence of how you left it. Relova tracks the bond deadlines for your state and helps you reply to deductions with your own records.

KNOW YOUR RIGHTS
Renter help covers every state and territory: entry notice, ending a lease, repairs, rent increases, pets and share houses. Check whether a rent increase notice is valid, write a repair request with your state's timeframes, and get your records ready if a dispute goes to a tribunal.

EVERY ADDRESS, UPDATED
The Address Hub lists who needs your new address, from myGov to your bank, with legal deadlines where they apply.

BUDGET AND BOXES
Track quotes and costs, split them with housemates, and label boxes with QR codes so you can find the kettle on the first night.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no tracking and no advertising. Your move is stored on your iPhone, and in your own iCloud only if you turn on sync. Relova takes no referral fees from removalists, utilities or agents.

Relova gives general information from official Australian government sources. It isn't legal advice.

Relova Plus is a one-time purchase that adds PDF evidence packs, tribunal packs, a move summary and printable box labels.

name: Remote Duo: Trackpad & Screen
description:
Turn your iPhone into a trackpad, keyboard, and live screen for your computer, whether it's a Mac, a Windows PC, or a Linux box.

Built for iPhone Duo: unfold it in portrait and the top half shows your computer's screen while the bottom half becomes its trackpad and keyboard, like a laptop that fits in your pocket. Folded, or on any other iPhone, it's a full-screen trackpad and remote.

FREE
• Trackpad with the gestures you know: tap to click, two-finger scroll with momentum, right click, drag
• Full keyboard, plus esc, tab, arrows, and ⌘ / ctrl / alt keys
• Live screen view on iPhone Duo: tap to click right where you look, pinch to zoom in on small text, and the view follows your pointer
• Pick which display to show on computers with more than one

REMOTE DUO PRO (one-time purchase, free 7-day trial)
• Fit to Duo: give your Mac a screen shaped exactly like your phone's, so the picture fills it edge to edge, even on a Mac mini with no monitor
• Computer sound on your phone, in sync with the picture
• Media remote: play, pause, volume, and arrow keys for the couch
• All your computers in one list

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your phone talks directly to your computer over your own network, encrypted with a certificate the app pins when you pair. No accounts, no analytics, no ads, no Remote Duo servers.

GET STARTED
1. Install the free, open-source Remote Duo Host on your computer from iruntech.github.io/remote-duo
2. Open Remote Duo, tap +, and pick your computer
3. Enter the PIN from the host's menu, or scan its QR code with the Camera

No computer handy? Tap Try the Demo to see how it works.

Away from home? Use Tailscale on both devices and connect by its address.

name: Renoa: Renovation Planner
description:
Renovating a kitchen, a bathroom or a whole home? Renoa keeps everything about each room together: measurements with their verification status, reference images, material selections, contractor quotes, the budget, payments, tasks, progress photos and the defects that remain before sign-off.

• Room workspace: references, measurements, materials, tasks, costs and photos per room
• Quote comparison by scope, quantity, exclusions and payment terms, not just the headline total
• Contractor instruction packs as clean PDFs, in English or Urdu, with every measurement labelled Verified or Estimate
• Change register: record extra work and its cost before it becomes an argument
• Budget that separates committed, spent and paid, with the basis explained
• Transparent quantity calculators for tiles, flooring and paint
• Handover checklist: defects, warranties, receipts, material codes
• Works in English and Urdu

Renoa needs no account. Everything stays on your device. No ads, and your household data is never sold.

Renoa is a planning and record-keeping tool. It is not CAD, structural engineering or a building-code checker. Quantities and calculator results are estimates to confirm with your supplier or contractor.

RENOA PLUS (optional)
The free version includes one active project with up to three rooms. Renoa Plus adds up to 3 projects, 20 rooms per project, 5 GB of attachments, instruction-pack issuing, advanced quote comparison and advanced reports. Plus is available as a monthly or annual auto-renewing subscription, or as a one-time 90-day Renovation Pass that does not renew. Prices are shown in the app before you buy. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period and can be managed in your Apple ID settings. Viewing and editing your existing records is never blocked.

Terms of use: https://mdgoaltech-web.github.io/renoa-site/terms.html
Privacy policy: https://mdgoaltech-web.github.io/renoa-site/privacy.html

name: RentOS - Vận hành toà nhà
description:
RentOS giúp chủ nhà, ban quản lý và khách thuê làm việc trên cùng một ứng dụng: quản lý phòng / mặt bằng cho thuê, khách hàng, hợp đồng, hoá đơn và thông báo.

DÀNH CHO KHÁCH THUÊ
• Xem thông tin phòng / mặt bằng bạn đang thuê
• Theo dõi hoá đơn hằng tháng: số tiền, trạng thái thanh toán, chi tiết điện nước và các khoản phí
• Thanh toán nhanh bằng cách quét mã VietQR trong ứng dụng ngân hàng của bạn
• Nhận thông báo nhắc hoá đơn và tin từ chủ nhà
• Cập nhật hồ sơ cá nhân, đổi mật khẩu, liên hệ chủ nhà nhanh bằng một chạm

DÀNH CHO CHỦ NHÀ / BAN QUẢN LÝ
• Tổng quan: số bất động sản, phòng, khách, hợp đồng, tỷ lệ lấp đầy, doanh thu và công nợ
• Quản lý bất động sản, phòng / mặt bằng cùng ảnh và trạng thái (còn trống, đang thuê, bảo trì)
• Quản lý khách hàng, gán khách vào phòng, chọn người đại diện
• Lập hoá đơn theo kỳ, nhập chỉ số điện nước, xem và chia sẻ hoá đơn dạng PDF
• Xem hợp đồng dạng PDF, gọi điện cho khách chỉ với một chạm
• Quét căn cước công dân (CCCD) bằng AI để tự điền thông tin khách (tuỳ chọn, có thể nhập tay)
• Nhận thông báo từ hệ thống

LƯU Ý
• Tài khoản do chủ nhà / ban quản lý cấp, ứng dụng không cho tự đăng ký. Đăng nhập bằng số điện thoại hoặc email.
• Khách thuê có thể tự xoá tài khoản ngay trong ứng dụng (Cá nhân → Xoá tài khoản).
• Tiền thuê được thanh toán bằng chuyển khoản ngân hàng (VietQR) ở ứng dụng ngân hàng, ngoài RentOS.

name: ReSolute NYC
description:
ReSolute Archive Radio is one station, always on.

It plays recordings from the ReSolute archive, back to back, around the clock. Everyone who tunes in hears the same moment. The only thing the radio tells you is the date the recording was made.

No rewind. No skip. No tracklist.

RADIO
- Tune in and leave it on. It keeps playing with your screen locked.
- Light and dark mode.

FLYER MACHINE
- A claw machine loaded with every ReSolute flyer since 2008. Steer the claw, drop it, and see what you pull.

WHAT'S NEXT
- Swipe through upcoming ReSolute nights and get tickets on Resident Advisor.
- Turn on notifications to hear about new events, offers, merch drops and the mix of the week. You choose which ones you get.

ReSolute has been throwing parties in New York since 2007.

name: Resonanccs
description:
Cette application accompagne les musiciens dans leur pratique et leur location d’instruments, dans un cadre simple et calme. Elle est pensée pour ceux qui souhaitent suivre leur travail instrumental tout en découvrant des instruments à louer.

Vous pouvez enregistrer vos séances de pratique au quotidien : indiquer la durée, les morceaux travaillés et ajouter des notes personnelles. L’application synthétise ensuite vos temps de travail sur la semaine, avec un suivi de l’objectif hebdomadaire, des jours consécutifs de pratique et des morceaux étudiés. Vous pouvez aussi consulter une carte de synthèse hebdomadaire, que vous pouvez enregistrer ou partager.

La section instruments vous permet de parcourir un parc d’instruments révisés en atelier, filtrer par famille, consulter leur disponibilité et les tarifs de location mensuelle ou hebdomadaire. Chaque fiche détaille les frais annexes, l’assurance, la caution et les modalités de remise de l’instrument, sans paiement à l’avance.

name: Review Link Maker
description:
Review Link Maker makes it easy to ask customers for a review.

Search for any business, tap it, and you get the direct link that opens the review box on Google for that place. Copy it, share it, or turn it into a QR code that customers can scan with their phone camera.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Search for the business by name, or paste its Google Maps link.
2. Copy or share the review link, or make a QR code.
3. Customers open it and land straight on the box for writing a review.

GREAT FOR
- Cafes, shops, salons, trades and anyone who relies on word of mouth
- Printing a QR code for the counter, the till, receipts, menus or flyers
- Adding your review link to emails, texts, invoices and social posts
- Helping a favourite local business get more reviews

FEATURES
- Search any business, with optional nearby results first
- Copy, share or test the review link in one tap
- Large, print ready QR code with your own short caption
- Save to Photos or share the QR image, or print it from the share sheet
- Keep a list of saved businesses and see your recent ones
- Paste a Google Maps link or Place ID instead of searching
- Light and dark mode, Dynamic Type and VoiceOver support

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no ads, no tracking. What you type into search is sent to Google's Places service to find businesses, and that's it. Your saved and recent businesses stay on your iPhone.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Google. Google and Google Maps are trademarks of Google LLC.

name: RevLin
description:
RevLin is the social network for people who live for cars and motorcycles. Show off your rides, discover what's out there and plan the next meet with people who share the same passion.

YOUR FEED
• Posts with up to 5 photos or videos, captions, mentions, hashtags and the place, from race tracks to scenic overlooks.
• Give revs to the posts you like, comment and save the best ones.

YOUR GARAGE
• A spec sheet for every ride: make, model, year, power, transmission, drivetrain, color and every photo.
• Your posts linked to each vehicle, and the spotteds others took of it.

EXPLORE
• Search people, makes, models, places and hashtags.
• A grid with what's trending in the community.

MESSAGES, GROUPS AND ROOMS
• Private and group chats with photos, videos, voice messages, GIFs, PDFs and view-once photos.
• Share posts, profiles and vehicles in a chat.
• Public rooms by topic and region, with moderation.

NOTIFICATIONS
• Revs, comments, mentions and new followers, as they happen.
• Turn on the bell on a profile to know when that person posts.

SAFETY AND PRIVACY
• Private account, blocking, and reports for posts, comments, messages and accounts.
• Two-factor authentication and the list of your signed-in sessions.
• Your location is only used when you tap "Use my location", and it is never stored.
• Download a copy of your data or delete your account whenever you want, right in the app.

RevLin is for people aged 16 and over. Made in Portugal.

name: Revlog
description:
Revlog is a logbook for the vehicles you actually drive — cars, motorbikes and scooters. Log a fill-up in seconds, see your real fuel economy, keep every service on schedule and know what each kilometre truly costs.

REAL FUEL ECONOMY
Log litres, price and the odometer at each fill-up. Revlog uses the full-tank method: when you fill to the brim twice, it divides the distance by the fuel you put back in. Partial top-ups are counted correctly. Every tank shows its own figure, plus your average, best and worst, and the fuel cost per kilometre. Choose km/l, L/100 km, mpg (US) or mpg (UK); miles and gallons follow automatically.

SERVICE SCHEDULE BY DISTANCE OR DATE
Engine oil, filters, tyres, brake pads, chain, coolant, battery, insurance, emission check, registration — or a custom job. Set an interval in kilometres, months or both. Revlog shows the next due point by odometer and by date, colours each job overdue, due soon or all good, and lets you log a job as done with its cost in one step. A standard schedule for each vehicle type gets you started.

DUE-SOON BOARD
The Garage dashboard collects everything that needs attention across all your vehicles, so the next oil change or insurance renewal never sneaks up on you. You choose how early the warning comes.

EXPENSES AND MONTHLY TOTALS
Parking, tolls, washes, parts, tax and fines live next to your fuel. Each vehicle gets monthly totals for the last six months, a split of where the extras go, and an all-in running cost per kilometre.

BUILT LIKE A DASHBOARD
A night-time instrument panel: rolling mechanical odometer reels, gauge arcs, hazard-stripe accents and an H-pattern gear shifter for navigation — 1 Garage, 2 Fuel, 3 Service, 4 Pit. Drag the knob or tap a gear.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CHOICE
Sign in with Apple, Google or email — or drive on as a guest and keep your log later without losing anything. Your log syncs through Google Firebase, works offline and is readable only by you.

PRIVACY
No ads. No tracking. No analytics. You can delete your account and every record in it from the Pit at any time.

name: Rezdock
description:
Rezdock is the online booking system for businesses that work by appointment: barbers, hair salons, massage, beauty, dental hygiene, car service, electricians and many more. Clients book through your booking page or the widget on your website. The Rezdock app keeps it all at hand when you are away from the computer.

WHAT YOU CAN DO IN THE APP
• See your calendar by day, by week or as a list, for the whole team or just for yourself
• Get a notification for every new booking, and when a client cancels or moves one
• Approve booking requests in a tap
• Add a booking while you are on the phone with a client
• Move a booking to another time or person, change the service, cancel it or mark a no-show
• Keep notes on bookings

MADE FOR THE WHOLE TEAM
Owners and reception see all bookings, team members see their own. Everyone gets notifications only for what concerns them.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Rezdock speaks English, Czech, Slovak, Polish and German.

Sign in with your Rezdock account. Services, working hours, your booking page and other settings are managed at rezdock.com.

name: RII Inspection Workstation
description:
RII Inspection Workstation brings guided visual inspection and reporting to iPad. Use it with the RII Touch industrial videoscope to capture live inspection images and recordings over the device's Wi-Fi hotspot.

• Start a guided project with an inspection template, or use Quick Start to capture and annotate photos and prepare a report.
• Organize photos and videos by inspection location. Review photos full screen and add observation tags, annotations, and calibrated 2D measurements.
• Apply a report style, review the report, and export to PDF or Word. Export the project to retain the original photos and videos.

The app is supplied at no separate charge to RII Touch customers. A device-specific activation code is required for first use. Once you have the code, activation and field work can be completed offline.

name: Rimepath: Snow Offroad
description:
Every tire leaves a mark. Pick your way across fresh powder, find grip on ice, and see your tracks when you double back. Rimepath is an offline 4x4 driving game built around the feel of a winter trail.

TEN CAREER STAGES
Cross timber bridges, tackle icy turns, and find a line through a shallow ford. Reach the green finish gate to earn unlocks, then replay stages to improve your best times.

DRIVE THE TERRAIN
Switch between 2WD and 4WD, toggle traction control, or attach the winch at low speed. Packed snow, loose powder, ice, and slush change how the tires grip.

BUILD YOUR GARAGE
Earn vehicles, paints, and tire sets by finishing stages. Preview a setup in the garage, then take your equipped rig into any practice zone.

Made for landscape play on iPhone and iPad. Play offline with touch controls. No ads, accounts, or in-app purchases.

name: Ring Tank: Water Ring Toss
description:
Remember the little water toy with two buttons? Ring Tank brings it back in 3D.

Press a pump to send a jet of water, tilt your phone to steer, and land every ring on its peg before the pumps run out.

• Endless levels across eight underwater worlds
• Ice to crack, fish to dodge, currents and moving pegs
• Three stars to earn on every level
• Keys to catch and chests to open
• A daily shot: one ring, one peg, one press
• Daily quests and a new season of rewards every month
• Boosters for the tricky tanks, tank skins to collect
• Plays in eight languages

Terms of Use: https://giot.wtf/aie/ringtank/terms

name: Rise Within: Affirmations
description:
Rise Within speaks short affirmations out loud, a few times a day. Your reminders play the line in Luna's or Leo's voice, so you hear it even when the app is closed.

Every line is in the first person, short enough to remember and plain enough to mean on an ordinary Tuesday. "I've done hard things before. I'll do this too." "I move before I feel ready, and ready catches up."

SPOKEN REMINDERS
• Each reminder plays its own affirmation in your chosen voice
• Morning, midday and evening, or every one, two or three hours
• Prefer quiet? Switch to text only
• Sound plays when your ringer is on and Focus allows it

TWO VOICES: LUNA AND LEO
• Luna is soft and calm. Leo is warm and steady
• All 355 lines come in both voices
• Each word lights up on screen as it's spoken

355 AFFIRMATIONS IN 12 TOPICS
• Morning Energy, Confidence, Calm, Gratitude, Self-Love and Focus
• Money & Abundance, Health & Body, Love & Relationships, Sleep, Hard Days and Discipline
• Search every line and keep your favorites in one place
• Skip lines about money, food, romance or other topics you'd rather not hear

MIXES FOR HOW YOU FEEL
• Anxious, Tired, Doubting myself, Lonely and Proud
• Repeat-after-me sessions: the voice says a line, then pauses so you can say it back
• Sessions for mornings, calm, confidence, work, gratitude and sleep
• Pick the pause (3 to 10 seconds), loop a session or set a sleep timer
• Say It Back lights up each word as you say it. Nothing is recorded

ROUGH DAY MODE
• One tap switches Today to gentle Hard Days lines for 24 hours, reminders too
• "Not for me" moves on to another line, shows fewer like it, or pauses a topic for a week
• A "Need more support?" card links to a free directory of support services

YOUR WORDS, YOUR VOICE
• Write your own affirmations
• Record a line in your own voice and play it back
• Set your recording as a reminder sound
• Your days: every line you heard, day by day

WIDGETS, SIRI AND SUNNY
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with a play button and a new line every hour
• A Control Center button, or say "Play an affirmation in Rise Within" to Siri
• Sunny, a small smiling sun, cheers when you finish a session
• Rise days add up. Rest days never cost you a thing
• Share a line as a story image

FREE, PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
No account, no ads, no tracking. All 710 voice clips live on your iPhone, so Rise Within works offline. Nothing you write or record is ever sent to us.

Rise Within is for daily practice. It is not medical advice or therapy.

Questions or ideas? Write to info@pianalytix.com. We read every message.

Terms of Use: https://risewithin.pianalytix.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://risewithin.pianalytix.com/privacy/

name: Rivet — Site Inventory
description:
Rivet is inventory tracking built for construction crews, not warehouse clerks.

Snap a photo of what you're taking or putting back. Rivet identifies the item, updates the count, and logs who moved it, where, and when. No typing part numbers into a spreadsheet at the end of the day.

BUILT FOR THE FIELD
• Photo scan in and out — point, shoot, done
• Works with no signal. Entries queue on the phone and sync when you get service
• Type it in yourself any time the photo isn't enough
• Suggestions as you type, so common items take one tap

FOR WHOEVER RUNS THE YARD
• Live inventory value, by site and by category
• Low-stock flags before a crew shows up to an empty rack
• See which items actually move, and who's moving them
• Every entry is permanent — corrections are logged as new entries, never erased

MULTIPLE SITES, THE RIGHT ACCESS
• Crew members see their own history and nothing else
• Site managers are scoped to the yards they run
• Owners and admins see everything, on the phone or the web dashboard

Rivet is invite-only: your administrator adds your phone number and you sign in with a texted code. No password to forget on a job site.

name: RNLearn
description:
RNLearn бол математикийн бодлого бодож, шалгалтандаа бэлдэх монгол хэл дээрх сургалтын апп юм.

• Жишиг 1000 цахим ном: бодлогуудыг хэвлэмэл номын хуудсаар нь, 1 болон 2 нүүрээр уншина.
• Хариугаа шалгах, сануулга (hint), алхам алхмаар бодолт.
• Тэмдэглэл: бодлого бүр дээр өөрийн тэмдэглэл, ноорог хөтөлнө.
• Хадгалсан бодлого, буруу хариулсан болон давтах жагсаалт.
• Явц ба streak: өдөр бүрийн дадлаа хянах, сануулга тохируулах.
• Хөтөлбөр: сэдэв, түвшингээр ангилсан дадлага.
• Томьёоны цуглуулга, iPhone болон iPad дээр ажиллана.

RNLearn is a Mongolian-language math learning app: read the "Jishig 1000" problem e-book, check answers, view step-by-step solutions, keep notes, and track daily progress.

name: ROADHEAD
description:
ROADHEAD tells short history stories about the places you drive past, timed so the best part comes as you pass.

Type where you're starting and where you're going, press Start, and put your phone in its holder. As you get close to a place with a good story, ROADHEAD starts telling it: 30 to 90 seconds about a town, a battle, a disaster, an invention or the people who lived there.

KEEPS PLAYING
Stories keep playing with your screen locked, and alongside Maps and your music. Choose whether your music pauses, turns down or keeps playing during a story. The lock screen and car controls work too.

STORIES WITH SOURCES
Each story shows its source, so you can read more. Many are written for your road by AI from public sources, mainly Wikipedia, and read aloud by a computer voice. If something's wrong, tap Report a mistake.

YOUR TASTE
Pick what you like: settlers, disasters, wars, crime, industry, famous people. Choose plain history or the darker side. Tap Interesting or Not interesting and ROADHEAD learns what to play.

YOUR LOCATION STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
Your phone works out which story is next. ROADHEAD's server gets only the From and To you type, never where you are.

Set it up before you drive. Don't touch the app while driving.

Built and hosted by Baumeister (baumeister.host).

name: Robomux: Virtual Robot Lab
description:
Robomux is a virtual robot workshop. Build a robot from true-to-scale parts, wire it up, write its code and watch it run with real physics – before you buy a single component.

BUILD WITH REAL PARTS
• A searchable library of tens of thousands of parts: Arduino boards, sensors, motor drivers, motors, servos, batteries, screws, nuts, standoffs, plates and aluminium profiles with their real dimensions, weights and electrical values
• Real assembly: screws need matching holes and thread sizes, standoffs stack, wheels press onto motor shafts
• Design your own parts the Tinkercad way: basic shapes, holes, grouping, 3D text, SVG import and generators for chassis plates, L / U brackets, spacers and wheels; export STL, 3MF, OBJ or SVG

WIRE AND CODE
• Breadboard, schematic and netlist views; jumper wires with real gauges and resistance
• Code with blocks, Arduino C++ or MicroPython
• Arduino Uno, Nano and Mega are emulated at the instruction level and run the real compiled program; Raspberry Pi Pico runs MicroPython
• Serial monitor and plotter, power panel: a motor on a bare pin, an LED without a resistor or an overloaded USB port behave like they would on your desk

SIMULATE
• Deterministic physics: wheels, friction on different floors, motors, servos and sensors such as ultrasonic distance, IR line and IMU
• A virtual 3D printer running real Marlin firmware and a CNC running real GRBL
• Industry 4.0 corner: PLC with Structured Text and ladder logic, HMI screens, tags, Modbus and MQTT

AUTOMATE
• Workflows: connect simulation events (sensor thresholds, serial lines, MQTT messages, schedules, webhooks) to actions with a visual node editor

A FULL EDITOR
• Unity-style editor with dockable windows: Scene, Hierarchy, Inspector, Code, Circuit, Console, Profiler and more
• Works on phones and tablets with touch controls; undo / redo and ready-made window layouts

SHARE
• Public profile and showcase for your robots; follow other makers, comment and message (age rules apply: posting, comments, following and messages open at 13)

Honest labels: boards that are emulated instruction by instruction are marked as such; others (for example ESP32 Wi-Fi) are marked "behavioural". ON IPHONE AND IPAD
• Export a robot as USDZ and place a true-to-scale snapshot on your desk with AR Quick Look
• Save STL, 3MF, OBJ, SVG and G-code exports to Files or share them with the share sheet

PLANS
The parts catalogue, profiles and the community are free. The workshop (simulation, code and compiling, design, workflows) is part of the Maker and Pro plans, available as monthly or yearly auto-renewable subscriptions in the app. Payment is charged to your Apple ID; the subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, and you can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://robomux.com/terms · Privacy Policy: https://robomux.com/privacy

The app needs an internet connection; your robots are saved to your account. No ads. Interface in English and Turkish.

name: Rock Paper Slap: Scissors Duel
description:
Rock paper scissors with three seconds on the clock, and the winner's cartoon character slaps the loser. The playground classic with thick outlines, loud yellow and round little heads that love to show off.

THREE SECONDS TO PICK
Every round starts a 3-second countdown. Pick rock, paper or scissors before it hits zero; you can change your mind until the very end. Too slow and you lose the round. Both too slow? Replay it.

WIN, THEN RUB IT IN
The round winner's character taunts the loser with a random move, each with its own shout: slap, shrug, tongue out, butt dance, loser "L" and fake crying.

PLAY YOUR WAY
- Vs. bot: works offline.
- 2 players on one phone: split screen, each player holds one end.
