name: Rockslide: Smash & Upgrade
description:
Load the slingshot, launch your rock and watch it tumble down the hill, smashing everything in its way.

Rockslide is a slingshot physics game about pure destruction: one boulder, one long hill and a world full of things to break.

Every shot pays gold. Spend it on a stronger slingshot, a heavier rock and better income, then launch again and roll further. Break the gate at the end of each stage to open the next.

• Five worlds, each with its own material: timber, pottery, glass, stone and iron
• Chain breaks for a multiplier, then Slam, Boost and Blast your way through
• Upgrades never reset unless you choose to be reborn
• Record mode: an endless hill for your longest roll
• Plays offline. No ads. No energy. No waiting.

The first world, Timber Village, is free. Unlock the full game once to play all five worlds, rebirth and record mode.

name: Roger That CDL
description:
Getting a commercial driver's license starts with the written permit tests. Roger That CDL gets you ready for them with short lessons, practice questions with plain explanations, and a veteran trucker named Roger who talks you through it.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 709 practice questions, each with an explanation of why the right answer is right and why your pick was wrong
• 101 lesson cards that cover the material before you are quizzed on it
• General Knowledge, Air Brakes, Combination Vehicles, Driving Safely, Cargo, Basic Control, Rules and Hours, Pre-Trip, Tanker, Passenger, School Bus, and Doubles and Triples
• Pre-trip inspection: learn the walkaround part by part, with what to check and how to say it to the examiner
• Backing Yard: steer a tractor-trailer through straight line, offset, parallel and alley dock backing, or watch Roger do it first
• Drive & Study: 13 audio chapters, about two and a half hours, that keep playing with the phone locked
• Hear Roger: every lesson read aloud
• State notes for all 50 states and D.C.
• A CB and trucking glossary
• Fix my weak spots: the questions you missed come back until you get them
• A readiness gauge that shows how close you are, topic by topic

HAZMAT+
A separate set of lessons, questions and audio for the hazardous materials endorsement: paperwork, placards, hazard classes, loading and driving rules.

FREE TO START
General Knowledge, the first backing drill and the pre-trip walkaround lesson are free. One purchase unlocks the full CDL course. Hazmat+ is a second, separate purchase. Both are one-time purchases, not subscriptions, and Restore Purchases brings them back on a new phone.

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS
There is no sign-up and no advertising. Your progress stays on your device. The app works offline.

Roger That CDL is an independent study aid. It is not affiliated with FMCSA, any state licensing agency or any driving school, and it does not issue licenses. Always check your state's current CDL manual.

name: Roll Bet Donut
description:
Every hill brings a new challenge in this physics-based rolling game. Choose your target distance and guide a colorful donut across dynamically generated tracks filled with climbs, slopes, and unexpected obstacles. Discover how far your donut can travel while maintaining its speed and momentum.

Preview the entire 100-meter route before starting. Each round features a different track layout and starting height, creating new opportunities to experiment with movement and strategy. Steep hills, smooth descents, and changing terrain make every run a unique experience.

Explore different donuts, unlock useful upgrades, and improve your performance through daily bonuses and challenges. Experiment with various starting conditions, discover effective combinations, and develop your skills as you progress through increasingly demanding routes.

Review your results after each attempt, explore detailed statistics, and track your personal achievements. Compare previous runs, improve your distance records, and discover new ways to complete challenging tracks.

Features:
- Dynamically generated 100-meter tracks with varied terrain.
- Adjustable target distances from 10 to 100 meters.
- Six unique donuts with different movement characteristics.
- Four helpful boosts to customize gameplay.
- Player statistics, achievements, and personal records.
- Detailed run history with distances and results.

All gameplay activities use virtual in-game points and do not involve real-world transactions.

name: Roof Stair Framing Calculator
description:
Framing and roofing math for carpenters, roofers and builders. Type a pitch and a span and read the cut lengths. Lay out a stair and see right away whether it passes the IRC. The app is free, it has no paywall and no ads, and it works offline on the job site.

FEET, INCHES AND FRACTIONS
The tape calculator has keys for feet, inches and fractions, so you can type 5' 6-1/2" + 3' 8-3/4" the way you read a tape and get 9' 3-1/4". Answers come in feet and inches, inches, decimal feet and millimeters, rounded to the fraction you pick, from 1/2" down to 1/32". Your past results stay in a running tape.

ROOF PITCH AND RAFTERS
Convert rise and run to pitch, angle and pitch factor, or go the other way. The common rafter screen gives the line length, tail, total length, plumb and level cuts, bird's mouth and the rafter count at your spacing, with the ridge already taken off. The hip and valley screen gives the hip length, side cuts and the full list of jack rafter lengths at 16" or 24" on center.

STAIRS AND STRINGERS
Enter the total rise and get the number of risers, riser height, tread depth, total run and stringer length, with every cut point on the stringer listed. Each IRC 2021 R311.7 rule gets its own pass or fail row with the section number: max riser 7-3/4", min tread 10", the 3/8" variation limit, the 151" flight rise, width, 6' 8" headroom and nosing. If your town amends the code, set your own max riser and min tread in Settings.

ROOF AREA, SHINGLES AND LUMBER
Roof area for a gable or hip roof from its plan size and pitch, in squares with your waste percent, plus shingle bundles, ridge, eave and starter lengths. Board feet and cost for any stock. Wall studs with corners, openings and layout marks at 12", 16", 19.2" or 24" on center, and floor joist counts.

IT SHOWS ITS WORKING
Each calculator has a "How this is calculated" section with the formula, the assumptions and where the numbers come from. Codes vary by place, so check local code before you build.

SAVED JOBS STAY ON YOUR PHONE
Give a calculation a name and save it, open it later with the same inputs, or share the result as text with your crew. You don't need an account. Nothing you type leaves your iPhone, and your iCloud Backup includes it like any other app data. You can delete all of it in Settings.

Feet and inches by default, with a switch to millimeters and meters. Free, with no in-app purchases.

name: Rosewood Solitaire
description:
Rosewood is Spider Solitaire made to be easy on the eyes and kind to your evening.

BIG, CLEAR CARDS
Choose standard, large or extra large cards. Extra large uses a two-row table so every card stays easy to read. Rosewood works with larger text sizes and Reduce Motion.

EVERY DEAL CAN BE WON
Every deal and every level is checked before you see it, so there is always a way through. Undo and hints are always free.

A JOURNEY THROUGH THE ROSE GARDEN
Play short Spider levels with a goal. Each win earns stars, and stars restore an old rose garden piece by piece: the arch, the roses, the fountain.

CLASSIC SPIDER
The game you know, with 1, 2 or 4 suits. No move limit, no timer, as many deals as you like.

CHALLENGE SOMEONE YOU LOVE
Send the same deal to a friend or grandchild by message and see who finishes faster. They can play for free.

CALM BY DESIGN
No ads while you play. No countdowns. A small daily gift and a streak to keep, if you like.

Rosewood is free to play. Optional Rosewood Pro (monthly or yearly, with a free week to start) adds 1,000 coins every day. Payment is charged to your Apple ID; it renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, and you can cancel any time in your Apple ID settings.

name: RoundLog — QR Station Inspecti
description:
RoundMark keeps recurring facility inspections accountable without turning the job into paperwork.

BUILD A STATION ROUTE
Create fixed inspection points for doors, cameras, safety equipment, rooms or equipment. Give each point an area, a short code and a recurring cadence. The code can be printed beside its QR label.

SCAN AND CHECK
Start a round from the first screen. Scan a station label with the camera or use the visible station card. Mark a normal point with one tap, or record an exception with severity, a written note and optional photo evidence from the system photo picker.

CALCULATE WHAT IS DUE
When the round is completed, RoundMark stores each result locally and calculates the next due date from that station's cadence. The home screen puts due and overdue points first.

REVIEW A REAL AUDIT TRAIL
The Reports tab shows completed checks, exception history, station totals and a seven-day exception trend. Export the local record as CSV through the standard iOS share sheet.

FOUR LANGUAGES
English, German, Japanese and Simplified Chinese can be selected inside the app.

LOCAL FIRST
No account. No advertising. No analytics. Stations, records, notes, attachments and exports stay in the app's local storage. Camera frames are used only for on-device QR recognition. The optional Sunday reminder is a local notification.

FREE AND PRO
The free edition stores up to three stations. One purchase unlocks unlimited stations for this Apple ID; this is a one-time, non-consumable unlock, not a subscription. Purchase and restore use StoreKit. Restore Purchase is available in Settings and on the purchase screen.

RoundMark is intended for small property, maintenance, retail, fleet and facilities teams that need continuous evidence of recurring checks.

name: Route 66 Restoration
description:
Bring Route 66 back to life, one town at a time.

The interstate passed these towns by. Now the signs are dark, the windows are boarded, and the travelers are gone. Your Aunt June thinks the old road has one more good run in it.

Drive west from Seligman, Arizona to the Santa Monica Pier through eight real Route 66 towns. Restore 32 gas stations, cafés, motels, and trading posts by solving puzzles: rewire neon signs, mix paint to match faded originals, rebuild tile murals, untangle fuse boxes, and seat picky motel guests. Each building you reopen brings cars back to the road and unlocks a postcard of real Route 66 history.

• 32 restoration puzzles across 5 puzzle types, tougher every town and fresh each time you play
• Real towns and real history, from the 1926 birth of the highway to the end of the road
• Flip to dusk and watch every sign you've fixed glow
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no internet needed
• Big, clear text and one-thumb play

name: Rowmark
description:
Rowmark is a small knitting notebook for gauge, cast-on counts, and yarn on hand.

Count a swatch after it has rested: stitches in 10 cm, rows in 10 cm, and the needle you used. Rowmark stores those numbers. It does not guess a gauge from the yarn name.

A piece is the width you want, the length, and any ease you type. Finished width is width plus ease. Cast-on stitches are finished width divided by 10, times stitches per 10 cm, then rounded to the nearest whole stitch. Rows use length the same way. The page shows the exact product and the rounded number, and explains the arithmetic in one sentence. Changing the swatch later updates the count the next time you open the piece.

Yarn is grams you weigh times the band’s meters per 100 g. A piece can store meters you used, weighed before and after. The cast-on page subtracts that from the skein only when you have typed meters used. It will not invent yardage from a stitch count.

Short notes cover how to count a swatch, what ease means, how skein meters are calculated, and what rounding does. A sample book — stockinette, rib, a scarf, a pullover body, and two skeins — is there so the numbers are visible before you replace them.

Rowmark does not size a garment to a body, write a pattern, or estimate yarn from stitches. Your swatches, pieces, and skeins stay in a file on this phone.

name: rPodcasts
description:
rPodcasts is the app for your self-hosted rPodcasts server, part of the Rotten Ninja collection.

Follow podcasts and video channels on your server, and listen or watch on your phone. The app keeps a full copy of your library, so browsing, playlists, the queue and marking episodes played all work offline. Changes sync back to your server and your other devices when you are online.

• Smart playlists: build playlists from filters such as tags, channels, length, date and played state.
• Queue: line up exactly what plays next.
• Downloads: keep the newest or oldest episodes of any playlist on your device, within a storage limit you set, on Wi-Fi only if you like.
• Per-channel settings: playback speed, skip intros and outros, video quality.
• Playback: background audio, lock screen and headphone controls, chapters, sleep timer.
• Status page: every sync, download and deletion is listed with the reason it happened.

No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Your library lives on your server.

rPodcasts needs an rPodcasts server. See rpodcast.rotten.ninja for how to run one.

name: Rugby Timer: Referee Clock
description:
Rugby Timer is a match clock built by a rugby referee, for rugby referees. Set the match up on your iPhone, then run it from your Apple Watch. The clock, the sin-bins and the score stay on your wrist, so your eyes stay on the game.

RUN THE MATCH FROM YOUR WRIST
• A clear match clock for both halves, with half lengths from 40 down to 7 minutes for sevens
• Time played past the clock, recorded for each half
• Half-time break countdown (2, 5, 10 or 15 minutes, or your own) with an alert when it ends
• Alerts at half-time and when a sin-bin ends, even with your wrist down
• Accidental tap lock, so a sleeve or a wet glove doesn't change the match
• Each match runs as a Rugby workout: the Watch stays on the match from kick-off to full time, then saves it to Health with your distance, heart rate and energy (optional)
• No phone at the ground? Start a Quick Match straight from the Watch
• Log substitutions by shirt number, with an optional limit for each team

CARDS AND SIN-BINS
• Yellow cards start a sin-bin countdown (10 minutes by default, adjustable)
• See every player in the bin and how long they have left
• Red cards logged as sent off, with the shirt number
• Optional 20-minute red card: a countdown until the team can bring on a replacement
• A second yellow for the same player prompts a red card
• HIA (12 min) and blood replacement (15 min) timers, logged in the match record
• End a sin-bin early or fix a wrong shirt number with a tap

SCORING
• Tries (+5), penalty tries (+7), conversions (+2), penalty goals and drop goals (+3)
• Record the scorer's shirt number
• Half-time and full-time stats: the score by half and a scoring breakdown for each team
• Count penalties and free kicks against each team with one tap, split by half
• Tapped the wrong team or number? Undo the last score or card for 15 seconds

BEFORE AND AFTER THE MATCH
• Optional coin toss on the Watch to decide who kicks off
• Extra time for knockout matches: two 10-minute halves then sudden death, or 5-minute sudden-death periods for sevens
• End a match early if it's abandoned for weather, injury or the pitch
• A match record with every score and card, ready to share as text with the teams or your referees' society
• Match history: every finished match kept on your iPhone, ready to read and share again

WORKS YOUR WAY
• No Apple Watch? Run the whole match on your iPhone
• Follow the clock and score on your iPhone Lock Screen and Dynamic Island, in a Home Screen widget, and in a complication on your Watch face
• If the app closes or crashes mid-match, it reopens right where you were: clock, score and sin-bins included
• Save your default team names, half length, sin-bin length and shirt-number range
• Designed for direct sunlight and floodlights: high-contrast dark screens and large numbers
• In English, Spanish, French and Brazilian Portuguese

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts. No ads. No tracking. Your matches stay on your devices, and workouts go only to the Health app.

Requires an iPhone with iOS 26.5 or later. Apple Watch with watchOS 26.5 or later is optional.

name: RUP Facile
description:
RUP Facile rassemble les informations du personnel, les présences et les échéances de votre établissement dans une application en français, sans compte en ligne.

FICHES DU PERSONNEL
Renseignez l’identité, l’emploi, le contrat, la qualification et les dates d’entrée et de sortie. Retrouvez une personne par son nom ou sa fonction. Archivez les personnes sorties de l’effectif tout en conservant leur dossier.

Enregistrez les présences, absences et congés par date, avec des précisions si nécessaire. Consultez l’historique et exportez les relevés en PDF.

Suivez les dates de formation, de visite, d’habilitation ou autres échéances administratives. Programmez des rappels locaux après autorisation des notifications.

name: Sama Jamm
description:
Sama Jàmm, « ma paix » en wolof, réunit ce qui accompagne la journée : lire, écouter, prier, et tenir le budget du foyer.

Lire : le Coran verset par verset, en arabe seul, avec la translittération si vous l’activez ; les invocations du matin et du soir. Tout se lit sans réseau, la recherche aussi.

Écouter : récitations du Coran, téléchargement pour l’écoute hors ligne, minuterie douce pour s’endormir.

Prier : horaires calculés sur votre téléphone, l’arc du jour pour voir où en est la journée, appel et rappels prière par prière, qibla guidée, compteur de dhikr.

Ensemble : le khatm collectif, un juz chacun, le Coran terminé à plusieurs.

Le budget du foyer : une enveloppe par poste, la dépense du jour, l’épargne avec son intention, le calcul de la zakat et les dettes entre proches. Vos chiffres restent sur votre téléphone, chiffrés.

Aucune publicité, aucune série à perdre, aucun classement.

name: Saybai: Learn to Speak Thai
description:
Saybai gets you speaking Thai from your very first lesson. Say each phrase out loud and your phone checks it, so you build real speaking confidence instead of only recognising words on a screen.

WHAT YOU GET
• Short lessons that take a few minutes each
• All five Thai tones, colour-coded and trained by ear
• Speaking checked on every phrase, using your phone's speech recognition
• Real conversations: greetings, ordering food, prices, directions and more
• Reviews that bring words back before you forget them
• Streaks, daily goals and achievements to keep you going
• Polite forms for the way you speak (khráp or khâ)

A GUIDED PATH
Lessons run from A1 (survival Thai) to B2. Start with the tones and greetings for free.

SAYBAI PREMIUM
The first lessons are free. Saybai Premium unlocks every lesson and conversation. It is an auto-renewing subscription, available weekly or annually. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://saybai.meezoy.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://saybai.meezoy.com/privacy

name: Saystitch
description:
Saystitch turns speech into text you can use in messages, email, notes and other apps. Choose a writing style, tap the microphone, and dictate with the Saystitch keyboard.

Pick a style for the moment: Verbatim, Clean, Professional, Casual, Email, Message, Notes or AI Prompt. Add names and specialist terms to your personal dictionary. Prefer typing? The keyboard includes regular QWERTY keys too.

Your words stay on your device when possible

• Saystitch has no account or Saystitch-operated servers.
• Apple’s on-device speech model is used when available for your language and device. If it isn’t available, Apple’s speech recognition service may process your audio.
• AI writing styles use on-device Apple Intelligence when available. Otherwise, Saystitch applies basic local cleanup.
• Your settings, personal dictionary and recent dictation history are stored on your device. Clear history from the History tab at any time.
• The microphone starts when you choose to dictate. You can turn off the optional ready period in Settings; iOS shows its orange microphone indicator while the mic is active.
• Saystitch uses Keyboard Full Access to share dictation results and settings between the app and keyboard.

Speech model availability varies by language and device. Apple Intelligence styles require a supported device with Apple Intelligence enabled. Requires iOS 26 or later.

To use the keyboard, open Settings › General › Keyboard › Keyboards › Add New Keyboard › Saystitch, then enable Allow Full Access. For the first dictation after the microphone turns off, open Saystitch and follow the on-screen Start Dictation prompt.

name: SC PCA
description: SC PCA is designed for people moving in batches, linking item destinations, actual costs, and setup/disassembly inputs. After taking or importing photos, items can be selected, destination areas filled in, and boxes placed. A copy of the packing list is retained when sealing the boxes. Departure and arrival are scheduled by batch, with each item confirmed to be present, discrepancies recorded, and placement completed. The ledger records expenses, refunds, and subsidies, and verifies net expenses, cash balance, and budget surplus for each batch. Setup/disassembly periods correspond to specific boxes, allowing users to select the next step based on remaining minutes, deadlines, and available volume. Seven types of charts present changes in time, cost, efficiency, occupancy, placement, and cash, and support export and backup for easy tracking of the relocation process.

name: ScreenCaster Pro
description:
ScreenCaster Pro streams your iPhone screen, live, to a web browser. Open a link or type a 6-digit code on the other screen, start the broadcast on your iPhone, and whatever you see on your phone appears there a moment later. Nothing to install on the viewing side.

It works in the web browser built into many cars, so your phone's navigation, music and more can show on the car's big screen. It also works on a laptop, a TV browser or a friend's computer.

HOW IT WORKS
• Create a private stream in the app, or start one in the browser and pair your iPhone with its 6-digit code.
• Tap Start Broadcast and pick ScreenCaster Pro.
• Open the viewing link, or type the watch code, in the browser that should show your screen.
• Tap Pause Broadcast whenever you want a break, and End Stream to revoke the link.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Viewing links are long and random; codes work once and expire in 5 minutes.
• Streams end on their own after the time you choose.
• Your screen passes through our relay live and is never recorded or stored.
• No account, no email, no password.
• No audio and no microphone access.

SMOOTH AND EFFICIENT
• Hardware video encoding keeps the picture smooth while using little data.
• Automatically falls back to still images on browsers that can't play video.

SUBSCRIPTION
ScreenCaster Pro is free to download. Streaming requires the ScreenCaster Pro Monthly subscription, which starts with a 3-day free trial. It includes up to 30 hours of streaming per month and up to 2 viewers per stream. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when the trial ends, and the subscription renews monthly unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple ID's Subscriptions settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://ndilitechnologies.com/privacy_sc.html

Everything visible on your screen while broadcasting, including notifications, is shown to your viewers. Only share links and codes with people you trust. When using ScreenCaster Pro in a vehicle, follow local laws and keep your attention on the road.

name: SealNote: Encrypted Notes
description:
SealNote is a notes app for iPhone, iPad and Mac that encrypts everything on your device. Notes are sealed with AES-256-GCM before they are written to disk or sent to iCloud, so only you can read them.

YOUR NOTES STAY YOURS
• Encrypted on the device; the key is kept in your iCloud Keychain
• Syncs through your own iCloud — there is no SealNote server
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking; the developer collects no data
• A recovery key you can save in case iCloud Keychain is unavailable
• Lock with Face ID or Touch ID

WRITE AND ORGANIZE
• Notebooks inside notebooks, tags, pinned notes, favorites, trash
• Markdown editor with live formatting and a formatting bar
• Checklists you tick with a tap, and note templates
• Photos and files up to 50 MB, shown right in the note
• Take a photo or record a video straight into a note on iPhone and iPad

FIND ANYTHING
• Search note text, tags and the contents of attachments
• Text in pictures and PDFs is recognized on your device
• Found words are highlighted in the note, the picture and the PDF

SHARE A NOTEBOOK
• Invite other Apple users to a notebook, to read or to edit
• A shared notebook has a key of its own, so your other notes stay out of reach

MOVE IN
• Import from UpNote (Markdown export) and Evernote (ENEX files)
• Works offline: every note is kept on the device
• Interface in English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese and Russian

Requires iOS or iPadOS 17, or macOS 14, or later. Sync needs an iCloud account with iCloud Keychain turned on.

Privacy policy: https://sealnote.app/privacy/
Support: https://sealnote.app/support/

name: Sear AI: What Is It Worth?
description:
Standing at a flea market or thrift store in front of a packed table, with only seconds to decide? One photo is enough: Sear AI recognizes the items, tags everything worth reselling with a price label, and gives the best find the price star.

HOW IT WORKS
• Photograph a table or shelf, or pick a photo from your library
• Sear AI marks up to six finds right in the photo, most valuable first
• Each lot card shows what it is, what it might fetch, how sure the estimate is, and what to check
• For the best find, Sear AI looks up prices on the web and shows the listings with their platform
• Save finds: the catalog keeps the picture, the range and the total of all lots

HONEST LABELS
• Prices are ranges, not made-up single numbers
• Every number says where it comes from: Estimate, Asking or Sold
• How sure the estimate is, in plain words
• "Nothing here" is a result, too
• To double-check, open the search for sold and current listings

FAIR PRICING
• Your first table is free, no trial subscription
• A table is one photo including a price lookup for the best find; every further lookup costs one table
• 20 tables as a pack, paid once, never expire
• Year pass: 230 tables per year, on all your devices

PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your catalog stays on your iPhone. Photos go to our service only for the estimate and are not stored there.

Sear AI estimates with AI and can be wrong. Check an item before you buy it.

The year pass renews automatically for another year unless you cancel at least 24 hours before it ends in your Apple Account settings.

name: SecureGard
description:
SecureGard is the companion app for SecureGard workspace administrators. It shows the same information as your SecureGard web console, so you can check on your team's working day from anywhere.

WHAT YOU CAN SEE
• Overview: who is active or idle right now, total tracked time, screenshots, keyword alerts and devices for any day
• Team: every person's live status, the app they are using and their time today, with search
• Person: time by category, top applications and websites, a timeline of the day, recent screenshots and device health
• Screenshots: a grid of recent screenshots you can filter by person, view full-screen and pinch to zoom
• Alerts: keyword alerts from your policy, each linked to the screenshot that triggered it
• Apple Watch: a live team summary, people and alerts on your wrist

VIEW-ONLY BY DESIGN
The app never changes settings or monitoring data. Users, working hours, screenshot frequency and keywords stay in the web console, where they belong.

TRANSPARENT MONITORING
SecureGard is designed for open, lawful monitoring of work devices. The desktop agent is visible to employees in the menu bar or system tray, tracks only during the working hours you configure, and does not record keystrokes, the camera or the microphone. Your organisation must tell staff about monitoring before it starts, as our Terms of Service require.

REQUIREMENTS
A SecureGard workspace administrator account. Workspaces are set up by organisations at securegard.co.uk. This app does not create accounts or sell subscriptions.

Data is hosted in the United Kingdom and protected with TLS in transit.

name: Seekd: Remote for slskd

• History of your own giving.
• Simple sign-in with your Smart ID and date of birth.

FOR LEADERS
• Members: records with contact details, family and church history.
• Attendance, events, rosters and voting.
• Treasury: accounts, income and expenses, receipts and reports.
• Publish announcements with a notification to members.
• Access protected with two-step verification.

Accounts are created by the church itself: if you are a member and do not have your Smart ID yet, ask the church office.

Available in English, Spanish and Portuguese, in light and dark mode.

name: Sentilou
description:
Sentilou — votre compagne de location de matériel de montagne et de randonnée.

Préparez vos prochaines aventures en toute sérénité. Sentilou vous permet de consulter, choisir et réserver du matériel de montagne et de randonnée adapté à chaque terrain, du sentier balisé aux ascensions en altitude.

CATALOGUE CLAIR ET DÉTAILLÉ
Parcourez des fiches produit illustrées : photos, caractéristiques techniques et conseils d'usage pour chaque équipement, afin de partir avec le bon matériel.

UNE SÉLECTION POUR CHAQUE PROJET
Que vous partiez en randonnée familiale, en trekking sur plusieurs jours ou en sortie d'alpinisme, retrouvez des références correspondant à votre niveau et à votre itinéraire.

RÉSERVATION SIMPLE
Sélectionnez un article, confirmez votre demande et recevez une confirmation claire. Le règlement s'effectue à la livraison, sans paiement préalable dans l'application.

ESPACE PERSONNEL
Retrouvez vos commandes, vos favoris et vos sorties enregistrées, et suivez l'évolution de vos locations au même endroit.

CARNET DE BORD
Conservez vos repères et préparez sereinement vos prochaines sorties.

CONFiance ET DROITS
Sentilou respecte vos droits : vous pouvez à tout moment consulter les conditions générales et la politique de confidentialité, ainsi que supprimer votre compte directement depuis l'application. Conformément à la législation française, vous disposez d'un délai de rétractation de 14 jours pour les commandes à distance.

Une question ? Contactez notre équipe depuis la section Profil de l'application.

name: Seongsu Convenience Store
description:
Seongsu-dong, Seoul. By day, crowds line up for pop-up stores and photos. By night, only dark signs and empty alleys remain.
Eighteen-year-old Tein just got into college, and he has three months to kill. So he takes the night shift at Seongsu 24, a quiet convenience store tucked down a back alley.
No customers, no stress. A sweet gig… until 3:12 a.m., when someone speaks to him in the empty store.

"Help me… please…"

■ One case per episode, one big story across them all
- A pop-up store staffer, an old shoemaker, a voice from the old factory town… Listen to the people the Seongsu night left behind, and help them let go.
- Every case reveals one more piece of a bigger puzzle. What has Tein's family been hiding from each other all these years?

■ Part-time clerk, part-time exorcist
- Ring up customers, stock shelves, mop the floor, then search for clues.
- A different mini-game every episode: pronunciation rhythm drills, mantra echoes, badminton smashes and more.
- The more you listen to the dead, the more it wears you down. Keep an eye on your "Me" gauge as you choose.

■ Funny, spooky, and heartfelt
- A hero who trips over his own words, a dad with endless dad jokes, a sharp-tongued mom, and a suspicious older sister.
- Half comedy, half chills and tears. A bite-sized adventure in portrait mode, like a web drama you play one episode at a time.

■ You'll love it if you
- enjoy short, episodic story games
- like ghost stories but not full-on horror
- love stories about family, neighborhoods, and ordinary people

* Episodes 1–5 are free. From Episode 6, unlock episodes one at a time with coins, by watching an ad, or with one free episode a day, or unlock all remaining episodes at once.
* Progress is saved on this device. Deleting the app resets your progress.

name: Sepawrate
description:
Help your dog feel calm when you leave.

Dogs with separation anxiety panic when they're alone. They might bark, howl, pace, chew the door or have accidents. Scolding doesn't help, because it's fear, not bad behavior. What does help is practice: lots of short absences that end before your dog gets worried. Over weeks, your dog learns that being alone is OK and that you always come back.

Sepawrate guides you through that practice, one calm departure at a time.

HOW IT WORKS
• Find the baseline: time how long your dog is OK alone before showing stress.
• Stay under it: each session is a short departure that ends while your dog is still calm.
• Grow slowly: after calm sessions, the next one is a little longer. After a hard one, it's shorter.
• Rate every session: say how it went and how the day had been, so the app can spot patterns.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• A plan that adapts. Each departure is set from your dog's last calm session. Planned short sessions, called easy wins, keep confidence up.
• A simple timer. Step out, and Sepawrate keeps time, even on your Lock Screen. If your dog gets worried, end early. That's a good call, not a failure.
• Patterns you'd miss. Sepawrate notices what makes sessions harder, like stormy days, evenings or skipping a walk, and tells you in plain words.
• Hard-day warnings. Get a heads-up about storms and fireworks holidays, so you can keep sessions short or take a rest day.
• Departure cues. Practice picking up keys, putting on shoes and opening the door without leaving, so the signs that you're going stop meaning panic.
• Progress worth seeing. A clear chart of time alone, weekly goals that rest days never break, and badges for good choices, like ending early.
• Short guides. Seven easy reads on how separation anxiety training works, signs of stress, setting up a calm space, and when to get more help.
• Widgets. See the next session and your week at a glance on your Home Screen and Lock Screen.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no sign-in, no ads and no tracking. Your dog's sessions stay on your device, with an optional backup to your own iCloud Drive. Location is only used if you turn on auto weather.

FREE
Sepawrate is free, with no ads and nothing to unlock.

A NOTE FROM ME
I'm a dog parent, not a vet or a trainer. Sepawrate is built on what I learned helping my own dog feel safe home alone, and I made it to share that with other dog parents going through the same thing.

Every dog is different, so I can't promise results for yours. Sepawrate is a training helper, not medical or professional advice. Please check with your vet or a dog behaviorist, and get help right away if your dog hurts themselves, stops eating or gets worse.

Works on iPhone and iPad with iOS 17 or later. AI insights need a device with Apple Intelligence.

name: Seral Venice
description:
Seral is a collective of young people in Venice. This is our app.

What's on: the nights we'd go to ourselves. DJ sets, gigs, bars, parties. Chosen one by one, not pulled from a list.

Around town: what else the city is doing. Exhibitions, films, theatre, Venezia and Reyer home games, regattas.

Swipe through the first deck and the app learns what you like. Follow the venues you care about and hear from them once, when they announce something. Find your friends from your contacts and see who's going.

Near you: tonight, on a map.

Seral is run by Seral APS, a non-profit association in Venice. No ads.

name: Serventi Display
description:
Serventi Display is the app for running your venue's digital screens.

Sign in to your Serventi Display account to manage what appears on your menu boards and signage — from your iPhone or iPad, wherever you are.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• See which screens are online and add a new one with a six-digit pairing code
• Update playlists, menus, images and videos, then publish to your screens
• Change prices or mark an item unavailable so every board stays accurate
• Manage more than one screen or location from the same account
• Use this iPad or iPhone as a display at events or pop-ups — pair it, play full screen, and keep the screen awake until you leave display mode

Already have a compatible Android TV or Google TV? Install the Serventi Display player from Google Play on the television, then pair it from this app. You can also use a Serventi Display Adapter, or the browser player, with the same account.

An account is required. This app is for businesses that use Serventi Display to run their screens. Open an account at display.serventi.co.uk.

Serventi Display — Your Screens. Your Content. Your Control.

Built in the UK. Support: info@serventi.co.uk

name: ServerScope
description:
ServerScope helps you check websites and Plesk hosting panels from your iPhone.

Save your endpoints, refresh when you need an update, and review the latest saved results.

FEATURES
• Run on-demand availability checks.
• View HTTP status and response time.
• Check HTTPS certificate expiry when available.
• Keep your saved monitors on your device.

PLESK PANEL CHECKS
Add your Plesk panel’s HTTPS address, including its port when needed—for example, https://panel.example.com:8443.

Refresh to check the panel endpoint’s response, response time, and HTTPS certificate expiry when available.

No Plesk credentials are required. ServerScope does not sign in to Plesk, access its management API, or manage websites, email, databases, or server settings. A responding Plesk login page does not confirm that all hosted websites or services are healthy.

IMPORTANT LIMITATIONS
Checks run when you refresh. ServerScope does not provide continuous background monitoring or guaranteed uptime alerts.

Saved results describe the last check, not necessarily the current server state. Certificate expiry may be unavailable for some endpoints.

Only check systems you own or have permission to monitor.

OPTIONAL AI ASSISTANT
The AI assistant is currently an owner-only pilot and is not available to general users.

SUPPORT
For help, contact support@serverscope.se.

ServerScope is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Plesk.

name: Serviced: Car Service History
description:
Serviced turns the pile of garage receipts in your glovebox into a clear record of everything done to your car.

Scan a receipt with the camera or import a photo. Serviced reads it on your device, suggests the date, garage, mileage, cost and each job on the invoice, and you confirm. The original receipt stays attached, one tap away.

WHAT YOU GET
• A timeline of every visit, for every vehicle you own
• Each receipt broken into its jobs: oil, brakes, tires, battery and more
• A status view showing when each part of the car was last looked at
• History per component, so "when were the brakes last done?" has an answer
• Odometer readings alongside the work
• The original receipt image, zoomable, kept with the record

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything stays on your device
• No account, no sign-up, no ads, no tracking
• Nothing is uploaded: the reading is done by Apple Intelligence on your iPhone or iPad
• Optional Face ID lock

GOOD TO KNOW
• Receipt scanning needs a device with Apple Intelligence turned on. Without it, you can still add and edit records by hand.
• You stay in charge: Serviced suggests, you confirm, and you can correct anything.
• Works on iPhone, iPad, and iPhone Duo.

Useful when you sell the car, make a warranty claim, or just want to know what was done and when.

name: Sesinle Masal: Uyku Masalları
description:
Her gece bir masal. Kahramanı çocuğunuz, sesi sizin.

Bir kez yaklaşık bir dakika konuşun; Sesinle Masal, çocuğunuzun başrolde olduğu yepyeni masalları sizin sesinizle okusun. Geç kaldığınız akşamlarda da, yolda olduğunuz gecelerde de.

ÜÇ ADIMDA İLK MASAL
- Sesinizi kaydedin: sessiz bir odada yaklaşık bir dakika, ekrandaki metni sesli okuyun. Açık rızanızla sesinizden bir ses modeli oluşturulur.
- Çocuğunuzu tanıtın: adı, yaşı (2-10) ve sevdikleri: uzay, deniz, dinozor, kedi... İsterseniz bir hedef de ekleyin, "diş fırçalamak" gibi.
- Masallar gelsin: ilk 2 masal hediye. Abonelikte her hafta 3 yeni masal ve klasik masallar sizin sesinizle hazırlanır.

NELER VAR
- Kahraman çocuğunuz: her masalda adı geçer, sevdiği şeyler hikâyeye girer, küçük bir ders yumuşakça anlatılır.
- Sizin sesiniz: uzaktayken bile çocuğunuz uykuya tanıdık ve güven veren bir sesle dalar.
- Klasik masallar: Keloğlan'dan Kırmızı Başlıklı Kız'a, sevilen klasikler de sizin sesinizle okunur.
- Kendi masalınız: yazdığınız metni sizin sesinizle okutun (abonelikte).
- İnternetsiz dinleyin: masallar telefona iner; uçakta, yolda ya da köyde dinlenir.
- Uyku zamanlayıcısı ve kararan ekran: masal bitince ses yavaşça kısılır.
- Uyku için yazıldı: sakin bir dil; şiddet, korku ve kötü karakter yok. Her masal huzurla uykuya dalarak biter.

SESİNİZ SİZİN
Ses kaydı KVKK kapsamında özel nitelikli kişisel veridir. Yalnızca açık rızanızla ve yalnızca sizin masallarınız için kullanılır, şifreli korunur. Sesinizi ya da tüm hesabınızı istediğiniz an uygulama içinden tek dokunuşla silersiniz. Hesap açmak, e-posta ya da şifre gerekmez. Reklam ve analitik yoktur.

FİYAT
- 2 masal hediye: kayıt sonrası kısa bir kişisel masal, ardından seçtiğiniz uzun bir masal. Kart bilgisi istenmez.
- Aylık abonelik: her hafta 3 yeni kişisel masal ve klasik masal kütüphanesi.
- Yıllık abonelik: aylık plana göre yaklaşık yüzde 44 tasarruf.
Ödeme, satın alma onaylandığında Apple Kimliği hesabınızdan alınır. Abonelik, dönem bitmeden en az 24 saat önce iptal edilmezse otomatik yenilenir ve yenileme ücreti dönem bitmeden önceki 24 saat içinde alınır. Aboneliği iPhone Ayarlar > Apple Kimliği > Abonelikler bölümünden yönetebilir ve iptal edebilirsiniz. Hediye masallar bir deneme süresi değildir; abonelik kendiliğinden başlamaz.

Kullanım Koşulları (EULA): https://www.diclesoftware.com/sesinlemasal/kosullar/
Gizlilik Politikası (KVKK): https://www.diclesoftware.com/sesinlemasal/gizlilik/
Destek: destek@diclesoftware.com

Dicle Software

name: Set Block
description: Set Block is for a beginner who has just closed the Hangul chart and is still in the chair. One empty square is on the desk. Choose a basic or double consonant, then a basic or compound vowel. This iPhone builds the syllable block, writes the reading, and shows whether the vowel sits on the right, sits below, or wraps the consonant. The squares you set stay on this iPhone, with a count of how many of the 399 open syllables are still unset.

name: Seyir: Video & Live Streams
description:
Seyir is a calm video browser that puts you in charge of what you watch. It opens public sites such as YouTube, Twitch and Kick in one app, gathers the channels you follow into one list and shows you how much you watch. No account, no tracking: your history and follows stay on your phone.

FOCUS
• Hide Shorts, recommendations and comments
• Intent check: asks "What are you here for?" when you open a site
• A daily watch time and per-channel limits; when time is up, the curtain falls
• Content rules: hide channels, keywords and videos you never want to see

WATCH BETTER
• Skip sponsored segments automatically (community data from SponsorBlock)
• See a video's estimated dislike count
• Listening mode with the screen off, and a sleep timer
• Picture in Picture, Lock Screen and Control Center controls
• Chapters, caption size and skip interval settings
• Continue where you left off, a watch later list, and tabs

FOLLOW
• Follow YouTube, Twitch and Kick channels in one list, no account needed
• See which Twitch and Kick channels are live
• Back up your library; export your YouTube channels as OPML

STAY PRIVATE
• Content filters for ads, trackers, pop-ups and cookie notices, each one on or off as you like
• Private tabs: never written to history, cookies deleted when the last one closes
• App lock with Face ID, Touch ID or passcode
• Pause or clear your history any time

LOGBOOK
• Your weekly watch and listening time, time saved by skipping sponsors and mobile data saved
• Share your week as a single card

MAKE IT YOURS
• Light and dark themes, alternative app icons, floating button styles
• English, Turkish, Finnish, Spanish, Russian and Arabic

Seyir is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by Google, YouTube, Twitch, Kick or SponsorBlock. These names are trademarks of their owners. Content belongs to the sites and their creators; Seyir does not download, host or redistribute content.

Privacy and terms: https://www.senoldogan.dev/app-policy/seyir

name: Sfragis: OpenPGP Encryption
description:
Sfragis is a free, open-source OpenPGP app for iPhone, iPad and Mac. Create keys, swap them by QR code, and encrypt, sign and verify messages, all on your device.

YOUR KEYS STAY HERE
• Keys are created and stored on your device, in an encrypted keyring locked by a key in the iOS Keychain.
• Each private key is also protected by its own passphrase, which is never saved.
• No accounts, servers, analytics or tracking. Sfragis makes no network connections.

EVERYTHING YOU NEED
• Ed25519 or RSA 4096 keys, with expiry and revocation
• Import keys from text, files or QR codes
• Encrypt to one or more people and sign as yourself
• Decrypt, with a clear report of who signed
• Copy, share or show results as a QR code

KEYS BY QR CODE
• Show your public key as a QR code, or as a short looping sequence when it is too big for one.
• Scan a contact's fingerprint code to confirm you hold their real key.

WORKS WITH STANDARD TOOLS
Sfragis uses standard OpenPGP, so it works with GnuPG, Thunderbird, Proton Mail and other OpenPGP software.

OPEN SOURCE
Every line of Sfragis is public under the MIT licence at github.com/meltemiapps/sfragis. Read it, build it, audit it.

name: Shadowing: Loop & Repeat
description:
Shadow any audio you own: split it into sentences, loop, slow down, record yourself and compare against the original, offline.

What you get:
- Turn any audio into sentence drills
- Loop, slow down, repeat
- Record and compare with the original
- See your intonation next to the native speaker
- Any language. Offline. Pay once.

Free to start. One in-app purchase adds the rest, with no subscription.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

name: Sharp: Macro & Focus Stacking
description:
Sharp turns a series of photos focused at different distances into one image that is sharp from front to back, right on your iPhone or iPad.

Get close to an insect, a flower or a ring and only a thin slice is in focus. Focus stacking fixes that. Shoot a focus series with the built-in camera or import one you already have, and Sharp aligns, blends and renders a single all-in-focus photo.

SHOOT A FOCUS SERIES
• The built-in camera steps focus from near to far for you
• Starts on the closest-focusing lens, including Ultra Wide macro on supported iPhones
• Automatic frame count, or set frames, step and spacing yourself
• Focus peaking, loupe and grid to frame your subject
• Waits until the phone is steady before each shot
• HEIF or Apple ProRAW on supported devices
• Coverage chart shows how sharp each frame is and flags blurry ones before you leave the scene

IMPORT WHAT YOU ALREADY SHOT
• Import from Photos or Files: JPEG, HEIF, PNG, TIFF and camera RAW
• Sharp splits a shoot into separate focus series automatically
• Works with focus-bracketed series from mirrorless and DSLR cameras

STACK YOUR WAY
• Four stacking methods: Depth Map, Pyramid, Average and Wavelets
• Live preview grows frame by frame while the stack builds
• Tripod and hand-held alignment
• Sharpness map and depth map show where every detail comes from
• Full-resolution final render, even for large high-megapixel stacks

COMPARE, FINISH, EXPORT
• Compare results side by side, with a split slider or flicker
• Crop with aspect presets and straighten
• Adjust exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, temperature and vibrance, non-destructively
• Export 16-bit TIFF, 10-bit HEIF or JPEG in sRGB or Display P3
• Save to Photos or Files, or share, with the source frames if you need them

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything runs on your device. No account, no uploads, no tracking.

Great for macro, insects, flowers, jewelry and product shots, coins, minerals, miniatures and landscapes.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://gist.github.com/ToMark1881/9ae1fd5a6868191709f17d0cb06b6c47

name: Sheave Span
description:
Sheave Span keeps belt drives on this iPhone. Enter the large and small sheave pitch diameters, the center distance, and the belt section.

Pitch length is 2C plus half of pi times the two diameters, plus the square of their difference over four times the center. The nearest catalog length is marked. Choosing one sets the center that fits it. The small-sheave arc and the span over 64 deflection are on their own screens. Drag a sheave to change the center, or drag the measured sag against the target.

Drives stay in a file on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Shift Alarm: Roster Calendar
description:
Enter a rotating roster once, see every shift on a calendar, get a wake alarm matched to each shift, and total hours worked.

What you get:
- Your whole roster in one tap
- Alarms that match every shift
- Rings even on silent (iOS 26)
- Hours and overtime per pay period
- Add a partner's or second job's roster

Free to start. One in-app purchase adds the rest, with no subscription.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

Before you buy:
- Alarms that sound in silent mode need iOS 26 or later.

name: Shift Tracker by SCPB
description:
Shift Tracker is the app South Central Photo Booths' crew use to run every event, from leaving home to packing up the booth.

On the day
- Your next check-in and a countdown on the lock screen and in the Dynamic Island
- Check in or tell Scott you're running late right from the lock screen
- Shift Tracker on Apple Watch: your next check-in with a Check in button, and the booth's numbers while it's open
- "Hey Siri, check in with Shift Tracker"
- Setup photos sent straight from the Photos app to your shift
- Booth numbers while the booth is open: sessions, prints and paper left

After the event
- Talk through the night instead of typing the post-event form, then check what it filled in
- Scan a parking or toll receipt and it's added to your pay

Every day
- Confirm a new shift, or pick up an open one, right from the notification
- Your weekly hours and time off in one place, including time off that repeats
- Check your calendar for busy days and add them as time off in one tap
- Widgets for your next shift, what's ready to be paid, and what's coming up
- Find any of your shifts from iPhone search
- Your hours, pay and past events in one place

Shift Tracker is for South Central Photo Booths staff. You can sign in once we've added you.

name: ShiftBell - Shift Alarm Clock
description:
ShiftBell puts your work shifts and your alarms in one place.
Decide once — for example "2 hours before my shift starts" — and every time you add or change a shift, ShiftBell sets your iPhone alarms for you.

■ Made for shift workers
・Anyone whose working hours change from day to day: early, late, night shifts
・Nurses and care workers, restaurant and retail staff, factory shift workers
・Part-time workers on a rotating schedule

■ Alarms that follow your shifts
・Set alarms relative to your start or end time: "2 h 45 min before start", "30 min before end", and more
・Limit an alarm to certain shifts or weekdays ("early shifts only", "weekdays only")
・Create as many alarms as you like, with adjustable snooze
・Change or delete a shift and the old alarms are removed automatically
・If an alarm can't be set, the app tells you clearly

■ Easy shift planning
・Color-coded monthly calendar
・Tap a template (Early, Day, Late, Night…) and save
・Adjust the time for a single day with a "Custom" shift
・Overnight shifts (e.g. 22:00 – 7:00 next day)
・Add many days at once, or copy the previous day, week or month
・Notes for each day

■ And more
・Share your monthly schedule as text or an image
・Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets (today's and tomorrow's shift, next alarm)
・12 original alarm sounds, vibration only, or import your own audio
・8 theme colors and Dark Mode
・Optional Japanese public holidays

■ No account needed
Your shifts and notes stay on your iPhone.

■ About ads
All features are free. A one-time in-app purchase removes ads.

* Alarms use iOS's alarm system (AlarmKit). Please allow alarms when asked on first use.
* Depending on the state of your device, alarms may not ring. For important plans, please use another method as well.

name: Shimeji: Draw & Animate Pets
description:
Draw your own little characters, bring them to life frame by frame, and play with them on the Playground.

DRAW AND ANIMATE
Start from scratch or from a picture of your own. Draw every pose in the Art Editor with brush, eraser, fill and colours, and add frames to animate each move. In the Character Creator you decide how your character walks, climbs, falls and reacts when you tap, drag or throw it, and you test it live before it joins the Playground.

PLAY ON THE PLAYGROUND
Your characters walk along the floor, climb the walls and tumble back down. Tap, drag and throw them and watch them react. Playing earns XP, and every level unlocks new moves.

RAISE 3D CATS
Adopt cuddly 3D cats, each with its own personality, needs and friends. Pet them, feed them, play with the yarn ball and dress them up with a party hat. Copy a cat and paint its coat with your finger, right on the 3D model.

COLLECT ORIGINAL CHARACTERS
Browse dozens of original characters, each with its own moves and levels, and add your favourites to your collection.

YOUR CHARACTERS, YOUR FILES
Export your creations as files and send them with AirDrop, Messages or Files. Open character files your friends made, and import classic Shimeji character packs you own.

FULLSCREEN FOR YOUR VIDEOS
Fullscreen hides every button, so only your characters are on the stage: a plain background, a green screen or a photo of your own.

Your characters and drawings stay on your device, and there is no account to create. Anonymous usage statistics help us improve the app; change your choice any time in Settings.

name: Shise
description:
A fresh way to see the photos you already love.

Shise brings your chosen photos together by color and capture season. Find a shared shade, revisit a time of year, and turn a selection into a poster. Color analysis runs on your iPhone. Your photos are not uploaded to the developer.

FIND YOUR COLORS
Browse red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, purple, black, and white. Use Clear dominant to keep only distinct main colors, or Assign all to place successfully analyzed photos into the nine colors. Manual color choices take priority and can be reset to automatic.

REVISIT THE SEASONS
Explore spring, summer, autumn, and winter, then narrow a season by color. Seasons follow a Northern Hemisphere calendar: Mar–May, Jun–Aug, Sep–Nov, and Dec–Feb. Photos without a capture date have their own view.

MAKE A PHOTO POSTER
Create a 4- or 9-tile collage. Lock your favorites, drag to rearrange, or shuffle for another selection. Export a 2040 × 2240 JPEG through the system share sheet. The all-seasons poster uses a fixed four-tile layout; other layouts depend on the selected content.

START WITH A SCOPE
Choose albums and dates before analysis. See color and season distributions within that confirmed scope and save in-app favorites. After your confirmation, add photos to albums in Photos. Shise only adds album memberships; it does not move or delete originals.

CLASSIFICATION AND PRIVACY
Color labels are based on thumbnail statistics, not object recognition, and may differ from your own judgment. Other contains analyzed photos without a clear dominant color and is separate from pending or failed photos. Seasons follow capture dates, not the scene in the picture.

Normal color scanning requests locally available images only. You can explicitly allow iCloud downloads to retry cloud photos. Browsing thumbnails, opening photos, and exporting may also trigger system downloads, using time and data according to your connection and settings.

No account required. Favorites, manual colors, and analysis caches are stored locally. Shise does not provide its own cross-device sync. Deleting the app removes local data without deleting originals from your photo library.

name: Short Folio
description:
Short Folio is a local studio binder for short-drama creators.
Keep every series organized with covers, loglines, cast notes, and production status. Draft episodic scripts with hooks and synopses. Sketch storyboard beats with shot type, camera move, and dialogue hints. Build launch packs with cover stills, headlines, CTAs, and hashtags for Douyin, Kuaishou, and RedNote.
Everything stays on your iPhone—no account required. Search and filter across Projects, Scripts, Boards, and Launch. Share scripts or promo copy when you’re ready. Sample Chinese micro-drama workflows are included in English so you can explore a complete creative path on day one.
Made for writers, directors, and producers who want a focused place to archive projects and move the next episode forward.

name: Shot to Memory
description:
Screenshots full of useful text get buried in your photo library. Shot to Memo turns the text in the photos you pick into notes you can search.

PICK PHOTOS, GET NOTES • Select several photos at once and get a separate note for each. • Text is recognized on your device. No sign-in or internet connection needed. • The time the photo or screenshot was taken and its location are saved with the note.

KEY POINTS AND TAGS, AUTOMATICALLY • On supported devices, on-device AI writes the key points, a title and tags for you. • The full recognized text is always kept, so you can check it or switch back at any time. • Edit or delete tags freely, and filter your notes by tag.

EASY TO FIND AGAIN • Search by title, note text, original recognized text or tag. • Tap phone numbers and links in a note to open them. • Zoom into the original photo. • Open a note's location in the map app you prefer.

SEND IT WHERE YOU NEED IT • Add a note to your calendar or share it to Notes and other apps.

YOUR PRIVACY • Only the photos you pick are read, and the app never copies your photos. • Notes stay on this device and are never sent to the developer.

Text recognition and summaries can miss or misread things, so check important details against the original photo. Key points and automatic tags work on devices that support Apple Intelligence with it turned on. On other devices, the full recognized text is saved as the note.

name: ShutterLink Pro
description:
COMPATIBLE WITH NIKON Z8 — connect by USB-C cable or Wi-Fi.

ShutterLink Pro turns your iPad into a big, fast tethering screen for your Nikon Z8. See exactly what your camera sees, change settings from the iPad, and receive every shot the moment you press the shutter.

FREE TO DOWNLOAD — TRY EVERYTHING THAT MATTERS
The free version includes USB-C connection, full-screen live view, tap-to-focus, aperture / shutter speed / ISO control and shooting from the iPad, plus up to 20 JPEG photos a day transferred to the iPad. Your photos are always saved on the camera's memory card.

SHUTTERLINK PRO — ONE-TIME PURCHASE ($14.99, no subscription)
• Unlimited photo transfers
• Full-size RAW (NEF) files, alongside your JPEGs
• Save every shot to the Photos app automatically
• Self-timer from 1 to 59 seconds, with multiple shots
• Wi-Fi connection — shoot without the cable
Bought once, works on all your iPads with the same Apple ID.

FULL-SCREEN LIVE VIEW
• Large live view straight from the camera, on the whole iPad screen
• Tap anywhere to move the focus point and autofocus
• The focus box follows the camera: red, blinking while focusing, green when sharp — even when you half-press the shutter on the camera itself
• Turn live view off to see only your settings and save battery

FULL CAMERA CONTROL
• Aperture, shutter speed and ISO, with ISO Auto
• Image quality: JPEG Fine, RAW, or RAW + JPEG Fine
• Release mode (S, CL, CH, high-speed frame capture, self-timer up to 59 s)
• Exposure compensation, metering, white balance, Picture Control, Active D-Lighting, flash compensation, bracketing
• Focus mode, AF-area mode, VR, silent mode, skin softening, portrait impression balance
• Turn the camera monitor off, lock or unlock the camera body controls, HDMI external recording control
• Everything stays in sync: change a setting on the camera and the iPad updates

EVERY SHOT, INSTANTLY
• Photos arrive on the iPad automatically after each shot — from the iPad or from the camera's own shutter button
• Originals always stay on the camera's memory card

REVIEW LIKE THE PHOTOS APP
• Full-screen viewer: swipe between photos, pinch or double-tap to zoom and check focus
• Filter by JPEG, RAW or starred; select several photos to delete at once
• Share any photo in one tap

BUILT FOR THE STUDIO
• Reconnects automatically if the cable is unplugged
• Keeps the camera's clock in sync with the iPad
• Demo mode lets you try everything without a camera

COMPATIBILITY
• Nikon Z8 — USB-C (use a USB-C data cable) or Wi-Fi (camera in "Connect to computer", direct connection; the app pairs with the camera itself — no computer needed)
• iPad with USB-C, iPadOS 17 or later
• The cable is recommended for the fastest RAW transfers and live view

Nikon and Z8 are trademarks of Nikon Corporation. ShutterLink Pro is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nikon.

name: Sibyla AI Keyboard
description:
Sibyla AI Keyboard je česká klávesnice, která tuší, co chceš napsat, i když píšeš rychle a bez háčků a čárek. Napíšeš „dekuji za krasny vecer“, ťukneš na mezeru a na displeji stojí „Děkuji za krásný večer“. Nic nepřepínáš ani nedržíš. Pomáhá jí slovník, tvarosloví a malá neuronová síť (AI), která běží přímo v telefonu.

ROZUMÍ ČEŠTINĚ
• Diakritiku doplní po mezeře podle slovníku a okolních slov. V testu na 250 větách bez diakritiky doplnila správně 98,5 % slov.
• Pozná, kdy jde o „byt“ a kdy o „být“, „dobře“ nebo „dobré“, „zda“ nebo „zdá“. Rozhodne podle slov okolo, a když následující slovo napoví jinak, předchozí opraví.
• Malá neuronová síť přímo v telefonu odhadne z předchozích slov pád, číslo a osobu. Po „jdu s kamar“ nabídne „kamarádem“, po „k sestr“ „sestře“, po „my děl“ „děláme“.
• Tvarosloví MorfFlex CZ zná 210 744 tvarů od 46 982 slov. Po dopsaném slově nabídne jiné koncovky (vidím pes → psa) a ťuknutím slovo vyměníš.
• Pozná, jestli o sobě píšeš v mužském, nebo ženském rodě, a podle toho nabízí „byla“ a „ráda“, nebo „byl“ a „rád“.
• Překlep opraví sama, jen když si je jistá. Ostatní opravy nabídne v liště a rozhodnutí nechá na tobě.
• Anglická slova v české větě nechá být: „Meeting máme zítra v deset, pak call s klientem.“
• Nesahá na diakritiku, kterou napíšeš sám, na hesla, e-maily, webové adresy ani na zkratky jako DPH nebo YouTube.
• Smazat hned po opravě vrátí, co jsi napsal, a Sibyla si to slovo zapamatuje.

POHODLNÉ PSANÍ
• Přejeď z písmene nahoru a přidáš čárku (á é í ó ú ý). Dolů přidáš háček nebo kroužek (č ď ě ň ř š ť ž ů).
• Mezi klávesami není hluché místo. Ťuk do mezery mezi nimi se počítá bližší klávese.
• Učí se, kam na písmena dopadá tvůj prst, a hranici mezi nimi posune nejvýš o čtvrtinu klávesy. Klávesy vypadají pořád stejně.
• Podržením písmene vybereš číslici nebo další znak (ë, ľ, ł, ß). Tečka přejetím nahoru dá otazník, dolů vykřičník, čárka přejetím nahoru české uvozovky „ “.
• Tažením po mezerníku posouváš kurzor. Tažením z klávesy Smazat doleva mažeš po celých slovech.
• Dvě mezery za slovem dají tečku. Klávesa se smajlíkem vedle čárky otevře smajlíky.
• Píšeš klidně dvěma palci najednou, rychlé ťuky se neztrácejí.
• Enter se jmenuje podle toho, kde píšeš: Odeslat, Hledat, Přejít, Hotovo.
• Pozná, do jakého pole píšeš. V poli pro kód z SMS nebo číslo karty začne čísly. V e-mailu má u mezerníku @ a podržením tečky vybereš .cz nebo .com.

VELKÝ DISPLEJ I JEDNA RUKA
• Na telefonu otočeném na šířku a na každém dost širokém displeji se klávesnice rozdělí na dvě půlky u okrajů. Na všechno dosáhneš palci a mezerník vede přes obě půlky.
• Na běžném a předním displeji zůstává celá, jen se roztáhne do šířky.
• Jednoruční režim přisune klávesy k pravé, nebo levé ruce.

NASTAVÍŠ SI JI PODLE SEBE
• 30 voleb v šesti skupinách najdeš přímo v klávesnici pod hvězdičkami vlevo v liště. U každé volby vidíš, co udělá, a změna platí hned. Výchozí nastavení je vyladěné.
• Síla autokorekce: Šetrná, Jen diakritika, nebo Vypnutá.
• Citlivost přejetí a výška kláves mají po třech stupních. Dokončování slov začne od druhého, třetího, nebo čtvrtého písmene.
• Tvar kláves ve třech podobách, světlé nebo tmavé barvy, tučné nebo větší písmo, QWERTZ i QWERTY a stálá řada čísel.
• Tlačítkem Zapomenout naučené smažeš slova, která si Sibyla zapamatovala, odhad rodu i naučený dotyk.

SOUKROMÍ
Sibyla nemá žádný kód pro připojení k internetu. Plný přístup je volitelný a potřebují ho jen vibrace při psaní, protože bez něj je iOS klávesnici nedovolí. Nic z toho, co napíšeš, klávesnici neopustí. Do pole pro heslo dává iOS vždycky svou klávesnici, takže uložená hesla vyplníš jako dřív a Sibyla heslo nikdy nevidí. Nemá reklamy a nepotřebuje účet.

V APLIKACI
Návod k zapnutí, popis všech voleb s náhledem dělené klávesnice, zkušební pole a měření rychlosti: přepíšeš 20 vět a uvidíš svoje slova za minutu a chybovost.
