name: Sideline Standings
description:
Sideline Standings keeps youth soccer families on top of their league.

Follow your team in ECNL, ECNL Regional League, Pre-ECNL or MLS NEXT and see:
- Where you stand: the conference table, your chances of finishing first or making the playoff spots, and the most points still possible
- Games: what's coming up, this weekend's results and how every result moves the table
- League: every game in your conference, results the moment they're posted
- Predict: play out the rest of the season and see how the final table could look

Alerts tell you the moment a score is posted for your team or anywhere in your league, with game-day reminders and a Sunday wrap-up. Quiet hours keep the phone silent overnight.

A free account (Apple, Google or email) keeps your teams and alerts on every device.

Not affiliated with ECNL or MLS NEXT.

name: Sieve Stack
description:
Sieve Stack runs a sieve analysis of aggregate or soil, from the first weighing to a report you can send.

SOURCES
Every stockpile, pit or bin is a card with its latest gradation drawn over the spec band, the sample date, Pass or Fail, and the fineness modulus.

THE STACK
The sieve set is drawn as a stack. Type the original dry mass and the washed mass, then what each sieve and the pan held, from the top down. Cumulative retained and passing update with every layer. When the pan is in, the sieve loss is checked against 0.3 %. A sieve that holds more than it should for an 8 in or 12 in frame is flagged with the number of runs to split it into.

GRADATION
Passing on a log axis over the spec band. Drag across the curve to read any size. Fineness modulus, D10, D30, D60, Cu and Cc, and a check of every sieve, the FM range and the 45 % rule between two sieves.

CLASSIFY
USCS symbol and name with the reasons, step by step. Drag the point on the plasticity chart to set LL and PI and watch a dual symbol like SP-SC turn into SP-SM.

BLEND
Mix two or three sources by dragging the dividers on one bar. The combined curve moves inside the band as you drag. Fit finds a ratio that passes every sieve, or names the sieve that blocks it.

TREND AND REPORT
Each source keeps FM and No. 200 control charts across its samples. The report lists every sieve with retained, cumulative and passing, the limits and the summary, and shares as text with an image of the curve.

US fine, US coarse, US soil and EN 933 sieve sets. ASTM C33 specs built in; add your own.

Everything stays on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Sightline Prompter
description:
Look at the lens. Your script follows your voice.

Sightline Prompter is a teleprompter that listens. It puts a short band of text right under the front camera, so your eyes stay where the viewer needs them, and it scrolls as you speak: faster when you speed up, still when you pause. No foot pedal, no assistant, no losing your place.

WHY CREATORS SWITCH
• Voice following that never jumps: it only matches the words on screen, so a cough or a side comment does not throw you off
• Text sits next to the lens in portrait and landscape, so there is no sideways glance on the recording
• Record in the app: 16:9 or 4:3, up to 4K at 60 fps, HDR, HEVC, H.264 and ProRes, with exposure, focus and white balance locks, torch, zoom and stabilization
• Recordings go straight to your Photos library

VOICE FOLLOWING IN 31 LANGUAGES
English, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Mandarin, Cantonese, Turkish and more. Many languages recognize your speech on the device, so it works without a connection.

YOUR SCRIPTS, EVERYWHERE
Write, search and edit scripts, or import text, Markdown, Word, PDF, RTF, HTML and OpenDocument files. Scripts sync with the Mac app through iCloud, so what you write on the Mac is on your phone before you press record. Add delivery cues in [[double brackets]]: they stay on screen as reminders and are never counted as words you must say.

FREE TO START, PRO WHEN YOU NEED MORE
Free: voice following and recording up to 2 minutes per run, 1080p at 30 fps, English, Turkish and Spanish.
Sightline Pro: no time limit, 4K 60 fps, HDR and ProRes, all 31 languages, adjustable prompter size, words-per-minute and time-left readout, controller tuning. One purchase covers iPhone and Mac.
Monthly $4.99, yearly $29.99 with a 7-day free trial, or lifetime $59.99 (prices may vary by region). Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage them in your Apple Account settings.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No analytics, no tracking, no ads. Scripts live in your own iCloud Drive. An iCloud sign-in on the device is required.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://berkbayri.github.io/sightline-prompter/privacy.html

name: SignSnap Park
description:
SignSnap Park remembers where you left the car. The pin, an optional photo, and the walk back stay on your iPhone. There is no account, and nothing you save is uploaded to a SignSnap Park server.

Free:

- Save your parking spot, with the time and an optional note such as a level or a space number.
- Add a photo of where you parked, from the camera or your photo library. The photo stays on this phone.
- Open walking directions back to the car in Apple Maps.
- Keep the current spot and the three newest spots you have left.

SignSnap Pro is an auto-renewable subscription, monthly or yearly, or a one-time lifetime unlock. In the United States the prices are $2.99 a month, $19.99 a year, and $39.99 once. The paywall loads those prices from the App Store. It does not invent them, and you confirm the charge with your Apple ID. Other countries can differ.

Pro adds:

- Reading a posted parking sign from a photo, on this iPhone. You can correct the words before anything is saved. Typing a sign, or trying a built-in sample, still parses on the free tier.
- Meter reminders. Start a countdown for the time you paid. When you allow notifications, the phone alerts you 10 minutes before, 5 minutes before, and when the time is up.
- Street-cleaning and restriction reminders from common sign wording, including a cleaning window, a no-parking window, or a tow-away window.
- Unlimited parking history. Older spots stay on the phone either way. Pro is what opens the ones past the three newest.

What the app does not do:

- It does not pay a meter or connect to a city parking system.
- It does not calculate holidays, permit zones, or dates such as the second and fourth Monday. That kind of sign is saved as the weekday only.
- It does not upload your location, photos, notes, or sign text.
- Alerts are scheduled on this iPhone. There is no remote push.
- One current spot and one running meter at a time.

Light and dark follow the iPhone setting. In Settings you can choose System, Light, or Dark, and that choice stays on the phone.

Subscriptions renew until you cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel them in your Apple ID subscriptions. The lifetime unlock does not renew.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Privacy policy: https://curb.expo.app/privacy.html

name: Simon Si - Your Virtual Pet
description:
Simon is an alien who only says “Yes”. He came to Earth trying to escape his planet because he has a hidden power… but after several events he lost his memory and was found by Cortex in the junkyard. Cortex decided to help him, but he can’t take care of Simon all the time… and that’s where YOU come in!

Feed him, take care of him, give him a bath, put him to bed, dress him however you like, decorate his house and have fun playing lots of minigames to earn coins for food, recipes, clothes, furniture and much more!

TAKE CARE OF SIMON
• Watch his hunger, energy, happiness and cleanliness
• Time keeps passing even when the game is closed
• If you neglect him he gets dirty, sad… and can even catch a cold

DRESS HIM UP & DECORATE
• Lots of clothes, hats and accessories
• Furnish his bedroom, kitchen, game room and more

COOK, GARDEN & MAKE FRIENDS
• Cook recipes step by step: chop, mix, fry and bake
• Grow your own garden
• Visit the park and meet new friends

LOTS OF MINIGAMES
• Earn coins in many different minigames and spend them in the shop

SECRETS & SURPRISES
• Cortex visits with a shop full of deals
• Special moons, shooting stars, storms and hidden secrets to discover

name: Simple Outages - California
description:
The simple option for getting the resolution time for your power outage. 

Immediately see the status of the power cut at your location, or any location within the PG&E area. 

See 3 nearby outages to understand how widespread the problem is. 

Save battery by using an app designed to save battery when you most need it.

name: Simply Salt Partners
description:
Salt Partners helps technicians at Simply Salt partner companies refer customers for water softener salt delivery.

Choose your company and verify your mobile number to create an account. Returning technicians open their saved company workspace automatically. New memberships require a company invitation or Simply Salt approval.

Find delivery times, submit a customer-authorized booking, and follow your referral from pending delivery to earned reward and recorded payout. Save your own Venmo, Zelle, or Apple Cash destination so Simply Salt can pay you separately. The app does not transfer money or collect bank passwords or card numbers.

Request approved company partnership stickers at no charge and follow their fulfillment status. Printing and standard shipping are free.

Explore a clearly labeled sample workspace before joining. Sample actions do not create deliveries, send messages, order stickers, or transfer money.

Salt Partners is for technicians at participating businesses. Delivery availability depends on the customer’s service address. US mobile verification is required for a real partner account.

name: Sipleaf
description:
Sipleaf is a houseplant care planner that knows when each of your plants is actually thirsty — not on a fixed calendar, but on a rhythm tuned to its species, its light, the season, its pot and its soil.

A LEAF THAT HOLDS WATER
Every plant gets its own thirst meter: a leaf that slowly empties as the days pass. Water it and the leaf refills with a gentle wave. One glance at the Today screen shows who needs a drink now, who is ready for a feed, and who comes next.

WATERING THAT ADAPTS
Pick from 40 common houseplants — pothos, monstera, snake plant, peace lily, ferns, succulents, palms, orchids, herbs and more. Each comes with a baseline watering and feeding rhythm. Sipleaf then adjusts it for:
- the light on its sill (low, medium or bright)
- the season where you live (plants drink sooner in summer, rest in winter)
- pot size and soil mix (from gritty cactus mix to semi-hydro LECA)
Open any plant to see exactly why it needs water every so many days, factor by factor.

SILLS FOR EVERY SPOT
Group plants by window, shelf or room and set how bright each spot is. Sipleaf flags plants that would be happier somewhere brighter or shadier, and lets you water everything thirsty on a sill in one tap.

LOG CARE IN ONE TAP
Water, mist, feed, repot or prune — with an optional note, today or back-dated. Soil still damp? Snooze a plant for a day. Every plant keeps its own history, and the Journal shows all of your care with a 14-day chart, weekly count, care streak and filters.

A GENTLE MORNING NUDGE
Turn on an optional morning reminder and choose the hour. Sipleaf only sends one on days when a plant will actually be thirsty — never on quiet days.

YOUR GREENHOUSE, YOUR WAY
Sign in with Apple, Google or email, or tap "Just browse for now" to try everything as a guest. Guests can save their greenhouse to an account later without losing a single plant. Your data syncs across devices and keeps working offline.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads. No tracking. No analytics. Your plants are stored in your own private space in Google Firebase and are only readable by your account. You can delete your account and every record from inside the app at any time.

Try the starter examples to explore, then add the plants you actually live with. Your windowsill will thank you.

name: Site Proof – Jobsite Records
description:
Keep each jobsite’s details and media together in one place.

Site Proof helps you document the stages of a job and create reports from the items you select.

ORGANIZE YOUR JOBSITES
Create a record with the jobsite name, client, address and notes. Edit your records and archive completed jobs.

DOCUMENT YOUR WORK
Take photos, record videos and voice notes, or import existing media. Add a title, comment and work stage to make each item easy to find.

BROWSE THE TIMELINE
Find your records by jobsite and filter them by media type or work stage.

SHARE A PDF REPORT
Choose which items to include. Photos and observations appear in the PDF. Audio and video recordings are listed in the report and remain available in the app.

BACK UP YOUR RECORDS
Export a backup containing your jobsite records and their media. Restore it from a file when needed. Restoring replaces the data currently stored in the app.

Records are stored on your device, with no user account or automatic synchronization. You choose which files to export and share.

Available in French and English.

Site Proof is an organization and documentation tool. It does not certify file authenticity or guarantee legal evidentiary value.

name: Six Rail Stamps
description:
When does the next train leave? Can you squeeze in a stop at Windmill Hill and still make it back to Central?

Six Rail Stamps is an offline railway puzzle game. Start each journey at Central, then collect station stamps and colored number balls as you visit new stops. Plan your route around the timetable and bring your discoveries home by 18:00, when trains stop running.

• Plan your rides and transfers. Waiting, riding, and visiting landmarks move the game clock forward. Take as long as you like to study the map.
• Make two-color pairs, single-color runs, and three-color runs to discover places like the Old Water Tower, Glass Market, and White Lighthouse.
• Explore three handcrafted levels: Riverside Journey: Tower No. 6, Afternoon Junction: Building No. 49, and Lighthouse Last Train: Windmill No. 8.
• Fill your travel journal with station stamps and illustrated discoveries. Replay with a different route to complete your collection and aim for three stars.

Play offline in English or Simplified Chinese. Pause anytime and pick up where you left off.

name: Skaut Akademiya
description:
Skaut Akademiya is the app for heads, administrators, cashiers and coaches of football academies and sports schools in Uzbekistan. Sign in with your phone number and an SMS code, and the academy that added you opens on its own. Parents and children use a different app, Skaut.

For each role
• Head: revenue and the age of debt, attendance by group, staff and invitations, refund approvals, announcements, the activity log.
• Administrator: groups and the schedule, children and parents, invoices, discounts and moving sessions, announcements.
• Cashier: payments and receipts, refunds sent to the head for approval, families' debts.
• Coach: today's groups and individual sessions, attendance in a tap, booking requests, notes and evaluations with photos and video (with a parent's consent), the month's pay.

AI assistant
The head asks in plain words, by text or voice: "What is this month's revenue?", "Who owes us?". The answer comes from the academy's own data with a button that opens the right screen. The numbers come from the data, not from the model; the assistant only reads and changes nothing. It stays off until the head turns it on.

Invitations
A staff member is invited with a skaut.uz/a/… link: it opens this app, and the academy appears right after sign-in.

App lock with Face ID or the device passcode. On iPhone, iPad and Mac, in Uzbek and Russian.

Academies join through skaut.uz: the Skaut team moves the lists and invites the staff. No ads, no tracking.

name: Skepsis: Learn Greek Roots
seller_name: THE GOOD LYFE CONSULTING GROUP LLC
description:
Y'all already speak Greek. Skepsis shows you where.

Telephone, photograph, democracy, kleptomania, Achilles' heel, a Trojan horse: English is full of Greek. Skepsis teaches the roots, myths and big ideas behind those words in short, playful lessons, so you can decode words you've never seen.

HOW IT WORKS
- 3-minute lessons. Guess first, then learn: guessing before you're told helps it stick.
- Learn a root with two words, then decode a third on your own.
- Build words from their pieces, match pairs, and play "Is it Greek?" (rodeo is Spanish; butter is secretly Greek).
- Spaced review brings words back after 1, 3, 7, 14 and 30 days.
- Rodeo: a speed round with 8 seconds per question. One miss bucks you off.

WHAT YOU'LL LEARN
- Everyday roots: tele, phon, graph, photo, auto
- Size and number: mega, micro, poly, mono
- Medicine: cardio, derm, -itis
- Power and people: democracy, -cracy, polis
- Myths: Nike, Achilles' heel, the Trojan horse, mentor
- Persuasion: ethos, pathos, logos, kairos, hubris
- Stoic ideas: the dichotomy of control, eudaimonia

KEEP GOING
Streaks (weekends never break them, plus freezes), daily quests, badges, and drachmas to spend on hats for Homer the armadillo. No hearts, no lives, no punishment.

FREE AND OPEN SOURCE
Skepsis is free. No ads, no account, no in-app purchases. The code is open (MIT) at github.com/ionpetro/skepsis. Your progress stays on your phone. The only thing we collect is anonymous usage data (with PostHog) to make lessons better, and you can turn it off in Settings.

name: Ski Tracks & Tracker
description:
Ski Tracks & Tracker turns your phone into a ski computer. Press start, put it in your pocket, and it records your whole day - every run, every lift, your top speed and total vertical - on piste maps that keep working when the signal doesn't.

AUTOMATIC RUN & LIFT DETECTION
Ski Tracks & Tracker tells runs from lift rides on its own. No buttons on the chairlift, no editing afterwards. Your day is split into runs and lifts with distance, vertical, top speed and time for each one.

PISTE MAPS THAT WORK OFFLINE
Runs, lifts, ski areas and winter points of interest, drawn on a map made for skiing. Download your country before you go and the map works up on the mountain with no data connection. Nordic and ski-touring routes are included.

YOUR STATS
• Top speed, vertical, distance, runs and time on snow
• Barometric altitude on supported iPhones for accurate vertical
• A speed chart and a speed-colored track for every run
• Compare runs side by side
• Season totals and personal records
• Heart rate from Apple Watch, with optional export to Apple Health

TRACK FROM ANYWHERE
• Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Apple Watch app to start, pause and stop without taking off your gloves
• Keeps recording in the background while your phone is in your pocket

RELIVE THE DAY
Replay your day on the map, run by run, with speed and altitude. Make share cards for your best days, add notes, and import or export GPX.

SKI WITH YOUR CREW
Start a team with friends and family and get a shared feed of everyone's ski days: runs, vertical, top speeds and photos from the mountain. Teams only see a summary of your day, never your raw GPS data. Everything syncs through your own iCloud, so there's no account to create.

FREE
Live tracking, run and lift detection, day stats, session history, season stats, GPX export and one offline country of your choice, with no time limit.

SKI TRACKS PRO — ONE PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
• Every country offline
• Unlimited offline map areas
• Replay
• Teams & sharing
• Speed analysis and run comparison
• Premium map styles: Winter 3D terrain and Satellite 3D (internet connection required)

Pro is a one-time purchase that is yours forever and can be restored on all your devices.

Continued use of GPS in the background can decrease battery life.

name: Skies Limo Partner
description:
The official app for Skies Limo chauffeurs in Tampa Bay.

Get new trips the moment dispatch assigns them, accept or decline in one tap, and see everything you need: pickup time and address, stops, flight number, passengers, bags, the client's notes, and the extras and free perks included with the ride.

On the day: go On duty, tap On my way, Arrived, On board and Complete, and the office and client stay updated automatically. Get directions in one tap, call the client, report wait time or extra stops, and record cash payments.

Open trips: when a trip needs a driver, you'll see it if it matches your vehicle and can take it first.

Location is shared with dispatch only while you're On duty and stops when you go Off duty.

For Skies Limo drivers only. Sign-in details come from the Skies Limo office.

name: Skin Diary: Routine & Photos
description:
Log your skincare routine and products, take consistent progress photos in a private on-device vault, and see what changed when your skin changed.

What you get:
- Tick off your AM and PM routine
- Same angle every week with the ghost overlay
- Compare any two dates
- See what you started before a breakout
- Photos stay on your phone. Always yours.

Free to start. One in-app purchase adds the rest, with no subscription.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Looking things up sends data off your phone: the product barcode or search term you look up goes to Open Beauty Facts. Nothing else you enter leaves your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

name: Skulz
description:
Skulz gjør det enkelt å dele utgifter i kollektivet, på hytta eller med vennegjengen.

Ta bilde av kvitteringen, så leser Skulz varene og prisene for deg. Velg hvem som skal betale for hva, og appen regner ut hvem som skylder hvem. Når det er tid for å gjøre opp, ser du nummeret og beløpet og kan betale med Vipps med ett trykk.

For dere som bor sammen: matbudsjett, faste utgifter, handleliste og gjøremål med fast rotasjon.

• Skann kvitteringer automatisk
• Del per vare, likt eller med egne andeler
• Se hvem som skylder hvem
• Gjør opp med Vipps
• Legg til venner med brukernavn
• Gratis å bruke

name: Sky Shards
description:
Dawn Isle is open from shore to summit. A storm cast you onto its shore, and the shards of the fallen sky answer only to you: they awaken the island's element and reveal its facets.

CLIMB AND GLIDE
Any cliff can be climbed, any peak is a launch point for your glider. Swim across lakes, hunt for chests, elemental echoes and puzzles. Villages, forests, ruins, beacons and the capital city of Zaregrad with its castle on the ledge.

ELEMENTS AND REACTIONS
The sky shard at your landing site awakens your element — Gale. Defeat the island's lords: their shards reveal its facets. Companions bring Flame, Tide, Storm, Frost and Stone to the party. Clash elements in battle: Flame with Tide makes Steam, Gale with Flame — Wildfire, Stone with Frost — Permafrost. Fifteen reactions in all.

PARTY
Five companions join the party through the story, and three more arrive through Starcall. Each has their own element and weapon. Hero copies unlock their facets or become shards for passive skills. Up to four heroes in battle — switch between them on the fly.

STORY
More than fifty steps of story across the whole island. Residents with quests speak in their own voices, day turns to night, and windows light up in the city.

TRIALS
Trial shards float in the sky: three waves of enemies in three minutes. The reward is relics with sets and random stats. Plus cooking, a forge and 56 achievements.

NOTHING EXTRA
• No ads, no internet and no sign-up — progress is stored on the device.
• A save code moves your progress to another device and to the browser version of the game.

Touch controls: a stick on the left, buttons on the right. The game is in English and Russian, with voice-over in both.

name: SKY Sound Feedback PRO 16CH
description:
SKY Sound Feedback PRO 16CH removes feedback (howling) from up to 16 live microphones in real time, on an iPad with a USB audio interface.

• Start with 4 channels and add them one at a time with + ADD CHANNEL, up to 16. Channels you have not added use no CPU at all.
• The AI listens to every channel all the time. It cuts only the frequencies that are howling and lets them go when the howl is gone.
• VOICE ONLY keeps a mic closed while nobody sings or speaks into it.
• LOW CUT from 20 to 400 Hz at 12/18/24 dB/oct. Drag it on the channel's own analyzer.
• AUTO NOISE takes out steady background noise by itself.
• A 6-band dynamic EQ on every channel. Drag a point for frequency and gain; pinch with two fingers for width (Q). Give any band a THRESHOLD and a RANGE, and it cuts or lifts only while its frequency gets too loud. The graph shows both the curve you set and the curve working right now.
• A compressor and a BYPASS key on every channel.
• Zero latency. If the interface or the buffer struggles, the audio passes straight through instead of going silent.
• A first start opens no audio and every channel is off: choose your audio device in SETTINGS first.

Free for 7 days with every feature. After that, one In-App Purchase unlocks it for good. If you already own a SKY licence key, enter it under Licence.

name: Skyday: Daily Planner & To-Do
description:
A calm daily planner that turns your to-do list into a day that actually fits.

Skyday puts your tasks, calendar and habits under a living sky that follows the real sun and your weather. Every day you finish becomes its own small painting.

• Tasks and calendar on one timeline. Drag a task into a free slot.
• "Done by": see when your day will really end, and what still fits.
• Plan my day in seconds with private, on-device intelligence. You approve every block.
• A fresh start every morning, with no red overdue pile.
• Habits and routines with a weekly rhythm and grace days, not streak guilt.
• Skies: each day painted from what you did. Focus raises mountains, kept habits grow forests, and the weather you lived is in the picture.
• A short thought for every day, to keep you going or to share.
• Focus sessions with Live Activities and the Dynamic Island.
• Widgets, Siri, Shortcuts and Spotlight.

FREE, FOREVER
Unlimited tasks, lists and projects. Reminders, repeats, widgets, iCloud sync, the living sky and Skies, Fresh Start, Evening Review, focus sessions, up to 5 habits and 2 routines, 3 smart filters and 3 countdowns, and one AI plan a day.

SKYDAY PRO
Plan and reset your day as often as you like, unlimited break-downs and brain dumps, unlimited habits, routines, filters and countdowns, guided routines with voice, habits ticked from Apple Health, Board view, alarm-style reminders, reminders that repeat until done, a shared list for two, your tasks in Calendar, text styles, accents and app icons.
Yearly (with a 3-day free trial), monthly, or once for life.

YOURS
No ads. No account. Your tasks stay on your devices and in your private iCloud. Planning runs on your iPhone. We never sell your data.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://monjil404.github.io/dayform/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://monjil404.github.io/dayform/privacy.html

name: Skyline Voyage: Tower Stack
description:
One tap. One tower. A whole world to see.

Drop each sliding floor right on top of the one below. Whatever hangs over gets sliced off and your tower gets thinner — but chain perfect drops and it grows back. As your tower rises, the skyline travels the globe: take off from Istanbul and fly on to Paris, London, New York, Tokyo, Rio, Cairo, Dubai, Sydney, Rome, Moscow, Beijing, Agra and San Francisco.

• WORLD TOUR — 14 hand-drawn cities, each with its own sky, lights and landmarks: the Eiffel Tower, Big Ben, the Statue of Liberty, Mount Fuji, the Pyramids, Burj Khalifa and more.
• WORLD POSTCARDS — Every height milestone unlocks a postcard with a fun fact. Collect all 16.
• MY SKYLINE — Every tower you finish becomes a building in your own city. Watch it glow at night.
• GOLDEN HOUR — Land 5 perfects in a row for double coins.
• CHALLENGE EVENTS — Breeze, Sunset Run, Narrow Pass, Night Flight and Gull Flock keep every climb fresh.
• ZEN MODE — No game over. Breathe, stack and relax.
• DAILY TOWER — Everyone gets the same tower every day.
• WORLD RANKING — Weekly and all-time leaderboards.
• 12 TOWER STYLES — Glass skyscraper, painted tile, neon, marble, lava, gold…
• DAILY MISSIONS, SLOW MOTION and more.
• PLAY OFFLINE — On the subway, on the bus, in line. (Ranking needs a connection.)
• 6 LANGUAGES — English, Türkçe, Deutsch, Español, Français, Português.

Perfect for short breaks: a run takes 30 seconds, but you'll always want "just one more city".

name: Skylore Stargazing
description:
Hold your phone up to the night sky — the stars and constellations you're pointing at appear on screen, with their names. That's it. No account, no sign-up, no clutter.

MADE FOR BEGINNERS
Most star apps overwhelm you with thousands of objects. This one shows what you can actually see from where you are. Tell it whether you're in a city or the countryside, and it draws only the stars your eyes can reach — so the screen matches the sky.

POINT AND SEE
• Live mode: move your phone across the sky and the view follows, using the compass and motion sensors
• Tap any constellation, bright star, planet or the Moon for a quick info card
• The Moon is drawn with its real phase
• Horizon and compass directions, so you always know which way you're facing
• Virtual sky: drag to explore indoors or during the day

STORIES IN THE SKY
Tap a famous constellation, planet, cluster or nebula to open its story card: the myth behind it, how to find it, and how high it is right now — plus fun facts for planets and deep-sky objects, and rise and set times for the Sun, Moon and planets. Every card has its own illustration.

FIND ANYTHING
Search for a planet, constellation, star or cluster and see at once whether it is up right now and which way to look. In Live sky an arrow guides you; in Virtual sky the view turns to it.

CLUSTERS, NEBULAE AND GALAXIES
The Pleiades, the Orion Nebula, the Andromeda Galaxy and 15 more objects you can see with your eyes or binoculars — drawn as they really look, as soft glows and star groups. Zoom in to see their names.

SEE THROUGH CITY LIGHTS
Night Vision uses your camera to stack frames and subtract light pollution, revealing stars that are invisible to the naked eye in a city — with constellation lines drawn right over the live view. Honest expectation: about one to two magnitudes deeper than your eyes. It is not a telescope.

PHOTOGRAPH THE SKY
Star Trails takes a long-exposure photo where stars draw lines across the sky as the Earth turns. Then overlay the constellation names from the app's own sky model and share it.
Free: up to 10 minutes of recording; it refills 3 hours after your last capture. Skylore Pro, a one-time in-app purchase, removes the limit — no subscription, no ads.
Optional auto-save every 10, 30 or 60 minutes keeps long Pro sessions safe.

PROTECT YOUR NIGHT VISION
Night Mode turns the whole screen red so you keep your dark-adapted eyes.

LIGHT AND PRIVATE
• Small download (about 14 MB) — installs in seconds, even on cellular
• Works completely offline; nothing is sent to a server
• Six languages: English, 한국어, 中文, 日本語, Français, Español
• 5,000 stars, all 88 constellations, the five naked-eye planets, the Sun and the Moon

Location is used only to compute your local sky. Motion sensors are used only to know where the phone is pointing. The camera is used only when you open Night Vision or Star Trails. Photo access is used only to save your star-trail pictures.

name: Slag Line
description:
Slag Line keeps the residual thickness of one ladle and shows whether the next heat can be charged.

Load the example ladle, or add the ladle you are about to measure. The shop map is the latest heat: slag line, barrel, and bottom, eight stations each. A station that must be gunned is marked. A station at the minimum is marked to tear out.

Tap a station and drag the inner face to the reading, then save it. When the lining must be gunned, mark the patch. The saved millimeters stay as measured. Charge the next heat copies the patched thickness into a new heat.

Compare shows this lining and the last one, in millimeters per heat. A torn-out lining is not edited there.

Readings stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: SlashFacts: Times Tables
description:
SlashFacts is a multiplication-tables trainer (2 to 9) built around a single gesture: answer by drawing one continuous stroke through the digits of the result.

SEE. REMEMBER. SLASH.

• Pick the tables to practise. Each round adapts to the facts you miss or answer slowly.
• A missed fact shows its answer and comes straight back until you answer correctly.
• The Facts map marks every fact answered right first time, so progress is easy to see.
• Haptic feedback on every answer. Fully usable offline.

Made for everyone: no account, no analytics, no ads. Everything stays on the device.

Made by PROTO/fish
https://proto.fish

name: Sleep Sound Tracker: Nocturne
description:
Something woke you at 3 AM. Nocturne tells you what it was.

Nocturne listens to your bedroom while you sleep and recognizes what happens in it: traffic, snoring, voices, coughing, a dog, rain, the fridge kicking in. In the morning you get a clear report of every sound, when it happened, how loud it was and whether it woke you. No guesswork, no vague "sleep quality" numbers you can't act on.

And while you sleep, Sleep Guard quietly protects you. When a noise rises, Nocturne gently raises a soft cover sound to meet it, then fades back down when the room settles. It never masks what matters: alarms, sirens and a child crying always come through.

WHAT WOKE YOU
• Recognizes 10+ kinds of sound: traffic, snoring, voices, coughing and sneezing, pets, wind and rain, crickets and birds, appliances, alarms and children
• A minute-by-minute picture of your night, with every sound you can tap to see
• A quiet score for each night and a trend across the week
• A two-second morning check-in: tell Nocturne which sounds woke you, and it learns what you're sensitive to

SLEEP GUARD
• Adaptive cover sound that rises only when the room gets loud, instead of a white noise machine blasting all night
• Reacts sooner to the sounds you've told it wake you up
• Learns the noises that come back at the same time every night and gets ready before they arrive
• Hard safety rule: alarms, sirens and your child are never covered

YOUR ROOM
• See what visits your room, how often, and at what time
• Spot the recurring sounds: the 6 AM garbage truck, the neighbour's late TV, the snoring that starts at 2

NOISE DIARY
Dealing with noisy neighbours, a building site or a loud street? Create a dated PDF of every sound over 7, 14 or 30 nights: when, how long, how loud. Share it with your landlord, building manager or anyone who needs proof. No audio is ever included.

AT A GLANCE
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with a living sky and your bedtime
• Live Activity and Dynamic Island while a night is running, so you see at a glance what Nocturne hears

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Sound is analyzed on your iPhone, in real time, and never recorded or uploaded
• No account, no sign-up
• Only the results are stored ("Traffic at 3:12 AM, softened"), on your device
• Delete a night, or everything, in one tap

HOW TO USE IT
Put your iPhone on the nightstand, plugged in, and tap Start. That's it. In the morning, read what happened and answer one question.

Nocturne is designed for light sleepers, city dwellers, new parents, people sharing a bed with a snorer, and anyone who wakes up tired without knowing why.

Nocturne is not a medical device and does not diagnose sleep disorders. If you're worried about your sleep or your breathing at night, talk to a doctor.

Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/nocturne-legals/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/nocturne-legals/terms-of-use

name: SlingBloom
description:
Pull back and sling your sprout between flowers.

Your drag sets the direction and strength of the next leap. Watch the arc while you aim, then pick a flower as the mist rises below. Play a quick run when you have a moment or see how far you can climb.

CHOOSE YOUR NEXT FLOWER
• Pull back farther for a stronger leap, then release to fly.
• Watch the flight preview turn green when the shot can reach a flower.
• Choose a smaller gold flower for extra pollen.

MAKE EVERY LANDING COUNT
• See how close you aimed with Nice, Great, and Perfect landings.
• Chain Perfect landings to earn more pollen.
• Try another run with a touch after a miss.

KEEP THE MIST BELOW
• Time your leap as flowers sway or open and close.
• Aim around thorns and passing moths while the mist climbs.
• Land on a broad flower for a breather as the garden changes.

GROW YOUR COLLECTION
• Earn pollen from landings and goals.
• Preview 12 sprout looks in motion, each with its own themed garden.
• Spend earned pollen on looks that change the scenery, flowers, and mist.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Keep the aim preview on when you want a guide.
• Set sound, haptics, and motion effects to suit you.
• Your scores, looks, and progress stay on your device.

No ads. No tracking. Everything is included. You can play offline and leave an optional tip on the home screen.

See how high your sprout can go.

name: Slopepin
description: Slopepin helps you walk a roof with purpose. Photograph shingles, joints, gutters, flashings, vents, moss, and damage, then drop pins on a simple roof plan so nothing gets lost between the ladder and the report. Tap the silhouette to mark chimneys and slopes, attach photos from the library or camera, and sort each find as urgent, monitor, or OK. Review everything on a call sheet before you leave the site. Built for quick field notes when you need a clear map of what you saw—not a full enterprise platform. Works offline on your device; your roofs and photos stay with you until you choose to share them.

name: Slow Burn: Couples Game
description:
Slow Burn is a card game for couples and close friends. Turn the lights down, put one phone in the middle or link your phones over Wi-Fi, and let the cards do the asking.

HOW IT WORKS
• One phone hosts. Everyone else scans its screen to join from their own phone, on the same Wi-Fi or hotspot. Nothing to type.
• Or pass a single phone around. No Wi-Fi needed.
• 2 to 5 players. Every game says whether it is for two or for a group.

THE GAMES
• Truth or Dare, in three levels of heat
• Questions: one of you answers out loud, then the other
• Would You Rather: both pick in secret, then compare
• Who Is More Likely: vote in secret, reveal together
• Never Have I Ever
• Match: say yes or no in secret, and only the ideas you both said yes to are ever shown
• Dice: an action, a place and a time

FROM WARM TO BOLD
Every game says how to play before the first card and shows its heat, from Warm to After Midnight. Turns go round the table, so nobody waits on one person. Start light and go as far as feels right. Anyone can pass any card, with no reasons needed.

MAKE IT YOURS
Write your own truths, dares, questions and match ideas, and add your own words to Dice. They stay on your phone and play on everyone's screen when you host.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up
• No internet needed, and nothing is uploaded
• No ads
• Secret answers stay secret until everyone has answered

SLOW BURN PRO
The warm games are free, and you can try the first 5 cards of every after-dark game free. One payment unlocks the full after-dark games and writing your own cards. No subscription. Only the host needs Pro: everyone who joins plays free.

For adults only (18+).

name: Smart Drive: Driver Insights
description:
Smart Drive helps learner drivers and instructors review recorded driving lessons and turn feedback into practical next steps.

Learners can submit links to driving-session videos, track review status, and view instructor scores, written feedback, and lesson transcripts. Instructors can review submissions, complete structured evaluations, and add feedback for each lesson.

Features include:
• Learner and instructor accounts
• Driving lesson video links
• Structured instructor evaluations and scores
• Instructor-written transcripts and feedback
• Optional AI-assisted analysis of lesson transcripts
• Progress views and account management
• In-app learner account deletion

Videos remain with the external hosting service selected by the user. Smart Drive stores the submitted link rather than uploading the video file. AI insights are based on the supplied transcript; the AI does not watch or assess the video.

Smart Drive supports learning and instructor review. It does not replace a qualified driving instructor or an official driving test, and it does not guarantee test readiness. AI-generated feedback may contain errors.

name: Smart Wafaa Staff
description:
Smart Wafaa Staff is the till app for businesses that run loyalty cards with Smart Wafaa. Your manager creates your account. You sign in and serve customers.

What you can do
- Scan a customer's card from Apple Wallet or Google Wallet and see it at once.
- Add a stamp, record a purchase, add or deduct credit, record a payment on a customer's tab, use a subscription visit or a membership service, and give out a reward. You see only what your manager switched on for you.
- Find a customer by name or by the last digits of their phone when a scan is not possible.
- Open every card a customer holds, with balances and history.
- Undo a recent entry and follow today's activity at your branch.
- Keep serving when the connection drops: entries wait on the phone and are sent when it is back.
- Use it in English or Arabic, with a full right-to-left layout.

For staff only. You need an account created by your business; the app does not sign up customers. Customers add their cards from the join link or the QR code at your counter.

name: SmartSleep: Sleep Tracker
description:
Put your phone by the bed. In the morning, you'll know how you slept.

SmartSleep listens to the night on your device to recognise snoring, coughing and sleep talking, counts how often you move, and gives you a clear report every morning.

• Sleep score and sleep time for every night
• See when you snored and listen back to short clips
• Smart alarm: wakes you a little earlier when your movement suggests light sleep
• Relaxing sounds, breathing exercises and a bedtime routine
• 7-day sleep debt, history, widgets, Apple Watch and Apple Health sync
• Your nights sync between your devices through your own iCloud
• Private: analysed on device, no account, no ads, audio is never sent anywhere

SmartSleep Pro: advice from your own nights, every recording, 30-day trends, what affects your sleep, room noise, the full sound library, a PDF report for your doctor, and a turn-over nudge when you snore.

SmartSleep is not a medical device. Figures are estimates from the phone's microphone and sensors and do not replace a doctor's opinion.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the renewal date in Apple ID Settings.
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://giang1percentdaily.github.io/smartsleep/

name: SMM-TODO
description:
Планировщик для SMM-специалистов, контент-менеджеров и фрилансеров, которые ведут сразу несколько клиентов. Записывайте задачи, съёмки и встречи за пару касаний, а напоминания сработают, даже если нет интернета.

Что умеет

Быстрая запись. Нажмите «+», напишите «снять сторис завтра в 15:00», и дата подставится сама.
Экран «Сегодня». Утром сразу видно, что делать сейчас: ближайшая съёмка, задачи, прогресс дня.
Календарь. Месяц, неделя и день, видно, в какие дни перегруз.
Напоминания. За час, за день, на точное время. Можно отложить или отметить выполненным прямо из уведомления.
Проекты и клиенты. Свой цвет у каждого проекта, бриф и заметки внутри, «всё по клиенту» в один тап.
Мероприятия. Место, время и чек-лист подготовки: «взять штатив», «зарядить свет».
Заметки и идеи. Записали мысль, потом превратили её в задачу одной кнопкой.
Шаблоны. Например, «Съёмка рилса» с готовым чек-листом.
Метки платформ: Instagram, TikTok, Telegram, YouTube, VK.

Спокойно и без стресса

Просроченные задачи подсвечены мягко, и сразу есть кнопки «Перенести на завтра» и «Выполнено».
Удалённое можно вернуть: отмена сразу и корзина на 30 дней.
Светлая и тёмная темы.

Работает офлайн

Приложение не требует регистрации и интернета. Все данные хранятся у вас на телефоне. Резервную копию можно сохранить файлом и перенести на новый телефон.

Для кого

SMM-менеджеры, контент-мейкеры, фрилансеры, маркетологи: все, кто привык держать дела в блокноте и хочет такую же простоту.

Скачайте «SMM-TODO» и вычёркивайте задачи с удовольствием.

name: Smoke Log: BBQ Cook Journal
description:
Log every smoker cook (meat, weight, rub, wood, pit and meat temps, stall, wrap, rest, result) so the next brisket is better than the last.

What you get:
- Log a temp check in two taps
- See the stall on your chart
- Every cook, rub and wood saved
- Your hours per pound, from your cooks
- Spritz and rest timers on your lock screen

Free to start. One in-app purchase adds the rest, with no subscription.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Looking things up sends data off your phone: the cook's location so the app can fetch the weather for that place goes to MET Norway. Nothing else you enter leaves your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

name: SMT Shipment
seller_name: SHIPMENT COMPANY FOR GENERAL TRADING AND LOGISTICAL SERVICES LTD
description:
SMT Shipment brings your cargo from China and the world to Iraq — and handles everything in between.

Since 2014 we have moved goods out of China every week, with our own team in Guangzhou, offices across Iraq, and customs cleared by people who do it every day.

WHAT YOU CAN DO IN THE APP
• Get a price – tell us the route, the cargo and the weight or CBM. A person from our team sends you the current rate on WhatsApp.
• 3D cargo calculator – enter carton or pallet sizes and see how they fill a 20ft or 40ft container, with the real CBM.
• Track a shipment – send your SMT reference or container number and we answer with the status.
• Call or WhatsApp us in one tap – main number +964 776 155 5510.
• WeChat QR codes for our Iraq and China offices.
• Answers to common questions about prices, customs, CBM and delivery.

OUR SERVICES
• Sea freight – full containers (FCL) or shared containers (LCL)
• Air freight – for cargo that cannot wait
• Land freight and trucking – cross-border through our Cizre hub
• Customs clearance – handled in-house
• Warehousing in Baghdad – short or long term
• Sourcing and inspection – our team on the ground in Guangzhou

OUR OFFICES
Headquarters in Sulaymaniyah (Talary Shusha, Office 40), offices in Baghdad and Erbil, a transit hub in Cizre (Turkey) and our sourcing team in China.

5 LANGUAGES
Arabic, Kurdish (Sorani), English, Turkish and Chinese.

Shipment Company for General Trading and Logistical Services Ltd
www.shipmentsmt.com

name: Snack Toss: Animal Collector
description:
Hold, aim and let go! Toss a snack as far as you can and watch a stampede of adorable animals race to grab it. Tap your favourite and it floats home in a bubble to your sanctuary.

• THROW FARTHER: every throw trains your arm, and the gym makes you stronger. Reach 8 lands: Meadow, Forest, Savanna, Desert, Jungle, Ocean Shore, Snow Peaks and the fiery Volcano Ridge.
• COLLECT 48 ANIMALS: bunnies, foxes, lions, penguins, narwhals, yetis, red pandas and legendary finds like the Ice Dragon and the Magma Dragon. Complete a land's set for a permanent income bonus.
• MYSTERY ANIMAL: fill the mystery tiles to reveal the mythic Starlight Unicorn.
• HUNT RARE VARIANTS: Big, Gold and the ultra-rare Rainbow animals earn way more. Merge duplicates to upgrade them.
• BETTER SNACKS, RARER FRIENDS: upgrade from carrots to Golden Carrots, Dragonfruit, Aurora Candy and Lava Cake.
• GROW YOUR SANCTUARY: every animal earns coins, even while you're away.
• RELEASE TO THE WILD: reached the last land? Release your animals, earn a Wild Star and start a faster run with permanent bonuses.
• PERFECT THROWS: release in the golden zone for slow-motion, extra-long tosses and beat your best-distance flag.

Free to play, no internet needed. Rewarded ads are always optional, and Remove Ads really removes the ads between throws.

name: Snap Agenda: Image to Action
description:
Turn a chosen screenshot into a next step you can act on.

Import one image from Photos or Files and read its text with on-device Apple Vision recognition. Keep the source image and recognized text with your action. Edit the task title, place or link and reminder yourself. Date suggestions are drafts that you must verify.

Find actions by title, place or source text. Mark tasks complete, enable local notifications, and review an action PDF with the source before exporting. JSON backup and restore keep your library portable.

Only images you choose are read. Text recognition runs on the device; there is no developer AI server or background library scanning. Recognition and detected dates may be inaccurate. No account or subscription.

name: SnapCanvas: Photo Video Editor
description:
Edit photos and videos, remove backgrounds, make collages and add text, all in one creative studio that works entirely on your iPhone. No account, no uploads, no ads in your way.

Perfect for social posts, stories, short videos, thumbnails, invitations and posters.

PHOTO EDITING
• Crop, rotate, straighten, flip and fix perspective
• 18 precise adjustments: exposure, contrast, highlights, shadows, whites, blacks, temperature, tint, vibrance, clarity, sharpness, vignette, grain, fade, blur and more
• 35 original filters (film, cinematic, warm, cool, black & white, retro, portrait, landscape and social looks), each with adjustable intensity
• Resize to any dimensions and export JPEG or PNG at full resolution

LAYERS
• Photos, text, stickers, shapes and drawings stay editable as separate layers
• Reorder, group, lock, hide, rename, duplicate and set opacity
• Snap-to-center and alignment guides, precise position controls

BACKGROUND STUDIO
• Erase and restore with soft brushes, plus a color-range magic wand
• Feather edges, add sticker-style outlines
• Swap in solid colors, gradients, patterns, blurred copies or your own photos
• Export transparent PNGs

TEXT, STICKERS & DRAWING
• 32 typefaces with outlines, shadows, backgrounds, gradients and curved text
• Original sticker art, emoji, shapes, arrows, frames and speech bubbles
• Pen, pencil, marker and highlighter with straight lines and shapes

COLLAGES & TEMPLATES
• Grid layouts for up to 9 photos with adjustable spacing, corners and borders
• Freestyle collages with framed, tilted prints
• 24 original templates for posts, stories, thumbnails, posters, invitations and more

VIDEO EDITOR
• Trim, split, reorder, duplicate and delete clips on a scrolling timeline
• Change speed from 0.25× to 4× with natural-sounding audio
• Crop, rotate, flip and reframe for 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9 and 21:9
• Filters and adjustments per clip, plus dissolve, fade, slide, push, wipe and zoom transitions
• Text, stickers, drawings and photo overlays with their own timing
• Add music, set volume and fades, and control each clip's original sound
• Export MP4 in 720p, 1080p, or 4K when your footage is 4K

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your photos, videos and projects never leave your iPhone. SnapCanvas has no sign-in, no analytics, no advertising and no third-party SDKs. Projects save automatically and pick up where you left off.

SNAPCANVAS PRO
Free includes the core editor, one filter in every category, a starter set of fonts and stickers, collages up to 4 photos, standard exports and the basic video editor. Pro unlocks every filter, font, sticker and template, advanced collages, layer groups, the magic wand and outlines, all video transitions, 4K and 60 fps video, larger photo exports and removes the watermark.

• Monthly: $1.99 • Annual: $19.99, with a 7-day free trial • Lifetime: $49.99 (one-time purchase)
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. A free trial becomes a paid annual subscription unless canceled at least 24 hours before it ends. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://crumbstudiosllc.com/snapcanvas/privacy/

name: Snooker League
description:
Snooker League is the app for players and managers of leagues run on league.snookers.pro.

FOR PLAYERS
• Your next match: opponent, date, venue, table and your head start
• Send a result in seconds; your league manager approves it
• District tables, the overall table, play-off and knockout brackets
• Your level and change points on every ladder, for example 12ft and 9ft tables
• Reminders a day and an hour before each match, and news when a draw or result involves you

FOR LEAGUE AND DISTRICT MANAGERS
• Approve or reject results from your phone
• Get notified as soon as a result is waiting

FAIR GAMES WITH A HANDICAP
Every league plays on a level ladder. The weaker player starts each frame with a head start that fits the number of reds, and levels move up and down with results.

Hebrew and English, light and dark mode. Accounts are created by invitation from your league; you can delete yours at any time in Settings.

name: Snooker Scoreboard Live
description:
Score a snooker match on your phone, ball by ball, and let everyone watch the score live on a TV, a tablet or their own phone.

SCORE WITH ONE THUMB
One button for each ball, plus fouls and undo. The scoreboard knows which balls are still on the table, follows the break and whose turn it is, and ends the frame when the table is cleared.

A SCOREBOARD FOR THE ROOM
TV mode turns the phone sideways and full screen, for mirroring to a TV or standing by the table. Any public match can also be opened in a browser at score.snookers.pro, where it updates the moment a ball is potted.

KEEPS GOING WITH NO SIGNAL
Basement club with bad reception? Score the whole match offline, including ending a frame and starting the next. It uploads by itself when the signal returns.

MADE FOR CLUBS AND LEAGUE NIGHTS
- Matches of any length, decided early or with every frame played
- Private matches that only you can see
- Reopen a frame that was ended by mistake
- Watch public matches without an account
- English, Hebrew and Arabic

Free, with no adverts. An account needs only a username and a password, and can be deleted in the app at any time.

name: Snowball Merge
description:
Merge snowballs into forts, build up your camp wall, and keep the warthogs out of the polar bears' camp!

Snowball Merge is a cozy merge puzzle with a camp to defend. Tap the snow pile to make snowballs, then drag two of the same together to make something bigger. Drop your pieces on the camp wall and they throw at the hogs marching down the trail. Do you merge for a bigger fort, or defend right now?

7 PIECES TO BUILD
A Snowball, a Packed Snowball, an Ice Block, a Snow Fort, a Frost Castle, a Cocoa Cannon and finally a Zap Igloo. Bigger pieces hit harder and reach further. Frost slows hogs, hot cocoa splashes a crowd, and zaps jump from hog to hog.

30 LEVELS IN 3 WORLDS
Snowy Woods, Frozen Lake and Glacier Peaks, with Shield Hogs, speedy Charger Hogs, Rocket Hogs and Big Tusk, the boss at the end of every world. Earn 3 stars a level: save the camp, keep your hearts, and build the level's goal piece.

A DAILY CHALLENGE
A fresh twist every day. No pressure, and nothing lost if you skip a day.

EARN SKINS AND HELPERS
Berry Snow, Minty Ice, Golden Glow, Rainbow Ice, a Snow Shovel, a Cocoa Break and more, unlocked with your stars.

HELP WHEN YOU NEED IT
A friendly coach teaches the first level step by step, and if a level beats you twice, you get a head start next time.

MADE FOR FAMILIES
- No ads.
- Nothing to buy: no loot boxes, no random rewards. Every unlock is earned by playing.
- No chat, no accounts, plays offline.
- Grown-up check before any outside link.
- Big buttons, big text and numbered pieces.

Made by Seventh Anvil Games, the makers of Polar Bears vs. Warthogs.

name: Snowparcel
description:
Snowparcel is a cozy Christmas puzzle game about delivering joy across a snowy village.

You are a night courier on Christmas Eve. Check each house’s gift order, load the right presents onto your sleigh, then plan a smart delivery route through icy roads, trees, and snowy obstacles.

HOW TO PLAY
• Study the house orders on the map
• Tap or drag gifts onto your sleigh
• Confirm your load, then tap tiles to plan a route
• Deliver every gift before you run out of moves

FEATURES
• Charming Christmas village levels with rising challenge
• Gift packing and route planning in one cozy loop
• Special mechanics like boosts, gift swaps, and bell tower routes
• Star ratings that reward efficient deliveries
• Offline play — no account, no waiting, no pressure
• Soft winter visuals, sleigh rides, and festive atmosphere

Perfect for short holiday sessions or a calm puzzle break. Load carefully, plan wisely, and bring every gift home in Snowparcel.

name: Snowy Jigsaw Puzzles
description:
Every picture in our jigsaw puzzles is a painted world: snowy castles, igloos under the night sky, frozen streams and cozy cottages. Put the last piece in and the painting wakes up: waterfalls run, windows glow, floating islands bob, and a friendly polar bear cub jumps in to cheer. Tap it and it stirs again.

FREE TO TRY, ONE PURCHASE FOR THE REST
The first album is free to try: 6 paintings at 6 sizes each, so 36 puzzles. One purchase, the Full Unlock, opens Albums 2 to 4, with 18 more paintings.

EASY TO START
- Start with big 4-piece puzzles, with no menus and no sign-up.
- Pieces snap into place with a happy sound.
- A piece dropped in the wrong spot drifts gently back to the tray.
- Pick any size from 4 to 48 pieces, so the whole family can play.

HELPERS WHEN YOU WANT THEM
- Edges first, a ghost picture under the board, shuffle and hints.
- Larger pieces, reduced effects and a left-hand layout in the grown-up settings.

COLLECT THEM ALL
- Every finished picture puts a sticker in the album.
- Each size you finish earns a ribbon on that sticker.
- Tap Bo on a finished picture and it comes alive again.
- Finish a picture at every size and Bo moves into its sticker.

CALM BY DESIGN
- No ads.
- No clocks, no scores, nothing random for sale.
- Play at your own pace; a puzzle in progress is saved where you left it.
- The purchase and Restore sit behind a grown-up check, and Delete My Data is in the grown-up settings.

Made by Seventh Anvil Games, the makers of Polar Bears vs. Warthogs.

name: Sober Day Counter & Journal
description:
Quit a habit, track your progress, and have a plan for the moments when it gets hard.

Whether you’re taking a break from alcohol, quitting smoking or vaping, or cutting back on social media, start by choosing the habit you want to change. Track your time, check in with yourself each day, and build a routine around the changes you want to make.

See how far you’ve come

Watch your progress in days, hours, minutes, and seconds. See your next milestone, look back at your progress calendar, and track the money and time you’ve saved where applicable.

Make a daily pledge

Set an intention for today, then come back in the evening to reflect on how it went. Your check-ins give you a record of the easy days, the hard days, and what helped you get through them.

Log urges and spot patterns

When an urge comes up, log it while it’s fresh. Use your journal to write about what happened, how you felt, and what you did next. Over time, your entries can help you recognize the situations that make it harder to stick with your decision.

Keep your reasons close

Read a daily motivational quote and return to your journal whenever you want to remind yourself why you started. Use the app to focus on the next day, the next milestone, or the next decision in front of you.

What’s included with Premium

• Coping Tools. Open a practical exercise when an urge hits. Try Box Breathing, Urge Surfing, the 10-Minute Delay, Play the Tape Forward, 5‑4‑3‑2‑1 Grounding, or a prompt to reach out to someone you trust.  
• Guided Workbook. Work through structured exercises to reflect on your triggers, plan for difficult situations, and decide how you want to respond.  
• Guided Journaling. Use prompts to explore what’s behind an urge, what’s changing, and what you want to do differently next time.  
• Motivation Packs. Browse themed collections of encouragement for days when you need a reminder of why you started.  
• Withdrawal Timeline. Explore what you might experience over time as you adjust to quitting.

Choose one habit. Make a plan for today. See what changes as the days add up.

Managing your subscription

You can manage or cancel your Premium subscription in your Apple Account settings. On your iPhone, go to Settings → [your name] → Subscriptions, select your Premium subscription, and tap Cancel Subscription.

Privacy Policy  
https://telegra.ph/Privacy-Policy-11-12-452

Terms of Use

name: SociPortal
description:
SociPortal, işletmelerin ve ajansların sosyal medya hesaplarını tek yerden yönetmesini sağlar. Gönderilerinizi hazırlayın, zamanlayın, ekibinizin onayından geçirin; yorum ve mesajları tek gelen kutusunda yanıtlayın.

Mobil uygulama, SociPortal panelinizin cebinizdeki hâlidir. Kullanmak için bir SociPortal hesabı gerekir.

ÖNE ÇIKANLAR
• Tek ekranda genel bakış: bağlı hesaplar, zamanlanmış ve yayındaki gönderiler, onay bekleyenler, dikkat gerektirenler
• Gönderi oluşturma: birden çok hesaba aynı anda, platforma özel metin, galeri veya kameradan fotoğraf ve video
• Yapay zekâ desteği: metin yazdırma, yeniden yazma, hashtag önerisi, görselden metin ve görsel üretme
• Takvim: planlanan gönderileri günlere göre görün, başka güne taşıyın
• Onay akışı: ekibinizin gönderdiği gönderileri onaylayın, not ekleyerek reddedin
• Gelen kutusu: Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn ve diğer hesaplardaki yorum ve mesajları yanıtlayın, hazır yanıtlar kullanın
• Analitik: etkileşim, en iyi saatler ve en iyi gönderiler
• Medya kütüphanesi, kampanyalar, şablonlar, kuyruk ve görevler
• Anlık bildirimler: onay isteği, yeni yorum, başarısız paylaşım
• Hesap güvenliği: iki adımlı doğrulama, cihaz yönetimi, uygulama içinden hesap silme

DESTEKLENEN PLATFORMLAR
Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, Threads, TikTok, YouTube, Pinterest, Google İşletme Profili ve WhatsApp kanalları.

name: Soi Nhà: Giám sát xây nhà
description:
Soi Nhà là ứng dụng giúp chủ nhà tự giám sát xây nhà và kiểm tra công trình đúng lúc, nhất là những phần sắp bị đổ bê tông, xây tô hay ốp lát che kín. Không cần biết chuyên môn xây dựng: mỗi giai đoạn đều có checklist rõ ràng, giải thích dễ hiểu và ảnh minh họa đúng sai.

Phù hợp với anh chị đang xây nhà phố lần đầu, xây nhà trọn gói hoặc thuê thợ theo nhân công, hay vừa nhận bàn giao căn hộ chung cư, không có thời gian túc trực ở công trình nhưng vẫn muốn biết thợ làm có đúng không.

CHECKLIST XÂY NHÀ THEO TỪNG TẦNG, TỪNG GIAI ĐOẠN
• 8 giai đoạn với 76 mục kiểm tra cho nhà phố xây mới: móng, khung kết cấu (cột, dầm, sàn), xây tường, điện nước âm tường, trát, chống thấm, hoàn thiện, nghiệm thu và bàn giao.
• Căn hộ chung cư: checklist nhận bàn giao và hoàn thiện nội thất.
• Chọn việc sắp làm ở mỗi tầng (đào móng, đổ cột dầm sàn, xây tô…), ứng dụng đưa ra danh sách cần kiểm tra cho đúng giai đoạn.
• Có tính cả tầng hầm: hầm để xe hoặc hầm ở được, tự thêm các mục dốc hầm, rãnh thu, hố bơm, chống thấm vách hầm.
• Mỗi mục có lý do vì sao quan trọng, dụng cụ cần chuẩn bị và các bước kiểm tra dễ làm theo.
• Tự thêm giai đoạn, mục kiểm tra riêng hoặc ẩn mục không áp dụng cho nhà mình.

KIỂM TRA TRƯỚC KHI BỊ CHE LẤP
• Nhắc riêng các mục "trước khi che lấp" ngay trên màn hình chính: thép sàn trước khi đổ bê tông, ống điện nước trước khi trát, lớp chống thấm trước khi lát gạch.
• Ví dụ: thử áp lực ống cấp nước, kiểm tra con kê thép sàn, ngâm nước thử chống thấm nhà vệ sinh và sân thượng.
• Đặt mốc sắp tới và nhận nhắc nhở đúng ngày để không bỏ lỡ lúc cần ra công trình.

ẢNH BẰNG CHỨNG VÀ THEO DÕI LỖI
• Chụp ảnh ngay trong mục kiểm tra, ảnh được lưu an toàn trên máy và gắn đúng tầng, đúng giai đoạn.
• Đánh dấu Đạt hoặc Lỗi cho từng mục. Ghi lỗi kèm vị trí, mức độ (nhẹ, nặng, ảnh hưởng an toàn) và mô tả.
• Theo dõi lỗi đến khi thợ báo đã sửa, rồi chính bạn xác nhận lại bằng ảnh sau khi sửa. Lịch sử sửa chữa được giữ nguyên, không bị ghi đè.
• Thư viện ảnh theo tầng và giai đoạn, lọc nhanh các mục lỗi.

TIẾN ĐỘ VÀ BÁO CÁO NGHIỆM THU
• Xem nhanh bao nhiêu mục đã đạt, còn lỗi, chưa kiểm tra ở từng tầng.
• Báo cáo tổng hợp kết quả kiểm tra và danh sách lỗi kèm ảnh ngay trong ứng dụng, tiện mở ra khi trao đổi với thợ hoặc nhà thầu.

DÙNG ĐƯỢC KHI KHÔNG CÓ MẠNG, TRÊN IPHONE VÀ IPAD
Mọi thao tác ghi kết quả, chụp ảnh đều chạy được ngoài công trường không có sóng. Không cần tạo tài khoản để bắt đầu: toàn bộ checklist, ảnh, sổ lỗi và báo cáo trên máy đều miễn phí. Trên iPad, màn hình rộng hiện danh sách và chi tiết cạnh nhau.

GÓI ĐỒNG BỘ (TUỲ CHỌN)
Đăng nhập bằng Apple hoặc Google và đăng ký Gói đồng bộ để sao lưu công trình và ảnh, đồng bộ giữa iPhone, iPad và điện thoại Android, mời người nhà cùng xem, cùng sửa công trình.
• Gói tháng và Gói năm, tự động gia hạn. Giá hiện trong ứng dụng trước khi mua.
• Thanh toán qua Apple ID khi xác nhận mua. Gói tự gia hạn trừ khi bạn tắt tự gia hạn ít nhất 24 giờ trước khi hết kỳ; tài khoản được trừ tiền cho kỳ tiếp theo trong 24 giờ trước khi hết kỳ.
• Quản lý và huỷ trong Cài đặt → Apple ID → Đăng ký.
• Chính sách quyền riêng tư: https://haiithust.github.io/soinha-privacy/
• Điều khoản sử dụng (EULA chuẩn của Apple): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

LƯU Ý
Soi Nhà hỗ trợ chủ nhà quan sát và ghi chép. Việc chủ nhà đánh dấu một mục là đạt không thay cho nghiệm thu của kỹ sư hay đơn vị có chuyên môn. Mục nào cần người có chuyên môn xác nhận, ứng dụng sẽ ghi rõ.

name: Solanis Orbit
description:
O Solanis Orbit é o CRM com inteligência artificial para empresas que atendem e vendem pelo WhatsApp. Seus agentes de IA respondem os clientes na hora, qualificam leads, agendam visitas, resumem conversas, transcrevem reuniões, se integram às plataformas que você já usa... A lista é grande.

CONVERSAS
•⁠  ⁠Todas as conversas do WhatsApp num só lugar, com busca, filtros e etiquetas
•⁠  ⁠Agentes de IA que respondem 24 horas por dia, no tom da sua empresa
•⁠  ⁠Assuma o atendimento a qualquer momento ou deixe uma nota privada para a equipe
•⁠  ⁠Fotos, áudios, vídeos e documentos direto na conversa

CHAT INTERNO
•⁠  ⁠Converse com a equipe em canais e mensagens diretas, sem sair do app

ORBIT AI
•⁠  ⁠Peça ao Orbit AI para resumir conversas, criar tarefas e encontrar informações
•⁠  ⁠Reunião de última hora? Ele transcreve para você

TAREFAS
•⁠  ⁠Quadro de tarefas da equipe, com responsáveis, prazos e anexos

E MAIS
•⁠  ⁠Lista de contatos
•⁠  ⁠Calendário interno, integrado ao que você já usa
