•⁠  ⁠Navegação simples e otimizada

Pare de perder tempo com CRMs genéricos. Comece em orbit.solanis.ai.

name: Solar Plus Storage
description:
Solar Plus Storage shows the state of your solar system's battery, read directly from its BMS.

• Bluetooth connection to the battery's BMS (JK BMS)
• Charge (%), voltage, current and power in real time
• Every cell's voltage, cell difference and temperatures
• Battery health, cycles and total running time
• Active alarms and event history (logbook)
• With the account your installer gives you: your batteries from anywhere, with 24-hour, 7-day and 30-day history
• Notifications for alarms and low battery
• Demo mode to try the app without a battery

BMS settings can only be changed by the company's technician, within safe LiFePO4 limits, and every change is logged.

The app is available in Greek and English.

name: Solo Streak: Single Days
description:
Solo Streak counts every day you spend on your own, and stays with you through the hardest days after a breakup.

Being alone is not the same as being lonely. Every day you stand on your own gets counted, written down and celebrated.

COUNT YOUR WAY
• Just broke up or never dated: pick a start date and see your days, months, years and even the seconds.
• A sky that follows the real time of day: sunrise, sun, sunset and moon.

A KIND NOTE EVERY DAY
• For the first 30 days after a breakup, a different note each day, written for the stage you are in.
• Turn on the nightly note to get it as a notification at the time you choose.

WANT TO TEXT THEM? HOLD ON
• Breathe with the app for three rounds, reread why it ended, then wait 10 minutes before deciding.
• Track your no-contact streak and how many times you resisted.

JOURNAL AND MOOD
• Pick a mood and write a few lines each day, with a prompt to get you started.
• A 30-day mood chart shows you are getting better.
• Pin your breakup story to remember why you moved on.

GOALS AND BADGES
• A list of things to do while single: a solo trip, a new skill, more books…
• Dozens of badges, one every day in your first week, from "Fresh Solo" to "Ten Thousand Days".

WIDGETS AND SHARING
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets show your streak and today's note.
• Create a Story-sized card of your streak with one tap.

TRULY PRIVATE
• No account, no ads, no tracking. Your data stays on your device and, as a backup, in your own iCloud.
• Lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.
• Automatic backup to your own iCloud, plus export and import as a file.

FOR YOU
• Daily habits: water, sleep, movement, reading, fresh air, breathing. With streaks and a 7-day view.
• Joy jar: drop in every small joy, then shake the jar on hard days and pull one out.
• Affirmations: 30 swipeable cards to steady your heart.
• Reality check: write down what really hurt. It shows up right when you're about to text them.
• Unsent letters: write it all, then let go and watch the letter fade away.
• Time capsule: write to your future self, sealed until the day you choose. The app lets you know when it's ready.
• Single fund: see how much being single has saved you.
• Solo dates: 20 ideas for taking yourself out.
• A "Ready to love again?" quiz and a daily fortune.
• A 30-day self-love challenge, 4-4-6 breathing, a monthly mood calendar and journey stats.
• When it's too much: a shortcut to free helplines near you.

FOUND SOMEONE? SWITCH TO COUNTING DAYS TOGETHER
• The app keeps your single record and starts counting your days together, down to the second.
• Couple profile: both your names and photos, photos kept on your device.
• Special dates: both birthdays, your first date, any day that matters, with a countdown.
• Reminders for monthiversaries, every 100 days, anniversaries and birthdays.
• 21 love milestones, from "Day One" to "Ten Thousand Days".
• Memories: photos, titles, dates and notes, with "on this day".
• 60 questions to ask each other, one a day.
• A together list and a time capsule for the two of you.
• A love note and a date idea every day.

name: Solunar Fish & Hunt Times
description:
Know when they move.

Solunar Fish & Hunt Times gives you the major and minor feeding periods for any spot, plus sun and moon times and a simple day rating, so you can plan the trip around the best hours.

EVERYTHING FOR YOUR SPOT, TO THE MINUTE
• Major periods (moon overhead and underfoot) and minor periods (moonrise and moonset)
• Sunrise, sunset, moonrise, moonset, solar noon and daylight
• Moon phase, % illuminated, moon age and distance
• A day rating from Poor to Excellent, with the reasons behind it: moon phase, periods that land on dawn or dusk, and a close moon
• A bite and movement curve for the whole day, with night shaded

PLAN THE MONTH
• Calendar with the moon phase and rating for every day
• The five best days of the month, each with its best window
• Next full and new moon

SAVE YOUR SPOTS
• Drop a pin, search a lake or park, use your location or type coordinates
• Each spot keeps its own time zone, so you can plan an out-of-state hunt from home
• See the next 10 days for any spot at a glance

WIDGETS
• Home Screen: today's rating, the next period, and the full list of today's periods
• Lock Screen: the next major or minor with a live countdown, or the day score with the moon

EXPORT
• Share a month as a CSV spreadsheet or a printable PDF, or export the next 12 months to CSV. Print it for the cabin wall or send it to your hunting party.

WORKS WITH NO SIGNAL
Every time is calculated on your iPhone with standard astronomical formulas, so there's nothing to download. They agree with US Naval Observatory times to within a couple of minutes. No account, no ads, no tracking.

SEASON PASS
Solunar needs a Season Pass subscription: $11.99 a year with a 7-day free trial, or $1.99 a month. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple ID settings.

Solunar periods are a planning guide based on long-standing solunar theory, not a guarantee. Always follow local seasons, legal shooting hours and regulations.

Terms: https://nooton.com/apps/solunar/terms
Privacy: https://nooton.com/apps/solunar/privacy

name: SomaliMusic
description:
SomaliMusic is the home of Somali music – from the golden age of qaraami to today's Banadiri hits and Somali rap.

LISTEN
• Over a thousand songs from Somali artists, old and new, with more added every week: Qaraami, Banadiri, Heeso Casri, Somali Rap and wedding songs
• Hit Music – the newest songs everyone is talking about
• Qaraami Classics – Magool, Hassan Adan Samatar, Saado Ali and the legends of the 70s and 80s
• Artist pages with all their songs and live play counts; verified artists are marked with a tick
• Likes, playlists and your own library

LISTEN TOGETHER & SING ALONG
• Start a room and send the link to a friend – in Mogadishu, Minneapolis, London or Nairobi
• You hear the same song at the same moment and see each other on camera
• Record a duet: each phone records in time with the music, and SomaliMusic turns it into one split-screen video
• Share it straight to TikTok, Instagram or WhatsApp
• Video and voice go directly between your phones – we don't store them

LIVE MUSIC
• Concerts and live shows from Somali artists, and tickets for concerts and tours

PODCASTS
• Codka Ubax and more Somali podcasts – switch between video and audio, ±15 seconds, playback speed and sleep timer

MADE FOR YOUR PHONE
• Music keeps playing with the screen off, with controls on the lock screen
• Event mode for weddings and parties: full-screen player that guests can't change

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
• English, Somali, Kiswahili and Arabic

Create a free account and listen free for 30 days.

Terms: https://somalimusic.io/terms
Privacy: https://somalimusic.io/privacy

name: Sone: Vinyl & Tape Deck
description:
Streaming solved music distribution — then stripped sound of its body.

A song became a weightless row in a database: frictionless, invisible, and easy to forget. Sone brings physics, inertia, and craft back to digital listening.

Music, Made Tangible.

Sone re-embodies your Apple Music catalog inside a precision-machined 180g direct-drive turntable, a differential-reel magnetic cassette transport, and an autonomous harmonic DJ mix studio — engineered natively in Metal and AVAudioEngine for iPhone, iPhone Duo, iPad, and Mac.

YOUR APPLE MUSIC LIBRARY, PLAYABLE BY HAND
- Connect your Apple Music library to load your personal playlists, album mosaics, and recently played favorites.
- Flip one tactile mechanical switch between Full Song (native full-length Apple Music playback) and Remix (real-time turntable pitch, stem, and scratch DSP).
- No subscription on hand? Built-in multi-stem Studio Test Pressings play out of the box with zero sign-in required.

TWO ANALOG ICONS, FORGED IN METAL
- Step into Full-Screen Deck Mode across Warm Silver and Matte Obsidian CNC-brushed aluminum chassis finishes:
  1. 180g Direct-Drive Turntable: Spin Classic Black, Smoked Amber, or Ivory pressings at 33 1/3 or 45 RPM. Tap the gimbal tonearm to drop or park the stylus with an authentic low-end contact thump, drag across grooves to needle-drop seek, rest a finger on the platter to brake the motor, or scratch with real-time lacquer groove foley.
  2. Dual-Reel Reference Cassette & Upright Pocket Deck: Watch area-conserving supply and take-up spools wind coplanar magnetic tape across permalloy heads in Type I, Type II, and Type IV Metal shells. Rotate into landscape — or unfold iPhone Duo — to transform the deck into a 90-degree upright portable tape player.
- Calibrated Stereo L/R VU Telemetry: Dual -20 to +3 dB ballistic needles with physical cast shadows and peak indicators driven by live stereo energy.
- Eco-ProMotion Thermal Architecture: Runs at cool 30 Hz during hands-off listening, leaps to 120 Hz the instant your finger touches the platter, and drops to 0 Hz when paused.

COMPUTATIONAL SOUND STUDIO
- Stem X-Ray & Tone Character: Spotlight Vocal Solo or Bass & Drums, saturate through Warm Tape, Air, or 12-Bit Sampler circuitry, slice rhythms with Beat Repeat (1/4 to 1/32), or step Outside the Club Door with spatial low-pass filtering and sub-bass CoreHaptics.

AUTONOMOUS HARMONIC MIX STUDIO
- Every playlist is a set waiting to happen. Sequence tracks with Camelot Harmonic Key & BPM Smart Sort, trigger seamless 4-mode Dual-Deck Auto-Mix transitions (Filter Sweep, Vinyl Spinback, Dub Echo, Bass Swap), save sets back to Apple Music, or render standalone .WAV mixtapes to keep and share.

DESIGNED FOR EVERY SURFACE — INCLUDING IPHONE DUO
- From one-thumb closed Pocket Vinyl on iPhone Duo's outer display to a dual-wing mastering console when unfolded, plus split-sidebar iPad and hidden-titlebar Mac studio layouts.

name: SongPerformance
description:
SongPerformance finds any song in seconds among your own files, shows the lyrics as the backing track plays, and takes the voice out of any song with AI, right on your iPad.

Try everything free for 7 days, then pay once. No subscription.

Your songs, found in seconds
Type a few words from the title or from any line. Capitals, accents and small typos don’t matter: “cafe” finds “café”. It searches all your folders at once, thousands of songs, with nothing to wait for.

Lyrics and backing track, together
A lyrics file and a track with the same name belong together. Tap play, and the lyrics scroll along with the music. Full screen, bigger letters and page-turn pedals make them easy to read on stage.

The voice out, with AI
No backing track for a song? Tap Voice, and the AI takes the voice out of it, on your iPad, without internet. It takes a few minutes, once per song. Then the voice goes and comes back with one tap, even while the song plays.

Any key, any speed, live
Move the backing track up or down a semitone at a time, and play it slower or faster without changing its key, while the song plays. The chords in your lyrics move too.

Samplers over the music
Put any sound on the pads: cheers, effects, a jingle. They play right over the backing track, several at once, each with its own volume: once, start/stop or on a loop.

Your whole set on big buttons
Turn a playlist into big buttons: one tap, and the song plays with its lyrics. Hold a button and drag it anywhere. Play through, stop after each song, or repeat.

Two windows and medleys
Play from one list while you prepare the next in the other. Medleys: several songs in one track, and the lyrics change to each part right on time.

Ready for the stage
The music keeps playing with the screen locked or another app open, with its controls on the Lock Screen. Bluetooth page-turn pedals and headphone buttons work too.

Your own files, on your iPad
SongPerformance reads the files you already have, in any folder in Files: on your iPad, in iCloud Drive or on a USB drive. Nothing is uploaded, there is no account and no ads, and it works without internet.

Lyrics in Word (.doc, .docx), PDF, text, RTF and ODT files; backing tracks in MP3, M4A and WAV; sheet music as PDF pages or photos. Lyrics stored inside MP3 files are shown too.

Try it free for 7 days
Start the free 7-day trial in the app: everything is included. Then choose your version and pay once.
- Lite: Find your songs, lyrics that scroll with the music, backing tracks, one playlist with 8 hot buttons.
- Full: Everything in Lite, plus: AI voice remover, key and speed, lyrics synced line by line, more than 8 hot buttons, unlimited playlists, samplers, two windows and medleys, sheet music, lyrics editing.
One payment, no subscription. From Lite you can move to Full later and pay only the difference.
Your purchase unlocks SongPerformance on every iPad signed in with the same Apple Account.

The AI voice remover needs an iPad with 4 GB of memory or more, such as iPad Pro, iPad Air (2020 or later), iPad mini (2021 or later) or iPad (2022 or later).

Questions or ideas? support@songperformance.app

name: Sort TRS
SOS POLARIS
description:
SOS POLARIS brings together, in one place, the official emergency numbers of the country you are in: police, ambulance, fire department, civil defense and coast guard.

HOW IT WORKS
• Choose the country once. The app keeps your choice on your phone.
• Tap the SOS button or the service you need. Your phone dialer opens with the number already typed, and the call only starts when you confirm.
• Works without internet once installed.

NUMBERS FROM OFFICIAL SOURCES
Each number comes from an official government or emergency service page and was checked twice. When a country has not been checked yet, the app says so clearly and never makes up a number.

DESIGNED FOR DIFFICULT MOMENTS
• Large, high-contrast SOS button.
• Shortcuts by situation: medical emergency, fire, accident, storm or flood.
• Optional card (name, allergies and a trusted contact) to show full screen to whoever is helping you. It is not saved or sent.
• Clear design with large, easy-to-read text.
• Portuguese, English, Spanish, French, German and Italian.

PRIVACY
No mandatory sign-up and no GPS: you choose the country, and the card stays on your phone only. The app sends anonymous usage statistics, which you can turn off in Settings, and sign-up is optional.

IMPORTANT
SOS POLARIS opens your phone dialer. It does not call emergency services by itself, does not guarantee the call and does not replace official services. If you are in immediate danger, call your local emergency service.

name: Souffle – Breathing & Pause
description:
Find a moment of calm with Souffle.

Follow simple breathing rhythms with visual guidance. Practice at your own pace, without creating an account.

INCLUDED FREE
• Coherent breathing
• A 3-minute breathing break
• Short breathing and relaxation guides

LIFETIME FULL ACCESS
A one-time in-app purchase unlocks additional breathing practices, custom routines and relaxing soundscapes. No subscription.

MADE FOR EVERYDAY BREAKS
• Exercises and sounds available offline
• French and English interface
• Custom routines stored on your device
• Restore your purchase through the App Store

An internet connection is required to purchase or restore full access.

Souffle is a wellbeing and relaxation tool. It does not provide medical diagnosis or treatment and does not replace medical advice. Breathe comfortably, without forcing, and stop if you feel unwell.

name: Sowpath
description:
Sowpath is a garden planner for the US that starts with your ZIP code.

Type your ZIP and Sowpath looks up your USDA hardiness zone and typical frost dates right on your phone. Tell it what you're planting in – pots on a balcony, raised beds, in-ground or a flower bed – how much sun it gets and how big it is. You get a planting plan with dates for your zone and a shopping list sized to your space.

HOW IT WORKS
• Enter your ZIP – your zone and last frost date appear instantly, even offline.
• Describe your space – garden type, sun, size, what you want to grow, your experience and budget, and whether to plant now or plan for spring.
• Get the plan – 5–10 plants that suit your zone, sun and season, with dates to start seeds indoors, sow or plant out, and harvest.

WHAT YOU GET
• Two frost dates, not one: the typical last and first frost for your zone, plus a "safer after" date for warm-loving plants like tomatoes and peppers.
• Coming up: the next three things to do, taken from your plant dates.
• A shopping list with quantities: bags of soil, pots, seed packets, starter plants, watering and tools, counted from your square feet or number of pots.
• Change the size and every quantity and the estimated total update instantly.
• Mark what you already have – it drops out of the total.
• Keep several gardens on your phone, rename them, and reopen any plan without waiting.
• Share a plan with a friend as plain text.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your ZIP code stays on your phone. The zone lookup uses a table built into the app; to make a plan we send only your zone, frost dates and garden details.
• No location access, no camera, no contacts.
• No account, no subscription, no ads.

OUTSIDE THE US?
Choose your hardiness zone by hand. Sowpath uses typical dates for that zone, clearly marked as approximate. Shopping links open amazon.com.

GOOD TO KNOW
Suggested by AI. Dates, quantities and prices are estimates. Frost dates are typical for your zone – check your local extension office.

Each shopping item opens a normal Amazon search in Safari, so you choose the product; no specific brands or models are recommended. As an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases, which keeps the app free.

Data sources: Zone data: 2023 USDA Plant Hardiness Zone Map, USDA-ARS & PRISM Climate Group, Oregon State University. Frost dates: NOAA NCEI U.S. Climate Normals 1991–2020. ZIP code locations: U.S. Census Bureau TIGERweb (2020 ZCTA).

name: Soze
description:
Keep your printmaking tools ready for the next workshop.

Soze helps you organize tool crates, track handoffs and partial returns, and see how many tables your recorded stock can cover.

- Build per-table and shared-tool recipes.
- Separate ready-to-pack, held and outstanding tools.
- Add tool reference and handback condition photos.
- Review history and plan tools needed for the next table.
- Share packing PDFs and back up saved records with photos.

Coverage follows your recorded counts. Always check tools before use.

name: SPAA - Teacher App
description:
SPAA (Shree Pavitra Arts Academy) Teacher App is the official mobile application for instructors, Gurus, and teachers to manage daily classroom workflows.

Key Features:
• Teacher Attendance: Verify and record daily attendance at assigned Gurukuls and school campuses.
• Student Attendance: Track student roll-calls, present/absent statuses, and monthly attendance reports.
• Classroom Moments: Capture and share student performance clips and class photos.
• Academic Schedules: View upcoming lectures, batches, and annual academic timelines.
• Leaves & Feedback: Submit leave applications and monthly classroom reviews directly from the app.

name: Space Blocks by MGS Studio
description:
Find your rhythm. Build your own cosmos.

Space Blocks is a block puzzle with a quiet cosmic atmosphere and a satisfying feel to every well-placed piece. Fit shapes onto an 8×8 board, complete full rows and columns, and keep room for your next combination.

CHASE YOUR BEST
Enjoy endless play without a timer. Choose Easy, Medium or Hard and build your own record, saved separately for each difficulty. Easy mode also lets you rotate pieces.

COMBOS AND A CLEAN BOARD
Keep a series of clears going and complete several lines at once. Clear the entire board for the highest celebration, Absolute Combo, and 1,000 extra points. As your score and line count grow, the background journey takes you past stars, planets and galaxies.

TAKE AN ADVENTURE
Explore four cosmic maps with 16 levels. Reach score targets, clear lines, collect coloured blocks, build combo chains and achieve a perfect clear. Replay any completed level.

EARN ACHIEVEMENTS
Earn 12 achievements for records, combo chains, perfect clears and adventure progress. Follow your next goal and work through five ranks, from Cadet to Cosmic Legend.

MAKE IT PERSONAL
Choose a photo from your library and see its fragments appear on occupied blocks. Your selected photo is processed and stored on your device, and you can remove it in Settings.

SET YOUR OWN MOOD
Choose block styles and cosmic backgrounds. Enjoy the original Cosmic Orbit soundtrack offline, with its own volume control. Adjust game sounds, haptics, effects and parallax: the background gently responds when you tilt your iPhone. Adaptive layouts support both the closed and open iPhone Duo displays.

Play offline without creating an account. Your current game, records and achievements are saved on your device.

The game interface is currently available in Russian.

name: Spacing Bench
description:
Spacing Bench tells you how many plants fit in a garden bed.

Enter the width and length in centimeters, then the gap between plants and the gap between rows. The app divides each side by that gap and multiplies the two counts. A 120 cm width at 20 cm spacing is 6 plants across. A dot grid draws a small picture of the same count.

Try the numbers on the bench before you sow. When they look right, start a planting and choose which bed receives it.

Beds
Each bed has a name, a width, a length, and a sun note: full sun, part sun, or shade. The card is drawn to that ratio, so a long bed looks long.

Plantings
A planting is one crop in one bed. Save the spacing, the day you planted, the days until harvest, and a status: growing, finished, or cleared.

Harvests
Write what you picked, an amount, and a unit you choose, such as handfuls, grams, or heads. Newest pickings are listed first.

Seed tins
Record the crop, the year on the packet, where it came from, where the tin sits, and how much is left, in your own words.

Guide
Four short articles explain beds, the spacing bench, harvests and seed tins, and how the file is stored.

On this iPhone
Beds, plantings, harvests, seed tins, and the last numbers on the bench stay in one private file on this iPhone. The first launch includes a sample bed so the pages are not empty. Delete anything you do not want. Deleting the app removes the file.

name: SpanoTransfer
description:
Spano Translate brings text, camera, voice and conversation translation together in one clear, easy-to-use app.

TEXT TRANSLATION
Type or paste text, choose your languages and translate online. Copy the result, listen with supported system voices, or save it to your favorites.

CAMERA AND PHOTO TEXT
Capture a photo or choose an image to recognize its text on your device. Check and edit the recognized text, then tap Translate when you are ready.

VOICE AND CONVERSATIONS
Use speech input for a single translation or take turns in a bilingual conversation. Chat-style translation keeps the original text and its translation together; it is designed for translation rather than general-purpose AI answers.

PHRASES THAT WORK OFFLINE
Browse 480 practical phrases across eight categories: culture, daily life, travel, weather, sports, dining, movies and flights. Built-in translations cover 200 languages, so these phrases are available from the first launch without downloading language packs.

KEEP USEFUL TRANSLATIONS CLOSE
Reopen translation history, manage favorites, copy text and use supported text-to-speech voices. History and favorites are stored on your device. Choose from 37 interface languages independently of your translation languages.

SYSTEM SHORTCUTS
Discover offline phrase widgets, supported Siri and Shortcuts actions, quick translation controls and an optional conversation Live Activity. On iOS 18.4 or later, select Spano as your default translation app to translate selected text in supported apps, then copy or replace it when the host permits. System features vary by iOS version and device.

Designed for iPhone, with layouts that adapt to available window space. No registration, advertising or subscriptions.

An internet connection is required for free-text translation. Speech recognition, OCR and spoken playback depend on system language support. Offline access applies to the built-in phrasebook. Selected-text translation and replacement depend on the host app.

name: SPARK: ADHD Focus & Quests
description:
Most to-do apps are built as open-ended list managers, which work great for traditional planning. For ADHD minds experiencing task paralysis, SPARK uses a guided, momentum-first approach designed to turn overwhelm into action in 120 seconds.

KEY FEATURES:
• AI Magic Task Slicer: Break intimidating tasks ("Clean the kitchen", "Do taxes", "Reply to that scary email") into tiny 1-to-3 minute micro-steps with zero friction.
• Brain Battery Filter: Match your tasks to your real-time energy—10% Zombie, 40% Low, or 80% Vibing.
• One-Step Hyperfocus Engine: Hide the rest of your backlog and focus on a single active micro-step with built-in Brown Noise, Tokyo Rain, and 40Hz Gamma procedural audio synthesis.
• Native iPhone Duo Dual-Screen Experience: Unfold your iPhone Duo to view your Command Deck on the left screen, the One-Step Hyperfocus Engine on the right screen, and the ergonomic Right-Thumb Dopamine Rail along the outer edge.
• Bloop's Sanctuary & Dopamine Reward Vault: Earn Spark Crystals strictly through effort to unlock 9 Sanctuary trophies and gear for Bloop, your focus gecko companion.
• 100% Earned by Effort: Zero In-App Purchases, zero subscriptions, zero ads, and 100% offline on-device privacy.

name: Speeku: Brazilian Portuguese
description:
Portuguese as it is spoken in Brazil, not Portugal. More than 1,500 short lessons take you from your first Oi to a real conversation, and every one of them works offline.

FREE TO START
Your first ten lessons are free, then four new lessons every week at no cost, and replays, culture lessons and flashcards are always free. One in-app purchase unlocks every lesson for good: no subscription, no ads.

THE PORTUGUESE OF BRAZIL
Speeku teaches the Portuguese you hear in São Paulo and Rio: its sounds, its você and a gente, o ônibus and o café da manhã, estou comendo and tudo bem? It is written for Brazil from the very first lesson, with a cafezinho, a pão de queijo and a brigadeiro along the way.

WHAT IS INSIDE
• More than 1,500 lessons, from A1 to B1, about ten exercises each
• Over 16,000 exercises of more than 50 kinds: pick the picture, build the sentence, fill the gap, play the scene, fill the verb table, sort into groups and many more
• More than 3,000 words and phrases, each practised until you can recall it on your own
• Every word and sentence spoken aloud, by six different voices, so your ear learns Brazil's sounds from day one
• A dictionary of more than 8,000 entries with Brazilian pronunciation and full verb tables, searchable offline
• Flashcards built from the words you have learned, which bring back the ones you are closest to forgetting first
• More than 70 culture lessons about the Brazil behind the words, from the festa junina to the Saturday feijoada

SAY IT OUT LOUD
Speaking drills and flashcards listen to what you say and check that it was the right word. The checking happens on your iPhone: nothing is recorded, uploaded or kept. It tells you which word it heard; it does not pretend to grade your accent.

FOUR STEPS TO EVERY WORD
Read it, hear it, say it, recall it. A few new words at a time, and a word is not yours until it has passed all four. The exercises keep changing, so the same word never comes back the same way twice.

WORKS ANYWHERE, KEEPS NOTHING
No account, no sign-up. Fully offline: the lessons, the dictionary and the speech checking all run on your iPhone, and the app collects no data of any kind. There is a lesson waiting on the plane, on the bus and on a beach with no signal. Your progress stays on your iPhone, and Settings can delete it whenever you like.

No streaks to protect and nothing that tells you off for missing a day. Just a short lesson whenever you have ten minutes.

The download is larger than most apps because the audio, the speech checking and the dictionary come with it instead of living on a server. One download, and then it works anywhere.

Start free and say your first words in Portuguese this evening.

name: Spendometer: Appliance Costs
description:
Ever wondered what that long shower actually cost? Spendometer shows you, penny by penny, while it's running.

Pick an appliance, tap Start, and a live meter counts up in pounds and pence. When you stop, you get a receipt: what it cost, how that compares with a cup of tea or a first-class stamp, and what it adds up to if you do the same every day for a year.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Time over 110 household appliances: electric shower, kettle, oven, tumble dryer, immersion heater, fan heater, gas central heating, EV charger and many more
• See what each one costs per hour before you switch it on
• Set a spending limit and get an alert when you reach it
• Run several meters at the same time
• Keep an eye on a running meter from the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island
• Try "what if" times with a slider: ten minutes, an hour, a whole evening
• Look back at a 7-day chart and your biggest spenders
• Share a receipt with the rest of the household
• Add your own appliances and adjust the wattage of any appliance
• Switch between UK and USA prices and names at any time

YOUR PRICES
Starts with the current Ofgem price cap rates for electricity and gas. Type in the unit rate from your own bill for a closer figure.

FAIR PRICING
The first appliance you time is free and stays free. A one-off purchase (£0.99) unlocks every appliance and lets you add your own. No subscription, no ads, no account.

PRIVATE
Spendometer has no server and collects nothing. Your appliances and history stay on your phone.

GOOD TO KNOW
Costs are estimates worked out from typical power ratings and your unit rate. They are not readings from your meter, so treat them as a guide. You don't need a smart meter, a smart plug or any other hardware.

name: Spezia: AI Intelligence
description:
Spezia is an analyst for the AI economy. It tells you what changed in AI, what it means for you, and where every number came from.

TODAY
A live feed of real items from the last few days: model releases, funding rounds, deals, outlooks, tool changes, video highlights and the U.S. data center build-out. Every card shows its source and its date. No account needed.

ASK
Ask a question in plain words and get an answer in under a minute: the key figures in bold, a chart or table when the data has one, numbered sources you can open, and follow-up questions to go deeper.

EVERY SPEZIA TOOL, BUILT FOR IPHONE
- Your front page, ranked for who you are and what you want from AI
- AI Intel: the day's stories by desk, with the key points and the source
- AI Progress: the pace of model releases, benchmarks and money, in charts
- AI by field: what AI can now do in law, medicine, finance, software and more
- Model leaderboard: every model ranked, with a profile of where each one leads
- Funding and company trackers: who is raising, who is paying, and every amount traced to its source
- Stock tracker: the AI stocks, their moves and the news behind them
- Tooling guide and software watch: the right model and tool for each job, and what changed this week
- AI Engineer: the repos, tools and techniques engineers who build with AI should use
- Video intelligence and the opportunity map
- The data center build-out: projects on a map, who is behind each one, and where the power comes from

WEEKLY BRIEF
One page each week on what moved in AI and the build-out. Every line links to its sources.

YOUR ACCOUNT
Sign in with Apple or with email. Your chats, profile and tools are the same on your phone and on spezia.ai. Free accounts include questions every month and most tools; tools that are part of a plan on your account open here too. Message Spezia's founder from the app, and delete your account at any time from the Account tab.

Spezia shows no ads and does not track you across apps or websites.

name: Spinkle: Word Wheel
description:
Spin the wheel. Pick a letter. See the answer take shape.
Try a new daily puzzle and build your streak.
Choose from 10 categories, from movies to nature.

Every spin gives you a new chance to earn points. Pick a consonant, buy a vowel with your points or guess the full answer when you’re ready. Play through short stages with English-language puzzles written for this edition.

Come back for a new daily challenge. Meet the clay mascots and make the game your own with music, sound and haptic settings.

Spinkle is free to play and contains ads. Optional purchases remove ads between stages or add letter hints.

name: Splash Fold
description:
A little bend. A big splash.

Splash Fold is a water puzzle set in a painted garden. A new pressure appears before every try. Choose your bend, open the orange valve, and guide one litre of water toward the drain.

Too little momentum leaves water short. Too much sends it past the drain. Catch at least 70% and earn three wins within five tries to unlock the next course.

Explore six courses with winding stone channels, changing valve positions, rocks, bumpers and a moving paddle. Watch turquoise droplets follow the walls and splash into the teal drain. Enjoy a gentle garden soundtrack, valve clicks, water sounds and win or miss chimes, with separate music and sound controls.

On compatible folding hardware with iOS 27.1 or later, gently bend the upper half while keeping the lower half flat. Play in portrait with the fold across the middle. An on-screen bend slider is automatically available on other supported devices and can also be selected in How to play.

A skippable introduction explains pressure, bending and the capture goal. Unlocked courses and sound preferences are saved on your device. Splash Fold works offline, with no account, advertising, subscriptions or in-app purchases.

name: Splat & Found: Paint Seek
description:
Somewhere in the picture, the hiders are hiding.
They painted themselves to blend into wallpaper, fruit stalls and bookshelves.
But hiders always leave a trace.

HOW TO PLAY
- Drag the scene and pinch to zoom as you look for traces.
- Paint footprints, a dropped brush, a tilted frame... each trace narrows down where a hider can be.
- Tap a hider and it pops out as the paint peels off!

WHAT'S INSIDE
- 50 levels across 8 places: school, home, market, amusement park, beach, campsite, train station and art museum
- Smarter hiders and fake traces as you go
- Earn three stars by finding them fast, with no mistakes and no hints
- Warm, hand-painted pictures
- Korean, English and Simplified Chinese

GOOD TO KNOW
- Free with ads. Ads appear only between levels, never during play.

Look closely together with the whole family. Found you!

name: Sprechklar: DTZ Sprechprüfung
description:
Sprich, als wärst du schon in der Prüfung.

Sprechklar bereitet dich auf den mündlichen Teil des Deutsch-Tests für Zuwanderer (DTZ, Niveau A2/B1) vor. Du übst mit KI-Prüfern, die dir wirklich zuhören: Herr Weber und Frau Schneider stellen Fragen, reagieren auf deine Antworten und fragen nach, so wie am echten Prüfungstag.

ALLE DREI PRÜFUNGSTEILE
• Teil 1 – Kennenlernen: über dich, deine Familie, Arbeit und Freizeit sprechen
• Teil 2 – Bild & Erfahrung: ein Foto beschreiben und von eigenen Erfahrungen erzählen
• Teil 3 – Gemeinsam planen: mit Samira etwas organisieren, Vorschläge machen und sich einigen
• Prüfungssimulation: alle Teile am Stück mit zwei Prüfern, wie in echt

DEIN ERGEBNIS
Nach jeder Übung bekommst du eine Einschätzung nach den fünf Bewertungskriterien der DTZ: Aufgabe, Gespräch, Wortschatz, Grammatik und Verständlichkeit. Du siehst deine häufigsten Fehler und bekommst Tipps – in deiner Sprache.

LERNEN
Die wichtigsten Sätze für jeden Prüfungsteil, mit natürlicher Stimme vorgelesen. Lena, deine KI-Lernhilfe, erklärt dir jeden Fehler aus deiner Übung und übt den richtigen Satz mit dir.

TIPPS IN DEINER SPRACHE
Deutsch, Arabisch, Türkisch, Ukrainisch, Russisch, Persisch, Kurdisch, Paschtu und Englisch. Die Prüfung selbst bleibt auf Deutsch – wie in echt.

PAKETE – EINMAL ZAHLEN, KEIN ABO
• Kostenlos: 3 Tage Teil 1 testen
• Starter: 30 Tage, alle Teile, 3 Übungen am Tag, 1 Simulation pro Woche
• Pro: 90 Tage, 10 Übungen und 1 Simulation am Tag, Fortschritt und Verlauf
• Premium: 90 Tage, 30 Übungen und 3 Simulationen am Tag, stärkere KI-Prüfer, Prüfungsergebnis als KI-Prognose, Lena, Prüfer-Gedächtnis, Schwerer Prüfungstag und Prüfungsreife-Zertifikat
• Extras: 1 zusätzliche Simulation oder 5 zusätzliche Übungen, wenn dein Tageslimit nicht reicht
Die Pakete verlängern sich nicht automatisch.

DATENSCHUTZ
Sprechklar speichert deine Sprachaufnahmen nicht. Sie werden nur für die Auswertung deiner Antwort verwendet.

WICHTIG
Sprechklar ist ein Übungsprogramm. Alle Ergebnisse sind Einschätzungen einer KI und keine offizielle Bewertung. Sprechklar ist nicht mit dem Bundesamt für Migration und Flüchtlinge (BAMF) oder den Prüfungsanbietern verbunden.

name: Sproutling Baby Tracker
description:
Caring for a newborn is exhausting enough without fighting complex, ad-cluttered tracking apps. 

Sproutling is designed for real-life parenting: quiet, intuitive, and fast enough to use with one hand in the dark.

Why parents love Sproutling:

• Live Lock Screen & Dynamic Island Timers
Start a nursing or sleep timer and see elapsed time right on your iPhone Lock Screen and Dynamic Island. Check feeding duration at a glance without ever unlocking your phone while holding your baby.

• AI Quick Note Importer
Too tired to tap through menus? Just type or dictate notes naturally (e.g., "Left breast 15m at 2:15am, wet diaper at 3am, weighed 8.4 lbs") and Sproutling parses and logs your entries instantly.

• Calm Night Mode
A gentle, low-contrast palette designed specifically to protect your eyes and your baby’s sleep during midnight feedings.

• Instant Multi-Caregiver Sync
Keep partners, grandparents, and nannies in sync with live real-time updates and secure, expiring invite codes. No duplicate timers or confusion about when baby last ate.

Visualize weight, length, and head circumference percentiles on responsive growth charts, track feed gaps, and generate comprehensive summary reports for your baby's checkups in one tap.

• Total Privacy & Zero Ads
Your baby’s data belongs to your family. No ads, no intrusive tracking, and in-app account deletion whenever you choose.

Whether you are tracking your newborn's first week or building a healthy routine, Sproutling brings clarity and calm to daily baby care.

name: SquaredCircle
description:
SquaredCircle is a platform built for professional wrestling fans.

Discover matches, rate performances, write reviews and see what the wrestling community thinks.

Whether you're revisiting an all-time classic or catching up on the latest action, SquaredCircle gives you a place to keep track of the matches that matter to you.

FEATURES

• Match Ratings – Rate wrestling matches using a five-star system, including half-star ratings.

• Reviews – Share your thoughts, discuss matches and read opinions from other fans.

• Community – Follow other wrestling fans, like reviews and join conversations through replies.

• Match Diary – Keep a personal record of the matches you've watched and rated.

Your wrestling opinions deserve a place to be heard.

Welcome to SquaredCircle.

name: Squawk Flights
description:
Every flight you've booked, tracked live.

LIVE ON TRIPS
• Two days before you fly, your flight goes live on Trips: gate, terminal, delays, landing time and baggage claim.
• Watch your plane cross the globe in real time, with the distance flown drawn in red.
• See the aircraft that will fly you, where it's coming from, and whether it will make it in time.
• Flights stay on Trips for 24 hours after landing, then move to Past.

SHARE A LIVE LINK
• Send anyone a link to your flight's live status, with a map of where the plane is. It opens in any browser with no app or sign-in, shows a rich preview in Messages, and can be added to their calendar.
• Shared pages never show what you paid or your confirmation code.

FARE DROPS
• Every trip you add is checked once a day, with today's fare next to what you paid and a price chart.
• Get an email when a fare drops, hits its lowest price, reaches your target, or falls below what you paid, so you can ask the airline for a credit.

YOUR YEAR IN THE AIR
• Every flight on a globe, with your miles, airports and countries, and a replay of the year that draws each route as the plane flies it.
• Past flights by year, with airports, airlines and what you spent.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No ads and no tracking. Face ID keeps the app locked, light and dark mode follow your phone, and you can delete your account and all of its data at any time.

name: Star Watch: Night Sky Map
description:
Star Watch is a sky map that turns with you. Raise your phone to the night sky and it names the star, constellation or planet in front of you.

POINT AND IDENTIFY
• Lift the phone and the map follows it; lower it to browse by hand
• Over 40,000 stars, 88 constellations and all 110 Messier objects
• Optional AR camera that lays the map over the real view

BEAUTIFUL AND ACCURATE
• NASA's all-sky Milky Way panorama, dust lanes and all
• Hand-drawn figures for 88 constellations, lit up with a tap
• Planet positions from NASA JPL's DE440 ephemeris
• 3D globes of the Sun, Moon and planets, lit to match their phase

WHAT'S UP TONIGHT
• Sunrise and sunset, Moon phase, rise and set times of the planets
• The next 45 days of Moon phases, Moon–planet meetings and meteor showers
• Visible passes of the International Space Station, Tiangong and Hubble

UNDERSTAND THE SKY
• Written descriptions of every constellation, the bright stars and deep-sky objects
• Photographs of more than 100 deep-sky objects
• Time travel: jump to any date or run the sky as a time-lapse
• Red night mode to protect your dark-adapted eyes

SIMPLE PRICING
Every feature is free for your first 10 sessions, with nothing to sign up for. After that one purchase unlocks everything for good. No subscription, no ads.

PRIVACY
No data is collected. Your location and camera are used only on your device.

name: StarPost by XModelAI

Create postcards that make moments memorable.

name: Steady: Interview Practice
description:
Practice interview answers out loud, hear yourself back, and see how you really sound. Steady gives you a question, records your answer, and shows your pace, long pauses and filler words, all worked out on your iPhone.

249 QUESTIONS WITH A PLAN FOR EACH
Common questions, behavioral "tell me about a time" questions, situational, tech and product, customer-facing roles, and medical school, residency, PA and nursing interviews. Every question comes with what the interviewer is really checking and the structure to use: STAR, present past future, and more.

RECORD, THEN SEE THE NUMBERS
Answer out loud with a timer that nudges you toward 90 seconds. Steady transcribes the answer on the device and counts um, uh, like, you know and other fillers, measures words per minute against a calm 130 to 160, and marks every pause over two seconds. Tap a highlighted word to hear that moment.

TRACK WHAT IS READY
Rate yourself on structure, a real example and a clear result. Mark questions ready and watch each set fill up before the big day.

IT STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
There is no account to make and there are no ads. Your recordings and transcripts never leave the iPhone: speech is recognized on the device, with no cloud AI. Your iCloud Backup includes them like any other app data. Delete all of it in Settings whenever you like.

Steady is free, with no in-app purchases.

name: Stediis
description:
Stediis brings your school's courses to your phone. Your lecturers publish notes, files, videos and quizzes; you study, take assessments and see your results, all in one place.
YOUR COURSES: Every course you're taking this semester, with its materials organized in folders, announcements from your lecturers, discussions and polls.

STUDY WITHOUT DATA: Save notes and files on your phone and open them anywhere, even with no connection. Saved copies update themselves when your lecturer changes a file.

QUIZZES, EXAMS AND ASSIGNMENTS: Take quizzes and exams on your phone with the time left always on screen. Your answers save as you go, and your attempt is handed in on time. Hand in assignments by uploading your work.

FAIR ASSESSMENTS: In Secure Mode, the assessment is the only thing on your screen until you hand it in, and screenshots are blocked, so every student is assessed fairly.

NEVER MISS A DEADLINE: Get notified when a new quiz is published, when results are released and when someone replies to you. Choose exactly what you're told about.

GETTING STARTED: Stediis works with schools that use it. Register with the registration code your school gives you, and your courses appear once your school approves you.

Questions? Visit stediis.com or email support@stediis.com.

name: StellarCapture
description:
StellarCapture turns what your crew says on site into finished paperwork.

Start a recording, walk the job, and talk through what you see and what you did. StellarCapture fills in your company's own forms from the recording, so technicians spend their time on the work, not on typing.

CAPTURE IT ALL IN ONE PASS

YOUR FORMS, FILLED IN

THE RIGHT JOB, AUTOMATICALLY

name: Stichblock – Score Keeper
description:
No more paper pads, pencils and spreadsheets at the table!

Stichblock – German for “trick pad” – is the score sheet for trick-taking games with bidding. Tap in the bids, play the round, then enter the tricks and bonus cards – the app scores with your house rules, keeps the table and crowns the winner. One phone is enough for the whole table, 2 to 8 players.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a rule profile, add players, set the seating order
• Tap the starting player or roll the dice
• Enter bids round the table with big number keys
• Play – the bids are shown in large digits
• Enter tricks and bonus cards, finish the round

THE APP KEEPS AN EYE ON THINGS
• Bid lock: the last bidder can’t choose the value that would make the bids add up
• Running total: “7 of 8 bid”
• Check: if the tricks don’t add up or too many bonus cards are given, the round can’t be finished
• The starting player moves on automatically
• Every round can be corrected later, all totals recalculate
• Undo for the last entry

THE APP TALKS ALONG
• “Jonas’s bid” – calls each player to bid
• “2 tricks not allowed” – the locked value for the last bidder
• “3 tricks” – confirms every entry
• “Sophie, first trick” – while counting tricks during play
• Fanfare and “Jonas wins” at the end of the game
Offline with your phone’s voices, choose the voice, mute with one tap during the game.

YOUR RULES
Score calculator for trick-taking games like Rage®, Oh Hell and games with ascending rounds. Every value can be changed:
• Number of rounds and card plan (descending, ascending, down and up, fixed or custom)
• Points for a correct bid and per trick
• Penalty fixed or per trick off
• Bonus cards with value and count, e.g. +5 and –5
• Do tricks and bonus count on a missed bid?
• Tie-break rule, number of players, dealer or first bidder

MADE FOR THE TABLE
• Big keys that everyone can use
• Screen stays on
• Landscape table that everyone can see
• Dark card-table green design, light mode if you like
• Fully offline – no account needed
• 15 languages

STICHBLOCK PRO – ONE-TIME, NO SUBSCRIPTION
The free version scores a complete game – with voice prompts and fanfare – and shows ads, never during a round. With Pro you get, for a one-time price:
• No ads
• Player profiles with avatar and colour
• Full history of all games and rounds
• Continue all games in progress
• Statistics per player: wins, win rate, average place, bid accuracy (also by number of cards), over- or underbidding, bonus balance, best game, head to head
• All charts: every player’s score progress as a line chart after each round, final score, points per round, win rate and accuracy over the months
• Unlimited rule profiles, shareable via link or QR code
• Export the table as CSV (Excel) or image
• Cloud backup and sync

Made in Austria – for game nights without maths mistakes.

Unofficial app. Rage is a trademark of AMIGO Spiel + Freizeit GmbH. Not affiliated with the publisher.

name: Stickoo: Words you can collect
description:
Hi! I'm a French dad, and I made Stickoo all by myself for my 4-year-old daughter, who is learning Korean and English. She adores stickers and sticks them absolutely everywhere, so I turned her love of stickers into a game: every word she learns earns her a new one! She loved it so much that I decided to share it with other families — for girls AND boys!

Stickoo turns a child's first words into a joyful sticker-collecting game, with more than 400 words in English, French, Spanish, Korean, Japanese and Chinese. Super fun to play together!

LISTEN AND TAP
A warm voice says a word, and your child taps the matching picture. Every right answer earns a star.

6 LANGUAGES, REAL VOICES
All words are recorded with natural voices. Pick the language your child speaks and the one they're learning.

STICKERS FOR GIRLS AND BOYS
Each profile picks a girl or a boy and gets its own collection: friends, princesses, heroes, golden and diamond levels… and sometimes a rare animal as a surprise gift!

TROPHIES
Unlock 33 yummy food trophies as you play.

OVER 400 WORDS
Family, body, animals, food, colors, numbers, toys, nature, vehicles and everyday phrases. New words unlock little by little and turn golden once they're well known.

MY NOTEBOOK
Kids stick, move, turn and resize their stickers anywhere in their own notebook.

10 MAGICAL WORLDS
Every quiz takes place in a new scene: spring, summer, autumn, winter, forest, night, mountain, under the sea, the beach and a birthday party.

EASY OR HARD
Easy mode for little ones. Hard mode for big kids and parents: every mistake costs a star!

FOR PARENTS
• One purchase, everything included: no ads, no in-app purchases, no subscription, no account
• No data collected: everything stays on the device
• Works offline
• Up to 5 player profiles

Stickoo is made by one person, with love, for girls and boys aged 3 to 8 — and for parents who want to learn with them. Thank you for supporting a small independent creator!

name: Still — Ideas Together
description:
Still gives independent creatives a place to ask for feedback and talk through their work.

Share a question in the Exchange, add context or a work link, and hear from other members. When you’ve decided what to try next, share a takeaway.

name: Stillair: Turbulence Forecast
description:
Nervous about flying? Stillair shows you what the air along your route is likely to feel like, explains every bump and sound in plain words, and keeps calming tools ready in your pocket, even without internet.

MADE FOR HOW YOU FEEL
• Start with three quick questions: how you feel about flying, what worries you most and when your next flight is. The answers stay on your iPhone and bring the right answers and shortcuts to the front.
• We scan your route right away. Too early? We'll tell you when the forecast is ready.

YOUR FLIGHT, MINUTE BY MINUTE
• Pick your departure and arrival airports and time. No flight number needed.
• See a smooth, light, moderate or rough strip along the whole route, at cruising altitude, timed to when your plane should be there.
• A plain summary: "First 40 minutes smooth, 20 minutes of light bumps over the Rockies, then smooth to landing."
• Storm areas near your route are marked separately.

IS THIS NORMAL?
• Short, honest answers for 30 sounds and feelings, from the "barking dog" on an A320 to the engines going quiet after takeoff.
• Articles on what turbulence is, how strong airliners are built, and why your seatbelt matters most.

CALM IN THE AIR
• Save your forecast before you board. Everything works in airplane mode.
• In-flight timeline: roughly where you are now and what the next part of the flight should feel like.
• Breathing exercises, grounding steps and calming cards for when the bumps start.

WHERE THE DATA COMES FROM
US: NOAA Graphical Turbulence Guidance (GTG). Worldwide: our own experimental model built on NOAA's global weather forecast. Each part of your route shows which source it uses.

FREE AND PRO
Free: unlimited flights, a "route scanned, forecast ready" note for each flight, whether storm cells are expected, breathing exercises and the 10 most asked "Is this normal?" answers.
Pro: your verdict and the minute-by-minute strip and summary, the map, the altitude view, the in-flight timeline that works offline, the "I feel bumps" guide, focus exercises, the full "Is this normal?" library, and an alert if your forecast changes before you fly.

Stillair is for information only. It is not for flight planning or operations, and it is not therapy or medical advice. Always follow your crew's instructions.

Subscription: Stillair Pro, weekly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account and renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://vayronapps.com/stillair/privacy.html

name: Stillwind: Ceiling Fan Balance
description:
A wobbling ceiling fan is usually fixed with a small balancing kit: clip a weight on each blade, see which blade calms the fan, slide the clip along it, then stick on a permanent weight. The hard part is telling whether a change helped, because from the floor every wobble looks the same. Stillwind measures it.

HOW IT MEASURES
Tape your iPhone to the part of the fan that doesn't spin, such as the switch housing, light kit or downrod. Stillwind records 12 seconds of motion and reports:
- how far the fan sways, in millimetres or inches
- the fan's speed in rpm
- how clear the reading is

GUIDED BALANCING
Stillwind walks you through the whole balancing kit procedure:
1. A first reading with no weight on.
2. A reading with the clip on each blade in turn, to find the blade that helps most.
3. Readings with the clip near the bracket and near the tip of that blade, to find the best spot.
4. A final check with the permanent weight on.
It compares every reading with the first one, so you can see exactly how much each change helped.

WHEN WEIGHT ISN'T THE ANSWER
Stillwind tells you when a fan is already steady, when a reading was taken at a different fan speed from the others, and when weight is unlikely to be the cause, so you know to check loose screws or a bent blade bracket instead.

MADE FOR A PHONE ON THE CEILING
Spoken, sound and haptic cues tell you when a reading starts and ends, and the screen stays awake while it records.

A RECORD FOR EVERY FAN
Keep a history and a wobble chart for each fan in the house, or do a quick check without saving.

PRIVATE
Motion data is processed on your iPhone and never leaves it. There is no account, no ads and no analytics, and the app doesn't ask for any permissions.

Safety: always switch the fan off and let it stop before touching the blades or attaching the phone.

name: Stomatik – Cabinet dentar

Pentru echipele cabinetelor care folosesc Stomatik. Contul se primește de la administratorul cabinetului. Fiecare om vede doar ce îi permite rolul lui: medic, asistentă, recepție, contabil, manager sau administrator.

name: STOW: Photo Backup to Drive
description:
Your photos and videos, safe on a drive you own. STOW copies the originals to an SSD, a USB-C flash drive or a NAS, verifies every file, and lets you browse the archive just like your Photos library.

Free, with no subscription, no account and no cloud.

EVERY FILE VERIFIED
STOW doesn't trust a copy until it has read it back: every file is compared with the original using a SHA-256 fingerprint. You always see what was copied, what was already there and what failed, with the reason.

YOUR ARCHIVE, LIKE PHOTOS
Browse the photos and videos on your drive month by month, with Live Photos that come alive. Need a photo back? "Bring back to Photos" returns it to your library with its original date and name.

FREE UP SPACE WITHOUT FEAR
In "Backup and free up space" mode, STOW re-checks the copies on your drive and offers to remove from your iPhone only what is truly safe. A photo edited after its last backup stays until the edit is saved, nothing is deleted without your confirmation, and iOS always asks one last time.

SSD, FLASH DRIVE OR NAS
Use an external drive, a USB-C flash drive, a folder in the Files app or a NAS connected through Files. Each destination keeps its own archive, organised by year and month.

RELIABLE WHEN THINGS GO WRONG
If the drive is unplugged or the connection drops, STOW stops with the right reason and resumes exactly where it left off, without copying anything twice. On iOS 26 a backup can keep going even when you leave the app.

ORIGINALS, NOT REDUCED COPIES
HEIC, JPEG, RAW and video in their original format, including Live Photos and RAW+JPEG pairs. Photos you edited in Photos are saved with the original and your latest edit, so they look the way you see them and you can always go back. Duplicates are recognised and not stored twice.

AN ARCHIVE FOR EVERYONE
The whole family can share one drive, each with their own profile and folder. New iPhone? Restore your profile from the archive.

STOW PRO, ONCE
Verified backup, the gallery and "Bring back to Photos" are always free. STOW Pro, a single purchase with no subscription and shared with Family Sharing, unlocks: Free up space, photo search with Apple's on-device image analysis, NAS and multiple drives, and a profile for everyone at home.

TRULY PRIVATE
STOW collects no data, uses no analytics or tracking, and sends nothing to external servers.

name: Sudoku Bolt
description:
Race a friend to the last square or take your time with a solo Sudoku. Sudoku Bolt gives you four difficulty levels, a fresh daily grid, and a live two-player race.

CLASSIC
Choose Easy, Medium, Hard, or Expert. Pencil in candidates, undo a move, or use a hint when you're stuck. Pause and come back to your saved puzzle anytime.

DAILY CHALLENGE
Solve the same grid as other players each day. A new challenge arrives at midnight UTC. Classic and Daily play offline.

HIGH SCORES
Beat your personal best. Faster finishes with fewer mistakes and hints earn higher scores. Browse your Classic records by difficulty and check your Daily results on the same device.

NEARBY DUEL

name: Sudoku Heist
description:
Every number is loot.

Sudoku Heist turns classic sudoku into a roguelike vault job. Solve the board with the rules you already know, but the order you fill it decides how much you steal.

FINISH LINES, MULTIPLY THE HAUL
A correct digit earns 10 plus its value. Complete a row, column or box and that placement doubles. Complete two at once for x4, all three for x8. Save the right cells for last and watch the loot pour in.

STAY QUIET
Clean placements build Stealth, a multiplier on everything you place. One wrong digit costs a heart and resets your Stealth. Lose every heart and the guards have you.

NINE VAULTS, THREE JOBS
Start on a corner store register and work up to the city reserve. Boards grow from 4x4 to 6x6 to 9x9, and every vault has a loot target you must hit before the board is full.

GEAR UP AT THE FENCE

FEEL EVERY CLICK
Safe tumblers drop as you place digits, brass bells ring when lines complete, and the dial spins on the final cell before the door swings open. Your heart pounds on your last life.

name: Summit: Fitness Challenge Game

Take the stairs. Climb Everest.

Summit turns the stairs and hills you already climb into progress up the world's most famous landmarks and mountains. There is nothing to log and nothing to start. Open the app and you are higher up Big Ben than when you last looked.

YOUR IPHONE HAS ALREADY BEEN COUNTING
Summit reads Flights Climbed from Apple Health, so the stairs at work, a hilly walk and a Sunday hike all count on their own. On day one it shows you everything you have climbed since your iPhone started counting.

25 CLIMBS, FROM BIG BEN TO MARS
Start with a landmark you can finish in about a week, then go bigger.
• Free: Christ the Redeemer, the Sydney Opera House, the Statue of Liberty, Big Ben, the Great Pyramid of Giza, the Washington Monument, the Sagrada Família, the Golden Gate Bridge, the Eiffel Tower, The Shard and the Burj Khalifa.
• With Summit Pro: Everest from Base Camp to its 8,849 m summit, K2, Kilimanjaro, the Matterhorn, Mount Fuji, Ben Nevis, Machu Picchu and more, all the way to Olympus Mons on Mars.

A WORLD DRAWN IN DOTS
Spin the globe, pick a climb and fly down onto it. Every landmark and mountain is a 3D scene built from real map and elevation data. Watch your marker move up the route, pass Everest's camps one by one, and pick up facts about the place at the height you have reached.

A FITNESS CHALLENGE THAT RUNS ITSELF
• A short morning briefing: what you climbed yesterday and how far is left
• Streaks, a weekly recap and your personal records
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets that keep up with your climb
• A stamp for every summit, and a card to share when you reach the top

FIVE FLIGHTS A DAY
A 2023 Tulane University study linked climbing five or more flights of stairs a day to around a 20% lower risk of cardiovascular disease. Summit makes those flights visible and gives you a reason to take the stairs again tomorrow.

HOW IT COUNTS
Summit measures climbing, not steps. Stairs and hills count; a walk on the flat does not. Keep your iPhone on you and Apple Health does the rest.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no sign-up, no server. Your climbing stays on your iPhone and in Apple Health.

SUMMIT PRO
Summit is free to download and the eleven landmarks above are free for good. Summit Pro is an optional subscription, monthly or yearly, that unlocks every mountain (Everest included), the Empire State Building and the CN Tower, Insights and streak freezes. New subscribers get a one-week free trial.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

name: Super Over: Quick Cricket
description:
Swipe where you want the ball to go. Time it right and it's gone: over cover, over the bowler's head, into the second tier. Super Over is cricket you can play in a coffee break.

BAT LIKE YOU MEAN IT
Every stroke in the book from one gesture. Swipe gently to place it along the ground; flick hard to loft it. Read the length: pull the short ones, drive the full ones, sweep the spinners, scoop the yorker over the keeper. Time it perfectly and hear the willow crack.

BOWL TO A PLAN
Pace, swing, off-spin and leg-spin: bouncers, yorkers, slower balls, outswingers, doosras and googlies. Pick the ball, drag the target to where it should pitch, and tap as the ring closes for pinpoint accuracy. Choose who bowls each over and set your field.

A WORLD TOUR
Thirty stops across six grounds: a city maidan, a village green with a pavilion clock, a harbour oval at golden hour, a monsoon park under heavy cloud, a desert arena under floodlights, and a hundred-thousand-seat bowl for the Final. Chases, defences, last-over thrillers and full matches, three stars each.

EVERY WAY TO PLAY
• Quick Match: pick the overs, the wickets, the ground and the opponent, then toss
• Super Over: one over each against the CPU or a friend on one phone
• Blitz: bat until you're out
• Daily Chase: the same target for everyone, every day
• Nets: practice against pace, swing or spin
• Squad: sign sixteen made-up stars, upgrade them, set your batting order

FIELDERS WHO TRY
Fielders read the ball and run for it: diving stops on the rope, catches in the deep, a keeper standing up to the spinners. LED stumps flash when they're hit. Sixes and wickets come back as instant replays — bowled ones from the stump cam.

No ads. No accounts. No tracking. Works offline.

name: Supermind: Brain Games
description:
Supermind is four fast brain games in one glowing, neon world. Every round lasts about 30 seconds. Nothing sits still: orbs orbit, rules flip and magnets swap.

Play for a minute a day, build streaks and watch your neural brain light up as you improve.

Four games, four skills
• Orbit Memory: lights flash around a spinning core. Tap them back in order while they keep moving. From level 5 a second ring spins the other way.

Every day

• Daily streaks that unlock the Aurora skin

Made to feel great
• Combos, particle bursts, screen pulses and haptics

Your progress, everywhere

name: SwaplySound

FIND YOUR EVENING SOUNDTRACK

name: TableMint: CSV Workshop
description:
Give small tables a clearer structure with TableMint. Import UTF-8 CSV from Files or paste explicitly, choose comma, semicolon or Tab, and inspect a real row-and-column grid without changing the original source.

Work with the structure:
• Read quoted delimiters, escaped quotes and embedded newlines.
• Review heading problems; choose repair or short-row padding explicitly.
• Select, reorder and rename output columns.
• Apply a row filter and stable text or decimal sort, then preview an independent result.
• Save exact-schema recipes for another compatible dataset.

Numbers stay explicit. Choose Text or Decimal statistics and a dot or comma decimal separator. Empty cells, invalid values and numeric zero remain separate. Inspect counts, distinct text values, sums, means and ranges from the complete accepted column. Save immutable statistical reports that remain independent of later source changes or deletion.

Export a properly quoted CSV or a useful statistical PDF through the system share sheet. CSV formula protection adds an apostrophe to formula-like values by default; an explicit OFF option retains exact trusted strings. PDFs summarize a column and clearly label their limited sample; full table data is available as CSV.

Processing and saved records work offline. No app account, advertising, analytics or table-data cloud synchronization is required. Input limits: 256 KiB, 1,000 data rows and 24 columns. Grids show the first 100 rows; processing and export use all accepted rows.

name: Tabs Pro: Tuner & Chords

description:
Play a song near your phone and Tabs Pro builds the guitar chord sheet and tablature: an editable starting point for you to check and polish. The analysis happens entirely on your device: none of your audio is sent anywhere. And the chromatic tuner you use before playing is included — with no ads along the way.

REAL-TIME CHROMATIC TUNER
Play a string and see the note, the octave, the frequency in Hz and how far above or below pitch it is, measured in cents. The indicator slides from -50 to +50 cents and turns green when the string enters the in-tune zone. The reading is stabilized so it doesn't jump between notes on every harmonic.

CHORDS FROM AUDIO
Record through the microphone or pick an audio file stored on your device — MP3, M4A and WAV in 16-bit PCM. Songs from streaming services are protected and cannot be opened by any app. The app identifies the notes, recognizes the chords and lays out the six-line tablature with the chords written above.

FINGERPICKING OR STRUMMING
The app picks the format on its own: when the part sounds fingerpicked, the transcription comes out note by note, with string and fret assigned; when it sounds strummed, it comes out as chords. Notes outside the guitar's range are discarded.

HEAR THE RESULT
The chord sheet is played back with guitar sound synthesized inside the app, and you set the playback speed between 40 and 200 BPM — from study pace to play-along tempo. Tap tempo sets that speed by tapping to the beat, instead of dragging a slider by eye.

FIX ANYTHING YOU WANT
Tap any chord to change the root, switch between major, minor, sevenths (7, m7, maj7 — shown as 7M), suspended and diminished, or remove it. Save to the on-device library and come back anytime.

EVERYTHING HAPPENS ON YOUR PHONE
Your audio is never sent to any server. There is no account to create, no ads, no data collection, and the app works without internet — you can put the phone in airplane mode and use everything. The app asks for a single permission: the microphone.

WHAT TO EXPECT FROM THIS VERSION
Tabs Pro gives you the song's direction: the generated chord sheet is a starting point for you to check and polish, not a finished transcription. The app recognizes major, minor, seventh (7, m7, maj7 — shown as 7M), suspended and diminished chords, plus slash chords like C/G. It works best with live guitar and minimal background noise, and the analysis covers the first three minutes of audio. Fix any chord by tapping it — editing is one touch away.

Tallied makes it easy to keep track of time spent on tasks. With one click of a button, you can start and stop time on a task, seamlessly across all your devices. name: Tally: ABA Behavior Data

COLLECT ANY KIND OF DATA IN ONE SESSION
