SEE PROGRESS
• Trend graphs for every behavior, by session, over 2 weeks, 30 days, 90 days or all time.
• Phase-change lines (Baseline, DRA, FCT, Maintenance and your own), with a trend line and mean for each phase.
• ABC patterns: the most common antecedents, consequences and pairs, plus time of day.

SHARE WITH YOUR TEAM
• PDF report per learner over any date range, with graphs and phase lines, session tables, ABC patterns and session notes. Ready for supervision, IEP meetings or the next appointment.
• Summary CSV (one row per session per behavior) and raw CSV (every timestamp) for Excel, Google Sheets or your own graphing.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Learners are identified by initials or a one-word nickname only. Tally blocks entries that look like full names, emails or ID numbers.
• No account, no cloud and no analytics. Your data stays on your device and only leaves it when you export a file yourself.
• Tally is a personal data-collection tool. It is not a HIPAA-covered service or an electronic health record, and it does not diagnose, treat or recommend interventions. Follow your organization's policy on recording client data on a personal device.

Works in light and dark mode, with Dynamic Type and VoiceOver labels.

SUBSCRIPTION
Tally Pro unlocks the whole app: $59.99 per year with a 7-day free trial, or $7.99 per month. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in Settings › Apple ID › Subscriptions.

Terms: https://nooton.com/apps/tally/terms
Privacy: https://nooton.com/apps/tally/privacy

name: Taluna
description:
Taluna is your private assistant to better understand what's going on with the people you care about and to prepare difficult conversations: partner, ex, co-parenting, family, friendship or work.

• Only you talk to your assistant. Nobody else reads your conversation.
• If you want, link a space with the other person using an invitation code. They only see the exact text you authorize, and you can withdraw it at any time.
• Your assistant remembers what you tell it to help you better, and you can see, correct and delete those memories.
• Keep notes of what you come to understand.
• Dictate with your voice if you prefer; the audio is not stored.
• Download your data or delete your account whenever you want.

Taluna supports you; it is not therapy or an emergency service. For adults 18 and over.

Subscription: 7-day free trial, then Taluna Premium monthly or yearly. It renews automatically and you can cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://taluna.pisiotechnologies.com/en/terms

name: TAMGURAN
description:
TAMGURAN – Türk Dünyasının Dijital Hafızası

Biz kimiz? Nereden geldik? Hangi destanları yaşattık?

Binlerce yıllık Türk tarihinin kapılarını aralamaya, bozkırların derinliklerinden günümüze uzanan eşsiz bir yolculuğa hazır mısın?

TAMGURAN, Türk tarihini, mitolojisini, destanlarını, kadim geleneklerini ve ortak kültürel mirasını yeni nesillere aktarmak amacıyla geliştirilmiş dijital bir kültür ve tarih platformudur.

KADİM DESTANLARI KEŞFET

Oğuz Kağan’ın efsanevi yolculuğuna katıl, gök tüylü kurtun izini sür, Ergenekon’un demir dağlarında yeniden doğuşun hikâyesini keşfet.

TÜRK MİTOLOJİSİNİN GİZEMLİ DÜNYASI

Ülgen, göğün katları, dünya ağacı, Bozkurt ve kadim Türk inanışları hakkında bilgi edin. Mitolojik anlatıları etkileyici görseller ve edebî hikâyeler eşliğinde oku.

TARİHİMİZİ YENİDEN TANI

Ötüken’den Orhun Yazıtları’na, Bilge Kağan’dan Dede Korkut’a uzanan kültürel mirası keşfet. Türk topluluklarının tarihî yolculuklarını ve ortak değerlerini öğren.

ÇOCUKLAR İÇİN MASALLAR

Çocukların dostluğu, cesareti, merhameti, yardımlaşmayı ve kültürel değerleri keşfedebileceği özgün masallarla yeni nesillerin hayal dünyasını zenginleştir.

ZENGİN BİR OKUMA DENEYİMİ

• Bölümler hâlinde ilerleyen, birbirini tamamlayan anlatılar

• Mistik atmosferli, özgün ve etkileyici görseller

• İçeriklerin arasında yer alan görsel ve medya desteği

• Sesli okuma ve erişilebilirlik özellikleri

• Kaynakçalarla desteklenen tarihî ve kültürel bilgiler

• Farklı Türk dilleri için geliştirilen çok dilli içerik altyapısı

• Düzenli olarak genişletilebilen dinamik içerik arşivi

AMACIMIZ: BİRLİK, DİRLİK VE ORTAK HAFIZA

TAMGURAN’ın en büyük amacı, dünyanın dört bir yanında yaşayan Türk toplulukları arasında kültürel bağları güçlendirmek, ortak tarihimizin unutulmamasına katkı sağlamak ve bu eşsiz mirası gelecek nesillere aktarmaktır.

Geçmişimizi tanıyarak geleceğimize birlikte ışık tutmayı hedefliyoruz.

TAMGURAN, Yazılım Geliştirme Uzmanı ÖZGÜR AYSU tarafından geliştirilmiş bağımsız bir kültür ve eğitim projesidir.

Köklerimizi tanıyalım. Destanlarımızı yaşatalım. Ortak hafızamızı geleceğe taşıyalım.

TAMGURAN – Türk Dünyasının Dijital Hafızası

name: Tandai: Daftar & Ceklis
description:
Tandai adalah aplikasi daftar serbaguna. Buat daftar apa saja, lalu tandai yang sudah selesai.

Mulai cepat dari 24 contoh: belanja, tagihan, absensi, to-do, cicilan, arisan, iuran warga, tabungan, utang piutang, tugas sekolah, jadwal pelajaran, resep, liburan, silsilah keluarga, dan lainnya. Kolomnya sudah siap, tinggal diisi. Atau buat daftar sendiri dari kosong.

EMPAT BENTUK DAFTAR
• Ceklis: tinggal centang yang sudah.
• Tabel: kolom teks, angka, uang, tanggal, centang, dan pilihan, lengkap dengan jumlahnya. Isi langsung di selnya.
• Kalender: catat rutinitas dan lihat hari yang sudah ditandai.
• Bertingkat: untuk silsilah keluarga dan struktur organisasi.
Daftar berpilihan juga bisa dilihat sebagai papan.

REKAP YANG BISA DIKIRIM
• Rekap tiap daftar: total, sudah, sisa, dan siapa yang belum.
• Absensi per pertemuan dan per nama, termasuk izin dan sakit.
• Kirim rekap ke WhatsApp, salin sebagai teks, cetak, atau unduh sebagai PDF dan lembar kerja.

SEMUA DI SATU BERANDA
• Dua menu utama: Daftar untuk membuat, Tandai untuk menandai.
• Jadwal terdekat dari semua daftar, supaya tagihan dan tenggat tidak terlewat.
• Pengingat pada harinya, dan sehari sebelumnya bila mau.

DAFTAR YANG BERULANG
• Atur daftar jadi harian, mingguan, bulanan, atau tahunan.
• Saat masanya berganti, tanda dikosongkan sendiri dan tanggalnya maju.
• Putaran yang lewat tersimpan dan bisa dibuka lagi kapan saja.

MUDAH DIPAKAI DI MANA SAJA
• Tetap bisa dipakai tanpa internet; perubahan tersimpan saat tersambung lagi.
• Masuk tanpa kata sandi: kode dari email, Apple, atau Google.
• Salin daftar jadi daftar baru, urutkan baris, dan saring per pilihan.
• Rupiah, ringgit, dolar Singapura, dan mata uang lain.
• Bahasa Indonesia dan Inggris, tampilan terang dan gelap.

Tanpa iklan dan tanpa pelacak. Tandai dibuat oleh aimoim.id, pembuat Toolisan.

name: Tandem: Posture Coach
description:
Tandem notices when you slouch and tells you once.

The AirPods you already wear know how your head is tipped. Tandem reads that motion, compares it with your own upright position, and can tell a slouch from a glance down at your phone. There is nothing to clip on and nothing to charge.

ONE NUDGE, THEN QUIET
• Stay slouched longer than you allow and one nudge arrives: a tap on your wrist, a chime in your AirPods, or a banner.
• Straighten up and a soft cue answers.
• One nudge for each slouch, never a string of them. Snooze for 30 minutes or pause for the day whenever you like.

SEE HOW THE DAY WENT
• Today shows how much of the day you were upright, when you slouched and for how long.
• Trends shows the weeks, and how sitting compares with walking.
• Each session opens to its own detail.

A COACH THAT KNOWS YOUR DAY
• Ask about your own history in plain words: when you slouch most, how this week compares, what helps at a desk.
• Choose the coach's voice and give it a name.
• Every number is counted by Tandem itself. Apple Intelligence only helps with the wording: on your iPhone, or through Apple's Private Cloud Compute, which keeps nothing and which you can switch off.

EVERYWHERE YOU LOOK
• Apple Watch app, complications and Smart Stack.
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, and a Live Activity while you're tracking.
• Ask Siri how your posture is today.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no server, no analytics, no ads.
• Your posture is measured, worked out and kept on your iPhone. Your history never leaves it.
• Tandem does not use the microphone, the camera or your location.

WHAT YOU NEED
• AirPods that sense head movement: AirPods Pro, AirPods Max, AirPods (3rd generation) or later.
• iPhone with iOS 26 or later. Apple Watch is optional.

While tracking is on, Tandem holds a silent audio session so iOS keeps passing AirPods motion with the screen off. It makes no sound except the chimes you choose, and it never listens.

Tandem is a posture reminder, not a medical device, and does not diagnose or treat any condition.

name: Tango Town
description:
Welcome to Tango Town, a cozy island city-builder in the sun.
Prince Kai has heard you are the most promising builder in the islands. He sails in, hands you your first shells and leaves the island in your hands. Lay paths, build homes for your islanders and grow a lively little town by the sea.

BUILD YOUR TOWN
Drag sandy paths across the island and place Beach Huts beside them
A clear green and red grid shows where every building fits
Watch your islanders stroll the streets and move into their new homes

GROW PRODUCTION CHAINS
Palm Cutters chop logs, Plank Shacks turn them into planks
Catch shrimp at the Shrimp Pier, tap coconut water at the Coconut Grove
Dig sand, fire glass at the Glassworks and craft Rose-tinted Glasses at the Optician
Couriers carry goods along your roads between the warehouse and every workshop

UPGRADE AND STAFF
Every workshop needs a worker, and islanders are shared out fairly
Level buildings up to 3 for more workers and faster output
Upgrade happy Beach Huts into Bungalows

KEEP EVERYONE HAPPY
Feed your islanders and give them what they need to stay cheerful
Put on the Rose-tinted Glasses to see at a glance what troubles your island
Reach milestones to unlock new buildings

FIVE-CHAPTER CAMPAIGN
First Footprints, Planks & Prawns, Glass Shore, Rose Tint and Pink Horizon
Each island has its own shape, size and goal, and every chapter opens the next

ENDLESS FREE PLAY
Generate a new island from any seed: small, medium or large; round, long or crescent
Choose Easy, Normal or Hard and share your favourite seeds with friends

MADE FOR RELAXING
No accounts, no ads, no in-app purchases
Plays fully offline, with autosave
Calm tropical music, gentle sounds and haptics you can tune in Settings
Pack your sunglasses and start building!

name: Tank Span
description:
Tank Span is a private notebook for the cars you drive. Fill-ups, trips, and service stay on this phone. There is no account and nothing is uploaded.

Desk shows the active vehicle, the latest full-tank economy, this month’s fuel and service spend, and jobs that are coming due. Log a fill-up, a trip, or a service visit from the same screen.

Economy uses the full-tank method. Sort full tanks by odometer. The volume of a full tank is the fuel used since the previous full tank, and the distance is the difference in readings. Partial fills stay in the cost total and are left out of that calculation, so a half tank does not count as a complete span. Two full tanks are needed before a number appears.

Pumps is the fill-up list: date, odometer, volume, price, station, and a full-tank mark. Garage holds one card per car, with maker, model, year, plate, and fuel type.

Trips store a start reading, an end reading, a purpose, and the places. They are a diary of drives and do not change the fuel math.

Service stores the kind of work, the cost, the shop, and an optional next date or next odometer. A job is marked coming due when the date is inside 45 days or the next reading is within 800 distance units of the latest number in the log.

Distance, volume, and the money symbol are labels you choose. Switching from kilometers to miles does not convert old readings. Type new numbers in the unit you selected.

Milemark is a personal log. It is not a tax record, a warranty, or a statement of official mileage.

name: TankDoseScale
description: TankDoseScale är för hemhydroponik: skriv in milliliter per liter på näringsflaskan och litrarna i tanken, så ser du direkt hur många milliliter del A och del B du ska hälla. Spara dagens EC och pH på samma batch och öppna kurvan igen senare. Färgbandet för gröda och stadium är ett publicerat trädgårdsintervall, inte en gödselorder eller växtdiagnos. Värden utanför EC 0–4 eller pH 4–8 sparas inte som en falsk avläsning.

name: Tanksage
description:
TankSage helps you make sense of a freshwater aquarium water test.

Type in the results of your own test (pH, ammonia, nitrite, nitrate and temperature), then describe what you see: the problem, the fish and plants in the tank, its size and how long it has been set up. TankSage suggests what may be going on, what to do next and what you might need.

HOW IT WORKS
• Check water: enter any of the five values. Every value is optional, and a value outside the accepted range is flagged under its field.
• Describe the problem: say what you see, who lives in the tank and how long it has been running.
• Get a diagnosis: an overall rating (ok, attention or urgent) and a short note on each parameter.
• Follow the plan: numbered steps, each with a time frame such as today or within 24 hours.
• See what to buy: each shopping item explains why it may help and opens an Amazon search in your browser, so you choose the exact product yourself.

YOUR TANKS STAY ON YOUR IPHONE
• Save your tanks and keep a history of checks for each one.
• Come back with a new check for the same tank and open earlier results any time.
• No account and no sign-up.

HONEST BY DESIGN
• Suggestions are generated by AI and may be wrong. Suggested by AI. Not a substitute for advice from an aquatic veterinarian.
• For freshwater aquariums only.
• Free: up to 10 AI checks per day (resets daily). No subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no ads.
• As an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases.

name: Tap Piano: Wrist Instruments
description:
Wear your Apple Watch, tap the table with your fingers, and play an entire song.

No piano skills needed: every tap plays the next note of the song. The sheet takes care of the pitch — you bring the rhythm and the feeling. You'll finish Ode to Joy on your first try.

FEELS LIKE A REAL INSTRUMENT
22 recorded instruments: grand piano, electric piano, guzheng, guitar, harp, violin, strings, flute, pan flute, ocarina, music box, kalimba, marimba, glockenspiel, steel drum, pipe organ, choir, harmonica and more. Each one looks like itself on your wrist — piano keys, zither strings with bridges, kalimba tines.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Tap: keep your wrist raised and tap the table with a finger
• Strum: flick your wrist like a guitarist and the chord sweeps along
• Bow: move your wrist side to side like a violinist — faster is louder, stop and the note fades

A WHOLE SONG, NOT SINGLE NOTES
The accompaniment follows your tempo: tap faster and it speeds up, slow down and it waits for you. Tap Preview to hear it first.

MANAGE SONGS ON IPHONE
• Import MIDI files — the melody is found automatically
• Write your own tunes in simple numbered notation, chords included
• Let AI write the sheet: copy a prompt to any AI chatbot and paste the result back
• Send to your watch in one tap

PRACTICE WITH FEEDBACK
After each song, your iPhone shows a rhythm score and whether each tap was early or late.

THOUGHTFUL DETAILS
• A friendly first-run guide with a 6-tap calibration
• Keeps playing when the screen dims
• Improvise mode: pick a scale, tap your own melody, and record it
• Works on every Apple Watch size

No internet, no account, no data collection, no ads.

Included: Ode to Joy, Canon in D, Für Elise, Swan Lake, Minuet in G, Turkish March, Greensleeves, Amazing Grace, Auld Lang Syne, Twinkle Twinkle Little Star, Happy Birthday, Jingle Bells, Silent Night and more.

name: TapShift: Saved Reels
description:
TapShift turns the reels you save into notes you can actually use.

Share a reel from Instagram, TikTok or YouTube to TapShift, paste a link, or add a screenshot. Within seconds TapShift writes a short note: the recipe, the place, the product or the tip, with the creator credited and a picture to remember it by.

• Save from the Share sheet in the apps you already use
• Notes sorted into 12 categories, from food and travel to fitness and music
• Ask your saves anything, in your own words and your own language
• Book or buy: place, trip and product notes link to partners such as Booking.com, GetYourGuide, Viator and Amazon
• Open places in Maps, or go back to the original post
• The app works in 40+ languages
• Delete a note, all your notes or your account at any time

TapShift is invite-only while we grow. No code yet? Join the waitlist at tapshift.in.

Notes are written by AI and can contain mistakes, so check details such as prices and addresses before you rely on them. TapShift may earn a commission when you book or buy through partner links.

name: Taskhouse Companion
description:
Taskhouse runs your coding agents on your Mac. This app keeps you in the loop when you step away from it.

When an agent wants to run a command, asks you a question or hits an error, it shows up in your Inbox. Open it, see exactly what the agent wants and why, and answer from your phone. The agent carries on as if you had answered at your desk.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Approve or deny tool calls, with the full command, the agent that asked and the task it belongs to.
- Hold to approve anything risky. Force pushes, deletes and other destructive commands need a one-second hold on a second screen, never a single tap.
- Answer agents' questions: pick one of their options or write your own.
- Follow any agent's terminal live, read-only.
- See every task on the board: who is working, who needs you, pull requests and CI.
- Check your usage limits, with 5-hour and weekly meters, tokens and cost per day.
- Send an agent a message when you want to steer it.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
The phone talks straight to your Mac over your own Tailscale network. There is no Taskhouse account and no analytics. Notifications are sealed on your Mac with a key only your phone holds, so the relay that delivers them never sees what they say. A paired phone is read-only until you allow more, and every action it takes is written to an audit log on your Mac.

WHAT YOU NEED
- Taskhouse on a Mac, with Remote turned on in Settings.
- Tailscale on the Mac and on this iPhone, signed in to the same account.

To pair, choose Pair a Device on the Mac and scan the code. Want to look around first? Tap Try the Demo on the first screen.

name: TaskKeel: Dependency Plans
description:
TaskKeel helps you reason about task order and the minimum workday schedule implied by dependencies.

Create a plan, estimate task durations in whole workdays, and choose which tasks must finish first. Dependency cycles are blocked before saving.

Review earliest relative-workday ranges in Timeline. Open Task Detail for earliest and latest boundaries, slack, and a duration-change preview. Blocks filters critical tasks or tasks with slack and lists prerequisite/downstream relationships.

Save an immutable version, then compare versions by task identity to see added, removed and changed tasks, durations and dependencies. Later live edits leave saved versions unchanged.

Generate and share actual paginated PDF or CSV reports. Export a whole-library JSON backup or restore a valid selected backup after confirmation.

The schedule uses relative workdays, starting at Day 1. It does not allocate people or resources, include holidays, or track actual completion. Multiple equally long branches can all be critical. No app account is required.

name: Tasting Notes: Wine & Whisky
description:
Keep a private, searchable log of every wine, whisky and beer you taste, with label photo, rating and flavour profile.

What you get:
- Snap the label, fields fill in
- Wine, whisky and beer in one app
- Tap the flavours you taste
- Find what you loved, fast
- No account. Your notes stay on your phone.

Free to start. One in-app purchase adds the rest, with no subscription.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

name: Tavren
description:
Roll the dice, gather the island's goods and build your way to victory.

Tavren is a strategy board game for 2 to 4 players, set on a small island of hexes. Every turn starts with a roll: each village beside a hex showing that number collects its grain, timber, stone or wool. Spend them on roads to stake out the coast, villages on the best corners, and upgrades that turn a quiet hamlet into a powerhouse. The first ruler to reach the target score wins.

BUILD YOUR WAY
• Grow villages into towns that collect double, and towns into castles.
• Specialise: a windmill on rich grain land, a lumbermill in the forest, a mine among the quarries, a workshop that lays cheap roads, or a market that trades at better rates.
• Race for the longest road, and draw action cards: road crews, good seasons, market days, guild charters and sheriffs.

TRADE AND SCHEME
• Offer trades to the other players, haggle with counter-offers, or deal with the bank and the harbours.
• Roll a 7 and the bandits strike: they rob a rival and shut down a hex until someone moves them on.

A FRESH ISLAND EVERY GAME
• Every game deals a new, fair island sized for the number of players, or pick the classic map.
• Quick, standard or long games, so it fits a coffee break or a long evening.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Against computer players at Easy, Normal or Hard, completely offline.
• Pass and play with friends and family on one iPhone or iPad.
• Online with friends through Game Center turn-based matches: invite them through Messages or get matched, then take your turns whenever it suits you. Game Center lets you know when it's your move.

EASY TO LEARN
• A five-minute guided game teaches you everything by playing.
• Glowing spots show where you can build, and the rules are always one tap away.

AND MORE
• Your record, best scores and badges, synced to your other devices through iCloud.
• Game Center achievements and leaderboards.
• A charming 3D island, gentle music and haptics.
• Made for iPhone and iPad, in portrait or landscape, with keyboard shortcuts on iPad.

No ads, no in-app purchases, no account and no tracking. Just a good board game.

name: TaxiKursen: Swedish Taxi Test
description:
Get ready for the Swedish taxi test with TaxiKursen: taxi theory, practice questions and mock tests for Trafikverket's knowledge test for the Swedish taxi driver licence (taxiförarlegitimation, often called taxikort). The test is in Swedish only, with no interpreter. In 2023, only about 1 in 3 taxi tests were passed*. That's why TaxiKursen teaches the Swedish used on the test, with help in your own language whenever you need it.

In the app:
- 89 short theory lessons in the ten test topics
- Over 1,000 practice questions with an explanation for every answer option and the legal source
- Mock tests that match the two parts of the real test: same time limit, number of questions and pass mark
- Questions you get wrong keep coming back until you know them
- A daily plan up to your test date, and an estimate of how close you are to passing
- Translation into Arabic, Somali, Persian/Dari, Turkish, Kurdish (Sorani and Kurmanji), Tigrinya and English
- Read-aloud in Swedish, and in your language if your phone supports it
- Glossary and road signs
- Works without internet

The topics follow the test: taxi regulations, traffic rules, safety, customer service, illness and disability, working conditions, the environment, fuel-efficient driving, vehicle knowledge and map reading.

Made for anyone who wants to become a taxi driver in Sweden. Try it free, no account needed: the full text of every lesson, 30 practice questions and one full mock test. Translation, read-aloud, the glossary and reviewing your mistakes are always free.

The full version unlocks all questions and check questions, unlimited mock tests and new questions when they arrive. Pay once – no subscription, nothing renews. Cheaper than retaking the test at Trafikverket. The purchase has no time limit.
You can restore your purchase on a new iPhone with the same Apple ID.

Questions? Email hej@taxikursen.se – we usually reply within 24 hours on weekdays.

Sources: the Taxi Traffic Act (2012:211) and the Road Traffic Ordinance on riksdagen.se, Transportstyrelsen's regulations on transportstyrelsen.se and Trafikverket's information about the knowledge test on trafikverket.se. The source is shown under every question in the app.

*Share of passed tests in 2023: legislation 32.7%, safety and behaviour 35.1%. Source: Swedish Taxi Association (Svenska Taxiförbundet), Branschläget 2024, with figures from Trafikverket and Transportstyrelsen.

name: TDOC Control de Accesos
description:
TDOC Control de Accesos es la aplicación móvil corporativa diseñada para supervisar, validar y registrar de forma ágil y segura el acceso de trabajadores, contratas y vehículos en centros de trabajo e instalaciones industriales.

Principales funcionalidades:
• Escaneo ultrarrápido de códigos QR identificativos de trabajadores y vehículos.
• Verificación en tiempo real del cumplimiento documental de Coordinación de Actividades Empresariales (CAE) y Prevención de Riesgos Laborales (PRL).
• Semáforo visual intuitivo de acceso: indicación inmediata de acceso permitido, restringido o documentación pendiente de subsanar.
• Detalle exhaustivo de requisitos: consulta el estado de aptitudes médicas, formación en PRL, seguros, pagos de la Seguridad Social y acreditaciones técnicas.
• Registro instantáneo de marcajes de entrada y salida con sincronización periódica en la nube y capacidad de operación sin conexión (offline).
• Consulta rápida del listado de personal y maquinaria presente en las instalaciones en cualquier momento.

Optimiza la seguridad laboral, asegura la conformidad legal y agiliza las colas en portería con el ecosistema TDOC.

name: Teacher Calculatore
description:
Teacher Calculator is the ultimate productivity tool designed specifically for teachers, professors, and educators to grade exams, quizzes, and assignments 3x faster.

Stop wasting time typing "0.25 + 0.5 + 1.25 =" on a standard calculator! With Teacher Calculator, every key represents a score value from your grading rubric—just tap to add or subtract points and watch the total update in real time.

KEY FEATURES:
• 1-Tap Instant Scoring: Tap any score button to add it directly to the total while keeping a clear view of the full calculation formula.
• Quick Add & Subtract Modes: Easily switch between adding (+) and deducting (-) points, undo the last entry, or reset with a single tap.
• Flexible Grid Layouts (12, 16, or 20 Keys): Choose the grid size that best fits your exam structure.
• Fully Customizable Buttons: Enable edit mode to customize any button value to match your exact grading scale, saved automatically.
• Easy Sharing: Share the full score breakdown and final grade in one tap.
• Light & Dark Mode: Grade comfortably day or night with a sleek, eye-friendly dark theme.
• Multi-Language Support: Seamlessly switch between English, French, and Arabic.

Save hours of grading time—download Teacher Calculator today!

name: Team Q: Question Cards
description:
Team Q (Team Questions) — question cards for real conversations. Sit down together, draw a card and talk.

Perfect for family dinners, date nights, evenings with friends or team meetings. The questions help you remember what matters, laugh, dream and get to know each other better.

DECKS
• Family Evenings 13+ — a free deck for whole-family conversations with older kids and teens.

name: TekuTeku Diary: Steps & Places

TekuTeku Diary turns your everyday walks into a diary — automatically.

WALK, AND IT'S RECORDED
• Daily steps and distance from Health, shown as a heat-map calendar
• Places you visit and how long you stay, recorded in a battery-friendly way
• The weather where you spent the day

WITH YOUR CALENDAR
• See events from the calendars on your iPhone (including Google Calendar) side by side
• Month, week, 5-day, 2-day and 1-day views
• Add and edit events right there

DIARY
• Insert the day's steps, places, events and weather with one tap

MEMORIES
• Photos you took that day, and where

name: TeleClub

INVITADOS Y RANKING

REGISTRO DE GASTOS Y BOTE

name: Telemetrix
description:
Telemetrix ialah aplikasi mudah alih rasmi untuk Platform Telemetri Alam Sekitar Telemetrix yang direka khas untuk juruteknik lapangan, saintis alam sekitar, penyelia loji dan pegawai penguat kuasa.

Aplikasi ini menyediakan akses segera dan bersepadu kepada aliran data telemetri kritikal merentas pelbagai kategori stesen pemantauan termasuk Sungai, Udara, Marin dan Industri.

CIRI-CIRI UTAMA:
• Pemantauan Masa Nyata & Penyelarasan Automatik: Semak bacaan sensor terkini dengan kemas kini latar belakang setiap 60 saat serta penunjuk status operasi (Dalam Talian, Amaran, Luar Talian).
• Indeks Kualiti Air (WQI): Pengiraan dan pengelasan WQI berdasarkan piawaian DOE / NWQS (Kelas I hingga Kelas V) berserta carta trend 24 jam dan rekod bacaan mengikut jam (Data Mentah & Data Terawat).
• Sokongan Luar Talian (Offline-First): Storan pangkalan data tempatan SQLite memastikan data stesen dan rekod bacaan kekal boleh diakses walaupun di kawasan liputan selular yang lemah atau terputus.
• Lokasi Terdekat (Nearest Location): Kenal pasti stesen pemantauan paling hampir dengan kedudukan GPS anda secara automatik lengkap dengan bacaan terkini dan trend 24 jam.
• Peta GIS Interaktif: Paparan satelit beresolusi tinggi dengan penapis berbilang kategori (Sungai, Udara, Marin, Industri) serta penanda status berkod warna.
• Galeri Foto Stesen & Amaran: Lihat imej struktur fizikal stesen di lapangan dan terima pemberitahuan pelanggaran ambang parameter sensor.
• Dwibahasa & Tema Adaptif: Menyokong penuh Bahasa Melayu dan Bahasa Inggeris serta mod paparan Cerah dan Gelap untuk kegunaan siang atau malam di lapangan.

name: Tellora: Scam Call Check
description:
Tellora helps you tell if a phone call might be a scam while you are still on the call.

HOW IT WORKS
1. You get a call that feels off.
2. Open Tellora and tap Check this call. You can also say "Check this call with Tellora" to Siri.
3. Merge the calls. Tellora plays a short notice so everyone on the call knows, then listens with you.
4. If the call sounds like a known scam, Tellora warns you on the screen and out loud. It can also call a helper you trust.

WHAT TELLORA LISTENS FOR
Pressure to act right now. Threats of arrest or a closed account. Requests for gift cards, wire transfers or crypto. Requests for codes, passwords or remote access to your computer.

PRACTICE CALLS
Try the built in practice calls to see what a warning looks like before you ever need one.

YOUR PRIVACY
Tellora only listens when you ask it to. It turns speech into text to check it and does not keep the call audio. You can delete your data at any time in Settings.

GOOD TO KNOW
Tellora is a helper, not a guarantee. It can miss a scam and it can be wrong. If you are unsure, hang up and call the company back on a number you trust. Tellora is not an emergency service. Your phone plan must support merging calls.

MATH

name: TextMint: Export Text Messages
description:
Turn a chat or text conversation into a clean PDF: every message with date, time and sender.
Share it with a lawyer, a court, a landlord, an employer, a school or an insurer, print it, or simply keep it.
Everything happens on your iPhone. Your chats are never uploaded. No account, no subscription.

What the document holds
• Every message with date, time and sender
• Numbered rows and page numbers, so anyone can point to one message
• An optional cover page
• A page with SHA-256 fingerprints of your source files
• Export as PDF, CSV or plain text, or print it
• Rename participants, choose a date range, A4 or US Letter

Where the conversation comes from
• A WhatsApp chat export: in WhatsApp choose Export Chat, then open the .zip or .txt file in TextMint.
• Screenshots of any chat app, such as Messages, Messenger, Instagram, Telegram or Signal. TextMint puts them in order, removes the overlap and reads the text on your iPhone.
• A screen recording: scroll through the conversation while recording, and TextMint reads the frames.
• Pasted text: paste a conversation and get the same clean layout.

TextMint cannot open your messages by itself. You decide what you give it.

Privacy
All processing happens on your iPhone. Your conversations are never uploaded. There is no account and no sign-in. The app can send anonymous usage counts, such as how often an export was made. They never contain anything from a conversation, and you can switch them off in Settings.

Purchases
TextMint is free to use. Without a purchase, an export holds the first 3 pages with a preview mark. For a full export, choose one of two one-time purchases:
• One Export: the full export of one conversation.
• TextMint Pro: every conversation, for good.
There is no subscription.

TextMint makes a clear, dated record of a conversation. Whether a document is accepted is up to the person or office you give it to.

name: Thám Tử Nhí
description:
THÁM TỬ NHÍ – trò chơi phá án bằng hình ảnh dành cho bé từ 5 đến 8 tuổi.

• Giọng đọc tiếng Việt cho câu hỏi, gợi ý và lời giải thích – bé tự chơi được
• Chọn sai cũng không sao: app đưa gợi ý nhẹ nhàng, không phạt, không gây áp lực
• Giải thích đơn giản sau mỗi câu và thưởng sao để bé có thêm động lực
• Nội dung mới được cập nhật tự động, không cần tải lại ứng dụng

name: The Number: Golf Caddie
description:
Meet The Number, a golf caddie for your iPhone and iPad. At your ball, tap Next shot and your caddie makes the call: the club, the target, what the shot plays like and why, in a few words.

EVERY NUMBER MEASURED
• The app measures every yard to the green and the trouble. Plays-like counts the slope, the wind and your lie.
• Wind shows on the hole map. Feels different where you stand? Set it yourself.

CALLS FOR YOUR GAME, TODAY
• Every call starts from your own clubs and how you are hitting them this round.
• Tell your caddie your favorite approach distance, and whether you like full swings or taking some off. Tee shots and lay-ups set you up for it.
• In the trees? Your caddie calls the way back out and tells you what the next shot plays.

PICK YOUR CADDIE
• Del: middle of the green, every time.
• Donna: plays the percentages, takes the gift.
• Mike: pin's right there, send it.

TALK OR TYPE
• Hold Talk and tell your caddie what you see, or type it, and the call changes.
• Spoken replies are optional, and off until you turn them on.

YOU DECIDE WHAT IS SENT
• Your caddie is an AI. Before the first call, the app asks your permission and shows what is sent. Never your name, email or username.

• No ads, nothing to buy, no tracking.

ON THE COURSE
• Bala Golf Club in Philadelphia, all 18 holes, plus Philadelphia Cricket Club's St. Martins nine in preview.
• Lose signal mid-round? Your yardages keep working.
• A simple scorecard, for nine holes or eighteen.

BY INVITATION
Sign-in is by invitation for now. Request an invite from the sign-in screen or on our website.

For casual rounds only: Rule 4.3 of the Rules of Golf does not allow this kind of advice in a round played under the Rules.

name: TheBowlers Together
description:
Build better bowling together, one session at a time. TheBowlers Together is a shared bowling tracker for two players who want to improve their game, review what happened, and plan the next session with purpose.

Keep your results, notes, goals, and partner tips in one easy iOS app, using a simple shared diary on one device. Compare progress against your own past games, not just each other, and turn every visit into a clearer plan for next time.

Key features
- Shared pair dashboard - see both players, recent sessions, averages, best games, and your current shared goal at a glance.
- Session history - record each visit, filter by period, club, format, or review status, and reopen drafts when needed.
- Quick score or frame by frame entry - log final scores fast or enter every frame with standard tenpin scoring support, including the tenth frame.
- Session review and partner tips - capture what worked, what was hard, and what to try next time, then save advice for future sessions.
- Progress and goals - track personal and shared goals, view trends, and measure improvement by completed games and sessions.
- Compare sessions - place two sessions side by side to see what changed, what improved, and what to keep doing.
- Player profiles and milestones - review records, streaks, history, and earned milestones for both bowlers.
- Offline first - use the core features without internet, with no sign in, chat, or cloud sync required.

Perfect for
- Two friends who bowl together and want a simple way to track scores, notes, and goals.
- Bowlers who want a practical way to review past games and plan the next session.
- Anyone looking for a clean tenpin bowling score tracker with session history and progress insights.

Why choose us
TheBowlers Together is built as a practical shared sports diary, not a social network or a flashy leaderboard. It focuses on the details that help you improve: accurate score keeping, useful review prompts, partner advice, and goals that carry into the next session. Missing data is never treated as zero, incomplete games are kept separate, and your statistics update when results change.

If you want a bowling app that helps two players improve together, start your pair, record your first session, and turn every game into a better plan for the next one.

name: Three Chances
description:

Each day, Three gives you up to three thoughtful introductions based on your
preferences, interests, broad area, and the kinds of dates you enjoy. Send a
specific opener when someone stands out. A conversation opens only after they
accept.

WHY THREE

• Up to three introductions a day
• Profiles with prompts, interests, and date preferences
• Intro-first messaging instead of an open inbox
• Open Tonight for simple, time-limited local plans
• Date planning inside accepted conversations
• Broad-area matching without sharing exact location

SAFETY AND PRIVACY

• Every photo enters moderation before it can appear
• Report and block controls throughout the member experience
• Spam checks on profiles, intros, openings, and messages
• Messages encrypted at rest and in transit
• No ads or sale of personal data
• Permanent account deletion inside the app
