area is still building, join the local queue and invite people you would trust
to meet.

name: Tick & Kin
description:
A cozy corner for your next focus session.

Tick & Kin pairs a Pomodoro timer with illustrated companions, gentle voice cues and a tactile flip clock. Study, read or work with a little company beside you.

START WITH THREE FREE COMPANIONS
Mochi, Pip and Pebble are included. Tap your companion for a little reaction, switch between them, and settle into their painted rooms.

FIND YOUR RHYTHM
Set your focus, short-break and long-break lengths. Turn either kind of break off if you prefer. Pause, resume or start over when you need to. Optional reminders let you know when a session ends.

A COMPANION FOR YOUR DESK
Use portrait or landscape on iPhone and iPad. On iPhone Duo, the layout adapts as you fold: a companion above and a timer below in tabletop mode, with room artwork arranged around the hinge. Changing the layout keeps your timer going.

LITTLE VOICES, AT YOUR PACE
Hear character voice cues or mute them and keep the floating captions. Interface and language support are always free: English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, French and German.

CHOOSE MORE COMPANY
Three optional, one-time purchases each add three companions and their scenes:
• Midnight Café: Jun, Bean and Maple
• Moonlight Academy: Luna, Atlas and Wisp
• Orbital Night Shift: Nova, Orbit and Comet

The three-pack collection includes all nine paid companions from these launch packs. Future packs are not included. Paid companions require an in-app purchase; the timer and three starter companions remain free.

No account. No ads. No subscription. The timer and bundled voices work offline. Purchases and restoration require access to the App Store.

A focus timer with personality—not an AI chat service or an app blocker.

name: Tidepool Tales
description:
Cast a line, meet a sea friend, watch it wiggle hello, and let it swim home. Then stay a while and play at each place. We made Tidepool Tales as a gentle fishing game for the whole family.

FREE TO TRY, ONE PURCHASE FOR THE REST
Sunny Pier, Coral Pool and Rock Pool are free to try, with 12 sea friends and the small game at each place. One purchase, the Full Unlock, opens Kelp Forest, the Sunken Ship and Rainbow Reef, with 12 more friends and their games.

HOW TO PLAY
Skipper Marlo the sea otter takes you out to the Sunny Pier. Pull down and let go to cast; a dotted arc shows where the line will land. Wait for the bobber to wiggle, tap, then tap again while the bubble is in the green to reel in a new friend. Say hello, see a fun fact acted out in a little picture, then tap LET IT GO and watch your friend swim home.
- Missed the wiggle? The same friend comes back on your next cast.
- Each miss on the reel makes the green zone bigger.

A SMALL GAME AT EVERY PLACE
- Sunny Pier: lead a school of sardines through shiny rings.
- Coral Pool: find two friends the same.
- Rock Pool: help a hermit crab find a bigger shell.
- Kelp Forest: find the friends hiding in the kelp.
- Sunken Ship: watch a cuttlefish flash its colors, then tap them back.
- Rainbow Reef: paint a friend in any colors you like.

24 SEA FRIENDS TO MEET
Sardines, crabs, a moon jelly, a little octopus, a leafy seadragon, a nautilus, a rainbow sea slug and more, each with a short fact in the Reef Album. Shy friends come by less often, and friends you haven't met come by more, so everyone turns up in the end. No friend can be lost.

A POOL OF YOUR OWN
Invite up to 8 friends to the Friends' Pool and set down shells and coral. Miss a day and nothing changes.

MADE FOR FAMILIES
- No ads.
- Catch and release only. Every friend is met, greeted and let go.
- No energy, no in-game currency, nothing random for sale.
- No chat, no accounts, plays offline.
- Grown-up check before the Full Unlock, Restore Purchases, outside links and Delete My Data.
- Big buttons, big friendly text, and a hint hand that shows what to do.

Made by Seventh Anvil Games, the makers of Polar Bears vs. Warthogs.

name: Tierkartei
description:
Diese Anwendung Tierkartei begleitet dich bei der liebevollen und strukturierten Pflege deiner Haustiere. Sie ist für alle Tierhalter gedacht, die wichtige Informationen rund um ihre Tiere übersichtlich festhalten und im Blick behalten möchten.

Du legst für jedes Tier eine eigene Akte an. Im Pflegetagebuch notierst du Gewichtsverläufe, Medikamentengaben und weitere Gesundheitsdaten. Die Entwicklung des Tieres wird dir anschaulich dargestellt. Außerdem kannst du individuelle Erinnerungen erstellen – für Fütterung, Fellpflege, Medikamente oder anstehende Termine. Du bestimmst dabei den Zeitpunkt, den Rhythmus und zusätzliche Hinweise selbst.

Ein weiterer Bereich dient der Vorratsverwaltung. Hier behältst du den Überblick über Futter und Pflegeprodukte, siehst, wann etwas geöffnet wurde und bis wann es geprüft werden sollte. So verlierst du nicht den Überblick über Haltbarkeit und Nachbestellungen.

name: Tight Spot: Parking Dispatcher
description:
Cars roll up to the gate one after another. You are the dispatcher: tap a free spot and the car drives over and parks itself. Easy. Until the owner comes back, and their car is boxed in by three others.

Tight Spot is a little parking lot comedy about making a hundred small decisions in a hurry. Every tap is a choice (near the gate or deep inside? the colored zone for a bigger tip, or the spot that is free right now?) and a few seconds later you see what it did: the lot flows, or it jams, or a driver leans on the horn.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a glowing spot to park the car at the gate. Keep tapping and the whole queue goes in.
• Watch the bubbles: how long each driver will stay, and whether they need a big bay, a charger, an accessible spot or the VIP row.
• Short stays near the gate, long stays deep inside. Do not let a car that leaves soon get blocked in a double row.
• A car is in the way? Tap it and it backs out to make room, then parks again. Tap a parked car and a free spot to move it.
• Three hearts per shift. Drivers who wait too long, at the gate or in their spot, complain.
• One finger, upright or sideways; a shift takes a minute or two.

WHAT IS IN THE LOT
• 100 levels in ten chapters and 23 parking lots: a corner market, a scenic spot packed with tour buses in Golden Week, a city hospital, the airport, a stadium at night, a night market, a railway station, a theme park, a tech park and, last of all, New Year's Eve around the clock tower.
• Something new in every chapter: color zones, double rows, bus bays and scooters, ambulances that must get through, taxis that stay a minute, chargers for green plates, VIP spots, two gates, then three; quick-stop spots for short stays, and bells: a train arrives, a show ends, the office closes, midnight strikes, and everybody wants out at once.
• Drivers with character: nervous learners, old hands who park in one go, the impatient and the relaxed.
• Three stars per level, each for its own little task. Fast dispatching builds a combo for extra tips.
• Endless mode with a new timetable every run.
• Three tools for a bad moment (a whistle that speeds everyone up, herbal tea that pauses all impatience, and the Mighty Lift that picks a car up and puts it anywhere) and five upgrades for your lot.

WHAT IS NOT IN THE LOT
• No ads. No account. No data collected.
• Every level is free. The only purchase is an optional bag of coins; coins are also the tips you earn by playing.

Everything in the game is drawn by the game itself, every sound is made by it, and every level has been played through and tuned by a robot dispatcher. Can you beat it?

name: TillDONE 2DO
description:
TillDONE 2DO keeps reminding you until the job is done. Write one line, get a notification when it's due, and if you don't mark it done it keeps reminding you at the interval you choose. Overdue items live in Due so they never get buried.

· Persistent snooze reminders · Rules and single-occurrence edits · Custom categories · A to-do list showing every reminder you created, including ones due far in the future · Home-screen Widget · Adjustable text size · Chinese / English · All data stays on your device: no account, no upload, no third-party SDKs, no ads, JSON export available.
Free version: up to 10 reminders. One-time purchase unlocks unlimited reminders, no subscription.
System limits: local notifications are scheduled 7 days ahead; if the app isn't opened for 7+ days, later ones won't be renewed until you open it again (this affects scheduling only, not the to-do list). Focus modes may suppress notifications.

name: Time to Stop: Timing Games
description:
How good is your timing?

Time to Stop is a collection of 12 fast, one-tap timing games. Watch the movement, trust your instincts, and tap anywhere to stop it as close to the target as you can.

Sounds easy? Every successful stop makes the next one a little harder.

12 GAMES. ONE SIMPLE RULE.
• Slot — Stop the ball inside the slot.
• Wheel — Land the glowing wedge on the pin.
• Orbit — Catch the dot on the arc.
• Pendulum — Freeze the swing in the zone.
• Pulse — Match the moving ring to the band.
• Bounce — Catch the ball in the beam.
• Clock — Hit the target time, even when the digits disappear.
• Fill — Stop the pour at exactly the right level.
• Align — Bring two moving dots together.
• Lock — Snap the square into its frame.
• Hue — Match two changing colors.
• Stack — Land each block on the tower.

CHASE THE PERFECT STOP.
Every tap is graded Perfect, Great, Good or Missed. You have three lives per run. Keep hitting the target, build your streak and chase a new personal best.

IT ONLY GETS HARDER.
Each successful hit raises the difficulty. Objects move faster, targets get smaller and your timing needs to get sharper. No long pauses between rounds. Just one challenge after another.

MAKE EVERY TAP COUNT.
Enjoy colorful backgrounds, satisfying hit effects, animated streaks and responsive haptic feedback. Collect 25 unique hit chimes through challenges, rewarded ads or the full-game unlock.

PLAY YOUR WAY.
Get 10 free plays each day. Want more? Watch an optional rewarded ad to earn 15 extra plays, or unlock the full game with a single purchase for unlimited plays, no ads and all 25 chimes.

No accounts. No complicated controls.
Just one more try.
How long can you keep your streak alive?

name: TimeSays
description:
Time, Written Beautifully.

What if time could be more than just numbers?

Meet TimeSays, a beautifully designed word clock that transforms the way you experience time. Instead of traditional digits, TimeSays expresses the time through words, creating a unique blend of typography, simplicity, and modern design.

More than a clock, it's a statement piece for your screen.

A DIFFERENT WAY TO SEE TIME

Watch time come to life through carefully arranged words. Every glance becomes a refreshing experience, turning something ordinary into something beautiful.

MINIMALISM MEETS FUNCTION

TimeSays combines elegant typography with a clean, distraction-free interface. No unnecessary complexity. Just time, beautifully expressed.

YOUR SCREEN, REIMAGINED

Transform your iPhone into a stylish digital desk clock. Whether you're working, relaxing, or simply enjoying your space, TimeSays adds a touch of elegance to your everyday environment.

WHY TIMESAYS?

- Time in Words: A creative alternative to traditional digital clocks.
- Beautiful Typography: A visually engaging way to experience every moment.
- Minimalist Design: A clean and timeless aesthetic.
- Perfect for Your Desk: Turn your screen into a decorative clock.
- A Unique Clock Experience: Where technology meets thoughtful design.

MAKE EVERY MOMENT LOOK BEAUTIFUL

Time is something we all share. How we experience it can be extraordinary.

Discover a more beautiful way to tell time.

TimeSays — Time, Written Beautifully.

name: Tincoat
description:
Tincoat is a bench for the paint you already own. Measure a room, see how many liters a job needs, and keep a rack of the tins on the shelf. Rooms, tins, jobs, and pour notes stay on this phone. There is no account and nothing is synced.

Add a room in meters: floor length, floor width, and wall height, plus a door count, a window count, and whether the ceiling is included. Wall area starts from the four walls, then takes off a fixed allowance for each door and window. The ceiling, when you include it, is length times width.

Each tin stores a color name, brand, label code, finish, full size, liters left, and the coverage printed on the label, in square meters per liter. A tin is marked low when little paint remains. The circle on the rack marks the finish name, not the paint color.

A job is one pour: one room, one tin, a date, a coat count, and a waste percent. Planned liters are paintable area times coats, divided by coverage, with your waste allowance added. Saving a job subtracts the liters you poured. Editing a job applies the difference. Deleting a job puts those liters back.

Coverage is a worksheet. Pick a saved room and a saved tin, set coats and waste, and see liters and how many full tins that rounds up to. It does not change the rack. Mix adds two volumes so you can see whether they would fit in another tin. It does not change liters left, and it does not predict a mixed color.

Finish notes explain matte, eggshell, satin, semi-gloss, and gloss, and how to read a spread rate. They are workshop notes, not a safety sheet and not a test of a brand. Tincoat does not measure a wall with the camera, convert units, time a coat, or order paint.

name: Tint Ratio
description:
Tint Ratio keeps the windows of one car on this iPhone. Add the car, pick the body, and measure each window.

The reading is the light through the glass compared with the open light, as a percent. A limit line says how far that percent sits under or over the floor you set. Plan a film darkness for one window before you cut it.

Find a car by name. Change the limits, edit a window, or delete a car you no longer need. The records stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: ToadScore: Toad in the Hole
description:
Toad in the Hole is the Sussex pub game: you chuck brass toads at a lead-topped table and aim for the hole in the middle. ToadScore keeps the score so you can keep throwing.

Tap each toad as it lands, on the table or in the hole, and ToadScore does the sums. It knows a bust, a dead toad and an eight, and shows every side's last turn.

- One against one, three or four sides, pairs, and solo practice
- Single games and series, with a toss to see who starts
- Share a game by its join code or QR code, and everyone at the table can score
- Your tables on a map, public or private to your own pub
- Stats for every player: averages, eights, wins and Rating
- Works offline, no adverts, no tracking

Signing in is optional but allows you to share games, track stats and add tables.

name: ToBoMin
description:
ToBoMin brings Yazidi adults together around shared community and meaningful relationships. Built for the Yazidi community, it combines culturally aware discovery with personal introductions and everyday community life.

Connections with community context
Create a profile using your nickname and choose which optional details to share. Discover eligible members with age and country preferences. Matching follows ToBoMin’s configured Yazidi community and opposite-gender rules.

Introductions with a story
Spotlight lets eligible reviewed members share a photo and answers to personal prompts through an introduction reviewed by an admin.

A shared community space
Share Feed posts and photos, join comments and polls, and play tic-tac-toe or 4 in a row with eligible members.

Choose how you connect
A mutual profile like opens a chat. You can also send an introduction, with further messages depending on acceptance. Reply, react, and manage your conversations from Messages.

Privacy and support
Control notification preferences and message previews, report concerns, block members, contact the admin team, and manage account deletion from Settings.

Available in English, German, Arabic, Armenian and Russian, including right-to-left Arabic. For adults aged 18 and over. Internet access, an account and community eligibility are required.

name: Tokpodz
description:
Tokpodz is where moments happen live, on schedule.

A pod is a live room with a start time and an end. A business launches a restock. A creator opens the floor for questions. Fans gather before kickoff. You set a reminder, you show up when it goes live, and you're in the room while it's happening.

LIVE AUDIO AND VIDEO Hosts go live with audio or video. Listen in, chat in real time, and raise your hand to come up on the mic.

CHAT AND Q&A Every pod has live chat and Q&A. Ask the host a question and get an answer in the room, heart the best messages, and @mention people.

THE SCHEDULE, NOT THE FEED Business hosts schedule pods ahead of time. Tap the bell to get a reminder before it starts, and a notification the moment it goes live. No algorithm decides what you see.

PODS END. THE VALUE DOESN'T. Pods expire by design. That keeps every room focused and worth showing up for. What stays is what matters: the people you met, the creators you subscribed to, and the next date on the schedule.

CLIPS Share short clips between pods, react and comment, and follow the creators you like.

FOR BUSINESSES Upgrade to a free business account to schedule pods, get a public event page to share, and see who attended your pods (attendees choose whether hosts can contact them).

Built for Nigerian small businesses, creators, and sports and entertainment fans.

Questions? admin@tokpodz.com · tokpodz.com/support

name: Tolica Greens
description:
De fleste golfere kjenner igjen følelsen. Scorekortet er ført, tallene ser ikke så verst ut – men du kan ikke si sikkert hvor slagene egentlig forsvant. Kanskje tre dårlige utslag på par 3-hullene, en bunker som kostet mer enn den burde, og følelsen av at det var den samme køllen igjen. Hukommelsen er en dårlig statistiker, og etter runden husker de fleste bare det som gjorde mest vondt.

Tolica Greens er laget for amatører og klubbgolfere som vil ha svar i stedet for gjetninger. Logg hvert slag mens du spiller, og få et bilde av spillet ditt som du kan lese i ettertid. Poenget er ikke flere tall, men å gjøre de riktige tallene lette å finne – slik at neste trening starter der den faktisk trengs.

Du er i gang på et blunk. Velg bane under Oppsett, gå gjennom stegene med Neste, og trykk Start runden. I Live-runde registrerer du slagene hull for hull. Etterpå finner du runden under Runder, der Rundedetaljer viser hulltabellen med score per hull. Profilen samler beste score, snittscore og antall runder, og peker ut ditt beste og svakeste hull målt mot par.

Kjernefunksjonene i korthet:
- Live-runde: registrer hvert slag, hull for hull, mens du spiller.
- Hulltabell og Rundedetaljer: se score per hull og hvordan runden fordelte seg.
- Køllebag og Kølledetaljer: full oversikt over køllene dine, med lengste og korteste slag.
- Køllegap-stigen: sammenlign avstandene side om side og finn hullene i settet ditt.
- Innsikt og Mønsterdetaljer: se hvor slagene går, og hva som gjentar seg fra runde til runde.
- Øvelsesbiblioteket og Øvelsesøkt: velg øvelser, gjennomfør økten og få en oppsummering.
- Mål og Prestasjoner: sett konkrete mål, følg fremdriften og se milepælene du har nådd.
- Banebiblioteket og Banedetaljer: lagre banene dine, med pinne på hver green og veibeskrivelse i Apple Kart.

Køllebagen er der alt begynner. Legg inn hver kølle, gi den gjerne et eget navn, og oppgi loft og forventet lengde. Når du har logget nok slag, kan du bruke loggført snitt i stedet for oppgitt lengde – da er det tallene fra banen som teller, ikke det du husker at du slo. Med Rediger kølle og Lagre kølle oppdaterer du oppsettet, og appen ber om bekreftelse før en kølle eller bane slettes.

Innsikt gir deg helheten. Herfra åpner du Mønsterdetaljer for å se hvilke situasjoner som koster flest slag, mens Treningshistorikk viser hva du har øvd på før. Mål fungerer på samme måte: sett et mål, følg fremdriften og se utviklingen over tid.

Når mønstrene er tydelige, kan du øve direkte på dem. Øvelsesbiblioteket har øvelser å velge mellom, og Øvelsesdetaljer forklarer hva hver enkelt går ut på. I en Øvelsesøkt jobber du deg gjennom øvelsen, og Øktoppsummering gir et kort tilbakeblikk etterpå. Start med svakhetene dine – det er der du henter flest slag.

Banene du spiller, samles i Banebiblioteket, der du kan filtrere på fylke for å finne fram raskt. Banedetaljer viser informasjonen om banen, og Rediger bane lar deg endre den. Nye baner legges inn via Banesetup, der du blant annet kan sette en pinne på hver green. Under Flere valg finner du veibeskrivelse i Apple Kart, så du kommer fram uten å lete.

Verktøy-siden samler resten, blant annet Range-delingen og Arkivhylla, der eldre innhold kan ligge uten å være i veien. Opprett konto med Registrer deg og logg inn med Logg inn. I Profil oppdaterer du opplysningene dine under Rediger profil, og under Endre passord bytter du passord på et øyeblikk. Juridisk tekst og Hjelp og ofte stilte spørsmål finner du direkte i appen.

Tolica Greens lover ingen mirakler. Den gjør noe mer nøkternt: den viser deg hvor slagene forsvinner, slik at du vet hva du skal trene på. Last ned og spill din neste runde med et klarere bilde.

name: Toneio: Local Player
description:
Your files. Your favorites. Your own listening space.

Toneio: Local Player brings your local audio, ringtone clips, and wallpapers together in a simple English-language app.

BRING YOUR MUSIC
Import audio from Files, including playable MP3, M4A, WAV, and AIFF files. Select several tracks at once. Toneio keeps a copy inside the app so downloaded music stays available offline. Cloud files need to be downloaded before importing. Copy-protected files and Apple Music subscription downloads are not supported.

LISTEN YOUR WAY
Play your imported tracks and the 20 included ringtones. Save favorites, revisit recently played tracks, shuffle your queue, or repeat a track. Keep listening in the background and control playback from the Lock Screen. Choose an available audio output with AirPlay.

MAKE A RINGTONE CLIP
Choose a starting point, preview your selection, and export an M4A clip up to 30 seconds long. Follow the included guide to finish setting your ringtone using GarageBand or iOS. Toneio does not change your system ringtone directly.

MAKE THE SCREEN YOURS
Browse 20 original, AI-generated wallpapers. Preview the complete image, try the lock screen preview, save favorites, and export the original image to Photos or the share sheet.

A LAYOUT THAT ADAPTS
Browse in portrait or landscape and choose a dark, light, or system appearance. Adaptive layouts make room for artwork and controls as the available window changes, including on iPhone Duo.

YOUR LIBRARY STAYS WITH YOU
No account, ads, or analytics. Toneio does not upload your imported audio. Your music copies, favorites, listening history, and preferences are stored in the app and may be included in your device backup. Removing an imported track leaves the original file in Files. Deleting the app removes its stored copies.

Toneio does not stream music or download songs from music services. Import only audio you have the right to use.

name: Tonrad
description:
Tonrad is a tonewheel organ app played on the screen of an iPhone or iPad (landscape only, iOS 18 or later).

PLAY
- Upper manual, lower manual and pedalboard, stacked on the screen and played with several fingers at once.
- The upper and lower manuals show part of their 61 keys; drag the strip above each one to move the range. All 25 pedal keys are shown.

SHAPE THE REGISTRATION
- Drawbars: 9 for the upper manual, 9 for the lower manual and 2 for the pedals (positions 0 to 8).
- Percussion (upper manual): second or third harmonic, volume and decay switches.
- Vibrato and chorus: six positions (V1 V2 V3 C1 C2 C3), switched on or off separately for the upper and lower manuals.
- Expression: moved by the EXP control at the right edge of the HOME screen.
- Rotary speaker: two speeds, slow and fast, and on or off, switched by the buttons at the left edge of the HOME screen.
- Spring reverb: three springs, with the amount set by the REV drawbar.
- The drawbars and the other controls are saved automatically and come back the next time you open the app.

SET SCREEN
The output volume, a PANIC button that stops every sound, the name of the audio output, the audio measurements and a "Privacy Policy" row that opens the privacy policy page.

HOW IT WAS MADE
The tone is computed from circuit and part values read from service documents and published papers. The source of each constant is recorded in a ledger kept with the code. Values the documents do not give were set by ear or are provisional.

WHAT IT DOES NOT DO
- External keyboards cannot be connected; you play the on-screen keys (the sound goes to the device's current audio output, such as headphones).
- The sound stops when the app goes to the background, and you can play again when you return to it.
- It does not record.
- It cannot be used as an Audio Unit (AUv3) plug-in.

YOUR DATA
Nothing about you or your use is collected, and the app makes no network connections. Settings stay on this device.

Screens are in English and Japanese.

name: Totem Trail: Savanna Dash
description:
Totem Trail is a tribal-themed arcade adventure that packs two runner games into one app — plus a brand-new challenge every single day.

Pick your warrior, charge your spirit, and race down sun-drenched trails or dash through the sunset plains. Every run earns tokens that unlock new tribe members, each with a unique perk, so every session helps your whole collection grow.

▸ Trail Rush 3D — the 3D savanna runner Steer your warrior down a winding 3D track past acacias, totems, and ancient stone gates. Scoop up sun gems to charge a star boost, time your lane changes to dodge spike barricades and fire pits, and cross the painted finish mat to clear each level.

▸ Savanna Dash — the sunset side-runner Tap to jump, tap again to flip. Leap over spike traps and boulders, duck under boomerangs, and chain gems, totem tokens, feathers, and golden masks for massive combos. Shields, magnets, and double-point stars keep every run fresh as day fades into night.

▸ Daily Trial — a new goal every day Clear today's trial on back-to-back days to grow your streak. Longer streaks mean bigger token rewards — miss a day and the streak resets, so keep coming back.

▸ Your Tribe — 10 warriors to collect From the Savanna Archer to the Graybeard Captain, each warrior comes with its own perk: bigger token multipliers, longer boosts, extra hearts, or an ancestral spirit that runs beside you.

▸ Your Records — every run matters Browse your run history, chase personal bests in both games, and earn all 13 trophies. One tribe, two games, shared progress.

Why players love it • Simple one-handed portrait play • Fast runs that fit between meetings • Two distinct games sharing one warrior roster • No account, no sign-in • Original tribal art hand-drawn in-engine

Privacy & ads Totem Trail may ask for permission to use tracking. Allowing it lets us tailor the ads and promotions you see, measure how our campaigns perform, and help new players discover the app. You can decline and still enjoy the full game. No personal details are ever required.

Grab your spear, feel the savanna wind, and lead your tribe home. The trail is waiting.

name: Traces in the Picture
description:
On a rainy night, a letter with no sender arrives at a detective's office.
"The last page has gone missing from our house. Please find it."
Rub a pencil over the indented paper and one more line appears: "Trust no one."

Traces in the Picture is a hidden object mystery thriller. Search every picture, find what doesn't belong, and piece together a case that has stayed buried for years.

■ 30 pictures, one case
An old house at the end of the woods, a study, an attic, even the yard inside a picture book. Each scene takes 3–5 minutes; the whole story runs about two hours.

■ What you find moves the story
Hidden objects fill your list, clues go into your notebook, and items like keys go into your bag to be used in other rooms. New tools reveal things you missed in rooms you've already searched.

■ Six ways to search
Rub with a pencil to reveal marks, look into pictures within pictures with a magnifier, compare and overlay two scenes, fit keys to locks, and assemble torn pieces.

■ Sound and haptics that build tension
Every scene has its own ambience: creaking doors, footsteps upstairs. At key moments, sound, vibration and screen effects hit together. Headphones recommended.

■ Good to know
· Made for adults. Includes bloodstains and other traces, plus tense sound and haptic effects. Graphic violence is never shown.
· No account needed. Your progress stays on your device, and the game plays offline (ads appear only when you're connected).
· Ads appear after some scenes, and ads for extra hints are always optional. A one-time in-app purchase removes all ads, and you get hints without ads too.
· Sound and vibration can be turned off separately in Settings.

name: Track It - Shell Game Puzzle
description:
Watch closely. One car has it. Can you still find it after the shuffle?

Track It is a shell game with cars. Something hides in one car: a getaway car disguises itself as a police car, a heart drops into an ambulance, gold bars go into an armoured van. Then the cars shuffle. Keep your eyes on the right one and tap it before the clock runs out.

It's the classic cup game, turned into a 3D brain teaser and eye test that gets harder every level.

HOW TO PLAY
• Watch the intro: the car with the prize shines for a moment, then never again
• The cars swap, spin, hide in smoke and lose their lights
• Tap the car you think has it before the timer runs out
• Right on the first try and quick = 3 stars

7 WORLDS, 84 LEVELS
• Police Lot: the getaway car hides among the cops
• Hospital: a heart drops into one of the ambulances
• Bank Vault: gold bars go into an armoured van
• London: a diamond hides in a black cab
• Dubai: a gold supercar disguised as a police car
• Piazza: a pizza lands on one of the scooters
• Airport: a briefcase goes into a motorcade SUV
Level 12 of every world is a BOSS: two things to track at once. Find both.

HARDER EVERY LEVEL
• From 3 cars up to 12 in one shuffle
• Faster swaps, 3- and 4-car rotations
• Smoke clouds, lights going out and fake-out moves that start a swap and turn back
• A real focus game: your attention and memory against the shuffle

ENDLESS MODE
Every right answer makes the next shuffle harder. One miss ends the run. Climb the global leaderboard, this week and all time, with your country flag.

DAILY CHALLENGE
5 rounds, the same shuffles for everyone today, one try. Compare your score on the daily leaderboard.

HELPS WHEN YOU NEED THEM
• Slow-Mo: the shuffle plays slower
• Spotlight: a faint glow stays on the car for a while
• X-Ray: half of the wrong cars are crossed out
Use coins, or watch a short video. Missed it? Watch a video for a second chance or +5 seconds.

LOOKS AND SOUNDS LIKE THE REAL THING
Flashing police light bars, sirens, tyre smoke and skid marks. Original music and real recorded sound effects for every swap, screech and tick of the clock.

FREE TO PLAY
Track It is free with ads. Earn coins as you play, plus a free gift every day. Coin packs, a starter pack and Remove ads are optional in-app purchases (no subscriptions). Coins are for in-game helps only.

If you like shell games, cup games, find-the-car puzzles, brain games, IQ and eye tests or memory games, give Track It a try. How far can you track it?

Questions or ideas? hello@digcy.com · trackit.digcy.com

name: Trail Day: Hike Planner
description:
Plan a day hike in five minutes: time estimate, latest safe start before sunset, kit checklist, and a trip-intentions message for your emergency contact. Then record the track offline.

What you get:
- Know your latest safe start
- Tell someone where you're going
- Kit checklist from the park rangers' list
- Turnaround alerts on your lock screen
- Records offline, learns your pace

Free to start. One in-app purchase adds the rest, with no subscription.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

name: TrailDive
description:
TrailDive lets you step into a mountain bike trail before you get there.

  Every trail is captured end to end: move through the images along the route, look around and see what the surface is like, where it tightens, where it
  opens up. The map and elevation profile follow wherever you are.

  WHAT YOU GET
  • Trails, pump tracks and bike parks, graded on the STS scale (S0-S5)
  • Length, climb and descent, lowest and highest point
  • The recommended bike and whether e-bikes are welcome
  • A map of trails near you, filtered by difficulty, category and bike
  • Directions to the trailhead in your phone's maps app

  THE COMMUNITY
  • Save the trails you want to ride
  • Leave a review and read what other riders say
  • See who mapped each trail

  It starts in the Bergamo Alps, with new trails added over time.

name: TrailKit
description:
TrailKit brings your outdoor equipment and trip preparation into one clear place. Whether you are packing for a short morning walk or a weekend under canvas, it helps you see what you own, build a useful kit and remember the details before departure.

Start with your gear locker. Add equipment with its category, measured weight, condition and personal notes. Keep shelter, sleep systems, cooking gear, clothing, tools and water equipment organized without losing the details that matter to you. Search by name or browse a category when it is time to find an item.

Combine your equipment into reusable kits for different seasons and outings. Choose the items, adjust their quantities and see the calculated base weight. A category breakdown shows how each part of your kit contributes to the total, making it easier to review your choices before you pack. Weight displays can use grams or kilograms.

Create a trip with a departure date, destination and an equipment kit. TrailKit copies the selected kit into a trip packing checklist, so you can check off items as they go into your bag. Add personal packing items and use a separate preflight checklist for weather checks, transport, water plans and sharing your itinerary. Later changes to a kit do not erase the packing decisions you already made for a trip.

Keep route memos for meeting points, trailhead details, contingency plans and other information you want to review before leaving. After the outing, write a journal entry about the conditions, memorable moments and equipment lessons you want to carry forward. A gear care planner helps you record cleaning, repairs and seasonal checks with due dates and completion states.

TrailKit uses clear typography, light and dark appearances, and weight graphics built from your own equipment records. Editable example entries help you explore the workflow, and your changes are saved on your device. The app is a preparation companion: route notes are personal memos, and it does not provide maps, turn-by-turn navigation or live trail conditions.

name: TranslateSermons
description:
TranslateSermons lets you follow a church service in your own language while it is being preached.

Scan the QR code your church shows (or type its code), choose your language, and the sermon appears as text a moment after it is spoken. Put in your headphones and tap Listen to hear it instead.

FOR PEOPLE AT THE SERVICE
• No account, no sign-in, nothing to set up
• Scan the church's QR code, or type the code on its screen
• Read the live translation, in large text if you like
• Listen to the translation in your headphones, with the screen locked
• Bible verses are shown from a real translation in your language
• See the original words next to the translation
• Suggest a better translation for any line; your church's team reviews it
• The app remembers your church and your language for next week

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
The app asks for nothing about you. It has no account, no advertising and no tracking. The camera is used only to scan the QR code.

FOR CHURCHES
Translation is set up by your church's team at translatesermons.com. This app is for the people listening.

Terms of use: https://translatesermons.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://translatesermons.com/privacy

name: Transport Mate
description:
Transport Mate shows the nearest stops and the next departures for public transport around you, in Norway and across the world.

• Stops within 1 km, with live departure times for train, metro, tram, bus and ferry
• Plan a trip: choose where you start and where you are going, and get up to five route suggestions with transfers
• Shows total travel time, walking time and each line with its departure time
• Full-screen map of the whole trip, and one tap to open walking directions in Apple Maps
• Open the operator's own app or website (Ruter, Vy, Skyss and more) from a stop or a route
• Search any place or address worldwide
• Five languages: English, Español, Français, Deutsch, Norsk
• No account, no ads, no tracking

Timetable data from Transitous and public transport operators. Places and maps from OpenStreetMap contributors. Times are indicative and may change. The app does not sell tickets.

name: Treasure Bay SunWin
description:
Treasure Bay SunWin mang đến bốn trò chơi giải trí giữa biển xanh, thác nước và những hòm kho báu rực rỡ.

Xóc Đĩa: chọn dự đoán Chẵn, Lẻ, 4 Trắng hoặc 4 Đỏ nếu muốn. Nhấn Xóc rồi Xác Nhận để mở bốn mặt đỏ/trắng. Kết quả được lưu trước khi mở, không thay đổi khi đóng app.

Bầu Cua Tôm Cá: chọn tối đa ba hình Bầu, Cua, Tôm, Cá, Gà, Nai hoặc quay tự do. Gieo ba viên độc lập, xem kết quả và số viên trùng lựa chọn trong lịch sử trên máy.

Mậu Binh: nhận 13 lá, xếp thành ba chi 5–5–3 và so bài với ba bot. Chạm hai lá để đổi vị trí hoặc dùng Xếp Bài. Biến thể cơ bản 1–6 có hướng dẫn riêng, không dùng thưởng chi hay các bộ đặc biệt.

Sâm Lốc: chơi với bốn bot, mỗi người 10 lá. Chọn bài, Đánh Bài, Bỏ Lượt hoặc dùng Gợi Ý. Có Báo Sâm và tới trắng theo biến thể luyện tập được giải thích trong app. Chất không phân độ mạnh; không dùng lá 2 trong sảnh.

Không đặt cược, không xu ảo, không ví, không nạp/rút và không đổi thưởng. Điểm so chi Mậu Binh chỉ biểu thị kết quả ván, không phải tài sản để mua, chuyển hoặc đặt cược.

Không đăng nhập, không quảng cáo, không mua hàng trong app và không đăng ký trả phí. Hình ảnh, âm thanh, bot và hướng dẫn đều được đóng gói trên thiết bị. Ván đang chơi, cài đặt và lịch sử được lưu cục bộ; không gửi dữ liệu về máy chủ. Bản sao lưu của hệ điều hành tùy thuộc cài đặt thiết bị.

Thiết kế chủ yếu cho màn hình dọc, có bố cục ngang riêng. Âm thanh và nhạc mặc định tắt. Hướng dẫn, kết quả, nhật ký hải trình và huy hiệu luyện tập giúp bạn khám phá từng trò chơi theo nhịp riêng.

**Key Features**

- Bốn trò giải trí: Xóc Đĩa, Bầu Cua Tôm Cá, Mậu Binh và Sâm Lốc.
- Dự đoán tùy chọn, hoàn toàn không có đặt cược hoặc xu.
- Ba bot cho Mậu Binh, bốn bot cho Sâm Lốc, hoạt động trên máy.
- Bài, mặt xúc xắc, số lá và kết quả do engine điều khiển.
- Xếp bài Mậu Binh, gợi ý Sâm và giải thích rõ biến thể.
- Lưu ván, cài đặt và tối đa 200 lượt lịch sử cho mỗi trò dự đoán.
- Không tài khoản, quảng cáo, mua hàng hoặc thuê bao.

name: Trek it!
description:
Start or join a group and follow your route walking, running or riding, with an alert at every turn.

Everyone in the group follows the same route, sees where the others are on it, and can message them with one tap. Press Start and put your phone away: Trek it! tells you when a turn is coming and when you've gone the wrong way.

GO TOGETHER
Start a group for a club run, a hiking day, a charity walk or a family trip. Pick a route, give the group a name, choose how long it lasts (1 to 14 days), and send the invite link or show the QR code. Joining takes one tap: no sign-up, no passwords to type.
• See everyone on the route: coloured pins with initials, how far ahead or behind each person is, and how far they have to the finish.
• Spot who's strayed: a pin turns amber when someone leaves the route.
• Message each other: "Wait for me", "I'm OK" or "Regroup at the next stop" in one tap, to one person or everyone. The alert stays until they've seen it.
• Meet at a regroup point: anyone can set one spot on the route where everyone waits, and see who's already there.

FEEL THE BUZZ
Trek it! follows you along the route with the screen locked. Every alert arrives as a notification with a vibration, so you know what's coming without looking:
• Turn alerts before each turn
• Off-route and back-on-route alerts
• Mile or kilometre markers
• A message from your group buzzes three times

YOUR ROUTE, FROM ANYWHERE
Open a GPX or TCX file from email, Files, Google Drive or the app you planned it in, or load one of your routes from Strava. Going on your own? Skip the group and press Start.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Trek it! is a situational awareness tool, not a fitness recorder.
• Nothing is recorded: no tracks, no activity history, no saved trips.
• No accounts: no sign-up, no email, no phone number.
• In a group, only your current location is shared, with that group alone, at most once a minute. Each update replaces the last one.
• Leave a group and your location is removed straight away. Messages are deleted once everyone has seen them. When the group ends or its creator deletes it, everything in it is deleted.

Trek it! is not an emergency service. In an emergency, call your local emergency number.

User's guide: https://trekit.marvinsun.com

name: TripsBooth
description:
TripsBooth is the easy way to keep your travel memories – and to discover where other travellers have been.

Capture a memory in seconds
• Tap once to record a voice memo of the moment
• Add photos from your camera or library (up to 10 per memory)
• Add a short note and the place – or leave them, TripsBooth fills them in
• Keep a memory private, or share it with other travellers

Explore and connect
• Browse trips shared by travellers around the world
• Like, rate and comment on memories
• Chat with other travellers
• Share a trip with friends by link or WhatsApp

Safe community
• Report or block any user or post
• Every report is reviewed by our team

Free and Premium
TripsBooth is free to use with up to 3 new memories a month. TripsBooth Premium gives unlimited memories and is available as an auto-renewable subscription (monthly or yearly) in the app.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple ID account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://tripsbooth.com/privacy

name: Trizzle: 3 puzzles al día
description:
Tres puzzles de lógica nuevos cada día. Un par de minutos, cero anuncios.

Cada día te esperan tres desafíos distintos, los mismos para todo el mundo:

INCLINA
Desliza el dedo y todas las fichas se mueven a la vez hasta chocar. Lleva cada ficha a la casilla de su color. Parece fácil… hasta que mover una desordena las demás.

GIROS
Toca una flecha para girar una fila o una columna. Forma el dibujo del objetivo con la menor cantidad de giros.

RAYOS
Gira los espejos para que la luz pase por todas las estrellas y llegue a la salida.

CADA PUZZLE TIENE UN PAR
El par es el mínimo de movimientos posible. Iguálalo y gana una estrella. Comparte tus resultados con amigos sin revelar la solución.

TU RACHA
Juega al menos un puzzle al día para mantener tu racha. El widget te muestra cuáles te faltan.

TRIZZLE PRO
• Práctica ilimitada en fácil, normal y difícil
• Archivo: juega los puzzles de días anteriores
• Pistas cuando te quedes pegado
Prueba gratis una semana. Los tres puzzles diarios son gratis para todos.

Sin anuncios, sin cuentas y sin internet: los puzzles se generan en tu iPhone.

La suscripción se renueva automáticamente salvo que la canceles al menos 24 horas antes del fin del período. Puedes administrarla y cancelarla en Ajustes > tu nombre > Suscripciones.
Términos de uso: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacidad: https://martin-974.github.io/Trizzle/privacidad.html

name: Trumpora 29: Royal Card Game
description:
Take your seat at a beautifully crafted Twenty Nine table. Play completely offline with three computer players: rivals Olivia and David, and a partner you name.

Bid your target, choose a secret trump (or place the Joker and play with no trumps), follow suit and work with your partner. Watch the deck shuffle in 3D, tap or slide your cards, and race your rivals to six match points. Keep score the traditional way with red and black Sixes on the round result and pause screen.

Free for everyone:
- Classic play with house-rule options and three bot difficulties.
- Daily deal: the same cards for everyone each day, with a local house reference.
- The 29 Academy: illustrated rules and hands-on practice, under How to play.
- Decision Lab: ten short interactive lessons.
- Clubhouse: Today, Train and Records, with streaks, weekly goals and achievements.
- Table Lens, Round Debrief and statistics.
- Match Story: round-by-round results, a match-score graph, the turning point and a few awards at the end of a match.
- Seven shuffle routines, each with its own sound: Original, Royal Sybil, Velvet Overhand, Twin Helix, Crown Fan, Silk Wash and Concertina. Leave Shuffle on Random or pick your favourite in Settings.
- Optional local reminders for deals, streaks, unfinished matches and goals. At most one a day, never at night, and only if you allow notifications.

Trumpora Club, one optional purchase with no subscription:
- Best-card guide and move hint, win-chance meter and bid advisor (training aids, switched off in daily and challenge play).
- Hand coach and "What if?" replays of your saved hands.
- Your hands: keep your recent and favourite hands.
- One decision better: short practice built from your own hands.
- Season: six rival teams, each with its own style.
- Daily vault and challenge packs with medals and stars.
- Signature lounges and saved table setups.
- Partnership career with a card to share.

No account, ads or tracking. You don't need an internet connection to play.

Twenty Nine has regional variants. This version explains its ascending auction, reveal and marriage choices, and an optional last-trick bonus. There is no online multiplayer, and no money wagers or prizes. Analysis is an estimate from simulations, not a guarantee.

name: Trustworthy TC
description:
Trustworthy TC keeps every real estate deal on track, from listing to contract to close and beyond. Built by a Tennessee transaction coordinator for agents and TCs who are done chasing dates in spreadsheets.
UPLOAD A CONTRACT. THE FILE BUILDS ITSELF. Upload a signed purchase and sale agreement and the app reads it: buyers, sellers, price, binding date, closing date and every contract deadline. It builds your task list and shows you what to confirm before anything is saved. Counter offers and amendments update the dates.
EVERY FILE AND EVERY DEADLINE ON ONE BOARD See open contracts, active listings and upcoming closings at a glance. Overdue and unconfirmed dates are flagged so nothing slips.
KNOW WHAT'S DUE TODAY All your tasks and deadlines across every file, sorted by what's overdue, due today and coming up. A morning phone alert tells you what needs you before the day starts.
EMAILS DRAFTED FOR EVERY STEP Intro emails to title and lenders, inspection reminders, clear-to-close requests, client welcome emails and more, filled in with the right names, dates and addresses. Send them from your own Gmail or Outlook, or schedule them for later.
NEVER MISS A DOCUMENT A required-documents checklist on every file, matched to Tennessee forms, so you know what's done, pending or missing before closing.
LISTINGS AND PAST CLIENTS Run listing intake with a seller questionnaire and MLS sheet. After closing, keep every client's home anniversary and stay-in-touch check-ins on your task list.
PORTALS FOR AGENTS AND CLIENTS Send an agent or a buyer or seller a private link. You choose exactly what they see: deadlines, documents, participants, emails and messages.
ALSO INCLUDED
• Transaction summary sheets and TC invoices on your letterhead
• Draft amendments and notifications from your own blank forms
• A private email address for each file that collects documents automatically
• Team access for TCs who work with many agents
Plans are chosen and managed on our website, app.trustworthytc.com. Sign in with your Trustworthy TC account to use the app.
Trustworthy TC is a working aid for real estate professionals. The executed contract and the responsible broker are always the final word.

name: TSPodcast: Podcast Player
description:
TSPodcast helps you discover podcasts worth your time and listen the way you like. Trending shows, suggestions based on the topics you pick, and a player with speed control, sleep timer and resume, all without an account.

Discover podcasts
• Trending podcasts in the language you choose, plus English, updated continuously from the open Podcast Index directory
• Choose from more than 100 topics (news, business, technology, education, history, health, comedy, sports, fiction…) to personalize your suggestions
• Search by show name or keyword, with shows in your language first
• Search inside a show to find the right episode
• Live podcasts: listen to episodes streaming right now

Listen your way
• Playback speed from 0.5× to 3.0×, remembered for each show
• Sleep timer: 5 to 60 minutes or at the end of the episode
• Skip back 15 seconds and forward 30 seconds
• Pick up every episode where you left off
• Background playback with controls on the lock screen and on Bluetooth headphones
• Mini player while you keep browsing
• App Shortcuts to continue listening, pause or set a sleep timer

Music
• Open music library: music feeds published by independent artists (Podcasting 2.0), with a Music filter in search

Your library, your choice
• Save favorite episodes in one place
• Hide shows you don't want to see, and bring them back any time in Settings
• Report a show or episode that breaks the rules
• Share links to shows and episodes
• Spam and gambling shows filtered out by a regularly updated block list

Your language, your privacy
• App in 15 languages, and podcast lists follow the language you choose
• Liquid Glass design on iOS 26
• Analytics and crash reports are sent only with your consent, and you can change your choice any time

TSPodcast is an independent app, not affiliated with any podcast producer. Podcast and music content belongs to its creators; directory data is provided by Podcast Index.

Feedback, bug reports or content removal requests: use the support link on this page. Every message is read.

TSPodcast is free, no account needed.

name: Tually
description:
Imagine all the people you didn’t know you could meet. Now you can, evenTUALLY.

Tually helps independent event-goers make one-to-one connections around shared plans. Choose Friends or Flirt, find an event and decide whether to appear in its people pool. Pools are discovery pages, not group chats. Tually does not organize mass meetups or sell tickets.

EXPLORE YOUR AREA
Find published music, sports, art, markets, beach, college, free local events and girls’ night out ideas. Discovery starts near your current or entered city; search an artist or event across cities, or choose Anywhere. Optional location access identifies your city. Listings vary by area and live feeds are still being connected. Check dates, admission, registration and eligibility on the official organizer page. Tually is independent of listed organizers.

FRIENDS OR FLIRT
Both modes, gender filters and ages 18–100 are included on every plan. Hold a connection ticket, then swipe right for a palm-tree Yes or down for a flamingo No. Buttons are also available. A mutual Yes opens a one-to-one chat through the event and until 24 hours after its listed end time. Matches remain saved; Premium can extend the chat window. Try a practice swipe without contacting anyone.

YOUR PASSPORT AND CALENDAR
Save event-specific photos and videos up to 15 seconds. Attendance and passport memories are self-reported, and albums stay private until you choose to share. Your personal calendar shows events you mark as attending. Free unticketed events have a simple Attending option. Ordinary attendance and passport memories require no ticket uploads or organizer codes.

EXTRA-TICKET HOSTS
Offering an extra ticket to take a guest requires private host approval before appearing publicly. Supporting documents must have ticket codes and private details concealed. Approval does not guarantee ticket validity, identity, transferability or admission. No ticket sales, payments or transfers happen in Tually.

MEMBERSHIPS
Free: event discovery, Friends and Flirt, joined-event pools, personal calendar, passport and standard one-to-one matching and chats.
Premium — USD $5.99/month: friends feed, likes, chat extensions, individual calendar-event invitations and looking for an extra ticket and browsing approved extra-ticket hosts with a visible profile, without marking yourself attending.
Explorer — USD $9.99/month: everything in Premium, plus all opted-in private event pools and full friend-calendar viewing when both friends have active Explorer memberships and the calendar owner approves. A request or upgrade never automatically shares a calendar. Either friend can stop sharing.

Event invitations require the recipient to accept before adding a plan privately. Only Explorer can browse privately. Free and Premium users choose a visible profile to browse people. Explorer private browsing hides your existing event card and never joins an event. Actual localized subscription prices appear before purchase. Apple bills monthly subscriptions, which renew until canceled in Apple subscription settings. Restore purchases is available in the app. Deleting a Tually account does not cancel an Apple subscription.

18+ only. Report and block unwanted contact or inappropriate content. Account deletion, privacy information and support are available in the app.
Support: tuallyfounder@gmail.com
Privacy: https://us-central1-tually-124bc.cloudfunctions.net/appInfo/privacy
Terms: https://us-central1-tually-124bc.cloudfunctions.net/appInfo/terms
Apple standard app license: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Tumble Block: Roll Puzzle
description:
Tip the block. Roll it across floating tiles. Stand it upright on the glowing goal.

Tumble Block is a calm, clever 3D logic puzzle that's simple to learn and gets deep fast. Every level is solvable, and every level is a little harder than the last, so there's always a new puzzle waiting.

HOW TO PLAY
• Swipe to roll the block one step in any direction
• Stand it upright on the glowing tile to win
• Plan ahead: narrow paths only fit the block one way

NEW IDEAS AS YOU GO
• Glass tiles: they hold the block lying down, but shatter if it stands on them
• Round buttons: any part of the block toggles a bridge
• Square plates: heavy, so only a standing block can press them
• Bridges that appear and vanish as you play

FEATURES
• Endless levels with a smooth difficulty curve
• No timers and no lives: take as long as you like
• Undo any move, and falling off never costs you the level
• A new colour theme every chapter
• Smart hints: a built-in solver shows the best next move from wherever you are
• 3-star ratings: match the shortest possible solution for a perfect score
• Satisfying 3D animations, sound and haptics
• Plays offline, no account needed
• Premium (one-time purchase): every level, unlimited hints, no ads

Can you find the perfect solution?

name: TURAYA
description:
TURAYA is your travel companion for unforgettable trips across Saudi Arabia, and Middle East

Turaya Trips
• Join our group trips on set dates, with a comfortable coach and a guide.
• Choose your room type (single, double or triple) and pick your own seats on the coach map.
• Travelling with children? Add them in a few taps. Children under 4 travel free.

Activities and packages
• Book tours and experiences on the date you choose, such as the Hegra Day Tour.
• Request a package or a custom trip, and our team sends you a quote.

Your TURAYA membership
• Earn Reward Points on every booking and use them on your next trip.
• Move up from Classic to Silver, Gold, Diamond and Privé for more rewards.
• Add your membership card and trip tickets to Apple Wallet.

Made for you
• Your e-ticket with a QR code for quick check-in.
• Save trips to your Wishlist and get an alert when they go on sale.
• Sign in with Face ID, use light or dark mode, and switch between Arabic, English and more languages.
• Your upcoming trips stay available offline.

You've seen the photos. Now live the story.

name: Turbo Loop: One-Screen Racing
description:
Turbo Loop is a top-down arcade racer where the whole track fits on one screen. Four cars, a few laps, and it is over in well under two minutes. Then you want one more go.

THE WHOLE RACE ON ONE SCREEN
No scrolling and no mini-map. You see every corner, every rival and every shortcut at once, so you always know who is ahead and where you can catch them.

BEAT THEM, TAKE THEIR RANK
Every track has its own top 100. Before each race you meet three drivers from the ranking and race against their recorded runs. Beat a driver's time and you take that place in the ranking. Come back later to see whether somebody has taken it from you.

10 TRACKS THAT DRIVE DIFFERENTLY
Grass, beach, desert, mud, snow, ice, a night city and lava. Sand and mud slow low cars down, ice makes everybody slide, and some tracks have jumps and crossings. Finish in the top 3 to unlock the next track, collect three stars on each, and beat all ten to win the cup.

6 CARS, EACH WITH ITS OWN ABILITY
- PICO turns sharper than anything else.
- DUNE keeps its full speed on sand, mud, snow and ice.
- RALLY-X gets a much bigger boost out of every drift.
- BRUTE shoves lighter rivals out of the way.
- PHANTOM makes nitro and boost pads last far longer.
- APEX-F sticks to the road, but barriers hurt it more.
Pick the right car for the surface. Paint it in one of six colours, each with its own second livery colour.

UPGRADE AND COME BACK
- Upgrade speed, acceleration, handling and nitro on every car.
- Grab coins and nitro on the track and hit the boost pads.
- Collect a daily bonus that grows over a 7-day streak.

SIMPLE CONTROLS
Steer left and right. The car does the rest. Easy to pick up, hard to drive a perfect lap.

Turbo Loop is free to play. It contains ads and optional in-app purchases.

name: Turkish Border Control
description:
You are the new officer at the Şehit Osman Bey border checkpoint. Compare every traveler's ID, pass, visa and vehicle registration. If everything checks out, APPROVE. If anything is off, REJECT.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag documents across the desk and drop the stamp onto a document.
• Names, ID numbers, photos, dates, plates and travel purpose must all agree.
• Correct calls earn money; mistakes earn fines. Cover your daily expenses to keep your job.

A NEW TOOL EVERY DAY
• Scale and X-RAY booth: catch hidden packages, weapons and concealed people.
• UV lamp for fake documents, fingerprint scanner for forged IDs.
• Listen to your boss on the phone: wanted persons, radar alerts, stolen plates.
• REPORT ERROR to accuse: a correct call makes them confess, a wrong one costs you.
• Special rules for foreign nationals, temporary protection holders, commercial trucks and diplomatic passports.
• Bribe offers, convincing stories and surprise inspectors. Conscience or cash?

FEATURES
• Retro pixel art, handcrafted atmosphere and music
• Multiple endings: your choices can make you a hero, an ordinary officer or a criminal
• A detailed Rulebook that grows with every shift
• 3 save slots plus autosave
• Fully offline, no ads, no permissions
• Turkish and English interface

This is a work of fiction; events, people and institutions are imaginary.

name: TurLEO Acente
description:
TurLEO Acente, TurLEO ile çalışan seyahat acentelerinin iş ortağı uygulamasıdır. Acente hesabınızla giriş yaparak müşterileriniz için ürün arar, rezervasyon oluşturur ve hesabınızı takip edersiniz.

Neler yapabilirsiniz?
• Yurt dışı ve yurt içi turlar, oteller, uçak biletleri, transferler ve ekstra turlar arasında arama
• Kıbrıs otelleri, vize başvurusu ve kişiye özel tur talebi
• Brüt satış fiyatı ve acente net fiyatını birlikte görme
• Rezervasyon oluşturma ve rezervasyon detaylarını izleme

• Ofisle karşılıklı belge paylaşımı (voucher, fatura, dekont)

name: Twinsy: Side by Side Video
description:
Make side-by-side and grid videos in seconds. Pick a layout, drop a video or photo in each box, and save one video to Photos.

• Layouts from two boxes to a 3×3 grid
• Formats for TikTok, Instagram Reels, Story and Post, and YouTube Shorts, with a feed preview so nothing important hides behind the buttons
• Drag a clip's film strip to line it up with the others; split and delete parts
• Zoom and move each video in its box
• A cute frame for every box: polka dots, hearts, stars, flowers, rainbow and more
• Works offline. No account, no ads, no tracking

name: Twovio: Dual Camera Video
description:
Capture the moment—and your side of the story. Twovio is an iPhone video camera for creators who want more than one view and more than one format.

ONE TAKE, TWO FORMATS
Record landscape 16:9, portrait 9:16, or both together. Give each format its own picture-in-picture composition so your story fits the way you share it.

FRONT AND REAR, TOGETHER
On compatible iPhones, record with the front and rear cameras at the same time. Show what you see and how you react. Single-camera recording is also available.

MAKE THE FRAME YOURS
Drag and pinch the picture-in-picture window to adjust its position and size. Swap the main and inset views, adjust mirroring, and check the alternate format while you shoot.

FIND YOUR LOOK
Choose from seven built-in LUT looks and adjust their intensity. Preview a look while filming and choose whether to apply it to your output. Exposure, white balance, zoom and recording options depend on your device.

KEEP YOUR FOOTAGE CLOSE
Review recordings in the local library, save finished videos to Photos, export to Files, or share using the iOS share sheet. Media processing stays on your iPhone. No account is required, and there are no ads, tracking or automatic media uploads.

TRIAL AND LIFETIME PRO
Activate a 10-day free trial through Apple's purchase confirmation to try all features. The trial does not renew or charge automatically. After the trial, recording and new exports require the one-time Lifetime Pro in-app purchase. Existing videos remain available to play and save. Restore eligible purchases in Settings.

Requires iOS 26 or later. Dual-camera capture requires a compatible iPhone. Available lenses, recording settings and manual controls vary by hardware and system conditions.

Support: https://twovio-support.pages.dev/en/support.html
Privacy: https://twovio-support.pages.dev/en/privacy.html
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: TWT Crew
description:
A TWT Crew reúne a tua atividade profissional num só lugar.

Consulta oportunidades e acompanha as tuas candidaturas e propostas. Vê tarefas de campanhas, acompanha pagamentos e recibos e mantém o teu perfil atualizado. Participa nos grupos privados da tua equipa e recebe notificações sobre novidades relevantes.
