name: Tycoon Shops
description:
Welcome to Tycoon Shops – Your Marketplace for Shopping and Business!

Discover a smarter and more convenient way to shop and sell with Tycoon Shops, your all-in-one online marketplace connecting customers and businesses.

Whether you're looking for your favorite products or ready to take your business online, Tycoon Shops makes it easy to discover products, connect with sellers, and build your own online store.

SHOP YOUR FAVORITE PRODUCTS

Explore a wide range of products from different sellers, including fashion, electronics, everyday essentials, and much more.

- Browse products across multiple categories.
- Discover products from different sellers.
- Find items that match your style, needs, and budget.
- Enjoy convenient shopping directly from your smartphone.

CREATE YOUR OWN ONLINE SHOP

Are you a business owner, entrepreneur, or aspiring seller? Tycoon Shops gives you the opportunity to establish your online presence and reach more customers.

- Create your own online store.
- Upload and showcase your products.
- Manage your product listings.
- Make your products accessible to potential customers.
- Expand your business beyond your physical location.

SELL AND GROW WITH EASE

Take your business to the next level by showcasing your products in an online marketplace where customers can discover and shop from your store.

Tycoon Shops makes it easier to manage your product listings, connect with potential customers, and create more opportunities for business growth.

WHY CHOOSE TYCOON SHOPS?

- A marketplace connecting buyers and sellers.
- Convenient mobile shopping experience.
- Multiple product categories to explore.
- Easy access to online stores and product listings.
- Opportunities for businesses to expand their reach.

YOUR SHOPPING. YOUR BUSINESS. YOUR TYCOON.

Whether you're shopping for something special or building your own business, Tycoon Shops is designed to make shopping and selling simple, convenient, and rewarding.

Download Tycoon Shops today and start shopping or building your business!

Visit us: https://tycoonshops.com

name: UK Christmas Ads
description:
Every big UK Christmas advert of 2026 in one place. Watch them, rate them, and see which one the nation thinks is best.

WATCH
Swipe through this year's adverts one at a time: John Lewis, Tesco, Sainsbury's, M&S, Aldi, Asda, Argos, Amazon, Very, Debenhams, Barbour, TK Maxx, JD Sports and Sports Direct. Each one plays from the brand's own YouTube channel, with a short note on who is in it, who made it and what the song is. Turn your phone, or tap full screen, and the advert fills the screen. New adverts are added as they come out, with no update needed.

RATE
Give each advert up to five stars, from Humbug to Tears.

THE NATION'S CHART
Every star counts once towards the nation's chart: the country's favourite Christmas adverts, in order. Everyone sees the adverts in a different order, so none of them gets a head start.

YOUR TIER LIST
Your own stars become a tier list: S for the ones that made you cry, D for the ones that did not. Send it as a picture to the family chat and find out who disagrees.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Free. No account and no sign-up.
• Your stars are kept on your device, and counted in the chart with no name attached. You can switch that off.
• A quick mute, and autoplay can be turned off.
• Each advert has a link to the brand's own app and a gift idea to go with it. The gift ideas are Amazon affiliate links: as an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases.

UK Christmas Ads is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by any of the brands shown. Brand and advert names belong to their owners. Adverts play in YouTube's embedded player from each brand's official channel; nothing is downloaded or copied.

From the makers of Days to Christmas.

name: UkeCoach: Ukulele Coach
description:
UkeCoach listens while you play and tells you what it heard.

Play a note or strum a chord and the app checks it with your iPhone's microphone. If something is off, it says which string to fix and how: press right behind the fret, let the string ring, or tune first.

WHAT YOU GET
• Chord check: pick a chord, strum, and see if it sounds right. 23 chords, from C, Am, F and G to sevenths and minors.
• String by string: pluck each string on its own and learn which fret it sounds like and which one is off.
• Tuner: G-C-E-A for high-G or low-G ukuleles, with a clear cents indicator.
• Ten short lessons: from your first four chords to a first loop, with Mimo, your practice buddy.
• Eight beginner songs: classic public-domain tunes like Twinkle Twinkle, Oh! Susanna and Amazing Grace, with the chords marked over the words and one tap to practise them.
• Optional camera view: see your hand live with the chord and finger numbers right on top of the picture. It is an approximate view only; the microphone decides what you played.
• Progress: see which chords you have checked. It is stored only on your device.
• English, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics. Audio and camera images are processed live on your device and never saved or sent.

GOOD TO KNOW
UkeCoach works best in a quiet room with the phone within arm's reach. Noise, echo, other instruments and nearby speech can affect results, and it can sometimes react to talking. Tune first for the best accuracy. When a strum is unclear, try string by string.

Requires iOS 26 or later.

name: Um Counter: Speaking Coach
description:
Record a practice talk and see your filler words, speaking pace and pauses, then track them over time, all processed on the phone.

What you get:
- See every um on your recording
- Pace, pauses and fillers in one view
- Track progress over weeks
- Add your own crutch words
- Works offline. Audio never leaves your phone.

Free to start. You can pay once or subscribe. Purchases are billed to your Apple account, and you can cancel a subscription any time in your store settings.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

Terms of use: https://michaeljohnpena.com/apps/umcounter/terms/
Privacy policy: https://michaeljohnpena.com/apps/umcounter/privacy/

name: Unarchiver .
description:
Unarchiver opens every archive you will ever be sent, and makes new ones in the formats people actually use. On the Mac, double-click an archive in Finder and it just extracts. On iPhone and iPad, tap it in Files, Mail, Safari or Messages, choose Unarchiver, and the contents appear in Files. Native design on every device, big readable controls, light and dark mode, and Liquid Glass on the latest systems.

EXTRACT ANYTHING
• ZIP and ZIPX, including password-protected ZIP (ZipCrypto and AES)
• RAR and RAR5, including multi-part .part1 / .r00 sets
• 7z, TAR, TGZ, TBZ, TXZ, tar.zst, tar.lz4
• ISO, CAB, XAR, PKG, DEB, RPM, LHA, CPIO, AR, WARC
• Split archives (.001, .002 …) joined automatically
• Comic books (CBZ, CBR, CB7, CBT), eBooks (EPUB), Office and iWork packages
• App bundles: IPA, APK, AAB, APPX, MSIX, JAR, WAR, VSIX, XPI, CRX, NuGet, wheel
• Single-file compressors: gz, bz2, xz, lzma, lz, Z, zst, lz4, uu

CREATE ARCHIVES
• ZIP with AES-256 encryption, 7z, tar.gz, tar.xz, tar.zst, tar.bz2, ISO, CPIO, XAR and more
• Drop in files and folders, or pick them from Files
• Choose compression from Fastest to Ultra; skip hidden .DS_Store files with one switch

MADE FOR YOUR DEVICES
• Mac: Finder double-click for every format, Services menu, Dock and window drag-and-drop
• iPhone and iPad: Share sheet and “Open in” for every supported type, results right in Files
• Browse an archive before extracting, search inside it, Quick Look any file, extract just the ones you need
• Smart folders keep your Desktop and Files tidy; choose what happens when something already exists
• Live progress and notifications for long jobs
• Filename encoding fixes for archives made on Windows or in other languages
• Full keyboard support, including iPad

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Unarchiver works entirely on your device, has no network access and collects no data. The built-in assistant answers questions about the app without sending anything anywhere.

FREE AND PRO
Your first extraction is free, so you can see how Unarchiver handles your files before deciding. Unarchiver Pro unlocks unlimited extracting, archive creation, password-protected archives, in-archive browsing and Quick Look, and accent themes. No ads, ever. One purchase works on Mac, iPhone and iPad.

Pro is available as a weekly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. The yearly plan starts with a free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://iihcs.click/terms
Privacy Policy: https://iihcs.click/privacy

NOTE: Encrypted RAR and encrypted 7z archives cannot be opened yet. Every other format listed above, including encrypted ZIP, is fully supported.

name: Understitch: Thread Puzzles
description:
Guide one continuous thread through two faces of an embroidery hoop. Every stitch brings the needle to the opposite side at the same hole. Plan both sides before you commit: a legal stitch can still leave the rest of the route out of reach. Finish the route to reveal the two embroidered scenes.

Take your time
Hold to preview a candidate stitch. Ask for a hint, undo your last move, or rewind to an earlier choice and try a different route. Leave a puzzle and pick up where you stopped.

Collect both sides
Explore 48 handcrafted patterns and 96 embroidered artwork faces. Revisit completed pieces in your Gallery and choose which face to display.

Start with four free patterns
A single, optional Lifetime Unlock opens the remaining 44 patterns and Daily Sampler. Complete a free pattern and own Lifetime Unlock to play the daily route. There are no ads, app accounts, or subscriptions.

Puzzles work offline. Buying or restoring Lifetime Unlock requires an App Store connection. Restore Purchase restores access to paid content; it does not restore puzzle progress.

name: Unfold Cafe: Idle Tycoon
description:
Unfold Cafe is an idle café tycoon built around one move: opening the screen.

Folded, your iPhone Duo is the counter. Tap to serve coffee, buy better beans and sign the lease for your next city. Unfold it and the street is in front of you in 3D, your café among the bakery, the bookshop and the florist: the new café cuts its ribbon the moment the screen opens.

No iPhone Duo? The game plays on every iPhone. Swipe up to open the board and swipe down to return to the counter.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Tap the counter to serve customers and earn coins. Tap fast to build a combo: every cup is worth up to 5×, and a perfect pour pays 5× on its own.
• Catch the VIP customer before they leave for a big tip or free beans.
• Choose where your chain begins: any of 40 cities in 10 countries, on a real map dotted with your cafés, little customers and balloons.
• Sign the lease for the next city. One café per city, in the middle of its street.
• Fill every city at home, then buy the permit for the nearest country: your chain grows neighbour by neighbour, and every new country adds 10% to your income.
• Open the screen for the grand opening and a bonus.
• Upgrade each café on the board. Kiosks grow into shops, shops into flagships, and every few levels a bench, a lamp, flower boxes or a balloon appears out front.
• Tap your café to drop down to the pavement and see it up close. Pinch and drag to turn the street, the counter and the map.
• Every country has its speciality, from cold brew to matcha latte, and each one helps your whole chain.
• Team up with the shops next door, start a morning rush or a street festival, and collect the day's goals.
• Earn stars and country stamps, then sell the chain for franchise shares and start again, stronger, in a new city.
• Your cafés keep earning while you are away.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
• Outer display: a one-handed counter.
• Inner display: the 3D street on one side of the fold, your chain on the other.
• Unfolded, you get the manager's desk: serve bulk orders with one tap, open the next city on the spot and upgrade the whole chain at once.
• Folding and unfolding is part of the game, not just a bigger screen.

MADE TO FEEL GOOD
• A relaxed lo-fi café soundtrack, crunchy coin sounds and haptics on every tap. Each one can be switched off.
• Customers queue at your counter, stroll the streets and walk into your café.
• Confetti and glitter for every grand opening and upgrade; the counter collects a tip jar, a menu board, a pastry cart and more as your beans get better.

FAIR AND SIMPLE
• Free to play. No ads, ever.
• A free espresso shot every four hours doubles your income for ten minutes.
• Double Income is a one-time purchase: every café and every cup earns 2×, for good.
• Beans buy permanent items such as the Neon Sign and the Barista Bot. You earn beans at every grand opening, from the day's goals and from VIP customers, or buy a pack.
• No account, no tracking, no data collected. Your game is saved on your device.

name: Unhaul: Almost-Bought Gallery
description: Unhaul is a playful photo gallery for things you almost bought — not a budget spreadsheet. Snap a photo instead of tapping checkout. Tag the store, impulse heat, and optional price. After a short wait, Unhaul asks whether you still want the item or are glad you walked away. • Capture almost-buys with photos, stores, moods, and notes • Regret queue and duels when two itches compete for attention • Dodge stats and weekly recaps celebrate money you did not spend • Store atlas and shelves group your almost collection by place • Playbook and a 30-second pause before you snap again • Badges and light streaks — no ledgers, no guilt trips Everything stays on your device. Your gallery is yours. Unhaul helps you notice impulse patterns and enjoy skipping with a little humor — not to replace professional financial advice.

name: Unisole Code
description:
Ônibus lotado, cinco minutos livres e o Unisole Code já está aberto. Uma lição curta aparece na tela, o conceito cabe em poucos parágrafos e, logo em seguida, o exercício pede a sua primeira linha de código. Aí começa a parte boa: você escreve, testa a ideia e avança.

Cada lição vai direto ao ponto. Você lê um conteúdo enxuto, entende o problema que ele resolve e parte imediatamente para a prática. As lições foram pensadas para quem está aprendendo a programar do zero, com linguagem simples e sem rodeios.

O coração do app é o editor de código integrado, que fica na própria tela. Digite sua solução, ajuste o que não funcionou e tente de novo. Errar faz parte, e aqui cada erro vira aprendizado rápido.

Os exercícios seguem uma sequência, então cada um que você resolve prepara o próximo. Termine uma atividade, siga para a seguinte e volte quando quiser revisar um trecho ou reescrever uma resposta. O ritmo é seu.

Tudo acontece direto no seu dispositivo. Não tem hora marcada nem lugar certo: estude na fila do banco, no intervalo do trabalho ou no sofá de casa, em sessões de cinco minutos ou de uma hora.

Quer começar a programar de verdade? Abra o Unisole Code, resolva a primeira lição e veja uma ideia virar código, um toque de cada vez.

name: Unplayed.
description: is a worldwide television drama archive built for browsing, not playback. Wander Korean, Japanese, American, Thai and other series by region, genre, year and charts. Open a title for ratings, heat, cast, episode notes and classic lines. Mark what you have watched, keep personal tags and lists, and use small tools when you need a date, a timezone or a random episode. Nothing streams here—just a darker, quieter place to remember the stories you want to return to.

name: Until: Countdown Widget
description:
Count down to the life events you care about, with your own photo, on the home screen and lock screen.

What you get:
- Your big days, on your home screen
- Use your own photos
- Lock screen countdowns
- Reminders as the day gets close
- No ads. Widgets free.

Free to start. One in-app purchase adds the rest, with no subscription.

name: Use By: Food Expiry Tracker
description:
Track what is in the fridge, freezer and pantry with use-by dates, and get reminded before food goes off. Add items by scanning a barcode or a receipt.

What you get:

- Scan a receipt, add the whole shop
- Barcode scan with Open Food Facts
- One reminder a day, never spam
- Track what you bin and save

Free to start. You can pay once or subscribe. Purchases are billed to your Apple account, and you can cancel a subscription any time in your store settings.

name: Usieno Roles
description:
Usieno Roles trasforma un solo telefono nel conduttore di un gioco di ruoli nascosti, pensato per una stanza piena di giocatori.

Ti è mai capitato di organizzare una serata con un gruppo numeroso e di restare senza fogli, senza carte o senza pazienza? Usieno Roles nasce proprio per questo. Lascia che sia il telefono a fare gli onori di casa: tiene le fila della partita e custodisce i segreti di ogni partecipante, così tu puoi pensare solo a far divertire il gruppo.

L'idea è semplice. Ogni giocatore riceve il proprio ruolo in privato e nessun altro al tavolo può sbirciarlo. Tutto il gioco si regge su questo: chi sa cosa, chi bluffa, chi cerca di smascherare chi mente. Tu guidi la serata, mentre l'app pensa all'ordine e alla riservatezza.

Ecco cosa offre Usieno Roles:

- Un solo telefono che conduce l'intera partita, dall'inizio alla fine.
- Ruoli nascosti, assegnati a ciascun giocatore lontano dagli occhi degli altri.
- Un'esperienza pensata per gruppi numerosi riuniti nello stesso posto.

È l'app ideale per chi organizza feste, cene e serate con amici, colleghi o parenti che amano i giochi di società. Il telefono resta al centro del tavolo o passa di mano in mano: al resto pensano le persone sedute intorno a te.

Usieno Roles è perfetta anche per coinvolgere chi di solito se ne sta in disparte. Ogni ruolo resta un segreto tra il giocatore e il telefono, e ogni partita è diversa dalla precedente, tra sospetti, alleanze e colpi di scena svelati ad alta voce.

Chiudi gli occhi, fai un bel respiro e che la partita abbia inizio. Scarica Usieno Roles, invita i tuoi amici e scopri quanto può essere divertente una stanza piena di segreti da svelare.

name: UthJa: Mission Alarm Clock
description:
Snooze wins most mornings. UthJa doesn't let it.

UthJa (Hindi for "get up") is an alarm that keeps ringing until you prove you're awake. Pick a mission, and the alarm only goes quiet once it's done.

NINE MISSIONS
- Maths: solve a few sums, from easy to tough
- Memory: remember the glowing tiles and tap them back
- Typing: type out a line, word for word
- Shake: shake the phone until the bar fills
- Steps: walk a few real steps
- Squats: a few squats to get the blood moving
- Photo: take a photo of a spot you chose, like your bathroom sink
- QR or barcode: scan a code kept away from your bed
- Object hunt: find an everyday item around the house

Chain up to five missions for the mornings that really matter.

MADE FOR EARLY STARTS
Built for students preparing for exams like UPSC, SSC, banking, JEE and NEET, and for anyone with an early class, shift or flight.
- Set how many snoozes you get, or switch snooze off
- Pick a calm or loud wake-up sound
- A Report tab with your on-time streak, average wake-up time, snoozes and badges
- A gentle bedtime reminder
- A home screen widget with your next alarm

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no sign-up. Alarms and missions work fully offline. Photos for the photo mission stay on your iPhone.

English and Hindi.

Questions or ideas? Write to connect@uthja.in.

name: UV Window: Sunscreen Timer
description:
Today's UV curve and sun protection window for where you are, plus sunscreen reapply reminders that follow your actual time outdoors.

What you get:
- Protection needed 9:40-16:10
- Reapply reminders with their own sound
- UV on your lock screen
- Timers for the whole family
- Pay once. No ads.

Free to start. One in-app purchase adds the rest, with no subscription.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Looking things up sends data off your phone: the place you choose, rounded to about 1 km, and the app name with its support page in the request header goes to MET Norway. Nothing else you enter leaves your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

name: Uyandır
description:
Alarmı kapatıp "beş dakika daha" diye geri uyuyanlar için kapatması zor bir alarm.

GÖREV OLMADAN SUSMAZ
Alarmı susturmak için bir görev yaparsın:
• Matematik: 1, 2, 3 ya da 5 soru, kolay, orta ya da zor
• Salla: telefonu belirli sayıda salla
• Yaz: ekrandaki cümleyi hatasız yaz
• Barkod: yataktan uzaktaki bir ürünün barkodunu okut

KAPATTIM SANMAK İŞE YARAMAZ
Bildirimi kaydırmak, sesi kısmak ya da uygulamayı kapatmak alarmı durdurmaz. Görev yapılana kadar alarm 20 dakika boyunca kısa aralıklarla yeniden çalar.

UYANIK MISIN?
Görevden birkaç dakika sonra bir kez daha sorar. Bir dakika içinde onaylamazsan alarm görevle birlikte baştan başlar. Alarmı kapatıp geri uyumanın önüne geçen asıl özellik bu.

SAATTE YA DA SÜRE SONRA
Belirli bir saate tekrarlı alarm kurabilir ya da "30 dakika sonra uyandır" gibi bir geri sayım başlatabilirsin.

SİSTEM ALARMI
iOS 26 ve sonrasında alarm, sistem alarmı olarak kurulur: sessiz modda, Odak açıkken ve uygulama kapalıyken de çalar.

SADE TASARIM
Masa saati sadeliğinde arayüz; aydınlık, karanlık ya da sistem teması.

Hesap yok, reklam yok, veri toplanmaz. Her şey telefonunda kalır.

name: VanaTell
description:
Vana'diel keeps talking. Now you can answer.

VanaTell sends your Final Fantasy XI tells, party chat and linkshell chat to your phone, so you can step away from the PC and still answer. Reply from your phone and the VanaTell addon (for Windower or Ashita) types it in game for you.

What comes through
• Every tell you send or receive
• Every party line
• Every line in both linkshells
• Lines you type at the keyboard show up on your phone too

Say, shout, yell, emotes and system messages stay in game.

How it works
1. Load the VanaTell addon in Windower (//lua load vanatell) or Ashita (/addon load vanatell) and pair it once with a code the app shows you.
2. Tells, party and linkshell lines arrive on your phone as they happen, with notifications you control per channel and a mute for any conversation.
3. Reply there. The addon sends it in game as you.

No account to create: the app sets itself up the first time you open it. Japanese chat and auto-translate phrases come through as they appear in game.

VanaTell is an independent companion app for Final Fantasy XI players. It requires the free VanaTell addon for Windower or Ashita on the PC running the game. VanaTell is not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix.

name: Vautio
description:
Vautio is a parkour and urban-movement practice space. Pick a name and a city, then keep your motions, training, and public spots in one place.
See what the practice looks like. The motion feed collects stills and short notes from athletes: a move, a session, a spot, a challenge result. Open a post to read it, like it, comment, save it, or share it. Search athletes, movements, spots, posts, and routes from the same place.
Learn a move, then write the session down. The movement library shows a move’s stage, preparation, and risk note. Log a session with the spot, the reps, and how it felt. Your journal and skill board keep that record so you can look back at what you have actually practiced.
Find legal public ground. Spots cover parks, approved training areas, open sports spaces, and indoor gyms. Read the access note, save a place, and string cleared stops into a route. Join a skill challenge, an urban challenge, or a meetup listed on a spot. Routes are practice lines, not turn-by-turn navigation.
Keep a portfolio. Save ordered sets of photos as pieces, mark them public or private, and pin one of your own motions on your profile. Your name, posts, training notes, and portfolio stay in Vautio on this iPhone.
Chalk is the in-app currency. A new name starts with 80 Chalk. You can buy more through the App Store and spend it on a mark under your name (15), holding one of your motions on your profile (50), or one extra portfolio frame (30). Two frames are included. When the rack is full, another piece needs a frame.
Train only where you are allowed to be. Self-stated grades describe your own practice. They are not a coaching certificate.

name: Vaxaro
description:
Vaxaro est l'application des boutiques en ligne qui livrent avec paiement à la livraison : chaque commande est confirmée par téléphone avant l'envoi.

Pour la confirmatrice
• Une fiche à la fois : nom, téléphone, produits, adresse, montant.
• Appel ou WhatsApp en un geste, puis le résultat d'un glissement : Confirmé, Échec, Annulé, Rappel.
• Rappels promis au client : le téléphone sonne à l'heure dite.
• Corrections de la fiche pendant l'appel (adresse, commune, quantité).
• « Mon rythme du jour » : ses chiffres face aux objectifs de la boutique.
• Fonctionne même quand le réseau coupe : rien n'est perdu, tout part au retour du réseau.

Pour le responsable de la boutique
• Alertes sur l'équipe, directement sur votre iPhone : une confirmatrice inactive sans pause déclarée, un rythme trop lent, trop d'échecs, des commandes qui attendent. Vous êtes prévenu, vous réagissez tout de suite.
• L'équipe en direct : qui travaille, qui ralentit, qui est en pause.
• Chiffres du jour, de la semaine et du mois.
• Confier des commandes à une personne, une par une ou par lot.
• Réglages de l'équipe : messages WhatsApp, motifs d'annulation, alertes.

Aussi
• Tournée du livreur, poste dépôt avec scan des codes-barres.
• Plusieurs boutiques sur le même téléphone.
• Français, anglais et arabe, mode sombre.

L'application demande un compte Vaxaro : les comptes sont créés par le responsable de la boutique sur vaxaro.net.

name: VaygoEats
description: Vaygo Eats makes food ordering easy and convenient. Discover nearby restaurants and home chefs, explore menus, customise meals, and order for delivery or pickup. Enjoy exciting deals, flexible payment options, live order tracking, and quick reordering of your favourite meals all in one app.

name: VaygoEats Rider
description:
Vaygo Eats Rider helps delivery riders manage their work—from starting a shift to completing deliveries.

MANAGE YOUR SHIFTS
View your shifts, complete selfie check-in, and go online when you’re ready to receive orders.

RECEIVE AND COMPLETE DELIVERIES
Receive nearby delivery offers, review order details, and update your progress through pickup and delivery.

KEEP TRACK OF YOUR EARNINGS
View your earnings, delivery performance, and cash collection details in one place.

STAY INFORMED
Get notifications about delivery offers and important updates. Access support through the app when you need help.

LOCATION WHILE YOU WORK
Vaygo Eats Rider collects location data for nearby order assignment and delivery progress tracking while you are online, including when the app is in the background or not in use. Going offline stops continuous location tracking. Location is also used when submitting a shift check-in or SOS request.

An approved Vaygo rider account is required to access delivery features. Available orders and shifts depend on service availability.

name: VBook Media
description:
VBook là ứng dụng chia sẻ kiến thức dành cho sinh viên qua video hướng dẫn ngắn gọn, dễ hiểu và sát với thực tế. Từ lập trình web, mobile đến quản trị hệ thống và nhiều chủ đề khác nữa, bạn có thể học mọi lúc, mọi nơi ngay trên ứng dụng.

Học theo danh mục. Tìm là thấy
Video được chia thành nhiều danh mục và nhiều chủ đề khác. Mỗi kỹ năng có mục lục chia theo từng phần, kèm thời lượng và ngày cập nhật, để bạn biết nên bắt đầu từ đâu và đang học đến đâu.

Quét QR mở video trong 1 giây
Bạn đang ở hội thảo chuyên đề hay buổi học trên lớp? Chỉ cần quét mã QR do diễn giả hoặc giảng viên chia sẻ là video tương ứng mở ra ngay. Bạn không cần gõ tên hay lướt tìm, cũng không bỏ lỡ nội dung quan trọng.

Tìm kiếm nhanh
Gõ vài chữ là ra ngay các khoá học liên quan, ví dụ "react"....

Phù hợp với
• Sinh viên công nghệ thông tin muốn học thêm ngoài giờ lên lớp
• Người tham dự hội thảo muốn xem lại nội dung buổi chia sẻ
• Giảng viên và diễn giả cần một nơi gửi tài liệu video cho người học

Tải Vbook và bắt đầu học ngay hôm nay!

name: VEDGE CDN & WAF - VNETWORK JSC
description:
VEdge Console is the mobile companion to the VNETWORK VEdge CDN and WAF platform. Sign in with your existing dashboard account and run your edge from anywhere.

OVERVIEW
• Fleet summary: domains, edge nodes, requests, bandwidth, cache hit ratio, WAF blocks
• Live traffic and status charts with 1h to 30d ranges
• Active attack campaigns and recent configuration changes

DOMAINS
• Add, enable, disable and delete domains
• Every configuration section in one place: upstream, cache policies, TLS, CORS, security headers, header rules, access control, rate limiting, bot management, DDoS, WAF settings, custom and firewall rules, logging and reports
• Configuration history with snapshots, diff and validation

SECURITY
• WAF events and statistics per domain, tier attribution, top blocked rules
• SSL certificate store: upload, ACME issuance, binding, chain audit and renewal

CACHING
• Purge by URL, prefix, suffix, tag or everything, with soft purge and warm-up
• Purge status tracking across edge nodes

ANALYTICS
• Domain and organization analytics: traffic, status groups, geography, devices, browsers, top paths, cache performance
• Request log search and CSV export

ADMINISTRATION
• Alert rules and notification channels (Telegram, Slack, Teams, Google Chat, webhook)
• Organizations, users, API keys and quotas
• Fleet-wide settings, edge node status, audit logs

ACCESS
• Username and password sign-in through your VEdge server, with optional two-factor authentication
• What you can see and change follows your role: super admin, support admin, organization admin, organization user or viewer
• A built-in demo workspace lets you explore the console without an account

VEdge Console requires access to a VNETWORK VEdge control plane. Contact VNETWORK to get started.

name: Venta Maps: Maps & Navigation
description:
Venta Maps is a high-quality free map by Venta: places, exact addresses, directions and turn-by-turn navigation with voice prompts.

• Search places and addresses — cafes, restaurants, pharmacies, shops, banks, hotels, clinics and more. One-tap categories, nearest first.
• Place cards — photos, opening hours and “open now”, phones, website, social media and messengers. Only what exists is shown.
• Directions by car, on foot and by bike — time, distance and arrival for each, with step-by-step instructions.
• Navigator — guides you along the route, speaks the turns and reroutes if you leave it.
• A beautiful 2D and 3D map — buildings, streets and labels in Russian, Armenian or English.
• Saved places — keep your favourites. With Venta ID they are available on all your devices.
• For business — add your organisation, update photos and hours, answer reviews and promote it on the map.

The most detailed coverage today is Armenia — Yerevan and the whole country. More countries are coming in future updates.

Signing in with Venta ID is optional: the map, search, directions and navigation work without an account.
Map data © OpenStreetMap.

name: VERIDIA Wetstock
description: A aplicação do posto do VERIDIA Wetstock, para empresas de distribuição de combustível que usam o VERIDIA Wetstock. O telemóvel do posto é registado pela empresa; cada trabalhador entra com o seu PIN e regista a passagem de turno (as leituras dos contadores de cada pistola e as medições dos tanques) e as medições de fecho do dia, mesmo sem rede. Tudo é enviado ao Wetstock quando houver sinal, uma vez, pela ordem em que foi feito. No seu próprio telemóvel, um proprietário ou gestor vê os indicadores dos seus postos e o stock de cada tanque. Requer uma conta Wetstock dada pela sua empresa.

name: Veyro Remote
description:
Veyro Remote – Smart Layout & Setup Studio
Veyro Remote is a modern remote layout studio and home entertainment setup planner designed to help you organize devices, customize remote-style controls, and manage your entertainment space with ease.
Featuring a sleek interface inspired by modern TV remotes, Veyro Remote combines interactive control previews with practical equipment management and setup planning tools.
Key Features
	•	Interactive Remote Studio: Explore a remote-style interface with directional controls, media buttons, shortcuts, and haptic feedback.
	•	Custom Remote Layouts: Personalize button labels, colors, and shortcuts to create layouts that suit your preferences.
	•	Device Management: Organize televisions, monitors, speakers, gaming consoles, and other entertainment equipment.
	•	HDMI & Input Planning: Keep track of HDMI connections, audio outputs, and connected accessories.
	•	Room Setup Organizer: Create and manage entertainment setups for different rooms.
	•	Smart Checklists: Plan installations, track completed tasks, and organize troubleshooting steps.
	•	Setup Guides: Access helpful references for managing entertainment equipment and connections.
	•	Progress & History: Review saved activities, control previews, and setup progress.
Simple, Private & Organized
Veyro Remote works offline, requires no account, and stores your information locally on your device.
Important: Veyro Remote is designed for remote layout customization, interactive previews, and entertainment setup planning. It does not connect to or control physical televisions or streaming devices.
Bring your entertainment setup ideas together with Veyro Remote — a stylish workspace for better organization and planning.

name: VibeCheck: Quiz & Match
description:
No photos. No swiping. Just vibes.

VibeCheck matches people by how they think, not how they look. Answer playful questions, compare your answers and see where you really click.

COUPLE MATCH (18+)
• Get matched live with someone who is online right now
• Answer the same questions at the same time
• See your match score and a vibe map: communication, daily life, money & career, social circle and values
• Chat opens only if your vibes match and you both say yes
• Instead of photos you see a vibe card: nickname, avatar, interests and latest results

FRIENDS
• Send a code to a friend and guess each other's answers
• Find out who really knows whom best
• Compare your answers question by question

DISCOVER YOURSELF
• Quick personality quizzes with result cards you can share
• What's your vibe? What's your creative energy? Find out in a minute

SAFE BY DESIGN
• 18+ only, with an age check
• Every chat starts with mutual consent, and a declined invite is final
• Message filters, reporting and blocking
• No photos, no location sharing

7 LANGUAGES
English, Türkçe, Deutsch, Español, Italiano, Français, Русский

Extra question packs and unlimited messages are optional in-app purchases. Quiz results are for fun, not a psychological assessment.

Terms: https://mkandemir.com.tr/vibecheck/terms.html
Privacy: https://mkandemir.com.tr/vibecheck/privacy.html

name: Victorian Institute Online
description:
Victorian Institute Online is the official mobile learning management application for students of Victorian Institute of Technology.
Stay connected with your learning environment and access your courses, educational resources and academic activities directly from your mobile device.
FEATURES
• My Courses: Access your enrolled courses and course materials.
• Interactive Learning: Participate in supported interactive activities, including H5P content.
• Learning Resources: Access study materials and resources provided by your institute.
• Academic Progress: View grades and monitor your learning progress.
• Calendar: Keep track of important dates and upcoming learning activities.
• Notifications: Stay informed about important announcements and updates.
• Student Account: Sign in securely using your institutional student credentials.
Victorian Institute Online makes it convenient to stay connected with your institute and access your learning environment.
Note: A valid Victorian Institute of Technology student account is required to access the learning platform.

name: Video to Photo: Frame by Frame
description:
A screenshot of a paused video gives you the player's resolution and whatever frame happened to be on screen. Video to Photo gives you the real frame, at the video's full resolution.

• Play at ¼×, ½×, 1× or 2× speed and pause right on the moment
• Drag the thumbnail strip to jump anywhere in long videos
• Move one frame at a time with the jog strip or the arrow buttons
• Works with 4K, 60 fps and slow-motion videos from your library
• Save as lossless PNG or smaller HEIF, straight to Photos
• No watermark on any save
• Works offline. Your videos never leave your iPhone
• No account. No tracking
• 5 free saves, then 1 free save every day. Unlock once for unlimited. No subscription

Great for thumbnails, sports form checks, wildlife and action shots, and the moment your kid finally smiled.

name: VideoNAS: NAS Video Player
description:
VideoNAS turns your Synology NAS into your own cinema. Watch the movies, series and family videos in your own folders on iPhone, iPad and Mac – no Plex, no Video Station, nothing to install on the NAS.

WATCH
• Streams straight from your NAS, also with a self-signed certificate
• Continue Watching, on every profile
• Subtitles (.srt, .vtt) next to your videos are found automatically
• Old DVD recordings in several parts play as one video
• MKV and AVI: open them in VLC or Infuse with one tap

YOUR LIBRARY
• Choose folders and say what's in them: movies, series or family videos
• Titles, years, seasons and episodes from the file names, with stills from the videos themselves
• "On This Day" brings back family moments from earlier years
• Collections for weddings, holidays, birthdays – or your own
• Search by title, year or folder

THE PLAYER (iPhone, iPad)
• Swipe for brightness and volume, double-tap to skip, hold for 2×
• Previous and next episode, playback speed, fill the screen

PRO – ONE-TIME PURCHASE, TRY FREE FOR 3 DAYS
• Download videos and watch offline – on a plane, in the car
• Profiles with their own DSM account, and kids profiles
• Unlimited libraries and your own collections
• Picture in Picture and AirPlay
• Media servers (DLNA): Synology Media Server, FRITZ!Box, Plex
• 2× and playback speed, accent colors and app icons
One purchase works on your iPhone, iPad and Mac. No subscription.

PRIVATE
Your videos and passwords only travel between your device and your own NAS. No account, no tracking, no ads.

Looking for Apple TV? Get VideoNAS TV, a separate app for the big screen.

Try it without a NAS: tap "Try the Demo".

VideoNAS is an independent app and is not affiliated with Synology Inc. Synology and DSM are trademarks of Synology Inc.

name: VietLish: English & Vietnamese
description:
Press play and start speaking. VietLish is a hands-free speaking course: a friendly teacher voice guides you through real conversations, pauses for you to answer, and builds sentences step by step, so you can learn while you cook, walk or drive.

• Learn English (for Vietnamese speakers) or Southern or Northern Vietnamese (for English speakers)
• Kids, Teens and Adults courses: short, playful lessons for children, school-life topics for teens, everyday conversations for adults
• Hands-free: listen, repeat in the pause, then speak in the conversation
• Lessons keep playing with the screen off
• Practice games for the lesson you are on: flash cards, quick match, speed round and reading
• Track your daily minutes and progress, backed up when you sign in
• Choose your own colours for each course

Lesson 1 of every course is free, no account needed. A subscription unlocks all lessons: 99,000 VND a month or 999,000 VND a year (the store shows the final price and renewal terms before you buy). In each course (Adults, Teens and Kids) you can watch one short ad a day to unlock one extra lesson for 24 hours; in Kids and Teens a grown-up answers a quick question first. All ads are child-safe, and Kids and Teens ads are never personalised. A short ad may show after a lesson, never during one. An internet connection is needed to sign in and to get the lessons.

Terms of Use: https://appmakernguyen-arch.github.io/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://appmakernguyen-arch.github.io/privacy.html

name: Vinage: Wine Cellar Manager
description:
Vinage is your personal wine cellar on your iPhone. Scan a label, keep track of what is in your cellar and see when each bottle is at its best.

SCAN A LABEL
Point the camera at a label. Vinage recognises the producer, wine, vintage, region and grapes and fills in the wine form for you. You check it, adjust where needed and save. A QR code on the bottle, such as a digital product passport, is read with the same scanner.

YOUR CELLAR, EXACTLY AS IT IS
Recreate your cellar as a rack, diamond rack, case or shelving unit and give every bottle its own slot. You always know where a bottle is, even after you move it.

DRINKING WINDOW AND AGEING
For each wine, one chart shows whether it still needs to rest, is at its best now or is past its peak, and for how many years. In your collection a small arc shows it at a glance.

NOTIFICATIONS AND BADGE
Vinage tells you when a bottle reaches its best years or is nearly past its peak. The number on the app icon shows how many bottles need your attention. Everything is calculated on your device.

WINE FOR YOUR DISH
Describe or dictate what you are eating, or take a photo of your plate. Vinage looks in your own cellar first and adds suggestions.

TASTINGS
Record tasting notes with scales for sweetness, body, tannin and acidity. Keep track of a tasting evening with friends or a wine fair and put your favourites on your wishlist.

EXPLORE AND LEARN
A world map shows where your wines come from, with background on countries and regions. For each wine you can read a review.

ONE CELLAR, TOGETHER
Sign in and share one cellar with your partner or housemate. Changes appear right away on every device.

YOUR DATA
Vinage works offline, from the very first start. Export your collection as a PDF, CSV or backup to Files, or share a wine card. Vinage has no ads and no tracking.

In six languages: English, Dutch, German, French, Spanish and Italian.

Vinage is intended for adults. Please enjoy responsibly.

name: Virtual Trek: Step Journeys
description:
Walk famous real-world routes (Camino, Kokoda, Great Ocean Walk) using your daily steps, with map progress, milestones and illustrated postcards.

What you get:
- Your steps move you along Kokoda
- Postcards at every landmark
- Finish by your goal date
- Camino, Larapinta, Hadrian's Wall and more
- No account. Steps come from Health.

Free to start. You can pay once or subscribe. Purchases are billed to your Apple account, and you can cancel a subscription any time in your store settings.

No account, no ads and no tracking. Your data stays on your phone, and you can export a backup whenever you like.

Terms of use: https://michaeljohnpena.com/apps/virtualtrek/terms/
Privacy policy: https://michaeljohnpena.com/apps/virtualtrek/privacy/

name: Vitals Remote: Mac Monitor
description:
Vitals Remote puts your Mac on your iPhone. See how hard it is working, get told when something goes wrong, and fix it without walking back to your desk.

You need the free Vitals app on your Mac, from vitals.rafay99.com. Pair once by scanning a QR code, and your phone connects over Wi-Fi at home or through Tailscale when you are away.

SEE YOUR MAC LIVE
• CPU, GPU, memory, battery and storage
• Temperatures and fan speeds from the real sensors
• Processes using the most CPU and memory
• History charts, so you can see what happened while you were away

Every number is a real reading from your Mac. If a sensor has no value, the app says so instead of guessing.

ALERTS THAT FIND YOU
When your Mac runs hot, runs out of memory or a process gets stuck, you get a notification on your phone. When the problem clears, the notification goes away by itself. No third-party push service is involved.

CONTROL IT FROM ANYWHERE
• Lock, sleep, restart or shut down
• Keep it awake, or let it sleep again
• Turn off the display, change the volume or mute it
• Open, hide, quit or force quit apps
• Stop a runaway process
• Pressure Guard steps in when your Mac is struggling, and you can undo it

Anything destructive is off until you turn it on for that phone, and the Mac keeps a log of every command.

FILES AND CLIPBOARD
• Send photos, files and links between your iPhone and your Mac, including from the Share sheet
• Share your clipboard both ways
• Browse your Mac's files and pull what you need to your phone

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your phone talks to your own Mac directly. The Wi-Fi link is end-to-end encrypted, remote access goes through your own Tailscale network, and there is no Vitals account or cloud server in the middle. You can revoke any phone from the Mac in one click.

name: VocabApp - 英単語
description:
自分の単語帳で、忘れる前にちょうどよく復習できる英単語アプリです。

■ 単語帳をすぐに用意
・写真から取り込み: 自分のノートや単語リストのページを撮ると、英単語と訳を読み取ります（端末内で読み取り。Google Gemini の API キーを設定すると、より正確に読み取れます）
・CSV ファイルから取り込み（1列目に英単語、2列目に訳）
・内蔵の単語帳: 日常基礎・TOEIC® テスト対策・ビジネス・アカデミック

■ 3つの学び方
・4択テスト: 意味を4つから選びます。英→日・日→英に対応
・左右振り分け: 覚えていたら右へ、まだなら左へ。テンポよく復習できます
・聞き流し: 「英語 → 日本語 → 英語」の音声を続けて再生。画面を消しても続きます。再生速度と読み上げパターンも選べます

■ 忘れる前に復習
答えた結果から、次の復習日を自動で決めます（間隔反復）。「本日の復習」から、今日見直すとよい単語をすぐに始められます。ミスした単語・未学習の単語・番号の範囲でも学べます。

■ ウィジェットとライブアクティビティ
・ホーム画面のウィジェット: 「本日の復習」「学習状況」「単語カード」の3種類。「本日の復習」は、ホーム画面のまま答えを見て「もう一度 / 覚えた」を記録できます。「学習状況」はロック画面にも置けます
・ライブアクティビティ: 学習の途中でホーム画面に戻っても、Dynamic Island とロック画面で単語カードの続きや聞き流しを操作できます

■ 例文と読み上げ
・例文の生成は Apple Intelligence（対応する端末）で、単語の読み上げは端末の音声で使えます
・AI の例文（Google Gemini・Groq）と AI 音声（Google Gemini・OpenAI）は、ご自身で取得した API キーを設定して使う任意の機能です。初めて使う前に、送信する内容を確認します

■ Web版と同じデータ
Google でログインすると、Web版（vocab-app-r.web.app）やほかの端末と、単語帳と学習の記録を共有できます。Apple でのログインや、ログインせずに始めることもできます。

■ そのほか
・経験値とレベル。爽快モード（紙吹雪・効果音・コンボ表示）
・ダークモード、軽量化モード（ぼかし・アニメーションを抑える）
・広告はありません

ご注意
・内蔵の単語帳は、NGSL Project の単語リスト（CC BY-SA 4.0）に日本語訳を加えたものです
・TOEIC は米国 ETS の登録商標です。このアプリは ETS の検討を受けたり、その承認を得たりしたものではありません。

name: Vocado: Tiếng Anh thực chiến
description:
Vocado giúp người đi làm nói tiếng Anh đúng nghề: lễ tân khách sạn, tiếp viên hàng không, dân IT. Mỗi ngày vài phút, bạn học đúng những câu sẽ dùng ở chỗ làm.

CA LÀM VIỆC VỚI KHÁCH AI
Vào ca, AI đóng vai khách hoặc đồng nghiệp. Bạn nói hoặc gõ câu trả lời, cuối ca nhận sao và nhận xét.

CÂU CỨU HỘ CHO CA HÔM NAY
Mỗi ngày một thẻ câu cứu hộ cho tình huống hay gặp: khách phàn nàn, hỏi đường, đổi phòng. Mở ra là dùng được ngay.

HỌC THEO NGHỀ, THEO MỨC
Chọn nghề và mức Dễ, Trung bình hoặc Khó. Bài học xếp theo tình huống thật ở quầy lễ tân, trên chuyến bay, trong team IT.

SAI ĐÂU, GỢI Ý ĐÚNG CHỖ ĐÓ
Trả lời sai, Vocado tô đúng từ cần sửa và cho thêm gợi ý trước khi hiện đáp án.

ÔN ĐÚNG LÚC SẮP QUÊN
Thẻ từ có 4 mức tự chấm. App tự hẹn ngày ôn lại để từ mới vào trí nhớ dài hạn.

name: Vocal Warm Up & Voice Training
description:
Singpop is a singing trainer you control with your voice. The app plays a line, you sing it back, and a green dot shows your voice live against the notes, so you can see at once whether you are in tune.

How a round works
Listen to a short line played in piano tones, then sing it back on "La". Your voice shows as a green dot beside a piano keyboard, with the name of the note you are singing (Do Re Mi or C D E, depending on your phone's language). Hold the dot on the bar and the note counts. At the end you get up to three stars and your "% in tune".

A vocal warm up in about five minutes
The daily warm up takes you through breathing, easy steps, a scale and single notes. A good start before choir, a lesson, karaoke night or your own practice.

106 melodies you already know
A road of 27 stages with folk songs, classical themes and carols. You learn each melody line by line, then sing it through. There are no lyrics to read: you sing on "La" and keep your ear on the pitch.

Voice training, one skill at a time
Between the songs you practise the basics: hit the note, three steps, the five-note scale, arpeggios, octave jumps and the full scale. Short drills that build pitch step by step.

Fits your vocal range
A short range check finds the lowest and highest notes you sing comfortably. After that, every song and every drill is moved to fit your own voice, low or high.

Stars, days in a row and world ranks
Collect stars, keep your days in a row going, and type a nickname to climb the world ranks for today and this week.

What you get without paying
Every song and every skill is open to everyone: two rounds every three hours, and the warm up once a day. Singpop Pro removes the waiting, as a monthly or yearly subscription or a one-time purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account; subscriptions renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, in your Apple Account settings.

Private by design
No ads and no account. The microphone is only used live on your device to read the pitch of your voice. Nothing is recorded, and your voice never leaves the device.

Works on iPhone, iPad and Mac.
Questions or ideas: info@jcom.llc
Privacy: https://singpop.app/privacy
Terms: https://singpop.app/terms

name: VoiceBlur
description:
VoiceBlur replaces the voice in a recording with a synthetic one. The words stay, the picture stays, and your real voice is gone.

Everything happens on your iPhone. The speech models are trimmed and optimized to run on the phone's own chip, so there is no server to send your audio to. Turn on Airplane Mode and it still works.

How it works
1. Record in the app, choose a recording from Files or a video from your library, or share one from Voice Memos.
2. Listen to any 10 seconds in a new, synthetic voice. Tap Original to compare, or try another voice.
3. Blur the whole recording and save or share it.

What it protects against
Every voice is checked on your phone before you hear it: a speaker-recognition model compares the sample with your real voice, and a voice it still recognises as you is swapped for another. That holds up against people listening and against speaker-recognition software that has a recording of your real voice. It does not hold up against someone who has VoiceBlur and recordings of the people they suspect, and it does not hide what you say. The app says so before you share.

What it does
- Replaces the speaker's voice. Words untouched.
- Videos keep their picture, with a small VoiceBlur mark in the bottom-right corner.
- Removes location, device and date metadata from the file.
- Handles voice memos, video, mp3, wav and other common formats. Several files at once get one shared voice.

What it does not do
- It is not perfect. Your words, names, places, accent and manner of speaking are still there. Background sounds stay.
- It is tuned for English. Other languages work with varying quality.
- Listen before you share.

Free
No purchases, no subscription, no ads.

Privacy
No account, no analytics, no crash reporting, no third-party code, no networking code.

name: Vouch Attendance
description:
Attendance for a full lecture hall in about a minute.

The lecturer starts class on their phone. Students check in from their seats with their fingerprint or face. The registry gets a record it can rely on, even when the campus has no internet.

Vouch is for universities that use it: your university creates your account, and there is no sign-up in the app.

ONE CLASS, START TO FINISH
- The lecturer picks the course and taps Start Session. Check-in opens and a live count shows who has arrived.
- Students check in from their seats in a few seconds each. Nobody queues and no sheet goes round.
- Check-in closes by itself after 15 minutes, or earlier with one tap. Teaching carries on.
- The lecturer's phone uploads the class the next time it has internet.
- Reports update for lecturers, department admins and the registry.

WHY THE RECORD HOLDS UP
A check-in only counts when the right student is in the right room with their own phone.
- Bluetooth: students can check in only within range of the lecturer's phone.
- Classroom location: GPS confirms the student is inside the classroom.
- Fingerprint or face, then a signed record: each check-in is signed on the student's phone after their fingerprint or face confirms it's them, and stays tamper-evident all the way to the final report.
- One phone per student: each account is tied to the student's own phone. Moving to a new phone goes through the registry.

WORKS OFFLINE
Classes run without internet, and students never need data. The lecturer's phone keeps the register and uploads it when it next connects, so a power cut or network outage during class doesn't lose a register.

FOR LECTURERS
- Start class in a few taps and keep teaching while the register fills itself.
- Run a quick roll call, or mark a student present by hand when their phone has died.
- Show a QR code for a student whose phone has no Bluetooth.
- Cover a colleague's class: any lecturer on a course can start it.
- Course reports with every student's record, and students below the threshold flagged before exam time.

FOR STUDENTS
- Activate your phone once with the code from your registry. No password after that.
- Check in with your fingerprint or face. No internet or data needed.
- Follow your own attendance in each course, and get warned early if you fall below your university's threshold.

FOR UNIVERSITIES
- A dated register for every class: who checked in and how many minutes after the start.
- Students at risk, early: set a threshold such as 75% and Vouch lists everyone below it in each course.
- Term reports by course and department, with manual entries and flagged check-ins counted. Download as CSV or PDF for the exam office.
- The registry stays in charge: it creates every student account and decides who is registered for each course each term.

YOUR PRIVACY
Vouch uses the fingerprint or face unlock already on your phone. Your fingerprint and face data never leave your phone, and Vouch never receives them.

Want Vouch at your university? Visit vouchapp.tech.

name: VYBE.FIT
description:
VYBE.FIT is your club's app. Watch your club's classes live, see your membership, and check in at the door.

FOR MEMBERS
• Watch your club's classes live, with less than a second of delay
• Catch up on replays your membership includes

Everything your role needs sits in its own Work tab, behind Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode:

name: Wajh: Qibla & Prayer Times
description:
Wajh: Qibla & Prayer Times shows the prayer times of your mosque's own method, points you to the Qibla, and helps you through Ramadan. No ads, no subscriptions, no account, and nothing about you is collected.

PRAYER TIMES THAT MATCH YOUR MOSQUE
• 17 calculation methods, including Diyanet, Umm al-Qura, the Moonsighting Committee, ISNA, the Muslim World League, Egypt, Karachi, Kemenag, JAKIM and MUIS
• Each method follows its authority's own rules, checked against the timetables they publish
• Choose your school (madhab): Hanafi, Shafi'i, Maliki, Hanbali or Ja'fari, with the Asr time that goes with it
• Move any prayer by a few minutes to match your mosque exactly
• The next prayer with a countdown, today's times, a monthly timetable and the Hijri date

QIBLA
• A clear compass that turns gold and taps once when you face the Qibla
• A map with the line to the Kaaba and mosques nearby

RAMADAN AND THE ISLAMIC YEAR
• Suhoor and iftar times for every day of Ramadan, with a countdown
• An iftar countdown on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• The special days and nights of the year, following Umm al-Qura, Diyanet's calendar or Shia observance

REMINDERS
• A notification for each prayer, an optional reminder before it, Jumu'ah, and suhoor and iftar in Ramadan
• Ask Siri when the next prayer is, without opening the app

ALSO
• A tasbih counter with gentle haptics
• A tracker for fasts and missed (qada) prayers, kept on your iPhone
• English, Dutch, German, French, Turkish and Arabic, switchable in the app

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your times are calculated on your iPhone. The app has no account, no advertising and no tracking, and sends nothing to the developer. Place names, city search and the map come from Apple Maps.

name: Wake Back To Red
description:
Wake Back to Red is built around one simple technique for a first lucid dream: one trigger, one check, one alarm.

IN THE DAY
Every time you notice something red, tap the dot and run the check: look at it, look away, picture it another colour, look back. Awake, red stays red. In a dream it changes, and that's when you realise you're dreaming.

AT BEDTIME
A 90-second ritual: set the cue volume, run the check once, and go to sleep holding one thought.

IN THE NIGHT
A few hours in, a gentle red light and soft tones wake you. Five quiet minutes in the red room, guided by voice, then back to sleep. Later, quiet sound cues play while you sleep, following a 2024 home study that paired a pre-sleep routine with sound cues.

IN THE MORNING
Tell the app your dream before it fades. It turns your voice into words on your phone, or you can type.

BUILT FOR 4 AM
- Black and red only from bedtime to morning. No blue light.
- Three wake layers: the app, a system alarm and a notification.
- If the app gets closed, the system alarm and the notification still wake you.
- Tap at night to see the time or end the night.

PRIVATE
No account, no analytics, no ads. Your journal and recordings stay on your phone.

Nobody can promise a lucid dream on a given night. This app makes the technique easy to follow, every night. Not medical advice.

Technique by Daniel Love. Not affiliated.

name: Wake Up, Loser: Roast Alarm

Your alarm has opinions now.

Wake Up, Loser is the alarm clock that roasts you out loud, makes you prove you're awake, and tells your crew every time you hit snooze. No more "five more minutes". You get up, or you get exposed.

ROASTED AWAKE
• A spoken roast every morning, in a natural voice, that gets meaner the more you snooze
• Pick your roaster: from gentle bestie to full Feral mode
• Snooze is allowed. It's just never private.

PROVE YOU'RE AWAKE

DISCOVER

PLANS

name: Weyora
description:
Stuck between “I should go out” and a blank map? Weyora turns a short mood, preference, or free hour into real places and walkable ideas—so every outing can feel like a small discovery.
Weyora is your pastel, English-first companion for meandering a city you name in plain text. Describe what you want in text or a reviewed voice note; after a clear AI agreement, suggestions are organised from that city wording plus theme tags—cafés, hidden bookshops, exhibitions, happenings, and weekend rambles—with short reasons you can actually use.

name: What's Required?
description:
What's Required? helps you understand and complete government and company procedures.

Find saved procedures, see requirements and steps in the right order, and keep a personal Todo list for what you need to do next. Downloaded procedure data stays available for browsing when you are offline.

The local assistant can search your saved procedures by text or voice. It can connect a request to relevant procedures and their prerequisites, while keeping messages and voice processing on your device. Optional downloaded models also work offline.

Features:
- Browse government and company procedure guides
- See required documents, steps, fees, locations, and official links
- Track procedures and documents in a synchronized Todo list
- Search in English, Arabic, and French
- Use text or on-device voice input

Always review the linked official source before starting a procedure.

name: Which book
description:
Which book keeps the order of one shelf and shows the book that is in the wrong place.

Load the sample shelf, or add the books in front of you. A book that is out of place is marked. Tap it to read which neighbor it should follow, and whether the volume or a decimal digit decides that. Move it there. The shelf does not rearrange itself.

Open the cart for books that are not on the shelf yet. Tap one to see the gap. Nothing moves until you place it.

Dewey and Library of Congress are both on this phone. The catalog stays on this phone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: WHInventory Warehouse Manager
description:
Know what you have, where it belongs, and who has it. WHInventory brings inventory, tools, locations, and your team into one company workspace.

DESCRIBE THE CHANGE
Ask the AI assistant to help organize your warehouse. Add categories and custom fields, set low-stock rules, or ask which tools are overdue. Review the proposed changes before applying them. The assistant follows your role permissions.

KEEP STOCK AND EQUIPMENT TOGETHER
Track counted stock alongside individually identified assets. Receive and issue supplies, move items between locations, and find records by name, SKU, or serial number. Scan a barcode or QR label with your device's camera to look up an item.

SEE WHO HAS WHAT
Check equipment out to a team member with a due date, record returns, and see overdue tools. Set value-based approval rules for check-outs that need a manager's decision.

MAKE THE APP FIT YOUR WORK
Turn modules on or off. Build categories and subcategories, add fields for your trade, and organize your locations. Invite your team and assign permissions for admins, managers, warehouse staff, and viewers.

COUNT, REVIEW, AND FOLLOW UP
Run cycle counts and post differences. Review low-stock, overdue, and service alerts. Keep a history of workspace changes and export your inventory data.

WHInventory requires an internet connection and a company workspace. Available features depend on the modules and permissions configured by your company. AI features require the service to be enabled. Company subscriptions are managed outside this app.

name: Whisper Live: Voice Keyboard
description:
Whisper Live turns your voice into text in any app. Tap the mic on the Whisper Live keyboard, talk, and your words are typed as you speak – in Mail, Notes, Messages, WhatsApp or anywhere you can type.

Everything happens on your device with Apple's speech recognition. There's no account, no server and no tracking, and it works in flight mode.

VOICE KEYBOARD
• Words appear live while you talk, like built-in dictation
• Hold the mic to talk, or tap to start and stop
• Stops by itself when you pause (you choose how long)
• A full keyboard for quick fixes, with undo

TUNED TO YOUR VOICE
• Sensitivity for quiet or loud rooms
• Settings for higher or lower voices
• Noise reduction and a far-from-the-mic mode
• Whisper mode for quiet places

CLEAN TEXT
• Removes "um" and "uh" and fixes punctuation
• Voice commands: "new line", "new paragraph", "delete that"
• Optional clean-up with on-device Apple Intelligence on supported devices
• Writing styles: casual, formal or as spoken
• Numbered lists when you say "one… two… three…"

YOUR WORDS
• Teach it names and terms with your own vocabulary
• Replacements and text snippets for things you say often
• Learns from your corrections, if you want it to

MORE
• Translate as you dictate with Apple's on-device translation
• Over 40 languages, with quick switching between your favourites
• History with editing, copy and share
• A Control Center button to start talking

FREE AND PRO
• Free: 20 dictations a day, with every feature
• Templates: To-do list, Meeting notes, Key points, Social post – talk freely, get the right shape
• Whisper Live Pro: unlimited dictation and your own templates – $4.99/month or $29.99/year, Family Sharing included

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Some languages need a one-time download of Apple's speech model. On-device AI clean-up needs a device that supports Apple Intelligence.

name: Who Survives the Night? Mafia
description:
Who Survives the Night? is a social deduction party game for 4 to 16 friends, in the spirit of Mafia and werewolf, with vampires. Open a room, share its 5-character code or an invite link, then talk, bluff and vote until the village is saved or the vampires take over.

HOW A GAME GOES
- Night: the vampires pick a victim, the doctor protects someone, the seer learns whether a player is a vampire.
- Day: the village finds out who is gone, talks it over and hunts for liars.
- Vote: everyone votes. The player with the most votes is hanged; if the village skips, nobody is.
- The village wins when every vampire is gone. The vampires win when they take over the village.

SECRET ROLES
- Vampire: hunts by night, hides by day. Vampires know each other.
- Villager: your only power is your voice and your ears.
- Doctor: protects one player each night.
- Seer: learns each night whether one player is a vampire.

TALK IT OUT
Text chat and voice chat are built in. The game decides who can hear whom: villagers sleep in silence at night and ghosts only hear other ghosts. You can mute anyone, block anyone, and use "Hide my IP address" so your voice goes through a relay. Voice is never recorded.

PRACTICE WITH BOTS
No friends around? "Practice with bots" starts a game against five bots right from the home screen. Nothing is saved and nobody else joins.

SAFE TO PLAY
Nicknames and chat are filtered. You can report or block any player, and a person reads the reports. The room's host can remove players and lock the room. Online play is for ages 13 and up.

FREE, WITH ADS
The game is free to play. There is a banner on the home screen, the lobby and the results screen, and a full-screen ad now and then when you leave a results screen, never during a game. After a long break an ad can also appear when you open the app.

PREMIUM
Premium removes all the ads. Nothing else changes: every role and every mode stays free for everyone. It comes three ways:
- Premium Weekly: auto-renewing subscription, 1 week
- Premium Monthly: auto-renewing subscription, 1 month
- Premium Lifetime: one-time purchase that never renews
The price for your country is shown in the app before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews automatically at the same price for the same period unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; the renewal is charged within the 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel a subscription at any time in your Apple Account settings. Purchases can be restored on a new phone.

No sign-up: online play uses an anonymous player that you can delete in Settings. 18 languages.

Terms of Use: https://ademkinatas.com/sabaha-kim-kalir/en/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://ademkinatas.com/sabaha-kim-kalir/en/privacy/

name: Wichtelzauber – Wichteln
description:
Wichtelzauber macht aus dem Wichteln ein kleines Fest – vom ersten Namen bis zum großen Aufdecken.

Anlass wählen, Leute eintragen, Paare ausschließen und auslosen. Zaubi, der kleine Wichtel, mischt die Namen, und jede:r erfährt nur, wen sie oder er beschenkt.

FÜR JEDEN ANLASS
• Weihnachten, Nikolaus, Silvester, Ostern, Opferfest, Muttertag, Vatertag, Einfach so – oder ein eigener Anlass
• Zaubi schlägt den nächsten Termin vor, mit allen Festtagen zur Auswahl
• Budget mit einem Tipp: 20, 25, 30, 50, 100 € oder frei

FAIR AUSGELOST
• Ab drei Personen
• Ausschlüsse für Paare oder alle, die sich nicht ziehen sollen
• Keine Zweierkreise, auf Wunsch ein großer Kreis
• Für Firmen: Teams nicht untereinander auslosen

ZUSAMMEN ODER JEDE:R FÜR SICH
• Alle an einem Gerät: aufdecken, verdecken, weitergeben
• Per Einladungslink: Jede:r macht mit dem eigenen iPhone, iPad oder Mac mit – ohne Konto, ohne Registrierung
• Die Zuteilung wird auf dem Gerät verschlüsselt. Niemand sonst kann sie lesen – auch nicht der Entwickler
• Oder per E-Mail und als druckbare Karten (PDF)

FÜR DIE FIRMENFEIER
• Namen aus einer Liste oder Tabelle einfügen
• Teams berücksichtigen
• Karten für alle auf einen Schlag

LIEBEVOLL GEMACHT
• Illustrationen für jeden Anlass, Avatare und Konfetti
• Ein Geschenk, das man gedrückt hält, bis es aufspringt
• Hell und dunkel, iPhone, iPad und Mac

DEINE DATEN BLEIBEN BEI DIR
Kein Konto, keine Werbung, kein Tracking, kein fremder Server. Runden liegen auf deinen Geräten und in deinem iCloud.

UNTERSTÜTZUNG
Die App ist kostenlos. Wer mag, gibt Zaubi ein Plätzchen aus – freigeschaltet wird dadurch nichts.

name: Wifi Strength
description:
Find where your Wi-Fi connection works best as you move around your home.

Wifi Strength checks connection time and failed attempts every two seconds. Watch the color chart change live, then save a test to review its results later.

• Test a public target such as Cloudflare or Google, or enter your own host and port.
• See recent connection times, average time, and success rate.
• View live estimates for streaming, gaming, and social media.
• Compare saved tests and inspect each recorded attempt.
• See your local Wi-Fi IP address and public IP address.

The activity indicators are estimates based on recent connection attempts. The app does not measure raw Wi-Fi radio signal, download speed, or streaming bandwidth. Public targets reflect the route to the internet; for a local test, use a reachable device on your network with an open port.

No account or subscription is required. Test history stays on your device.

name: WildHarvestSharing
description:
A shared equipment management application designed for communities, teams and outdoor enthusiasts, helping users easily manage their unused camping supplies and achieving integrated management of equipment registration, borrowing tracking, return inspection and usage statistics.

By creating an exclusive shared station, users can upload information about the storage area of their equipment and establish their own outdoor equipment sharing space. It supports various equipment categories such as tents, sleeping bags, tables and chairs, canopies, stoves, etc., for classification management, and records each borrowing and return process in real time.

The application provides complete equipment circulation records, status checks, loss feedback and data statistics functions, making shared equipment management more transparent and efficient, reducing resource waste, and allowing more people to easily enjoy outdoor life.

name: Winlog
description:
Winlog is a work wins log for people who want their next performance review, promotion case or job interview to be easy. Every win you log becomes a floor on your own tower, so you can watch your year stack up instead of forgetting it by December.

LOG A WIN IN SECONDS
Write what you did, the impact, a headline number (like +18% repeat orders) and how many people it helped. Tag the project and the skills it showed, set the date, and link it to a goal if it moves one forward. Edit or delete anything later.

KEEP THE GOOD WORDS
Kind messages vanish from chat in a week. Save feedback quotes word for word with who said it, how you know them (manager, peer, client and more) and when. Mark each one as praise or a growth note and filter between them.

GOALS WITH THEIR OWN TOWERS
Write down what you are working toward, add a target date, and link wins to it. Each goal grows its own tower of linked wins, shows how many people you helped along the way, and can be marked as reached.

BUILD THE CASE FOR YOUR REVIEW
Pick a window: last 30 days, this quarter, last quarter, last 6 months, this year or any custom range. Winlog shows the tower for that period and writes a clean plain-text summary: wins grouped by project, numbers, skills shown, goal progress and feedback quotes. Copy it or share it straight into your review document.

A FRIDAY NUDGE
Turn on the optional weekly Friday reminder and pick the hour. Winlog only asks for notification permission when you switch it on.

RIDE THE ELEVATOR
The app is a small building. An elevator panel on the right edge takes you between four floors: Lobby, Feedback, Goals and Review. The floor indicator counts as you ride.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CHOICE
Sign in with Apple, Google or email, or tap "Skip the sign-in" and start right away as a guest. Guests can link an account later from the Front Desk and keep every floor they built. Your data syncs through Google Firebase, keeps working offline, and is readable only by your account.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads. No tracking. No analytics. You can delete your account and everything in it at any time from Front Desk, Delete account.

name: WiseCost
description:
WiseCost puts your time tracking in your pocket. Log hours as you work, keep your timesheet up to date, request time off and, if you supervise a team, review what comes in, all from your phone.

LOG YOUR TIME
• Start a timer, or add hours by hand with a quick keypad
• Choose the contract, the item and a short description for each entry
• Work offline: entries are kept on your phone and sent when you are back online

YOUR TIMESHEET
• See the whole pay period in a grid, by contract and by day
• Swipe between periods
• Submit it for approval, and resubmit it if your supervisor sends it back with a comment

TIME OFF
• Request full or partial days, follow the status of each request and cancel when plans change
• See company holidays and add your own
• When a request is declined, the reason is shown with it

REPORTS
• See your hours by period and how they split across contracts, time off and internal accounts

FOR SUPERVISORS
• Review your team's timesheets and time off requests, and approve or reject them with a comment
• Enter hours or time off on behalf of someone on your team

MORE
• Work with several companies and switch between them from the top bar
• In-app notifications for what needs your attention
• Change your profile photo and your password

WiseCost mobile is for people whose company uses WiseCost. You sign in with the account your company created for you; accounts can't be created in the app.

name: WiTalk: Team & Work Chat
description:
WiTalk is a work chat app for companies that run their own WiTalk server. Accounts, conversations, photos and files are stored on your company's server, not on ours.

FOR EMPLOYEES
- Direct chats and work groups
- Send photos, videos, documents, voice notes and your current location
- Voice and video calls, one-to-one or in groups
- Reply, forward, pin and star messages
- Sent, delivered and read receipts
- Read your chats even when you lose signal
- Lock the app with Face ID or your iPhone passcode
- Link WiTalk Web on your computer by scanning a QR code

FOR COMPANIES
- Your data stays on your own server
- Admins create accounts and invite links, or use company sign-in (OIDC)
- Reporting and blocking to keep conversations healthy

HOW TO USE
WiTalk can only be used by employees of a registered company. Ask your company admin for the server address or an invite link, enter the address in the app, then sign in.

Your company doesn't use WiTalk yet? Sign up at https://talk.wiracode.com

Wofo Ink checks English text for AI sentence by sentence. Every sentence gets a 0–100% score showing how much of it AI changed, so you can see exactly where.

• 2× more accurate than GPTZero per sentence: average error of 10.4 points, vs 23.6 for Pangram and 29.9 for GPTZero.
• 99.63% official score on RAID, the world's largest public AI-detection leaderboard, ahead of Grammarly, GPTZero and QuillBot.
• Works with PDF, DOCX, TXT and web pages, and checks many files at once.
• About ⅓ the price of GPTZero.

Monthly and yearly passes are auto-renewing subscriptions. Cancel anytime in Settings.
